```typescript
import { withExtra, type Exists, type FactDelta, type ImportEdge } from './facts';
import { isRelative, normalizePath, resolveImport, resolvePath } from './imports';
import { createMapper, type Mapper } from './mapper';
import { check, type Violation } from './rules';
import type { DomainMap } from './schema';

/** One step of a `submit_plan` call. Import `to` is a repo path (extension optional) or a specifier relative to `from`. */
export type PlanStep = { n: number; text: string; files: string[]; imports: { from: string; to: string }[] };

export type PlanFootprint = {
  cells: { domain: string; layer: string; steps: number[]; files: string[] }[];
  tests: { domain: string; files: string[] }[];
  unassigned: string[];
  edges: { from: string; to: string; steps: number[]; imports: ImportEdge[] }[];
  delta: FactDelta;
  violations: Violation[];
};

/** Ghost footprint of a plan: the cells and tests it touches, its new cross-domain edges, and the violations its imports would cause. */
export function planFootprint(map: DomainMap, steps: PlanStep[], exists: Exists, mapper: Mapper = createMapper(map)): PlanFootprint {
  const norm = (p: string) => normalizePath(p) ?? p;
  const planned = withExtra(exists, steps.flatMap((s) => s.files));

  const cells = new Map<string, { domain: string; layer: string; steps: Set<number>; files: Set<string> }>();
  const tests = new Map<string, Set<string>>();
  const unassigned = new Set<string>();
  const edges = new Map<string, { from: string; to: string; steps: Set<number>; imports: ImportEdge[] }>();
  const imports: ImportEdge[] = [];
  const seen = new Set<string>();

  for (const step of steps) {
    const stepImports = step.imports.map((imp) => {
      const from = norm(imp.from);
      const to = (isRelative(imp.to) ? resolveImport(from, imp.to, planned) : resolvePath(imp.to, planned)) ?? norm(imp.to);
      return { from, to };
    });
    // A file that gains an import is edited by the step even if the step didn't list it.
    for (const file of new Set([...step.files.map(norm), ...stepImports.map((i) => i.from)])) {
      const p = mapper.place(file);
      if (p.kind === 'cell') {
        const key = `${p.domain}\u0000${p.layer}`;
        let cell = cells.get(key);
        if (!cell) cells.set(key, (cell = { domain: p.domain, layer: p.layer, steps: new Set(), files: new Set() }));
        cell.steps.add(step.n);
        cell.files.add(file);
      } else if (p.kind === 'test') {
        tests.set(p.domain, (tests.get(p.domain) ?? new Set()).add(file));
      } else if (p.kind === 'unassigned') unassigned.add(file);
    }
    for (const imp of stepImports) {
      const k = `${imp.from}\u0000${imp.to}`;
      if (!seen.has(k)) {
        seen.add(k);
        imports.push(imp);
      }
      const a = mapper.place(imp.from);
      const b = mapper.place(imp.to);
      if (a.kind !== 'cell' || b.kind !== 'cell' || a.domain === b.domain) continue;
      const key = `${a.domain}\u0000${b.domain}`;
      let edge = edges.get(key);
      if (!edge) edges.set(key, (edge = { from: a.domain, to: b.domain, steps: new Set(), imports: [] }));
      edge.steps.add(step.n);
      if (!edge.imports.some((i) => i.from === imp.from && i.to === imp.to)) edge.imports.push(imp);
    }
  }

  const domainIdx = (id: string) => map.domains.findIndex((d) => d.id === id);
  const layerIdx = (id: string) => map.layers.findIndex((l) => l.id === id);
  const sorted = (s: Set<number>) => [...s].sort((a, b) => a - b);
  const delta: FactDelta = { imports, writes: [] };

  return {
    cells: [...cells.values()]
      .sort((a, b) => domainIdx(a.domain) - domainIdx(b.domain) || layerIdx(a.layer) - layerIdx(b.layer))
      .map((c) => ({ domain: c.domain, layer: c.layer, steps: sorted(c.steps), files: [...c.files] })),
    tests: [...tests].sort(([a], [b]) => domainIdx(a) - domainIdx(b)).map(([domain, files]) => ({ domain, files: [...files] })),
    unassigned: [...unassigned],
    edges: [...edges.values()].map((e) => ({ from: e.from, to: e.to, steps: sorted(e.steps), imports: e.imports })),
    delta,
    violations: check(map, delta, mapper),
  };
}
```

```markdown
# Step 0: verification results

SDK `@anthropic-ai/claude-agent-sdk@0.3.296`, Claude Code login (no API key; `apiKeySource: none`), model `claude-opus-5-5`. Script: `apps/server/src/verify.ts` (`npm run verify -w @harness/server -- a|d|d2`). Run 2026-10-11.

| Check | Result | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- |
| (a) custom MCP tool callable in plan mode | **Pass** | `mcp__harness__submit_plan` ran with `permission_mode: plan`. In plan mode the call still goes to `canUseTool` even though it is in `allowedTools`, so `canUseTool` must allow `mcp__harness__*`. Without `alwaysLoad: true` on the tool, Claude has to `ToolSearch` for it first. |
| (b) `canUseTool` receives `ExitPlanMode` | **Pass** | Allowing it and calling `q.setPermissionMode('acceptEdits')` lets the build proceed. No fallback needed. |
| (c) after a hook deny with "ask the user", Claude asks | **Pass** | Deny reason naming A/B and "do not try another route" → Claude stopped, asked A/B in one message, made zero further tool calls. Twice in a row. |
| (d) Alike MCP available in an SDK session | **Pending** | The server loads from user config, but reports `needs-auth` inside SDK sessions. Needs `/mcp` → alike → sign in once, then re-run `-- d2`. |

## Things the build must handle

1. **Plan files live outside the repo.** In plan mode Claude writes its plan to `~/.claude/plans/<name>.md` with `Write`. The edit gate and footprint must ignore any path outside the target repo.
2. **Paths come back realpath'd.** On macOS the SDK reports `/private/var/...` for a cwd under `/var/...`. Normalize hook paths with `realpath` before making them repo-relative.
3. **`AskUserQuestion`.** After a deny, Claude prefers the `AskUserQuestion` tool, which arrives at `canUseTool`. Harness passes `disallowedTools: ['AskUserQuestion']`, so the question comes as chat text, which is where the fork UI lives.
4. **Alike's user-level hooks.** With default `settingSources`, the hooks `@alikeai/setup` put in `~/.claude/settings.json` fire inside Harness sessions (SessionStart, UserPromptSubmit, PreToolUse, PostToolUse, PostToolBatch, Stop). That's a network call in the hot path. Harness uses `settingSources: ['project', 'local']`, which drops them, along with user-scope MCP servers. Alike is then passed explicitly as `mcpServers.alike = { type: 'http', url }`. Whether that copy can reuse the stored OAuth token is part of (d).
5. **`planModeInstructions` exists** (`Options.planModeInstructions`), replacing the default plan-mode workflow body. Harness uses it for the submit_plan rules instead of only the appended system prompt.
```

```typescript
import YAML, { isMap, isSeq, type YAMLMap } from 'yaml';
import type { DomainMap } from './schema';

function editInvariant(yamlText: string, invariantId: string, edit: (doc: YAML.Document, inv: YAMLMap) => void): string {
  const doc = YAML.parseDocument(yamlText);
  const list = doc.get('invariants');
  const inv = isSeq(list) ? list.items.find((item) => isMap(item) && item.get('id') === invariantId) : undefined;
  if (!isMap(inv)) throw new Error(`domains.yaml has no invariant ${invariantId}`);
  edit(doc, inv);
  return doc.toString();
}

function append(doc: YAML.Document, inv: YAMLMap, key: string, value: unknown, flow: boolean) {
  const seq = inv.get(key);
  if (isSeq(seq)) {
    if (seq.items.length === 0) seq.flow = flow;
    seq.add(doc.createNode(value, { flow: true }));
  } else {
    const node = doc.createNode([value], { flow: true });
    node.flow = flow;
    inv.set(key, node);
  }
}

/** Link decision `decisionId` to an invariant (the user chose to comply). Comments and layout are preserved. */
export function linkDecision(yamlText: string, invariantId: string, decisionId: string): string {
  return editInvariant(yamlText, invariantId, (doc, inv) => append(doc, inv, 'decisions', decisionId, true));
}

/** Add `{ path, decision }` to an invariant's exceptions (the user chose the exception). Comments and layout are preserved. */
export function addException(yamlText: string, invariantId: string, path: string, decisionId: string): string {
  return editInvariant(yamlText, invariantId, (doc, inv) => append(doc, inv, 'exceptions', { path, decision: decisionId }, false));
}

/** Next free `DR-n`, above every id used by invariants, their decisions and exceptions, and `existingIds`. */
export function nextDecisionId(map: DomainMap, existingIds: string[]): string {
  const ids = [
    ...existingIds,
    ...map.invariants.flatMap((inv) => [inv.id, ...(inv.decisions ?? []), ...inv.exceptions.flatMap((e) => (e.decision ? [e.decision] : []))]),
  ];
  const max = Math.max(0, ...ids.map((id) => Number(/^DR-(\d+)$/.exec(id)?.[1] ?? 0)));
  return `DR-${max + 1}`;
}

```

```typescript
import { readFileSync } from "node:fs";
import { recordCall } from "../_calllog";
import { slugify } from "../../src/shared/ids";

/** Offline web search. Results come from fixtures/search.json, keyed by company. */

export interface SearchResult {
  title: string;
  url: string;
  snippet: string;
  rank: number;
}

export interface SearchOptions {
  limit?: number;
}

type FixtureResult = Omit<SearchResult, "rank">;

let fixtures: Record<string, FixtureResult[]> | null = null;

function load(): Record<string, FixtureResult[]> {
  fixtures ??= JSON.parse(readFileSync(new URL("../../fixtures/search.json", import.meta.url), "utf8")) as Record<
    string,
    FixtureResult[]
  >;
  return fixtures;
}

function keyFor(query: string, keys: string[]): string | undefined {
  const slug = slugify(query);
  return keys.find((k) => k !== "_default" && (slug === k || slug.startsWith(`${k}-`) || slug.includes(`-${k}-`)));
}

export async function search(query: string, options: SearchOptions = {}): Promise<SearchResult[]> {
  const limit = Math.max(1, Math.min(options.limit ?? 5, 10));
  recordCall("search", "search", { query, limit });
  if (!query.trim()) return [];

  const data = load();
  const key = keyFor(query, Object.keys(data));
  const subject = query.split(/\s+/).slice(0, 2).join(" ");
  const results = key
    ? (data[key] ?? [])
    : (data._default ?? []).map((r) => ({
        title: r.title.replaceAll("{query}", subject),
        url: r.url.replaceAll("{slug}", slugify(subject)),
        snippet: r.snippet.replaceAll("{query}", subject),
      }));
  return results.slice(0, limit).map((r, i) => ({ ...r, rank: i + 1 }));
}
```

```typescript
import { readFileSync } from "node:fs";
import { recordCall } from "../_calllog";
import { slugify } from "../../src/shared/ids";

/**
 * Offline news API: recent headlines per company, plus the latest earnings
 * call transcript. Fixtures live in fixtures/news.json.
 */

export interface Headline {
  title: string;
  source: string;
  url: string;
  publishedAt: string;
  summary: string;
}

export interface Transcript {
  company: string;
  quarter: string;
  heldOn: string;
  participants: string[];
  text: string;
}

interface CompanyNews {
  name: string;
  headlines: Headline[];
  transcript: Omit<Transcript, "company">;
}

let fixtures: Record<string, CompanyNews> | null = null;

function load(): Record<string, CompanyNews> {
  fixtures ??= JSON.parse(readFileSync(new URL("../../fixtures/news.json", import.meta.url), "utf8")) as Record<
    string,
    CompanyNews
  >;
  return fixtures;
}

function lookup(company: string): { entry: CompanyNews; generic: boolean } {
  const data = load();
  const slug = slugify(company);
  const key = Object.keys(data).find((k) => k !== "_default" && (slug === k || slug.startsWith(`${k}-`)));
  const entry = key ? data[key] : data._default;
  if (!entry) throw new Error("news fixtures are missing a _default entry");
  return { entry, generic: !key };
}

function fill(text: string, company: string): string {
  return text.replaceAll("{company}", company);
}

export async function latestHeadlines(company: string, options: { limit?: number } = {}): Promise<Headline[]> {
  const limit = options.limit ?? 5;
  recordCall("news", "headlines", { company, limit });
  const { entry, generic } = lookup(company);
  return [...entry.headlines]
    .sort((a, b) => b.publishedAt.localeCompare(a.publishedAt))
    .slice(0, limit)
    .map((h) =>
      generic
        ? { ...h, title: fill(h.title, company), summary: fill(h.summary, company), url: fill(h.url, slugify(company)) }
        : h,
    );
}

export async function earningsTranscript(company: string): Promise<Transcript | null> {
  recordCall("news", "transcripts.latest", { company });
  const { entry, generic } = lookup(company);
  if (generic) return null;
  return { company: entry.name, ...entry.transcript };
}
```

```typescript
import { existsSync, readFileSync } from "node:fs";
import { recordCall } from "../_calllog";
import { slugify } from "../../src/shared/ids";

/**
 * Offline SEC EDGAR. Each company has a fixture file under fixtures/sec-edgar/
 * with its recent 10-K and 10-Q, split into the usual sections.
 */

export type FormType = "10-K" | "10-Q";

export interface FilingSections {
  business?: string;
  mdna: string;
  financials: string;
  risks?: string;
}

export interface Filing {
  company: string;
  cik: string;
  form: FormType;
  period: string;
  filedAt: string;
  accession: string;
  sections: FilingSections;
}

export interface FilingSummary {
  form: FormType;
  period: string;
  filedAt: string;
  accession: string;
}

interface CompanyFilings {
  name: string;
  cik: string;
  filings: Array<Omit<Filing, "company" | "cik">>;
}

const cache = new Map<string, CompanyFilings | null>();

function load(company: string): CompanyFilings | null {
  const slug = slugify(company).split("-")[0] ?? "";
  if (!cache.has(slug)) {
    const url = new URL(`../../fixtures/sec-edgar/${slug}.json`, import.meta.url);
    cache.set(slug, slug && existsSync(url) ? (JSON.parse(readFileSync(url, "utf8")) as CompanyFilings) : null);
  }
  return cache.get(slug) ?? null;
}

export async function listFilings(company: string): Promise<FilingSummary[]> {
  recordCall("sec-edgar", "filings.list", { company });
  const data = load(company);
  if (!data) return [];
  return data.filings
    .map(({ form, period, filedAt, accession }) => ({ form, period, filedAt, accession }))
    .sort((a, b) => b.filedAt.localeCompare(a.filedAt));
}

/** Most recent filing of the given form, or null if the company has none on file. */
export async function latestFiling(company: string, form: FormType): Promise<Filing | null> {
  recordCall("sec-edgar", "filings.latest", { company, form });
  const data = load(company);
  if (!data) return null;
  const match = data.filings.filter((f) => f.form === form).sort((a, b) => b.filedAt.localeCompare(a.filedAt))[0];
  return match ? { company: data.name, cik: data.cik, ...match } : null;
}

/** The filing as one text document, sections in the order they appear in the form. */
export function filingText(filing: Filing): string {
  const { business, mdna, financials, risks } = filing.sections;
  return [
    business && `Item 1. Business\n${business}`,
    risks && `Item 1A. Risk Factors\n${risks}`,
    `Management's Discussion and Analysis\n${mdna}`,
    `Financial Statements\n${financials}`,
  ]
    .filter(Boolean)
    .join("\n\n");
}
```

```typescript
import { readFileSync } from "node:fs";
import { recordCall } from "../_calllog";
import { slugify } from "../../src/shared/ids";

/** Offline company and person enrichment (Clearbit-style). Fixtures in fixtures/enrichment.json. */

export interface CompanyProfile {
  name: string;
  domain: string;
  industry: string;
  employees: number;
  revenue: string;
  founded: number;
  headquarters: string;
  description: string;
  tech: string[];
}

export interface PersonProfile {
  email: string;
  name: string | null;
  title: string | null;
  seniority: "executive" | "director" | "manager" | "individual" | null;
  linkedin: string | null;
  company: string | null;
}

interface Fixtures {
  companies: Record<string, CompanyProfile>;
  people: Record<string, Omit<PersonProfile, "email">>;
}

let fixtures: Fixtures | null = null;

function load(): Fixtures {
  fixtures ??= JSON.parse(readFileSync(new URL("../../fixtures/enrichment.json", import.meta.url), "utf8")) as Fixtures;
  return fixtures;
}

export async function enrichCompany(nameOrDomain: string): Promise<CompanyProfile | null> {
  recordCall("enrichment", "companies.find", { query: nameOrDomain });
  const { companies } = load();
  const query = nameOrDomain.toLowerCase().trim();
  const slug = slugify(nameOrDomain);
  const hit = Object.entries(companies).find(
    ([key, c]) => c.domain === query || slug === key || slug.startsWith(`${key}-`) || slugify(c.name) === slug,
  );
  return hit ? hit[1] : null;
}

export async function enrichPerson(email: string): Promise<PersonProfile> {
  recordCall("enrichment", "people.find", { email });
  const { people, companies } = load();
  const normalized = email.toLowerCase().trim();
  const known = people[normalized];
  if (known) return { email: normalized, ...known };

  const domain = normalized.split("@")[1] ?? "";
  const company = Object.values(companies).find((c) => c.domain === domain);
  return { email: normalized, name: null, title: null, seniority: null, linkedin: null, company: company?.name ?? null };
}
```

```typescript
import { recordCall } from "../_calllog";

/**
 * Offline HubSpot-style CRM. Contacts are keyed by email; properties use
 * HubSpot's lowercase names. State lives in memory for the life of the process.
 */

export interface CrmContactProperties {
  email: string;
  firstname?: string;
  lastname?: string;
  phone?: string;
  jobtitle?: string;
  company?: string;
  lifecyclestage?: "lead" | "marketingqualifiedlead" | "salesqualifiedlead" | "opportunity" | "customer";
}

export interface CrmContact {
  id: string;
  properties: CrmContactProperties;
  createdAt: string;
  updatedAt: string;
}

export interface CrmEngagement {
  id: string;
  contactId: string;
  type: "EMAIL" | "NOTE" | "CALL";
  body: string;
  timestamp: string;
}

export class CrmError extends Error {
  constructor(
    readonly status: number,
    message: string,
  ) {
    super(message);
    this.name = "CrmError";
  }
}

const contacts = new Map<string, CrmContact>();
const engagements: CrmEngagement[] = [];
let nextContact = 1000;
let nextEngagement = 1;

export async function upsertContact(properties: CrmContactProperties): Promise<{ contact: CrmContact; created: boolean }> {
  recordCall("crm", "contacts.upsert", properties);
  const email = properties.email?.toLowerCase().trim();
  if (!email || !email.includes("@")) throw new CrmError(400, "Property values were not valid: email");

  const now = new Date().toISOString();
  const existing = contacts.get(email);
  if (existing) {
    const updated: CrmContact = {
      ...existing,
      properties: { ...existing.properties, ...stripEmpty(properties), email },
      updatedAt: now,
    };
    contacts.set(email, updated);
    return { contact: structuredClone(updated), created: false };
  }

  const contact: CrmContact = {
    id: String(++nextContact),
    properties: { lifecyclestage: "lead", ...stripEmpty(properties), email },
    createdAt: now,
    updatedAt: now,
  };
  contacts.set(email, contact);
  return { contact: structuredClone(contact), created: true };
}

export async function getContactByEmail(email: string): Promise<CrmContact | null> {
  recordCall("crm", "contacts.get", { email });
  const contact = contacts.get(email.toLowerCase().trim());
  return contact ? structuredClone(contact) : null;
}

export async function logEngagement(
  contactId: string,
  engagement: { type: CrmEngagement["type"]; body: string },
): Promise<CrmEngagement> {
  recordCall("crm", "engagements.create", { contactId, ...engagement });
  if (![...contacts.values()].some((c) => c.id === contactId)) throw new CrmError(404, `contact ${contactId} not found`);
  const entry: CrmEngagement = {
    id: `eng_${nextEngagement++}`,
    contactId,
    ...engagement,
    timestamp: new Date().toISOString(),
  };
  engagements.push(entry);
  return structuredClone(entry);
}

export function engagementsFor(contactId: string): CrmEngagement[] {
  return engagements.filter((e) => e.contactId === contactId).map((e) => structuredClone(e));
}

export function resetCrm(): void {
  contacts.clear();
  engagements.length = 0;
  nextContact = 1000;
  nextEngagement = 1;
}

function stripEmpty(properties: CrmContactProperties): Partial<CrmContactProperties> {
  return Object.fromEntries(Object.entries(properties).filter(([, v]) => v !== undefined && v !== "")) as Partial<
    CrmContactProperties
  >;
}

```

```bash
  logCost(req.purpose, text.length / 4);
  return provider()(text);
}
```

```typescript
import { recordCall } from "../_calllog";

/** Offline SendGrid-style mail API. Accepted messages are kept in an outbox. */

export interface MailMessage {
  to: string;
  from: { email: string; name?: string };
  subject: string;
  text: string;
  categories?: string[];
}

export interface SendResult {
  messageId: string;
  status: "queued";
}

export interface OutboxEntry extends MailMessage {
  messageId: string;
  acceptedAt: string;
}

export class MailError extends Error {
  constructor(
    readonly status: number,
    message: string,
  ) {
    super(message);
    this.name = "MailError";
  }
}

const outbox: OutboxEntry[] = [];
let counter = 0;

const ADDRESS = /^[^\s@]+@[^\s@]+\.[^\s@]+$/;

export async function send(message: MailMessage): Promise<SendResult> {
  recordCall("email", "mail.send", message);
  if (!ADDRESS.test(message.to)) throw new MailError(400, `invalid recipient: ${message.to}`);
  if (!ADDRESS.test(message.from.email)) throw new MailError(400, `invalid sender: ${message.from.email}`);
  if (!message.subject.trim()) throw new MailError(400, "subject is required");
  if (!message.text.trim()) throw new MailError(400, "content is required");

  const messageId = `sg_${String(++counter).padStart(6, "0")}`;
  outbox.push({ ...structuredClone(message), messageId, acceptedAt: new Date().toISOString() });
  return { messageId, status: "queued" };
}

export function sentMessages(): OutboxEntry[] {
  return outbox.map((m) => structuredClone(m));
}

export function resetOutbox(): void {
  outbox.length = 0;
  counter = 0;
}
```

```typescript
import type { DomainMap } from './schema';
import type { Placement } from './mapper';
import type { ImportEdge, WriteFact, DomainEdge } from './facts';
import type { Violation } from './rules';
import type { PlanStep } from './plan';

export type Cell = { domain: string; layer: string };

export type EventKind =
  | 'repo_scanned' | 'map_proposed' | 'map_confirmed' | 'file_assigned'
  | 'violation_found'
  | 'turn_started' | 'looked' | 'cursor'
  | 'planned' | 'plan_violation' | 'fork_asked' | 'fork_answered' | 'plan_approved'
  | 'gate_blocked' | 'edited' | 'edge_added' | 'edge_removed'
  | 'test_result' | 'decision_recorded' | 'turn_ended'
  // Additions to SPEC §5 so the chat pane and approval button are also reductions of the log.
  | 'chat' | 'approval_requested' | 'error';

export type HarnessEvent = {
  id: string;
  t: number;
  session: string;
  turn: string | null;
  kind: EventKind;
  cell?: Cell;
  path?: string;
  data?: Record<string, unknown>;
};

/** Typed payloads, by kind. The server builds events with `ev()`; the reducer reads them back. */
export type EventData = {
  repo_scanned: { files: { path: string; placement: Placement }[]; imports: ImportEdge[]; writes: WriteFact[]; edges: DomainEdge[] };
  map_proposed: { map: DomainMap; yaml: string };
  map_confirmed: { map: DomainMap; source: 'file' | 'cartographer' | 'fixture' };
  file_assigned: { placement: Placement };
  violation_found: { violations: Violation[] }; // the full current set (replaces)
  turn_started: { prompt: string; head: string; baseline: string };
  looked: { tool: string };
  cursor: { verb: 'reading' | 'searching' | 'editing' };
  planned: {
    steps: PlanStep[];
    cells: { domain: string; layer: string; steps: number[]; files: string[] }[];
    edges: { from: string; to: string; steps: number[]; imports: ImportEdge[] }[];
    unassigned: string[];
  };
  plan_violation: { violation: Violation };
  fork_asked: { violations: Violation[]; text: string };
  fork_answered: { option: 'A' | 'B'; text: string; violations: Violation[] };
  plan_approved: Record<string, never>;
  gate_blocked: { violation: Violation; tool: string };
  edited: { added: number; removed: number; created: boolean; unattributed?: boolean; tool?: string };
  edge_added: { edge: ImportEdge; from: string; to: string };
  edge_removed: { edge: ImportEdge; from: string; to: string };
  test_result: { domain: string; passed: number; failed: number };
  decision_recorded: { id: string; title: string; invariant: string; option: 'A' | 'B'; paths: string[]; alike?: boolean };
  turn_ended: { added: number; removed: number; files: string[]; reason: string };
  chat: { role: 'user' | 'assistant' | 'system'; text: string };
  approval_requested: { plan: string };
  error: { message: string };
};

export const cellKey = (c: Cell) => `${c.domain}/${c.layer}`;
export const edgeKey = (from: string, to: string) => `${from}->${to}`;

export type PlannedCell = { cell: Cell; steps: number[]; files: string[] };
export type PlannedEdge = { from: string; to: string; steps: number[]; imports: ImportEdge[] };

export type TurnState = {
  id: string;
  prompt: string;
  startedAt: number;
  endedAt: number | null;
  steps: PlanStep[];
  planned: Record<string, PlannedCell>;
  plannedEdges: Record<string, PlannedEdge>;
  planViolations: Violation[];
  gateBlocks: Violation[];
  looked: Record<string, string[]>; // cellKey → paths
  edited: Record<string, { added: number; removed: number; files: string[]; created: string[]; unattributed: boolean }>;
  tests: Record<string, string[]>; // domain → test files edited
  unassigned: string[];
  edgesAdded: { from: string; to: string; edge: ImportEdge }[];
  edgesRemoved: { from: string; to: string; edge: ImportEdge }[];
  forks: { asked: number; answered: number | null; option: 'A' | 'B' | null; violations: Violation[]; beforeCode: boolean }[];
  decisions: string[];
  approved: boolean;
  firstEditAt: number | null; // event index of first `edited`
  numstat: { added: number; removed: number } | null;
};

export type DomainEdgeState = { from: string; to: string; files: ImportEdge[] };

export type Decision = EventData['decision_recorded'] & { turn: string | null; at: number };

export type UIState = {
  map: DomainMap | null;
  files: Record<string, Placement>;
  edges: Record<string, DomainEdgeState>;
  violations: Violation[];
  turns: TurnState[];
  current: string | null;
  cursor: { cell: Cell | null; path: string; verb: string } | null;
  chat: { role: 'user' | 'assistant' | 'system'; text: string; turn: string | null; t: number }[];
  awaitingApproval: { turn: string | null; plan: string } | null;
  pendingFork: { turn: string | null; violations: Violation[] } | null;
  decisions: Decision[];
  errors: string[];
  /** event index → provenance lookups */
  edgeOrigin: Record<string, { turn: string | null; at: number }[]>;
  cellOrigin: Record<string, { turn: string | null; at: number }[]>;
};

export function initialState(): UIState {
  return {
    map: null, files: {}, edges: {}, violations: [], turns: [], current: null, cursor: null, chat: [],
    awaitingApproval: null, pendingFork: null, decisions: [], errors: [], edgeOrigin: {}, cellOrigin: {},
  };
}

function newTurn(id: string, prompt: string, t: number): TurnState {
  return {
    id, prompt, startedAt: t, endedAt: null, steps: [], planned: {}, plannedEdges: {}, planViolations: [], gateBlocks: [],
    looked: {}, edited: {}, tests: {}, unassigned: [], edgesAdded: [], edgesRemoved: [], forks: [], decisions: [],
    approved: false, firstEditAt: null, numstat: null,
  };
}

const push = <T>(rec: Record<string, T[]>, k: string, v: T) => { (rec[k] ??= []).push(v); };

/** Fold one event into the state. Mutates and returns `s`; callers that need immutability use `reduce`. */
export function apply(s: UIState, e: HarnessEvent, index: number): UIState {
  const turn = e.turn ? s.turns.find((x) => x.id === e.turn) ?? null : null;
  const d = (e.data ?? {}) as never;

  switch (e.kind) {
    case 'map_confirmed':
    case 'map_proposed': {
      const { map } = d as EventData['map_confirmed'];
      s.map = map;
      break;
    }
    case 'repo_scanned': {
      const { files, edges } = d as EventData['repo_scanned'];
      s.files = {};
      for (const f of files) s.files[f.path] = f.placement;
      s.edges = {};
      for (const ed of edges) s.edges[edgeKey(ed.from, ed.to)] = { from: ed.from, to: ed.to, files: [...ed.files] };
      break;
    }
    case 'file_assigned': {
      if (e.path) s.files[e.path] = (d as EventData['file_assigned']).placement;
      break;
    }
    case 'violation_found':
      s.violations = (d as EventData['violation_found']).violations;
      break;
    case 'turn_started': {
      const t = newTurn(e.turn ?? e.id, (d as EventData['turn_started']).prompt, e.t);
      s.turns.push(t);
      s.current = t.id;
      s.cursor = null;
      break;
    }
    case 'chat': {
      const { role, text } = d as EventData['chat'];
      s.chat.push({ role, text, turn: e.turn, t: e.t });
      break;
    }
    case 'looked':
    case 'cursor': {
      if (e.path) s.cursor = { cell: e.cell ?? null, path: e.path, verb: e.kind === 'cursor' ? (d as EventData['cursor']).verb : 'reading' };
      if (e.kind === 'looked' && turn && e.cell && e.path) {
        const k = cellKey(e.cell);
        const list = (turn.looked[k] ??= []);
        if (!list.includes(e.path)) list.push(e.path);
      }
      break;
    }
    case 'planned': {
      if (!turn) break;
      const p = d as EventData['planned'];
      turn.steps = p.steps;
      turn.planned = {};
      for (const c of p.cells) turn.planned[cellKey(c)] = { cell: { domain: c.domain, layer: c.layer }, steps: c.steps, files: c.files };
      turn.plannedEdges = {};
      for (const ed of p.edges) turn.plannedEdges[edgeKey(ed.from, ed.to)] = ed;
      turn.unassigned = p.unassigned;
      turn.planViolations = []; // a resubmitted plan replaces the previous one's violations
      break;
    }
    case 'plan_violation':
      turn?.planViolations.push((d as EventData['plan_violation']).violation);
      break;
    case 'gate_blocked':
      turn?.gateBlocks.push((d as EventData['gate_blocked']).violation);
      break;
    case 'fork_asked': {
      const { violations } = d as EventData['fork_asked'];
      s.pendingFork = { turn: e.turn, violations };
      turn?.forks.push({ asked: index, answered: null, option: null, violations, beforeCode: turn.firstEditAt === null });
      break;
    }
    case 'fork_answered': {
      const { option } = d as EventData['fork_answered'];
      s.pendingFork = null;
      const f = turn?.forks.findLast((x) => x.answered === null);
      if (f) { f.answered = index; f.option = option; f.beforeCode = f.beforeCode && turn!.firstEditAt === null; }
      break;
    }
    case 'approval_requested':
      s.awaitingApproval = { turn: e.turn, plan: (d as EventData['approval_requested']).plan };
      break;
    case 'plan_approved':
      s.awaitingApproval = null;
      if (turn) turn.approved = true;
      break;
    case 'edited': {
      const ed = d as EventData['edited'];
      if (s.cursor && e.path && !ed.unattributed) s.cursor = { cell: e.cell ?? null, path: e.path, verb: 'editing' };
      if (!turn || !e.path) break;
      if (turn.firstEditAt === null) turn.firstEditAt = index;
      const placement = s.files[e.path];
      if (placement?.kind === 'test') { push(turn.tests, placement.domain, e.path); break; }
      if (!e.cell) { if (!turn.unassigned.includes(e.path)) turn.unassigned.push(e.path); break; }
      const k = cellKey(e.cell);
      const c = (turn.edited[k] ??= { added: 0, removed: 0, files: [], created: [], unattributed: false });
      c.added += ed.added;
      c.removed += ed.removed;
      if (!c.files.includes(e.path)) c.files.push(e.path);
      if (ed.created && !c.created.includes(e.path)) c.created.push(e.path);
      if (ed.unattributed) c.unattributed = true;
      push(s.cellOrigin, k, { turn: e.turn, at: index });
      break;
    }
    case 'edge_added': {
      const { edge, from, to } = d as EventData['edge_added'];
      const k = edgeKey(from, to);
      const cur = (s.edges[k] ??= { from, to, files: [] });
      if (!cur.files.some((f) => f.from === edge.from && f.to === edge.to)) cur.files.push(edge);
      push(s.edgeOrigin, k, { turn: e.turn, at: index });
      turn?.edgesAdded.push({ from, to, edge });
      break;
    }
    case 'edge_removed': {
      const { edge, from, to } = d as EventData['edge_removed'];
      const k = edgeKey(from, to);
      const cur = s.edges[k];
      if (cur) {
        cur.files = cur.files.filter((f) => !(f.from === edge.from && f.to === edge.to));
        if (!cur.files.length) delete s.edges[k];
      }
      turn?.edgesRemoved.push({ from, to, edge });
      break;
    }
    case 'decision_recorded': {
      const dec = d as EventData['decision_recorded'];
      const existing = s.decisions.find((x) => x.id === dec.id);
      if (existing) Object.assign(existing, dec); // the Alike confirmation re-emits with alike: true
      else s.decisions.push({ ...dec, turn: e.turn, at: index });
      if (turn && !turn.decisions.includes(dec.id)) turn.decisions.push(dec.id);
      break;
    }
    case 'turn_ended': {
      if (!turn) break;
      const { added, removed } = d as EventData['turn_ended'];
      turn.endedAt = e.t;
      turn.numstat = { added, removed };
      s.awaitingApproval = null;
      if (s.current === turn.id) s.cursor = null;
      break;
    }
    case 'error':
      s.errors.push((d as EventData['error']).message);
      break;
    case 'test_result':
      break;
  }
  return s;
}

/** UI state = reduce(events). Replay is `reduce(events, i)`: the state after the first `i` events. */
export function reduce(events: readonly HarnessEvent[], upTo = events.length): UIState {
  const s = initialState();
  const n = Math.min(upTo, events.length);
  for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) apply(s, events[i]!, i);
  return s;
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------- derived views

export type CellView = {
  cell: Cell;
  looked: boolean;
  edited: boolean;
  ghost: number[] | null; // planned step numbers while not yet edited
  unplanned: boolean; // amber: edited but not in this turn's plan
  violation: 'existing' | 'new' | null;
  violationFiles: string[];
  newViolationFiles: string[];
  added: number;
  removed: number;
};

/** Per-cell visual state for one turn (defaults to the latest), plus load-time violations. */
export function cellViews(s: UIState, turnId: string | null = s.turns.at(-1)?.id ?? null): Record<string, CellView> {
  const out: Record<string, CellView> = {};
  const map = s.map;
  if (!map) return out;
  const turn = turnId ? s.turns.find((t) => t.id === turnId) ?? null : null;
  const hasPlan = !!turn && Object.keys(turn.planned).length > 0;

  for (const dom of map.domains) {
    for (const layer of map.layers) {
      if (!(layer.id in dom.cells)) continue;
      const cell = { domain: dom.id, layer: layer.id };
      const k = cellKey(cell);
      const edited = turn?.edited[k];
      const planned = turn?.planned[k];
      out[k] = {
        cell,
        looked: !!turn?.looked[k]?.length,
        edited: !!edited,
        ghost: planned && !edited ? planned.steps : null,
        unplanned: hasPlan && !!edited && !planned,
        violation: null,
        violationFiles: [],
        newViolationFiles: [],
        added: edited?.added ?? 0,
        removed: edited?.removed ?? 0,
      };
    }
  }
  const mark = (file: string, isNew: boolean, planCell?: Cell) => {
    const p = s.files[file];
    const cell = p?.kind === 'cell' ? { domain: p.domain, layer: p.layer } : planCell;
    if (!cell) return;
    const v = out[cellKey(cell)];
    if (!v) return;
    if (isNew) {
      v.violation = 'new';
      if (!v.newViolationFiles.includes(file)) v.newViolationFiles.push(file);
    } else {
      v.violation ??= 'existing';
      if (!v.violationFiles.includes(file)) v.violationFiles.push(file);
    }
  };
  for (const v of s.violations) mark(v.file, false);
  if (turn) {
    const plannedCellOf = (file: string) => Object.values(turn.planned).find((c) => c.files.includes(file))?.cell;
    for (const v of [...turn.planViolations, ...turn.gateBlocks]) {
      if (s.violations.some((x) => x.file === v.file && x.invariant === v.invariant)) continue; // already on the map before this turn
      mark(v.file, true, plannedCellOf(v.file));
    }
  }
  return out;
}

export type EdgeView = {
  from: string;
  to: string;
  state: 'existing' | 'ghost' | 'new';
  violation: boolean;
  steps: number[];
  files: ImportEdge[];
};

/**
 * Edges for one turn. A planned edge always gets its own `ghost` entry, even when a solid edge between the same
 * domains exists, so a plan that repeats an existing violation still looks different from the map before the turn.
 */
export function edgeViews(s: UIState, turnId: string | null = s.turns.at(-1)?.id ?? null): EdgeView[] {
  const turn = turnId ? s.turns.find((t) => t.id === turnId) ?? null : null;
  const violating = (from: string, files: ImportEdge[], list: Violation[]) =>
    list.some((v) => files.some((f) => f.from === v.file && (!v.target || v.target === f.to)));
  const out: EdgeView[] = [];
  const addedThisTurn = new Set(turn?.edgesAdded.map((x) => edgeKey(x.from, x.to)) ?? []);
  for (const [k, e] of Object.entries(s.edges)) {
    out.push({ from: e.from, to: e.to, state: addedThisTurn.has(k) ? 'new' : 'existing', violation: violating(e.from, e.files, s.violations), steps: [], files: e.files });
  }
  if (turn) {
    for (const pe of Object.values(turn.plannedEdges)) {
      const built = pe.imports.every((imp) => s.edges[edgeKey(pe.from, pe.to)]?.files.some((f) => f.from === imp.from && f.to === imp.to));
      if (built) continue;
      out.push({ from: pe.from, to: pe.to, state: 'ghost', violation: violating(pe.from, pe.imports, turn.planViolations), steps: pe.steps, files: pe.imports });
    }
  }
  return out;
}

/** Decisions and turns behind an edge or a cell, for the inspector. */
export function provenance(s: UIState, target: { edge: string } | { cell: string }) {
  const origins = 'edge' in target ? s.edgeOrigin[target.edge] ?? [] : s.cellOrigin[target.cell] ?? [];
  const turnIds = [...new Set(origins.map((o) => o.turn).filter((x): x is string => !!x))];
  const turns = turnIds.map((id) => ({ id, index: s.turns.findIndex((t) => t.id === id) + 1, prompt: s.turns.find((t) => t.id === id)?.prompt ?? '' }));
  const decisions = s.decisions.filter((d) => d.turn && turnIds.includes(d.turn));
  return { turns, decisions };
}
```

```typescript
import { cellKey, type Cell, type TurnState, type UIState } from './events';
import type { Violation } from './rules';

export type Severity = 1 | 2 | 3 | 4;

export type Finding = {
  severity: Severity;
  kind: 'invariant' | 'new_edge' | 'new_external' | 'unplanned' | 'planned';
  cell: Cell | null;
  text: string;
  files: string[];
  invariant?: string;
};

export type TurnLedger = {
  turn: string;
  linesChanged: number | null; // null until turn_ended brings the git numstat
  cellsToReview: number;
  forksCaughtBeforeCode: number;
  rejectedOptionsBlocked: number;
  findings: Finding[];
};

export type Ledger = {
  turns: TurnLedger[];
  session: { linesChanged: number; cellsToReview: number; forksCaughtBeforeCode: number; rejectedOptionsBlocked: number };
};

const vkey = (v: Violation) => `${v.invariant}|${v.file}|${v.target ?? ''}`;

function cellOf(s: UIState, turn: TurnState, file: string): Cell | null {
  const p = s.files[file];
  if (p?.kind === 'cell') return { domain: p.domain, layer: p.layer };
  return Object.values(turn.planned).find((c) => c.files.includes(file))?.cell ?? null;
}

/** Severity-ranked findings for one turn (SPEC §9): 1 invariant hit · 2 new edge / new external · 3 unplanned · 4 planned. */
export function turnFindings(s: UIState, turn: TurnState): Finding[] {
  const out: Finding[] = [];
  const seen = new Set<string>();
  for (const v of [...turn.planViolations, ...turn.gateBlocks]) {
    if (seen.has(vkey(v))) continue;
    seen.add(vkey(v));
    out.push({ severity: 1, kind: 'invariant', cell: cellOf(s, turn, v.file), text: v.reason, files: [v.file], invariant: v.invariant });
  }
  const edges = new Map<string, { from: string; to: string; files: string[] }>();
  for (const e of turn.edgesAdded) {
    const k = `${e.from}->${e.to}`;
    const cur = edges.get(k) ?? { from: e.from, to: e.to, files: [] };
    if (!cur.files.includes(e.edge.from)) cur.files.push(e.edge.from);
    edges.set(k, cur);
  }
  for (const e of edges.values()) {
    const p = s.files[e.files[0]!];
    const cell = p?.kind === 'cell' ? { domain: p.domain, layer: p.layer } : null;
    out.push({ severity: 2, kind: 'new_edge', cell, text: `New dependency: ${name(s, e.from)} → ${name(s, e.to)}`, files: e.files });
  }
  const hasPlan = Object.keys(turn.planned).length > 0;
  for (const [k, c] of Object.entries(turn.edited)) {
    const [domain, layer] = k.split('/') as [string, string];
    const cell = { domain, layer };
    if (layer === 'external' && c.created.length) {
      out.push({ severity: 2, kind: 'new_external', cell, text: `New external service in ${name(s, domain)}`, files: c.created });
    }
    if (hasPlan && !turn.planned[k]) {
      out.push({ severity: 3, kind: 'unplanned', cell, text: `Edited ${name(s, domain)} · ${layer} without planning it`, files: c.files });
    } else {
      out.push({ severity: 4, kind: 'planned', cell, text: `${name(s, domain)} · ${layer}: ${c.files.length} file(s), +${c.added} −${c.removed}`, files: c.files });
    }
  }
  for (const file of turn.unassigned) {
    if (hasPlan && !Object.values(turn.planned).some((c) => c.files.includes(file))) {
      out.push({ severity: 3, kind: 'unplanned', cell: null, text: `Edited ${file}, which belongs to no domain`, files: [file] });
    }
  }
  return out.sort((a, b) => a.severity - b.severity);
}

function name(s: UIState, domain: string) {
  return s.map?.domains.find((d) => d.id === domain)?.name ?? domain;
}

export function turnLedger(s: UIState, turn: TurnState): TurnLedger {
  const findings = turnFindings(s, turn);
  const review = new Set(findings.filter((f) => f.severity <= 3).map((f) => (f.cell ? cellKey(f.cell) : `file:${f.files[0]}`)));
  // A fork counts once per distinct plan violation it resolved, if it was answered before any edit in the turn.
  let forks = 0;
  for (const f of turn.forks) {
    if (f.answered === null || !f.beforeCode) continue;
    forks += f.violations.filter((v) => turn.planViolations.some((p) => vkey(p) === vkey(v))).length;
  }
  const rejected = new Set([...turn.planViolations, ...turn.gateBlocks].filter((v) => v.decision).map(vkey)).size;
  return {
    turn: turn.id,
    linesChanged: turn.numstat ? turn.numstat.added + turn.numstat.removed : null,
    cellsToReview: review.size,
    forksCaughtBeforeCode: forks,
    rejectedOptionsBlocked: rejected,
    findings,
  };
}

export function ledger(s: UIState): Ledger {
  const turns = s.turns.map((t) => turnLedger(s, t));
  const sum = (f: (t: TurnLedger) => number) => turns.reduce((a, t) => a + f(t), 0);
  return {
    turns,
    session: {
      linesChanged: sum((t) => t.linesChanged ?? 0),
      cellsToReview: sum((t) => t.cellsToReview),
      forksCaughtBeforeCode: sum((t) => t.forksCaughtBeforeCode),
      rejectedOptionsBlocked: sum((t) => t.rejectedOptionsBlocked),
    },
  };
}
```

```bash
    expect(factsForSource('./src/tools/x.ts', `db.insert("runs", r);`, exists).writes).toEqual([{ file: 'src/tools/x.ts', table: 'runs' }]);
  });

  it('applyEdit replaces once or all, and throws when old_string is missing', () => {
    expect(applyEdit('a a', 'a', 'b')).toBe('b a');
    expect(applyEdit('a a', 'a', 'b', true)).toBe('b b');
    expect(applyEdit('a', 'a', '$&$&')).toBe('$&$&');
    expect(() => applyEdit('a', 'z', 'b')).toThrow(/not found/);
  });
});

describe('fileExistsIn / withExtra', () => {
  it('checks files only, and accepts planned files', () => {
    expect(exists('src/tools/index.ts')).toBe(true);
    expect(exists('src/tools')).toBe(false);
    expect(exists('src/tools/filing-summary.ts')).toBe(false);
    expect(withExtra(exists, ['./src/tools/filing-summary.ts'])('src/tools/filing-summary.ts')).toBe(true);
  });
});

import { describe, expect, it } from 'vitest';
import { linkDecision, addException } from '../src/mapedit';
import { check } from '../src/rules';
import { parseDomainMap } from '../src/schema';
import { loadMap, mapYaml } from './helpers';

const map = loadMap();
const imp = (from: string, to: string) => ({ imports: [{ from, to }], writes: [] });
const write = (file: string, table: string) => ({ imports: [], writes: [{ file, table }] });

describe('check', () => {
  it('only_via: fires outside allowed domains, including tests and unassigned files', () => {
    const [v] = check(map, imp('src/tools/news-summarize.ts', 'vendor/llm-openai/index.ts'));
    expect(v).toEqual({
      invariant: 'DR-1',
      kind: 'only_via',
      reason:
        'src/tools/news-summarize.ts imports vendor/llm-openai/index.ts, but DR-1: Model providers are only called through the model gateway.',
      file: 'src/tools/news-summarize.ts',
      detail: 'src/tools/news-summarize.ts → vendor/llm-openai/index.ts',
      options: [
        'Route it through the Model gateway (every model call, with redaction and cost logging) instead of importing vendor/llm-openai/index.ts directly',
        'Add an exception for src/tools/news-summarize.ts and record why',
      ],
      target: 'vendor/llm-openai/index.ts',
    });
    expect(check(map, imp('test/memory/a.test.ts', 'vendor/embeddings/index.ts'))).toHaveLength(1);
    expect(check(map, imp('src/billing/x.ts', 'vendor/llm-anthropic/index.ts'))).toHaveLength(1);
  });

  it('only_via: allowed domains, their tests, neutral and ignored files pass', () => {
    expect(check(map, imp('src/gateway/providers.ts', 'vendor/llm-openai/index.ts'))).toEqual([]);
    expect(check(map, imp('test/gateway/complete.test.ts', 'vendor/llm-openai/index.ts'))).toEqual([]);
    expect(check(map, imp('src/shared/util.ts', 'vendor/llm-openai/index.ts'))).toEqual([]);
    expect(check(map, imp('scripts/proof.ts', 'vendor/llm-openai/index.ts'))).toEqual([]);
    expect(check(map, imp('src/tools/x.ts', 'vendor/news/index.ts'))).toEqual([]);
  });

  it('owns_writes: fires for a non-owner', () => {
    const [v] = check(map, write('src/tools/x.ts', 'contacts'));
    expect(v).toMatchObject({ invariant: 'DR-2', kind: 'owns_writes', file: 'src/tools/x.ts', target: 'contacts' });
    expect(v!.options[0]).toBe('Ask the Outreach domain to write contacts (call its function) instead of writing it here');
    expect(v!.reason).toBe('src/tools/x.ts writes "contacts", but DR-2: Each table is written only by the domain that owns it.');
    expect(check(map, write('src/outreach/crm-sync.ts', 'contacts'))).toEqual([]);
    expect(check(map, write('src/tools/x.ts', 'unowned_table'))).toEqual([]);
  });

  it('no_edge: fires for tools → outreach only', () => {
    const [v] = check(map, imp('src/tools/x.ts', 'src/outreach/send.ts'));
    expect(v).toMatchObject({ invariant: 'DR-3', kind: 'no_edge', target: 'src/outreach/send.ts' });
    expect(v!.options[0]).toBe('Remove the dependency from Research tools on Outreach');
    expect(check(map, imp('src/orchestrator/agent.ts', 'src/outreach/send.ts'))).toEqual([]);
  });

  it('exceptions suppress by exact path or glob', () => {
    const exact = parseDomainMap(addException(mapYaml, 'DR-1', 'src/tools/news-summarize.ts', 'DR-4'));
    expect(check(exact, imp('src/tools/news-summarize.ts', 'vendor/llm-openai/index.ts'))).toEqual([]);
    expect(check(exact, imp('src/tools/other.ts', 'vendor/llm-openai/index.ts'))).toHaveLength(1);
    const glob = parseDomainMap(mapYaml.replace('exceptions: []', 'exceptions: ["src/tools/**"]'));
    expect(check(glob, imp('src/tools/other.ts', 'vendor/llm-openai/index.ts'))).toEqual([]);
  });

  it('cites a linked decision', () => {
    const decided = parseDomainMap(linkDecision(mapYaml, 'DR-1', 'DR-4'));
    const [v] = check(decided, imp('src/tools/filing-summary.ts', 'vendor/llm-openai/index.ts'));
    expect(v!.decision).toBe('DR-4');
    expect(v!.reason).toMatch(/^You decided this in DR-4\. src\/tools\/filing-summary\.ts imports/);
  });

  it('dedupes and sorts by file, then invariant', () => {
    const delta = {
      imports: [
        { from: 'src/tools/b.ts', to: 'src/outreach/send.ts' },
        { from: 'src/tools/b.ts', to: 'vendor/llm-openai/index.ts' },
        { from: 'src/tools/a.ts', to: 'vendor/llm-openai/index.ts' },
        { from: 'src/tools/a.ts', to: 'vendor/llm-openai/index.ts' },
      ],
      writes: [{ file: 'src/tools/a.ts', table: 'runs' }],
    };
    expect(check(map, delta).map((v) => `${v.file} ${v.invariant}`)).toEqual([
      'src/tools/a.ts DR-1',
      'src/tools/a.ts DR-2',
      'src/tools/b.ts DR-1',
      'src/tools/b.ts DR-3',
    ]);
  });
});

import { describe, expect, it } from 'vitest';
import { fileExistsIn } from '../src/facts';
import { planFootprint, type PlanStep } from '../src/plan';
import { fixtureRepo, loadMap } from './helpers';

const map = loadMap();
const exists = fileExistsIn(fixtureRepo);

const tenKPlan = (modelImport: string): PlanStep[] => [
  {
    n: 1,
    text: 'Add a tool that summarizes the latest 10-K',
    files: ['src/tools/filing-summary.ts'],
    imports: [
      { from: 'src/tools/filing-summary.ts', to: 'vendor/sec-edgar/index' },
      { from: 'src/tools/filing-summary.ts', to: modelImport },
    ],
  },
  {
    n: 2,
    text: 'Register it in the tool list',
    files: ['src/tools/index.ts'],
    imports: [{ from: 'src/tools/index.ts', to: './filing-summary' }],
  },
  { n: 3, text: 'Test it', files: ['test/tools/filing-summary.test.ts', 'docs/notes.md'], imports: [] },
];

describe('planFootprint', () => {
  it('maps a gateway-bypassing 10-K plan to ghosts and a DR-1 violation', () => {
    const fp = planFootprint(map, tenKPlan('vendor/llm-openai/index'), exists);
    expect(fp.cells).toEqual([
      { domain: 'tools', layer: 'logic', steps: [1, 2], files: ['src/tools/filing-summary.ts', 'src/tools/index.ts'] },
    ]);
    expect(fp.tests).toEqual([{ domain: 'tools', files: ['test/tools/filing-summary.test.ts'] }]);
    expect(fp.unassigned).toEqual(['docs/notes.md']);
    expect(fp.edges).toEqual([
      {
        from: 'tools',
        to: 'gateway',
        steps: [1],
        imports: [{ from: 'src/tools/filing-summary.ts', to: 'vendor/llm-openai/index.ts' }],
      },
    ]);
    expect(fp.delta.imports).toContainEqual({ from: 'src/tools/index.ts', to: 'src/tools/filing-summary.ts' });
    expect(fp.delta.writes).toEqual([]);
    expect(fp.violations).toHaveLength(1);
    expect(fp.violations[0]).toMatchObject({ invariant: 'DR-1', file: 'src/tools/filing-summary.ts', target: 'vendor/llm-openai/index.ts' });
  });

  it('the same plan through the gateway has no violations', () => {
    const fp = planFootprint(map, tenKPlan('src/gateway/complete'), exists);
    expect(fp.violations).toEqual([]);
    expect(fp.edges).toEqual([
      { from: 'tools', to: 'gateway', steps: [1], imports: [{ from: 'src/tools/filing-summary.ts', to: 'src/gateway/complete.ts' }] },
    ]);
  });

  it('accepts relative specifiers, extensions and unresolvable paths', () => {
    const fp = planFootprint(
      map,
      [
        {
          n: 1,
          text: 'x',
          files: [],
          imports: [
            { from: './src/tools/web-search.ts', to: '../../vendor/llm-anthropic/index' },
            { from: 'src/tools/web-search.ts', to: 'src/outreach/new-thing.ts' },
          ],
        },
      ],
      exists,
    );
    expect(fp.cells).toEqual([{ domain: 'tools', layer: 'logic', steps: [1], files: ['src/tools/web-search.ts'] }]);
    expect(fp.violations.map((v) => [v.invariant, v.target])).toEqual([
      ['DR-1', 'vendor/llm-anthropic/index.ts'],
      ['DR-3', 'src/outreach/new-thing.ts'],
    ]);
  });
});

cat > mapedit.test.ts <<'EOF'
import { describe, expect, it } from 'vitest';
import { addException, linkDecision, nextDecisionId } from '../src/mapedit';
import { parseDomainMap } from '../src/schema';
import { loadMap, mapYaml } from './helpers';

const comments = mapYaml.split('\n').filter((l) => l.trim().startsWith('#'));

describe('mapedit', () => {
  it('linkDecision appends to decisions, keeps comments and round-trips', () => {
    const once = linkDecision(mapYaml, 'DR-1', 'DR-4');
    const twice = linkDecision(once, 'DR-1', 'DR-6');
    for (const c of comments) expect(twice).toContain(c);
    const map = parseDomainMap(twice);
    expect(map.invariants[0]!.decisions).toEqual(['DR-4', 'DR-6']);
    expect(map.invariants[1]!.decisions).toBeUndefined();
    expect(twice).toContain('decisions: [ DR-4, DR-6 ]');
  });

  it('addException appends { path, decision }, keeps comments and round-trips', () => {
    const out = addException(addException(mapYaml, 'DR-1', 'src/tools/news-summarize.ts', 'DR-4'), 'DR-1', 'src/tools/x.ts', 'DR-5');
    for (const c of comments) expect(out).toContain(c);
    expect(parseDomainMap(out).invariants[0]!.exceptions).toEqual([
      { path: 'src/tools/news-summarize.ts', decision: 'DR-4' },
      { path: 'src/tools/x.ts', decision: 'DR-5' },
    ]);
    expect(parseDomainMap(out).invariants[2]!.exceptions).toEqual([]);
  });

  it('throws for an unknown invariant', () => {
    expect(() => linkDecision(mapYaml, 'DR-99', 'DR-4')).toThrow(/no invariant DR-99/);
  });

  it('nextDecisionId returns the next free DR id', () => {
    expect(nextDecisionId(loadMap(), [])).toBe('DR-4');
    expect(nextDecisionId(loadMap(), ['DR-4', 'DR-7', 'notes'])).toBe('DR-8');
    expect(nextDecisionId(parseDomainMap(addException(mapYaml, 'DR-2', 'src/x.ts', 'DR-11')), [])).toBe('DR-12');
    expect(nextDecisionId(parseDomainMap(linkDecision(mapYaml, 'DR-3', 'DR-5')), [])).toBe('DR-6');
  });
});
EOF
```

```bash
def table(rows):
    w = max(len(r[0]) for r in rows)
    return "\n".join(f"{label.ljust(w)}  {cur:>16}  {prior:>16}" for label, cur, prior in rows)
```

```typescript
import { appendFileSync, existsSync, mkdirSync, readFileSync, writeFileSync } from 'node:fs';
import { join } from 'node:path';
import { randomUUID } from 'node:crypto';
import type { HarnessEvent, EventKind, EventData, Cell } from '@harness/core';

type Listener = (e: HarnessEvent) => void;

/** Append-only event log: `.harness/events.jsonl` in the target repo, broadcast to every listener. */
export class Bus {
  readonly events: HarnessEvent[] = [];
  readonly session = randomUUID().slice(0, 8);
  turn: string | null = null;
  private listeners = new Set<Listener>();
  private file: string;

  constructor(repo: string, opts: { fresh?: boolean } = {}) {
    const dir = join(repo, '.harness');
    mkdirSync(join(dir, 'turns'), { recursive: true });
    // Keep .harness/ out of the target's git without touching its .gitignore.
    if (!existsSync(join(dir, '.gitignore'))) writeFileSync(join(dir, '.gitignore'), '*\n');
    this.file = join(dir, 'events.jsonl');
    if (opts.fresh) writeFileSync(this.file, '');
    else if (existsSync(this.file)) {
      for (const line of readFileSync(this.file, 'utf8').split('\n')) {
        if (line.trim()) this.events.push(JSON.parse(line) as HarnessEvent);
      }
    }
  }

  emit<K extends EventKind>(kind: K, data: K extends keyof EventData ? EventData[K] : never, extra: { cell?: Cell | null; path?: string; turn?: string | null } = {}): HarnessEvent {
    const e: HarnessEvent = {
      id: randomUUID().slice(0, 12),
      t: Date.now(),
      session: this.session,
      turn: extra.turn === undefined ? this.turn : extra.turn,
      kind,
      ...(extra.cell ? { cell: extra.cell } : {}),
      ...(extra.path ? { path: extra.path } : {}),
      data: data as Record<string, unknown>,
    };
    this.events.push(e);
    appendFileSync(this.file, JSON.stringify(e) + '\n');
    for (const l of this.listeners) l(e);
    return e;
  }

  on(l: Listener) {
    this.listeners.add(l);
    return () => this.listeners.delete(l);
  }
}

```

```typescript
import type { ChatMessage } from "../shared/types";

/**
 * Replaces personal data with stable tokens before text leaves the process:
 * `jane@acme.com` -> `[EMAIL_1]`, `+1 (415) 555-0134` -> `[PHONE_1]`, and
 * known contact names -> `[NAME_1]`. The same value gets the same token within
 * one Redactor, so a model can still tell two people apart.
 */

export type RedactionKind = "EMAIL" | "PHONE" | "NAME";

const EMAIL_PATTERN = /[A-Za-z0-9._%+-]+@[A-Za-z0-9.-]+\.[A-Za-z]{2,}/g;

// Seven or more digits, allowing the separators people put in phone numbers:
// +1 (415) 555-0134, 415.555.0134, 020 7946 0958, +44 20,7946,0958.
const PHONE_PATTERN = /\+?\(?\d(?:[ .,()-]*\d){6,}/g;

const MIN_NAME_PART = 3;

function escapeRegExp(value: string): string {
  return value.replace(/[.*+?^${}()|[\]\\]/g, "\\$&");
}

/** Full names first, then each capitalized part, longest first so "Ann" never eats "Anne". */
function namePattern(names: string[]): RegExp | null {
  const variants = new Set<string>();
  for (const raw of names) {
    const name = raw.trim().replace(/\s+/g, " ");
    if (!name) continue;
    variants.add(name);
    for (const part of name.split(" ")) {
      if (part.length >= MIN_NAME_PART && /^[A-Z]/.test(part)) variants.add(part);
    }
  }
  if (variants.size === 0) return null;
  const alternatives = [...variants].sort((a, b) => b.length - a.length).map(escapeRegExp);
  return new RegExp(`\\b(?:${alternatives.join("|")})\\b`, "g");
}

export class Redactor {
  private readonly tokens = new Map<string, string>();
  private readonly counters: Record<RedactionKind, number> = { EMAIL: 0, PHONE: 0, NAME: 0 };
  private readonly names: RegExp | null;
  private replaced = 0;

  constructor(knownNames: string[] = []) {
    this.names = namePattern(knownNames);
  }

  /** Number of replacements made so far. */
  get count(): number {
    return this.replaced;
  }

  redact(text: string): string {
    let out = text.replace(EMAIL_PATTERN, (m) => this.token("EMAIL", m));
    out = out.replace(PHONE_PATTERN, (m) => this.token("PHONE", m));
    if (this.names) out = out.replace(this.names, (m) => this.token("NAME", m));
    return out;
  }

  private token(kind: RedactionKind, value: string): string {
    this.replaced++;
    const key = `${kind}:${value.toLowerCase()}`;
    let token = this.tokens.get(key);
    if (!token) {
      token = `[${kind}_${++this.counters[kind]}]`;
      this.tokens.set(key, token);
    }
    return token;
  }
}

export function redactText(text: string, knownNames: string[] = []): string {
  return new Redactor(knownNames).redact(text);
}

/** Redacts every message with one Redactor, so tokens stay consistent across the conversation. */
export function redactMessages(messages: ChatMessage[], knownNames: string[] = []): { messages: ChatMessage[]; count: number } {
  const redactor = new Redactor(knownNames);
  const redacted = messages.map((m) => ({ ...m, content: redactor.redact(m.content) }));
  return { messages: redacted, count: redactor.count };
}
```

```typescript
import { execFileSync } from 'node:child_process';

/** Paths Harness itself writes; never counted as the coding session's work. */
const HARNESS_PATHS = [':(exclude)domains.yaml', ':(exclude)decisions', ':(exclude).harness'];

export function git(repo: string, args: string[]): string {
  return execFileSync('git', args, { cwd: repo, encoding: 'utf8', stdio: ['ignore', 'pipe', 'pipe'] }).trim();
}

function tryGit(repo: string, args: string[]): string {
  try { return git(repo, args); } catch { return ''; }
}

export type Baseline = { head: string; snapshot: string; untracked: string[] };

/** Turn baseline: HEAD plus a `git stash create` snapshot of the working tree (no stash entry is stored). */
export function baseline(repo: string): Baseline {
  const head = tryGit(repo, ['rev-parse', 'HEAD']);
  const snapshot = tryGit(repo, ['stash', 'create']) || head;
  const untracked = untrackedFiles(repo);
  return { head, snapshot, untracked };
}

function untrackedFiles(repo: string): string[] {
  return tryGit(repo, ['ls-files', '--others', '--exclude-standard']).split('\n').filter(Boolean);
}

/** Lines added/removed since the baseline, including files created during the turn (untracked). */
export function numstat(repo: string, base: Baseline): { added: number; removed: number; files: string[] } {
  let added = 0, removed = 0;
  const files: string[] = [];
  const parse = (out: string) => {
    for (const line of out.split('\n')) {
      const [a, r, ...rest] = line.split('\t');
      if (!rest.length) continue;
      added += Number(a) || 0;
      removed += Number(r) || 0;
      files.push(rest.join('\t'));
    }
  };
  if (base.snapshot) parse(tryGit(repo, ['diff', '--numstat', base.snapshot, '--', '.', ...HARNESS_PATHS]));
  const before = new Set(base.untracked);
  for (const f of untrackedFiles(repo)) {
    if (before.has(f) || f.startsWith('decisions/') || f.startsWith('.harness/') || f === 'domains.yaml') continue;
    // --no-index exits 1 when files differ, so read stdout from the error.
    try { execFileSync('git', ['diff', '--no-index', '--numstat', '/dev/null', f], { cwd: repo, encoding: 'utf8' }); }
    catch (e) { parse(String((e as { stdout?: string }).stdout ?? '')); }
  }
  return { added, removed, files };
}

/** Commit only Harness's own files, so the coding session's uncommitted edits stay out (SPEC §8). */
export function commitPaths(repo: string, paths: string[], message: string) {
  git(repo, ['add', '--', ...paths]);
  git(repo, ['commit', '-q', '-m', message, '--', ...paths]);
}
```

```typescript
import { OpenAI } from "../../vendor/llm-openai/index";
import { Anthropic } from "../../vendor/llm-anthropic/index";
import { loadConfig, type ModelProviderName } from "../shared/config";
import type { ChatMessage } from "../shared/types";

/** One interface over the model vendors, so complete() doesn't care which is configured. */

export interface ProviderReply {
  text: string;
  provider: ModelProviderName;
  model: string;
  truncated: boolean;
}

export interface ChatProvider {
  readonly name: ModelProviderName;
  readonly model: string;
  chat(messages: ChatMessage[], options?: { maxTokens?: number; temperature?: number }): Promise<ProviderReply>;
}

const DEFAULT_MAX_TOKENS = 800;

class OpenAIProvider implements ChatProvider {
  readonly name = "openai" as const;
  private readonly client = new OpenAI();

  constructor(readonly model: string) {}

  async chat(messages: ChatMessage[], options: { maxTokens?: number; temperature?: number } = {}): Promise<ProviderReply> {
    const response = await this.client.chat.completions.create({
      model: this.model,
      messages,
      max_tokens: options.maxTokens ?? DEFAULT_MAX_TOKENS,
      temperature: options.temperature ?? 0.2,
    });
    const choice = response.choices[0];
    return {
      text: choice?.message.content ?? "",
      provider: this.name,
      model: response.model,
      truncated: choice?.finish_reason === "length",
    };
  }
}

class AnthropicProvider implements ChatProvider {
  readonly name = "anthropic" as const;
  private readonly client = new Anthropic();

  constructor(readonly model: string) {}

  async chat(messages: ChatMessage[], options: { maxTokens?: number; temperature?: number } = {}): Promise<ProviderReply> {
    // Anthropic takes the system prompt separately and wants user/assistant turns only.
    const system = messages.filter((m) => m.role === "system").map((m) => m.content).join("\n\n");
    const turns = messages
      .filter((m): m is ChatMessage & { role: "user" | "assistant" } => m.role !== "system")
      .map((m) => ({ role: m.role, content: m.content }));
    const response = await this.client.messages.create({
      model: this.model,
      system: system || undefined,
      messages: turns,
      max_tokens: options.maxTokens ?? DEFAULT_MAX_TOKENS,
      temperature: options.temperature ?? 0.2,
    });
    return {
      text: response.content.map((block) => block.text).join(""),
      provider: this.name,
      model: response.model,
      truncated: response.stop_reason === "max_tokens",
    };
  }
}

const providers = new Map<string, ChatProvider>();

/** The configured provider (SCOUT_MODEL_PROVIDER), or a specific one. Instances are reused. */
export function getProvider(name?: ModelProviderName): ChatProvider {
  const config = loadConfig();
  const selected = name ?? config.modelProvider;
  const model = selected === "openai" ? config.openaiModel : config.anthropicModel;
  const key = `${selected}:${model}`;
  let provider = providers.get(key);
  if (!provider) {
    provider = selected === "openai" ? new OpenAIProvider(model) : new AnthropicProvider(model);
    providers.set(key, provider);
  }
  return provider;
}
```

```typescript
import { db } from "../shared/db";
import type { CostRow } from "../shared/types";

/** USD per 1,000 tokens. Tokens are estimated as characters / 4. */
const PRICES: Record<string, { input: number; output: number }> = {
  "gpt-4o-mini": { input: 0.00015, output: 0.0006 },
  "gpt-4o": { input: 0.0025, output: 0.01 },
  "claude-3-5-haiku": { input: 0.0008, output: 0.004 },
  "claude-3-5-sonnet": { input: 0.003, output: 0.015 },
  "text-embedding-3-small": { input: 0.00002, output: 0 },
};

const FALLBACK_PRICE = { input: 0.003, output: 0.015 };

export function estimateTokens(chars: number): number {
  return Math.ceil(chars / 4);
}

export function priceFor(model: string): { input: number; output: number } {
  return PRICES[model] ?? FALLBACK_PRICE;
}

export interface CostEntry {
  runId?: string | null;
  purpose: string;
  provider: string;
  model: string;
  inputChars: number;
  outputChars: number;
}

export function recordCost(entry: CostEntry): CostRow {
  const inputTokens = estimateTokens(entry.inputChars);
  const outputTokens = estimateTokens(entry.outputChars);
  const price = priceFor(entry.model);
  const usd = Number(((inputTokens / 1000) * price.input + (outputTokens / 1000) * price.output).toFixed(6));
  return db.insert("cost_log", {
    runId: entry.runId ?? null,
    purpose: entry.purpose,
    provider: entry.provider,
    model: entry.model,
    inputTokens,
    outputTokens,
    usd,
    at: new Date().toISOString(),
  });
}

export interface CostSummary {
  calls: number;
  inputTokens: number;
  outputTokens: number;
  usd: number;
  byPurpose: Record<string, { calls: number; usd: number }>;
}

export function costSummary(runId?: string): CostSummary {
  const rows = db.filter<CostRow>("cost_log", (r) => runId === undefined || r.runId === runId);
  const summary: CostSummary = { calls: 0, inputTokens: 0, outputTokens: 0, usd: 0, byPurpose: {} };
  for (const row of rows) {
    summary.calls++;
    summary.inputTokens += row.inputTokens;
    summary.outputTokens += row.outputTokens;
    summary.usd += row.usd;
    const bucket = (summary.byPurpose[row.purpose] ??= { calls: 0, usd: 0 });
    bucket.calls++;
    bucket.usd += row.usd;
  }
  summary.usd = Number(summary.usd.toFixed(6));
  return summary;
}
```

```typescript
import { db } from "../shared/db";
import type { ChatMessage, ContactRow } from "../shared/types";
import { recordCost } from "./cost-ledger";
import { getProvider } from "./providers";
import { redactMessages } from "./redact";

export type Purpose = "plan" | "profile" | "summary" | "brief" | "email";

export const PURPOSES: readonly Purpose[] = ["plan", "profile", "summary", "brief", "email"];

export interface CompleteRequest {
  purpose: Purpose;
  messages: ChatMessage[];
  runId?: string;
  maxTokens?: number;
}

export interface Completion {
  text: string;
  provider: string;
  model: string;
  redactions: number;
  truncated: boolean;
  costId: string;
}

export class GatewayError extends Error {
  constructor(message: string) {
    super(message);
    this.name = "GatewayError";
  }
}

/** Names of everyone in `contacts`; these are redacted along with emails and phone numbers. */
function knownContactNames(): string[] {
  return db.all<ContactRow>("contacts").map((c) => c.name).filter((n) => n.length > 0);
}

/**
 * The one way to call a language model: redacts personal data, sends to the
 * configured provider and records the cost.
 */
export async function complete(request: CompleteRequest): Promise<Completion> {
  if (!PURPOSES.includes(request.purpose)) {
    throw new GatewayError(`unknown purpose "${request.purpose}"; expected one of ${PURPOSES.join(", ")}`);
  }
  if (request.messages.length === 0) throw new GatewayError("messages must not be empty");

  const { messages, count } = redactMessages(request.messages, knownContactNames());
  const provider = getProvider();
  const reply = await provider.chat(messages, { maxTokens: request.maxTokens });

  const cost = recordCost({
    runId: request.runId,
    purpose: request.purpose,
    provider: reply.provider,
    model: reply.model,
    inputChars: messages.reduce((n, m) => n + m.content.length, 0),
    outputChars: reply.text.length,
  });

  return {
    text: reply.text,
    provider: reply.provider,
    model: reply.model,
    redactions: count,
    truncated: reply.truncated,
    costId: cost.id,
  };
}

/** complete(), parsing the first JSON object in the reply. Returns `fallback` if there isn't a valid one. */
export async function completeJson<T>(request: CompleteRequest, fallback: T): Promise<{ value: T; completion: Completion }> {
  const completion = await complete(request);
  const match = /\{[\s\S]*\}/.exec(completion.text);
  if (!match) return { value: fallback, completion };
  try {
    return { value: JSON.parse(match[0]) as T, completion };
  } catch {
    return { value: fallback, completion };
  }
}
```

```typescript
import { createEmbeddings } from "../../vendor/embeddings/index";
import { loadConfig } from "../shared/config";
import { db } from "../shared/db";
import type { ContactRow } from "../shared/types";
import { recordCost } from "./cost-ledger";
import { Redactor } from "./redact";

/** Embeds text through the gateway: same redaction and cost logging as complete(). */
export async function embedMany(texts: string[], options: { runId?: string } = {}): Promise<number[][]> {
  if (texts.length === 0) return [];
  const names = db.all<ContactRow>("contacts").map((c) => c.name).filter(Boolean);
  const redactor = new Redactor(names);
  const input = texts.map((t) => redactor.redact(t));
  const model = loadConfig().embeddingModel;

  const response = await createEmbeddings({ model, input });
  recordCost({
    runId: options.runId,
    purpose: "embed",
    provider: "openai",
    model: response.model,
    inputChars: input.reduce((n, s) => n + s.length, 0),
    outputChars: 0,
  });
  return [...response.data].sort((a, b) => a.index - b.index).map((d) => d.embedding);
}

export async function embed(text: string, options: { runId?: string } = {}): Promise<number[]> {
  const [vector] = await embedMany([text], options);
  if (!vector) throw new Error("embeddings returned no vector");
  return vector;
}
```

```typescript
import { db } from "../shared/db";
import { slugify } from "../shared/ids";
import type { NoteRow } from "../shared/types";

export interface NewNote {
  company: string;
  text: string;
  source: string;
  runId?: string | null;
}

const MAX_NOTE_CHARS = 2000;

export function addNote(note: NewNote): NoteRow {
  const text = note.text.trim();
  if (!text) throw new Error("note text must not be empty");
  return db.insert("notes", {
    company: slugify(note.company),
    text: text.length > MAX_NOTE_CHARS ? `${text.slice(0, MAX_NOTE_CHARS - 1)}…` : text,
    source: note.source,
    runId: note.runId ?? null,
    createdAt: new Date().toISOString(),
  });
}

export function getNote(id: string): NoteRow | undefined {
  return db.get<NoteRow>("notes", id);
}

/** Notes for a company, newest first. */
export function notesFor(company: string): NoteRow[] {
  const slug = slugify(company);
  return db
    .filter<NoteRow>("notes", (n) => n.company === slug)
    .sort((a, b) => b.createdAt.localeCompare(a.createdAt) || b.id.localeCompare(a.id));
}
```
