```typescript
import { existsSync, readFileSync, realpathSync } from 'node:fs';
import { join, relative, isAbsolute } from 'node:path';
import { watch, type FSWatcher } from 'chokidar';
import { diffLines } from 'diff';
import {
  parseDomainMap, createMapper, scanRepo, factsForSource, domainEdges, check, fileExistsIn,
  type DomainMap, type Facts, type ImportEdge, type Violation, type Placement,
} from '@harness/core';
import type { Bus } from './bus';

const CODE = /\.(ts|tsx|js|jsx|mjs|cjs|mts)$/;

export class Repo {
  readonly root: string;
  map!: DomainMap;
  mapText = '';
  mapper!: ReturnType<typeof createMapper>;
  facts: Facts = { files: [], imports: [], writes: [] };
  violations: Violation[] = [];
  private contents = new Map<string, string>();
  private pending = new Map<string, NodeJS.Timeout>(); // paths a hook is editing; the watcher leaves them alone
  private watcher: FSWatcher | null = null;
  exists: (p: string) => boolean;

  constructor(root: string, private bus: Bus) {
    this.root = realpathSync(root);
    this.exists = fileExistsIn(this.root);
  }

  get mapPath() { return join(this.root, 'domains.yaml'); }
  hasMap() { return existsSync(this.mapPath); }

  /** Load (or reload) domains.yaml text. */
  setMap(text: string) {
    this.mapText = text;
    this.map = parseDomainMap(text);
    this.mapper = createMapper(this.map);
  }

  loadMapFile() { this.setMap(readFileSync(this.mapPath, 'utf8')); }

  /** Repo-relative POSIX path for an absolute path from a hook, or null if it is outside the repo. */
  rel(p: string): string | null {
    let abs = isAbsolute(p) ? p : join(this.root, p);
    try { abs = realpathSync(abs); } catch {
      // New file: resolve the parent instead.
      const i = abs.lastIndexOf('/');
      try { abs = join(realpathSync(abs.slice(0, i)), abs.slice(i + 1)); } catch { /* keep as is */ }
    }
    const r = relative(this.root, abs);
    if (!r || r.startsWith('..') || isAbsolute(r)) return null;
    return r.split('\\').join('/');
  }

  place(path: string): Placement { return this.mapper.place(path); }

  cellOf(path: string) {
    const p = this.place(path);
    return p.kind === 'cell' ? { domain: p.domain, layer: p.layer } : null;
  }

  /** Placement for a directory (Grep/Glob path): the single cell all known files under it share, if any. */
  cellForDir(dir: string) {
    const prefix = dir.replace(/\/$/, '') + '/';
    let found: { domain: string; layer: string } | null = null;
    for (const f of this.facts.files) {
      if (!f.startsWith(prefix)) continue;
      const c = this.cellOf(f);
      if (!c) continue;
      if (found && (found.domain !== c.domain || found.layer !== c.layer)) return null;
      found = c;
    }
    return found;
  }

  /** Full fact scan → `repo_scanned` + `violation_found`. */
  scan() {
    this.facts = scanRepo(this.root, this.map);
    this.contents.clear();
    for (const f of this.facts.files) {
      if (CODE.test(f)) this.contents.set(f, readFileSync(join(this.root, f), 'utf8'));
    }
    this.bus.emit('repo_scanned', {
      files: this.facts.files.map((path) => ({ path, placement: this.place(path) })),
      imports: this.facts.imports,
      writes: this.facts.writes,
      edges: domainEdges(this.facts, this.mapper),
    }, { turn: null });
    this.recheck();
  }

  /** Re-run the checker over the whole repo (load call site) and publish the current set. */
  recheck() {
    this.violations = check(this.map, this.facts, this.mapper);
    this.bus.emit('violation_found', { violations: this.violations }, { turn: null });
  }

  current(path: string): string | null {
    if (this.contents.has(path)) return this.contents.get(path)!;
    const abs = join(this.root, path);
    return existsSync(abs) ? readFileSync(abs, 'utf8') : null;
  }

  markPending(path: string) {
    clearTimeout(this.pending.get(path));
    this.pending.set(path, setTimeout(() => this.pending.delete(path), 10_000));
  }

  /**
   * A file changed on disk: emit `edited` (+/− lines) and edge events from its import diff, and update facts.
   * Called by the PostToolUse hook (attributed) and the watcher (unattributed). No-op if the content is unchanged.
   */
  fileChanged(path: string, attr: { tool?: string; unattributed?: boolean }) {
    if (this.mapper.isIgnored(path)) return;
    const abs = join(this.root, path);
    const deleted = !existsSync(abs);
    const next = deleted ? '' : readFileSync(abs, 'utf8');
    const prev = this.contents.get(path);
    const known = this.facts.files.includes(path);
    if (prev === next && known) return;
    if (!attr.unattributed) { clearTimeout(this.pending.get(path)); this.pending.delete(path); }

    let added = 0, removed = 0;
    for (const part of diffLines(prev ?? '', next)) {
      if (part.added) added += part.count ?? 0;
      else if (part.removed) removed += part.count ?? 0;
    }
    const created = !known && !deleted;
    if (created) {
      this.facts.files.push(path);
      this.exists = fileExistsIn(this.root);
      this.bus.emit('file_assigned', { placement: this.place(path) }, { path });
    }
    if (deleted) this.facts.files = this.facts.files.filter((f) => f !== path);

    // Import and write facts for this one file.
    const before = this.facts.imports.filter((i) => i.from === path);
    const after = CODE.test(path) && !deleted ? factsForSource(path, next, this.exists) : { imports: [], writes: [] };
    this.facts.imports = [...this.facts.imports.filter((i) => i.from !== path), ...after.imports];
    this.facts.writes = [...this.facts.writes.filter((w) => w.file !== path), ...after.writes];
    if (deleted) this.contents.delete(path); else if (CODE.test(path)) this.contents.set(path, next);

    this.bus.emit('edited', { added, removed, created, ...(attr.unattributed ? { unattributed: true } : {}), ...(attr.tool ? { tool: attr.tool } : {}) }, { path, cell: this.cellOf(path) });

    const key = (i: ImportEdge) => `${i.from}→${i.to}`;
    const beforeKeys = new Set(before.map(key));
    const afterKeys = new Set(after.imports.map(key));
    const gained = after.imports.filter((i) => !beforeKeys.has(key(i)));
    const lost = before.filter((i) => !afterKeys.has(key(i)));
    for (const de of domainEdges({ imports: gained, writes: [] }, this.mapper)) {
      for (const edge of de.files) this.bus.emit('edge_added', { edge, from: de.from, to: de.to }, { path });
    }
    for (const de of domainEdges({ imports: lost, writes: [] }, this.mapper)) {
      for (const edge of de.files) this.bus.emit('edge_removed', { edge, from: de.from, to: de.to }, { path });
    }
  }

  /** Completeness: any write that no hook reported (e.g. from Bash) becomes an unattributed `edited` event. */
  startWatcher() {
    const ignored = (p: string) => {
      const r = relative(this.root, p);
      if (!r || r.startsWith('..')) return false;
      return /(^|\/)(node_modules|\.git|\.harness)(\/|$)/.test(r) || this.mapper.isIgnored(r.split('\\').join('/'));
    };
    this.watcher = watch(this.root, { ignored, ignoreInitial: true, awaitWriteFinish: { stabilityThreshold: 120, pollInterval: 40 } });
    const handle = (abs: string) => {
      const r = this.rel(abs);
      if (!r || this.pending.has(r) || r === 'domains.yaml') return;
      this.fileChanged(r, { unattributed: true });
    };
    this.watcher.on('add', handle).on('change', handle).on('unlink', handle);
  }

  async close() { await this.watcher?.close(); }
}
```

```typescript
import { embed, embedMany } from "../gateway/embed";
import { db } from "../shared/db";
import { slugify } from "../shared/ids";
import type { EmbeddingRow, NoteRow } from "../shared/types";

export interface ScoredNote {
  note: NoteRow;
  score: number;
}

export function cosine(a: number[], b: number[]): number {
  let dot = 0;
  let na = 0;
  let nb = 0;
  for (let i = 0; i < Math.min(a.length, b.length); i++) {
    const x = a[i] ?? 0;
    const y = b[i] ?? 0;
    dot += x * y;
    na += x * x;
    nb += y * y;
  }
  return na === 0 || nb === 0 ? 0 : dot / Math.sqrt(na * nb);
}

/** Embeds notes in one batch and stores their vectors. */
export async function indexNotes(notes: NoteRow[], runId?: string): Promise<void> {
  if (notes.length === 0) return;
  const vectors = await embedMany(
    notes.map((n) => n.text),
    { runId },
  );
  notes.forEach((note, i) => {
    db.insert("embeddings", { noteId: note.id, company: note.company, vector: vectors[i] ?? [] });
  });
}

/** Top-k notes for a company by similarity to the query. */
export async function searchNotes(company: string, query: string, k: number, runId?: string): Promise<ScoredNote[]> {
  const slug = slugify(company);
  const candidates = db.filter<EmbeddingRow>("embeddings", (e) => e.company === slug);
  if (candidates.length === 0) return [];

  const queryVector = await embed(query, { runId });
  const scored: ScoredNote[] = [];
  for (const candidate of candidates) {
    const note = db.get<NoteRow>("notes", candidate.noteId);
    if (note) scored.push({ note, score: cosine(queryVector, candidate.vector) });
  }
  return scored.sort((a, b) => b.score - a.score || a.note.id.localeCompare(b.note.id)).slice(0, k);
}

```

```typescript
import type { NoteRow, ToolResult } from "../shared/types";
import { addNote } from "./notes-store";
import { indexNotes, searchNotes } from "./vector-index";

export const DEFAULT_TOP_K = 3;

/** The notes most relevant to `query` from earlier research on this company. */
export async function retrieveNotes(
  company: string,
  query: string,
  options: { k?: number; runId?: string } = {},
): Promise<NoteRow[]> {
  const results = await searchNotes(company, query, options.k ?? DEFAULT_TOP_K, options.runId);
  return results.map((r) => r.note);
}

/** Keeps each tool's findings as a note so the next run on this company can use them. */
export async function rememberResults(runId: string, company: string, results: ToolResult[]): Promise<NoteRow[]> {
  const notes = results
    .filter((r) => r.summary.trim().length > 0)
    .map((r) =>
      addNote({
        company,
        runId,
        source: r.tool,
        text: [r.summary, ...r.facts.slice(0, 5).map((f) => `- ${f}`)].join("\n"),
      }),
    );
  await indexNotes(notes, runId);
  return notes;
}
```

```typescript
import { search } from "../../vendor/search/index";
import { complete } from "../gateway/complete";
import type { Tool } from "../shared/types";

const SYSTEM = "You condense web search results about a company into three short sentences a sales rep can skim before a call.";

const FOCUS_WORDS = ["pricing", "hiring", "expansion", "partnership", "product", "funding", "procurement", "leadership"];

/** Adds the goal's most useful keyword to the query, so results lean toward what the rep cares about. */
function buildQuery(company: string, goal: string): string {
  const lower = goal.toLowerCase();
  const focus = FOCUS_WORDS.find((w) => lower.includes(w));
  return focus ? `${company} ${focus}` : company;
}

export const webSearch: Tool = {
  name: "web_search",
  tags: ["search", "web", "company", "overview"],
  description: "Searches the web for the company and condenses the top results.",

  async run(input, ctx) {
    const query = buildQuery(input.company, input.goal);
    const results = await search(query, { limit: 5 });
    ctx.log.debug("web search", { query, results: results.length });
    if (results.length === 0) {
      return { tool: this.name, summary: "", facts: [], sources: [] };
    }

    const listing = results.map((r) => `${r.rank}. ${r.title}: ${r.snippet}`).join("\n");
    const completion = await complete({
      purpose: "summary",
      runId: ctx.runId,
      messages: [
        { role: "system", content: SYSTEM },
        { role: "user", content: `Company: ${input.company}\n\n${listing}` },
      ],
    });

    return {
      tool: this.name,
      summary: completion.text,
      facts: results.map((r) => r.title),
      sources: results.map((r) => r.url),
    };
  },
};
```

```typescript
const SYSTEM =
  "You write a two-sentence company profile for a sales rep: what the company does and how big it is, then who the contact is and what they likely care about.";

function companyLines(company: CompanyProfile): string[] {

    `Company: ${company.name} (${company.domain})`,
    `Industry: ${company.industry}`,
    `Employees: ${company.employees.toLocaleString("en-US")}`,
    `Revenue: ${company.revenue}`,
    `Founded: ${company.founded}`,
    `Headquarters: ${company.headquarters}`,
    `About: ${company.description}`,
    `Uses: ${company.tech.join(", ")}`,
  ];
}

function personLines(person: PersonProfile, fallbackName?: string): string[] {

  return [
    name ? `Contact: ${name}` : "Contact: unknown",
    person.title ? `Title: ${person.title}` : "",
    person.seniority ? `Seniority: ${person.seniority}` : "",
  ].filter(Boolean);
}

      messages: [
        { role: "system", content: SYSTEM },
        { role: "user", content: facts.join("\n") },
      ],
    });

    return {
      tool: this.name,
      summary: completion.text,
      facts,
      sources: [`https://${company.domain}`, ...(person.linkedin ? [person.linkedin] : [])],
    };
  },
};
```

```typescript
import YAML, { isMap, isSeq, type Node } from 'yaml';
import type { DomainMap } from './schema';

const flow = (value: unknown) => YAML.stringify(value, { collectionStyle: 'flow', lineWidth: 0 }).trimEnd();

/** End of the source line on which `node`'s value ends (before any trailing comment's newline). */
function lineEndAfter(text: string, node: Node): number {
  let p = node.range![1];
  while (p > 0 && /\s/.test(text[p - 1]!)) p--;
  const nl = text.indexOf('\n', p);
  return nl === -1 ? text.length : nl;
}

function column(text: string, offset: number): number {
  return offset - (text.lastIndexOf('\n', offset - 1) + 1);
}

/**
 * Append `value` to the list at `key` of invariant `invariantId`, creating the key if missing.
 * Splices text into the original so comments, spacing and alignment elsewhere are untouched.
 */
function appendToInvariant(yamlText: string, invariantId: string, key: string, value: unknown): string {
  const doc = YAML.parseDocument(yamlText);
  const list = doc.get('invariants');
  const inv = isSeq(list) ? list.items.find((item) => isMap(item) && item.get('id') === invariantId) : undefined;
  if (!isMap(inv) || inv.items.length === 0) throw new Error(`domains.yaml has no invariant ${invariantId}`);
  const splice = (at: number, insert: string) => yamlText.slice(0, at) + insert + yamlText.slice(at);
  const item = flow(value);
  const seq = inv.get(key, true);

  if (isSeq(seq) && seq.flow) {
    const close = yamlText.lastIndexOf(']', seq.range![1] - 1);
    return splice(close, seq.items.length ? `, ${item}` : item);
  }
  if (isSeq(seq)) {
    const last = seq.items.at(-1) as Node | undefined;
    if (!last) throw new Error(`${invariantId}.${key} is malformed`);
    return splice(lineEndAfter(yamlText, last), `\n${' '.repeat(column(yamlText, seq.range![0]))}- ${item}`);
  }
  if (seq !== undefined && seq !== null) throw new Error(`${invariantId}.${key} is not a list`);
  const firstKey = inv.items[0]!.key as Node;
  const lastPair = inv.items.at(-1)!;
  const end = lineEndAfter(yamlText, (lastPair.value ?? lastPair.key) as Node);
  return splice(end, `\n${' '.repeat(column(yamlText, firstKey.range![0]))}${key}: [${item}]`);
}

/** Link decision `decisionId` to an invariant (the user chose to comply). Only the edited line changes. */
export function linkDecision(yamlText: string, invariantId: string, decisionId: string): string {
  return appendToInvariant(yamlText, invariantId, 'decisions', decisionId);
}

/** Add `{ path, decision }` to an invariant's exceptions (the user chose the exception). Only the edited line changes. */
export function addException(yamlText: string, invariantId: string, path: string, decisionId: string): string {
  return appendToInvariant(yamlText, invariantId, 'exceptions', { path, decision: decisionId });
}

/** Next free `DR-n`, above every id used by invariants, their decisions and exceptions, and `existingIds`. */
export function nextDecisionId(map: DomainMap, existingIds: string[]): string {
  const ids = [
    ...existingIds,
    ...map.invariants.flatMap((inv) => [inv.id, ...(inv.decisions ?? []), ...inv.exceptions.flatMap((e) => (e.decision ? [e.decision] : []))]),
  ];
  const max = Math.max(0, ...ids.map((id) => Number(/^DR-(\d+)$/.exec(id)?.[1] ?? 0)));
  return `DR-${max + 1}`;
}

```

```typescript
import { latestHeadlines, type Headline } from "../../vendor/news/index";
import type { Tool } from "../shared/types";

/** Groups recent headlines by topic. No model call: it's a quick, cheap scan. */

export type Topic = "deals" | "results" | "leadership" | "product" | "expansion" | "funding" | "other";

const TOPIC_WORDS: Array<[Topic, string[]]> = [
  ["funding", ["raises", "series", "funding", "valuation", "investment"]],
  ["deals", ["contract", "deal", "partners", "partnership", "signs", "wins", "lands", "selects", "agreement"]],
  ["results", ["revenue", "quarter", "results", "earnings", "guidance", "posts", "reports", "crosses"]],
  ["leadership", ["names", "appoints", "hires", "ceo", "cfo", "cro", "officer", "executive"]],
  ["product", ["launches", "launch", "releases", "unveils", "pilots", "product"]],
  ["expansion", ["opens", "expands", "expansion", "plant", "office", "terminal"]],
];

const TOPIC_ORDER: Topic[] = ["deals", "results", "funding", "leadership", "product", "expansion", "other"];

export function topicOf(headline: Pick<Headline, "title">): Topic {
  const words = headline.title.toLowerCase().split(/[^a-z]+/);
  for (const [topic, keywords] of TOPIC_WORDS) {
    if (keywords.some((k) => words.includes(k))) return topic;
  }
  return "other";
}

export function groupByTopic(headlines: Headline[]): Map<Topic, Headline[]> {
  const groups = new Map<Topic, Headline[]>();
  for (const headline of headlines) {
    const topic = topicOf(headline);
    groups.set(topic, [...(groups.get(topic) ?? []), headline]);
  }
  return new Map(TOPIC_ORDER.filter((t) => groups.has(t)).map((t) => [t, groups.get(t) ?? []]));
}

export const newsDigest: Tool = {
  name: "news_digest",
  tags: ["news", "digest", "headlines"],
  description: "Lists the company's recent headlines grouped by topic (deals, results, leadership, ...).",

  async run(input, ctx) {
    const headlines = await latestHeadlines(input.company, { limit: 8 });
    ctx.log.debug("news digest", { headlines: headlines.length });
    if (headlines.length === 0) {
      return { tool: this.name, summary: `No recent news for ${input.company}.`, facts: [], sources: [] };
    }

    const groups = groupByTopic(headlines);
    const counts = [...groups.entries()].map(([topic, items]) => `${items.length} ${topic}`);
    const latest = headlines[0];
    const summary = `${headlines.length} recent headlines for ${input.company} (${counts.join(", ")}). Latest: ${latest?.title} (${latest?.publishedAt}).`;

    return {
      tool: this.name,
      summary,
      facts: [...groups.entries()].flatMap(([topic, items]) =>
        items.map((h) => `[${topic}] ${h.title} (${h.source}, ${h.publishedAt})`),
      ),
      sources: headlines.map((h) => h.url),
    };
  },
};

```

```typescript
import { OpenAI } from "../../vendor/llm-openai/index";
import { latestHeadlines } from "../../vendor/news/index";
import { loadConfig } from "../shared/config";
import type { Tool } from "../shared/types";

const client = new OpenAI();

export const newsSummarize: Tool = {
  name: "news_summarize",
  tags: ["news", "summary"],
  description: "Turns the company's latest headlines into talking points for the contact.",

  async run(input, ctx) {
    const headlines = await latestHeadlines(input.company, { limit: 6 });
    if (headlines.length === 0) {
      return { tool: this.name, summary: "", facts: [], sources: [] };
    }

    const contact = [input.contact.name, input.contact.title, input.contact.email, input.contact.phone]
      .filter(Boolean)
      .join(", ");
    const news = headlines.map((h) => `- ${h.title} (${h.publishedAt}). ${h.summary}`).join("\n");

    const response = await client.chat.completions.create({
      model: loadConfig().openaiModel,
      temperature: 0.2,
      messages: [
        { role: "system", content: "Turn recent news into two or three talking points for a sales call. Keep every figure exact." },
        {
          role: "user",
          content: `Prospect: ${input.company}. Contact: ${contact}. Goal: ${input.goal}\n\nNews:\n${news}`,
        },
      ],
    });
    ctx.log.debug("summarized news", { headlines: headlines.length });

    return {
      tool: this.name,
      summary: response.choices[0]?.message.content ?? "",
      facts: headlines.map((h) => h.title),
      sources: headlines.map((h) => h.url),
    };
  },
};
```

```typescript
import { describe, expect, it } from 'vitest';
import { addException, linkDecision, nextDecisionId } from '../src/mapedit';
import { parseDomainMap } from '../src/schema';
import { loadMap, mapYaml } from './helpers';

/** Lines of `after` that are not in `before`, and how many lines `before` lost. */
function lineDiff(before: string, after: string) {
  const a = before.split('\n');
  const b = after.split('\n');
  return { added: b.filter((l) => !a.includes(l)), removed: a.filter((l) => !b.includes(l)).length };
}

describe('mapedit', () => {
  it('linkDecision adds a decisions line, then appends to it, touching nothing else', () => {
    const once = linkDecision(mapYaml, 'DR-1', 'DR-4');
    expect(lineDiff(mapYaml, once)).toEqual({ added: ['    decisions: [DR-4]'], removed: 0 });
    const twice = linkDecision(once, 'DR-1', 'DR-6');
    expect(lineDiff(mapYaml, twice)).toEqual({ added: ['    decisions: [DR-4, DR-6]'], removed: 0 });
    const map = parseDomainMap(twice);
    expect(map.invariants[0]!.decisions).toEqual(['DR-4', 'DR-6']);
    expect(map.invariants[1]!.decisions).toBeUndefined();
    // The last invariant in the file works too.
    expect(parseDomainMap(linkDecision(mapYaml, 'DR-3', 'DR-5')).invariants[2]!.decisions).toEqual(['DR-5']);
  });

  it('addException appends { path, decision } to a flow list, touching nothing else', () => {
    const out = addException(addException(mapYaml, 'DR-1', 'src/tools/news-summarize.ts', 'DR-4'), 'DR-1', 'src/tools/x.ts', 'DR-5');
    expect(lineDiff(mapYaml, out)).toEqual({
      added: ['    exceptions: [{ path: src/tools/news-summarize.ts, decision: DR-4 }, { path: src/tools/x.ts, decision: DR-5 }]'],
      removed: 1,
    });
    expect(parseDomainMap(out).invariants[0]!.exceptions).toEqual([
      { path: 'src/tools/news-summarize.ts', decision: 'DR-4' },
      { path: 'src/tools/x.ts', decision: 'DR-5' },
    ]);
    expect(parseDomainMap(out).invariants[2]!.exceptions).toEqual([]);
  });

  it('appends to block lists and keeps trailing comments', () => {
    const block = mapYaml.replace(
      /(id: DR-2[\s\S]*?)exceptions: \[\]/,
      '$1exceptions:\n      - src/legacy/import.ts # migrated later\n      - { path: src/x.ts, decision: DR-7 }',
    );
    const out = addException(block, 'DR-2', 'src/tools/y.ts', 'DR-8');
    expect(lineDiff(block, out)).toEqual({ added: ['      - { path: src/tools/y.ts, decision: DR-8 }'], removed: 0 });
    expect(out).toContain('# migrated later');
    expect(parseDomainMap(out).invariants[1]!.exceptions).toEqual([
      { path: 'src/legacy/import.ts' },
      { path: 'src/x.ts', decision: 'DR-7' },
      { path: 'src/tools/y.ts', decision: 'DR-8' },
    ]);
  });

  it('throws for an unknown invariant', () => {
    expect(() => linkDecision(mapYaml, 'DR-99', 'DR-4')).toThrow(/no invariant DR-99/);
  });

  it('nextDecisionId returns the next free DR id', () => {
    expect(nextDecisionId(loadMap(), [])).toBe('DR-4');
    expect(nextDecisionId(loadMap(), ['DR-4', 'DR-7', 'notes'])).toBe('DR-8');
    expect(nextDecisionId(parseDomainMap(addException(mapYaml, 'DR-2', 'src/x.ts', 'DR-11')), [])).toBe('DR-12');
    expect(nextDecisionId(parseDomainMap(linkDecision(mapYaml, 'DR-3', 'DR-5')), [])).toBe('DR-6');
  });
});
```

```typescript
import type { Tool } from "../shared/types";
import { tools } from "../tools/index";

/** "Filings," -> "filing", "10-K" -> "10-k". Plural-insensitive so tags read naturally. */
export function normalizeKeyword(word: string): string {
  const w = word.toLowerCase().replace(/[^a-z0-9-]/g, "");
  return w.length > 3 && w.endsWith("s") && !w.endsWith("ss") ? w.slice(0, -1) : w;
}

export class ToolRegistry {
  private readonly byName = new Map<string, Tool>();
  private readonly byTag = new Map<string, Tool[]>();

  constructor(list: Tool[]) {
    for (const tool of list) this.register(tool);
  }

  register(tool: Tool): void {
    if (!/^[a-z][a-z0-9_]*$/.test(tool.name)) throw new Error(`tool name must be snake_case: "${tool.name}"`);
    if (this.byName.has(tool.name)) throw new Error(`tool registered twice: ${tool.name}`);
    this.byName.set(tool.name, tool);
    for (const tag of tool.tags) {
      const key = normalizeKeyword(tag);
      this.byTag.set(key, [...(this.byTag.get(key) ?? []), tool]);
    }
  }

  get(name: string): Tool | undefined {
    return this.byName.get(name);
  }

  has(name: string): boolean {
    return this.byName.has(name);
  }

  list(): Tool[] {
    return [...this.byName.values()];
  }

  /** One line per tool, for the planner prompt. */
  describe(): string {
    return this.list()
      .map((t) => `- ${t.name} [${t.tags.join(", ")}]: ${t.description}`)
      .join("\n");
  }

  /** Tools with a tag that appears as a word in the goal, in registration order. */
  matchGoal(goal: string): Tool[] {
    const words = new Set(goal.split(/[\s,.;:!?()"']+/).filter(Boolean).map(normalizeKeyword));
    const matched = new Set<Tool>();
    for (const word of words) {
      for (const tool of this.byTag.get(word) ?? []) matched.add(tool);
    }
    return this.list().filter((t) => matched.has(t));
  }
}

export const registry = new ToolRegistry(tools);

```

```typescript
import { completeJson } from "../gateway/complete";
import type { RunRequest } from "../shared/types";
import type { ToolRegistry } from "./tool-registry";

export const PLANNER_SYSTEM_PROMPT = [
  "You plan research for a B2B sales rep before they contact a prospect.",
  "Pick the tools that will find the most useful facts for the rep's goal, in the order to run them.",
  'Reply with JSON only: {"tools": ["tool_name", ...], "reason": "one sentence"}.',
].join(" ");

export interface PlanStep {
  tool: string;
  reason: string;
}

export interface Plan {
  steps: PlanStep[];
  /** Which tools the model chose and which were added because their tags matched the goal. */
  picked: { model: string[]; tags: string[] };
}

interface PlannerReply {
  tools?: unknown;
  reason?: unknown;
}

export async function planRun(
  request: RunRequest,
  options: { registry: ToolRegistry; runId: string; maxSteps: number },
): Promise<Plan> {
  const { registry, runId, maxSteps } = options;
  const { value } = await completeJson<PlannerReply>(
    {
      purpose: "plan",
      runId,
      messages: [
        { role: "system", content: PLANNER_SYSTEM_PROMPT },
        {
          role: "user",
          content: `Company: ${request.company}\nGoal: ${request.goal}\n\nAvailable tools:\n${registry.describe()}`,
        },
      ],
    },
    {},
  );

  const reason = typeof value.reason === "string" ? value.reason : "Chosen by the planner.";
  const modelPicks = Array.isArray(value.tools)
    ? [...new Set(value.tools.filter((t): t is string => typeof t === "string" && registry.has(t)))]
    : [];
  const tagPicks = registry
    .matchGoal(request.goal)
    .map((t) => t.name)
    .filter((name) => !modelPicks.includes(name));

  const steps: PlanStep[] = [
    ...modelPicks.map((tool) => ({ tool, reason })),
    ...tagPicks.map((tool) => ({ tool, reason: "Tags match the goal." })),
  ].slice(0, maxSteps);

  return { steps, picked: { model: modelPicks, tags: tagPicks } };
}
```

```typescript
import { existsSync, mkdirSync, readdirSync, readFileSync, writeFileSync } from 'node:fs';
import { basename, join } from 'node:path';
import { parse as parseYaml, stringify as stringifyYaml } from 'yaml';
import { linkDecision, addException, nextDecisionId, type Violation } from '@harness/core';
import { commitPaths, git } from './git';
import type { Repo } from './repo';
import type { Bus } from './bus';

export type DecisionRecord = {
  id: string;
  title: string;
  outcome: string;
  status: string;
  type: string;
  invariant: string;
  anchors: { paths: string[] };
  rejected: string;
  rationale: string;
};

/** Read `decisions/DR-*.md` (front matter + body). */
export function listDecisions(root: string): DecisionRecord[] {
  const dir = join(root, 'decisions');
  if (!existsSync(dir)) return [];
  const out: DecisionRecord[] = [];
  for (const f of readdirSync(dir).filter((f) => /^DR-\d+\.md$/.test(f))) {
    const text = readFileSync(join(dir, f), 'utf8');
    const m = /^---\n([\s\S]*?)\n---\n?([\s\S]*)$/.exec(text);
    if (!m) continue;
    const fm = parseYaml(m[1]!) as Omit<DecisionRecord, 'rationale'>;
    out.push({ ...fm, rationale: m[2]!.trim() });
  }
  return out.sort((a, b) => Number(a.id.slice(3)) - Number(b.id.slice(3)));
}

/** Parse which option the user picked. Explicit A/B wins; "exception" leans B; otherwise A (comply). */
export function parseOption(text: string): 'A' | 'B' {
  const t = text.trim();
  const m = /^\(?\s*(?:option\s+)?([ab])\b/i.exec(t) ?? /\b(?:option|choose|pick|go with)\s+\(?([ab])\b/i.exec(t);
  if (m) return m[1]!.toUpperCase() as 'A' | 'B';
  return /\bexception\b/i.test(t) ? 'B' : 'A';
}

function repoAnchor(root: string) {
  let repository = basename(root);
  try { repository = git(root, ['remote', 'get-url', 'origin']) || repository; } catch { /* no remote */ }
  let branch = 'main';
  try { branch = git(root, ['rev-parse', '--abbrev-ref', 'HEAD']); } catch { /* no commits */ }
  return { repository, branch };
}

/**
 * An answered fork becomes a standing decision (SPEC §8): write decisions/DR-n.md, update domains.yaml
 * (A links the decision to the invariant, B adds an exception), commit just those two files, emit
 * `decision_recorded`, and return the instruction that asks Claude to record it in Alike.
 */
export function recordFork(repo: Repo, bus: Bus, violations: Violation[], option: 'A' | 'B', answer: string, prompt: string) {
  const existing = listDecisions(repo.root).map((d) => d.id);
  const byInvariant = new Map<string, Violation[]>();
  for (const v of violations) byInvariant.set(v.invariant, [...(byInvariant.get(v.invariant) ?? []), v]);

  const made: DecisionRecord[] = [];
  let yamlText = repo.mapText;
  for (const [invariantId, vs] of byInvariant) {
    const inv = repo.map.invariants.find((i) => i.id === invariantId);
    if (!inv) continue;
    const id = nextDecisionId(repo.map, [...existing, ...made.map((d) => d.id)]);
    const files = [...new Set(vs.map((v) => v.file))];
    const v0 = vs[0]!;
    const [chosen, rejected] = option === 'A' ? [v0.options[0], v0.options[1]] : [v0.options[1], v0.options[0]];
    const title = option === 'A'
      ? `${files.join(', ')} follows ${inv.id}: ${inv.rule}`
      : `Exception to ${inv.id} for ${files.join(', ')}`;
    const rec: DecisionRecord = {
      id, title, outcome: chosen, status: 'made', type: 'standing', invariant: inv.id,
      anchors: { paths: files }, rejected,
      rationale: [
        `The user chose ${option}, in their words: "${answer.trim()}"`,
        '',
        `Asked during: "${prompt.trim()}"`,
        '',
        `What triggered it: ${v0.reason}`,
        '',
        `Rejected: ${rejected}`,
      ].join('\n'),
    };
    made.push(rec);
    yamlText = option === 'A' ? linkDecision(yamlText, inv.id, id) : addException(yamlText, inv.id, files[0]!, id);
  }
  if (!made.length) return { decisions: [], alikeInstruction: '' };

  mkdirSync(join(repo.root, 'decisions'), { recursive: true });
  const paths: string[] = ['domains.yaml'];
  for (const d of made) {
    const { rationale, ...fm } = d;
    const rel = `decisions/${d.id}.md`;
    writeFileSync(join(repo.root, rel), `---\n${stringifyYaml(fm).trim()}\n---\n\n${rationale}\n`);
    paths.push(rel);
  }
  writeFileSync(repo.mapPath, yamlText);
  try { commitPaths(repo.root, paths, `docs(decisions): ${made.map((d) => d.id).join(', ')} ${made[0]!.title}`.slice(0, 100)); }
  catch (e) { bus.emit('error', { message: `Could not commit ${paths.join(', ')}: ${(e as Error).message}` }); }

  repo.setMap(yamlText);
  bus.emit('map_confirmed', { map: repo.map, source: 'file' });
  for (const d of made) {
    bus.emit('decision_recorded', { id: d.id, title: d.title, invariant: d.invariant, option, paths: d.anchors.paths, alike: false });
  }

  const anchor = repoAnchor(repo.root);
  const alikeInstruction = made.map((d) =>
    `Record ${d.id} in Alike now with mcp__alike__record_decision: title "${d.id}: ${d.title}", outcome "${d.outcome}", ` +
    `rationale "${d.rationale.replace(/\n+/g, ' ').replace(/"/g, "'")}", type "standing", code anchors ` +
    `{ repository: "${anchor.repository}", branch: "${anchor.branch}", paths: ${JSON.stringify(d.anchors.paths)} }. ` +
    `If you have not yet this session, first call mcp__alike__describe_entity_kind with kind "decision" to confirm the field names. ` +
    `If the Alike tools are unavailable, skip this silently.`,
  ).join('\n');
  return { decisions: made, alikeInstruction };
}
```

```typescript
import { db } from "../shared/db";
import type { RunRequest, RunRow, RunStep } from "../shared/types";

export function startRun(request: RunRequest): RunRow {
  return db.insert("runs", {
    company: request.company,
    goal: request.goal,
    contactEmail: request.contact.email,
    status: "running",
    plan: [],
    steps: [],
    startedAt: new Date().toISOString(),
  } satisfies Omit<RunRow, "id">);
}

export function getRun(id: string): RunRow | undefined {
  return db.get<RunRow>("runs", id);
}

export function listRuns(limit = 20): RunRow[] {
  return db
    .all<RunRow>("runs")
    .sort((a, b) => b.startedAt.localeCompare(a.startedAt) || b.id.localeCompare(a.id))
    .slice(0, limit);
}

function requireRun(id: string): RunRow {
  const run = getRun(id);
  if (!run) throw new Error(`run not found: ${id}`);
  return run;
}

export function setPlan(id: string, tools: string[]): RunRow {
  requireRun(id);
  return db.update<RunRow>("runs", id, { plan: tools });
}

export function recordStep(id: string, step: RunStep): RunRow {
  const run = requireRun(id);
  return db.update<RunRow>("runs", id, { steps: [...run.steps, step] });
}

export function finishRun(id: string, brief: string): RunRow {
  requireRun(id);
  return db.update<RunRow>("runs", id, { status: "done", brief, finishedAt: new Date().toISOString() });
}

export function failRun(id: string, error: string): RunRow {
  requireRun(id);
  return db.update<RunRow>("runs", id, { status: "failed", error, finishedAt: new Date().toISOString() });
}
```

```typescript
import { complete } from "../gateway/complete";
import { retrieveNotes, rememberResults } from "../memory/retrieve";
import { syncContact } from "../outreach/crm-sync";
import { draftEmail } from "../outreach/draft-email";
import { deliver } from "../outreach/send";
import { loadConfig } from "../shared/config";
import { createLogger, type Logger } from "../shared/logger";
import type { NoteRow, RunRequest, RunResult, RunStep, ToolResult } from "../shared/types";
import { planRun } from "./planner";
import { failRun, finishRun, recordStep, setPlan, startRun } from "./run-state";
import { registry as defaultRegistry, type ToolRegistry } from "./tool-registry";

export const BRIEF_SYSTEM_PROMPT =
  "You write a research brief for a B2B sales rep: what the company is focused on right now, what changed recently, and one angle for the conversation. Five sentences at most.";

export interface AgentOptions {
  registry?: ToolRegistry;
  log?: Logger;
  maxSteps?: number;
}

function errorMessage(err: unknown): string {
  return err instanceof Error ? err.message : String(err);
}

function briefPrompt(request: RunRequest, results: ToolResult[], pastNotes: NoteRow[]): string {
  const findings = results
    .filter((r) => r.summary)
    .map((r) => `From ${r.tool}: ${r.summary}\n${r.facts.slice(0, 4).map((f) => `  - ${f}`).join("\n")}`);
  const earlier = pastNotes.map((n) => `- (${n.source}, ${n.createdAt.slice(0, 10)}) ${n.text.split("\n")[0]}`);
  return [
    `Company: ${request.company}.`,
    `Goal: ${request.goal}`,
    `Contact: ${request.contact.name ?? request.contact.email}${request.contact.title ? `, ${request.contact.title}` : ""}.`,
    "",
    "Findings:",
    ...(findings.length ? findings : ["(none)"]),
    "",
    "Earlier notes:",
    ...(earlier.length ? earlier : ["(none)"]),
  ].join("\n");
}

/**
 * One research run: sync the contact, recall earlier notes, plan, run up to
 * `maxSteps` tools, keep the findings, write the brief and draft the email.
 */
export async function runAgent(request: RunRequest, options: AgentOptions = {}): Promise<RunResult> {
  const config = loadConfig();
  const registry = options.registry ?? defaultRegistry;
  const maxSteps = Math.min(options.maxSteps ?? config.maxSteps, config.maxSteps);
  const run = startRun(request);
  const log = (options.log ?? createLogger("agent")).child(run.id);

  try {
    const contact = await syncContact(request.contact, request.company);
    const pastNotes = await retrieveNotes(request.company, request.goal, { runId: run.id });
    const plan = await planRun(request, { registry, runId: run.id, maxSteps });
    setPlan(
      run.id,
      plan.steps.map((s) => s.tool),
    );
    log.info("planned", { steps: plan.steps.map((s) => s.tool), pastNotes: pastNotes.length });

    const results: ToolResult[] = [];
    const steps: RunStep[] = [];
    for (const [i, planned] of plan.steps.entries()) {
      const tool = registry.get(planned.tool);
      let step: RunStep;
      if (!tool) {
        step = { index: i + 1, tool: planned.tool, status: "error", summary: "", error: "unknown tool" };
      } else {
        try {
          const result = await tool.run(
            { company: request.company, contact: request.contact, goal: request.goal },
            { runId: run.id, log: log.child(tool.name) },
          );
          results.push(result);
          step = { index: i + 1, tool: tool.name, status: "ok", summary: result.summary };
        } catch (err) {
          log.warn("tool failed", { tool: tool.name, error: errorMessage(err) });
          step = { index: i + 1, tool: tool.name, status: "error", summary: "", error: errorMessage(err) };
        }
      }
      recordStep(run.id, step);
      steps.push(step);
    }

    await rememberResults(run.id, request.company, results);

    const brief = await complete({
      purpose: "brief",
      runId: run.id,
      messages: [
        { role: "system", content: BRIEF_SYSTEM_PROMPT },
        { role: "user", content: briefPrompt(request, results, pastNotes) },
      ],
    });

    const draft = await draftEmail({ contact, company: request.company, goal: request.goal, brief: brief.text, runId: run.id });
    const delivery = await deliver(draft, contact, { runId: run.id, send: request.send ?? false });

    finishRun(run.id, brief.text);
    return {
      runId: run.id,
      company: request.company,
      brief: brief.text,
      steps,
      notesUsed: pastNotes.length,
      email: { ...draft, ...delivery },
    };
  } catch (err) {
    failRun(run.id, errorMessage(err));
    throw err;
  }
}
```

```typescript
import { createSdkMcpServer, tool } from '@anthropic-ai/claude-agent-sdk';
import { z } from 'zod';
import { planFootprint, withExtra, type PlanStep, type Violation } from '@harness/core';
import { listDecisions } from './decisions';
import type { Repo } from './repo';
import type { Bus } from './bus';

const text = (t: string) => ({ content: [{ type: 'text' as const, text: t }] });

export function violationText(vs: Violation[]): string {
  return vs.map((v) => `${v.reason}\n  (A) ${v.options[0]}\n  (B) ${v.options[1]}`).join('\n');
}

export const ASK_RULE =
  'Stop and ask the user to choose A or B, in one short message that names both options, then wait for the answer. ' +
  'Never work around a violation or try another route.';

export type PlanHooks = {
  /** Called after each submit_plan with its violations, so the session can track the fork. */
  onPlan(steps: PlanStep[], violations: Violation[]): void;
  /** Instructions queued for the next tool result (e.g. recording a decision in Alike). */
  takeNotes(): string[];
};

export function harnessTools(repo: Repo, bus: Bus, hooks: PlanHooks) {
  const cellName = (domain: string, layer: string) =>
    `${repo.map.domains.find((d) => d.id === domain)?.name ?? domain} · ${repo.map.layers.find((l) => l.id === layer)?.name ?? layer}`;

  return createSdkMcpServer({
    name: 'harness',
    version: '0.1.0',
    tools: [
      tool(
        'submit_plan',
        'Submit your implementation plan before editing anything. Numbered steps; each lists the exact repo-relative file paths it will create or modify, and every new import it adds as { from: path, to: path }. Returns the architecture footprint and any rule violations.',
        {
          steps: z.array(z.object({
            n: z.number().int(),
            text: z.string(),
            files: z.array(z.string()),
            imports: z.array(z.object({ from: z.string(), to: z.string() })).default([]),
          })),
        },
        async ({ steps }) => {
          const norm = (p: string) => repo.rel(p) ?? p.replace(/^\.\//, '');
          const clean: PlanStep[] = steps.map((s) => ({
            n: s.n, text: s.text, files: s.files.map(norm),
            imports: s.imports.map((i) => ({ from: norm(i.from), to: i.to.startsWith('.') ? i.to : norm(i.to) })),
          }));
          const exists = withExtra(repo.exists, clean.flatMap((s) => s.files));
          const fp = planFootprint(repo.map, clean, exists, repo.mapper);
          bus.emit('planned', {
            steps: clean,
            cells: fp.cells.map((c) => ({ domain: c.domain, layer: c.layer, steps: c.steps, files: c.files })),
            edges: fp.edges.map((e) => ({ from: e.from, to: e.to, steps: e.steps, imports: e.imports })),
            unassigned: fp.unassigned,
          });
          for (const v of fp.violations) bus.emit('plan_violation', { violation: v }, { path: v.file, cell: repo.cellOf(v.file) });
          hooks.onPlan(clean, fp.violations);

          const lines = [
            `Plan recorded: ${clean.length} step(s).`,
            `Cells: ${fp.cells.map((c) => `${cellName(c.domain, c.layer)} (steps ${c.steps.join(', ')})`).join('; ') || 'none'}.`,
            `New cross-domain dependencies: ${fp.edges.map((e) => `${e.from} → ${e.to}`).join('; ') || 'none'}.`,
          ];
          if (fp.unassigned.length) lines.push(`Files outside every domain: ${fp.unassigned.join(', ')}.`);
          if (fp.violations.length) {
            lines.push('', `VIOLATIONS (${fp.violations.length}):`, violationText(fp.violations), '', ASK_RULE + ' Do not exit plan mode until the user has answered and you have resubmitted the plan.');
          } else {
            lines.push('No violations. Exit plan mode when ready.');
          }
          const notes = hooks.takeNotes();
          if (notes.length) lines.push('', ...notes);
          return text(lines.join('\n'));
        },
        { alwaysLoad: true },
      ),
      tool('cell_for', 'Which domain × layer cell a repo path belongs to.', { path: z.string() }, async ({ path }) => {
        const rel = repo.rel(path) ?? path;
        const p = repo.place(rel);
        return text(p.kind === 'cell' ? `${rel} → ${cellName(p.domain, p.layer)} (${p.domain}/${p.layer})` : `${rel} → ${p.kind}${'domain' in p ? ` (${p.domain})` : ''}`);
      }, { alwaysLoad: true }),
      tool('domain', 'A domain: purpose, cells with their paths and tables, files, and the rules that involve it.', { id: z.string() }, async ({ id }) => {
        const d = repo.map.domains.find((x) => x.id === id || x.name.toLowerCase() === id.toLowerCase());
        if (!d) return text(`No domain "${id}". Domains: ${repo.map.domains.map((x) => x.id).join(', ')}`);
        const files = repo.facts.files.filter((f) => repo.mapper.domainOf(f) === d.id);
        const rules = repo.map.invariants.filter((i) => JSON.stringify(i).includes(`"${d.id}"`)).map((i) => `${i.id}: ${i.rule}`);
        return text(JSON.stringify({ id: d.id, name: d.name, purpose: d.purpose, cells: d.cells, files, rules }, null, 2));
      }),
      tool('who_writes', 'Which domain owns a table, and which files write it today.', { table: z.string() }, async ({ table }) => {
        const owner = repo.mapper.ownerOf(table);
        const writers = repo.facts.writes.filter((w) => w.table === table).map((w) => w.file);
        return text(JSON.stringify({ table, owner, writers }, null, 2));
      }),
      tool('decisions_for', 'Standing decisions whose anchors overlap these paths.', { paths: z.array(z.string()) }, async ({ paths }) => {
        const rel = paths.map((p) => repo.rel(p) ?? p);
        const all = listDecisions(repo.root);
        const hits = all.filter((d) => d.anchors.paths.some((a) => rel.some((p) => p === a || p.startsWith(a.replace(/\*\*?.*$/, '')))));
        return text(hits.length ? hits.map((d) => `${d.id}: ${d.title}\nOutcome: ${d.outcome}\nRejected: ${d.rejected}\n${d.rationale}`).join('\n\n') : 'No standing decisions for these paths.');
      }),
    ],
  });
}
```

```typescript
import { upsertContact } from "../../vendor/crm/index";
import { db } from "../shared/db";
import type { ContactInput, ContactRow } from "../shared/types";

function splitName(name: string | undefined): { firstname?: string; lastname?: string } {
  const parts = (name ?? "").trim().split(/\s+/).filter(Boolean);
  if (parts.length === 0) return {};
  return { firstname: parts[0], lastname: parts.slice(1).join(" ") || undefined };
}

/** Name from the address when we don't have one: "jane.doe@acme.com" -> "Jane Doe". */
export function nameFromEmail(email: string): string {
  const local = email.split("@")[0] ?? "";
  return local
    .split(/[._-]+/)
    .filter((p) => /^[a-z]+$/i.test(p))
    .map((p) => p.charAt(0).toUpperCase() + p.slice(1).toLowerCase())
    .join(" ");
}

export function contactByEmail(email: string): ContactRow | undefined {
  const normalized = email.toLowerCase().trim();
  return db.find<ContactRow>("contacts", (c) => c.email === normalized);
}

/** Upserts the contact in the CRM, then mirrors it into `contacts`. */
export async function syncContact(input: ContactInput, company: string): Promise<ContactRow> {
  const email = input.email.toLowerCase().trim();
  const existing = contactByEmail(email);
  const name = input.name?.trim() || existing?.name || nameFromEmail(email);

  const { contact } = await upsertContact({
    email,
    ...splitName(name),
    phone: input.phone,
    jobtitle: input.title,
    company,
  });

  const fields = {
    email,
    name,
    phone: input.phone ?? existing?.phone ?? null,
    title: input.title ?? existing?.title ?? null,
    company,
    crmId: contact.id,
    updatedAt: new Date().toISOString(),
  };

  if (existing) return db.update<ContactRow>("contacts", existing.id, fields);
  return db.insert("contacts", fields);
}
```

```typescript
  "You write the body of a short first-touch sales email: three or four sentences, one specific observation about the prospect from the brief, and a low-pressure ask for a call. No greeting and no sign-off.";

  contact: ContactRow;

  runId: string;

  return contact.name.split(/\s+/)[0] || "there";

export function subjectFor(company: string, goal: string): string {
  const lower = goal.toLowerCase();
  if (lower.includes("renewal")) return `Planning ahead for your renewal, ${company}`;
  if (lower.includes("expansion") || lower.includes("expand")) return `Supporting ${company}'s expansion`;
  return `A quick idea for ${company}`;
}

export async function draftEmail(input: DraftInput): Promise<EmailDraft> {
  const config = loadConfig();
  const completion = await complete({
    purpose: "email",
    runId: input.runId,
    messages: [
      { role: "system", content: EMAIL_SYSTEM_PROMPT },
      {

          `Prospect: ${input.company}`,
          `Recipient: ${input.contact.name}${input.contact.title ? `, ${input.contact.title}` : ""}`,
          `Goal: ${input.goal}`,
          "",
          `Brief: ${input.brief}`,
        ].join("\n"),
      },
    ],
  });

  const body = [`Hi ${firstName(input.contact)},`, "", completion.text.trim(), "", "Best,", config.senderName].join("\n");
  return { to: input.contact.email, subject: subjectFor(input.company, input.goal), body };
}
```

```typescript
import { db } from "../shared/db";
import type { OutreachRow } from "../shared/types";

export function logDraft(entry: { runId: string; contactId: string; subject: string; body: string }): OutreachRow {
  return db.insert("outreach_log", {
    ...entry,
    status: "drafted",
    messageId: null,
    createdAt: new Date().toISOString(),
    sentAt: null,
  } satisfies Omit<OutreachRow, "id">);
}

export function markSent(id: string, messageId: string): OutreachRow {
  return db.update<OutreachRow>("outreach_log", id, { status: "sent", messageId, sentAt: new Date().toISOString() });
}

/** Everything sent or drafted to a contact, newest first. */
export function historyFor(contactId: string): OutreachRow[] {
  return db
    .filter<OutreachRow>("outreach_log", (r) => r.contactId === contactId)
    .sort((a, b) => b.createdAt.localeCompare(a.createdAt) || b.id.localeCompare(a.id));
}

/** True if we emailed this contact within the last `days` days. */
export function contactedRecently(contactId: string, days: number, now = new Date()): boolean {
  const cutoff = now.getTime() - days * 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000;
  return historyFor(contactId).some((r) => r.status === "sent" && r.sentAt !== null && Date.parse(r.sentAt) >= cutoff);
}
```

```typescript
import { logEngagement } from "../../vendor/crm/index";
import { send } from "../../vendor/email/index";
import { loadConfig } from "../shared/config";
import type { ContactRow, Delivery, EmailDraft } from "../shared/types";
import { contactedRecently, logDraft, markSent } from "./outreach-log";

const COOL_OFF_DAYS = 7;

/**
 * Logs the draft, and sends it only when asked to. A contact emailed in the
 * last week gets a draft instead, so reruns don't double-send.
 */
export async function deliver(
  draft: EmailDraft,
  contact: ContactRow,
  options: { runId: string; send: boolean },
): Promise<Delivery> {
  const tooSoon = contactedRecently(contact.id, COOL_OFF_DAYS);
  const entry = logDraft({ runId: options.runId, contactId: contact.id, subject: draft.subject, body: draft.body });
  if (!options.send || tooSoon) return { status: "drafted", logId: entry.id };

  const config = loadConfig();
  const result = await send({
    to: draft.to,
    from: { email: config.fromAddress, name: config.senderName },
    subject: draft.subject,
    text: draft.body,
    categories: ["scout", "first-touch"],
  });
  markSent(entry.id, result.messageId);
  await logEngagement(contact.crmId, { type: "EMAIL", body: `${draft.subject}\n\n${draft.body}` });
  return { status: "sent", logId: entry.id, messageId: result.messageId };
}
```

```typescript
import type { ContactInput, RunRequest } from "../shared/types";

export type Validation<T> = { ok: true; value: T } | { ok: false; errors: string[] };

const EMAIL = /^[^\s@]+@[^\s@]+\.[^\s@]{2,}$/;
const PHONE = /^\+?[\d\s().-]{7,20}$/;

const LIMITS = {
  company: { min: 2, max: 120 },
  goal: { min: 5, max: 500 },
  name: { max: 120 },
  title: { max: 120 },
};

function isObject(value: unknown): value is Record<string, unknown> {
  return typeof value === "object" && value !== null && !Array.isArray(value);
}

function optionalString(
  source: Record<string, unknown>,
  key: string,
  max: number,
  errors: string[],
  path: string,
): string | undefined {
  const value = source[key];
  if (value === undefined || value === null || value === "") return undefined;
  if (typeof value !== "string") {
    errors.push(`${path}${key} must be a string`);
    return undefined;
  }
  const trimmed = value.trim();
  if (trimmed.length > max) errors.push(`${path}${key} must be at most ${max} characters`);
  return trimmed || undefined;
}

/** Accepts `"jane@acme.com"`, `"Jane Doe <jane@acme.com>"` or an object. */
export function parseContact(value: unknown, errors: string[]): ContactInput | undefined {
  if (typeof value === "string") {
    const angle = /^\s*(.*?)\s*<([^>]+)>\s*$/.exec(value);
    const email = (angle ? angle[2] : value)?.trim() ?? "";
    if (!EMAIL.test(email)) {
      errors.push("contact must be a valid email address");
      return undefined;
    }
    return { email: email.toLowerCase(), name: angle?.[1] || undefined };
  }
  if (!isObject(value)) {
    errors.push("contact is required");
    return undefined;
  }

  const email = typeof value.email === "string" ? value.email.trim().toLowerCase() : "";
  if (!EMAIL.test(email)) errors.push("contact.email must be a valid email address");
  const name = optionalString(value, "name", LIMITS.name.max, errors, "contact.");
  const title = optionalString(value, "title", LIMITS.title.max, errors, "contact.");
  const phone = optionalString(value, "phone", 20, errors, "contact.");
  if (phone && !PHONE.test(phone)) errors.push("contact.phone must be a phone number");
  return { email, name, title, phone };
}

export function validateRunRequest(body: unknown): Validation<RunRequest> {
  const errors: string[] = [];
  if (!isObject(body)) return { ok: false, errors: ["body must be a JSON object"] };

  const company = typeof body.company === "string" ? body.company.trim() : "";
  if (company.length < LIMITS.company.min || company.length > LIMITS.company.max) {
    errors.push(`company must be ${LIMITS.company.min}-${LIMITS.company.max} characters`);
  }

  const goal = typeof body.goal === "string" ? body.goal.trim() : "";
  if (goal.length < LIMITS.goal.min || goal.length > LIMITS.goal.max) {
    errors.push(`goal must be ${LIMITS.goal.min}-${LIMITS.goal.max} characters`);
  }

  const contact = parseContact(body.contact, errors);

  if (body.send !== undefined && typeof body.send !== "boolean") errors.push("send must be true or false");

  const unknown = Object.keys(body).filter((k) => !["company", "goal", "contact", "send"].includes(k));
  if (unknown.length) errors.push(`unknown field(s): ${unknown.join(", ")}`);

  if (errors.length > 0 || !contact) return { ok: false, errors };
  return { ok: true, value: { company, goal, contact, send: body.send === true } };
}
```

```typescript
import { createServer, type IncomingMessage, type Server, type ServerResponse } from "node:http";
import { pathToFileURL } from "node:url";
import { runAgent } from "../orchestrator/agent";
import { getRun, listRuns } from "../orchestrator/run-state";
import { loadConfig } from "../shared/config";
import { db } from "../shared/db";
import { createLogger } from "../shared/logger";
import { validateRunRequest } from "./validate";

const log = createLogger("http");
const MAX_BODY_BYTES = 64 * 1024;

class HttpError extends Error {
  constructor(
    readonly status: number,
    message: string,
    readonly details?: unknown,
  ) {
    super(message);
  }
}

function send(res: ServerResponse, status: number, body: unknown): void {
  const payload = JSON.stringify(body);
  res.writeHead(status, { "content-type": "application/json; charset=utf-8", "content-length": Buffer.byteLength(payload) });
  res.end(payload);
}

async function readJson(req: IncomingMessage): Promise<unknown> {
  const chunks: Buffer[] = [];
  let size = 0;
  for await (const chunk of req) {
    size += (chunk as Buffer).length;
    if (size > MAX_BODY_BYTES) throw new HttpError(413, "request body too large");
    chunks.push(chunk as Buffer);
  }
  if (size === 0) return undefined;
  try {
    return JSON.parse(Buffer.concat(chunks).toString("utf8"));
  } catch {
    throw new HttpError(400, "body is not valid JSON");
  }
}

function persist(): void {
  const path = loadConfig().snapshotPath;
  if (path) db.snapshot(path);
}

async function handle(req: IncomingMessage, res: ServerResponse): Promise<void> {
  const url = new URL(req.url ?? "/", "http://localhost");
  const method = req.method ?? "GET";

  if (method === "GET" && url.pathname === "/health") {
    return send(res, 200, { ok: true });
  }

  if (url.pathname === "/runs") {
    if (method === "GET") return send(res, 200, { runs: listRuns(Number(url.searchParams.get("limit") ?? 20)) });
    if (method !== "POST") throw new HttpError(405, "method not allowed");
    const parsed = validateRunRequest(await readJson(req));
    if (!parsed.ok) throw new HttpError(400, "invalid request", parsed.errors);
    const result = await runAgent(parsed.value);
    persist();
    return send(res, 201, result);
  }

  const match = /^\/runs\/([\w-]+)$/.exec(url.pathname);
  if (match && method === "GET") {
    const run = getRun(match[1] ?? "");
    if (!run) throw new HttpError(404, "run not found");
    return send(res, 200, run);
  }

  throw new HttpError(404, "not found");
}

export function createScoutServer(): Server {
  return createServer((req, res) => {
    handle(req, res).catch((err: unknown) => {
      if (err instanceof HttpError) {
        send(res, err.status, { error: err.message, ...(err.details ? { details: err.details } : {}) });
        return;
      }
      log.error("request failed", { url: req.url, error: err instanceof Error ? err.message : String(err) });
      send(res, 500, { error: "internal error" });
    });
  });
}

export async function start(port = loadConfig().port): Promise<Server> {
  const snapshot = loadConfig().snapshotPath;
  if (snapshot && db.restore(snapshot)) log.info("restored snapshot", { path: snapshot });
  const server = createScoutServer();
  await new Promise<void>((resolve) => server.listen(port, resolve));
  log.warn(`scout listening on http://localhost:${port}`);
  return server;
}

if (process.argv[1] && import.meta.url === pathToFileURL(process.argv[1]).href) {
  start().catch((err: unknown) => {
    log.error("failed to start", { error: err instanceof Error ? err.message : String(err) });
    process.exitCode = 1;
  });
}
```

```typescript
import { join } from 'node:path';
import { randomUUID } from 'node:crypto';
import {
  query, type Query, type SDKUserMessage, type HookCallback, type PreToolUseHookInput, type PostToolUseHookInput,
  type CanUseTool, type PermissionResult, type McpServerConfig,
} from '@anthropic-ai/claude-agent-sdk';
import { applyEdit, deltaForEdit, check, withExtra, type PlanStep, type Violation } from '@harness/core';
import { harnessTools, violationText, ASK_RULE } from './harness-tools';
import { listDecisions, parseOption, recordFork } from './decisions';
import { baseline, numstat, type Baseline } from './git';
import type { Repo } from './repo';
import type { Bus } from './bus';

const PLAN_RULES = [
  'Explore read-only, briefly. Then, before editing anything, call mcp__harness__submit_plan with numbered steps.',
  'Each step lists the exact repo-relative file paths it will create or modify, and every new import it adds as { from: path, to: path }.',
  'If the result contains violations: ' + ASK_RULE,
  'After the user answers, resubmit the plan with mcp__harness__submit_plan, then call ExitPlanMode.',
  'If there are no violations, call ExitPlanMode with a short plan.',
].join('\n');

/** Push-based prompt stream fed by the chat pane. */
class Inbox implements AsyncIterable<SDKUserMessage> {
  private queue: SDKUserMessage[] = [];
  private wake: (() => void) | null = null;
  push(text: string) {
    this.queue.push({ type: 'user', message: { role: 'user', content: text }, parent_tool_use_id: null });
    this.wake?.();
  }
  async *[Symbol.asyncIterator]() {
    while (true) {
      while (this.queue.length) yield this.queue.shift()!;
      await new Promise<void>((r) => (this.wake = r));
      this.wake = null;
    }
  }
}

type Turn = {
  id: string;
  prompt: string;
  base: Baseline;
  planned: boolean;
  steps: PlanStep[];
  planViolations: Violation[]; // from the latest submit_plan
  gateBlocks: Violation[]; // since the last answer
  forkOpen: Violation[] | null; // asked, awaiting the user's A/B
  lastText: string;
};

export type Ephemeral = (msg: { type: 'delta'; text: string } | { type: 'busy'; busy: boolean }) => void;

export class Session {
  private inbox = new Inbox();
  private q: Query | null = null;
  private turn: Turn | null = null;
  private approval: { resolve: (r: PermissionResult) => void; input: Record<string, unknown> } | null = null;
  private notes: string[] = [];
  busy = false;

  constructor(private repo: Repo, private bus: Bus, private ephemeral: Ephemeral) {}

  brief(): string {
    const m = this.repo.map;
    const domains = m.domains.map((d) => {
      const cells = Object.entries(d.cells).map(([layer, c]) => `    ${layer}: ${[...(c.paths ?? []), ...(c.tables ?? []).map((t) => `table ${t}`)].join(', ')}`);
      return `- ${d.name} (${d.id}): ${d.purpose}\n${cells.join('\n')}`;
    });
    const decisions = listDecisions(this.repo.root).map((d) =>
      `- ${d.id}: ${d.title}\n  Outcome: ${d.outcome}\n  Rejected: ${d.rejected}\n  ${d.rationale.replace(/\n+/g, '\n  ')}`);
    // Seeded invariants are deliberately not listed (SPEC §6): they are enforced at plan and edit time.
    return [
      '# Harness',
      'You are working inside Harness, which shows the user a live domain × layer map of this repo and checks every plan and edit against its architecture rules.',
      '',
      '## Map (domains.yaml)',
      `Layers: ${m.layers.map((l) => l.id).join(', ')}`,
      ...domains,
      '',
      '## Standing decisions the user has made',
      decisions.length ? decisions.join('\n') : '(none yet)',
      '',
      '## Rules',
      PLAN_RULES,
      'If an edit is denied with options A and B: ' + ASK_RULE,
    ].join('\n');
  }

  start() {
    const alike: Record<string, McpServerConfig> = process.env.HARNESS_ALIKE === '0' ? {} : { alike: { type: 'http', url: 'https://alike.network/api-general/mcp' } };
    this.q = query({
      prompt: this.inbox,
      options: {
        cwd: this.repo.root,
        permissionMode: 'plan',
        planModeInstructions: PLAN_RULES,
        // User settings carry Alike's own hooks (network calls); keep the hot path deterministic. See VERIFY.md.
        settingSources: ['project', 'local'],
        strictMcpConfig: true,
        systemPrompt: { type: 'preset', preset: 'claude_code', append: this.brief() },
        mcpServers: {
          harness: harnessTools(this.repo, this.bus, {
            onPlan: (steps, violations) => this.onPlan(steps, violations),
            takeNotes: () => this.notes.splice(0),
          }),
          ...alike,
        },
        allowedTools: ['mcp__harness__*', 'mcp__alike__record_decision', 'mcp__alike__resolve_work_item', 'mcp__alike__describe_entity_kind'],
        disallowedTools: ['AskUserQuestion'],
        includePartialMessages: true,
        hooks: {
          PreToolUse: [
            { matcher: 'Read|Grep|Glob', hooks: [this.observeRead] },
            { matcher: 'Edit|Write', hooks: [this.gate] },
          ],
          PostToolUse: [
            { matcher: 'Edit|Write', hooks: [this.afterEdit] },
            { matcher: 'mcp__alike__record_decision', hooks: [this.afterAlike] },
          ],
        },
        canUseTool: this.canUseTool,
        stderr: (d) => { if (process.env.HARNESS_DEBUG) process.stderr.write(d); },
      },
    });
    void this.loop();
  }

  private async loop() {
    try {
      for await (const m of this.q!) {
        if (m.type === 'stream_event') {
          const ev = m.event as { type: string; delta?: { type: string; text?: string } };
          if (ev.type === 'content_block_delta' && ev.delta?.type === 'text_delta' && ev.delta.text) this.ephemeral({ type: 'delta', text: ev.delta.text });
        } else if (m.type === 'assistant' && !m.parent_tool_use_id) {
          const t = m.message.content.filter((b) => b.type === 'text').map((b) => (b as { text: string }).text).join('\n').trim();
          if (t) {
            this.bus.emit('chat', { role: 'assistant', text: t });
            if (this.turn) this.turn.lastText = t;
          }
        } else if (m.type === 'result') {
          this.onResult(m.subtype);
        }
      }
    } catch (e) {
      this.bus.emit('error', { message: `Session ended: ${(e as Error).message}` });
    }
  }

  // ---------------------------------------------------------------- chat input

  userMessage(text: string) {
    const t = text.trim();
    if (!t) return;
    if (this.approval) {
      this.bus.emit('chat', { role: 'user', text: t });
      if (/^(approve|approved|lgtm|yes|ok|go|ship it)\b/i.test(t)) this.approve();
      else this.rejectPlan(t);
      return;
    }
    if (this.turn?.forkOpen) {
      const violations = this.turn.forkOpen;
      const option = parseOption(t);
      this.bus.emit('chat', { role: 'user', text: t });
      this.bus.emit('fork_answered', { option, text: t, violations });
      this.turn.forkOpen = null;
      this.turn.planViolations = [];
      this.turn.gateBlocks = [];
      const { decisions, alikeInstruction } = recordFork(this.repo, this.bus, violations, option, t, this.turn.prompt);
      if (alikeInstruction && process.env.HARNESS_ALIKE !== '0') this.notes.push(alikeInstruction);
      const ids = decisions.map((d) => d.id).join(', ');
      this.send(`${t}\n\n[Harness: recorded as ${ids || 'a decision'} in decisions/ and domains.yaml. ` +
        (option === 'B' ? `${violations[0]?.file} is now an exception. ` : '') +
        'Resubmit the plan with mcp__harness__submit_plan, then exit plan mode.]');
      return;
    }
    if (!this.turn) this.startTurn(t);
    this.bus.emit('chat', { role: 'user', text: t });
    this.send(t);
  }

  private send(text: string) {
    this.busy = true;
    this.ephemeral({ type: 'busy', busy: true });
    this.inbox.push(text);
  }

  private startTurn(prompt: string) {
    const id = `t${randomUUID().slice(0, 6)}`;
    this.turn = { id, prompt, base: baseline(this.repo.root), planned: false, steps: [], planViolations: [], gateBlocks: [], forkOpen: null, lastText: '' };
    this.bus.turn = id;
    this.bus.emit('turn_started', { prompt, head: this.turn.base.head, baseline: this.turn.base.snapshot });
  }

  approve() {
    if (!this.approval) return;
    const { resolve, input } = this.approval;
    this.approval = null;
    this.bus.emit('plan_approved', {} as never);
    resolve({ behavior: 'allow', updatedInput: input });
    void this.q?.setPermissionMode('acceptEdits');
  }

  private rejectPlan(feedback: string) {
    if (!this.approval) return;
    const { resolve } = this.approval;
    this.approval = null;
    resolve({ behavior: 'deny', message: `The user did not approve the plan yet. Their feedback: ${feedback}` });
  }

  private onPlan(steps: PlanStep[], violations: Violation[]) {
    if (!this.turn) return;
    this.turn.planned = true;
    this.turn.steps = steps;
    this.turn.planViolations = violations;
  }

  private onResult(subtype: string) {
    this.busy = false;
    this.ephemeral({ type: 'busy', busy: false });
    const turn = this.turn;
    if (!turn) return;
    if (subtype !== 'success') this.bus.emit('error', { message: `Turn ended with ${subtype}` });
    const open = [...turn.planViolations, ...turn.gateBlocks];
    if (open.length && subtype === 'success') {
      // Claude stopped to ask: the turn stays open until the user answers.
      turn.forkOpen = open;
      this.bus.emit('fork_asked', { violations: open, text: turn.lastText });
      return;
    }
    this.endTurn(subtype);
  }

  private endTurn(reason: string) {
    const turn = this.turn!;
    const stat = numstat(this.repo.root, turn.base);
    this.bus.emit('turn_ended', { ...stat, reason });
    const events = this.bus.events.filter((e) => e.turn === turn.id);
    writeFileSync(join(this.repo.root, '.harness/turns', `${turn.id}.json`), JSON.stringify({ id: turn.id, prompt: turn.prompt, baseline: turn.base, steps: turn.steps, numstat: stat, events }, null, 2));
    this.turn = null;
    this.bus.turn = null;
    this.repo.recheck();
    void this.q?.setPermissionMode('plan');
  }

  // ---------------------------------------------------------------- hooks

  private observeRead: HookCallback = async (input) => {
    const i = input as PreToolUseHookInput;
    const ti = i.tool_input as { file_path?: string; path?: string };
    if (i.tool_name === 'Read' && ti.file_path) {
      const rel = this.repo.rel(ti.file_path);
      if (rel) this.bus.emit('looked', { tool: 'Read' }, { path: rel, cell: this.repo.cellOf(rel) });
    } else {
      const rel = this.repo.rel(ti.path ?? this.repo.root);
      if (rel) this.bus.emit('cursor', { verb: 'searching' }, { path: rel, cell: this.repo.cellOf(rel) ?? this.repo.cellForDir(rel) });
    }
    return { async: true };
  };

  /** The edit gate: same checker as load and plan, on the imports/writes this edit would add. */
  private gate: HookCallback = async (input) => {
    const i = input as PreToolUseHookInput;
    const ti = i.tool_input as { file_path?: string; content?: string; old_string?: string; new_string?: string; replace_all?: boolean };
    if (!ti.file_path) return {};
    const rel = this.repo.rel(ti.file_path);
    if (!rel) return {}; // outside the repo, e.g. Claude's own plan file
    const old = this.repo.current(rel);
    let next: string;
    try {
      next = i.tool_name === 'Write' ? ti.content ?? '' : applyEdit(old ?? '', ti.old_string ?? '', ti.new_string ?? '', ti.replace_all);
    } catch {
      return {}; // the Edit will fail on its own
    }
    const delta = deltaForEdit(rel, old, next, withExtra(this.repo.exists, [rel]));
    const violations = check(this.repo.map, delta, this.repo.mapper);
    this.bus.emit('cursor', { verb: 'editing' }, { path: rel, cell: this.repo.cellOf(rel) });
    if (!violations.length) {
      this.repo.markPending(rel);
      return {};
    }
    for (const v of violations) this.bus.emit('gate_blocked', { violation: v, tool: i.tool_name }, { path: rel, cell: this.repo.cellOf(rel) });
    this.turn?.gateBlocks.push(...violations);
    return {
      hookSpecificOutput: {
        hookEventName: 'PreToolUse',
        permissionDecision: 'deny',
        permissionDecisionReason: `Harness blocked this edit.\n${violationText(violations)}\n${ASK_RULE}`,
      },
    };
  };

  private afterEdit: HookCallback = async (input) => {
    const i = input as PostToolUseHookInput;
    const ti = i.tool_input as { file_path?: string };
    const rel = ti.file_path ? this.repo.rel(ti.file_path) : null;
    if (rel) setImmediate(() => this.repo.fileChanged(rel, { tool: i.tool_name }));
    return { async: true };
  };

  private afterAlike: HookCallback = async (input) => {
    const i = input as PostToolUseHookInput;
    const res = JSON.stringify(i.tool_response ?? '');
    const ids = new Set(JSON.stringify(i.tool_input).match(/DR-\d+/g) ?? []);
    if (/error|failed|unauthori[sz]ed/i.test(res) && !/"id"/.test(res)) return { async: true };
    for (const d of this.bus.events.filter((e) => e.kind === 'decision_recorded')) {
      const data = d.data as { id: string };
      if (ids.has(data.id)) this.bus.emit('decision_recorded', { ...(d.data as never), alike: true });
    }
    return { async: true };
  };

  private canUseTool: CanUseTool = async (name, input) => {
    if (name === 'ExitPlanMode') {
      const turn = this.turn;
      if (turn && !turn.planned) {
        return { behavior: 'deny', message: 'Call mcp__harness__submit_plan with your numbered steps before exiting plan mode.' };
      }
      if (turn?.planViolations.length) {
        return { behavior: 'deny', message: `The plan has unresolved violations.\n${violationText(turn.planViolations)}\n${ASK_RULE}` };
      }
      const plan = String((input as { plan?: unknown }).plan ?? '');
      this.bus.emit('approval_requested', { plan });
      return new Promise<PermissionResult>((resolve) => { this.approval = { resolve, input }; });
    }
    return { behavior: 'allow', updatedInput: input };
  };

  interrupt() { void this.q?.interrupt(); }
}
```

```typescript
import { parseArgs } from "node:util";
import { runAgent } from "../orchestrator/agent";
import { loadConfig } from "../shared/config";
import { db } from "../shared/db";
import type { RunResult } from "../shared/types";
import { validateRunRequest } from "./validate";

const USAGE = `Usage: npm run scout -- --company <name> --contact <email> --goal "<goal>" [options]

Options:
  --name <name>     contact's full name
  --title <title>   contact's job title
  --phone <phone>   contact's phone number
  --send            send the drafted email (default: draft only)
  --json            print the full result as JSON
  -h, --help        show this message`;

function printResult(result: RunResult): void {
  const line = "-".repeat(60);
  console.log(`\nRun ${result.runId}: ${result.company}`);
  console.log(line);
  for (const step of result.steps) {
    console.log(`${step.index}. ${step.tool.padEnd(18)} ${step.status === "ok" ? "ok" : `failed: ${step.error}`}`);
  }
  console.log(`${line}\nBrief\n${line}\n${result.brief}`);
  console.log(`${line}\nEmail (${result.email.status}) to ${result.email.to}\n${line}`);
  console.log(`Subject: ${result.email.subject}\n\n${result.email.body}`);
  if (result.notesUsed > 0) console.log(`\n(used ${result.notesUsed} note(s) from earlier runs)`);
}

export async function main(argv = process.argv.slice(2)): Promise<number> {
  const { values } = parseArgs({
    args: argv,
    options: {
      company: { type: "string" },
      contact: { type: "string" },
      goal: { type: "string" },
      name: { type: "string" },
      title: { type: "string" },
      phone: { type: "string" },
      send: { type: "boolean", default: false },
      json: { type: "boolean", default: false },
      help: { type: "boolean", short: "h", default: false },
    },
    strict: true,
  });

  if (values.help) {
    console.log(USAGE);
    return 0;
  }

  const parsed = validateRunRequest({
    company: values.company,
    goal: values.goal,
    contact: { email: values.contact, name: values.name, title: values.title, phone: values.phone },
    send: values.send,
  });
  if (!parsed.ok) {
    console.error(`${parsed.errors.map((e) => `error: ${e}`).join("\n")}\n\n${USAGE}`);
    return 2;
  }

  const snapshot = loadConfig().snapshotPath;
  if (snapshot) db.restore(snapshot);
  const result = await runAgent(parsed.value);
  if (snapshot) db.snapshot(snapshot);

  if (values.json) console.log(JSON.stringify(result, null, 2));
  else printResult(result);
  return 0;
}

main().then(
  (code) => {
    process.exitCode = code;
  },
  (err: unknown) => {
    console.error(err instanceof Error ? err.message : err);
    process.exitCode = 1;
  },
);
```
