```typescript
import { cellKey, type DomainMap, type EdgeView, type ImportEdge, type TurnState, type UIState, type Violation } from '@harness/core/view';

export type Rect = { x: number; y: number; w: number; h: number };

export type GridLayout = {
  width: number;
  height: number;
  labelW: number;
  headerH: number;
  gapX: number;
  gapY: number;
  colW: number;
  rowH: number;
  cols: { id: string; name: string; purpose: string; x: number; index: number }[];
  rows: { id: string; name: string; y: number; index: number }[];
  cells: Record<string, Rect & { col: number; row: number }>;
  unassigned: Rect | null;
};

/** Fixed grid: a gutter on both sides of every column and row, so edges can route around cells. */
export function gridLayout(map: DomainMap, size: { w: number; h: number }, withUnassigned: boolean): GridLayout {
  const labelW = 64;
  const headerH = 46;
  const n = map.domains.length + (withUnassigned ? 1 : 0);
  const r = map.layers.length;
  const gapX = Math.max(28, Math.min(44, size.w * 0.032));
  const gapY = 26;
  const colW = Math.max(96, (size.w - labelW - gapX * (n + 1)) / n);
  const rowH = Math.max(72, Math.min(150, (size.h - headerH - gapY * (r + 1)) / r));
  const colX = (i: number) => labelW + gapX + i * (colW + gapX);
  const rowY = (j: number) => headerH + gapY + j * (rowH + gapY);
  const cols = map.domains.map((d, i) => ({ id: d.id, name: d.name, purpose: d.purpose, x: colX(i), index: i }));
  const rows = map.layers.map((l, j) => ({ id: l.id, name: l.name, y: rowY(j), index: j }));
  const cells: GridLayout['cells'] = {};
  map.domains.forEach((d, i) => {
    map.layers.forEach((l, j) => {
      if (l.id in d.cells) cells[cellKey({ domain: d.id, layer: l.id })] = { x: colX(i), y: rowY(j), w: colW, h: rowH, col: i, row: j };
    });
  });
  const unassigned = withUnassigned ? { x: colX(n - 1), y: rowY(0), w: colW, h: rowY(r - 1) + rowH - rowY(0) } : null;
  if (withUnassigned) cols.push({ id: '__unassigned', name: 'Unassigned', purpose: 'Files that match no cell in domains.yaml', x: colX(n - 1), index: n - 1 });
  return {
    width: labelW + gapX * (n + 1) + colW * n,
    height: headerH + gapY * (r + 1) + rowH * r,
    labelW, headerH, gapX, gapY, colW, rowH, cols, rows, cells, unassigned,
  };
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------- edges

export type EdgeSegment = {
  key: string; // stable React key
  edgeKey: string; // `${from}->${to}`
  pair: string; // `${srcCell}=>${dstCell}`
  from: string;
  to: string;
  src: string; // cellKey
  dst: string; // cellKey
  state: EdgeView['state'];
  violation: boolean;
  steps: number[];
  files: ImportEdge[];
};

/** Which cell a file sits in: its placement, else the cell a plan put it in. */
function cellForFile(s: UIState, turn: TurnState | null, file: string): string | null {
  const p = s.files[file];
  if (p?.kind === 'cell') return cellKey(p);
  const planned = turn && Object.values(turn.planned).find((c) => c.files.includes(file));
  return planned ? cellKey(planned.cell) : null;
}

function fallbackCell(map: DomainMap, domain: string): string | null {
  const d = map.domains.find((x) => x.id === domain);
  const layer = d && map.layers.find((l) => l.id in d.cells);
  return d && layer ? cellKey({ domain, layer: layer.id }) : null;
}

/**
 * Splits each domain edge from `edgeViews` into one segment per (source cell, target cell) pair, so a gateway
 * bypass to the provider (tools·logic → gateway·external) is drawn apart from calls to complete() (→ gateway·logic).
 * The edge's `violation` flag is kept only on the segments whose files are the violating imports.
 */
export function edgeSegments(s: UIState, turn: TurnState | null, edges: EdgeView[]): EdgeSegment[] {
  const map = s.map;
  if (!map) return [];
  const out: EdgeSegment[] = [];
  for (const e of edges) {
    const groups = new Map<string, { src: string; dst: string; files: ImportEdge[] }>();
    for (const f of e.files.length ? e.files : [{ from: '', to: '' }]) {
      const src = (f.from && cellForFile(s, turn, f.from)) || fallbackCell(map, e.from);
      const dst = (f.to && cellForFile(s, turn, f.to)) || fallbackCell(map, e.to);
      if (!src || !dst) continue;
      const k = `${src}=>${dst}`;
      const g = groups.get(k) ?? { src, dst, files: [] };
      if (f.from) g.files.push(f);
      groups.set(k, g);
    }
    const list: Violation[] = e.state === 'ghost' ? turn?.planViolations ?? [] : s.violations;
    for (const [pair, g] of groups) {
      const violation = e.violation && (groups.size === 1 || g.files.some((f) => list.some((v) => v.file === f.from && (!v.target || v.target === f.to))));
      const edgeKey = `${e.from}->${e.to}`;
      out.push({ key: `${e.state}:${pair}`, edgeKey, pair, from: e.from, to: e.to, src: g.src, dst: g.dst, state: e.state, violation, steps: e.steps, files: g.files });
    }
  }
  // Existing edges first, then new, then ghosts: lanes are assigned in this order and stay stable as a turn adds edges.
  const rank = { existing: 0, new: 1, ghost: 2 } as const;
  return out.sort((a, b) => rank[a.state] - rank[b.state] || a.key.localeCompare(b.key));
}

type Pt = [number, number];

/** Alternating lane offsets around a gutter's center: 0, +s, −s, +2s, … */
const lane = (i: number, s: number) => (i === 0 ? 0 : (i % 2 ? 1 : -1) * Math.ceil(i / 2) * s);

export type RoutedSegment = EdgeSegment & { d: string; length: number };

/** Orthogonal routes through the gutters, with a separate lane per segment in every gutter it uses. */
export function routeEdges(L: GridLayout, segs: EdgeSegment[]): RoutedSegment[] {
  const used = new Map<string, number>();
  const take = (k: string) => {
    const n = used.get(k) ?? 0;
    used.set(k, n + 1);
    return n;
  };
  const colGutterX = (g: number) => L.labelW + g * (L.colW + L.gapX) + L.gapX / 2;
  const rowGutterY = (g: number) => L.headerH + g * (L.rowH + L.gapY) + L.gapY / 2;
  const laneX = Math.min(7, L.gapX / 6);
  const laneY = Math.min(6, L.gapY / 5);
  const out: RoutedSegment[] = [];

  for (const seg of segs) {
    const S = L.cells[seg.src];
    const T = L.cells[seg.dst];
    if (!S || !T || S === T) continue;
    const dir = T.col > S.col ? 1 : T.col < S.col ? -1 : 0;
    let pts: Pt[];
    const sideY = (c: typeof S, side: string) => c.y + c.h / 2 + lane(take(`port:${seg.src === side ? '' : ''}${side}`), 9);
    if (dir === 0) {
      // Same column (only possible for odd placements): loop out through the right gutter.
      const gx = colGutterX(S.col + 1) + lane(take(`col:${S.col + 1}`), laneX);
      const ey = sideY(S, `${seg.src}:r`);
      const ty = sideY(T, `${seg.dst}:r`);
      pts = [[S.x + S.w, ey], [gx, ey], [gx, ty], [T.x + T.w, ty]];
    } else {
      const sx = dir > 0 ? S.x + S.w : S.x;
      const tx = dir > 0 ? T.x : T.x + T.w;
      const gS = dir > 0 ? S.col + 1 : S.col;
      const gT = dir > 0 ? T.col : T.col + 1;
      const ey = sideY(S, `${seg.src}:${dir > 0 ? 'r' : 'l'}`);
      const ty = sideY(T, `${seg.dst}:${dir > 0 ? 'l' : 'r'}`);
      if (gS === gT) {
        if (S.row === T.row) {
          const y = (ey + ty) / 2;
          pts = [[sx, y], [tx, y]];
        } else {
          const gx = colGutterX(gS) + lane(take(`col:${gS}`), laneX);
          pts = [[sx, ey], [gx, ey], [gx, ty], [tx, ty]];
        }
      } else {
        let rg: number;
        if (T.row > S.row) rg = S.row + 1;
        else if (T.row < S.row) rg = S.row;
        else rg = (used.get(`row:${S.row + 1}`) ?? 0) <= (used.get(`row:${S.row}`) ?? 0) ? S.row + 1 : S.row;
        const gy = rowGutterY(rg) + lane(take(`row:${rg}`), laneY);
        const gx1 = colGutterX(gS) + lane(take(`col:${gS}`), laneX);
        const gx2 = colGutterX(gT) + lane(take(`col:${gT}`), laneX);
        pts = [[sx, ey], [gx1, ey], [gx1, gy], [gx2, gy], [gx2, ty], [tx, ty]];
      }
    }
    const { d, length } = roundedPath(pts, 7);
    out.push({ ...seg, d, length });
  }
  return out;
}

function roundedPath(pts: Pt[], r: number) {
  let length = 0;
  for (let i = 1; i < pts.length; i++) length += Math.hypot(pts[i]![0] - pts[i - 1]![0], pts[i]![1] - pts[i - 1]![1]);
  let d = `M${pts[0]![0].toFixed(1)},${pts[0]![1].toFixed(1)}`;
  for (let i = 1; i < pts.length - 1; i++) {
    const [px, py] = pts[i - 1]!;
    const [cx, cy] = pts[i]!;
    const [nx, ny] = pts[i + 1]!;
    const d1 = Math.hypot(cx - px, cy - py);
    const d2 = Math.hypot(nx - cx, ny - cy);
    const rr = Math.min(r, d1 / 2, d2 / 2);
    if (rr < 0.5) {
      d += `L${cx.toFixed(1)},${cy.toFixed(1)}`;
      continue;
    }
    const ax = cx - ((cx - px) / d1) * rr;
    const ay = cy - ((cy - py) / d1) * rr;
    const bx = cx + ((nx - cx) / d2) * rr;
    const by = cy + ((ny - cy) / d2) * rr;
    d += `L${ax.toFixed(1)},${ay.toFixed(1)}Q${cx.toFixed(1)},${cy.toFixed(1)} ${bx.toFixed(1)},${by.toFixed(1)}`;
  }
  const last = pts[pts.length - 1]!;
  d += `L${last[0].toFixed(1)},${last[1].toFixed(1)}`;
  return { d, length };
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------- invariants

/** Glob → RegExp for the subset domains.yaml uses (`**`, `*`, `?`). */
export function globRe(glob: string): RegExp {
  let re = '';
  for (let i = 0; i < glob.length; i++) {
    const c = glob[i]!;
    if (c === '*' && glob[i + 1] === '*') {
      if (glob[i + 2] === '/') { re += '(?:.*/)?'; i += 2; } else { re += '.*'; i++; }
    } else if (c === '*') re += '[^/]*';
    else if (c === '?') re += '[^/]';
    else re += c.replace(/[.+^${}()|[\]\\]/g, '\\$&');
  }
  return new RegExp(`^${re}$`);
}

/** Invariants that involve a domain (and, for `only_via`, files of a given cell). */
export function invariantsFor(map: DomainMap, domain: string, files: string[]) {
  return map.invariants.filter((inv) => {
    if (inv.kind === 'only_via') return inv.allowed_from.includes(domain) || files.some((f) => inv.targets.some((t) => globRe(t).test(f)));
    if (inv.kind === 'owns_writes') return Object.values(inv.owners).includes(domain);
    return inv.from === domain || inv.to === domain;
  });
}
```

```typescript
import { useEffect, useRef, useState } from 'react';

export const reducedMotion = () => typeof matchMedia !== 'undefined' && matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)').matches;

/** Counts up (or down) to `value` over ~400 ms whenever it changes. */
export function useTween(value: number, ms = 400): number {
  const [shown, setShown] = useState(value);
  const from = useRef(value);
  useEffect(() => {
    if (reducedMotion() || from.current === value) {
      from.current = value;
      setShown(value);
      return;
    }
    const start = performance.now();
    const a = from.current;
    let raf = 0;
    const step = (now: number) => {
      const k = Math.min(1, (now - start) / ms);
      const eased = 1 - (1 - k) ** 3;
      setShown(Math.round(a + (value - a) * eased));
      if (k < 1) raf = requestAnimationFrame(step);
      else from.current = value;
    };
    raf = requestAnimationFrame(step);
    return () => {
      cancelAnimationFrame(raf);
      from.current = value;
    };
  }, [value, ms]);
  return shown;
}

/** True for a moment after `key` changes (not on mount). */
export function useFlash(key: unknown, ms = 650): boolean {
  const [on, setOn] = useState(false);
  const first = useRef(true);
  useEffect(() => {
    if (first.current) {
      first.current = false;
      return;
    }
    setOn(true);
    const t = setTimeout(() => setOn(false), ms);
    return () => clearTimeout(t);
  }, [key, ms]);
  return on;
}

export function useSize<T extends HTMLElement>() {
  const ref = useRef<T>(null);
  const [size, setSize] = useState({ w: 0, h: 0 });
  useEffect(() => {
    const el = ref.current;
    if (!el) return;
    const ro = new ResizeObserver(([e]) => {
      if (e) setSize({ w: e.contentRect.width, h: e.contentRect.height });
    });
    ro.observe(el);
    return () => ro.disconnect();
  }, []);
  return [ref, size] as const;
}
```

import { Fragment, type ReactNode } from 'react';

/** Just enough markdown for chat: fenced code, headings, lists, paragraphs, `code`, **bold**, *italic*. */
export function Markdown({ text }: { text: string }) {
  const blocks: ReactNode[] = [];
  const lines = text.replace(/\r\n/g, '\n').split('\n');
  let i = 0;
  let key = 0;
  while (i < lines.length) {
    const line = lines[i]!;
    const fence = line.match(/^\s*```(\w*)/);
    if (fence) {
      const body: string[] = [];
      i++;
      while (i < lines.length && !/^\s*```/.test(lines[i]!)) body.push(lines[i++]!);
      i++;
      blocks.push(<pre key={key++} className="md-pre"><code>{body.join('\n')}</code></pre>);
      continue;
    }
    if (!line.trim()) { i++; continue; }
    const heading = line.match(/^(#{1,4})\s+(.*)/);
    if (heading) {
      blocks.push(<p key={key++} className="md-h">{inline(heading[2]!)}</p>);
      i++;
      continue;
    }
    if (/^\s*([-*]|\d+[.)])\s+/.test(line)) {
      const ordered = /^\s*\d+[.)]/.test(line);
      const items: string[] = [];
      while (i < lines.length && /^\s*([-*]|\d+[.)])\s+/.test(lines[i]!)) {
        let item = lines[i]!.replace(/^\s*([-*]|\d+[.)])\s+/, '');
        i++;
        while (i < lines.length && /^\s{2,}\S/.test(lines[i]!) && !/^\s*([-*]|\d+[.)])\s+/.test(lines[i]!)) item += ' ' + lines[i++]!.trim();
        items.push(item);
      }
      const Tag = ordered ? 'ol' : 'ul';
      blocks.push(<Tag key={key++} className="md-list">{items.map((it, j) => <li key={j}>{inline(it)}</li>)}</Tag>);
      continue;
    }
    const para: string[] = [];
    while (i < lines.length && lines[i]!.trim() && !/^\s*(```|#{1,4}\s|[-*]\s|\d+[.)]\s)/.test(lines[i]!)) para.push(lines[i++]!);
    blocks.push(<p key={key++}>{inline(para.join(' '))}</p>);
  }
  return <div className="md">{blocks}</div>;
}

function inline(s: string): ReactNode[] {
  const out: ReactNode[] = [];
  const re = /(`[^`]+`)|(\*\*[^*]+\*\*)|(\*[^*\s][^*]*\*)/g;
  let last = 0;
  let m: RegExpExecArray | null;
  let k = 0;
  while ((m = re.exec(s))) {
    if (m.index > last) out.push(<Fragment key={k++}>{s.slice(last, m.index)}</Fragment>);
    const t = m[0];
    if (m[1]) out.push(<code key={k++}>{t.slice(1, -1)}</code>);
    else if (m[2]) out.push(<strong key={k++}>{t.slice(2, -2)}</strong>);
    else out.push(<em key={k++}>{t.slice(1, -1)}</em>);
    last = m.index + t.length;
  }
  if (last < s.length) out.push(<Fragment key={k++}>{s.slice(last)}</Fragment>);
  return out;
}

```typescript
        {v.ui.errors.map((e, i) => (
          <div key={`e${i}`} className="msg msg-note">{e}</div>
        ))}
      </div>

      {v.ui.pendingFork && <ForkCard />}
      {v.ui.awaitingApproval && !v.ui.pendingFork && <ApprovalCard plan={v.ui.awaitingApproval.plan} disabled={replaying} />}
      <Composer disabled={replaying} busy={busy && v.live} />
    </aside>
  );
}

function ForkCard() {
  const v = useView();
  const setDraft = useStore((s) => s.setDraft);
  const fork = v.ui.pendingFork!;
  const first = fork.violations[0];
  if (!first) return null;
  return (
    <section className="card card-fork" aria-label="Choose how to proceed">
      <p className="card-kicker">{first.invariant} would be crossed</p>
      <p className="card-reason">{first.reason}</p>
      <div className="fork-options">
        {(['A', 'B'] as const).map((opt, i) => (
          <button key={opt} className="fork-option" disabled={!v.live} onClick={() => setDraft(`${opt} — `, true)}>
            <span className="fork-letter">{opt}</span>
            <span>{first.options[i]}</span>
          </button>
        ))}
      </div>
      <p className="card-hint">Pick one and add your reason. It becomes a decision later sessions follow.</p>
    </section>
  );
}

function ApprovalCard({ plan, disabled }: { plan: string; disabled: boolean }) {
  return (
    <section className="card card-approve" aria-label="Plan waiting for approval">
      <p className="card-kicker">Plan ready</p>
      {plan.trim() && (
        <div className="card-plan">
          <Markdown text={plan} />
        </div>
      )}
      <div className="card-actions">
        <button className="btn btn-primary" disabled={disabled} onClick={() => void api.approve()}>Approve plan</button>
        <span className="card-hint">or reply with changes</span>
      </div>
    </section>
  );
}

function Composer({ disabled, busy }: { disabled: boolean; busy: boolean }) {
  const draft = useStore((s) => s.draft);
  const focusTick = useStore((s) => s.focusTick);
  const setDraft = useStore((s) => s.setDraft);
  const ta = useRef<HTMLTextAreaElement>(null);

  useEffect(() => {
    const el = ta.current;
    if (!el || !focusTick) return;
    el.focus();
    el.setSelectionRange(el.value.length, el.value.length);
  }, [focusTick]);

  useLayoutEffect(() => {
    const el = ta.current;
    if (!el) return;
    el.style.height = 'auto';
    el.style.height = `${Math.min(160, el.scrollHeight)}px`;
  }, [draft]);

  const send = () => {
    const t = draft.trim();
    if (!t || disabled) return;
    void api.chat(t);
    setDraft('');
  };

  return (
    <div className="composer">
      <textarea
        ref={ta}
        rows={1}
        value={draft}
        disabled={disabled}
        placeholder={disabled ? 'Replaying. Go live to send.' : fakeMode ? 'Fake log loaded; sending is off.' : 'Message Claude'}
        onChange={(e) => setDraft(e.target.value)}
        onKeyDown={(e) => {
          if (e.key === 'Enter' && !e.shiftKey && !e.nativeEvent.isComposing) {
            e.preventDefault();
            send();
          }
        }}
      />
      {busy ? (
        <button className="btn btn-stop" onClick={() => void api.interrupt()}>Stop</button>
      ) : (
        <button className="btn btn-primary" disabled={disabled || !draft.trim()} onClick={send}>Send</button>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}
```

```typescript
import { useMemo } from 'react';
import { cellKey, type CellView } from '@harness/core/view';
import { basename, stem, useView } from '../derive';
import { useFlash, useSize, useTween } from '../hooks';
import { edgeSegments, gridLayout, routeEdges, type GridLayout, type Rect } from '../layout';
import { useStore } from '../store';

export function MapGrid() {
  const v = useView();
  const [ref, size] = useSize<HTMLDivElement>();
  const select = useStore((s) => s.select);
  const map = v.ui.map;
  const withUnassigned = v.unassigned.length > 0 || (v.turn?.unassigned.length ?? 0) > 0;

  const L = useMemo(() => (map && size.w > 0 ? gridLayout(map, size, withUnassigned) : null), [map, size, withUnassigned]);
  const routed = useMemo(() => (L ? routeEdges(L, edgeSegments(v.ui, v.turn, v.edges)) : []), [L, v.ui, v.turn, v.edges]);

  return (
    <div className="grid-wrap" ref={ref} onClick={() => select(null)}>
      {!map && <GridEmpty />}
      {map && L && (
        <div className="grid" style={{ width: L.width, height: L.height }}>
          {L.cols.map((c) => (
            <div key={c.id} className={`col-head ${c.id === '__unassigned' ? 'is-unassigned' : ''}`} style={{ left: c.x, width: L.colW, height: L.headerH }} tabIndex={0}>
              <span className="col-name">{c.name}</span>
              <span className="col-purpose" role="tooltip">{c.purpose}</span>
            </div>
          ))}
          {L.rows.map((r) => (
            <div key={r.id} className="row-label" style={{ top: r.y, height: L.rowH, width: L.labelW }}>{r.name}</div>
          ))}
          {Object.entries(L.cells).map(([k, rect]) => (
            <Cell key={k} k={k} rect={rect} view={v.cells[k]} />
          ))}
          {L.unassigned && <UnassignedColumn rect={L.unassigned} />}
          <EdgeLayer L={L} routed={routed} />
          <AgentCursor L={L} />
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

function GridEmpty() {
  const conn = useStore((s) => s.conn);
  return (
    <div className="grid-empty">
      <p className="grid-empty-title">{conn === 'down' ? 'Waiting for the Harness server' : 'Reading the repo'}</p>
      <p>{conn === 'down' ? 'Start it with HARNESS_REPO=<path> npm run dev. This page reconnects on its own.' : 'The map appears once domains.yaml is loaded or proposed.'}</p>
    </div>
  );
}

function Cell({ k, rect, view }: { k: string; rect: Rect; view: CellView | undefined }) {
  const v = useView();
  const selection = useStore((s) => s.selection);
  const select = useStore((s) => s.select);
  const [domain, layer] = k.split('/') as [string, string];
  const files = v.cellFiles[k] ?? [];
  const tables = v.ui.map?.domains.find((d) => d.id === domain)?.cells[layer]?.tables ?? [];
  const flash = useFlash(files.length);
  const added = useTween(view?.added ?? 0);
  const removed = useTween(view?.removed ?? 0);
  const selected = selection && 'cell' in selection && selection.cell === k;

  const cls = ['cell'];
  if (view?.looked && !view.edited) cls.push('is-looked');
  if (view?.edited) cls.push(view.unplanned ? 'is-unplanned' : 'is-edited');
  if (view?.ghost) cls.push('is-ghost');
  if (view?.violation) cls.push('is-violation');
  if (view?.violation === 'new') cls.push('is-new-violation');
  if (selected) cls.push('is-selected');
  if (flash) cls.push('is-flash');

  const maxLines = Math.max(1, Math.floor((rect.h - 44 - (tables.length ? 20 : 0)) / 18));
  const names = files.map(stem);
  const shown = names.length > maxLines ? names.slice(0, maxLines - 1) : names;
  const more = names.length - shown.length;
  const label = `${v.ui.map?.domains.find((d) => d.id === domain)?.name ?? domain}, ${layer}`;

  return (
    <button
      type="button"
      className={cls.join(' ')}
      style={{ left: rect.x, top: rect.y, width: rect.w, height: rect.h }}
      aria-label={label}
      onClick={(e) => {
        e.stopPropagation();
        select(selected ? null : { cell: k });
      }}
    >
      <span className="cell-files">
        {shown.map((n, i) => <span key={i} className="cell-file">{n}</span>)}
        {more > 0 && <span className="cell-more">+{more} more</span>}
      </span>
      {tables.length > 0 && (
        <span className="cell-tables">{tables.map((t) => <span key={t} className="cell-table">{t}</span>)}</span>
      )}
      <span className="cell-foot">
        <span className="cell-count">{files.length} {files.length === 1 ? 'file' : 'files'}</span>
        {view?.edited && (
          <span className="cell-diff">
            <span className="plus">+{added}</span> <span className="minus">−{removed}</span>
          </span>
        )}
      </span>
      {view?.ghost && (
        <span className="cell-steps" aria-label={`Planned in step ${view.ghost.join(', ')}`}>
          {view.ghost.map((n) => <span key={n} className="step-dot">{n}</span>)}
        </span>
      )}
      {view?.violation && view.violationFiles.length > 0 && (
        <span className="badge-existing" title={view.violationFiles.join('\n')}>
          {view.violationFiles.length}
        </span>
      )}
      {view?.violation === 'new' && (
        <span className="badge-new" title={view.newViolationFiles.join('\n')}>
          <strong>new</strong> {view.newViolationFiles.map(basename).join(', ')}
        </span>
      )}
    </button>
  );
}

function UnassignedColumn({ rect }: { rect: Rect }) {
  const v = useView();
  const select = useStore((s) => s.select);
  const edited = new Set(v.turn?.unassigned ?? []);
  const files = [...new Set([...v.unassigned, ...edited])].sort();
  return (
    <button
      type="button"
      className={`cell cell-unassigned ${edited.size ? 'is-unplanned' : ''}`}
      style={{ left: rect.x, top: rect.y, width: rect.w, height: rect.h }}
      onClick={(e) => {
        e.stopPropagation();
        select({ unassigned: true });
      }}
    >
      <span className="cell-files">
        {files.slice(0, 14).map((f) => <span key={f} className="cell-file" title={f}>{basename(f)}</span>)}
        {files.length > 14 && <span className="cell-more">+{files.length - 14} more</span>}
      </span>
      <span className="cell-foot"><span className="cell-count">{files.length} {files.length === 1 ? 'file' : 'files'}</span></span>
    </button>
  );
}

function EdgeLayer({ L, routed }: { L: GridLayout; routed: ReturnType<typeof routeEdges> }) {
  const selection = useStore((s) => s.selection);
  const select = useStore((s) => s.select);
  const selCell = selection && 'cell' in selection ? selection.cell : null;
  const selPair = selection && 'pair' in selection ? selection.pair : null;
  return (
    <svg className="edges" width={L.width} height={L.height} aria-hidden="false">
      <defs>
        {(['existing', 'new', 'ghost', 'violation'] as const).map((k) => (
          <marker key={k} id={`arrow-${k}`} viewBox="0 0 10 10" refX="9" refY="5" markerWidth="7" markerHeight="7" markerUnits="userSpaceOnUse" orient="auto-start-reverse">
            <path d="M0,1 L9,5 L0,9 z" className={`arrowhead arrowhead-${k}`} />
          </marker>
        ))}
      </defs>
      {routed.map((r) => {
        const kind = r.violation ? 'violation' : r.state;
        const focused = selPair === r.pair || (selCell !== null && (r.src === selCell || r.dst === selCell));
        const dimmed = (selPair !== null || selCell !== null) && !focused;
        return (
          <g
            key={r.key}
            className={`edge edge-${r.state} ${r.violation ? 'edge-violation' : ''} ${focused ? 'is-focused' : ''} ${dimmed ? 'is-dimmed' : ''}`}
            onClick={(e) => {
              e.stopPropagation();
              select({ edge: r.edgeKey, pair: r.pair });
            }}
          >
            <title>{`${r.files.map((f) => `${f.from} → ${f.to}`).join('\n')}`}</title>
            <path className="edge-hit" d={r.d} />
            <path
              className="edge-line"
              d={r.d}
              markerEnd={`url(#arrow-${kind})`}
              {...(r.state === 'new' ? { pathLength: 1 } : {})}
            />
          </g>
        );
      })}
    </svg>
  );
}

function AgentCursor({ L }: { L: GridLayout }) {
  const v = useView();
  const c = v.ui.cursor;
  const rect = c?.cell ? L.cells[cellKey(c.cell)] : undefined;
  if (!c || !rect) return null;
  return (
    <div className="cursor" style={{ transform: `translate(${rect.x + 10}px, ${rect.y - 13}px)` }} aria-live="polite">
      <span className="cursor-avatar" aria-hidden="true">C</span>
      <span className="cursor-label">
        Claude · {c.verb} <code>{basename(c.path)}</code>
      </span>
    </div>
  );
}
```

```typescript
import { cellKey, type Finding } from '@harness/core/view';
import { useView, type View } from '../derive';
import { useStore } from '../store';

function phase(v: View): string {
  const t = v.turn;
  if (!t) return '';
  if (t.endedAt !== null) return 'Done';
  if (v.ui.pendingFork?.turn === t.id) return 'Waiting for your choice';
  if (v.ui.awaitingApproval?.turn === t.id) return 'Waiting for approval';
  if (t.approved) return 'Building';
  if (t.steps.length) return 'Planning';
  return 'Exploring';
}

export function TurnSummary() {
  const v = useView();
  const setTurn = useStore((s) => s.setTurn);
  const select = useStore((s) => s.select);
  const selection = useStore((s) => s.selection);
  const turn = v.turn;

  if (!turn) {
    return (
      <section className="summary summary-empty">
        <p>Ask Claude to change something; the map shows what it plans and does.</p>
      </section>
    );
  }

  const findings = v.turnLedger?.findings ?? [];
  const selCell = selection && 'cell' in selection ? selection.cell : null;

  return (
    <section className="summary">
      <div className="summary-turn">
        <div className="turn-tabs" role="tablist" aria-label="Turns">
          {v.ui.turns.map((t, i) => (
            <button
              key={t.id}
              role="tab"
              aria-selected={t.id === turn.id}
              className={`turn-tab ${t.id === turn.id ? 'is-active' : ''}`}
              onClick={() => setTurn(i === v.ui.turns.length - 1 ? null : t.id)}
            >
              Turn {i + 1}
            </button>
          ))}
          <span className="turn-phase">{phase(v)}</span>
        </div>
        <p className="turn-prompt">{turn.prompt}</p>
        {v.steps.total > 0 && (
          <div className="steps" aria-label={`${v.steps.done} of ${v.steps.total} steps`}>
            <span className="steps-bar">
              {Array.from({ length: v.steps.total }, (_, i) => <span key={i} className={`steps-seg ${i < v.steps.done ? 'is-done' : ''}`} />)}
            </span>
            <span className="steps-text">{v.steps.done} of {v.steps.total} steps</span>
          </div>
        )}
      </div>
      <ol className="findings" aria-label="Findings, loudest first">
        {findings.length === 0 && <li className="finding finding-none">Nothing to review yet.</li>}
        {findings.map((f, i) => (
          <li key={i}>
            <button
              className={`finding sev-${f.severity} ${f.cell && selCell === cellKey(f.cell) ? 'is-selected' : ''}`}
              disabled={!f.cell}
              onClick={(e) => {
                e.stopPropagation();
                if (f.cell) select({ cell: cellKey(f.cell) });
              }}
            >
              <span className="finding-mark" aria-hidden="true" />
              <span className="finding-text">{findingText(f)}</span>
              {f.invariant && <span className="finding-tag">{f.invariant}</span>}
            </button>
          </li>
        ))}
      </ol>
    </section>
  );
}

function findingText(f: Finding) {
  return f.text;
}
```

```typescript
import { useView } from '../derive';
import { useStore } from '../store';

export function Scrubber() {
  const v = useView();
  const total = useStore((s) => s.events.length);
  const setReplay = useStore((s) => s.setReplay);
  const setTurn = useStore((s) => s.setTurn);
  if (!total) return <div className="scrubber" />;
  const pct = (i: number) => `${(i / total) * 100}%`;
  return (
    <div className={`scrubber ${v.live ? '' : 'is-replaying'}`}>
      <span className="scrub-label">{v.live ? 'Live' : `Replay ${v.upTo} of ${total}`}</span>
      <div className="scrub-track">
        <div className="scrub-ticks" aria-hidden="true">
          {v.turnStarts.map((i, n) => (
            <span key={i} className="scrub-tick" style={{ left: pct(i) }}>
              <span className="scrub-tick-label">Turn {n + 1}</span>
            </span>
          ))}
        </div>
        <input
          type="range"
          min={0}
          max={total}
          value={v.upTo}
          aria-label="Replay the event log"
          onChange={(e) => {
            const i = Number(e.target.value);
            setTurn(null);
            setReplay(i >= total ? null : i);
          }}
        />
      </div>
      <button className={`btn btn-live ${v.live ? 'is-live' : ''}`} disabled={v.live} onClick={() => setReplay(null)}>
        Live
      </button>
    </div>
  );
}
```

```typescript
import { useTween } from '../hooks';

export function Header() {
  const repo = useStore((s) => s.repo);
  const conn = useStore((s) => s.conn);
  const name = repo.split('/').filter(Boolean).pop() ?? '';
  return (
    <header className="top">
      <div className="brand">
        <span className="brand-mark" aria-hidden="true">
          <span /><span /><span /><span />
        </span>
        <span className="brand-name">Harness</span>
        {name && <span className="brand-repo">{name}</span>}
        {conn === 'down' && <span className="conn-down">Server not reachable. Reconnecting…</span>}
      </div>
      <Ledger />
    </header>
  );
}

function Ledger() {
  const v = useView();
  const s = v.ledger.session;
  const t = v.turnLedger;
  const items: { label: string; value: number; turn: number | null }[] = [
    { label: 'Lines changed', value: s.linesChanged, turn: t ? t.linesChanged : null },
    { label: 'Cells to review', value: s.cellsToReview, turn: t?.cellsToReview ?? null },
    { label: 'Forks caught before code', value: s.forksCaughtBeforeCode, turn: t?.forksCaughtBeforeCode ?? null },
    { label: 'Rejected options blocked', value: s.rejectedOptionsBlocked, turn: t?.rejectedOptionsBlocked ?? null },
  ];
  return (
    <dl className="ledger" aria-label="Session ledger">
      {items.map((it) => (
        <Counter key={it.label} {...it} turnIndex={v.turnIndex} />
      ))}
    </dl>
  );
}

function Counter({ label, value, turn, turnIndex }: { label: string; value: number; turn: number | null; turnIndex: number }) {
  const shown = useTween(value, 600);
  return (
    <div className="counter">
      <dd className="counter-value">{shown.toLocaleString()}</dd>
      <dt className="counter-label">{label}</dt>
      {turnIndex > 0 && <dd className="counter-turn">{turn === null ? '–' : turn.toLocaleString()} in turn {turnIndex}</dd>}
    </div>
  );
}
```

```typescript
import { useEffect, useState, type ReactNode } from 'react';
import { provenance, type DomainMap, type Invariant, type Violation } from '@harness/core/view';
import { api } from '../connection';
import { turnViolations, useView, type View } from '../derive';
import { edgeSegments, invariantsFor } from '../layout';
import { useStore, type Selection } from '../store';

export function Inspector() {
  const selection = useStore((s) => s.selection);
  const select = useStore((s) => s.select);
  const v = useView();
  const [file, setFile] = useState<string | null>(null);

  useEffect(() => setFile(null), [selection]);
  useEffect(() => {
    const onKey = (e: KeyboardEvent) => {
      if (e.key === 'Escape') select(null);
    };
    addEventListener('keydown', onKey);
    return () => removeEventListener('keydown', onKey);
  }, [select]);

  if (!selection || !v.ui.map) return null;
  return (
    <aside className="inspector" aria-label="Inspector" onClick={(e) => e.stopPropagation()}>
      <button className="inspector-close" aria-label="Close inspector" onClick={() => select(null)}>×</button>
      {file ? (
        <FilePreview path={file} onBack={() => setFile(null)} />
      ) : (
        <Body v={v} sel={selection} map={v.ui.map} openFile={setFile} />
      )}
    </aside>
  );
}

function Body({ v, sel, map, openFile }: { v: View; sel: Selection; map: DomainMap; openFile: (p: string) => void }) {
  if ('unassigned' in sel) {
    const files = [...new Set([...v.unassigned, ...(v.turn?.unassigned ?? [])])].sort();
    return (
      <>
        <h2 className="insp-title">Unassigned</h2>
        <p className="insp-sub">Files that match no cell in domains.yaml. Add their paths to a domain to place them.</p>
        <Section title="Files"><FileList files={files} openFile={openFile} /></Section>
      </>
    );
  }
  if ('cell' in sel) return <CellBody v={v} k={sel.cell} map={map} openFile={openFile} />;
  return <EdgeBody v={v} edge={sel.edge} pair={sel.pair} map={map} openFile={openFile} />;
}

function CellBody({ v, k, map, openFile }: { v: View; k: string; map: DomainMap; openFile: (p: string) => void }) {
  const [domainId, layerId] = k.split('/') as [string, string];
  const domain = map.domains.find((d) => d.id === domainId);
  const layer = map.layers.find((l) => l.id === layerId);
  const cell = domain?.cells[layerId];
  const view = v.cells[k];
  const files = v.cellFiles[k] ?? [];
  const edited = v.turn?.edited[k];
  const planned = v.turn?.planned[k];
  const plannedNew = (planned?.files ?? []).filter((f) => !files.includes(f));
  const tests = v.testFiles[domainId] ?? [];
  const invs = invariantsFor(map, domainId, files);
  const vios = turnViolations(v).filter(({ v: x }) => cellOfFile(v, x.file) === k);
  const prov = provenance(v.ui, { cell: k });

  const state: string[] = [];
  if (view?.edited) state.push(view.unplanned ? 'Edited without being planned' : 'Edited this turn');
  if (view?.ghost) state.push(`Planned in step ${view.ghost.join(', ')}`);
  if (view?.looked && !view.edited) state.push('Looked at this turn');

  return (
    <>
      <h2 className="insp-title">{domain?.name ?? domainId} <span className="insp-layer">{layer?.name ?? layerId}</span></h2>
      {domain && <p className="insp-sub">{domain.purpose}</p>}
      {state.length > 0 && <p className={`insp-state ${view?.unplanned ? 'is-amber' : ''}`}>{state.join('. ')}{edited ? `: +${edited.added} −${edited.removed}` : ''}</p>}

      {vios.length > 0 && (
        <Section title="Rules crossed">
          {vios.map(({ v: x, source }, i) => <ViolationItem key={i} v={x} source={source} />)}
        </Section>
      )}

      <Section title={`Files (${files.length})`}>
        <FileList files={files} openFile={openFile} marks={(f) => (edited?.created.includes(f) ? 'created' : edited?.files.includes(f) ? 'edited' : null)} />
        {plannedNew.length > 0 && (
          <p className="insp-note">Planned, not created yet: {plannedNew.map((f) => <code key={f}>{f}</code>)}</p>
        )}
      </Section>

      {(cell?.paths?.length || cell?.tables?.length) && (
        <Section title="Defined by">
          {cell?.paths?.map((p) => <code key={p} className="insp-glob">{p}</code>)}
          {cell?.tables?.length ? <p className="insp-note">Owns tables {cell.tables.map((t) => <code key={t}>{t}</code>)}</p> : null}
        </Section>
      )}

      {invs.length > 0 && <Section title="Rules for this domain">{invs.map((i) => <InvariantItem key={i.id} inv={i} />)}</Section>}

      {tests.length > 0 && (
        <Section title={`Tests for ${domain?.name ?? domainId}`}><FileList files={tests} openFile={openFile} /></Section>
      )}

      <Provenance prov={prov} />
    </>
  );
}

function EdgeBody({ v, edge, pair, map, openFile }: { v: View; edge: string; pair: string; map: DomainMap; openFile: (p: string) => void }) {
  const seg = edgeSegments(v.ui, v.turn, v.edges).find((s) => s.edgeKey === edge && s.pair === pair);
  const [from, to] = edge.split('->') as [string, string];
  const name = (id: string) => map.domains.find((d) => d.id === id)?.name ?? id;
  const files = seg?.files ?? [];
  const vios = turnViolations(v).filter(({ v: x }) => files.some((f) => f.from === x.file && (!x.target || x.target === f.to)));
  const invs = map.invariants.filter(
    (i) => (i.kind === 'no_edge' && i.from === from && i.to === to) || (i.kind === 'only_via' && files.some((f) => i.targets.some((t) => matches(t, f.to)))),
  );
  const prov = provenance(v.ui, { edge });
  const turnNo = v.turnIndex;
  const state = seg?.state === 'ghost' ? `Planned in step ${seg.steps.join(', ')}, not built yet` : seg?.state === 'new' ? `Added in turn ${turnNo}` : 'On the map before this turn';
  const [srcCell, dstCell] = pair.split('=>') as [string, string];
  const layerName = (k: string) => map.layers.find((l) => l.id === k.split('/')[1])?.name ?? '';

  return (
    <>
      <h2 className="insp-title">{name(from)} <span className="insp-arrow">→</span> {name(to)}</h2>
      <p className="insp-sub">{layerName(srcCell)} to {layerName(dstCell)}. Derived from imports; flow down a column is not drawn.</p>
      <p className={`insp-state ${seg?.violation ? 'is-red' : ''}`}>{state}</p>
      {vios.length > 0 && <Section title="Rules crossed">{vios.map(({ v: x, source }, i) => <ViolationItem key={i} v={x} source={source} />)}</Section>}
      <Section title={`Imports (${files.length})`}>
        <ul className="insp-imports">
          {files.map((f, i) => (
            <li key={i}>
              <button className="link" onClick={() => openFile(f.from)}>{f.from}</button>
              <span className="insp-arrow">→</span>
              <button className="link" onClick={() => openFile(f.to)}>{f.to}</button>
            </li>
          ))}
        </ul>
      </Section>
      {invs.length > 0 && <Section title="Rules on this dependency">{invs.map((i) => <InvariantItem key={i.id} inv={i} />)}</Section>}
      <Provenance prov={prov} />
    </>
  );
}

const matches = (glob: string, path: string) => {
  const re = new RegExp(`^${glob.replace(/[.+^${}()|[\]\\]/g, '\\$&').replace(/\*\*\/?/g, '\u0000').replace(/\*/g, '[^/]*').replace(/\u0000/g, '.*')}$`);
  return re.test(path);
};

function cellOfFile(v: View, file: string): string | null {
  const p = v.ui.files[file];
  if (p?.kind === 'cell') return `${p.domain}/${p.layer}`;
  const planned = v.turn && Object.entries(v.turn.planned).find(([, c]) => c.files.includes(file));
  return planned ? planned[0] : null;
}

function Section({ title, children }: { title: string; children: ReactNode }) {
  return (
    <section className="insp-section">
      <h3>{title}</h3>
      {children}
    </section>
  );
}

function FileList({ files, openFile, marks }: { files: string[]; openFile: (p: string) => void; marks?: (f: string) => string | null }) {
  if (!files.length) return <p className="insp-note">None.</p>;
  return (
    <ul className="insp-files">
      {files.map((f) => {
        const m = marks?.(f);
        return (
          <li key={f}>
            <button className="link" onClick={() => openFile(f)}>{f}</button>
            {m && <span className={`insp-mark mark-${m}`}>{m}</span>}
          </li>
        );
      })}
    </ul>
  );
}

function ViolationItem({ v, source }: { v: Violation; source: 'load' | 'plan' | 'gate' }) {
  const where = source === 'load' ? 'Found on load' : source === 'plan' ? 'In this turn’s plan' : 'Blocked at edit';
  return (
    <div className={`insp-violation ${source === 'load' ? '' : 'is-new'}`}>
      <p className="insp-vio-head"><strong>{v.invariant}</strong> {where}</p>
      <p>{v.reason}</p>
      <code className="insp-glob">{v.detail}</code>
    </div>
  );
}

function InvariantItem({ inv }: { inv: Invariant }) {
  return (
    <div className="insp-inv">
      <p><strong>{inv.id}</strong> {inv.rule}</p>
      {(inv.decisions?.length || inv.exceptions.length) ? (
        <p className="insp-note">
          {inv.decisions?.length ? <>Confirmed by {inv.decisions.join(', ')}. </> : null}
          {inv.exceptions.length ? <>Exceptions: {inv.exceptions.map((e) => <code key={e.path}>{e.path}{e.decision ? ` (${e.decision})` : ''}</code>)}</> : null}
        </p>
      ) : null}
    </div>
  );
}

function Provenance({ prov }: { prov: ReturnType<typeof provenance> }) {
  if (!prov.turns.length && !prov.decisions.length) {
    return <Section title="History"><p className="insp-note">No changes this session.</p></Section>;
  }
  return (
    <Section title="History">
      <ul className="insp-prov">
        {prov.turns.map((t) => {
          const decs = prov.decisions.filter((d) => d.turn === t.id);
          return (
            <li key={t.id}>
              <span>Changed in turn {t.index}{decs.length ? `, under ${decs.map((d) => d.id).join(', ')}` : ''}</span>
              <span className="insp-prov-prompt">{t.prompt}</span>
              {decs.map((d) => (
                <span key={d.id} className="insp-prov-dec">
                  <strong>{d.id}</strong> {d.title}{d.alike ? ' · in Alike' : ''}
                </span>
              ))}
            </li>
          );
        })}
      </ul>
    </Section>
  );
}

function FilePreview({ path, onBack }: { path: string; onBack: () => void }) {
  const [text, setText] = useState<string | null | undefined>(undefined);
  useEffect(() => {
    let live = true;
    setText(undefined);
    api.file(path).then((t) => live && setText(t)).catch(() => live && setText(null));
    return () => {
      live = false;
    };
  }, [path]);
  return (
    <>
      <button className="link insp-back" onClick={onBack}>Back</button>
      <h2 className="insp-title insp-path">{path}</h2>
      {text === undefined && <p className="insp-note">Loading…</p>}
      {text === null && <p className="insp-note">Not on disk. It may be planned but not created yet.</p>}
      {typeof text === 'string' && (
        <pre className="insp-code">
          {text.split('\n').map((l, i) => (
            <span key={i} className="code-line"><span className="code-no">{i + 1}</span>{l || ' '}{'\n'}</span>
          ))}
        </pre>
      )}
    </>
  );
}
```

```css
.cell.is-edited .cell-foot, .cell.is-edited .cell-more { color: rgb(255 255 255 / 0.82); }
.cell.is-edited .cell-table { background: rgb(255 255 255 / 0.14); border-color: transparent; }
/* unplanned: amber fill */
.cell.is-unplanned { background: var(--amber); border-color: var(--amber); color: var(--ink); }
.cell.is-unplanned .cell-foot { color: var(--amber-ink); }
/* invariant hit: red */
.cell.is-violation { border: 2.5px solid var(--red); }
.cell.is-violation:not(.is-edited):not(.is-unplanned) { background: var(--red-wash); }
.cell.is-new-violation { box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px var(--sheet), 0 0 0 5px var(--red); }
.cell.is-selected { box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px var(--sheet), 0 0 0 5px var(--ink); }
.cell.is-new-violation.is-selected { box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px var(--sheet), 0 0 0 5px var(--ink), 0 0 0 7px var(--red); }
.cell.is-flash { background: var(--agent-wash); border-color: var(--agent); transition: none; }

.cell-steps { position: absolute; top: -10px; right: 8px; display: flex; gap: 3px; }
.step-dot {
  min-width: 21px; height: 21px; padding: 0 5px; border-radius: 11px; display: grid; place-items: center;
  background: var(--paper); border: 1.5px solid var(--agent); color: var(--agent-deep);
  font-family: var(--cond); font-weight: 600; font-size: 13px;
}
.badge-existing {
  position: absolute; top: -10px; right: -10px;
  min-width: 22px; height: 22px; padding: 0 6px; border-radius: 11px; display: grid; place-items: center;
  background: var(--paper); border: 2px solid var(--red); color: var(--red-ink);
  font-family: var(--cond); font-weight: 600; font-size: 13px;
}
.cell-steps + .badge-existing, .is-ghost .badge-existing { right: auto; left: -10px; }
.badge-new {
  position: absolute; left: 8px; bottom: -12px; max-width: calc(100% - 16px);
  background: var(--red); color: #fff; border-radius: 5px; padding: 2px 7px;
  font-size: 12px; line-height: 18px; white-space: nowrap; overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis;
  font-family: var(--mono);
}
.badge-new strong { font-family: var(--cond); font-size: 13px; margin-right: 3px; }

.cell-unassigned { border-style: dashed; background: transparent; }
.cell-unassigned .cell-file { font-family: var(--mono); font-size: 12px; }

/* edges */
.edges { position: absolute; inset: 0; overflow: visible; pointer-events: none; }
.edge { pointer-events: visiblePainted; cursor: pointer; transition: opacity 200ms; }
.edge-hit { fill: none; stroke: transparent; stroke-width: 12px; pointer-events: stroke; }
.edge-line { fill: none; stroke: var(--edge); stroke-width: 1.5px; stroke-linejoin: round; }
.edge-new .edge-line { stroke: var(--agent); stroke-width: 2.25px; stroke-dasharray: 1; stroke-dashoffset: 0; animation: draw-in 700ms var(--ease) both; }
.edge-ghost .edge-line { stroke: var(--agent); stroke-opacity: 0.6; stroke-width: 2px; stroke-dasharray: 6 5; }
.edge-violation .edge-line { stroke: var(--red); stroke-opacity: 1; stroke-width: 2.25px; }
.edge.is-focused .edge-line { stroke-width: 3px; }
.edge.is-dimmed { opacity: 0.25; }
.edge:hover .edge-line { stroke-width: 3px; }
.arrowhead-existing { fill: var(--edge); }
.arrowhead-new { fill: var(--agent); }
.arrowhead-ghost { fill: var(--agent); fill-opacity: 0.6; }
.arrowhead-violation { fill: var(--red); }
@keyframes draw-in { from { stroke-dashoffset: 1; } to { stroke-dashoffset: 0; } }

/* agent cursor */
.cursor {
  position: absolute; left: 0; top: 0; z-index: 15; pointer-events: none;
  display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px;
  transition: transform 250ms var(--ease);
}
.cursor-avatar {
  width: 24px; height: 24px; border-radius: 50%; display: grid; place-items: center;
  background: var(--agent); color: #fff; font-family: var(--cond); font-weight: 600; font-size: 13px;
  box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px var(--paper);
}
.cursor-label {
  background: var(--ink); color: #fff; font-size: 12.5px; padding: 2px 8px; border-radius: 5px; white-space: nowrap;
}
.cursor-label code { font-size: 12px; }

/* proposal banner */
.banner {
  position: absolute; z-index: 25; left: 50%; bottom: 14px; transform: translateX(-50%);
  display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 24px;
  background: var(--paper); border: 1px solid var(--ink); border-radius: 12px; padding: 12px 14px 12px 18px;
  box-shadow: 0 8px 24px rgb(24 32 47 / 0.14);
}
.banner p { margin: 0; }
.banner-title { font-family: var(--cond); font-weight: 600; font-size: 18px; }
.banner-sub { font-size: 13px; color: var(--graphite); }
.banner-actions { display: flex; gap: 8px; }

/* ------------------------------------------------------------ inspector */
.inspector {
  position: absolute; z-index: 30; top: 0; right: 0; bottom: 0; width: 400px; overflow-y: auto;
  background: var(--paper); border-left: 1px solid var(--rule); padding: 20px 22px 28px;
  box-shadow: -10px 0 30px rgb(24 32 47 / 0.08);
  animation: slide-in 180ms var(--ease) both;
}
@keyframes slide-in { from { transform: translateX(16px); opacity: 0; } }
.inspector-close {
  position: absolute; top: 12px; right: 14px; width: 30px; height: 30px; border-radius: 7px;
  border: 0; background: transparent; font-size: 22px; line-height: 1; cursor: pointer; color: var(--graphite);
}
.inspector-close:hover { background: var(--sheet); color: var(--ink); }
.insp-title { font-family: var(--cond); font-weight: 600; font-size: 22px; margin: 0 36px 2px 0; line-height: 1.15; }
.insp-path { font-family: var(--mono); font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500; overflow-wrap: anywhere; }
.insp-layer { color: var(--graphite); font-weight: 500; }
.insp-arrow { color: var(--graphite); margin: 0 6px; }
.insp-sub { margin: 0 0 10px; color: var(--graphite); font-size: 14px; }
.insp-state { margin: 0 0 6px; font-weight: 600; color: var(--agent-deep); font-size: 14px; }
.insp-state.is-amber { color: var(--amber-ink); }
.insp-state.is-red { color: var(--red-ink); }
.insp-section { margin-top: 18px; }
.insp-section h3 { margin: 0 0 6px; font-family: var(--cond); font-weight: 600; font-size: 15px; color: var(--graphite); }
.insp-files, .insp-imports, .insp-prov { list-style: none; margin: 0; padding: 0; display: grid; gap: 4px; }
.insp-files li { display: flex; align-items: baseline; gap: 8px; }
.insp-imports li { font-size: 12.5px; }
.insp-mark { font-size: 11.5px; padding: 0 6px; border-radius: 4px; background: var(--agent-wash); color: var(--agent-deep); font-weight: 600; }
.insp-note { margin: 4px 0 0; font-size: 13px; color: var(--graphite); }
.insp-note code { margin-right: 6px; color: var(--ink); }
.insp-glob { display: block; font-size: 12.5px; color: var(--ink); overflow-wrap: anywhere; }
.insp-violation { border-left: 3px solid var(--red); padding: 4px 0 4px 10px; margin-bottom: 8px; font-size: 14px; }
.insp-violation p { margin: 0 0 4px; }
.insp-violation.is-new { background: var(--red-wash); border-radius: 0 6px 6px 0; padding-right: 8px; }
.insp-vio-head strong { color: var(--red-ink); margin-right: 6px; }
.insp-inv { font-size: 14px; margin-bottom: 6px; }
.insp-inv p { margin: 0; }
.insp-inv strong { margin-right: 6px; }
.insp-prov li { display: grid; gap: 2px; font-size: 14px; }
.insp-prov-prompt { color: var(--graphite); font-size: 13px; }
.insp-prov-dec { font-size: 13px; }
.insp-prov-dec strong { margin-right: 6px; }
.insp-back { font-family: var(--sans); font-size: 14px; margin-bottom: 8px; }
.insp-code {
  margin: 12px 0 0; font: 12px/1.55 var(--mono); background: var(--sheet); border: 1px solid var(--rule-soft);
  border-radius: 8px; padding: 10px 0; overflow-x: auto;
}
.code-line { display: block; padding-right: 12px; white-space: pre; }
.code-no { display: inline-block; width: 38px; padding-right: 10px; text-align: right; color: var(--faint); user-select: none; }

/* ------------------------------------------------------------ bottom: summary + scrubber */
.bottom { grid-area: bottom; background: var(--paper); border-top: 1px solid var(--rule); }
.summary { display: grid; grid-template-columns: minmax(260px, 0.9fr) minmax(0, 1.4fr); gap: 28px; padding: 14px 28px 10px; height: 168px; }
.summary-empty { display: flex; align-items: center; color: var(--graphite); height: 96px; }
.summary-empty p { margin: 0; }
.summary-turn { min-width: 0; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 6px; }
.turn-tabs { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 4px; flex-wrap: wrap; }
.turn-tab {
  border: 1px solid var(--rule); background: var(--paper); border-radius: 6px; padding: 2px 9px;
  font-family: var(--cond); font-weight: 600; font-size: 14px; cursor: pointer; color: var(--graphite);
}
.turn-tab.is-active { background: var(--ink); border-color: var(--ink); color: #fff; }
.turn-phase { margin-left: 8px; font-size: 13px; color: var(--graphite); }
.turn-prompt {
  margin: 0; font-size: 17px; font-weight: 500; line-height: 1.3;
  display: -webkit-box; -webkit-line-clamp: 3; -webkit-box-orient: vertical; overflow: hidden;
}
.steps { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; margin-top: auto; }
.steps-bar { display: flex; gap: 3px; }
.steps-seg { width: 22px; height: 7px; border-radius: 2px; border: 1.5px dashed rgb(75 68 214 / 0.55); transition: background 250ms, border-color 250ms; }
.steps-seg.is-done { background: var(--agent); border: 1.5px solid var(--agent); }
.steps-text { font-size: 14px; font-weight: 600; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }

.findings { list-style: none; margin: 0; padding: 0 4px 0 0; overflow-y: auto; display: grid; gap: 2px; align-content: start; }
.finding {
  width: 100%; display: grid; grid-template-columns: 10px 1fr auto; gap: 10px; align-items: baseline;
  text-align: left; background: none; border: 0; border-radius: 6px; padding: 4px 8px; cursor: pointer; font-size: 14px;
}
.finding:hover:not(:disabled) { background: var(--sheet); }
.finding:disabled { cursor: default; }
.finding.is-selected { background: var(--sheet); box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px var(--rule); }
.finding-mark { width: 10px; height: 10px; border-radius: 3px; background: var(--rule); align-self: center; }
.sev-1 .finding-mark { background: var(--red); }
.sev-1 .finding-text { color: var(--red-ink); font-weight: 500; }
.sev-2 .finding-mark, .sev-3 .finding-mark { background: var(--amber); }
.sev-4 { color: var(--graphite); font-size: 13px; }
.sev-4 .finding-mark { background: transparent; border: 1.5px solid var(--rule); }
.finding-tag { font-family: var(--cond); font-weight: 600; font-size: 13px; color: var(--red-ink); }
.finding-none { color: var(--graphite); font-size: 14px; padding: 4px 8px; }

.scrubber { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 16px; padding: 6px 28px 12px; min-height: 44px; }
.scrub-label { font-size: 13px; color: var(--graphite); min-width: 120px; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }
.is-replaying .scrub-label { color: var(--agent-deep); font-weight: 600; }
.scrub-track { position: relative; flex: 1; height: 26px; display: flex; align-items: center; }
.scrub-ticks { position: absolute; inset: 0; pointer-events: none; }
.scrub-tick { position: absolute; top: 2px; bottom: 2px; width: 2px; margin-left: -1px; background: var(--ink); border-radius: 1px; }
.scrub-tick-label { position: absolute; left: 5px; top: -3px; font-size: 11px; color: var(--graphite); white-space: nowrap; }
.scrub-track input[type='range'] { width: 100%; margin: 0; accent-color: var(--agent); background: transparent; position: relative; }
.btn-live { padding: 4px 12px; font-size: 13px; }
.btn-live.is-live { color: var(--graphite); }

@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
  *, *::before, *::after { animation-duration: 0.01ms !important; transition-duration: 0.01ms !important; }
}
```

```typescript
import { readFileSync, writeFileSync } from 'node:fs';
import { dirname, join } from 'node:path';

import type { Cell, EventData, EventKind, HarnessEvent, Violation } from '@harness/core/view';

let n = 0;

function ev<K extends EventKind>(kind: K, data: K extends keyof EventData ? EventData[K] : never, extra: { cell?: Cell; path?: string; turn?: string | null; gap?: number } = {}) {
  t += extra.gap ?? 1200;

    session,
    turn: extra.turn === undefined ? TURN : extra.turn,

    ...(extra.cell ? { cell: extra.cell } : {}),

}
```

<summary>Tool use: **AskUserQuestion**</summary>
**Where should Scout's frontend sit on the Harness map?**

Options:
- **UI row across domains (Recommended)** - Add a `ui` layer on top. Feature folders map to their domain: web/src/features/runs → Agent loop, /notes → Memory, /outreach → Outreach, /costs → Model gateway. A feature change lights a vertical stripe UI→Logic→Data, which is the pitch's 'normal change is a stripe'. Needs a fixture/domains.yaml update the harness session must pick up.
- **One cell in Channels** - The whole web app is just another channel: web/** maps to Channels › Entry. Minimal map change (one glob), no new layer, but UI edits always light the same cell.

**Frontend stack?**

Options:
- **React + Vite + TS (Recommended)** - Reads as a real product codebase; served by Scout's own server after `npm run build`, Vite dev server with proxy for `npm run dev`. Adds a build step and React deps.
- **No framework** - Plain TypeScript + HTML/CSS served directly by the node:http server, no build step. Lighter, but looks less like a production app.


**Answer:** UI row across domains (Recommended)" selected preview:
            Channels  Agent loop  Tools  Gateway  Memory  Outreach
UI          app shell runs        —      costs    notes   outreach
Entry       HTTP,CLI  —           —      —        —       —
Logic       validate  loop,plan   tools  complete retrieve draft

# Frontend Design

Approach this as the design lead at a design studio known for giving every client a distinct visual identity that is not mistaken for anyone else's. This client has already rejected proposals that felt cliché or templated, and is paying for a distinctive point of view: make deliberate, opinionated choices about palette, typography, and layout that are specific to this brief, and take aesthetic risk if justified.

## Ground your designs in the subject matter

If the brief does not identify what the product or subject matter is, identify it yourself before designing, and confirm with the client. You can come up with one concrete subject, the design's audience, and the design's primary job, as a proposal. If there's any information in your memory about the client's preferences or context about what they're building, use that as a hint. The subject's industry, subject matter, materials, and vernacular are where distinctive visual choices come from — a design for a toy for girls aged 8–11 will be very aesthetically different from a dashboard for financial analysts. Build with the brief's real content and subject matter throughout.

## Design principles

For web designs, the hero is the first thing viewers will see. Open with the most characteristic thing in the subject's world, in the form that is most appropriate: a headline, an image, an animation, a live demo, an interactive moment, or other treatments. Be deliberate with your choice: a big number with a small label, supporting stats, and a gradient accent is the default treatment, so only use it if that's truly the best option.

Typography carries the personality of the page. You don't need a different typeface for display or headline text and body content: use one family or two, and if two, make them clearly distinct.

Choose your typefaces deliberately, not the default families you would reach for on any other project, and set a clear type scale following the default guidance of The Elements of Typographic Style with intentional weights, widths, and spacing. When type is used as a headline or visual element, use the type treatment itself as an active part of the design, not a neutral delivery vehicle for the content.

Default to line lengths of less than 80 characters. Serif typefaces can have slightly longer line lengths; give serif body text slightly more line-height than a sans-serif.

Avoid these default typographic treatments; they are the commonest tells of a generated page:
- Accenting just a single word or phrase in a headline, like putting one word in italic/bold or a different color.
- Using all caps for labels.
- Adding unnecessary typographic labels above content.

Visual structure is information. Structural devices like outlines, borders, numbering, eyebrows, dividers, labels, etc., encode useful information about the content rather than decorate it. Many generic designs use numbered markers (01 / 02 / 03), but that's only appropriate if the content actually is a sequence — like a stepped process or a timeline. Before adding numbered markers, check the content really is a sequence.

Use non-user-triggered motion sparingly and deliberately, only to draw attention. A single orchestrated moment — one page-load sequence or one reveal — lands better than scattered effects; fade-and-slide-up entrances on each section and hover transitions on every card are the generic default and read as AI-generated. Motion that answers a person's action (opening, expanding, confirming) is welcome when it shows what changed.

Consider written content carefully. Often a design brief may not contain real content, and it's up to you to come up with copy and placeholder content. Copy can make a design feel as templated as the design itself. See the below section on writing for more guidance.

## Process: plan, review against the brief, build, critique

For calibration, AI-generated design right now clusters around some traits:
1. a warm cream background (near #F4F1EA) with a high-contrast serif display and a terracotta or warm-clay accent (often near #D97757 — Anthropic's own Claude-interaction accent, so on a user's brief it reads as a tell);
2. a near-black background with a single bright acid-green or vermilion accent;
3. a broadsheet-style layout with hairline rules, zero border-radius, and dense newspaper-like columns;
4. the SaaS-card kit: content chopped into identical rounded cards, one border-radius on everything regardless of hierarchy, the same soft grey shadow (rgba(0,0,0,.1)) under each, and gradient washes as decoration;
5. template chrome that appears whatever the subject: a tracked-out ALL-CAPS eyebrow label above every heading; meta strings joined with middle dots ('A · B · C'); labels built as 'WORD — fragment' with a spaced em dash; tinted near-black (#0B0B0B, #111) standing in for black; a monospace face for small data labels; a '→' appended to link and button text.

All traits are legitimate for some briefs, but they are defaults rather than choices, and they appear regardless of subject. Where the brief pins down a visual direction, follow it exactly — the brief's own words always win, including when it asks for one of these looks. Where it leaves an axis free, don't spend that freedom on one of these defaults. As with a hired human designer, there's often a careful balance between doing what you're good at and taking each project as a chance to experiment and learn.

Work in two passes. First, brainstorm a short design plan based on the client's design brief: create a compact token system with color, type, layout, and principles.
- Color: describe the core base palette as 4–6 named hex values.
- Type: the typefaces and their roles.
- Layout: a layout concept, using one-sentence prose descriptions and ASCII wireframes to ideate and compare. Include alignment guidance; should the content be left aligned, center aligned, justified?
- Principles: the high-level guidance for what makes this page unique.

Then review that plan against the brief before building: if any part of it reads like the generic default you would produce for any similar page (work through a similar prompt to see if you arrive somewhere similar) rather than a choice made for this specific brief — revise that part, say what you changed and why. Only after you've confirmed the relative uniqueness of your design plan should you start to write the code, following the revised plan.

When writing the code, be careful of structuring your CSS selector specificities. It's easy to generate CSS classes that cancel each other out (especially with a type-based selector like .section and an element-based selector like .cta). This can happen often with padding/margin between sections.

## Restraint and self-critique

Spend your boldness in one place. Let one element be the memorable thing, keep everything around it quiet and disciplined, and cut any decoration that does not serve the brief. Build to a quality floor without announcing it: responsive down to mobile, visible keyboard focus, reduced motion respected, visually accessible, harmonious color palettes. Critique your own work as you build, taking screenshots to review if your environment supports it — a picture is worth 1000 tokens. Consider Chanel's advice: before leaving the house, take a look in the mirror and remove one accessory. Human creatives have memory and always try to do something new, so if you have a space to quickly jot down notes about what you've tried, it can help you in future passes.

## More on writing in design

Words appear in a design for one reason: to make it easier to understand and use. They are design content, not decoration. Bring the same intentionality and minimalism to copywriting that you would bring to spacing and color. Before writing anything, ask what the design needs to say, and how it can best be said to help the person navigate the experience.

Write from the end user's perspective. Name things by what users will understand in simple language, not by how the system is built. A user manages notifications, not webhook config. Describe what something is or does in plain terms rather than selling it. Being specific and legible to new users is always better than being clever.

Use active voice as default. A CTA says exactly what happens when it is used: "Save changes," not "Submit." An action keeps the same name through the whole flow, so the button that says "Publish" produces a toast that says "Published." The vocabulary of an interface is the signposting for someone navigating the product. Cohesion and consistency are how people learn their way around.

Treat failure and emptiness as moments for direction, not mood. Explain what went wrong and how to fix it, in the interface's voice rather than a person's. Errors don't apologize, and they are never vague about what happened. An empty screen is an invitation to act.

Keep the tone conversational: plain verbs, sentence case, no filler, with tone matched to the brand and the audience. Let each written element do exactly one job.

Before writing code, here's the design plan.

**Subject:** Scout is a research desk for account executives. The main job is to start a research run and read the brief and draft email before a call. Accounts, outreach, model usage and the tool list are secondary pages.

**Palette:**
| Name | Hex | Use |
|---|---|---|
| Pine | `#17322B` | sidebar and primary buttons |
| Paper | `#F4F6F3` | page background, a cool grey-green rather than cream |
| Surface | `#FFFFFF` | panels |
| Ink | `#1C2420` | text |
| Moss | `#5D6B65` | secondary text |
| Brass | `#A8741A` | waypoints, active navigation, focus rings |

Status colours are a green for *sent*, brass for *drafted* and a red for errors.

**Type:** Schibsted Grotesk (a sturdy newsroom grotesk) for the interface, and Newsreader for the brief and the email, since reading them is the core job. Both fonts are bundled locally so the app stays offline.

**Layout:** a pine sidebar on the left, with everything left-aligned. The home page is a call-sheet form above a table of recent research. A run page shows the brief and the email on the left, with the trail on the right.

**The one bold element is the trail.** The tool steps form a real sequence, so they're drawn as numbered brass waypoints on a vertical line that draws in once when the page loads. That's the only automatic animation, and it's off for people who prefer reduced motion. Everything else stays quiet: plain tables with rules, no card grids, no capitalised labels, no `·` separators, no `→` on buttons.

**Redaction markers:** tokens like `[NAME_1]` and `[PHONE_3]` appear as small marked chips ("hidden before it reached the model"). That makes the 10-K figure problem obvious in the UI.

**Checked against the generic defaults:** the cream-serif-terracotta, black-and-acid and SaaS card-grid looks are all avoided. Pine and brass come from the "Scout" idea and are rare in sales tools.

**One backend change for readability:** the fake model currently echoes "Label: value" lines, so briefs read like raw forms. I'll make it pull the first prose sentences instead, so the UI shows readable text. The 10-K redaction problem still shows.
```text
import { logEngagement } from "../../vendor/crm/index";
import { send } from "../../vendor/email/index";
import { loadConfig } from "../shared/config";
import type { ContactRow, Delivery, EmailDraft, OutreachRow } from "../shared/types";
import { db } from "../shared/db";
import { contactedRecently, getOutreach, logDraft, markSent } from "./outreach-log";

const COOL_OFF_DAYS = 7;

/**
 * Logs the draft, and sends it only when asked to. A contact emailed in the
 * last week gets a draft instead, so reruns don't double-send.
 */
export class OutreachError extends Error {
  constructor(
    readonly code: "not_found" | "already_sent" | "too_soon",
    message: string,
  ) {
    super(message);
    this.name = "OutreachError";
  }
}

async function sendAndLog(entry: OutreachRow, contact: ContactRow): Promise<string> {
  const config = loadConfig();
  const result = await send({
    to: contact.email,
    from: { email: config.fromAddress, name: config.senderName },
    subject: entry.subject,
    text: entry.body,
    categories: ["scout", "first-touch"],
  });
  markSent(entry.id, result.messageId);
  await logEngagement(contact.crmId, { type: "EMAIL", body: `${entry.subject}\n\n${entry.body}` });
  return result.messageId;
}

export async function deliver(
  draft: EmailDraft,
  contact: ContactRow,
  options: { runId: string; send: boolean },
): Promise<Delivery> {
  const tooSoon = contactedRecently(contact.id, COOL_OFF_DAYS);
  const entry = logDraft({ runId: options.runId, contactId: contact.id, subject: draft.subject, body: draft.body });
  if (!options.send || tooSoon) return { status: "drafted", logId: entry.id };

  const messageId = await sendAndLog(entry, contact);
  return { status: "sent", logId: entry.id, messageId };
}

/** Sends a draft that was logged earlier, e.g. after someone reviewed it. */
export async function sendDraft(logId: string): Promise<OutreachRow> {
  const entry = getOutreach(logId);
  if (!entry) throw new OutreachError("not_found", `no draft with id ${logId}`);
  if (entry.status === "sent") throw new OutreachError("already_sent", "this email was already sent");
  const contact = db.get<ContactRow>("contacts", entry.contactId);
  if (!contact) throw new OutreachError("not_found", "the contact for this draft no longer exists");
  if (contactedRecently(contact.id, COOL_OFF_DAYS)) {
    throw new OutreachError("too_soon", `${contact.name} was emailed in the last ${COOL_OFF_DAYS} days`);
  }
  await sendAndLog(entry, contact);
  return getOutreach(logId) as OutreachRow;
}
```

```typescript
import { existsSync, readFileSync, statSync } from "node:fs";
import { createServer, type IncomingMessage, type Server, type ServerResponse } from "node:http";
import { extname, join, normalize } from "node:path";
import { fileURLToPath, pathToFileURL } from "node:url";
import { costSummary, recentCosts } from "../gateway/cost-ledger";
import { listAccounts, notesFor } from "../memory/notes-store";
import { runAgent } from "../orchestrator/agent";
import { getRun, listRuns } from "../orchestrator/run-state";
import { registry } from "../orchestrator/tool-registry";
import { contactByEmail, listContacts } from "../outreach/crm-sync";
import { draftForRun, recentOutreach } from "../outreach/outreach-log";
import { OutreachError, sendDraft } from "../outreach/send";
import { loadConfig } from "../shared/config";
import { db } from "../shared/db";
import { createLogger } from "../shared/logger";
import type { ContactRow, RunRow } from "../shared/types";
import { validateRunRequest } from "./validate";

const log = createLogger("http");
const MAX_BODY_BYTES = 64 * 1024;
const WEB_ROOT = fileURLToPath(new URL("../../web/dist/", import.meta.url));

const MIME: Record<string, string> = {
  ".html": "text/html; charset=utf-8",
  ".js": "text/javascript; charset=utf-8",
  ".css": "text/css; charset=utf-8",
  ".svg": "image/svg+xml",
  ".woff2": "font/woff2",
  ".png": "image/png",
  ".ico": "image/x-icon",
  ".json": "application/json; charset=utf-8",
};

class HttpError extends Error {
  constructor(
    readonly status: number,
    message: string,
    readonly details?: unknown,
  ) {
    super(message);
  }
}

function send(res: ServerResponse, status: number, body: unknown): void {
  const payload = JSON.stringify(body);
  res.writeHead(status, { "content-type": "application/json; charset=utf-8", "content-length": Buffer.byteLength(payload) });
  res.end(payload);
}

async function readJson(req: IncomingMessage): Promise<unknown> {
  const chunks: Buffer[] = [];
  let size = 0;
  for await (const chunk of req) {
    size += (chunk as Buffer).length;
    if (size > MAX_BODY_BYTES) throw new HttpError(413, "request body too large");
    chunks.push(chunk as Buffer);
  }
  if (size === 0) return undefined;
  try {
    return JSON.parse(Buffer.concat(chunks).toString("utf8"));
  } catch {
    throw new HttpError(400, "body is not valid JSON");
  }
}

function persist(): void {
  const path = loadConfig().snapshotPath;
  if (path) db.snapshot(path);
}

function withContact(run: RunRow): RunRow & { contact: ContactRow | null } {
  return { ...run, contact: contactByEmail(run.contactEmail) ?? null };
}

type Handler = (params: string[], req: IncomingMessage, url: URL) => Promise<[number, unknown]> | [number, unknown];

const routes: Array<[method: string, pattern: RegExp, handler: Handler]> = [
  ["GET", /^\/api\/runs$/, (_p, _r, url) => [200, { runs: listRuns(Number(url.searchParams.get("limit") ?? 20)).map(withContact) }]],
  [
    "POST",
    /^\/api\/runs$/,
    async (_p, req) => {
      const parsed = validateRunRequest(await readJson(req));
      if (!parsed.ok) throw new HttpError(400, "invalid request", parsed.errors);
      const result = await runAgent(parsed.value);
      persist();
      return [201, result];
    },
  ],
  [
    "GET",
    /^\/api\/runs\/([\w-]+)$/,
    ([id = ""]) => {
      const run = getRun(id);
      if (!run) throw new HttpError(404, "run not found");
      return [200, { run: withContact(run), email: draftForRun(id) ?? null, usage: costSummary(id) }];
    },
  ],
  ["GET", /^\/api\/accounts$/, () => [200, { accounts: listAccounts() }]],
  ["GET", /^\/api\/accounts\/([\w-]+)\/notes$/, ([company = ""]) => [200, { notes: notesFor(company) }]],
  ["GET", /^\/api\/contacts$/, () => [200, { contacts: listContacts() }]],
  ["GET", /^\/api\/outreach$/, () => [200, { outreach: recentOutreach(100) }]],
  [
    "POST",
    /^\/api\/outreach\/([\w-]+)\/send$/,
    async ([id = ""]) => {
      try {
        const entry = await sendDraft(id);
        persist();
        return [200, entry];
      } catch (err) {
        if (err instanceof OutreachError) throw new HttpError(err.code === "not_found" ? 404 : 409, err.message);
        throw err;
      }
    },
  ],
  ["GET", /^\/api\/usage$/, () => [200, { summary: costSummary(), recent: recentCosts(50) }]],
  [
    "GET",
    /^\/api\/tools$/,
    () => [200, { tools: registry.list().map(({ name, tags, description }) => ({ name, tags, description })) }],
  ],
];

/** Serves the built web app; unknown paths get index.html so client-side routes work on reload. */
function serveStatic(pathname: string, res: ServerResponse): void {
  const index = join(WEB_ROOT, "index.html");
  if (!existsSync(index)) {
    res.writeHead(404, { "content-type": "text/plain; charset=utf-8" });
    res.end("The web app isn't built yet. Run `npm run build`, or use `npm run dev` for development.\n");
    return;
  }
  const requested = normalize(join(WEB_ROOT, decodeURIComponent(pathname)));
  const file = requested.startsWith(WEB_ROOT) && existsSync(requested) && statSync(requested).isFile() ? requested : index;
  const immutable = file.includes(`${WEB_ROOT}assets`);
  res.writeHead(200, {
    "content-type": MIME[extname(file)] ?? "application/octet-stream",
    "cache-control": immutable ? "public, max-age=31536000, immutable" : "no-cache",
  });
  res.end(readFileSync(file));
}

async function handle(req: IncomingMessage, res: ServerResponse): Promise<void> {
  const url = new URL(req.url ?? "/", "http://localhost");
  const method = req.method ?? "GET";

  if (method === "GET" && url.pathname === "/health") return send(res, 200, { ok: true });

  if (url.pathname.startsWith("/api/")) {
    const matching = routes.filter(([, pattern]) => pattern.test(url.pathname));
    if (matching.length === 0) throw new HttpError(404, "not found");
    const route = matching.find(([m]) => m === method);
    if (!route) throw new HttpError(405, "method not allowed");
    const [, pattern, handler] = route;
    const params = (pattern.exec(url.pathname) ?? []).slice(1);
    const [status, body] = await handler(params, req, url);
    return send(res, status, body);
  }

  if (method !== "GET" && method !== "HEAD") throw new HttpError(405, "method not allowed");
  serveStatic(url.pathname, res);
}

export function createScoutServer(): Server {
  return createServer((req, res) => {
    handle(req, res).catch((err: unknown) => {
      if (err instanceof HttpError) {
        send(res, err.status, { error: err.message, ...(err.details ? { details: err.details } : {}) });
        return;
      }
      log.error("request failed", { url: req.url, error: err instanceof Error ? err.message : String(err) });
      send(res, 500, { error: "internal error" });
    });
  });
}

export async function start(port = loadConfig().port): Promise<Server> {
  const snapshot = loadConfig().snapshotPath;
  if (snapshot && db.restore(snapshot)) log.info("restored snapshot", { path: snapshot });
  const server = createScoutServer();
  await new Promise<void>((resolve) => server.listen(port, resolve));
  log.warn(`scout listening on http://localhost:${port}`);
  return server;
}

if (process.argv[1] && import.meta.url === pathToFileURL(process.argv[1]).href) {
```
