```typescript
import { useSyncExternalStore, type AnchorHTMLAttributes, type MouseEvent } from "react";

/** A small history router: enough for a handful of pages without another dependency. */

const listeners = new Set<() => void>();

function subscribe(listener: () => void): () => void {
  listeners.add(listener);
  window.addEventListener("popstate", listener);
  return () => {
    listeners.delete(listener);
    window.removeEventListener("popstate", listener);
  };
}

export function navigate(to: string): void {
  if (to === window.location.pathname + window.location.search) return;
  window.history.pushState(null, "", to);
  window.scrollTo({ top: 0 });
  for (const listener of listeners) listener();
}

export function usePath(): string {
  return useSyncExternalStore(subscribe, () => window.location.pathname);
}

/** Returns the captured groups if `pattern` matches the current path. */
export function matchPath(path: string, pattern: RegExp): string[] | null {
  const match = pattern.exec(path);
  return match ? match.slice(1) : null;
}

type LinkProps = AnchorHTMLAttributes<HTMLAnchorElement> & { to: string };

export function Link({ to, onClick, ...rest }: LinkProps) {
  const handle = (event: MouseEvent<HTMLAnchorElement>) => {
    onClick?.(event);
    if (event.defaultPrevented || event.button !== 0 || event.metaKey || event.ctrlKey || event.shiftKey || event.altKey) {
      return;
    }
    event.preventDefault();
    navigate(to);
  };
  return <a href={to} onClick={handle} {...rest} />;
}
```

```typescript
import { AccountsPage } from "../features/notes/AccountsPage";
import { OutreachPage } from "../features/outreach/OutreachPage";
import { ResearchPage } from "../features/runs/ResearchPage";
import { RunPage } from "../features/runs/RunPage";
import { ToolsPage } from "../features/tools/ToolsPage";
import { UsagePage } from "../features/usage/UsagePage";
import { EmptyState } from "../shared/ui";
import { Link, matchPath, usePath } from "./router";
import { Sidebar } from "./Sidebar";

function Page({ path }: { path: string }) {
  if (path === "/") return <ResearchPage />;
  const run = matchPath(path, /^\/runs\/([\w-]+)$/);
  if (run) return <RunPage id={run[0] ?? ""} />;
  const account = matchPath(path, /^\/accounts(?:\/([\w-]+))?$/);
  if (account) return <AccountsPage company={account[0]} />;
  if (path === "/outreach") return <OutreachPage />;
  if (path === "/usage") return <UsagePage />;
  if (path === "/tools") return <ToolsPage />;
  return (
    <EmptyState title="There's no page here">
      Check the address, or go back to <Link to="/">Research</Link>.
    </EmptyState>
  );
}

export function App() {
  const path = usePath();
  return (
    <div className="shell">
      <Sidebar path={path} />
      <main className="main" id="main">
        <Page path={path} />
      </main>
    </div>
  );
}
```

```typescript
import { useCallback, useEffect, useRef, useState } from "react";
import type {
  ContactRow,
  CostRow,
  NoteRow,
  OutreachRow,
  RunRequest,
  RunResult,
  RunRow,
} from "../../../src/shared/types";

export type { ContactRow, CostRow, NoteRow, OutreachRow, RunRequest, RunResult, RunRow };

export type RunListItem = RunRow & { contact: ContactRow | null };

export interface RunDetail {
  run: RunListItem;
  email: OutreachRow | null;
  usage: UsageSummary;
}

export interface AccountSummary {
  company: string;
  notes: number;
  lastNoteAt: string;
  sources: string[];
}

export interface UsageSummary {
  calls: number;
  inputTokens: number;
  outputTokens: number;
  usd: number;
  byPurpose: Record<string, { calls: number; usd: number }>;
}

export interface ToolInfo {
  name: string;
  tags: string[];
  description: string;
}

export class ApiError extends Error {
  constructor(
    readonly status: number,
    message: string,
    readonly details: string[] = [],
  ) {
    super(message);
    this.name = "ApiError";
  }
}

async function request<T>(path: string, init?: RequestInit): Promise<T> {
  let res: Response;
  try {
    res = await fetch(`/api${path}`, { ...init, headers: { "content-type": "application/json", ...init?.headers } });
  } catch {
    throw new ApiError(0, "Scout's server isn't responding. Check that it's running, then try again.");
  }
  const body = (await res.json().catch(() => ({}))) as { error?: string; details?: string[] };
  if (!res.ok) throw new ApiError(res.status, body.error ?? `Request failed with status ${res.status}`, body.details);
  return body as T;
}

export const api = {
  runs: () => request<{ runs: RunListItem[] }>("/runs?limit=25").then((b) => b.runs),
  run: (id: string) => request<RunDetail>(`/runs/${encodeURIComponent(id)}`),
  startRun: (body: RunRequest) => request<RunResult>("/runs", { method: "POST", body: JSON.stringify(body) }),
  accounts: () => request<{ accounts: AccountSummary[] }>("/accounts").then((b) => b.accounts),
  notes: (company: string) => request<{ notes: NoteRow[] }>(`/accounts/${encodeURIComponent(company)}/notes`).then((b) => b.notes),
  contacts: () => request<{ contacts: ContactRow[] }>("/contacts").then((b) => b.contacts),
  outreach: () => request<{ outreach: OutreachRow[] }>("/outreach").then((b) => b.outreach),
  sendDraft: (id: string) => request<OutreachRow>(`/outreach/${encodeURIComponent(id)}/send`, { method: "POST" }),
  usage: () => request<{ summary: UsageSummary; recent: CostRow[] }>("/usage"),
  tools: () => request<{ tools: ToolInfo[] }>("/tools").then((b) => b.tools),
};

export interface Resource<T> {
  data: T | undefined;
  error: ApiError | undefined;
  loading: boolean;
  reload: () => void;
}

/** Loads data on mount and whenever `key` changes; keeps the previous data while reloading. */
export function useResource<T>(key: string, load: () => Promise<T>): Resource<T> {
  const [data, setData] = useState<T>();
  const [error, setError] = useState<ApiError>();
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [version, setVersion] = useState(0);
  const loadRef = useRef(load);
  loadRef.current = load;

  useEffect(() => {
    let cancelled = false;
    setLoading(true);
    loadRef
      .current()
      .then((value) => {
        if (cancelled) return;
        setData(value);
        setError(undefined);
      })
      .catch((err: unknown) => {
        if (cancelled) return;
        setError(err instanceof ApiError ? err : new ApiError(0, String(err)));
      })
      .finally(() => {
        if (!cancelled) setLoading(false);
      });
    return () => {
      cancelled = true;
    };
  }, [key, version]);

  const reload = useCallback(() => setVersion((v) => v + 1), []);
  return { data, error, loading, reload };
}

```

```typescript
const TOOL_LABELS: Record<string, string> = {
  web_search: "Web search",
  company_profile: "Company profile",
  news_digest: "News digest",
  news_summarize: "News talking points",
};

/** "filing_summary" -> "Filing summary", with friendlier names for the built-in tools. */
export function toolLabel(name: string): string {
  if (TOOL_LABELS[name]) return TOOL_LABELS[name];
  const words = name.replace(/_/g, " ");
  return words.charAt(0).toUpperCase() + words.slice(1);
}

const PURPOSE_LABELS: Record<string, string> = {
  plan: "Planning",
  profile: "Company profiles",
  summary: "Summaries",
  brief: "Briefs",
  email: "Email drafts",
  embed: "Note search",
};

export function purposeLabel(purpose: string): string {
  return PURPOSE_LABELS[purpose] ?? purpose;
}

/** "acme-robotics" -> "Acme Robotics" */
export function companyName(slug: string): string {
  return slug
    .split("-")
    .filter(Boolean)
    .map((w) => w.charAt(0).toUpperCase() + w.slice(1))
    .join(" ");
}

const relative = new Intl.RelativeTimeFormat("en", { numeric: "auto" });
const STEPS: Array<[Intl.RelativeTimeFormatUnit, number]> = [
  ["second", 60],
  ["minute", 60],
  ["hour", 24],
  ["day", 7],
  ["week", 4.35],
  ["month", 12],
  ["year", Number.POSITIVE_INFINITY],
];

export function timeAgo(iso: string | null | undefined, now = Date.now()): string {
  if (!iso) return "";
  let value = (Date.parse(iso) - now) / 1000;
  for (const [unit, size] of STEPS) {
    if (Math.abs(value) < size) return unit === "second" && Math.abs(value) < 45 ? "just now" : relative.format(Math.round(value), unit);
    value /= size;
  }
  return "";
}

const dateTimeFormat = new Intl.DateTimeFormat("en", { dateStyle: "medium", timeStyle: "short" });

export function dateTime(iso: string | null | undefined): string {
  return iso ? dateTimeFormat.format(new Date(iso)) : "";
}

export function count(n: number): string {
  return n.toLocaleString("en-US");
}

/** Model costs are fractions of a cent, so show enough digits to tell runs apart. */
export function usd(n: number): string {
  if (n === 0) return "$0";
  if (n < 0.01) return `$${n.toFixed(4)}`;
  return `$${n.toFixed(2)}`;
}

export function hostOf(url: string): string {
  try {
    return new URL(url).hostname.replace(/^www\./, "");
  } catch {
    return url;
  }
}

export function plural(n: number, one: string, many = `${one}s`): string {
  return `${count(n)} ${n === 1 ? one : many}`;
}

```

```typescript
import { Fragment } from "react";

const TOKEN = /\[(EMAIL|PHONE|NAME)_(\d+)\]/g;

const KIND_LABEL: Record<string, string> = { EMAIL: "email", PHONE: "phone", NAME: "name" };

/**
 * Text that came back from a model, with redaction tokens like [NAME_1] shown
 * as small markers instead of raw brackets.
 */
export function Redacted({ text }: { text: string }) {
  const parts: Array<string | { kind: string; n: string }> = [];
  let last = 0;
  for (const match of text.matchAll(TOKEN)) {
    const index = match.index ?? 0;
    if (index > last) parts.push(text.slice(last, index));
    parts.push({ kind: match[1] ?? "", n: match[2] ?? "" });
    last = index + match[0].length;
  }
  if (last < text.length) parts.push(text.slice(last));

  return (
    <>
      {parts.map((part, i) =>
        typeof part === "string" ? (
          <Fragment key={i}>{part}</Fragment>
        ) : (
          <mark key={i} className="redacted" title="Hidden before this text was sent to the model">
            {KIND_LABEL[part.kind]} {part.n}
          </mark>
        ),
      )}
    </>
  );
}
```

```typescript
import { useState } from "react";
import { api, ApiError, type OutreachRow } from "./api";
import { dateTime } from "./format";
import { Icon } from "./icons";
import { Button, ErrorNote, StatusPill } from "./ui";

/** A drafted or sent email, with Send and Copy actions. */
export function EmailPreview({
  entry,
  to,
  onSent,
}: {
  entry: OutreachRow;
  to: string;
  onSent?: (entry: OutreachRow) => void;
}) {
  const [current, setCurrent] = useState(entry);
  const [sending, setSending] = useState(false);
  const [error, setError] = useState<ApiError>();
  const [copied, setCopied] = useState(false);

  const sendNow = async () => {
    setSending(true);
    setError(undefined);
    try {
      const updated = await api.sendDraft(current.id);
      setCurrent(updated);
      onSent?.(updated);
    } catch (err) {
      setError(err instanceof ApiError ? err : new ApiError(0, String(err)));
    } finally {
      setSending(false);
    }
  };

  const copy = async () => {
    await navigator.clipboard.writeText(`Subject: ${current.subject}\n\n${current.body}`);
    setCopied(true);
    window.setTimeout(() => setCopied(false), 1600);
  };

  return (
    <div className="email">
      <dl className="email-meta">
        <div>
          <dt>To</dt>
          <dd>{to}</dd>
        </div>
        <div>
          <dt>Subject</dt>
          <dd>{current.subject}</dd>
        </div>
      </dl>
      <div className="email-body reading">{current.body}</div>
      <div className="email-actions">
        <StatusPill status={current.status} />
        {current.status === "sent" ? (
          <span className="muted">Sent {dateTime(current.sentAt)}</span>
        ) : (
          <Button onClick={sendNow} busy={sending}>
            {sending ? "Sending" : "Send email"}
          </Button>
        )}
        <Button variant="quiet" onClick={copy}>
          <Icon name={copied ? "check" : "copy"} size={16} />
          {copied ? "Copied" : "Copy text"}
        </Button>
      </div>
      {error && <ErrorNote error={error} />}
    </div>
  );
}

```

```typescript
import { useState, type FormEvent } from "react";
import { Link, navigate } from "../../app/router";
import { api, ApiError, useResource, type ContactRow, type RunListItem } from "../../shared/api";
import { plural, timeAgo, toolLabel } from "../../shared/format";
import { Button, EmptyState, ErrorNote, Loading, PageHeader, Section, StatusPill } from "../../shared/ui";

interface FormState {
  company: string;
  email: string;
  name: string;
  title: string;
  phone: string;
  goal: string;
  send: boolean;
}

const EMPTY: FormState = { company: "", email: "", name: "", title: "", phone: "", goal: "", send: false };

function fromContact(contact: ContactRow, goal: string): FormState {
  return {
    company: contact.company,
    email: contact.email,
    name: contact.name,
    title: contact.title ?? "",
    phone: contact.phone ?? "",
    goal,
    send: false,
  };
}

function ResearchForm({ contacts }: { contacts: ContactRow[] }) {
  const [form, setForm] = useState<FormState>(EMPTY);
  const [busy, setBusy] = useState(false);
  const [error, setError] = useState<ApiError>();
  const set = <K extends keyof FormState>(key: K, value: FormState[K]) => setForm((f) => ({ ...f, [key]: value }));

  const submit = async (event: FormEvent) => {
    event.preventDefault();
    setBusy(true);
    setError(undefined);
    try {
      const result = await api.startRun({
        company: form.company,
        goal: form.goal,
        send: form.send,
        contact: {
          email: form.email,
          name: form.name || undefined,
          title: form.title || undefined,
          phone: form.phone || undefined,
        },
      });
      navigate(`/runs/${result.runId}`);
    } catch (err) {
      setError(err instanceof ApiError ? err : new ApiError(0, String(err)));
      setBusy(false);
    }
  };

  return (
    <form className="call-sheet" onSubmit={submit} noValidate>
      {contacts.length > 0 && (
        <div className="quick-pick">
          <span className="muted">Recent contacts</span>
          <ul>
            {contacts.slice(0, 6).map((c) => (
              <li key={c.id}>
                <button type="button" className="chip" onClick={() => setForm(fromContact(c, form.goal))}>
                  {c.name}
                  <span className="chip-sub">{c.company}</span>
                </button>
              </li>
            ))}
          </ul>
        </div>
      )}

      <div className="field-grid">
        <label className="field span-2">
          <span>Company</span>
          <input value={form.company} onChange={(e) => set("company", e.target.value)} placeholder="Acme Robotics" required autoComplete="organization" />
        </label>
        <label className="field">
          <span>Contact email</span>
          <input type="email" value={form.email} onChange={(e) => set("email", e.target.value)} placeholder="jane.doe@acmerobotics.com" required />
        </label>
        <label className="field">
          <span>Contact name</span>
          <input value={form.name} onChange={(e) => set("name", e.target.value)} placeholder="Jane Doe" autoComplete="off" />
        </label>
        <label className="field">
          <span>Job title</span>
          <input value={form.title} onChange={(e) => set("title", e.target.value)} placeholder="VP Operations" />
        </label>
        <label className="field">
          <span>
            Phone <em>optional</em>
          </span>
          <input type="tel" value={form.phone} onChange={(e) => set("phone", e.target.value)} placeholder="+1 (412) 555-0134" />
        </label>
        <label className="field span-2">
          <span>What do you need for this conversation?</span>
          <textarea
            rows={3}
            value={form.goal}
            onChange={(e) => set("goal", e.target.value)}
            placeholder="Prep for the renewal call next week. Check recent news and what their annual report says about priorities."
            required
          />
          <small>Mention news, filings or a topic, and Scout adds the tools that cover it.</small>
        </label>
      </div>

      {error && (
        <div className="form-errors" role="alert">
          <p>{error.details.length ? "Fix these and try again:" : error.message}</p>
          {error.details.length > 0 && (
            <ul>
              {error.details.map((d) => (
                <li key={d}>{d}</li>
              ))}
            </ul>
          )}
        </div>
      )}

      <div className="form-foot">
        <label className="check">
          <input type="checkbox" checked={form.send} onChange={(e) => set("send", e.target.checked)} />
          <span>Send the email as soon as it's written</span>
        </label>
        <Button type="submit" busy={busy}>
          {busy ? "Researching" : "Start research"}
        </Button>
      </div>
    </form>
  );
}

function RunsTable({ runs }: { runs: RunListItem[] }) {
  if (runs.length === 0) {
    return <EmptyState title="No research yet">Fill in a company and a contact above, and your first brief shows up here.</EmptyState>;
  }
  return (
    <div className="table-wrap">
      <table className="table">
        <thead>
          <tr>
            <th scope="col">Company</th>
            <th scope="col">Contact</th>
            <th scope="col">Goal</th>
            <th scope="col">Tools used</th>
            <th scope="col">Status</th>
            <th scope="col">Started</th>
          </tr>
        </thead>
        <tbody>
          {runs.map((run) => (
            <tr key={run.id} className="row-link" onClick={() => navigate(`/runs/${run.id}`)}>
              <td>
                <Link to={`/runs/${run.id}`} className="strong-link">
                  {run.company}
                </Link>
              </td>
              <td>{run.contact?.name ?? run.contactEmail}</td>
              <td className="truncate" title={run.goal}>
                {run.goal}
              </td>
              <td className="muted" title={run.plan.map(toolLabel).join(", ")}>
                {plural(run.steps.length, "tool")}
              </td>
              <td>
                <StatusPill status={run.status} />
              </td>
              <td className="muted nowrap">{timeAgo(run.startedAt)}</td>
            </tr>
          ))}
        </tbody>
      </table>
    </div>
  );
}

export function ResearchPage() {
  const runs = useResource("runs", api.runs);
  const contacts = useResource("contacts", api.contacts);

  return (
    <>
      <PageHeader title="Research a prospect">
        Scout looks up the company, its recent news and filings, then writes you a brief and a first email.
      </PageHeader>
      <ResearchForm contacts={contacts.data ?? []} />
      <Section title="Recent research">
        {runs.error ? <ErrorNote error={runs.error} onRetry={runs.reload} /> : runs.data ? <RunsTable runs={runs.data} /> : <Loading />}
      </Section>
    </>
  );
}
```

```typescript
        )}
        {sources.length > 0 && (
          <ul className="sources" aria-label="Sources">
            {sources.slice(0, 4).map((url) => (
              <li key={url}>
                <a href={url} target="_blank" rel="noreferrer">
                  {hostOf(url)}
                  <Icon name="external" size={13} />
                </a>
              </li>
            ))}
          </ul>
        )}
        {facts.length > 0 && (
          <>
            <button type="button" className="text-button" aria-expanded={open} onClick={() => setOpen((o) => !o)}>
              {open ? "Hide details" : `Show ${plural(facts.length, "detail")}`}
            </button>
            {open && (
              <ul className="facts">
                {facts.map((fact) => (
                  <li key={fact}>
                    <Redacted text={fact} />
                  </li>
                ))}
              </ul>
            )}
          </>
        )}
      </div>
    </li>
  );
}

/** The tools a run used, in order, as waypoints on a line. */
export function Trail({ steps }: { steps: Step[] }) {
  if (steps.length === 0) return <p className="muted">No tools ran.</p>;
  return (
    <ol className="trail">
      {steps.map((step) => (
        <Waypoint key={step.index} step={step} />
      ))}
    </ol>
  );
}

```

```typescript
import { Link } from "../../app/router";
import { api, useResource } from "../../shared/api";
import { EmailPreview } from "../../shared/EmailPreview";
import { dateTime, plural, usd } from "../../shared/format";
import { Icon } from "../../shared/icons";
import { Redacted } from "../../shared/Redacted";
import { EmptyState, ErrorNote, Loading, StatusPill } from "../../shared/ui";
import { Trail } from "./Trail";

export function RunPage({ id }: { id: string }) {
  const detail = useResource(`run:${id}`, () => api.run(id));

  if (detail.error?.status === 404) {
    return (
      <EmptyState title="This research run doesn't exist">
        It may have been cleared. Go back to <Link to="/">Research</Link> to start a new one.
      </EmptyState>
    );
  }
  if (detail.error) return <ErrorNote error={detail.error} onRetry={detail.reload} />;
  if (!detail.data) return <Loading label="Loading research" />;

  const { run, email, usage } = detail.data;
  const contact = run.contact;

  return (
    <article className="run">
      <Link to="/" className="back-link">
        <Icon name="back" size={16} />
        Research
      </Link>

      <header className="run-header">
        <div>
          <h1>{run.company}</h1>
          <p className="run-contact">
            <span className="run-contact-name">{contact?.name ?? run.contactEmail}</span>
            {contact?.title && <span>{contact.title}</span>}
            <span className="muted">{run.contactEmail}</span>
          </p>
        </div>
        <StatusPill status={run.status} />
      </header>
      <p className="run-goal">{run.goal}</p>

      <div className="run-grid">
        <div className="run-main">
          <section className="brief" aria-labelledby="brief-title">
            <h2 id="brief-title">Brief</h2>
            {run.status === "failed" ? (
              <p className="waypoint-error">This run stopped early: {run.error}</p>
            ) : (
              <p className="reading brief-text">
                <Redacted text={run.brief ?? ""} />
              </p>
            )}
            <p className="footnote">
              Written {dateTime(run.finishedAt ?? run.startedAt)}. Personal details were hidden from the model and appear as
              marked placeholders.
            </p>
          </section>

          <section aria-labelledby="email-title">
            <h2 id="email-title">First email</h2>
            {email ? (
              <EmailPreview entry={email} to={contact ? `${contact.name} <${contact.email}>` : run.contactEmail} />
            ) : (
              <p className="muted">No email was drafted for this run.</p>
            )}
          </section>
        </div>

        <aside className="run-side" aria-labelledby="trail-title">
          <h2 id="trail-title">How Scout researched this</h2>
          <Trail steps={run.steps} />
          <p className="footnote">
            {plural(usage.calls, "model call")}, {usd(usage.usd)} total.{" "}
            <Link to="/usage">See model usage</Link>
          </p>
        </aside>
      </div>
    </article>
  );
}

```

```typescript
import { Link } from "../../app/router";
import { api, useResource, type AccountSummary } from "../../shared/api";
import { companyName, dateTime, plural, timeAgo, toolLabel } from "../../shared/format";
import { Redacted } from "../../shared/Redacted";
import { EmptyState, ErrorNote, Loading, PageHeader } from "../../shared/ui";

function sourceLabel(source: string): string {
  return source === "seed" ? "Added by your team" : toolLabel(source);
}

function Notes({ company }: { company: string }) {
  const notes = useResource(`notes:${company}`, () => api.notes(company));
  if (notes.error) return <ErrorNote error={notes.error} onRetry={notes.reload} />;
  if (!notes.data) return <Loading label="Loading notes" />;
  if (notes.data.length === 0) return <EmptyState title="No notes for this account yet" />;

  return (
    <ol className="notes">
      {notes.data.map((note) => (
        <li key={note.id} className="note">
          <p className="note-meta">
            <span>{sourceLabel(note.source)}</span>
            <time dateTime={note.createdAt} title={dateTime(note.createdAt)}>
              {timeAgo(note.createdAt)}
            </time>
          </p>
          <p className="note-text">
            <Redacted text={note.text} />
          </p>
        </li>
      ))}
    </ol>
  );
}

function AccountList({ accounts, selected }: { accounts: AccountSummary[]; selected: string }) {
  return (
    <nav aria-label="Accounts">
      <ul className="account-list">
        {accounts.map((a) => (
          <li key={a.company}>
            <Link
              to={`/accounts/${a.company}`}
              className={a.company === selected ? "account active" : "account"}
              aria-current={a.company === selected ? "page" : undefined}
            >
              <span className="account-name">{companyName(a.company)}</span>
              <span className="muted">
                {plural(a.notes, "note")}, updated {timeAgo(a.lastNoteAt)}
              </span>
            </Link>
          </li>
        ))}
      </ul>
    </nav>
  );
}

export function AccountsPage({ company }: { company?: string }) {
  const accounts = useResource("accounts", api.accounts);
  const selected = company ?? accounts.data?.[0]?.company ?? "";

  return (
    <>
      <PageHeader title="Accounts">
        What Scout remembers about each company. Every run saves its findings here, and the next run on the same company starts
        from them.
      </PageHeader>
      {accounts.error ? (
        <ErrorNote error={accounts.error} onRetry={accounts.reload} />
      ) : !accounts.data ? (
        <Loading />
      ) : accounts.data.length === 0 ? (
        <EmptyState title="No accounts yet">
          Notes appear here after your first <Link to="/">research run</Link>.
        </EmptyState>
      ) : (
        <div className="split">
          <AccountList accounts={accounts.data} selected={selected} />
          <section aria-labelledby="notes-title">
            <h2 id="notes-title" className="split-title">
              {companyName(selected)}
            </h2>
            <Notes company={selected} />
          </section>
        </div>
      )}
    </>
  );
}
```

```typescript
import { useMemo, useState } from "react";
import { Link } from "../../app/router";
import { api, useResource, type ContactRow, type OutreachRow } from "../../shared/api";
import { dateTime, timeAgo } from "../../shared/format";
import { EmailPreview } from "../../shared/EmailPreview";
import { EmptyState, ErrorNote, Loading, PageHeader, StatusPill } from "../../shared/ui";

type Filter = "all" | "drafted" | "sent";

const FILTERS: Array<[Filter, string]> = [
  ["all", "All"],
  ["drafted", "Waiting to send"],
  ["sent", "Sent"],
];

function OutreachRowView({
  entry,
  contact,
  open,
  onToggle,
  onSent,
}: {
  entry: OutreachRow;
  contact: ContactRow | undefined;
  open: boolean;
  onToggle: () => void;
  onSent: () => void;
}) {
  return (
    <li className={open ? "outbox-item open" : "outbox-item"}>
      <button type="button" className="outbox-summary" aria-expanded={open} onClick={onToggle}>
        <span className="outbox-to">
          <span className="strong">{contact?.name ?? "Unknown contact"}</span>
          <span className="muted">{contact?.company}</span>
        </span>
        <span className="outbox-subject">{entry.subject}</span>
        <StatusPill status={entry.status} />
        <time className="muted nowrap" dateTime={entry.createdAt} title={dateTime(entry.createdAt)}>
          {timeAgo(entry.createdAt)}
        </time>
      </button>
      {open && (
        <div className="outbox-detail">
          <EmailPreview entry={entry} to={contact ? `${contact.name} <${contact.email}>` : ""} onSent={onSent} />
          <p className="footnote">
            From <Link to={`/runs/${entry.runId}`}>this research run</Link>.
          </p>
        </div>
      )}
    </li>
  );
}

export function OutreachPage() {
  const outreach = useResource("outreach", api.outreach);
  const contacts = useResource("contacts", api.contacts);
  const [filter, setFilter] = useState<Filter>("all");
  const [openId, setOpenId] = useState<string>();

  const byId = useMemo(() => new Map((contacts.data ?? []).map((c) => [c.id, c])), [contacts.data]);
  const entries = (outreach.data ?? []).filter((e) => filter === "all" || e.status === filter);
  const waiting = (outreach.data ?? []).filter((e) => e.status === "drafted").length;

  return (
    <>
      <PageHeader title="Outreach">
        {waiting > 0
          ? `${waiting} ${waiting === 1 ? "email is" : "emails are"} waiting for you to review and send.`
          : "Every email Scout has drafted or sent."}
      </PageHeader>

      <div className="segmented" role="group" aria-label="Show">
        {FILTERS.map(([value, label]) => (
          <button key={value} type="button" aria-pressed={filter === value} onClick={() => setFilter(value)}>
            {label}
          </button>
        ))}
      </div>

      {outreach.error ? (
        <ErrorNote error={outreach.error} onRetry={outreach.reload} />
      ) : !outreach.data ? (
        <Loading />
      ) : entries.length === 0 ? (
        <EmptyState title={filter === "sent" ? "Nothing sent yet" : "No emails here"}>
          Emails are drafted at the end of each <Link to="/">research run</Link>.
        </EmptyState>
      ) : (
        <ul className="outbox">
          {entries.map((entry) => (
            <OutreachRowView
              key={entry.id}
              entry={entry}
              contact={byId.get(entry.contactId)}
              open={openId === entry.id}
              onToggle={() => setOpenId(openId === entry.id ? undefined : entry.id)}
              onSent={outreach.reload}
            />
          ))}
        </ul>
      )}
    </>
  );
}

```

```typescript
import { Link } from "../../app/router";
import { api, useResource } from "../../shared/api";
import { count, dateTime, purposeLabel, timeAgo, usd } from "../../shared/format";
import { EmptyState, ErrorNote, Loading, PageHeader, Section } from "../../shared/ui";

export function UsagePage() {
  const usage = useResource("usage", api.usage);

  return (
    <>
      <PageHeader title="Model usage">
        Every call Scout makes to a language model goes through one gateway, which hides personal details first and records the
        cost here.
      </PageHeader>

      {usage.error ? (
        <ErrorNote error={usage.error} onRetry={usage.reload} />
      ) : !usage.data ? (
        <Loading />
      ) : usage.data.summary.calls === 0 ? (
        <EmptyState title="No model calls yet">
          Costs show up here after your first <Link to="/">research run</Link>.
        </EmptyState>
      ) : (
        <>
          <dl className="totals">
            <div>
              <dt>Model calls</dt>
              <dd>{count(usage.data.summary.calls)}</dd>
            </div>
            <div>
              <dt>Tokens sent</dt>
              <dd>{count(usage.data.summary.inputTokens)}</dd>
            </div>
            <div>
              <dt>Tokens received</dt>
              <dd>{count(usage.data.summary.outputTokens)}</dd>
            </div>
            <div>
              <dt>Cost</dt>
              <dd>{usd(usage.data.summary.usd)}</dd>
            </div>
          </dl>

          <Section title="By task">
            <div className="table-wrap">
              <table className="table">
                <thead>
                  <tr>
                    <th scope="col">Task</th>
                    <th scope="col" className="num">
                      Calls
                    </th>
                    <th scope="col" className="num">
                      Cost
                    </th>
                    <th scope="col">Share of cost</th>
                  </tr>
                </thead>
                <tbody>
                  {Object.entries(usage.data.summary.byPurpose)
                    .sort((a, b) => b[1].usd - a[1].usd)
                    .map(([purpose, row]) => {
                      const share = usage.data!.summary.usd > 0 ? row.usd / usage.data!.summary.usd : 0;
                      return (
                        <tr key={purpose}>
                          <td>{purposeLabel(purpose)}</td>
                          <td className="num">{count(row.calls)}</td>
                          <td className="num">{usd(row.usd)}</td>
                          <td>
                            <span className="share" aria-label={`${Math.round(share * 100)}%`}>
                              <span style={{ width: `${Math.max(2, share * 100)}%` }} />
                            </span>
                          </td>
                        </tr>
                      );
                    })}
                </tbody>
              </table>
            </div>
          </Section>

          <Section title="Latest calls">
            <div className="table-wrap">
              <table className="table">
                <thead>
                  <tr>
                    <th scope="col">When</th>
                    <th scope="col">Task</th>
                    <th scope="col">Model</th>
                    <th scope="col" className="num">
                      Tokens
                    </th>
                    <th scope="col" className="num">
                      Cost
                    </th>
                    <th scope="col">Run</th>
                  </tr>
                </thead>
                <tbody>
                  {usage.data.recent.map((row) => (
                    <tr key={row.id}>
                      <td className="muted nowrap" title={dateTime(row.at)}>
                        {timeAgo(row.at)}
                      </td>
                      <td>{purposeLabel(row.purpose)}</td>
                      <td className="muted">{row.model}</td>
                      <td className="num">{count(row.inputTokens + row.outputTokens)}</td>
                      <td className="num">{usd(row.usd)}</td>
                      <td>{row.runId?.startsWith("run_") ? <Link to={`/runs/${row.runId}`}>View</Link> : <span className="muted">None</span>}</td>
                    </tr>
                  ))}
                </tbody>
              </table>
            </div>
          </Section>
        </>
      )}
    </>
  );
}
```

```css
:root {
  --pine: #17322b;
  --pine-2: #21443a;
  --pine-ink: #cfe0d8;
  --paper: #f4f6f3;
  --surface: #ffffff;
  --ink: #1c2420;
  --moss: #5d6b65;
  --line: #dde3df;
  --line-strong: #c6cfca;
  --brass: #a8741a;
  --brass-soft: #f3e7cf;
  --brass-ink: #6e4b0e;
  --sent: #2f7a50;
  --sent-soft: #e2f1e8;
  --danger: #b3261e;
  --danger-soft: #fbe9e7;

  --ui: "Schibsted Grotesk Variable", "Schibsted Grotesk", ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif;
  --read: "Newsreader Variable", "Newsreader", Georgia, "Times New Roman", serif;

  --radius-s: 6px;
  --radius-m: 10px;
  --sidebar: 236px;

  color-scheme: light;
  font-family: var(--ui);
  font-size: 15px;
  line-height: 1.5;
  color: var(--ink);
  background: var(--paper);
  font-feature-settings: "tnum" 1;
  -webkit-font-smoothing: antialiased;
}

*,
*::before,
*::after {
  box-sizing: border-box;
}

body {
  margin: 0;
  background: var(--paper);
}

h1,
h2,
h3,
p {
  margin: 0;
}

a {
  color: var(--pine);
  text-decoration-thickness: 1px;
  text-underline-offset: 3px;
}

a:hover {
  color: var(--brass-ink);
}

:focus-visible {
  outline: 2px solid var(--brass);
  outline-offset: 2px;
  border-radius: 3px;
}

.muted {
  color: var(--moss);
}

.strong {
  font-weight: 600;
}

.nowrap {
  white-space: nowrap;
}

.icon {
  flex: none;
}

/* ---- Shell --------------------------------------------------------------- */

.shell {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: var(--sidebar) minmax(0, 1fr);
  min-height: 100vh;
}

.sidebar {
  position: sticky;
  top: 0;
  height: 100vh;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 28px;
  padding: 22px 14px;
  background: var(--pine);
  color: var(--pine-ink);
}

.brand {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 10px;
  padding: 2px 8px;
  color: #fff;
  text-decoration: none;
  font-size: 1.2rem;
  font-weight: 700;
  letter-spacing: -0.01em;
}

.brand:hover {
  color: #fff;
}

.sidebar ul {
  list-style: none;
  margin: 0;
  padding: 0;
  display: grid;
  gap: 2px;
}

.nav-link {
  position: relative;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 11px;
  padding: 9px 10px;
  border-radius: var(--radius-s);
  color: var(--pine-ink);
  text-decoration: none;
  font-weight: 500;
}

.nav-link:hover {
  color: #fff;
  background: var(--pine-2);
}

.nav-link.active {
  color: #fff;
  background: var(--pine-2);
}

.nav-link.active::before {
  content: "";
  position: absolute;
  left: -14px;
  top: 8px;
  bottom: 8px;
  width: 3px;
  border-radius: 0 3px 3px 0;
  background: #d8a64a;
}

.sidebar-foot {
  margin-top: auto;
  padding: 0 10px;
  font-size: 0.8rem;
  line-height: 1.45;
  color: #9db5ab;
}

.sidebar-foot strong {
  display: block;
  color: var(--pine-ink);
  font-weight: 500;
}

.main {
  min-width: 0;
  padding: 44px clamp(20px, 4vw, 56px) 80px;
  max-width: 1240px;
}

/* ---- Page furniture ------------------------------------------------------ */

.page-header {
  display: flex;
  justify-content: space-between;
  align-items: flex-end;
  gap: 24px;
  margin-bottom: 28px;
}

.page-header h1 {
  font-size: 2rem;
  line-height: 1.15;
  font-weight: 700;
  letter-spacing: -0.02em;
}

.page-lede {
  margin-top: 8px;
  max-width: 64ch;
  color: var(--moss);
  font-size: 1.02rem;
}

.section {
  margin-top: 44px;
}

.section-head {
  display: flex;
  align-items: baseline;
  justify-content: space-between;
  gap: 16px;
  margin-bottom: 12px;
}

h2 {
  font-size: 1.05rem;
  font-weight: 650;
  letter-spacing: -0.005em;
}

.footnote {
  margin-top: 14px;
  font-size: 0.85rem;
  color: var(--moss);
}

.reading {
  font-family: var(--read);
  font-size: 1.12rem;
  line-height: 1.62;
  font-optical-sizing: auto;
}

/* ---- Buttons, pills, chips ----------------------------------------------- */

.button {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  gap: 8px;
  min-height: 38px;
  padding: 0 16px;
  border-radius: var(--radius-s);
  border: 1px solid transparent;
  font: inherit;
  font-weight: 600;
  cursor: pointer;
  white-space: nowrap;
}

.button:disabled {
  cursor: default;
  opacity: 0.7;
}

.button-primary {
  background: var(--pine);
  color: #fff;
}

.button-primary:hover:not(:disabled) {
  background: var(--pine-2);
}

.button-quiet {
  background: transparent;
  color: var(--ink);
  border-color: var(--line-strong);
}

.button-quiet:hover:not(:disabled) {
  background: var(--surface);
  border-color: var(--moss);
}

.text-button {
  margin-top: 8px;
  padding: 0;
  border: 0;
  background: none;
  font: inherit;
  font-size: 0.87rem;
  color: var(--pine);
  text-decoration: underline;
  text-underline-offset: 3px;
  cursor: pointer;
}

.pill {
  display: inline-block;
  padding: 2px 9px;
  border-radius: 999px;
  font-size: 0.8rem;
  font-weight: 600;
  white-space: nowrap;
}

.pill-drafted {
  background: var(--brass-soft);
  color: var(--brass-ink);
}

.pill-sent,
.pill-done,
.pill-ok {
  background: var(--sent-soft);
  color: var(--sent);
}

.pill-running {
  background: #e7ecf3;
  color: #34506f;
}

.pill-failed,
.pill-error {
  background: var(--danger-soft);
  color: var(--danger);
}

.redacted {
  display: inline-block;
  padding: 0 6px;
  margin: 0 1px;
  border-radius: 4px;
  border: 1px dashed #c9a96a;
  background: #fbf5e8;
  color: var(--brass-ink);
  font-family: var(--ui);
  font-size: 0.78em;
  font-weight: 600;
  line-height: 1.55;
  vertical-align: 0.08em;
  cursor: help;
}

.spinner {
  width: 14px;
  height: 14px;
  border-radius: 50%;
  border: 2px solid currentColor;
  border-right-color: transparent;
  animation: spin 0.8s linear infinite;
}

@keyframes spin {
  to {
    transform: rotate(360deg);
  }
}

.loading {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 10px;
  color: var(--moss);
  padding: 24px 0;
}

.empty {
  padding: 40px 24px;
  border: 1px dashed var(--line-strong);
  border-radius: var(--radius-m);
  color: var(--moss);
  text-align: left;
}

.empty-title {
  color: var(--ink);
  font-weight: 650;
  margin-bottom: 4px;
}

.error-note {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 12px;
  padding: 12px 14px;
  border-radius: var(--radius-s);
  background: var(--danger-soft);
  color: var(--danger);
  margin: 12px 0;
}

.error-note p {
  flex: 1;
}

/* ---- Research form ------------------------------------------------------- */

.call-sheet {
  background: var(--surface);
  border: 1px solid var(--line);
  border-radius: var(--radius-m);
  padding: 22px 24px 20px;
}

.quick-pick {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 12px;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  padding-bottom: 18px;
  margin-bottom: 18px;
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line);
  font-size: 0.87rem;
}

.quick-pick ul {
  display: flex;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  gap: 6px;
  list-style: none;
  margin: 0;
  padding: 0;
}

.chip {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: baseline;
  gap: 6px;
  padding: 4px 10px;
  border-radius: 999px;
  border: 1px solid var(--line-strong);
  background: var(--paper);
  font: inherit;
  font-weight: 550;
  color: var(--ink);
  cursor: pointer;
}

.chip:hover {
  border-color: var(--pine);
}

.chip-sub {
  color: var(--moss);
  font-weight: 400;
}

.field-grid {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr));
  gap: 16px 20px;
}

.field {
  display: grid;
  gap: 6px;
  font-size: 0.9rem;
  font-weight: 550;
}

.field em {
  font-style: normal;
  font-weight: 400;
  color: var(--moss);
}

.field small {
  font-weight: 400;
  color: var(--moss);
  font-size: 0.83rem;
}

.span-2 {
  grid-column: span 2;
}

input,
textarea {
  width: 100%;
  font: inherit;
  font-weight: 400;
  font-size: 0.97rem;
  color: var(--ink);
  background: #fbfcfb;
  border: 1px solid var(--line-strong);
  border-radius: var(--radius-s);
  padding: 9px 11px;
}

textarea {
  resize: vertical;
  min-height: 80px;
  line-height: 1.45;
}

input::placeholder,
textarea::placeholder {
  color: #9aa6a1;
}

input:focus,
textarea:focus {
  outline: none;
  border-color: var(--brass);
  box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px #a8741a33;
  background: #fff;
}

.form-foot {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: space-between;
  gap: 16px;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  margin-top: 20px;
}

.check {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 9px;
  font-size: 0.92rem;
  cursor: pointer;
}

.check input {
  width: 16px;
  height: 16px;
  accent-color: var(--pine);
}

.form-errors {
  margin-top: 16px;
  padding: 12px 14px;
  border-radius: var(--radius-s);
  background: var(--danger-soft);
  color: var(--danger);
  font-size: 0.92rem;
}

.form-errors ul {
  margin: 6px 0 0;
  padding-left: 18px;
}

/* ---- Tables -------------------------------------------------------------- */

.table-wrap {
  overflow-x: auto;
  background: var(--surface);
  border: 1px solid var(--line);
  border-radius: var(--radius-m);
}

.table {
  width: 100%;
  border-collapse: collapse;
  font-size: 0.93rem;
}

.table th {
  text-align: left;
  font-weight: 550;
  font-size: 0.83rem;
  color: var(--moss);
  padding: 10px 14px;
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line);
}

.table td {
  padding: 11px 14px;
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line);
  vertical-align: middle;
}

.table tr:last-child td {
  border-bottom: 0;
}

.table .num {
  text-align: right;
}

.row-link {
  cursor: pointer;
}

.row-link:hover td {
  background: #f8faf8;
}

.strong-link {
  font-weight: 600;
  text-decoration: none;
  color: var(--ink);
}

.truncate {
  max-width: 340px;
  overflow: hidden;
  text-overflow: ellipsis;
  white-space: nowrap;
}

/* ---- Run ----------------------------------------------------------------- */

.back-link {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 4px;
  font-size: 0.9rem;
  text-decoration: none;
  color: var(--moss);
  margin-bottom: 18px;
}

.run-header {
  display: flex;
  justify-content: space-between;
  align-items: flex-start;
  gap: 20px;
}

.run-header h1 {
  font-size: clamp(2rem, 4vw, 2.75rem);
  line-height: 1.05;
  font-weight: 750;
  letter-spacing: -0.03em;
}

.run-contact {
  display: flex;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  gap: 4px 14px;
  margin-top: 10px;
  font-size: 0.97rem;
}

.run-contact-name {
  font-weight: 600;
}

.run-goal {
  margin-top: 14px;
  max-width: 72ch;
  padding-left: 14px;
  border-left: 3px solid var(--line-strong);
  color: var(--moss);
}

.run-grid {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1.55fr) minmax(280px, 1fr);
  gap: 40px;
  margin-top: 36px;
  align-items: start;
}

.run-main {
  display: grid;
  gap: 36px;
}

.run-main h2,
.run-side h2 {
  margin-bottom: 12px;
}

.brief {
  background: var(--surface);
  border: 1px solid var(--line);
  border-radius: var(--radius-m);
  padding: 24px 28px;
}

.brief-text {
  font-size: 1.22rem;
  line-height: 1.6;
  max-width: 62ch;
}

.email {
  background: var(--surface);
  border: 1px solid var(--line);
  border-radius: var(--radius-m);
}

.email-meta {
  margin: 0;
  padding: 14px 20px;
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line);
  display: grid;
  gap: 4px;
  font-size: 0.92rem;
}

.email-meta div {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: 72px 1fr;
}

.email-meta dt {
  color: var(--moss);
}

.email-meta dd {
  margin: 0;
}

.email-body {
  padding: 18px 20px;
  white-space: pre-wrap;
  max-width: 64ch;
  font-size: 1.05rem;
}

.email-actions {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 12px;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  padding: 12px 20px;
  border-top: 1px solid var(--line);
  background: #fafbfa;
  border-radius: 0 0 var(--radius-m) var(--radius-m);
}

.email-actions .pill {
  margin-right: auto;
}

/* The trail: the run's tools as waypoints on a line. It draws in once. */

.trail {
  position: relative;
  list-style: none;
  margin: 0;
  padding: 0;
}

.trail::before {
  content: "";
  position: absolute;
  left: 13px;
  top: 14px;
  bottom: 14px;
  width: 2px;
  background: linear-gradient(var(--brass), #d8b878);
  transform-origin: top;
  animation: trail-draw 700ms cubic-bezier(0.3, 0.7, 0.2, 1) both;
}

.waypoint {
  position: relative;
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: 28px minmax(0, 1fr);
  gap: 14px;
  padding-bottom: 22px;
  animation: waypoint-in 360ms ease-out both;
  animation-delay: calc(var(--i) * 110ms);
}

.waypoint:last-child {
  padding-bottom: 0;
}

.waypoint-marker {
  position: relative;
  z-index: 1;
  display: grid;
  place-items: center;
  width: 28px;
  height: 28px;
  border-radius: 50%;
  background: var(--paper);
  border: 2px solid var(--brass);
  color: var(--brass-ink);
  font-weight: 700;
  font-size: 0.82rem;
}

.waypoint-error .waypoint-marker {
  border-color: var(--danger);
  color: var(--danger);
}

.waypoint-head {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 10px;
  min-height: 28px;
}

.waypoint-head h3 {
  font-size: 0.98rem;
  font-weight: 650;
}

.waypoint-summary {
  margin-top: 4px;
  font-size: 0.93rem;
  color: #36423d;
}

.waypoint-error {
  margin-top: 4px;
  color: var(--danger);
  font-size: 0.93rem;
}

.sources {
  display: flex;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  gap: 4px 12px;
  list-style: none;
  margin: 8px 0 0;
  padding: 0;
  font-size: 0.84rem;
}

.sources a {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 3px;
  color: var(--moss);
}

.facts {
  margin: 8px 0 0;
  padding-left: 16px;
  font-size: 0.87rem;
  color: var(--moss);
  display: grid;
  gap: 3px;
}

@keyframes trail-draw {
  from {
    transform: scaleY(0);
  }
}

@keyframes waypoint-in {
  from {
    opacity: 0;
    transform: translateY(4px);
  }
}

/* ---- Accounts ------------------------------------------------------------ */

.split {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: 280px minmax(0, 1fr);
  gap: 36px;
  align-items: start;
}

.split-title {
  font-size: 1.4rem;
  margin-bottom: 16px;
}

.account-list {
  list-style: none;
  margin: 0;
  padding: 0;
  border-top: 1px solid var(--line);
}

.account {
  display: grid;
  gap: 2px;
  padding: 12px 12px;
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line);
  text-decoration: none;
  color: var(--ink);
  font-size: 0.87rem;
}

.account:hover {
  background: var(--surface);
  color: var(--ink);
}

.account.active {
  background: var(--surface);
  box-shadow: inset 3px 0 0 var(--brass);
}

.account-name {
  font-size: 1rem;
  font-weight: 600;
}

.notes {
  list-style: none;
  margin: 0;
  padding: 0;
  display: grid;
  gap: 12px;
}

.note {
  background: var(--surface);
  border: 1px solid var(--line);
  border-radius: var(--radius-s);
  padding: 14px 18px;
}

.note-meta {
  display: flex;
  justify-content: space-between;
  gap: 12px;
  font-size: 0.83rem;
  color: var(--moss);
  margin-bottom: 6px;
}

.note-text {
  font-family: var(--read);
  font-size: 1.03rem;
  line-height: 1.55;
  white-space: pre-line;
  max-width: 70ch;
}

/* ---- Outreach ------------------------------------------------------------ */

.segmented {
  display: inline-flex;
  padding: 3px;
  border-radius: 8px;
  background: #e8ece9;
  margin-bottom: 16px;
}

.segmented button {
  border: 0;
  background: none;
  font: inherit;
  font-size: 0.9rem;
  font-weight: 550;
  color: var(--moss);
  padding: 6px 12px;
  border-radius: 6px;
  cursor: pointer;
}

.segmented button[aria-pressed="true"] {
  background: var(--surface);
  color: var(--ink);
  box-shadow: 0 1px 2px #17322b26;
}

.outbox {
  list-style: none;
  margin: 0;
  padding: 0;
  background: var(--surface);
  border: 1px solid var(--line);
  border-radius: var(--radius-m);
}

.outbox-item + .outbox-item {
  border-top: 1px solid var(--line);
}

.outbox-summary {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: minmax(160px, 1fr) minmax(0, 2fr) auto 110px;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 16px;
  width: 100%;
  padding: 13px 16px;
  border: 0;
  background: none;
  font: inherit;
  text-align: left;
  color: var(--ink);
  cursor: pointer;
}

.outbox-summary:hover {
  background: #f8faf8;
}

.outbox-to {
  display: grid;
  font-size: 0.93rem;
}

.outbox-to .muted {
  font-size: 0.83rem;
}

.outbox-subject {
  overflow: hidden;
  text-overflow: ellipsis;
  white-space: nowrap;
}

.outbox-summary time {
  text-align: right;
  font-size: 0.87rem;
}

.outbox-detail {
  padding: 4px 16px 18px;
}

.outbox-detail .email {
  background: #fbfcfb;
}

/* ---- Usage --------------------------------------------------------------- */

.totals {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(4, minmax(0, 1fr));
  margin: 0;
  background: var(--surface);
  border: 1px solid var(--line);
  border-radius: var(--radius-m);
}

.totals div {
  padding: 16px 20px;
}

.totals div + div {
  border-left: 1px solid var(--line);
}

.totals dt {
  font-size: 0.85rem;
  color: var(--moss);
}

.totals dd {
  margin: 2px 0 0;
  font-size: 1.5rem;
  font-weight: 650;
  letter-spacing: -0.01em;
}

.share {
  display: block;
  width: 160px;
  height: 8px;
  border-radius: 4px;
  background: #e8ece9;
  overflow: hidden;
}

.share span {
  display: block;
  height: 100%;
  background: var(--pine);
}

/* ---- Tools --------------------------------------------------------------- */

.tool-list {
  list-style: none;
  margin: 0;
  padding: 0;
  display: grid;
  border-top: 1px solid var(--line);
}

.tool {
  display: grid;
  gap: 6px;
  padding: 18px 4px;
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line);
}

.tool-head {
  display: flex;
  align-items: baseline;
  gap: 12px;
}

.tool-head h2 {
  font-size: 1.1rem;
}

.tool code {
  font-size: 0.82rem;
  color: var(--moss);
}

.tool p {
  max-width: 70ch;
}

.tags {
  display: flex;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  gap: 6px;
  list-style: none;
  margin: 2px 0 0;
  padding: 0;
}

.tags li {
  padding: 1px 8px;
  border-radius: 999px;
  background: #e8ece9;
  font-size: 0.82rem;
  color: #3f4b46;
}

/* ---- Small screens and reduced motion ------------------------------------ */

@media (max-width: 960px) {
  .run-grid,
  .split {
    grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr);
  }
  .totals {
    grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr));
  }
  .totals div:nth-child(3) {
    border-left: 0;
  }
  .totals div:nth-child(n + 3) {
    border-top: 1px solid var(--line);
  }
}
```

```bash
cd /Users/johnzhang/Documents/GitHub/scout-agent && cat > scripts/dev.ts <<'EOF'
/**
 * npm run dev
 *
 * Starts the API (restarting on change) and the web app's dev server together.
 * Open http://localhost:5173; API calls are proxied to the API on :8787.
 */
import { spawn, type ChildProcess } from "node:child_process";

const children: ChildProcess[] = [];

function run(name: string, command: string, args: string[]): void {
  const child = spawn(command, args, { stdio: ["ignore", "pipe", "pipe"], env: process.env });
  const prefix = (chunk: Buffer) =>
    chunk
      .toString()
      .split("\n")
      .filter((line) => line.trim())
      .map((line) => `[${name}] ${line}\n`)
      .join("");
  child.stdout?.on("data", (chunk: Buffer) => process.stdout.write(prefix(chunk)));
  child.stderr?.on("data", (chunk: Buffer) => process.stderr.write(prefix(chunk)));
  child.on("exit", (code) => {
    console.error(`[${name}] exited with code ${code ?? 0}`);
    shutdown(code ?? 0);
  });
  children.push(child);
}

function shutdown(code: number): void {
  for (const child of children) if (child.exitCode === null) child.kill("SIGTERM");
  process.exitCode = code;
}

process.on("SIGINT", () => shutdown(0));
process.on("SIGTERM", () => shutdown(0));

run("api", "npx", ["tsx", "watch", "src/channels/routes.ts"]);
run("web", "npx", ["vite", "--config", "web/vite.config.ts"]);
EOF
```
