```text
import { existsSync, readFileSync, realpathSync } from 'node:fs';
import { join, relative, isAbsolute } from 'node:path';
import { watch, type FSWatcher } from 'chokidar';
import { diffLines } from 'diff';
import {
  parseDomainMap, createMapper, scanRepo, factsForSource, domainEdges, check, fileExistsIn,
  type DomainMap, type Facts, type ImportEdge, type Violation, type Placement,
} from '@harness/core';
import type { Bus } from './bus';

const CODE = /\.(ts|tsx|js|jsx|mjs|cjs|mts)$/;

export class Repo {
  readonly root: string;
  map!: DomainMap;
  mapText = '';
  mapper!: ReturnType<typeof createMapper>;
  facts: Facts = { files: [], imports: [], writes: [] };
  violations: Violation[] = [];
  private contents = new Map<string, string>();
  private pending = new Map<string, NodeJS.Timeout>(); // paths a hook is editing; the watcher leaves them alone
  private watcher: FSWatcher | null = null;
  exists: ReturnType<typeof fileExistsIn>;

  constructor(root: string, private bus: Bus) {
    this.root = realpathSync(root);
    this.exists = fileExistsIn(this.root);
  }

  get mapPath() { return join(this.root, 'domains.yaml'); }
  hasMap() { return existsSync(this.mapPath); }

  /** Load (or reload) domains.yaml text. */
  setMap(text: string) {
    this.mapText = text;
    this.map = parseDomainMap(text);
    this.mapper = createMapper(this.map);
  }

  loadMapFile() { this.setMap(readFileSync(this.mapPath, 'utf8')); }

  /** Repo-relative POSIX path for an absolute path from a hook, or null if it is outside the repo. */
  rel(p: string): string | null {
    let abs = isAbsolute(p) ? p : join(this.root, p);
    try { abs = realpathSync(abs); } catch {
      // New file: resolve the parent instead.
      const i = abs.lastIndexOf('/');
      try { abs = join(realpathSync(abs.slice(0, i)), abs.slice(i + 1)); } catch { /* keep as is */ }
    }
    const r = relative(this.root, abs);
    if (!r || r.startsWith('..') || isAbsolute(r)) return null;
    return r.split('\\').join('/');
  }

  place(path: string): Placement { return this.mapper.place(path); }

  cellOf(path: string) {
    const p = this.place(path);
    return p.kind === 'cell' ? { domain: p.domain, layer: p.layer } : null;
  }

  /** Placement for a directory (Grep/Glob path): the single cell all known files under it share, if any. */
  cellForDir(dir: string) {
    const prefix = dir.replace(/\/$/, '') + '/';
    let found: { domain: string; layer: string } | null = null;
    for (const f of this.facts.files) {
      if (!f.startsWith(prefix)) continue;
      const c = this.cellOf(f);
      if (!c) continue;
      if (found && (found.domain !== c.domain || found.layer !== c.layer)) return null;
      found = c;
    }
    return found;
  }

  /** Every non-ignored file under the current map. */
  listFiles() { return scanRepo(this.root, this.map).files; }

  /** Full fact scan → `repo_scanned` + `violation_found`. */
  scan() {
    this.facts = scanRepo(this.root, this.map);
    this.contents.clear();
    for (const f of this.facts.files) {
      if (CODE.test(f)) this.contents.set(f, readFileSync(join(this.root, f), 'utf8'));
    }
    this.bus.emit('repo_scanned', {
      files: this.facts.files.map((path) => ({ path, placement: this.place(path) })),
      imports: this.facts.imports,
      writes: this.facts.writes,
      edges: domainEdges(this.facts, this.mapper),
    }, { turn: null });
    this.recheck();
  }

  /** Re-run the checker over the whole repo (load call site) and publish the current set. */
  recheck() {
    this.violations = check(this.map, this.facts, this.mapper);
    this.bus.emit('violation_found', { violations: this.violations }, { turn: null });
  }

  current(path: string): string | null {
    if (this.contents.has(path)) return this.contents.get(path)!;
    const abs = join(this.root, path);
    return existsSync(abs) ? readFileSync(abs, 'utf8') : null;
  }

  markPending(path: string) {
    clearTimeout(this.pending.get(path));
    this.pending.set(path, setTimeout(() => this.pending.delete(path), 10_000));
  }

  /**
   * A file changed on disk: emit `edited` (+/− lines) and edge events from its import diff, and update facts.
   * Called by the PostToolUse hook (attributed) and the watcher (unattributed). No-op if the content is unchanged.
   */
  fileChanged(path: string, attr: { tool?: string; unattributed?: boolean }) {
    if (this.mapper.isIgnored(path)) return;
    const abs = join(this.root, path);
    const deleted = !existsSync(abs);
    const next = deleted ? '' : readFileSync(abs, 'utf8');
    const prev = this.contents.get(path);
    const known = this.facts.files.includes(path);
    if (prev === next && known) return;
    if (!attr.unattributed) { clearTimeout(this.pending.get(path)); this.pending.delete(path); }

    let added = 0, removed = 0;
    for (const part of diffLines(prev ?? '', next)) {
      if (part.added) added += part.count ?? 0;
      else if (part.removed) removed += part.count ?? 0;
    }
    const created = !known && !deleted;
    if (created) {
      this.facts.files.push(path);
      this.bus.emit('file_assigned', { placement: this.place(path) }, { path });
    }
    if (deleted) this.facts.files = this.facts.files.filter((f) => f !== path);
    if (created || deleted) this.exists.clear();

    // Import and write facts for this one file.
    const before = this.facts.imports.filter((i) => i.from === path);
    const after = CODE.test(path) && !deleted ? factsForSource(path, next, this.exists) : { imports: [], writes: [] };
    this.facts.imports = [...this.facts.imports.filter((i) => i.from !== path), ...after.imports];
    this.facts.writes = [...this.facts.writes.filter((w) => w.file !== path), ...after.writes];
    if (deleted) this.contents.delete(path); else if (CODE.test(path)) this.contents.set(path, next);

    this.bus.emit('edited', { added, removed, created, ...(attr.unattributed ? { unattributed: true } : {}), ...(attr.tool ? { tool: attr.tool } : {}) }, { path, cell: this.cellOf(path) });

    const key = (i: ImportEdge) => `${i.from}→${i.to}`;
    const beforeKeys = new Set(before.map(key));
    const afterKeys = new Set(after.imports.map(key));
    const gained = after.imports.filter((i) => !beforeKeys.has(key(i)));
    const lost = before.filter((i) => !afterKeys.has(key(i)));
    for (const de of domainEdges({ imports: gained, writes: [] }, this.mapper)) {
      for (const edge of de.files) this.bus.emit('edge_added', { edge, from: de.from, to: de.to }, { path });
    }
    for (const de of domainEdges({ imports: lost, writes: [] }, this.mapper)) {
      for (const edge of de.files) this.bus.emit('edge_removed', { edge, from: de.from, to: de.to }, { path });
    }
  }

  /** Completeness: any write that no hook reported (e.g. from Bash) becomes an unattributed `edited` event. */
  startWatcher() {
    const ignored = (p: string) => {
      const r = relative(this.root, p);
      if (!r || r.startsWith('..')) return false;
      return /(^|\/)(node_modules|\.git|\.harness)(\/|$)/.test(r) || this.mapper.isIgnored(r.split('\\').join('/'));
    };
    this.watcher = watch(this.root, { ignored, ignoreInitial: true, awaitWriteFinish: { stabilityThreshold: 120, pollInterval: 40 } });
    const handle = (abs: string) => {
      const r = this.rel(abs);
      if (!r || this.pending.has(r) || r === 'domains.yaml') return;
      this.fileChanged(r, { unattributed: true });
    };
    this.watcher.on('add', handle).on('change', handle).on('unlink', handle);
  }

  async close() { await this.watcher?.close(); }
}
import { execFileSync } from 'node:child_process';

/** Paths Harness itself writes; never counted as the coding session's work. */
const HARNESS_PATHS = [':(exclude)domains.yaml', ':(exclude)decisions', ':(exclude).harness'];

export function git(repo: string, args: string[]): string {
  return execFileSync('git', args, { cwd: repo, encoding: 'utf8', stdio: ['ignore', 'pipe', 'pipe'] }).trim();
}

function tryGit(repo: string, args: string[]): string {
  try { return git(repo, args); } catch { return ''; }
}

export type Baseline = { head: string; snapshot: string; untracked: string[] };

/** Turn baseline: HEAD plus a `git stash create` snapshot of the working tree (no stash entry is stored). */
export function baseline(repo: string): Baseline {
  const head = tryGit(repo, ['rev-parse', 'HEAD']);
  const snapshot = tryGit(repo, ['stash', 'create']) || head;
  const untracked = untrackedFiles(repo);
  return { head, snapshot, untracked };
}

function untrackedFiles(repo: string): string[] {
  return tryGit(repo, ['ls-files', '--others', '--exclude-standard']).split('\n').filter(Boolean);
}

/** Lines added/removed since the baseline, including files created during the turn (untracked). */
export function numstat(repo: string, base: Baseline): { added: number; removed: number; files: string[] } {
  let added = 0, removed = 0;
  const files: string[] = [];
  const parse = (out: string, name?: string) => {
    for (const line of out.split('\n')) {
      const [a, r, ...rest] = line.split('\t');
      if (!rest.length) continue;
      added += Number(a) || 0;
      removed += Number(r) || 0;
      files.push(name ?? rest.join('\t'));
    }
  };
  if (base.snapshot) parse(tryGit(repo, ['diff', '--numstat', base.snapshot, '--', '.', ...HARNESS_PATHS]));
  const before = new Set(base.untracked);
  for (const f of untrackedFiles(repo)) {
    if (before.has(f) || f.startsWith('decisions/') || f.startsWith('.harness/') || f === 'domains.yaml') continue;
    // --no-index exits 1 when files differ, so read stdout from the error.
    try { execFileSync('git', ['diff', '--no-index', '--numstat', '/dev/null', f], { cwd: repo, encoding: 'utf8' }); }
    catch (e) { parse(String((e as { stdout?: string }).stdout ?? ''), f); }
  }
  return { added, removed, files };
}

/** Commit only Harness's own files, so the coding session's uncommitted edits stay out (SPEC §8). */
export function commitPaths(repo: string, paths: string[], message: string) {
  git(repo, ['add', '--', ...paths]);
  git(repo, ['commit', '-q', '-m', message, '--', ...paths]);
}

import type { DomainMap } from './schema';

import type { AuditFinding, AuditOutcome, DriftSignal, Label, MapProposal, ProposalOutcome } from './contracts/cartography';

export type Cell = { domain: string; layer: string };

export type EventKind =
  | 'repo_scanned' | 'map_proposed' | 'map_confirmed' | 'file_assigned'
  | 'violation_found'
  | 'turn_started' | 'looked' | 'cursor'
  | 'planned' | 'plan_violation' | 'fork_asked' | 'fork_answered' | 'plan_approved'
  | 'gate_blocked' | 'edited' | 'edge_added' | 'edge_removed'
  | 'test_result' | 'decision_recorded' | 'turn_ended'
  // Additions to SPEC §5 so the chat pane and approval button are also reductions of the log.
  | 'chat' | 'approval_requested' | 'error'
  // NAVIGATION_PLAN: per-file facts for the context graph, and the living map (§3.1, §4.7).
  | 'facts_changed' | 'facts_resolved' | 'call_added' | 'call_removed'
  | 'drift_detected' | 'map_proposal_resolved' | 'labels_updated'
  | 'audit_finding' | 'audit_resolved' | 'maintenance_run';

export type HarnessEvent = {
  id: string;
  t: number;
  session: string;
  turn: string | null;
  kind: EventKind;
  cell?: Cell;
  path?: string;
  data?: Record<string, unknown>;
};

/** Typed payloads, by kind. The server builds events with `ev()`; the reducer reads them back. */
export type EventData = {
  /** `fileFacts` (Tier 1, every code file) is optional for older logs; without it facts are derived from imports/writes. */
  repo_scanned: { files: { path: string; placement: Placement }[]; imports: ImportEdge[]; writes: WriteFact[]; edges: DomainEdge[]; fileFacts?: FileFacts[] };
  /** Onboarding proposal when `proposal` is absent (sets the map). A living-map proposal (`proposal` set) never changes the map until accepted. */
  map_proposed: { map: DomainMap; yaml: string; proposal?: MapProposal };
  map_confirmed: { map: DomainMap; source: 'file' | 'cartographer' | 'fixture' };
  file_assigned: { placement: Placement };
  violation_found: { violations: Violation[] }; // the full current set (replaces)
  turn_started: { prompt: string; head: string; baseline: string };
  looked: { tool: string };
  cursor: { verb: 'reading' | 'searching' | 'editing' };
  planned: {
    steps: PlanStep[];
    cells: { domain: string; layer: string; steps: number[]; files: string[] }[];
    edges: { from: string; to: string; steps: number[]; imports: ImportEdge[] }[];
    unassigned: string[];
  };
  plan_violation: { violation: Violation };
  fork_asked: { violations: Violation[]; text: string };
  fork_answered: { option: 'A' | 'B'; text: string; violations: Violation[] };
  plan_approved: Record<string, never>;
  gate_blocked: { violation: Violation; tool: string };
  edited: { added: number; removed: number; created: boolean; unattributed?: boolean; tool?: string; symbols?: SymbolDiff };
  edge_added: { edge: ImportEdge; from: string; to: string };
  edge_removed: { edge: ImportEdge; from: string; to: string };
  test_result: { domain: string; passed: number; failed: number };
  decision_recorded: { id: string; title: string; invariant: string; option: 'A' | 'B'; paths: string[]; alike?: boolean };
  turn_ended: { added: number; removed: number; files: string[]; reason: string };
  chat: { role: 'user' | 'assistant' | 'system'; text: string };
  approval_requested: { plan: string };
  error: { message: string };
  /** A file's Tier 1 facts after it changed (null = deleted). Emitted with every `edited`/`file_assigned`. */
  facts_changed: { facts: FileFacts | null };
  /** Tier 2 typed facts; ignored unless `hash` matches the file's current facts. */
  facts_resolved: { facts: SemanticFacts };
  call_added: { from: string; to: string; confidence: CallConfidence };
  call_removed: { from: string; to: string; confidence: CallConfidence };
  drift_detected: { signals: DriftSignal[] }; // the full current set (replaces)
  map_proposal_resolved: { proposal: string; outcome: ProposalOutcome; decision?: string };
  labels_updated: { labels: Label[] }; // upserts by (target, kind)
  audit_finding: { finding: AuditFinding };
  audit_resolved: { id: string; outcome: AuditOutcome };
  maintenance_run: { agent: 'cartographer' | 'auditor'; trigger: string; ms: number; cost: number | null; ok: boolean };
};

export const cellKey = (c: Cell) => `${c.domain}/${c.layer}`;
export const edgeKey = (from: string, to: string) => `${from}->${to}`;

export type PlannedCell = { cell: Cell; steps: number[]; files: string[] };
export type PlannedEdge = { from: string; to: string; steps: number[]; imports: ImportEdge[] };

export type TurnState = {

  chat: { role: 'user' | 'assistant' | 'system'; text: string; turn: string | null; t: number }[];
  awaitingApproval: { turn: string | null; plan: string } | null;
  pendingFork: { turn: string | null; violations: Violation[] } | null;
  decisions: Decision[];

const FALLBACK_MAP = resolve(here, '../../../fixtures/scout-agent.domains.yaml');

const bus = new Bus(REPO, { fresh: process.env.HARNESS_FRESH === '1' });
const sockets = new Set<WebSocket>();
const broadcast = (msg: unknown) => {
  const s = JSON.stringify(msg);
  for (const ws of sockets) if (ws.readyState === ws.OPEN) ws.send(s);
};
bus.on((event) => broadcast({ type: 'event', event }));

const repo = new Repo(REPO, bus);
let session: Session | null = null;
let proposal: { yaml: string; source: 'cartographer' | 'fixture' } | null = null;
let busy = false;

function startSession() {
  repo.scan();
  repo.startWatcher();
  session = new Session(repo, bus, (m) => {
    if (m.type === 'busy') busy = m.busy;
    broadcast(m);
  });
  session.start();
}

/** Load: use domains.yaml if present; otherwise propose one (cartographer, else the fixture) and wait for Confirm. */
async function load() {
  if (repo.hasMap()) {
    repo.loadMapFile();
    bus.emit('map_confirmed', { map: repo.map, source: 'file' }, { turn: null });
    startSession();
    return;
  }
  let yaml: string;
  let source: 'cartographer' | 'fixture' = 'cartographer';
  try {
    if (process.env.HARNESS_CARTOGRAPHER === '0') throw new Error('disabled');
    yaml = await proposeMap(repo, bus);
  } catch (e) {
    if ((e as Error).message !== 'disabled') bus.emit('error', { message: `Cartographer failed, using the reference map: ${(e as Error).message}` }, { turn: null });
    yaml = readFileSync(FALLBACK_MAP, 'utf8');
    source = 'fixture';
  }
  showProposal(yaml, source);
}

function showProposal(yaml: string, source: 'cartographer' | 'fixture') {
  repo.setMap(yaml);
  proposal = { yaml, source };
  bus.emit('map_proposed', { map: repo.map, yaml }, { turn: null });
  // The shell plays the map assembling: one file_assigned per file, ~15 ms apart.
  const files = repo.listFiles();
  files.forEach((path, i) => setTimeout(() => bus.emit('file_assigned', { placement: repo.place(path) }, { path, turn: null }), i * 15));
}

const app = new Hono();
app.get('/api/info', (c) => c.json({ repo: REPO, session: bus.session, busy, proposal: !!proposal }));
app.get('/api/events', (c) => c.json(bus.events));
app.post('/api/chat', async (c) => {
  const { text } = await c.req.json<{ text: string }>();
  if (!session) return c.json({ error: 'Confirm the map first.' }, 409);
  session.userMessage(text);
  return c.json({ ok: true });
});
app.post('/api/approve', (c) => { session?.approve(); return c.json({ ok: true }); });
app.post('/api/interrupt', (c) => { session?.interrupt(); return c.json({ ok: true }); });
app.post('/api/map/confirm', (c) => {
  if (!proposal) return c.json({ error: 'No proposal pending.' }, 409);
  writeFileSync(repo.mapPath, proposal.yaml);
  try { commitPaths(repo.root, ['domains.yaml'], 'docs: add domains.yaml architecture map'); }
  catch (e) { bus.emit('error', { message: `Could not commit domains.yaml: ${(e as Error).message}` }, { turn: null }); }
  repo.setMap(proposal.yaml);
  bus.emit('map_confirmed', { map: repo.map, source: proposal.source }, { turn: null });
  proposal = null;
  startSession();
  return c.json({ ok: true });
});
app.post('/api/map/fallback', (c) => {
  if (!proposal) return c.json({ error: 'No proposal pending.' }, 409);
  showProposal(readFileSync(FALLBACK_MAP, 'utf8'), 'fixture');
  return c.json({ ok: true });
});
app.get('/api/file', (c) => {
  const p = c.req.query('path') ?? '';
  const rel = repo.rel(p);
  if (!rel || !existsSync(join(repo.root, rel))) return c.json({ error: 'not found' }, 404);
  return c.text(readFileSync(join(repo.root, rel), 'utf8'));
});

const shellDist = resolve(here, '../../shell/dist');
if (existsSync(shellDist)) app.use('/*', serveStatic({ root: shellDist }));

const server = serve({ fetch: app.fetch, port: PORT }, () => console.log(`Harness server on http://localhost:${PORT} · repo ${REPO}`));
const wss = new WebSocketServer({ server: server as never, path: '/ws' });
wss.on('connection', (ws) => {
  sockets.add(ws);
  ws.send(JSON.stringify({ type: 'hello', events: bus.events, busy, session: bus.session }));
  ws.on('close', () => sockets.delete(ws));
});

void load();

const shutdown = async () => { await repo.close(); process.exit(0); };
process.on('SIGINT', shutdown);
process.on('SIGTERM', shutdown);

import { existsSync, readFileSync, realpathSync } from 'node:fs';
import { join, relative, isAbsolute } from 'node:path';
import { watch, type FSWatcher } from 'chokidar';
import { diffLines } from 'diff';
import {
  parseDomainMap, createMapper, scanRepo, factsForSource, domainEdges, check, fileExistsIn,
  type DomainMap, type Facts, type ImportEdge, type Violation, type Placement,

import type { Bus } from './bus';

const CODE = /\.(ts|tsx|js|jsx|mjs|cjs|mts)$/;

export class Repo {
  readonly root: string;
  map!: DomainMap;
  mapText = '';
  mapper!: ReturnType<typeof createMapper>;
  facts: Facts = { files: [], imports: [], writes: [] };
  violations: Violation[] = [];
  private contents = new Map<string, string>();
  private pending = new Map<string, NodeJS.Timeout>(); // paths a hook is editing; the watcher leaves them alone
  private watcher: FSWatcher | null = null;
  exists: ReturnType<typeof fileExistsIn>;

  constructor(root: string, private bus: Bus) {
    this.root = realpathSync(root);
    this.exists = fileExistsIn(this.root);
  }

  get mapPath() { return join(this.root, 'domains.yaml'); }
  hasMap() { return existsSync(this.mapPath); }

  /** Load (or reload) domains.yaml text. */
  setMap(text: string) {
    this.mapText = text;
    this.map = parseDomainMap(text);
    this.mapper = createMapper(this.map);
  }

  loadMapFile() { this.setMap(readFileSync(this.mapPath, 'utf8')); }

  /** Repo-relative POSIX path for an absolute path from a hook, or null if it is outside the repo. */

      // New file: resolve the parent instead.
      const i = abs.lastIndexOf('/');
      try { abs = join(realpathSync(abs.slice(0, i)), abs.slice(i + 1)); } catch { /* keep as is */ }
    }
    const r = relative(this.root, abs);
    if (!r || r.startsWith('..') || isAbsolute(r)) return null;
    return r.split('\\').join('/');
  }

  place(path: string): Placement { return this.mapper.place(path); }

  cellOf(path: string) {
    const p = this.place(path);
    return p.kind === 'cell' ? { domain: p.domain, layer: p.layer } : null;
  }

  /** Placement for a directory (Grep/Glob path): the single cell all known files under it share, if any. */
  cellForDir(dir: string) {
    const prefix = dir.replace(/\/$/, '') + '/';
    let found: { domain: string; layer: string } | null = null;
    for (const f of this.facts.files) {
      if (!f.startsWith(prefix)) continue;
      const c = this.cellOf(f);
      if (!c) continue;
      if (found && (found.domain !== c.domain || found.layer !== c.layer)) return null;
      found = c;
    }
    return found;
  }

  /** Every non-ignored file under the current map. */
  listFiles() { return scanRepo(this.root, this.map).files; }

  /** Full fact scan → `repo_scanned` + `violation_found`. */
  scan() {

    this.contents.clear();
    for (const f of this.facts.files) {
      if (CODE.test(f)) this.contents.set(f, readFileSync(join(this.root, f), 'utf8'));
    }
    this.bus.emit('repo_scanned', {
      files: this.facts.files.map((path) => ({ path, placement: this.place(path) })),
      imports: this.facts.imports,
      writes: this.facts.writes,
      edges: domainEdges(this.facts, this.mapper),
    }, { turn: null });
    this.recheck();
  }

  /** Re-run the checker over the whole repo (load call site) and publish the current set. */
  recheck() {
    this.violations = check(this.map, this.facts, this.mapper);
    this.bus.emit('violation_found', { violations: this.violations }, { turn: null });
  }

  current(path: string): string | null {
    if (this.contents.has(path)) return this.contents.get(path)!;
    const abs = join(this.root, path);

  markPending(path: string) {

  /**

   * Called by the PostToolUse hook (attributed) and the watcher (unattributed). No-op if the content is unchanged.

  fileChanged(path: string, attr: { tool?: string; unattributed?: boolean }) {

    const abs = join(this.root, path);
    const deleted = !existsSync(abs);
    const next = deleted ? '' : readFileSync(abs, 'utf8');

    let added = 0, removed = 0;
    for (const part of diffLines(prev ?? '', next)) {

    if (created) {

    if (created || deleted) this.exists.clear();

    const before = this.facts.imports.filter((i) => i.from === path);
    const after = CODE.test(path) && !deleted ? factsForSource(path, next, this.exists) : { imports: [], writes: [] };
    this.facts.imports = [...this.facts.imports.filter((i) => i.from !== path), ...after.imports];
    this.facts.writes = [...this.facts.writes.filter((w) => w.file !== path), ...after.writes];
    if (deleted) this.contents.delete(path); else if (CODE.test(path)) this.contents.set(path, next);

    this.bus.emit('edited', { added, removed, created, ...(attr.unattributed ? { unattributed: true } : {}), ...(attr.tool ? { tool: attr.tool } : {}) }, { path, cell: this.cellOf(path) });

    const beforeKeys = new Set(before.map(key));
    const afterKeys = new Set(after.imports.map(key));
    const gained = after.imports.filter((i) => !beforeKeys.has(key(i)));
    const lost = before.filter((i) => !afterKeys.has(key(i)));
    for (const de of domainEdges({ imports: gained, writes: [] }, this.mapper)) {
      for (const edge of de.files) this.bus.emit('edge_added', { edge, from: de.from, to: de.to }, { path });
    }
    for (const de of domainEdges({ imports: lost, writes: [] }, this.mapper)) {
      for (const edge of de.files) this.bus.emit('edge_removed', { edge, from: de.from, to: de.to }, { path });
    }

  /** Completeness: any write that no hook reported (e.g. from Bash) becomes an unattributed `edited` event. */
  startWatcher() {
    const ignored = (p: string) => {
      const r = relative(this.root, p);
      if (!r || r.startsWith('..')) return false;
      return /(^|\/)(node_modules|\.git|\.harness)(\/|$)/.test(r) || this.mapper.isIgnored(r.split('\\').join('/'));
    };
    this.watcher = watch(this.root, { ignored, ignoreInitial: true, awaitWriteFinish: { stabilityThreshold: 120, pollInterval: 40 } });
    const handle = (abs: string) => {
      const r = this.rel(abs);
      if (!r || this.pending.has(r) || r === 'domains.yaml') return;
      this.fileChanged(r, { unattributed: true });
    };
    this.watcher.on('add', handle).on('change', handle).on('unlink', handle);
  }

  async close() { await this.watcher?.close(); }
}
import { appendFileSync, existsSync, mkdirSync, readFileSync, writeFileSync } from 'node:fs';
import { join } from 'node:path';
import { randomUUID } from 'node:crypto';
import type { HarnessEvent, EventKind, EventData, Cell } from '@harness/core';

type Listener = (e: HarnessEvent) => void;

/** Append-only event log: `.harness/events.jsonl` in the target repo, broadcast to every listener. */
export class Bus {
  readonly events: HarnessEvent[] = [];
  readonly session = randomUUID().slice(0, 8);
  turn: string | null = null;
  private listeners = new Set<Listener>();
  private file: string;

  constructor(repo: string, opts: { fresh?: boolean } = {}) {
    const dir = join(repo, '.harness');
    mkdirSync(join(dir, 'turns'), { recursive: true });
    // Keep .harness/ out of the target's git without touching its .gitignore.
    if (!existsSync(join(dir, '.gitignore'))) writeFileSync(join(dir, '.gitignore'), '*\n');
    this.file = join(dir, 'events.jsonl');
    if (opts.fresh) writeFileSync(this.file, '');
    else if (existsSync(this.file)) {
      for (const line of readFileSync(this.file, 'utf8').split('\n')) {
        if (line.trim()) this.events.push(JSON.parse(line) as HarnessEvent);
      }
    }
  }

  emit<K extends EventKind>(kind: K, data: K extends keyof EventData ? EventData[K] : never, extra: { cell?: Cell | null; path?: string; turn?: string | null } = {}): HarnessEvent {
    const e: HarnessEvent = {
      id: randomUUID().slice(0, 12),
      t: Date.now(),
      session: this.session,
      turn: extra.turn === undefined ? this.turn : extra.turn,
      kind,
      ...(extra.cell ? { cell: extra.cell } : {}),
      ...(extra.path ? { path: extra.path } : {}),
      data: data as Record<string, unknown>,
    };
    this.events.push(e);
    appendFileSync(this.file, JSON.stringify(e) + '\n');
    for (const l of this.listeners) l(e);
    return e;
  }

  on(l: Listener) {
    this.listeners.add(l);
    return () => this.listeners.delete(l);
  }
}
import { execFileSync } from 'node:child_process';

/** Paths Harness itself writes; never counted as the coding session's work. */
const HARNESS_PATHS = [':(exclude)domains.yaml', ':(exclude)decisions', ':(exclude).harness'];

export function git(repo: string, args: string[]): string {
  return execFileSync('git', args, { cwd: repo, encoding: 'utf8', stdio: ['ignore', 'pipe', 'pipe'] }).trim();
}

function tryGit(repo: string, args: string[]): string {
  try { return git(repo, args); } catch { return ''; }
}

export type Baseline = { head: string; snapshot: string; untracked: string[] };

/** Turn baseline: HEAD plus a `git stash create` snapshot of the working tree (no stash entry is stored). */
export function baseline(repo: string): Baseline {
  const head = tryGit(repo, ['rev-parse', 'HEAD']);
  const snapshot = tryGit(repo, ['stash', 'create']) || head;
  const untracked = untrackedFiles(repo);
  return { head, snapshot, untracked };
}

function untrackedFiles(repo: string): string[] {
  return tryGit(repo, ['ls-files', '--others', '--exclude-standard']).split('\n').filter(Boolean);
}

/** Lines added/removed since the baseline, including files created during the turn (untracked). */
export function numstat(repo: string, base: Baseline): { added: number; removed: number; files: string[] } {
  let added = 0, removed = 0;
  const files: string[] = [];
  const parse = (out: string, name?: string) => {
    for (const line of out.split('\n')) {
      const [a, r, ...rest] = line.split('\t');
      if (!rest.length) continue;
      added += Number(a) || 0;
      removed += Number(r) || 0;
      files.push(name ?? rest.join('\t'));
    }
  };
  if (base.snapshot) parse(tryGit(repo, ['diff', '--numstat', base.snapshot, '--', '.', ...HARNESS_PATHS]));
  const before = new Set(base.untracked);
  for (const f of untrackedFiles(repo)) {
    if (before.has(f) || f.startsWith('decisions/') || f.startsWith('.harness/') || f === 'domains.yaml') continue;
    // --no-index exits 1 when files differ, so read stdout from the error.
    try { execFileSync('git', ['diff', '--no-index', '--numstat', '/dev/null', f], { cwd: repo, encoding: 'utf8' }); }
    catch (e) { parse(String((e as { stdout?: string }).stdout ?? ''), f); }
  }
  return { added, removed, files };
}

/** Commit only Harness's own files, so the coding session's uncommitted edits stay out (SPEC §8). */
export function commitPaths(repo: string, paths: string[], message: string) {
  git(repo, ['add', '--', ...paths]);
  git(repo, ['commit', '-q', '-m', message, '--', ...paths]);
}
import { existsSync, mkdirSync, readdirSync, readFileSync, writeFileSync } from 'node:fs';
import { basename, join } from 'node:path';
import { parse as parseYaml, stringify as stringifyYaml } from 'yaml';
import { linkDecision, addException, nextDecisionId, type Violation } from '@harness/core';
import { commitPaths, git } from './git';
import type { Repo } from './repo';
import type { Bus } from './bus';

export type DecisionRecord = {
  id: string;
  title: string;
  outcome: string;
  status: string;
  type: string;
  invariant: string;
  anchors: { paths: string[] };
  rejected: string;
  rationale: string;
};

/** Read `decisions/DR-*.md` (front matter + body). */
export function listDecisions(root: string): DecisionRecord[] {
  const dir = join(root, 'decisions');
  if (!existsSync(dir)) return [];
  const out: DecisionRecord[] = [];
  for (const f of readdirSync(dir).filter((f) => /^DR-\d+\.md$/.test(f))) {
    const text = readFileSync(join(dir, f), 'utf8');
    const m = /^---\n([\s\S]*?)\n---\n?([\s\S]*)$/.exec(text);
    if (!m) continue;
    const fm = parseYaml(m[1]!) as Omit<DecisionRecord, 'rationale'>;
    out.push({ ...fm, rationale: m[2]!.trim() });
  }
  return out.sort((a, b) => Number(a.id.slice(3)) - Number(b.id.slice(3)));
}

/** Parse which option the user picked. Explicit A/B wins; "exception" leans B; otherwise A (comply). */
export function parseOption(text: string): 'A' | 'B' {
  const t = text.trim();
  const m = /^\(?\s*(?:option\s+)?([ab])\b/i.exec(t) ?? /\b(?:option|choose|pick|go with)\s+\(?([ab])\b/i.exec(t);
  if (m) return m[1]!.toUpperCase() as 'A' | 'B';
  return /\bexception\b/i.test(t) ? 'B' : 'A';
}

/** The decision in the user's own words: their answer minus the "A —" prefix, first sentence, if it says something. */
export function titleFromAnswer(answer: string): string | null {
  const t = answer.trim().replace(/^\(?\s*(?:option\s+)?[ab]\b\)?\s*[—–:,.-]*\s*/i, '');
  const first = (t.split(/(?<=[.!?])\s/)[0] ?? '').replace(/[.!?]+$/, '').trim();
  if (first.length < 12) return null;
  const s = first[0]!.toUpperCase() + first.slice(1);
  return s.length > 100 ? s.slice(0, 99).replace(/\s+\S*$/, '') + '…' : s;
}

/**
 * `owner/name`, which Alike's path anchors require: HARNESS_REPO_SLUG, else the origin remote,
 * else `<git user>/<folder>` for a repo with no remote.
 */
function repoAnchor(root: string) {
  if (process.env.HARNESS_REPO_SLUG) return { repository: process.env.HARNESS_REPO_SLUG };
  try {
    const m = /[:/]([^/:]+\/[^/]+?)(?:\.git)?$/.exec(git(root, ['remote', 'get-url', 'origin']));
    if (m) return { repository: m[1]! };
  } catch { /* no remote */ }
  let owner = 'local';
  try { owner = git(root, ['config', 'user.name']).replace(/[^\w.-]+/g, '-') || owner; } catch { /* unset */ }

export function recordFork(repo: Repo, bus: Bus, violations: Violation[], option: 'A' | 'B', answer: string, prompt: string) {

  let yamlText = repo.mapText;
  for (const [invariantId, vs] of byInvariant) {
    const inv = repo.map.invariants.find((i) => i.id === invariantId);
    if (!inv) continue;
    const id = nextDecisionId(repo.map, [...existing, ...made.map((d) => d.id)]);
    const files = [...new Set(vs.map((v) => v.file))];
    const v0 = vs[0]!;
    const [chosen, rejected] = option === 'A' ? [v0.options[0], v0.options[1]] : [v0.options[1], v0.options[0]];
    const title = titleFromAnswer(answer) ?? (option === 'A'
      ? `${files.join(', ')} follows ${inv.id}: ${inv.rule}`
      : `Exception to ${inv.id} for ${files.join(', ')}`);
    const rec: DecisionRecord = {
      id, title, outcome: chosen, status: 'made', type: 'standing', invariant: inv.id,
      anchors: { paths: files }, rejected,
      rationale: [
        `The user chose ${option}, in their words: "${answer.trim()}"`,
        '',
        `Asked during: "${prompt.trim()}"`,
        '',
        `What triggered it: ${v0.reason}`,
        '',
        `Rejected: ${rejected}`,
      ].join('\n'),
    };
    made.push(rec);
    yamlText = option === 'A' ? linkDecision(yamlText, inv.id, id) : addException(yamlText, inv.id, files[0]!, id);
  }
  if (!made.length) return { decisions: [], alikeInstruction: '' };

  mkdirSync(join(repo.root, 'decisions'), { recursive: true });
  const paths: string[] = ['domains.yaml'];
  for (const d of made) {
    const { rationale, ...fm } = d;
    const rel = `decisions/${d.id}.md`;
    writeFileSync(join(repo.root, rel), `---\n${stringifyYaml(fm).trim()}\n---\n\n${rationale}\n`);
    paths.push(rel);
  }
  writeFileSync(repo.mapPath, yamlText);
  try { commitPaths(repo.root, paths, `docs(decisions): ${made.map((d) => d.id).join(', ')} ${made[0]!.title}`.slice(0, 100)); }
  catch (e) { bus.emit('error', { message: `Could not commit ${paths.join(', ')}: ${(e as Error).message}` }); }

  repo.setMap(yamlText);
  bus.emit('map_confirmed', { map: repo.map, source: 'file' });
  for (const d of made) {
    bus.emit('decision_recorded', { id: d.id, title: d.title, invariant: d.invariant, option, paths: d.anchors.paths, alike: false });
  }

  const anchor = repoAnchor(repo.root);
  // Field names checked against Alike's record_decision schema (VERIFY.md, step 0d).
  const alikeInstruction = made.map((d) => {
    const args = {
      title: `${d.id}: ${d.title}`,
      outcome: d.outcome,
      rationale: d.rationale.replace(/\n+/g, ' '),
      decision_type: 'standing',
      status: 'made',
      anchors: d.anchors.paths.map((path) => ({ kind: 'path', label: 'governs', path, repository: anchor.repository })),
    };
    return `Record ${d.id} in Alike now: call mcp__alike__record_decision with exactly these arguments: ${JSON.stringify(args)}. If the Alike tools are unavailable, skip this silently.`;
  }).join('\n');
  return { decisions: made, alikeInstruction };
}
import { query } from '@anthropic-ai/claude-agent-sdk';
import { stringify } from 'yaml';
import { scanRepo, DomainMapSchema, type DomainMap } from '@harness/core';
import type { Repo } from './repo';
import type { Bus } from './bus';

const DEFAULT_IGNORE = ['node_modules/**', '.git/**', '.harness/**', 'decisions/**', '*.json', '*.md', '*.config.ts', '.*', 'domains.yaml'];

/** Flat shape for structured output; converted to the domains.yaml schema afterwards. */
const OUTPUT_SCHEMA = {
  type: 'object',
  additionalProperties: false,
  required: ['layers', 'neutral', 'ignore', 'domains', 'invariants'],
  properties: {
    layers: { type: 'array', items: { type: 'object', additionalProperties: false, required: ['id', 'name'], properties: { id: { type: 'string' }, name: { type: 'string' } } } },
    neutral: { type: 'array', items: { type: 'string' }, description: 'Globs for shared code that belongs to no domain (types, db helpers, logging).' },
    ignore: { type: 'array', items: { type: 'string' }, description: 'Globs to skip entirely (fixtures, scripts, build output, config).' },
    domains: {
      type: 'array',
      items: {
        type: 'object',
        additionalProperties: false,
        required: ['id', 'name', 'purpose', 'cells', 'tests'],
        properties: {
          id: { type: 'string' }, name: { type: 'string', description: 'Product language, 1–3 words.' }, purpose: { type: 'string' },
          cells: {
            type: 'array',
            items: {
              type: 'object', additionalProperties: false, required: ['layer', 'paths', 'tables'],
              properties: { layer: { type: 'string' }, paths: { type: 'array', items: { type: 'string' } }, tables: { type: 'array', items: { type: 'string' } } },
            },
          },
          tests: { type: 'array', items: { type: 'string' } },
        },
      },
    },
    invariants: {
      type: 'array',
      items: {
        type: 'object',
        additionalProperties: false,
        required: ['id', 'rule', 'kind', 'targets', 'allowed_from', 'owners', 'from', 'to'],
        properties: {
          id: { type: 'string', description: 'DR-1, DR-2 or DR-3' },
          rule: { type: 'string', description: 'One plain sentence.' },
          kind: { type: 'string', enum: ['only_via', 'owns_writes', 'no_edge'] },
          targets: { type: 'array', items: { type: 'string' }, description: 'only_via: globs of the guarded files (e.g. vendor clients).' },
          allowed_from: { type: 'array', items: { type: 'string' }, description: 'only_via: domain ids allowed to import the targets.' },
          owners: { type: 'array', items: { type: 'object', additionalProperties: false, required: ['table', 'domain'], properties: { table: { type: 'string' }, domain: { type: 'string' } } }, description: 'owns_writes: table → owning domain id.' },
          from: { type: 'string', description: 'no_edge: domain id (empty otherwise).' },
          to: { type: 'string', description: 'no_edge: domain id (empty otherwise).' },
        },
      },
    },
  },
} as const;

type Out = {
  layers: { id: string; name: string }[];
  neutral: string[];
  ignore: string[];
  domains: { id: string; name: string; purpose: string; cells: { layer: string; paths: string[]; tables: string[] }[]; tests: string[] }[];
  invariants: { id: string; rule: string; kind: 'only_via' | 'owns_writes' | 'no_edge'; targets: string[]; allowed_from: string[]; owners: { table: string; domain: string }[]; from: string; to: string }[];
};

function toMap(o: Out): DomainMap {
  const raw = {
    version: 1,
    layers: o.layers,
    neutral: o.neutral,
    ignore: [...new Set([...DEFAULT_IGNORE, ...o.ignore])],
    domains: o.domains.map((d) => ({
      id: d.id, name: d.name, purpose: d.purpose,
      cells: Object.fromEntries(d.cells.map((c) => [c.layer, { ...(c.paths.length ? { paths: c.paths } : {}), ...(c.tables.length ? { tables: c.tables } : {}) }])),
      ...(d.tests.length ? { tests: d.tests } : {}),
    })),
    invariants: o.invariants.map((i) => {
      const base = { id: i.id, rule: i.rule, kind: i.kind, exceptions: [], source: 'cartographer' };
      if (i.kind === 'only_via') return { ...base, targets: i.targets, allowed_from: i.allowed_from };
      if (i.kind === 'owns_writes') return { ...base, owners: Object.fromEntries(i.owners.map((x) => [x.table, x.domain])) };
      return { ...base, from: i.from, to: i.to };
    }),
  };
  return DomainMapSchema.parse(raw);
}

/**
 * One-shot map proposal (SPEC §10): a separate read-only query on a smaller model, given the file tree,
 * import edges and table writes. Never runs inside the coding session. Returns domains.yaml text.
 */
export async function proposeMap(repo: Repo, bus: Bus): Promise<string> {
  const bare: DomainMap = { version: 1, layers: [{ id: 'x', name: 'x' }], ignore: DEFAULT_IGNORE, domains: [], invariants: [] } as DomainMap;
  const facts = scanRepo(repo.root, bare);
  const prompt = [
    'Propose an architecture map for this repo as a domain × layer grid that a product person can read.',
    '- 5–9 domains named in product language (e.g. "Model gateway", not "src/gateway"). Every source file should land in exactly one cell or in `neutral`/`ignore`.',
    '- Layers suited to this repo, top to bottom (for an agent system: entry, logic, data, external). Data cells list the tables that domain writes. External cells hold vendor/third-party client code.',
    '- When a folder holds exactly one cell, use a folder glob (e.g. `src/tools/**`) so files added later land in the right cell. List explicit file paths only where one folder is split across several cells. Map test folders with `tests` globs.',
    '- Exactly 3 invariants, ids DR-1, DR-2, DR-3, the most load-bearing ones you can infer from the facts below: DR-1 `only_via` for the vendor clients that only one domain should import (e.g. all model providers and embeddings in one rule); DR-2 one `owns_writes` rule covering every table with its owning domain; DR-3 one `no_edge` between two domains that must stay independent. The code may already break one of them in a single place; that is expected, still propose the rule.',
    'You may read files to understand purposes. Do not modify anything.',
    '',
    `Files (${facts.files.length}):`, ...facts.files,
    '',
    'Import edges (from → to):', ...facts.imports.map((i) => `${i.from} → ${i.to}`),
    '',
    'Table writes (file: table):', ...facts.writes.map((w) => `${w.file}: ${w.table}`),
  ].join('\n');

  const q = query({
    prompt,
    options: {
      cwd: repo.root,
      model: process.env.HARNESS_CARTOGRAPHER_MODEL ?? 'claude-haiku-5-5',
      tools: ['Read', 'Grep', 'Glob'],
      permissionMode: 'dontAsk',
      allowedTools: ['Read', 'Grep', 'Glob'],
      settingSources: [],
      strictMcpConfig: true,
      outputFormat: { type: 'json_schema', schema: OUTPUT_SCHEMA as unknown as Record<string, unknown> },
      maxTurns: 20,
    },
  });
  for await (const m of q) {
    if (m.type === 'result') {
      if (m.subtype !== 'success' || !m.structured_output) throw new Error(`cartographer ${m.subtype}`);
      const map = toMap(m.structured_output as Out);
      const header = '# Proposed by the Harness cartographer and confirmed by the user.\n# Domains are columns, layers are rows. Edges are derived from imports, never declared.\n\n';
      bus.emit('chat', { role: 'system', text: `Cartographer proposed ${map.domains.length} domains and ${map.invariants.length} rules.` }, { turn: null });
      return header + stringify(map, { collectionStyle: "any", lineWidth: 140 });
    }
  }
  throw new Error('cartographer returned no result');
}

export function scoutFacts(): Record<string, FileFacts> {
  const map = loadMap();

  const out: Record<string, FileFacts> = {};

      imports: facts.imports.filter((i) => i.from === path).map((i) => ({ to: i.to, typeOnly: false })),

      calls: CALLS[path] ?? [],

# Reference map for the Scout demo repo.
# Live, the cartographer proposes this on load and the user confirms it.
# This copy is the test fixture for packages/core and the fallback if the
# cartographer's proposal is off on stage.

version: 1

layers:
  - { id: entry,    name: Entry }
  - { id: logic,    name: Logic }
  - { id: data,     name: Data }
  - { id: external, name: External }

# Paths that belong to no domain and never create cross-domain edges.
neutral: ["src/shared/**", "vendor/_calllog.ts"]
ignore: ["node_modules/**", ".git/**", ".harness/**", "fixtures/**", "scripts/**", "decisions/**", "*.json", "*.md", "*.config.ts", ".*", "domains.yaml"]

domains:
  - id: channels
    name: Channels
    purpose: Take requests from HTTP and the CLI
    cells:
      entry: { paths: ["src/channels/routes.ts", "src/channels/cli.ts"] }
      logic: { paths: ["src/channels/validate.ts"] }
    tests: ["test/channels/**"]

  - id: orchestrator
    name: Agent loop
    purpose: Plan each run and call tools in order
    cells:
      logic: { paths: ["src/orchestrator/agent.ts", "src/orchestrator/planner.ts", "src/orchestrator/tool-registry.ts"] }
      data:  { paths: ["src/orchestrator/run-state.ts"], tables: ["runs"] }
    tests: ["test/orchestrator/**"]

  - id: tools
    name: Research tools
    purpose: Look up companies, news and filings
    cells:
      logic:    { paths: ["src/tools/**"] }
      external: { paths: ["vendor/search/**", "vendor/news/**", "vendor/sec-edgar/**", "vendor/enrichment/**"] }
    tests: ["test/tools/**"]

  - id: gateway
    name: Model gateway
    purpose: Every model call, with redaction and cost logging
    cells:
      logic:    { paths: ["src/gateway/complete.ts", "src/gateway/embed.ts", "src/gateway/redact.ts", "src/gateway/providers.ts"] }
      data:     { paths: ["src/gateway/cost-ledger.ts"], tables: ["cost_log"] }
      external: { paths: ["vendor/llm-openai/**", "vendor/llm-anthropic/**", "vendor/embeddings/**"] }
    tests: ["test/gateway/**"]

  - id: memory
    name: Memory
    purpose: Store and retrieve notes about each company
    cells:
      logic: { paths: ["src/memory/retrieve.ts", "src/memory/vector-index.ts"] }
      data:  { paths: ["src/memory/notes-store.ts"], tables: ["notes", "embeddings"] }
    tests: ["test/memory/**"]

  - id: outreach
    name: Outreach
    purpose: Draft emails and keep the CRM in sync
    cells:
      logic:    { paths: ["src/outreach/draft-email.ts", "src/outreach/send.ts"] }
      data:     { paths: ["src/outreach/crm-sync.ts", "src/outreach/outreach-log.ts"], tables: ["contacts", "outreach_log"] }
      external: { paths: ["vendor/crm/**", "vendor/email/**"] }
    tests: ["test/outreach/**"]

# Seeded by the cartographer on load (source: cartographer), confirmed by the user.
# Runtime decisions get the next free id (DR-4, DR-5, ...) and live in decisions/.
invariants:

    source: cartographer

import { writeFileSync } from 'node:fs';
import { join } from 'node:path';
import { randomUUID } from 'node:crypto';
import {
  query, type Query, type SDKUserMessage, type HookCallback, type PreToolUseHookInput, type PostToolUseHookInput,
  type CanUseTool, type PermissionResult, type McpServerConfig,
} from '@anthropic-ai/claude-agent-sdk';
import { applyEdit, deltaForEdit, check, withExtra, type PlanStep, type Violation, type EventData } from '@harness/core';
import { harnessTools, violationText, ASK_RULE } from './harness-tools';
import { listDecisions, parseOption, recordFork } from './decisions';
import { baseline, numstat, type Baseline } from './git';
import type { Repo } from './repo';
import type { Bus } from './bus';

const PLAN_RULES = [
  'Explore read-only, briefly. Then, before editing anything, call mcp__harness__submit_plan with numbered steps.',
  'Each step lists the exact repo-relative file paths it will create or modify, and every new import it adds as { from: path, to: path }.',
  'If the result contains violations: ' + ASK_RULE,
  'After the user answers, resubmit the plan with mcp__harness__submit_plan, then call ExitPlanMode.',
  'If there are no violations, call ExitPlanMode with a short plan.',
].join('\n');

/** Push-based prompt stream fed by the chat pane. */
class Inbox implements AsyncIterable<SDKUserMessage> {
  private queue: SDKUserMessage[] = [];
  private wake: (() => void) | null = null;
  push(text: string) {
    this.queue.push({ type: 'user', message: { role: 'user', content: text }, parent_tool_use_id: null });
    this.wake?.();
  }
  async *[Symbol.asyncIterator]() {
    while (true) {
      while (this.queue.length) yield this.queue.shift()!;
      await new Promise<void>((r) => (this.wake = r));
      this.wake = null;
    }
  }
}

type Turn = {
  id: string;
  prompt: string;
  base: Baseline;
  planned: boolean;
  steps: PlanStep[];
  planViolations: Violation[]; // from the latest submit_plan
  gateBlocks: Violation[]; // since the last answer
  forkOpen: Violation[] | null; // asked, awaiting the user's A/B
  lastText: string;
};

/** If a shell command writes a file inside the repo, a short description of how; otherwise null. */
export function bashWriteTarget(cmd: string, rel: (p: string) => string | null): string | null {
  const inRepo = (p: string) => !!p && !p.startsWith('/dev/') && rel(p.replace(/^['"]|['"]$/g, '')) !== null;
  // Redirects to a file: `> f`, `>> f`, `cat <<EOF > f` (not 2>&1, >&2, >/dev/null).
  for (const m of cmd.matchAll(/(?:^|[^0-9&>])>>?\s*([^\s;&|<>()]+)/g)) if (!m[1]!.startsWith('&') && inRepo(m[1]!)) return `redirect to ${m[1]}`;
  for (const m of cmd.matchAll(/\btee\s+(?:-a\s+)?([^\s;&|<>()]+)/g)) if (inRepo(m[1]!)) return `tee ${m[1]}`;
  if (/\b(sed|perl)\s+(-[a-zA-Z]*\s+)*-[a-zA-Z]*i/.test(cmd)) return 'in-place edit';
  if (/\b(python3?|node|ruby|perl|deno|bun)\b[\s\S]*(open\([^)]*['"][wa]\+?['"]|write_text|writeFileSync|appendFileSync|\.write\(|fs\.write)/.test(cmd)) return 'script that writes files';
  return null;
}

export type Ephemeral = (msg: { type: 'delta'; text: string } | { type: 'busy'; busy: boolean }) => void;

export class Session {
  private inbox = new Inbox();
  private q: Query | null = null;
  private turn: Turn | null = null;
  private approval: { resolve: (r: PermissionResult) => void; input: Record<string, unknown> } | null = null;
  private notes: string[] = [];
  busy = false;

  constructor(private repo: Repo, private bus: Bus, private ephemeral: Ephemeral) {}

  brief(): string {
    const m = this.repo.map;
    const domains = m.domains.map((d) => {
      const cells = Object.entries(d.cells).map(([layer, c]) => `    ${layer}: ${[...(c.paths ?? []), ...(c.tables ?? []).map((t) => `table ${t}`)].join(', ')}`);
      return `- ${d.name} (${d.id}): ${d.purpose}\n${cells.join('\n')}`;
    });
    const decisions = listDecisions(this.repo.root).map((d) =>
      `- ${d.id}: ${d.title}\n  Outcome: ${d.outcome}\n  Rejected: ${d.rejected}\n  ${d.rationale.replace(/\n+/g, '\n  ')}`);
    // Seeded invariants are deliberately not listed (SPEC §6): they are enforced at plan and edit time.
    return [
      '# Harness',
      'You are working inside Harness, which shows the user a live domain × layer map of this repo and checks every plan and edit against its architecture rules.',
      '',
      '## Map (domains.yaml)',
      `Layers: ${m.layers.map((l) => l.id).join(', ')}`,
      ...domains,
      '',
      '## Standing decisions the user has made',
      decisions.length ? decisions.join('\n') : '(none yet)',
      '',
      '## Rules',
      PLAN_RULES,
      'Change files only with the Edit and Write tools, never through Bash (no heredocs, `sed -i` or scripts that write files): Harness checks each Edit/Write against the rules.',
      'If an edit is denied with options A and B: ' + ASK_RULE,
    ].join('\n');
  }

  start() {
    const alike: Record<string, McpServerConfig> = process.env.HARNESS_ALIKE === '0' ? {} : { alike: { type: 'http', url: 'https://alike.network/api-general/mcp' } };
    this.q = query({
      prompt: this.inbox,
      options: {
        cwd: this.repo.root,
        permissionMode: 'plan',
        planModeInstructions: PLAN_RULES,
        // User settings carry Alike's own hooks (network calls); keep the hot path deterministic. See VERIFY.md.
        settingSources: ['project', 'local'],
        strictMcpConfig: true,
        systemPrompt: { type: 'preset', preset: 'claude_code', append: this.brief() },
        mcpServers: {
          harness: harnessTools(this.repo, this.bus, {
            onPlan: (steps, violations) => this.onPlan(steps, violations),
            takeNotes: () => this.notes.splice(0),
          }),
          ...alike,
        },
        // No allowedTools: canUseTool approves everything except ExitPlanMode, which waits for the user.
        disallowedTools: ['AskUserQuestion'],
        includePartialMessages: true,
        hooks: {
          PreToolUse: [
            { matcher: 'Read|Grep|Glob', hooks: [this.observeRead] },
            { matcher: 'Bash', hooks: [this.observeBash, this.gateBash] },
            { matcher: 'Edit|Write', hooks: [this.gate] },
          ],
          PostToolUse: [
            { matcher: 'Edit|Write', hooks: [this.afterEdit] },
            { matcher: 'mcp__alike__record_decision', hooks: [this.afterAlike] },
          ],
        },
        canUseTool: this.canUseTool,
        stderr: (d) => { if (process.env.HARNESS_DEBUG) process.stderr.write(d); },
      },
    });
    void this.loop();
  }

  private async loop() {
    try {
      for await (const m of this.q!) {
        if (m.type === 'stream_event') {
          const ev = m.event as { type: string; delta?: { type: string; text?: string } };
          if (ev.type === 'content_block_delta' && ev.delta?.type === 'text_delta' && ev.delta.text) this.ephemeral({ type: 'delta', text: ev.delta.text });
        } else if (m.type === 'assistant' && !m.parent_tool_use_id) {
          const t = m.message.content.filter((b) => b.type === 'text').map((b) => (b as { text: string }).text).join('\n').trim();
          if (t) {
            this.bus.emit('chat', { role: 'assistant', text: t });
            if (this.turn) this.turn.lastText = t;
          }
        } else if (m.type === 'result') {
          this.onResult(m.subtype);
        }
      }
    } catch (e) {
      this.bus.emit('error', { message: `Session ended: ${(e as Error).message}` });
    }
  }

  // ---------------------------------------------------------------- chat input

  userMessage(text: string) {
    const t = text.trim();
    if (!t) return;
    if (this.approval) {
      this.bus.emit('chat', { role: 'user', text: t });
      if (/^(approve|approved|lgtm|yes|ok|go|ship it)\b/i.test(t)) this.approve();
      else this.rejectPlan(t);
      return;
    }
    if (this.turn?.forkOpen) {
      const violations = this.turn.forkOpen;
      const option = parseOption(t);
      this.bus.emit('chat', { role: 'user', text: t });
      this.bus.emit('fork_answered', { option, text: t, violations });
      this.turn.forkOpen = null;
      this.turn.planViolations = [];
      this.turn.gateBlocks = [];
      const { decisions, alikeInstruction } = recordFork(this.repo, this.bus, violations, option, t, this.turn.prompt);
      if (alikeInstruction && process.env.HARNESS_ALIKE !== '0') this.notes.push(alikeInstruction);
      const ids = decisions.map((d) => d.id).join(', ');
      this.send(`${t}\n\n[Harness: recorded as ${ids || 'a decision'} in decisions/ and domains.yaml. ` +
        (option === 'B' ? `${violations[0]?.file} is now an exception. ` : '') +
        'Resubmit the plan with mcp__harness__submit_plan, then exit plan mode.]');
      return;
    }
    if (!this.turn) this.startTurn(t);
    this.bus.emit('chat', { role: 'user', text: t });
    this.send(t);
  }

  private send(text: string) {
    this.busy = true;
    this.ephemeral({ type: 'busy', busy: true });
    this.inbox.push(text);
  }

  private startTurn(prompt: string) {
    const id = `t${randomUUID().slice(0, 6)}`;
    this.turn = { id, prompt, base: baseline(this.repo.root), planned: false, steps: [], planViolations: [], gateBlocks: [], forkOpen: null, lastText: '' };
    this.bus.turn = id;
    this.bus.emit('turn_started', { prompt, head: this.turn.base.head, baseline: this.turn.base.snapshot });
  }

  approve() {
    if (!this.approval) return;
    const { resolve, input } = this.approval;
    this.approval = null;
    this.bus.emit('plan_approved', {} as never);
    resolve({ behavior: 'allow', updatedInput: input });
    void this.q?.setPermissionMode('acceptEdits');
  }

  private rejectPlan(feedback: string) {
    if (!this.approval) return;
    const { resolve } = this.approval;
    this.approval = null;
    resolve({ behavior: 'deny', message: `The user did not approve the plan yet. Their feedback: ${feedback}` });
  }

  private onPlan(steps: PlanStep[], violations: Violation[]) {
    if (!this.turn) return;
    this.turn.planned = true;
    this.turn.steps = steps;
    this.turn.planViolations = violations;
  }

  private onResult(subtype: string) {
    this.busy = false;
    this.ephemeral({ type: 'busy', busy: false });
    const turn = this.turn;
    if (!turn) return;
    if (subtype !== 'success') this.bus.emit('error', { message: `Turn ended with ${subtype}` });
    const open = [...turn.planViolations, ...turn.gateBlocks];
    if (open.length && subtype === 'success') {
      // Claude stopped to ask: the turn stays open until the user answers.
      turn.forkOpen = open;
      this.bus.emit('fork_asked', { violations: open, text: turn.lastText });
      return;
    }
    this.endTurn(subtype);
  }

  private endTurn(reason: string) {
    const turn = this.turn!;
    const stat = numstat(this.repo.root, turn.base);
    this.bus.emit('turn_ended', { ...stat, reason });
    const events = this.bus.events.filter((e) => e.turn === turn.id);
    writeFileSync(join(this.repo.root, '.harness/turns', `${turn.id}.json`), JSON.stringify({ id: turn.id, prompt: turn.prompt, baseline: turn.base, steps: turn.steps, numstat: stat, events }, null, 2));
    this.turn = null;
    this.bus.turn = null;
    this.repo.recheck();
    void this.q?.setPermissionMode('plan');
  }

  // ---------------------------------------------------------------- hooks

  private observeRead: HookCallback = async (input) => {
    const i = input as PreToolUseHookInput;
    const ti = i.tool_input as { file_path?: string; path?: string };
    if (i.tool_name === 'Read' && ti.file_path) {
      const rel = this.repo.rel(ti.file_path);
      if (rel) this.bus.emit('looked', { tool: 'Read' }, { path: rel, cell: this.repo.cellOf(rel) });
    } else {
      const rel = this.repo.rel(ti.path ?? this.repo.root);
      if (rel) this.bus.emit('cursor', { verb: 'searching' }, { path: rel, cell: this.repo.cellOf(rel) ?? this.repo.cellForDir(rel) });
    }
    return { async: true };
  };

  /** Claude often reads with `cat`/`sed`/`grep` in Bash: any repo file named in the command counts as looked at. */
  private observeBash: HookCallback = async (input) => {
    const cmd = String((input as PreToolUseHookInput & { tool_input: { command?: string } }).tool_input.command ?? '');
    if (/(^|[;&|]\s*)(cat|head|tail|sed|grep|rg|less|wc|nl|awk)\b/.test(cmd)) {
      for (const token of new Set(cmd.split(/[\s'";|&()<>]+/))) {
        const rel = /[\w-]\.\w+$/.test(token) ? this.repo.rel(token) : null;
        if (rel && this.repo.facts.files.includes(rel)) this.bus.emit('looked', { tool: 'Bash' }, { path: rel, cell: this.repo.cellOf(rel) });
      }
    }
    return { async: true };
  };

  /**
   * Edits made through Bash (heredocs, `sed -i`, inline scripts) would skip the edit gate. Deny commands that
   * write files inside the repo and ask for Edit/Write instead; tests, git and reads pass. The watcher still
   * records anything that slips through, as an unattributed edit.
   */
  private gateBash: HookCallback = async (input) => {
    const cmd = String((input as PreToolUseHookInput & { tool_input: { command?: string } }).tool_input.command ?? '');
    const target = bashWriteTarget(cmd, (p) => this.repo.rel(p));
    if (!target) return {};
    return {
      hookSpecificOutput: {
        hookEventName: 'PreToolUse',
        permissionDecision: 'deny',
        permissionDecisionReason: `Harness: change files in this repo with the Edit or Write tool, not through Bash (${target}), so every edit can be checked against the architecture rules. Make this change with Edit/Write instead.`,
      },
    };
  };

  /** The edit gate: same checker as load and plan, on the imports/writes this edit would add. */
  private gate: HookCallback = async (input) => {
    const i = input as PreToolUseHookInput;
    const ti = i.tool_input as { file_path?: string; content?: string; old_string?: string; new_string?: string; replace_all?: boolean };
    if (!ti.file_path) return {};
    const rel = this.repo.rel(ti.file_path);
    if (!rel) return {}; // outside the repo, e.g. Claude's own plan file
    const old = this.repo.current(rel);
    let next: string;
    try {
      next = i.tool_name === 'Write' ? ti.content ?? '' : applyEdit(old ?? '', ti.old_string ?? '', ti.new_string ?? '', ti.replace_all);
    } catch {
      return {}; // the Edit will fail on its own
    }
    const delta = deltaForEdit(rel, old, next, withExtra(this.repo.exists, [rel]));
    const violations = check(this.repo.map, delta, this.repo.mapper);
    this.bus.emit('cursor', { verb: 'editing' }, { path: rel, cell: this.repo.cellOf(rel) });
    if (!violations.length) {
      this.repo.markPending(rel);
      return {};
    }
    for (const v of violations) this.bus.emit('gate_blocked', { violation: v, tool: i.tool_name }, { path: rel, cell: this.repo.cellOf(rel) });
    this.turn?.gateBlocks.push(...violations);
    return {
      hookSpecificOutput: {
        hookEventName: 'PreToolUse',
        permissionDecision: 'deny',
        permissionDecisionReason: `Harness blocked this edit.\n${violationText(violations)}\n${ASK_RULE}`,
      },
    };
  };

  private afterEdit: HookCallback = async (input) => {
    const i = input as PostToolUseHookInput;
    const ti = i.tool_input as { file_path?: string };
    const rel = ti.file_path ? this.repo.rel(ti.file_path) : null;
    if (rel) setImmediate(() => this.repo.fileChanged(rel, { tool: i.tool_name }));
    return { async: true };
  };

  private afterAlike: HookCallback = async (input) => {
    const i = input as PostToolUseHookInput;
    const res = JSON.stringify(i.tool_response ?? '');
    const ids = new Set(JSON.stringify(i.tool_input).match(/DR-\d+/g) ?? []);
    if (/error|failed|unauthori[sz]ed/i.test(res) && !/"id"/.test(res)) return { async: true };
    for (const d of this.bus.events.filter((e) => e.kind === 'decision_recorded')) {
      const data = d.data as { id: string };
      if (ids.has(data.id)) this.bus.emit('decision_recorded', { ...(d.data as EventData['decision_recorded']), alike: true });
    }
    return { async: true };
  };

  private canUseTool: CanUseTool = async (name, input) => {
    if (name === 'ExitPlanMode') {
      const turn = this.turn;
      if (turn && !turn.planned) {
        return { behavior: 'deny', message: 'Call mcp__harness__submit_plan with your numbered steps before exiting plan mode.' };
      }
      if (turn?.planViolations.length) {
        return { behavior: 'deny', message: `The plan has unresolved violations.\n${violationText(turn.planViolations)}\n${ASK_RULE}` };
      }
      const plan = String((input as { plan?: unknown }).plan ?? '');
      this.bus.emit('approval_requested', { plan });
      return new Promise<PermissionResult>((resolve) => { this.approval = { resolve, input }; });
    }
    return { behavior: 'allow', updatedInput: input };
  };

  interrupt() { void this.q?.interrupt(); }
}

#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Make a throwaway git repo from the core fixture (mirrors Scout's layout) for running the server/shell.
# Usage: scripts/sandbox.sh [dir] [--no-map]   → prints the dir; then HARNESS_REPO=<dir> npm run dev
set -euo pipefail
here="$(cd "$(dirname "$0")/.." && pwd)"
dir="${1:-${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/harness-sandbox}"
rm -rf "$dir" && mkdir -p "$dir"
cp -R "$here/packages/core/test/fixture-repo/." "$dir/"
[[ "${2:-}" == "--no-map" ]] || cp "$here/fixtures/scout-agent.domains.yaml" "$dir/domains.yaml"
cd "$dir"
git init -q && git add -A && git -c user.email=sandbox@harness -c user.name=sandbox commit -qm "sandbox: scout fixture"
echo "$dir"
{
  "name": "harness",
  "private": true,
  "type": "module",
  "workspaces": ["packages/*", "apps/*"],
  "scripts": {
    "dev": "concurrently -k -n server,shell -c blue,magenta \"npm run dev -w @harness/server\" \"npm run dev -w @harness/shell\"",
    "test": "npm test -w @harness/core",
    "typecheck": "tsc -b packages/core apps/server apps/shell"
  },
  "devDependencies": {
    "concurrently": "^9.1.2",
    "typescript": "^5.6.3"
  }
}

// React Flow stress page: N custom nodes inside 24 group (cell) nodes, ~1.5N edges.
// Exposes window.bench.{zoom, relayout} which return measured frame stats.

    "wts27": "npm:web-tree-sitter@^0.27.1"

// Per-file parse/extract benchmark: Harness regex vs oxc-parser vs swc vs web-tree-sitter (+tags query) vs ast-grep.
import fs from 'node:fs';
import path from 'node:path';
import { performance } from 'node:perf_hooks';
import { parseSync as oxcParse, Visitor } from 'oxc-parser';
import swc from '@swc/core';
import { Parser, Language, Query } from 'web-tree-sitter';
import { parse as sgParse, Lang } from '@ast-grep/napi';
import { parseImports } from './harness-imports.mjs';
import { scanWrites } from './harness-writes.mjs';

const HERE = path.dirname(new URL(import.meta.url).pathname);
const corpora = {
  scout: ['/Users/johnzhang/Documents/GitHub/scout-agent', ['src', 'vendor', 'web/src', 'scripts', 'test']],
  hono: [`${HERE}/corpus/hono`, ['src']],
  excalidraw: [`${HERE}/corpus/excalidraw`, ['packages']],
};

function walk(root, dir, out) {
  const abs = path.join(root, dir);
  if (!fs.existsSync(abs)) return;
  for (const e of fs.readdirSync(abs, { withFileTypes: true })) {
    if (e.name === 'node_modules' || e.name.startsWith('.')) continue;
    const rel = path.join(dir, e.name);
    if (e.isDirectory()) walk(root, rel, out);
    else if (/\.(ts|tsx|mts|js|jsx|mjs)$/.test(e.name) && !e.name.endsWith('.d.ts')) out.push(rel);
  }
}

const stats = (xs) => {
  const s = [...xs].sort((a, b) => a - b);
  const q = (p) => s[Math.min(s.length - 1, Math.floor(p * s.length))];
  return { mean: xs.reduce((a, b) => a + b, 0) / xs.length, p50: q(0.5), p95: q(0.95), max: s[s.length - 1] };
};
const fmt = (n) => (n < 1 ? n.toFixed(3) : n.toFixed(2));

// ---- tree-sitter setup
await Parser.init();
const wasmDir = `${HERE}/node_modules/tree-sitter-wasms/out`;
const tsLang = await Language.load(`${wasmDir}/tree-sitter-typescript.wasm`);
const tsxLang = await Language.load(`${wasmDir}/tree-sitter-tsx.wasm`);
const tagSrc = fs.readFileSync(`${HERE}/queries/javascript.tags.scm`, 'utf8') + '\n' + fs.readFileSync(`${HERE}/queries/typescript.tags.scm`, 'utf8');
// Extra query: imports + call sites with enclosing function, the facts Harness needs.
const extra = `
(import_statement source: (string (string_fragment) @import))
(export_statement source: (string (string_fragment) @import))
(call_expression function: (import) arguments: (arguments (string (string_fragment) @import)))
`;
const mkQ = (lang) => new Query(lang, tagSrc + extra);
const tsQ = mkQ(tsLang), tsxQ = mkQ(tsxLang);
const tsParser = new Parser(); tsParser.setLanguage(tsLang);
const tsxParser = new Parser(); tsxParser.setLanguage(tsxLang);

// ---- extractors (each returns a small summary so work isn't optimized away)
const extractors = {
  'regex (Harness today)': (file, src) => {
    const imps = parseImports(src); const w = scanWrites(src);
    return { imports: imps.length, writes: w.length };
  },
  'oxc: parse + module record': (file, src) => {
    const r = oxcParse(file, src);
    const m = r.module;
    return { imports: m.staticImports.length + m.dynamicImports.length, exports: m.staticExports.length };
  },
  'oxc: parse + AST walk (defs, calls)': (file, src) => {
    const r = oxcParse(file, src);
    const m = r.module;
    let defs = 0, calls = 0;
    new Visitor({
      FunctionDeclaration() { defs++; },
      ClassDeclaration() { defs++; },
      MethodDefinition() { defs++; },
      VariableDeclarator(n) { if (n.init && /Function/.test(n.init.type)) defs++; },
      CallExpression() { calls++; },
      NewExpression() { calls++; },
    }).visit(r.program);
    return { imports: m.staticImports.length + m.dynamicImports.length, defs, calls };
  },
  'swc: parseSync (AST only)': (file, src) => {
    const ast = swc.parseSync(src, { syntax: 'typescript', tsx: file.endsWith('x'), comments: false });
    return { items: ast.body.length };
  },
  'tree-sitter: parse only': (file, src) => {
    const p = file.endsWith('x') ? tsxParser : tsParser;
    const t = p.parse(src); const n = t.rootNode.childCount; t.delete();
    return { top: n };
  },
  'tree-sitter: parse + tags query': (file, src) => {
    const tsx = file.endsWith('x');
    const t = (tsx ? tsxParser : tsParser).parse(src);
    const caps = (tsx ? tsxQ : tsQ).captures(t.rootNode);
    let defs = 0, refs = 0, imports = 0;
    for (const c of caps) {
      if (c.name.startsWith('definition.')) defs++;
      else if (c.name.startsWith('reference.')) refs++;
      else if (c.name === 'import') imports++;
    }
    t.delete();
    return { defs, refs, imports };
  },
  'ast-grep napi: parse + find calls': (file, src) => {
    const root = sgParse(file.endsWith('x') ? Lang.Tsx : Lang.TypeScript, src).root();
    const calls = root.findAll({ rule: { kind: 'call_expression' } }).length;
    return { calls };
  },
};

const results = {};
for (const [name, [root, dirs]] of Object.entries(corpora)) {
  const files = [];
  for (const d of dirs) walk(root, d, files);
  const srcs = files.map((f) => [f, fs.readFileSync(path.join(root, f), 'utf8')]);
  const lines = srcs.reduce((a, [, s]) => a + s.split('\n').length, 0);
  results[name] = { files: files.length, lines, by: {} };
  console.log(`\n## ${name}: ${files.length} files, ${lines} lines`);
  for (const [ename, fn] of Object.entries(extractors)) {
    // warmup
    for (const [f, s] of srcs) fn(f, s);
    const totals = [];
    let per = [];
    let agg = {};
    for (let run = 0; run < 3; run++) {
      per = [];
      agg = {};
      const t0 = performance.now();
      for (const [f, s] of srcs) {
        const a = performance.now();
        let out;
        try { out = fn(f, s); } catch (e) { out = { error: 1 }; }
        per.push(performance.now() - a);
        for (const [k, v] of Object.entries(out)) agg[k] = (agg[k] ?? 0) + v;
      }
      totals.push(performance.now() - t0);
    }
    const st = stats(per);
    const total = Math.min(...totals);
    results[name].by[ename] = { total, ...st, agg };
    console.log(`${ename.padEnd(38)} total ${fmt(total).padStart(8)} ms | per-file mean ${fmt(st.mean)} p50 ${fmt(st.p50)} p95 ${fmt(st.p95)} max ${fmt(st.max)} ms | ${JSON.stringify(agg)}`);
  }
}

// ---- incremental reparse in tree-sitter: single-character edit in the largest excalidraw file
{
  const root = corpora.excalidraw[0];
  const files = []; walk(root, 'packages', files);
  const biggest = files.map((f) => [f, fs.statSync(path.join(root, f)).size]).sort((a, b) => b[1] - a[1])[0][0];
  const src = fs.readFileSync(path.join(root, biggest), 'utf8');
  const p = biggest.endsWith('x') ? tsxParser : tsParser;
  let t0 = performance.now();
  const tree = p.parse(src);
  const full = performance.now() - t0;
  const at = src.indexOf('function ') + 9;
  const edited = src.slice(0, at) + 'x' + src.slice(at);
  const pt = (i) => { let row = 0, col = 0; for (let k = 0; k < i; k++) { if (src[k] === '\n') { row++; col = 0; } else col++; } return { row, column: col }; };
  const startPosition = pt(at);
  tree.edit({ startIndex: at, oldEndIndex: at, newEndIndex: at + 1, startPosition, oldEndPosition: startPosition, newEndPosition: { row: startPosition.row, column: startPosition.column + 1 } });
  t0 = performance.now();
  const tree2 = p.parse(edited, tree);
  const inc = performance.now() - t0;
  const changed = tree.getChangedRanges(tree2);
  t0 = performance.now();
  oxcParse(biggest, edited);
  const oxcFull = performance.now() - t0;

/** Everything the UI shows, as a pure function of (events, replay index, selected turn). */
export type View = {
  ui: UIState;
  upTo: number;
  live: boolean;
  turn: TurnState | null;
  turnIndex: number; // 1-based, 0 when no turn
  cells: Record<string, CellView>;
  edges: EdgeView[];

  turnLedger: TurnLedger | null;

  cellFiles: Record<string, string[]>;
  testFiles: Record<string, string[]>;
  unassigned: string[];
  proposal: { domains: number; rules: number } | null;
  steps: { done: number; total: number };
  turnStarts: number[];
};

let reduceCache: { events: readonly HarnessEvent[]; upTo: number; ui: UIState } | null = null;
let viewCache: { ui: UIState; turnSel: string | null; view: View } | null = null;

function reduced(events: readonly HarnessEvent[], upTo: number): UIState {
  if (reduceCache && reduceCache.events === events && reduceCache.upTo === upTo) return reduceCache.ui;
  const ui = reduce(events, upTo);
  reduceCache = { events, upTo, ui };
  return ui;
}

export function deriveView(events: readonly HarnessEvent[], replay: number | null, turnSel: string | null): View {
  const upTo = replay ?? events.length;
  const ui = reduced(events, upTo);
  if (viewCache && viewCache.ui === ui && viewCache.turnSel === turnSel) return viewCache.view;

  const testFiles: Record<string, string[]> = {};
  const unassigned: string[] = [];

    if (p.kind === 'cell') (cellFiles[cellKey(p)] ??= []).push(path);
    else if (p.kind === 'test') (testFiles[p.domain] ??= []).push(path);
    else if (p.kind === 'unassigned') unassigned.push(path);
  }
  for (const list of Object.values(cellFiles)) list.sort();

  let confirmed = -1;

    const k = events[i]!.kind;
    if (k === 'turn_started') turnStarts.push(i);
    if (i >= upTo) continue;
    if (k === 'map_proposed') proposed = i;
    if (k === 'map_confirmed') confirmed = i;
  }
  const proposal = proposed > confirmed && ui.map ? { domains: ui.map.domains.length, rules: ui.map.invariants.length } : null;

  const l = ledger(ui);
  const view: View = {
    ui,
    upTo,
    live: replay === null,
    turn,
    turnIndex: turn ? ui.turns.indexOf(turn) + 1 : 0,
    cells: cellViews(ui, turn?.id ?? null),
    edges: edgeViews(ui, turn?.id ?? null),
    ledger: l,
