// diffMaps: what a candidate map changes, as ghost-able ProposalChanges (NAVIGATION_PLAN §4.5).
import { createMapper } from '../mapper';
import type { DomainMap, Invariant } from '../schema';
import type { ProposalChange } from '../contracts/cartography';
import type { DiffMaps } from '../contracts/api';

/** Rule body without its runtime bookkeeping (exceptions and linked decisions don't make it a different rule). */
const ruleShape = (i: Invariant) => {
  const { exceptions: _e, decisions: _d, source: _s, ...rest } = i;
  return JSON.stringify(rest, Object.keys(rest).sort());
};

/**
 * Domain adds/removes/renames/purposes, cell adds/removes, file placements and moves (over `files`), and rule
 * adds/retires/changes, in that order. Deterministic: domains in map order, files and rules sorted.
 */
export const diffMaps: DiffMaps = (current, next, files) => {
  const out: ProposalChange[] = [];
  const before = new Map(current.domains.map((d) => [d.id, d]));
  const after = new Map(next.domains.map((d) => [d.id, d]));

  for (const d of next.domains) {
    const b = before.get(d.id);
    if (!b) {
      out.push({ kind: 'add_domain', domain: d.id, name: d.name });
      out.push({ kind: 'purpose', domain: d.id, purpose: d.purpose });
      for (const layer of Object.keys(d.cells)) out.push({ kind: 'add_cell', domain: d.id, layer });
      continue;
    }
    if (b.name !== d.name) out.push({ kind: 'rename_domain', domain: d.id, from: b.name, to: d.name });
    if (b.purpose !== d.purpose) out.push({ kind: 'purpose', domain: d.id, purpose: d.purpose });
    for (const layer of Object.keys(d.cells)) if (!(layer in b.cells)) out.push({ kind: 'add_cell', domain: d.id, layer });
    for (const layer of Object.keys(b.cells)) if (!(layer in d.cells)) out.push({ kind: 'remove_cell', domain: d.id, layer });
  }
  for (const d of current.domains) if (!after.has(d.id)) out.push({ kind: 'remove_domain', domain: d.id });

  const a = createMapper(current);
  const n = createMapper(next);
  for (const path of [...new Set(files)].sort()) {
    const from = a.place(path), to = n.place(path);
    if (to.kind !== 'cell') continue;
    if (from.kind === 'cell') {
      if (from.domain !== to.domain || from.layer !== to.layer) out.push({ kind: 'move', path, from: { domain: from.domain, layer: from.layer }, to: { domain: to.domain, layer: to.layer } });
    } else if (from.kind === 'unassigned') {
      out.push({ kind: 'place', path, domain: to.domain, layer: to.layer });
    } else {
      out.push({ kind: 'move', path, from: { domain: from.kind === 'test' ? from.domain : from.kind, layer: from.kind === 'test' ? 'tests' : from.kind }, to: { domain: to.domain, layer: to.layer } });
    }
  }

  const rulesBefore = new Map(current.invariants.map((i) => [i.id, i]));
  const rulesAfter = new Map(next.invariants.map((i) => [i.id, i]));
  for (const id of [...rulesAfter.keys()].sort()) {
    const i = rulesAfter.get(id)!, b = rulesBefore.get(id);
    if (!b) out.push({ kind: 'add_rule', invariant: id, rule: i.rule });
    else if (ruleShape(b) !== ruleShape(i)) out.push({ kind: 'change_rule', invariant: id, rule: i.rule });
  }
  for (const id of [...rulesBefore.keys()].sort()) if (!rulesAfter.has(id)) out.push({ kind: 'retire_rule', invariant: id });
  return out;
};

/** Canonical key of a change set, used to recognize a proposal the user already rejected. */
export function changeSignature(changes: readonly ProposalChange[]): string {
  return changes.map((c) => JSON.stringify(c, Object.keys(c).sort())).sort().join('\n');
}

/** Short human summary of a change set ("add domain Billing; place 3 files; …"). */
export function summarizeChanges(changes: readonly ProposalChange[]): string {
  const parts: string[] = [];
  const count = (k: ProposalChange['kind']) => changes.filter((c) => c.kind === k).length;
  for (const c of changes) {
    if (c.kind === 'add_domain') parts.push(`add domain ${c.name} (${c.domain})`);
    else if (c.kind === 'remove_domain') parts.push(`remove domain ${c.domain}`);
    else if (c.kind === 'rename_domain') parts.push(`rename ${c.domain} "${c.from}" → "${c.to}"`);
    else if (c.kind === 'add_rule') parts.push(`add rule ${c.invariant}: ${c.rule}`);
    else if (c.kind === 'retire_rule') parts.push(`retire rule ${c.invariant}`);
    else if (c.kind === 'change_rule') parts.push(`change rule ${c.invariant}: ${c.rule}`);
  }
  const placed = count('place'), moved = count('move');
  if (placed) parts.push(`place ${placed} file${placed === 1 ? '' : 's'}`);
  if (moved) parts.push(`move ${moved} file${moved === 1 ? '' : 's'}`);
  return parts.join('; ') || 'no structural change';
}

// The deterministic domain × layer grid at every depth: an expanded domain's column widens to fit its containers,
// the other columns compress to spines, rows grow to the tallest container. Edges route through the gutters;
// edges that leave a container start at its ELK port and continue through the gutters to the other endpoint.
import type { EdgeStatus, ViolationState, VisibleEdge, VisibleNode } from '@harness/core/view';
import type { Scene } from '../scene';
import { portKey, type Box, type ContainerLayout, type Pt } from './containers';

export const COL_W = 236;
export const SPINE_W = 64;
export const ROW_H = 132;
export const GAP_X = 56;
export const GAP_Y = 46;

export type NodeType = 'band' | 'cell' | 'spine' | 'container' | 'file';
export type FrameNode = Box & { id: string; type: NodeType; z: number };
export type FrameEdge = {
  id: string;
  d: string;
  status: EdgeStatus;
  violation: ViolationState;
  count: number;
  steps: number[];
  mid: Pt;
  from: string;
  to: string;
};
export type Col = { id: string; name: string; purpose: string; x: number; w: number; spine: boolean; expanded: boolean; index: number };
export type Row = { id: string; name: string; y: number; h: number };
export type Frame = {
  nodes: FrameNode[];
  boxes: Record<string, FrameNode>;
  edges: FrameEdge[];
  cols: Col[];
  rows: Row[];
  bounds: Box;
  focus: Box | null;
  key: string; // expanded set the frame was laid out for
};

export function buildFrame(scene: Scene, layouts: ReadonlyMap<string, ContainerLayout>, key: string): Frame {
  const { grid, projection } = scene;
  const byId = new Map(projection.nodes.map((n) => [n.id, n]));
  const open = new Set(projection.nodes.filter((n) => n.kind === 'domain' && n.expanded).map((n) => n.domain!));
  const any = open.size > 0;

  // Track sizes.
  const colW = grid.domains.map((d) => {
    if (!open.has(d.id)) return any ? SPINE_W : COL_W;
    let w = COL_W;
    for (const l of grid.cells[d.id] ?? []) w = Math.max(w, layouts.get(`cell:${d.id}/${l}`)?.w ?? 0);
    return w;
  });
  const rowH = grid.layers.map((l) => {
    let h = ROW_H;
    for (const d of open) h = Math.max(h, layouts.get(`cell:${d}/${l.id}`)?.h ?? 0);
    return h;
  });
  const cols: Col[] = [];
  let x = 0;
  grid.domains.forEach((d, i) => {
    cols.push({ id: d.id, name: d.name, purpose: d.purpose, x, w: colW[i]!, spine: any && !open.has(d.id), expanded: open.has(d.id), index: i });
    x += colW[i]! + GAP_X;
  });
  const rows: Row[] = [];
  let y = 0;
  grid.layers.forEach((l, j) => {
    rows.push({ id: l.id, name: l.name, y, h: rowH[j]! });
    y += rowH[j]! + GAP_Y;
  });
  const width = x - GAP_X;
  const height = y - GAP_Y;
  const colOf = new Map(cols.map((c) => [c.id, c]));
  const rowOf = new Map(rows.map((r, j) => [r.id, { ...r, index: j }]));

  // Node boxes.
  const nodes: FrameNode[] = [];
  const boxes: Record<string, FrameNode> = {};
  const add = (n: FrameNode) => { nodes.push(n); boxes[n.id] = n; };
  let focus: Box | null = null;
  for (const n of projection.nodes) {
    if (n.kind === 'domain' && n.expanded) {
      const c = colOf.get(n.domain!)!;
      const b = { x: c.x - 14, y: -14, w: c.w + 28, h: height + 28 };
      add({ id: n.id, type: 'band', z: 0, ...b });
      focus = focus ? union(focus, b) : b;
    } else if (n.kind === 'cell') {
      const c = colOf.get(n.domain!)!;
      const r = rowOf.get(n.layer!)!;
      add({ id: n.id, type: n.expanded ? 'container' : c.spine ? 'spine' : 'cell', z: 1, x: c.x, y: r.y, w: c.w, h: r.h });
    }
  }
  for (const n of projection.nodes) {
    if (n.kind !== 'file' || !n.parent) continue;
    const parent = boxes[n.parent];
    const b = layouts.get(n.parent)?.nodes[n.id];
    if (!parent || !b) continue;
    add({ id: n.id, type: 'file', z: 2, x: parent.x + b.x, y: parent.y + b.y, w: b.w, h: b.h });
  }

  // Gutters and lanes.
  const colGutter = (g: number) => (g <= 0 ? -GAP_X / 2 : cols[g - 1]!.x + cols[g - 1]!.w + GAP_X / 2);
  const rowGutter = (g: number) => (g <= 0 ? -GAP_Y / 2 : rows[g - 1]!.y + rows[g - 1]!.h + GAP_Y / 2);
  const used = new Map<string, number>();
  const take = (k: string) => { const n = used.get(k) ?? 0; used.set(k, n + 1); return n; };
  const lane = (i: number, s: number) => (i === 0 ? 0 : (i % 2 ? 1 : -1) * Math.ceil(i / 2) * s);

  type Side = 'top' | 'right' | 'bottom' | 'left';
  type Anchor = { p: Pt; side: Side; col: number; row: number; pre: Pt[] };
  const cellIndex = (n: VisibleNode) => ({ col: colOf.get(n.domain!)!.index, row: rowOf.get(n.layer!)!.index });

  const anchor = (self: VisibleNode, other: VisibleNode, e: VisibleEdge, out: boolean): Anchor | null => {
    const { col, row } = cellIndex(self);
    if (self.kind === 'file') {
      const container = boxes[self.parent!];
      const port = layouts.get(self.parent!)?.ports[portKey(e.id, self.parent!)];
      if (!container || !port) return null;
      const side = (scene.projection.ports.find((p) => p.edge === e.id && p.container === self.parent)?.side ?? 'right') as Side;
      const abs = port.route.map((q) => ({ x: container.x + q.x, y: container.y + q.y }));
      const at = { x: container.x + port.at.x, y: container.y + port.at.y };
      if (side === 'right') at.x = container.x + container.w;
      if (side === 'left') at.x = container.x;
      if (side === 'bottom') at.y = container.y + container.h;
      if (side === 'top') at.y = container.y;
      // ELK routes run child → port for outgoing edges and port → child for incoming ones.
      const pre = out ? abs : [...abs].reverse();
      return { p: at, side, col, row, pre };
    }
    const b = boxes[self.id];
    if (!b) return null;
    const o = cellIndex(other);
    const side: Side = o.col > col ? 'right' : o.col < col ? 'left' : o.row > row ? 'bottom' : 'top';
    const k = take(`port:${self.id}:${side}`);
    const p = side === 'right' || side === 'left'
      ? { x: side === 'right' ? b.x + b.w : b.x, y: b.y + b.h / 2 + lane(k, 10) }
      : { x: b.x + b.w / 2 + lane(k, 10), y: side === 'bottom' ? b.y + b.h : b.y };
    return { p, side, col, row, pre: [] };
  };

  const route = (A: Anchor, B: Anchor): Pt[] => {
    const hA = A.side === 'left' || A.side === 'right';
    const hB = B.side === 'left' || B.side === 'right';
    const gxOf = (a: Anchor) => (a.side === 'right' ? a.col + 1 : a.col);
    const gyOf = (a: Anchor) => (a.side === 'bottom' ? a.row + 1 : a.row);
    const gx = (g: number) => colGutter(g) + lane(take(`col:${g}`), 7);
    const gy = (g: number) => rowGutter(g) + lane(take(`row:${g}`), 6);
    if (hA && hB) {
      const g1 = gxOf(A);
      const g2 = gxOf(B);
      if (g1 === g2) {
        if (Math.abs(A.p.y - B.p.y) < 1) return [A.p, B.p];
        const x1 = gx(g1);
        return [A.p, { x: x1, y: A.p.y }, { x: x1, y: B.p.y }, B.p];
      }
      const rg = B.row > A.row ? A.row + 1 : B.row < A.row ? A.row : A.row + 1;
      const x1 = gx(g1);
      const yy = gy(rg);
      const x2 = gx(g2);
      return [A.p, { x: x1, y: A.p.y }, { x: x1, y: yy }, { x: x2, y: yy }, { x: x2, y: B.p.y }, B.p];
    }
    if (!hA && !hB) {
      const g1 = gyOf(A);
      const g2 = gyOf(B);
      if (g1 === g2) {
        const y1 = gy(g1);
        return [A.p, { x: A.p.x, y: y1 }, { x: B.p.x, y: y1 }, B.p];
      }
      const y1 = gy(g1);
      const xx = gx(A.col + 1);
      const y2 = gy(g2);
      return [A.p, { x: A.p.x, y: y1 }, { x: xx, y: y1 }, { x: xx, y: y2 }, { x: B.p.x, y: y2 }, B.p];
    }
    if (hA) {
      const x1 = gx(gxOf(A));
      const y2 = gy(gyOf(B));
      return [A.p, { x: x1, y: A.p.y }, { x: x1, y: y2 }, { x: B.p.x, y: y2 }, B.p];
    }
    const y1 = gy(gyOf(A));
    const x2 = gx(gxOf(B));
    return [A.p, { x: A.p.x, y: y1 }, { x: x2, y: y1 }, { x: x2, y: B.p.y }, B.p];
  };

  // Existing edges first, then new, then ghosts: lanes are assigned in this order and stay stable as a turn adds edges.
  const rank = { existing: 0, new: 1, ghost: 2 } as const;
  const ordered = [...projection.edges].sort((a, b) => rank[a.status] - rank[b.status] || a.id.localeCompare(b.id));
  const edges: FrameEdge[] = [];
  for (const e of ordered) {
    const a = byId.get(e.from);
    const b = byId.get(e.to);
    if (!a || !b) continue;
    let pts: Pt[] | null = null;
    if (a.kind === 'file' && b.kind === 'file' && a.parent === b.parent) {
      const c = boxes[a.parent!];
      const inner = layouts.get(a.parent!)?.edges[e.id];
      if (c && inner?.length) pts = inner.map((q) => ({ x: c.x + q.x, y: c.y + q.y }));
    } else {
      const A = anchor(a, b, e, true);
      const B = anchor(b, a, e, false);
      if (A && B) pts = [...A.pre, ...route(A, B), ...B.pre];
    }
    if (!pts || pts.length < 2) continue;
    pts = dedupe(pts);
    edges.push({ id: e.id, d: roundedPath(pts, 8), status: e.status, violation: e.violation, count: e.count, steps: e.steps, mid: midpoint(pts), from: e.from, to: e.to });
  }

  return { nodes, boxes, edges, cols, rows, bounds: { x: -GAP_X / 2, y: -GAP_Y / 2, w: width + GAP_X, h: height + GAP_Y }, focus, key };
}

export const union = (a: Box, b: Box): Box => {
  const x = Math.min(a.x, b.x);
  const y = Math.min(a.y, b.y);
  return { x, y, w: Math.max(a.x + a.w, b.x + b.w) - x, h: Math.max(a.y + a.h, b.y + b.h) - y };
};

function dedupe(pts: Pt[]): Pt[] {
  const out: Pt[] = [];
  for (const p of pts) {
    const q = out[out.length - 1];
    if (q && Math.abs(q.x - p.x) < 0.5 && Math.abs(q.y - p.y) < 0.5) continue;
    out.push(p);
  }
  return out;
}

function midpoint(pts: Pt[]): Pt {
  let total = 0;
  for (let i = 1; i < pts.length; i++) total += Math.hypot(pts[i]!.x - pts[i - 1]!.x, pts[i]!.y - pts[i - 1]!.y);
  let half = total / 2;
  for (let i = 1; i < pts.length; i++) {
    const a = pts[i - 1]!;
    const b = pts[i]!;
    const d = Math.hypot(b.x - a.x, b.y - a.y);
    if (half <= d && d > 0) return { x: a.x + ((b.x - a.x) * half) / d, y: a.y + ((b.y - a.y) * half) / d };
    half -= d;
  }
  return pts[0]!;
}

export function roundedPath(pts: Pt[], r: number): string {
  const f = (n: number) => n.toFixed(1);
  let d = `M${f(pts[0]!.x)},${f(pts[0]!.y)}`;
  for (let i = 1; i < pts.length - 1; i++) {
    const p = pts[i - 1]!;
    const c = pts[i]!;
    const n = pts[i + 1]!;
    const d1 = Math.hypot(c.x - p.x, c.y - p.y);
    const d2 = Math.hypot(n.x - c.x, n.y - c.y);
    const rr = Math.min(r, d1 / 2, d2 / 2);
    if (rr < 0.5) { d += `L${f(c.x)},${f(c.y)}`; continue; }
    const ax = c.x - ((c.x - p.x) / d1) * rr;
    const ay = c.y - ((c.y - p.y) / d1) * rr;
    const bx = c.x + ((n.x - c.x) / d2) * rr;
    const by = c.y + ((n.y - c.y) / d2) * rr;
    d += `L${f(ax)},${f(ay)}Q${f(c.x)},${f(c.y)} ${f(bx)},${f(by)}`;
  }
  const last = pts[pts.length - 1]!;
  return `${d}L${f(last.x)},${f(last.y)}`;
}

// buildGraph (NAVIGATION_PLAN §3.2): one containment tree plus leaf edges, from domains.yaml and per-file facts.
// Pure and browser-safe (the mapper only needs picomatch).
import { createMapper, matchesAny, type Placement } from '../mapper';
import type { DomainMap } from '../schema';
import type { UIState } from '../events';
import type { CallFact, FileFacts, SemanticFacts } from '../contracts/facts';
import {
  NEUTRAL_ID, ROOT_ID, UNASSIGNED_ID, cellId, domainId, edgeId, fileOf, groupId, tableId, testsId,
  type ContextGraph, type EdgeKind, type GraphEdge, type GraphNode, type NodeKind,
} from '../contracts/graph';

/** Top-level container for bare packages no `external` cell claims. */
export const VENDORS_ID = 'group:vendors';
/** A container holding more files than this is split into directory groups. */
export const GROUP_THRESHOLD = 12;
/** The layer whose cells hold external services; vendor packages and trace sinks live there. */
export const EXTERNAL_LAYER = 'external';

const KIND_RANK: Partial<Record<NodeKind, number>> = { group: 0, file: 1, table: 2, vendor: 3, symbol: 4, route: 5, entry: 6 };

const emptyFacts = (path: string): FileFacts => ({ path, hash: '', imports: [], writes: [], symbols: [], calls: [], routes: [], entries: [] });
const isPseudo = (id: string) => id.startsWith('vendor:') || id.startsWith('table:');
const normalize = (p: string) => p.replace(/\\/g, '/').split('/').filter((s) => s && s !== '.').join('/');

/**
 * Containment: repo → domain → cell → (group) → file → symbol (nested by `parent`), with routes and entries under
 * their file and tables under the cell that lists them. Test files sit in `tests:<domain>` under their domain;
 * files matching no cell in `unassigned`, shared code in `neutral` (both top-level, created when non-empty).
 * Bare packages (`vendor:<pkg>`) go into the `external` cell that claims them (a glob matching `<pkg>` or
 * `node_modules/<pkg>/…`, importing domains first), else into the top-level `group:vendors`.
 * A cell with confirmed `components` groups matching files by component; any container with more than
 * GROUP_THRESHOLD remaining files groups them by directory (recursively).
 * Leaf edges: imports (file→file), uses (file→vendor), calls, implements, handles (route→handler), writes (→table).
 * Tier 2 calls replace a file's syntactic calls when `semantic[path].hash === facts[path].hash`.
 */
export function buildGraph(
  map: DomainMap,
  facts: Readonly<Record<string, FileFacts>>,
  semantic: Readonly<Record<string, SemanticFacts>> = {},
): ContextGraph {
  const mapper = createMapper(map);
  const nodes: Record<string, GraphNode> = {};
  const rank: Record<string, number> = {};
  const add = (n: Omit<GraphNode, 'order'>, r: number) => {
    if (!nodes[n.id]) { nodes[n.id] = { ...n, order: 0 }; rank[n.id] = r; }
    return nodes[n.id]!;
  };

  // ---- skeleton: domains in map order, cells in layer order (their order is the grid position)
  add({ id: ROOT_ID, kind: 'repo', parent: null, label: 'repo' }, 0);
  const layerIdx = new Map(map.layers.map((l, i) => [l.id, i]));
  map.domains.forEach((d, i) => {
    add({ id: domainId(d.id), kind: 'domain', parent: ROOT_ID, label: d.name, domain: d.id }, i);
    for (const l of map.layers) {
      if (l.id in d.cells) add({ id: cellId(d.id, l.id), kind: 'cell', parent: domainId(d.id), label: l.name, domain: d.id, layer: l.id }, layerIdx.get(l.id)!);
    }
  });
  const nd = map.domains.length;
  const ensureTop = (id: string) => {
    if (id === UNASSIGNED_ID) return add({ id, kind: 'unassigned', parent: ROOT_ID, label: 'Unassigned' }, nd);
    if (id === NEUTRAL_ID) return add({ id, kind: 'neutral', parent: ROOT_ID, label: 'Shared' }, nd + 1);
    return add({ id: VENDORS_ID, kind: 'group', parent: ROOT_ID, label: 'Vendors' }, nd + 2);
  };
  const ensureTests = (domain: string) =>
    add({ id: testsId(domain), kind: 'tests', parent: domainId(domain), label: 'Tests', domain }, map.layers.length);

  // ---- files: every path with facts plus every repo path they import
  const paths = new Set<string>();
  for (const [path, f] of Object.entries(facts)) {
    paths.add(path);
    for (const i of f.imports) if (!isPseudo(i.to)) paths.add(i.to);
  }
  const placement = new Map<string, Placement>();
  const byContainer = new Map<string, string[]>();
  for (const path of [...paths].sort()) {
    const p = mapper.place(path);
    if (p.kind === 'ignored') continue;
    placement.set(path, p);
    const c = p.kind === 'cell' ? cellId(p.domain, p.layer) : p.kind === 'test' ? ensureTests(p.domain).id : ensureTop(p.kind === 'neutral' ? NEUTRAL_ID : UNASSIGNED_ID).id;
    const list = byContainer.get(c) ?? [];
    list.push(path);
    byContainer.set(c, list);
  }

  const putFile = (path: string, parent: string) => {
    const p = placement.get(path)!;
    add({
      id: path, kind: 'file', parent, label: path.slice(path.lastIndexOf('/') + 1), path,
      ...(p.kind === 'cell' ? { domain: p.domain, layer: p.layer } : p.kind === 'test' ? { domain: p.domain } : {}),
    }, KIND_RANK.file!);
  };
  /** Directory groups for a container holding too many files; recursive, files directly in the common dir stay put. */
  const groupByDir = (parent: string, files: string[], gid: (dir: string) => string, scope: Pick<GraphNode, 'domain' | 'layer'>) => {
    if (files.length <= GROUP_THRESHOLD) { for (const f of files) putFile(f, parent); return; }
    const prefix = commonDir(files);
    const dirs = new Map<string, string[]>();
    for (const f of files) {
      const rest = prefix ? f.slice(prefix.length + 1) : f;
      const i = rest.indexOf('/');
      if (i < 0) { putFile(f, parent); continue; }
      const dir = (prefix ? `${prefix}/` : '') + rest.slice(0, i);
      const list = dirs.get(dir) ?? [];
      list.push(f);
      dirs.set(dir, list);
    }
    for (const [dir, list] of dirs) {
      const id = gid(dir);
      add({ id, kind: 'group', parent, label: `${dir.slice(prefix ? prefix.length + 1 : 0)}/`, path: dir, ...scope }, KIND_RANK.group!);
      groupByDir(id, list, gid, scope);
    }
  };
  for (const [container, files] of byContainer) {
    const n = nodes[container]!;
    if (n.kind === 'cell') {
      const { domain, layer } = n as Required<Pick<GraphNode, 'domain' | 'layer'>>;
      const comps = map.domains.find((d) => d.id === domain)?.cells[layer]?.components ?? [];
      const rest: string[] = [];
      for (const f of files) {
        const comp = comps.find((c) => matchesAny(c.paths, f));
        if (!comp) { rest.push(f); continue; }
        const id = groupId(domain, layer, comp.id);
        add({ id, kind: 'group', parent: container, label: comp.name, domain, layer }, KIND_RANK.group!);
        putFile(f, id);
      }
      groupByDir(container, rest, (dir) => groupId(domain, layer, dir), { domain, layer });
    } else {
      groupByDir(container, files, (dir) => `group:${container}/${dir}`, n.domain ? { domain: n.domain } : {});
    }
  }
  const inherit = (parent: string): Pick<GraphNode, 'domain' | 'layer'> => {
    const p = nodes[parent]!;
    return { ...(p.domain ? { domain: p.domain } : {}), ...(p.layer ? { layer: p.layer } : {}) };
  };

  // ---- symbols, routes, entries (under their file; symbols nested by parent)
  for (const path of [...placement.keys()]) {
    const f = facts[path];
    if (!f) continue;
    const scope = inherit(path);
    const own = new Set(f.symbols.map((s) => s.id));
    for (const s of f.symbols) {
      const nested = !!s.parent && own.has(s.parent);
      add({
        id: s.id, kind: 'symbol', parent: nested ? s.parent : path,
        label: nested ? s.name.slice(s.name.lastIndexOf('.') + 1) : s.name, ...scope, symbol: { kind: s.kind, exported: s.exported },
      }, KIND_RANK.symbol!);
    }
    for (const r of f.routes) add({ id: r.id, kind: 'route', parent: path, label: `${r.method} ${r.path}`, ...scope }, KIND_RANK.route!);
    for (const e of f.entries) add({ id: e.id, kind: 'entry', parent: path, label: e.label, ...scope }, KIND_RANK.entry!);
  }

  // ---- tables: under the cell that lists them, else unassigned
  map.domains.forEach((d) => {
    for (const [layer, cell] of Object.entries(d.cells)) {
      for (const t of cell.tables ?? []) add({ id: tableId(t), kind: 'table', parent: cellId(d.id, layer), label: t, domain: d.id, layer }, KIND_RANK.table!);
    }
  });
  const ensureTable = (id: string) => nodes[id] ?? add({ id, kind: 'table', parent: ensureTop(UNASSIGNED_ID).id, label: id.slice(6) }, KIND_RANK.table!);

  // ---- vendors: claimed by an `external` cell (importing domains first), else the top-level Vendors group
  const callsOf = (path: string, f: FileFacts): CallFact[] => {
    const s = semantic[path];
    return s && s.hash === f.hash ? s.calls : f.calls;
  };
  const importers = new Map<string, Set<string>>();
  const noteVendor = (v: string, from: string) => {
    const set = importers.get(v) ?? new Set<string>();
    const d = mapper.domainOf(fileOf(from) ?? from);
    if (d) set.add(d);
    importers.set(v, set);
  };
  for (const [path, f] of Object.entries(facts)) {
    if (!placement.has(path)) continue;
    for (const i of f.imports) if (i.to.startsWith('vendor:')) noteVendor(i.to, path);
    for (const c of callsOf(path, f)) if (c.to.startsWith('vendor:')) noteVendor(c.to, c.from);
  }
  const externals = map.domains.flatMap((d) => (d.cells[EXTERNAL_LAYER] ? [{ domain: d.id, globs: d.cells[EXTERNAL_LAYER]!.paths ?? [] }] : []));
  for (const [v, doms] of [...importers].sort(([a], [b]) => (a < b ? -1 : 1))) {
    const pkg = v.slice(7);
    const claims = (g: string[]) => matchesAny(g, pkg) || matchesAny(g, `node_modules/${pkg}`) || matchesAny(g, `node_modules/${pkg}/index.js`);
    const owner = externals.find((e) => doms.has(e.domain) && claims(e.globs)) ?? externals.find((e) => claims(e.globs));
    if (owner) add({ id: v, kind: 'vendor', parent: cellId(owner.domain, EXTERNAL_LAYER), label: pkg, domain: owner.domain, layer: EXTERNAL_LAYER }, KIND_RANK.vendor!);
    else add({ id: v, kind: 'vendor', parent: ensureTop(VENDORS_ID).id, label: pkg }, KIND_RANK.vendor!);
  }

  // ---- leaf edges
  const edges = new Map<string, GraphEdge>();
  const resolve = (id: string): string | null => {
    if (nodes[id]) return id;
    if (id.startsWith('table:')) return ensureTable(id).id;
    const f = fileOf(id);
    return f && nodes[f] ? f : null;
  };
  const edge = (kind: EdgeKind, from: string | null, to: string | null, owner: string, count = 1, extra: Partial<GraphEdge> = {}) => {
    if (!from || !to) return;
    const id = edgeId(kind, from, to);
    const cur = edges.get(id);
    if (cur) {
      cur.count += count;
      if (extra.typeOnly === false) cur.typeOnly = false;
    } else edges.set(id, { id, kind, from, to, count, owner, ...extra });
  };
  for (const path of placement.keys()) {
    const f = facts[path];
    if (!f) continue;
    for (const i of f.imports) {
      if (i.to.startsWith('vendor:')) edge('uses', path, resolve(i.to), path, 1, { typeOnly: i.typeOnly });
      else edge('imports', path, resolve(i.to), path, 1, { typeOnly: i.typeOnly });
    }
    for (const c of callsOf(path, f)) edge('calls', resolve(c.from), resolve(c.to), path, c.count, { confidence: c.confidence });
    const s = semantic[path];
    if (s && s.hash === f.hash) for (const im of s.implements) edge('implements', resolve(im.from), resolve(im.to), path);
    for (const w of f.writes) edge('writes', w.symbol ? resolve(w.symbol) : path, ensureTable(tableId(w.table)).id, path);
    for (const r of f.routes) if (r.handler) edge('handles', r.id, resolve(r.handler), path);
  }

  // ---- children, sorted by (rank, id); `order` is the sibling index (domains/cells: grid index)
  const children: Record<string, string[]> = {};
  for (const n of Object.values(nodes)) if (n.parent) (children[n.parent] ??= []).push(n.id);
  for (const [parent, list] of Object.entries(children)) {
    list.sort((a, b) => rank[a]! - rank[b]! || (a < b ? -1 : a > b ? 1 : 0));

    list.forEach((id, i) => { nodes[id]!.order = grid ? rank[id]! : i; });

function commonDir(files: string[]): string {
  let parts = files[0]!.split('/').slice(0, -1);
  for (const f of files) {
    const p = f.split('/');
    let i = 0;
    while (i < parts.length && i < p.length - 1 && parts[i] === p[i]) i++;
    parts = parts.slice(0, i);
  }
  return parts.join('/');
}

/**
 * The facts the graph is built from: `ui.facts`, plus empty stubs for every file the log knows about but has no
 * facts for (placed files, files a turn touched or planned, planned import endpoints), so ghosts and fresh files
 * have a leaf. Cross-domain cell→cell imports follow `ui.edges` (the reducer's record of edge_added/removed), so
 * logs without `facts_changed` still project the same edges as `edgeViews`. A no-op when facts are current.
 */
export function graphFacts(ui: UIState): Record<string, FileFacts> {
  const out: Record<string, FileFacts> = { ...ui.facts };
  const stub = (path: string) => { if (!out[path] && !isPseudo(path)) out[path] = emptyFacts(path); };
  for (const [path, p] of Object.entries(ui.files)) if (p.kind !== 'ignored') stub(path);
  for (const t of ui.turns) {
    for (const p of Object.keys(t.paths)) stub(p);
    for (const c of Object.values(t.planned)) c.files.forEach(stub);
    t.unassigned.forEach(stub);
    for (const files of Object.values(t.tests)) files.forEach(stub);
    for (const s of t.steps) for (const f of [...s.files, ...s.imports.map((i) => i.from)]) stub(normalize(fileOf(f) ?? f));
    for (const e of Object.values(t.plannedEdges)) for (const i of e.imports) { stub(i.from); stub(i.to); }
    for (const e of t.edgesAdded) { stub(e.edge.from); stub(e.edge.to); }
  }
  if (!ui.map) return out;
  const mapper = createMapper(ui.map);
  const want = new Map<string, Set<string>>();
  for (const e of Object.values(ui.edges)) for (const f of e.files) { stub(f.from); stub(f.to); (want.get(f.from) ?? want.set(f.from, new Set()).get(f.from)!).add(f.to); }
  const cross = (a: string, b: string) => {
    const pa = mapper.place(a);
    const pb = mapper.place(b);
    return pa.kind === 'cell' && pb.kind === 'cell' && pa.domain !== pb.domain;
  };
  for (const [path, f] of Object.entries(out)) {
    const w = want.get(path);
    const keep = f.imports.filter((i) => isPseudo(i.to) || !cross(path, i.to) || !!w?.has(i.to));
    const extra = [...(w ?? [])].filter((to) => !f.imports.some((i) => i.to === to)).sort();
    if (keep.length !== f.imports.length || extra.length) out[path] = { ...f, imports: [...keep, ...extra.map((to) => ({ to, typeOnly: false }))] };
  }
  return out;
}

/** The context graph for a UI state (null before a map exists). */
export function graphOf(ui: UIState): ContextGraph | null {
  return ui.map ? buildGraph(ui.map, graphFacts(ui), ui.semantic) : null;
}

// Per-graph indexes, computed once and cached by identity (graphs are treated as immutable).
import type { ContextGraph, GraphEdge } from '../contracts/graph';

export type GraphIndex = {
  edgeIds: Set<string>;
  out: Map<string, GraphEdge[]>; // from → edges, in edge-id order
  depth: Map<string, number>; // root = 0
  files: Map<string, number>; // file nodes in each subtree (a file counts itself)
  symbols: Map<string, number>; // symbol nodes strictly below each node
};

const cache = new WeakMap<ContextGraph, GraphIndex>();

export function indexOf(g: ContextGraph): GraphIndex {
  let ix = cache.get(g);
  if (ix) return ix;
  const out = new Map<string, GraphEdge[]>();
  for (const e of g.edges) {
    const list = out.get(e.from);
    if (list) list.push(e);
    else out.set(e.from, [e]);
  }
  const depth = new Map<string, number>([[g.root, 0]]);
  const files = new Map<string, number>();
  const symbols = new Map<string, number>();
  const post: string[] = [];
  const stack = [g.root];
  while (stack.length) {
    const id = stack.pop()!;
    post.push(id);
    for (const c of g.children[id] ?? []) { depth.set(c, depth.get(id)! + 1); stack.push(c); }
  }
  for (let i = post.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
    const id = post[i]!;
    const n = g.nodes[id]!;
    let f = n.kind === 'file' ? 1 : 0;
    let s = 0;
    for (const c of g.children[id] ?? []) {
      f += files.get(c)!;
      s += symbols.get(c)! + (g.nodes[c]!.kind === 'symbol' ? 1 : 0);
    }
    files.set(id, f);
    symbols.set(id, s);
  }
  ix = { edgeIds: new Set(g.edges.map((e) => e.id)), out, depth, files, symbols };
  cache.set(g, ix);
  return ix;
}

/** Ancestors of `id` from the root down, including `id`. */
export function pathTo(g: ContextGraph, id: string): string[] {
  const out: string[] = [];
  for (let n: string | null = id; n; n = g.nodes[n]?.parent ?? null) out.push(n);
  return out.reverse();
}

export const byId = (a: string, b: string) => (a < b ? -1 : a > b ? 1 : 0);

// Instant onboarding map (NAVIGATION_PLAN §4.2 step 1): deterministic, no model, under a second.
import YAML from 'yaml';
import { DomainMapSchema, type DomainMap } from '../schema';
import type { FileFacts } from '../contracts/facts';
import { topFolder } from './drift';
import { CODE_FILE, TEST_FILE, majority, repoImports, titleCase } from './util';

export const SKELETON_LAYERS = [
  { id: 'entry', name: 'Entry' },
  { id: 'logic', name: 'Logic' },
  { id: 'data', name: 'Data' },
  { id: 'external', name: 'External' },
] as const;

export const SKELETON_IGNORE = [
  'node_modules/**', '.git/**', '.harness/**', 'decisions/**', 'fixtures/**', 'scripts/**', 'dist/**', 'build/**', 'coverage/**',
  '*.json', '*.md', '*.config.ts', '*.config.js', '.*', 'domains.yaml',
];

const VENDOR_DIR = /^(vendor|vendors|third[-_]party|external|clients|integrations)$/;
const NEUTRAL_DIR = /^(shared|common|utils?|types|helpers)$/;
const ENTRY = /(^|[/._-])(routes?|router|cli|server|main|handlers?|controllers?|pages?|bin|cmd|commands?|api)([/._-]|$)/;
const DATA = /(^|[/._-])(stores?|repo|repository|repositories|models?|schema|db|dao|ledger|state|log|sync|migrations?|persistence|storage|cache)([/._-]|$)/;
const EXTERNAL = /(^|[/._-])(client|sdk)([/._-]|$)/;

/** Folder/name heuristic for a file's layer (a file that writes a table is data). */
export function layerFor(path: string, facts?: FileFacts): 'entry' | 'logic' | 'data' | 'external' {
  const parts = path.replace(/\.[^./]+$/, '').split('/');
  if (parts.some((p) => VENDOR_DIR.test(p))) return 'external';
  const tail = parts.slice(-2).join('/');
  if (facts?.writes.length || DATA.test(tail)) return 'data';
  if (ENTRY.test(tail)) return 'entry';
  if (EXTERNAL.test(tail)) return 'external';
  return 'logic';
}

/** Where a code file goes in the skeleton: a domain folder, a vendor unit, neutral, or a test. */
function homeOf(path: string): { kind: 'domain'; folder: string; slug: string } | { kind: 'vendor'; unit: string } | { kind: 'neutral' } | { kind: 'test' } {
  if (TEST_FILE.test(path)) return { kind: 'test' };
  const parts = path.split('/');
  if (parts.length >= 2 && VENDOR_DIR.test(parts[0]!)) return parts.length >= 3 ? { kind: 'vendor', unit: `${parts[0]}/${parts[1]}` } : { kind: 'neutral' };
  const top = topFolder(path);
  if (!top) return { kind: 'domain', folder: '', slug: 'app' };
  const slug = top.split('/').at(-1)!;
  if (NEUTRAL_DIR.test(slug)) return { kind: 'neutral' };
  if (top === 'src' || top === 'lib' || top === 'app') return { kind: 'domain', folder: top, slug: 'app' }; // files directly under src/
  return { kind: 'domain', folder: top, slug };
}

/**
 * One domain per top-level source folder; layers from folder/name heuristics; tables owned by the domain that
 * writes them most. Vendor client folders go to the external cell of the domain that imports them most (else neutral).
 * Single-layer domains use a folder glob so new files land in place; mixed folders list files explicitly.
 */
export function skeletonMap(files: readonly string[], facts: Readonly<Record<string, FileFacts>>): DomainMap {
  const code = [...new Set(files.filter((f) => CODE_FILE.test(f)))].sort();
  const domains = new Map<string, { slug: string; folder: string; cells: Map<string, string[]>; tables: Map<string, number> }>();
  const vendors = new Map<string, string[]>();
  const neutral = new Set<string>();
  const tests: string[] = [];
  const domainOfFile = new Map<string, string>();

  for (const f of code) {
    const h = homeOf(f);
    if (h.kind === 'test') { tests.push(f); continue; }
    if (h.kind === 'neutral') {
      const parts = f.split('/');
      neutral.add(parts.length >= 3 || (parts.length === 2 && !VENDOR_DIR.test(parts[0]!)) ? `${parts.slice(0, -1).join('/')}/**` : f);
      continue;
    }
    if (h.kind === 'vendor') { vendors.set(h.unit, [...(vendors.get(h.unit) ?? []), f]); continue; }
    const d = domains.get(h.slug) ?? { slug: h.slug, folder: h.folder, cells: new Map(), tables: new Map() };
    domains.set(h.slug, d);
    const layer = layerFor(f, facts[f]);
    d.cells.set(layer, [...(d.cells.get(layer) ?? []), f]);
    for (const w of facts[f]?.writes ?? []) d.tables.set(w.table, (d.tables.get(w.table) ?? 0) + 1);
    domainOfFile.set(f, h.slug);
  }

  // Vendor units → external cell of their main importer.
  const vendorCells = new Map<string, string[]>();
  for (const [unit, unitFiles] of [...vendors].sort(([a], [b]) => a.localeCompare(b))) {
    const importers = Object.values(facts).flatMap((ff) => (repoImports(ff).some((to) => unitFiles.includes(to)) ? [domainOfFile.get(ff.path)] : [])).filter((x): x is string => !!x);
    const owner = majority(importers);
    if (owner) vendorCells.set(owner, [...(vendorCells.get(owner) ?? []), `${unit}/**`]);
    else neutral.add(`${unit}/**`);
  }

  // Each table goes to the domain that writes it most (ties: first id).
  const tableOwner = new Map<string, string>();
  const tableBest = new Map<string, number>();
  for (const d of [...domains.values()].sort((a, b) => a.slug.localeCompare(b.slug))) {
    for (const [t, n] of d.tables) if (n > (tableBest.get(t) ?? 0)) { tableBest.set(t, n); tableOwner.set(t, d.slug); }
  }

  const raw = {
    version: 1,
    layers: SKELETON_LAYERS.map((l) => ({ ...l })),
    neutral: [...neutral].sort(),
    ignore: SKELETON_IGNORE,
    domains: [...domains.values()].sort((a, b) => a.slug.localeCompare(b.slug)).map((d) => {
      const cells: Record<string, { paths: string[]; tables?: string[] }> = {};
      const single = d.cells.size === 1 && d.folder !== '' && d.slug !== 'app';
      for (const layer of SKELETON_LAYERS.map((l) => l.id)) {
        const own = d.cells.get(layer) ?? [];
        const ext = layer === 'external' ? vendorCells.get(d.slug) ?? [] : [];
        if (!own.length && !ext.length) continue;
        const paths = [...(single && own.length ? [`${d.folder}/**`] : own), ...ext];
        const tables = [...tableOwner].filter(([, o]) => o === d.slug).map(([t]) => t).sort();
        const writesHere = own.some((f) => facts[f]?.writes.length);
        cells[layer] = { paths, ...(tables.length && writesHere ? { tables } : {}) };
      }
      const testGlobs = ['test', 'tests'].map((t) => `${t}/${d.slug}/**`).filter((g) => tests.some((f) => f.startsWith(g.slice(0, -2))));
      return {
        id: d.slug,
        name: d.slug === 'app' ? 'App' : titleCase(d.slug),
        purpose: d.folder ? `Code under ${d.folder}/` : 'Top-level code',
        cells,
        ...(testGlobs.length ? { tests: testGlobs } : {}),
      };
    }),
    invariants: [],
  };
  return DomainMapSchema.parse(raw);
}

/** domains.yaml text for a map (stable key order; flow style kept for short lists). */
export function mapToYaml(map: DomainMap, header = ''): string {
  return header + YAML.stringify(map, { lineWidth: 140 });
}

// The instant, faint placement guess for an unassigned file (NAVIGATION_PLAN §4.3). Deterministic; never a model.
import { createMapper } from '../mapper';
import type { DomainMap } from '../schema';
import type { FileFacts } from '../contracts/facts';
import { topFolder } from './drift';
import { layerFor } from './skeleton';
import { dirOf, majority, repoImports } from './util';

/** `basis` says why: already placed, folder siblings, import neighbours, or a new top-level folder (`domain` may not exist yet). */
export type PlacementGuess = { domain: string; layer: string; basis: 'cell' | 'siblings' | 'imports' | 'folder' };

/**
 * Guess a cell for `path`: its placement if it already has one; else the majority cell of files in the same folder
 * (then the parent folder); else the majority domain of what it imports and what imports it; else, for a folder
 * the map knows nothing about, a new domain named after it. Null for neutral, ignored and test files.
 */
export function instantGuess(map: DomainMap, facts: Readonly<Record<string, FileFacts>>, path: string): PlacementGuess | null {
  const mapper = createMapper(map);
  const own = mapper.place(path);
  if (own.kind === 'cell') return { domain: own.domain, layer: own.layer, basis: 'cell' };
  if (own.kind !== 'unassigned') return null;

  const paths = Object.keys(facts).filter((p) => p !== path).sort();
  const cellOf = (p: string) => { const pl = mapper.place(p); return pl.kind === 'cell' ? pl : null; };
  const layers = map.layers.map((l) => l.id);
  const fitLayer = (domain: string | null, fallback: string[]) => {
    const want = layerFor(path, facts[path]);
    const cells = domain ? Object.keys(map.domains.find((d) => d.id === domain)?.cells ?? {}) : layers;
    if (cells.includes(want)) return want;
    return majority(fallback.filter((l) => cells.includes(l))) ?? (cells.includes('logic') ? 'logic' : cells[0] ?? layers[0]!);
  };

  for (const dir of [dirOf(path), dirOf(dirOf(path))]) {
    if (!dir) continue;
    const sibs = paths.filter((p) => dirOf(p) === dir).map(cellOf).filter((c) => !!c);
    const best = majority(sibs.map((c) => `${c.domain}\u0000${c.layer}`));
    if (best) { const [domain, layer] = best.split('\u0000') as [string, string]; return { domain, layer, basis: 'siblings' }; }
  }

  const imports = facts[path] ? repoImports(facts[path]!) : [];
  const importers = paths.filter((p) => repoImports(facts[p]!).includes(path));
  const neighbours = [...imports, ...importers].map(cellOf).filter((c) => !!c);
  const domain = majority(neighbours.map((c) => c.domain));
  if (domain) return { domain, layer: fitLayer(domain, neighbours.filter((c) => c.domain === domain).map((c) => c.layer)), basis: 'imports' };

  const top = topFolder(path);
  if (top && !paths.some((p) => p.startsWith(`${top}/`) && cellOf(p))) {
    const slug = top.split('/').at(-1)!;
    return { domain: slug, layer: fitLayer(null, []), basis: 'folder' };
  }
  return null;
}

// activityFor: the selected turn's activity per leaf (file and symbol ids), a pure read of the reduced UI state.
import type { UIState } from '../events';
import type { TurnActivity } from '../contracts/api';
import { edgeId, fileOf, type ContextGraph, type LeafActivity, type ProposalMark, type ViolationState } from '../contracts/graph';
import { byId, indexOf } from './util';

const PROPOSAL_RANK: Record<NonNullable<ProposalMark>, number> = { rename: 1, add: 2, move_in: 3, move_out: 4, remove: 5 };
/** The stronger of two proposal marks (remove > move_out > move_in > add > rename). */
export const strongerMark = (a: ProposalMark, b: ProposalMark): ProposalMark => (!a ? b : !b ? a : PROPOSAL_RANK[b] > PROPOSAL_RANK[a] ? b : a);

export const emptyLeaf = (): LeafActivity => ({
  looked: false, edited: false, added: 0, removed: 0, created: false, unattributed: false, ghostSteps: [], planned: false,
  unplanned: false, violation: null, cursor: false, symbols: null, audit: 0, proposal: null,
});

const normalize = (p: string) => p.replace(/\\/g, '/').split('/').filter((s) => s && s !== '.').join('/');

/**
 * Per-leaf activity for one turn (default: the latest, like cellViews). Same semantics as cellViews, per leaf:
 * - looked / edited / added / removed / created / unattributed from `turn.paths`; symbol leaves named in a
 *   file's symbol diff are edited (lines stay on the file, so rollups never double count);
 * - ghostSteps: plan steps naming the leaf (files ∪ import sources, or `path#symbol`) while it is not edited;
 * - unplanned: edited, the turn has a plan (`turn.planned` non-empty), and neither the leaf nor its file is planned;
 * - violation: `new` for a turn violation (plan or gate) not already on the map (same file + invariant),
 *   else `existing` for a current violation;
 * - cursor (only for the current turn), audit (open findings), proposal (pending proposals touching the leaf).
 */
export function activityFor(ui: UIState, graph: ContextGraph, turnId: string | null = ui.turns.at(-1)?.id ?? null): TurnActivity {
  const turn = turnId ? ui.turns.find((t) => t.id === turnId) ?? null : null;
  const ix = indexOf(graph);
  const leaves: Record<string, LeafActivity> = {};
  const has = (id: string) => !!graph.nodes[id];
  const leaf = (id: string) => (leaves[id] ??= emptyLeaf());

  if (turn) {
    for (const [path, pa] of Object.entries(turn.paths)) {
      if (!has(path)) continue;
      const l = leaf(path);
      l.looked = pa.looked;
      l.edited = pa.edits > 0;
      l.added = pa.added;
      l.removed = pa.removed;
      l.created = pa.created;
      l.unattributed = pa.unattributed;
      l.symbols = pa.symbols;
      if (!pa.symbols) continue;
      const added = new Set(pa.symbols.added);
      for (const s of [...pa.symbols.added, ...pa.symbols.sig, ...pa.symbols.body, ...pa.symbols.renamed.map((r) => r[1])]) {
        if (!has(s)) continue;
        const sl = leaf(s);
        sl.edited = true;
        if (added.has(s)) sl.created = true;
      }
    }
    const steps = new Map<string, Set<number>>();
    for (const s of turn.steps) {
      for (const raw of [...s.files, ...s.imports.map((i) => i.from)]) {
        const hash = raw.indexOf('#');
        const id = hash < 0 ? normalize(raw) : `${normalize(raw.slice(0, hash))}${raw.slice(hash)}`;
        if (!has(id)) continue;
        (steps.get(id) ?? steps.set(id, new Set()).get(id)!).add(s.n);
      }
    }
    for (const [id, set] of steps) {
      const l = leaf(id);
      l.planned = true;
      if (!l.edited) l.ghostSteps = [...set].sort((a, b) => a - b);
    }
    const hasPlan = Object.keys(turn.planned).length > 0;
    for (const [id, l] of Object.entries(leaves)) {
      const file = fileOf(id);
      l.unplanned = hasPlan && l.edited && !l.planned && !(file && steps.has(file));
    }
  }

  // violations: current ones are `existing`; a turn's plan/gate violation not already on the map is `new`
  const files = new Set<string>();
  const edges = new Set<string>();
  for (const v of ui.violations) {
    if (!has(v.file)) continue;
    files.add(v.file);
    const l = leaf(v.file);
    l.violation ??= 'existing';
    for (const e of ix.out.get(v.file) ?? []) if (e.kind === 'imports' && (!v.target || v.target === e.to)) edges.add(e.id);
  }
  const known = (file: string, invariant: string) => ui.violations.some((x) => x.file === file && x.invariant === invariant);
  if (turn) {
    for (const v of [...turn.planViolations, ...turn.gateBlocks]) {
      if (known(v.file, v.invariant) || !has(v.file)) continue;
      leaf(v.file).violation = 'new';
    }
  }

  let cursor: string | null = null;
  if (ui.cursor && (!turn || turn.id === ui.current) && has(ui.cursor.path)) {
    cursor = ui.cursor.path;
    leaf(cursor).cursor = true;
  }

  for (const f of Object.values(ui.findings)) {
    if (f.status !== 'open') continue;
    for (const p of new Set(f.files)) if (has(p)) leaf(p).audit += 1;
  }

  const mark = (id: string, m: ProposalMark) => { if (has(id)) leaf(id).proposal = strongerMark(leaf(id).proposal, m); };
  const filesWhere = (pred: (domain?: string, layer?: string) => boolean) =>
    Object.values(graph.nodes).filter((n) => n.kind === 'file' && pred(n.domain, n.layer)).map((n) => n.id);
  for (const p of Object.values(ui.proposals)) {
    if (p.status !== 'pending') continue;
    for (const c of p.proposal.changes) {
      if (c.kind === 'place') mark(c.path, 'add');
      else if (c.kind === 'move') mark(c.path, 'move_out');
      else if (c.kind === 'remove_domain') for (const f of filesWhere((d) => d === c.domain)) mark(f, 'remove');
      else if (c.kind === 'remove_cell') for (const f of filesWhere((d, l) => d === c.domain && l === c.layer)) mark(f, 'remove');
      else if (c.kind === 'rename_domain') for (const f of filesWhere((d) => d === c.domain)) mark(f, 'rename');
    }
  }

  // planned imports not yet built (a planned domain edge disappears only once all of its imports exist, as in edgeViews)
  const plannedEdges: TurnActivity['plannedEdges'] = [];
  if (turn) {
    for (const pe of Object.values(turn.plannedEdges)) {
      if (pe.imports.every((i) => ix.edgeIds.has(edgeId('imports', i.from, i.to)))) continue;
      for (const i of pe.imports) {
        const hit = turn.planViolations.find((v) => v.file === i.from && (!v.target || v.target === i.to));
        const violation: ViolationState = !hit ? null : known(hit.file, hit.invariant) ? 'existing' : 'new';
        plannedEdges.push({ from: i.from, to: i.to, steps: [...pe.steps], violation });
      }
    }
    plannedEdges.sort((a, b) => byId(a.from, b.from) || byId(a.to, b.to));
  }

  const added = new Set<string>();
  for (const e of turn?.edgesAdded ?? []) added.add(edgeId('imports', e.edge.from, e.edge.to));
  for (const c of turn?.callsAdded ?? []) added.add(edgeId('calls', c.from, c.to));

  return {
    turn: turn?.id ?? null,
    leaves,
    plannedEdges,
    addedEdges: [...added].filter((id) => ix.edgeIds.has(id)).sort(byId),
    cursor,
    violations: { files: [...files].sort(byId), edges: [...edges].sort(byId) },
  };
}

import { create } from 'zustand';
import type { VisibleNode } from '@harness/core/view';
import type { Scene } from './scene';

export type Theme = 'atlas' | 'control' | 'strata';
const params = new URLSearchParams(location.search);
const themeParam = params.get('theme');
export const initialTheme: Theme = themeParam === 'control' || themeParam === 'strata' ? themeParam : 'atlas';

/**
 * View-only state for the v2 map (expanded set, theme), plus the current projection's nodes published by id with
 * structural sharing, so each node component re-renders only when its own slice changes.
 */
type V2Store = {
  expanded: string[];
  theme: Theme;
  nodes: Record<string, VisibleNode>;
  preview: Record<string, string[]>;
  planned: Record<string, true>;
  cursor: Scene['cursor'];
  setExpanded(e: string[]): void;
  toggle(id: string): void;
  publish(scene: Scene): void;
};

const same = (a: unknown, b: unknown) => JSON.stringify(a) === JSON.stringify(b);

export const useV2 = create<V2Store>((set, get) => ({
  expanded: (params.get('expand') ?? '').split(',').filter(Boolean).map((d) => (d.startsWith('domain:') ? d : `domain:${d}`)),
  theme: initialTheme,
  nodes: {},
  preview: {},
  planned: {},
  cursor: null,
  setExpanded: (expanded) => set({ expanded }),
  toggle: (id) => set((s) => ({ expanded: s.expanded.includes(id) ? s.expanded.filter((x) => x !== id) : [...s.expanded, id] })),
  publish: (scene) => {
    const prev = get();
    const nodes: Record<string, VisibleNode> = {};
    for (const n of scene.projection.nodes) {
      const p = prev.nodes[n.id];
      nodes[n.id] = p && same(p, n) ? p : n;
    }
    const preview: Record<string, string[]> = {};
    for (const [k, v] of Object.entries(scene.preview)) preview[k] = prev.preview[k] && same(prev.preview[k], v) ? prev.preview[k]! : v;
    set({
      nodes,
      preview,
      planned: Object.fromEntries(scene.planned.map((p) => [p, true as const])),
      cursor: same(prev.cursor, scene.cursor) ? prev.cursor : scene.cursor,
    });
  },
}));

// project (NAVIGATION_PLAN §3.2): visible nodes with rolled-up activity, aggregated edges and ports for one view.
import type { TurnActivity } from '../contracts/api';
import type { CallConfidence } from '../contracts/facts';
import {
  NEUTRAL_ID, cellId, fileOf,
  type ContextGraph, type EdgeKind, type Port, type Projection, type Rollup, type ViewState, type VisibleEdge, type VisibleNode, type ViolationState,
} from '../contracts/graph';
import { strongerMark } from './activity';
import { byId, indexOf, pathTo } from './util';

const SEVERITY = { new: 2, existing: 1 } as const;
/** The worse of two violation states ('new' > 'existing' > null). */
export const worse = (a: ViolationState, b: ViolationState): ViolationState => ((b ? SEVERITY[b] : 0) > (a ? SEVERITY[a] : 0) ? b : a);
const CONFIDENCE: Record<CallConfidence, number> = { dispatch: 0, syntactic: 1, typed: 2 };
/** Weakest call confidence (dispatch < syntactic < typed). */
const weaker = (a: CallConfidence | null, b: CallConfidence | undefined): CallConfidence | null =>
  !b ? a : !a || CONFIDENCE[b] < CONFIDENCE[a] ? b : a;

const emptyRollup = (leaves: number): Rollup => ({
  looked: false, edited: false, added: 0, removed: 0, ghostSteps: [], unplanned: false, violation: null,
  violationFiles: [], newViolationFiles: [], cursor: false, audit: 0, proposal: null, leaves,
});

/** True when a rollup carries activity from the turn (what the turn lens keeps). */
export const isActive = (r: Rollup) =>
  r.looked || r.edited || r.ghostSteps.length > 0 || r.unplanned || r.violation === 'new' || r.cursor || r.added > 0 || r.removed > 0;

/**
 * Visible set: the root's children, plus the children of every expanded visible node. `view.focus` does not
 * change visibility (autoExpand does). Leaf activity rolls up to the nearest visible ancestor: booleans OR,
 * counts sum, violation MAX. Ghost and unplanned keep cellViews' cell semantics at every depth: a planned unit
 * (a cell, or a leaf outside cells) is a ghost only while nothing in it under the node is edited, and an edited
 * unit is unplanned only if nothing in it under the node is planned. Leaf edges map to their nearest visible
 * endpoints and aggregate by (from, to); self-loops and edges touching neutral code or the root are dropped.
 * Ghost (planned) edges aggregate in their own lane. Ports mark where an edge leaves or enters an expanded container.
 * `lens.kinds` filters edge kinds (empty = all); `lens.turnOnly` keeps only nodes with turn activity.
 */
export function project(graph: ContextGraph, view: ViewState, activity: TurnActivity): Projection {
  const ix = indexOf(graph);
  const expanded = new Set(view.expanded);

  // ---- visible tree (pre-order, siblings by order)
  const visible = new Map<string, VisibleNode>();
  const order: string[] = [];
  const walk = (parent: string, vparent: string | null, depth: number) => {
    for (const id of graph.children[parent] ?? []) {
      const n = graph.nodes[id]!;
      const expandable = (graph.children[id]?.length ?? 0) > 0;
      const isOpen = expandable && expanded.has(id);
      visible.set(id, {
        id, kind: n.kind, parent: vparent, label: n.label, depth, expanded: isOpen, expandable, order: n.order,
        ...(n.domain ? { domain: n.domain } : {}), ...(n.layer ? { layer: n.layer } : {}), ...(n.path ? { path: n.path } : {}),
        rollup: emptyRollup(n.kind === 'file' ? ix.symbols.get(id)! : n.kind === 'symbol' ? ix.symbols.get(id)! + 1 : ix.files.get(id)!),
      });
      order.push(id);
      if (isOpen) walk(id, id, depth + 1);
    }
  };
  walk(graph.root, null, 0);

  const repMemo = new Map<string, string | null>();
  /** Nearest visible ancestor-or-self (null for the root and unknown ids). */
  const rep = (id: string): string | null => {
    let r = repMemo.get(id);
    if (r !== undefined) return r;
    const n = graph.nodes[id];
    r = !n || id === graph.root ? null : visible.has(id) ? id : n.parent ? rep(n.parent) : null;
    repMemo.set(id, r);
    return r;
  };
  const topMemo = new Map<string, string>();
  const top = (id: string): string => {
    let t = topMemo.get(id);
    if (t !== undefined) return t;
    const p = graph.nodes[id]?.parent;
    t = !p || p === graph.root ? id : top(p);
    topMemo.set(id, t);
    return t;
  };
  /** Cell semantics unit: a leaf's cell, or the leaf's file outside cells. */
  const unit = (id: string) => {
    const n = graph.nodes[id]!;
    return n.domain && n.layer ? cellId(n.domain, n.layer) : fileOf(id) ?? id;
  };

  // ---- rollups
  type Unit = { ghost: Set<number>; edited: boolean; planned: boolean; unplanned: boolean };
  const units = new Map<string, Map<string, Unit>>();
  for (const [id, l] of Object.entries(activity.leaves)) {
    const r = rep(id);
    if (!r) continue;
    const ro = visible.get(r)!.rollup;
    ro.looked ||= l.looked;
    ro.edited ||= l.edited;
    ro.added += l.added;
    ro.removed += l.removed;
    ro.violation = worse(ro.violation, l.violation);
    if (l.violation === 'new') ro.newViolationFiles.push(fileOf(id) ?? id);
    ro.cursor ||= l.cursor;
    ro.audit += l.audit;
    ro.proposal = strongerMark(ro.proposal, l.proposal);
    const byUnit = units.get(r) ?? units.set(r, new Map()).get(r)!;
    const k = unit(id);
    const u = byUnit.get(k) ?? byUnit.set(k, { ghost: new Set(), edited: false, planned: false, unplanned: false }).get(k)!;
    for (const s of l.ghostSteps) u.ghost.add(s);
    u.edited ||= l.edited;
    u.planned ||= l.planned;
    u.unplanned ||= l.unplanned;
  }
  for (const [r, byUnit] of units) {
    const ro = visible.get(r)!.rollup;
    const ghost = new Set<number>();
    for (const u of byUnit.values()) {
      if (!u.edited) for (const s of u.ghost) ghost.add(s);
      if (u.unplanned && !u.planned) ro.unplanned = true;
    }
    ro.ghostSteps = [...ghost].sort((a, b) => a - b);
  }
  for (const f of activity.violations.files) {
    const r = rep(f);
    if (r) visible.get(r)!.rollup.violationFiles.push(f);
  }
  for (const v of visible.values()) {
    v.rollup.violationFiles = [...new Set(v.rollup.violationFiles)].sort(byId);
    v.rollup.newViolationFiles = [...new Set(v.rollup.newViolationFiles)].sort(byId);
  }

  const shown = view.lens.turnOnly ? new Set(order.filter((id) => isActive(visible.get(id)!.rollup))) : null;
  const nodes = order.filter((id) => !shown || shown.has(id)).map((id) => visible.get(id)!);

  // ---- edges
  const kinds = view.lens.kinds.length ? new Set<EdgeKind>(view.lens.kinds) : null;
  const added = new Set(activity.addedEdges);
  const existing = new Set(activity.violations.edges);
  const endpoints = (from: string, to: string): [string, string] | null => {
    const a = rep(from);
    const b = rep(to);
    if (!a || !b || a === b || top(from) === NEUTRAL_ID || top(to) === NEUTRAL_ID) return null;
    if (shown && (!shown.has(a) || !shown.has(b))) return null;
    return [a, b];
  };
  const solid = new Map<string, VisibleEdge & { kindSet: Set<EdgeKind> }>();
  for (const e of graph.edges) {
    if (kinds && !kinds.has(e.kind)) continue;
    const ends = endpoints(e.from, e.to);
    if (!ends) continue;
    const id = `${ends[0]}->${ends[1]}`;
    let v = solid.get(id);
    if (!v) solid.set(id, (v = { id, from: ends[0], to: ends[1], kinds: [], kindSet: new Set(), count: 0, status: 'existing', violation: null, confidence: null, steps: [], leafEdges: [] }));
    v.kindSet.add(e.kind);
    v.count += 1;
    v.leafEdges.push(e.id);
    if (added.has(e.id)) v.status = 'new';
    if (existing.has(e.id)) v.violation = worse(v.violation, 'existing');
    if (e.kind === 'calls') v.confidence = weaker(v.confidence, e.confidence);
  }
  const ghosts = new Map<string, VisibleEdge & { stepSet: Set<number> }>();
  if (!kinds || kinds.has('imports')) {
    for (const pe of activity.plannedEdges) {
      const ends = endpoints(pe.from, pe.to);
      if (!ends) continue;
      const id = `ghost:${ends[0]}->${ends[1]}`;
      let v = ghosts.get(id);
      if (!v) ghosts.set(id, (v = { id, from: ends[0], to: ends[1], kinds: ['imports'], count: 0, status: 'ghost', violation: null, confidence: null, steps: [], stepSet: new Set(), leafEdges: [] }));
      v.count += 1;
      v.leafEdges.push(`plan|${pe.from}|${pe.to}`);
      v.violation = worse(v.violation, pe.violation);
      for (const s of pe.steps) v.stepSet.add(s);
    }
  }
  const edges: VisibleEdge[] = [
    ...[...solid.values()].map(({ kindSet, ...v }) => ({ ...v, kinds: [...kindSet].sort(byId) })),
    ...[...ghosts.values()].map(({ stepSet, ...v }) => ({ ...v, steps: [...stepSet].sort((a, b) => a - b) })),
  ].sort((a, b) => byId(a.id, b.id));

  // ---- ports: every expanded container an edge leaves (out) or enters (in)
  const ports: Port[] = [];
  const ancestors = (id: string) => {
    const out: string[] = [];
    for (let p = visible.get(id)!.parent; p; p = visible.get(p)!.parent) out.push(p);
    return out;
  };
  for (const e of edges) {
    const fa = ancestors(e.from);
    const ta = ancestors(e.to);
    const ts = new Set(ta);
    const fs = new Set(fa);
    for (const c of fa) if (!ts.has(c)) ports.push({ container: c, edge: e.id, side: side(graph, c, e.to), direction: 'out' });
    for (const c of ta) if (!fs.has(c)) ports.push({ container: c, edge: e.id, side: side(graph, c, e.from), direction: 'in' });
  }
  return { nodes, edges, ports };
}

/**
 * Which side of container `c` faces node `x`, from grid position: where their ancestor chains diverge, siblings
 * under a domain are rows (cells in layer order, tests last) → top/bottom; anywhere else (domain columns in map
 * order, or children inside a cell) → left/right by sibling order.
 */
export function side(graph: ContextGraph, c: string, x: string): Port['side'] {
  const pc = pathTo(graph, c);
  const px = pathTo(graph, x);
  let i = 0;
  while (i < pc.length && i < px.length && pc[i] === px[i]) i++;
  const a = pc[i];
  const b = px[i];
  if (!a || !b) return 'right'; // one contains the other: not a crossing
  const after = graph.nodes[b]!.order > graph.nodes[a]!.order;
  return graph.nodes[pc[i - 1]!]!.kind === 'domain' ? (after ? 'bottom' : 'top') : after ? 'right' : 'left';
}

// autoExpand (NAVIGATION_PLAN §1.3): Furnas degree of interest = a-priori importance − tree distance from focus.
import type { TurnActivity } from '../contracts/api';
import type { ContextGraph, LeafActivity } from '../contracts/graph';
import { byId, indexOf, pathTo } from './util';

/** A-priori importance of a leaf: cursor ≫ new violation > ghost/planned > edited > looked > existing violation > rest. */
export function importance(l: LeafActivity): number {
  if (l.cursor) return 100;
  if (l.violation === 'new') return 8;
  if (l.ghostSteps.length || l.planned) return 6;
  if (l.edited) return 5;
  if (l.looked) return 4;
  if (l.violation === 'existing') return 2;
  return 0;
}

/**
 * Containers to expand for a view of at most `budget` visible nodes. A container's importance is the max over
 * its leaves (plus files with a current violation); its interest is importance − tree distance to the anchor
 * (`focus`, else the agent cursor, else the root). Candidates are containers with some importance and the
 * anchor's ancestors-or-self; the most interesting visible candidate is expanded whenever its children still fit
 * the budget. Ties: interest, then shallower, then id. Symbols are never expanded. Returns ids in expansion order.
 */
export function autoExpand(graph: ContextGraph, activity: TurnActivity, focus: string | null, budget: number): string[] {
  const ix = indexOf(graph);
  const score = new Map<string, number>();
  const raise = (id: string, s: number) => {
    if (s <= 0) return;
    for (let n: string | null = id; n; n = graph.nodes[n]?.parent ?? null) {
      if ((score.get(n) ?? 0) >= s) break; // ancestors already carry at least this much
      score.set(n, s);
    }
  };
  for (const [id, l] of Object.entries(activity.leaves)) if (graph.nodes[id]) raise(id, importance(l));
  for (const f of activity.violations.files) if (graph.nodes[f]) raise(f, 2);

  const anchor = focus && graph.nodes[focus] ? focus : activity.cursor && graph.nodes[activity.cursor] ? activity.cursor : graph.root;
  const anchorPath = pathTo(graph, anchor);
  const onPath = new Set(anchorPath);
  const dist = (id: string) => {
    const p = pathTo(graph, id);
    let i = 0;
    while (i < p.length && i < anchorPath.length && p[i] === anchorPath[i]) i++;
    return p.length + anchorPath.length - 2 * i;
  };
  const interest = (id: string) => (score.get(id) ?? 0) - dist(id);

  const kids = (id: string) => graph.children[id] ?? [];
  let visible = kids(graph.root).length;
  if (visible > budget) return [];
  const cand: { id: string; interest: number; depth: number }[] = [];
  const offer = (id: string) => {
    const n = graph.nodes[id]!;
    if (n.kind === 'symbol' || !kids(id).length || (!score.has(id) && !onPath.has(id))) return;
    cand.push({ id, interest: interest(id), depth: ix.depth.get(id)! });
  };
  kids(graph.root).forEach(offer);
  const out: string[] = [];
  while (cand.length) {
    cand.sort((a, b) => b.interest - a.interest || a.depth - b.depth || byId(a.id, b.id));
    const { id } = cand.shift()!;
    const n = kids(id).length;
    if (visible + n > budget) continue;
    visible += n;
    out.push(id);
    kids(id).forEach(offer);
  }
  return out;
}

// Custom React Flow nodes. Each is memoized and reads only its own slice of the projection from the v2 store,
// plus the zoom bucket, so a zoom re-renders a node only when its level of detail changes.
import { memo } from 'react';
import { useStore as useFlow, type NodeProps } from '@xyflow/react';
import type { Rollup, VisibleNode } from '@harness/core/view';
import { useV2 } from './store';

export type Lod = 'far' | 'mid' | 'near';
export const lodOf = (zoom: number): Lod => (zoom < 0.42 ? 'far' : zoom < 0.82 ? 'mid' : 'near');
export const useLod = () => useFlow((s) => lodOf(s.transform[2]));

function stateClasses(r: Rollup, ghost: boolean) {
  const c: string[] = [];
  if (r.looked && !r.edited) c.push('is-looked');
  if (r.edited) c.push(r.unplanned ? 'is-unplanned' : 'is-edited');
  if (ghost) c.push('is-ghost');
  if (r.violation === 'existing') c.push('is-violation');
  if (r.violation === 'new') c.push('is-new-violation');
  if (r.cursor) c.push('is-cursor');
  return c.join(' ');
}

function Steps({ steps }: { steps: number[] }) {
  if (!steps.length) return null;
  return (
    <span className="v2-steps" aria-label={`Planned in step ${steps.join(', ')}`}>
      {steps.map((n) => <span key={n} className="v2-step">{n}</span>)}
    </span>
  );
}

function Diff({ r }: { r: Rollup }) {
  if (!r.edited) return null;
  return (
    <span className="v2-diff">
      <span className="plus">+{r.added}</span>
      <span className="minus">−{r.removed}</span>
    </span>
  );
}

function ViolationMark({ r }: { r: Rollup }) {
  if (r.violation === 'new') return <span className="v2-vmark is-new" title={r.newViolationFiles.join('\n')}>new</span>;
  if (r.violation === 'existing') return <span className="v2-vmark" title={r.violationFiles.join('\n')}>{r.violationFiles.length}</span>;
  return null;
}

const useNode = (id: string) => useV2((s) => s.nodes[id]) as VisibleNode | undefined;

export const FileNode = memo(function FileNode({ id }: NodeProps) {
  const n = useNode(id);
  const lod = useLod();
  const isNew = useV2((s) => !!s.planned[id]);
  if (!n) return null;
  const r = n.rollup;
  const ghost = r.ghostSteps.length > 0;
  return (
    <div className={`v2-file ${stateClasses(r, ghost)} ${isNew ? 'is-planned-new' : ''} lod-${lod}`}>
      {lod !== 'far' && <span className="v2-file-name">{n.label}</span>}
      {lod === 'near' && (
        <span className="v2-file-meta">
          <Diff r={r} />
          <Steps steps={r.ghostSteps} />
        </span>
      )}
      {lod !== 'far' && <ViolationMark r={r} />}
    </div>
  );
});

export const CellNode = memo(function CellNode({ id }: NodeProps) {
  const n = useNode(id);
  const lod = useLod();
  const preview = useV2((s) => s.preview[id]);
  if (!n) return null;
  const r = n.rollup;
  const ghost = r.ghostSteps.length > 0 && !r.edited;
  const names = preview ?? [];
  const shown = names.slice(0, 4);
  return (
    <div className={`v2-cell ${stateClasses(r, ghost)} lod-${lod}`}>
      {lod === 'far' ? (
        <span className="v2-cell-count is-big">{r.leaves}</span>
      ) : (
        <>
          <span className="v2-cell-files">
            {(lod === 'near' ? shown : shown.slice(0, 2)).map((f) => <span key={f} className="v2-cell-file">{f}</span>)}
            {names.length > (lod === 'near' ? 4 : 2) && <span className="v2-cell-more">+{names.length - (lod === 'near' ? 4 : 2)} more</span>}
          </span>
          <span className="v2-cell-foot">
            <span className="v2-cell-count">{r.leaves} {r.leaves === 1 ? 'file' : 'files'}</span>
            <Diff r={r} />
          </span>
        </>
      )}
      {ghost && <Steps steps={r.ghostSteps} />}
      <ViolationMark r={r} />
    </div>
  );
});

/** A compressed column's cell: no text, only the state it carries (fill, ghost dash, rule marks, count). */
export const SpineNode = memo(function SpineNode({ id }: NodeProps) {
  const n = useNode(id);
  if (!n) return null;
  const r = n.rollup;
  const ghost = r.ghostSteps.length > 0 && !r.edited;
  return (
    <div className={`v2-spine ${stateClasses(r, ghost)}`} title={`${n.label}: ${r.leaves} files`}>
      <span className="v2-spine-count">{r.leaves}</span>
      {ghost && <Steps steps={r.ghostSteps} />}
      <ViolationMark r={r} />
    </div>
  );
});

export const ContainerNode = memo(function ContainerNode({ id }: NodeProps) {
  const n = useNode(id);
  const lod = useLod();
  if (!n) return null;
  const r = n.rollup;
  return (
    <div className={`v2-container ${r.violation ? `has-${r.violation}` : ''} ${r.edited ? 'has-edits' : ''} lod-${lod}`}>
      <span className="v2-container-head">
        <span className="v2-container-name">{n.label}</span>
        <span className="v2-container-count">{r.leaves} {r.leaves === 1 ? 'file' : 'files'}</span>
        <Diff r={r} />
      </span>
    </div>
  );
});

/** The expanded domain's column: the next step down the depth lightness ramp. */
export const BandNode = memo(function BandNode({ id }: NodeProps) {
  const n = useNode(id);
  if (!n) return null;
  return <div className="v2-band"><span className="v2-band-name">{n.label}</span></div>;
});

export const nodeTypes = { file: FileNode, cell: CellNode, spine: SpineNode, container: ContainerNode, band: BandNode };

// trace (NAVIGATION_PLAN §2 "Wiring trace"): shortest call chains from a symbol, route or file to its sinks.
import type { ContextGraph } from '../contracts/graph';
import { EXTERNAL_LAYER } from './build';
import { byId, indexOf } from './util';

export const MAX_TRACE_PATHS = 5;

const adjacency = new WeakMap<ContextGraph, Map<string, { to: string; sinkOnly: boolean }[]>>();

/** calls and handles forward, implements from the interface member to each implementation, writes into tables. */
function adjacencyOf(g: ContextGraph) {
  let adj = adjacency.get(g);
  if (adj) return adj;
  adj = new Map();
  const link = (a: string, b: string, sinkOnly: boolean) => {
    const list = adj!.get(a) ?? adj!.set(a, []).get(a)!;
    if (!list.some((x) => x.to === b)) list.push({ to: b, sinkOnly });
  };
  for (const e of g.edges) {
    if (e.kind === 'calls' || e.kind === 'handles') link(e.from, e.to, false);
    else if (e.kind === 'implements') link(e.to, e.from, false);
    else if (e.kind === 'writes') link(e.from, e.to, true);
  }
  for (const list of adj.values()) list.sort((x, y) => byId(x.to, y.to));
  adjacency.set(g, adj);
  return adj;
}

/**
 * BFS over calls ∪ implements ∪ handles (plus writes into a table sink). Default sinks: vendor and table nodes,
 * and anything inside an `external` cell. Sinks end a chain. Returns at most MAX_TRACE_PATHS shortest chains
 * (one per sink, nearest first, ties by sink id), each starting at `from`. Dispatch through a registry shows up
 * as an interface member followed by an implementation (`implements` walked backwards).
 */
export function trace(graph: ContextGraph, from: string, sinks?: readonly string[]): string[][] {
  if (!graph.nodes[from]) return [];
  indexOf(graph);
  const adj = adjacencyOf(graph);
  const given = sinks ? new Set(sinks) : null;
  const isSink = (id: string) => {
    if (given) return given.has(id);
    const n = graph.nodes[id];
    return id.startsWith('vendor:') || id.startsWith('table:') || n?.layer === EXTERNAL_LAYER;
  };
  const parent = new Map<string, string | null>([[from, null]]);
  const found: string[] = [];
  let frontier = [from];
  while (frontier.length && found.length < MAX_TRACE_PATHS) {
    const next: string[] = [];
    const reached: string[] = [];
    for (const id of frontier) {
      for (const { to, sinkOnly } of adj.get(id) ?? []) {
        if (parent.has(to) || (sinkOnly && !isSink(to))) continue;
        parent.set(to, id);
        if (isSink(to)) reached.push(to);
        else next.push(to);
      }
    }
    found.push(...reached.sort(byId));
    frontier = next;
  }
  return found.slice(0, MAX_TRACE_PATHS).map((sink) => {
    const path: string[] = [];
    for (let n: string | null = sink; n !== null; n = parent.get(n) ?? null) path.push(n);
    return path.reverse();
  });
}

      ev('edited', { added: 1, removed: 0, created: false, unattributed: true }, { turn: 't3', path: 'src/memory/retrieve.ts', cell: { domain: 'memory', layer: 'logic' } }),
      ev('turn_ended', { added: 1, removed: 0, files: [], reason: 'success' }, { turn: 't3' }),
    ];
    expect(historyFromUI(reduce([...events, ...more]))).toEqual([
      { id: 't1', source: 'turn', files: ['src/outreach/draft-email.ts', 'src/tools/filing-summary.ts', 'src/tools/index.ts'] },
      { id: 't3', source: 'turn', files: ['src/memory/retrieve.ts'] },
    ]);
  });

  it('flags bulk units (more than 10 files and 30% of known files)', () => {
    const known = new Set(Object.keys(scoutFacts()));

    };

      .replace('name: Agent loop', 'name: Run loop')
      .replace('purpose: Store and retrieve notes about each company', 'purpose: Company memory')
      .replace('logic: { paths: ["src/memory/retrieve.ts", "src/memory/vector-index.ts"] }', 'logic: { paths: ["src/memory/retrieve.ts"] }\n      data:  { paths: ["src/memory/notes-store.ts", "src/memory/vector-index.ts"], tables: ["notes", "embeddings"] }\n      external: { paths: [] }')
      .replace(/      data:  \{ paths: \["src\/memory\/notes-store.ts"\], tables: \["notes", "embeddings"\] \}\n/, '')
      .replace('rule: Research tools never depend on outreach', 'rule: Research tools never import outreach')
      .replace(/  - id: DR-2[\s\S]*?source: cartographer\n\n/, ''));
    const changes = diffMaps(map, next, files);
    expect(changes).toEqual([
      { kind: 'rename_domain', domain: 'orchestrator', from: 'Agent loop', to: 'Run loop' },
      { kind: 'purpose', domain: 'memory', purpose: 'Company memory' },
      { kind: 'add_cell', domain: 'memory', layer: 'external' },
      { kind: 'move', path: 'src/memory/vector-index.ts', from: { domain: 'memory', layer: 'logic' }, to: { domain: 'memory', layer: 'data' } },
      { kind: 'retire_rule', invariant: 'DR-2' },
    ]);
    // rule text change is a change_rule; linking a decision or adding an exception is not
    const reworded = parseDomainMap(mapYaml.replace('rule: Research tools never depend on outreach', 'rule: Tools never import outreach').replace('allowed_from: [gateway]', 'allowed_from: [gateway]\n    decisions: [DR-4]'));
    expect(diffMaps(map, reworded, files)).toEqual([{ kind: 'change_rule', invariant: 'DR-3', rule: 'Tools never import outreach' }]);
    const removed = { ...map, domains: map.domains.filter((d) => d.id !== 'memory') };
    expect(diffMaps(map, removed, files)).toContainEqual({ kind: 'remove_domain', domain: 'memory' });
  });

  it('change signatures ignore order', () => {
    const c = diffMaps(map, billingMap(), files);
    expect(changeSignature([...c].reverse())).toBe(changeSignature(c));
    expect(changeSignature(c)).not.toBe(changeSignature(c.slice(1)));
  });
});

describe('instantGuess', () => {
  const facts = {
    ...billingFacts(),
    'src/memory/summarize.ts': ff('src/memory/summarize.ts', ['src/memory/retrieve.ts']),
    'src/glue/wire.ts': ff('src/glue/wire.ts', ['src/gateway/complete.ts', 'src/gateway/redact.ts', 'src/tools/index.ts']),
  };

  it('returns the existing cell for a placed file', () => {
    expect(instantGuess(map, facts, 'src/tools/news-summarize.ts')).toEqual({ domain: 'tools', layer: 'logic', basis: 'cell' });
  });
  it('uses the majority cell of folder siblings', () => {
    expect(instantGuess(map, facts, 'src/memory/summarize.ts')).toEqual({ domain: 'memory', layer: 'logic', basis: 'siblings' });
  });
  it('falls back to the majority domain of its import neighbours', () => {
    expect(instantGuess(map, facts, 'src/glue/wire.ts')).toEqual({ domain: 'gateway', layer: 'logic', basis: 'imports' });
  });
  it('names a new domain after a folder the map knows nothing about', () => {
    expect(instantGuess(map, facts, 'src/billing/invoice.ts')).toEqual({ domain: 'billing', layer: 'data', basis: 'folder' });
    expect(instantGuess(map, facts, 'src/billing/charge.ts')).toEqual({ domain: 'billing', layer: 'logic', basis: 'folder' });
  });
  it('returns null for neutral files', () => {
    expect(instantGuess(map, facts, 'src/shared/db.ts')).toBeNull();
  });
});

describe('skeletonMap', () => {
  const facts = scoutFacts();
  const files = [...Object.keys(facts), 'README.md', 'package.json'];

  it('builds one domain per top-level source folder with heuristic layers, owned tables and vendor cells', () => {
    const sk = skeletonMap(files, facts);
    expect(sk.domains.map((d) => d.id)).toEqual(['channels', 'gateway', 'memory', 'orchestrator', 'outreach', 'tools']);
    expect(sk.layers.map((l) => l.id)).toEqual(['entry', 'logic', 'data', 'external']);
    const m = createMapper(sk);
    // Same cells as the hand-made reference map for every placed source file.
    const ref = createMapper(map);
    for (const path of Object.keys(facts)) expect([path, m.place(path)]).toEqual([path, ref.place(path)]);
    expect(m.ownerOf('cost_log')).toEqual({ domain: 'gateway', layer: 'data' });
    expect(sk.domains.find((d) => d.id === 'tools')!.cells.logic!.paths).toEqual(['src/tools/**']);
    expect(sk.invariants).toEqual([]);
  });

  it('round-trips through domains.yaml text and is deterministic', () => {
    const sk = skeletonMap(files, facts);
    expect(parseDomainMap(mapToYaml(sk))).toEqual(sk);
    expect(skeletonMap([...files].reverse(), facts)).toEqual(sk);
  });

  it('puts a new folder in its own domain', () => {
    const bf = billingFacts();
    const sk = skeletonMap(Object.keys(bf), bf);
    const billing = sk.domains.find((d) => d.id === 'billing')!;
    expect(billing.cells.logic!.paths).toEqual(['src/billing/charge.ts']);
    expect(billing.cells.data).toEqual({ paths: ['src/billing/invoice.ts', 'src/billing/refund.ts'], tables: ['invoices'] });
  });

  it('layer heuristics', () => {
    expect(layerFor('src/api/routes.ts')).toBe('entry');
    expect(layerFor('src/x/user-store.ts')).toBe('data');
    expect(layerFor('vendor/stripe/index.ts')).toBe('external');
    expect(layerFor('src/x/stripe-client.ts')).toBe('external');
    expect(layerFor('src/x/catalog.ts')).toBe('logic');
  });
});

describe('billing yaml fixture', () => {
  it('parses', () => expect(parseDomainMap(billingYaml).domains.at(-1)!.id).toBe('billing'));
});
