```typescript
// Staged, interruptible transitions between two laid-out frames (NAVIGATION_PLAN §3.3):
//   0–150 ms   fade out edges that will change and nodes that will go
//   150–450 ms one commit, then FLIP the moved nodes with the Web Animations API; the camera flies in parallel
//   450–650 ms new nodes fade in and changed edges draw in (CSS, keyed on the commit)
// A new request at any point cancels the pending stage and starts from what is on screen.
import type { Frame } from './layout/grid';

export const reducedMotion = () => typeof matchMedia !== 'undefined' && matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)').matches;

export const T_FADE = 150;
export const T_MOVE = 300;
export const T_ENTER = 200;
const EASE = 'cubic-bezier(0.25, 0.8, 0.3, 1)';
const FADE_ID = 'v2-fade';

export type Enter = { nodes: Set<string>; edges: Set<string>; seq: number };
export type TransitionStats = { commitMs: number; commitToFrameMs: number; moved: number; entered: number; removed: number; animated: boolean };

export type TransitionHooks = {
  root(): HTMLElement | null;
  /** Must commit synchronously (flushSync): content and positions land in one React commit. */
  commit(next: Frame, enter: Enter): void;
  camera(next: Frame, prev: Frame | null, animate: boolean): void;
};

const sel = (attr: string, id: string) => `[${attr}="${CSS.escape(id)}"]`;

export class Transitioner {
  private timers: number[] = [];
  private seq = 0;
  shown: Frame | null = null;
  last: TransitionStats | null = null;
  onDone: ((s: TransitionStats) => void) | null = null;

  constructor(private hooks: TransitionHooks) {}

  cancel() {
    for (const t of this.timers) clearTimeout(t);
    this.timers = [];
    const root = this.hooks.root();
    if (!root) return;
    for (const a of root.getAnimations({ subtree: true })) {
      if (a.id === FADE_ID) a.cancel();
      else if (a instanceof CSSAnimation || a instanceof CSSTransition) continue;
      else a.finish();
    }
  }

  go(next: Frame) {
    this.cancel();
    const prev = this.shown;
    const root = this.hooks.root();
    const animate = !!prev && !!root && !reducedMotion();
    const prevEdges = new Map(prev?.edges.map((e) => [e.id, e.d]) ?? []);
    const nextEdges = new Map(next.edges.map((e) => [e.id, e.d]));
    const changedEdges = [...prevEdges].filter(([id, d]) => nextEdges.get(id) !== d).map(([id]) => id);
    const removed = prev ? prev.nodes.filter((n) => !next.boxes[n.id]).map((n) => n.id) : [];
    const enter: Enter = {
      nodes: new Set(prev ? next.nodes.filter((n) => !prev.boxes[n.id]).map((n) => n.id) : []),
      edges: new Set(prev ? next.edges.filter((e) => prevEdges.get(e.id) !== e.d).map((e) => e.id) : []),
      seq: ++this.seq,
    };

    if (animate && root) {
      for (const id of changedEdges) root.querySelector(sel('data-edge', id))?.animate([{ opacity: 1 }, { opacity: 0 }], { duration: T_FADE, fill: 'forwards', easing: 'ease-out', id: FADE_ID });
      for (const id of removed) root.querySelector(`.react-flow__node${sel('data-id', id)}`)?.animate([{ opacity: 1 }, { opacity: 0 }], { duration: T_FADE, fill: 'forwards', easing: 'ease-out', id: FADE_ID });
    }
    const run = () => this.commit(prev, next, enter, animate, removed.length);
    if (animate && (changedEdges.length || removed.length)) this.timers.push(window.setTimeout(run, T_FADE));
    else run();
  }

  private commit(prev: Frame | null, next: Frame, enter: Enter, animate: boolean, removed: number) {
    const root = this.hooks.root();
    if (root) for (const a of root.getAnimations({ subtree: true })) if (a.id === FADE_ID) a.cancel();
    const t0 = performance.now();
    this.hooks.commit(next, enter);
    const commitMs = performance.now() - t0;
    this.shown = next;

    let moved = 0;
    if (animate && prev && root) {
      for (const n of next.nodes) {
        const a = prev.boxes[n.id];
        if (!a) continue;
        const posChanged = Math.abs(a.x - n.x) > 0.5 || Math.abs(a.y - n.y) > 0.5;
        const sizeChanged = Math.abs(a.w - n.w) > 0.5 || Math.abs(a.h - n.h) > 0.5;
        if (!posChanged && !sizeChanged) continue;
        const el = root.querySelector<HTMLElement>(`.react-flow__node${sel('data-id', n.id)}`);
        if (!el) continue;
        moved++;
        const from: Keyframe = { transform: `translate(${a.x}px, ${a.y}px)` };
        const to: Keyframe = { transform: `translate(${n.x}px, ${n.y}px)` };
        if (sizeChanged) Object.assign(from, { width: `${a.w}px`, height: `${a.h}px` }), Object.assign(to, { width: `${n.w}px`, height: `${n.h}px` });
        el.animate([from, to], { duration: T_MOVE, easing: EASE });
      }
    }
    this.hooks.camera(next, prev, animate);
    const stats: TransitionStats = { commitMs, commitToFrameMs: 0, moved, entered: enter.nodes.size, removed, animated: animate };
    requestAnimationFrame(() => {
      stats.commitToFrameMs = performance.now() - t0;
      this.last = stats;
      const done = () => this.onDone?.(stats);
      if (animate) this.timers.push(window.setTimeout(done, T_MOVE + T_ENTER));
      else done();
    });
  }
}
```

```typescript
// THROWAWAY (N0 spike): a synthetic large Projection for performance measurement (`?map=v2&bench=500`).
// 6 domains × 4 layers; `n` files spread over the cells of the first three domains, ~1.5n import edges
// (mostly inside a cell, some across cells and domains), deterministic.
import { cellId, domainId, ROOT_ID, type Port, type VisibleEdge, type VisibleNode } from '@harness/core/view';
import type { GridSpec, Scene } from '../scene';
import { emptyRollup, mergeRollups } from './fakeProjection';

function rng(seed: number) {
  let s = seed >>> 0;
  return () => (s = (s * 1664525 + 1013904223) >>> 0) / 2 ** 32;
}

const DOMAINS = ['Channels', 'Agent loop', 'Research tools', 'Model gateway', 'Memory', 'Outreach'];
const LAYERS = ['Entry', 'Logic', 'Data', 'External'];

export function benchScene(n: number, expanded: readonly string[]): Scene {
  const grid: GridSpec = {
    domains: DOMAINS.map((name, i) => ({ id: `d${i}`, name, purpose: 'Synthetic' })),
    layers: LAYERS.map((name, i) => ({ id: `l${i}`, name })),
    cells: Object.fromEntries(DOMAINS.map((_, i) => [`d${i}`, LAYERS.map((__, j) => `l${j}`)])),
  };
  const r = rng(7);
  const files: { id: string; d: number; l: number }[] = [];
  for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) {
    const d = i % 3;
    const l = Math.floor(r() * 4);
    files.push({ id: `src/d${d}/l${l}/file-${String(i).padStart(4, '0')}.ts`, d, l });
  }
  // a few files in the other domains, so collapsed cells have counts
  for (let i = 0; i < 60; i++) files.push({ id: `src/d${3 + (i % 3)}/l${i % 4}/other-${i}.ts`, d: 3 + (i % 3), l: i % 4 });
  files.sort((a, b) => a.id.localeCompare(b.id));
  const open = (d: number) => expanded.includes(domainId(`d${d}`));

  const leafRollup = (i: number) => {
    const x = emptyRollup();
    x.leaves = 1;
    if (i % 11 === 0) { x.edited = true; x.added = 3 + (i % 17); x.removed = i % 5; }
    if (i % 13 === 0) x.looked = true;
    if (i % 29 === 0) x.ghostSteps = [1 + (i % 4)];
    if (i % 41 === 0) { x.violation = 'existing'; x.violationFiles = ['x']; }
    return x;
  };

  const nodes: VisibleNode[] = [];
  const byCell = new Map<string, { id: string; i: number }[]>();
  files.forEach((f, i) => {
    const k = cellId(`d${f.d}`, `l${f.l}`);
    byCell.set(k, [...(byCell.get(k) ?? []), { id: f.id, i }]);
  });
  const preview: Record<string, string[]> = {};
  grid.domains.forEach((dom, d) => {
    const cells: VisibleNode[] = [];
    const kids: VisibleNode[] = [];
    grid.layers.forEach((lay, l) => {
      const k = cellId(dom.id, lay.id);
      const list = byCell.get(k) ?? [];
      const rollups = list.map(({ i }) => leafRollup(i));
      cells.push({ id: k, kind: 'cell', parent: domainId(dom.id), label: lay.name, depth: 2, expanded: open(d) && list.length > 0, expandable: list.length > 0, order: l, domain: dom.id, layer: lay.id, rollup: mergeRollups(rollups) });
      if (open(d)) list.forEach(({ id }, j) => kids.push({ id, kind: 'file', parent: k, label: id.split('/').pop()!, depth: 3, expanded: false, expandable: false, order: j, domain: dom.id, layer: lay.id, path: id, rollup: rollups[j]! }));
      else preview[k] = list.slice(0, 6).map(({ id }) => id.split('/').pop()!);
    });
    nodes.push({ id: domainId(dom.id), kind: 'domain', parent: ROOT_ID, label: dom.name, depth: 1, expanded: open(d), expandable: true, order: d, domain: dom.id, rollup: mergeRollups(cells.map((c) => c.rollup)) }, ...cells, ...kids);
  });

  const where = new Map(files.map((f) => [f.id, f]));
  const vis = (id: string) => {
    const f = where.get(id)!;
    return open(f.d) ? id : cellId(`d${f.d}`, `l${f.l}`);
  };
  const agg = new Map<string, VisibleEdge>();
  const er = rng(11);
  const domainFiles = (d: number) => files.filter((f) => f.d === d);
  for (let k = 0; k < Math.round(n * 1.5); k++) {
    const a = files[Math.floor(er() * n * 0.98)]!;
    let b: (typeof files)[number];
    const roll = er();
    if (roll < 0.8) {
      const same = files.filter((f) => f.d === a.d && f.l === a.l); // inside the cell
      b = same[Math.floor(er() * same.length)]!;
    } else if (roll < 0.93) {
      const same = domainFiles(a.d);
      b = same[Math.floor(er() * same.length)]!;
    } else b = files[Math.floor(er() * files.length)]!;
    if (a.id === b.id || a.id > b.id) continue; // acyclic-ish: imports point "down" the sort order
    const from = vis(a.id);
    const to = vis(b.id);
    if (from === to) continue;
    if (a.d === b.d && !open(a.d)) continue;
    const id = `existing|${from}|${to}`;
    const e = agg.get(id) ?? { id, from, to, kinds: ['imports'], count: 0, status: 'existing', violation: null, confidence: null, steps: [], leafEdges: [] };
    e.count++;
    agg.set(id, e);
  }
  const edges = [...agg.values()].sort((x, y) => x.id.localeCompare(y.id));
  const byId = new Map(nodes.map((x) => [x.id, x]));
  const ports: Port[] = [];
  const di = (id: string) => Number(id.slice(1));
  for (const e of edges) {
    for (const [self, other, direction] of [[e.from, e.to, 'out'], [e.to, e.from, 'in']] as const) {
      const s = byId.get(self)!;
      const o = byId.get(other)!;
      if (s.kind !== 'file' || s.parent === (o.kind === 'file' ? o.parent : o.id)) continue;
      const dd = di(o.domain!) - di(s.domain!);
      const dl = Number(o.layer!.slice(1)) - Number(s.layer!.slice(1));
      ports.push({ container: s.parent!, edge: e.id, side: dd > 0 ? 'right' : dd < 0 ? 'left' : dl > 0 ? 'bottom' : 'top', direction });
    }
  }
  return { grid, projection: { nodes, edges, ports }, cursor: null, preview, planned: [] };
}

/** One container of `n` files with ~1.5n internal edges, for timing ELK on a big cell. */
export function bigCell(n: number) {
  const r = rng(3);
  const children = Array.from({ length: n }, (_, i) => `f${String(i).padStart(4, '0')}`);
  const edges: { id: string; from: string; to: string }[] = [];
  for (let k = 0; k < Math.round(n * 1.5); k++) {
    const a = Math.floor(r() * n);
    const b = Math.floor(r() * n);
    if (a < b) edges.push({ id: `e${k}`, from: children[a]!, to: children[b]! });
  }
  return { id: `cell:big/${n}`, children, edges, ports: [] };
}
```

```typescript
// Parity (NAVIGATION_PLAN §3.2, N2): project() agrees with today's cellViews/edgeViews on every prefix of the log.
//
// Today's views are cell granularity (domain × layer); the projection's root children are domains. So parity is
// defined at "domains expanded one level": view.expanded = every domain id, lens.kinds = ['imports'].
// - Cells: each visible `cell:` node's rollup equals the cellView (looked, edited, added, removed, ghost steps,
//   unplanned, violation, violationFiles, newViolationFiles) and the two sets of cells are identical.
// - Edges: the visible cell→cell edges whose cells are in different domains, grouped by domain pair, equal
//   edgeViews: the same solid pairs with the same state (new/existing), violation flag and file imports, and the same
//   ghost pairs with the same violation flag, steps and planned imports (ghosts never merge with solid edges).
import { describe, expect, it } from 'vitest';
import { cellKey, cellViews, edgeViews, reduce, type HarnessEvent, type UIState } from '../src/events';
import { activityFor, graphOf, project } from '../src/graph';
import { domainId, type Projection, type ViewState } from '../src/contracts/graph';
import type { Violation } from '../src/rules';
import { demoLog } from './turn-log';

/** A second turn exercising tests, unassigned and neutral files, an unplanned file inside a planned cell, an unplanned
 *  cell, a gate block on a file that already violates another rule, and an edge added and one removed. */
function secondTurn(): HarnessEvent[] {
  let n = 0;
  const ev = (kind: HarnessEvent['kind'], data: Record<string, unknown>, extra: Partial<HarnessEvent> = {}): HarnessEvent =>
    ({ id: `t2-${n}`, t: 2000 + n++, session: 's1', turn: 't2', kind, data, ...extra });
  const block: Violation = {
    invariant: 'DR-3', kind: 'no_edge', reason: 'tools never depend on outreach', file: 'src/tools/news-summarize.ts',
    detail: '', options: ['A', 'B'], target: 'src/outreach/send.ts',
  };
  return [
    ev('turn_started', { prompt: 'memory tweaks', head: '', baseline: '' }),
    ev('looked', { tool: 'Read' }, { path: 'src/shared/db.ts' }),
    ev('planned', {
      steps: [{ n: 1, text: 'retrieve', files: ['src/memory/retrieve.ts'], imports: [{ from: 'src/memory/retrieve.ts', to: 'src/outreach/send.ts' }] }],
      cells: [{ domain: 'memory', layer: 'logic', steps: [1], files: ['src/memory/retrieve.ts'] }],
      edges: [{ from: 'memory', to: 'outreach', steps: [1], imports: [{ from: 'src/memory/retrieve.ts', to: 'src/outreach/send.ts' }] }],
      unassigned: [],
    }),
    ev('edited', { added: 4, removed: 2, created: false }, { path: 'src/memory/vector-index.ts', cell: { domain: 'memory', layer: 'logic' } }),
    ev('edited', { added: 5, removed: 0, created: false }, { path: 'test/memory/retrieve.test.ts' }),
    ev('edited', { added: 7, removed: 0, created: true }, { path: 'src/misc/foo.ts' }),
    ev('gate_blocked', { violation: block, tool: 'Edit' }, { path: block.file }),
    ev('edited', { added: 1, removed: 1, created: false }, { path: 'src/gateway/redact.ts', cell: { domain: 'gateway', layer: 'logic' } }),
    ev('edited', { added: 2, removed: 0, created: false }, { path: 'src/memory/retrieve.ts', cell: { domain: 'memory', layer: 'logic' } }),
    ev('edge_added', { edge: { from: 'src/memory/retrieve.ts', to: 'src/outreach/send.ts' }, from: 'memory', to: 'outreach' }, { path: 'src/memory/retrieve.ts' }),
    ev('edge_removed', { edge: { from: 'src/tools/company-profile.ts', to: 'src/gateway/complete.ts' }, from: 'tools', to: 'gateway' }),
    ev('turn_ended', { added: 19, removed: 3, files: [], reason: 'success' }),
  ];
}

const parityView = (ui: UIState): ViewState => ({
  expanded: ui.map!.domains.map((d) => domainId(d.id)),
  focus: null,
  lens: { kinds: ['imports'], turnOnly: false },
  budget: 50,
  follow: false,
});

const sorted = <T>(xs: T[]) => [...xs].sort();

function cellsOf(p: Projection) {
  const out: Record<string, unknown> = {};
  for (const n of p.nodes) {
    if (n.kind !== 'cell') continue;
    const r = n.rollup;
    out[`${n.domain}/${n.layer}`] = {
      looked: r.looked, edited: r.edited, added: r.added, removed: r.removed, ghost: r.ghostSteps, unplanned: r.unplanned,
      violation: r.violation, violationFiles: r.violationFiles, newViolationFiles: r.newViolationFiles,
    };
  }
  return out;
}

function domainEdgesOf(p: Projection) {
  const byId = new Map(p.nodes.map((n) => [n.id, n]));
  const out = new Map<string, { from: string; to: string; state: string; violation: boolean; steps: number[]; files: string[] }>();
  for (const e of p.edges) {
    const a = byId.get(e.from)!;
    const b = byId.get(e.to)!;
    if (a.kind !== 'cell' || b.kind !== 'cell' || a.domain === b.domain) continue;
    const ghost = e.status === 'ghost';
    const k = `${ghost ? 'ghost' : 'solid'}:${a.domain}->${b.domain}`;
    const cur = out.get(k) ?? { from: a.domain!, to: b.domain!, state: ghost ? 'ghost' : 'existing', violation: false, steps: [], files: [] };
    if (e.status === 'new') cur.state = 'new';
    cur.violation ||= e.violation !== null;
    cur.steps = sorted([...new Set([...cur.steps, ...e.steps])]);
    cur.files.push(...e.leafEdges.map((id) => id.split('|').slice(1).join(' -> ')));
    out.set(k, cur);
  }
  return [...out.entries()].sort(([a], [b]) => a.localeCompare(b)).map(([, v]) => ({ ...v, files: sorted(v.files) }));
}

function expectParity(ui: UIState, turnId?: string | null) {
  const graph = graphOf(ui)!;
  const p = project(graph, parityView(ui), activityFor(ui, graph, turnId));

  const cv = cellViews(ui, turnId);
  const want: Record<string, unknown> = {};
  for (const [k, v] of Object.entries(cv)) {
    want[k] = {
      looked: v.looked, edited: v.edited, added: v.added, removed: v.removed, ghost: v.ghost ?? [], unplanned: v.unplanned,
      violation: v.violation, violationFiles: sorted(v.violationFiles), newViolationFiles: sorted(v.newViolationFiles),
    };
  }
  expect(cellsOf(p)).toEqual(want);

  const ev = edgeViews(ui, turnId)
    .map((e) => ({
      key: `${e.state === 'ghost' ? 'ghost' : 'solid'}:${e.from}->${e.to}`,
      v: { from: e.from, to: e.to, state: e.state, violation: e.violation, steps: sorted(e.steps), files: sorted(e.files.map((f) => `${f.from} -> ${f.to}`)) },
    }))
    .sort((a, b) => a.key.localeCompare(b.key))
    .map((x) => x.v);
  expect(domainEdgesOf(p)).toEqual(ev);
}

describe('parity: project() at domains-expanded == cellViews/edgeViews', () => {
  const { events } = demoLog();
  const full = [...events, ...secondTurn()];

  it('holds on every prefix of the demo log', () => {
    let checked = 0;
    for (let i = 0; i <= events.length; i++) {
      const ui = reduce(events, i);
      if (!ui.map) continue;
      expectParity(ui);
      checked++;
    }
    expect(checked).toBe(events.length);
  });

  it('holds on every prefix of the demo log plus a second turn, for each selected turn', () => {
    for (let i = 1; i <= full.length; i++) {
      const ui = reduce(full, i);
      if (!ui.map) continue;
      expectParity(ui);
      for (const t of ui.turns) expectParity(ui, t.id);
      expectParity(ui, null);
    }
  });

  it('is not vacuous: the demo states show up in the projection', () => {
    const forkAsked = events.findIndex((e) => e.kind === 'fork_asked');
    const mid = reduce(events, forkAsked + 1);
    const g = graphOf(mid)!;
    const p = project(g, parityView(mid), activityFor(mid, g));
    const tools = p.nodes.find((n) => n.id === 'cell:tools/logic')!.rollup;
    expect(tools).toMatchObject({ ghostSteps: [1, 2], violation: 'new', newViolationFiles: ['src/tools/filing-summary.ts'], violationFiles: ['src/tools/news-summarize.ts'] });
    expect(p.edges.filter((e) => e.status === 'ghost').map((e) => [e.from, e.to, e.violation])).toEqual([['cell:tools/logic', 'cell:gateway/external', 'new']]);

    const end = reduce(full);
    const g2 = graphOf(end)!;
    const p2 = project(g2, parityView(end), activityFor(end, g2));
    const cells = cellsOf(p2) as Record<string, { unplanned: boolean; edited: boolean; violation: string | null; newViolationFiles: string[]; violationFiles: string[] }>;
    expect(cells['memory/logic']).toMatchObject({ edited: true, unplanned: false });
    expect(cells['gateway/logic']).toMatchObject({ edited: true, unplanned: true });
    expect(cells['tools/logic']).toMatchObject({ violation: 'new', violationFiles: ['src/tools/news-summarize.ts'], newViolationFiles: ['src/tools/news-summarize.ts'] });
    expect(p2.edges.some((e) => e.from === 'cell:memory/logic' && e.to === 'cell:outreach/logic' && e.status === 'new')).toBe(true);
    // Outside cells: the test edit sits on tests:memory, the unassigned file on `unassigned`, nothing on neutral.
    const byId = new Map(p2.nodes.map((n) => [n.id, n.rollup]));
    expect(byId.get('tests:memory')).toMatchObject({ edited: true, added: 5 });
    expect(byId.get('unassigned')).toMatchObject({ edited: true, added: 7, unplanned: true });
    expect(byId.get('neutral')).toMatchObject({ looked: true, edited: false });
    expect(cellKey({ domain: 'memory', layer: 'logic' })).toBe('memory/logic');
  });
});
```

```typescript
import { describe, expect, it } from 'vitest';
import { detectDrift, thresholdsFor, topFolder, groupHash, cellFiles, labelHash } from '../src/cartography';
import { DEFAULT_THRESHOLDS, type DriftSignal, type DriftThresholds, type HistoryTurn, type Label } from '../src/contracts/cartography';

import { parseDomainMap } from '../src/schema';
import { initialState, reduce, type HarnessEvent, type UIState } from '../src/events';
import { scoutFacts } from './scout-facts';
import { loadMap, mapYaml } from './helpers';
import { BILLING, billingFacts, billingMap, ev, ff } from './cartography-fixtures';

const map = loadMap();
const T = (o: Partial<DriftThresholds> = {}): DriftThresholds => ({ ...DEFAULT_THRESHOLDS, ...o });
const h = (id: string, files: string[], source: HistoryTurn['source'] = 'turn'): HistoryTurn => ({ id, source, files });
const only = (signals: DriftSignal[], kind: DriftSignal['signal']) => signals.filter((s) => s.signal === kind);
const ui0 = initialState();

describe('thresholds', () => {
  it('merges cartography.thresholds over the defaults, ignoring unknown keys', () => {
    const m = parseDomainMap(`${mapYaml}\ncartography:\n  thresholds: { wideTurnsMedian: 4, persist: 3, bogus: 1 }\n`);
    expect(thresholdsFor(m)).toEqual({ ...DEFAULT_THRESHOLDS, wideTurnsMedian: 4, persist: 3 });
    expect(thresholdsFor(null)).toEqual(DEFAULT_THRESHOLDS);
  });
  it('top-level folders', () => {
    expect(topFolder('src/billing/invoice.ts')).toBe('src/billing');
    expect(topFolder('packages/core/src/x.ts')).toBe('packages/core');
    expect(topFolder('vendor/news/index.ts')).toBe('vendor');
    expect(topFolder('index.ts')).toBeNull();
  });
});

describe('detectDrift', () => {
  it('is quiet on the confirmed Scout map', () => {
    expect(detectDrift(map, scoutFacts(), ui0, [], T())).toEqual([]);
  });

  it('unplaced code and new top-level folders, persisted across surveys while the scope overlaps', () => {
    const facts = billingFacts();
    const first = detectDrift(map, facts, ui0, [], T());
    expect(only(first, 'unassigned')).toEqual([{ signal: 'unassigned', metric: 'files in Unassigned under src/billing/', value: 3, threshold: 0, scope: BILLING, persisted: 1 }]);
    expect(only(first, 'new_top_level')).toEqual([{ signal: 'new_top_level', metric: 'new top-level folder src/billing/ (no file on the map)', value: 3, threshold: 0, scope: BILLING, persisted: 1 }]);
    const second = detectDrift(map, facts, ui0, [], T(), first);
    expect(only(second, 'unassigned')[0]!.persisted).toBe(2);
    // one more file in the folder: the scope overlaps, so the count carries on
    const third = detectDrift(map, { ...facts, 'src/billing/tax.ts': ff('src/billing/tax.ts') }, ui0, [], T(), second);
    expect(only(third, 'unassigned')[0]).toMatchObject({ value: 4, persisted: 3 });
    // a different folder starts at 1
    const other = detectDrift(map, { ...scoutFacts(), 'src/search/x.ts': ff('src/search/x.ts') }, ui0, [], T(), third);
    expect(only(other, 'unassigned')[0]).toMatchObject({ scope: ['src/search/x.ts'], persisted: 1 });
    // placed by the map: gone
    expect(detectDrift(billingMap(), facts, ui0, [], T(), third)).toEqual([]);
  });

  it('turns too wide: median cells lit over the last N turns, needing 3 turns', () => {
    const wide = ['src/channels/routes.ts', 'src/orchestrator/agent.ts', 'src/tools/index.ts', 'src/gateway/complete.ts']; // 4 cells
    const facts = scoutFacts();
    expect(only(detectDrift(map, facts, ui0, [h('t1', wide), h('t2', wide)], T()), 'wide_turns')).toEqual([]);
    const hist = [h('c1', ['src/tools/index.ts'], 'commit'), h('t1', wide), h('t2', wide), h('t3', ['src/tools/index.ts']), h('t4', wide)];
    expect(only(detectDrift(map, facts, ui0, hist, T()), 'wide_turns')).toEqual([{
      signal: 'wide_turns', metric: 'median cells lit per turn (last 10)', value: 4, threshold: 3, persisted: 1,
      scope: ['domain:channels', 'domain:gateway', 'domain:orchestrator', 'domain:tools'],
    }]);
    // window of 2: the last two turns are 1 and 4 → median 2.5
    expect(only(detectDrift(map, facts, ui0, hist, T({ wideTurnsWindow: 2 })), 'wide_turns')).toEqual([]);
  });

  it('co-change across a boundary: pairs in different domains together in >= 3 of the last 20 units', () => {
    const pair = ['src/tools/news-summarize.ts', 'src/gateway/complete.ts'];
    const same = ['src/tools/news-summarize.ts', 'src/tools/index.ts']; // same domain: never a signal
    const hist = [h('c1', pair, 'commit'), h('t1', [...pair, 'README.md']), h('c2', same, 'commit'), h('c3', same, 'commit'), h('c4', same, 'commit')];
    expect(only(detectDrift(map, scoutFacts(), ui0, hist, T()), 'co_change')).toEqual([]);
    const sigs = only(detectDrift(map, scoutFacts(), ui0, [...hist, h('t2', pair)], T()), 'co_change');
    expect(sigs).toEqual([{
      signal: 'co_change', metric: 'src/gateway/complete.ts and src/tools/news-summarize.ts changed together (last 20 turns or commits)',
      value: 3, threshold: 3, scope: ['src/gateway/complete.ts', 'src/tools/news-summarize.ts'], persisted: 1,
    }]);
    // outside the window
    expect(only(detectDrift(map, scoutFacts(), ui0, [...hist, h('t2', pair)], T({ coChangeWindow: 3 })), 'co_change')).toEqual([]);
  });

  it('coupling growth: importing files per domain pair added by turns since the map was confirmed', () => {
    const facts = { ...scoutFacts(), 'src/tools/filing-summary.ts': ff('src/tools/filing-summary.ts', ['src/gateway/complete.ts']) };
    const edge = { from: 'src/tools/filing-summary.ts', to: 'src/gateway/complete.ts' };
    const ui = reduce([
      ev('turn_started', { prompt: 'p', head: '', baseline: '' }, { turn: 't1' }),
      ev('edge_added', { edge, from: 'tools', to: 'gateway' }, { turn: 't1' }),
      ev('turn_ended', { added: 1, removed: 0, files: [], reason: 'success' }, { turn: 't1' }),
    ]);
    const mapper = createMapper(map);
    const before = Object.values(facts).filter((f) => mapper.domainOf(f.path) === 'tools' && f.imports.some((i) => mapper.domainOf(i.to) === 'gateway')).length - 1;
    expect(only(detectDrift(map, facts, ui, [], T({ couplingGrowthFiles: 1 })), 'coupling_growth')).toEqual([{
      signal: 'coupling_growth', metric: 'files importing tools → gateway added since the map was confirmed', value: 1, threshold: 1,
      scope: ['domain:tools', 'domain:gateway'], persisted: 1,
    }]);
    expect(only(detectDrift(map, facts, ui, [], T({ couplingGrowthRatio: 1 / before })), 'coupling_growth')[0]).toMatchObject({ value: Math.round((1 / before) * 1000) / 1000 });
    expect(only(detectDrift(map, facts, ui, [], T({ couplingGrowthRatio: 1 / before + 0.01 })), 'coupling_growth')).toEqual([]);
    // the edge was removed again: no growth
    expect(only(detectDrift(map, scoutFacts(), ui, [], T({ couplingGrowthFiles: 1 })), 'coupling_growth')).toEqual([]);
  });

  it('rule erosion (exceptions or B answers) and reinforcement (A answers in one domain)', () => {
    const eroded = parseDomainMap(mapYaml.replace(/(kind: only_via[\s\S]*?)exceptions: \[\]/, '$1exceptions: ["src/a.ts", "src/b.ts", "src/c.ts"]'));
    expect(only(detectDrift(eroded, scoutFacts(), ui0, [], T()), 'rule_erosion')).toEqual([
      { signal: 'rule_erosion', metric: 'exceptions to DR-1', value: 3, threshold: 3, scope: ['rule:DR-1'], persisted: 1 },
    ]);
    const decide = (id: string, option: 'A' | 'B', paths: string[], invariant = 'DR-1'): HarnessEvent =>
      ev('decision_recorded', { id, title: id, invariant, option, paths });
    const ui = reduce([
      decide('DR-4', 'B', ['src/tools/a.ts']), decide('DR-5', 'B', ['src/tools/b.ts']), decide('DR-5', 'B', ['src/tools/b.ts']), // re-emitted: counted once
      decide('DR-6', 'A', ['src/tools/c.ts'], 'DR-3'), decide('DR-7', 'A', ['src/tools/d.ts'], 'DR-3'), decide('DR-8', 'A', ['src/memory/retrieve.ts'], 'DR-3'),
    ]);
    const sigs = detectDrift(map, scoutFacts(), ui, [], T());
    expect(only(sigs, 'rule_erosion')).toEqual([{ signal: 'rule_erosion', metric: 'option B (exception) chosen for DR-1', value: 2, threshold: 2, scope: ['rule:DR-1'], persisted: 1 }]);
    expect(only(sigs, 'rule_reinforcement')).toEqual([]); // 2 in tools, 1 in memory
    const ui2 = reduce([...[6, 7, 9].map((n) => decide(`DR-${n}`, 'A', [`src/tools/x${n}.ts`], 'DR-3'))]);
    expect(only(detectDrift(map, scoutFacts(), ui2, [], T()), 'rule_reinforcement')).toEqual([
      { signal: 'rule_reinforcement', metric: 'option A chosen for DR-3 in tools', value: 3, threshold: 3, scope: ['rule:DR-3', 'domain:tools'], persisted: 1 },
    ]);
  });

  it('bloated cells: over N files, or over a share of the domain above N/2 files', () => {
    expect(only(detectDrift(map, scoutFacts(), ui0, [], T({ bloatedCellFiles: 4 })), 'bloated_cell')).toEqual([
      { signal: 'bloated_cell', metric: 'files in gateway/logic', value: 4 + 0, threshold: 4, scope: ['cell:gateway/logic'], persisted: 1 },
      { signal: 'bloated_cell', metric: 'files in tools/logic', value: 5, threshold: 4, scope: ['cell:tools/logic'], persisted: 1 },
    ].filter((s) => s.value > 4));
    // share rule: tools/logic is 5 of 9 tools files (56% > 40%) and above 8/2 = 4 files
    expect(only(detectDrift(map, scoutFacts(), ui0, [], T({ bloatedCellFiles: 8 })), 'bloated_cell')).toEqual([
      { signal: 'bloated_cell', metric: "share of tools's files in logic", value: 0.556, threshold: 0.4, scope: ['cell:tools/logic'], persisted: 1 },
    ]);
  });

  it('stale labels: a summary whose symbol body changed, a group whose cell membership changed', () => {
    const facts = scoutFacts();
    const mapper = createMapper(map);
    const tools = cellFiles(mapper, facts, 'tools', 'logic');
    const labels: Label[] = [
      { target: 'src/gateway/complete.ts#complete', kind: 'summary', text: 'Calls a model', hash: 'body:src/gateway/complete.ts#complete', confirmed: false },
      { target: 'src/gateway/redact.ts#redact', kind: 'summary', text: 'Redacts', hash: 'old', confirmed: false },
      { target: 'src/tools/index.ts', kind: 'group', text: 'Registry', hash: groupHash(tools), confirmed: false },
    ];
    const ui: UIState = reduce([ev('labels_updated', { labels })]);
    expect(labelHash(mapper, facts, labels[0]!)).toBe(labels[0]!.hash);
    expect(only(detectDrift(map, facts, ui, [], T()), 'stale_label')).toEqual([
      { signal: 'stale_label', metric: 'labels whose target changed', value: 1, threshold: 0, scope: ['src/gateway/redact.ts#redact'], persisted: 1 },
    ]);
    // a new file joins tools/logic: the group label goes stale too
    const more = { ...facts, 'src/tools/filing.ts': ff('src/tools/filing.ts') };
    expect(only(detectDrift(map, more, ui, [], T()), 'stale_label')[0]!.scope).toEqual(['src/gateway/redact.ts#redact', 'src/tools/index.ts']);
  });

  it('is deterministic and ordered by kind, then scope', () => {
    const facts = billingFacts();
    const hist = [h('t1', [...BILLING, 'src/tools/index.ts', 'src/gateway/complete.ts', 'src/memory/retrieve.ts']), h('t2', [...BILLING, 'src/tools/index.ts', 'src/gateway/complete.ts', 'src/memory/retrieve.ts']), h('t3', [...BILLING, 'src/tools/index.ts', 'src/gateway/complete.ts', 'src/memory/retrieve.ts'])];
    const a = detectDrift(map, facts, ui0, hist, T());
    expect(a.map((s) => s.signal)).toEqual(['unassigned', 'new_top_level', 'wide_turns', 'co_change', 'co_change', 'co_change']);
    expect(detectDrift(map, Object.fromEntries(Object.entries(facts).reverse()), ui0, hist, T())).toEqual(a);
  });
});
```

```typescript
// N0 spike renderer: React Flow viewport + DOM nodes, one SVG edge layer of precomputed paths, ELK per container
// in a worker, staged FLIP transitions and a van Wijk camera (React Flow's d3-zoom transition with interpolateZoom).
import { memo, useCallback, useEffect, useLayoutEffect, useMemo, useRef, useState } from 'react';
import { flushSync } from 'react-dom';
import { ReactFlow, ReactFlowProvider, ViewportPortal, useReactFlow, useStoreApi, type Node, type Viewport } from '@xyflow/react';
import '@xyflow/react/dist/base.css';
import './v2.css';
import { domainId } from '@harness/core/view';
import { useView } from '../derive';
import { useStore } from '../store';
import { containerInputs, buildFrame, union, type Frame } from './layout/grid';
import { layoutContainer, type Box, type ContainerLayout } from './layout/containers';
import { nodeTypes, useLod } from './nodes';
import { fakeScene } from './spike/fakeProjection';
import { benchScene, bigCell } from './spike/benchScene';
import { useV2 } from './store';
import { Transitioner, reducedMotion, T_FADE, T_MOVE, type Enter, type TransitionStats } from './transition';
import type { Scene } from './scene';

const params = new URLSearchParams(location.search);
const BENCH = Number(params.get('bench') ?? 0);
export const COMP = params.has('comp');

export type Insets = { top: number; right: number; bottom: number; left: number };
const DEFAULT_INSETS: Insets = { top: 64, right: 28, bottom: 28, left: 92 };

type Shown = { frame: Frame; enter: Enter };
type Stats = { layoutMs: number; elk: { id: string; files: number; ms: number }[]; transition: TransitionStats | null };

export default function MapV2({ insets = DEFAULT_INSETS }: { insets?: Insets }) {
  return (
    <ReactFlowProvider>
      <Inner insets={insets} />
    </ReactFlowProvider>
  );
}

function useScene(): Scene | null {
  const v = useView();
  const expanded = useV2((s) => s.expanded);
  return useMemo(() => (BENCH ? benchScene(BENCH, expanded) : fakeScene(v.ui, v.turn, expanded)), [v.ui, v.turn, expanded]);
}

function viewportFor(b: Box, W: number, H: number, ins: Insets, maxZoom = 1.3): Viewport {
  const aw = Math.max(50, W - ins.left - ins.right);
  const ah = Math.max(50, H - ins.top - ins.bottom);
  const zoom = Math.max(0.08, Math.min(maxZoom, aw / b.w, ah / b.h));
  return { zoom, x: ins.left + (aw - b.w * zoom) / 2 - b.x * zoom, y: ins.top + (ah - b.h * zoom) / 2 - b.y * zoom };
}

function Inner({ insets }: { insets: Insets }) {
  const scene = useScene();
  const rf = useReactFlow();
  const rootRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
  const [shown, setShown] = useState<Shown | null>(null);
  const stats = useRef<Stats>({ layoutMs: 0, elk: [], transition: null });
  const insetsRef = useRef(insets);
  insetsRef.current = insets;

  const camera = useCallback((next: Frame, prev: Frame | null, animate: boolean) => {
    if (prev && prev.key === next.key) return; // the camera moves only when the view changes, not on every event
    const el = rootRef.current;
    if (!el) return;
    const { width: W, height: H } = el.getBoundingClientRect();
    let vp = viewportFor(next.bounds, W, H, insetsRef.current);
    if (next.focus && vp.zoom < 0.62) vp = viewportFor(union(next.focus, { ...next.focus, x: next.focus.x - 120, w: next.focus.w + 240 }), W, H, insetsRef.current);
    void rf.setViewport(vp, { duration: animate ? T_MOVE : 0, interpolate: 'smooth' });
  }, [rf]);

  const tr = useMemo(() => new Transitioner({
    root: () => rootRef.current,
    commit: (frame, enter) => flushSync(() => {
      useV2.getState().publish(frame.scene);
      setShown({ frame, enter });
    }),
    camera,
  }), [camera]);

  // Lay out every expanded container (worker, cached), then hand the frame to the transitioner.
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!scene) return;
    let live = true;
    const key = useV2.getState().expanded.join(',');
    const t0 = performance.now();
    void Promise.all(containerInputs(scene).map(layoutContainer)).then((ls: ContainerLayout[]) => {
      if (!live) return;
      stats.current.layoutMs = performance.now() - t0;
      stats.current.elk = ls.map((l) => ({ id: l.id, files: Object.keys(l.nodes).length, ms: +l.ms.toFixed(1) }));
      tr.go(buildFrame(scene, new Map(ls.map((l) => [l.id, l])), key));
    });
    return () => { live = false; };
  }, [scene, tr]);

  useEffect(() => () => tr.cancel(), [tr]);

  // Keyboard: Esc collapses the last expanded domain; Enter on a focused header expands it (see Headers).
  useEffect(() => {
    const onKey = (e: KeyboardEvent) => {
      if (e.key !== 'Escape' || (e.target as HTMLElement | null)?.closest('textarea, input')) return;
      const ex = useV2.getState().expanded;
      if (ex.length) useV2.getState().setExpanded(ex.slice(0, -1));
    };
    window.addEventListener('keydown', onKey);
    return () => window.removeEventListener('keydown', onKey);
  }, []);

  useBenchApi(tr, stats, rf);

  const rfNodes = useMemo<Node[]>(() => {
    if (!shown) return [];
    const { frame, enter } = shown;
    return frame.nodes.map((n) => ({
      id: n.id,
      type: n.type,
      position: { x: n.x, y: n.y },
      data: {},
      width: n.w,
      height: n.h,
      style: { width: n.w, height: n.h },
      zIndex: n.z,
      draggable: false,
      selectable: false,
      connectable: false,
      focusable: n.type !== 'band',
      className: enter.nodes.has(n.id) ? 'v2-enter' : undefined,
    }));
  }, [shown]);

  const toggle = useV2((s) => s.toggle);
  const onNodeDoubleClick = useCallback((_: unknown, node: Node) => {
    const n = useV2.getState().nodes[node.id];
    if (n?.domain) toggle(domainId(n.domain));
  }, [toggle]);

  const theme = useV2((s) => s.theme);
  return (
    <div ref={rootRef} className={`v2-map theme-${theme}`} data-theme={theme}>
      <ReactFlow
        nodes={rfNodes}
        edges={[]}
        nodeTypes={nodeTypes}
        nodesDraggable={false}
        nodesConnectable={false}
        elementsSelectable={false}
        zoomOnDoubleClick={false}
        onNodeDoubleClick={onNodeDoubleClick}
        minZoom={0.08}
        maxZoom={2.5}
        proOptions={{ hideAttribution: COMP }}
        onlyRenderVisibleElements={params.get('visible') === '1'}
      >
        {shown && (
          <ViewportPortal>
            <EdgeLayer frame={shown.frame} enter={shown.enter} />
            <Cursor frame={shown.frame} />
          </ViewportPortal>
        )}
      </ReactFlow>
      {shown && <Headers frame={shown.frame} insets={insets} />}
    </div>
  );
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------- edges: one SVG of precomputed paths

const EdgeLayer = memo(function EdgeLayer({ frame, enter }: { frame: Frame; enter: Enter }) {
  const lod = useLod();
  return (
    <svg className="v2-edges" width={1} height={1}>
      <defs>
        {(['existing', 'new', 'ghost', 'violation'] as const).map((k) => (
          <marker key={k} id={`v2-arrow-${k}`} viewBox="0 0 10 10" refX="9" refY="5" markerWidth="8" markerHeight="8" markerUnits="userSpaceOnUse" orient="auto-start-reverse">
            <path d="M0,1 L9,5 L0,9 z" className={`v2-arrowhead is-${k}`} />
          </marker>
        ))}
      </defs>
      {frame.edges.map((e) => {
        const kind = e.violation ? 'violation' : e.status;
        const entering = enter.edges.has(e.id);
        return (
          <g
            key={entering ? `${e.id}#${enter.seq}` : e.id}
            data-edge={e.id}
            className={`v2-edge is-${e.status} ${e.violation ? `is-violation is-violation-${e.violation}` : ''} ${entering ? 'is-enter' : ''}`}
          >
            <path className="v2-edge-line" d={e.d} markerEnd={`url(#v2-arrow-${kind})`} {...(entering && e.status !== 'ghost' ? { pathLength: 1 } : {})} />
            {lod !== 'far' && (e.count > 1 || e.steps.length > 0) && (
              <g className="v2-edge-tag" transform={`translate(${e.mid.x.toFixed(1)},${e.mid.y.toFixed(1)})`}>
                <rect x={-12} y={-9} width={24} height={18} rx={9} />
                <text textAnchor="middle" dy="0.35em">{e.steps.length ? e.steps.join(',') : e.count}</text>
              </g>
            )}
          </g>
        );
      })}
    </svg>
  );
});

function Cursor({ frame }: { frame: Frame }) {
  const c = useV2((s) => s.cursor);
  const b = c ? frame.boxes[c.node] : undefined;
  if (!c || !b) return null;
  const name = c.path.split('/').pop();
  return (
    <div className="v2-cursor" style={{ transform: `translate(${b.x + 10}px, ${b.y - 15}px)` }} aria-live="polite">
      <span className="v2-cursor-avatar" aria-hidden="true">C</span>
      <span className="v2-cursor-label">Claude · {c.verb} <code>{name}</code></span>
    </div>
  );
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------- screen-space headers (crisp at any zoom)

function Headers({ frame, insets }: { frame: Frame; insets: Insets }) {
  const store = useStoreApi();
  const colRefs = useRef<(HTMLButtonElement | null)[]>([]);
  const rowRefs = useRef<(HTMLDivElement | null)[]>([]);
  const toggle = useV2((s) => s.toggle);
  const nodes = useV2((s) => s.nodes);

  useLayoutEffect(() => {
    const place = ([tx, ty, k]: [number, number, number]) => {
      frame.cols.forEach((c, i) => {
        const el = colRefs.current[i];
        if (!el) return;
        const w = c.spine ? Math.max(c.w * k, 120) : c.w * k;
        el.style.transform = `translate(${(tx + (c.x + c.w / 2) * k - w / 2).toFixed(1)}px, 0)`;
        el.style.width = `${w.toFixed(1)}px`;
      });
      frame.rows.forEach((r, j) => {
        const el = rowRefs.current[j];
        if (!el) return;
        el.style.transform = `translate(0, ${(ty + r.y * k).toFixed(1)}px)`;
        el.style.height = `${(r.h * k).toFixed(1)}px`;
      });
    };
    place(store.getState().transform);
    return store.subscribe((s, p) => { if (s.transform !== p.transform) place(s.transform); });
  }, [frame, store]);

  return (
    <div className="v2-headers" style={{ ['--hdr-h' as string]: `${insets.top - 12}px`, ['--lbl-w' as string]: `${insets.left - 12}px` }}>
      <div className="v2-colheads">
        {frame.cols.map((c, i) => {
          const r = nodes[domainId(c.id)]?.rollup;
          return (
            <button
              key={c.id}
              ref={(el) => { colRefs.current[i] = el; }}
              type="button"
              className={`v2-colhead ${c.spine ? 'is-spine' : ''} ${c.expanded ? 'is-expanded' : ''}`}
              onClick={() => toggle(domainId(c.id))}
              title={c.purpose}
              aria-expanded={c.expanded}
            >
              <span className="v2-colhead-name">{c.name}</span>
              {c.expanded && <span className="v2-colhead-purpose">{c.purpose}</span>}
              {r && (r.violation || r.edited || r.ghostSteps.length > 0) && (
                <span className="v2-colhead-marks" aria-hidden="true">
                  {r.edited && <i className={r.unplanned ? 'is-unplanned' : 'is-edited'} />}
                  {r.ghostSteps.length > 0 && <i className="is-ghost" />}
                  {r.violation && <i className={`is-${r.violation}-violation`} />}
                </span>
              )}
            </button>
          );
        })}
      </div>
      <div className="v2-rowheads">
        {frame.rows.map((r, j) => (
          <div key={r.id} ref={(el) => { rowRefs.current[j] = el; }} className="v2-rowhead">
            <span>{r.name}</span>
          </div>
        ))}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------- measurement hooks for the N0 bench (Playwright)

type Bench = {
  ready: () => boolean;
  count: () => number;
  stats: () => Stats & { reducedMotion: boolean };
  zoom: (ms?: number) => Promise<FrameStats>;
  toggle: (domain: string) => Promise<TransitionStats & { layoutMs: number }>;
  elkCell: (n: number) => Promise<{ files: number; edges: number; workerMs: number; roundTripMs: number }>;
  setTheme: (t: 'atlas' | 'control' | 'strata') => void;
};
type FrameStats = { frames: number; fps: number; p50: number; p95: number; p99: number; max: number; domNodes: number };

function measureFrames(ms: number, step: (p: number) => void): Promise<FrameStats> {
  return new Promise((resolve) => {
    const times: number[] = [];
    const t0 = performance.now();
    const frame = (t: number) => {
      times.push(t);
      const p = Math.min(1, (t - t0) / ms);
      step(p);
      if (p < 1) requestAnimationFrame(frame);
      else {
        const dts = times.slice(1).map((x, i) => x - times[i]!).sort((a, b) => a - b);
        const q = (f: number) => +dts[Math.min(dts.length - 1, Math.floor(dts.length * f))]!.toFixed(2);
        resolve({ frames: times.length, fps: +((1000 * (times.length - 1)) / (times.at(-1)! - times[0]!)).toFixed(1), p50: q(0.5), p95: q(0.95), p99: q(0.99), max: q(1), domNodes: document.querySelectorAll('.react-flow__node').length });
      }
    };
    requestAnimationFrame(frame);
  });
}

function useBenchApi(tr: Transitioner, stats: React.MutableRefObject<Stats>, rf: ReturnType<typeof useReactFlow>) {
  useEffect(() => {
    const api: Bench = {
      ready: () => !!tr.shown,
      count: () => document.querySelectorAll('.react-flow__node').length,
      stats: () => ({ ...stats.current, transition: tr.last, reducedMotion: reducedMotion() }),
      zoom: (ms = 3000) => {
        const b = tr.shown!.bounds;
        const cx = b.x + b.w / 2;
        const cy = b.y + b.h / 2;
        const el = document.querySelector('.v2-map')!.getBoundingClientRect();
        return measureFrames(ms, (p) => {
          const z = 0.2 + 1.2 * Math.sin(p * Math.PI); // far → near → far, crossing every LOD bucket twice
          void rf.setViewport({ zoom: z, x: el.width / 2 - (cx + (p - 0.5) * b.w * 0.4) * z, y: el.height / 2 - cy * z });
        });
      },
      toggle: (domain) => new Promise((resolve) => {
        const t0 = performance.now();
        tr.onDone = (s) => {
          tr.onDone = null;
          resolve({ ...s, layoutMs: +(performance.now() - t0 - T_FADE).toFixed(1) });
        };
        useV2.getState().toggle(domain.startsWith('domain:') ? domain : `domain:${domain}`);
      }),
      elkCell: async (n) => {
        const c = bigCell(n);
        const t0 = performance.now();
        const l = await layoutContainer(c);
        return { files: n, edges: c.edges.length, workerMs: +l.ms.toFixed(1), roundTripMs: +(performance.now() - t0).toFixed(1) };
      },
      setTheme: (theme) => useV2.setState({ theme }),
    };
    (window as unknown as { __v2: Bench }).__v2 = api;
  }, [tr, stats, rf]);
}

export { useStore };
```

```typescript
// Small, fast, deterministic string hash (two FNV-1a variants → 16 hex chars). Browser-safe.

export function hashText(text: string): string {
  let a = 0x811c9dc5;
  let b = 0x01000193 ^ text.length;
  for (let i = 0; i < text.length; i++) {
    const c = text.charCodeAt(i);
    a = Math.imul(a ^ c, 0x01000193);
    b = Math.imul(b ^ c, 0x5bd1e995);
    b ^= b >>> 15;
  }
  return (a >>> 0).toString(16).padStart(8, '0') + (b >>> 0).toString(16).padStart(8, '0');
}

/** Collapse whitespace runs so formatting-only edits keep the same hash. */
export const squash = (text: string) => text.replace(/\s+/g, ' ').trim();
```

```typescript
// Which symbols an edit changed (NAVIGATION_PLAN §3.1). Pure and browser-safe.
import type { SymbolDiff, SymbolFact } from '../contracts/facts';

/**
 * Classify symbols as added, removed, signature-changed or body-changed by comparing hashes.
 * A removed and an added symbol of the same kind with the same `bodyHash` is a rename, listed only under `renamed`.
 */
export function diffSymbols(before: readonly SymbolFact[], after: readonly SymbolFact[]): SymbolDiff {
  const old = new Map(before.map((s) => [s.id, s]));
  const now = new Map(after.map((s) => [s.id, s]));
  const sig: string[] = [];
  const body: string[] = [];
  for (const s of after) {
    const o = old.get(s.id);
    if (!o) continue;
    if (o.sigHash !== s.sigHash) sig.push(s.id);
    else if (o.bodyHash !== s.bodyHash) body.push(s.id);
  }
  const removed = before.filter((s) => !now.has(s.id));
  const added = after.filter((s) => !old.has(s.id));
  const renamed: [string, string][] = [];
  const taken = new Set<string>();
  for (const r of removed) {
    const a = added.find((x) => !taken.has(x.id) && x.kind === r.kind && x.bodyHash === r.bodyHash);
    if (!a) continue;
    taken.add(a.id);
    taken.add(r.id);
    renamed.push([r.id, a.id]);
  }
  return {
    added: added.filter((s) => !taken.has(s.id)).map((s) => s.id),
    removed: removed.filter((s) => !taken.has(s.id)).map((s) => s.id),
    sig,
    body,
    renamed,
  };
}
```

```typescript
// Regex fallback for source that doesn't parse (mid-edit files). Browser-safe.

const REGEX_PRECEDERS = new Set('(,=:[!&|?{};+-*%<>~^'.split(''));
const REGEX_KEYWORDS = /(?:^|[^\w$])(?:return|typeof|case|do|else|in|of|void|yield|await|delete|throw|new)$/;

/**
 * Replace `//` and `/* *\/` comments with spaces (newlines kept), leaving strings,
 * template literals and regex literals intact, so offsets and line numbers still match.
 */
export function stripComments(src: string): string {
  const n = src.length;
  let out = '';
  let i = 0;

  const copyQuoted = (quote: string) => {
    out += src[i++];
    while (i < n && src[i] !== quote && src[i] !== '\n') {
      if (src[i] === '\\') out += src[i++];
      if (i < n) out += src[i++];
    }
    if (i < n && src[i] === quote) out += src[i++];
  };

  const copyRegex = () => {
    let inClass = false;
    out += src[i++];
    while (i < n && src[i] !== '\n') {
      const c = src[i]!;
      if (c === '\\') {
        out += src.slice(i, i + 2);
        i += 2;
        continue;
      }
      out += c;
      i++;
      if (c === '[') inClass = true;
      else if (c === ']') inClass = false;
      else if (c === '/' && !inClass) break;
    }
  };

  const copyTemplate = () => {
    out += src[i++];
    while (i < n && src[i] !== '`') {
      if (src[i] === '\\') {
        out += src.slice(i, i + 2);
        i += 2;
      } else if (src[i] === '$' && src[i + 1] === '{') {
        out += '${';
        i += 2;
        code(true);
      } else out += src[i++];
    }
    if (i < n) out += src[i++];
  };

  // Scan code; when `inTemplate`, stop after the `}` that closes the `${`.
  function code(inTemplate: boolean) {
    let depth = 0;
    while (i < n) {
      const c = src[i]!;
      const next = src[i + 1];
      if (c === '/' && next === '/') {
        while (i < n && src[i] !== '\n') {
          out += ' ';
          i++;
        }
      } else if (c === '/' && next === '*') {
        const end = src.indexOf('*/', i + 2);
        const stop = end === -1 ? n : end + 2;
        out += src.slice(i, stop).replace(/[^\n]/g, ' ');
        i = stop;
      } else if (c === '"' || c === "'") copyQuoted(c);
      else if (c === '`') copyTemplate();
      else if (c === '/') {
        const before = out.trimEnd();
        const prev = before[before.length - 1];
        if (prev === undefined || REGEX_PRECEDERS.has(prev) || REGEX_KEYWORDS.test(before)) copyRegex();
        else out += src[i++];
      } else {
        if (c === '{') depth++;
        else if (c === '}') {
          if (inTemplate && depth === 0) {
            out += src[i++];
            return;
          }
          depth--;
        }
        out += src[i++];
      }
    }
  }

  code(false);
  return out;
}

const STATIC_FROM = /(?<![\w$.])(?:import|export)\s+(type\s+)?[\w$\s{},*]*?\bfrom\s*(['"])([^'"\n]+)\2/g;
const SIDE_EFFECT = /(?<![\w$.])import\s*(['"])([^'"\n]+)\1/g;
const DYNAMIC = /(?<![\w$.])import\s*\(\s*(['"`])([^'"`$\n]+)\1\s*\)/g;
export const REQUIRE = /(?<![\w$.])require\s*\(\s*(['"])([^'"\n]+)\1\s*\)/g;

export type SpecSite = { spec: string; typeOnly: boolean; at: number };

/** Import specifiers in comment-stripped code, in source order (regex; the fallback when parsing fails). */
export function regexImports(code: string): SpecSite[] {
  const found: SpecSite[] = [];
  for (const m of code.matchAll(STATIC_FROM)) found.push({ spec: m[3]!, typeOnly: !!m[1], at: m.index });
  for (const re of [SIDE_EFFECT, DYNAMIC, REQUIRE]) {
    for (const m of code.matchAll(re)) found.push({ spec: m[2]!, typeOnly: false, at: m.index });
  }
  return found.sort((a, b) => a.at - b.at);
}
```

```typescript
// Write adapters: table writes found in comment-free code. Text-based so the edit gate needs no AST, and the
// gate, the load scan and extractFacts all see the same writes. Browser-safe.

export type WriteHit = { table: string; via: string; at: number };

type Adapter = { via: string; guard: RegExp; find: (code: string, out: WriteHit[]) => void };

const each = (re: RegExp, code: string, fn: (m: RegExpMatchArray) => void) => {
  for (const m of code.matchAll(re)) fn(m);
};

/** Scout: `db.insert("t", …)` / `db.update("t", …)` with a literal table name. */
const SCOUT = /(?<![\w$])db\s*\.\s*(?:insert|update)\s*\(\s*(?:"([^"\\\n]+)"|'([^'\\\n]+)'|`([^`\\$]+)`)/g;
/** Prisma: `prisma.user.create(…)`, `tx.post.updateMany(…)`. */
const PRISMA = /(?<![\w$])(?:prisma|tx)\s*\.\s*([a-z][\w$]*)\s*\.\s*(?:create|createMany|createManyAndReturn|update|updateMany|updateManyAndReturn|upsert|delete|deleteMany)\s*\(/g;
/** Drizzle: `db.insert(users).values(…)`, `.update(users).set(…)`, `.delete(users).where(…)`. */
const DRIZZLE = /\.\s*(?:insert|update|delete)\s*\(\s*([A-Za-z_$][\w$]*)\s*\)\s*\.\s*(?:values|set|where|returning|onConflictDoNothing|onConflictDoUpdate)\s*\(/g;
/** Knex: `knex("t")…insert(…)`, `trx("t").update(…)`, `knex.table("t").del()`. */
const KNEX = /(?<![\w$])(?:knex|trx)\s*(?:\.\s*(?:table|into|from)\s*)?\(\s*(['"`])([\w.]+)\1\s*\)/g;
const KNEX_WRITE = /^[^;]{0,400}?\.\s*(?:insert|update|del|delete|upsert|merge|increment|decrement)\s*\(/;
/** Kysely: `db.insertInto("t")`, `.updateTable("t")`, `.deleteFrom("t")`. */
const KYSELY = /\.\s*(?:insertInto|replaceInto|updateTable|deleteFrom|mergeInto)\s*\(\s*(['"`])([\w.]+)\1/g;
/** Raw SQL at the start of a string or template literal. */
const SQL = /(['"`])\s*(?:(?:INSERT|REPLACE)\s+(?:OR\s+\w+\s+)?INTO|DELETE\s+FROM|MERGE\s+INTO|UPDATE)\s+[`"[]?([A-Za-z_][\w.]*)[`"\]]?(\s+SET\b)?/gi;

const ADAPTERS: Adapter[] = [
  { via: 'db', guard: /\bdb\s*\./, find: (code, out) => each(SCOUT, code, (m) => out.push({ table: (m[1] ?? m[2] ?? m[3])!, via: 'db', at: m.index! })) },
  { via: 'prisma', guard: /\b(?:prisma|tx)\s*\./, find: (code, out) => each(PRISMA, code, (m) => out.push({ table: m[1]!, via: 'prisma', at: m.index! })) },
  { via: 'drizzle', guard: /\.\s*(?:insert|update|delete)\s*\(/, find: (code, out) => each(DRIZZLE, code, (m) => out.push({ table: m[1]!, via: 'drizzle', at: m.index! })) },
  {
    via: 'knex',
    guard: /\b(?:knex|trx)\b/,
    find: (code, out) => each(KNEX, code, (m) => {
      const after = code.slice(m.index! + m[0].length, m.index! + m[0].length + 400);
      if (KNEX_WRITE.test(after)) out.push({ table: m[2]!, via: 'knex', at: m.index! });
    }),
  },
  { via: 'kysely', guard: /\.\s*(?:insertInto|replaceInto|updateTable|deleteFrom|mergeInto)\b/, find: (code, out) => each(KYSELY, code, (m) => out.push({ table: m[2]!, via: 'kysely', at: m.index! })) },
  {
    via: 'sql',
    guard: /\b(?:insert|replace|delete|merge|update)\s/i,
    find: (code, out) => each(SQL, code, (m) => {
      if (/^\s*update/i.test(code.slice(m.index! + 1, m.index! + 12)) && !m[3]) return; // UPDATE needs SET
      out.push({ table: m[2]!, via: 'sql', at: m.index! });
    }),
  },
];

/** Table writes in `code` (comments already blanked), in source order. */
export function findWrites(code: string): WriteHit[] {
  const out: WriteHit[] = [];
  for (const a of ADAPTERS) if (a.guard.test(code)) a.find(code, out);
  return out.sort((x, y) => x.at - y.at);
}

/** `source` with the given comment spans replaced by spaces (offsets kept). */
export function maskComments(source: string, comments: readonly { start: number; end: number }[]): string {
  if (comments.length === 0) return source;
  let out = '';
  let at = 0;
  for (const c of comments) {
    out += source.slice(at, c.start) + source.slice(c.start, c.end).replace(/[^\n]/g, ' ');
    at = c.end;
  }
  return out + source.slice(at);
}
```

```typescript
// A repo resolver rides along on an `Exists` function, so `resolveImport(from, spec, exists)` and every caller of
// it (gate, plan, load scan) gain tsconfig paths, package exports and workspaces without a signature change.

/** Module resolution against one repo on disk (see `createRepoResolver`). */
export type RepoResolverLike = {
  /** Repo path, `vendor:<pkg>` (package or node builtin), or null. Files on disk only. */
  resolve(fromFile: string, spec: string): string | null;
  /** Repo-relative candidate bases for a non-relative spec from tsconfig `paths` (for files that don't exist yet). */
  candidates(fromFile: string, spec: string): string[];
  clear(): void;
};

const KEY = Symbol.for('harness.repoResolver');

type Carrier = { [KEY]?: () => RepoResolverLike };

/** The resolver attached to `fn`, if any. */
export function resolverOf(fn: object): RepoResolverLike | null {
  return (fn as Carrier)[KEY]?.() ?? null;
}

/** Attach a (lazily created) resolver to `fn`, or copy the one `from` carries. Returns `fn`. */
export function attachResolver<T extends object>(fn: T, from: (() => RepoResolverLike) | object | null): T {
  const get = typeof from === 'function' && !(KEY in from) ? (from as () => RepoResolverLike) : from ? (from as Carrier)[KEY] : undefined;
  if (get) Object.defineProperty(fn, KEY, { value: get, enumerable: false });
  return fn;
}
```

```text
import { cellKey, type Cell, type TurnState, type UIState } from './events';
import type { Violation } from './rules';

export type Severity = 1 | 2 | 3 | 4;

export type Finding = {
  severity: Severity;
  kind: 'invariant' | 'new_edge' | 'new_external' | 'unplanned' | 'planned';
  cell: Cell | null;
  text: string;
  files: string[];
  invariant?: string;
};

export type TurnLedger = {
  turn: string;
  linesChanged: number | null; // null until turn_ended brings the git numstat
  cellsToReview: number;
  forksCaughtBeforeCode: number;
  rejectedOptionsBlocked: number;
  findings: Finding[];
};

export type Ledger = {
  turns: TurnLedger[];
  session: { linesChanged: number; cellsToReview: number; forksCaughtBeforeCode: number; rejectedOptionsBlocked: number };
};

const vkey = (v: Violation) => `${v.invariant}|${v.file}|${v.target ?? ''}`;

function cellOf(s: UIState, turn: TurnState, file: string): Cell | null {
  const p = s.files[file];
  if (p?.kind === 'cell') return { domain: p.domain, layer: p.layer };
  const edited = Object.entries(turn.edited).find(([, c]) => c.files.includes(file));
  if (edited) { const [domain, layer] = edited[0].split('/') as [string, string]; return { domain, layer }; }
  return Object.values(turn.planned).find((c) => c.files.includes(file))?.cell ?? null;
}

/** Severity-ranked findings for one turn (SPEC §9): 1 invariant hit · 2 new edge / new external · 3 unplanned · 4 planned. */
export function turnFindings(s: UIState, turn: TurnState): Finding[] {
  const out: Finding[] = [];
  const seen = new Set<string>();
  for (const { v } of turn.violationsSeen) {
    if (seen.has(vkey(v))) continue;
    seen.add(vkey(v));
    out.push({ severity: 1, kind: 'invariant', cell: cellOf(s, turn, v.file), text: v.reason, files: [v.file], invariant: v.invariant });
  }
  const edges = new Map<string, { from: string; to: string; files: string[] }>();
  for (const e of turn.edgesAdded) {
    const k = `${e.from}->${e.to}`;
    const cur = edges.get(k) ?? { from: e.from, to: e.to, files: [] };
    if (!cur.files.includes(e.edge.from)) cur.files.push(e.edge.from);
    edges.set(k, cur);
  }
  for (const e of edges.values()) {
    const cell = cellOf(s, turn, e.files[0]!);
    out.push({ severity: 2, kind: 'new_edge', cell, text: `New dependency: ${name(s, e.from)} → ${name(s, e.to)}`, files: e.files });
  }
  const hasPlan = Object.keys(turn.planned).length > 0;
  for (const [k, c] of Object.entries(turn.edited)) {
    const [domain, layer] = k.split('/') as [string, string];
    const cell = { domain, layer };
    if (layer === 'external' && c.created.length) {
      out.push({ severity: 2, kind: 'new_external', cell, text: `New external service in ${name(s, domain)}`, files: c.created });
    }
    if (hasPlan && !turn.planned[k]) {
      out.push({ severity: 3, kind: 'unplanned', cell, text: `Edited ${name(s, domain)} · ${layer} without planning it`, files: c.files });
    } else {
      out.push({ severity: 4, kind: 'planned', cell, text: `${name(s, domain)} · ${layer}: ${c.files.length} file(s), +${c.added} −${c.removed}`, files: c.files });
    }
  }
  for (const file of turn.unassigned) {
    if (hasPlan && !Object.values(turn.planned).some((c) => c.files.includes(file))) {
      out.push({ severity: 3, kind: 'unplanned', cell: null, text: `Edited ${file}, which belongs to no domain`, files: [file] });
    }
  }
  return out.sort((a, b) => a.severity - b.severity);
}
```

```typescript
// A repo resolver rides along on an `Exists` function, so `resolveImport(from, spec, exists)` and every caller of
// it (gate, plan, load scan) gain tsconfig paths, package exports and workspaces without a signature change.

/** Module resolution against one repo on disk (see `createRepoResolver`). */
export type RepoResolverLike = {
  /** Repo path, `vendor:<pkg>` (package or node builtin), or null. Files on disk only. */
  resolve(fromFile: string, spec: string): string | null;
  /** Repo-relative candidate bases for a non-relative spec from tsconfig `paths` (for files that don't exist yet). */
  candidates(fromFile: string, spec: string): string[];
  clear(): void;
};

const KEY = Symbol.for('harness.repoResolver');

type Carrier = { [KEY]?: () => RepoResolverLike };

/** The resolver attached to `fn`, if any. */
export function resolverOf(fn: object): RepoResolverLike | null {
  return (fn as Carrier)[KEY]?.() ?? null;
}

/** Attach a (lazily created) resolver to `fn`. Returns `fn`. */
export function attachResolver<T extends object>(fn: T, get: () => RepoResolverLike): T {
  Object.defineProperty(fn, KEY, { value: get, enumerable: false, configurable: true });
  return fn;
}

/** Give `fn` the resolver `from` carries, if any. Returns `fn`. */
export function carryResolver<T extends object>(fn: T, from: object): T {
  const get = (from as Carrier)[KEY];
  return get ? attachResolver(fn, get) : fn;
}
```

_**Agent (claude-opus-5-5 2026-10-11 20:56:36Z)**_

Yes, a real database is worth adding, if it's done in a way that doesn't break what the harness relies on. Right now `src/shared/db.ts` is a JSON file pretending to be a database. A real one with a real schema makes "where does a phone number end up?" land on something concrete: a `phone` column in a table that one domain owns.

**What I'd use: PGlite, real Postgres embedded in the app.**
- It runs inside the Node process. There's no server to start, no Docker and no native modules, and it works on your Node 20.
- Data persists to `.scout/pgdata`, and tests use a throwaway in-memory database.
- It's real Postgres: real tables, column types and SQL, and it can be swapped for a hosted Postgres later. That's a believable story for a production system.

**What I'd keep, because the harness depends on it:** the `db.insert("contacts", row)` call style, with the table name as a string. SPEC's write scanner and the DR-2 ownership rule find writes by that pattern. If I switched to an ORM like Drizzle (`db.insert(contacts)`), the scanner would stop seeing writes until the other session builds the Drizzle support in N1. DR-2 would then quietly check nothing.

**What changes:**
1. **Each domain owns its schema file:** `src/outreach/schema.sql` (contacts, outreach_log), `src/memory/schema.sql`, and so on. They're plain SQL files read at startup, not imports, so they add no edges, and the map shows each table's definition in its owner's column. The contacts table's `phone text` column then sits in Outreach › Data.
2. **Every database call becomes asynchronous**, since Postgres calls take time. That touches roughly 40 call sites and the tests, but the logic stays the same.
3. **The JSON snapshot goes away**, and the seed script writes into Postgres.
4. **An `npm run db -- "select name, phone from contacts"` command**, so you can show stored data in a terminal during the demo.

**How it fits the demo:**
- **Beat 1's trace** ends at a real table with a real column: the phone number goes into Postgres (contacts), to the CRM sandbox, and, through the news tool, to Claude unredacted. That's three sinks, one of them red.
- **Beat 6's loophole** becomes more concrete, since a tool reading `outreach_log` is now a real SQL query.
- **A possible extra beat:** "phone numbers are stored in plain text, encrypt them". It's a quiet change inside one domain, so it shows that a well-contained change lights only one column.

**Cost:** about 2 hours. It becomes one more commit before the news summarizer, `feat(db): move storage to Postgres (PGlite)`, which reads like normal growth from a prototype store to a database. I'd re-verify each commit and the proof as before. The harness side needs one small thing: the map YAML's data cells list the new `schema.sql` files.

The alternative is SQLite, which is lighter, but Node's built-in SQLite needs Node 22.5 or newer, and the usual library is a native module.

Should I go ahead with PGlite? I'd do it together with the three Scout changes from the demo plan, then update `DEMO_PLAN.md` and `DEMO_REPO_SPEC.md` to match.
