```typescript
// The living-map loop (NAVIGATION_PLAN §4.1, §4.3): at every turn end, measure drift deterministically; when a signal
// has persisted and no proposal is pending for its scope, run the cartographer out of band, score its candidates
// against the current map, and queue the best one as a proposal. Never runs while a turn is open; never blocks one.
import { writeFileSync } from 'node:fs';
import { Hono } from 'hono';
import {
  reduce, historyFromUI, detectDrift, thresholdsFor, scoreMap, diffMaps, changeSignature, summarizeChanges, describeScores,
  parseDomainMap, createMapper, PROPOSAL_MARGIN,
  type DomainMap, type DriftSignal, type DriftSignalKind, type FileFacts, type HistoryTurn, type MapProposal, type MapScore, type UIState,
} from '@harness/core';
import { commitPaths } from '../git';
import type { Bus } from '../bus';
import type { Repo } from '../repo';
import { gitHistory, toFileFacts } from './history';
import { sdkProposer, type Candidate, type Proposer } from './runner';
import { listRejected, listStanding, writeRejection } from './records';
import { labelsFor, sdkLabeler, type Labeler } from './labels';

/** Signals the cartographer acts on. Stale labels and bloated cells go to the labels job; reinforcement is the auditor's. */
const CARTOGRAPHER_SIGNALS = new Set<DriftSignalKind>(['unassigned', 'new_top_level', 'wide_turns', 'co_change', 'coupling_growth', 'rule_erosion']);

/** Candidates within this much of the best total count as "similar"; among them the smallest change wins. */
export const SIMILAR = 0.1;

export type LivingMapOptions = {
  bus: Bus;
  repo: Repo;
  proposer?: Proposer | null; // default: the Agent SDK cartographer (null when HARNESS_CARTOGRAPHER=0)
  labeler?: Labeler | null; // default: the Agent SDK labeler (null when HARNESS_LABELS=0)
  k?: number; // candidates per run (default 4, or HARNESS_CARTOGRAPHER_K)
  gitLimit?: number;
};

export type Result = { ok: true; decision?: string } | { ok: false; status: 400 | 404 | 409; error: string };

type Scored = { candidate: Candidate; map: DomainMap; changes: ReturnType<typeof diffMaps>; score: MapScore };

/** Pick the proposal: lowest total; among totals within SIMILAR of it, the fewest changes. Null unless it beats current by the margin. */
export function chooseCandidate(current: MapScore, scored: readonly Scored[]): number | null {
  if (!scored.length) return null;
  const best = Math.min(...scored.map((s) => s.score.total));
  if (current.total - best < PROPOSAL_MARGIN) return null;
  let pick = -1;
  scored.forEach((s, i) => {
    if (s.score.total > best + SIMILAR) return;
    const p = scored[pick];
    if (!p || s.changes.length < p.changes.length || (s.changes.length === p.changes.length && s.score.total < p.score.total)) pick = i;
  });
  return pick;
}

export function attachLivingMap(opts: LivingMapOptions) {
  const { bus, repo } = opts;
  const proposer = opts.proposer === undefined ? (process.env.HARNESS_CARTOGRAPHER === '0' ? null : sdkProposer) : opts.proposer;
  const labeler = opts.labeler === undefined ? (process.env.HARNESS_LABELS === '0' ? null : sdkLabeler) : opts.labeler;
  const k = opts.k ?? Number(process.env.HARNESS_CARTOGRAPHER_K ?? 4);
  let previous: DriftSignal[] | null = null;
  let queued = false;
  let cartographing = false;
  let labelling = false;
  const work = new Set<Promise<unknown>>();
  const track = <T>(p: Promise<T>) => { work.add(p); void p.finally(() => work.delete(p)); return p; };

  const ready = () => !!repo.map && repo.hasMap();
  const facts = (): Record<string, FileFacts> => toFileFacts(repo.facts);
  const history = (ui: UIState): HistoryTurn[] => [...gitHistory(repo.root, opts.gitLimit), ...historyFromUI(ui)];

  /** Ids plus the domains they live in (files and cells), so scopes can be compared at domain granularity. */
  const expand = (ids: readonly string[]) => {
    const out = new Set(ids);
    for (const id of ids) {
      const cell = /^cell:([^/]+)\//.exec(id);
      if (cell) out.add(`domain:${cell[1]}`);
      else if (!id.includes(':')) { const d = repo.mapper.domainOf(id); if (d) out.add(`domain:${d}`); }
    }
    return out;
  };

  /** Measure drift now (or queue until the open turn ends), then start the cartographer / labels jobs if warranted. */
  function survey(): void {
    if (!ready()) return;
    if (bus.turn) { queued = true; return; }
    queued = false;
    const ui = reduce(bus.events);
    previous ??= ui.drift;
    const f = facts();
    const hist = history(ui);
    const t = thresholdsFor(repo.map);
    const signals = detectDrift(repo.map, f, ui, hist, t, previous);
    previous = signals;
    bus.emit('drift_detected', { signals }, { turn: null });

    const pending = Object.values(ui.proposals).filter((p) => p.status === 'pending').map((p) => expand(p.proposal.scope));
    const triggers = signals.filter((s) => CARTOGRAPHER_SIGNALS.has(s.signal) && s.persisted >= t.persist && !pending.some((ps) => [...expand(s.scope)].some((id) => ps.has(id))));
    if (triggers.length && proposer && !cartographing) {
      cartographing = true;
      track(cartograph(triggers, ui, f, hist).finally(() => { cartographing = false; }));
    }

    const stale = signals.find((s) => s.signal === 'stale_label')?.scope.flatMap((target) => {
      const pl = repo.place(target);
      return pl.kind === 'cell' && ui.labels[`group:${target}`] ? [`cell:${pl.domain}/${pl.layer}`] : [];
    }) ?? [];
    const cells = [...signals.filter((s) => s.signal === 'bloated_cell' && s.persisted >= t.persist).flatMap((s) => s.scope), ...stale];
    if (cells.length && labeler && !labelling) {
      labelling = true;
      track(label(cells).finally(() => { labelling = false; }));
    }
  }

  async function cartograph(triggers: DriftSignal[], ui: UIState, f: Record<string, FileFacts>, hist: HistoryTurn[]) {
    const t0 = Date.now();
    const base = repo.map, baseYaml = repo.mapText;
    const trigger = [...new Set(triggers.map((s) => s.signal))].join(',');
    const done = (ok: boolean, cost: number | null) => bus.emit('maintenance_run', { agent: 'cartographer', trigger, ms: Date.now() - t0, cost, ok }, { turn: null });

    // Scope: trigger scopes, their domains, and one hop along import edges.
    const scope = expand(triggers.flatMap((s) => s.scope));
    const mapper = createMapper(base);
    const hop = new Set<string>();
    for (const file of Object.values(f)) for (const imp of file.imports) {
      const a = mapper.domainOf(file.path), b = mapper.domainOf(imp.to);
      if (a && b && a !== b && (scope.has(`domain:${a}`) || scope.has(file.path))) hop.add(`domain:${b}`);
      if (a && b && a !== b && (scope.has(`domain:${b}`) || scope.has(imp.to))) hop.add(`domain:${a}`);
      if (!a && b && scope.has(file.path)) hop.add(`domain:${b}`); // unassigned file importing a domain
    }
    const fullScope = [...new Set([...scope, ...hop])].sort();
    const standing = listStanding(repo.root);
    const rejected = listRejected(repo.root);

    let result;
    try {
      result = await proposer!({
        root: repo.root, yaml: baseYaml, map: base, facts: f, signals: triggers, scope: fullScope, history: hist,
        turns: ui.turns.map((x) => ({ id: x.id, prompt: x.prompt, files: Object.keys(x.paths).filter((p) => x.paths[p]!.edits > 0).sort() })).filter((x) => x.files.length),
        decisions: standing, rejected, k,
      });
    } catch (e) {
      bus.emit('error', { message: `Cartographer failed: ${(e as Error).message}` }, { turn: null });
      return void done(false, (e as { cost?: number }).cost ?? null);
    }
    if (repo.mapText !== baseYaml) return void done(false, result.cost); // the map changed while it ran: stale

    const files = Object.keys(f);
    const seen = new Set(rejected.map((r) => r.signature));
    const scored: Scored[] = [];
    const decisionPaths = Object.fromEntries(standing.filter((d) => d.paths.length).map((d) => [d.id, d.paths]));
    for (const candidate of result.candidates.slice(0, k)) {
      let map: DomainMap;
      try { map = parseDomainMap(candidate.yaml); } catch { continue; } // invalid YAML or schema: dropped
      const changes = diffMaps(base, map, files);
      const sig = changeSignature(changes);
      if (!changes.length || seen.has(sig)) continue; // no-op, a repeat of a rejected proposal, or a duplicate
      seen.add(sig);
      scored.push({ candidate, map, changes, score: scoreMap(map, f, hist, { current: base, decisionPaths }) });
    }
    const current = scoreMap(base, f, hist, { current: base, decisionPaths });
    const chosen = chooseCandidate(current, scored);
    if (chosen === null) return void done(true, result.cost);

    const best = scored[chosen]!;
    const n = Math.max(0, ...Object.keys(reduce(bus.events).proposals).map((id) => Number(/^MP-(\d+)$/.exec(id)?.[1] ?? 0))) + 1;
    const touched = best.changes.flatMap((c) => ('domain' in c ? [`domain:${c.domain}`] : c.kind === 'move' ? [`domain:${c.from.domain}`, `domain:${c.to.domain}`] : 'path' in c ? [c.path] : []));
    const proposal: MapProposal = {
      id: `MP-${n}`,
      trigger: triggers,
      scope: [...new Set([...scope, ...touched])].sort(),
      candidates: scored.map((s) => ({ yaml: s.candidate.yaml, score: s.score })),
      chosen,
      current,
      changes: best.changes,
      rationale: `${best.candidate.title} ${best.candidate.rationale}`.trim(),
    };
    bus.emit('map_proposed', { map: base, yaml: baseYaml, proposal }, { turn: null });
    bus.emit('chat', { role: 'system', text: `Cartographer proposal ${proposal.id}: ${summarizeChanges(best.changes)} · ${describeScores(current, best.score)}` }, { turn: null });
    done(true, result.cost);
  }

  async function label(cells: string[]) {
    const t0 = Date.now();
    try {
      const r = await labelsFor({ root: repo.root, map: repo.map, facts: facts(), cells, labeler: labeler! });
      if (r.labels.length) bus.emit('labels_updated', { labels: r.labels }, { turn: null });
      if (r.calls) bus.emit('maintenance_run', { agent: 'cartographer', trigger: 'labels', ms: Date.now() - t0, cost: r.cost, ok: true }, { turn: null });
    } catch (e) {
      bus.emit('maintenance_run', { agent: 'cartographer', trigger: 'labels', ms: Date.now() - t0, cost: null, ok: false }, { turn: null });
      bus.emit('error', { message: `Labels failed: ${(e as Error).message}` }, { turn: null });
    }
  }

  const pendingProposal = (id: string): { proposal: MapProposal; yaml: string } | Result => {
    const p = reduce(bus.events).proposals[id];
    if (!p) return { ok: false, status: 404, error: `No proposal ${id}.` };
    if (p.status !== 'pending') return { ok: false, status: 409, error: `${id} is already ${p.status}.` };
    const at = bus.events.findLast((e) => e.kind === 'map_proposed' && (e.data as { proposal?: MapProposal }).proposal?.id === id);
    return { proposal: p.proposal, yaml: (at?.data as { yaml: string }).yaml };
  };

  /** Accept: write and commit domains.yaml (only it), reload the map, rescan, emit map_confirmed + resolved. */
  function accept(id: string, candidate?: number): Result {
    const p = pendingProposal(id);
    if ('ok' in p) return p;
    if (p.yaml !== repo.mapText) return { ok: false, status: 409, error: `domains.yaml changed since ${id} was proposed; run a survey for a fresh proposal.` };
    const idx = candidate ?? p.proposal.chosen;
    const yaml = p.proposal.candidates[idx]?.yaml;
    if (!yaml) return { ok: false, status: 400, error: `${id} has no candidate ${idx}.` };
    writeFileSync(repo.mapPath, yaml);
    try { commitPaths(repo.root, ['domains.yaml'], `docs(map): accept ${id}: ${summarizeChanges(diffMaps(repo.map, parseDomainMap(yaml), Object.keys(facts())))}`.slice(0, 100)); }
    catch (e) { bus.emit('error', { message: `Could not commit domains.yaml: ${(e as Error).message}` }, { turn: null }); }
    repo.setMap(yaml);
    bus.emit('map_confirmed', { map: repo.map, source: 'cartographer' }, { turn: null });
    repo.scan();
    bus.emit('map_proposal_resolved', { proposal: id, outcome: 'accepted' }, { turn: null });
    schedule();
    return { ok: true };
  }

  /** Reject: record decisions/DR-n.md (status: rejected) and commit only it; the cartographer is told never to repeat it. */
  function reject(id: string, reason?: string): Result {
    const p = pendingProposal(id);
    if ('ok' in p) return p;
    const { id: decision, path } = writeRejection(repo.root, repo.map, p.proposal, reason);
    try { commitPaths(repo.root, [path], `docs(decisions): ${decision} reject map proposal ${id}`); }
    catch (e) { bus.emit('error', { message: `Could not commit ${path}: ${(e as Error).message}` }, { turn: null }); }
    bus.emit('map_proposal_resolved', { proposal: id, outcome: 'rejected', decision }, { turn: null });
    return { ok: true, decision };
  }

  /** Survey on the next tick (after the emitter has finished closing the turn). */
  function schedule() {
    track(new Promise<void>((resolve) => setImmediate(() => { try { survey(); } finally { resolve(); } })));
  }

  const off = bus.on((e) => {
    if (e.kind === 'turn_ended') schedule();
  });

  return {
    survey: schedule,
    accept,
    reject,
    get queued() { return queued; },
    /** Resolves once no survey, cartographer or labels job is in flight (for tests and shutdown). */
    async idle() { while (work.size) await Promise.allSettled([...work]); },
    detach: off,
  };
}

export type LivingMap = ReturnType<typeof attachLivingMap>;

/** HTTP endpoints, mounted under /api by the server. */
export function livingMapRoutes(lm: LivingMap) {
  const r = new Hono();
  const reply = (c: { json: (b: unknown, s?: 200 | 400 | 404 | 409) => Response }, res: Result) => (res.ok ? c.json(res) : c.json({ error: res.error }, res.status));
  r.post('/proposals/:id/accept', async (c) => {
    const body = await c.req.json<{ candidate?: number }>().catch(() => ({} as { candidate?: number }));
    return reply(c, lm.accept(c.req.param('id'), body.candidate));
  });
  r.post('/proposals/:id/reject', async (c) => {
    const body = await c.req.json<{ reason?: string }>().catch(() => ({} as { reason?: string }));
    return reply(c, lm.reject(c.req.param('id'), body.reason));
  });
  r.post('/living-map/survey', (c) => { lm.survey(); return c.json({ ok: true, queued: lm.queued }); });
  return r;
}
```

```typescript
/** Instant onboarding proposal (no model, < 1 s): the deterministic skeleton map as domains.yaml text. */
export function onboardingSkeleton(root: string): string {
  const bare = { version: 1, layers: [{ id: 'x', name: 'x' }], ignore: SKELETON_IGNORE, domains: [], invariants: [] } as DomainMap;
  const facts = scanRepo(root, bare);
  return mapToYaml(skeletonMap(facts.files, toFileFacts(facts)), '# Instant skeleton (deterministic, no model). The cartographer refines it.\n\n');
}
```

```typescript
// Route paths and file-based routes (Next.js). Pure and browser-safe.
import type { RouteFact } from '../contracts/facts';

export const HTTP_METHODS = ['GET', 'POST', 'PUT', 'PATCH', 'DELETE', 'HEAD', 'OPTIONS'];

/**
 * Normalize a route path so ids are stable: params (`:id`, `{id}`, `[id]`, `[...x]`, regex groups `([\w-]+)`) become `{}`,
 * regex anchors and escapes are dropped, and a leading `/` is ensured.
 */
export function normalizeRoutePath(raw: string): string {
  let p = raw.trim().replace(/^\^/, '').replace(/\$$/, '').replace(/\\\//g, '/');
  p = p.replace(/\((?:[^()\\]|\\.)*\)\??/g, '{}'); // regex capture groups
  p = p.replace(/\[\[?\.{0,3}[^\]/]*\]?\]/g, '{}'); // [id], [...slug], [[...slug]]
  p = p.replace(/:[A-Za-z_$][\w$]*\??/g, '{}').replace(/\{[^}/]+\}/g, '{}').replace(/\*+/g, '{}');
  p = p.replace(/\\(.)/g, '$1').replace(/\/+/g, '/');
  if (!p.startsWith('/')) p = `/${p}`;
  return p.length > 1 ? p.replace(/\/$/, '') : p;
}

export const routeId = (method: string, path: string) => `route:${method} ${path}`;

export function routeFact(method: string, rawPath: string, file: string, handler: string | null): RouteFact {
  const m = method.toUpperCase() === 'ALL' ? 'ANY' : method.toUpperCase();
  const path = normalizeRoutePath(rawPath);
  return { id: routeId(m, path), method: m, path, file, handler };
}

const NEXT_APP_ROUTE = /(?:^|\/)app\/((?:.*\/)?)route\.[cm]?[jt]sx?$/;
const NEXT_APP_PAGE = /(?:^|\/)app\/((?:.*\/)?)page\.[cm]?[jt]sx?$/;
const NEXT_PAGES = /(?:^|\/)pages\/(.*)\.[cm]?[jt]sx?$/;

/** URL path for a Next.js segment list: route groups `(x)` and slots `@x` drop out. */
const segmentsToPath = (dir: string) =>
  normalizeRoutePath(`/${dir.split('/').filter((s) => s && !/^\(.*\)$/.test(s) && !s.startsWith('@')).join('/')}`);

/** Next.js file-based routes and pages for `path`, given its export names. Handlers are symbol names in the file. */
export function nextRoutes(path: string, exportNames: readonly string[]): { routes: { method: string; path: string; symbol: string }[]; page: string | null } {
  let m = NEXT_APP_ROUTE.exec(path);
  if (m) {
    const url = segmentsToPath(m[1]!);
    return { routes: exportNames.filter((n) => HTTP_METHODS.includes(n)).map((n) => ({ method: n, path: url, symbol: n })), page: null };
  }
  m = NEXT_APP_PAGE.exec(path);
  if (m) return { routes: [], page: segmentsToPath(m[1]!) };
  m = NEXT_PAGES.exec(path);
  if (m) {
    const rest = m[1]!.replace(/(?:^|\/)index$/, '');
    if (/^api(?:\/|$)/.test(rest)) return { routes: exportNames.includes('default') ? [{ method: 'ANY', path: segmentsToPath(rest), symbol: 'default' }] : [], page: null };
    if (/(?:^|\/)_(?:app|document|error)$/.test(rest) || /^_/.test(rest)) return { routes: [], page: null };
    return { routes: [], page: segmentsToPath(rest) };
  }
  return { routes: [], page: null };
}
```

```typescript
// Lazy per-graph indexes, cached by identity (graphs are treated as immutable once built).
import type { ContextGraph, GraphEdge } from '../contracts/graph';

const memo = <T>(build: (g: ContextGraph) => T) => {
  const cache = new WeakMap<ContextGraph, T>();
  return (g: ContextGraph): T => {
    let v = cache.get(g);
    if (v === undefined) cache.set(g, (v = build(g)));
    return v;
  };
};

/** from → leaf edges, in graph order. */
export const outEdges = memo((g) => {
  const out = new Map<string, GraphEdge[]>();
  for (const e of g.edges) {
    const list = out.get(e.from);
    if (list) list.push(e);
    else out.set(e.from, [e]);
  }
  return out;
});

export const edgeIds = memo((g) => new Set(g.edges.map((e) => e.id)));

/** Files in a subtree (a file counts itself) and symbols strictly below a node; memoized for containers only. */
export const subtreeCounts = memo((g) => {
  const cache = new Map<string, { files: number; symbols: number }>();
  const count = (id: string): { files: number; symbols: number } => {
    const kids = g.children[id];
    const self = g.nodes[id]!.kind === 'file' ? 1 : 0;
    if (!kids?.length) return { files: self, symbols: 0 };
    let c = cache.get(id);
    if (c) return c;
    c = { files: self, symbols: 0 };
    for (const k of kids) {
      const s = count(k);
      c.files += s.files;
      c.symbols += s.symbols + (g.nodes[k]!.kind === 'symbol' ? 1 : 0);
    }
    cache.set(id, c);
    return c;
  };
  return count;
});

/** Ancestors of `id` from the root down, including `id`. */
export function pathTo(g: ContextGraph, id: string): string[] {
  const out: string[] = [];
  for (let n: string | null = id; n; n = g.nodes[n]?.parent ?? null) out.push(n);
  return out.reverse();
}

export const byId = (a: string, b: string) => (a < b ? -1 : a > b ? 1 : 0);

```

```css
  --v2-line: #a7b4c0;
  --v2-line-soft: #c5cfd8;
  --v2-ink: #142130;
  --v2-ink-2: #4a5a6b;
  --v2-ink-3: #8090a0;
  --v2-agent: #3a35d4;
  --v2-agent-wash: #e2e1fa;
  --v2-agent-ink: #ffffff;
  --v2-amber: #e59d1f;
  --v2-amber-wash: #fbebc8;
  --v2-amber-ink: #5f3d00;
  --v2-red: #c9302a;
  --v2-red-wash: #f8dfdb;
  --v2-edge: #7d8b99;
  --v2-tick: #9aa8b5;
  --v2-dots: transparent;
  --v2-chrome: #eef2f5;
  --v2-chrome-line: #c3ccd5;
  --v2-r-cell: 2px;
  --v2-r-file: 2px;
  --v2-head: 'Barlow Semi Condensed', 'Barlow', system-ui, sans-serif;
  --v2-sans: 'Barlow', system-ui, sans-serif;
  --v2-mono: 'JetBrains Mono', ui-monospace, Menlo, monospace;
  --v2-glow: none;
  color-scheme: light;
}

[data-theme='control'] {
  --v2-ground: #0c141e;
  --v2-band: #08101a;
  --v2-cell: #132030;
  --v2-container: #101b29;
  --v2-file: #19283a;
  --v2-line: #2b3c52;
  --v2-line-soft: #1f2d3f;
  --v2-ink: #e3ebf4;
  --v2-ink-2: #97a8bc;
  --v2-ink-3: #62758c;
  --v2-agent: #8e88ff;
  --v2-agent-wash: rgb(142 136 255 / 0.16);
  --v2-agent-ink: #0c0b2a;
  --v2-amber: #ffb22e;
  --v2-amber-wash: rgb(255 178 46 / 0.16);
  --v2-amber-ink: #2a1a00;
  --v2-red: #ff5a50;
  --v2-red-wash: rgb(255 90 80 / 0.14);
  --v2-edge: #50637a;
  --v2-tick: transparent;
  --v2-dots: #23344a;
  --v2-chrome: #0a121b;
  --v2-chrome-line: #1d2b3c;
  --v2-r-cell: 6px;
  --v2-r-file: 5px;
  --v2-head: 'Barlow Semi Condensed', 'Barlow', system-ui, sans-serif;
  --v2-sans: 'Barlow', system-ui, sans-serif;
  --v2-mono: 'JetBrains Mono', ui-monospace, Menlo, monospace;
  --v2-glow: 0 0 0 1px rgb(142 136 255 / 0.9), 0 0 22px 2px rgb(142 136 255 / 0.45);
  color-scheme: dark;
}

[data-theme='strata'] {
  --v2-ground: #dfe4ea;
  --v2-band: #f8f9fb;          /* the plane in focus */
  --v2-cell: #eef1f5;
  --v2-container: #f1f4f7;
  --v2-file: #ffffff;
  --v2-line: #b3bdc8;
  --v2-line-soft: #d3dae2;
  --v2-ink: #111c2a;
  --v2-ink-2: #4b5a6a;
  --v2-ink-3: #8794a3;
  --v2-agent: #4136cf;
  --v2-agent-wash: #e4e2fb;
  --v2-agent-ink: #ffffff;
  --v2-amber: #e49a17;
  --v2-amber-wash: #fbebc7;
  --v2-amber-ink: #5f3d00;
  --v2-red: #cc2e29;
  --v2-red-wash: #f9dfdc;
  --v2-edge: #8592a0;
  --v2-tick: transparent;
  --v2-dots: transparent;
  --v2-chrome: #e9edf1;
  --v2-chrome-line: #cfd6de;
  --v2-r-cell: 12px;
  --v2-r-file: 8px;
  --v2-head: 'Barlow', system-ui, sans-serif;
  --v2-sans: 'Barlow', system-ui, sans-serif;
  --v2-mono: 'JetBrains Mono', ui-monospace, Menlo, monospace;
  --v2-glow: none;
  color-scheme: light;
}

/* ------------------------------------------------------------ map */
.v2-map {
  position: relative; flex: 1; min-height: 0; height: 100%;
  background: var(--v2-ground); color: var(--v2-ink); font-family: var(--v2-sans);
  --ease: cubic-bezier(0.25, 0.8, 0.3, 1);
}
.v2-map .react-flow { background: transparent; }
.v2-map .react-flow__node { cursor: default; }
.v2-map .react-flow__viewport-portal { pointer-events: none; }
[data-theme='strata'] .v2-map { background: linear-gradient(180deg, #e7ebf0 0%, #d7dee6 100%); }

/* band: the open domain's column */
.v2-band { width: 100%; height: 100%; background: var(--v2-band); border-radius: calc(var(--v2-r-cell) + 6px); }
.v2-band-name { display: none; }
[data-theme='atlas'] .v2-band { box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px var(--v2-line-soft); }
[data-theme='control'] .v2-band { box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px #1a2a3d; }
[data-theme='strata'] .v2-band { box-shadow: 0 1px 0 rgb(255 255 255 / 0.8) inset, 0 40px 80px -30px rgb(20 32 52 / 0.35), 0 0 0 1px rgb(20 32 52 / 0.06); }

/* collapsed cell (System level) */
.v2-cell {
  position: relative; width: 100%; height: 100%; box-sizing: border-box;
  display: flex; flex-direction: column; justify-content: space-between;
  padding: 12px 14px 10px; border-radius: var(--v2-r-cell);
  background: var(--v2-cell); border: 1px solid var(--v2-line-soft);
}
.v2-cell-files { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 3px; min-width: 0; }
.v2-cell-file { font: 500 15px/1.25 var(--v2-mono); white-space: nowrap; overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; }
.v2-cell-more { font-size: 13px; color: var(--v2-ink-3); }
.v2-cell-foot { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: baseline; font-size: 13px; color: var(--v2-ink-2); }
.v2-cell-count.is-big { font: 600 44px/1 var(--v2-head); color: var(--v2-ink-2); margin: auto; }

/* spine: a compressed column's cell, state only */
.v2-spine {
  position: relative; width: 100%; height: 100%; box-sizing: border-box; border-radius: var(--v2-r-cell);
  background: var(--v2-cell); border: 1px solid var(--v2-line-soft);
  display: flex; align-items: flex-end; justify-content: center; padding-bottom: 8px;
}
.v2-spine-count { font: 600 15px/1 var(--v2-head); color: var(--v2-ink-3); font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }
.v2-spine.is-edited .v2-spine-count, .v2-spine.is-unplanned .v2-spine-count { color: inherit; }

/* container: an expanded cell holding files */
.v2-container {
  width: 100%; height: 100%; box-sizing: border-box; border-radius: var(--v2-r-cell);
  background: var(--v2-container); border: 1px solid var(--v2-line);
}
.v2-container.has-new { border-color: var(--v2-red); }
.v2-container-head { display: flex; align-items: baseline; gap: 10px; padding: 11px 16px 0 18px; }
.v2-container-name { font: 600 19px/1 var(--v2-head); letter-spacing: 0.01em; }
.v2-container-count { font-size: 13.5px; color: var(--v2-ink-3); }
.v2-container .v2-diff { margin-left: auto; }

/* file */
.v2-file {
  position: relative; width: 100%; height: 100%; box-sizing: border-box;
  display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; padding: 0 12px;
  border-radius: var(--v2-r-file); background: var(--v2-file); border: 1px solid var(--v2-line);
}
.v2-file-name { font: 500 15px/1 var(--v2-mono); white-space: nowrap; overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; min-width: 0; flex: 1; }
.v2-file-meta { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; }
.v2-file.lod-far { padding: 0; }

/* ------------------------------------------------------------ states (cells, spines, files) */
.is-looked { border: 1.5px dashed var(--v2-agent); }
.is-edited { background: var(--v2-agent); border-color: var(--v2-agent); color: var(--v2-agent-ink); }
.is-edited .v2-cell-foot, .is-edited .v2-cell-more { color: inherit; opacity: 0.85; }
.is-unplanned { background: var(--v2-amber); border-color: var(--v2-amber); color: var(--v2-amber-ink); }
.is-unplanned .v2-cell-foot { color: var(--v2-amber-ink); }
.is-ghost { border: 1.5px dashed color-mix(in srgb, var(--v2-agent) 60%, transparent); background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--v2-agent-wash) 55%, var(--v2-file)); }
.v2-file.is-planned-new { background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--v2-agent-wash) 40%, transparent); }
.v2-file.is-planned-new .v2-file-name { font-style: italic; }
.is-violation { box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 2px var(--v2-red); }
.is-new-violation { box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 2.5px var(--v2-red); border-color: var(--v2-red); }
.v2-file.is-cursor { outline: 2.5px solid var(--v2-agent); outline-offset: 3px; box-shadow: var(--v2-glow); }
.v2-file.is-cursor.is-new-violation { box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 2.5px var(--v2-red), var(--v2-glow); }

.v2-diff { display: inline-flex; gap: 6px; font: 600 13.5px/1 var(--v2-mono); font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }
.v2-diff .plus, .v2-diff .minus { opacity: 0.9; }
.v2-container .v2-diff .plus { color: var(--v2-agent); }
.v2-container .v2-diff .minus { color: var(--v2-ink-3); }

.v2-steps { position: absolute; top: -10px; right: 10px; display: flex; gap: 3px; }
.v2-step {
  min-width: 20px; height: 20px; padding: 0 5px; box-sizing: border-box; border-radius: 10px;
  display: grid; place-content: center; font: 700 12px/1 var(--v2-sans);
  background: var(--v2-agent); color: var(--v2-agent-ink); box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px var(--v2-ground);
}
.v2-file .v2-steps { position: static; }
.v2-file .v2-step { box-shadow: none; }

.v2-vmark {
  position: absolute; top: -10px; left: 10px; height: 20px; padding: 0 7px; box-sizing: border-box; border-radius: 10px;
  display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 5px; font: 700 12px/1 var(--v2-sans); letter-spacing: 0.02em;
  background: var(--v2-file); color: var(--v2-red); box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1.5px var(--v2-red);
}
.v2-vmark.is-new { background: var(--v2-red); color: #fff; box-shadow: none; }
.v2-vmark b { font-weight: 700; }
.v2-file .v2-vmark { top: -11px; left: auto; right: -8px; }
.v2-spine .v2-vmark { left: 50%; transform: translateX(-50%); top: 8px; padding: 0 6px; }
.v2-spine .v2-steps { right: 50%; transform: translateX(50%); top: 34px; }

/* ------------------------------------------------------------ edges */
.v2-edges { position: absolute; left: 0; top: 0; overflow: visible; pointer-events: none; }
.v2-ticks { fill: none; stroke: var(--v2-tick); stroke-width: 1; }
.v2-edge-line { fill: none; stroke: var(--v2-edge); stroke-width: 1.6px; stroke-linejoin: round; }
.v2-arrowhead { fill: var(--v2-edge); }
.v2-edge.is-new .v2-edge-line { stroke: var(--v2-agent); stroke-width: 2.4px; }
.v2-arrowhead.is-new, .v2-arrowhead.is-ghost { fill: var(--v2-agent); }
.v2-edge.is-ghost .v2-edge-line { stroke: var(--v2-agent); stroke-dasharray: 7 5; stroke-width: 2px; opacity: 0.85; }
.v2-edge.is-violation .v2-edge-line { stroke: var(--v2-red); stroke-width: 2.4px; opacity: 1; }
.v2-arrowhead.is-violation { fill: var(--v2-red); }
.v2-edge-tag rect { fill: var(--v2-ground); stroke: var(--v2-line); }
.v2-edge-tag text { font: 700 12px var(--v2-sans); fill: var(--v2-ink-2); }
.v2-edge.is-ghost .v2-edge-tag rect { fill: var(--v2-agent); stroke: none; }
.v2-edge.is-ghost .v2-edge-tag text { fill: var(--v2-agent-ink); }
.v2-edge.is-violation .v2-edge-tag rect { fill: var(--v2-red); stroke: none; }
.v2-edge.is-violation .v2-edge-tag text { fill: #fff; }

/* stage 3 of a transition: new nodes fade in, changed edges draw in (one-shot, never looping) */
.v2-enter { animation: v2-fade-in 200ms var(--ease) 300ms backwards; }
.v2-edge.is-enter { animation: v2-fade-in 200ms var(--ease) 300ms backwards; }
.v2-edge.is-enter:not(.is-ghost) .v2-edge-line { stroke-dasharray: 1; animation: v2-draw 220ms var(--ease) 300ms backwards; }
@keyframes v2-fade-in { from { opacity: 0; } to { opacity: 1; } }
@keyframes v2-draw { from { stroke-dashoffset: 1; } to { stroke-dashoffset: 0; } }

/* agent cursor */
.v2-cursor {
  position: absolute; left: 0; top: 0; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; z-index: 5;
  transition: transform 250ms var(--ease); white-space: nowrap;
}
.v2-cursor-avatar {
  width: 28px; height: 28px; border-radius: 50%; display: grid; place-content: center;
  background: var(--v2-agent); color: var(--v2-agent-ink); font: 700 14px/1 var(--v2-sans);
  box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px var(--v2-ground), var(--v2-glow);
}
.v2-cursor-label {
  padding: 5px 11px; border-radius: 14px; font: 600 14px/1 var(--v2-sans);
  background: var(--v2-agent); color: var(--v2-agent-ink); box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px var(--v2-ground);
}
.v2-cursor-label code { font: 600 13.5px/1 var(--v2-mono); }

/* ------------------------------------------------------------ screen-space headers */
.v2-headers { position: absolute; inset: 0; pointer-events: none; z-index: 5; }
.v2-colheads {
  position: absolute; left: 0; right: 0; top: 0; height: var(--hdr-h);
  background: linear-gradient(180deg, var(--v2-ground) 70%, color-mix(in srgb, var(--v2-ground) 0%, transparent));
}
.v2-colhead {
  position: absolute; left: 0; top: 0; height: 100%; padding: 0 6px 10px; border: 0; background: none;
  display: flex; flex-direction: column; justify-content: flex-end; align-items: center; gap: 3px;
  color: var(--v2-ink); pointer-events: auto; cursor: pointer; text-align: center;
}
.v2-colhead-name { font: 600 18px/1.05 var(--v2-head); letter-spacing: 0.005em; }
.v2-colhead-purpose { font: 400 13.5px/1.2 var(--v2-sans); color: var(--v2-ink-2); }
.v2-colhead.is-spine .v2-colhead-name { font-size: 14.5px; color: var(--v2-ink-2); }
.v2-colhead.is-expanded .v2-colhead-name { font-size: 22px; }
.v2-colhead:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--v2-agent); outline-offset: -2px; border-radius: 4px; }
.v2-colhead-marks { position: absolute; top: 8px; display: flex; gap: 4px; }
.v2-colhead-marks i { width: 8px; height: 8px; border-radius: 50%; display: block; }
.v2-colhead-marks .is-edited { background: var(--v2-agent); }
.v2-colhead-marks .is-unplanned { background: var(--v2-amber); }
.v2-colhead-marks .is-ghost { box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1.5px var(--v2-agent); }
.v2-colhead-marks .is-existing-violation { box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 2px var(--v2-red); }
.v2-colhead-marks .is-new-violation { background: var(--v2-red); }
.v2-rowheads {
  position: absolute; left: 0; top: 0; bottom: 0; width: var(--lbl-w);
  background: linear-gradient(90deg, var(--v2-ground) 72%, color-mix(in srgb, var(--v2-ground) 0%, transparent));
}
.v2-rowhead { position: absolute; left: 0; top: 0; width: 100%; display: flex; align-items: center; padding-left: 22px; box-sizing: border-box; }
.v2-rowhead span { font: 500 15.5px/1 var(--v2-head); color: var(--v2-ink-2); }

/* ------------------------------------------------------------ comp shell */
.v2-shell {
  display: grid; grid-template-columns: 340px minmax(0, 1fr); grid-template-rows: 76px minmax(0, 1fr);
  grid-template-areas: 'rail top' 'rail stage'; height: 100vh;
  background: var(--v2-ground); color: var(--v2-ink); font-family: var(--v2-sans);
}
.v2-stage { grid-area: stage; position: relative; min-height: 0; display: flex; }
.v2-top {
  grid-area: top; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 24px;
  padding: 0 36px 0 30px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--v2-chrome-line); background: var(--v2-ground);
}
.v2-rail {
  grid-area: rail; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 18px; padding: 22px 26px;
  background: var(--v2-chrome); border-right: 1px solid var(--v2-chrome-line); overflow: hidden;
}
.v2-brand { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; height: 32px; margin-bottom: 14px; }
.v2-brand-mark { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 9px 9px; gap: 3px; }
.v2-brand-mark span { width: 9px; height: 9px; border-radius: 2px; background: var(--v2-ink); }
.v2-brand-mark span:nth-child(2) { background: var(--v2-agent); }
.v2-brand-mark span:nth-child(3) { opacity: 0.25; }
.v2-brand-name { font: 600 20px/1 var(--v2-head); }
.v2-brand-repo { font: 500 13.5px/1 var(--v2-mono); color: var(--v2-ink-2); padding-left: 10px; border-left: 1px solid var(--v2-chrome-line); }
.v2-rail-turn { margin: 0; font: 600 14px/1 var(--v2-head); color: var(--v2-ink-3); }
.v2-prompt { margin: -8px 0 4px; font: 500 21px/1.3 var(--v2-sans); }
.v2-plan { list-style: none; margin: 0; padding: 0; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 10px; }
.v2-plan li { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 26px 1fr; gap: 10px; align-items: start; font-size: 15.5px; line-height: 1.35; }
.v2-plan-n {
  width: 24px; height: 24px; border-radius: 12px; display: grid; place-content: center; font: 700 13px/1 var(--v2-sans);
  box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1.5px var(--v2-agent); color: var(--v2-agent);
}
.v2-plan .is-done .v2-plan-n { background: var(--v2-agent); color: var(--v2-agent-ink); box-shadow: none; }
.v2-plan .is-done .v2-plan-text { color: var(--v2-ink-2); }
.v2-plan .is-here .v2-plan-text { font-weight: 600; }
.v2-plan .is-here .v2-plan-n { box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 2.5px var(--v2-agent), var(--v2-glow); }
.v2-note { border-radius: 8px; padding: 13px 15px; }
.v2-note h3 { margin: 0 0 5px; font: 600 16px/1.2 var(--v2-head); }
.v2-note p { margin: 0; font-size: 14.5px; line-height: 1.4; }
.v2-note code { font: 500 13.5px var(--v2-mono); }
.v2-note p code + code::before { content: ', '; font-family: var(--v2-sans); }
.v2-note.is-red { background: var(--v2-red-wash); box-shadow: inset 3px 0 0 var(--v2-red); }
.v2-note.is-red h3 { color: var(--v2-red); }
.v2-note.is-amber { background: var(--v2-amber-wash); box-shadow: inset 3px 0 0 var(--v2-amber); }

.v2-crumbs ol { list-style: none; display: flex; align-items: center; margin: 0; padding: 0; font: 500 17px/1 var(--v2-head); }
.v2-crumbs li { display: flex; align-items: center; color: var(--v2-ink-2); }
.v2-crumbs li + li::before { content: '›'; margin: 0 10px; color: var(--v2-ink-3); }
.v2-crumbs button { border: 0; background: none; padding: 4px 2px; font: inherit; color: inherit; cursor: pointer; }
.v2-crumbs button:hover { color: var(--v2-agent); }
.v2-crumbs [aria-current] { color: var(--v2-ink); font-weight: 600; }

.v2-ledger { display: flex; gap: 34px; margin: 0; }
.v2-counter { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 4px; min-width: 70px; }
.v2-counter dd, .v2-counter dt { margin: 0; }
.v2-counter dd { font: 600 30px/1 var(--v2-head); font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }
.v2-counter dt { font-size: 13px; color: var(--v2-ink-2); line-height: 1.15; max-width: 110px; }

.v2-legend {
  position: absolute; left: 96px; bottom: 18px; z-index: 6; display: flex; gap: 22px; margin: 0; padding: 0; list-style: none;
  font-size: 14px; color: var(--v2-ink-2);
}
.v2-legend li { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 7px; }
.v2-legend i { width: 18px; height: 13px; border-radius: 3px; display: block; box-sizing: border-box; background: var(--v2-file); border: 1px solid var(--v2-line); }
.v2-legend .k-looked { border: 1.5px dashed var(--v2-agent); }
.v2-legend .k-edited { background: var(--v2-agent); border-color: var(--v2-agent); }
.v2-legend .k-unplanned { background: var(--v2-amber); border-color: var(--v2-amber); }
.v2-legend .k-ghost { border: 1.5px dashed var(--v2-agent); background: var(--v2-agent-wash); }
.v2-legend .k-existing { box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 2px var(--v2-red); border: 0; }
.v2-legend .k-new { background: var(--v2-red); border: 0; }

/* ------------------------------------------------------------ direction signatures */
/* Atlas: hairline sheet, registration marks at gutter crossings, region names set like a map. */
[data-theme='atlas'] .v2-colhead-name { letter-spacing: 0.03em; }
[data-theme='atlas'] .v2-colheads { border-bottom: 1px solid var(--v2-line-soft); background: var(--v2-ground); }
[data-theme='atlas'] .v2-rowheads { border-right: 1px solid var(--v2-line-soft); background: var(--v2-ground); }
[data-theme='atlas'] .v2-rowhead span { font-style: italic; font-family: var(--v2-sans); font-weight: 400; }
[data-theme='atlas'] .v2-file { border-color: var(--v2-line); }

/* Control room: dark instruments, the agent alone glows; everything else is flat. */
[data-theme='control'] .v2-colheads { border-bottom: 1px solid var(--v2-chrome-line); background: var(--v2-chrome); }
[data-theme='control'] .v2-rowheads { border-right: 1px solid var(--v2-chrome-line); background: var(--v2-chrome); }
[data-theme='control'] .v2-counter dd { font-family: var(--v2-mono); font-weight: 500; font-size: 28px; }
[data-theme='control'] .v2-counter dd { color: var(--v2-ink); }
[data-theme='control'] .v2-edge-tag rect { fill: var(--v2-chrome); }
[data-theme='control'] .is-edited { box-shadow: 0 0 0 1px var(--v2-agent); }
[data-theme='control'] .v2-vmark { background: var(--v2-ground); }
[data-theme='control'] .v2-note.is-red h3 { color: var(--v2-red); }
[data-theme='control'] .v2-note.is-amber h3 { color: var(--v2-amber); }

/* Strata: depth of field. The open domain is the focal plane; parent levels recede (faded, slightly blurred);
   type size follows depth. */
[data-theme='strata'] .v2-colheads, [data-theme='strata'] .v2-rowheads { background: none; }
[data-theme='strata'] .v2-colhead.is-spine { opacity: 0.32; filter: blur(0.6px); }
[data-theme='strata'] .v2-colhead.is-expanded .v2-colhead-name { font-size: 34px; font-weight: 300; letter-spacing: -0.01em; }
[data-theme='strata'] .v2-colhead.is-expanded .v2-colhead-purpose { font-size: 14px; }
[data-theme='strata'] .v2-spine, [data-theme='strata'] .v2-cell { opacity: 0.14; filter: blur(1.4px); }
[data-theme='strata'] .v2-container { border-color: var(--v2-line-soft); background: var(--v2-container); }
[data-theme='strata'] .v2-container-name { font: 500 21px/1 var(--v2-sans); }
[data-theme='strata'] .v2-file { box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgb(20 32 52 / 0.08); }
[data-theme='strata'] .v2-file.is-edited, [data-theme='strata'] .v2-file.is-unplanned { box-shadow: 0 6px 14px -6px rgb(20 32 52 / 0.35); }
[data-theme='strata'] .v2-top { background: none; border-bottom: 0; }
[data-theme='strata'] .v2-rail { background: rgb(255 255 255 / 0.55); }
[data-theme='strata'] .v2-shell { background: linear-gradient(180deg, #e7ebf0 0%, #d7dee6 100%); }

@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
  .v2-enter, .v2-edge.is-enter, .v2-edge.is-enter .v2-edge-line { animation: none !important; }
  .v2-cursor { transition: none; }
}
```

```typescript
    for (const e of f.entries) add(scoped({ id: e.id, kind: 'entry', parent: path, label: e.label }, file), KIND_RANK.entry!);

  const callsOf = (path: string, f: FileFacts): CallFact[] => {
    const s = semantic[path];
    return s && s.hash === f.hash ? s.calls : f.calls;
  };
  const importers = new Map<string, Set<string>>();
  const noteVendor = (v: string, from: string) => {
    const set = importers.get(v) ?? new Set<string>();
    const d = mapper.domainOf(fileOf(from) ?? from);
    if (d) set.add(d);
    importers.set(v, set);
  };
  for (const path of placement.keys()) {
    const f = facts[path];
    if (!f) continue;
    for (const i of f.imports) if (i.to.startsWith('vendor:')) noteVendor(i.to, path);
    for (const c of callsOf(path, f)) if (c.to.startsWith('vendor:')) noteVendor(c.to, c.from);
  }
  const externals = map.domains.flatMap((d) => (d.cells[EXTERNAL_LAYER] ? [{ domain: d.id, globs: d.cells[EXTERNAL_LAYER]!.paths ?? [] }] : []));

    const owner = externals.find((e) => doms.has(e.domain) && claims(e.globs)) ?? externals.find((e) => claims(e.globs));
    if (owner) add({ id: v, kind: 'vendor', parent: cellId(owner.domain, EXTERNAL_LAYER), label: pkg, domain: owner.domain, layer: EXTERNAL_LAYER }, KIND_RANK.vendor!);
    else add({ id: v, kind: 'vendor', parent: ensureTop(VENDORS_ID).id, label: pkg }, KIND_RANK.vendor!);
  }

  // ---- leaf edges, grouped by owner file (in path order) and sorted by id within it
  const edges: GraphEdge[] = [];
  const seen = new Map<string, GraphEdge>();
  let local = new Map<string, GraphEdge>();
  const resolve = (id: string): string | null => {
    if (nodes[id]) return id;
    if (id.startsWith('table:')) return ensureTable(id).id;
    const f = fileOf(id);
    return f && nodes[f] ? f : null;
  };
  const edge = (kind: EdgeKind, from: string | null, to: string | null, owner: string, count: number, typeOnly?: boolean, confidence?: CallConfidence) => {
    if (!from || !to) return;
    const id = edgeId(kind, from, to);
    const cur = local.get(id) ?? seen.get(id);
    if (cur) {
      cur.count += count;
      if (typeOnly === false) cur.typeOnly = false;
      return;
    }
    const e: GraphEdge = { id, kind, from, to, count, owner };
    if (typeOnly !== undefined) e.typeOnly = typeOnly;
    if (confidence) e.confidence = confidence;
    local.set(id, e);
  };
  for (const path of placement.keys()) {
    const f = facts[path];
    if (!f) continue;
    for (const i of f.imports) edge(i.to.startsWith('vendor:') ? 'uses' : 'imports', path, resolve(i.to), path, 1, i.typeOnly);
    for (const c of callsOf(path, f)) edge('calls', resolve(c.from), resolve(c.to), path, c.count, undefined, c.confidence);
    const s = semantic[path];
    if (s && s.hash === f.hash) for (const im of s.implements) edge('implements', resolve(im.from), resolve(im.to), path, 1);
    for (const w of f.writes) edge('writes', w.symbol ? resolve(w.symbol) : path, ensureTable(tableId(w.table)).id, path, 1);
    for (const r of f.routes) if (r.handler) edge('handles', r.id, resolve(r.handler), path, 1);
    if (!local.size) continue;
    for (const e of [...local.values()].sort((a, b) => (a.id < b.id ? -1 : 1))) { edges.push(e); seen.set(e.id, e); }
    local = new Map();
  }

  // ---- children, sorted by (rank, id); `order` is the sibling index (domains/cells: their grid index)
  for (const [parent, list] of Object.entries(children)) {
    list.sort((a, b) => rank.get(a)! - rank.get(b)! || (a < b ? -1 : a > b ? 1 : 0));
    const grid = parent === ROOT_ID || nodes[parent]!.kind === 'domain';
    for (let i = 0; i < list.length; i++) nodes[list[i]!]!.order = grid ? rank.get(list[i]!)! : i;
  }
  return { root: ROOT_ID, nodes, children, edges };
```

```bash
// elkjs's own worker script, loaded only on the first layout (the v1 map never pulls it in).
type ElkApi = { layout(g: ElkNode): Promise<ElkNode> };
let elk: Promise<ElkApi> | null = null;
const cache = new Map<string, ContainerLayout>();

function getElk(): Promise<ElkApi> {
  elk ??= Promise.all([import('elkjs/lib/elk-api.js'), import('elkjs/lib/elk-worker.min.js?url')]).then(([api, url]) => {
    const ELK = api.default;
    return new ELK({ workerFactory: () => new Worker(url.default) }) as ElkApi;
  });
  return elk;
}

/** Cached by the container's children, edges and ports (and the elkjs version, via the bundle). `ms` is the worker round trip. */
export async function layoutContainer(c: ContainerInput): Promise<ContainerLayout> {
  const key = JSON.stringify(c);
  const hit = cache.get(key);
  if (hit) return hit;
  const api = await getElk();
  const t0 = performance.now();
  const out = await api.layout(elkGraph(c));
  const l = readLayout(c, out, performance.now() - t0);
  cache.set(key, l);
  return l;
}

export const clearLayoutCache = () => cache.clear();
```

```text
function commonDir(files: string[]): string {
  let parts = files[0]!.split('/').slice(0, -1);
  for (const f of files) {
    const p = f.split('/');
    let i = 0;
    while (i < parts.length && i < p.length - 1 && parts[i] === p[i]) i++;
```

```typescript
        { title: 'Broken.', rationale: '', yaml: 'domains: [' },
        { title: 'No change.', rationale: '', yaml: input.yaml },
      ],
    };
  };
}

function setup(yaml: string | null = mapYaml, opts: { proposer?: Proposer | null; labeler?: Labeler | null } = {}) {
  const root = sandbox(yaml);
  const bus = new Bus(root, { fresh: true });
  const repo = new Repo(root, bus);
  repo.loadMapFile();
  bus.emit('map_confirmed', { map: repo.map, source: 'file' }, { turn: null });
  repo.scan();
  const calls: ProposeInput[] = [];
  const lm = attachLivingMap({ bus, repo, proposer: opts.proposer === undefined ? fakeProposer(calls) : opts.proposer, labeler: opts.labeler ?? null, gitLimit: 50 });
  /** A coding turn as the session drives it: hooks report edits, then turn_ended, then the turn closes. */
  const turn = (id: string, write: () => string[]) => {
    bus.turn = id;
    bus.emit('turn_started', { prompt: `turn ${id}`, head: '', baseline: '' });
    for (const p of write()) repo.fileChanged(p, { tool: 'Write' });
    bus.emit('turn_ended', { added: 1, removed: 0, files: [], reason: 'success' });
    bus.turn = null;
  };
  const writeBilling = () => {
    mkdirSync(join(root, 'src/billing'), { recursive: true });
    for (const [p, text] of Object.entries(FILES)) writeFileSync(join(root, p), text);
    return Object.keys(FILES);
  };
  const touchInvoice = () => { appendFileSync(join(root, 'src/billing/invoice.ts'), '\nexport const VERSION = 1;\n'); return ['src/billing/invoice.ts']; };
  const of = <K extends keyof EventData>(kind: K) => bus.events.filter((e): e is HarnessEvent & { data: EventData[K] } => e.kind === kind).map((e) => e.data as EventData[K]);
  return { root, bus, repo, lm, calls, turn, writeBilling, touchInvoice, of };
}

describe('living-map loop (fake proposer)', () => {
  it('drift persists over two turns → scored proposal → accept commits only domains.yaml and reloads the map', async () => {
    const { root, repo, lm, calls, turn, writeBilling, touchInvoice, of, bus } = setup();

    turn('t1', writeBilling);
    await lm.idle();
    const d1 = of('drift_detected').at(-1)!.signals;
    expect(d1.find((s) => s.signal === 'unassigned')).toMatchObject({ value: 3, scope: BILLING, persisted: 1 });
    expect(calls).toHaveLength(0);

    turn('t2', touchInvoice);
    await lm.idle();
    const d2 = of('drift_detected').at(-1)!.signals;
    expect(d2.find((s) => s.signal === 'unassigned')).toMatchObject({ value: 3, persisted: 2 });
    expect(d2.find((s) => s.signal === 'new_top_level')).toMatchObject({ persisted: 2 });
    expect(calls).toHaveLength(1);
    expect(calls[0]!.signals.map((s) => s.signal)).toEqual(['unassigned', 'new_top_level']);
    expect(calls[0]!.rejected).toEqual([]);
    expect(calls[0]!.turns.map((t) => t.files)).toEqual([BILLING, ['src/billing/invoice.ts']]);
    expect(calls[0]!.scope).toEqual(expect.arrayContaining([...BILLING]));

    const proposed = of('map_proposed').filter((p) => p.proposal);
    expect(proposed).toHaveLength(1);
    const { proposal, yaml, map } = proposed[0]!;
    expect(yaml).toBe(mapYaml); // the current map rides along unchanged; the reducer keeps it
    expect(map.domains.map((d) => d.id)).not.toContain('billing');
    expect(proposal!.id).toBe('MP-1');
    expect(proposal!.candidates).toHaveLength(2); // invalid and no-op candidates dropped
    expect(proposal!.changes).toContainEqual({ kind: 'add_domain', domain: 'billing', name: 'Billing' });
    expect(proposal!.changes.filter((c) => c.kind === 'place')).toHaveLength(3);
    const chosen = proposal!.candidates[proposal!.chosen]!;
    expect(chosen.score.unassigned).toBe(0);
    expect(proposal!.current.unassigned).toBe(3);
    expect(chosen.score.modularity).toBeGreaterThan(proposal!.current.modularity);
    expect(proposal!.current.total - chosen.score.total).toBeGreaterThanOrEqual(PROPOSAL_MARGIN);
    expect(Math.min(...proposal!.candidates.map((c) => c.score.total))).toBe(chosen.score.total);
    expect(proposal!.scope).toContain('domain:billing');
    expect(of('maintenance_run').at(-1)).toMatchObject({ agent: 'cartographer', trigger: 'unassigned,new_top_level', ok: true, cost: 0 });
    expect(reduce(bus.events).proposals['MP-1']!.status).toBe('pending');

    // A third turn while MP-1 is pending: drift persists, but the scope is covered, so no new run.
    turn('t3', touchInvoice);
    await lm.idle();
    expect(calls).toHaveLength(1);

    const head = git(root, 'rev-parse', 'HEAD');
    expect(lm.accept('MP-1')).toEqual({ ok: true });
    expect(git(root, 'rev-list', '--count', `${head}..HEAD`)).toBe('1');
    expect(git(root, 'show', '--name-only', '--format=', 'HEAD')).toBe('domains.yaml');
    expect(git(root, 'status', '--porcelain')).toContain('?? src/billing/'); // the session's work stays uncommitted
    expect(parseDomainMap(readFileSync(join(root, 'domains.yaml'), 'utf8')).domains.at(-1)!.id).toBe('billing');
    expect(repo.place('src/billing/refund.ts')).toEqual({ kind: 'cell', domain: 'billing', layer: 'logic' });

    await lm.idle();
    const ui = reduce(bus.events);
    expect(ui.map!.domains.map((d) => d.id)).toContain('billing');
    expect(ui.files['src/billing/invoice.ts']).toEqual({ kind: 'cell', domain: 'billing', layer: 'logic' });
    expect(ui.proposals['MP-1']!.status).toBe('accepted');
    expect(ui.drift.filter((s) => s.signal === 'unassigned')).toEqual([]);
    expect(lm.accept('MP-1')).toMatchObject({ ok: false, status: 409 });
    expect(lm.accept('MP-9')).toMatchObject({ ok: false, status: 404 });
  });

  it('reject records a DR with status: rejected (only that file committed); the proposer gets it next time and it is never re-proposed', async () => {
    const { root, lm, calls, turn, writeBilling, touchInvoice, of, bus } = setup();
    turn('t1', writeBilling);
    turn('t2', touchInvoice);
    await lm.idle();
    const mp1 = of('map_proposed').find((p) => p.proposal)!.proposal!;
    expect(mp1.changes).toContainEqual({ kind: 'add_domain', domain: 'billing', name: 'Billing' });

    expect(lm.reject('MP-1', 'Billing stays unplaced until the pricing work lands')).toEqual({ ok: true, decision: 'DR-4' });
    expect(git(root, 'show', '--name-only', '--format=', 'HEAD')).toBe('decisions/DR-4.md');
    const dr = readFileSync(join(root, 'decisions/DR-4.md'), 'utf8');
    expect(dr).toMatch(/^---\nid: DR-4\n/);
    expect(dr).toContain('status: rejected');
    expect(dr).toContain('proposal: MP-1');
    expect(dr).toContain('pricing work lands');
    expect(git(root, 'status', '--porcelain')).toContain('?? src/billing/');
    expect(reduce(bus.events).proposals['MP-1']).toMatchObject({ status: 'rejected', decision: 'DR-4' });
    expect(of('map_proposal_resolved').at(-1)).toEqual({ proposal: 'MP-1', outcome: 'rejected', decision: 'DR-4' });

    turn('t3', touchInvoice);
    await lm.idle();
    expect(calls).toHaveLength(2);
    expect(calls[1]!.rejected).toEqual([expect.objectContaining({ decision: 'DR-4', proposal: 'MP-1', changes: mp1.changes })]);
    // The fake repeats Billing; the loop drops it. The other candidate (fold into tools) is new, so it may be proposed.
    const later = of('map_proposed').filter((p) => p.proposal && p.proposal.id !== 'MP-1');
    for (const p of later) expect(p.proposal!.changes).not.toContainEqual({ kind: 'add_domain', domain: 'billing', name: 'Billing' });
    expect(later.map((p) => p.proposal!.id)).toEqual(['MP-2']);
    expect(later[0]!.proposal!.changes.filter((c) => c.kind === 'place').map((c) => c.kind === 'place' && c.domain)).toEqual(['tools', 'tools', 'tools']);
  });

  it('queues a survey while a turn is open, and labels bloated cells once (cached by membership)', async () => {
    const yaml = `${mapYaml}\ncartography:\n  thresholds: { bloatedCellFiles: 4, bloatedCellShare: 1 }\n`;
    const seen: string[] = [];
    const labeler: Labeler = async ({ cell, files }) => {
      seen.push(cell);
      return { cost: 0.01, groups: [{ name: 'News', files: files.filter((f) => f.includes('news')) }, { name: 'Lookup', files: files.filter((f) => !f.includes('news')) }] };
    };
    const { root, bus, lm, of } = setup(yaml, { proposer: null, labeler });
    bus.turn = 'open';
    expect(lm.survey()).toEqual({ queued: true });
    await lm.idle();
    expect(of('drift_detected')).toHaveLength(0);
    bus.turn = null;
    lm.survey();
    await lm.idle();
    lm.survey();
    await lm.idle();
    expect(seen).toEqual(['cell:tools/logic']); // persisted 2 → one labeler call
    const labels = of('labels_updated').at(-1)!.labels;
    expect(labels.map((l) => [l.target, l.text])).toEqual([
      ['src/tools/news-digest.ts', 'News'], ['src/tools/news-summarize.ts', 'News'],
      ['src/tools/company-profile.ts', 'Lookup'], ['src/tools/index.ts', 'Lookup'], ['src/tools/web-search.ts', 'Lookup'],
    ]);
    expect(labels.every((l) => l.kind === 'group' && !l.confirmed && l.hash === labels[0]!.hash)).toBe(true);
    expect(of('maintenance_run').at(-1)).toMatchObject({ trigger: 'labels', cost: 0.01, ok: true });
    lm.survey();
    await lm.idle();
    expect(seen).toHaveLength(1); // cached under .harness/labels/<hash>.json
    expect(readFileSync(join(root, `.harness/labels/${labels[0]!.hash}.json`), 'utf8')).toContain('"News"');
    const direct = await labelsFor({ root, map: parseDomainMap(yaml), facts: {}, cells: ['cell:tools/logic'], labeler });
    expect(direct).toEqual({ labels: [], cost: 0, calls: 0 }); // no files in the cell: nothing to label
  });
});

describe('living-map node helpers', () => {
  it('gitHistory lists commits oldest first without Harness files', () => {
    const root = sandbox();
    mkdirSync(join(root, 'decisions'));
    writeFileSync(join(root, 'decisions/DR-9.md'), 'x');
    appendFileSync(join(root, 'src/tools/index.ts'), '\n');
    git(root, 'add', '-A');
    git(root, 'commit', '-qm', 'second');
    const h = gitHistory(root);
    expect(h).toHaveLength(2);
    expect(h[1]).toMatchObject({ source: 'commit', files: ['src/tools/index.ts'] });
    expect(h[0]!.files).toContain('src/gateway/complete.ts');
    expect(h[0]!.files).not.toContain('domains.yaml');
    expect(gitHistory(join(root, 'src'))).toHaveLength(2); // inside the repo still works
  });

  it('onboardingSkeleton gives a valid instant map for a repo without domains.yaml', () => {
    const root = sandbox(null);
    const text = onboardingSkeleton(root);
    const map = parseDomainMap(text);
    expect(map.domains.map((d) => d.id)).toEqual(['channels', 'gateway', 'memory', 'orchestrator', 'outreach', 'tools']);
  });
});
```

```bash
// elkjs's own worker script, loaded only on the first layout (the v1 map never pulls it in).
type ElkApi = { layout(g: ElkNode): Promise<ElkNode> };
let elk: Promise<ElkApi> | null = null;
const cache = new Map<string, ContainerLayout>();

function getElk(): Promise<ElkApi> {
  elk ??= Promise.all([import('elkjs/lib/elk-api.js'), import('elkjs/lib/elk-worker.min.js?url')]).then(([api, url]) => {
    const ELK = api.default;
    return new ELK({ workerFactory: () => new Worker(url.default) }) as ElkApi;
  });
  return elk;
}

/** Cached by the container's children, edges and ports (and the elkjs version, via the bundle). `ms` is the worker round trip. */
export async function layoutContainer(c: ContainerInput): Promise<ContainerLayout> {
  const key = JSON.stringify(c);
  const hit = cache.get(key);
  if (hit) return hit;
  const api = await getElk();
  const t0 = performance.now();
  const out = await api.layout(elkGraph(c));
  const l = readLayout(c, out, performance.now() - t0);
  cache.set(key, l);
  return l;
}

export const clearLayoutCache = () => cache.clear();
'''
s=s.replace(a,b)
open(p,'w').write(s)
EOF
echo ok
```

```typescript
import { existsSync, mkdirSync, readFileSync, readdirSync } from "node:fs";
import { dirname, join } from "node:path";
import { fileURLToPath } from "node:url";
import { PGlite } from "@electric-sql/pglite";
import { vector } from "@electric-sql/pglite-pgvector";
import { loadConfig } from "./config";
import type { TableName } from "./types";

/**
 * Postgres, embedded (PGlite), with pgvector. Data lives in `.scout/pgdata`
 * unless SCOUT_DATABASE=memory.
 *
 * Each domain owns its tables in `src/<domain>/schema.sql`; they are applied
 * on first use. Columns are snake_case in SQL and camelCase in rows, and
 * timestamps come back as ISO strings.
 */

type Row = Record<string, unknown>;

interface Column {
  type: string;
}

const SRC = fileURLToPath(new URL("../", import.meta.url));

export class NotFoundError extends Error {
  constructor(table: TableName, id: string) {
    super(`${table}: no row with id ${id}`);
    this.name = "NotFoundError";
  }
}

// ---- Connection and schema -------------------------------------------------

let opening: Promise<PGlite> | null = null;
let columns = new Map<string, Map<string, Column>>();

/** Every `src/<domain>/schema.sql`, in a stable order. */
export function schemaFiles(): string[] {
  return readdirSync(SRC, { withFileTypes: true })
    .filter((entry) => entry.isDirectory())
    .map((entry) => join(SRC, entry.name, "schema.sql"))
    .filter((path) => existsSync(path))
    .sort();
}

async function loadColumns(pg: PGlite): Promise<void> {
  const result = await pg.query<{ table_name: string; column_name: string; udt_name: string }>(
    "select table_name, column_name, udt_name from information_schema.columns where table_schema = 'public'",
  );
  columns = new Map();
  for (const row of result.rows) {
    const table = columns.get(row.table_name) ?? new Map<string, Column>();
    table.set(row.column_name, { type: row.udt_name });
    columns.set(row.table_name, table);
  }
}

async function open(): Promise<PGlite> {
  const { databasePath } = loadConfig();
  if (databasePath) mkdirSync(dirname(databasePath), { recursive: true });
  const pg = await PGlite.create({ dataDir: databasePath ?? undefined, extensions: { vector } });
  await pg.exec("create extension if not exists vector;");
  for (const file of schemaFiles()) await pg.exec(readFileSync(file, "utf8"));
  await loadColumns(pg);
  return pg;
}

function connection(): Promise<PGlite> {
  opening ??= open();
  return opening;
}

// ---- Mapping ---------------------------------------------------------------

const toColumn = (key: string) => key.replace(/[A-Z]/g, (c) => `_${c.toLowerCase()}`);
const toKey = (column: string) => column.replace(/_([a-z0-9])/g, (_, c: string) => c.toUpperCase());

function tableColumns(table: TableName): Map<string, Column> {
  const known = columns.get(table);
  if (!known) throw new Error(`unknown table: ${table}`);
  return known;
}

function encode(value: unknown, column: Column | undefined): unknown {
  if (value === undefined) return null;
  if (column?.type === "vector" && Array.isArray(value)) return `[${value.join(",")}]`;
  if (column?.type === "jsonb" || column?.type === "json") return JSON.stringify(value);
  return value;
}

function decode<T>(row: Row, table?: TableName): T {
  const out: Row = {};
  const known = table ? columns.get(table) : undefined;
  for (const [column, value] of Object.entries(row)) {
    let v = value;
    if (v instanceof Date) v = v.toISOString();
    else if (typeof v === "string" && known?.get(column)?.type === "vector") v = JSON.parse(v) as number[];
    out[toKey(column)] = v;
  }
  return out as T;
}

/** "createdAt desc, id" -> "created_at desc, id". Only plain field names and asc/desc are accepted. */
function orderClause(orderBy: string): string {
  return orderBy
    .split(",")
    .map((part) => {
      const [field = "", direction = "asc", ...rest] = part.trim().split(/\s+/);
      if (rest.length || !/^[a-zA-Z]+$/.test(field) || !/^(asc|desc)$/i.test(direction)) {
        throw new Error(`bad orderBy: ${orderBy}`);
      }
      return `${toColumn(field)} ${direction.toLowerCase()}`;
    })
    .join(", ");
}

// ---- API -------------------------------------------------------------------

export interface WhereOptions {
  orderBy?: string;
  limit?: number;
}

export const db = {
  async insert<T extends object>(table: TableName, row: T): Promise<T & { id: string }> {
    const pg = await connection();
    const known = tableColumns(table);
    const entries = Object.entries(row).filter(([, value]) => value !== undefined);
    const names = entries.map(([key]) => toColumn(key));
    const values = entries.map(([key, value]) => encode(value, known.get(toColumn(key))));
    const placeholders = values.map((_, i) => `$${i + 1}`);
    const result = await pg.query<Row>(
      `insert into ${table} (${names.join(", ")}) values (${placeholders.join(", ")}) returning *`,
      values,
    );
    return decode(result.rows[0] ?? {}, table);
  },

  async update<T = Row>(table: TableName, id: string, patch: Row): Promise<T> {
    const pg = await connection();
    const known = tableColumns(table);
    const entries = Object.entries(patch).filter(([key, value]) => value !== undefined && key !== "id");
    const sets = entries.map(([key], i) => `${toColumn(key)} = $${i + 1}`);
    const values = entries.map(([key, value]) => encode(value, known.get(toColumn(key))));
    const result = await pg.query<Row>(
      `update ${table} set ${sets.join(", ")} where id = $${values.length + 1} returning *`,
      [...values, id],
    );
    if (!result.rows[0]) throw new NotFoundError(table, id);
    return decode(result.rows[0], table);
  },

  async get<T>(table: TableName, id: string): Promise<T | undefined> {
    const rows = await db.where<T>(table, { id }, { limit: 1 });
    return rows[0];
  },

  /** Rows whose columns equal every value in `criteria` (null matches IS NULL). */
  async where<T>(table: TableName, criteria: Row = {}, options: WhereOptions = {}): Promise<T[]> {
    const pg = await connection();
    tableColumns(table);
    const conditions: string[] = [];
    const values: unknown[] = [];
    for (const [key, value] of Object.entries(criteria)) {
      if (value === null) {
        conditions.push(`${toColumn(key)} is null`);
      } else {
        values.push(value);
        conditions.push(`${toColumn(key)} = $${values.length}`);
      }
    }
    const sql = [
      `select * from ${table}`,
      conditions.length ? `where ${conditions.join(" and ")}` : "",
      options.orderBy ? `order by ${orderClause(options.orderBy)}` : "",
      options.limit ? `limit ${Math.max(1, Math.floor(options.limit))}` : "",
    ].join(" ");
    const result = await pg.query<Row>(sql, values);
    return result.rows.map((row) => decode<T>(row, table));
  },

  async all<T>(table: TableName, options: WhereOptions = {}): Promise<T[]> {
    return db.where<T>(table, {}, options);
  },

  async count(table: TableName, criteria: Row = {}): Promise<number> {
    return (await db.where(table, criteria)).length;
  },

  /** A read-only query for joins and aggregates. Writes go through insert/update. */
  async query<T>(sql: string, params: unknown[] = []): Promise<T[]> {
    if (!/^\s*(select|with)\b/i.test(sql)) throw new Error("db.query only runs reads; use db.insert or db.update");
    const pg = await connection();
    const result = await pg.query<Row>(sql, params);
    return result.rows.map((row) => decode<T>(row));
  },

  /** Empties every table and restarts id sequences. Used by tests and the proof script. */
  async reset(): Promise<void> {
    const pg = await connection();
    const tables = [...columns.keys()];
    if (tables.length) await pg.exec(`truncate ${tables.join(", ")};`);
    const sequences = await pg.query<{ sequence_name: string }>(
      "select sequence_name from information_schema.sequences where sequence_schema = 'public'",
    );
    for (const { sequence_name } of sequences.rows) await pg.exec(`alter sequence ${sequence_name} restart;`);
  },

  async close(): Promise<void> {
    if (!opening) return;
    const pg = await opening;
    opening = null;
    await pg.close();
  },
};
```

```text
  // ---- leaf edges, grouped by owner file (in path order) and sorted by id within it
  const edges: GraphEdge[] = [];
  const seen = new Map<string, GraphEdge>();
  const local: GraphEdge[] = [];
  const resolve = (id: string): string | null => {
    if (nodes[id]) return id;
    if (id.startsWith('table:')) return ensureTable(id).id;
    const f = fileOf(id);
    return f && nodes[f] ? f : null;
  };
  const edge = (kind: EdgeKind, from: string | null, to: string | null, owner: string, count: number, typeOnly?: boolean, confidence?: CallConfidence) => {
    if (!from || !to) return;
    const id = edgeId(kind, from, to);
    const cur = seen.get(id);
    if (cur) {
      cur.count += count;
      if (typeOnly === false) cur.typeOnly = false;
      return;
    }
    const e: GraphEdge = { id, kind, from, to, count, owner };
    if (typeOnly !== undefined) e.typeOnly = typeOnly;
    if (confidence) e.confidence = confidence;
    seen.set(id, e);
    local.push(e);
  };
```

```typescript
import { existsSync, mkdirSync, readFileSync, readdirSync } from "node:fs";
import { dirname, join } from "node:path";
import { fileURLToPath } from "node:url";
import { PGlite } from "@electric-sql/pglite";
import { vector } from "@electric-sql/pglite-pgvector";
import { loadConfig } from "./config";
import type { TableName } from "./types";

/**
 * Postgres, embedded (PGlite), with pgvector. Data lives in `.scout/pgdata`
 * unless SCOUT_DATABASE=memory.
 *
 * Each domain owns its tables in `src/<domain>/schema.sql`; they are applied
 * on first use. Columns are snake_case in SQL and camelCase in rows, and
 * timestamps come back as ISO strings.
 */

type Row = Record<string, unknown>;

interface Column {
  type: string;
}

const SRC = fileURLToPath(new URL("../", import.meta.url));

export class NotFoundError extends Error {
  constructor(table: TableName, id: string) {
    super(`${table}: no row with id ${id}`);
    this.name = "NotFoundError";
  }
}

// ---- Connection and schema -------------------------------------------------

let opening: Promise<PGlite> | null = null;
let columns = new Map<string, Map<string, Column>>();

/** Every `src/<domain>/schema.sql`, in a stable order. */
export function schemaFiles(): string[] {
  return readdirSync(SRC, { withFileTypes: true })
    .filter((entry) => entry.isDirectory())
    .map((entry) => join(SRC, entry.name, "schema.sql"))
    .filter((path) => existsSync(path))
    .sort();
}

async function loadColumns(pg: PGlite): Promise<void> {
  const result = await pg.query<{ table_name: string; column_name: string; udt_name: string }>(
    "select table_name, column_name, udt_name from information_schema.columns where table_schema = 'public'",
  );
  columns = new Map();
  for (const row of result.rows) {
    const table = columns.get(row.table_name) ?? new Map<string, Column>();
    table.set(row.column_name, { type: row.udt_name });
    columns.set(row.table_name, table);
  }
}

async function open(): Promise<PGlite> {
  const { databasePath } = loadConfig();
  if (databasePath) mkdirSync(dirname(databasePath), { recursive: true });
  const pg = await PGlite.create({ dataDir: databasePath ?? undefined, extensions: { vector } });
  await pg.exec("create extension if not exists vector;");
  for (const file of schemaFiles()) await pg.exec(readFileSync(file, "utf8"));
  await loadColumns(pg);
  return pg;
}

function connection(): Promise<PGlite> {
  opening ??= open();
  return opening;
}

// ---- Mapping ---------------------------------------------------------------

const toColumn = (key: string) => key.replace(/[A-Z]/g, (c) => `_${c.toLowerCase()}`);
const toKey = (column: string) => column.replace(/_([a-z0-9])/g, (_, c: string) => c.toUpperCase());

function tableColumns(table: TableName): Map<string, Column> {
  const known = columns.get(table);
  if (!known) throw new Error(`unknown table: ${table}`);
  return known;
}

function encode(value: unknown, column: Column | undefined): unknown {
  if (value === undefined) return null;
  if (column?.type === "vector" && Array.isArray(value)) return `[${value.join(",")}]`;
  if (column?.type === "jsonb" || column?.type === "json") return JSON.stringify(value);
  return value;
}

function decode<T>(row: Row, table?: TableName): T {
  const out: Row = {};
  const known = table ? columns.get(table) : undefined;
  for (const [column, value] of Object.entries(row)) {
    let v = value;
    if (v instanceof Date) v = v.toISOString();
    else if (typeof v === "string" && known?.get(column)?.type === "vector") v = JSON.parse(v) as number[];
    out[toKey(column)] = v;
  }
  return out as T;
}

/** "createdAt desc, id" -> "created_at desc, id". Only plain field names and asc/desc are accepted. */
function orderClause(orderBy: string): string {
  return orderBy
    .split(",")
    .map((part) => {
      const [field = "", direction = "asc", ...rest] = part.trim().split(/\s+/);
      if (rest.length || !/^[a-zA-Z]+$/.test(field) || !/^(asc|desc)$/i.test(direction)) {
        throw new Error(`bad orderBy: ${orderBy}`);
      }
      return `${toColumn(field)} ${direction.toLowerCase()}`;
    })
    .join(", ");
}

// ---- API -------------------------------------------------------------------

export interface WhereOptions {
  orderBy?: string;
  limit?: number;
}

export const db = {
  async insert<T extends object>(table: TableName, row: T): Promise<T & { id: string }> {
    const pg = await connection();
    const known = tableColumns(table);
    const entries = Object.entries(row).filter(([, value]) => value !== undefined);
    const names = entries.map(([key]) => toColumn(key));
    const values = entries.map(([key, value]) => encode(value, known.get(toColumn(key))));
    const placeholders = values.map((_, i) => `$${i + 1}`);
    const result = await pg.query<Row>(
      `insert into ${table} (${names.join(", ")}) values (${placeholders.join(", ")}) returning *`,
      values,
    );
    return decode(result.rows[0] ?? {}, table);
  },

  async update<T = Row>(table: TableName, id: string, patch: Row): Promise<T> {
    const pg = await connection();
    const known = tableColumns(table);
    const entries = Object.entries(patch).filter(([key, value]) => value !== undefined && key !== "id");
    const sets = entries.map(([key], i) => `${toColumn(key)} = $${i + 1}`);
    const values = entries.map(([key, value]) => encode(value, known.get(toColumn(key))));
    const result = await pg.query<Row>(
      `update ${table} set ${sets.join(", ")} where id = $${values.length + 1} returning *`,
      [...values, id],
    );
    if (!result.rows[0]) throw new NotFoundError(table, id);
    return decode(result.rows[0], table);
  },

  async get<T>(table: TableName, id: string): Promise<T | undefined> {
    const rows = await db.where<T>(table, { id }, { limit: 1 });
    return rows[0];
  },

  /** Rows whose columns equal every value in `criteria` (null matches IS NULL). */
  async where<T>(table: TableName, criteria: Row = {}, options: WhereOptions = {}): Promise<T[]> {
    const pg = await connection();
    tableColumns(table);
    const conditions: string[] = [];
    const values: unknown[] = [];
    for (const [key, value] of Object.entries(criteria)) {
      if (value === null) {
        conditions.push(`${toColumn(key)} is null`);
      } else {
        values.push(value);
        conditions.push(`${toColumn(key)} = $${values.length}`);
      }
    }
    const sql = [
      `select * from ${table}`,
      conditions.length ? `where ${conditions.join(" and ")}` : "",
      options.orderBy ? `order by ${orderClause(options.orderBy)}` : "",
      options.limit ? `limit ${Math.max(1, Math.floor(options.limit))}` : "",
    ].join(" ");
    const result = await pg.query<Row>(sql, values);
    return result.rows.map((row) => decode<T>(row, table));
  },

  async all<T>(table: TableName, options: WhereOptions = {}): Promise<T[]> {
    return db.where<T>(table, {}, options);
  },

  async count(table: TableName, criteria: Row = {}): Promise<number> {
    return (await db.where(table, criteria)).length;
  },

  /** A read-only query for joins and aggregates. Writes go through insert/update. */
  async query<T>(sql: string, params: unknown[] = []): Promise<T[]> {
    if (!/^\s*(select|with)\b/i.test(sql)) throw new Error("db.query only runs reads; use db.insert or db.update");
    const pg = await connection();
    const result = await pg.query<Row>(sql, params);
    return result.rows.map((row) => decode<T>(row));
  },

  /** Empties every table and restarts id sequences. Used by tests and the proof script. */
  async reset(): Promise<void> {
    const pg = await connection();
    const tables = [...columns.keys()];
    if (tables.length) await pg.exec(`truncate ${tables.join(", ")};`);
    const sequences = await pg.query<{ sequence_name: string }>(
      "select sequence_name from information_schema.sequences where sequence_schema = 'public'",
    );
    for (const { sequence_name } of sequences.rows) await pg.exec(`alter sequence ${sequence_name} restart;`);
  },

  async close(): Promise<void> {
    if (!opening) return;
    const pg = await opening;
    opening = null;
    await pg.close();
  },
};
```
