```typescript
// Tier 1 facts for one file (NAVIGATION_PLAN §3.1): one oxc parse, one walk. Node-only.
import { parseSync, visitorKeys } from 'oxc-parser';
import picomatch from 'picomatch';
import type { CallFact, EntryFact, FileFacts, RouteFact, SymbolFact, SymbolKind, WriteSite } from '../contracts/facts';
import { maskComments } from './adapters';
import { hashText, squash } from './hash';
import { BULK_MIN, isMinified, parseModule, parseName, remember, type ModuleRecord } from './record';
import { packageName } from './resolver';
import { nextRoutes, routeFact } from './routes';

/** `(from, spec)` → repo path, `vendor:<pkg>`, or null (unresolved). */
export type Resolve = (from: string, spec: string) => string | null;

/** A package.json entry whose target is the file (`bin`, `scripts`, `main`). */
export type PackageEntry = { kind: 'bin' | 'script' | 'main'; label: string };

export type ExtractContext = {
  /** Import/export record of another repo file, so calls link through barrels and default exports. */
  recordOf?: (file: string) => ModuleRecord | null;
  /** package.json entries that run this file. A `script` whose file reads `process.argv` becomes a `cli` entry. */
  entries?: readonly PackageEntry[];
  /** `cartography.routes` in domains.yaml: `pattern` is a JS regex source with `method` and `path` groups (or groups 1, 2). */
  routes?: readonly { file: string; pattern: string }[];
};

/** Tier 1 facts for `path`. Large (> ~500 KB) or minified files get imports, writes and file routes only. */
export function extractFacts(path: string, source: string, resolve: Resolve, ctx: ExtractContext = {}): FileFacts {
  return extract(path, source, resolve, ctx).facts;
}

/** `extractFacts`, plus whether the source parsed (when it didn't, symbols and calls are empty, not "all removed"). */
export function extract(path: string, source: string, resolve: Resolve, ctx: ExtractContext = {}): { facts: FileFacts; parsed: boolean } {
  const { record, parsed } = parseModule(path, source);
  remember(path, source, record);
  const facts: FileFacts = { path, hash: hashText(source), imports: [], writes: [], symbols: [], calls: [], routes: [], entries: [] };

  const imports = new Map<string, boolean>();
  for (const s of record.specs) {
    const to = resolve(path, s.spec);
    if (to && to !== path) imports.set(to, (imports.get(to) ?? true) && s.typeOnly);
  }
  facts.imports = [...imports].map(([to, typeOnly]) => ({ to, typeOnly }));

  let result = parsed;
  if (!result && record.mode === 'lexer' && source.length <= BULK_MIN && !isMinified(source)) {
    const r = parseSync(parseName(path), source);
    if (r.errors.length === 0) result = r;
  }
  const code = result ? maskComments(source, result.comments) : source;
  const w = new Walker(path, source, resolve, ctx, record);
  if (result && source.length <= BULK_MIN && !isMinified(source)) w.run(result.program as unknown as N);
  w.finish();

  facts.symbols = w.symbols;
  facts.calls = [...w.calls.values()];
  const routes = new Map<string, RouteFact>();
  for (const r of w.routes()) if (!routes.has(r.id)) routes.set(r.id, r);

  const next = nextRoutes(path, [...record.exports.keys()]);
  const exportedSymbol = (name: string) => {
    const t = record.exports.get(name);
    const local = t && 'local' in t ? t.local : name;
    return w.symbols.find((s) => s.parent === null && s.name === local)?.id ?? null;
  };
  for (const r of next.routes) {
    const f = routeFact(r.method, r.path, path, exportedSymbol(r.symbol));
    if (!routes.has(f.id)) routes.set(f.id, f);
  }
  for (const r of customRoutes(path, code, ctx.routes ?? [], w)) if (!routes.has(r.id)) routes.set(r.id, r);
  facts.routes = [...routes.values()];

  const writes = new Map<string, WriteSite>();
  for (const hit of record.writes) {
    const site = { table: hit.table, symbol: w.innermost(hit.at), via: hit.via };
    writes.set(`${site.table}\u0000${site.symbol}\u0000${site.via}`, site);
  }
  facts.writes = [...writes.values()];

  const entries = new Map<string, EntryFact>();
  const entry = (kind: EntryFact['kind'], label: string, symbol: string | null) =>
    entries.set(`entry:${kind}:${label}`, { id: `entry:${kind}:${label}`, kind, file: path, symbol, label });
  for (const e of ctx.entries ?? []) entry(e.kind === 'script' && /\bprocess\s*\.\s*argv\b/.test(code) ? 'cli' : e.kind, e.label, null);
  for (const r of facts.routes) entry('route', `${r.method} ${r.path}`, r.handler);
  if (next.page) entry('page', next.page, exportedSymbol('default'));
  facts.entries = [...entries.values()];

  return { facts, parsed: record.mode !== 'regex' };
}

/** Routes from user-confirmed patterns (`cartography.routes`). The handler is the first symbol defined after the match. */
function customRoutes(path: string, code: string, patterns: readonly { file: string; pattern: string }[], w: Walker): RouteFact[] {
  const out: RouteFact[] = [];
  for (const p of patterns) {
    if (!picomatch.isMatch(path, p.file)) continue;
    let re: RegExp;
    try {
      re = new RegExp(p.pattern, 'g');
    } catch {
      continue;
    }
    const matches = [...code.matchAll(re)];
    matches.forEach((m, i) => {
      const g = m.groups ?? {};
      const method = g.method ?? (m.length > 2 ? m[1] : undefined) ?? 'ANY';
      const raw = g.path ?? (m.length > 2 ? m[2] : m[1]);
      if (raw === undefined) return;
      const end = m.index + m[0].length;
      const stop = matches[i + 1]?.index ?? code.length;
      out.push(routeFact(method, raw, path, w.firstSymbolIn(end, stop) ?? w.innermost(m.index)));
    });
  }
  return out;
}

type N = { type: string; start: number; end: number; [key: string]: any };

const FN = new Set(['ArrowFunctionExpression', 'FunctionExpression']);
const SKIP_KEYS = new Set(['typeAnnotation', 'returnType', 'typeParameters', 'typeArguments', 'superTypeArguments', 'implements']);
const WRAPPERS = new Set(['TSAsExpression', 'TSSatisfiesExpression', 'TSNonNullExpression', 'ParenthesizedExpression', 'TSTypeAssertion', 'TSInstantiationExpression', 'ChainExpression']);
const ROUTE_METHODS = new Set(['get', 'post', 'put', 'patch', 'delete', 'options', 'head', 'all']);
const FRAMEWORKS = new Set(['express', 'hono', 'fastify', '@koa/router', 'koa-router', '@hono/zod-openapi']);

const unwrap = (n: N | null | undefined): N | null => {
  let x = n ?? null;
  while (x && WRAPPERS.has(x.type)) x = x.expression;
  return x;
};
const strValue = (n: N | null | undefined): string | null => {
  const x = unwrap(n);
  if (!x) return null;
  if (x.type === 'Literal' && typeof x.value === 'string') return x.value;
  if (x.type === 'TemplateLiteral' && x.expressions.length === 0) return x.quasis[0]?.value?.cooked ?? null;
  return null;
};
const keyName = (key: N, computed: boolean): string | null => {
  if (!computed && key.type === 'Identifier') return key.name;
  if (key.type === 'PrivateIdentifier') return `#${key.name}`;
  return strValue(key);
};

type Binding = { spec: string; name: string }; // name: imported name, 'default', or '*' (namespace / CommonJS module)
type PendingRoute = { method: string; path: string; handler: N | null; enclosing: string | null };

class Walker {
  symbols: SymbolFact[] = [];
  calls = new Map<string, CallFact>();
  private sigText = new Map<string, string>();
  private used = new Map<string, number>();
  private cbCount = 0;
  private bindings = new Map<string, Binding>();
  private topNames = new Set<string>();
  private receivers = new Set<string>();
  private pending: PendingRoute[] = [];
  private nodeSym = new WeakMap<object, string>();
  private current: SymbolFact | null = null;
  private cls: SymbolFact | null = null;
  private resolved = new Map<string, string | null>();
  private jsx: boolean;

  constructor(private path: string, private source: string, private resolve: Resolve, private ctx: ExtractContext, private record: ModuleRecord) {
    this.jsx = /\.[jt]sx$/.test(path);
  }

  run(program: N) {
    this.prepass(program.body as N[]);
    for (const stmt of program.body as N[]) this.statement(stmt);
  }

  /** Mark symbols exported through `export { a, b as c }`, then hash signatures (which include the export flag). */
  finish() {
    for (const t of this.record.exports.values()) {
      if (!('local' in t)) continue;
      const s = this.symbols.find((x) => x.parent === null && x.name === t.local);
      if (s) s.exported = true;
    }
    for (const s of this.symbols) s.sigHash = hashText(`${this.sigText.get(s.id) ?? ''}|${s.exported ? 'export' : ''}`);
  }

  /** Id of the innermost symbol whose span contains `at`. */
  innermost(at: number): string | null {
    let best: SymbolFact | null = null;
    for (const s of this.symbols) {
      if (s.span.start <= at && at < s.span.end && (!best || s.span.end - s.span.start < best.span.end - best.span.start)) best = s;
    }
    return best?.id ?? null;
  }

  /** First symbol starting in [from, to) at the same nesting as `from`. */
  firstSymbolIn(from: number, to: number): string | null {
    const parent = this.innermost(from);
    return this.symbols.find((s) => s.span.start >= from && s.span.start < to && s.parent === parent)?.id ?? null;
  }

  routes(): RouteFact[] {
    return this.pending.map((r) => {
      const h = unwrap(r.handler);
      let id = h ? this.nodeSym.get(h) ?? null : null;
      if (!id && h?.type === 'Identifier') id = this.target(h);
      return routeFact(r.method, r.path, this.path, id ?? r.enclosing);
    });
  }

  // ---- declarations

  private prepass(body: N[]) {
    const frameworkLocals = new Set<string>();
    for (const s of body) {
      if (s.type !== 'ImportDeclaration' || s.importKind === 'type') continue;
      const spec = s.source.value as string;
      for (const sp of s.specifiers as N[]) {
        if (sp.importKind === 'type') continue;
        const name = sp.type === 'ImportNamespaceSpecifier' ? '*' : sp.type === 'ImportDefaultSpecifier' ? 'default' : keyName(sp.imported, false) ?? 'default';
        this.bindings.set(sp.local.name, { spec, name });
        if (FRAMEWORKS.has(packageName(spec) ?? '')) frameworkLocals.add(sp.local.name);
      }
    }
    for (const s0 of body) {
      const exported = s0.type === 'ExportNamedDeclaration' || s0.type === 'ExportDefaultDeclaration';
      const s = exported ? s0.declaration : s0;
      if (!s) continue;
      if ((s.type === 'FunctionDeclaration' || s.type === 'ClassDeclaration') && s.id) this.topNames.add(s.id.name);
      if (s.type !== 'VariableDeclaration') continue;
      for (const d of s.declarations as N[]) {
        if (d.id.type !== 'Identifier') continue;
        if (this.isSymbolDeclarator(d, exported)) this.topNames.add(d.id.name);
        if (this.isFramework(d.init, frameworkLocals)) this.receivers.add(d.id.name);
      }
    }
    for (const t of this.record.exports.values()) if ('local' in t) this.topNames.add(t.local);
  }

  private isSymbolDeclarator(d: N, exported: boolean): boolean {
    const init = unwrap(d.init);
    if (init && (FN.has(init.type) || init.type === 'ClassExpression')) return true;
    return exported || (!!d.id.typeAnnotation && init?.type === 'ObjectExpression');
  }

  /** `express()`, `express.Router()`, `new Hono()`, `new Hono().basePath('/api')`, `Fastify()`, `new Router()`. */
  private isFramework(init: N | null | undefined, locals: Set<string>): boolean {
    let x = unwrap(init);
    while (x?.type === 'CallExpression' && x.callee.type === 'MemberExpression' && x.callee.object.type !== 'Identifier') x = unwrap(x.callee.object);
    if (!x || (x.type !== 'CallExpression' && x.type !== 'NewExpression')) return false;
    const c = unwrap(x.callee);
    if (c?.type === 'Identifier') return locals.has(c.name);
    return c?.type === 'MemberExpression' && c.object.type === 'Identifier' && locals.has(c.object.name);
  }

  private statement(s: N) {
    switch (s.type) {
      case 'ImportDeclaration':
        return;
      case 'ExportNamedDeclaration':
        if (s.declaration) this.declaration(s.declaration, true, s);
        return;
      case 'ExportDefaultDeclaration':
        return this.exportDefault(s);
      case 'FunctionDeclaration':
      case 'ClassDeclaration':
      case 'VariableDeclaration':
      case 'TSInterfaceDeclaration':
      case 'TSTypeAliasDeclaration':
      case 'TSEnumDeclaration':
        return this.declaration(s, false, s);
      default:
        this.visit(s);
    }
  }

  private declaration(d: N, exported: boolean, outer: N) {
    switch (d.type) {
      case 'FunctionDeclaration':
        if (d.id && d.body) this.fn(d.id.name, d, exported, null, outer);
        return;
      case 'ClassDeclaration':
        return this.klass(d.id?.name ?? 'default', d, exported, outer);
      case 'VariableDeclaration':
        for (const v of d.declarations as N[]) this.declarator(v, exported, d.declarations.length === 1 ? outer : v);
        return;
      case 'TSInterfaceDeclaration':
      case 'TSTypeAliasDeclaration':
      case 'TSEnumDeclaration':
        if (exported) this.typeDecl(d, outer);
        return;
      default:
        this.visit(d);
    }
  }

  private exportDefault(s: N) {
    const d = s.declaration as N;
    if (d.type === 'FunctionDeclaration' || FN.has(d.type)) return this.fn(d.id?.name ?? 'default', d, true, null, s);
    if (d.type === 'ClassDeclaration' || d.type === 'ClassExpression') return this.klass(d.id?.name ?? 'default', d, true, s);
    if (d.type === 'TSInterfaceDeclaration') return this.typeDecl(d, s);
    if (d.type === 'Identifier') return;
    const sym = this.define('default', 'const', true, null, s, 'const', this.text(d));
    this.inside(sym, () => (unwrap(d)?.type === 'ObjectExpression' ? this.members(unwrap(d)!, sym, '') : this.visit(d)));
  }

  private declarator(d: N, exported: boolean, span: N) {
    this.capture(d);
    if (d.id.type !== 'Identifier') return this.visit(d.init);
    const name = d.id.name as string;
    const init = unwrap(d.init);
    if (init && FN.has(init.type)) return this.fn(name, init, exported, null, span);
    if (init?.type === 'ClassExpression') return this.klass(name, init, exported, span);
    if (!this.isSymbolDeclarator(d, exported)) return this.visit(d.init);
    // `export const chat = call;` aliases a local function: it is one.
    const alias = init?.type === 'Identifier' ? this.symbols.find((s) => s.parent === null && s.name === init.name)?.kind : undefined;
    const kind: SymbolKind = alias && alias !== 'const' && alias !== 'type' ? alias : 'const';
    const sym = this.define(name, kind, exported, null, span, `const ${this.text(d.id.typeAnnotation)}`, this.text(d.init));
    this.inside(sym, () => (init?.type === 'ObjectExpression' ? this.members(init, sym, '') : this.visit(d.init)));
  }

  /** Methods of an object literal held by a symbol: `newsSummarize.run`, nested `api.runs.list`. */
  private members(obj: N, parent: SymbolFact, prefix: string) {
    for (const p of obj.properties as N[]) {
      if (p.type !== 'Property') {
        this.visit(p);
        continue;
      }
      const key = keyName(p.key, p.computed);
      const v = unwrap(p.value);
      if (p.computed) this.visit(p.key);
      if (key && v && (p.method || FN.has(v.type))) this.fn(prefix + key, v, false, parent, p, 'method');
      else if (key && v?.type === 'ObjectExpression') this.members(v, parent, `${prefix}${key}.`);
      else this.visit(p.value);
    }
  }

  private fn(name: string, node: N, exported: boolean, parent: SymbolFact | null, span: N, kind?: SymbolKind) {
    const k = kind ?? (this.jsx && /^[A-Z]/.test(name) ? 'component' : 'function');
    const sym = this.define(name, k, exported, parent, span, this.fnSig(node), this.text(node.body));
    this.nodeSym.set(node, sym.id);
    this.inside(sym, () => this.fnBody(node));
  }

  private klass(name: string, node: N, exported: boolean, span: N) {
    const sig = `class ${this.text(node.typeParameters)} ${this.text(node.superClass)} ${(node.implements ?? []).map((i: N) => this.text(i)).join(',')}`;
    const sym = this.define(name, 'class', exported, null, span, sig, this.text(node.body));
    this.nodeSym.set(node, sym.id);
    const prev = this.cls;
    this.cls = sym;
    this.inside(sym, () => {
      for (const dec of node.decorators ?? []) this.visit(dec);
      this.visit(node.superClass);
      for (const m of node.body.body as N[]) {
        const key = m.key ? keyName(m.key, m.computed) : null;
        const value = unwrap(m.value);
        if ((m.type === 'MethodDefinition' || m.type === 'TSAbstractMethodDefinition') && key && value?.body) {
          for (const dec of m.decorators ?? []) this.visit(dec);
          this.fn(m.kind === 'constructor' ? 'constructor' : key, value, false, sym, m, 'method');
        } else if (m.type === 'PropertyDefinition' && key && value && FN.has(value.type)) {
          this.fn(key, value, false, sym, m, 'method');
        } else this.visit(m);
      }
    });
    this.cls = prev;
  }

  private typeDecl(d: N, span: N) {
    const sym = this.define(d.id.name, 'type', true, null, span, this.text(d), this.text(d));
    const body: N[] = d.type === 'TSInterfaceDeclaration' ? d.body.body : d.typeAnnotation?.type === 'TSTypeLiteral' ? d.typeAnnotation.members : [];
    for (const m of body) {
      const key = m.key ? keyName(m.key, m.computed) : null;
      if (!key || (m.type !== 'TSPropertySignature' && m.type !== 'TSMethodSignature')) continue;
      const fnType = m.type === 'TSMethodSignature' || m.typeAnnotation?.typeAnnotation?.type === 'TSFunctionType';
      this.define(key, fnType ? 'method' : 'property', false, sym, m, this.text(m), this.text(m));
    }
  }

  private define(name: string, kind: SymbolKind, exported: boolean, parent: SymbolFact | null, span: N, sig: string, body: string): SymbolFact {
    const qual = parent ? `${parent.name}.${name}` : name;
    const n = (this.used.get(qual) ?? 0) + 1;
    this.used.set(qual, n);
    const full = n === 1 ? qual : `${qual}~${n}`;
    const sym: SymbolFact = {
      id: `${this.path}#${full}`, file: this.path, name: full, kind, exported, parent: parent?.id ?? null,
      span: { start: span.start, end: span.end }, sigHash: '', bodyHash: hashText(squash(body)),
    };
    this.sigText.set(sym.id, `${kind}|${squash(sig)}`);
    this.symbols.push(sym);
    return sym;
  }

  private fnSig(f: N): string {
    const params = f.params?.length ? this.source.slice(f.params[0].start, f.params[f.params.length - 1].end) : '';
    return `${f.async ? 'async ' : ''}${f.generator ? '*' : ''}${this.text(f.typeParameters)}(${params}):${this.text(f.returnType)}`;
  }

  private text(n: N | null | undefined): string {
    return n ? this.source.slice(n.start, n.end) : '';
  }

  private inside(sym: SymbolFact, fn: () => void) {
    const prev = this.current;
    this.current = sym;
    fn();
    this.current = prev;
  }

  private fnBody(f: N) {
    for (const p of f.params ?? []) this.visit(p);
    this.visit(f.body);
  }

  // ---- expressions

  private visit(node: N | null | undefined): void {
    if (!node || typeof node.type !== 'string') return;
    switch (node.type) {
      case 'CallExpression':
      case 'NewExpression':
        this.call(node);
        break;
      case 'ArrowFunctionExpression':
      case 'FunctionExpression':
        // Top-level anonymous callbacks (route handlers, `createServer(…)`, `describe(…)`) get their own symbol.
        if (!this.current) {
          this.cbCount++;
          return this.fn(`<cb${this.cbCount}>`, node, false, null, node, 'function');
        }
        break;
      case 'VariableDeclarator':
        this.capture(node);
        break;
      case 'ImportDeclaration':
      case 'TSInterfaceDeclaration':
      case 'TSTypeAliasDeclaration':
      case 'TSDeclareFunction':
        return;
    }
    for (const key of visitorKeys[node.type] ?? []) {
      if (SKIP_KEYS.has(key)) continue;
      const child = node[key];
      if (Array.isArray(child)) for (const c of child) this.visit(c);
      else if (child && typeof child === 'object') this.visit(child);
    }
  }

  /** Bindings from `const { a } = await import('x')`, `const m = require('x')`. */
  private capture(d: N) {
    let init = unwrap(d.init);
    if (init?.type === 'AwaitExpression') init = unwrap(init.argument);
    let spec: string | null = null;
    if (init?.type === 'ImportExpression') spec = strValue(init.source);
    else if (init?.type === 'CallExpression' && init.callee.type === 'Identifier' && init.callee.name === 'require' && init.arguments.length === 1) spec = strValue(init.arguments[0]);
    if (spec === null) return;
    if (d.id.type === 'Identifier') this.bindings.set(d.id.name, { spec, name: '*' });
    else if (d.id.type === 'ObjectPattern') {
      for (const p of d.id.properties as N[]) {
        const key = p.type === 'Property' ? keyName(p.key, p.computed) : null;
        const local = p.value?.type === 'AssignmentPattern' ? p.value.left : p.value;
        if (key && local?.type === 'Identifier') this.bindings.set(local.name, { spec, name: key });
      }
    }
  }

  private call(node: N) {
    const callee = unwrap(node.callee);
    if (!callee) return;
    const to = this.target(callee);
    const from = this.current?.id ?? this.path;
    if (to && to !== from) {
      const key = `${from}\u0000${to}`;
      const c = this.calls.get(key);
      if (c) c.count++;
      else this.calls.set(key, { from, to, confidence: 'syntactic', count: 1 });
    }
    if (node.type === 'CallExpression') this.frameworkRoute(node, callee);
  }

  /** Callee → symbol id (`file#name.member`), `vendor:<pkg>`, or null when it isn't an import or a top-level symbol. */
  private target(callee: N): string | null {
    const chain: string[] = [];
    let root: N | null = callee;
    while (root?.type === 'MemberExpression') {
      const prop = root.computed ? strValue(root.property) : root.property.type === 'Identifier' ? root.property.name : null;
      if (prop === null) return null;
      chain.unshift(prop);
      root = unwrap(root.object);
    }
    if (!root) return null;
    if (root.type === 'ThisExpression') return this.cls && chain.length ? `${this.path}#${[this.cls.name, ...chain].join('.')}` : null;
    if (root.type !== 'Identifier') return null;
    const b = this.bindings.get(root.name);
    if (b) return this.linkImport(b, chain);
    return this.topNames.has(root.name) ? `${this.path}#${[root.name, ...chain].join('.')}` : null;
  }

  private res(from: string, spec: string): string | null {
    const key = `${from}\u0000${spec}`;
    let hit = this.resolved.get(key);
    if (hit === undefined) this.resolved.set(key, (hit = this.resolve(from, spec)));
    return hit;
  }

  private linkImport(b: Binding, chain: string[]): string | null {
    let file = this.res(this.path, b.spec);
    if (!file || file.startsWith('vendor:')) return file;
    let name = b.name;
    const rest = [...chain];
    for (let hops = 0; hops < 4; hops++) {
      if (name === '*') {
        const next = rest.shift();
        if (next === undefined) return file;
        name = next;
      }
      const t = this.follow(file, name, 0);
      if (t.file.startsWith('vendor:')) return t.file;
      file = t.file;
      name = t.name;
      if (name !== '*') break;
    }
    return `${file}#${[name, ...rest].join('.')}`;
  }

  /** Follow `name` exported by `file` through re-exports and `export *` to where it is defined. */
  private follow(file: string, name: string, depth: number): { file: string; name: string; found: boolean } {
    const rec = depth > 8 ? null : this.ctx.recordOf?.(file);
    if (!rec) return { file, name, found: false };
    const e = rec.exports.get(name);
    if (e) {
      if ('local' in e) return { file, name: e.local, found: true };
      const to = this.res(file, e.spec);
      if (!to) return { file, name, found: true };
      if (to.startsWith('vendor:') || e.name === '*') return { file: to, name: e.name, found: true };
      return this.follow(to, e.name, depth + 1);
    }
    for (const star of rec.stars) {
      const to = this.res(file, star);
      if (!to || to.startsWith('vendor:')) continue;
      const t = this.follow(to, name, depth + 1);
      if (t.found) return t;
    }
    return { file, name, found: false };
  }

  /** `app.get('/x', h)` on an Express/Hono/Fastify/Koa-router instance; Fastify's `app.route({ method, url, handler })`. */
  private frameworkRoute(node: N, callee: N) {
    if (callee.type !== 'MemberExpression' || callee.computed || callee.object.type !== 'Identifier' || !this.receivers.has(callee.object.name)) return;
    const method = callee.property.name as string;
    const args = node.arguments as N[];
    const enclosing = this.current?.id ?? null;
    if (ROUTE_METHODS.has(method) && args.length >= 2) {
      const path = strValue(args[0]);
      if (path !== null) this.pending.push({ method, path, handler: args[args.length - 1] ?? null, enclosing });
    } else if (method === 'route' && unwrap(args[0])?.type === 'ObjectExpression') {
      const props = new Map<string, N>();
      for (const p of unwrap(args[0])!.properties as N[]) {
        const k = p.type === 'Property' ? keyName(p.key, p.computed) : null;
        if (k) props.set(k, p.value);
      }
      const url = strValue(props.get('url') ?? props.get('path'));
      const m = props.get('method');
      const methods = unwrap(m)?.type === 'ArrayExpression' ? (unwrap(m)!.elements as N[]).map(strValue) : [strValue(m)];
      if (url !== null) for (const x of methods) if (x) this.pending.push({ method: x, path: url, handler: props.get('handler') ?? null, enclosing });
    }
  }
}

/**
 * Point each call at the deepest symbol that exists: `db.ts#db.all` stays if `db.all` is a symbol, `registry.get` on a Map
 * becomes `#registry`, and a member nothing defines becomes the file path. `symbolsOf` gives a file's symbol names
 * (null = unknown, leave as is). Calls that collapse onto the same target are merged; self-calls drop.
 */
export function settleCalls(calls: readonly CallFact[], symbolsOf: (file: string) => ReadonlySet<string> | null): CallFact[] {
  const out = new Map<string, CallFact>();
  for (const c of calls) {
    let to = c.to;
    const hash = to.indexOf('#');
    if (!to.startsWith('vendor:') && hash !== -1) {
      const file = to.slice(0, hash);
      const names = symbolsOf(file);
      if (names) {
        const parts = to.slice(hash + 1).split('.');
        while (parts.length && !names.has(parts.join('.'))) parts.pop();
        to = parts.length ? `${file}#${parts.join('.')}` : file;
      }
    }
    if (to === c.from || (!to.includes('#') && c.from.startsWith(`${to}#`))) continue;
    const key = `${c.from}\u0000${to}`;
    const prev = out.get(key);
    if (prev) prev.count += c.count;
    else out.set(key, { ...c, to });
  }
  return [...out.values()];
}
```

```typescript
import { db } from "../shared/db";
import type { RunRequest, RunRow, RunStep } from "../shared/types";

export async function startRun(request: RunRequest): Promise<RunRow> {
  return db.insert("runs", {
    company: request.company,
    goal: request.goal,
    contactEmail: request.contact.email,
    status: "running",
    plan: [],
    steps: [],
  } satisfies Omit<RunRow, "id" | "startedAt">) as Promise<RunRow>;
}

export async function getRun(id: string): Promise<RunRow | undefined> {
  return db.get<RunRow>("runs", id);
}

export async function listRuns(limit = 20): Promise<RunRow[]> {
  return db.all<RunRow>("runs", { orderBy: "startedAt desc, id desc", limit });
}

async function requireRun(id: string): Promise<RunRow> {
  const run = await getRun(id);
  if (!run) throw new Error(`run not found: ${id}`);
  return run;
}

export async function setPlan(id: string, tools: string[]): Promise<RunRow> {
  await requireRun(id);
  return db.update("runs", id, { plan: tools });
}

export async function recordStep(id: string, step: RunStep): Promise<RunRow> {
  const run = await requireRun(id);
  return db.update("runs", id, { steps: [...run.steps, step] });
}

export async function finishRun(id: string, brief: string): Promise<RunRow> {
  await requireRun(id);
  return db.update("runs", id, { status: "done", brief, finishedAt: new Date().toISOString() });
}

export async function failRun(id: string, error: string): Promise<RunRow> {
  await requireRun(id);
  return db.update("runs", id, { status: "failed", error, finishedAt: new Date().toISOString() });
}
```

```text
11	export function cosine(a: number[], b: number[]): number {
12	  let dot = 0;
13	  let na = 0;
14	  let nb = 0;
15	  for (let i = 0; i < Math.min(a.length, b.length); i++) {
16	    const x = a[i] ?? 0;
17	    const y = b[i] ?? 0;
18	    dot += x * y;
19	    na += x * x;
20	    nb += y * y;
21	  }
22	  return na === 0 || nb === 0 ? 0 : dot / Math.sqrt(na * nb);
23	}

26	export async function indexNotes(notes: NoteRow[], runId?: string): Promise<void> {
27	  if (notes.length === 0) return;

29	    notes.map((n) => n.text),
30	    { runId },
31	  );
32	  notes.forEach((note, i) => {
33	    db.insert("embeddings", { noteId: note.id, company: note.company, vector: vectors[i] ?? [] });

38	export async function searchNotes(company: string, query: string, k: number, runId?: string): Promise<ScoredNote[]> {
39	  const slug = slugify(company);
40	  const candidates = db.filter<EmbeddingRow>("embeddings", (e) => e.company === slug);
41	  if (candidates.length === 0) return [];
42	
43	  const queryVector = await embed(query, { runId });
44	  const scored: ScoredNote[] = [];
45	  for (const candidate of candidates) {
46	    const note = db.get<NoteRow>("notes", candidate.noteId);
47	    if (note) scored.push({ note, score: cosine(queryVector, candidate.vector) });
48	  }
49	  return scored.sort((a, b) => b.score - a.score || a.note.id.localeCompare(b.note.id)).slice(0, k);
50	}
```

```bash
import { db } from "../shared/db";
import { slugify } from "../shared/ids";
import type { NoteRow } from "../shared/types";

export interface NewNote {
  company: string;
  text: string;
  source: string;
  runId?: string | null;
}

const MAX_NOTE_CHARS = 2000;

export async function addNote(note: NewNote): Promise<NoteRow> {
  const text = note.text.trim();
  if (!text) throw new Error("note text must not be empty");
  return db.insert("notes", {
    company: slugify(note.company),
    text: text.length > MAX_NOTE_CHARS ? `${text.slice(0, MAX_NOTE_CHARS - 1)}…` : text,
    source: note.source,
    runId: note.runId ?? null,
  }) as Promise<NoteRow>;
}

export async function getNote(id: string): Promise<NoteRow | undefined> {
  return db.get<NoteRow>("notes", id);
}

/** Notes for a company, newest first. */
export async function notesFor(company: string): Promise<NoteRow[]> {
  return db.where<NoteRow>("notes", { company: slugify(company) }, { orderBy: "createdAt desc, id desc" });
}

export interface AccountSummary {
  company: string;
  notes: number;
  lastNoteAt: string;
  sources: string[];
}

/** Every company we hold notes on, most recently researched first. */
export async function listAccounts(): Promise<AccountSummary[]> {
  return db.query<AccountSummary>(
    `select company, count(*)::int as notes, max(created_at) as last_note_at,
            array_agg(distinct source order by source) as sources
       from notes
      group by company
      order by last_note_at desc, company`,
  );
}

import { embed, embedMany } from "../gateway/embed";
import { db } from "../shared/db";
import { slugify } from "../shared/ids";
import type { NoteRow } from "../shared/types";

export interface ScoredNote {
  note: NoteRow;
  score: number;
}

/** Embeds notes in one batch and stores their vectors. */
export async function indexNotes(notes: NoteRow[], runId?: string): Promise<void> {
  if (notes.length === 0) return;
  const vectors = await embedMany(
    notes.map((n) => n.text),
    { runId },
  );
  for (const [i, note] of notes.entries()) {
    await db.insert("embeddings", { noteId: note.id, company: note.company, vector: vectors[i] ?? [] });
  }
}

/** Top-k notes for a company by cosine similarity to the query (pgvector). */
export async function searchNotes(company: string, query: string, k: number, runId?: string): Promise<ScoredNote[]> {
  const slug = slugify(company);
  const [{ count } = { count: 0 }] = await db.query<{ count: number }>(
    "select count(*)::int as count from embeddings where company = $1",
    [slug],
  );
  if (count === 0) return [];

  const queryVector = await embed(query, { runId });
  if (queryVector.every((v) => v === 0)) return [];
  const rows = await db.query<NoteRow & { score: number }>(
    `select n.*, 1 - (e.vector <=> $2) as score
       from embeddings e
       join notes n on n.id = e.note_id
      where e.company = $1
      order by e.vector <=> $2, n.id
      limit $3`,
    [slug, `[${queryVector.join(",")}]`, k],
  );
  return rows.map(({ score, ...note }) => ({ note, score }));
}
```

```typescript
import * as fs from 'node:fs';
import type { FileFacts } from './contracts/facts';
import { attachResolver, carryResolver, resolverOf } from './facts/context';
import { settleCalls, extract, type ExtractContext, type PackageEntry } from './facts/extract';
import { moduleRecord, type ModuleRecord } from './facts/record';
import { createRepoResolver } from './facts/resolver';
import { packageEntries } from './facts/entries';
import { normalizePath, resolveImport, resolveSpecifier } from './imports';
import { createMapper, matchesAny, type Mapper } from './mapper';
import type { DomainMap } from './schema';

/** File → file import. */
export type ImportEdge = { from: string; to: string };
export type WriteFact = { file: string; table: string };
/** Cross-domain dependency (domain ids) with the file imports behind it. */
export type DomainEdge = { from: string; to: string; files: ImportEdge[] };
export type Facts = { files: string[]; imports: ImportEdge[]; writes: WriteFact[] };
export type FactDelta = { imports: ImportEdge[]; writes: WriteFact[] };

export type Exists = (path: string) => boolean;

export const CODE_EXTENSIONS = ['.ts', '.tsx', '.js', '.jsx', '.mjs', '.cjs', '.mts'];

export function isCodeFile(path: string): boolean {
  return CODE_EXTENSIONS.some((ext) => path.endsWith(ext));
}

/**
 * File-existence check against a repo root, cached. Call `clear()` after files are created or deleted.
 * It carries the repo's module resolver (tsconfig paths, package exports, workspaces) for `resolveImport`.
 */
export function fileExistsIn(root: string): Exists & { clear(): void } {
  const cache = new Map<string, boolean>();
  let resolver: ReturnType<typeof createRepoResolver> | null = null;
  const exists = (path: string) => {
    let hit = cache.get(path);
    if (hit === undefined) {
      try {
        hit = fs.statSync(`${root}/${path}`).isFile();
      } catch {
        hit = false;
      }
      cache.set(path, hit);
    }
    return hit;
  };
  attachResolver(exists, () => (resolver ??= createRepoResolver(root)));
  return Object.assign(exists, {
    clear: () => {
      cache.clear();
      resolver?.clear();
    },
  });
}

/** `exists`, plus `paths` that will exist (e.g. files a plan creates). Keeps `exists`'s resolver. */
export function withExtra(exists: Exists, paths: readonly string[]): Exists {
  const extra = new Set(paths.map((p) => normalizePath(p) ?? p));
  return carryResolver((path: string) => extra.has(path) || exists(path), exists);
}

/** Every non-ignored file under `root`, sorted. */
export function listRepoFiles(root: string, map: DomainMap, mapper: Mapper = createMapper(map)): string[] {
  const files: string[] = [];
  const walk = (dir: string) => {
    for (const entry of fs.readdirSync(dir ? `${root}/${dir}` : root, { withFileTypes: true })) {
      if (entry.name === 'node_modules' || entry.name === '.git') continue;
      const path = dir ? `${dir}/${entry.name}` : entry.name;
      if (mapper.isIgnored(path)) continue;
      if (entry.isDirectory()) walk(path);
      else if (entry.isFile()) files.push(path);
    }
  };
  walk('');
  return files.sort();
}

/** Full fact scan of a repo: every non-ignored file, plus resolved imports and table writes of code files. */
export function scanRepo(root: string, map: DomainMap): Facts {
  const files = listRepoFiles(root, map);
  const exists = scanExists(root, files);
  const imports: ImportEdge[] = [];
  const writes: WriteFact[] = [];
  for (const file of files) {
    if (!isCodeFile(file)) continue;
    const delta = factsForSource(file, fs.readFileSync(`${root}/${file}`, 'utf8'), exists);
    imports.push(...delta.imports);
    writes.push(...delta.writes);
  }
  return { files, imports, writes };
}

/** Files known from the walk, then disk; carries the repo resolver. */
function scanExists(root: string, files: readonly string[]): Exists {
  const known = new Set(files);
  const onDisk = fileExistsIn(root);
  return carryResolver((p: string) => known.has(p) || onDisk(p), onDisk);
}

/** Imports and writes of one file, with the gate's own multiset counting. */
function counts(path: string, record: ModuleRecord, exists: Exists) {
  const imports = new Map<string, number>();
  for (const s of record.specs) {
    const to = resolveImport(path, s.spec, exists);
    if (to) imports.set(to, (imports.get(to) ?? 0) + 1);
  }
  const writes = new Map<string, number>();
  for (const w of record.writes) writes.set(w.table, (writes.get(w.table) ?? 0) + 1);
  return { imports, writes };
}

/** One file's resolved imports and table writes (each target/table once). */
export function factsForSource(path: string, source: string, exists: Exists): FactDelta {
  return deltaForEdit(path, null, source, exists);
}

/**
 * Imports and writes that `newSource` adds over `oldSource` (multiset difference by target/table). This is the edit gate's
 * hot path: no AST walk, the old text's record is usually cached, and large or minified files skip parsing (< 20 ms at 1 MB).
 */
export function deltaForEdit(path: string, oldSource: string | null, newSource: string, exists: Exists): FactDelta {
  const file = normalizePath(path) ?? path;
  const before = oldSource === null ? null : counts(file, moduleRecord(file, oldSource), exists);
  const after = counts(file, moduleRecord(file, newSource), exists);
  const added = (key: string, n: number, old: Map<string, number> | undefined) => n > (old?.get(key) ?? 0);
  return {
    imports: [...after.imports].filter(([to, n]) => added(to, n, before?.imports)).map(([to]) => ({ from: file, to })),
    writes: [...after.writes].filter(([t, n]) => added(t, n, before?.writes)).map(([table]) => ({ file, table })),
  };
}

/** Apply a Claude Code `Edit` to file text. Throws if `oldString` is not found. */
export function applyEdit(current: string, oldString: string, newString: string, replaceAll = false): string {
  if (!current.includes(oldString)) throw new Error('old_string not found in file');
  return replaceAll ? current.split(oldString).join(newString) : current.replace(oldString, () => newString);
}

/** Cross-domain edges between cell files. Neutral, ignored, unassigned and test files, and same-domain imports, draw none. */
export function domainEdges(facts: Facts | FactDelta, mapper: Mapper): DomainEdge[] {
  const edges = new Map<string, DomainEdge>();
  for (const imp of facts.imports) {
    const a = mapper.place(imp.from);
    const b = mapper.place(imp.to);
    if (a.kind !== 'cell' || b.kind !== 'cell' || a.domain === b.domain) continue;
    const key = `${a.domain}\u0000${b.domain}`;
    let edge = edges.get(key);
    if (!edge) edges.set(key, (edge = { from: a.domain, to: b.domain, files: [] }));
    edge.files.push(imp);
  }
  return [...edges.values()].sort((x, y) => x.from.localeCompare(y.from) || x.to.localeCompare(y.to));
}

// ---- Tier 1 facts (NAVIGATION_PLAN §3.1)

/**
 * Per-repo extraction state: resolves through `exists`'s resolver, reads other files for barrel linking, and knows
 * package.json entries and `cartography.routes`. `read(path)` returns current text (or null), e.g. the server's cache.
 */
export function createFactsIndex(root: string, map: DomainMap, exists: Exists, read: (path: string) => string | null) {
  const resolve = (from: string, spec: string) => resolveSpecifier(from, spec, exists);
  let entries: Map<string, PackageEntry[]> | null = null;
  const routes = map.cartography?.routes ?? [];
  const ctx = (path: string): ExtractContext => ({
    recordOf: (file) => {
      if (!isCodeFile(file)) return null;
      const text = read(file);
      return text === null ? null : moduleRecord(file, text);
    },
    entries: (entries ??= packageEntries(root, exists)).get(path) ?? [],
    routes: routes.filter((r) => matchesAny([r.file], path)),
  });
  return {
    resolve,
    /** Facts for one file, calls not yet settled (see `settleCalls`). `parsed` is false for source with syntax errors. */
    extract: (path: string, source: string) => extract(path, source, resolve, ctx(path)),
    /** Forget cached package.json entries (after package.json changes). */
    reset: () => {
      entries = null;
    },
    hasResolver: () => resolverOf(exists) !== null,
  };
}

/** Symbol names per file, for `settleCalls`. */
export const symbolNames = (facts: Readonly<Record<string, FileFacts>>) => (file: string): ReadonlySet<string> | null => {
  const f = facts[file];
  return f ? new Set(f.symbols.map((s) => s.name)) : null;
};

/** `scanRepo` plus Tier 1 `FileFacts` for every code file, calls settled against the whole repo. */
export function scanRepoFacts(root: string, map: DomainMap): Facts & { fileFacts: Record<string, FileFacts> } {
  const files = listRepoFiles(root, map);
  const exists = scanExists(root, files);
  const texts = new Map<string, string>();
  const read = (p: string) => {
    let t = texts.get(p);
    if (t === undefined) {
      try {
        t = fs.readFileSync(`${root}/${p}`, 'utf8');
      } catch {
        return null;
      }
      texts.set(p, t);
    }
    return t;
  };
  const index = createFactsIndex(root, map, exists, read);
  const imports: ImportEdge[] = [];
  const writes: WriteFact[] = [];
  const fileFacts: Record<string, FileFacts> = {};
  for (const file of files) {
    if (!isCodeFile(file)) continue;
    const source = read(file)!;
    const delta = factsForSource(file, source, exists);
    imports.push(...delta.imports);
    writes.push(...delta.writes);
    fileFacts[file] = index.extract(file, source).facts;
  }
  const names = symbolNames(fileFacts);
  for (const f of Object.values(fileFacts)) f.calls = settleCalls(f.calls, names);
  return { files, imports, writes, fileFacts };
}
```

```bash
import { db } from "../shared/db";
import type { OutreachRow } from "../shared/types";

export async function logDraft(entry: { runId: string; contactId: string; subject: string; body: string }): Promise<OutreachRow> {
  return db.insert("outreach_log", {
    ...entry,
    status: "drafted",
    messageId: null,
    sentAt: null,
  } satisfies Omit<OutreachRow, "id" | "createdAt">) as Promise<OutreachRow>;
}

export async function markSent(id: string, messageId: string): Promise<OutreachRow> {
  return db.update("outreach_log", id, { status: "sent", messageId, sentAt: new Date().toISOString() });
}

export async function getOutreach(id: string): Promise<OutreachRow | undefined> {
  return db.get<OutreachRow>("outreach_log", id);
}

export async function draftForRun(runId: string): Promise<OutreachRow | undefined> {
  const [entry] = await db.where<OutreachRow>("outreach_log", { runId }, { orderBy: "createdAt desc, id desc", limit: 1 });
  return entry;
}

/** Latest drafts and sends across all contacts. */
export async function recentOutreach(limit = 50): Promise<OutreachRow[]> {
  return db.all<OutreachRow>("outreach_log", { orderBy: "createdAt desc, id desc", limit });
}

/** Everything sent or drafted to a contact, newest first. */
export async function historyFor(contactId: string): Promise<OutreachRow[]> {
  return db.where<OutreachRow>("outreach_log", { contactId }, { orderBy: "createdAt desc, id desc" });
}

/** True if we emailed this contact within the last `days` days. */
export async function contactedRecently(contactId: string, days: number, now = new Date()): Promise<boolean> {
  const cutoff = now.getTime() - days * 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000;
  const history = await historyFor(contactId);
  return history.some((r) => r.status === "sent" && r.sentAt !== null && Date.parse(r.sentAt) >= cutoff);
}
```

```typescript
// Entry points from package.json: `bin`, `main`, and `scripts` that run a source file. Node-only (reads files).
import * as fs from 'node:fs';
import { normalizePath, resolvePath } from '../imports';
import type { PackageEntry } from './extract';
import { workspaceDirs } from './resolver';

const RUNNERS = new Set(['node', 'tsx', 'ts-node', 'ts-node-esm', 'bun', 'deno', 'esno', 'esrun', 'vite-node', 'nodemon', 'jiti', 'sucrase-node', 'babel-node']);
const CODE = /\.[cm]?[jt]sx?$/;

type Pkg = { name?: string; bin?: string | Record<string, string>; main?: string; scripts?: Record<string, string> };

/** package.json entries (root and workspace packages) keyed by the repo file they run. */
export function packageEntries(root: string, exists: (path: string) => boolean): Map<string, PackageEntry[]> {
  const out = new Map<string, PackageEntry[]>();
  for (const dir of ['', ...workspaceDirs(root)]) {
    let pkg: Pkg;
    try {
      pkg = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(`${root}/${dir ? `${dir}/` : ''}package.json`, 'utf8')) as Pkg;
    } catch {
      continue;
    }
    const target = (file: string): string | null => {
      const p = normalizePath(dir ? `${dir}/${file}` : file);
      if (!p) return null;
      // Built outputs (`dist/cli.js`) usually come from `src/cli.ts`.
      return resolvePath(p, exists) ?? resolvePath(p.replace(/(^|\/)(?:dist|build|lib|out)\//, '$1src/'), exists);
    };
    const add = (file: string | undefined, entry: PackageEntry) => {
      const t = file ? target(file) : null;
      if (!t) return;
      const list = out.get(t) ?? [];
      if (!list.some((e) => e.kind === entry.kind && e.label === entry.label)) list.push(entry);
      out.set(t, list);
    };
    const name = pkg.name ?? (dir || 'root');
    if (typeof pkg.bin === 'string') add(pkg.bin, { kind: 'bin', label: name.replace(/^@[^/]+\//, '') });
    else for (const [bin, file] of Object.entries(pkg.bin ?? {})) add(file, { kind: 'bin', label: bin });
    if (pkg.main) add(pkg.main, { kind: 'main', label: name });
    for (const [script, cmd] of Object.entries(pkg.scripts ?? {})) {
      const label = dir ? `${name}:${script}` : script;
      for (const part of cmd.split(/&&|\|\||[;|&]/)) {
        const tokens = part.trim().split(/\s+/).filter((t) => !/^\w+=/.test(t)); // drop `FOO=1` env prefixes
        const runner = tokens[0]?.replace(/^npx$/, '') || tokens[1];
        if (!runner || !RUNNERS.has(runner)) continue;
        const file = tokens.find((t) => !t.startsWith('-') && CODE.test(t));
        if (file) add(file, { kind: 'script', label });
      }
    }
  }
  return out;
}
```

```bash
/**
 * npm run db -- "select name, phone from contacts"
 *
 * Runs one read-only query against the local database and prints the rows.
 * With no query, lists the tables and their row counts.
 */
import { db } from "../src/shared/db";

async function main(): Promise<void> {
  const sql = process.argv.slice(2).join(" ").trim();
  const rows = sql
    ? await db.query<Record<string, unknown>>(sql)
    : await db.query<Record<string, unknown>>(
        `select table_name as "table", (xpath('/row/n/text()',
                query_to_xml(format('select count(*) as n from %I', table_name), false, true, '')))[1]::text::int as rows
           from information_schema.tables
          where table_schema = 'public' and table_type = 'BASE TABLE'
          order by table_name`,
      );
  if (rows.length === 0) console.log("(no rows)");
  else console.table(rows);
  await db.close();
}

main().catch((err: unknown) => {
  console.error(err instanceof Error ? err.message : err);
  process.exitCode = 1;
});
EOF
```

  `total` (lower is better) = cells lit mean ×1, median ×0.5, modularity ×−2, unassigned ×0.5 per file, Gini ×1, decisions broken ×3 each, files moved ×0.1, ids removed ×0.5.

_**Agent (claude-opus-5-5 2026-10-11 21:06:07Z)**_

**Cartography is merged; three lanes are still running.**

The cartography lane, the headless half of the living map (N5), is in `harness-build`, with the two small fixes above committed on top. 95 tests pass, and core, server and shell all typecheck.

What it adds:
- **Drift detection.** Every drift signal in the plan is implemented, along with deterministic map scoring, git-history mining, a placement guess for unassigned files, and an instant skeleton map for onboarding.
- **The cartographer loop.** It runs only after a turn ends and stays quiet until a drift signal has lasted two turns. When it does run, it scores the candidate maps and proposes one only if it clearly beats the current map.
- **Accept and reject.** Both are API endpoints. Accepting commits only `domains.yaml`. Rejecting records a decision so the cartographer never proposes that change again. There are no buttons for these yet; that's wave 2.

In its one real run ($0.24), the cartographer was given a new `src/billing/` folder. It proposed a Billing domain, a rule update and three file placements. The score improved from 2.42 to 0.76 (lower is better). That run exposed two bugs, both fixed and covered by tests: the wrong candidate was being chosen, and nested rule changes were silently dropped.

Two leftovers for when the Facts lane lands:
- The cartographer still sees only imports and writes, not functions and calls.
- Onboarding still ends with the old one-shot cartographer instead of the scored candidates.

Still running: Facts (N1), Graph (N2) and the renderer spike with the design comps (N0). I'll merge Facts, then Graph, then the spike, as each finishes.

Unrelated: a `DEMO_PLAN.md` appeared in the repo, and `DEMO_REPO_SPEC.md` changed again. I haven't touched either.

```typescript
describe('resolveSpecifier (oxc-resolver over the alias fixture)', () => {
  it('resolves tsconfig paths, including through `extends`, and baseUrl paths', () => {
    expect(r('apps/web/src/main.ts', '@shared/format')).toBe('packages/shared/src/format.ts'); // paths from tsconfig.base.json

    expect(r('packages/core/src/a.ts', '#internal/util')).toBe('packages/core/src/lib/util.ts');
    expect(existsSync(join(root, '.harness/ws-modules/@acme/core'))).toBe(true); // no node_modules: shimmed under .harness/
  });

    expect(r('apps/web/src/main.ts', './z.js')).toBe('apps/web/src/z.ts');
    expect(r('apps/web/src/main.ts', 'react')).toBe('vendor:react');
    expect(r('apps/api/src/server.ts', 'hono/jsx')).toBe('vendor:hono');
    expect(r('apps/web/src/main.ts', 'node:fs')).toBe('vendor:node:fs');
    expect(r('apps/web/src/main.ts', 'fs')).toBe('vendor:node:fs');
    expect(r('apps/api/src/server.ts', '~/missing')).toBeNull(); // an alias that matches nothing is not a package
    expect(resolveImport('apps/web/src/main.ts', 'react', exists)).toBeNull(); // repo files only
  });

    const planned = withExtra(exists, ['packages/shared/src/slugify.ts', 'apps/api/src/billing/index.ts']);

    expect(r('apps/api/src/server.ts', './billing', planned)).toBe('apps/api/src/billing/index.ts');
    expect(r('apps/web/src/main.ts', '@shared/slugify')).toBeNull();
  });

    expect(main.imports).toEqual(expect.arrayContaining([

      { to: 'packages/core/src/lib/util.ts', typeOnly: false },
      { to: 'packages/shared/src/format.ts', typeOnly: false },
      { to: 'vendor:react', typeOnly: false },
      { to: 'vendor:node:fs', typeOnly: false },
    ]));
    const calls = main.calls.map((c) => `${c.to}${c.count > 1 ? ` x${c.count}` : ''}`).sort();
    expect(calls).toEqual([
      'apps/web/src/main.ts#main'.replace('#main', '') === '' ? '' : 'packages/core/src/lib/more.ts#more',
```

  ### Exported API
  These come from `src/graph/index.ts` and are re-exported from both `src/index.ts` and `src/view.ts`. A compile-time test checks them against the contract signatures.
  - `buildGraph(map, facts, semantic?)`

  ### Decisions you should know about
  - **Tests:** a `tests:<domain>` node sits under its domain, after the cells.
  - **Pseudo-domains:** `unassigned`, `neutral` and `group:vendors` are top-level nodes, created only when they have something in them. Tables that no cell owns go under `unassigned`.
  - **Vendors:** `vendor:<pkg>` goes into the `external` cell that claims it, meaning a glob matching `<pkg>` or `node_modules/<pkg>/…`. Importing domains are checked first. Anything unclaimed goes under `group:vendors`.
  - **Grouping:**
    - A cell with confirmed `components` groups its files by component.
    - Any container still holding more than 12 files is grouped by directory, recursively.
    - Group ids are `groupId(d, l, dir)` or `groupId(d, l, componentId)`.
  - **Missing symbols:** a call to a symbol the graph doesn't have falls back to that symbol's file node.
  - **Edge order:** edges are ordered by owner file path, then by id within each owner. It's deterministic but not a single global sort, because sorting all ids was the perf hot spot.
  - **`graphFacts(ui)` adds two things to `ui.facts`:**
    - Empty stub facts for files the log knows but has no facts for: placed files, files a turn touched, planned files, and planned import endpoints. Without these, ghosts and newly created files would have no leaf; the demo log has no `facts_changed` events.
    - Cross-domain cell→cell imports are taken from `ui.edges`. When facts are current, this changes nothing.
  - **Container rollups cover the whole subtree,** including expanded containers, so a domain header still shows a violation from inside it. Booleans OR, counts sum, and violation severity takes the max.
  - **Ghost and unplanned keep cellViews' cell-level meaning at every depth:**
    - A ghost disappears once anything in that cell, under the node, has been edited.
    - Amber (unplanned) is suppressed if anything in that cell is planned.
    - Outside cells, the unit is the file.
  - **Edge aggregation:**
    - `count` is the number of leaf edges.
    - `confidence` is the weakest, ordered dispatch < syntactic < typed.
    - An empty `lens.kinds` means all kinds.
    - Ghost edges have ids `ghost:A->B` and never merge with solid ones.
  - **Port sides:** where the ancestor chains diverge under a domain, the port goes top or bottom (layer rows, tests last). Anywhere else it goes left or right by sibling order.
  - **`autoExpand` rules:**
    - Importance scores: cursor 100, new violation 8, ghost or planned 6, edited 5, looked 4, existing violation 2.
    - Interest is importance minus tree distance to the focus, or to the cursor if there's no focus, or to the root.
    - It only expands containers with some importance, plus the focus and its ancestors.
    - Ties break by interest, then shallower first, then id. It never expands symbols.
  - **`trace` rules:**
    - It walks calls and handles forwards and `implements` backwards (from an interface member to its implementations, which is how registry dispatch shows up). `writes` is used only as the last hop into a table.
    - Default sinks are vendor nodes, table nodes, and anything in an `external` cell.
    - It returns one shortest path per sink, at most five.
    - Collapsing hops within a cell is left to the renderer.
  
  ### Parity definition
  Parity is checked at "domains expanded one level": `expanded` = every domain id and `lens.kinds = ['imports']`. Two things must hold:
  - **Cells:** the visible `cell:` nodes match `cellViews` exactly — looked, edited, added, removed, ghost steps, unplanned, violation, `violationFiles` and `newViolationFiles` — and the two sets of cells are identical.
  - **Edges:** the cross-domain cell→cell edges, grouped by domain pair, match `edgeViews` — the same solid pairs with the same new/existing state, violation flag and file imports, and the same ghost pairs with the same violation flag, steps and imports.
  
  `test/graph-parity.test.ts` checks this on every prefix of the demo log. It also checks every prefix of the demo log plus a hand-built second turn, for every selected turn. That second turn covers a test-file edit, an unassigned file, a neutral look, an unplanned file inside a planned cell, an unplanned cell, a gate block on a file that already violates another rule, and one edge added and one removed. To make sure the test bites, I broke the ghost rule and then the unplanned rule on purpose; parity failed both times.
  
  One edge case is not covered: if a turn adds an import, then removes it, while another import in the same domain pair stays, `edgeViews` reports "new" but the projection reports "existing".

  Synthetic repo: 2,000 files, 10,000 symbols, 12,212 nodes, 19,907 edges. Typical view: 2 domains, 2 cells and 1 group expanded, giving 40 visible nodes and 261 visible edges.
  - **Plain node, quiet machine:** `buildGraph` about 28–30 ms and `project` about 7–8 ms, roughly 36 ms in total.

```python
  let at = 0;

    const from = (at / total) * 360;
    at += n;
    return `${color} ${from}deg ${(at / total) * 360}deg`;
  });
  stops.push(`var(--v2-line) ${(at / total) * 360}deg 360deg`);
  return <span className="v2-ring" aria-hidden="true" style={{ background: `conic-gradient(${stops.join(', ')})` }} />;
```

```mjs
// Same launch as the research bench (full Chromium, headless, GPU raster): rAF deltas ≈ per-frame cost (not vsync-locked).
import { chromium } from 'playwright';
const [base = 'http://localhost:5182', mode = 'headless'] = process.argv.slice(2);
const headed = mode === 'headed';
const browser = await chromium.launch({ executablePath: chromium.executablePath(), headless: !headed, args: ['--enable-gpu-rasterization', '--ignore-gpu-blocklist'] });
const page = await browser.newPage({ viewport: { width: 1440, height: 900 } });
page.on('pageerror', (e) => console.log('pageerror', e.message));
const ready = () => page.waitForFunction(() => window.__v2?.ready(), null, { timeout: 60000 });
const log = (k, v) => console.log(k.padEnd(34), JSON.stringify(v));

// ---- Scout (fake comp log): System → Domain transitions and ELK per container
await page.goto(`${base}/?map=v2&fake=comp&comp=1`);
await ready();

log('scout elk cold', await page.evaluate(() => window.__v2.stats().elk));
log('scout collapse (Esc path)', await page.evaluate(() => window.__v2.toggle('tools')));
log('scout expand tools (cached)', await page.evaluate(() => window.__v2.toggle('tools')));
const warm = [];
for (let i = 0; i < 7; i++) warm.push(await page.evaluate(() => window.__v2.relayout()));
log('scout elk warm runs (ms)', warm.map((r) => r.map((c) => `${c.id}:${c.files}f/${c.edges}e/${c.ports}p=${c.ms}`).join(' ')));
const commits = [];
for (let i = 0; i < 6; i++) commits.push(await page.evaluate(() => window.__v2.toggle('tools')));
log('scout toggle x6 commit ms', commits.map((c) => `${c.commitMs.toFixed(1)}/${c.commitToFrameMs.toFixed(1)}`));
log('scout zoom', await page.evaluate(() => window.__v2.zoom(3000)));

// ---- ELK on a 300-file cell (warm worker), 5 runs
const big = [];
for (let i = 0; i < 5; i++) big.push(await page.evaluate((n) => { window.__clear?.(); return window.__v2.elkCell(n + 0); }, 300));
log('elk 300-file cell', big);

// ---- synthetic large projection: ~500 visible files
for (const visible of ['0', '1']) {
  await page.goto(`${base}/?map=v2&bench=500&expand=d0,d1,d2&visible=${visible}`);
  await ready();
  await page.waitForTimeout(800);
  const s = await page.evaluate(() => ({ dom: window.__v2.count(), edges: document.querySelectorAll('.v2-edge').length, elk: window.__v2.stats().elk, layoutMs: window.__v2.stats().layoutMs }));

  log(`bench500 visible=${visible} elk`, s.elk);
  const z = [];

  log(`bench500 visible=${visible} zoom x3`, z);
  const t = [];
  for (let i = 0; i < 4; i++) t.push(await page.evaluate(() => window.__v2.toggle('d2')));
  log(`bench500 visible=${visible} toggle d2`, t.map((c) => ({ commit: +c.commitMs.toFixed(1), toFrame: +c.commitToFrameMs.toFixed(1), moved: c.moved, entered: c.entered, removed: c.removed, layout: c.layoutMs })));
}

log('renderer', gpu);
log('browser', browser.version());
```

```typescript
import { describe, expect, it } from 'vitest';
import type { FileFacts } from '../src/contracts/facts';
import { deltaForEdit, domainEdges, fileExistsIn, scanRepo, scanRepoFacts } from '../src/facts';
import { diffSymbols } from '../src/facts/diff';
import { extractFacts, settleCalls, type ExtractContext } from '../src/facts/extract';
import { moduleRecord } from '../src/facts/record';
import { normalizeRoutePath } from '../src/facts/routes';
import { createMapper } from '../src/mapper';
import { check } from '../src/rules';
import { fixtureRepo, loadMap } from './helpers';
import { scoutFacts } from './scout-facts';

// The fixture's custom router (`req.method === "POST" && req.url === "/runs"`), confirmed the way `cartography.routes` would be.
const ROUTE_PATTERN = { file: 'src/channels/routes.ts', pattern: 'req\\.method === "(?<method>[A-Z]+)" && req\\.url === "(?<path>[^"]+)"' };

describe('scanRepoFacts on the Scout fixture', () => {
  const map = loadMap();
  map.cartography = { routes: [ROUTE_PATTERN] };
  const scan = scanRepoFacts(fixtureRepo, map);
  const facts = scan.fileFacts;
  const hand = scoutFacts();

  it('keeps the load scan identical: one violation (DR-1 in news-summarize) and the same domain edges', () => {
    const old = scanRepo(fixtureRepo, loadMap());
    expect(scan.imports).toEqual(old.imports);
    expect(scan.writes).toEqual(old.writes);
    expect(check(map, scan).map((v) => `${v.invariant} ${v.file} ${v.target}`)).toEqual(['DR-1 src/tools/news-summarize.ts vendor/llm-openai/index.ts']);
    const mapper = createMapper(map);
    expect(domainEdges(scan, mapper)).toEqual(domainEdges(old, mapper));
  });

  it('reproduces the hand-written symbols, calls, routes and entries in test/scout-facts.ts', () => {
    for (const [path, h] of Object.entries(hand)) {
      const f = facts[path]!;
      expect(f, path).toBeDefined();
      const shape = (s: FileFacts['symbols'][number]) => `${s.id} ${s.kind} ${s.exported} ${s.parent}`;
      expect(f.symbols.map(shape), path).toEqual(expect.arrayContaining(h.symbols.map(shape)));
      const call = (c: FileFacts['calls'][number]) => `${c.from} → ${c.to} ${c.confidence}`;
      expect(f.calls.map(call), path).toEqual(expect.arrayContaining(h.calls.map(call)));
      expect(f.routes, path).toEqual(h.routes);
      expect(f.entries.map((e) => e.id), path).toEqual(expect.arrayContaining(h.entries.map((e) => e.id)));
      expect(f.imports.filter((i) => !i.to.startsWith('vendor:')).map((i) => i.to).sort(), path).toEqual(h.imports.map((i) => i.to).sort());
      expect(f.writes.map((w) => w.table), path).toEqual(h.writes.map((w) => w.table));
    }
  });

  it('records type-only imports, vendor ids and the symbol behind each write', () => {
    expect(facts['src/tools/news-summarize.ts']!.imports).toContainEqual({ to: 'src/shared/types.ts', typeOnly: true });
    expect(facts['src/channels/routes.ts']!.imports).toContainEqual({ to: 'vendor:node:http', typeOnly: false });
    expect(facts['src/gateway/cost-ledger.ts']!.writes).toEqual([{ table: 'cost_log', symbol: 'src/gateway/cost-ledger.ts#logCost', via: 'db' }]);
    expect(facts['src/channels/routes.ts']!.entries.map((e) => e.id)).toEqual(['entry:route:POST /runs']);
  });
});

const files: Record<string, string> = {
  'src/lib/a.ts': 'export function a() {}\nexport default function main() {}\n',
  'src/lib/index.ts': 'export { a as alpha } from "./a";\nexport * from "./b";\nexport * as ns from "./a";\n',
  'src/lib/b.ts': 'export const b = () => 1;\n',
};
const resolve = (from: string, spec: string): string | null => {
  if (!spec.startsWith('.')) return `vendor:${spec.split('/')[0]}`;
  const dir = from.split('/').slice(0, -1);
  for (const seg of spec.split('/')) seg === '..' ? dir.pop() : seg !== '.' && dir.push(seg);
  const base = dir.join('/');
  return [base, `${base}.ts`, `${base}/index.ts`].find((p) => p in files || p === 'src/x.ts') ?? null;
};
const ctx: ExtractContext = { recordOf: (f) => (files[f] === undefined ? null : moduleRecord(f, files[f]!)) };
const facts = (src: string, path = 'src/x.ts', c: ExtractContext = ctx) => extractFacts(path, src, resolve, c);

describe('extractFacts: symbols', () => {
  it('names functions, classes, methods, exported consts and object-literal members; ids carry no line numbers', () => {
    const f = facts([
      'import type { Tool } from "./types";',
      'export function run(a: number): number { return a; }',
      'function helper() {}',
      'export class Store extends Base { constructor() { super(); } get size() { return 1; } static make() {} private go = () => 1; }',
      'export const tool: Tool = { name: "t", run: async () => 1, nested: { deep() {} } };',
      'const local = { run() {} };',
      'export const LIMIT = 3, chat = run;',
      'export interface Shape { run(x: number): void; size: number }',
      'function dup() {}',
      'function dup() {}',
      'export { helper };',
    ].join('\n'));
    expect(f.symbols.map((s) => `${s.name}:${s.kind}${s.exported ? '*' : ''}${s.parent ? `<${s.parent.split('#')[1]}` : ''}`)).toEqual([
      'run:function*', 'helper:function*', 'Store:class*', 'Store.constructor:method<Store', 'Store.size:method<Store', 'Store.make:method<Store',
      'Store.go:method<Store', 'tool:const*', 'tool.run:method<tool', 'tool.nested.deep:method<tool', 'LIMIT:const*', 'chat:function*',
      'Shape:type*', 'Shape.run:method<Shape', 'Shape.size:property<Shape', 'dup:function', 'dup~2:function',
    ]);
    expect(f.symbols.every((s) => /^src\/x\.ts#[^\d:]/.test(s.id) && s.span.end > s.span.start)).toBe(true);
  });

  it('gives top-level anonymous callbacks <cbN> symbols and folds callbacks inside a symbol into it', () => {
    const f = facts('describe("x", () => { go(); });\nexport function go() { [1].map((x) => x + 1).forEach(() => go()); }\nsetTimeout(function () {}, 1);\n');
    expect(f.symbols.map((s) => s.name)).toEqual(['<cb1>', 'go', '<cb2>']);
    expect(f.calls).toEqual([{ from: 'src/x.ts#<cb1>', to: 'src/x.ts#go', confidence: 'syntactic', count: 1 }]);
  });

  it('marks components in .tsx files', () => {
    const f = facts('export function Page() { return <div/>; }\nexport const Row = () => <span/>;\nexport const useThing = () => 1;\n', 'src/ui/Page.tsx');
    expect(f.symbols.map((s) => `${s.name}:${s.kind}`)).toEqual(['Page:component', 'Row:component', 'useThing:function']);
  });

  it('hashes signatures and bodies apart, ignoring whitespace', () => {
    const [a] = facts('export function f(a: number) { return a + 1; }').symbols;
    const [b] = facts('export function f(a: number) {\n  return a  + 1;\n}').symbols;
    const [c] = facts('export function f(a: number) { return a + 2; }').symbols;
    const [d] = facts('export function f(a: string) { return a + 1; }').symbols;
    const [e] = facts('function f(a: number) { return a + 1; }').symbols;
    expect([b!.sigHash, b!.bodyHash]).toEqual([a!.sigHash, a!.bodyHash]);
    expect([c!.sigHash === a!.sigHash, c!.bodyHash === a!.bodyHash]).toEqual([true, false]);
    expect(d!.sigHash).not.toBe(a!.sigHash);
    expect(e!.sigHash).not.toBe(a!.sigHash); // export flag is part of the signature
  });
});

    ]);

describe('large and broken files', () => {
  it('records only imports and writes for files over ~500 KB or minified', () => {
    const big = `import { a } from "./lib/a";\nexport const blob = "${'A'.repeat(600_000)}";\nexport function f() { a(); }\ndb.insert("runs", r);\n`;
    const f = facts(big);
    expect(f.imports).toEqual([{ to: 'src/lib/a.ts', typeOnly: false }]);
    expect(f.writes.map((w) => w.table)).toEqual(['runs']);
    expect(f.symbols).toEqual([]);
  });

  it('falls back to the regex parser for source with syntax errors', () => {
    const f = facts('import { a } from "./lib/a";\nexport function broken( {\ndb.insert("runs", r);\n');
    expect(f.imports.map((i) => i.to)).toEqual(['src/lib/a.ts']);
    expect(f.writes.map((w) => w.table)).toEqual(['runs']);
  });
});

describe('diffSymbols', () => {
  const sym = (name: string, sig: string, body: string, kind: 'function' | 'const' = 'function') => ({
    id: `f.ts#${name}`, file: 'f.ts', name, kind, exported: true, parent: null, span: { start: 0, end: 1 }, sigHash: sig, bodyHash: body,
  });
  it('classifies added, removed, signature, body and renamed symbols', () => {
    const before = [sym('a', 's1', 'b1'), sym('b', 's2', 'b2'), sym('c', 's3', 'b3'), sym('old', 's4', 'b4'), sym('gone', 's5', 'b5')];
    const after = [sym('a', 's1', 'b1'), sym('b', 's2x', 'b2'), sym('c', 's3', 'b3x'), sym('new', 's4', 'b4'), sym('fresh', 's6', 'b6')];
    expect(diffSymbols(before, after)).toEqual({ added: ['f.ts#fresh'], removed: ['f.ts#gone'], sig: ['f.ts#b'], body: ['f.ts#c'], renamed: [['f.ts#old', 'f.ts#new']] });
  });

  it('works on extracted facts: a rename keeps the body hash', () => {
    const a = facts('export function plan(x: number) { return x * 2; }\nexport function keep() {}');
    const b = facts('export function schedule(x: number) { return x * 2; }\nexport function keep() { return 1; }');
    expect(diffSymbols(a.symbols, b.symbols)).toEqual({ added: [], removed: [], sig: [], body: ['src/x.ts#keep'], renamed: [['src/x.ts#plan', 'src/x.ts#schedule']] });
  });
});

describe('edit gate budget', () => {
  const exists = fileExistsIn(fixtureRepo);
  const time = (fn: () => void) => {
    fn(); // warm-up (native binding, wasm)
    const runs: number[] = [];
    for (let i = 0; i < 5; i++) {
      const t = performance.now();
      fn();
      runs.push(performance.now() - t);
    }
    return Math.min(...runs);
  };

  it('deltaForEdit stays under 20 ms on a ~1 MB generated file (woff2-wasm style)', () => {
    const blob = Buffer.alloc(720_000, 7).toString('base64');
    const old = `import { x } from "../gateway/complete";\nexport const wasm = "${blob}";\nexport default wasm;\n`;
    const next = old.replace('export default wasm;', 'import { chat } from "../../vendor/llm-openai/index";\nexport default wasm + chat;');
    expect(next.length).toBeGreaterThan(950_000);
    let delta = deltaForEdit('src/tools/woff2-wasm.ts', old, next, exists);
    expect(delta.imports).toEqual([{ from: 'src/tools/woff2-wasm.ts', to: 'vendor/llm-openai/index.ts' }]);
    const ms = time(() => (delta = deltaForEdit('src/tools/woff2-wasm.ts', `${old}\n`, `${next}\n`, exists)));
    expect(ms).toBeLessThan(20);
  });

  it('deltaForEdit stays under 20 ms on ~1 MB of dense code', () => {
    let code = 'import { complete } from "../gateway/complete";\n';
    for (let i = 0; code.length < 1_000_000; i++) code += `export function f${i}(x: number): number {\n  const y = complete({ purpose: "p${i}", messages: [] });\n  return [1, 2].map((q) => q * x).length + Number(y);\n}\n`;
    const next = `import { chat } from "../../vendor/llm-openai/index";\n${code}`;
    const ms = time(() => deltaForEdit('src/tools/generated.ts', `${code}\n`, `${next}\n`, exists));
    expect(deltaForEdit('src/tools/generated.ts', code, next, exists).imports).toEqual([{ from: 'src/tools/generated.ts', to: 'vendor/llm-openai/index.ts' }]);
    expect(ms).toBeLessThan(20);
  });
});
```

_**Agent (claude-opus-5-5 2026-10-11 21:10:06Z)**_

Alike earns its place by doing what Harness's own memory can't: carry a decision to agents that aren't running inside Harness. Harness already writes decisions to `decisions/DR-n.md` and puts them in its own sessions' prompts, so if Alike only stores a copy, it's redundant and a judge will see that.

**What I checked just now:**
- **Alike's decision format matches SPEC §8 almost one to one:** title, rationale, `status` (made, rejected, superseded), `decision_type: standing`, path anchors labelled "governs", and `alternative_to`, which links a rejected option to the decision that beat it. "Rejected options stay rejected" has a native home.
- **It currently sees none of your sessions:** `list_agent_sessions` came back empty, even though you're running three or four Claude sessions on this project right now. Sessions only show up once they call `resolve_work_item`, and transcript capture is off.

**Where it fits, strongest first:**
1. **Beat 4: memory beyond Harness.**
   - Instead of a fresh Harness session, the follow-up ("also mention any calls we've logged") goes into plain Claude Code in a terminal, a tool that knows nothing about Harness.
   - The Alike hooks installed earlier inject DR-4 because its path anchors match the files being worked on (`src/orchestrator/agent.ts`, `src/outreach/**`, `src/tools/**`). Claude routes the change through the run loop and cites DR-4.
   - Cut back to Harness: its file watcher saw those edits, and they landed in the right stripe.
   - Line: "The decision followed the code, not the tool."
   - This is the only beat where a sponsor does something the core product can't.
2. **Record both sides of the fork.** Option A goes in as a standing decision (made, anchored to paths). Option B goes in as a rejected decision with `alternative_to` pointing at DR-4. Small code change in the harness, and it makes the rejected path visible to any agent, anywhere.
3. **Alike → Harness: decisions made elsewhere become rules.** Alike learns decisions from conversations Harness never sees, e.g. a teammate's chat. At load, Harness could pull standing decisions anchored to repo paths and show them as dashed "advisory" badges, and the auditor (N9) could check turns against them. A good extended-cut beat: "Alike remembers what was decided; Harness checks the code still does it." That's the Build Plan's original framing, now in both directions.
4. **Multiplayer (vision slide).** At turn start Harness calls `resolve_work_item` with the git branch, and Alike reports which other agents are on the same work item. Harness could show them as faded cursors. That turns the Build Plan's multiplayer slide into a small real feature, but it's a stretch for the hackathon.

**Things to settle first:**
- **Does injection work as I'm assuming?** Beat 1 depends on Alike's hooks surfacing a path-anchored decision in plain Claude Code. Testing it means recording one test decision in your Alike workspace and opening a session that touches those paths, about 10 minutes.
- **Keep Alike's hooks out of the Harness coding session**, so its context injection doesn't sit in the deterministic hot path. That's the open item from step 0 that I flagged earlier; the injection is then shown only in the plain Claude Code session.
- **Unfinished check from the parent session:** it was verifying Scout's four newest commits (database, web refactor, exact revenue, summarizer last) when that session ended. Whichever session owns Scout should rerun that check before tagging `demo-start`.

Should I test the injection now? It would add one clearly labelled test decision to your Alike workspace, which I'd archive afterwards. If it works, I'll add the reworked beat 4, both-sides-of-the-fork recording, and the extended beat to `DEMO_PLAN.md`.

```text
import { appendFileSync, existsSync, mkdirSync, readFileSync, writeFileSync } from 'node:fs';
import { join } from 'node:path';
import { randomUUID } from 'node:crypto';
import type { HarnessEvent, EventKind, EventData, Cell } from '@harness/core';

type Listener = (e: HarnessEvent) => void;

/** Append-only event log: `.harness/events.jsonl` in the target repo, broadcast to every listener. */
export class Bus {
  readonly events: HarnessEvent[] = [];
  readonly session = randomUUID().slice(0, 8);
  turn: string | null = null;
  private listeners = new Set<Listener>();
  private file: string;

  constructor(repo: string, opts: { fresh?: boolean } = {}) {
    const dir = join(repo, '.harness');
    mkdirSync(join(dir, 'turns'), { recursive: true });
    // Keep .harness/ out of the target's git without touching its .gitignore.
    if (!existsSync(join(dir, '.gitignore'))) writeFileSync(join(dir, '.gitignore'), '*\n');
    this.file = join(dir, 'events.jsonl');
    if (opts.fresh) writeFileSync(this.file, '');
    else if (existsSync(this.file)) {

      }

  emit<K extends EventKind>(kind: K, data: K extends keyof EventData ? EventData[K] : never, extra: { cell?: Cell | null; path?: string; turn?: string | null } = {}): HarnessEvent {
    const e: HarnessEvent = {
      id: randomUUID().slice(0, 12),
      t: Date.now(),
      session: this.session,
      turn: extra.turn === undefined ? this.turn : extra.turn,
      kind,
      ...(extra.cell ? { cell: extra.cell } : {}),
      ...(extra.path ? { path: extra.path } : {}),
      data: data as Record<string, unknown>,
    };
    this.events.push(e);
    appendFileSync(this.file, JSON.stringify(e) + '\n');
    for (const l of this.listeners) l(e);
    return e;
  }

  on(l: Listener) {
    this.listeners.add(l);
    return () => this.listeners.delete(l);

      hookSpecificOutput: {
        hookEventName: 'PreToolUse',
        permissionDecision: 'deny',
        permissionDecisionReason: `Harness blocked this edit.\n${violationText(violations)}\n${ASK_RULE}`,
      },
    };
  };

  private afterEdit: HookCallback = async (input) => {

    if (rel) setImmediate(() => this.repo.fileChanged(rel, { tool: i.tool_name }));
    return { async: true };
```

```text
import { serveStatic } from '@hono/node-server/serve-static';
import { WebSocketServer, type WebSocket } from 'ws';
import { Bus } from './bus';
import { Repo } from './repo';
import { Session } from './session';
import { commitPaths } from './git';
import { proposeMap } from './cartographer';

const here = dirname(fileURLToPath(import.meta.url));
const REPO = process.env.HARNESS_REPO ? resolve(process.env.INIT_CWD ?? process.cwd(), process.env.HARNESS_REPO) : '';
if (!REPO || !existsSync(REPO)) {
  console.error(`Set HARNESS_REPO to the target repo (got "${process.env.HARNESS_REPO ?? ''}").`);
  process.exit(1);

const PORT = Number(process.env.PORT ?? 4310);

const bus = new Bus(REPO, { fresh: process.env.HARNESS_FRESH === '1' });
const sockets = new Set<WebSocket>();
const broadcast = (msg: unknown) => {
  const s = JSON.stringify(msg);
  for (const ws of sockets) if (ws.readyState === ws.OPEN) ws.send(s);
};
bus.on((event) => broadcast({ type: 'event', event }));

const repo = new Repo(REPO, bus);
let session: Session | null = null;
let proposal: { yaml: string; source: 'cartographer' | 'fixture' } | null = null;
let busy = false;

function startSession() {
  repo.scan();
  repo.startWatcher();
  session = new Session(repo, bus, (m) => {
    if (m.type === 'busy') busy = m.busy;
    broadcast(m);
  });
  session.start();
}

/** Load: use domains.yaml if present; otherwise propose one (cartographer, else the fixture) and wait for Confirm. */
async function load() {
  if (repo.hasMap()) {
    repo.loadMapFile();
    bus.emit('map_confirmed', { map: repo.map, source: 'file' }, { turn: null });
    startSession();
    return;
  }
  let yaml: string;
  let source: 'cartographer' | 'fixture' = 'cartographer';
  try {
    if (process.env.HARNESS_CARTOGRAPHER === '0') throw new Error('disabled');
    yaml = await proposeMap(repo, bus);
  } catch (e) {
    if ((e as Error).message !== 'disabled') bus.emit('error', { message: `Cartographer failed, using the reference map: ${(e as Error).message}` }, { turn: null });
```
