// Tier 1 facts for one file (NAVIGATION_PLAN §3.1): one oxc parse, one walk. Node-only.
import { parseSync, visitorKeys } from 'oxc-parser';
import { matchesAny } from '../mapper';
import type { CallFact, EntryFact, FileFacts, RouteFact, SymbolFact, SymbolKind, WriteSite } from '../contracts/facts';
import { maskComments } from './adapters';
import { hashText, squash } from './hash';
import { BULK_MIN, isMinified, parseModule, parseName, remember, type ModuleRecord } from './record';
import { packageName } from './resolver';
import { nextRoutes, routeFact } from './routes';

/** `(from, spec)` → repo path, `vendor:<pkg>`, or null (unresolved). */
export type Resolve = (from: string, spec: string) => string | null;

/** A package.json entry whose target is the file (`bin`, `scripts`, `main`). */
export type PackageEntry = { kind: 'bin' | 'script' | 'main'; label: string };

export type ExtractContext = {
  /** Import/export record of another repo file, so calls link through barrels and default exports. */
  recordOf?: (file: string) => ModuleRecord | null;
  /** package.json entries that run this file. A `script` whose file reads its arguments becomes a `cli` entry. */
  entries?: readonly PackageEntry[];
  /** `cartography.routes` in domains.yaml: `pattern` is a JS regex source with `method` and `path` groups (or groups 1, 2). */
  routes?: readonly { file: string; pattern: string }[];
};

/** Reads CLI arguments (`process.argv.slice(2)`, `argv[2]`, `parseArgs(…)`), not just the `argv[1]` is-main check. */
const READS_ARGS = /\bprocess\s*\.\s*argv\s*(?:\.\s*(?:slice|includes|indexOf|filter|find)\b|\[\s*[2-9])|\bparseArgs\s*\(/;

/** Tier 1 facts for `path`. Large (> ~500 KB) or minified files get imports, writes and file routes only. */
export function extractFacts(path: string, source: string, resolve: Resolve, ctx: ExtractContext = {}): FileFacts {
  return extract(path, source, resolve, ctx).facts;
}

/** `extractFacts`, plus whether the source parsed (when it didn't, symbols and calls are empty, not "all removed"). */
export function extract(path: string, source: string, resolve: Resolve, ctx: ExtractContext = {}): { facts: FileFacts; parsed: boolean } {
  const { record, parsed } = parseModule(path, source);
  remember(path, source, record);
  const facts: FileFacts = { path, hash: hashText(source), imports: [], writes: [], symbols: [], calls: [], routes: [], entries: [] };

  const imports = new Map<string, boolean>();
  for (const s of record.specs) {
    const to = resolve(path, s.spec);
    if (to && to !== path) imports.set(to, (imports.get(to) ?? true) && s.typeOnly);
  }
  facts.imports = [...imports].map(([to, typeOnly]) => ({ to, typeOnly }));

  let result = parsed;
  if (!result && record.mode === 'lexer' && source.length <= BULK_MIN && !isMinified(source)) {
    const r = parseSync(parseName(path), source);
    if (r.errors.length === 0) result = r;
  }
  const code = result ? maskComments(source, result.comments) : source;
  const w = new Walker(path, source, resolve, ctx, record);
  if (result && source.length <= BULK_MIN && !isMinified(source)) w.run(result.program as unknown as N);
  w.finish();

  facts.symbols = w.symbols;
  facts.calls = [...w.calls.values()];
  const routes = new Map<string, RouteFact>();
  for (const r of w.routes()) if (!routes.has(r.id)) routes.set(r.id, r);

  const next = nextRoutes(path, [...record.exports.keys()]);
  const exportedSymbol = (name: string) => {
    const t = record.exports.get(name);
    const local = t && 'local' in t ? t.local : name;
    return w.symbols.find((s) => s.parent === null && s.name === local)?.id ?? null;
  };
  for (const r of next.routes) {
    const f = routeFact(r.method, r.path, path, exportedSymbol(r.symbol));
    if (!routes.has(f.id)) routes.set(f.id, f);
  }
  for (const r of customRoutes(path, code, ctx.routes ?? [], w)) if (!routes.has(r.id)) routes.set(r.id, r);
  facts.routes = [...routes.values()];

  const writes = new Map<string, WriteSite>();
  for (const hit of record.writes) {
    const site = { table: hit.table, symbol: w.innermost(hit.at), via: hit.via };
    writes.set(`${site.table}\u0000${site.symbol}\u0000${site.via}`, site);
  }
  facts.writes = [...writes.values()];

  const entries = new Map<string, EntryFact>();
  const entry = (kind: EntryFact['kind'], label: string, symbol: string | null) =>
    entries.set(`entry:${kind}:${label}`, { id: `entry:${kind}:${label}`, kind, file: path, symbol, label });
  for (const e of ctx.entries ?? []) entry(e.kind === 'script' && READS_ARGS.test(code) ? 'cli' : e.kind, e.label, null);
  for (const r of facts.routes) entry('route', `${r.method} ${r.path}`, r.handler);
  if (next.page) entry('page', next.page, exportedSymbol('default'));
  facts.entries = [...entries.values()];

  return { facts, parsed: record.mode !== 'regex' };
}

/** Routes from user-confirmed patterns (`cartography.routes`). The handler is the first symbol defined after the match. */
function customRoutes(path: string, code: string, patterns: readonly { file: string; pattern: string }[], w: Walker): RouteFact[] {
  const out: RouteFact[] = [];
  for (const p of patterns) {
    if (!matchesAny([p.file], path)) continue;
    let re: RegExp;
    try {
      re = new RegExp(p.pattern, 'g');
    } catch {
      continue;
    }
    const matches = [...code.matchAll(re)];
    matches.forEach((m, i) => {
      const g = m.groups ?? {};
      const method = g.method ?? (m.length > 2 ? m[1] : undefined) ?? 'ANY';
      const raw = g.path ?? (m.length > 2 ? m[2] : m[1]);
      if (raw === undefined) return;
      const end = m.index + m[0].length;
      const stop = matches[i + 1]?.index ?? code.length;
      out.push(routeFact(method, raw, path, w.firstSymbolIn(end, stop) ?? w.innermost(m.index)));
    });
  }
  return out;
}

type N = { type: string; start: number; end: number; [key: string]: any };

const FN = new Set(['ArrowFunctionExpression', 'FunctionExpression']);
const SKIP_KEYS = new Set(['typeAnnotation', 'returnType', 'typeParameters', 'typeArguments', 'superTypeArguments', 'implements']);
const WRAPPERS = new Set(['TSAsExpression', 'TSSatisfiesExpression', 'TSNonNullExpression', 'ParenthesizedExpression', 'TSTypeAssertion', 'TSInstantiationExpression', 'ChainExpression']);
const ROUTE_METHODS = new Set(['get', 'post', 'put', 'patch', 'delete', 'options', 'head', 'all']);
const FRAMEWORKS = new Set(['express', 'hono', 'fastify', '@koa/router', 'koa-router', '@hono/zod-openapi']);

const unwrap = (n: N | null | undefined): N | null => {
  let x = n ?? null;
  while (x && WRAPPERS.has(x.type)) x = x.expression;
  return x;
};
const strValue = (n: N | null | undefined): string | null => {
  const x = unwrap(n);
  if (!x) return null;
  if (x.type === 'Literal' && typeof x.value === 'string') return x.value;
  if (x.type === 'TemplateLiteral' && x.expressions.length === 0) return x.quasis[0]?.value?.cooked ?? null;
  return null;
};
const keyName = (key: N, computed: boolean): string | null => {
  if (!computed && key.type === 'Identifier') return key.name;
  if (key.type === 'PrivateIdentifier') return `#${key.name}`;
  return strValue(key);
};

type Binding = { spec: string; name: string }; // name: imported name, 'default', or '*' (namespace / CommonJS module)
type PendingRoute = { method: string; path: string; handler: N | null; enclosing: string | null };

class Walker {
  symbols: SymbolFact[] = [];
  calls = new Map<string, CallFact>();
  private sigText = new Map<string, string>();
  private used = new Map<string, number>();
  private cbCount = 0;
  private bindings = new Map<string, Binding>();
  private topNames = new Set<string>();
  private receivers = new Map<string, string>(); // router local → route prefix
  private pending: PendingRoute[] = [];
  private nodeSym = new WeakMap<object, string>();
  private current: SymbolFact | null = null;
  private cls: SymbolFact | null = null;
  private resolved = new Map<string, string | null>();
  private jsx: boolean;

  constructor(private path: string, private source: string, private resolve: Resolve, private ctx: ExtractContext, private record: ModuleRecord) {
    this.jsx = /\.[jt]sx$/.test(path);
  }

  run(program: N) {
    this.prepass(program.body as N[]);
    for (const stmt of program.body as N[]) this.statement(stmt);
  }

  /** Mark symbols exported through `export { a, b as c }`, then hash signatures (which include the export flag). */
  finish() {
    for (const t of this.record.exports.values()) {
      if (!('local' in t)) continue;
      const s = this.symbols.find((x) => x.parent === null && x.name === t.local);
      if (s) s.exported = true;
    }
    for (const s of this.symbols) s.sigHash = hashText(`${this.sigText.get(s.id) ?? ''}|${s.exported ? 'export' : ''}`);
  }

  /** Id of the innermost symbol whose span contains `at`. */
  innermost(at: number): string | null {
    let best: SymbolFact | null = null;
    for (const s of this.symbols) {
      if (s.span.start <= at && at < s.span.end && (!best || s.span.end - s.span.start < best.span.end - best.span.start)) best = s;
    }
    return best?.id ?? null;
  }

  /** First symbol starting in [from, to) at the same nesting as `from`. */
  firstSymbolIn(from: number, to: number): string | null {
    const parent = this.innermost(from);
    return this.symbols.find((s) => s.span.start >= from && s.span.start < to && s.parent === parent)?.id ?? null;
  }

  routes(): RouteFact[] {
    return this.pending.map((r) => {
      const h = unwrap(r.handler);
      let id = h ? this.nodeSym.get(h) ?? null : null;
      if (!id && h?.type === 'Identifier') id = this.target(h);
      return routeFact(r.method, r.path, this.path, id ?? r.enclosing);
    });
  }

  // ---- declarations

  private prepass(body: N[]) {
    const frameworkLocals = new Set<string>();
    for (const s of body) {
      if (s.type !== 'ImportDeclaration' || s.importKind === 'type') continue;
      const spec = s.source.value as string;
      for (const sp of s.specifiers as N[]) {
        if (sp.importKind === 'type') continue;
        const name = sp.type === 'ImportNamespaceSpecifier' ? '*' : sp.type === 'ImportDefaultSpecifier' ? 'default' : keyName(sp.imported, false) ?? 'default';
        this.bindings.set(sp.local.name, { spec, name });
        if (FRAMEWORKS.has(packageName(spec) ?? '')) frameworkLocals.add(sp.local.name);
      }
    }
    for (const s0 of body) {
      const exported = s0.type === 'ExportNamedDeclaration' || s0.type === 'ExportDefaultDeclaration';
      const s = exported ? s0.declaration : s0;
      if (!s) continue;
      if ((s.type === 'FunctionDeclaration' || s.type === 'ClassDeclaration') && s.id) this.topNames.add(s.id.name);
      if (s.type !== 'VariableDeclaration') continue;
      for (const d of s.declarations as N[]) {
        if (d.id.type !== 'Identifier') continue;
        if (this.isSymbolDeclarator(d, exported)) this.topNames.add(d.id.name);
        const prefix = this.frameworkPrefix(d.init, frameworkLocals);
        if (prefix !== null) this.receivers.set(d.id.name, prefix);
      }
    }
    for (const t of this.record.exports.values()) if ('local' in t) this.topNames.add(t.local);
  }

  private isSymbolDeclarator(d: N, exported: boolean): boolean {
    const init = unwrap(d.init);
    if (init && (FN.has(init.type) || init.type === 'ClassExpression')) return true;
    if (exported) return true;
    // Object literals that are typed, or hold functions (a module-like namespace), name their members.
    return init?.type === 'ObjectExpression' && (!!d.id.typeAnnotation || init.properties.some((p: N) => p.type === 'Property' && (p.method || FN.has(unwrap(p.value)?.type ?? ''))));
  }

  /**
   * Route prefix if `init` creates a router from an imported framework: `express()`, `express.Router()`, `new Hono()`,
   * `new Hono().basePath('/api')` (prefix `/api`), `Fastify()`, `new Router({ prefix: '/x' })`; null otherwise.
   */
  private frameworkPrefix(init: N | null | undefined, locals: Set<string>): string | null {
    let x = unwrap(init);
    let prefix = '';
    while (x?.type === 'CallExpression' && x.callee.type === 'MemberExpression' && unwrap(x.callee.object)?.type !== 'Identifier') {
      if (!x.callee.computed && x.callee.property.name === 'basePath') prefix = (strValue(x.arguments[0]) ?? '') + prefix;
      x = unwrap(x.callee.object);
    }
    if (!x || (x.type !== 'CallExpression' && x.type !== 'NewExpression')) return null;
    const c = unwrap(x.callee);
    const ok = c?.type === 'Identifier' ? locals.has(c.name) : c?.type === 'MemberExpression' && c.object.type === 'Identifier' && locals.has(c.object.name);
    if (!ok) return null;
    const opts = unwrap(x.arguments[0]);
    const p = opts?.type === 'ObjectExpression' ? opts.properties.find((q: N) => q.type === 'Property' && keyName(q.key, q.computed) === 'prefix') : null;
    return (p ? strValue(p.value) ?? '' : '') + prefix;
  }

  private statement(s: N) {
    switch (s.type) {
      case 'ImportDeclaration':
        return;
      case 'ExportNamedDeclaration':
        if (s.declaration) this.declaration(s.declaration, true, s);
        return;
      case 'ExportDefaultDeclaration':
        return this.exportDefault(s);
      case 'FunctionDeclaration':
      case 'ClassDeclaration':
      case 'VariableDeclaration':
      case 'TSInterfaceDeclaration':
      case 'TSTypeAliasDeclaration':
      case 'TSEnumDeclaration':
        return this.declaration(s, false, s);
      default:
        this.visit(s);
    }
  }

  private declaration(d: N, exported: boolean, outer: N) {
    switch (d.type) {
      case 'FunctionDeclaration':
        if (d.id && d.body) this.fn(d.id.name, d, exported, null, outer);
        return;
      case 'ClassDeclaration':
        return this.klass(d.id?.name ?? 'default', d, exported, outer);
      case 'VariableDeclaration':
        for (const v of d.declarations as N[]) this.declarator(v, exported, d.declarations.length === 1 ? outer : v);
        return;
      case 'TSInterfaceDeclaration':
      case 'TSTypeAliasDeclaration':
      case 'TSEnumDeclaration':
        if (exported) this.typeDecl(d, outer);
        return;
      default:
        this.visit(d);
    }
  }

  private exportDefault(s: N) {
    const d = s.declaration as N;
    if (d.type === 'FunctionDeclaration' || FN.has(d.type)) return this.fn(d.id?.name ?? 'default', d, true, null, s);
    if (d.type === 'ClassDeclaration' || d.type === 'ClassExpression') return this.klass(d.id?.name ?? 'default', d, true, s);
    if (d.type === 'TSInterfaceDeclaration') return this.typeDecl(d, s);
    if (d.type === 'Identifier') return;
    const sym = this.define('default', 'const', true, null, s, 'const', this.text(d));
    this.inside(sym, () => (unwrap(d)?.type === 'ObjectExpression' ? this.members(unwrap(d)!, sym, '') : this.visit(d)));
  }

  private declarator(d: N, exported: boolean, span: N) {
    this.capture(d);
    if (d.id.type !== 'Identifier') return this.visit(d.init);
    const name = d.id.name as string;
    const init = unwrap(d.init);
    if (init && FN.has(init.type)) return this.fn(name, init, exported, null, span);
    if (init?.type === 'ClassExpression') return this.klass(name, init, exported, span);
    if (!this.isSymbolDeclarator(d, exported)) return this.visit(d.init);
    // `export const chat = call;` aliases a local function: it is one.
    const alias = init?.type === 'Identifier' ? this.symbols.find((s) => s.parent === null && s.name === init.name)?.kind : undefined;
    const kind: SymbolKind = alias && alias !== 'const' && alias !== 'type' ? alias : 'const';
    const sym = this.define(name, kind, exported, null, span, `const ${this.text(d.id.typeAnnotation)}`, this.text(d.init));
    this.inside(sym, () => (init?.type === 'ObjectExpression' ? this.members(init, sym, '') : this.visit(d.init)));
  }

  /** Methods of an object literal held by a symbol: `newsSummarize.run`, nested `api.runs.list`. */
  private members(obj: N, parent: SymbolFact, prefix: string) {
    for (const p of obj.properties as N[]) {
      if (p.type !== 'Property') {
        this.visit(p);
        continue;
      }
      const key = keyName(p.key, p.computed);
      const v = unwrap(p.value);
      if (p.computed) this.visit(p.key);
      if (key && v && (p.method || FN.has(v.type))) this.fn(prefix + key, v, false, parent, p, 'method');
      else if (key && v?.type === 'ObjectExpression') this.members(v, parent, `${prefix}${key}.`);
      else this.visit(p.value);
    }
  }

  private fn(name: string, node: N, exported: boolean, parent: SymbolFact | null, span: N, kind?: SymbolKind) {
    const k = kind ?? (this.jsx && /^[A-Z]/.test(name) ? 'component' : 'function');
    const sym = this.define(name, k, exported, parent, span, this.fnSig(node), this.text(node.body));
    this.nodeSym.set(node, sym.id);
    this.inside(sym, () => this.fnBody(node));
  }

  private klass(name: string, node: N, exported: boolean, span: N) {
    const sig = `class ${this.text(node.typeParameters)} ${this.text(node.superClass)} ${(node.implements ?? []).map((i: N) => this.text(i)).join(',')}`;
    const sym = this.define(name, 'class', exported, null, span, sig, this.text(node.body));
    this.nodeSym.set(node, sym.id);
    const prev = this.cls;
    this.cls = sym;
    this.inside(sym, () => {
      for (const dec of node.decorators ?? []) this.visit(dec);
      this.visit(node.superClass);
      for (const m of node.body.body as N[]) {
        const key = m.key ? keyName(m.key, m.computed) : null;
        const value = unwrap(m.value);
        if ((m.type === 'MethodDefinition' || m.type === 'TSAbstractMethodDefinition') && key && value?.body) {
          for (const dec of m.decorators ?? []) this.visit(dec);
          this.fn(m.kind === 'constructor' ? 'constructor' : key, value, false, sym, m, 'method');
        } else if (m.type === 'PropertyDefinition' && key && value && FN.has(value.type)) {
          this.fn(key, value, false, sym, m, 'method');
        } else this.visit(m);
      }
    });
    this.cls = prev;
  }

  private typeDecl(d: N, span: N) {
    const sym = this.define(d.id.name, 'type', true, null, span, this.text(d), this.text(d));
    const body: N[] = d.type === 'TSInterfaceDeclaration' ? d.body.body : d.typeAnnotation?.type === 'TSTypeLiteral' ? d.typeAnnotation.members : [];
    for (const m of body) {
      const key = m.key ? keyName(m.key, m.computed) : null;
      if (!key || (m.type !== 'TSPropertySignature' && m.type !== 'TSMethodSignature')) continue;
      const fnType = m.type === 'TSMethodSignature' || m.typeAnnotation?.typeAnnotation?.type === 'TSFunctionType';
      this.define(key, fnType ? 'method' : 'property', false, sym, m, this.text(m), this.text(m));
    }
  }

  private define(name: string, kind: SymbolKind, exported: boolean, parent: SymbolFact | null, span: N, sig: string, body: string): SymbolFact {
    const qual = parent ? `${parent.name}.${name}` : name;
    const n = (this.used.get(qual) ?? 0) + 1;
    this.used.set(qual, n);
    const full = n === 1 ? qual : `${qual}~${n}`;
    const sym: SymbolFact = {
      id: `${this.path}#${full}`, file: this.path, name: full, kind, exported, parent: parent?.id ?? null,
      span: { start: span.start, end: span.end }, sigHash: '', bodyHash: hashText(squash(body)),
    };
    this.sigText.set(sym.id, `${kind}|${squash(sig)}`);
    this.symbols.push(sym);
    return sym;
  }

  private fnSig(f: N): string {
    const params = f.params?.length ? this.source.slice(f.params[0].start, f.params[f.params.length - 1].end) : '';
    return `${f.async ? 'async ' : ''}${f.generator ? '*' : ''}${this.text(f.typeParameters)}(${params}):${this.text(f.returnType)}`;
  }

  private text(n: N | null | undefined): string {
    return n ? this.source.slice(n.start, n.end) : '';
  }

  private inside(sym: SymbolFact, fn: () => void) {
    const prev = this.current;
    this.current = sym;
    fn();
    this.current = prev;
  }

  private fnBody(f: N) {
    for (const p of f.params ?? []) this.visit(p);
    this.visit(f.body);
  }

  // ---- expressions

  private visit(node: N | null | undefined): void {
    if (!node || typeof node.type !== 'string') return;
    switch (node.type) {
      case 'CallExpression':
      case 'NewExpression':
        this.call(node);
        break;
      case 'ArrowFunctionExpression':
      case 'FunctionExpression':
        // Top-level anonymous callbacks (route handlers, `createServer(…)`, `describe(…)`) get their own symbol.
        if (!this.current) {
          this.cbCount++;
          return this.fn(`<cb${this.cbCount}>`, node, false, null, node, 'function');
        }
        break;
      case 'VariableDeclarator':
        this.capture(node);
        break;
      case 'ImportDeclaration':
      case 'TSInterfaceDeclaration':
      case 'TSTypeAliasDeclaration':
      case 'TSDeclareFunction':
        return;
    }
    for (const key of visitorKeys[node.type] ?? []) {
      if (SKIP_KEYS.has(key)) continue;
      const child = node[key];
      if (Array.isArray(child)) for (const c of child) this.visit(c);
      else if (child && typeof child === 'object') this.visit(child);
    }
  }

  /** Bindings from `const { a } = await import('x')`, `const m = require('x')`. */
  private capture(d: N) {
    let init = unwrap(d.init);
    if (init?.type === 'AwaitExpression') init = unwrap(init.argument);
    let spec: string | null = null;
    if (init?.type === 'ImportExpression') spec = strValue(init.source);
    else if (init?.type === 'CallExpression' && init.callee.type === 'Identifier' && init.callee.name === 'require' && init.arguments.length === 1) spec = strValue(init.arguments[0]);
    if (spec === null) return;
    if (d.id.type === 'Identifier') this.bindings.set(d.id.name, { spec, name: '*' });
    else if (d.id.type === 'ObjectPattern') {
      for (const p of d.id.properties as N[]) {
        const key = p.type === 'Property' ? keyName(p.key, p.computed) : null;
        const local = p.value?.type === 'AssignmentPattern' ? p.value.left : p.value;
        if (key && local?.type === 'Identifier') this.bindings.set(local.name, { spec, name: key });
      }
    }
  }

  private call(node: N) {
    const callee = unwrap(node.callee);
    if (!callee) return;
    const to = this.target(callee);
    const from = this.current?.id ?? this.path;
    if (to && to !== from) {
      const key = `${from}\u0000${to}`;
      const c = this.calls.get(key);
      if (c) c.count++;
      else this.calls.set(key, { from, to, confidence: 'syntactic', count: 1 });
    }
    if (node.type === 'CallExpression') this.frameworkRoute(node, callee);
  }

  /** Callee → symbol id (`file#name.member`), `vendor:<pkg>`, or null when it isn't an import or a top-level symbol. */
  private target(callee: N): string | null {
    const chain: string[] = [];
    let root: N | null = callee;
    while (root?.type === 'MemberExpression') {
      const prop = root.computed ? strValue(root.property) : root.property.type === 'Identifier' ? root.property.name : null;
      if (prop === null) return null;
      chain.unshift(prop);
      root = unwrap(root.object);
    }
    if (!root) return null;
    if (root.type === 'ThisExpression') return this.cls && chain.length ? `${this.path}#${[this.cls.name, ...chain].join('.')}` : null;
    if (root.type !== 'Identifier') return null;
    const b = this.bindings.get(root.name);
    if (b) return this.linkImport(b, chain);
    return this.topNames.has(root.name) ? `${this.path}#${[root.name, ...chain].join('.')}` : null;
  }

  private res(from: string, spec: string): string | null {
    const key = `${from}\u0000${spec}`;
    let hit = this.resolved.get(key);
    if (hit === undefined) this.resolved.set(key, (hit = this.resolve(from, spec)));
    return hit;
  }

  private linkImport(b: Binding, chain: string[]): string | null {
    let file = this.res(this.path, b.spec);
    if (!file || file.startsWith('vendor:')) return file;
    let name = b.name;
    const rest = [...chain];
    for (let hops = 0; hops < 4; hops++) {
      if (name === '*') {
        const next = rest.shift();
        if (next === undefined) return file;
        name = next;
      }
      const t = this.follow(file, name, 0);
      if (t.file.startsWith('vendor:')) return t.file;
      file = t.file;
      name = t.name;
      if (name !== '*') break;
    }
    return `${file}#${[name, ...rest].join('.')}`;
  }

  /** Follow `name` exported by `file` through re-exports and `export *` to where it is defined. */
  private follow(file: string, name: string, depth: number): { file: string; name: string; found: boolean } {
    const rec = depth > 8 ? null : this.ctx.recordOf?.(file);
    if (!rec) return { file, name, found: false };
    const e = rec.exports.get(name);
    if (e) {
      if ('local' in e) return { file, name: e.local, found: true };
      const to = this.res(file, e.spec);
      if (!to) return { file, name, found: true };
      if (to.startsWith('vendor:') || e.name === '*') return { file: to, name: e.name, found: true };
      return this.follow(to, e.name, depth + 1);
    }
    for (const star of rec.stars) {
      const to = this.res(file, star);
      if (!to || to.startsWith('vendor:')) continue;
      const t = this.follow(to, name, depth + 1);
      if (t.found) return t;
    }
    return { file, name, found: false };
  }

  /** `app.get('/x', h)` on an Express/Hono/Fastify/Koa-router instance; Fastify's `app.route({ method, url, handler })`. */
  private frameworkRoute(node: N, callee: N) {
    if (callee.type !== 'MemberExpression' || callee.computed || callee.object.type !== 'Identifier' || !this.receivers.has(callee.object.name)) return;
    const method = callee.property.name as string;
    const args = node.arguments as N[];
    const enclosing = this.current?.id ?? null;
    const prefix = this.receivers.get(callee.object.name)!;
    if (ROUTE_METHODS.has(method) && args.length >= 2) {
      const path = strValue(args[0]);
      if (path !== null) this.pending.push({ method, path: prefix + path, handler: args[args.length - 1] ?? null, enclosing });
    } else if (method === 'route' && unwrap(args[0])?.type === 'ObjectExpression') {
      const props = new Map<string, N>();
      for (const p of unwrap(args[0])!.properties as N[]) {
        const k = p.type === 'Property' ? keyName(p.key, p.computed) : null;
        if (k) props.set(k, p.value);
      }
      const url = strValue(props.get('url') ?? props.get('path'));
      const m = props.get('method');
      const methods = unwrap(m)?.type === 'ArrayExpression' ? (unwrap(m)!.elements as N[]).map(strValue) : [strValue(m)];
      if (url !== null) for (const x of methods) if (x) this.pending.push({ method: x, path: prefix + url, handler: props.get('handler') ?? null, enclosing });
    }
  }
}

/**
 * Point each call at the deepest symbol that exists: `db.ts#db.all` stays if `db.all` is a symbol, `registry.get` on a Map
 * becomes `#registry`, and a member nothing defines becomes the file path. `symbolsOf` gives a file's symbol names
 * (null = unknown, leave as is). Calls that collapse onto the same target are merged; self-calls drop.
 */
export function settleCalls(calls: readonly CallFact[], symbolsOf: (file: string) => ReadonlySet<string> | null): CallFact[] {
  const out = new Map<string, CallFact>();
  for (const c of calls) {
    let to = c.to;
    const hash = to.indexOf('#');
    if (!to.startsWith('vendor:') && hash !== -1) {
      const file = to.slice(0, hash);
      const names = symbolsOf(file);
      if (names) {
        const parts = to.slice(hash + 1).split('.');
        while (parts.length && !names.has(parts.join('.'))) parts.pop();
        to = parts.length ? `${file}#${parts.join('.')}` : file;
      }
    }
    if (to === c.from || (!to.includes('#') && c.from.startsWith(`${to}#`))) continue;
    const key = `${c.from}\u0000${to}`;
    const prev = out.get(key);
    if (prev) prev.count += c.count;
    else out.set(key, { ...c, to });
  }
  return [...out.values()];
}

// Contract (NAVIGATION_PLAN §1, §3.2): one containment tree plus leaf edges; every level is a projection.
// Browser-safe: types and id helpers only. Implementations live in src/graph/ (Graph lane).
import type { CallConfidence, SymbolDiff } from './facts';

export type NodeKind =
  | 'repo'
  | 'domain'
  | 'cell'
  | 'group' // a directory or confirmed component inside a cell
  | 'file'
  | 'symbol'
  | 'table'
  | 'vendor' // bare package or external service not claimed by a cell
  | 'route'
  | 'entry'
  | 'unassigned' // pseudo-domain for files that match no cell
  | 'neutral' // shared code (domains.yaml `neutral`): never creates edges
  | 'tests'; // a domain's test files

export type GraphNode = {
  id: string;
  kind: NodeKind;
  parent: string | null;
  label: string;
  order: number; // stable sort key among siblings (model order for layout)
  domain?: string; // domain id, for nodes inside a domain
  layer?: string; // layer id, for cells and everything inside them
  path?: string; // repo path for files and groups (directory)
  symbol?: { kind: string; exported: boolean };
};

export type EdgeKind = 'imports' | 'calls' | 'implements' | 'handles' | 'writes' | 'reads' | 'uses' | 'fetches' | 'starts';

export type GraphEdge = {
  id: string; // edgeId(kind, from, to)
  kind: EdgeKind;
  from: string; // leaf node id
  to: string;
  count: number;
  owner: string; // the file whose facts produced it; replaced when that file changes
  confidence?: CallConfidence;
  typeOnly?: boolean;
};

export type ContextGraph = {
  root: string; // 'repo'
  nodes: Record<string, GraphNode>;
  children: Record<string, string[]>; // parent id → child ids, sorted by `order`
  edges: GraphEdge[];
};

/** View-only state held by the shell (not in the event log unless D5 says so). */
export type ViewState = {
  expanded: readonly string[];
  focus: string | null;
  lens: { kinds: readonly EdgeKind[]; turnOnly: boolean };
  budget: number; // max detailed visible nodes for autoExpand (DOI)
  follow: boolean;
};

export type ViolationState = 'existing' | 'new' | null;
export type ProposalMark = 'add' | 'move_in' | 'move_out' | 'remove' | 'rename' | null;

/** Agent and map activity for one leaf (file or symbol id) in the selected turn. */
export type LeafActivity = {
  looked: boolean;
  edited: boolean;
  added: number;
  removed: number;
  created: boolean;
  unattributed: boolean;
  ghostSteps: number[]; // planned in these steps and not yet edited
  planned: boolean;
  unplanned: boolean; // edited, the turn has a plan, and this leaf is not in it
  violation: ViolationState;
  cursor: boolean;
  symbols: SymbolDiff | null; // for files: which symbols the turn changed
  audit: number; // open advisory findings
  proposal: ProposalMark; // pending cartographer proposal touching this leaf
};

/** Activity rolled up to a visible node: booleans OR, counts sum, severity MAX (never averaged). */
export type Rollup = {
  looked: boolean;
  edited: boolean;
  added: number;
  removed: number;
  ghostSteps: number[];
  unplanned: boolean;
  violation: ViolationState;
  violationFiles: string[];
  newViolationFiles: string[];
  cursor: boolean;
  audit: number;
  proposal: ProposalMark;
  leaves: number; // files (or symbols) underneath
};

export type VisibleNode = {
  id: string;
  kind: NodeKind;
  parent: string | null; // nearest visible ancestor
  label: string;
  depth: number;
  expanded: boolean;
  expandable: boolean;
  order: number;
  domain?: string;
  layer?: string;
  path?: string;
  rollup: Rollup;
};

export type EdgeStatus = 'existing' | 'new' | 'ghost';

/** Leaf edges aggregated to their nearest visible endpoints. A ghost edge never merges with a solid one. */
export type VisibleEdge = {
  id: string;
  from: string; // visible node ids
  to: string;
  kinds: EdgeKind[];
  count: number;
  status: EdgeStatus;
  violation: ViolationState;
  confidence: CallConfidence | null; // weakest confidence among its call edges, null if none
  steps: number[]; // plan steps, for ghost edges
  leafEdges: string[]; // GraphEdge ids (or plan import keys for ghosts)
};

/** Where an aggregated edge crosses out of an expanded container. */
export type Port = { container: string; edge: string; side: 'top' | 'right' | 'bottom' | 'left'; direction: 'out' | 'in' };

export type Projection = { nodes: VisibleNode[]; edges: VisibleEdge[]; ports: Port[] };

// ---------------------------------------------------------------- ids

export const ROOT_ID = 'repo';
export const UNASSIGNED_ID = 'unassigned';
export const NEUTRAL_ID = 'neutral';
export const domainId = (domain: string) => `domain:${domain}`;
export const cellId = (domain: string, layer: string) => `cell:${domain}/${layer}`;
export const groupId = (domain: string, layer: string, dir: string) => `group:${domain}/${layer}/${dir}`;
export const testsId = (domain: string) => `tests:${domain}`;
export const tableId = (table: string) => `table:${table}`;
export const vendorId = (name: string) => `vendor:${name}`;
export const symbolId = (path: string, qualified: string) => `${path}#${qualified}`;
export const edgeId = (kind: EdgeKind, from: string, to: string) => `${kind}|${from}|${to}`;

/** The file a leaf id belongs to: `src/a.ts#f.g` → `src/a.ts`; file ids are returned as-is; others → null. */
export function fileOf(id: string): string | null {
  if (/^(domain|cell|group|tests|table|vendor|route|entry|journey):/.test(id) || id === ROOT_ID || id === UNASSIGNED_ID || id === NEUTRAL_ID) return null;
  const i = id.indexOf('#');
  return i === -1 ? id : id.slice(0, i);
}
import type { DomainMap } from './schema';
import type { Placement } from './mapper';
import type { ImportEdge, WriteFact, DomainEdge } from './facts';
import type { Violation } from './rules';
import type { PlanStep } from './plan';
import type { FileFacts, SemanticFacts, SymbolDiff, CallConfidence } from './contracts/facts';
import type { AuditFinding, AuditOutcome, DriftSignal, Journey, Label, MapProposal, ProposalOutcome } from './contracts/cartography';

export type Cell = { domain: string; layer: string };

export type EventKind =
  | 'repo_scanned' | 'map_proposed' | 'map_confirmed' | 'file_assigned'
  | 'violation_found'
  | 'turn_started' | 'looked' | 'cursor'
  | 'planned' | 'plan_violation' | 'fork_asked' | 'fork_answered' | 'plan_approved'
  | 'gate_blocked' | 'edited' | 'edge_added' | 'edge_removed'
  | 'test_result' | 'decision_recorded' | 'turn_ended'
  // Additions to SPEC §5 so the chat pane and approval button are also reductions of the log.
  | 'chat' | 'approval_requested' | 'error'
  // NAVIGATION_PLAN: per-file facts for the context graph, and the living map (§3.1, §4.7).
  | 'facts_changed' | 'facts_resolved' | 'call_added' | 'call_removed'
  | 'drift_detected' | 'map_proposal_resolved' | 'labels_updated'
  | 'audit_finding' | 'audit_resolved' | 'maintenance_run' | 'journeys_updated';

export type HarnessEvent = {
  id: string;
  t: number;
  session: string;
  turn: string | null;
  kind: EventKind;
  cell?: Cell;
  path?: string;
  data?: Record<string, unknown>;
};

/** Typed payloads, by kind. The server builds events with `ev()`; the reducer reads them back. */
export type EventData = {
  /** `fileFacts` (Tier 1, every code file) is optional for older logs; without it facts are derived from imports/writes. */
  repo_scanned: { files: { path: string; placement: Placement }[]; imports: ImportEdge[]; writes: WriteFact[]; edges: DomainEdge[]; fileFacts?: FileFacts[] };
  /** Onboarding proposal when `proposal` is absent (sets the map). A living-map proposal (`proposal` set) never changes the map until accepted. */
  map_proposed: { map: DomainMap; yaml: string; proposal?: MapProposal };
  map_confirmed: { map: DomainMap; source: 'file' | 'cartographer' | 'fixture' };
  file_assigned: { placement: Placement };
  violation_found: { violations: Violation[] }; // the full current set (replaces)
  turn_started: { prompt: string; head: string; baseline: string };
  looked: { tool: string };
  cursor: { verb: 'reading' | 'searching' | 'editing' };
  planned: {
    steps: PlanStep[];
    cells: { domain: string; layer: string; steps: number[]; files: string[] }[];
    edges: { from: string; to: string; steps: number[]; imports: ImportEdge[] }[];
    unassigned: string[];
  };
  plan_violation: { violation: Violation };
  fork_asked: { violations: Violation[]; text: string };
  fork_answered: { option: 'A' | 'B'; text: string; violations: Violation[] };
  plan_approved: Record<string, never>;
  gate_blocked: { violation: Violation; tool: string };
  edited: { added: number; removed: number; created: boolean; unattributed?: boolean; tool?: string; symbols?: SymbolDiff };
  edge_added: { edge: ImportEdge; from: string; to: string };
  edge_removed: { edge: ImportEdge; from: string; to: string };
  test_result: { domain: string; passed: number; failed: number };
  decision_recorded: { id: string; title: string; invariant: string; option: 'A' | 'B'; paths: string[]; alike?: boolean };
  turn_ended: { added: number; removed: number; files: string[]; reason: string };
  chat: { role: 'user' | 'assistant' | 'system'; text: string };
  approval_requested: { plan: string };
  error: { message: string };
  /** A file's Tier 1 facts after it changed (null = deleted). Emitted with every `edited`/`file_assigned`. */
  facts_changed: { facts: FileFacts | null };
  /** Tier 2 typed facts; ignored unless `hash` matches the file's current facts. */
  facts_resolved: { facts: SemanticFacts };
  call_added: { from: string; to: string; confidence: CallConfidence };
  call_removed: { from: string; to: string; confidence: CallConfidence };
  drift_detected: { signals: DriftSignal[] }; // the full current set (replaces)
  map_proposal_resolved: { proposal: string; outcome: ProposalOutcome; decision?: string };
  labels_updated: { labels: Label[] }; // upserts by (target, kind)
  audit_finding: { finding: AuditFinding };
  audit_resolved: { id: string; outcome: AuditOutcome };
  maintenance_run: { agent: 'cartographer' | 'auditor'; trigger: string; ms: number; cost: number | null; ok: boolean };
  journeys_updated: { journeys: Journey[] }; // the full current set (replaces)
};

export const cellKey = (c: Cell) => `${c.domain}/${c.layer}`;
export const edgeKey = (from: string, to: string) => `${from}->${to}`;

export type PlannedCell = { cell: Cell; steps: number[]; files: string[] };
export type PlannedEdge = { from: string; to: string; steps: number[]; imports: ImportEdge[] };

export type TurnState = {
  id: string;
  prompt: string;
  startedAt: number;
  endedAt: number | null;
  steps: PlanStep[];
  planned: Record<string, PlannedCell>;
  plannedEdges: Record<string, PlannedEdge>;
  planViolations: Violation[]; // the latest plan's (a resubmitted plan replaces them)
  gateBlocks: Violation[]; // unanswered edit-gate blocks
  violationsSeen: { v: Violation; source: 'plan' | 'gate' }[]; // every violation raised in the turn, for the ledger
  looked: Record<string, string[]>; // cellKey → paths
  edited: Record<string, { added: number; removed: number; files: string[]; created: string[]; unattributed: boolean }>;
  tests: Record<string, string[]>; // domain → test files edited
  unassigned: string[];
  edgesAdded: { from: string; to: string; edge: ImportEdge }[];
  edgesRemoved: { from: string; to: string; edge: ImportEdge }[];
  forks: { asked: number; answered: number | null; option: 'A' | 'B' | null; violations: Violation[]; beforeCode: boolean }[];
  decisions: string[];
  approved: boolean;
  firstEditAt: number | null; // event index of first `edited`
  numstat: { added: number; removed: number } | null;
  /** Leaf-level activity (for the context graph): path → what happened to that file this turn. */
  paths: Record<string, PathActivity>;
  callsAdded: { from: string; to: string }[];
  callsRemoved: { from: string; to: string }[];
};

export type PathActivity = { looked: boolean; added: number; removed: number; created: boolean; unattributed: boolean; edits: number; symbols: SymbolDiff | null };

export type ProposalState = { proposal: MapProposal; status: 'pending' | ProposalOutcome; at: number; decision?: string };
export type FindingState = AuditFinding & { status: 'open' | AuditOutcome; turn: string | null; at: number };

export type DomainEdgeState = { from: string; to: string; files: ImportEdge[] };

export type Decision = EventData['decision_recorded'] & { turn: string | null; at: number };

export type UIState = {
  map: DomainMap | null;
  files: Record<string, Placement>;
  edges: Record<string, DomainEdgeState>;
  violations: Violation[];
  turns: TurnState[];
  current: string | null;
  cursor: { cell: Cell | null; path: string; verb: string } | null;
  chat: { role: 'user' | 'assistant' | 'system'; text: string; turn: string | null; t: number }[];
  awaitingApproval: { turn: string | null; plan: string } | null;
  pendingFork: { turn: string | null; violations: Violation[] } | null;
  decisions: Decision[];
  errors: string[];
  /** event index → provenance lookups */
  edgeOrigin: Record<string, { turn: string | null; at: number }[]>;
  cellOrigin: Record<string, { turn: string | null; at: number }[]>;
  /** Tier 1 facts per file, and Tier 2 facts whose hash still matches. */
  facts: Record<string, FileFacts>;
  semantic: Record<string, SemanticFacts>;
  drift: DriftSignal[];
  proposals: Record<string, ProposalState>;
  labels: Record<string, Label>; // key: `${kind}:${target}`
  findings: Record<string, FindingState>;
  maintenance: (EventData['maintenance_run'] & { t: number })[];
  journeys: Journey[];
};

export function initialState(): UIState {
  return {
    map: null, files: {}, edges: {}, violations: [], turns: [], current: null, cursor: null, chat: [],
    awaitingApproval: null, pendingFork: null, decisions: [], errors: [], edgeOrigin: {}, cellOrigin: {},
    facts: {}, semantic: {}, drift: [], proposals: {}, labels: {}, findings: {}, maintenance: [], journeys: [],
  };
}

function newTurn(id: string, prompt: string, t: number): TurnState {
  return {
    id, prompt, startedAt: t, endedAt: null, steps: [], planned: {}, plannedEdges: {}, planViolations: [], gateBlocks: [], violationsSeen: [],
    looked: {}, edited: {}, tests: {}, unassigned: [], edgesAdded: [], edgesRemoved: [], forks: [], decisions: [],
    approved: false, firstEditAt: null, numstat: null, paths: {}, callsAdded: [], callsRemoved: [],
  };
}

const push = <T>(rec: Record<string, T[]>, k: string, v: T) => { (rec[k] ??= []).push(v); };

const pathActivity = (t: TurnState, path: string): PathActivity =>
  (t.paths[path] ??= { looked: false, added: 0, removed: 0, created: false, unattributed: false, edits: 0, symbols: null });

const union = (a: string[], b: string[]) => [...new Set([...a, ...b])];

function mergeSymbols(a: SymbolDiff | null, b: SymbolDiff): SymbolDiff {
  if (!a) return { added: [...b.added], removed: [...b.removed], sig: [...b.sig], body: [...b.body], renamed: [...b.renamed] };
  return { added: union(a.added, b.added), removed: union(a.removed, b.removed), sig: union(a.sig, b.sig), body: union(a.body, b.body), renamed: [...a.renamed, ...b.renamed] };
}

/** Facts for a scan from an older log without `fileFacts`: imports and writes only. */
function factsFromScan(scan: EventData['repo_scanned']): Record<string, FileFacts> {
  const out: Record<string, FileFacts> = {};
  const get = (path: string) => (out[path] ??= { path, hash: '', imports: [], writes: [], symbols: [], calls: [], routes: [], entries: [] });
  for (const i of scan.imports) get(i.from).imports.push({ to: i.to, typeOnly: false });
  for (const w of scan.writes) get(w.file).writes.push({ table: w.table, symbol: null, via: 'db' });
  return out;
}

/** Fold one event into the state. Mutates and returns `s`; callers that need immutability use `reduce`. */
export function apply(s: UIState, e: HarnessEvent, index: number): UIState {
  const turn = e.turn ? s.turns.find((x) => x.id === e.turn) ?? null : null;
  const d = (e.data ?? {}) as never;

  switch (e.kind) {
    case 'map_confirmed': {
      s.map = (d as EventData['map_confirmed']).map;
      break;
    }
    case 'map_proposed': {
      const p = d as EventData['map_proposed'];
      if (p.proposal) s.proposals[p.proposal.id] = { proposal: p.proposal, status: 'pending', at: index };
      else s.map = p.map;
      break;
    }
    case 'repo_scanned': {
      const scan = d as EventData['repo_scanned'];
      s.files = {};
      for (const f of scan.files) s.files[f.path] = f.placement;
      s.edges = {};
      for (const ed of scan.edges) s.edges[edgeKey(ed.from, ed.to)] = { from: ed.from, to: ed.to, files: [...ed.files] };
      if (scan.fileFacts) {
        s.facts = {};
        for (const f of scan.fileFacts) s.facts[f.path] = f;
      } else {
        s.facts = factsFromScan(scan);
      }
      s.semantic = {};
      break;
    }
    case 'facts_changed': {
      const { facts } = d as EventData['facts_changed'];
      const path = facts?.path ?? e.path;
      if (!path) break;
      if (facts) s.facts[path] = facts;
      else delete s.facts[path];
      if (s.semantic[path] && s.semantic[path]!.hash !== facts?.hash) delete s.semantic[path];
      break;
    }
    case 'facts_resolved': {
      const { facts } = d as EventData['facts_resolved'];
      if (s.facts[facts.path]?.hash === facts.hash) s.semantic[facts.path] = facts;
      break;
    }
    case 'call_added':
    case 'call_removed': {
      const { from, to } = d as EventData['call_added'];
      (e.kind === 'call_added' ? turn?.callsAdded : turn?.callsRemoved)?.push({ from, to });
      break;
    }
    case 'drift_detected':
      s.drift = (d as EventData['drift_detected']).signals;
      break;
    case 'map_proposal_resolved': {
      const r = d as EventData['map_proposal_resolved'];
      const p = s.proposals[r.proposal];
      if (p) { p.status = r.outcome; if (r.decision) p.decision = r.decision; }
      break;
    }
    case 'labels_updated':
      for (const l of (d as EventData['labels_updated']).labels) s.labels[`${l.kind}:${l.target}`] = l;
      break;
    case 'audit_finding': {
      const { finding } = d as EventData['audit_finding'];
      s.findings[finding.id] = { ...finding, status: 'open', turn: e.turn, at: index };
      break;
    }
    case 'audit_resolved': {
      const r = d as EventData['audit_resolved'];
      const f = s.findings[r.id];
      if (f) f.status = r.outcome;
      break;
    }
    case 'journeys_updated':
      s.journeys = (d as EventData['journeys_updated']).journeys;
      break;
    case 'maintenance_run':
      s.maintenance.push({ ...(d as EventData['maintenance_run']), t: e.t });
      break;
    case 'file_assigned': {
      if (e.path) s.files[e.path] = (d as EventData['file_assigned']).placement;
      break;
    }
    case 'violation_found':
      s.violations = (d as EventData['violation_found']).violations;
      break;
    case 'turn_started': {
      const t = newTurn(e.turn ?? e.id, (d as EventData['turn_started']).prompt, e.t);
      s.turns.push(t);
      s.current = t.id;
      s.cursor = null;
      break;
    }
    case 'chat': {
      const { role, text } = d as EventData['chat'];
      s.chat.push({ role, text, turn: e.turn, t: e.t });
      break;
    }
    case 'looked':
    case 'cursor': {
      if (e.path) s.cursor = { cell: e.cell ?? null, path: e.path, verb: e.kind === 'cursor' ? (d as EventData['cursor']).verb : 'reading' };
      if (e.kind === 'looked' && turn && e.path) pathActivity(turn, e.path).looked = true;
      if (e.kind === 'looked' && turn && e.cell && e.path) {
        const k = cellKey(e.cell);
        const list = (turn.looked[k] ??= []);
        if (!list.includes(e.path)) list.push(e.path);
      }
      break;
    }
    case 'planned': {
      if (!turn) break;
      const p = d as EventData['planned'];
      turn.steps = p.steps;
      turn.planned = {};
      for (const c of p.cells) turn.planned[cellKey(c)] = { cell: { domain: c.domain, layer: c.layer }, steps: c.steps, files: c.files };
      turn.plannedEdges = {};
      for (const ed of p.edges) turn.plannedEdges[edgeKey(ed.from, ed.to)] = ed;
      turn.unassigned = p.unassigned;
      turn.planViolations = []; // a resubmitted plan replaces the previous one's violations
      break;
    }
    case 'plan_violation': {
      const { violation } = d as EventData['plan_violation'];
      turn?.planViolations.push(violation);
      turn?.violationsSeen.push({ v: violation, source: 'plan' });
      break;
    }
    case 'gate_blocked': {
      const { violation } = d as EventData['gate_blocked'];
      turn?.gateBlocks.push(violation);
      turn?.violationsSeen.push({ v: violation, source: 'gate' });
      break;
    }
    case 'fork_asked': {
      const { violations } = d as EventData['fork_asked'];
      s.pendingFork = { turn: e.turn, violations };
      turn?.forks.push({ asked: index, answered: null, option: null, violations, beforeCode: turn.firstEditAt === null });
      break;
    }
    case 'fork_answered': {
      const { option } = d as EventData['fork_answered'];
      s.pendingFork = null;
      const f = turn?.forks.findLast((x) => x.answered === null);
      if (f) { f.answered = index; f.option = option; f.beforeCode = f.beforeCode && turn!.firstEditAt === null; }
      if (turn) turn.gateBlocks = []; // answered; the decision now governs
      break;
    }
    case 'approval_requested':
      s.awaitingApproval = { turn: e.turn, plan: (d as EventData['approval_requested']).plan };
      break;
    case 'plan_approved':
      s.awaitingApproval = null;
      if (turn) turn.approved = true;
      break;
    case 'edited': {
      const ed = d as EventData['edited'];
      if (s.cursor && e.path && !ed.unattributed) s.cursor = { cell: e.cell ?? null, path: e.path, verb: 'editing' };
      if (!turn || !e.path) break;
      if (turn.firstEditAt === null) turn.firstEditAt = index;
      const pa = pathActivity(turn, e.path);
      pa.added += ed.added;
      pa.removed += ed.removed;
      pa.edits += 1;
      if (ed.created) pa.created = true;
      if (ed.unattributed) pa.unattributed = true;
      if (ed.symbols) pa.symbols = mergeSymbols(pa.symbols, ed.symbols);
      const placement = s.files[e.path];
      if (placement?.kind === 'test') { push(turn.tests, placement.domain, e.path); break; }
      if (!e.cell) { if (!turn.unassigned.includes(e.path)) turn.unassigned.push(e.path); break; }
      const k = cellKey(e.cell);
      const c = (turn.edited[k] ??= { added: 0, removed: 0, files: [], created: [], unattributed: false });
      c.added += ed.added;
      c.removed += ed.removed;
      if (!c.files.includes(e.path)) c.files.push(e.path);
      if (ed.created && !c.created.includes(e.path)) c.created.push(e.path);
      if (ed.unattributed) c.unattributed = true;
      push(s.cellOrigin, k, { turn: e.turn, at: index });
      break;
    }
    case 'edge_added': {
      const { edge, from, to } = d as EventData['edge_added'];
      const k = edgeKey(from, to);
      const cur = (s.edges[k] ??= { from, to, files: [] });
      if (!cur.files.some((f) => f.from === edge.from && f.to === edge.to)) cur.files.push(edge);
      push(s.edgeOrigin, k, { turn: e.turn, at: index });
      turn?.edgesAdded.push({ from, to, edge });
      break;
    }
    case 'edge_removed': {
      const { edge, from, to } = d as EventData['edge_removed'];
      const k = edgeKey(from, to);
      const cur = s.edges[k];
      if (cur) {
        cur.files = cur.files.filter((f) => !(f.from === edge.from && f.to === edge.to));
        if (!cur.files.length) delete s.edges[k];
      }
      turn?.edgesRemoved.push({ from, to, edge });
      break;
    }
    case 'decision_recorded': {
      const dec = d as EventData['decision_recorded'];
      const existing = s.decisions.find((x) => x.id === dec.id);
      if (existing) Object.assign(existing, dec); // the Alike confirmation re-emits with alike: true
      else s.decisions.push({ ...dec, turn: e.turn, at: index });
      if (turn && !turn.decisions.includes(dec.id)) turn.decisions.push(dec.id);
      break;
    }
    case 'turn_ended': {
      if (!turn) break;
      const { added, removed } = d as EventData['turn_ended'];
      turn.endedAt = e.t;
      turn.numstat = { added, removed };
      s.awaitingApproval = null;
      if (s.current === turn.id) s.cursor = null;
      break;
    }
    case 'error':
      s.errors.push((d as EventData['error']).message);
      break;
    case 'test_result':
      break;
  }
  return s;
}

/** UI state = reduce(events). Replay is `reduce(events, i)`: the state after the first `i` events. */
export function reduce(events: readonly HarnessEvent[], upTo = events.length): UIState {
  const s = initialState();
  const n = Math.min(upTo, events.length);
  for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) apply(s, events[i]!, i);
  return s;
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------- derived views

export type CellView = {
  cell: Cell;
  looked: boolean;
  edited: boolean;
  ghost: number[] | null; // planned step numbers while not yet edited
  unplanned: boolean; // amber: edited but not in this turn's plan
  violation: 'existing' | 'new' | null;
  violationFiles: string[];
  newViolationFiles: string[];
  added: number;
  removed: number;
};

/** Per-cell visual state for one turn (defaults to the latest), plus load-time violations. */
export function cellViews(s: UIState, turnId: string | null = s.turns.at(-1)?.id ?? null): Record<string, CellView> {
  const out: Record<string, CellView> = {};
  const map = s.map;
  if (!map) return out;
  const turn = turnId ? s.turns.find((t) => t.id === turnId) ?? null : null;
  const hasPlan = !!turn && Object.keys(turn.planned).length > 0;

  for (const dom of map.domains) {
    for (const layer of map.layers) {
      if (!(layer.id in dom.cells)) continue;
      const cell = { domain: dom.id, layer: layer.id };
      const k = cellKey(cell);
      const edited = turn?.edited[k];
      const planned = turn?.planned[k];
      out[k] = {
        cell,
        looked: !!turn?.looked[k]?.length,
        edited: !!edited,
        ghost: planned && !edited ? planned.steps : null,
        unplanned: hasPlan && !!edited && !planned,
        violation: null,
        violationFiles: [],
        newViolationFiles: [],
        added: edited?.added ?? 0,
        removed: edited?.removed ?? 0,
      };
    }
  }
  const mark = (file: string, isNew: boolean, planCell?: Cell) => {
    const p = s.files[file];
    const cell = p?.kind === 'cell' ? { domain: p.domain, layer: p.layer } : planCell;
    if (!cell) return;
    const v = out[cellKey(cell)];
    if (!v) return;
    if (isNew) {
      v.violation = 'new';
      if (!v.newViolationFiles.includes(file)) v.newViolationFiles.push(file);
    } else {
      v.violation ??= 'existing';
      if (!v.violationFiles.includes(file)) v.violationFiles.push(file);
    }
  };
  for (const v of s.violations) mark(v.file, false);
  if (turn) {
    const plannedCellOf = (file: string) => Object.values(turn.planned).find((c) => c.files.includes(file))?.cell;
    for (const v of [...turn.planViolations, ...turn.gateBlocks]) {
      if (s.violations.some((x) => x.file === v.file && x.invariant === v.invariant)) continue; // already on the map before this turn
      mark(v.file, true, plannedCellOf(v.file));
    }
  }
  return out;
}

export type EdgeView = {
  from: string;
  to: string;
  state: 'existing' | 'ghost' | 'new';
  violation: boolean;
  steps: number[];
  files: ImportEdge[];
};

/**
 * Edges for one turn. A planned edge always gets its own `ghost` entry, even when a solid edge between the same
 * domains exists, so a plan that repeats an existing violation still looks different from the map before the turn.
 */
export function edgeViews(s: UIState, turnId: string | null = s.turns.at(-1)?.id ?? null): EdgeView[] {
  const turn = turnId ? s.turns.find((t) => t.id === turnId) ?? null : null;
  const violating = (from: string, files: ImportEdge[], list: Violation[]) =>
    list.some((v) => files.some((f) => f.from === v.file && (!v.target || v.target === f.to)));
  const out: EdgeView[] = [];
  const addedThisTurn = new Set(turn?.edgesAdded.map((x) => edgeKey(x.from, x.to)) ?? []);
  for (const [k, e] of Object.entries(s.edges)) {
    out.push({ from: e.from, to: e.to, state: addedThisTurn.has(k) ? 'new' : 'existing', violation: violating(e.from, e.files, s.violations), steps: [], files: e.files });
  }
  if (turn) {
    for (const pe of Object.values(turn.plannedEdges)) {
      const built = pe.imports.every((imp) => s.edges[edgeKey(pe.from, pe.to)]?.files.some((f) => f.from === imp.from && f.to === imp.to));
      if (built) continue;
      out.push({ from: pe.from, to: pe.to, state: 'ghost', violation: violating(pe.from, pe.imports, turn.planViolations), steps: pe.steps, files: pe.imports });
    }
  }
  return out;
}

/** Decisions and turns behind an edge or a cell, for the inspector. */
export function provenance(s: UIState, target: { edge: string } | { cell: string }) {
  const origins = 'edge' in target ? s.edgeOrigin[target.edge] ?? [] : s.cellOrigin[target.cell] ?? [];
  const turnIds = [...new Set(origins.map((o) => o.turn).filter((x): x is string => !!x))];
  const turns = turnIds.map((id) => ({ id, index: s.turns.findIndex((t) => t.id === id) + 1, prompt: s.turns.find((t) => t.id === id)?.prompt ?? '' }));
  const decisions = s.decisions.filter((d) => d.turn && turnIds.includes(d.turn));
  return { turns, decisions };
}

// autoExpand (NAVIGATION_PLAN §1.3): Furnas degree of interest = a-priori importance − tree distance from focus.
import type { TurnActivity } from '../contracts/api';
import type { ContextGraph, LeafActivity } from '../contracts/graph';
import { byId, pathTo } from './util';

/** A-priori importance of a leaf: cursor ≫ new violation > ghost/planned > edited > looked > existing violation > rest. */
export function importance(l: LeafActivity): number {
  if (l.cursor) return 100;
  if (l.violation === 'new') return 8;
  if (l.ghostSteps.length || l.planned) return 6;
  if (l.edited) return 5;
  if (l.looked) return 4;
  if (l.violation === 'existing') return 2;
  return 0;
}

/**
 * Containers to expand for a view of at most `budget` visible nodes. A container's importance is the max over
 * its leaves (plus files with a current violation); its interest is importance − tree distance to the anchor
 * (`focus`, else the agent cursor, else the root). Candidates are containers with some importance and the
 * anchor's ancestors-or-self; the most interesting visible candidate is expanded whenever its children still fit
 * the budget. Ties: interest, then shallower, then id. Symbols are never expanded. Returns ids in expansion order.
 */
export function autoExpand(graph: ContextGraph, activity: TurnActivity, focus: string | null, budget: number): string[] {
  const score = new Map<string, number>();
  const raise = (id: string, s: number) => {
    if (s <= 0) return;
    for (let n: string | null = id; n; n = graph.nodes[n]?.parent ?? null) {
      if ((score.get(n) ?? 0) >= s) break; // ancestors already carry at least this much
      score.set(n, s);
    }
  };
  for (const [id, l] of Object.entries(activity.leaves)) if (graph.nodes[id]) raise(id, importance(l));
  for (const f of activity.violations.files) if (graph.nodes[f]) raise(f, 2);

  const anchor = focus && graph.nodes[focus] ? focus : activity.cursor && graph.nodes[activity.cursor] ? activity.cursor : graph.root;
  const anchorPath = pathTo(graph, anchor);
  const onPath = new Set(anchorPath);
  const dist = (id: string) => {
    const p = pathTo(graph, id);
    let i = 0;
    while (i < p.length && i < anchorPath.length && p[i] === anchorPath[i]) i++;
    return p.length + anchorPath.length - 2 * i;
  };
  const interest = (id: string) => (score.get(id) ?? 0) - dist(id);

  const kids = (id: string) => graph.children[id] ?? [];
  let visible = kids(graph.root).length;
  if (visible > budget) return [];
  const cand: { id: string; interest: number; depth: number }[] = [];
  const offer = (id: string) => {
    const n = graph.nodes[id]!;
    if (n.kind === 'symbol' || !kids(id).length || (!score.has(id) && !onPath.has(id))) return;
    cand.push({ id, interest: interest(id), depth: pathTo(graph, id).length });
  };
  kids(graph.root).forEach(offer);
  const out: string[] = [];
  while (cand.length) {
    cand.sort((a, b) => b.interest - a.interest || a.depth - b.depth || byId(a.id, b.id));
    const { id } = cand.shift()!;
    const n = kids(id).length;
    if (visible + n > budget) continue;
    visible += n;
    out.push(id);
    kids(id).forEach(offer);
  }
  return out;
}
// Graph lane (NAVIGATION_PLAN §3.2): ContextGraph, activity, projection, DOI expansion and trace. Pure, browser-safe.
//
// Typical use: `const g = graphOf(ui); const p = project(g, view, activityFor(ui, g, turnId));`
// Parity with today's views is defined at "domains expanded one level" (view.expanded = every domain id,
// lens.kinds = ['imports']): the visible `cell:` nodes equal cellViews and the cross-domain cell→cell edges,
// grouped by domain pair, equal edgeViews (test/graph-parity.test.ts checks every prefix of the demo log).
export { buildGraph, graphFacts, graphOf, VENDORS_ID, GROUP_THRESHOLD, EXTERNAL_LAYER } from './build';
export { activityFor, emptyLeaf, strongerMark } from './activity';
export { project, side, worse, isActive } from './project';
export { autoExpand, importance } from './expand';
export { trace, MAX_TRACE_PATHS } from './trace';
// Lazy per-graph indexes, cached by identity (graphs are treated as immutable once built).
import type { ContextGraph, GraphEdge } from '../contracts/graph';

const memo = <T>(build: (g: ContextGraph) => T) => {
  const cache = new WeakMap<ContextGraph, T>();
  return (g: ContextGraph): T => {
    let v = cache.get(g);
    if (v === undefined) cache.set(g, (v = build(g)));
    return v;
  };
};

/** from → leaf edges, in graph order. */
export const outEdges = memo((g) => {
  const out = new Map<string, GraphEdge[]>();
  for (const e of g.edges) {
    const list = out.get(e.from);
    if (list) list.push(e);
    else out.set(e.from, [e]);
  }
  return out;
});

export const edgeIds = memo((g) => new Set(g.edges.map((e) => e.id)));

/** Files in a subtree (a file counts itself) and symbols strictly below a node; memoized for containers only. */
export const subtreeCounts = memo((g) => {
  const cache = new Map<string, { files: number; symbols: number }>();
  const count = (id: string): { files: number; symbols: number } => {
    const kids = g.children[id];
    const self = g.nodes[id]!.kind === 'file' ? 1 : 0;
    if (!kids?.length) return { files: self, symbols: 0 };
    let c = cache.get(id);
    if (c) return c;
    c = { files: self, symbols: 0 };
    for (const k of kids) {
      const s = count(k);
      c.files += s.files;
      c.symbols += s.symbols + (g.nodes[k]!.kind === 'symbol' ? 1 : 0);
    }
    cache.set(id, c);
    return c;
  };
  return count;
});

/** Ancestors of `id` from the root down, including `id`. */
export function pathTo(g: ContextGraph, id: string): string[] {
  const out: string[] = [];
  for (let n: string | null = id; n; n = g.nodes[n]?.parent ?? null) out.push(n);
  return out.reverse();
}

export const byId = (a: string, b: string) => (a < b ? -1 : a > b ? 1 : 0);
// trace (NAVIGATION_PLAN §2 "Wiring trace"): shortest call chains from a symbol, route or file to its sinks.
import type { ContextGraph } from '../contracts/graph';
import { EXTERNAL_LAYER } from './build';
import { byId } from './util';

export const MAX_TRACE_PATHS = 5;

const adjacency = new WeakMap<ContextGraph, Map<string, { to: string; sinkOnly: boolean }[]>>();

/** calls and handles forward, implements from the interface member to each implementation, writes into tables. */
function adjacencyOf(g: ContextGraph) {
  let adj = adjacency.get(g);
  if (adj) return adj;
  adj = new Map();
  const link = (a: string, b: string, sinkOnly: boolean) => {
    const list = adj!.get(a) ?? adj!.set(a, []).get(a)!;
    if (!list.some((x) => x.to === b)) list.push({ to: b, sinkOnly });
  };
  for (const e of g.edges) {
    if (e.kind === 'calls' || e.kind === 'handles') link(e.from, e.to, false);
    else if (e.kind === 'implements') link(e.to, e.from, false);
    else if (e.kind === 'writes') link(e.from, e.to, true);
  }
  for (const list of adj.values()) list.sort((x, y) => byId(x.to, y.to));
  adjacency.set(g, adj);
  return adj;
}

/**
 * BFS over calls ∪ implements ∪ handles (plus writes into a table sink). Default sinks: vendor and table nodes,
 * and anything inside an `external` cell. Sinks end a chain. Returns at most MAX_TRACE_PATHS shortest chains
 * (one per sink, nearest first, ties by sink id), each starting at `from`. Dispatch through a registry shows up
 * as an interface member followed by an implementation (`implements` walked backwards).
 */
export function trace(graph: ContextGraph, from: string, sinks?: readonly string[]): string[][] {
  if (!graph.nodes[from]) return [];
  const adj = adjacencyOf(graph);
  const given = sinks ? new Set(sinks) : null;
  const isSink = (id: string) => {
    if (given) return given.has(id);
    const n = graph.nodes[id];
    return id.startsWith('vendor:') || id.startsWith('table:') || n?.layer === EXTERNAL_LAYER;
  };
  const parent = new Map<string, string | null>([[from, null]]);
  const found: string[] = [];
  let frontier = [from];
  while (frontier.length && found.length < MAX_TRACE_PATHS) {
    const next: string[] = [];
    const reached: string[] = [];
    for (const id of frontier) {
      for (const { to, sinkOnly } of adj.get(id) ?? []) {
        if (parent.has(to) || (sinkOnly && !isSink(to))) continue;
        parent.set(to, id);
        if (isSink(to)) reached.push(to);
        else next.push(to);
      }
    }
    found.push(...reached.sort(byId));
    frontier = next;
  }
  return found.slice(0, MAX_TRACE_PATHS).map((sink) => {
    const path: string[] = [];
    for (let n: string | null = sink; n !== null; n = parent.get(n) ?? null) path.push(n);
    return path.reverse();
  });
}
