// A repo resolver rides along on an `Exists` function, so `resolveImport(from, spec, exists)` and every caller of
// it (gate, plan, load scan) gain tsconfig paths, package exports and workspaces without a signature change.

/** Module resolution against one repo on disk (see `createRepoResolver`). */
export type RepoResolverLike = {
  /** Repo path, `vendor:<pkg>` (package or node builtin), or null. Files on disk only. */
  resolve(fromFile: string, spec: string): string | null;
  /**
   * Repo-relative candidate bases for a non-relative spec from tsconfig `paths`/`baseUrl` (for files that don't exist
   * yet); `alias` is true when a `paths` pattern matched, i.e. the spec is not a package name.
   */
  candidates(fromFile: string, spec: string): { bases: string[]; alias: boolean };
  clear(): void;
};

const KEY = Symbol.for('harness.repoResolver');

type Carrier = { [KEY]?: () => RepoResolverLike };

/** The resolver attached to `fn`, if any. */
export function resolverOf(fn: object): RepoResolverLike | null {
  return (fn as Carrier)[KEY]?.() ?? null;
}

/** Attach a (lazily created) resolver to `fn`. Returns `fn`. */
export function attachResolver<T extends object>(fn: T, get: () => RepoResolverLike): T {
  Object.defineProperty(fn, KEY, { value: get, enumerable: false, configurable: true });
  return fn;
}

/** Give `fn` the resolver `from` carries, if any. Returns `fn`. */
export function carryResolver<T extends object>(fn: T, from: object): T {
  const get = (from as Carrier)[KEY];
  return get ? attachResolver(fn, get) : fn;
}
// The import/export record and table writes of one file: what the edit gate, the load scan and extractFacts share.
// Node-only (oxc-parser native binding). Parsing is skipped for large or minified files, so the gate stays fast.
import { initSync as initLexer, parse as lex } from 'es-module-lexer';
import { parseSync, type ParseResult } from 'oxc-parser';
import { findWrites, maskComments, type WriteHit } from './adapters';
import { REQUIRE, regexImports, stripComments, type SpecSite } from './regex';

/** Above this size (or when minified) the record comes from es-module-lexer: oxc's AST transfer costs ~40 ms/MB. */
export const LEX_MIN = 128_000;
/** Above this size (or when minified) a file gets the import/export record only: no symbols, calls or routes. */
export const BULK_MIN = 500_000;

/** What an export name points at: a local binding, or `name` (`'*'` = namespace) of the module `spec`. */
export type ExportTarget = { local: string } | { spec: string; name: string };

export type ModuleRecord = {
  specs: SpecSite[]; // imports, re-exports, dynamic imports, require(), in source order
  exports: Map<string, ExportTarget>;
  stars: string[]; // `export * from` specs
  writes: WriteHit[];
  mode: 'oxc' | 'lexer' | 'regex';
};

const CODE_EXT = /\.(?:[cm]?[jt]sx?|d\.ts)$/;
/** File name oxc uses to pick the language (`.ts` when the path has no code extension). */
export const parseName = (path: string) => (CODE_EXT.test(path) ? path : `${path || 'source'}.ts`);

/** Long average line length means generated or minified code. */
export function isMinified(source: string): boolean {
  if (source.length < 20_000) return false;
  const sample = Math.min(source.length, 100_000);
  let lines = 1;
  for (let i = source.indexOf('\n'); i !== -1 && i < sample; i = source.indexOf('\n', i + 1)) lines++;
  return sample / lines > 400;
}

const literal = (text: string): string | null => {
  const m = /^(['"])([^'"\n]*)\1$/.exec(text) ?? /^`([^`$\n]*)`$/.exec(text);
  return m ? (m[2] ?? m[1]!) : null;
};

const requires = (code: string, out: SpecSite[]) => {
  for (const m of code.matchAll(REQUIRE)) out.push({ spec: m[2]!, typeOnly: false, at: m.index });
};

function fromOxc(source: string, r: ParseResult): ModuleRecord {
  const m = r.module;
  const specs: SpecSite[] = [];
  const exports = new Map<string, ExportTarget>();
  const stars: string[] = [];
  for (const si of m.staticImports) specs.push({ spec: si.moduleRequest.value, typeOnly: si.entries.length > 0 && si.entries.every((e) => e.isType), at: si.start });
  for (const se of m.staticExports) {
    const req = se.entries.find((e) => e.moduleRequest)?.moduleRequest;
    if (req) specs.push({ spec: req.value, typeOnly: se.entries.every((e) => e.isType), at: se.start });
    for (const e of se.entries) {
      const key = e.exportName.kind === 'Default' ? 'default' : e.exportName.name;
      if (e.moduleRequest) {
        if (e.importName.kind === 'AllButDefault') stars.push(e.moduleRequest.value);
        else if (key) exports.set(key, { spec: e.moduleRequest.value, name: e.importName.kind === 'All' ? '*' : (e.importName.name ?? 'default') });
      } else if (key) {
        // `import { a } from './x'; export { a }`: oxc points importName at the import specifier.
        const at = e.importName.start;
        const si = at === null ? undefined : m.staticImports.find((s) => s.start <= at && at < s.end);
        const ie = si?.entries.find((x) => x.importName.start === at || x.localName.start === at);
        if (si && ie) {
          const name = ie.importName.kind === 'Default' ? 'default' : ie.importName.kind === 'NamespaceObject' ? '*' : ie.importName.name!;
          exports.set(key, { spec: si.moduleRequest.value, name });
        } else exports.set(key, { local: e.localName.name ?? 'default' });
      }
    }
  }
  for (const di of m.dynamicImports) {
    const spec = literal(source.slice(di.moduleRequest.start, di.moduleRequest.end));
    if (spec !== null) specs.push({ spec, typeOnly: false, at: di.start });
  }
  const code = maskComments(source, r.comments);
  requires(code, specs);
  return { specs: specs.sort((a, b) => a.at - b.at), exports, stars, writes: findWrites(code), mode: 'oxc' };
}

function fromLexer(source: string): ModuleRecord | null {
  initLexer();
  let parsed;
  try {
    parsed = lex(source);
  } catch {
    return null; // e.g. JSX: let oxc handle it
  }
  const [imps, exps] = parsed;
  const specs: SpecSite[] = [];
  for (const i of imps) {
    if (i.n === undefined || i.t === 3) continue; // non-literal dynamic import, import.meta
    specs.push({ spec: i.n, typeOnly: i.t === 1 && /^(?:import|export)\s+type[\s{*]/.test(source.slice(i.ss, i.ss + 16)), at: i.ss });
  }
  requires(source, specs);
  const exports = new Map<string, ExportTarget>();
  for (const e of exps) exports.set(e.n, { local: e.ln ?? e.n });
  return { specs: specs.sort((a, b) => a.at - b.at), exports, stars: [], writes: findWrites(source), mode: 'lexer' };
}

function fromRegex(source: string): ModuleRecord {
  const code = stripComments(source);
  return { specs: regexImports(code), exports: new Map(), stars: [], writes: findWrites(code), mode: 'regex' };
}

/**
 * Parse `source` and build its record. `parsed` is the oxc result (for the AST walk) when oxc parsed it cleanly.
 * Large or minified files go through es-module-lexer; source with syntax errors falls back to regex.
 */
export function parseModule(path: string, source: string): { record: ModuleRecord; parsed: ParseResult | null } {
  if (source.length > LEX_MIN || isMinified(source)) {
    const record = fromLexer(source);
    if (record) return { record, parsed: null };
  }
  const r = parseSync(parseName(path), source);
  if (r.errors.length > 0) return { record: fromRegex(source), parsed: null };
  return { record: fromOxc(source, r), parsed: r };
}

const CACHE_PATHS = 1024;
const cache = new Map<string, { source: string; record: ModuleRecord }[]>(); // path → last two texts (old and new)

/** `parseModule(...).record`, remembering the last two records per path, so the gate's old text is usually a hit. */
export function moduleRecord(path: string, source: string): ModuleRecord {
  const hit = cache.get(path)?.find((e) => e.source === source);
  return hit ? hit.record : remember(path, source, parseModule(path, source).record);
}

export function remember(path: string, source: string, record: ModuleRecord): ModuleRecord {
  const list = (cache.get(path) ?? []).filter((e) => e.source !== source);
  cache.delete(path);
  cache.set(path, [{ source, record }, ...list.slice(0, 1)]);
  if (cache.size > CACHE_PATHS) cache.delete(cache.keys().next().value!);
  return record;
}
// Node-only module resolution for one repo: oxc-resolver for files on disk (tsconfig `paths`/`baseUrl` with
// `extends`, package `exports`/`imports`, workspaces, `.js`→`.ts`, directory index), get-tsconfig for planned files.
import * as fs from 'node:fs';
import * as path from 'node:path';
import { createPathsMatcher, getTsconfig } from 'get-tsconfig';
import { ResolverFactory } from 'oxc-resolver';
import picomatch from 'picomatch';
import YAML from 'yaml';
import type { RepoResolverLike } from './context';

/** Package name for a bare specifier (`react-dom/client` → `react-dom`), `node:x` as is; null for aliases like `@/x`, `~/x`, `#x`. */
export function packageName(spec: string): string | null {
  if (spec.startsWith('node:')) return spec;
  const parts = spec.split('/');
  const name = spec.startsWith('@') ? (parts.length >= 2 ? `${parts[0]}/${parts[1]}` : '') : parts[0]!;
  return /^(?:@[a-z0-9][\w.-]*\/)?[a-z0-9][\w.-]*$/i.test(name) ? name : null;
}

const toPosix = (p: string) => p.split(path.sep).join('/');

export type RepoResolver = RepoResolverLike & { root: string };

/**
 * Resolver for the repo at `root`. If a workspace package isn't linked under `node_modules` (no install yet), it is
 * symlinked under `<root>/.harness/ws-modules` so `exports` maps still apply (Harness may write only under `.harness/`).
 */
export function createRepoResolver(rootIn: string): RepoResolver {
  const root = fs.realpathSync(rootIn);
  const modules = ['node_modules'];
  const shim = linkWorkspaces(root);
  if (shim) modules.push(shim);
  const factory = new ResolverFactory({
    tsconfig: 'auto',
    extensions: ['.ts', '.tsx', '.mts', '.cts', '.js', '.jsx', '.mjs', '.cjs', '.json', '.d.ts'],
    extensionAlias: { '.js': ['.ts', '.tsx', '.js', '.jsx'], '.jsx': ['.tsx', '.jsx'], '.mjs': ['.mts', '.mjs'], '.cjs': ['.cts', '.cjs'] },
    conditionNames: ['source', 'types', 'import', 'require', 'module', 'node', 'default'],
    mainFields: ['types', 'module', 'main'],
    builtinModules: true,
    nodePath: false,
    modules,
  });

  type Matcher = { match: (spec: string) => string[]; patterns: string[] };
  const matchers = new Map<string, Matcher | null>();
  const tsconfigCache = new Map<string, unknown>();
  const matcherFor = (dir: string) => {
    let m = matchers.get(dir);
    if (m === undefined) {
      const ts = getTsconfig(dir, 'tsconfig.json', tsconfigCache as never);
      const match = ts && ts.path.startsWith(root + path.sep) ? createPathsMatcher(ts) : null;
      m = match ? { match, patterns: Object.keys(ts?.config.compilerOptions?.paths ?? {}) } : null;
      matchers.set(dir, m);
    }
    return m;
  };
  const matchesPattern = (pattern: string, spec: string) => {
    const star = pattern.indexOf('*');
    return star === -1 ? pattern === spec : spec.startsWith(pattern.slice(0, star)) && spec.endsWith(pattern.slice(star + 1));
  };

  const inRepo = (abs: string): string | null => {
    const rel = toPosix(path.relative(root, abs));
    if (!rel || rel.startsWith('..') || path.isAbsolute(rel)) return null;
    return rel;
  };

  return {
    root,
    resolve(fromFile, spec) {
      let r;
      try {
        r = factory.resolveFileSync(path.join(root, fromFile), spec);
      } catch {
        return null;
      }
      if (r.builtin) return `vendor:${r.builtin.resolved}`;
      if (!r.path) return null;
      const rel = inRepo(r.path);
      if (rel && !/(^|\/)node_modules\//.test(rel)) return rel;
      const pkg = packageName(spec);
      return pkg ? `vendor:${pkg}` : null;
    },
    candidates(fromFile, spec) {
      const m = matcherFor(path.dirname(path.join(root, fromFile)));
      if (!m) return { bases: [], alias: false };
      return { bases: m.match(spec).flatMap((abs) => inRepo(abs) ?? []), alias: m.patterns.some((p) => matchesPattern(p, spec)) };
    },
    clear() {
      factory.clearCache();
      matchers.clear();
      tsconfigCache.clear();
    },
  };
}

/** Workspace package dirs (repo-relative) from package.json `workspaces` and pnpm-workspace.yaml. */
export function workspaceDirs(root: string): string[] {
  const globs: string[] = [];
  try {
    const pkg = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(path.join(root, 'package.json'), 'utf8')) as { workspaces?: string[] | { packages?: string[] } };
    globs.push(...(Array.isArray(pkg.workspaces) ? pkg.workspaces : (pkg.workspaces?.packages ?? [])));
  } catch { /* no package.json */ }
  try {
    const pnpm = YAML.parse(fs.readFileSync(path.join(root, 'pnpm-workspace.yaml'), 'utf8')) as { packages?: string[] } | null;
    globs.push(...(pnpm?.packages ?? []));
  } catch { /* not pnpm */ }
  const include = globs.filter((g) => !g.startsWith('!')).map((g) => g.replace(/^\.\//, '').replace(/\/$/, ''));
  if (include.length === 0) return [];
  const match = picomatch(include, { ignore: globs.filter((g) => g.startsWith('!')).map((g) => g.slice(1).replace(/^\.\//, '')) });
  const depth = Math.max(...include.map((g) => (g.includes('**') ? 4 : g.split('/').length)));
  const out: string[] = [];
  const walk = (dir: string, d: number) => {
    if (d > depth) return;
    let entries: fs.Dirent[];
    try {
      entries = fs.readdirSync(path.join(root, dir), { withFileTypes: true });
    } catch {
      return;
    }
    for (const e of entries) {
      if (!e.isDirectory() || e.name === 'node_modules' || e.name.startsWith('.')) continue;
      const rel = dir ? `${dir}/${e.name}` : e.name;
      if (match(rel) && fs.existsSync(path.join(root, rel, 'package.json'))) out.push(rel);
      walk(rel, d + 1);
    }
  };
  walk('', 1);
  return out.sort();
}

/** Symlink workspace packages missing from `node_modules` under `.harness/ws-modules`; returns that dir, or null if none were needed. */
function linkWorkspaces(root: string): string | null {
  const missing: { name: string; dir: string }[] = [];
  for (const dir of workspaceDirs(root)) {
    let name: string | undefined;
    try {
      name = (JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(path.join(root, dir, 'package.json'), 'utf8')) as { name?: string }).name;
    } catch { /* unreadable */ }
    if (name && !fs.existsSync(path.join(root, 'node_modules', name))) missing.push({ name, dir });
  }
  if (missing.length === 0) return null;
  const shim = path.join(root, '.harness', 'ws-modules');
  for (const { name, dir } of missing) {
    const link = path.join(shim, name);
    const target = path.join(root, dir);
    try {
      if (fs.realpathSync(link) === target) continue;
    } catch { /* missing or dangling */ }
    fs.rmSync(link, { force: true });
    fs.mkdirSync(path.dirname(link), { recursive: true });
    fs.symlinkSync(target, link, 'dir');
  }
  return shim;
}
// Entry points from package.json: `bin`, `main`, and `scripts` that run a source file. Node-only (reads files).
import * as fs from 'node:fs';
import { normalizePath, resolvePath } from '../imports';
import type { PackageEntry } from './extract';
import { workspaceDirs } from './resolver';

const RUNNERS = new Set(['node', 'tsx', 'ts-node', 'ts-node-esm', 'bun', 'deno', 'esno', 'esrun', 'vite-node', 'nodemon', 'jiti', 'sucrase-node', 'babel-node']);
const CODE = /\.[cm]?[jt]sx?$/;

type Pkg = { name?: string; bin?: string | Record<string, string>; main?: string; scripts?: Record<string, string> };

/** package.json entries (root and workspace packages) keyed by the repo file they run. */
export function packageEntries(root: string, exists: (path: string) => boolean): Map<string, PackageEntry[]> {
  const out = new Map<string, PackageEntry[]>();
  for (const dir of ['', ...workspaceDirs(root)]) {
    let pkg: Pkg;
    try {
      pkg = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(`${root}/${dir ? `${dir}/` : ''}package.json`, 'utf8')) as Pkg;
    } catch {
      continue;
    }
    const target = (file: string): string | null => {
      const p = normalizePath(dir ? `${dir}/${file}` : file);
      if (!p) return null;
      // Built outputs (`dist/cli.js`) usually come from `src/cli.ts`.
      return resolvePath(p, exists) ?? resolvePath(p.replace(/(^|\/)(?:dist|build|lib|out)\//, '$1src/'), exists);
    };
    const add = (file: string | undefined, entry: PackageEntry) => {
      const t = file ? target(file) : null;
      if (!t) return;
      const list = out.get(t) ?? [];
      if (!list.some((e) => e.kind === entry.kind && e.label === entry.label)) list.push(entry);
      out.set(t, list);
    };
    const name = pkg.name ?? (dir || 'root');
    if (typeof pkg.bin === 'string') add(pkg.bin, { kind: 'bin', label: name.replace(/^@[^/]+\//, '') });
    else for (const [bin, file] of Object.entries(pkg.bin ?? {})) add(file, { kind: 'bin', label: bin });
    if (pkg.main) add(pkg.main, { kind: 'main', label: name });
    for (const [script, cmd] of Object.entries(pkg.scripts ?? {})) {
      const label = dir ? `${name}:${script}` : script;
      for (const part of cmd.split(/&&|\|\||[;|&]/)) {
        const tokens = part.trim().split(/\s+/).filter((t) => !/^\w+=/.test(t)); // drop `FOO=1` env prefixes
        const runner = tokens[0]?.replace(/^npx$/, '') || tokens[1];
        if (!runner || !RUNNERS.has(runner)) continue;
        const file = tokens.find((t) => !t.startsWith('-') && CODE.test(t));
        if (file) add(file, { kind: 'script', label });
      }
    }
  }
  return out;
}
// Route paths and file-based routes (Next.js). Pure and browser-safe.
import type { RouteFact } from '../contracts/facts';

export const HTTP_METHODS = ['GET', 'POST', 'PUT', 'PATCH', 'DELETE', 'HEAD', 'OPTIONS'];

/**
 * Normalize a route path so ids are stable: params (`:id`, `{id}`, `[id]`, `[...x]`, regex groups `([\w-]+)`) become `{}`,
 * regex anchors and escapes are dropped, and a leading `/` is ensured.
 */
export function normalizeRoutePath(raw: string): string {
  let p = raw.trim().replace(/^\^/, '').replace(/\$$/, '').replace(/\\\//g, '/');
  p = p.replace(/\((?:[^()\\]|\\.)*\)\??/g, '{}'); // regex capture groups
  p = p.replace(/\[\[?\.{0,3}[^\]/]*\]?\]/g, '{}'); // [id], [...slug], [[...slug]]
  p = p.replace(/:[A-Za-z_$][\w$]*\??/g, '{}').replace(/\{[^}/]+\}/g, '{}').replace(/\{\}[+*?]+/g, '{}');
  p = p.replace(/(^|\/)\*+(?=\/|$)/g, '$1{}');
  p = p.replace(/\\(.)/g, '$1').replace(/\/+/g, '/');
  if (!p.startsWith('/')) p = `/${p}`;
  return p.length > 1 ? p.replace(/\/$/, '') : p;
}

export const routeId = (method: string, path: string) => `route:${method} ${path}`;

export function routeFact(method: string, rawPath: string, file: string, handler: string | null): RouteFact {
  const m = method.toUpperCase() === 'ALL' ? 'ANY' : method.toUpperCase();
  const path = normalizeRoutePath(rawPath);
  return { id: routeId(m, path), method: m, path, file, handler };
}

const NEXT_APP_ROUTE = /(?:^|\/)app\/((?:.*\/)?)route\.[cm]?[jt]sx?$/;
const NEXT_APP_PAGE = /(?:^|\/)app\/((?:.*\/)?)page\.[cm]?[jt]sx?$/;
const NEXT_PAGES = /(?:^|\/)pages\/(.*)\.[cm]?[jt]sx?$/;

/** URL path for a Next.js segment list: route groups `(x)` and slots `@x` drop out. */
const segmentsToPath = (dir: string) =>
  normalizeRoutePath(`/${dir.split('/').filter((s) => s && !/^\(.*\)$/.test(s) && !s.startsWith('@')).join('/')}`);

/** Next.js file-based routes and pages for `path`, given its export names. Handlers are symbol names in the file. */
export function nextRoutes(path: string, exportNames: readonly string[]): { routes: { method: string; path: string; symbol: string }[]; page: string | null } {
  let m = NEXT_APP_ROUTE.exec(path);
  if (m) {
    const url = segmentsToPath(m[1]!);
    return { routes: exportNames.filter((n) => HTTP_METHODS.includes(n)).map((n) => ({ method: n, path: url, symbol: n })), page: null };
  }
  m = NEXT_APP_PAGE.exec(path);
  if (m) return { routes: [], page: segmentsToPath(m[1]!) };
  m = NEXT_PAGES.exec(path);
  if (m) {
    const rest = m[1]!.replace(/(?:^|\/)index$/, '');
    if (/^api(?:\/|$)/.test(rest)) return { routes: exportNames.includes('default') ? [{ method: 'ANY', path: segmentsToPath(rest), symbol: 'default' }] : [], page: null };
    if (/(?:^|\/)_(?:app|document|error)$/.test(rest) || /^_/.test(rest)) return { routes: [], page: null };
    return { routes: [], page: segmentsToPath(rest) };
  }
  return { routes: [], page: null };
}
// Which symbols an edit changed (NAVIGATION_PLAN §3.1). Pure and browser-safe.
import type { SymbolDiff, SymbolFact } from '../contracts/facts';

/**
 * Classify symbols as added, removed, signature-changed or body-changed by comparing hashes.
 * A removed and an added symbol of the same kind with the same `bodyHash` is a rename, listed only under `renamed`.
 */
export function diffSymbols(before: readonly SymbolFact[], after: readonly SymbolFact[]): SymbolDiff {
  const old = new Map(before.map((s) => [s.id, s]));
  const now = new Map(after.map((s) => [s.id, s]));
  const sig: string[] = [];
  const body: string[] = [];
  for (const s of after) {
    const o = old.get(s.id);
    if (!o) continue;
    if (o.sigHash !== s.sigHash) sig.push(s.id);
    else if (o.bodyHash !== s.bodyHash) body.push(s.id);
  }
  const removed = before.filter((s) => !now.has(s.id));
  const added = after.filter((s) => !old.has(s.id));
  const renamed: [string, string][] = [];
  const taken = new Set<string>();
  for (const r of removed) {
    const a = added.find((x) => !taken.has(x.id) && x.kind === r.kind && x.bodyHash === r.bodyHash);
    if (!a) continue;
    taken.add(a.id);
    taken.add(r.id);
    renamed.push([r.id, a.id]);
  }
  return {
    added: added.filter((s) => !taken.has(s.id)).map((s) => s.id),
    removed: removed.filter((s) => !taken.has(s.id)).map((s) => s.id),
    sig,
    body,
    renamed,
  };
}
// Small, fast, deterministic string hash (two FNV-1a variants → 16 hex chars). Browser-safe.

export function hashText(text: string): string {
  let a = 0x811c9dc5;
  let b = 0x01000193 ^ text.length;
  for (let i = 0; i < text.length; i++) {
    const c = text.charCodeAt(i);
    a = Math.imul(a ^ c, 0x01000193);
    b = Math.imul(b ^ c, 0x5bd1e995);
    b ^= b >>> 15;
  }
  return (a >>> 0).toString(16).padStart(8, '0') + (b >>> 0).toString(16).padStart(8, '0');
}

/** Collapse whitespace runs so formatting-only edits keep the same hash. */
export const squash = (text: string) => text.replace(/\s+/g, ' ').trim();

import type { FileFacts } from './contracts/facts';
import { attachResolver, carryResolver } from './facts/context';
import { settleCalls, extract, type ExtractContext, type PackageEntry } from './facts/extract';
import { moduleRecord, type ModuleRecord } from './facts/record';
import { createRepoResolver } from './facts/resolver';
import { packageEntries } from './facts/entries';
import { normalizePath, resolveImport, resolveSpecifier } from './imports';
import { createMapper, type Mapper } from './mapper';
import type { DomainMap } from './schema';

/** File → file import. */
export type ImportEdge = { from: string; to: string };
export type WriteFact = { file: string; table: string };
/** Cross-domain dependency (domain ids) with the file imports behind it. */
export type DomainEdge = { from: string; to: string; files: ImportEdge[] };
export type Facts = { files: string[]; imports: ImportEdge[]; writes: WriteFact[] };
export type FactDelta = { imports: ImportEdge[]; writes: WriteFact[] };

export type Exists = (path: string) => boolean;

export const CODE_EXTENSIONS = ['.ts', '.tsx', '.js', '.jsx', '.mjs', '.cjs', '.mts'];

export function isCodeFile(path: string): boolean {
  return CODE_EXTENSIONS.some((ext) => path.endsWith(ext));
}

/**
 * File-existence check against a repo root, cached. Call `clear()` after files are created or deleted.
 * It carries the repo's module resolver (tsconfig paths, package exports, workspaces) for `resolveImport`.
 */
export function fileExistsIn(root: string): Exists & { clear(): void } {
  const cache = new Map<string, boolean>();
  let resolver: ReturnType<typeof createRepoResolver> | null = null;
  const exists = (path: string) => {
    let hit = cache.get(path);
    if (hit === undefined) {
      try {
        hit = fs.statSync(`${root}/${path}`).isFile();
      } catch {
        hit = false;
      }
      cache.set(path, hit);
    }
    return hit;
  };
  attachResolver(exists, () => (resolver ??= createRepoResolver(root)));
  return Object.assign(exists, {
    clear: () => {
      cache.clear();
      resolver?.clear();
    },
  });
}

/** `exists`, plus `paths` that will exist (e.g. files a plan creates). Keeps `exists`'s resolver. */
export function withExtra(exists: Exists, paths: readonly string[]): Exists {
  const extra = new Set(paths.map((p) => normalizePath(p) ?? p));
  return carryResolver((path: string) => extra.has(path) || exists(path), exists);
}

/** Every non-ignored file under `root`, sorted. */
export function listRepoFiles(root: string, map: DomainMap, mapper: Mapper = createMapper(map)): string[] {
  const files: string[] = [];
  const walk = (dir: string) => {
    for (const entry of fs.readdirSync(dir ? `${root}/${dir}` : root, { withFileTypes: true })) {
      if (entry.name === 'node_modules' || entry.name === '.git') continue;
      const path = dir ? `${dir}/${entry.name}` : entry.name;
      if (mapper.isIgnored(path)) continue;
      if (entry.isDirectory()) walk(path);
      else if (entry.isFile()) files.push(path);
    }
  };
  walk('');
  return files.sort();
}

/** Full fact scan of a repo: every non-ignored file, plus resolved imports and table writes of code files. */
export function scanRepo(root: string, map: DomainMap): Facts {
  const files = listRepoFiles(root, map);
  const exists = scanExists(root, files);
  const imports: ImportEdge[] = [];
  const writes: WriteFact[] = [];
  for (const file of files) {
    if (!isCodeFile(file)) continue;
    const delta = factsForSource(file, fs.readFileSync(`${root}/${file}`, 'utf8'), exists);
    imports.push(...delta.imports);
    writes.push(...delta.writes);
  }
  return { files, imports, writes };
}

/** Files known from the walk, then disk; carries the repo resolver. */
function scanExists(root: string, files: readonly string[]): Exists {
  const known = new Set(files);
  const onDisk = fileExistsIn(root);
  return carryResolver((p: string) => known.has(p) || onDisk(p), onDisk);
}

/** Imports and writes of one file, with the gate's own multiset counting. */
function counts(path: string, record: ModuleRecord, exists: Exists) {
  const imports = new Map<string, number>();
  for (const s of record.specs) {
    const to = resolveImport(path, s.spec, exists);
    if (to) imports.set(to, (imports.get(to) ?? 0) + 1);
  }
  const writes = new Map<string, number>();
  for (const w of record.writes) writes.set(w.table, (writes.get(w.table) ?? 0) + 1);
  return { imports, writes };
}

/** One file's resolved imports and table writes (each target/table once). */
export function factsForSource(path: string, source: string, exists: Exists): FactDelta {
  return deltaForEdit(path, null, source, exists);
}

/**
 * Imports and writes that `newSource` adds over `oldSource` (multiset difference by target/table). This is the edit gate's
 * hot path: no AST walk, the old text's record is usually cached, and large or minified files skip parsing (< 20 ms at 1 MB).
 */
export function deltaForEdit(path: string, oldSource: string | null, newSource: string, exists: Exists): FactDelta {
  const file = normalizePath(path) ?? path;
  const before = oldSource === null ? null : counts(file, moduleRecord(file, oldSource), exists);
  const after = counts(file, moduleRecord(file, newSource), exists);
  const added = (key: string, n: number, old: Map<string, number> | undefined) => n > (old?.get(key) ?? 0);
  return {
    imports: [...after.imports].filter(([to, n]) => added(to, n, before?.imports)).map(([to]) => ({ from: file, to })),
    writes: [...after.writes].filter(([t, n]) => added(t, n, before?.writes)).map(([table]) => ({ file, table })),
  };
}

/** Apply a Claude Code `Edit` to file text. Throws if `oldString` is not found. */
export function applyEdit(current: string, oldString: string, newString: string, replaceAll = false): string {
  if (!current.includes(oldString)) throw new Error('old_string not found in file');
  return replaceAll ? current.split(oldString).join(newString) : current.replace(oldString, () => newString);
}

/** Cross-domain edges between cell files. Neutral, ignored, unassigned and test files, and same-domain imports, draw none. */
export function domainEdges(facts: Facts | FactDelta, mapper: Mapper): DomainEdge[] {
  const edges = new Map<string, DomainEdge>();
  for (const imp of facts.imports) {
    const a = mapper.place(imp.from);
    const b = mapper.place(imp.to);
    if (a.kind !== 'cell' || b.kind !== 'cell' || a.domain === b.domain) continue;
    const key = `${a.domain}\u0000${b.domain}`;
    let edge = edges.get(key);
    if (!edge) edges.set(key, (edge = { from: a.domain, to: b.domain, files: [] }));
    edge.files.push(imp);
  }
  return [...edges.values()].sort((x, y) => x.from.localeCompare(y.from) || x.to.localeCompare(y.to));
}

// ---- Tier 1 facts (NAVIGATION_PLAN §3.1)

/**
 * Per-repo extraction state: resolves through `exists`'s resolver, reads other files for barrel linking, and knows
 * package.json entries and `cartography.routes`. `read(path)` returns current text (or null), e.g. the server's cache.
 */
export function createFactsIndex(root: string, map: DomainMap, exists: Exists, read: (path: string) => string | null) {
  const resolve = (from: string, spec: string) => resolveSpecifier(from, spec, exists);
  let entries: Map<string, PackageEntry[]> | null = null;
  const routes = map.cartography?.routes ?? [];
  const ctx = (path: string): ExtractContext => ({
    recordOf: (file) => {
      if (!isCodeFile(file)) return null;
      const text = read(file);
      return text === null ? null : moduleRecord(file, text);
    },
    entries: (entries ??= packageEntries(root, exists)).get(path) ?? [],
    routes,
  });
  return {
    resolve,
    /** Facts for one file, calls not yet settled (see `settleCalls`). `parsed` is false for source with syntax errors. */
    extract: (path: string, source: string) => extract(path, source, resolve, ctx(path)),
  };
}

/** Symbol names per file, for `settleCalls` (memoized). */
export function symbolNames(facts: Readonly<Record<string, FileFacts>>): (file: string) => ReadonlySet<string> | null {
  const sets = new Map<string, ReadonlySet<string> | null>();
  return (file) => {
    if (!sets.has(file)) sets.set(file, facts[file] ? new Set(facts[file]!.symbols.map((s) => s.name)) : null);
    return sets.get(file)!;
  };
}

/** `scanRepo` plus Tier 1 `FileFacts` for every code file, calls settled against the whole repo. */
export function scanRepoFacts(root: string, map: DomainMap): Facts & { fileFacts: Record<string, FileFacts> } {
  const files = listRepoFiles(root, map);
  const exists = scanExists(root, files);
  const texts = new Map<string, string>();
  const read = (p: string) => {
    let t = texts.get(p);
    if (t === undefined) {
      try {
        t = fs.readFileSync(`${root}/${p}`, 'utf8');
      } catch {
        return null;
      }
      texts.set(p, t);
    }
    return t;
  };
  const index = createFactsIndex(root, map, exists, read);
  const imports: ImportEdge[] = [];
  const writes: WriteFact[] = [];
  const fileFacts: Record<string, FileFacts> = {};
  for (const file of files) {
    if (!isCodeFile(file)) continue;
    const source = read(file)!;
    fileFacts[file] = index.extract(file, source).facts; // first: it leaves the record cached for the gate facts
    const delta = factsForSource(file, source, exists);
    imports.push(...delta.imports);
    writes.push(...delta.writes);
  }
  const names = symbolNames(fileFacts);
  for (const f of Object.values(fileFacts)) f.calls = settleCalls(f.calls, names);
  return { files, imports, writes, fileFacts };
}

import { z } from 'zod';
import YAML from 'yaml';

const LayerSchema = z.object({ id: z.string(), name: z.string() });

/** A confirmed sub-group inside a cell (promoted from an inferred cartographer label). */
const ComponentSchema = z.object({ id: z.string(), name: z.string(), paths: z.array(z.string()) });

const CellSchema = z.object({
  paths: z.array(z.string()).optional(),
  tables: z.array(z.string()).optional(),
  components: z.array(ComponentSchema).optional(),
});

/** Living-map settings (NAVIGATION_PLAN §4.4). Missing thresholds fall back to DEFAULT_THRESHOLDS. */
const CartographySchema = z.object({
  thresholds: z.record(z.string(), z.number()).optional(),
  /**
   * Custom router patterns: `pattern` is a JS regex source matched against `file`'s text, with named groups
   * `method` and `path` (or groups 1 and 2); the handler is the first symbol defined after the match.
   */
  routes: z.array(z.object({ file: z.string(), pattern: z.string() })).optional(),
});

const DomainSchema = z.object({
  id: z.string(),
  name: z.string(),
  purpose: z.string(),
  cells: z.record(z.string(), CellSchema),
  tests: z.array(z.string()).optional(),
});

/** An exception may be written as a bare path string; it is normalized to `{ path }`. */
const ExceptionSchema = z.union([
  z.string().transform((path): { path: string; decision?: string } => ({ path })),
  z.object({ path: z.string(), decision: z.string().optional() }),
]);

const InvariantBase = z.object({
  id: z.string(),
  rule: z.string(),
  exceptions: z.array(ExceptionSchema).default([]),
  source: z.string().optional(),
  /** Decision records (DR ids) that confirmed this invariant. */
  decisions: z.array(z.string()).optional(),
});

const InvariantSchema = z.discriminatedUnion('kind', [
  InvariantBase.extend({
    kind: z.literal('only_via'),
    targets: z.array(z.string()),
    allowed_from: z.array(z.string()),
  }),
  InvariantBase.extend({
    kind: z.literal('owns_writes'),
    owners: z.record(z.string(), z.string()),
  }),
  InvariantBase.extend({
    kind: z.literal('no_edge'),
    from: z.string(),
    to: z.string(),
  }),
]);

/** Schema for a target repo's `domains.yaml`. */
export const DomainMapSchema = z
  .object({
    version: z.number(),
    layers: z.array(LayerSchema),
    neutral: z.array(z.string()).optional(),
    ignore: z.array(z.string()).optional(),
    domains: z.array(DomainSchema),
    invariants: z.array(InvariantSchema).default([]),
    cartography: CartographySchema.optional(),
  })
  .superRefine((map, ctx) => {
    const layers = new Set(map.layers.map((l) => l.id));
    const domains = new Set(map.domains.map((d) => d.id));
    const issue = (path: (string | number)[], message: string) => ctx.addIssue({ code: 'custom', path, message });
    map.domains.forEach((d, i) => {
      for (const layer of Object.keys(d.cells)) {
        if (!layers.has(layer)) issue(['domains', i, 'cells', layer], `unknown layer "${layer}"`);
      }
    });
    map.invariants.forEach((inv, i) => {
      const refs =
        inv.kind === 'only_via' ? inv.allowed_from : inv.kind === 'owns_writes' ? Object.values(inv.owners) : [inv.from, inv.to];
      for (const ref of refs) {
        if (!domains.has(ref)) issue(['invariants', i], `${inv.id} refers to unknown domain "${ref}"`);
      }
    });
  });

export type DomainMap = z.output<typeof DomainMapSchema>;
export type Layer = DomainMap['layers'][number];
export type Domain = DomainMap['domains'][number];
export type Invariant = DomainMap['invariants'][number];
export type InvariantException = Invariant['exceptions'][number];

/** Parse and validate `domains.yaml` text. Throws an Error with a readable message. */
export function parseDomainMap(yamlText: string): DomainMap {
  let raw: unknown;
  try {
    raw = YAML.parse(yamlText);
  } catch (err) {
    throw new Error(`domains.yaml is not valid YAML: ${(err as Error).message}`);
  }
  const result = DomainMapSchema.safeParse(raw);
  if (!result.success) throw new Error(`domains.yaml is invalid:\n${z.prettifyError(result.error)}`);
  return result.data;
}

function secondTurn(): HarnessEvent[] {
  let n = 0;
  const ev = (kind: HarnessEvent['kind'], data: Record<string, unknown>, extra: Partial<HarnessEvent> = {}): HarnessEvent =>
    ({ id: `t2-${n}`, t: 2000 + n++, session: 's1', turn: 't2', kind, data, ...extra });
  const block: Violation = {
    invariant: 'DR-3', kind: 'no_edge', reason: 'tools never depend on outreach', file: 'src/tools/news-summarize.ts',
    detail: '', options: ['A', 'B'], target: 'src/outreach/send.ts',
  };
  return [
    ev('turn_started', { prompt: 'memory tweaks', head: '', baseline: '' }),
    ev('looked', { tool: 'Read' }, { path: 'src/shared/db.ts' }),

      steps: [{ n: 1, text: 'retrieve', files: ['src/memory/retrieve.ts'], imports: [{ from: 'src/memory/retrieve.ts', to: 'src/outreach/send.ts' }] }],
      cells: [{ domain: 'memory', layer: 'logic', steps: [1], files: ['src/memory/retrieve.ts'] }],

    ev('edited', { added: 5, removed: 0, created: false }, { path: 'test/memory/retrieve.test.ts' }),
    ev('edited', { added: 7, removed: 0, created: true }, { path: 'src/misc/foo.ts' }),
    ev('gate_blocked', { violation: block, tool: 'Edit' }, { path: block.file }),

    ev('edited', { added: 2, removed: 0, created: false }, { path: 'src/memory/retrieve.ts', cell: { domain: 'memory', layer: 'logic' } }),
    ev('edge_added', { edge: { from: 'src/memory/retrieve.ts', to: 'src/outreach/send.ts' }, from: 'memory', to: 'outreach' }, { path: 'src/memory/retrieve.ts' }),
    ev('edge_removed', { edge: { from: 'src/tools/company-profile.ts', to: 'src/gateway/complete.ts' }, from: 'tools', to: 'gateway' }),

const parityView = (ui: UIState): ViewState => ({
  expanded: ui.map!.domains.map((d) => domainId(d.id)),
  focus: null,
  lens: { kinds: ['imports'], turnOnly: false },
  budget: 50,
  follow: false,
});

const sorted = <T>(xs: T[]) => [...xs].sort();

function cellsOf(p: Projection) {
  const out: Record<string, unknown> = {};
  for (const n of p.nodes) {
    if (n.kind !== 'cell') continue;
    const r = n.rollup;
    out[`${n.domain}/${n.layer}`] = {
      looked: r.looked, edited: r.edited, added: r.added, removed: r.removed, ghost: r.ghostSteps, unplanned: r.unplanned,
      violation: r.violation, violationFiles: r.violationFiles, newViolationFiles: r.newViolationFiles,
    };
  }
  return out;
}

function domainEdgesOf(p: Projection) {
  const byId = new Map(p.nodes.map((n) => [n.id, n]));
  const out = new Map<string, { from: string; to: string; state: string; violation: boolean; steps: number[]; files: string[] }>();
  for (const e of p.edges) {
    const a = byId.get(e.from)!;
    const b = byId.get(e.to)!;
    if (a.kind !== 'cell' || b.kind !== 'cell' || a.domain === b.domain) continue;
    const ghost = e.status === 'ghost';
    const k = `${ghost ? 'ghost' : 'solid'}:${a.domain}->${b.domain}`;
    const cur = out.get(k) ?? { from: a.domain!, to: b.domain!, state: ghost ? 'ghost' : 'existing', violation: false, steps: [], files: [] };
    if (e.status === 'new') cur.state = 'new';
    cur.violation ||= e.violation !== null;
    cur.steps = sorted([...new Set([...cur.steps, ...e.steps])]);
    cur.files.push(...e.leafEdges.map((id) => id.split('|').slice(1).join(' -> ')));
    out.set(k, cur);
  }
  return [...out.entries()].sort(([a], [b]) => a.localeCompare(b)).map(([, v]) => ({ ...v, files: sorted(v.files) }));
}

function expectParity(ui: UIState, turnId?: string | null) {
  const graph = graphOf(ui)!;
  const p = project(graph, parityView(ui), activityFor(ui, graph, turnId));

  const cv = cellViews(ui, turnId);
  const want: Record<string, unknown> = {};
  for (const [k, v] of Object.entries(cv)) {
    want[k] = {
      looked: v.looked, edited: v.edited, added: v.added, removed: v.removed, ghost: v.ghost ?? [], unplanned: v.unplanned,
      violation: v.violation, violationFiles: sorted(v.violationFiles), newViolationFiles: sorted(v.newViolationFiles),
    };
  }
  expect(cellsOf(p)).toEqual(want);

  const ev = edgeViews(ui, turnId)
    .map((e) => ({
      key: `${e.state === 'ghost' ? 'ghost' : 'solid'}:${e.from}->${e.to}`,
      v: { from: e.from, to: e.to, state: e.state, violation: e.violation, steps: sorted(e.steps), files: sorted(e.files.map((f) => `${f.from} -> ${f.to}`)) },
    }))
    .sort((a, b) => a.key.localeCompare(b.key))
    .map((x) => x.v);
  expect(domainEdgesOf(p)).toEqual(ev);
}

      expectParity(ui);

    expect(byId.get('unassigned')).toMatchObject({ edited: true, added: 7, unplanned: true });

// trace (NAVIGATION_PLAN §2 "Wiring trace"): shortest call chains from a symbol, route or file to its sinks.
import type { ContextGraph } from '../contracts/graph';
import { EXTERNAL_LAYER } from './build';
import { byId } from './util';

export const MAX_TRACE_PATHS = 5;

const adjacency = new WeakMap<ContextGraph, Map<string, { to: string; sinkOnly: boolean }[]>>();

/** calls and handles forward, implements from the interface member to each implementation, writes into tables. */
function adjacencyOf(g: ContextGraph) {
  let adj = adjacency.get(g);
  if (adj) return adj;
  adj = new Map();
  const link = (a: string, b: string, sinkOnly: boolean) => {
    const list = adj!.get(a) ?? adj!.set(a, []).get(a)!;
    if (!list.some((x) => x.to === b)) list.push({ to: b, sinkOnly });
  };
  for (const e of g.edges) {
    if (e.kind === 'calls' || e.kind === 'handles') link(e.from, e.to, false);
    else if (e.kind === 'implements') link(e.to, e.from, false);
    else if (e.kind === 'writes') link(e.from, e.to, true);
  }
  for (const list of adj.values()) list.sort((x, y) => byId(x.to, y.to));
  adjacency.set(g, adj);
  return adj;
}

/**
 * BFS over calls ∪ implements ∪ handles (plus writes into a table sink). Default sinks: vendor and table nodes,
 * and anything inside an `external` cell. Sinks end a chain. Returns at most MAX_TRACE_PATHS shortest chains
 * (one per sink, nearest first, ties by sink id), each starting at `from`. Dispatch through a registry shows up
 * as an interface member followed by an implementation (`implements` walked backwards).
 */
export function trace(graph: ContextGraph, from: string, sinks?: readonly string[]): string[][] {
  if (!graph.nodes[from]) return [];
  const adj = adjacencyOf(graph);
  const given = sinks ? new Set(sinks) : null;
  const isSink = (id: string) => {
    if (given) return given.has(id);
    const n = graph.nodes[id];
    return id.startsWith('vendor:') || id.startsWith('table:') || n?.layer === EXTERNAL_LAYER;
  };
  const parent = new Map<string, string | null>([[from, null]]);
  const found: string[] = [];
  let frontier = [from];
  while (frontier.length && found.length < MAX_TRACE_PATHS) {
    const next: string[] = [];
    const reached: string[] = [];
    for (const id of frontier) {
      for (const { to, sinkOnly } of adj.get(id) ?? []) {
        if (parent.has(to) || (sinkOnly && !isSink(to))) continue;
        parent.set(to, id);
        if (isSink(to)) reached.push(to);
        else next.push(to);
      }
    }
    found.push(...reached.sort(byId));
    frontier = next;
  }
  return found.slice(0, MAX_TRACE_PATHS).map((sink) => {
    const path: string[] = [];
    for (let n: string | null = sink; n !== null; n = parent.get(n) ?? null) path.push(n);
    return path.reverse();
  });
}
// buildGraph (NAVIGATION_PLAN §3.2): one containment tree plus leaf edges, from domains.yaml and per-file facts.
// Pure and browser-safe (the mapper only needs picomatch).
import { createMapper, matchesAny, type Placement } from '../mapper';
import type { DomainMap } from '../schema';
import type { UIState } from '../events';
import type { CallConfidence, CallFact, FileFacts, SemanticFacts } from '../contracts/facts';
import {
  NEUTRAL_ID, ROOT_ID, UNASSIGNED_ID, cellId, domainId, edgeId, fileOf, groupId, tableId, testsId,
  type ContextGraph, type EdgeKind, type GraphEdge, type GraphNode, type NodeKind,
} from '../contracts/graph';

/** Top-level container for bare packages no `external` cell claims. */
export const VENDORS_ID = 'group:vendors';
/** A container holding more files than this is split into directory groups. */
export const GROUP_THRESHOLD = 12;
/** The layer whose cells hold external services; vendor packages and trace sinks live there. */
export const EXTERNAL_LAYER = 'external';

const KIND_RANK: Partial<Record<NodeKind, number>> = { group: 0, file: 1, table: 2, vendor: 3, symbol: 4, route: 5, entry: 6 };

const emptyFacts = (path: string): FileFacts => ({ path, hash: '', imports: [], writes: [], symbols: [], calls: [], routes: [], entries: [] });
const isPseudo = (id: string) => id.startsWith('vendor:') || id.startsWith('table:');
const normalize = (p: string) => p.replace(/\\/g, '/').split('/').filter((s) => s && s !== '.').join('/');

/**
 * Containment: repo → domain → cell → (group) → file → symbol (nested by `parent`), with routes and entries under
 * their file and tables under the cell that lists them. Test files sit in `tests:<domain>` under their domain;
 * files matching no cell in `unassigned`, shared code in `neutral` (both top-level, created when non-empty).
 * Bare packages (`vendor:<pkg>`) go into the `external` cell that claims them (a glob matching `<pkg>` or
 * `node_modules/<pkg>/…`, importing domains first), else into the top-level `group:vendors`.
 * A cell with confirmed `components` groups matching files by component; any container with more than
 * GROUP_THRESHOLD remaining files groups them by directory (recursively).
 * Leaf edges: imports (file→file), uses (file→vendor), calls, implements, handles (route→handler), writes (→table).
 * Tier 2 calls replace a file's syntactic calls when `semantic[path].hash === facts[path].hash`.
 */
export function buildGraph(
  map: DomainMap,
  facts: Readonly<Record<string, FileFacts>>,
  semantic: Readonly<Record<string, SemanticFacts>> = {},
): ContextGraph {
  const mapper = createMapper(map);
  const nodes: Record<string, GraphNode> = {};
  const children: Record<string, string[]> = {};
  const rank = new Map<string, number>();
  const add = (n: Omit<GraphNode, 'order'>, r: number): GraphNode => {
    const cur = nodes[n.id];
    if (cur) return cur;
    const node = n as GraphNode;
    node.order = 0;
    nodes[n.id] = node;
    rank.set(n.id, r);
    if (n.parent) (children[n.parent] ??= []).push(n.id);
    return node;
  };
  /** Copy a container's domain/layer onto a node (no spread: this runs per symbol). */
  const scoped = <T extends Omit<GraphNode, 'order'>>(n: T, from: GraphNode): T => {
    if (from.domain) n.domain = from.domain;
    if (from.layer) n.layer = from.layer;
    return n;
  };

  // ---- skeleton: domains in map order, cells in layer order (their order is the grid position)
  add({ id: ROOT_ID, kind: 'repo', parent: null, label: 'repo' }, 0);
  const layerIdx = new Map(map.layers.map((l, i) => [l.id, i]));
  map.domains.forEach((d, i) => {
    add({ id: domainId(d.id), kind: 'domain', parent: ROOT_ID, label: d.name, domain: d.id }, i);
    for (const l of map.layers) {
      if (l.id in d.cells) add({ id: cellId(d.id, l.id), kind: 'cell', parent: domainId(d.id), label: l.name, domain: d.id, layer: l.id }, layerIdx.get(l.id)!);
    }
  });
  const nd = map.domains.length;
  const ensureTop = (id: string) => {
    if (id === UNASSIGNED_ID) return add({ id, kind: 'unassigned', parent: ROOT_ID, label: 'Unassigned' }, nd);
    if (id === NEUTRAL_ID) return add({ id, kind: 'neutral', parent: ROOT_ID, label: 'Shared' }, nd + 1);
    return add({ id: VENDORS_ID, kind: 'group', parent: ROOT_ID, label: 'Vendors' }, nd + 2);
  };
  const ensureTests = (domain: string) =>
    add({ id: testsId(domain), kind: 'tests', parent: domainId(domain), label: 'Tests', domain }, map.layers.length);

  // ---- files: every path with facts plus every repo path they import
  const paths = new Set<string>();
  for (const [path, f] of Object.entries(facts)) {
    paths.add(path);
    for (const i of f.imports) if (!isPseudo(i.to)) paths.add(i.to);
  }
  const placement = new Map<string, Placement>();
  const byContainer = new Map<string, string[]>();
  for (const path of [...paths].sort()) {
    const p = mapper.place(path);
    if (p.kind === 'ignored') continue;
    placement.set(path, p);
    const c = p.kind === 'cell' ? cellId(p.domain, p.layer) : p.kind === 'test' ? ensureTests(p.domain).id : ensureTop(p.kind === 'neutral' ? NEUTRAL_ID : UNASSIGNED_ID).id;
    const list = byContainer.get(c) ?? [];
    list.push(path);
    byContainer.set(c, list);
  }

  const putFile = (path: string, parent: string) => {
    const p = placement.get(path)!;
    const n: Omit<GraphNode, 'order'> = { id: path, kind: 'file', parent, label: path.slice(path.lastIndexOf('/') + 1), path };
    if (p.kind === 'cell' || p.kind === 'test') n.domain = p.domain;
    if (p.kind === 'cell') n.layer = p.layer;
    add(n, KIND_RANK.file!);
  };
  /** Directory groups for a container holding too many files; recursive, files directly in the common dir stay put. */
  const groupByDir = (parent: string, files: string[], gid: (dir: string) => string, scope: Pick<GraphNode, 'domain' | 'layer'>) => {
    if (files.length <= GROUP_THRESHOLD) { for (const f of files) putFile(f, parent); return; }
    const prefix = commonDir(files);
    const dirs = new Map<string, string[]>();
    for (const f of files) {
      const rest = prefix ? f.slice(prefix.length + 1) : f;
      const i = rest.indexOf('/');
      if (i < 0) { putFile(f, parent); continue; }
      const dir = (prefix ? `${prefix}/` : '') + rest.slice(0, i);
      const list = dirs.get(dir) ?? [];
      list.push(f);
      dirs.set(dir, list);
    }
    for (const [dir, list] of dirs) {
      const id = gid(dir);
      add({ id, kind: 'group', parent, label: `${dir.slice(prefix ? prefix.length + 1 : 0)}/`, path: dir, ...scope }, KIND_RANK.group!);
      groupByDir(id, list, gid, scope);
    }
  };
  for (const [container, files] of byContainer) {
    const n = nodes[container]!;
    if (n.kind === 'cell') {
      const { domain, layer } = n as Required<Pick<GraphNode, 'domain' | 'layer'>>;
      const comps = map.domains.find((d) => d.id === domain)?.cells[layer]?.components ?? [];
      const rest: string[] = [];
      for (const f of files) {
        const comp = comps.find((c) => matchesAny(c.paths, f));
        if (!comp) { rest.push(f); continue; }
        const id = groupId(domain, layer, comp.id);
        add({ id, kind: 'group', parent: container, label: comp.name, domain, layer }, KIND_RANK.group!);
        putFile(f, id);
      }
      groupByDir(container, rest, (dir) => groupId(domain, layer, dir), { domain, layer });
    } else {
      groupByDir(container, files, (dir) => `group:${container}/${dir}`, n.domain ? { domain: n.domain } : {});
    }
  }

  // ---- symbols, routes, entries (under their file; symbols nested by parent)
  for (const path of placement.keys()) {
    const f = facts[path];
    if (!f) continue;
    const file = nodes[path]!;
    const own = f.symbols.some((s) => s.parent) ? new Set(f.symbols.map((s) => s.id)) : null;
    for (const s of f.symbols) {
      const nested = !!s.parent && !!own?.has(s.parent);
      add(scoped({
        id: s.id, kind: 'symbol', parent: nested ? s.parent : path,
        label: nested ? s.name.slice(s.name.lastIndexOf('.') + 1) : s.name, symbol: { kind: s.kind, exported: s.exported },
      }, file), KIND_RANK.symbol!);
    }
    for (const r of f.routes) add(scoped({ id: r.id, kind: 'route', parent: path, label: `${r.method} ${r.path}` }, file), KIND_RANK.route!);
    for (const e of f.entries) add(scoped({ id: e.id, kind: 'entry', parent: path, label: e.label }, file), KIND_RANK.entry!);
  }

  // ---- tables: under the cell that lists them, else unassigned
  map.domains.forEach((d) => {
    for (const [layer, cell] of Object.entries(d.cells)) {
      for (const t of cell.tables ?? []) add({ id: tableId(t), kind: 'table', parent: cellId(d.id, layer), label: t, domain: d.id, layer }, KIND_RANK.table!);
    }
  });
  const ensureTable = (id: string) => nodes[id] ?? add({ id, kind: 'table', parent: ensureTop(UNASSIGNED_ID).id, label: id.slice(6) }, KIND_RANK.table!);

  // ---- vendors: claimed by an `external` cell (importing domains first), else the top-level Vendors group
  const callsOf = (path: string, f: FileFacts): CallFact[] => {
    const s = semantic[path];
    return s && s.hash === f.hash ? s.calls : f.calls;
  };
  const importers = new Map<string, Set<string>>();
  const noteVendor = (v: string, from: string) => {
    const set = importers.get(v) ?? new Set<string>();
    const d = mapper.domainOf(fileOf(from) ?? from);
    if (d) set.add(d);
    importers.set(v, set);
  };
  for (const path of placement.keys()) {
    const f = facts[path];
    if (!f) continue;
    for (const i of f.imports) if (i.to.startsWith('vendor:')) noteVendor(i.to, path);
    for (const c of callsOf(path, f)) if (c.to.startsWith('vendor:')) noteVendor(c.to, c.from);
  }
  const externals = map.domains.flatMap((d) => (d.cells[EXTERNAL_LAYER] ? [{ domain: d.id, globs: d.cells[EXTERNAL_LAYER]!.paths ?? [] }] : []));
  for (const [v, doms] of [...importers].sort(([a], [b]) => (a < b ? -1 : 1))) {
    const pkg = v.slice(7);
    const claims = (g: string[]) => matchesAny(g, pkg) || matchesAny(g, `node_modules/${pkg}`) || matchesAny(g, `node_modules/${pkg}/index.js`);
    const owner = externals.find((e) => doms.has(e.domain) && claims(e.globs)) ?? externals.find((e) => claims(e.globs));
    if (owner) add({ id: v, kind: 'vendor', parent: cellId(owner.domain, EXTERNAL_LAYER), label: pkg, domain: owner.domain, layer: EXTERNAL_LAYER }, KIND_RANK.vendor!);
    else add({ id: v, kind: 'vendor', parent: ensureTop(VENDORS_ID).id, label: pkg }, KIND_RANK.vendor!);
  }

  // ---- leaf edges, grouped by owner file (in path order) and sorted by id within it
  const edges: GraphEdge[] = [];
  const seen = new Map<string, Map<string, GraphEdge[]>>(); // from → to → edges (one per kind); avoids hashing new id strings
  const local: GraphEdge[] = [];
  const resolve = (id: string): string | null => {
    if (nodes[id]) return id;
    if (id.startsWith('table:')) return ensureTable(id).id;
    const f = fileOf(id);
    return f && nodes[f] ? f : null;
  };
  const edge = (kind: EdgeKind, from: string | null, to: string | null, owner: string, count: number, typeOnly?: boolean, confidence?: CallConfidence) => {
    if (!from || !to) return;
    const row = seen.get(from) ?? seen.set(from, new Map()).get(from)!;
    const same = row.get(to);
    const cur = same?.find((x) => x.kind === kind);
    if (cur) {
      cur.count += count;
      if (typeOnly === false) cur.typeOnly = false;
      return;
    }
    const e: GraphEdge = { id: edgeId(kind, from, to), kind, from, to, count, owner };
    if (typeOnly !== undefined) e.typeOnly = typeOnly;
    if (confidence) e.confidence = confidence;
    if (same) same.push(e);
    else row.set(to, [e]);
    local.push(e);
  };
  for (const path of placement.keys()) {
    const f = facts[path];
    if (!f) continue;
    for (const i of f.imports) edge(i.to.startsWith('vendor:') ? 'uses' : 'imports', path, resolve(i.to), path, 1, i.typeOnly);
    for (const c of callsOf(path, f)) edge('calls', resolve(c.from), resolve(c.to), path, c.count, undefined, c.confidence);
    const s = semantic[path];
    if (s && s.hash === f.hash) for (const im of s.implements) edge('implements', resolve(im.from), resolve(im.to), path, 1);
    for (const w of f.writes) edge('writes', w.symbol ? resolve(w.symbol) : path, ensureTable(tableId(w.table)).id, path, 1);
    for (const r of f.routes) if (r.handler) edge('handles', r.id, resolve(r.handler), path, 1);
    if (!local.length) continue;
    for (const e of local.sort((a, b) => (a.id < b.id ? -1 : 1))) edges.push(e);
    local.length = 0;
  }

  // ---- children, sorted by (rank, id); `order` is the sibling index (domains/cells: their grid index)
  for (const [parent, list] of Object.entries(children)) {
    list.sort((a, b) => rank.get(a)! - rank.get(b)! || (a < b ? -1 : a > b ? 1 : 0));
    const grid = parent === ROOT_ID || nodes[parent]!.kind === 'domain';
    for (let i = 0; i < list.length; i++) nodes[list[i]!]!.order = grid ? rank.get(list[i]!)! : i;
  }
  return { root: ROOT_ID, nodes, children, edges };
}

/** Longest common directory of sorted paths (the common prefix of the first and last, cut at a `/`). */
function commonDir(sorted: string[]): string {
  const a = sorted[0]!;
  const b = sorted[sorted.length - 1]!;
  let i = 0;
  while (i < a.length && a[i] === b[i]) i++;
  return a.slice(0, Math.max(0, a.lastIndexOf('/', i - 1)));
}

/**
 * The facts the graph is built from: `ui.facts`, plus empty stubs for every file the log knows about but has no
 * facts for (placed files, files a turn touched or planned, planned import endpoints), so ghosts and fresh files
 * have a leaf. Cross-domain cell→cell imports follow `ui.edges` (the reducer's record of edge_added/removed), so
 * logs without `facts_changed` still project the same edges as `edgeViews`. A no-op when facts are current.
 */
export function graphFacts(ui: UIState): Record<string, FileFacts> {
  const out: Record<string, FileFacts> = { ...ui.facts };
  const stub = (path: string) => { if (!out[path] && !isPseudo(path)) out[path] = emptyFacts(path); };
  for (const [path, p] of Object.entries(ui.files)) if (p.kind !== 'ignored') stub(path);
  for (const t of ui.turns) {
    for (const p of Object.keys(t.paths)) stub(p);
    for (const c of Object.values(t.planned)) c.files.forEach(stub);
    t.unassigned.forEach(stub);
    for (const files of Object.values(t.tests)) files.forEach(stub);
    for (const s of t.steps) for (const f of [...s.files, ...s.imports.map((i) => i.from)]) stub(normalize(fileOf(f) ?? f));
    for (const e of Object.values(t.plannedEdges)) for (const i of e.imports) { stub(i.from); stub(i.to); }
    for (const e of t.edgesAdded) { stub(e.edge.from); stub(e.edge.to); }
  }
  if (!ui.map) return out;
  const mapper = createMapper(ui.map);
  const want = new Map<string, Set<string>>();
  for (const e of Object.values(ui.edges)) for (const f of e.files) { stub(f.from); stub(f.to); (want.get(f.from) ?? want.set(f.from, new Set()).get(f.from)!).add(f.to); }
  const cross = (a: string, b: string) => {
    const pa = mapper.place(a);
    const pb = mapper.place(b);
    return pa.kind === 'cell' && pb.kind === 'cell' && pa.domain !== pb.domain;
  };
  for (const [path, f] of Object.entries(out)) {
    const w = want.get(path);
    const keep = f.imports.filter((i) => isPseudo(i.to) || !cross(path, i.to) || !!w?.has(i.to));
    const extra = [...(w ?? [])].filter((to) => !f.imports.some((i) => i.to === to)).sort();
    if (keep.length !== f.imports.length || extra.length) out[path] = { ...f, imports: [...keep, ...extra.map((to) => ({ to, typeOnly: false }))] };
  }
  return out;
}

/** The context graph for a UI state (null before a map exists). */
export function graphOf(ui: UIState): ContextGraph | null {
  return ui.map ? buildGraph(ui.map, graphFacts(ui), ui.semantic) : null;
}
// Lazy per-graph indexes, cached by identity (graphs are treated as immutable once built).
import type { ContextGraph, GraphEdge } from '../contracts/graph';

const memo = <T>(build: (g: ContextGraph) => T) => {
  const cache = new WeakMap<ContextGraph, T>();
  return (g: ContextGraph): T => {
    let v = cache.get(g);
    if (v === undefined) cache.set(g, (v = build(g)));
    return v;
  };
};

/** from → leaf edges, in graph order. */
export const outEdges = memo((g) => {
  const out = new Map<string, GraphEdge[]>();
  for (const e of g.edges) {
    const list = out.get(e.from);
    if (list) list.push(e);
    else out.set(e.from, [e]);
  }
  return out;
});

export const edgeIds = memo((g) => new Set(g.edges.map((e) => e.id)));

/** Files in a subtree (a file counts itself) and symbols strictly below a node; memoized for containers only. */
export const subtreeCounts = memo((g) => {
  const cache = new Map<string, { files: number; symbols: number }>();
  const count = (id: string): { files: number; symbols: number } => {
    const kids = g.children[id];
    const self = g.nodes[id]!.kind === 'file' ? 1 : 0;
    if (!kids?.length) return { files: self, symbols: 0 };
    let c = cache.get(id);
    if (c) return c;
    c = { files: self, symbols: 0 };
    for (const k of kids) {
      const s = count(k);
      c.files += s.files;
      c.symbols += s.symbols + (g.nodes[k]!.kind === 'symbol' ? 1 : 0);
    }
    cache.set(id, c);
    return c;
  };
  return count;
});

/** Ancestors of `id` from the root down, including `id`. */
export function pathTo(g: ContextGraph, id: string): string[] {
  const out: string[] = [];
  for (let n: string | null = id; n; n = g.nodes[n]?.parent ?? null) out.push(n);
  return out.reverse();
}

export const byId = (a: string, b: string) => (a < b ? -1 : a > b ? 1 : 0);
// Graph lane (NAVIGATION_PLAN §3.2): ContextGraph, activity, projection, DOI expansion and trace. Pure, browser-safe.
//
// Typical use: `const g = graphOf(ui); const p = project(g, view, activityFor(ui, g, turnId));`
// Parity with today's views is defined at "domains expanded one level" (view.expanded = every domain id,
// lens.kinds = ['imports']): the visible `cell:` nodes equal cellViews and the cross-domain cell→cell edges,
// grouped by domain pair, equal edgeViews (test/graph-parity.test.ts checks every prefix of the demo log).
export { buildGraph, graphFacts, graphOf, VENDORS_ID, GROUP_THRESHOLD, EXTERNAL_LAYER } from './build';
export { activityFor, emptyLeaf, strongerMark } from './activity';
export { project, side, worse, isActive } from './project';
export { autoExpand, importance } from './expand';
export { trace, MAX_TRACE_PATHS } from './trace';

    const ab = p.edges.filter((e) => e.from === 'domain:a' && e.to === 'domain:b');
    expect(ab.map((e) => e.status).sort()).toEqual(['existing', 'ghost']);
    expect(ab.find((e) => e.status === 'ghost')).toMatchObject({ id: 'ghost:domain:a->domain:b', count: 2, steps: [1, 2], violation: 'new', kinds: ['imports'] });
    expect(project(g, view([], { kinds: ['calls'] }), a).edges.some((e) => e.status === 'ghost')).toBe(false);
  });

  it('filters edge kinds with the lens', () => {
    const p = project(g, view([], { kinds: ['calls'] }), act({}));
    expect(p.edges.every((e) => e.kinds.length === 1 && e.kinds[0] === 'calls')).toBe(true);
    // handler → run and run → vendor:openai stay inside domain a: self-loops at this depth
    expect(p.edges.map((e) => e.id)).toEqual(['domain:a->domain:b']);
    // f1#run → table:ta surfaces as f1 → ta once the cell is open; g.ts writes an unowned table (in Unassigned)
    const writes = project(g, view(['domain:a', 'cell:a/logic'], { kinds: ['writes'] }), act({}));
    expect(writes.edges.map((e) => e.id)).toEqual(['domain:b->unassigned', 'src/a/logic/f1.ts->table:ta']);
  });

  it('turn lens keeps only active nodes and their containers', () => {
    const a = act({ 'src/a/logic/f1.ts': { edited: true, added: 1 }, 'src/b/g.ts': { violation: 'existing' } });
    const p = project(g, view(['domain:a', 'domain:b'], { turnOnly: true }), a);
    expect(p.nodes.map((n) => n.id)).toEqual(['domain:a', 'cell:a/logic']);
    expect(p.edges).toEqual([]);
  });

  it('adds ports on every expanded container an edge crosses, with grid sides', () => {
    const p1 = project(g, view(['domain:a']), act({}));
    const e1 = p1.edges.find((e) => e.from === 'cell:a/logic' && e.to === 'domain:b')!;
    expect(p1.ports.filter((x) => x.edge === e1.id)).toEqual([{ container: 'domain:a', edge: e1.id, side: 'right', direction: 'out' }]);
    const back = p1.edges.find((e) => e.from === 'domain:c' && e.to === 'cell:a/logic')!;
    expect(p1.ports.filter((x) => x.edge === back.id)).toEqual([{ container: 'domain:a', edge: back.id, side: 'right', direction: 'in' }]);

    const p2 = project(g, view(['domain:a', 'domain:b', 'cell:a/logic', 'cell:b/logic']), act({}));
    const e2 = p2.edges.find((e) => e.from === 'src/a/logic/f1.ts' && e.to === 'src/b/g.ts')!;
    expect(p2.ports.filter((x) => x.edge === e2.id)).toEqual([
      { container: 'cell:a/logic', edge: e2.id, side: 'right', direction: 'out' },
      { container: 'domain:a', edge: e2.id, side: 'right', direction: 'out' },
      { container: 'cell:b/logic', edge: e2.id, side: 'left', direction: 'in' },
      { container: 'domain:b', edge: e2.id, side: 'left', direction: 'in' },
    ]);
    // within a column: rows → top/bottom (entry above logic; tests below every layer)
    const p3 = project(g, view(['domain:a', 'cell:a/entry', 'cell:a/logic']), act({}));
    const down = p3.edges.find((e) => e.from === 'src/a/entry/api.ts' && e.to === 'src/a/logic/f1.ts')!;
    expect(p3.ports.filter((x) => x.edge === down.id)).toEqual([
      { container: 'cell:a/entry', edge: down.id, side: 'bottom', direction: 'out' },
      { container: 'cell:a/logic', edge: down.id, side: 'top', direction: 'in' },
    ]);
    const up = p3.edges.find((e) => e.from === testsId('a') && e.to === 'src/a/logic/f1.ts')!;
    expect(p3.ports.filter((x) => x.edge === up.id)).toEqual([{ container: 'cell:a/logic', edge: up.id, side: 'bottom', direction: 'in' }]);
    // no ports when both endpoints are top-level
    expect(project(g, view(), act({})).ports).toEqual([]);
  });
});

describe('autoExpand', () => {
  const g = buildGraph(mini, miniFacts());
  const visibleCount = (expanded: string[]) => project(g, view(expanded), act({})).nodes.length;

  it('expands toward the cursor first, within the budget, deterministically', () => {
    const a = act({ 'src/a/logic/f1.ts': { cursor: true, looked: true }, 'src/b/h.ts': { edited: true } }, { cursor: 'src/a/logic/f1.ts' });
    const full = autoExpand(g, a, null, 50);
    expect(full.slice(0, 3)).toEqual(['domain:a', 'cell:a/logic', 'src/a/logic/f1.ts']);
    expect(full).toContain('domain:b');
    expect(full.some((id) => g.nodes[id]!.kind === 'symbol')).toBe(false);
    expect(autoExpand(g, a, null, 50)).toEqual(full);
    for (const budget of [6, 10, 12, 14, 20]) {
      const ex = autoExpand(g, a, null, budget);
      expect(visibleCount(ex)).toBeLessThanOrEqual(budget);
    }
    expect(autoExpand(g, a, null, 10)).toEqual(['domain:a']);
    expect(autoExpand(g, a, null, 5)).toEqual([]); // the root's children alone exceed it
  });

  it('opens the focus path even without activity, and prefers interest near the focus', () => {
    // the focus and its ancestors open; its children (the Core group) stay collapsed without interest of their own
    expect(autoExpand(g, act({}), 'cell:c/logic', 50)).toEqual(['domain:c', 'cell:c/logic']);
    const a = act({ 'src/a/logic/f2.ts': { looked: true }, 'src/b/h.ts': { looked: true } });
    expect(autoExpand(g, a, 'domain:b', 50)[0]).toBe('domain:b');
    expect(autoExpand(g, a, 'domain:a', 50)[0]).toBe('domain:a');
  });
});

describe('trace (Scout fixture)', () => {
  const map = loadMap();
  const facts = scoutFacts();
  facts['src/shared/types.ts'] = { ...facts['src/shared/types.ts']!, symbols: [
    { ...sym('src/shared/types.ts', 'Tool'), kind: 'type' },
    { ...sym('src/shared/types.ts', 'Tool.run', 'Tool'), kind: 'property' },
  ] };
  const typed = (path: string, calls: CallFact[], impl: { from: string; to: string }[] = []): SemanticFacts => ({ path, hash: 'fixture', calls, implements: impl });
  const asTyped = (path: string) => facts[path]!.calls.map((c) => ({ ...c, confidence: 'typed' as const }));
  // Tier 2: the agent dispatches through the registry's Tool.run; tools implement it; the provider picks a model.
  const semantic: Record<string, SemanticFacts> = {
    'src/orchestrator/agent.ts': typed('src/orchestrator/agent.ts', [call('src/orchestrator/agent.ts#runAgent', 'src/shared/types.ts#Tool.run', 'dispatch')]),
    'src/tools/news-summarize.ts': typed('src/tools/news-summarize.ts', asTyped('src/tools/news-summarize.ts'), [{ from: 'src/tools/news-summarize.ts#newsSummarize.run', to: 'src/shared/types.ts#Tool.run' }]),
    'src/tools/company-profile.ts': typed('src/tools/company-profile.ts', asTyped('src/tools/company-profile.ts'), [{ from: 'src/tools/company-profile.ts#companyProfile.run', to: 'src/shared/types.ts#Tool.run' }]),
    'src/gateway/providers.ts': typed('src/gateway/providers.ts', [
      call('src/gateway/providers.ts#provider', 'vendor/llm-openai/index.ts#call', 'typed'),
      call('src/gateway/providers.ts#provider', 'vendor/llm-anthropic/index.ts#call', 'typed'),
    ]),
  };
  const g = buildGraph(map, facts, semantic);
  const CHAT = 'vendor/llm-openai/index.ts#chat';

  it('reaches the OpenAI chat from the HTTP server only via news-summarize (through the tool registry)', () => {
    const paths = trace(g, 'src/channels/routes.ts#server', [CHAT]);
    expect(paths).toEqual([[
      'src/channels/routes.ts#server', 'src/orchestrator/agent.ts#runAgent', 'src/shared/types.ts#Tool.run',
      'src/tools/news-summarize.ts#newsSummarize.run', CHAT,
    ]]);
    expect(trace(g, 'route:POST /runs', [CHAT])[0]!.slice(0, 2)).toEqual(['route:POST /runs', 'src/channels/routes.ts#server']);
    // Tier 1 alone can't see through the registry
    expect(trace(buildGraph(map, facts), 'src/channels/routes.ts#server', [CHAT])).toEqual([]);
  });

  it('through complete() reaches the providers via providers.ts, and the cost table', () => {
    const paths = trace(g, 'src/gateway/complete.ts#complete');
    expect(paths).toContainEqual(['src/gateway/complete.ts#complete', 'src/gateway/providers.ts#provider', 'vendor/llm-openai/index.ts']);
    expect(paths).toContainEqual(['src/gateway/complete.ts#complete', 'src/gateway/providers.ts#provider', 'vendor/llm-anthropic/index.ts']);
    expect(paths.every((p) => !p.includes('src/tools/news-summarize.ts#newsSummarize.run'))).toBe(true);
    const viaProfile = trace(g, 'src/tools/company-profile.ts#companyProfile.run');
    expect(viaProfile.filter((p) => p.at(-1)!.startsWith('vendor/llm-')).every((p) => p.includes('src/gateway/providers.ts#provider'))).toBe(true);
  });

  it('is deterministic, shortest first, and capped at five paths', () => {
    const all = trace(g, 'src/channels/routes.ts#server');
    expect(all.length).toBeLessThanOrEqual(5);
    expect(all.map((p) => p.length)).toEqual([...all.map((p) => p.length)].sort((a, b) => a - b));
    expect(trace(g, 'src/channels/routes.ts#server')).toEqual(all);
    expect(trace(g, 'nope')).toEqual([]);
  });
});
