// Graph lane (NAVIGATION_PLAN §3.2): ContextGraph, activity, projection, DOI expansion and trace. Pure, browser-safe.
//
// Typical use: `const g = graphOf(ui); const p = project(g, view, activityFor(ui, g, turnId));`
// Parity with today's views is defined at "domains expanded one level" (view.expanded = every domain id,
// lens.kinds = ['imports']): the visible `cell:` nodes equal cellViews and the cross-domain cell→cell edges,
// grouped by domain pair, equal edgeViews (test/graph-parity.test.ts checks every prefix of the demo log).
export { buildGraph, graphFacts, graphOf, VENDORS_ID, GROUP_THRESHOLD, EXTERNAL_LAYER } from './build';
export { activityFor, emptyLeaf, strongerMark } from './activity';
export { project, side, worse, isActive } from './project';
export { autoExpand, importance } from './expand';
export { trace, MAX_TRACE_PATHS } from './trace';
// buildGraph (NAVIGATION_PLAN §3.2): one containment tree plus leaf edges, from domains.yaml and per-file facts.
// Pure and browser-safe (the mapper only needs picomatch).
import { createMapper, matchesAny, type Placement } from '../mapper';
import type { DomainMap } from '../schema';
import type { UIState } from '../events';
import type { CallConfidence, CallFact, FileFacts, SemanticFacts } from '../contracts/facts';
import {
  NEUTRAL_ID, ROOT_ID, UNASSIGNED_ID, cellId, domainId, edgeId, fileOf, groupId, tableId, testsId,
  type ContextGraph, type EdgeKind, type GraphEdge, type GraphNode, type NodeKind,
} from '../contracts/graph';

/** Top-level container for bare packages no `external` cell claims. */
export const VENDORS_ID = 'group:vendors';
/** A container holding more files than this is split into directory groups. */
export const GROUP_THRESHOLD = 12;
/** The layer whose cells hold external services; vendor packages and trace sinks live there. */
export const EXTERNAL_LAYER = 'external';

const KIND_RANK: Partial<Record<NodeKind, number>> = { group: 0, file: 1, table: 2, vendor: 3, symbol: 4, route: 5, entry: 6 };

const emptyFacts = (path: string): FileFacts => ({ path, hash: '', imports: [], writes: [], symbols: [], calls: [], routes: [], entries: [] });
const isPseudo = (id: string) => id.startsWith('vendor:') || id.startsWith('table:');
const normalize = (p: string) => p.replace(/\\/g, '/').split('/').filter((s) => s && s !== '.').join('/');

/**
 * Containment: repo → domain → cell → (group) → file → symbol (nested by `parent`), with routes and entries under
 * their file and tables under the cell that lists them. Test files sit in `tests:<domain>` under their domain;
 * files matching no cell in `unassigned`, shared code in `neutral` (both top-level, created when non-empty).
 * Bare packages (`vendor:<pkg>`) go into the `external` cell that claims them (a glob matching `<pkg>` or
 * `node_modules/<pkg>/…`, importing domains first), else into the top-level `group:vendors`.
 * A cell with confirmed `components` groups matching files by component; any container with more than
 * GROUP_THRESHOLD remaining files groups them by directory (recursively).
 * Leaf edges: imports (file→file), uses (file→vendor), calls, implements, handles (route→handler), writes (→table).
 * Tier 2 calls replace a file's syntactic calls when `semantic[path].hash === facts[path].hash`.
 */
export function buildGraph(
  map: DomainMap,
  facts: Readonly<Record<string, FileFacts>>,
  semantic: Readonly<Record<string, SemanticFacts>> = {},
): ContextGraph {
  const mapper = createMapper(map);
  const nodes: Record<string, GraphNode> = {};
  const children: Record<string, string[]> = {};
  const rank = new Map<string, number>();
  const add = (n: Omit<GraphNode, 'order'>, r: number): GraphNode => {
    const cur = nodes[n.id];
    if (cur) return cur;
    const node = n as GraphNode;
    node.order = 0;
    nodes[n.id] = node;
    rank.set(n.id, r);
    if (n.parent) (children[n.parent] ??= []).push(n.id);
    return node;
  };
  /** Copy a container's domain/layer onto a node (no spread: this runs per symbol). */
  const scoped = <T extends Omit<GraphNode, 'order'>>(n: T, from: GraphNode): T => {
    if (from.domain) n.domain = from.domain;
    if (from.layer) n.layer = from.layer;
    return n;
  };

  // ---- skeleton: domains in map order, cells in layer order (their order is the grid position)
  add({ id: ROOT_ID, kind: 'repo', parent: null, label: 'repo' }, 0);
  const layerIdx = new Map(map.layers.map((l, i) => [l.id, i]));
  map.domains.forEach((d, i) => {
    add({ id: domainId(d.id), kind: 'domain', parent: ROOT_ID, label: d.name, domain: d.id }, i);
    for (const l of map.layers) {
      if (l.id in d.cells) add({ id: cellId(d.id, l.id), kind: 'cell', parent: domainId(d.id), label: l.name, domain: d.id, layer: l.id }, layerIdx.get(l.id)!);
    }
  });
  const nd = map.domains.length;
  const ensureTop = (id: string) => {
    if (id === UNASSIGNED_ID) return add({ id, kind: 'unassigned', parent: ROOT_ID, label: 'Unassigned' }, nd);
    if (id === NEUTRAL_ID) return add({ id, kind: 'neutral', parent: ROOT_ID, label: 'Shared' }, nd + 1);
    return add({ id: VENDORS_ID, kind: 'group', parent: ROOT_ID, label: 'Vendors' }, nd + 2);
  };
  const ensureTests = (domain: string) =>
    add({ id: testsId(domain), kind: 'tests', parent: domainId(domain), label: 'Tests', domain }, map.layers.length);

  // ---- files: every path with facts plus every repo path they import
  const paths = new Set<string>();
  for (const [path, f] of Object.entries(facts)) {
    paths.add(path);
    for (const i of f.imports) if (!isPseudo(i.to)) paths.add(i.to);
  }
  const placement = new Map<string, Placement>();
  const byContainer = new Map<string, string[]>();
  for (const path of [...paths].sort()) {
    const p = mapper.place(path);
    if (p.kind === 'ignored') continue;
    placement.set(path, p);
    const c = p.kind === 'cell' ? cellId(p.domain, p.layer) : p.kind === 'test' ? ensureTests(p.domain).id : ensureTop(p.kind === 'neutral' ? NEUTRAL_ID : UNASSIGNED_ID).id;
    const list = byContainer.get(c) ?? [];
    list.push(path);
    byContainer.set(c, list);
  }

  const putFile = (path: string, parent: string) => {
    const p = placement.get(path)!;
    const n: Omit<GraphNode, 'order'> = { id: path, kind: 'file', parent, label: path.slice(path.lastIndexOf('/') + 1), path };
    if (p.kind === 'cell' || p.kind === 'test') n.domain = p.domain;
    if (p.kind === 'cell') n.layer = p.layer;
    add(n, KIND_RANK.file!);
  };
  /** Directory groups for a container holding too many files; recursive, files directly in the common dir stay put. */
  const groupByDir = (parent: string, files: string[], gid: (dir: string) => string, scope: Pick<GraphNode, 'domain' | 'layer'>) => {
    if (files.length <= GROUP_THRESHOLD) { for (const f of files) putFile(f, parent); return; }
    const prefix = commonDir(files);
    const dirs = new Map<string, string[]>();
    for (const f of files) {
      const rest = prefix ? f.slice(prefix.length + 1) : f;
      const i = rest.indexOf('/');
      if (i < 0) { putFile(f, parent); continue; }
      const dir = (prefix ? `${prefix}/` : '') + rest.slice(0, i);
      const list = dirs.get(dir) ?? [];
      list.push(f);
      dirs.set(dir, list);
    }
    for (const [dir, list] of dirs) {
      const id = gid(dir);
      add({ id, kind: 'group', parent, label: `${dir.slice(prefix ? prefix.length + 1 : 0)}/`, path: dir, ...scope }, KIND_RANK.group!);
      groupByDir(id, list, gid, scope);
    }
  };
  for (const [container, files] of byContainer) {
    const n = nodes[container]!;
    if (n.kind === 'cell') {
      const { domain, layer } = n as Required<Pick<GraphNode, 'domain' | 'layer'>>;
      const comps = map.domains.find((d) => d.id === domain)?.cells[layer]?.components ?? [];
      const rest: string[] = [];
      for (const f of files) {
        const comp = comps.find((c) => matchesAny(c.paths, f));
        if (!comp) { rest.push(f); continue; }
        const id = groupId(domain, layer, comp.id);
        add({ id, kind: 'group', parent: container, label: comp.name, domain, layer }, KIND_RANK.group!);
        putFile(f, id);
      }
      groupByDir(container, rest, (dir) => groupId(domain, layer, dir), { domain, layer });
    } else {
      groupByDir(container, files, (dir) => `group:${container}/${dir}`, n.domain ? { domain: n.domain } : {});
    }
  }

  // ---- symbols, routes, entries (under their file; symbols nested by parent)
  for (const path of placement.keys()) {
    const f = facts[path];
    if (!f) continue;
    const file = nodes[path]!;
    const own = f.symbols.some((s) => s.parent) ? new Set(f.symbols.map((s) => s.id)) : null;
    for (const s of f.symbols) {
      const nested = !!s.parent && !!own?.has(s.parent);
      add(scoped({
        id: s.id, kind: 'symbol', parent: nested ? s.parent : path,
        label: nested ? s.name.slice(s.name.lastIndexOf('.') + 1) : s.name, symbol: { kind: s.kind, exported: s.exported },
      }, file), KIND_RANK.symbol!);
    }
    for (const r of f.routes) add(scoped({ id: r.id, kind: 'route', parent: path, label: `${r.method} ${r.path}` }, file), KIND_RANK.route!);
    for (const e of f.entries) add(scoped({ id: e.id, kind: 'entry', parent: path, label: e.label }, file), KIND_RANK.entry!);
  }

  // ---- tables: under the cell that lists them, else unassigned
  map.domains.forEach((d) => {
    for (const [layer, cell] of Object.entries(d.cells)) {
      for (const t of cell.tables ?? []) add({ id: tableId(t), kind: 'table', parent: cellId(d.id, layer), label: t, domain: d.id, layer }, KIND_RANK.table!);
    }
  });

/** Longest common directory of sorted paths (the common prefix of the first and last, cut at a `/`). */
function commonDir(sorted: string[]): string {
  const a = sorted[0]!;
  const b = sorted[sorted.length - 1]!;
  let i = 0;
  while (i < a.length && a[i] === b[i]) i++;
  return a.slice(0, Math.max(0, a.lastIndexOf('/', i - 1)));
}

/**
 * The facts the graph is built from: `ui.facts`, plus empty stubs for every file the log knows about but has no
 * facts for (placed files, files a turn touched or planned, planned import endpoints), so ghosts and fresh files
 * have a leaf. Cross-domain cell→cell imports follow `ui.edges` (the reducer's record of edge_added/removed), so
 * logs without `facts_changed` still project the same edges as `edgeViews`. A no-op when facts are current.
 */
export function graphFacts(ui: UIState): Record<string, FileFacts> {
  const out: Record<string, FileFacts> = { ...ui.facts };
  const stub = (path: string) => { if (!out[path] && !isPseudo(path)) out[path] = emptyFacts(path); };
  for (const [path, p] of Object.entries(ui.files)) if (p.kind !== 'ignored') stub(path);
  for (const t of ui.turns) {
    for (const p of Object.keys(t.paths)) stub(p);
    for (const c of Object.values(t.planned)) c.files.forEach(stub);
    t.unassigned.forEach(stub);
    for (const files of Object.values(t.tests)) files.forEach(stub);
    for (const s of t.steps) for (const f of [...s.files, ...s.imports.map((i) => i.from)]) stub(normalize(fileOf(f) ?? f));
    for (const e of Object.values(t.plannedEdges)) for (const i of e.imports) { stub(i.from); stub(i.to); }
    for (const e of t.edgesAdded) { stub(e.edge.from); stub(e.edge.to); }
  }
  if (!ui.map) return out;
  const mapper = createMapper(ui.map);
  const want = new Map<string, Set<string>>();
  for (const e of Object.values(ui.edges)) for (const f of e.files) { stub(f.from); stub(f.to); (want.get(f.from) ?? want.set(f.from, new Set()).get(f.from)!).add(f.to); }
  const cross = (a: string, b: string) => {
    const pa = mapper.place(a);
    const pb = mapper.place(b);
    return pa.kind === 'cell' && pb.kind === 'cell' && pa.domain !== pb.domain;
  };
  for (const [path, f] of Object.entries(out)) {
    const w = want.get(path);

    const extra = [...(w ?? [])].filter((to) => !f.imports.some((i) => i.to === to)).sort();
    if (keep.length !== f.imports.length || extra.length) out[path] = { ...f, imports: [...keep, ...extra.map((to) => ({ to, typeOnly: false }))] };

/** The context graph for a UI state (null before a map exists). */
export function graphOf(ui: UIState): ContextGraph | null {

// trace (NAVIGATION_PLAN §2 "Wiring trace"): shortest call chains from a symbol, route or file to its sinks.
import type { ContextGraph } from '../contracts/graph';
import { EXTERNAL_LAYER } from './build';
import { byId } from './util';

export const MAX_TRACE_PATHS = 5;

const adjacency = new WeakMap<ContextGraph, Map<string, { to: string; sinkOnly: boolean }[]>>();

/** calls and handles forward, implements from the interface member to each implementation, writes into tables. */
function adjacencyOf(g: ContextGraph) {
  let adj = adjacency.get(g);
  if (adj) return adj;
  adj = new Map();
  const link = (a: string, b: string, sinkOnly: boolean) => {
    const list = adj!.get(a) ?? adj!.set(a, []).get(a)!;
    if (!list.some((x) => x.to === b)) list.push({ to: b, sinkOnly });
  };
  for (const e of g.edges) {
    if (e.kind === 'calls' || e.kind === 'handles') link(e.from, e.to, false);
    else if (e.kind === 'implements') link(e.to, e.from, false);
    else if (e.kind === 'writes') link(e.from, e.to, true);
  }
  for (const list of adj.values()) list.sort((x, y) => byId(x.to, y.to));
  adjacency.set(g, adj);
  return adj;
}

/**
 * BFS over calls ∪ implements ∪ handles (plus writes into a table sink). Default sinks: vendor and table nodes,
 * and anything inside an `external` cell. Sinks end a chain. Returns at most MAX_TRACE_PATHS shortest chains
 * (one per sink, nearest first, ties by sink id), each starting at `from`. Dispatch through a registry shows up
 * as an interface member followed by an implementation (`implements` walked backwards).
 */
export function trace(graph: ContextGraph, from: string, sinks?: readonly string[]): string[][] {
  if (!graph.nodes[from]) return [];
  const adj = adjacencyOf(graph);
  const given = sinks ? new Set(sinks) : null;
  const isSink = (id: string) => {
    if (given) return given.has(id);
    const n = graph.nodes[id];
    return id.startsWith('vendor:') || id.startsWith('table:') || n?.layer === EXTERNAL_LAYER;
  };
  const parent = new Map<string, string | null>([[from, null]]);
  const found: string[] = [];
  let frontier = [from];
  while (frontier.length && found.length < MAX_TRACE_PATHS) {
    const next: string[] = [];
    const reached: string[] = [];
    for (const id of frontier) {
      for (const { to, sinkOnly } of adj.get(id) ?? []) {
        if (parent.has(to) || (sinkOnly && !isSink(to))) continue;
        parent.set(to, id);
        if (isSink(to)) reached.push(to);
        else next.push(to);
      }
    }
    found.push(...reached.sort(byId));
    frontier = next;
  }
  return found.slice(0, MAX_TRACE_PATHS).map((sink) => {
    const path: string[] = [];
    for (let n: string | null = sink; n !== null; n = parent.get(n) ?? null) path.push(n);
    return path.reverse();
  });
}
// Lazy per-graph indexes, cached by identity (graphs are treated as immutable once built).
import type { ContextGraph, GraphEdge } from '../contracts/graph';

const memo = <T>(build: (g: ContextGraph) => T) => {
  const cache = new WeakMap<ContextGraph, T>();
  return (g: ContextGraph): T => {
    let v = cache.get(g);
    if (v === undefined) cache.set(g, (v = build(g)));
    return v;
  };
};

/** from → leaf edges, in graph order. */
export const outEdges = memo((g) => {
  const out = new Map<string, GraphEdge[]>();
  for (const e of g.edges) {
    const list = out.get(e.from);
    if (list) list.push(e);
    else out.set(e.from, [e]);
  }
  return out;
});

export const edgeIds = memo((g) => new Set(g.edges.map((e) => e.id)));

/** Files in a subtree (a file counts itself) and symbols strictly below a node; memoized for containers only. */
export const subtreeCounts = memo((g) => {
  const cache = new Map<string, { files: number; symbols: number }>();
  const count = (id: string): { files: number; symbols: number } => {
    const kids = g.children[id];
    const self = g.nodes[id]!.kind === 'file' ? 1 : 0;
    if (!kids?.length) return { files: self, symbols: 0 };
    let c = cache.get(id);
    if (c) return c;
    c = { files: self, symbols: 0 };
    for (const k of kids) {
      const s = count(k);
      c.files += s.files;
      c.symbols += s.symbols + (g.nodes[k]!.kind === 'symbol' ? 1 : 0);
    }
    cache.set(id, c);
    return c;
  };
  return count;
});

/** Ancestors of `id` from the root down, including `id`. */
export function pathTo(g: ContextGraph, id: string): string[] {
  const out: string[] = [];
  for (let n: string | null = id; n; n = g.nodes[n]?.parent ?? null) out.push(n);
  return out.reverse();
}

export const byId = (a: string, b: string) => (a < b ? -1 : a > b ? 1 : 0);

// Entry points from package.json: `bin`, `main`, and `scripts` that run a source file. Node-only (reads files).
import * as fs from 'node:fs';
import { normalizePath, resolvePath } from '../imports';
import type { PackageEntry } from './extract';
import { workspaceDirs } from './resolver';

const RUNNERS = new Set(['node', 'tsx', 'ts-node', 'ts-node-esm', 'bun', 'deno', 'esno', 'esrun', 'vite-node', 'nodemon', 'jiti', 'sucrase-node', 'babel-node']);
const CODE = /\.[cm]?[jt]sx?$/;

type Pkg = { name?: string; bin?: string | Record<string, string>; main?: string; scripts?: Record<string, string> };

/** package.json entries (root and workspace packages) keyed by the repo file they run. */
export function packageEntries(root: string, exists: (path: string) => boolean): Map<string, PackageEntry[]> {
  const out = new Map<string, PackageEntry[]>();
  for (const dir of ['', ...workspaceDirs(root)]) {
    let pkg: Pkg;
    try {
      pkg = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(`${root}/${dir ? `${dir}/` : ''}package.json`, 'utf8')) as Pkg;
    } catch {
      continue;
    }
    const target = (file: string): string | null => {
      const p = normalizePath(dir ? `${dir}/${file}` : file);
      if (!p) return null;
      // Built outputs (`dist/cli.js`) usually come from `src/cli.ts`.
      return resolvePath(p, exists) ?? resolvePath(p.replace(/(^|\/)(?:dist|build|lib|out)\//, '$1src/'), exists);
    };
    const add = (file: string | undefined, entry: PackageEntry) => {
      const t = file ? target(file) : null;
      if (!t) return;
      const list = out.get(t) ?? [];
      if (!list.some((e) => e.kind === entry.kind && e.label === entry.label)) list.push(entry);
      out.set(t, list);
    };
    const name = pkg.name ?? (dir || 'root');
    if (typeof pkg.bin === 'string') add(pkg.bin, { kind: 'bin', label: name.replace(/^@[^/]+\//, '') });
    else for (const [bin, file] of Object.entries(pkg.bin ?? {})) add(file, { kind: 'bin', label: bin });
    if (pkg.main) add(pkg.main, { kind: 'main', label: name });
    for (const [script, cmd] of Object.entries(pkg.scripts ?? {})) {
      const label = dir ? `${name}:${script}` : script;
      for (const part of cmd.split(/&&|\|\||[;|&]/)) {
        const tokens = part.trim().split(/\s+/).filter((t) => !/^\w+=/.test(t)); // drop `FOO=1` env prefixes
        const runner = tokens[0]?.replace(/^npx$/, '') || tokens[1];
        if (!runner || !RUNNERS.has(runner)) continue;
        const file = tokens.find((t) => !t.startsWith('-') && CODE.test(t));
        if (file) add(file, { kind: 'script', label });
      }
    }
  }
  return out;
}
// Route paths and file-based routes (Next.js). Pure and browser-safe.
import type { RouteFact } from '../contracts/facts';

export const HTTP_METHODS = ['GET', 'POST', 'PUT', 'PATCH', 'DELETE', 'HEAD', 'OPTIONS'];

/**
 * Normalize a route path so ids are stable: params (`:id`, `{id}`, `[id]`, `[...x]`, regex groups `([\w-]+)`) become `{}`,
 * regex anchors and escapes are dropped, and a leading `/` is ensured.
 */
export function normalizeRoutePath(raw: string): string {
  let p = raw.trim().replace(/^\^/, '').replace(/\$$/, '').replace(/\\\//g, '/');
  p = p.replace(/\((?:[^()\\]|\\.)*\)\??/g, '{}'); // regex capture groups
  p = p.replace(/\[\[?\.{0,3}[^\]/]*\]?\]/g, '{}'); // [id], [...slug], [[...slug]]
  p = p.replace(/:[A-Za-z_$][\w$]*\??/g, '{}').replace(/\{[^}/]+\}/g, '{}').replace(/\{\}[+*?]+/g, '{}');
  p = p.replace(/(^|\/)\*+(?=\/|$)/g, '$1{}');
  p = p.replace(/\\(.)/g, '$1').replace(/\/+/g, '/');
  if (!p.startsWith('/')) p = `/${p}`;
  return p.length > 1 ? p.replace(/\/$/, '') : p;
}

export const routeId = (method: string, path: string) => `route:${method} ${path}`;

export function routeFact(method: string, rawPath: string, file: string, handler: string | null): RouteFact {
  const m = method.toUpperCase() === 'ALL' ? 'ANY' : method.toUpperCase();
  const path = normalizeRoutePath(rawPath);
  return { id: routeId(m, path), method: m, path, file, handler };
}

const NEXT_APP_ROUTE = /(?:^|\/)app\/((?:.*\/)?)route\.[cm]?[jt]sx?$/;
const NEXT_APP_PAGE = /(?:^|\/)app\/((?:.*\/)?)page\.[cm]?[jt]sx?$/;
const NEXT_PAGES = /(?:^|\/)pages\/(.*)\.[cm]?[jt]sx?$/;

/** URL path for a Next.js segment list: route groups `(x)` and slots `@x` drop out. */
const segmentsToPath = (dir: string) =>
  normalizeRoutePath(`/${dir.split('/').filter((s) => s && !/^\(.*\)$/.test(s) && !s.startsWith('@')).join('/')}`);

/** Next.js file-based routes and pages for `path`, given its export names. Handlers are symbol names in the file. */
export function nextRoutes(path: string, exportNames: readonly string[]): { routes: { method: string; path: string; symbol: string }[]; page: string | null } {
  let m = NEXT_APP_ROUTE.exec(path);
  if (m) {
    const url = segmentsToPath(m[1]!);
    return { routes: exportNames.filter((n) => HTTP_METHODS.includes(n)).map((n) => ({ method: n, path: url, symbol: n })), page: null };
  }
  m = NEXT_APP_PAGE.exec(path);
  if (m) return { routes: [], page: segmentsToPath(m[1]!) };
  m = NEXT_PAGES.exec(path);
  if (m) {
    const rest = m[1]!.replace(/(?:^|\/)index$/, '');
    if (/^api(?:\/|$)/.test(rest)) return { routes: exportNames.includes('default') ? [{ method: 'ANY', path: segmentsToPath(rest), symbol: 'default' }] : [], page: null };
    if (/(?:^|\/)_(?:app|document|error)$/.test(rest) || /^_/.test(rest)) return { routes: [], page: null };
    return { routes: [], page: segmentsToPath(rest) };
  }
  return { routes: [], page: null };
}

export type Selection = { cell: string } | { edge: string; pair: string } | { unassigned: true };

export type Conn = 'connecting' | 'open' | 'down' | 'fake';

/**
 * The store holds the event log and purely ephemeral UI state. Everything the map, ledger, summary and chat show
 * is derived from `events` (see derive.ts); nothing here is a second copy of footprint, ghosts or ledger.
 */
type Store = {
  events: HarnessEvent[];
  /** null = live; otherwise the number of events to reduce (replay). */
  replay: number | null;
  /** Streaming assistant text not yet committed as a `chat` event. */
  delta: string;
  busy: boolean;
  conn: Conn;
  repo: string;
  draft: string;
  focusTick: number;
  selection: Selection | null;
  /** null = latest turn. */
  turn: string | null;
  hover: string | null;

  hello(events: HarnessEvent[], busy: boolean): void;
  append(e: HarnessEvent): void;
  addDelta(text: string): void;
  setBusy(b: boolean): void;
  setConn(c: Conn): void;
  setRepo(r: string): void;
  setDraft(d: string, focus?: boolean): void;
  select(s: Selection | null): void;
  setTurn(id: string | null): void;
  setReplay(i: number | null): void;
  setHover(h: string | null): void;
};

export const useStore = create<Store>((set) => ({
  events: [],
  replay: null,
  delta: '',
  busy: false,
  conn: 'connecting',
  repo: '',
  draft: '',
  focusTick: 0,
  selection: null,
  turn: null,
  hover: null,

  hello: (events, busy) => set({ events, busy, delta: '' }),
  append: (e) =>
    set((s) => {
      if (s.events.length && s.events[s.events.length - 1]!.id === e.id) return s;
      const clear = e.kind === 'chat' && (e.data as { role?: string } | undefined)?.role === 'assistant';
      return { events: [...s.events, e], ...(clear ? { delta: '' } : {}) };
    }),
  addDelta: (text) => set((s) => ({ delta: s.delta + text })),
  setBusy: (busy) => set(busy ? { busy } : { busy, delta: '' }),
  setConn: (conn) => set({ conn }),
  setRepo: (repo) => set({ repo }),
  setDraft: (draft, focus) => set((s) => ({ draft, focusTick: focus ? s.focusTick + 1 : s.focusTick })),
  select: (selection) => set({ selection }),
  setTurn: (turn) => set({ turn }),
  setReplay: (replay) => set({ replay }),
  setHover: (hover) => set({ hover }),
}));
import { useEffect, useRef, useState } from 'react';

export const reducedMotion = () => typeof matchMedia !== 'undefined' && matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)').matches;

/** Counts up (or down) to `value` over ~400 ms whenever it changes. */
export function useTween(value: number, ms = 400): number {
  const [shown, setShown] = useState(value);
  const from = useRef(value);
  useEffect(() => {
    if (reducedMotion() || from.current === value) {
      from.current = value;
      setShown(value);
      return;
    }
    const start = performance.now();
    const a = from.current;
    let raf = 0;
    const step = (now: number) => {
      const k = Math.min(1, (now - start) / ms);
      const eased = 1 - (1 - k) ** 3;
      setShown(Math.round(a + (value - a) * eased));
      if (k < 1) raf = requestAnimationFrame(step);
      else from.current = value;
    };
    raf = requestAnimationFrame(step);
    return () => {
      cancelAnimationFrame(raf);
      from.current = value;
    };
  }, [value, ms]);
  return shown;
}

/** True for a moment after `key` changes (not on mount). */
export function useFlash(key: unknown, ms = 650): boolean {
  const [on, setOn] = useState(false);
  const first = useRef(true);
  useEffect(() => {
    if (first.current) {
      first.current = false;
      return;
    }
    setOn(true);
    const t = setTimeout(() => setOn(false), ms);
    return () => clearTimeout(t);
  }, [key, ms]);
  return on;
}

export function useSize<T extends HTMLElement>() {
  const ref = useRef<T>(null);
  const [size, setSize] = useState({ w: 0, h: 0 });
  useEffect(() => {
    const el = ref.current;
    if (!el) return;
    const ro = new ResizeObserver(([e]) => {
      if (e) setSize({ w: e.contentRect.width, h: e.contentRect.height });
    });
    ro.observe(el);
    return () => ro.disconnect();
  }, []);
  return [ref, size] as const;
}
import type { HarnessEvent } from '@harness/core/view';
import { useStore } from './store';

type ServerMsg =
  | { type: 'hello'; events: HarnessEvent[]; busy: boolean; session: string }
  | { type: 'event'; event: HarnessEvent }
  | { type: 'delta'; text: string }
  | { type: 'busy'; busy: boolean };

const params = new URLSearchParams(location.search);
/** Dev-only: `?fake=1` loads /fake-events.json at once, `?fake=play` streams it; `&at=N` opens the replay at N. */
export const fakeMode = params.get('fake');

export function connect() {
  if (fakeMode) return loadFake(fakeMode === 'play', fakeMode);
  void fetch('/api/info')
    .then((r) => r.json() as Promise<{ repo: string }>)
    .then((i) => useStore.getState().setRepo(i.repo))
    .catch(() => {});
  openSocket(500);
}

function openSocket(delay: number) {
  const ws = new WebSocket(`${location.protocol === 'https:' ? 'wss' : 'ws'}://${location.host}/ws`);
  let opened = false;
  ws.onopen = () => {
    opened = true;
    useStore.getState().setConn('open');
  };
  ws.onmessage = (m) => {
    const msg = JSON.parse(String(m.data)) as ServerMsg;
    const s = useStore.getState();
    if (msg.type === 'hello') s.hello(msg.events, msg.busy);
    else if (msg.type === 'event') s.append(msg.event);
    else if (msg.type === 'delta') s.addDelta(msg.text);
    else if (msg.type === 'busy') s.setBusy(msg.busy);
  };
  ws.onclose = () => {
    useStore.getState().setConn('down');
    const next = opened ? 500 : Math.min(delay * 2, 8000);
    setTimeout(() => openSocket(next), opened ? 500 : delay);
  };
}

async function loadFake(play: boolean, fakeMode: string) {
  const st = useStore.getState();
  st.setConn('fake');
  st.setRepo('scout-agent (fake turn)');
  const file = fakeMode === '1' || fakeMode === 'play' ? 'fake' : fakeMode; // `?fake=comp` → /comp-events.json
  const events = (await (await fetch(`/${file}-events.json`)).json()) as HarnessEvent[];
  const at = params.get('at');
  if (!play) {
    st.hello(events, false);
    if (at !== null) st.setReplay(Math.max(0, Math.min(events.length, Number(at))));
    return;
  }
  st.hello([], false);
  for (let i = 0; i < events.length; i++) {
    const e = events[i]!;
    const prev = events[i - 1];
    const gap = prev ? Math.max(20, Math.min(900, (e.t - prev.t) / 3)) : 0;
    await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, e.kind === 'file_assigned' ? 15 : gap));
    useStore.getState().append(e);
  }
}

async function post(path: string, body?: unknown) {
  if (fakeMode) return;
  await fetch(path, { method: 'POST', headers: { 'content-type': 'application/json' }, body: JSON.stringify(body ?? {}) });
}

export const api = {
  chat: (text: string) => post('/api/chat', { text }),
  approve: () => post('/api/approve'),
  interrupt: () => post('/api/interrupt'),
  confirmMap: () => post('/api/map/confirm'),
  fallbackMap: () => post('/api/map/fallback'),
  async file(path: string): Promise<string | null> {
    const r = await fetch(`/api/file?path=${encodeURIComponent(path)}`);
    return r.ok ? r.text() : null;
  },
};
import {
  cellKey, cellViews, edgeViews, ledger, reduce, turnLedger,
  type CellView, type EdgeView, type HarnessEvent, type Ledger, type TurnLedger, type TurnState, type UIState, type Violation,
} from '@harness/core/view';
import { useStore } from './store';

/** Everything the UI shows, as a pure function of (events, replay index, selected turn). */
export type View = {
  ui: UIState;
  upTo: number;
  live: boolean;
  turn: TurnState | null;
  turnIndex: number; // 1-based, 0 when no turn
  cells: Record<string, CellView>;
  edges: EdgeView[];
  ledger: Ledger;
  turnLedger: TurnLedger | null;
  /** cellKey → files placed there (product files only; tests are listed under their domain). */
  cellFiles: Record<string, string[]>;
  testFiles: Record<string, string[]>;
  unassigned: string[];
  proposal: { domains: number; rules: number } | null;
  steps: { done: number; total: number };
  turnStarts: number[];
};

let reduceCache: { events: readonly HarnessEvent[]; upTo: number; ui: UIState } | null = null;
let viewCache: { ui: UIState; turnSel: string | null; view: View } | null = null;

function reduced(events: readonly HarnessEvent[], upTo: number): UIState {
  if (reduceCache && reduceCache.events === events && reduceCache.upTo === upTo) return reduceCache.ui;
  const ui = reduce(events, upTo);
  reduceCache = { events, upTo, ui };
  return ui;
}

export function deriveView(events: readonly HarnessEvent[], replay: number | null, turnSel: string | null): View {
  const upTo = replay ?? events.length;
  const ui = reduced(events, upTo);
  if (viewCache && viewCache.ui === ui && viewCache.turnSel === turnSel) return viewCache.view;

  const turn = (turnSel && ui.turns.find((t) => t.id === turnSel)) || ui.turns.at(-1) || null;
  const cellFiles: Record<string, string[]> = {};
  const testFiles: Record<string, string[]> = {};
  const unassigned: string[] = [];
  for (const [path, p] of Object.entries(ui.files)) {
    if (p.kind === 'cell') (cellFiles[cellKey(p)] ??= []).push(path);
    else if (p.kind === 'test') (testFiles[p.domain] ??= []).push(path);
    else if (p.kind === 'unassigned') unassigned.push(path);
  }
  for (const list of Object.values(cellFiles)) list.sort();

  let proposed = -1;
  let confirmed = -1;
  const turnStarts: number[] = [];
  for (let i = 0; i < events.length; i++) {
    const k = events[i]!.kind;
    if (k === 'turn_started') turnStarts.push(i);
    if (i >= upTo) continue;
    if (k === 'map_proposed') proposed = i;
    if (k === 'map_confirmed') confirmed = i;
  }
  const proposal = proposed > confirmed && ui.map ? { domains: ui.map.domains.length, rules: ui.map.invariants.length } : null;

  const l = ledger(ui);
  const view: View = {
    ui,
    upTo,
    live: replay === null,
    turn,
    turnIndex: turn ? ui.turns.indexOf(turn) + 1 : 0,
    cells: cellViews(ui, turn?.id ?? null),
    edges: edgeViews(ui, turn?.id ?? null),
    ledger: l,
    turnLedger: turn ? turnLedger(ui, turn) : null,
    cellFiles,
    testFiles,
    unassigned,
    proposal,
    steps: turn ? stepProgress(turn) : { done: 0, total: 0 },
    turnStarts,
  };
  viewCache = { ui, turnSel, view };
  return view;
}

/** "3 of 6 steps": a step is done when every cell it plans has been edited (or, for a step with no cells, its files). */
function stepProgress(turn: TurnState) {
  const editedFiles = new Set([
    ...Object.values(turn.edited).flatMap((c) => c.files),
    ...Object.values(turn.tests).flat(),
    ...turn.unassigned,
  ]);
  let done = 0;
  for (const step of turn.steps) {
    const cells = Object.entries(turn.planned).filter(([, c]) => c.steps.includes(step.n)).map(([k]) => k);
    const ok = cells.length ? cells.every((k) => !!turn.edited[k]) : step.files.length > 0 && step.files.every((f) => editedFiles.has(f));
    if (ok) done++;
  }
  return { done, total: turn.steps.length };
}

export function useView(): View {
  const events = useStore((s) => s.events);
  const replay = useStore((s) => s.replay);
  const turnSel = useStore((s) => s.turn);
  return deriveView(events, replay, turnSel);
}

/** Violations relevant to the selected turn (load-time plus this turn's plan and gate), for the inspector. */
export function turnViolations(v: View): { v: Violation; source: 'load' | 'plan' | 'gate' }[] {
  const out: { v: Violation; source: 'load' | 'plan' | 'gate' }[] = v.ui.violations.map((x) => ({ v: x, source: 'load' as const }));
  for (const x of v.turn?.planViolations ?? []) out.push({ v: x, source: 'plan' });
  for (const x of v.turn?.gateBlocks ?? []) out.push({ v: x, source: 'gate' });
  return out;
}

export const basename = (p: string) => p.split('/').pop() ?? p;
export const stem = (p: string) => {
  const parts = p.split('/');
  const last = parts.pop() ?? p;
  // vendor/<name>/index.ts reads better as its folder name
  if (/^index\.[tj]sx?$/.test(last) && parts.length) return parts.pop()!;
  return last.replace(/\.[tj]sx?$/, '');
};

// Tier 1 facts for one file (NAVIGATION_PLAN §3.1): one oxc parse, one walk. Node-only.
import { parseSync, visitorKeys } from 'oxc-parser';
import { matchesAny } from '../mapper';
import type { CallFact, EntryFact, FileFacts, RouteFact, SymbolFact, SymbolKind, WriteSite } from '../contracts/facts';
import { maskComments } from './adapters';
import { hashText, squash } from './hash';
import { BULK_MIN, isMinified, parseModule, parseName, remember, type ModuleRecord } from './record';
import { packageName } from './resolver';
import { nextRoutes, routeFact } from './routes';

/** `(from, spec)` → repo path, `vendor:<pkg>`, or null (unresolved). */
export type Resolve = (from: string, spec: string) => string | null;

/** A package.json entry whose target is the file (`bin`, `scripts`, `main`). */
export type PackageEntry = { kind: 'bin' | 'script' | 'main'; label: string };

export type ExtractContext = {
  /** Import/export record of another repo file, so calls link through barrels and default exports. */
  recordOf?: (file: string) => ModuleRecord | null;
  /** package.json entries that run this file. A `script` whose file reads its arguments becomes a `cli` entry. */
  entries?: readonly PackageEntry[];
  /** `cartography.routes` in domains.yaml: `pattern` is a JS regex source with `method` and `path` groups (or groups 1, 2). */
  routes?: readonly { file: string; pattern: string }[];
};

/** Reads CLI arguments (`process.argv.slice(2)`, `argv[2]`, `parseArgs(…)`), not just the `argv[1]` is-main check. */
const READS_ARGS = /\bprocess\s*\.\s*argv\s*(?:\.\s*(?:slice|includes|indexOf|filter|find)\b|\[\s*[2-9])|\bparseArgs\s*\(/;

/** Tier 1 facts for `path`. Large (> ~500 KB) or minified files get imports, writes and file routes only. */
export function extractFacts(path: string, source: string, resolve: Resolve, ctx: ExtractContext = {}): FileFacts {
  return extract(path, source, resolve, ctx).facts;
}

/** `extractFacts`, plus whether the source parsed (when it didn't, symbols and calls are empty, not "all removed"). */
export function extract(path: string, source: string, resolve: Resolve, ctx: ExtractContext = {}): { facts: FileFacts; parsed: boolean } {
  const { record, parsed } = parseModule(path, source);
  remember(path, source, record);
  const facts: FileFacts = { path, hash: hashText(source), imports: [], writes: [], symbols: [], calls: [], routes: [], entries: [] };

  const imports = new Map<string, boolean>();
  for (const s of record.specs) {
    const to = resolve(path, s.spec);
    if (to && to !== path) imports.set(to, (imports.get(to) ?? true) && s.typeOnly);
  }
  facts.imports = [...imports].map(([to, typeOnly]) => ({ to, typeOnly }));

  let result = parsed;
  if (!result && record.mode === 'lexer' && source.length <= BULK_MIN && !isMinified(source)) {
    const r = parseSync(parseName(path), source);
    if (r.errors.length === 0) result = r;
  }
  const code = result ? maskComments(source, result.comments) : source;
  const w = new Walker(path, source, resolve, ctx, record);
  if (result && source.length <= BULK_MIN && !isMinified(source)) w.run(result.program as unknown as N);
  w.finish();

  facts.symbols = w.symbols;
  facts.calls = [...w.calls.values()];
  const routes = new Map<string, RouteFact>();
  for (const r of w.routes()) if (!routes.has(r.id)) routes.set(r.id, r);

  const next = nextRoutes(path, [...record.exports.keys()]);
  const exportedSymbol = (name: string) => {
    const t = record.exports.get(name);
    const local = t && 'local' in t ? t.local : name;
    return w.symbols.find((s) => s.parent === null && s.name === local)?.id ?? null;
  };
  for (const r of next.routes) {
    const f = routeFact(r.method, r.path, path, exportedSymbol(r.symbol));
    if (!routes.has(f.id)) routes.set(f.id, f);
  }
  for (const r of customRoutes(path, code, ctx.routes ?? [], w)) if (!routes.has(r.id)) routes.set(r.id, r);
  facts.routes = [...routes.values()];

  const writes = new Map<string, WriteSite>();
  for (const hit of record.writes) {
    const site = { table: hit.table, symbol: w.innermost(hit.at), via: hit.via };
    writes.set(`${site.table}\u0000${site.symbol}\u0000${site.via}`, site);
  }
  facts.writes = [...writes.values()];

  const entries = new Map<string, EntryFact>();
  const entry = (kind: EntryFact['kind'], label: string, symbol: string | null) =>
    entries.set(`entry:${kind}:${label}`, { id: `entry:${kind}:${label}`, kind, file: path, symbol, label });
  for (const e of ctx.entries ?? []) entry(e.kind === 'script' && READS_ARGS.test(code) ? 'cli' : e.kind, e.label, null);
  for (const r of facts.routes) entry('route', `${r.method} ${r.path}`, r.handler);
  if (next.page) entry('page', next.page, exportedSymbol('default'));

  return { facts, parsed: record.mode !== 'regex' };
}

/** Routes from user-confirmed patterns (`cartography.routes`). The handler is the first symbol defined after the match. */
function customRoutes(path: string, code: string, patterns: readonly { file: string; pattern: string }[], w: Walker): RouteFact[] {
  const out: RouteFact[] = [];
  for (const p of patterns) {
    if (!matchesAny([p.file], path)) continue;
    let re: RegExp;
    try {
      re = new RegExp(p.pattern, 'g');
    } catch {
      continue;
    }
    const matches = [...code.matchAll(re)];
    matches.forEach((m, i) => {
      const g = m.groups ?? {};
      const method = g.method ?? (m.length > 2 ? m[1] : undefined) ?? 'ANY';
      const raw = g.path ?? (m.length > 2 ? m[2] : m[1]);
      if (raw === undefined) return;
      const end = m.index + m[0].length;
      const stop = matches[i + 1]?.index ?? code.length;
      out.push(routeFact(method, raw, path, w.firstSymbolIn(end, stop) ?? w.innermost(m.index)));
    });
  }
  return out;
}

type N = { type: string; start: number; end: number; [key: string]: any };

const FN = new Set(['ArrowFunctionExpression', 'FunctionExpression']);
const SKIP_KEYS = new Set(['typeAnnotation', 'returnType', 'typeParameters', 'typeArguments', 'superTypeArguments', 'implements']);
const WRAPPERS = new Set(['TSAsExpression', 'TSSatisfiesExpression', 'TSNonNullExpression', 'ParenthesizedExpression', 'TSTypeAssertion', 'TSInstantiationExpression', 'ChainExpression']);
const ROUTE_METHODS = new Set(['get', 'post', 'put', 'patch', 'delete', 'options', 'head', 'all']);
const FRAMEWORKS = new Set(['express', 'hono', 'fastify', '@koa/router', 'koa-router', '@hono/zod-openapi']);

const unwrap = (n: N | null | undefined): N | null => {
  let x = n ?? null;
  while (x && WRAPPERS.has(x.type)) x = x.expression;
  return x;
};
const strValue = (n: N | null | undefined): string | null => {
  const x = unwrap(n);
  if (!x) return null;
  if (x.type === 'Literal' && typeof x.value === 'string') return x.value;
  if (x.type === 'TemplateLiteral' && x.expressions.length === 0) return x.quasis[0]?.value?.cooked ?? null;
  return null;
};
const keyName = (key: N, computed: boolean): string | null => {
  if (!computed && key.type === 'Identifier') return key.name;
  if (key.type === 'PrivateIdentifier') return `#${key.name}`;
  return strValue(key);
};

type Binding = { spec: string; name: string }; // name: imported name, 'default', or '*' (namespace / CommonJS module)
type PendingRoute = { method: string; path: string; handler: N | null; enclosing: string | null };

class Walker {

  calls = new Map<string, CallFact>();
  private sigText = new Map<string, string>();
  private used = new Map<string, number>();
  private cbCount = 0;
  private bindings = new Map<string, Binding>();
  private topNames = new Set<string>();
  private receivers = new Map<string, string>(); // router local → route prefix
  private pending: PendingRoute[] = [];
  private nodeSym = new WeakMap<object, string>();
  private current: SymbolFact | null = null;
  private cls: SymbolFact | null = null;
  private resolved = new Map<string, string | null>();
  private jsx: boolean;

  constructor(private path: string, private source: string, private resolve: Resolve, private ctx: ExtractContext, private record: ModuleRecord) {
    this.jsx = /\.[jt]sx$/.test(path);
  }

  run(program: N) {
    this.prepass(program.body as N[]);
    for (const stmt of program.body as N[]) this.statement(stmt);

import { cellKey, type DomainMap, type EdgeView, type ImportEdge, type TurnState, type UIState, type Violation } from '@harness/core/view';

export type Rect = { x: number; y: number; w: number; h: number };

export type GridLayout = {
  width: number;
  height: number;
  labelW: number;
  headerH: number;
  gapX: number;
  gapY: number;
  colW: number;
  rowH: number;
  cols: { id: string; name: string; purpose: string; x: number; index: number }[];
  rows: { id: string; name: string; y: number; index: number }[];
  cells: Record<string, Rect & { col: number; row: number }>;
  unassigned: Rect | null;
};

/** Fixed grid: a gutter on both sides of every column and row, so edges can route around cells. */
export function gridLayout(map: DomainMap, size: { w: number; h: number }, withUnassigned: boolean): GridLayout {
  const labelW = 64;
  const headerH = 46;
  const n = map.domains.length + (withUnassigned ? 1 : 0);
  const r = map.layers.length;
  const gapX = Math.max(28, Math.min(44, size.w * 0.032));
  const gapY = 26;
  const colW = Math.max(96, (size.w - labelW - gapX * (n + 1)) / n);
  const rowH = Math.max(72, Math.min(150, (size.h - headerH - gapY * (r + 1)) / r));
  const colX = (i: number) => labelW + gapX + i * (colW + gapX);
  const rowY = (j: number) => headerH + gapY + j * (rowH + gapY);
  const cols = map.domains.map((d, i) => ({ id: d.id, name: d.name, purpose: d.purpose, x: colX(i), index: i }));
  const rows = map.layers.map((l, j) => ({ id: l.id, name: l.name, y: rowY(j), index: j }));
  const cells: GridLayout['cells'] = {};
  map.domains.forEach((d, i) => {
    map.layers.forEach((l, j) => {
      if (l.id in d.cells) cells[cellKey({ domain: d.id, layer: l.id })] = { x: colX(i), y: rowY(j), w: colW, h: rowH, col: i, row: j };
    });
  });
  const unassigned = withUnassigned ? { x: colX(n - 1), y: rowY(0), w: colW, h: rowY(r - 1) + rowH - rowY(0) } : null;
  if (withUnassigned) cols.push({ id: '__unassigned', name: 'Unassigned', purpose: 'Files that match no cell in domains.yaml', x: colX(n - 1), index: n - 1 });
  return {
    width: labelW + gapX * (n + 1) + colW * n,
    height: headerH + gapY * (r + 1) + rowH * r,
    labelW, headerH, gapX, gapY, colW, rowH, cols, rows, cells, unassigned,
  };
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------- edges

export type EdgeSegment = {
  key: string; // stable React key
  edgeKey: string; // `${from}->${to}`
  pair: string; // `${srcCell}=>${dstCell}`
  from: string;
  to: string;
  src: string; // cellKey
  dst: string; // cellKey
  state: EdgeView['state'];
  violation: boolean;
  steps: number[];
  files: ImportEdge[];
};

/** Which cell a file sits in: its placement, else the cell a plan put it in. */
function cellForFile(s: UIState, turn: TurnState | null, file: string): string | null {
  const p = s.files[file];
  if (p?.kind === 'cell') return cellKey(p);
  const planned = turn && Object.values(turn.planned).find((c) => c.files.includes(file));
  return planned ? cellKey(planned.cell) : null;
}

function fallbackCell(map: DomainMap, domain: string): string | null {
  const d = map.domains.find((x) => x.id === domain);
  const layer = d && map.layers.find((l) => l.id in d.cells);
  return d && layer ? cellKey({ domain, layer: layer.id }) : null;
}

/**
 * Splits each domain edge from `edgeViews` into one segment per (source cell, target cell) pair, so a gateway
 * bypass to the provider (tools·logic → gateway·external) is drawn apart from calls to complete() (→ gateway·logic).
 * The edge's `violation` flag is kept only on the segments whose files are the violating imports.
 */
export function edgeSegments(s: UIState, turn: TurnState | null, edges: EdgeView[]): EdgeSegment[] {
  const map = s.map;
  if (!map) return [];
  const out: EdgeSegment[] = [];
  for (const e of edges) {
    const groups = new Map<string, { src: string; dst: string; files: ImportEdge[] }>();
    for (const f of e.files.length ? e.files : [{ from: '', to: '' }]) {
      const src = (f.from && cellForFile(s, turn, f.from)) || fallbackCell(map, e.from);
      const dst = (f.to && cellForFile(s, turn, f.to)) || fallbackCell(map, e.to);
      if (!src || !dst) continue;
      const k = `${src}=>${dst}`;
      const g = groups.get(k) ?? { src, dst, files: [] };
      if (f.from) g.files.push(f);
      groups.set(k, g);
    }
    const list: Violation[] = e.state === 'ghost' ? turn?.planViolations ?? [] : s.violations;
    const added = turn?.edgesAdded ?? [];
    for (const [pair, g] of groups) {
      const violation = e.violation && (groups.size === 1 || g.files.some((f) => list.some((v) => v.file === f.from && (!v.target || v.target === f.to))));
      const edgeKey = `${e.from}->${e.to}`;
      // `new` is per domain pair in edgeViews; only the cell pairs whose imports were added this turn draw in as new.
      const state = e.state === 'new' && !g.files.some((f) => added.some((a) => a.edge.from === f.from && a.edge.to === f.to)) ? 'existing' : e.state;
      out.push({ key: `${state}:${pair}`, edgeKey, pair, from: e.from, to: e.to, src: g.src, dst: g.dst, state, violation, steps: e.steps, files: g.files });
    }
  }
  // Existing edges first, then new, then ghosts: lanes are assigned in this order and stay stable as a turn adds edges.
  const rank = { existing: 0, new: 1, ghost: 2 } as const;
  return out.sort((a, b) => rank[a.state] - rank[b.state] || a.key.localeCompare(b.key));
}

type Pt = [number, number];

/** Alternating lane offsets around a gutter's center: 0, +s, −s, +2s, … */
const lane = (i: number, s: number) => (i === 0 ? 0 : (i % 2 ? 1 : -1) * Math.ceil(i / 2) * s);

export type RoutedSegment = EdgeSegment & { d: string; length: number };

/** Orthogonal routes through the gutters, with a separate lane per segment in every gutter it uses. */
export function routeEdges(L: GridLayout, segs: EdgeSegment[]): RoutedSegment[] {
  const used = new Map<string, number>();
  const take = (k: string) => {
    const n = used.get(k) ?? 0;
    used.set(k, n + 1);
    return n;
  };
  const colGutterX = (g: number) => L.labelW + g * (L.colW + L.gapX) + L.gapX / 2;
  const rowGutterY = (g: number) => L.headerH + g * (L.rowH + L.gapY) + L.gapY / 2;
  const laneX = Math.min(7, L.gapX / 6);
  const laneY = Math.min(6, L.gapY / 5);
  const out: RoutedSegment[] = [];

  for (const seg of segs) {
    const S = L.cells[seg.src];
    const T = L.cells[seg.dst];
    if (!S || !T || S === T) continue;
    const dir = T.col > S.col ? 1 : T.col < S.col ? -1 : 0;
    let pts: Pt[];
    const sideY = (c: typeof S, port: string) => c.y + c.h / 2 + lane(take(`port:${port}`), 9);
    if (dir === 0) {
      // Same column (only possible for odd placements): loop out through the right gutter.
      const gx = colGutterX(S.col + 1) + lane(take(`col:${S.col + 1}`), laneX);
      const ey = sideY(S, `${seg.src}:r`);
      const ty = sideY(T, `${seg.dst}:r`);
      pts = [[S.x + S.w, ey], [gx, ey], [gx, ty], [T.x + T.w, ty]];
    } else {
      const sx = dir > 0 ? S.x + S.w : S.x;
      const tx = dir > 0 ? T.x : T.x + T.w;
      const gS = dir > 0 ? S.col + 1 : S.col;
      const gT = dir > 0 ? T.col : T.col + 1;
      const ey = sideY(S, `${seg.src}:${dir > 0 ? 'r' : 'l'}`);
      const ty = sideY(T, `${seg.dst}:${dir > 0 ? 'l' : 'r'}`);
      if (gS === gT) {
        if (S.row === T.row) {
          const y = (ey + ty) / 2;
          pts = [[sx, y], [tx, y]];
        } else {
          const gx = colGutterX(gS) + lane(take(`col:${gS}`), laneX);
          pts = [[sx, ey], [gx, ey], [gx, ty], [tx, ty]];
        }
      } else {
        let rg: number;
        if (T.row > S.row) rg = S.row + 1;
        else if (T.row < S.row) rg = S.row;
        else rg = (used.get(`row:${S.row + 1}`) ?? 0) <= (used.get(`row:${S.row}`) ?? 0) ? S.row + 1 : S.row;
        const gy = rowGutterY(rg) + lane(take(`row:${rg}`), laneY);
        const gx1 = colGutterX(gS) + lane(take(`col:${gS}`), laneX);
        const gx2 = colGutterX(gT) + lane(take(`col:${gT}`), laneX);
        pts = [[sx, ey], [gx1, ey], [gx1, gy], [gx2, gy], [gx2, ty], [tx, ty]];
      }
    }
    const { d, length } = roundedPath(pts, 7);
    out.push({ ...seg, d, length });
  }
  return out;
}

function roundedPath(pts: Pt[], r: number) {
  let length = 0;
  for (let i = 1; i < pts.length; i++) length += Math.hypot(pts[i]![0] - pts[i - 1]![0], pts[i]![1] - pts[i - 1]![1]);
  let d = `M${pts[0]![0].toFixed(1)},${pts[0]![1].toFixed(1)}`;
  for (let i = 1; i < pts.length - 1; i++) {
    const [px, py] = pts[i - 1]!;
    const [cx, cy] = pts[i]!;
    const [nx, ny] = pts[i + 1]!;
    const d1 = Math.hypot(cx - px, cy - py);
    const d2 = Math.hypot(nx - cx, ny - cy);
    const rr = Math.min(r, d1 / 2, d2 / 2);
    if (rr < 0.5) {
      d += `L${cx.toFixed(1)},${cy.toFixed(1)}`;
      continue;
    }
    const ax = cx - ((cx - px) / d1) * rr;
    const ay = cy - ((cy - py) / d1) * rr;
    const bx = cx + ((nx - cx) / d2) * rr;
    const by = cy + ((ny - cy) / d2) * rr;
    d += `L${ax.toFixed(1)},${ay.toFixed(1)}Q${cx.toFixed(1)},${cy.toFixed(1)} ${bx.toFixed(1)},${by.toFixed(1)}`;
  }
  const last = pts[pts.length - 1]!;
  d += `L${last[0].toFixed(1)},${last[1].toFixed(1)}`;
  return { d, length };
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------- invariants

/** Glob → RegExp for the subset domains.yaml uses (`**`, `*`, `?`). */
export function globRe(glob: string): RegExp {
  let re = '';
  for (let i = 0; i < glob.length; i++) {
    const c = glob[i]!;
    if (c === '*' && glob[i + 1] === '*') {
      if (glob[i + 2] === '/') { re += '(?:.*/)?'; i += 2; } else { re += '.*'; i++; }
    } else if (c === '*') re += '[^/]*';
    else if (c === '?') re += '[^/]';
    else re += c.replace(/[.+^${}()|[\]\\]/g, '\\$&');
  }
  return new RegExp(`^${re}$`);
}

/** Invariants that involve a domain (and, for `only_via`, files of a given cell). */
export function invariantsFor(map: DomainMap, domain: string, files: string[]) {
  return map.invariants.filter((inv) => {
    if (inv.kind === 'only_via') return inv.allowed_from.includes(domain) || files.some((f) => inv.targets.some((t) => globRe(t).test(f)));
    if (inv.kind === 'owns_writes') return Object.values(inv.owners).includes(domain);
    return inv.from === domain || inv.to === domain;
  });
}

import { useEffect, useState, type ReactNode } from 'react';
import { provenance, type DomainMap, type Invariant, type Violation } from '@harness/core/view';
import { api } from '../connection';
import { turnViolations, useView, type View } from '../derive';
import { edgeSegments, globRe, invariantsFor } from '../layout';
import { useStore, type Selection } from '../store';

export function Inspector() {
  const selection = useStore((s) => s.selection);
  const select = useStore((s) => s.select);
  const v = useView();
  const [file, setFile] = useState<string | null>(null);

  useEffect(() => setFile(null), [selection]);
  useEffect(() => {
    const onKey = (e: KeyboardEvent) => {
      if (e.key === 'Escape') select(null);
    };
    addEventListener('keydown', onKey);
    return () => removeEventListener('keydown', onKey);
  }, [select]);

  if (!selection || !v.ui.map) return null;
  return (
    <aside className="inspector" aria-label="Inspector" onClick={(e) => e.stopPropagation()}>
      <button className="inspector-close" aria-label="Close inspector" onClick={() => select(null)}>×</button>
      {file ? (
        <FilePreview path={file} onBack={() => setFile(null)} />
      ) : (
        <Body v={v} sel={selection} map={v.ui.map} openFile={setFile} />
      )}
    </aside>
  );
}

function Body({ v, sel, map, openFile }: { v: View; sel: Selection; map: DomainMap; openFile: (p: string) => void }) {
  if ('unassigned' in sel) {
    const files = [...new Set([...v.unassigned, ...(v.turn?.unassigned ?? [])])].sort();
    return (
      <>
        <h2 className="insp-title">Unassigned</h2>
        <p className="insp-sub">Files that match no cell in domains.yaml. Add their paths to a domain to place them.</p>
        <Section title="Files"><FileList files={files} openFile={openFile} /></Section>
      </>
    );
  }
  if ('cell' in sel) return <CellBody v={v} k={sel.cell} map={map} openFile={openFile} />;
  return <EdgeBody v={v} edge={sel.edge} pair={sel.pair} map={map} openFile={openFile} />;
}

function CellBody({ v, k, map, openFile }: { v: View; k: string; map: DomainMap; openFile: (p: string) => void }) {
  const [domainId, layerId] = k.split('/') as [string, string];
  const domain = map.domains.find((d) => d.id === domainId);
  const layer = map.layers.find((l) => l.id === layerId);
  const cell = domain?.cells[layerId];
  const view = v.cells[k];
  const files = v.cellFiles[k] ?? [];
  const edited = v.turn?.edited[k];
  const planned = v.turn?.planned[k];
  const plannedNew = (planned?.files ?? []).filter((f) => !files.includes(f));
  const tests = v.testFiles[domainId] ?? [];
  const invs = invariantsFor(map, domainId, files);
  const vios = turnViolations(v).filter(({ v: x }) => cellOfFile(v, x.file) === k);
  const prov = provenance(v.ui, { cell: k });

  const state: string[] = [];
  if (view?.edited) state.push(view.unplanned ? 'Edited without being planned' : 'Edited this turn');
  if (view?.ghost) state.push(`Planned in ${stepList(view.ghost)}`);
  if (view?.looked && !view.edited) state.push('Looked at this turn');

  return (
    <>
      <h2 className="insp-title">{domain?.name ?? domainId} <span className="insp-layer">{layer?.name ?? layerId}</span></h2>
      {domain && <p className="insp-sub">{domain.purpose}</p>}
      {state.length > 0 && <p className={`insp-state ${view?.unplanned ? 'is-amber' : ''}`}>{state.join('. ')}{edited ? `: +${edited.added} −${edited.removed}` : ''}</p>}

      {vios.length > 0 && (
        <Section title="Rules crossed">
          {vios.map(({ v: x, source }, i) => <ViolationItem key={i} v={x} source={source} />)}
        </Section>
      )}

      <Section title={`Files (${files.length})`}>
        <FileList files={files} openFile={openFile} marks={(f) => (edited?.created.includes(f) ? 'created' : edited?.files.includes(f) ? 'edited' : null)} />
        {plannedNew.length > 0 && (
          <p className="insp-note">Planned, not created yet: {plannedNew.map((f) => <code key={f}>{f}</code>)}</p>
        )}
      </Section>

      {(cell?.paths?.length || cell?.tables?.length) && (
        <Section title="Defined by">
          {cell?.paths?.map((p) => <code key={p} className="insp-glob">{p}</code>)}
          {cell?.tables?.length ? <p className="insp-note">Owns tables {cell.tables.map((t) => <code key={t}>{t}</code>)}</p> : null}
        </Section>
      )}

      {invs.length > 0 && <Section title="Rules for this domain">{invs.map((i) => <InvariantItem key={i.id} inv={i} />)}</Section>}

      {tests.length > 0 && (
        <Section title={`Tests for ${domain?.name ?? domainId}`}><FileList files={tests} openFile={openFile} /></Section>
      )}

      <Provenance prov={prov} />
    </>
  );
}

function EdgeBody({ v, edge, pair, map, openFile }: { v: View; edge: string; pair: string; map: DomainMap; openFile: (p: string) => void }) {
  const seg = edgeSegments(v.ui, v.turn, v.edges).find((s) => s.edgeKey === edge && s.pair === pair);
  const [from, to] = edge.split('->') as [string, string];
  const name = (id: string) => map.domains.find((d) => d.id === id)?.name ?? id;
  const files = seg?.files ?? [];
  const vios = turnViolations(v).filter(({ v: x }) => files.some((f) => f.from === x.file && (!x.target || x.target === f.to)));
  const invs = map.invariants.filter(
    (i) => (i.kind === 'no_edge' && i.from === from && i.to === to) || (i.kind === 'only_via' && files.some((f) => i.targets.some((t) => globRe(t).test(f.to)))),
  );
  const prov = provenance(v.ui, { edge });
  const turnNo = v.turnIndex;
  const state = seg?.state === 'ghost' ? `Planned in ${stepList(seg.steps)}, not built yet` : seg?.state === 'new' ? `Added in turn ${turnNo}` : 'On the map before this turn';
  const [srcCell, dstCell] = pair.split('=>') as [string, string];
  const layerName = (k: string) => map.layers.find((l) => l.id === k.split('/')[1])?.name ?? '';

  return (
    <>
      <h2 className="insp-title">{name(from)} <span className="insp-arrow">→</span> {name(to)}</h2>
      <p className="insp-sub">{layerName(srcCell)} to {layerName(dstCell)}. Derived from imports; flow down a column is not drawn.</p>
      <p className={`insp-state ${seg?.violation ? 'is-red' : ''}`}>{state}</p>
      {vios.length > 0 && <Section title="Rules crossed">{vios.map(({ v: x, source }, i) => <ViolationItem key={i} v={x} source={source} />)}</Section>}
      <Section title={`Imports (${files.length})`}>
        <ul className="insp-imports">
          {files.map((f, i) => (
            <li key={i}>
              <button className="link" onClick={() => openFile(f.from)}>{f.from}</button>
              <span className="insp-arrow">→</span>
              <button className="link" onClick={() => openFile(f.to)}>{f.to}</button>
            </li>
          ))}
        </ul>
      </Section>
      {invs.length > 0 && <Section title="Rules on this dependency">{invs.map((i) => <InvariantItem key={i.id} inv={i} />)}</Section>}
      <Provenance prov={prov} scope={`${name(from)} → ${name(to)}`} />
    </>
  );
}

function cellOfFile(v: View, file: string): string | null {
  const p = v.ui.files[file];
  if (p?.kind === 'cell') return `${p.domain}/${p.layer}`;
  const planned = v.turn && Object.entries(v.turn.planned).find(([, c]) => c.files.includes(file));
  return planned ? planned[0] : null;
}

function Section({ title, children }: { title: string; children: ReactNode }) {
  return (
    <section className="insp-section">
      <h3>{title}</h3>
      {children}
    </section>
  );
}

function FileList({ files, openFile, marks }: { files: string[]; openFile: (p: string) => void; marks?: (f: string) => string | null }) {
  if (!files.length) return <p className="insp-note">None.</p>;
  return (
    <ul className="insp-files">
      {files.map((f) => {
        const m = marks?.(f);
        return (
          <li key={f}>
            <button className="link" onClick={() => openFile(f)}>{f}</button>
            {m && <span className={`insp-mark mark-${m}`}>{m}</span>}
          </li>
        );
      })}
    </ul>
  );
}

function ViolationItem({ v, source }: { v: Violation; source: 'load' | 'plan' | 'gate' }) {
  const where = source === 'load' ? 'Found on load' : source === 'plan' ? 'In this turn’s plan' : 'Blocked at edit';
  return (
    <div className={`insp-violation ${source === 'load' ? '' : 'is-new'}`}>
      <p className="insp-vio-head"><strong>{v.invariant}</strong> {where}</p>
      <p>{v.reason}</p>
      <code className="insp-glob">{v.detail}</code>
    </div>
  );
}

function InvariantItem({ inv }: { inv: Invariant }) {
  return (
    <div className="insp-inv">
      <p><strong>{inv.id}</strong> {inv.rule}</p>
      {(inv.decisions?.length || inv.exceptions.length) ? (
        <p className="insp-note">
          {inv.decisions?.length ? <>Confirmed by {inv.decisions.join(', ')}. </> : null}
          {inv.exceptions.length ? <>Exceptions: {inv.exceptions.map((e) => <code key={e.path}>{e.path}{e.decision ? ` (${e.decision})` : ''}</code>)}</> : null}
        </p>
      ) : null}
    </div>
  );
}

function Provenance({ prov, scope }: { prov: ReturnType<typeof provenance>; scope?: string }) {
  if (!prov.turns.length && !prov.decisions.length) {
    return <Section title="History"><p className="insp-note">No changes this session.</p></Section>;
  }
  return (
    <Section title="History">
      <ul className="insp-prov">
        {prov.turns.map((t) => {
          const decs = prov.decisions.filter((d) => d.turn === t.id);
          return (
            <li key={t.id}>
              <span>{scope ? `${scope} changed in turn ${t.index}` : `Changed in turn ${t.index}`}{decs.length ? `, under ${decs.map((d) => d.id).join(', ')}` : ''}</span>
              <span className="insp-prov-prompt">{t.prompt}</span>
              {decs.map((d) => (
                <span key={d.id} className="insp-prov-dec">
                  <strong>{d.id}</strong> {d.title}{d.alike ? ' · in Alike' : ''}
                </span>
              ))}
            </li>
          );
        })}
      </ul>
    </Section>
  );
}

function FilePreview({ path, onBack }: { path: string; onBack: () => void }) {
  const [text, setText] = useState<string | null | undefined>(undefined);
  useEffect(() => {
    let live = true;
    setText(undefined);
    api.file(path).then((t) => live && setText(t)).catch(() => live && setText(null));
    return () => {
      live = false;
    };
  }, [path]);
  return (
    <>
      <button className="link insp-back" onClick={onBack}>Back</button>
      <h2 className="insp-title insp-path">{path}</h2>
      {text === undefined && <p className="insp-note">Loading…</p>}
      {text === null && <p className="insp-note">Not on disk. It may be planned but not created yet.</p>}
      {typeof text === 'string' && (
        <pre className="insp-code">
          {text.split('\n').map((l, i) => (
            <span key={i} className="code-line"><span className="code-no">{i + 1}</span>{l || ' '}{'\n'}</span>
          ))}
        </pre>
      )}
    </>
  );
}

const stepList = (steps: number[]) =>
  steps.length === 1 ? `step ${steps[0]}` : `steps ${steps.slice(0, -1).join(', ')} and ${steps[steps.length - 1]}`;
import { useView } from '../derive';
import { useTween } from '../hooks';
import { useStore } from '../store';

export function Header() {
  const repo = useStore((s) => s.repo);
  const conn = useStore((s) => s.conn);
  const name = repo.split('/').filter(Boolean).pop() ?? '';
  return (
    <header className="top">
      <div className="brand">
        <span className="brand-mark" aria-hidden="true">
          <span /><span /><span /><span />
        </span>
        <span className="brand-name">Harness</span>
        {name && <span className="brand-repo">{name}</span>}
        {conn === 'down' && <span className="conn-down">Server not reachable. Reconnecting…</span>}
      </div>
      <Ledger />
    </header>
  );
}

function Ledger() {
  const v = useView();
  const s = v.ledger.session;
  const t = v.turnLedger;
  const items: { label: string; value: number; turn: number | null }[] = [
    { label: 'Lines changed', value: s.linesChanged, turn: t ? t.linesChanged : null },
    { label: 'Cells to review', value: s.cellsToReview, turn: t?.cellsToReview ?? null },
    { label: 'Forks caught before code', value: s.forksCaughtBeforeCode, turn: t?.forksCaughtBeforeCode ?? null },
    { label: 'Rejected options blocked', value: s.rejectedOptionsBlocked, turn: t?.rejectedOptionsBlocked ?? null },
  ];
  return (
    <dl className="ledger" aria-label="Session ledger">
      {items.map((it) => (
        <Counter key={it.label} {...it} turnIndex={v.turnIndex} />
      ))}
    </dl>
  );
}

function Counter({ label, value, turn, turnIndex }: { label: string; value: number; turn: number | null; turnIndex: number }) {
  const shown = useTween(value, 600);
  return (
    <div className="counter">
      <dd className="counter-value">{shown.toLocaleString()}</dd>
      <dt className="counter-label">{label}</dt>
      {turnIndex > 0 && <dd className="counter-turn">{turn === null ? '–' : turn.toLocaleString()} in turn {turnIndex}</dd>}
    </div>
  );
}
import { useView } from '../derive';
import { useStore } from '../store';

export function Scrubber() {
  const v = useView();
  const total = useStore((s) => s.events.length);
  const setReplay = useStore((s) => s.setReplay);
  const setTurn = useStore((s) => s.setTurn);
  if (!total) return <div className="scrubber" />;
  const pct = (i: number) => `${(i / total) * 100}%`;
  return (
    <div className={`scrubber ${v.live ? '' : 'is-replaying'}`}>
      <span className="scrub-label">{v.live ? 'Live' : `Replay ${v.upTo} of ${total}`}</span>
      <div className="scrub-track">
        <div className="scrub-ticks" aria-hidden="true">
          {v.turnStarts.map((i, n) => (
            <span key={i} className="scrub-tick" style={{ left: pct(i) }}>
              <span className="scrub-tick-label">Turn {n + 1}</span>
            </span>
          ))}
        </div>
        <input
          type="range"
          min={0}
          max={total}
          value={v.upTo}
          aria-label="Replay the event log"
          onChange={(e) => {
            const i = Number(e.target.value);
            setTurn(null);
            setReplay(i >= total ? null : i);
          }}
        />
      </div>
      <button className={`btn btn-live ${v.live ? 'is-live' : ''}`} disabled={v.live} onClick={() => setReplay(null)}>
        Live
      </button>
    </div>
  );
}
import { cellKey } from '@harness/core/view';
import { useView, type View } from '../derive';
import { useStore } from '../store';

function phase(v: View): string {
  const t = v.turn;
  if (!t) return '';
  if (t.endedAt !== null) return 'Done';
  if (v.ui.pendingFork?.turn === t.id) return 'Waiting for your choice';
  if (v.ui.awaitingApproval?.turn === t.id) return 'Waiting for approval';
  if (t.approved) return 'Building';
  if (t.steps.length) return 'Planning';
  return 'Exploring';
}

export function TurnSummary() {
  const v = useView();
  const setTurn = useStore((s) => s.setTurn);
  const select = useStore((s) => s.select);
  const selection = useStore((s) => s.selection);
  const turn = v.turn;

  if (!turn) {
    return (
      <section className="summary summary-empty">
        <p>Ask Claude to change something; the map shows what it plans and does.</p>
      </section>
    );
  }

  const findings = v.turnLedger?.findings ?? [];
  const selCell = selection && 'cell' in selection ? selection.cell : null;

  return (
    <section className="summary">
      <div className="summary-turn">
        <div className="turn-tabs" role="tablist" aria-label="Turns">
          {v.ui.turns.map((t, i) => (
            <button
              key={t.id}
              role="tab"
              aria-selected={t.id === turn.id}
              className={`turn-tab ${t.id === turn.id ? 'is-active' : ''}`}
              onClick={() => setTurn(i === v.ui.turns.length - 1 ? null : t.id)}
            >
              Turn {i + 1}
            </button>
          ))}
          <span className="turn-phase">{phase(v)}</span>
        </div>
        <p className="turn-prompt">{turn.prompt}</p>
        {v.steps.total > 0 && (
          <div className="steps" aria-label={`${v.steps.done} of ${v.steps.total} steps`}>
            <span className="steps-bar">
              {Array.from({ length: v.steps.total }, (_, i) => <span key={i} className={`steps-seg ${i < v.steps.done ? 'is-done' : ''}`} />)}
            </span>
            <span className="steps-text">{v.steps.done} of {v.steps.total} steps</span>
          </div>
        )}
      </div>
      <ol className="findings" aria-label="Findings, loudest first">
        {findings.length === 0 && <li className="finding finding-none">Nothing to review yet.</li>}
        {findings.map((f, i) => {
          const res = f.kind === 'invariant' ? resolution(v, f.invariant, f.files[0]) : null;
          return (
          <li key={i}>
            <button
              className={`finding sev-${f.severity} ${res ? 'is-resolved' : ''} ${f.cell && selCell === cellKey(f.cell) ? 'is-selected' : ''}`}
              disabled={!f.cell}
              onClick={(e) => {
                e.stopPropagation();
                if (f.cell) select({ cell: cellKey(f.cell) });
              }}
            >
              <span className="finding-mark" aria-hidden="true" />
              <span className="finding-text">{f.text}</span>
              {f.invariant && <span className="finding-tag">{res ? `${f.invariant}, answered ${res}` : f.invariant}</span>}
            </button>
          </li>
          );
        })}
      </ol>
    </section>
  );
}


/** "A · DR-4" when a fork in this turn answered the violation before code; null while it is open. */
function resolution(v: View, invariant: string | undefined, file: string | undefined): string | null {
  const t = v.turn;
  if (!t || !invariant) return null;
  const fork = t.forks.find((f) => f.answered !== null && f.violations.some((x) => x.invariant === invariant && x.file === file));
  if (!fork) return null;
  const dec = v.ui.decisions.find((d) => d.turn === t.id && d.invariant === invariant && d.paths.includes(file ?? ''));
  return `${fork.option}${dec ? ` (${dec.id})` : ''}`;
}
import { api } from '../connection';
import { useView } from '../derive';

export function MapBanner() {
  const v = useView();
  if (!v.proposal) return null;
  const placed = Object.values(v.ui.files).filter((p) => p.kind === 'cell').length;
  return (
    <div className="banner" role="region" aria-label="Proposed map">
      <div>
        <p className="banner-title">
          Proposed map: {v.proposal.domains} domains, {v.proposal.rules} rules
        </p>
        <p className="banner-sub">{placed} files placed. Check the columns read like your product, then confirm.</p>
      </div>
      <div className="banner-actions">
        <button className="btn" disabled={!v.live} onClick={() => void api.fallbackMap()}>Use reference map</button>
        <button className="btn btn-primary" disabled={!v.live} onClick={() => void api.confirmMap()}>Confirm</button>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

});

};

const ROUTES: Record<string, RouteFact[]> = {

/** FileFacts for every code file in the fixture repo (hash = 'fixture'). */
export function scoutFacts(): Record<string, FileFacts> {
  const map = loadMap();
  const facts = scanRepo(fixtureRepo, map);
  const out: Record<string, FileFacts> = {};
  for (const path of facts.files.filter((f) => /\.(ts|tsx|js|mjs)$/.test(f))) {
    out[path] = {
      path,
      hash: 'fixture',
      imports: facts.imports.filter((i) => i.from === path).map((i) => ({ to: i.to, typeOnly: false })),
      writes: facts.writes.filter((w) => w.file === path).map((w) => ({ table: w.table, symbol: null, via: 'db' })),
      symbols: SYMBOLS[path] ?? [],
      calls: CALLS[path] ?? [],
      routes: ROUTES[path] ?? [],
      entries: path === 'src/channels/cli.ts' ? [{ id: 'entry:cli:scout', kind: 'cli', file: path, symbol: null, label: 'scout' }] : [],
    };
  }
  return out;
}

// TypeScript 7 (Go) "unstable" sync API: oxc finds call sites, tsgo resolves them in batches.
import fs from 'node:fs';
import path from 'node:path';
import { performance } from 'node:perf_hooks';
import { API, SymbolFlags } from 'typescript/unstable/sync';
import { parseSync, Visitor } from 'oxc-parser';

const HERE = path.dirname(new URL(import.meta.url).pathname);
const which = process.argv[2] ?? 'scout';
const cfg = {
  scout: { root: '/Users/johnzhang/Documents/GitHub/scout-agent', tsconfig: 'tsconfig.json', edit: 'src/tools/news-summarize.ts' },
  hono: { root: `${HERE}/corpus/hono`, tsconfig: 'tsconfig.build.json', edit: 'src/hono-base.ts' },
  excalidraw: { root: `${HERE}/corpus/excalidraw`, tsconfig: 'tsconfig.json', edit: 'packages/element/src/mutateElement.ts' },
}[which];

let t = performance.now();
const lap = (label) => { const n = performance.now(); console.log(`  ${label}: ${(n - t).toFixed(0)} ms`); t = n; };
console.log(`## typescript@7 unstable/sync API: ${which}`);
const api = new API({ cwd: cfg.root });
lap('spawn tsgo');
const tsconfig = path.join(cfg.root, cfg.tsconfig);
let snap = api.updateSnapshot({ openProjects: [tsconfig] });
const project = snap.getProject(tsconfig) ?? snap.getProjects()[0];
lap(`open project (${project.program.getSourceFileNames().length} files incl. libs)`);

const repoFiles = project.program.getSourceFileNames().filter((f) => f.startsWith(cfg.root) && !f.includes('/node_modules/') && !f.endsWith('.d.ts'));
function callSites(file, src) {
  const pos = [];
  const r = parseSync(file, src);
  new Visitor({
    CallExpression(n) { const c = n.callee; pos.push(c.type === 'MemberExpression' ? c.property.start : c.start); },
    NewExpression(n) { pos.push(n.callee.start); },
  }).visit(r.program);
  return pos;
}
function resolveFile(proj, file) {
  const src = fs.readFileSync(file, 'utf8');
  const positions = callSites(file, src);
  if (!positions.length) return { total: 0, resolved: 0, inRepo: 0 };
  const syms = proj.checker.getSymbolAtPosition(file, positions);
  let resolved = 0, inRepo = 0;
  for (let s of syms) {
    if (!s) continue;
    if (s.flags & SymbolFlags.Alias) s = proj.checker.getAliasedSymbol(s);
    const d = s.declarations?.[0];
    if (!d) continue;
    resolved++;
    if (String(d.path).startsWith(cfg.root.toLowerCase()) || String(d.path).startsWith(cfg.root)) if (!String(d.path).includes('node_modules')) inRepo++;
  }
  return { total: positions.length, resolved, inRepo };
}
let total = 0, resolved = 0, inRepo = 0;
for (const f of repoFiles) { const r = resolveFile(project, f); total += r.total; resolved += r.resolved; inRepo += r.inRepo; }
lap(`resolve ${total} call sites in ${repoFiles.length} files -> ${resolved} resolved, ${inRepo} to in-repo declarations`);

// Incremental: write a modified copy? We must not modify the corpus for scout (read-only), so use the
// virtual-change path only for corpora we own; for scout just re-snapshot with "changed" (no content change).
const editFile = path.join(cfg.root, cfg.edit);
const times = [];
const original = fs.readFileSync(editFile, 'utf8');
const canWrite = which !== 'scout';
for (let i = 0; i < 4; i++) {
  if (canWrite) fs.writeFileSync(editFile, original + `\nexport function __probe${i}() { return ${i}; }\n`);
  const a = performance.now();
  const s2 = api.updateSnapshot({ fileChanges: { changed: [editFile] } });
  const p2 = s2.getProject(tsconfig) ?? s2.getProjects()[0];
  resolveFile(p2, editFile);
  times.push(performance.now() - a);
  snap.dispose(); snap = s2;
}
if (canWrite) fs.writeFileSync(editFile, original);
console.log(`  incremental: updateSnapshot(changed: 1 file) + re-resolve that file: ${times.map((x) => x.toFixed(0)).join(', ')} ms${canWrite ? '' : ' (content unchanged; scout is read-only)'}`);
api.close();

// The deterministic domain × layer grid at every depth: an expanded domain's column widens to fit its containers,
// the other columns compress to spines, rows grow to the tallest container. Edges route through the gutters;
// edges that leave a container start at its ELK port and continue through the gutters to the other endpoint.
import type { EdgeStatus, ViolationState, VisibleEdge, VisibleNode } from '@harness/core/view';
import type { Scene } from '../scene';
import { portKey, portSide, type Box, type ContainerInput, type ContainerLayout, type Pt } from './containers';

/** One ELK input per expanded cell: its files, the edges inside it, and the ports where edges leave it. */
export function containerInputs(scene: Scene): ContainerInput[] {
  const { nodes, edges, ports } = scene.projection;
  const out = new Map<string, ContainerInput>();
  for (const n of nodes) if (n.kind === 'cell' && n.expanded) out.set(n.id, { id: n.id, children: [], edges: [], ports: [] });
  const parent = new Map<string, string>();
  for (const n of [...nodes].sort((a, b) => a.order - b.order)) {
    if (n.kind === 'file' && n.parent && out.has(n.parent)) { out.get(n.parent)!.children.push(n.id); parent.set(n.id, n.parent); }
  }
  const byEdge = new Map(edges.map((e) => [e.id, e]));
  for (const e of edges) {
    const c = parent.get(e.from);
    if (c && c === parent.get(e.to)) out.get(c)!.edges.push({ id: e.id, from: e.from, to: e.to });
  }
  for (const p of ports) {
    const e = byEdge.get(p.edge);
    const c = out.get(p.container);
    if (!e || !c) continue;
    c.ports.push({ ...p, node: p.direction === 'out' ? e.from : e.to });
  }
  return [...out.values()];
}

export const COL_W = 236;
export const SPINE_W = 64;
export const ROW_H = 132;
export const ROW_H_SPINE = 92; // rows with no open container shrink while a domain is open
export const GAP_X = 56;
export const GAP_Y = 42;

export type NodeType = 'band' | 'cell' | 'spine' | 'container' | 'file';
