import { readFileSync } from 'node:fs';
import { fileURLToPath } from 'node:url';
import { parseDomainMap } from '../src/schema';

export const mapYaml = readFileSync(new URL('../../../fixtures/scout-agent.domains.yaml', import.meta.url), 'utf8');
export const loadMap = () => parseDomainMap(mapYaml);
export const fixtureRepo = fileURLToPath(new URL('./fixture-repo', import.meta.url));
// End-to-end: the server's living-map loop on a temp git copy of the fixture repo, with a FAKE proposer and labeler
// (no model calls). Lives here so `npm test` runs it; it imports the server's living-map modules directly.
import { afterAll, describe, expect, it } from 'vitest';
import { appendFileSync, cpSync, mkdirSync, mkdtempSync, readFileSync, realpathSync, rmSync, writeFileSync } from 'node:fs';
import { tmpdir } from 'node:os';
import { join } from 'node:path';
import { execFileSync } from 'node:child_process';
import { Bus } from '../../../apps/server/src/bus';
import { Repo } from '../../../apps/server/src/repo';
import { attachLivingMap, labelsFor, gitHistory, onboardingSkeleton, chooseCandidate, disruption, type ProposeInput, type Proposer, type Labeler } from '../../../apps/server/src/living-map';
import { reduce, type EventData, type HarnessEvent } from '../src/events';
import { parseDomainMap } from '../src/schema';
import { PROPOSAL_MARGIN } from '../src/cartography';
import { fixtureRepo, mapYaml } from './helpers';
import { BILLING, billingBlock } from './cartography-fixtures';

const dirs: string[] = [];
afterAll(() => { for (const d of dirs) rmSync(d, { recursive: true, force: true }); });

const git = (root: string, ...args: string[]) => execFileSync('git', args, { cwd: root, encoding: 'utf8' }).trim();

/** A throwaway git repo from the fixture (like scripts/sandbox.sh), with domains.yaml committed. */
function sandbox(yaml: string | null = mapYaml): string {
  const dir = realpathSync(mkdtempSync(join(process.env.HARNESS_TEST_TMP ?? tmpdir(), 'harness-lm-')));
  dirs.push(dir);
  cpSync(fixtureRepo, dir, { recursive: true });
  if (yaml) writeFileSync(join(dir, 'domains.yaml'), yaml);
  git(dir, 'init', '-q');
  git(dir, 'config', 'user.email', 'test@harness');
  git(dir, 'config', 'user.name', 'test');
  git(dir, 'add', '-A');
  git(dir, 'commit', '-qm', 'fixture');
  return dir;
}

const FILES: Record<string, string> = {
  'src/billing/invoice.ts': 'import { db } from "../shared/db";\nimport { charge } from "./charge";\nexport function invoice(id: string, amount: number) {\n  db.insert("invoices", { id, amount });\n  return charge(id, amount);\n}\n',
  'src/billing/charge.ts': 'import { db } from "../shared/db";\nexport function charge(id: string, amount: number) {\n  db.update("invoices", id, { charged: amount });\n  return id;\n}\n',
  'src/billing/refund.ts': 'import { db } from "../shared/db";\nimport { charge } from "./charge";\nimport { invoice } from "./invoice";\nexport function refund(id: string) {\n  db.insert("invoices", { id: `${id}-refund` });\n  charge(id, 0);\n  return invoice;\n}\n',
};

/** Fake cartographer: a Billing domain, a fold into Research tools, an invalid map and a no-op. Records its inputs. */
function fakeProposer(calls: ProposeInput[]): Proposer {
  return async (input) => {
    calls.push(input);
    return {
      cost: 0,
      candidates: [
        { title: 'Fold billing into tools.', rationale: 'Smallest change.', yaml: input.yaml.replace('logic:    { paths: ["src/tools/**"] }', 'logic:    { paths: ["src/tools/**", "src/billing/**"] }') },
        { title: 'Add a Billing domain.', rationale: 'src/billing is its own product area.', yaml: input.yaml.replace('\n# Seeded by', `${billingBlock}\n# Seeded by`) },
        { title: 'Broken.', rationale: '', yaml: 'domains: [' },
        { title: 'No change.', rationale: '', yaml: input.yaml },
      ],
    };
  };
}

function setup(yaml: string | null = mapYaml, opts: { proposer?: Proposer | null; labeler?: Labeler | null } = {}) {
  const root = sandbox(yaml);
  const bus = new Bus(root, { fresh: true });
  const repo = new Repo(root, bus);
  repo.loadMapFile();
  bus.emit('map_confirmed', { map: repo.map, source: 'file' }, { turn: null });
  repo.scan();
  const calls: ProposeInput[] = [];
  const lm = attachLivingMap({ bus, repo, proposer: opts.proposer === undefined ? fakeProposer(calls) : opts.proposer, labeler: opts.labeler ?? null, gitLimit: 50 });
  /** A coding turn as the session drives it: hooks report edits, then turn_ended, then the turn closes. */
  const turn = (id: string, write: () => string[]) => {
    bus.turn = id;
    bus.emit('turn_started', { prompt: `turn ${id}`, head: '', baseline: '' });
    for (const p of write()) repo.fileChanged(p, { tool: 'Write' });
    bus.emit('turn_ended', { added: 1, removed: 0, files: [], reason: 'success' });
    bus.turn = null;
  };
  const writeBilling = () => {
    mkdirSync(join(root, 'src/billing'), { recursive: true });
    for (const [p, text] of Object.entries(FILES)) writeFileSync(join(root, p), text);
    return Object.keys(FILES);
  };
  const touchInvoice = () => { appendFileSync(join(root, 'src/billing/invoice.ts'), '\nexport const VERSION = 1;\n'); return ['src/billing/invoice.ts']; };
  const of = <K extends keyof EventData>(kind: K) => bus.events.filter((e): e is HarnessEvent & { data: EventData[K] } => e.kind === kind).map((e) => e.data as EventData[K]);
  return { root, bus, repo, lm, calls, turn, writeBilling, touchInvoice, of };
}

function declName(decl) {
  const parts = [];

    const nm = n.name && ts.isIdentifier(n.name) ? n.name.text : (n.name && ts.isPrivateIdentifier?.(n.name) ? n.name.text : null);
    if (nm && (ts.isFunctionDeclaration(n) || ts.isClassDeclaration(n) || ts.isMethodDeclaration(n) || ts.isVariableDeclaration(n) || ts.isPropertyDeclaration(n) || ts.isPropertyAssignment(n) || ts.isInterfaceDeclaration(n) || ts.isMethodSignature(n) || ts.isPropertySignature(n))) parts.unshift(nm);

function enclosing(node) {

    if (ts.isFunctionDeclaration(n) || ts.isMethodDeclaration(n) || ((ts.isArrowFunction(n) || ts.isFunctionExpression(n)) && n.parent && (ts.isVariableDeclaration(n.parent) || ts.isPropertyAssignment(n.parent)))) {

    }
  }
  return '<module>';
}

function callsIn(sf) {
  const edges = [];
  let total = 0, resolved = 0;
  const visit = (node) => {
    if (ts.isCallExpression(node) || ts.isNewExpression(node)) {
      total++;
      let sym = checker.getSymbolAtLocation(ts.isPropertyAccessExpression(node.expression) ? node.expression.name : node.expression);
      if (sym && sym.flags & ts.SymbolFlags.Alias) sym = checker.getAliasedSymbol(sym);
      const decl = sym?.declarations?.[0];
      if (decl) {
        resolved++;
        const tsf = decl.getSourceFile();
        if (inRepo(tsf)) edges.push({ from: `${rel(sf.fileName)}#${enclosing(node)}`, to: `${rel(tsf.fileName)}#${declName(decl)}` });
      }
    }
    ts.forEachChild(node, visit);
  };
  visit(sf);
  return { edges, total, resolved };
}

}
console.log(`  incremental edit of ${cfg.edit}: new Program+checker+re-resolve one file: ${times.map((x) => x.toFixed(0)).join(', ')} ms`);

  const inc = item ? ls.provideCallHierarchyIncomingCalls(target.getFilePath(), pos) : [];
  const out = item ? ls.provideCallHierarchyOutgoingCalls(target.getFilePath(), pos) : [];
  console.log(`  LanguageService call hierarchy for ${fn.getName()}: ${inc.length} incoming, ${out.length} outgoing in ${(performance.now() - a).toFixed(0)} ms`);
}

43	function useScene(): Scene | null {

49	function viewportFor(b: Box, W: number, H: number, ins: Insets, maxZoom = 1.3): Viewport {
50	  const aw = Math.max(50, W - ins.left - ins.right);
51	  const ah = Math.max(50, H - ins.top - ins.bottom);
52	  const zoom = Math.max(0.08, Math.min(maxZoom, aw / b.w, ah / b.h));
53	  return { zoom, x: ins.left + (aw - b.w * zoom) / 2 - b.x * zoom, y: ins.top + (ah - b.h * zoom) / 2 - b.y * zoom };
54	}

56	function Inner({ insets }: { insets: Insets }) {
57	  const scene = useScene();
58	  const rf = useReactFlow();
59	  const rootRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
60	  const [shown, setShown] = useState<Shown | null>(null);

62	  const insetsRef = useRef(insets);

65	  const camera = useCallback((next: Frame, prev: Frame | null, animate: boolean) => {
66	    if (prev && prev.key === next.key) return; // the camera moves only when the view changes, not on every event

68	    if (!el) return;

70	    let vp = viewportFor(next.bounds, W, H, insetsRef.current);

128	      height: n.h,

228	function Headers({ frame, insets }: { frame: Frame; insets: Insets }) {
229	  const store = useStoreApi();
230	  const colRefs = useRef<(HTMLButtonElement | null)[]>([]);
231	  const rowRefs = useRef<(HTMLDivElement | null)[]>([]);

235	  useLayoutEffect(() => {
236	    const place = ([tx, ty, k]: [number, number, number]) => {
237	      frame.cols.forEach((c, i) => {

255	  return (

297	/** Control Room: a static ring per domain showing the state mix of its cells (no motion). */
298	function Ring({ cells }: { cells: (Rollup | undefined)[] }) {
299	  const parts: [string, number][] = [
300	    ['var(--v2-red)', cells.filter((r) => r?.violation).length],
301	    ['var(--v2-amber)', cells.filter((r) => r?.unplanned).length],
302	    ['var(--v2-agent)', cells.filter((r) => r && r.edited && !r.unplanned && !r.violation).length],
303	    ['color-mix(in srgb, var(--v2-agent) 45%, transparent)', cells.filter((r) => r && !r.edited && !r.violation && (r.looked || r.ghostSteps.length > 0)).length],
304	  ];
305	  const total = Math.max(1, cells.length);
306	  let at = 0;
307	  const stops = parts.filter(([, n]) => n > 0).map(([color, n]) => {
308	    const from = (at / total) * 360;
309	    at += n;
310	    return `${color} ${from}deg ${(at / total) * 360}deg`;
311	  });
312	  stops.push(`var(--v2-line) ${(at / total) * 360}deg 360deg`);
313	  return <span className="v2-ring" aria-hidden="true" style={{ background: `conic-gradient(${stops.join(', ')})` }} />;
314	}

316	// ---------------------------------------------------------------- measurement hooks for the N0 bench (Playwright)
317	
318	type Bench = {
319	  ready: () => boolean;
320	  count: () => number;
321	  stats: () => Stats & { reducedMotion: boolean };
322	  zoom: (ms?: number) => Promise<FrameStats>;
323	  toggle: (domain: string) => Promise<TransitionStats & { layoutMs: number }>;

329	type FrameStats = { frames: number; fps: number; p50: number; p95: number; p99: number; max: number; domNodes: number };
330	
331	function measureFrames(ms: number, step: (p: number) => void): Promise<FrameStats> {
332	  return new Promise((resolve) => {
333	    const times: number[] = [];
334	    const t0 = performance.now();
335	    const frame = (t: number) => {
336	      times.push(t);
337	      const p = Math.min(1, (t - t0) / ms);
338	      step(p);
339	      if (p < 1) requestAnimationFrame(frame);
340	      else {
341	        const dts = times.slice(1).map((x, i) => x - times[i]!).sort((a, b) => a - b);
342	        const q = (f: number) => +dts[Math.min(dts.length - 1, Math.floor(dts.length * f))]!.toFixed(2);
343	        resolve({ frames: times.length, fps: +((1000 * (times.length - 1)) / (times.at(-1)! - times[0]!)).toFixed(1), p50: q(0.5), p95: q(0.95), p99: q(0.99), max: q(1), domNodes: document.querySelectorAll('.react-flow__node').length });
344	      }
345	    };
346	    requestAnimationFrame(frame);
347	  });
348	}

350	function useBenchApi(tr: Transitioner, stats: React.MutableRefObject<Stats>, rf: ReturnType<typeof useReactFlow>) {
351	  useEffect(() => {
352	    const api: Bench = {
353	      ready: () => !!tr.shown,
354	      count: () => document.querySelectorAll('.react-flow__node').length,
355	      stats: () => ({ ...stats.current, transition: tr.last, reducedMotion: reducedMotion() }),
356	      zoom: (ms = 3000) => {
357	        const b = tr.shown!.bounds;
358	        const cx = b.x + b.w / 2;
359	        const cy = b.y + b.h / 2;
360	        const el = document.querySelector('.v2-map')!.getBoundingClientRect();
361	        return measureFrames(ms, (p) => {
362	          const z = 0.2 + 1.2 * Math.sin(p * Math.PI); // far → near → far, crossing every LOD bucket twice
363	          void rf.setViewport({ zoom: z, x: el.width / 2 - (cx + (p - 0.5) * b.w * 0.4) * z, y: el.height / 2 - cy * z });
364	        });
365	      },

368	          tr.onDone = null;
369	          resolve({ ...s, layoutMs: +stats.current.layoutMs.toFixed(1) });
370	        };
371	        useV2.getState().toggle(domain.startsWith('domain:') ? domain : `domain:${domain}`);
372	      }),
373	      elkCell: async (n) => {
374	        const c = bigCell(n);
375	        clearLayoutCache();

652	export class Transitioner {

659	  constructor(private hooks: TransitionHooks) {}

import { existsSync, readFileSync, writeFileSync } from 'node:fs';
import { join, resolve, dirname } from 'node:path';
import { fileURLToPath } from 'node:url';
import { Hono } from 'hono';
import { serve } from '@hono/node-server';
import { serveStatic } from '@hono/node-server/serve-static';
import { WebSocketServer, type WebSocket } from 'ws';
import { Bus } from './bus';
import { Repo } from './repo';
import { Session } from './session';
import { commitPaths } from './git';
import { proposeMap } from './cartographer';
import { attachLivingMap, livingMapRoutes, onboardingSkeleton } from './living-map'; // living map (NAVIGATION_PLAN §4)

const here = dirname(fileURLToPath(import.meta.url));
const REPO = process.env.HARNESS_REPO ? resolve(process.env.INIT_CWD ?? process.cwd(), process.env.HARNESS_REPO) : '';
if (!REPO || !existsSync(REPO)) {
  console.error(`Set HARNESS_REPO to the target repo (got "${process.env.HARNESS_REPO ?? ''}").`);
  process.exit(1);
}
const PORT = Number(process.env.PORT ?? 4310);
const FALLBACK_MAP = resolve(here, '../../../fixtures/scout-agent.domains.yaml');

const bus = new Bus(REPO, { fresh: process.env.HARNESS_FRESH === '1' });
const sockets = new Set<WebSocket>();
const broadcast = (msg: unknown) => {
  const s = JSON.stringify(msg);
  for (const ws of sockets) if (ws.readyState === ws.OPEN) ws.send(s);
};
bus.on((event) => broadcast({ type: 'event', event }));

const repo = new Repo(REPO, bus);
let session: Session | null = null;
let proposal: { yaml: string; source: 'cartographer' | 'fixture' } | null = null;
let busy = false;

function startSession() {
  repo.scan();
  repo.startWatcher();
  session = new Session(repo, bus, (m) => {
    if (m.type === 'busy') busy = m.busy;
    broadcast(m);
  });
  session.start();
}

/** Load: use domains.yaml if present; otherwise propose one (cartographer, else the fixture) and wait for Confirm. */
async function load() {
  if (repo.hasMap()) {
    repo.loadMapFile();
    bus.emit('map_confirmed', { map: repo.map, source: 'file' }, { turn: null });
    startSession();
    return;
  }
  // ---- living map: show the instant deterministic skeleton while the cartographer works (NAVIGATION_PLAN §4.2) ----
  showProposal(onboardingSkeleton(repo.root), 'cartographer');
  // ---- end living map ----
  let yaml: string;
  let source: 'cartographer' | 'fixture' = 'cartographer';
  try {
    if (process.env.HARNESS_CARTOGRAPHER === '0') throw new Error('disabled');
    yaml = await proposeMap(repo, bus);
  } catch (e) {
    if ((e as Error).message !== 'disabled') bus.emit('error', { message: `Cartographer failed, using the reference map: ${(e as Error).message}` }, { turn: null });
    yaml = readFileSync(FALLBACK_MAP, 'utf8');
    source = 'fixture';
  }
  if (session) return; // living map: the user confirmed the skeleton before the cartographer answered
  showProposal(yaml, source);
}

function showProposal(yaml: string, source: 'cartographer' | 'fixture') {
  repo.setMap(yaml);
  proposal = { yaml, source };
  bus.emit('map_proposed', { map: repo.map, yaml }, { turn: null });
  // The shell plays the map assembling: one file_assigned per file, ~15 ms apart.
  const files = repo.listFiles();
  files.forEach((path, i) => setTimeout(() => bus.emit('file_assigned', { placement: repo.place(path) }, { path, turn: null }), i * 15));
}

const app = new Hono();

// ---- living map (NAVIGATION_PLAN §4): drift → cartographer proposals, accept/reject, survey ----
const living = attachLivingMap({ bus, repo });
app.route('/api', livingMapRoutes(living));
// ---- end living map ----
app.get('/api/info', (c) => c.json({ repo: REPO, session: bus.session, busy, proposal: !!proposal }));
app.get('/api/events', (c) => c.json(bus.events));
app.post('/api/chat', async (c) => {
  const { text } = await c.req.json<{ text: string }>();
  if (!session) return c.json({ error: 'Confirm the map first.' }, 409);
  session.userMessage(text);
  return c.json({ ok: true });

app.post('/api/approve', (c) => { session?.approve(); return c.json({ ok: true }); });
app.post('/api/interrupt', (c) => { session?.interrupt(); return c.json({ ok: true }); });

import { appendFileSync, existsSync, mkdirSync, readFileSync, writeFileSync } from 'node:fs';
import { join } from 'node:path';
import { randomUUID } from 'node:crypto';
import type { HarnessEvent, EventKind, EventData, Cell } from '@harness/core';

type Listener = (e: HarnessEvent) => void;

/** Append-only event log: `.harness/events.jsonl` in the target repo, broadcast to every listener. */
export class Bus {
  readonly events: HarnessEvent[] = [];
  readonly session = randomUUID().slice(0, 8);
  turn: string | null = null;
  private listeners = new Set<Listener>();
  private file: string;

  constructor(repo: string, opts: { fresh?: boolean } = {}) {
    const dir = join(repo, '.harness');
    mkdirSync(join(dir, 'turns'), { recursive: true });
    // Keep .harness/ out of the target's git without touching its .gitignore.
    if (!existsSync(join(dir, '.gitignore'))) writeFileSync(join(dir, '.gitignore'), '*\n');
    this.file = join(dir, 'events.jsonl');
    if (opts.fresh) writeFileSync(this.file, '');
    else if (existsSync(this.file)) {
      for (const line of readFileSync(this.file, 'utf8').split('\n')) {
        if (line.trim()) this.events.push(JSON.parse(line) as HarnessEvent);
      }
    }
  }

  emit<K extends EventKind>(kind: K, data: K extends keyof EventData ? EventData[K] : never, extra: { cell?: Cell | null; path?: string; turn?: string | null } = {}): HarnessEvent {
    const e: HarnessEvent = {
      id: randomUUID().slice(0, 12),
      t: Date.now(),
      session: this.session,
      turn: extra.turn === undefined ? this.turn : extra.turn,
      kind,
      ...(extra.cell ? { cell: extra.cell } : {}),
      ...(extra.path ? { path: extra.path } : {}),
      data: data as Record<string, unknown>,
    };
    this.events.push(e);
    appendFileSync(this.file, JSON.stringify(e) + '\n');
    for (const l of this.listeners) l(e);
    return e;
  }

  on(l: Listener) {
    this.listeners.add(l);
    return () => this.listeners.delete(l);
  }
}

8	/** One ELK input per expanded cell: its files, the edges inside it, and the ports where edges leave it. */
9	export function containerInputs(scene: Scene): ContainerInput[] {
10	  const { nodes, edges, ports } = scene.projection;
11	  const out = new Map<string, ContainerInput>();
12	  for (const n of nodes) if (n.kind === 'cell' && n.expanded) out.set(n.id, { id: n.id, children: [], edges: [], ports: [] });
13	  const parent = new Map<string, string>();
14	  for (const n of [...nodes].sort((a, b) => a.order - b.order)) {
15	    if (n.kind === 'file' && n.parent && out.has(n.parent)) { out.get(n.parent)!.children.push(n.id); parent.set(n.id, n.parent); }
16	  }
17	  const byEdge = new Map(edges.map((e) => [e.id, e]));
18	  for (const e of edges) {
19	    const c = parent.get(e.from);
20	    if (c && c === parent.get(e.to)) out.get(c)!.edges.push({ id: e.id, from: e.from, to: e.to });
21	  }
22	  for (const p of ports) {
23	    const e = byEdge.get(p.edge);
24	    const c = out.get(p.container);
25	    if (!e || !c) continue;
26	    c.ports.push({ ...p, node: p.direction === 'out' ? e.from : e.to });
27	  }
28	  return [...out.values()];
29	}

66	export function buildFrame(scene: Scene, layouts: ReadonlyMap<string, ContainerLayout>, key: string): Frame {

69	  const open = new Set(projection.nodes.filter((n) => n.kind === 'domain' && n.expanded).map((n) => n.domain!));
70	  const any = open.size > 0;

73	  const colW = grid.domains.map((d) => {

75	    let w = COL_W;

78	  });

245	export const union = (a: Box, b: Box): Box => {

251	function dedupe(pts: Pt[]): Pt[] {

253	  for (const p of pts) {

259	}

261	function midpoint(pts: Pt[]): Pt {
262	  let total = 0;
263	  for (let i = 1; i < pts.length; i++) total += Math.hypot(pts[i]!.x - pts[i - 1]!.x, pts[i]!.y - pts[i - 1]!.y);
264	  let half = total / 2;
265	  for (let i = 1; i < pts.length; i++) {
266	    const a = pts[i - 1]!;
267	    const b = pts[i]!;
268	    const d = Math.hypot(b.x - a.x, b.y - a.y);
269	    if (half <= d && d > 0) return { x: a.x + ((b.x - a.x) * half) / d, y: a.y + ((b.y - a.y) * half) / d };
270	    half -= d;
271	  }
272	  return pts[0]!;
273	}

275	export function roundedPath(pts: Pt[], r: number): string {
276	  const f = (n: number) => n.toFixed(1);
277	  let d = `M${f(pts[0]!.x)},${f(pts[0]!.y)}`;
278	  for (let i = 1; i < pts.length - 1; i++) {
279	    const p = pts[i - 1]!;
280	    const c = pts[i]!;
281	    const n = pts[i + 1]!;
282	    const d1 = Math.hypot(c.x - p.x, c.y - p.y);
283	    const d2 = Math.hypot(n.x - c.x, n.y - c.y);
284	    const rr = Math.min(r, d1 / 2, d2 / 2);
285	    if (rr < 0.5) { d += `L${f(c.x)},${f(c.y)}`; continue; }
286	    const ax = c.x - ((c.x - p.x) / d1) * rr;
287	    const ay = c.y - ((c.y - p.y) / d1) * rr;
288	    const bx = c.x + ((n.x - c.x) / d2) * rr;
289	    const by = c.y + ((n.y - c.y) / d2) * rr;
290	    d += `L${f(ax)},${f(ay)}Q${f(c.x)},${f(c.y)} ${f(bx)},${f(by)}`;
291	  }
292	  const last = pts[pts.length - 1]!;
293	  return `${d}L${f(last.x)},${f(last.y)}`;
294	}
295	// Per-container ELK layout: one layered run per expanded cell, in a worker, cached by the container's content.
296	import type { ElkExtendedEdge, ElkNode } from 'elkjs/lib/elk-api';

299	export type Pt = { x: number; y: number };
300	export type Box = { x: number; y: number; w: number; h: number };
301	
302	/** Fixed sizes per kind (layout never depends on zoom or content, so positions stay put). */
303	export const FILE_W = 220;
304	export const FILE_H = 42;
305	export const PAD = { top: 44, left: 18, right: 18, bottom: 18 };
306	
307	export type ContainerInput = {
308	  id: string;
309	  children: string[]; // sorted by model order
310	  edges: { id: string; from: string; to: string }[];
311	  ports: (Port & { node: string })[]; // node = the child the edge attaches to
312	};
313	
314	export type ContainerLayout = {
315	  id: string;
316	  w: number;
317	  h: number;
318	  nodes: Record<string, Box>; // relative to the container
319	  edges: Record<string, Pt[]>; // internal edges, relative
320	  ports: Record<string, { at: Pt; route: Pt[] }>; // by `${edge}|${container}`: border point + route from/to the child
321	  ms: number;

324	const ELK_SIDE = { top: 'NORTH', right: 'EAST', bottom: 'SOUTH', left: 'WEST' } as const;
325	/**
326	 * The side a port sits on is the renderer's call (it depends on the layout): toward the other column when it is to the
327	 * left or right; for the same column, out on the right and in on the left, so ELK keeps a left-to-right flow
328	 * (north/south ports in a rightward layered layout cost a layer each: Scout's External cell went from 244 to 1126 px).
329	 */
330	export function portSide(p: Pick<Port, 'side' | 'direction'>): Port['side'] {
331	  if (p.side === 'left' || p.side === 'right') return p.side;
332	  return p.direction === 'out' ? 'right' : 'left';
333	}
334	export const portKey = (edge: string, container: string) => `${edge}|${container}`;
335	
336	export function elkGraph(c: ContainerInput): ElkNode {
337	  const edges: ElkExtendedEdge[] = c.edges.map((e) => ({ id: e.id, sources: [e.from], targets: [e.to] }));
338	  const ports = c.ports.map((p, i) => {

452	    r.removed += x.removed;

474	export function fakeScene(ui: UIState, turn: TurnState | null, expanded: readonly string[]): Scene | null {

505	  const leaf = (path: string): Rollup => {

525	  const ruleOf = (f: string) => [...new Set([...ui.violations, ...newList].filter((v) => v.file === f).map((v) => v.invariant))];
526	  map.domains.forEach((d, di) => {
527	    const open = isOpen(d.id);
528	    const cellRollups: Rollup[] = [];
529	    const cellNodes: VisibleNode[] = [];
530	    const fileNodes: VisibleNode[] = [];
531	    map.layers.forEach((l, li) => {
532	      if (!(l.id in d.cells)) return;

579	  for (const v of turn?.gateBlocks ?? []) {

584	  const agg = new Map<string, VisibleEdge>();
585	  for (const l of leaves) {

587	    const to = visibleOf(l.to);
588	    if (!from || !to || from === to) continue;
589	    const a = fileCell.get(l.from)!;
590	    const b = fileCell.get(l.to)!;
591	    if (a.domain === b.domain && !isOpen(a.domain)) continue; // inside a collapsed domain: not drawn at System level
592	    const id = `${l.status}|${from}|${to}`;
593	    const e = agg.get(id) ?? { id, from, to, kinds: ['imports'], count: 0, status: l.status, violation: null, confidence: null, steps: [], leafEdges: [] };
594	    e.count++;
595	    e.violation = maxViolation(e.violation, l.violation);

597	    e.leafEdges.push(`imports|${l.from}|${l.to}`);

600	  const edges = [...agg.values()].sort((x, y) => x.id.localeCompare(y.id));

602	  // Ports: where an edge leaves (or enters) an expanded cell.
603	  const byId = new Map(nodes.map((n) => [n.id, n]));
604	  const ports: Port[] = [];
605	  for (const e of edges) {
606	    for (const [self, other, direction] of [[e.from, e.to, 'out'], [e.to, e.from, 'in']] as const) {

608	      const o = byId.get(other);

// Living map (NAVIGATION_PLAN §4), server side: git history, the cartographer runner, the drift → proposal loop,
// rejection records and inferred labels. The pure engine (scoring, drift, diffs, skeleton) is in @harness/core.
import { scanRepo, skeletonMap, mapToYaml, SKELETON_IGNORE, type DomainMap } from '@harness/core';
import { toFileFacts } from './history';

export { gitHistory, toFileFacts } from './history';
export { sdkProposer, buildPrompt, CANDIDATES_SCHEMA, type Proposer, type ProposeInput, type ProposerResult, type Candidate, type RejectedProposal } from './runner';

/** Instant onboarding proposal (no model, < 1 s): the deterministic skeleton map as domains.yaml text. */
export function onboardingSkeleton(root: string): string {
  const bare = { version: 1, layers: [{ id: 'x', name: 'x' }], ignore: SKELETON_IGNORE, domains: [], invariants: [] } as DomainMap;
  const facts = scanRepo(root, bare);
  return mapToYaml(skeletonMap(facts.files, toFileFacts(facts)), '# Instant skeleton (deterministic, no model). The cartographer refines it.\n\n');
}
// The living-map loop (NAVIGATION_PLAN §4.1, §4.3): at every turn end, measure drift deterministically; when a signal
// has persisted and no proposal is pending for its scope, run the cartographer out of band, score its candidates
// against the current map, and queue the best one as a proposal. Never runs while a turn is open; never blocks one.
import { writeFileSync } from 'node:fs';
import { Hono } from 'hono';
import {
  reduce, historyFromUI, detectDrift, thresholdsFor, scoreMap, diffMaps, changeSignature, summarizeChanges, describeScores,
  parseDomainMap, createMapper, PROPOSAL_MARGIN,
  type DomainMap, type DriftSignal, type DriftSignalKind, type FileFacts, type HistoryTurn, type MapProposal, type MapScore, type ProposalChange, type UIState,
} from '@harness/core';
import { commitPaths } from '../git';
import type { Bus } from '../bus';
import type { Repo } from '../repo';
import { gitHistory, toFileFacts } from './history';
import { sdkProposer, type Candidate, type Proposer } from './runner';
import { listRejected, listStanding, writeRejection } from './records';
import { labelsFor, sdkLabeler, type Labeler } from './labels';

/** Signals the cartographer acts on. Stale labels and bloated cells go to the labels job; reinforcement is the auditor's. */
const CARTOGRAPHER_SIGNALS = new Set<DriftSignalKind>(['unassigned', 'new_top_level', 'wide_turns', 'co_change', 'coupling_growth', 'rule_erosion']);

/** Candidates within this much of the best total count as "similar"; among them the least disruptive wins. */
export const SIMILAR = 0.05;

/**
 * How much a change set disturbs what already exists: moved files, removed ids, and edits to existing domains and
 * rules (rename, purpose rewrite, cell/domain removal, rule change/retire). Additions (new domain, new cell, placing
 * unassigned files, new rule) cost nothing: they extend the map rather than rewrite it.
 */
export function disruption(changes: readonly ProposalChange[]): number {
  const added = new Set(changes.flatMap((c) => (c.kind === 'add_domain' ? [c.domain] : [])));
  return changes.filter((c) => {
    if (c.kind === 'purpose') return !added.has(c.domain);
    return ['move', 'rename_domain', 'remove_domain', 'remove_cell', 'retire_rule', 'change_rule'].includes(c.kind);
  }).length;
}

export type LivingMapOptions = {
  bus: Bus;
  repo: Repo;
  proposer?: Proposer | null; // default: the Agent SDK cartographer (null when HARNESS_CARTOGRAPHER=0)
  labeler?: Labeler | null; // default: the Agent SDK labeler (null when HARNESS_LABELS=0)
  k?: number; // candidates per run (default 4, or HARNESS_CARTOGRAPHER_K)
  gitLimit?: number;
};

export type Result = { ok: true; decision?: string } | { ok: false; status: 400 | 404 | 409; error: string };

type Scored = { candidate: Candidate; map: DomainMap; changes: ReturnType<typeof diffMaps>; score: MapScore };

/** Pick the proposal: lowest total; among totals within SIMILAR of it, the least disruptive (then lowest total, then first). Null unless it beats current by the margin. */
export function chooseCandidate(current: MapScore, scored: readonly Pick<Scored, 'changes' | 'score'>[]): number | null {
  if (!scored.length) return null;
  const best = Math.min(...scored.map((s) => s.score.total));
  if (current.total - best < PROPOSAL_MARGIN) return null;
  let pick = -1;
  scored.forEach((s, i) => {
    if (s.score.total > best + SIMILAR) return;
    const p = scored[pick];
    const [a, b] = [disruption(s.changes), p ? disruption(p.changes) : Infinity];
    if (a < b || (a === b && s.score.total < p!.score.total)) pick = i;
  });
  return pick;
}

export function attachLivingMap(opts: LivingMapOptions) {
  const { bus, repo } = opts;
  const proposer = opts.proposer === undefined ? (process.env.HARNESS_CARTOGRAPHER === '0' ? null : sdkProposer) : opts.proposer;
  const labeler = opts.labeler === undefined ? (process.env.HARNESS_LABELS === '0' ? null : sdkLabeler) : opts.labeler;
  const k = opts.k ?? Number(process.env.HARNESS_CARTOGRAPHER_K ?? 4);
  let previous: DriftSignal[] | null = null;
  let queued = false;
  let cartographing = false;
  let labelling = false;
  const work = new Set<Promise<unknown>>();
  const track = <T>(p: Promise<T>) => { work.add(p); const off = () => { work.delete(p); }; p.then(off, off); return p; };

  const ready = () => !!repo.map && repo.hasMap();
  const facts = (): Record<string, FileFacts> => toFileFacts(repo.facts);
  const history = (ui: UIState): HistoryTurn[] => [...gitHistory(repo.root, opts.gitLimit), ...historyFromUI(ui)];

  /** Ids plus the domains they live in (files and cells), so scopes can be compared at domain granularity. */
  const expand = (ids: readonly string[]) => {
    const out = new Set(ids);
    for (const id of ids) {
      const cell = /^cell:([^/]+)\//.exec(id);
      if (cell) out.add(`domain:${cell[1]}`);
      else if (!id.includes(':')) { const d = repo.mapper.domainOf(id); if (d) out.add(`domain:${d}`); }
    }
    return out;
  };

  /** Measure drift now (or queue until the open turn ends), then start the cartographer / labels jobs if warranted. */
  function survey(): void {
    if (!ready()) return;
    if (bus.turn) { queued = true; return; }
    queued = false;
    const ui = reduce(bus.events);
    previous ??= ui.drift;
    const f = facts();
    const hist = history(ui);
    const t = thresholdsFor(repo.map);
    const signals = detectDrift(repo.map, f, ui, hist, t, previous);
    previous = signals;
    bus.emit('drift_detected', { signals }, { turn: null });

    const pending = Object.values(ui.proposals).filter((p) => p.status === 'pending').map((p) => expand(p.proposal.scope));
    const triggers = signals.filter((s) => CARTOGRAPHER_SIGNALS.has(s.signal) && s.persisted >= t.persist && !pending.some((ps) => [...expand(s.scope)].some((id) => ps.has(id))));
    if (triggers.length && proposer && !cartographing) {
      cartographing = true;
      track(cartograph(triggers, ui, f, hist)
        .catch((e: Error) => { bus.emit('error', { message: `Cartographer run failed: ${e.message}` }, { turn: null }); })
        .finally(() => { cartographing = false; }));
    }

    const stale = signals.find((s) => s.signal === 'stale_label')?.scope.flatMap((target) => {
      const pl = repo.place(target);
      return pl.kind === 'cell' && ui.labels[`group:${target}`] ? [`cell:${pl.domain}/${pl.layer}`] : [];
    }) ?? [];
    const cells = [...signals.filter((s) => s.signal === 'bloated_cell' && s.persisted >= t.persist).flatMap((s) => s.scope), ...stale];
    if (cells.length && labeler && !labelling) {
      labelling = true;
      track(label(cells).finally(() => { labelling = false; }));
    }
  }

  async function cartograph(triggers: DriftSignal[], ui: UIState, f: Record<string, FileFacts>, hist: HistoryTurn[]) {
    const t0 = Date.now();
    const base = repo.map, baseYaml = repo.mapText;
    const trigger = [...new Set(triggers.map((s) => s.signal))].join(',');
    const done = (ok: boolean, cost: number | null) => bus.emit('maintenance_run', { agent: 'cartographer', trigger, ms: Date.now() - t0, cost, ok }, { turn: null });

    // Scope: trigger scopes, their domains, and one hop along import edges.
    const scope = expand(triggers.flatMap((s) => s.scope));
    const mapper = createMapper(base);
    const hop = new Set<string>();
    for (const file of Object.values(f)) for (const imp of file.imports) {
      const a = mapper.domainOf(file.path), b = mapper.domainOf(imp.to);
      if (a && b && a !== b && (scope.has(`domain:${a}`) || scope.has(file.path))) hop.add(`domain:${b}`);
      if (a && b && a !== b && (scope.has(`domain:${b}`) || scope.has(imp.to))) hop.add(`domain:${a}`);
      if (!a && b && scope.has(file.path)) hop.add(`domain:${b}`); // unassigned file importing a domain
    }
    const fullScope = [...new Set([...scope, ...hop])].sort();
    const standing = listStanding(repo.root);
    const rejected = listRejected(repo.root);

    let result;
    try {
      result = await proposer!({
        root: repo.root, yaml: baseYaml, map: base, facts: f, signals: triggers, scope: fullScope, history: hist,
        turns: ui.turns.map((x) => ({ id: x.id, prompt: x.prompt, files: Object.keys(x.paths).filter((p) => x.paths[p]!.edits > 0).sort() })).filter((x) => x.files.length),
        decisions: standing, rejected, k,
      });
    } catch (e) {
      bus.emit('error', { message: `Cartographer failed: ${(e as Error).message}` }, { turn: null });
      return void done(false, (e as { cost?: number }).cost ?? null);
    }
    if (repo.mapText !== baseYaml) return void done(false, result.cost); // the map changed while it ran: stale

    const files = Object.keys(f);
    const seen = new Set(rejected.map((r) => r.signature));
    const scored: Scored[] = [];
    const decisionPaths = Object.fromEntries(standing.filter((d) => d.paths.length).map((d) => [d.id, d.paths]));
    for (const candidate of result.candidates.slice(0, k)) {
      let map: DomainMap;
      try { map = parseDomainMap(candidate.yaml); } catch { continue; } // invalid YAML or schema: dropped
      const changes = diffMaps(base, map, files);
      const sig = changeSignature(changes);
      if (!changes.length || seen.has(sig)) continue; // no-op, a repeat of a rejected proposal, or a duplicate
      seen.add(sig);
      scored.push({ candidate, map, changes, score: scoreMap(map, f, hist, { current: base, decisionPaths }) });
    }
    const current = scoreMap(base, f, hist, { current: base, decisionPaths });
    const chosen = chooseCandidate(current, scored);
    if (chosen === null) return void done(true, result.cost);

    const best = scored[chosen]!;
    const n = Math.max(0, ...Object.keys(reduce(bus.events).proposals).map((id) => Number(/^MP-(\d+)$/.exec(id)?.[1] ?? 0))) + 1;
    const touched = best.changes.flatMap((c): string[] => (c.kind === 'move' ? [`domain:${c.from.domain}`, `domain:${c.to.domain}`] : 'domain' in c ? [`domain:${c.domain}`] : []));
    const proposal: MapProposal = {
      id: `MP-${n}`,
      trigger: triggers,
      scope: [...new Set([...scope, ...touched])].sort(),
      candidates: scored.map((s) => ({ yaml: s.candidate.yaml, score: s.score })),
      chosen,
      current,
      changes: best.changes,
      rationale: `${best.candidate.title} ${best.candidate.rationale}`.trim(),
    };
    bus.emit('map_proposed', { map: base, yaml: baseYaml, proposal }, { turn: null });
    bus.emit('chat', { role: 'system', text: `Cartographer proposal ${proposal.id}: ${summarizeChanges(best.changes)} · ${describeScores(current, best.score)}` }, { turn: null });
    done(true, result.cost);
  }

  async function label(cells: string[]) {
    const t0 = Date.now();
    try {
      const r = await labelsFor({ root: repo.root, map: repo.map, facts: facts(), cells, labeler: labeler! });
      if (r.labels.length) bus.emit('labels_updated', { labels: r.labels }, { turn: null });
      if (r.calls) bus.emit('maintenance_run', { agent: 'cartographer', trigger: 'labels', ms: Date.now() - t0, cost: r.cost, ok: true }, { turn: null });
    } catch (e) {
      bus.emit('maintenance_run', { agent: 'cartographer', trigger: 'labels', ms: Date.now() - t0, cost: null, ok: false }, { turn: null });
      bus.emit('error', { message: `Labels failed: ${(e as Error).message}` }, { turn: null });
    }
  }

  const pendingProposal = (id: string): { proposal: MapProposal; yaml: string } | Result => {
    const p = reduce(bus.events).proposals[id];
    if (!p) return { ok: false, status: 404, error: `No proposal ${id}.` };
    if (p.status !== 'pending') return { ok: false, status: 409, error: `${id} is already ${p.status}.` };
    const at = bus.events.findLast((e) => e.kind === 'map_proposed' && (e.data as { proposal?: MapProposal }).proposal?.id === id);
    return { proposal: p.proposal, yaml: (at?.data as { yaml: string }).yaml };
  };

  /** Accept: write and commit domains.yaml (only it), reload the map, rescan, emit map_confirmed + resolved. */
  function accept(id: string, candidate?: number): Result {
    const p = pendingProposal(id);
    if ('ok' in p) return p;
    if (p.yaml !== repo.mapText) return { ok: false, status: 409, error: `domains.yaml changed since ${id} was proposed; run a survey for a fresh proposal.` };
    const idx = candidate ?? p.proposal.chosen;
    const yaml = p.proposal.candidates[idx]?.yaml;
    if (!yaml) return { ok: false, status: 400, error: `${id} has no candidate ${idx}.` };
    writeFileSync(repo.mapPath, yaml);
    try { commitPaths(repo.root, ['domains.yaml'], `docs(map): accept ${id}: ${summarizeChanges(diffMaps(repo.map, parseDomainMap(yaml), Object.keys(facts())))}`.slice(0, 100)); }
    catch (e) { bus.emit('error', { message: `Could not commit domains.yaml: ${(e as Error).message}` }, { turn: null }); }
    repo.setMap(yaml);
    bus.emit('map_confirmed', { map: repo.map, source: 'cartographer' }, { turn: null });
    repo.scan();
    bus.emit('map_proposal_resolved', { proposal: id, outcome: 'accepted' }, { turn: null });
    schedule();
    return { ok: true };
  }

  /** Reject: record decisions/DR-n.md (status: rejected) and commit only it; the cartographer is told never to repeat it. */
  function reject(id: string, reason?: string): Result {
    const p = pendingProposal(id);
    if ('ok' in p) return p;
    const { id: decision, path } = writeRejection(repo.root, repo.map, p.proposal, reason);
    try { commitPaths(repo.root, [path], `docs(decisions): ${decision} reject map proposal ${id}`); }
    catch (e) { bus.emit('error', { message: `Could not commit ${path}: ${(e as Error).message}` }, { turn: null }); }
    bus.emit('map_proposal_resolved', { proposal: id, outcome: 'rejected', decision }, { turn: null });
    return { ok: true, decision };
  }

  /** Survey on the next tick (after the emitter has finished closing the turn). */
  function schedule() {
    track(new Promise<void>((resolve) => setImmediate(() => {
      try { survey(); }
      catch (e) { bus.emit('error', { message: `Living map survey failed: ${(e as Error).message}` }, { turn: null }); }
      finally { resolve(); }
    })));
  }

  const off = bus.on((e) => {
    if (e.kind === 'turn_ended') schedule();
  });

  return {
    /** Survey now, or (while a turn is open) at its end. */
    survey() { schedule(); return { queued: !!bus.turn }; },
    accept,
    reject,
    get queued() { return queued; },
    /** Resolves once no survey, cartographer or labels job is in flight (for tests and shutdown). */
    async idle() { while (work.size) await Promise.allSettled([...work]); },
    detach: off,
  };
}

export type LivingMap = ReturnType<typeof attachLivingMap>;

/** HTTP endpoints, mounted under /api by the server. */
export function livingMapRoutes(lm: LivingMap) {
  const r = new Hono();
  const reply = (c: { json: (b: unknown, s?: 200 | 400 | 404 | 409) => Response }, res: Result) => (res.ok ? c.json(res) : c.json({ error: res.error }, res.status));
  r.post('/proposals/:id/accept', async (c) => {
    const body = await c.req.json<{ candidate?: number }>().catch(() => ({} as { candidate?: number }));
    return reply(c, lm.accept(c.req.param('id'), body.candidate));
  });
  r.post('/proposals/:id/reject', async (c) => {
    const body = await c.req.json<{ reason?: string }>().catch(() => ({} as { reason?: string }));
    return reply(c, lm.reject(c.req.param('id'), body.reason));
  });
  r.post('/living-map/survey', (c) => c.json({ ok: true, ...lm.survey() }));
  return r;
}
// The cartographer agent (NAVIGATION_PLAN §4.5): a separate, read-only Agent SDK session that proposes K candidate
// domains.yaml maps for a set of drift signals. It never edits anything and never blocks the coding session; the
// loop scores its candidates deterministically. The model call is behind `Proposer` so tests inject a fake.
import { query } from '@anthropic-ai/claude-agent-sdk';
import { createMapper, type DomainMap, type DriftSignal, type FileFacts, type HistoryTurn, type ProposalChange } from '@harness/core';

export type RejectedProposal = { decision: string; proposal: string; summary: string; changes: ProposalChange[]; signature: string };
export type StandingDecision = { id: string; title: string; outcome: string; rationale: string; invariant: string; paths: string[] };

export type ProposeInput = {
  root: string;
  yaml: string; // current domains.yaml text
  map: DomainMap;
  facts: Readonly<Record<string, FileFacts>>;
  signals: DriftSignal[]; // the persisted signals that triggered this run
  scope: string[]; // node ids: trigger scopes plus the affected domains and one hop
  history: readonly HistoryTurn[];
  turns: { id: string; prompt: string; files: string[] }[]; // recent Harness turns
  decisions: StandingDecision[];
  rejected: RejectedProposal[]; // never propose these again
  k: number;
};
export type Candidate = { title: string; rationale: string; yaml: string };
export type ProposerResult = { candidates: Candidate[]; cost: number | null };
export type Proposer = (input: ProposeInput) => Promise<ProposerResult>;

export const CANDIDATES_SCHEMA = {
  type: 'object',
  additionalProperties: false,
  required: ['candidates'],
  properties: {
    candidates: {
      type: 'array',
      items: {
        type: 'object',
        additionalProperties: false,
        required: ['title', 'rationale', 'yaml'],
        properties: {
          title: { type: 'string', description: 'One line, e.g. "Add a Billing domain for src/billing/".' },
          rationale: { type: 'string', description: 'Two or three sentences: what changes and why it fixes the signals.' },
          yaml: { type: 'string', description: 'The COMPLETE domains.yaml text for this candidate (not a diff).' },
        },
      },
    },
  },
} as const;

/** Co-changed file pairs across the history (top 10), for the prompt. */
function coChange(history: readonly HistoryTurn[], known: Set<string>): string[] {
  const pairs = new Map<string, number>();
  for (const u of history.slice(-50)) {
    const fs = u.files.filter((f) => known.has(f)).sort();
    if (fs.length > 12) continue;
    for (let i = 0; i < fs.length; i++) for (let j = i + 1; j < fs.length; j++) pairs.set(`${fs[i]} + ${fs[j]}`, (pairs.get(`${fs[i]} + ${fs[j]}`) ?? 0) + 1);
  }
  return [...pairs].filter(([, n]) => n > 1).sort(([a, x], [b, y]) => y - x || a.localeCompare(b)).slice(0, 10).map(([k, n]) => `${k} (${n}×)`);
}

/** The cartographer's prompt: rules, signals, scoped facts, recent turns, decisions, rejected proposals, current map. */
export function buildPrompt(input: ProposeInput): string {
  const mapper = createMapper(input.map);
  const scopeDomains = new Set(input.scope.filter((s) => s.startsWith('domain:')).map((s) => s.slice(7)));
  const scopeIds = new Set(input.scope);
  const inScope = (p: string) => {
    const pl = mapper.place(p);
    return scopeIds.has(p) || pl.kind === 'unassigned' || ((pl.kind === 'cell' || pl.kind === 'test') && scopeDomains.has(pl.domain));
  };
  const files = Object.values(input.facts).filter((f) => inScope(f.path)).sort((a, b) => a.path.localeCompare(b.path));
  const where = (p: string) => { const pl = mapper.place(p); return pl.kind === 'cell' ? `${pl.domain}/${pl.layer}` : pl.kind === 'test' ? `${pl.domain} tests` : pl.kind; };
  const together = coChange(input.history, new Set(Object.keys(input.facts)));
  const counts = new Map<string, number>();
  for (const p of Object.keys(input.facts)) counts.set(where(p), (counts.get(where(p)) ?? 0) + 1);

  return [
    'You are the cartographer for this repo\'s architecture map, `domains.yaml` (domains are columns, layers are rows; files are placed by path globs).',
    `Deterministic drift signals have fired. Propose up to ${input.k} DIFFERENT candidate maps that would fix them. Each candidate is the complete new domains.yaml.`,
    'Your candidates are scored by code, not by you: cells lit per past turn/commit (fewer is better), import-graph modularity by domain, unassigned files, evenness of cell sizes, decisions broken, and churn (files moved, ids removed).',
    '',
    '## Rules',
    '- Change as little as possible. Start from the current domains.yaml text and keep everything you do not need to change (comments, ids, order, invariants, exceptions, decisions, cartography settings).',
    '- A rename keeps the `id`; change only `name`. Prefer placing or moving files over re-cutting domains. Never remove an invariant that lists `decisions` or exceptions with a `decision`.',
    '- New domains: lowercase id, product-language name (1–3 words), a one-line purpose. When a folder sits in one cell, use a folder glob (e.g. `src/billing/**`) so later files land there.',
    '- A table belongs to exactly one cell\'s `tables` (the domain that writes it). Every `owns_writes` owner, `only_via.allowed_from` and `no_edge` endpoint must name an existing domain id. Layers must exist in `layers`.',
    '- Make the candidates genuinely different from each other (e.g. a new domain vs. placing the files in an existing domain vs. a different split).',
    '- NEVER propose a change the user already rejected (listed below), nor one with the same effect.',
    '- You may Read/Grep/Glob files to understand purposes. Do not modify anything.',
    '',
    '## Signals',
    ...input.signals.map((s) => `- ${s.signal}: ${s.metric} = ${s.value} (threshold ${s.threshold}, held ${s.persisted} turns) · scope: ${s.scope.join(', ')}`),
    '',
    `## Scope (affected domains plus one hop): ${input.scope.join(', ')}`,
    '',
    '## Files in scope (placement · imports · table writes)',
    ...files.map((f) => {
      const imports = f.imports.map((i) => i.to).filter((t) => !t.startsWith('vendor:'));
      return `- ${f.path} [${where(f.path)}]${imports.length ? ` → ${imports.join(', ')}` : ''}${f.writes.length ? ` · writes ${[...new Set(f.writes.map((w) => w.table))].join(', ')}` : ''}`;
    }),
    '',
    '## File counts per placement (whole repo)',
    ...[...counts].sort(([a], [b]) => a.localeCompare(b)).map(([k, n]) => `- ${k}: ${n}`),
    '',
    '## Recent turns (prompt → files edited)',
    ...(input.turns.length ? input.turns.slice(-10).map((t) => `- ${t.id}: "${t.prompt.slice(0, 160)}" → ${t.files.join(', ')}`) : ['(none)']),
    '',
    '## Files that often change together',
    ...(together.length ? together.map((x) => `- ${x}`) : ['(none)']),
    '',
    '## Standing decisions (do not break them)',
    ...(input.decisions.length ? input.decisions.map((d) => `- ${d.id}${d.invariant ? ` (on ${d.invariant})` : ''}: ${d.title}. Outcome: ${d.outcome}. Governs: ${d.paths.join(', ') || '-'}`) : ['(none)']),
    '',
    '## Proposals the user REJECTED (never propose these again)',
    ...(input.rejected.length ? input.rejected.map((r) => `- ${r.proposal} (${r.decision}): ${r.summary}\n  changes: ${JSON.stringify(r.changes)}`) : ['(none)']),
    '',
    '## Current domains.yaml',
    '```yaml',
    input.yaml.trimEnd(),
    '```',
  ].join('\n');
}

/**
 * The real proposer: a read-only Agent SDK query on the strongest model at high effort, with structured output.
 * Model: `HARNESS_CARTOGRAPHER_MODEL` (default `claude-opus-5-5`).
 */
export const sdkProposer: Proposer = async (input) => {
  const q = query({
    prompt: buildPrompt(input),
    options: {
      cwd: input.root,
      model: process.env.HARNESS_CARTOGRAPHER_MODEL ?? 'claude-opus-5-5',
      effort: 'high',
      tools: ['Read', 'Grep', 'Glob'],
      allowedTools: ['Read', 'Grep', 'Glob'],
      permissionMode: 'dontAsk',
      settingSources: [],
      strictMcpConfig: true,
      outputFormat: { type: 'json_schema', schema: CANDIDATES_SCHEMA as unknown as Record<string, unknown> },
      maxTurns: 30,
    },
  });
  for await (const m of q) {
    if (m.type !== 'result') continue;
    if (m.subtype !== 'success' || !m.structured_output) throw Object.assign(new Error(`cartographer ${m.subtype}`), { cost: m.total_cost_usd });
    const out = m.structured_output as { candidates?: Candidate[] };
    return { candidates: (out.candidates ?? []).slice(0, input.k), cost: m.total_cost_usd };
  }
  throw new Error('cartographer returned no result');
};

import fs from "node:fs";
import module from "node:module";
import path from "node:path";
import { fileURLToPath } from "node:url";

// NOTE: Keep VS Code extension's resolveTsdkPathToExe in sync with this function.
export default function getExePath() {
    const __dirname = path.dirname(fileURLToPath(import.meta.url));
    const normalizedDirname = __dirname.replace(/\\/g, "/");

    const pkg = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(path.join(__dirname, "..", "package.json"), "utf8"));
    const pkgName = pkg.name;
    const baseName = pkgName.startsWith("@") ? pkgName.split("/")[1] : pkgName;
    const expectedBinName = baseName === "typescript" ? "tsc" : "tsgo";
    const binNames = pkg.bin && typeof pkg.bin === "object" ? Object.keys(pkg.bin) : [];
    if (binNames.length !== 1 || binNames[0] !== expectedBinName) {
        throw new Error(`Expected ${pkgName} to declare exactly one bin entry named ${expectedBinName}.`);
    }
    let binName = expectedBinName;
    let exeDir;

    const expectedPackage = baseName + "-" + process.platform + "-" + process.arch;

    if (normalizedDirname.endsWith("/_packages/" + baseName + "/lib")) {
        // We're running directly from source in the repo.
        // The local repo build (`hereby build`) always produces `tsgo`, regardless
        // of the published `bin` name, so don't use binName here.
        exeDir = path.resolve(__dirname, "..", "..", "..", "built", "local");
        binName = "tsgo";
    }
    else if (normalizedDirname.endsWith("/built/npm/" + baseName + "/lib")) {
        // We're running from the built output.
        exeDir = path.resolve(__dirname, "..", "..", expectedPackage, "lib");
    }
    else {
        // We're actually running from an installed package.
        const platformPackageName = "@typescript/" + expectedPackage;
        try {
            if (typeof import.meta.resolve === "undefined") {
                // v16.20.1
                const require = module.createRequire(import.meta.url);
                const packageJson = require.resolve(platformPackageName + "/package.json");
                exeDir = path.join(path.dirname(packageJson), "lib");
            }
            else {
                // v20.6.0, v18.19.0
                const packageJson = import.meta.resolve(platformPackageName + "/package.json");
                const packageJsonPath = fileURLToPath(packageJson);
                exeDir = path.join(path.dirname(packageJsonPath), "lib");
            }
        }
        catch (e) {
            throw new Error("Unable to resolve " + platformPackageName + ". Either your platform is unsupported, or you are missing the package on disk.");
        }
    }

    let exe = path.join(exeDir, binName);
    if (process.platform === "win32") {
        exe += ".exe";
        if (exe.length >= 248) {
            exe = "\\\\?\\" + exe;
        }
    }

    if (!fs.existsSync(exe)) {
        throw new Error("Executable not found: " + exe);
    }

    return exe;
}

// The v2 chrome used for the D1 comps (`&comp=1`): turn rail, breadcrumbs, ledger, legend around the v2 map.
// Everything shown is derived from the event log (useView) plus v2 view state; counts only, never minutes.
import { domainId } from '@harness/core/view';
import { useView } from '../derive';
import { useStore } from '../store';
import MapV2 from './MapV2';
import { useV2 } from './store';

export default function CompShell() {
  const theme = useV2((s) => s.theme);
  return (
    <div className={`v2-shell theme-${theme}`} data-theme={theme}>
      <TurnRail />
      <header className="v2-top">
        <Breadcrumbs />
        <Ledger />
      </header>
      <main className="v2-stage">
        <MapV2 insets={{ top: theme === 'strata' ? 96 : 66, right: 36, bottom: 30, left: 96 }} />
      </main>
    </div>
  );
}

function Breadcrumbs() {
  const v = useView();
  const expanded = useV2((s) => s.expanded);
  const setExpanded = useV2((s) => s.setExpanded);
  const cursor = useV2((s) => s.cursor);
  const map = v.ui.map;
  const last = expanded.at(-1);
  const dom = last && map?.domains.find((d) => domainId(d.id) === last);
  const cell = dom && v.ui.cursor?.cell?.domain === dom.id ? map?.layers.find((l) => l.id === v.ui.cursor?.cell?.layer) : null;
  const crumbs: { label: string; onClick?: () => void; current?: boolean }[] = [{ label: 'System', onClick: () => setExpanded([]) }];
  if (dom) crumbs.push({ label: dom.name, onClick: () => setExpanded([last!]) });
  if (cell) crumbs.push({ label: cell.name });
  if (cursor && dom && cursor.node === cursor.path) crumbs.push({ label: cursor.path.split('/').pop()! });
  crumbs[crumbs.length - 1]!.current = true;
  return (
    <nav className="v2-crumbs" aria-label="Where you are">
      <ol>
        {crumbs.map((c, i) => (
          <li key={i}>
            {c.onClick && !c.current ? <button type="button" onClick={c.onClick}>{c.label}</button> : <span aria-current={c.current ? 'location' : undefined}>{c.label}</span>}
          </li>
        ))}
      </ol>
    </nav>
  );
}

function Ledger() {
  const v = useView();
  const s = v.ledger.session;
  const items = [
    { label: 'Lines changed', value: s.linesChanged },
    { label: 'Cells to review', value: s.cellsToReview },
    { label: 'Forks caught before code', value: s.forksCaughtBeforeCode },
    { label: 'Rejected options blocked', value: s.rejectedOptionsBlocked },
  ];
  return (
    <dl className="v2-ledger" aria-label="Session ledger">
      {items.map((it) => (

function TurnRail() {
  const v = useView();

  const turn = v.turn;

  const editedFiles = new Set(Object.values(turn?.edited ?? {}).flatMap((e) => e.files));
  const cursorPath = v.ui.cursor?.path;
  const unplanned = turn && Object.keys(turn.planned).length
    ? Object.entries(turn.edited).filter(([k]) => !turn.planned[k]).flatMap(([, e]) => e.files)
    : [];
  return (
    <aside className="v2-rail">
      <div className="v2-brand">

              const here = !done && !!cursorPath && st.files.includes(cursorPath);
              return (
                <li key={st.n} className={done ? 'is-done' : here ? 'is-here' : 'is-todo'}>

                </li>

      )}

}

import { api, fakeMode } from '../connection';

export function ChatPane() {

  return (

      <div className="chat-head">
        <span className="chat-title">Claude Code</span>
        <span className={`chat-state ${busy ? 'is-busy' : ''}`}>
          {replaying ? 'Replaying' : conn === 'down' ? 'Offline' : busy ? 'Working' : 'Ready'}
        </span>
      </div>

      <div className="chat-log" ref={scroller}>
        {empty && (
          <div className="chat-empty">

        {v.ui.errors.map((e, i) => (

      {v.ui.awaitingApproval && !v.ui.pendingFork && <ApprovalCard plan={v.ui.awaitingApproval.plan} disabled={replaying} />}
      <Composer disabled={replaying || conn === 'down'} busy={busy && v.live} why={replaying ? 'Replaying. Go live to send.' : 'Waiting for the server.'} />
    </aside>
  );
}

function ForkCard() {

function ApprovalCard({ plan, disabled }: { plan: string; disabled: boolean }) {

    <section className="card card-approve" aria-label="Plan waiting for approval">
      <p className="card-kicker">Plan ready</p>
      {plan.trim() && (
        <div className="card-plan">
          <Markdown text={plan} />
        </div>
      )}
      <div className="card-actions">
        <button className="btn btn-primary" disabled={disabled} onClick={() => void api.approve()}>Approve plan</button>
        <span className="card-hint">or reply with changes</span>
      </div>
    </section>

function Composer({ disabled, busy, why }: { disabled: boolean; busy: boolean; why: string }) {
  const draft = useStore((s) => s.draft);
  const focusTick = useStore((s) => s.focusTick);
  const setDraft = useStore((s) => s.setDraft);
  const ta = useRef<HTMLTextAreaElement>(null);

  useEffect(() => {
    const el = ta.current;
    if (!el || !focusTick) return;
    el.focus();
    el.setSelectionRange(el.value.length, el.value.length);
  }, [focusTick]);

  useLayoutEffect(() => {
    const el = ta.current;
    if (!el) return;
    el.style.height = 'auto';
    el.style.height = `${Math.min(160, el.scrollHeight)}px`;
  }, [draft]);

  const send = () => {
    const t = draft.trim();
    if (!t || disabled) return;
    void api.chat(t);
    setDraft('');
  };

  return (
    <div className="composer">
      <textarea
        ref={ta}
        rows={1}
        value={draft}
        disabled={disabled}
        placeholder={disabled ? why : fakeMode ? 'Fake log loaded; sending is off.' : 'Message Claude'}
        onChange={(e) => setDraft(e.target.value)}
        onKeyDown={(e) => {
          if (e.key === 'Enter' && !e.shiftKey && !e.nativeEvent.isComposing) {
            e.preventDefault();
            send();
          }
        }}
      />
      {busy ? (
        <button className="btn btn-stop" onClick={() => void api.interrupt()}>Stop</button>
      ) : (
        <button className="btn btn-primary" disabled={disabled || !draft.trim()} onClick={send}>Send</button>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

// Rejected proposals are decisions (NAVIGATION_PLAN §4.5): decisions/DR-n.md with `status: rejected`, so the
// cartographer never proposes the same change again. Same file format and id sequence as fork decisions.
import { mkdirSync, writeFileSync } from 'node:fs';
import { join } from 'node:path';
import { stringify as stringifyYaml } from 'yaml';
import { nextDecisionId, summarizeChanges, changeSignature, describeScores, type MapProposal, type ProposalChange } from '@harness/core';
import { listDecisions } from '../decisions';
import type { RejectedProposal, StandingDecision } from './runner';

/** Paths a proposal touches (placed or moved files), for the decision's anchors. */
function touchedPaths(changes: readonly ProposalChange[]): string[] {
  return [...new Set(changes.flatMap((c) => (c.kind === 'place' || c.kind === 'move' ? [c.path] : [])))].sort();
}

/** Write decisions/DR-n.md recording the rejection; returns its id and repo-relative path. Does not commit. */
export function writeRejection(root: string, map: Parameters<typeof nextDecisionId>[0], proposal: MapProposal, reason?: string): { id: string; path: string } {
  const id = nextDecisionId(map, listDecisions(root).map((d) => d.id));
  const summary = summarizeChanges(proposal.changes);
  const chosen = proposal.candidates[proposal.chosen];
  const fm = {
    id,
    title: `Keep the map as it is: rejected ${proposal.id} (${summary})`,
    outcome: 'Keep the current map',
    status: 'rejected',
    type: 'map_proposal',
    invariant: '',
    proposal: proposal.id,
    anchors: { paths: touchedPaths(proposal.changes) },
    rejected: `${proposal.id}: ${summary}`,
    signature: changeSignature(proposal.changes),
    changes: proposal.changes,
  };
  const body = [
    `The user rejected cartographer proposal ${proposal.id}.${reason?.trim() ? ` In their words: "${reason.trim()}"` : ''}`,
    '',
    `Triggered by: ${proposal.trigger.map((s) => `${s.signal} (${s.metric} = ${s.value})`).join('; ')}`,
    '',
    `Proposal: ${proposal.rationale}`,
    chosen ? `\nScores: ${describeScores(proposal.current, chosen.score)}` : '',
  ].join('\n');
  mkdirSync(join(root, 'decisions'), { recursive: true });
  const path = `decisions/${id}.md`;
  writeFileSync(join(root, path), `---\n${stringifyYaml(fm).trim()}\n---\n\n${body.trim()}\n`);
  return { id, path };
}

type Front = { id: string; status?: string; type?: string; proposal?: string; rejected?: string; changes?: ProposalChange[]; signature?: string; invariant?: string; anchors?: { paths?: string[] }; title: string; outcome: string; rationale: string };

/** Every rejected map proposal on record. */
export function listRejected(root: string): RejectedProposal[] {
  return (listDecisions(root) as unknown as Front[])
    .filter((d) => d.status === 'rejected' && d.type === 'map_proposal')
    .map((d) => ({ decision: d.id, proposal: d.proposal ?? '', summary: d.rejected ?? d.title, changes: d.changes ?? [], signature: d.signature ?? changeSignature(d.changes ?? []) }));
}

/** Standing (made) decisions with their anchored paths. */
export function listStanding(root: string): StandingDecision[] {
  return (listDecisions(root) as unknown as Front[])
    .filter((d) => d.status !== 'rejected')
    .map((d) => ({ id: d.id, title: d.title, outcome: d.outcome, rationale: d.rationale, invariant: d.invariant ?? '', paths: d.anchors?.paths ?? [] }));
}
// Inferred sub-group labels for bloated cells (NAVIGATION_PLAN §4.5): applied automatically, marked inferred,
// cached under .harness/labels/<hash>.json keyed by the cell's file set, regenerated only when that set changes.
import { existsSync, mkdirSync, readFileSync, writeFileSync } from 'node:fs';
import { join } from 'node:path';
import { query } from '@anthropic-ai/claude-agent-sdk';
import { cellFiles, createMapper, groupHash, type DomainMap, type FileFacts, type Label } from '@harness/core';

export type Group = { name: string; files: string[] };
export type LabelerInput = { root: string; cell: string; files: string[]; facts: Readonly<Record<string, FileFacts>> };
export type Labeler = (input: LabelerInput) => Promise<{ groups: Group[]; cost: number | null }>;

const GROUPS_SCHEMA = {
  type: 'object', additionalProperties: false, required: ['groups'],
  properties: {
    groups: {
      type: 'array',
      items: { type: 'object', additionalProperties: false, required: ['name', 'files'], properties: { name: { type: 'string' }, files: { type: 'array', items: { type: 'string' } } } },
    },
  },
} as const;

/** Real labeler: a small, tool-less structured query. Model: `HARNESS_LABELER_MODEL` (default `claude-haiku-5-5`). */
export const sdkLabeler: Labeler = async ({ root, cell, files, facts }) => {
  const lines = files.map((f) => `- ${f}${facts[f]?.symbols.length ? `: ${facts[f]!.symbols.map((s) => s.name).join(', ')}` : ''}${facts[f]?.imports.length ? ` (imports ${facts[f]!.imports.map((i) => i.to).join(', ')})` : ''}`);
  const q = query({
    prompt: [
      `The architecture-map cell ${cell} holds ${files.length} files. Split them into 3–7 sub-groups by purpose, with short product-language names (1–3 words).`,
      'Every file goes in exactly one group. Use the exact paths given.', '', ...lines,
    ].join('\n'),
    options: {
      cwd: root, model: process.env.HARNESS_LABELER_MODEL ?? 'claude-haiku-5-5', tools: [], settingSources: [], strictMcpConfig: true,
      outputFormat: { type: 'json_schema', schema: GROUPS_SCHEMA as unknown as Record<string, unknown> }, maxTurns: 3,
    },
  });
  for await (const m of q) {
    if (m.type !== 'result') continue;
    if (m.subtype !== 'success' || !m.structured_output) throw new Error(`labeler ${m.subtype}`);
    return { groups: (m.structured_output as { groups: Group[] }).groups, cost: m.total_cost_usd };
  }
  throw new Error('labeler returned no result');
};

/**
 * Group labels for `cells` (`cell:<domain>/<layer>` ids): one `group` Label per file, its text the sub-group name.
 * Cached by the cell's file-set hash; the labeler runs only on a cache miss.
 */
export async function labelsFor(opts: { root: string; map: DomainMap; facts: Readonly<Record<string, FileFacts>>; cells: string[]; labeler: Labeler }) {
  const mapper = createMapper(opts.map);
  const dir = join(opts.root, '.harness', 'labels');
  mkdirSync(dir, { recursive: true });
  const labels: Label[] = [];
  let cost = 0, calls = 0;
  for (const cell of [...new Set(opts.cells)].sort()) {
    const m = /^cell:([^/]+)\/(.+)$/.exec(cell);
    if (!m) continue;
    const files = cellFiles(mapper, opts.facts, m[1]!, m[2]!);
    if (!files.length) continue;
    const hash = groupHash(files);
    const file = join(dir, `${hash}.json`);
    let groups: Group[];
    if (existsSync(file)) groups = (JSON.parse(readFileSync(file, 'utf8')) as { groups: Group[] }).groups;
    else {
      const r = await opts.labeler({ root: opts.root, cell, files, facts: opts.facts });
      calls++;
      cost += r.cost ?? 0;
      groups = r.groups;
      writeFileSync(file, JSON.stringify({ cell, files, groups }, null, 2));
    }
    const inCell = new Set(files);
    for (const g of groups) for (const f of g.files) if (inCell.has(f)) labels.push({ target: f, kind: 'group', text: g.name, hash, confirmed: false });
  }
  return { labels, cost, calls };
}
// Node-side inputs for the living map: git commits as history units, and per-file facts from a repo scan.
import { git } from '../git';
import type { Facts, FileFacts, HistoryTurn } from '@harness/core';

const HARNESS_OWN = (p: string) => p === 'domains.yaml' || p.startsWith('decisions/') || p.startsWith('.harness/');
const CODE = /\.(ts|tsx|js|jsx|mjs|cjs|mts)$/;

/** The last `limit` non-merge commits, oldest first, as history units (`git log --name-only`). Harness's own files are dropped. */
export function gitHistory(root: string, limit = 200): HistoryTurn[] {
  let out: string;
  try { out = git(root, ['log', `-n${limit}`, '--no-merges', '--name-only', '--format=%x00%H']); }
  catch { return []; } // not a repo, or no commits yet
  const units: HistoryTurn[] = [];
  for (const chunk of out.split('\0')) {
    const [sha, ...rest] = chunk.trim().split('\n');
    if (!sha) continue;
    const files = rest.map((f) => f.trim()).filter((f) => f && !HARNESS_OWN(f));
    if (files.length) units.push({ id: `commit:${sha.slice(0, 10)}`, source: 'commit', files: [...new Set(files)].sort() });
  }
  return units.reverse();
}

/** Tier-1-lite FileFacts (imports and writes only) for every code file of a scan, until the Facts lane emits real ones. */
export function toFileFacts(facts: Facts): Record<string, FileFacts> {
  const out: Record<string, FileFacts> = {};
  for (const path of facts.files) {
    if (CODE.test(path)) out[path] = { path, hash: '', imports: [], writes: [], symbols: [], calls: [], routes: [], entries: [] };
  }
  for (const i of facts.imports) out[i.from]?.imports.push({ to: i.to, typeOnly: false });
  for (const w of facts.writes) out[w.file]?.writes.push({ table: w.table, symbol: null, via: 'db' });
  return out;
}
import { existsSync, mkdirSync, readdirSync, readFileSync, writeFileSync } from 'node:fs';
import { basename, join } from 'node:path';
import { parse as parseYaml, stringify as stringifyYaml } from 'yaml';
import { linkDecision, addException, nextDecisionId, type Violation } from '@harness/core';
import { commitPaths, git } from './git';
import type { Repo } from './repo';
import type { Bus } from './bus';

export type DecisionRecord = {
  id: string;
  title: string;
  outcome: string;
  status: string;
  type: string;
  invariant: string;
  anchors: { paths: string[] };
  rejected: string;
  rationale: string;
};

/** Read `decisions/DR-*.md` (front matter + body). */
export function listDecisions(root: string): DecisionRecord[] {
  const dir = join(root, 'decisions');
  if (!existsSync(dir)) return [];
  const out: DecisionRecord[] = [];
  for (const f of readdirSync(dir).filter((f) => /^DR-\d+\.md$/.test(f))) {
    const text = readFileSync(join(dir, f), 'utf8');
    const m = /^---\n([\s\S]*?)\n---\n?([\s\S]*)$/.exec(text);
    if (!m) continue;
    const fm = parseYaml(m[1]!) as Omit<DecisionRecord, 'rationale'>;
    out.push({ ...fm, rationale: m[2]!.trim() });
  }
  return out.sort((a, b) => Number(a.id.slice(3)) - Number(b.id.slice(3)));
}

/** Parse which option the user picked. Explicit A/B wins; "exception" leans B; otherwise A (comply). */
export function parseOption(text: string): 'A' | 'B' {
  const t = text.trim();
  const m = /^\(?\s*(?:option\s+)?([ab])\b/i.exec(t) ?? /\b(?:option|choose|pick|go with)\s+\(?([ab])\b/i.exec(t);
  if (m) return m[1]!.toUpperCase() as 'A' | 'B';
  return /\bexception\b/i.test(t) ? 'B' : 'A';
}

/** The decision in the user's own words: their answer minus the "A —" prefix, first sentence, if it says something. */
export function titleFromAnswer(answer: string): string | null {
  const t = answer.trim().replace(/^\(?\s*(?:option\s+)?[ab]\b\)?\s*[—–:,.-]*\s*/i, '');
  const first = (t.split(/(?<=[.!?])\s/)[0] ?? '').replace(/[.!?]+$/, '').trim();
  if (first.length < 12) return null;
  const s = first[0]!.toUpperCase() + first.slice(1);
  return s.length > 100 ? s.slice(0, 99).replace(/\s+\S*$/, '') + '…' : s;
}

/**
 * `owner/name`, which Alike's path anchors require: HARNESS_REPO_SLUG, else the origin remote,
 * else `<git user>/<folder>` for a repo with no remote.
 */
function repoAnchor(root: string) {
  if (process.env.HARNESS_REPO_SLUG) return { repository: process.env.HARNESS_REPO_SLUG };
  try {
    const m = /[:/]([^/:]+\/[^/]+?)(?:\.git)?$/.exec(git(root, ['remote', 'get-url', 'origin']));
    if (m) return { repository: m[1]! };
  } catch { /* no remote */ }
  let owner = 'local';
  try { owner = git(root, ['config', 'user.name']).replace(/[^\w.-]+/g, '-') || owner; } catch { /* unset */ }
  return { repository: `${owner}/${basename(root)}` };
}

/**
 * An answered fork becomes a standing decision (SPEC §8): write decisions/DR-n.md, update domains.yaml
 * (A links the decision to the invariant, B adds an exception), commit just those two files, emit
 * `decision_recorded`, and return the instruction that asks Claude to record it in Alike.
 */
export function recordFork(repo: Repo, bus: Bus, violations: Violation[], option: 'A' | 'B', answer: string, prompt: string) {
  const existing = listDecisions(repo.root).map((d) => d.id);
  const byInvariant = new Map<string, Violation[]>();
  for (const v of violations) byInvariant.set(v.invariant, [...(byInvariant.get(v.invariant) ?? []), v]);

  const made: DecisionRecord[] = [];
  let yamlText = repo.mapText;
  for (const [invariantId, vs] of byInvariant) {
    const inv = repo.map.invariants.find((i) => i.id === invariantId);
    if (!inv) continue;
    const id = nextDecisionId(repo.map, [...existing, ...made.map((d) => d.id)]);
    const files = [...new Set(vs.map((v) => v.file))];
    const v0 = vs[0]!;
    const [chosen, rejected] = option === 'A' ? [v0.options[0], v0.options[1]] : [v0.options[1], v0.options[0]];
    const title = titleFromAnswer(answer) ?? (option === 'A'
      ? `${files.join(', ')} follows ${inv.id}: ${inv.rule}`
      : `Exception to ${inv.id} for ${files.join(', ')}`);
    const rec: DecisionRecord = {
      id, title, outcome: chosen, status: 'made', type: 'standing', invariant: inv.id,
      anchors: { paths: files }, rejected,
      rationale: [
        `The user chose ${option}, in their words: "${answer.trim()}"`,
        '',
        `Asked during: "${prompt.trim()}"`,
        '',
        `What triggered it: ${v0.reason}`,
        '',
        `Rejected: ${rejected}`,
      ].join('\n'),
    };
    made.push(rec);
    yamlText = option === 'A' ? linkDecision(yamlText, inv.id, id) : addException(yamlText, inv.id, files[0]!, id);
  }
  if (!made.length) return { decisions: [], alikeInstruction: '' };

  mkdirSync(join(repo.root, 'decisions'), { recursive: true });
  const paths: string[] = ['domains.yaml'];
  for (const d of made) {
    const { rationale, ...fm } = d;
    const rel = `decisions/${d.id}.md`;
    writeFileSync(join(repo.root, rel), `---\n${stringifyYaml(fm).trim()}\n---\n\n${rationale}\n`);
    paths.push(rel);
  }
  writeFileSync(repo.mapPath, yamlText);
  try { commitPaths(repo.root, paths, `docs(decisions): ${made.map((d) => d.id).join(', ')} ${made[0]!.title}`.slice(0, 100)); }
  catch (e) { bus.emit('error', { message: `Could not commit ${paths.join(', ')}: ${(e as Error).message}` }); }

  repo.setMap(yamlText);
  bus.emit('map_confirmed', { map: repo.map, source: 'file' });
  for (const d of made) {
    bus.emit('decision_recorded', { id: d.id, title: d.title, invariant: d.invariant, option, paths: d.anchors.paths, alike: false });
  }

  const anchor = repoAnchor(repo.root);
  // Field names checked against Alike's record_decision schema (VERIFY.md, step 0d).
  const alikeInstruction = made.map((d) => {
    const args = {
      title: `${d.id}: ${d.title}`,
      outcome: d.outcome,
      rationale: d.rationale.replace(/\n+/g, ' '),
      decision_type: 'standing',
      status: 'made',
      anchors: d.anchors.paths.map((path) => ({ kind: 'path', label: 'governs', path, repository: anchor.repository })),
    };
    return `Record ${d.id} in Alike now: call mcp__alike__record_decision with exactly these arguments: ${JSON.stringify(args)}. If the Alike tools are unavailable, skip this silently.`;
  }).join('\n');
  return { decisions: made, alikeInstruction };
}

import { join, relative, isAbsolute } from 'node:path';
import { watch, type FSWatcher } from 'chokidar';
import { diffLines } from 'diff';

const CODE = /\.(ts|tsx|js|jsx|mjs|cjs|mts)$/;

export class Repo {
  readonly root: string;
  map!: DomainMap;
  mapText = '';
  mapper!: ReturnType<typeof createMapper>;
  facts: Facts = { files: [], imports: [], writes: [] };
  /** Tier 1 facts per code file (NAVIGATION_PLAN §3.1); the previous value is diffed on every change. */
  fileFacts = new Map<string, FileFacts>();
  private index!: ReturnType<typeof createFactsIndex>;
  violations: Violation[] = [];
  private contents = new Map<string, string>();

  private watcher: FSWatcher | null = null;
  exists: ReturnType<typeof fileExistsIn>;

  constructor(root: string, private bus: Bus) {
    this.root = realpathSync(root);
    this.exists = fileExistsIn(this.root);
  }

  get mapPath() { return join(this.root, 'domains.yaml'); }
  hasMap() { return existsSync(this.mapPath); }

  /** Load (or reload) domains.yaml text. */
  setMap(text: string) {
    this.mapText = text;
    this.map = parseDomainMap(text);
    this.mapper = createMapper(this.map);
    this.index = createFactsIndex(this.root, this.map, this.exists, (p) => this.current(p));
  }

  loadMapFile() { this.setMap(readFileSync(this.mapPath, 'utf8')); }

  /** Repo-relative POSIX path for an absolute path from a hook, or null if it is outside the repo. */
  rel(p: string): string | null {
    let abs = isAbsolute(p) ? p : join(this.root, p);
    try { abs = realpathSync(abs); } catch {
      // New file: resolve the parent instead.
      const i = abs.lastIndexOf('/');
      try { abs = join(realpathSync(abs.slice(0, i)), abs.slice(i + 1)); } catch { /* keep as is */ }
    }
    const r = relative(this.root, abs);
    if (!r || r.startsWith('..') || isAbsolute(r)) return null;
    return r.split('\\').join('/');
  }

  place(path: string): Placement { return this.mapper.place(path); }

  cellOf(path: string) {
    const p = this.place(path);
    return p.kind === 'cell' ? { domain: p.domain, layer: p.layer } : null;
  }

  /** Placement for a directory (Grep/Glob path): the single cell all known files under it share, if any. */
  cellForDir(dir: string) {
    const prefix = dir.replace(/\/$/, '') + '/';
    let found: { domain: string; layer: string } | null = null;
    for (const f of this.facts.files) {
      if (!f.startsWith(prefix)) continue;
      const c = this.cellOf(f);
      if (!c) continue;
      if (found && (found.domain !== c.domain || found.layer !== c.layer)) return null;
      found = c;
    }
    return found;

  /** Every non-ignored file under the current map. */
  listFiles() { return listRepoFiles(this.root, this.map, this.mapper); }

  /** Full fact scan → `repo_scanned` (with Tier 1 `fileFacts`) + `violation_found`. */
  scan() {

    this.facts = facts;
    this.fileFacts = new Map(Object.entries(fileFacts));
    this.contents.clear();
    for (const f of this.facts.files) {

    this.bus.emit('repo_scanned', {

      facts.calls = settleCalls(facts.calls, names);

  recheck() {

  fileChanged(path: string, attr: { tool?: string; unattributed?: boolean }) {

    const deleted = !existsSync(abs);
