    if (!attr.unattributed) { clearTimeout(this.pending.get(path)); this.pending.delete(path); }

    let added = 0, removed = 0;
    for (const part of diffLines(prev ?? '', next)) {
      if (part.added) added += part.count ?? 0;
      else if (part.removed) removed += part.count ?? 0;
    }
    const created = !known && !deleted;
    if (created) {
      this.facts.files.push(path);
      this.bus.emit('file_assigned', { placement: this.place(path) }, { path });
    }
    if (deleted) this.facts.files = this.facts.files.filter((f) => f !== path);
    if (created || deleted) this.exists.clear();

    // Import and write facts for this one file.
    const code = CODE.test(path);
    // Tier 1 first: its parse leaves the import/write record cached for the gate facts below.
    const tier1 = code ? this.refreshFacts(path, deleted ? null : next) : null;
    const before = this.facts.imports.filter((i) => i.from === path);
    const after = code && !deleted ? factsForSource(path, next, this.exists) : { imports: [], writes: [] };
    this.facts.imports = [...this.facts.imports.filter((i) => i.from !== path), ...after.imports];
    this.facts.writes = [...this.facts.writes.filter((w) => w.file !== path), ...after.writes];
    if (deleted) this.contents.delete(path); else if (code) this.contents.set(path, next);

    // Which symbols changed; the file's new facts follow right after `edited`.
    const symbols: SymbolDiff | undefined = tier1 ? diffSymbols(tier1.prev?.symbols ?? [], tier1.next?.symbols ?? []) : undefined;
    this.bus.emit('edited', {
      added, removed, created, ...(attr.unattributed ? { unattributed: true } : {}), ...(attr.tool ? { tool: attr.tool } : {}), ...(symbols ? { symbols } : {}),
    }, { path, cell: this.cellOf(path) });
    if (tier1) this.bus.emit('facts_changed', { facts: tier1.next }, { path, cell: this.cellOf(path) });

    const key = (i: ImportEdge) => `${i.from}→${i.to}`;
    const beforeKeys = new Set(before.map(key));
    const afterKeys = new Set(after.imports.map(key));
    const gained = after.imports.filter((i) => !beforeKeys.has(key(i)));
    const lost = before.filter((i) => !afterKeys.has(key(i)));
    for (const de of domainEdges({ imports: gained, writes: [] }, this.mapper)) {
      for (const edge of de.files) this.bus.emit('edge_added', { edge, from: de.from, to: de.to }, { path });

    for (const de of domainEdges({ imports: lost, writes: [] }, this.mapper)) {

    }

    // Outgoing call edges, diffed like imports.
    if (tier1) {
      const callKey = (c: { from: string; to: string }) => `${c.from}\u0000${c.to}`;
      const oldCalls = new Set((tier1.prev?.calls ?? []).map(callKey));
      const newCalls = new Set((tier1.next?.calls ?? []).map(callKey));
      for (const c of tier1.next?.calls ?? []) {
        if (!oldCalls.has(callKey(c))) this.bus.emit('call_added', { from: c.from, to: c.to, confidence: c.confidence }, { path });
      }
      for (const c of tier1.prev?.calls ?? []) {

  /** Completeness: any write that no hook reported (e.g. from Bash) becomes an unattributed `edited` event. */
  startWatcher() {
    const ignored = (p: string) => {
      const r = relative(this.root, p);
      if (!r || r.startsWith('..')) return false;
      return /(^|\/)(node_modules|\.git|\.harness)(\/|$)/.test(r) || this.mapper.isIgnored(r.split('\\').join('/'));

      const r = this.rel(abs);
      if (!r || this.pending.has(r) || r === 'domains.yaml') return;
      this.fileChanged(r, { unattributed: true });

import { execFileSync } from 'node:child_process';

/** Paths Harness itself writes; never counted as the coding session's work. */
const HARNESS_PATHS = [':(exclude)domains.yaml', ':(exclude)decisions', ':(exclude).harness'];

export function git(repo: string, args: string[]): string {
  return execFileSync('git', args, { cwd: repo, encoding: 'utf8', stdio: ['ignore', 'pipe', 'pipe'] }).trim();
}

function tryGit(repo: string, args: string[]): string {
  try { return git(repo, args); } catch { return ''; }
}

export type Baseline = { head: string; snapshot: string; untracked: string[] };

/** Turn baseline: HEAD plus a `git stash create` snapshot of the working tree (no stash entry is stored). */
export function baseline(repo: string): Baseline {
  const head = tryGit(repo, ['rev-parse', 'HEAD']);
  const snapshot = tryGit(repo, ['stash', 'create']) || head;
  const untracked = untrackedFiles(repo);
  return { head, snapshot, untracked };
}

function untrackedFiles(repo: string): string[] {
  return tryGit(repo, ['ls-files', '--others', '--exclude-standard']).split('\n').filter(Boolean);
}

/** Lines added/removed since the baseline, including files created during the turn (untracked). */
export function numstat(repo: string, base: Baseline): { added: number; removed: number; files: string[] } {
  let added = 0, removed = 0;
  const files: string[] = [];
  const parse = (out: string, name?: string) => {
    for (const line of out.split('\n')) {
      const [a, r, ...rest] = line.split('\t');
      if (!rest.length) continue;
      added += Number(a) || 0;
      removed += Number(r) || 0;
      files.push(name ?? rest.join('\t'));
    }
  };
  if (base.snapshot) parse(tryGit(repo, ['diff', '--numstat', base.snapshot, '--', '.', ...HARNESS_PATHS]));
  const before = new Set(base.untracked);
  for (const f of untrackedFiles(repo)) {
    if (before.has(f) || f.startsWith('decisions/') || f.startsWith('.harness/') || f === 'domains.yaml') continue;
    // --no-index exits 1 when files differ, so read stdout from the error.
    try { execFileSync('git', ['diff', '--no-index', '--numstat', '/dev/null', f], { cwd: repo, encoding: 'utf8' }); }
    catch (e) { parse(String((e as { stdout?: string }).stdout ?? ''), f); }
  }
  return { added, removed, files };
}

/** Commit only Harness's own files, so the coding session's uncommitted edits stay out (SPEC §8). */
export function commitPaths(repo: string, paths: string[], message: string) {
  git(repo, ['add', '--', ...paths]);
  git(repo, ['commit', '-q', '-m', message, '--', ...paths]);
}

  violations: Violation[] = [];
  private contents = new Map<string, string>();
  private pending = new Map<string, NodeJS.Timeout>(); // paths a hook is editing; the watcher leaves them alone
  private watcher: FSWatcher | null = null;
  exists: ReturnType<typeof fileExistsIn>;

  constructor(root: string, private bus: Bus) {
    this.root = realpathSync(root);
    this.exists = fileExistsIn(this.root);
  }

  get mapPath() { return join(this.root, 'domains.yaml'); }
  hasMap() { return existsSync(this.mapPath); }

  /** Load (or reload) domains.yaml text. */
  setMap(text: string) {
    this.mapText = text;
    this.map = parseDomainMap(text);
    this.mapper = createMapper(this.map);
    this.index = createFactsIndex(this.root, this.map, this.exists, (p) => this.current(p));
  }

  loadMapFile() { this.setMap(readFileSync(this.mapPath, 'utf8')); }

  /** Repo-relative POSIX path for an absolute path from a hook, or null if it is outside the repo. */
  rel(p: string): string | null {
    let abs = isAbsolute(p) ? p : join(this.root, p);
    try { abs = realpathSync(abs); } catch {
      // New file: resolve the parent instead.
      const i = abs.lastIndexOf('/');
      try { abs = join(realpathSync(abs.slice(0, i)), abs.slice(i + 1)); } catch { /* keep as is */ }
    }
    const r = relative(this.root, abs);
    if (!r || r.startsWith('..') || isAbsolute(r)) return null;
    return r.split('\\').join('/');
  }

  place(path: string): Placement { return this.mapper.place(path); }

  cellOf(path: string) {
    const p = this.place(path);
    return p.kind === 'cell' ? { domain: p.domain, layer: p.layer } : null;
  }

  /** Placement for a directory (Grep/Glob path): the single cell all known files under it share, if any. */
  cellForDir(dir: string) {
    const prefix = dir.replace(/\/$/, '') + '/';
    let found: { domain: string; layer: string } | null = null;
    for (const f of this.facts.files) {
      if (!f.startsWith(prefix)) continue;
      const c = this.cellOf(f);
      if (!c) continue;
      if (found && (found.domain !== c.domain || found.layer !== c.layer)) return null;
      found = c;
    }
    return found;
  }

  /** Every non-ignored file under the current map. */
  listFiles() { return listRepoFiles(this.root, this.map, this.mapper); }

  /** Full fact scan → `repo_scanned` (with Tier 1 `fileFacts`) + `violation_found`. */
  scan() {
    this.exists.clear();
    const { fileFacts, ...facts } = scanRepoFacts(this.root, this.map);
    this.facts = facts;
    this.fileFacts = new Map(Object.entries(fileFacts));
    this.contents.clear();
    for (const f of this.facts.files) {
      if (CODE.test(f)) this.contents.set(f, readFileSync(join(this.root, f), 'utf8'));
    }
    this.bus.emit('repo_scanned', {
      files: this.facts.files.map((path) => ({ path, placement: this.place(path) })),
      imports: this.facts.imports,
      writes: this.facts.writes,
      edges: domainEdges(this.facts, this.mapper),
      fileFacts: [...this.fileFacts.values()],
    }, { turn: null });
    this.recheck();
  }

  /**
   * Tier 1 facts for a changed code file (null when deleted), calls settled against the rest of the repo. If the new
   * text doesn't parse (mid-edit), symbols, calls, routes and entries stay as they were instead of reading as removed.
   */
  private refreshFacts(path: string, text: string | null): { prev: FileFacts | null; next: FileFacts | null } {
    const prev = this.fileFacts.get(path) ?? null;
    if (text === null) {
      this.fileFacts.delete(path);
      return { prev, next: null };
    }
    const { facts, parsed } = this.index.extract(path, text);
    if (!parsed && prev) Object.assign(facts, { symbols: prev.symbols, calls: prev.calls, routes: prev.routes, entries: prev.entries });
    else {
      const names = (file: string) => {
        const f = file === path ? facts : this.fileFacts.get(file);
        return f ? new Set(f.symbols.map((s) => s.name)) : null;
      };
      facts.calls = settleCalls(facts.calls, names);
    }
    this.fileFacts.set(path, facts);
    return { prev, next: facts };
  }

  /** Re-run the checker over the whole repo (load call site) and publish the current set. */
  recheck() {
    this.violations = check(this.map, this.facts, this.mapper);
    this.bus.emit('violation_found', { violations: this.violations }, { turn: null });
  }

  current(path: string): string | null {
    if (this.contents.has(path)) return this.contents.get(path)!;
    const abs = join(this.root, path);
    return existsSync(abs) ? readFileSync(abs, 'utf8') : null;
  }

  markPending(path: string) {
    clearTimeout(this.pending.get(path));
    this.pending.set(path, setTimeout(() => this.pending.delete(path), 10_000));
  }

  /**
   * A file changed on disk: emit `edited` (+/− lines) and edge events from its import diff, and update facts.
   * Called by the PostToolUse hook (attributed) and the watcher (unattributed). No-op if the content is unchanged.
   */
  fileChanged(path: string, attr: { tool?: string; unattributed?: boolean }) {
    if (this.mapper.isIgnored(path)) return;
    const abs = join(this.root, path);
    const deleted = !existsSync(abs);
    const next = deleted ? '' : readFileSync(abs, 'utf8');
    const prev = this.contents.get(path);
    const known = this.facts.files.includes(path);
    if (prev === next && known) return;
    if (!attr.unattributed) { clearTimeout(this.pending.get(path)); this.pending.delete(path); }

    let added = 0, removed = 0;
    for (const part of diffLines(prev ?? '', next)) {
      if (part.added) added += part.count ?? 0;
      else if (part.removed) removed += part.count ?? 0;
    }
    const created = !known && !deleted;
    if (created) {
      this.facts.files.push(path);
      this.bus.emit('file_assigned', { placement: this.place(path) }, { path });
    }
    if (deleted) this.facts.files = this.facts.files.filter((f) => f !== path);
    if (created || deleted) this.exists.clear();

    // Import and write facts for this one file.
    const code = CODE.test(path);
    // Tier 1 first: its parse leaves the import/write record cached for the gate facts below.
    const tier1 = code ? this.refreshFacts(path, deleted ? null : next) : null;
    const before = this.facts.imports.filter((i) => i.from === path);
    const after = code && !deleted ? factsForSource(path, next, this.exists) : { imports: [], writes: [] };
    this.facts.imports = [...this.facts.imports.filter((i) => i.from !== path), ...after.imports];
    this.facts.writes = [...this.facts.writes.filter((w) => w.file !== path), ...after.writes];
    if (deleted) this.contents.delete(path); else if (code) this.contents.set(path, next);

    // Which symbols changed; the file's new facts follow right after `edited`.
    const symbols: SymbolDiff | undefined = tier1 ? diffSymbols(tier1.prev?.symbols ?? [], tier1.next?.symbols ?? []) : undefined;
    this.bus.emit('edited', {
      added, removed, created, ...(attr.unattributed ? { unattributed: true } : {}), ...(attr.tool ? { tool: attr.tool } : {}), ...(symbols ? { symbols } : {}),
    }, { path, cell: this.cellOf(path) });
    if (tier1) this.bus.emit('facts_changed', { facts: tier1.next }, { path, cell: this.cellOf(path) });

    const key = (i: ImportEdge) => `${i.from}→${i.to}`;
    const beforeKeys = new Set(before.map(key));
    const afterKeys = new Set(after.imports.map(key));
    const gained = after.imports.filter((i) => !beforeKeys.has(key(i)));
    const lost = before.filter((i) => !afterKeys.has(key(i)));
    for (const de of domainEdges({ imports: gained, writes: [] }, this.mapper)) {
      for (const edge of de.files) this.bus.emit('edge_added', { edge, from: de.from, to: de.to }, { path });
    }
    for (const de of domainEdges({ imports: lost, writes: [] }, this.mapper)) {
      for (const edge of de.files) this.bus.emit('edge_removed', { edge, from: de.from, to: de.to }, { path });
    }

    // Outgoing call edges, diffed like imports.
    if (tier1) {
      const callKey = (c: { from: string; to: string }) => `${c.from}\u0000${c.to}`;
      const oldCalls = new Set((tier1.prev?.calls ?? []).map(callKey));
      const newCalls = new Set((tier1.next?.calls ?? []).map(callKey));
      for (const c of tier1.next?.calls ?? []) {
        if (!oldCalls.has(callKey(c))) this.bus.emit('call_added', { from: c.from, to: c.to, confidence: c.confidence }, { path });
      }
      for (const c of tier1.prev?.calls ?? []) {
        if (!newCalls.has(callKey(c))) this.bus.emit('call_removed', { from: c.from, to: c.to, confidence: c.confidence }, { path });
      }
    }
  }

  /** Completeness: any write that no hook reported (e.g. from Bash) becomes an unattributed `edited` event. */
  startWatcher() {
    const ignored = (p: string) => {
      const r = relative(this.root, p);
      if (!r || r.startsWith('..')) return false;
      return /(^|\/)(node_modules|\.git|\.harness)(\/|$)/.test(r) || this.mapper.isIgnored(r.split('\\').join('/'));
    };
    this.watcher = watch(this.root, { ignored, ignoreInitial: true, awaitWriteFinish: { stabilityThreshold: 120, pollInterval: 40 } });
    const handle = (abs: string) => {
      const r = this.rel(abs);
      if (!r || this.pending.has(r) || r === 'domains.yaml') return;
      this.fileChanged(r, { unattributed: true });
    };
    this.watcher.on('add', handle).on('change', handle).on('unlink', handle);
  }

  async close() { await this.watcher?.close(); }
}
import { existsSync, readFileSync, writeFileSync } from 'node:fs';
import { join, resolve, dirname } from 'node:path';
import { fileURLToPath } from 'node:url';
import { Hono } from 'hono';
import { serve } from '@hono/node-server';
import { serveStatic } from '@hono/node-server/serve-static';
import { WebSocketServer, type WebSocket } from 'ws';
import { Bus } from './bus';
import { Repo } from './repo';
import { Session } from './session';
import { commitPaths } from './git';
import { proposeMap } from './cartographer';
import { attachLivingMap, livingMapRoutes, onboardingSkeleton } from './living-map'; // living map (NAVIGATION_PLAN §4)

const here = dirname(fileURLToPath(import.meta.url));
const REPO = process.env.HARNESS_REPO ? resolve(process.env.INIT_CWD ?? process.cwd(), process.env.HARNESS_REPO) : '';
if (!REPO || !existsSync(REPO)) {
  console.error(`Set HARNESS_REPO to the target repo (got "${process.env.HARNESS_REPO ?? ''}").`);
  process.exit(1);
}
const PORT = Number(process.env.PORT ?? 4310);
const FALLBACK_MAP = resolve(here, '../../../fixtures/scout-agent.domains.yaml');

const bus = new Bus(REPO, { fresh: process.env.HARNESS_FRESH === '1' });
const sockets = new Set<WebSocket>();
const broadcast = (msg: unknown) => {
  const s = JSON.stringify(msg);
  for (const ws of sockets) if (ws.readyState === ws.OPEN) ws.send(s);
};
bus.on((event) => broadcast({ type: 'event', event }));

const repo = new Repo(REPO, bus);
let session: Session | null = null;
let proposal: { yaml: string; source: 'cartographer' | 'fixture' } | null = null;
let busy = false;

function startSession() {
  repo.scan();
  repo.startWatcher();
  session = new Session(repo, bus, (m) => {
    if (m.type === 'busy') busy = m.busy;
    broadcast(m);
  });
  session.start();
}

/** Load: use domains.yaml if present; otherwise propose one (cartographer, else the fixture) and wait for Confirm. */
async function load() {
  if (repo.hasMap()) {
    repo.loadMapFile();
    bus.emit('map_confirmed', { map: repo.map, source: 'file' }, { turn: null });
    startSession();
    return;
  }
  // ---- living map: show the instant deterministic skeleton while the cartographer works (NAVIGATION_PLAN §4.2) ----
  showProposal(onboardingSkeleton(repo.root), 'cartographer');
  // ---- end living map ----
  let yaml: string;
  let source: 'cartographer' | 'fixture' = 'cartographer';
  try {
    if (process.env.HARNESS_CARTOGRAPHER === '0') throw new Error('disabled');
    yaml = await proposeMap(repo, bus);
  } catch (e) {
    if ((e as Error).message !== 'disabled') bus.emit('error', { message: `Cartographer failed, using the reference map: ${(e as Error).message}` }, { turn: null });
    yaml = readFileSync(FALLBACK_MAP, 'utf8');
    source = 'fixture';
  }
  if (session) return; // living map: the user confirmed the skeleton before the cartographer answered
  showProposal(yaml, source);
}

function showProposal(yaml: string, source: 'cartographer' | 'fixture') {
  repo.setMap(yaml);
  proposal = { yaml, source };
  bus.emit('map_proposed', { map: repo.map, yaml }, { turn: null });
  // The shell plays the map assembling: one file_assigned per file, ~15 ms apart.
  const files = repo.listFiles();
  files.forEach((path, i) => setTimeout(() => bus.emit('file_assigned', { placement: repo.place(path) }, { path, turn: null }), i * 15));
}

const app = new Hono();

// ---- living map (NAVIGATION_PLAN §4): drift → cartographer proposals, accept/reject, survey ----
const living = attachLivingMap({ bus, repo });
app.route('/api', livingMapRoutes(living));
// ---- end living map ----
app.get('/api/info', (c) => c.json({ repo: REPO, session: bus.session, busy, proposal: !!proposal }));
app.get('/api/events', (c) => c.json(bus.events));
app.post('/api/chat', async (c) => {
  const { text } = await c.req.json<{ text: string }>();
  if (!session) return c.json({ error: 'Confirm the map first.' }, 409);
  session.userMessage(text);
  return c.json({ ok: true });
});
app.post('/api/approve', (c) => { session?.approve(); return c.json({ ok: true }); });
app.post('/api/interrupt', (c) => { session?.interrupt(); return c.json({ ok: true }); });
app.post('/api/map/confirm', (c) => {
  if (!proposal) return c.json({ error: 'No proposal pending.' }, 409);
  writeFileSync(repo.mapPath, proposal.yaml);
  try { commitPaths(repo.root, ['domains.yaml'], 'docs: add domains.yaml architecture map'); }
  catch (e) { bus.emit('error', { message: `Could not commit domains.yaml: ${(e as Error).message}` }, { turn: null }); }
  repo.setMap(proposal.yaml);
  bus.emit('map_confirmed', { map: repo.map, source: proposal.source }, { turn: null });
  proposal = null;
  startSession();
  return c.json({ ok: true });
});
app.post('/api/map/fallback', (c) => {
  if (!proposal) return c.json({ error: 'No proposal pending.' }, 409);
  showProposal(readFileSync(FALLBACK_MAP, 'utf8'), 'fixture');
  return c.json({ ok: true });
});
app.get('/api/file', (c) => {
  const p = c.req.query('path') ?? '';
  const rel = repo.rel(p);
  if (!rel || !existsSync(join(repo.root, rel))) return c.json({ error: 'not found' }, 404);
  return c.text(readFileSync(join(repo.root, rel), 'utf8'));
});

const shellDist = resolve(here, '../../shell/dist');
if (existsSync(shellDist)) app.use('/*', serveStatic({ root: shellDist }));

const server = serve({ fetch: app.fetch, port: PORT }, () => console.log(`Harness server on http://localhost:${PORT} · repo ${REPO}`));
const wss = new WebSocketServer({ server: server as never, path: '/ws' });
wss.on('connection', (ws) => {
  sockets.add(ws);
  ws.send(JSON.stringify({ type: 'hello', events: bus.events, busy, session: bus.session }));
  ws.on('close', () => sockets.delete(ws));
});

void load();

const shutdown = async () => { await repo.close(); process.exit(0); };
process.on('SIGINT', shutdown);
process.on('SIGTERM', shutdown);
import { appendFileSync, existsSync, mkdirSync, readFileSync, writeFileSync } from 'node:fs';
import { join } from 'node:path';
import { randomUUID } from 'node:crypto';
import type { HarnessEvent, EventKind, EventData, Cell } from '@harness/core';

type Listener = (e: HarnessEvent) => void;

/** Append-only event log: `.harness/events.jsonl` in the target repo, broadcast to every listener. */
export class Bus {
  readonly events: HarnessEvent[] = [];
  readonly session = randomUUID().slice(0, 8);
  turn: string | null = null;
  private listeners = new Set<Listener>();
  private file: string;

  constructor(repo: string, opts: { fresh?: boolean } = {}) {
    const dir = join(repo, '.harness');
    mkdirSync(join(dir, 'turns'), { recursive: true });
    // Keep .harness/ out of the target's git without touching its .gitignore.
    if (!existsSync(join(dir, '.gitignore'))) writeFileSync(join(dir, '.gitignore'), '*\n');
    this.file = join(dir, 'events.jsonl');
    if (opts.fresh) writeFileSync(this.file, '');
    else if (existsSync(this.file)) {
      for (const line of readFileSync(this.file, 'utf8').split('\n')) {
        if (line.trim()) this.events.push(JSON.parse(line) as HarnessEvent);
      }
    }
  }

  emit<K extends EventKind>(kind: K, data: K extends keyof EventData ? EventData[K] : never, extra: { cell?: Cell | null; path?: string; turn?: string | null } = {}): HarnessEvent {
    const e: HarnessEvent = {
      id: randomUUID().slice(0, 12),
      t: Date.now(),
      session: this.session,
      turn: extra.turn === undefined ? this.turn : extra.turn,
      kind,
      ...(extra.cell ? { cell: extra.cell } : {}),
      ...(extra.path ? { path: extra.path } : {}),
      data: data as Record<string, unknown>,
    };
    this.events.push(e);
    appendFileSync(this.file, JSON.stringify(e) + '\n');
    for (const l of this.listeners) l(e);
    return e;
  }

  on(l: Listener) {
    this.listeners.add(l);
    return () => this.listeners.delete(l);
  }
}

import { createSdkMcpServer, tool } from '@anthropic-ai/claude-agent-sdk';
import { z } from 'zod';
import { planFootprint, withExtra, type PlanStep, type Violation } from '@harness/core';
import { listDecisions } from './decisions';
import type { Repo } from './repo';
import type { Bus } from './bus';

const text = (t: string) => ({ content: [{ type: 'text' as const, text: t }] });

export function violationText(vs: Violation[]): string {
  return vs.map((v) => `${v.reason}\n  (A) ${v.options[0]}\n  (B) ${v.options[1]}`).join('\n');
}

export const ASK_RULE =
  'Stop and ask the user to choose A or B, in one short message that names both options, then wait for the answer. ' +
  'Never work around a violation or try another route.';

export type PlanHooks = {
  /** Called after each submit_plan with its violations, so the session can track the fork. */
  onPlan(steps: PlanStep[], violations: Violation[]): void;
  /** Instructions queued for the next tool result (e.g. recording a decision in Alike). */
  takeNotes(): string[];
};

export function harnessTools(repo: Repo, bus: Bus, hooks: PlanHooks) {
  const cellName = (domain: string, layer: string) =>
    `${repo.map.domains.find((d) => d.id === domain)?.name ?? domain} · ${repo.map.layers.find((l) => l.id === layer)?.name ?? layer}`;

  return createSdkMcpServer({
    name: 'harness',
    version: '0.1.0',
    tools: [
      tool(
        'submit_plan',
        'Submit your implementation plan before editing anything. Numbered steps; each lists the exact repo-relative file paths it will create or modify, and every new import it adds as { from: path, to: path }. Returns the architecture footprint and any rule violations.',
        {
          steps: z.array(z.object({
            n: z.number().int(),
            text: z.string(),
            files: z.array(z.string()),
            imports: z.array(z.object({ from: z.string(), to: z.string() })).default([]),
          })),
        },
        async ({ steps }) => {
          const norm = (p: string) => repo.rel(p) ?? p.replace(/^\.\//, '');
          const clean: PlanStep[] = steps.map((s) => ({
            n: s.n, text: s.text, files: s.files.map(norm),
            imports: s.imports.map((i) => ({ from: norm(i.from), to: i.to.startsWith('.') ? i.to : norm(i.to) })),
          }));
          const exists = withExtra(repo.exists, clean.flatMap((s) => s.files));
          const fp = planFootprint(repo.map, clean, exists, repo.mapper);
          bus.emit('planned', {
            steps: clean,
            cells: fp.cells.map((c) => ({ domain: c.domain, layer: c.layer, steps: c.steps, files: c.files })),
            edges: fp.edges.map((e) => ({ from: e.from, to: e.to, steps: e.steps, imports: e.imports })),
            unassigned: fp.unassigned,
          });
          for (const v of fp.violations) bus.emit('plan_violation', { violation: v }, { path: v.file, cell: repo.cellOf(v.file) });
          hooks.onPlan(clean, fp.violations);

          const lines = [
            `Plan recorded: ${clean.length} step(s).`,
            `Cells: ${fp.cells.map((c) => `${cellName(c.domain, c.layer)} (steps ${c.steps.join(', ')})`).join('; ') || 'none'}.`,
            `New cross-domain dependencies: ${fp.edges.map((e) => `${e.from} → ${e.to}`).join('; ') || 'none'}.`,
          ];
          if (fp.unassigned.length) lines.push(`Files outside every domain: ${fp.unassigned.join(', ')}.`);
          if (fp.violations.length) {
            lines.push('', `VIOLATIONS (${fp.violations.length}):`, violationText(fp.violations), '', ASK_RULE + ' Do not exit plan mode until the user has answered and you have resubmitted the plan.');
          } else {
            lines.push('No violations. Exit plan mode when ready.');
          }
          const notes = hooks.takeNotes();
          if (notes.length) lines.push('', ...notes);
          return text(lines.join('\n'));
        },
        { alwaysLoad: true },
      ),
      tool('cell_for', 'Which domain × layer cell a repo path belongs to.', { path: z.string() }, async ({ path }) => {
        const rel = repo.rel(path) ?? path;
        const p = repo.place(rel);
        return text(p.kind === 'cell' ? `${rel} → ${cellName(p.domain, p.layer)} (${p.domain}/${p.layer})` : `${rel} → ${p.kind}${'domain' in p ? ` (${p.domain})` : ''}`);
      }, { alwaysLoad: true }),
      tool('domain', 'A domain: purpose, cells with their paths and tables, files, and the rules that involve it.', { id: z.string() }, async ({ id }) => {
        const d = repo.map.domains.find((x) => x.id === id || x.name.toLowerCase() === id.toLowerCase());
        if (!d) return text(`No domain "${id}". Domains: ${repo.map.domains.map((x) => x.id).join(', ')}`);
        const files = repo.facts.files.filter((f) => repo.mapper.domainOf(f) === d.id);
        const rules = repo.map.invariants.filter((i) => JSON.stringify(i).includes(`"${d.id}"`)).map((i) => `${i.id}: ${i.rule}`);
        return text(JSON.stringify({ id: d.id, name: d.name, purpose: d.purpose, cells: d.cells, files, rules }, null, 2));
      }),
      tool('who_writes', 'Which domain owns a table, and which files write it today.', { table: z.string() }, async ({ table }) => {
        const owner = repo.mapper.ownerOf(table);
        const writers = repo.facts.writes.filter((w) => w.table === table).map((w) => w.file);
        return text(JSON.stringify({ table, owner, writers }, null, 2));
      }),
      tool('decisions_for', 'Standing decisions whose anchors overlap these paths.', { paths: z.array(z.string()) }, async ({ paths }) => {
        const rel = paths.map((p) => repo.rel(p) ?? p);
        const all = listDecisions(repo.root);
        const hits = all.filter((d) => d.anchors.paths.some((a) => rel.some((p) => p === a || p.startsWith(a.replace(/\*\*?.*$/, '')))));
        return text(hits.length ? hits.map((d) => `${d.id}: ${d.title}\nOutcome: ${d.outcome}\nRejected: ${d.rejected}\n${d.rationale}`).join('\n\n') : 'No standing decisions for these paths.');
      }),
    ],
  });
}
import { query } from '@anthropic-ai/claude-agent-sdk';
import { stringify } from 'yaml';
import { scanRepo, DomainMapSchema, type DomainMap } from '@harness/core';
import type { Repo } from './repo';
import type { Bus } from './bus';

const DEFAULT_IGNORE = ['node_modules/**', '.git/**', '.harness/**', 'decisions/**', '*.json', '*.md', '*.config.ts', '.*', 'domains.yaml'];

/** Flat shape for structured output; converted to the domains.yaml schema afterwards. */
const OUTPUT_SCHEMA = {
  type: 'object',
  additionalProperties: false,
  required: ['layers', 'neutral', 'ignore', 'domains', 'invariants'],
  properties: {
    layers: { type: 'array', items: { type: 'object', additionalProperties: false, required: ['id', 'name'], properties: { id: { type: 'string' }, name: { type: 'string' } } } },
    neutral: { type: 'array', items: { type: 'string' }, description: 'Globs for shared code that belongs to no domain (types, db helpers, logging).' },
    ignore: { type: 'array', items: { type: 'string' }, description: 'Globs to skip entirely (fixtures, scripts, build output, config).' },
    domains: {
      type: 'array',
      items: {
        type: 'object',
        additionalProperties: false,
        required: ['id', 'name', 'purpose', 'cells', 'tests'],
        properties: {
          id: { type: 'string' }, name: { type: 'string', description: 'Product language, 1–3 words.' }, purpose: { type: 'string' },
          cells: {
            type: 'array',
            items: {
              type: 'object', additionalProperties: false, required: ['layer', 'paths', 'tables'],
              properties: { layer: { type: 'string' }, paths: { type: 'array', items: { type: 'string' } }, tables: { type: 'array', items: { type: 'string' } } },
            },
          },
          tests: { type: 'array', items: { type: 'string' } },
        },
      },
    },
    invariants: {
      type: 'array',
      items: {
        type: 'object',
        additionalProperties: false,
        required: ['id', 'rule', 'kind', 'targets', 'allowed_from', 'owners', 'from', 'to'],
        properties: {
          id: { type: 'string', description: 'DR-1, DR-2 or DR-3' },
          rule: { type: 'string', description: 'One plain sentence.' },
          kind: { type: 'string', enum: ['only_via', 'owns_writes', 'no_edge'] },
          targets: { type: 'array', items: { type: 'string' }, description: 'only_via: globs of the guarded files (e.g. vendor clients).' },
          allowed_from: { type: 'array', items: { type: 'string' }, description: 'only_via: domain ids allowed to import the targets.' },
          owners: { type: 'array', items: { type: 'object', additionalProperties: false, required: ['table', 'domain'], properties: { table: { type: 'string' }, domain: { type: 'string' } } }, description: 'owns_writes: table → owning domain id.' },
          from: { type: 'string', description: 'no_edge: domain id (empty otherwise).' },
          to: { type: 'string', description: 'no_edge: domain id (empty otherwise).' },
        },
      },
    },
  },
} as const;

type Out = {
  layers: { id: string; name: string }[];
  neutral: string[];
  ignore: string[];
  domains: { id: string; name: string; purpose: string; cells: { layer: string; paths: string[]; tables: string[] }[]; tests: string[] }[];
  invariants: { id: string; rule: string; kind: 'only_via' | 'owns_writes' | 'no_edge'; targets: string[]; allowed_from: string[]; owners: { table: string; domain: string }[]; from: string; to: string }[];
};

function toMap(o: Out): DomainMap {
  const raw = {
    version: 1,
    layers: o.layers,
    neutral: o.neutral,
    ignore: [...new Set([...DEFAULT_IGNORE, ...o.ignore])],
    domains: o.domains.map((d) => ({
      id: d.id, name: d.name, purpose: d.purpose,
      cells: Object.fromEntries(d.cells.map((c) => [c.layer, { ...(c.paths.length ? { paths: c.paths } : {}), ...(c.tables.length ? { tables: c.tables } : {}) }])),
      ...(d.tests.length ? { tests: d.tests } : {}),
    })),
    invariants: o.invariants.map((i) => {
      const base = { id: i.id, rule: i.rule, kind: i.kind, exceptions: [], source: 'cartographer' };
      if (i.kind === 'only_via') return { ...base, targets: i.targets, allowed_from: i.allowed_from };
      if (i.kind === 'owns_writes') return { ...base, owners: Object.fromEntries(i.owners.map((x) => [x.table, x.domain])) };
      return { ...base, from: i.from, to: i.to };
    }),
  };
  return DomainMapSchema.parse(raw);
}

/**
 * One-shot map proposal (SPEC §10): a separate read-only query on a smaller model, given the file tree,
 * import edges and table writes. Never runs inside the coding session. Returns domains.yaml text.
 */
export async function proposeMap(repo: Repo, bus: Bus): Promise<string> {
  const bare: DomainMap = { version: 1, layers: [{ id: 'x', name: 'x' }], ignore: DEFAULT_IGNORE, domains: [], invariants: [] } as DomainMap;
  const facts = scanRepo(repo.root, bare);
  const prompt = [
    'Propose an architecture map for this repo as a domain × layer grid that a product person can read.',
    '- 5–9 domains named in product language (e.g. "Model gateway", not "src/gateway"). Every source file should land in exactly one cell or in `neutral`/`ignore`.',
    '- Layers suited to this repo, top to bottom (for an agent system: entry, logic, data, external). Data cells list the tables that domain writes. External cells hold vendor/third-party client code.',
    '- When a folder holds exactly one cell, use a folder glob (e.g. `src/tools/**`) so files added later land in the right cell. List explicit file paths only where one folder is split across several cells. Map test folders with `tests` globs.',
    '- Exactly 3 invariants, ids DR-1, DR-2, DR-3, the most load-bearing ones you can infer from the facts below: DR-1 `only_via` for the vendor clients that only one domain should import (e.g. all model providers and embeddings in one rule); DR-2 one `owns_writes` rule covering every table with its owning domain; DR-3 one `no_edge` between two domains that must stay independent. The code may already break one of them in a single place; that is expected, still propose the rule.',
    'You may read files to understand purposes. Do not modify anything.',
    '',
    `Files (${facts.files.length}):`, ...facts.files,
    '',
    'Import edges (from → to):', ...facts.imports.map((i) => `${i.from} → ${i.to}`),
    '',
    'Table writes (file: table):', ...facts.writes.map((w) => `${w.file}: ${w.table}`),
  ].join('\n');

  const q = query({
    prompt,
    options: {
      cwd: repo.root,
      model: process.env.HARNESS_CARTOGRAPHER_MODEL ?? 'claude-haiku-5-5',
      tools: ['Read', 'Grep', 'Glob'],
      permissionMode: 'dontAsk',
      allowedTools: ['Read', 'Grep', 'Glob'],
      settingSources: [],
      strictMcpConfig: true,
      outputFormat: { type: 'json_schema', schema: OUTPUT_SCHEMA as unknown as Record<string, unknown> },
      maxTurns: 20,
    },
  });
  for await (const m of q) {
    if (m.type === 'result') {
      if (m.subtype !== 'success' || !m.structured_output) throw new Error(`cartographer ${m.subtype}`);
      const map = toMap(m.structured_output as Out);
      const header = '# Proposed by the Harness cartographer and confirmed by the user.\n# Domains are columns, layers are rows. Edges are derived from imports, never declared.\n\n';
      bus.emit('chat', { role: 'system', text: `Cartographer proposed ${map.domains.length} domains and ${map.invariants.length} rules.` }, { turn: null });
      return header + stringify(map, { collectionStyle: "any", lineWidth: 140 });
    }
  }
  throw new Error('cartographer returned no result');
}

// THROWAWAY (N0 spike): a synthetic large Projection for performance measurement (`?map=v2&bench=500`).
// 6 domains × 4 layers; `n` files spread over the cells of the first three domains, ~1.5n import edges
// (mostly inside a cell, some across cells and domains), deterministic.
import { cellId, domainId, ROOT_ID, type Port, type VisibleEdge, type VisibleNode } from '@harness/core/view';
import type { GridSpec, Scene } from '../scene';
import { emptyRollup, mergeRollups } from './fakeProjection';

function rng(seed: number) {
  let s = seed >>> 0;
  return () => (s = (s * 1664525 + 1013904223) >>> 0) / 2 ** 32;
}

const DOMAINS = ['Channels', 'Agent loop', 'Research tools', 'Model gateway', 'Memory', 'Outreach'];
const LAYERS = ['Entry', 'Logic', 'Data', 'External'];

export function benchScene(n: number, expanded: readonly string[]): Scene {
  const grid: GridSpec = {
    domains: DOMAINS.map((name, i) => ({ id: `d${i}`, name, purpose: 'Synthetic' })),
    layers: LAYERS.map((name, i) => ({ id: `l${i}`, name })),
    cells: Object.fromEntries(DOMAINS.map((_, i) => [`d${i}`, LAYERS.map((__, j) => `l${j}`)])),
  };
  const r = rng(7);
  const files: { id: string; d: number; l: number }[] = [];
  for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) {
    const d = i % 3;
    const l = Math.floor(r() * 4);
    files.push({ id: `src/d${d}/l${l}/file-${String(i).padStart(4, '0')}.ts`, d, l });
  }
  // a few files in the other domains, so collapsed cells have counts
  for (let i = 0; i < 60; i++) files.push({ id: `src/d${3 + (i % 3)}/l${i % 4}/other-${i}.ts`, d: 3 + (i % 3), l: i % 4 });
  files.sort((a, b) => a.id.localeCompare(b.id));
  const open = (d: number) => expanded.includes(domainId(`d${d}`));

  const leafRollup = (i: number) => {
    const x = emptyRollup();
    x.leaves = 1;
    if (i % 11 === 0) { x.edited = true; x.added = 3 + (i % 17); x.removed = i % 5; }
    if (i % 13 === 0) x.looked = true;
    if (i % 29 === 0) x.ghostSteps = [1 + (i % 4)];
    if (i % 41 === 0) { x.violation = 'existing'; x.violationFiles = ['x']; }

  private send(text: string) {
    this.busy = true;
    this.ephemeral({ type: 'busy', busy: true });
    this.inbox.push(text);
  }

  private startTurn(prompt: string) {
    const id = `t${randomUUID().slice(0, 6)}`;
    this.turn = { id, prompt, base: baseline(this.repo.root), planned: false, steps: [], planViolations: [], gateBlocks: [], forkOpen: null, lastText: '' };
    this.bus.turn = id;
    this.bus.emit('turn_started', { prompt, head: this.turn.base.head, baseline: this.turn.base.snapshot });
  }

  approve() {
    if (!this.approval) return;
    const { resolve, input } = this.approval;
    this.approval = null;
    this.bus.emit('plan_approved', {} as never);
    resolve({ behavior: 'allow', updatedInput: input });
    void this.q?.setPermissionMode('acceptEdits');
  }

  private rejectPlan(feedback: string) {
    if (!this.approval) return;
    const { resolve } = this.approval;
    this.approval = null;
    resolve({ behavior: 'deny', message: `The user did not approve the plan yet. Their feedback: ${feedback}` });
  }

  private onPlan(steps: PlanStep[], violations: Violation[]) {
    if (!this.turn) return;
    this.turn.planned = true;
    this.turn.steps = steps;
    this.turn.planViolations = violations;
  }

  private onResult(subtype: string) {
    this.busy = false;
    this.ephemeral({ type: 'busy', busy: false });
    const turn = this.turn;
    if (!turn) return;
    if (subtype !== 'success') this.bus.emit('error', { message: `Turn ended with ${subtype}` });
    const open = [...turn.planViolations, ...turn.gateBlocks];
    if (open.length && subtype === 'success') {
      // Claude stopped to ask: the turn stays open until the user answers.
      turn.forkOpen = open;
      this.bus.emit('fork_asked', { violations: open, text: turn.lastText });
      return;
    }
    this.endTurn(subtype);
  }

  private endTurn(reason: string) {
    const turn = this.turn!;
    const stat = numstat(this.repo.root, turn.base);
    this.bus.emit('turn_ended', { ...stat, reason });
    const events = this.bus.events.filter((e) => e.turn === turn.id);
    writeFileSync(join(this.repo.root, '.harness/turns', `${turn.id}.json`), JSON.stringify({ id: turn.id, prompt: turn.prompt, baseline: turn.base, steps: turn.steps, numstat: stat, events }, null, 2));
    this.turn = null;
    this.bus.turn = null;
    this.repo.recheck();
    void this.q?.setPermissionMode('plan');
  }

// Living map (NAVIGATION_PLAN §4), server side: git history, the cartographer runner, the drift → proposal loop,
// rejection records and inferred labels. The pure engine (scoring, drift, diffs, skeleton) is in @harness/core.
import { scanRepo, skeletonMap, mapToYaml, SKELETON_IGNORE, type DomainMap } from '@harness/core';
import { toFileFacts } from './history';

export { gitHistory, toFileFacts } from './history';
export { sdkProposer, buildPrompt, CANDIDATES_SCHEMA, type Proposer, type ProposeInput, type ProposerResult, type Candidate, type RejectedProposal } from './runner';
export { writeRejection, listRejected, listStanding } from './records';
export { labelsFor, sdkLabeler, type Labeler, type Group } from './labels';
export { attachLivingMap, livingMapRoutes, chooseCandidate, disruption, SIMILAR, type LivingMap, type LivingMapOptions } from './loop';

/** Instant onboarding proposal (no model, < 1 s): the deterministic skeleton map as domains.yaml text. */
export function onboardingSkeleton(root: string): string {
  const bare = { version: 1, layers: [{ id: 'x', name: 'x' }], ignore: SKELETON_IGNORE, domains: [], invariants: [] } as DomainMap;
  const facts = scanRepo(root, bare);
  return mapToYaml(skeletonMap(facts.files, toFileFacts(facts)), '# Instant skeleton (deterministic, no model). The cartographer refines it.\n\n');
}
// The living-map loop (NAVIGATION_PLAN §4.1, §4.3): at every turn end, measure drift deterministically; when a signal
// has persisted and no proposal is pending for its scope, run the cartographer out of band, score its candidates
// against the current map, and queue the best one as a proposal. Never runs while a turn is open; never blocks one.
import { writeFileSync } from 'node:fs';
import { Hono } from 'hono';
import {
  reduce, historyFromUI, detectDrift, thresholdsFor, scoreMap, diffMaps, changeSignature, summarizeChanges, describeScores,
  parseDomainMap, createMapper, PROPOSAL_MARGIN,
  type DomainMap, type DriftSignal, type DriftSignalKind, type FileFacts, type HistoryTurn, type MapProposal, type MapScore, type ProposalChange, type UIState,
} from '@harness/core';
import { commitPaths } from '../git';
import type { Bus } from '../bus';
import type { Repo } from '../repo';
import { gitHistory, toFileFacts } from './history';
import { sdkProposer, type Candidate, type Proposer } from './runner';
import { listRejected, listStanding, writeRejection } from './records';
import { labelsFor, sdkLabeler, type Labeler } from './labels';

/** Signals the cartographer acts on. Stale labels and bloated cells go to the labels job; reinforcement is the auditor's. */
const CARTOGRAPHER_SIGNALS = new Set<DriftSignalKind>(['unassigned', 'new_top_level', 'wide_turns', 'co_change', 'coupling_growth', 'rule_erosion']);

/** Candidates within this much of the best total count as "similar"; among them the least disruptive wins. */
export const SIMILAR = 0.05;

/**
 * How much a change set disturbs what already exists: moved files, removed ids, and edits to existing domains and
 * rules (rename, purpose rewrite, cell/domain removal, rule change/retire). Additions (new domain, new cell, placing
 * unassigned files, new rule) cost nothing: they extend the map rather than rewrite it.
 */
export function disruption(changes: readonly ProposalChange[]): number {
  const added = new Set(changes.flatMap((c) => (c.kind === 'add_domain' ? [c.domain] : [])));
  return changes.filter((c) => {
    if (c.kind === 'purpose') return !added.has(c.domain);
    return ['move', 'rename_domain', 'remove_domain', 'remove_cell', 'retire_rule', 'change_rule'].includes(c.kind);
  }).length;
}

export type LivingMapOptions = {
  bus: Bus;
  repo: Repo;
  proposer?: Proposer | null; // default: the Agent SDK cartographer (null when HARNESS_CARTOGRAPHER=0)
  labeler?: Labeler | null; // default: the Agent SDK labeler (null when HARNESS_LABELS=0)
  k?: number; // candidates per run (default 4, or HARNESS_CARTOGRAPHER_K)
  gitLimit?: number;
};

export type Result = { ok: true; decision?: string } | { ok: false; status: 400 | 404 | 409; error: string };

type Scored = { candidate: Candidate; map: DomainMap; changes: ReturnType<typeof diffMaps>; score: MapScore };

/** Pick the proposal: lowest total; among totals within SIMILAR of it, the least disruptive (then lowest total, then first). Null unless it beats current by the margin. */
export function chooseCandidate(current: MapScore, scored: readonly Pick<Scored, 'changes' | 'score'>[]): number | null {
  if (!scored.length) return null;
  const best = Math.min(...scored.map((s) => s.score.total));
  if (current.total - best < PROPOSAL_MARGIN) return null;
  let pick = -1;
  scored.forEach((s, i) => {
    if (s.score.total > best + SIMILAR) return;
    const p = scored[pick];
    const [a, b] = [disruption(s.changes), p ? disruption(p.changes) : Infinity];
    if (a < b || (a === b && s.score.total < p!.score.total)) pick = i;
  });
  return pick;
}

export function attachLivingMap(opts: LivingMapOptions) {
  const { bus, repo } = opts;
  const proposer = opts.proposer === undefined ? (process.env.HARNESS_CARTOGRAPHER === '0' ? null : sdkProposer) : opts.proposer;
  const labeler = opts.labeler === undefined ? (process.env.HARNESS_LABELS === '0' ? null : sdkLabeler) : opts.labeler;
  const k = opts.k ?? Number(process.env.HARNESS_CARTOGRAPHER_K ?? 4);
  let previous: DriftSignal[] | null = null;
  let queued = false;
  let cartographing = false;
  let labelling = false;
  const work = new Set<Promise<unknown>>();
  const track = <T>(p: Promise<T>) => { work.add(p); const off = () => { work.delete(p); }; p.then(off, off); return p; };

  const ready = () => !!repo.map && repo.hasMap();
  const facts = (): Record<string, FileFacts> => toFileFacts(repo.facts);
  const history = (ui: UIState): HistoryTurn[] => [...gitHistory(repo.root, opts.gitLimit), ...historyFromUI(ui)];

  /** Ids plus the domains they live in (files and cells), so scopes can be compared at domain granularity. */
  const expand = (ids: readonly string[]) => {
    const out = new Set(ids);
    for (const id of ids) {
      const cell = /^cell:([^/]+)\//.exec(id);
      if (cell) out.add(`domain:${cell[1]}`);
      else if (!id.includes(':')) { const d = repo.mapper.domainOf(id); if (d) out.add(`domain:${d}`); }
    }
    return out;
  };

  /** Measure drift now (or queue until the open turn ends), then start the cartographer / labels jobs if warranted. */
  function survey(): void {
    if (!ready()) return;
    if (bus.turn) { queued = true; return; }
    queued = false;
    const ui = reduce(bus.events);
    previous ??= ui.drift;
    const f = facts();
    const hist = history(ui);
    const t = thresholdsFor(repo.map);
    const signals = detectDrift(repo.map, f, ui, hist, t, previous);
    previous = signals;
    bus.emit('drift_detected', { signals }, { turn: null });

    const pending = Object.values(ui.proposals).filter((p) => p.status === 'pending').map((p) => expand(p.proposal.scope));
    const triggers = signals.filter((s) => CARTOGRAPHER_SIGNALS.has(s.signal) && s.persisted >= t.persist && !pending.some((ps) => [...expand(s.scope)].some((id) => ps.has(id))));
    if (triggers.length && proposer && !cartographing) {
      cartographing = true;
      track(cartograph(triggers, ui, f, hist)
        .catch((e: Error) => { bus.emit('error', { message: `Cartographer run failed: ${e.message}` }, { turn: null }); })
        .finally(() => { cartographing = false; }));
    }

    const stale = signals.find((s) => s.signal === 'stale_label')?.scope.flatMap((target) => {
      const pl = repo.place(target);
      return pl.kind === 'cell' && ui.labels[`group:${target}`] ? [`cell:${pl.domain}/${pl.layer}`] : [];
    }) ?? [];
    const cells = [...signals.filter((s) => s.signal === 'bloated_cell' && s.persisted >= t.persist).flatMap((s) => s.scope), ...stale];
    if (cells.length && labeler && !labelling) {
      labelling = true;
      track(label(cells).finally(() => { labelling = false; }));
    }
  }

  async function cartograph(triggers: DriftSignal[], ui: UIState, f: Record<string, FileFacts>, hist: HistoryTurn[]) {
    const t0 = Date.now();
    const base = repo.map, baseYaml = repo.mapText;
    const trigger = [...new Set(triggers.map((s) => s.signal))].join(',');
    const done = (ok: boolean, cost: number | null) => bus.emit('maintenance_run', { agent: 'cartographer', trigger, ms: Date.now() - t0, cost, ok }, { turn: null });

    // Scope: trigger scopes, their domains, and one hop along import edges.
    const scope = expand(triggers.flatMap((s) => s.scope));
    const mapper = createMapper(base);
    const hop = new Set<string>();
    for (const file of Object.values(f)) for (const imp of file.imports) {
      const a = mapper.domainOf(file.path), b = mapper.domainOf(imp.to);
      if (a && b && a !== b && (scope.has(`domain:${a}`) || scope.has(file.path))) hop.add(`domain:${b}`);
      if (a && b && a !== b && (scope.has(`domain:${b}`) || scope.has(imp.to))) hop.add(`domain:${a}`);
      if (!a && b && scope.has(file.path)) hop.add(`domain:${b}`); // unassigned file importing a domain
    }
    const fullScope = [...new Set([...scope, ...hop])].sort();
    const standing = listStanding(repo.root);
    const rejected = listRejected(repo.root);

    let result;
    try {
      result = await proposer!({
        root: repo.root, yaml: baseYaml, map: base, facts: f, signals: triggers, scope: fullScope, history: hist,
        turns: ui.turns.map((x) => ({ id: x.id, prompt: x.prompt, files: Object.keys(x.paths).filter((p) => x.paths[p]!.edits > 0).sort() })).filter((x) => x.files.length),
        decisions: standing, rejected, k,
      });
    } catch (e) {
      bus.emit('error', { message: `Cartographer failed: ${(e as Error).message}` }, { turn: null });
      return void done(false, (e as { cost?: number }).cost ?? null);
    }
    if (repo.mapText !== baseYaml) return void done(false, result.cost); // the map changed while it ran: stale

    const files = Object.keys(f);
    const seen = new Set(rejected.map((r) => r.signature));
    const scored: Scored[] = [];
    const decisionPaths = Object.fromEntries(standing.filter((d) => d.paths.length).map((d) => [d.id, d.paths]));
    for (const candidate of result.candidates.slice(0, k)) {
      let map: DomainMap;
      try { map = parseDomainMap(candidate.yaml); } catch { continue; } // invalid YAML or schema: dropped
      const changes = diffMaps(base, map, files);
      const sig = changeSignature(changes);
      if (!changes.length || seen.has(sig)) continue; // no-op, a repeat of a rejected proposal, or a duplicate
      seen.add(sig);
      scored.push({ candidate, map, changes, score: scoreMap(map, f, hist, { current: base, decisionPaths }) });
    }
    const current = scoreMap(base, f, hist, { current: base, decisionPaths });
    const chosen = chooseCandidate(current, scored);
    if (chosen === null) return void done(true, result.cost);

    const best = scored[chosen]!;
    const n = Math.max(0, ...Object.keys(reduce(bus.events).proposals).map((id) => Number(/^MP-(\d+)$/.exec(id)?.[1] ?? 0))) + 1;
    const touched = best.changes.flatMap((c): string[] => (c.kind === 'move' ? [`domain:${c.from.domain}`, `domain:${c.to.domain}`] : 'domain' in c ? [`domain:${c.domain}`] : []));
    const proposal: MapProposal = {
      id: `MP-${n}`,
      trigger: triggers,
      scope: [...new Set([...scope, ...touched])].sort(),
      candidates: scored.map((s) => ({ yaml: s.candidate.yaml, score: s.score })),
      chosen,
      current,
      changes: best.changes,
      rationale: `${best.candidate.title} ${best.candidate.rationale}`.trim(),
    };
    bus.emit('map_proposed', { map: base, yaml: baseYaml, proposal }, { turn: null });
    bus.emit('chat', { role: 'system', text: `Cartographer proposal ${proposal.id}: ${summarizeChanges(best.changes)} · ${describeScores(current, best.score)}` }, { turn: null });
    done(true, result.cost);
  }

  async function label(cells: string[]) {
    const t0 = Date.now();
    try {
      const r = await labelsFor({ root: repo.root, map: repo.map, facts: facts(), cells, labeler: labeler! });
      if (r.labels.length) bus.emit('labels_updated', { labels: r.labels }, { turn: null });
      if (r.calls) bus.emit('maintenance_run', { agent: 'cartographer', trigger: 'labels', ms: Date.now() - t0, cost: r.cost, ok: true }, { turn: null });
    } catch (e) {
      bus.emit('maintenance_run', { agent: 'cartographer', trigger: 'labels', ms: Date.now() - t0, cost: null, ok: false }, { turn: null });
      bus.emit('error', { message: `Labels failed: ${(e as Error).message}` }, { turn: null });
    }
  }

  const pendingProposal = (id: string): { proposal: MapProposal; yaml: string } | Result => {
    const p = reduce(bus.events).proposals[id];
    if (!p) return { ok: false, status: 404, error: `No proposal ${id}.` };
    if (p.status !== 'pending') return { ok: false, status: 409, error: `${id} is already ${p.status}.` };
    const at = bus.events.findLast((e) => e.kind === 'map_proposed' && (e.data as { proposal?: MapProposal }).proposal?.id === id);
    return { proposal: p.proposal, yaml: (at?.data as { yaml: string }).yaml };
  };

  /** Accept: write and commit domains.yaml (only it), reload the map, rescan, emit map_confirmed + resolved. */
  function accept(id: string, candidate?: number): Result {
    const p = pendingProposal(id);
    if ('ok' in p) return p;
    if (p.yaml !== repo.mapText) return { ok: false, status: 409, error: `domains.yaml changed since ${id} was proposed; run a survey for a fresh proposal.` };
    const idx = candidate ?? p.proposal.chosen;
    const yaml = p.proposal.candidates[idx]?.yaml;
    if (!yaml) return { ok: false, status: 400, error: `${id} has no candidate ${idx}.` };
    writeFileSync(repo.mapPath, yaml);
    try { commitPaths(repo.root, ['domains.yaml'], `docs(map): accept ${id}: ${summarizeChanges(diffMaps(repo.map, parseDomainMap(yaml), Object.keys(facts())))}`.slice(0, 100)); }
    catch (e) { bus.emit('error', { message: `Could not commit domains.yaml: ${(e as Error).message}` }, { turn: null }); }
    repo.setMap(yaml);
    bus.emit('map_confirmed', { map: repo.map, source: 'cartographer' }, { turn: null });
    repo.scan();
    bus.emit('map_proposal_resolved', { proposal: id, outcome: 'accepted' }, { turn: null });
    schedule();
    return { ok: true };
  }

  /** Reject: record decisions/DR-n.md (status: rejected) and commit only it; the cartographer is told never to repeat it. */
  function reject(id: string, reason?: string): Result {
    const p = pendingProposal(id);
    if ('ok' in p) return p;
    const { id: decision, path } = writeRejection(repo.root, repo.map, p.proposal, reason);
    try { commitPaths(repo.root, [path], `docs(decisions): ${decision} reject map proposal ${id}`); }
    catch (e) { bus.emit('error', { message: `Could not commit ${path}: ${(e as Error).message}` }, { turn: null }); }
    bus.emit('map_proposal_resolved', { proposal: id, outcome: 'rejected', decision }, { turn: null });
    return { ok: true, decision };
  }

  /** Survey on the next tick (after the emitter has finished closing the turn). */
  function schedule() {
    track(new Promise<void>((resolve) => setImmediate(() => {
      try { survey(); }
      catch (e) { bus.emit('error', { message: `Living map survey failed: ${(e as Error).message}` }, { turn: null }); }
      finally { resolve(); }
    })));
  }

  const off = bus.on((e) => {
    if (e.kind === 'turn_ended') schedule();
  });

  return {
    /** Survey now, or (while a turn is open) at its end. */
    survey() { schedule(); return { queued: !!bus.turn }; },
    accept,
    reject,
    get queued() { return queued; },
    /** Resolves once no survey, cartographer or labels job is in flight (for tests and shutdown). */
    async idle() { while (work.size) await Promise.allSettled([...work]); },
    detach: off,
  };
}

export type LivingMap = ReturnType<typeof attachLivingMap>;

/** HTTP endpoints, mounted under /api by the server. */
export function livingMapRoutes(lm: LivingMap) {
  const r = new Hono();
  const reply = (c: { json: (b: unknown, s?: 200 | 400 | 404 | 409) => Response }, res: Result) => (res.ok ? c.json(res) : c.json({ error: res.error }, res.status));
  r.post('/proposals/:id/accept', async (c) => {
    const body = await c.req.json<{ candidate?: number }>().catch(() => ({} as { candidate?: number }));
    return reply(c, lm.accept(c.req.param('id'), body.candidate));
  });
  r.post('/proposals/:id/reject', async (c) => {
    const body = await c.req.json<{ reason?: string }>().catch(() => ({} as { reason?: string }));
    return reply(c, lm.reject(c.req.param('id'), body.reason));
  });
  r.post('/living-map/survey', (c) => c.json({ ok: true, ...lm.survey() }));
  return r;
}
// The cartographer agent (NAVIGATION_PLAN §4.5): a separate, read-only Agent SDK session that proposes K candidate
// domains.yaml maps for a set of drift signals. It never edits anything and never blocks the coding session; the
// loop scores its candidates deterministically. The model call is behind `Proposer` so tests inject a fake.
import { query } from '@anthropic-ai/claude-agent-sdk';
import { createMapper, type DomainMap, type DriftSignal, type FileFacts, type HistoryTurn, type ProposalChange } from '@harness/core';

export type RejectedProposal = { decision: string; proposal: string; summary: string; changes: ProposalChange[]; signature: string };
export type StandingDecision = { id: string; title: string; outcome: string; rationale: string; invariant: string; paths: string[] };

export type ProposeInput = {
  root: string;
  yaml: string; // current domains.yaml text
  map: DomainMap;
  facts: Readonly<Record<string, FileFacts>>;
  signals: DriftSignal[]; // the persisted signals that triggered this run
  scope: string[]; // node ids: trigger scopes plus the affected domains and one hop
  history: readonly HistoryTurn[];
  turns: { id: string; prompt: string; files: string[] }[]; // recent Harness turns
  decisions: StandingDecision[];
  rejected: RejectedProposal[]; // never propose these again
  k: number;
};
export type Candidate = { title: string; rationale: string; yaml: string };
export type ProposerResult = { candidates: Candidate[]; cost: number | null };
export type Proposer = (input: ProposeInput) => Promise<ProposerResult>;

export const CANDIDATES_SCHEMA = {
  type: 'object',
  additionalProperties: false,
  required: ['candidates'],
  properties: {
    candidates: {
      type: 'array',
      items: {
        type: 'object',
        additionalProperties: false,
        required: ['title', 'rationale', 'yaml'],
        properties: {
          title: { type: 'string', description: 'One line, e.g. "Add a Billing domain for src/billing/".' },
          rationale: { type: 'string', description: 'Two or three sentences: what changes and why it fixes the signals.' },
          yaml: { type: 'string', description: 'The COMPLETE domains.yaml text for this candidate (not a diff).' },
        },
      },
    },
  },
} as const;

/** Co-changed file pairs across the history (top 10), for the prompt. */
function coChange(history: readonly HistoryTurn[], known: Set<string>): string[] {
  const pairs = new Map<string, number>();
  for (const u of history.slice(-50)) {
    const fs = u.files.filter((f) => known.has(f)).sort();
    if (fs.length > 12) continue;
    for (let i = 0; i < fs.length; i++) for (let j = i + 1; j < fs.length; j++) pairs.set(`${fs[i]} + ${fs[j]}`, (pairs.get(`${fs[i]} + ${fs[j]}`) ?? 0) + 1);
  }
  return [...pairs].filter(([, n]) => n > 1).sort(([a, x], [b, y]) => y - x || a.localeCompare(b)).slice(0, 10).map(([k, n]) => `${k} (${n}×)`);
}

/** The cartographer's prompt: rules, signals, scoped facts, recent turns, decisions, rejected proposals, current map. */
export function buildPrompt(input: ProposeInput): string {
  const mapper = createMapper(input.map);
  const scopeDomains = new Set(input.scope.filter((s) => s.startsWith('domain:')).map((s) => s.slice(7)));
  const scopeIds = new Set(input.scope);
  const inScope = (p: string) => {
    const pl = mapper.place(p);
    return scopeIds.has(p) || pl.kind === 'unassigned' || ((pl.kind === 'cell' || pl.kind === 'test') && scopeDomains.has(pl.domain));
  };
  const files = Object.values(input.facts).filter((f) => inScope(f.path)).sort((a, b) => a.path.localeCompare(b.path));
  const where = (p: string) => { const pl = mapper.place(p); return pl.kind === 'cell' ? `${pl.domain}/${pl.layer}` : pl.kind === 'test' ? `${pl.domain} tests` : pl.kind; };
  const together = coChange(input.history, new Set(Object.keys(input.facts)));
  const counts = new Map<string, number>();
  for (const p of Object.keys(input.facts)) counts.set(where(p), (counts.get(where(p)) ?? 0) + 1);

  return [
    'You are the cartographer for this repo\'s architecture map, `domains.yaml` (domains are columns, layers are rows; files are placed by path globs).',
    `Deterministic drift signals have fired. Propose up to ${input.k} DIFFERENT candidate maps that would fix them. Each candidate is the complete new domains.yaml.`,
    'Your candidates are scored by code, not by you: cells lit per past turn/commit (fewer is better), import-graph modularity by domain, unassigned files, evenness of cell sizes, decisions broken, and churn (files moved, ids removed).',
    '',
    '## Rules',
    '- Change as little as possible. Start from the current domains.yaml text and keep everything you do not need to change (comments, ids, order, invariants, exceptions, decisions, cartography settings).',
    '- A rename keeps the `id`; change only `name`. Prefer placing or moving files over re-cutting domains. Never remove an invariant that lists `decisions` or exceptions with a `decision`.',
    '- New domains: lowercase id, product-language name (1–3 words), a one-line purpose. When a folder sits in one cell, use a folder glob (e.g. `src/billing/**`) so later files land there.',
    '- A table belongs to exactly one cell\'s `tables` (the domain that writes it). Every `owns_writes` owner, `only_via.allowed_from` and `no_edge` endpoint must name an existing domain id. Layers must exist in `layers`.',
    '- Make the candidates genuinely different from each other (e.g. a new domain vs. placing the files in an existing domain vs. a different split).',
    '- NEVER propose a change the user already rejected (listed below), nor one with the same effect.',
    '- You may Read/Grep/Glob files to understand purposes. Do not modify anything.',
    '',
    '## Signals',
    ...input.signals.map((s) => `- ${s.signal}: ${s.metric} = ${s.value} (threshold ${s.threshold}, held ${s.persisted} turns) · scope: ${s.scope.join(', ')}`),
    '',
    `## Scope (affected domains plus one hop): ${input.scope.join(', ')}`,
    '',
    '## Files in scope (placement · imports · table writes)',
    ...files.map((f) => {
      const imports = f.imports.map((i) => i.to).filter((t) => !t.startsWith('vendor:'));
      return `- ${f.path} [${where(f.path)}]${imports.length ? ` → ${imports.join(', ')}` : ''}${f.writes.length ? ` · writes ${[...new Set(f.writes.map((w) => w.table))].join(', ')}` : ''}`;
    }),
    '',
    '## File counts per placement (whole repo)',
    ...[...counts].sort(([a], [b]) => a.localeCompare(b)).map(([k, n]) => `- ${k}: ${n}`),
    '',
    '## Recent turns (prompt → files edited)',
    ...(input.turns.length ? input.turns.slice(-10).map((t) => `- ${t.id}: "${t.prompt.slice(0, 160)}" → ${t.files.join(', ')}`) : ['(none)']),
    '',
    '## Files that often change together',
    ...(together.length ? together.map((x) => `- ${x}`) : ['(none)']),
    '',
    '## Standing decisions (do not break them)',
    ...(input.decisions.length ? input.decisions.map((d) => `- ${d.id}${d.invariant ? ` (on ${d.invariant})` : ''}: ${d.title}. Outcome: ${d.outcome}. Governs: ${d.paths.join(', ') || '-'}`) : ['(none)']),
    '',
    '## Proposals the user REJECTED (never propose these again)',
    ...(input.rejected.length ? input.rejected.map((r) => `- ${r.proposal} (${r.decision}): ${r.summary}\n  changes: ${JSON.stringify(r.changes)}`) : ['(none)']),
    '',
    '## Current domains.yaml',
    '```yaml',
    input.yaml.trimEnd(),
    '```',
  ].join('\n');
}

/**
 * The real proposer: a read-only Agent SDK query on the strongest model at high effort, with structured output.
 * Model: `HARNESS_CARTOGRAPHER_MODEL` (default `claude-opus-5-5`).
 */
export const sdkProposer: Proposer = async (input) => {
  const q = query({
    prompt: buildPrompt(input),
    options: {
      cwd: input.root,
      model: process.env.HARNESS_CARTOGRAPHER_MODEL ?? 'claude-opus-5-5',
      effort: 'high',
      tools: ['Read', 'Grep', 'Glob'],
      allowedTools: ['Read', 'Grep', 'Glob'],
      permissionMode: 'dontAsk',
      settingSources: [],
      strictMcpConfig: true,
      outputFormat: { type: 'json_schema', schema: CANDIDATES_SCHEMA as unknown as Record<string, unknown> },
      maxTurns: 30,
    },
  });
  for await (const m of q) {
    if (m.type !== 'result') continue;
    if (m.subtype !== 'success' || !m.structured_output) throw Object.assign(new Error(`cartographer ${m.subtype}`), { cost: m.total_cost_usd });
    const out = m.structured_output as { candidates?: Candidate[] };
    return { candidates: (out.candidates ?? []).slice(0, input.k), cost: m.total_cost_usd };
  }
  throw new Error('cartographer returned no result');
};
