// Node-side inputs for the living map: git commits as history units, and per-file facts from a repo scan.
import { git } from '../git';
import type { Facts, FileFacts, HistoryTurn } from '@harness/core';

const HARNESS_OWN = (p: string) => p === 'domains.yaml' || p.startsWith('decisions/') || p.startsWith('.harness/');
const CODE = /\.(ts|tsx|js|jsx|mjs|cjs|mts)$/;

/** The last `limit` non-merge commits, oldest first, as history units (`git log --name-only`). Harness's own files are dropped. */
export function gitHistory(root: string, limit = 200): HistoryTurn[] {
  let out: string;
  try { out = git(root, ['log', `-n${limit}`, '--no-merges', '--name-only', '--format=%x00%H']); }
  catch { return []; } // not a repo, or no commits yet
  const units: HistoryTurn[] = [];
  for (const chunk of out.split('\0')) {
    const [sha, ...rest] = chunk.trim().split('\n');
    if (!sha) continue;
    const files = rest.map((f) => f.trim()).filter((f) => f && !HARNESS_OWN(f));
    if (files.length) units.push({ id: `commit:${sha.slice(0, 10)}`, source: 'commit', files: [...new Set(files)].sort() });
  }
  return units.reverse();
}

/** Tier-1-lite FileFacts (imports and writes only) for every code file of a scan, until the Facts lane emits real ones. */
export function toFileFacts(facts: Facts): Record<string, FileFacts> {
  const out: Record<string, FileFacts> = {};
  for (const path of facts.files) {
    if (CODE.test(path)) out[path] = { path, hash: '', imports: [], writes: [], symbols: [], calls: [], routes: [], entries: [] };
  }
  for (const i of facts.imports) out[i.from]?.imports.push({ to: i.to, typeOnly: false });
  for (const w of facts.writes) out[w.file]?.writes.push({ table: w.table, symbol: null, via: 'db' });
  return out;
}
// Inferred sub-group labels for bloated cells (NAVIGATION_PLAN §4.5): applied automatically, marked inferred,
// cached under .harness/labels/<hash>.json keyed by the cell's file set, regenerated only when that set changes.
import { existsSync, mkdirSync, readFileSync, writeFileSync } from 'node:fs';
import { join } from 'node:path';
import { query } from '@anthropic-ai/claude-agent-sdk';
import { cellFiles, createMapper, groupHash, type DomainMap, type FileFacts, type Label } from '@harness/core';

export type Group = { name: string; files: string[] };
export type LabelerInput = { root: string; cell: string; files: string[]; facts: Readonly<Record<string, FileFacts>> };
export type Labeler = (input: LabelerInput) => Promise<{ groups: Group[]; cost: number | null }>;

const GROUPS_SCHEMA = {
  type: 'object', additionalProperties: false, required: ['groups'],
  properties: {
    groups: {
      type: 'array',
      items: { type: 'object', additionalProperties: false, required: ['name', 'files'], properties: { name: { type: 'string' }, files: { type: 'array', items: { type: 'string' } } } },
    },
  },
} as const;

/** Real labeler: a small, tool-less structured query. Model: `HARNESS_LABELER_MODEL` (default `claude-haiku-5-5`). */
export const sdkLabeler: Labeler = async ({ root, cell, files, facts }) => {
  const lines = files.map((f) => `- ${f}${facts[f]?.symbols.length ? `: ${facts[f]!.symbols.map((s) => s.name).join(', ')}` : ''}${facts[f]?.imports.length ? ` (imports ${facts[f]!.imports.map((i) => i.to).join(', ')})` : ''}`);
  const q = query({
    prompt: [
      `The architecture-map cell ${cell} holds ${files.length} files. Split them into 3–7 sub-groups by purpose, with short product-language names (1–3 words).`,
      'Every file goes in exactly one group. Use the exact paths given.', '', ...lines,
    ].join('\n'),
    options: {
      cwd: root, model: process.env.HARNESS_LABELER_MODEL ?? 'claude-haiku-5-5', tools: [], settingSources: [], strictMcpConfig: true,
      outputFormat: { type: 'json_schema', schema: GROUPS_SCHEMA as unknown as Record<string, unknown> }, maxTurns: 3,
    },
  });
  for await (const m of q) {
    if (m.type !== 'result') continue;
    if (m.subtype !== 'success' || !m.structured_output) throw new Error(`labeler ${m.subtype}`);
    return { groups: (m.structured_output as { groups: Group[] }).groups, cost: m.total_cost_usd };
  }
  throw new Error('labeler returned no result');
};

/**
 * Group labels for `cells` (`cell:<domain>/<layer>` ids): one `group` Label per file, its text the sub-group name.
 * Cached by the cell's file-set hash; the labeler runs only on a cache miss.
 */
export async function labelsFor(opts: { root: string; map: DomainMap; facts: Readonly<Record<string, FileFacts>>; cells: string[]; labeler: Labeler }) {
  const mapper = createMapper(opts.map);
  const dir = join(opts.root, '.harness', 'labels');
  mkdirSync(dir, { recursive: true });
  const labels: Label[] = [];
  let cost = 0, calls = 0;
  for (const cell of [...new Set(opts.cells)].sort()) {
    const m = /^cell:([^/]+)\/(.+)$/.exec(cell);
    if (!m) continue;
    const files = cellFiles(mapper, opts.facts, m[1]!, m[2]!);
    if (!files.length) continue;
    const hash = groupHash(files);
    const file = join(dir, `${hash}.json`);
    let groups: Group[];
    if (existsSync(file)) groups = (JSON.parse(readFileSync(file, 'utf8')) as { groups: Group[] }).groups;
    else {
      const r = await opts.labeler({ root: opts.root, cell, files, facts: opts.facts });
      calls++;
      cost += r.cost ?? 0;
      groups = r.groups;
      writeFileSync(file, JSON.stringify({ cell, files, groups }, null, 2));
    }
    const inCell = new Set(files);
    for (const g of groups) for (const f of g.files) if (inCell.has(f)) labels.push({ target: f, kind: 'group', text: g.name, hash, confirmed: false });
  }
  return { labels, cost, calls };
}
// Rejected proposals are decisions (NAVIGATION_PLAN §4.5): decisions/DR-n.md with `status: rejected`, so the
// cartographer never proposes the same change again. Same file format and id sequence as fork decisions.
import { mkdirSync, writeFileSync } from 'node:fs';
import { join } from 'node:path';
import { stringify as stringifyYaml } from 'yaml';
import { nextDecisionId, summarizeChanges, changeSignature, describeScores, type MapProposal, type ProposalChange } from '@harness/core';
import { listDecisions } from '../decisions';
import type { RejectedProposal, StandingDecision } from './runner';

/** Paths a proposal touches (placed or moved files), for the decision's anchors. */
function touchedPaths(changes: readonly ProposalChange[]): string[] {
  return [...new Set(changes.flatMap((c) => (c.kind === 'place' || c.kind === 'move' ? [c.path] : [])))].sort();
}

/** Write decisions/DR-n.md recording the rejection; returns its id and repo-relative path. Does not commit. */
import { writeFileSync } from 'node:fs';
import { join } from 'node:path';
import { randomUUID } from 'node:crypto';
import {
  query, type Query, type SDKUserMessage, type HookCallback, type PreToolUseHookInput, type PostToolUseHookInput,
  type CanUseTool, type PermissionResult, type McpServerConfig,
} from '@anthropic-ai/claude-agent-sdk';
import { applyEdit, deltaForEdit, check, withExtra, type PlanStep, type Violation, type EventData } from '@harness/core';
import { harnessTools, violationText, ASK_RULE } from './harness-tools';
import { listDecisions, parseOption, recordFork } from './decisions';
import { baseline, numstat, type Baseline } from './git';
import type { Repo } from './repo';
import type { Bus } from './bus';

const PLAN_RULES = [
  'Explore read-only, briefly. Then, before editing anything, call mcp__harness__submit_plan with numbered steps.',
  'Each step lists the exact repo-relative file paths it will create or modify, and every new import it adds as { from: path, to: path }.',
  'If the result contains violations: ' + ASK_RULE,
  'After the user answers, resubmit the plan with mcp__harness__submit_plan, then call ExitPlanMode.',
  'If there are no violations, call ExitPlanMode with a short plan.',
].join('\n');

/** Push-based prompt stream fed by the chat pane. */
class Inbox implements AsyncIterable<SDKUserMessage> {
  private queue: SDKUserMessage[] = [];
  private wake: (() => void) | null = null;
  push(text: string) {
    this.queue.push({ type: 'user', message: { role: 'user', content: text }, parent_tool_use_id: null });
    this.wake?.();
  }
  async *[Symbol.asyncIterator]() {
    while (true) {
      while (this.queue.length) yield this.queue.shift()!;
      await new Promise<void>((r) => (this.wake = r));
      this.wake = null;
    }
  }
}

type Turn = {
  id: string;
  prompt: string;
  base: Baseline;
  planned: boolean;
  steps: PlanStep[];
  planViolations: Violation[]; // from the latest submit_plan
  gateBlocks: Violation[]; // since the last answer
  forkOpen: Violation[] | null; // asked, awaiting the user's A/B
  lastText: string;
};

/** If a shell command writes a file inside the repo, a short description of how; otherwise null. */
export function bashWriteTarget(cmd: string, rel: (p: string) => string | null): string | null {
  const inRepo = (p: string) => !!p && !p.startsWith('/dev/') && rel(p.replace(/^['"]|['"]$/g, '')) !== null;
  // Redirects to a file: `> f`, `>> f`, `cat <<EOF > f` (not 2>&1, >&2, >/dev/null).
  for (const m of cmd.matchAll(/(?:^|[^0-9&>])>>?\s*([^\s;&|<>()]+)/g)) if (!m[1]!.startsWith('&') && inRepo(m[1]!)) return `redirect to ${m[1]}`;
  for (const m of cmd.matchAll(/\btee\s+(?:-a\s+)?([^\s;&|<>()]+)/g)) if (inRepo(m[1]!)) return `tee ${m[1]}`;
  if (/\b(sed|perl)\s+(-[a-zA-Z]*\s+)*-[a-zA-Z]*i/.test(cmd)) return 'in-place edit';
  if (/\b(python3?|node|ruby|perl|deno|bun)\b[\s\S]*(open\([^)]*['"][wa]\+?['"]|write_text|writeFileSync|appendFileSync|\.write\(|fs\.write)/.test(cmd)) return 'script that writes files';
  return null;
}

export type Ephemeral = (msg: { type: 'delta'; text: string } | { type: 'busy'; busy: boolean }) => void;

export class Session {
  private inbox = new Inbox();
  private q: Query | null = null;
  private turn: Turn | null = null;
  private approval: { resolve: (r: PermissionResult) => void; input: Record<string, unknown> } | null = null;
  private notes: string[] = [];
  busy = false;

  constructor(private repo: Repo, private bus: Bus, private ephemeral: Ephemeral) {}

  brief(): string {
    const m = this.repo.map;
    const domains = m.domains.map((d) => {
      const cells = Object.entries(d.cells).map(([layer, c]) => `    ${layer}: ${[...(c.paths ?? []), ...(c.tables ?? []).map((t) => `table ${t}`)].join(', ')}`);
      return `- ${d.name} (${d.id}): ${d.purpose}\n${cells.join('\n')}`;
    });
    // Rejected map proposals are cartographer memory, not standing decisions for the coding agent.
    const decisions = listDecisions(this.repo.root).filter((d) => d.status !== 'rejected').map((d) =>
      `- ${d.id}: ${d.title}\n  Outcome: ${d.outcome}\n  Rejected: ${d.rejected}\n  ${d.rationale.replace(/\n+/g, '\n  ')}`);
    // Seeded invariants are deliberately not listed (SPEC §6): they are enforced at plan and edit time.
    return [
      '# Harness',
      'You are working inside Harness, which shows the user a live domain × layer map of this repo and checks every plan and edit against its architecture rules.',
      '',
      '## Map (domains.yaml)',
      `Layers: ${m.layers.map((l) => l.id).join(', ')}`,
      ...domains,
      '',
      '## Standing decisions the user has made',
      decisions.length ? decisions.join('\n') : '(none yet)',
      '',
      '## Rules',
      PLAN_RULES,
      'Change files only with the Edit and Write tools, never through Bash (no heredocs, `sed -i` or scripts that write files): Harness checks each Edit/Write against the rules.',
      'If an edit is denied with options A and B: ' + ASK_RULE,
    ].join('\n');
  }

  start() {
    const alike: Record<string, McpServerConfig> = process.env.HARNESS_ALIKE === '0' ? {} : { alike: { type: 'http', url: 'https://alike.network/api-general/mcp' } };
    this.q = query({
      prompt: this.inbox,
      options: {
        cwd: this.repo.root,
        permissionMode: 'plan',
        planModeInstructions: PLAN_RULES,
        // User settings carry Alike's own hooks (network calls); keep the hot path deterministic. See VERIFY.md.
        settingSources: ['project', 'local'],
        strictMcpConfig: true,
        systemPrompt: { type: 'preset', preset: 'claude_code', append: this.brief() },
        mcpServers: {
          harness: harnessTools(this.repo, this.bus, {
            onPlan: (steps, violations) => this.onPlan(steps, violations),
            takeNotes: () => this.notes.splice(0),
          }),
          ...alike,
        },
        // No allowedTools: canUseTool approves everything except ExitPlanMode, which waits for the user.
        disallowedTools: ['AskUserQuestion'],
        includePartialMessages: true,
        hooks: {
          PreToolUse: [
            { matcher: 'Read|Grep|Glob', hooks: [this.observeRead] },
            { matcher: 'Bash', hooks: [this.observeBash, this.gateBash] },
            { matcher: 'Edit|Write', hooks: [this.gate] },
          ],
          PostToolUse: [
            { matcher: 'Edit|Write', hooks: [this.afterEdit] },
            { matcher: 'mcp__alike__record_decision', hooks: [this.afterAlike] },
          ],
        },
        canUseTool: this.canUseTool,
        stderr: (d) => { if (process.env.HARNESS_DEBUG) process.stderr.write(d); },
      },
    });
    void this.loop();
  }

  private async loop() {
    try {
      for await (const m of this.q!) {
        if (m.type === 'stream_event') {
          const ev = m.event as { type: string; delta?: { type: string; text?: string } };
          if (ev.type === 'content_block_delta' && ev.delta?.type === 'text_delta' && ev.delta.text) this.ephemeral({ type: 'delta', text: ev.delta.text });
        } else if (m.type === 'assistant' && !m.parent_tool_use_id) {
          const t = m.message.content.filter((b) => b.type === 'text').map((b) => (b as { text: string }).text).join('\n').trim();
          if (t) {
            this.bus.emit('chat', { role: 'assistant', text: t });
            if (this.turn) this.turn.lastText = t;
          }
        } else if (m.type === 'result') {
          this.onResult(m.subtype);
        }
      }
    } catch (e) {
      this.bus.emit('error', { message: `Session ended: ${(e as Error).message}` });
    }
  }

  // ---------------------------------------------------------------- chat input

  userMessage(text: string) {
    const t = text.trim();
    if (!t) return;
    if (this.approval) {
      this.bus.emit('chat', { role: 'user', text: t });
      if (/^(approve|approved|lgtm|yes|ok|go|ship it)\b/i.test(t)) this.approve();
      else this.rejectPlan(t);
      return;
    }
    if (this.turn?.forkOpen) {
      const violations = this.turn.forkOpen;
      const option = parseOption(t);
      this.bus.emit('chat', { role: 'user', text: t });
      this.bus.emit('fork_answered', { option, text: t, violations });
      this.turn.forkOpen = null;
      this.turn.planViolations = [];
      this.turn.gateBlocks = [];
      const { decisions, alikeInstruction } = recordFork(this.repo, this.bus, violations, option, t, this.turn.prompt);
      if (alikeInstruction && process.env.HARNESS_ALIKE !== '0') this.notes.push(alikeInstruction);
      const ids = decisions.map((d) => d.id).join(', ');
      this.send(`${t}\n\n[Harness: recorded as ${ids || 'a decision'} in decisions/ and domains.yaml. ` +
        (option === 'B' ? `${violations[0]?.file} is now an exception. ` : '') +
        'Resubmit the plan with mcp__harness__submit_plan, then exit plan mode.]');
      return;
    }
    if (!this.turn) this.startTurn(t);
    this.bus.emit('chat', { role: 'user', text: t });
    this.send(t);
  }

  private send(text: string) {
    this.busy = true;
    this.ephemeral({ type: 'busy', busy: true });
    this.inbox.push(text);
  }

  private startTurn(prompt: string) {
    const id = `t${randomUUID().slice(0, 6)}`;
    this.turn = { id, prompt, base: baseline(this.repo.root), planned: false, steps: [], planViolations: [], gateBlocks: [], forkOpen: null, lastText: '' };
    this.bus.turn = id;
    this.bus.emit('turn_started', { prompt, head: this.turn.base.head, baseline: this.turn.base.snapshot });
  }

  approve() {
    if (!this.approval) return;
    const { resolve, input } = this.approval;
    this.approval = null;
    this.bus.emit('plan_approved', {} as never);
    resolve({ behavior: 'allow', updatedInput: input });
    void this.q?.setPermissionMode('acceptEdits');
  }

  private rejectPlan(feedback: string) {
    if (!this.approval) return;
    const { resolve } = this.approval;
    this.approval = null;
    resolve({ behavior: 'deny', message: `The user did not approve the plan yet. Their feedback: ${feedback}` });
  }

  private onPlan(steps: PlanStep[], violations: Violation[]) {
    if (!this.turn) return;
    this.turn.planned = true;
    this.turn.steps = steps;
    this.turn.planViolations = violations;
  }

  private onResult(subtype: string) {
    this.busy = false;
    this.ephemeral({ type: 'busy', busy: false });
    const turn = this.turn;
    if (!turn) return;
    if (subtype !== 'success') this.bus.emit('error', { message: `Turn ended with ${subtype}` });
    const open = [...turn.planViolations, ...turn.gateBlocks];
    if (open.length && subtype === 'success') {
      // Claude stopped to ask: the turn stays open until the user answers.
      turn.forkOpen = open;
      this.bus.emit('fork_asked', { violations: open, text: turn.lastText });
      return;
    }
    this.endTurn(subtype);
  }

  private endTurn(reason: string) {
    const turn = this.turn!;
    const stat = numstat(this.repo.root, turn.base);
    this.bus.emit('turn_ended', { ...stat, reason });
    const events = this.bus.events.filter((e) => e.turn === turn.id);
    writeFileSync(join(this.repo.root, '.harness/turns', `${turn.id}.json`), JSON.stringify({ id: turn.id, prompt: turn.prompt, baseline: turn.base, steps: turn.steps, numstat: stat, events }, null, 2));
    this.turn = null;
    this.bus.turn = null;
    this.repo.recheck();
    void this.q?.setPermissionMode('plan');
  }

  // ---------------------------------------------------------------- hooks

  private observeRead: HookCallback = async (input) => {
    const i = input as PreToolUseHookInput;
    const ti = i.tool_input as { file_path?: string; path?: string };
    if (i.tool_name === 'Read' && ti.file_path) {
      const rel = this.repo.rel(ti.file_path);
      if (rel) this.bus.emit('looked', { tool: 'Read' }, { path: rel, cell: this.repo.cellOf(rel) });
    } else {
      const rel = this.repo.rel(ti.path ?? this.repo.root);
      if (rel) this.bus.emit('cursor', { verb: 'searching' }, { path: rel, cell: this.repo.cellOf(rel) ?? this.repo.cellForDir(rel) });
    }
    return { async: true };
  };

  /** Claude often reads with `cat`/`sed`/`grep` in Bash: any repo file named in the command counts as looked at. */
  private observeBash: HookCallback = async (input) => {
    const cmd = String((input as PreToolUseHookInput & { tool_input: { command?: string } }).tool_input.command ?? '');
    if (/(^|[;&|]\s*)(cat|head|tail|sed|grep|rg|less|wc|nl|awk)\b/.test(cmd)) {
      for (const token of new Set(cmd.split(/[\s'";|&()<>]+/))) {
        const rel = /[\w-]\.\w+$/.test(token) ? this.repo.rel(token) : null;
        if (rel && this.repo.facts.files.includes(rel)) this.bus.emit('looked', { tool: 'Bash' }, { path: rel, cell: this.repo.cellOf(rel) });
      }
    }
    return { async: true };
  };

  /**
   * Edits made through Bash (heredocs, `sed -i`, inline scripts) would skip the edit gate. Deny commands that
   * write files inside the repo and ask for Edit/Write instead; tests, git and reads pass. The watcher still
   * records anything that slips through, as an unattributed edit.
   */
  private gateBash: HookCallback = async (input) => {
    const cmd = String((input as PreToolUseHookInput & { tool_input: { command?: string } }).tool_input.command ?? '');
    const target = bashWriteTarget(cmd, (p) => this.repo.rel(p));
    if (!target) return {};
    return {
      hookSpecificOutput: {
        hookEventName: 'PreToolUse',
        permissionDecision: 'deny',
        permissionDecisionReason: `Harness: change files in this repo with the Edit or Write tool, not through Bash (${target}), so every edit can be checked against the architecture rules. Make this change with Edit/Write instead.`,
      },
    };
  };

  /** The edit gate: same checker as load and plan, on the imports/writes this edit would add. */
  private gate: HookCallback = async (input) => {
    const i = input as PreToolUseHookInput;
    const ti = i.tool_input as { file_path?: string; content?: string; old_string?: string; new_string?: string; replace_all?: boolean };
    if (!ti.file_path) return {};
    const rel = this.repo.rel(ti.file_path);
    if (!rel) return {}; // outside the repo, e.g. Claude's own plan file
    const old = this.repo.current(rel);
    let next: string;
    try {
      next = i.tool_name === 'Write' ? ti.content ?? '' : applyEdit(old ?? '', ti.old_string ?? '', ti.new_string ?? '', ti.replace_all);
    } catch {
      return {}; // the Edit will fail on its own
    }
    const delta = deltaForEdit(rel, old, next, withExtra(this.repo.exists, [rel]));
    const violations = check(this.repo.map, delta, this.repo.mapper);
    this.bus.emit('cursor', { verb: 'editing' }, { path: rel, cell: this.repo.cellOf(rel) });
    if (!violations.length) {
      this.repo.markPending(rel);
      return {};
    }
    for (const v of violations) this.bus.emit('gate_blocked', { violation: v, tool: i.tool_name }, { path: rel, cell: this.repo.cellOf(rel) });
    this.turn?.gateBlocks.push(...violations);
    return {
      hookSpecificOutput: {
        hookEventName: 'PreToolUse',
        permissionDecision: 'deny',
        permissionDecisionReason: `Harness blocked this edit.\n${violationText(violations)}\n${ASK_RULE}`,
      },
    };
  };

  private afterEdit: HookCallback = async (input) => {
    const i = input as PostToolUseHookInput;
    const ti = i.tool_input as { file_path?: string };
    const rel = ti.file_path ? this.repo.rel(ti.file_path) : null;
    if (rel) setImmediate(() => this.repo.fileChanged(rel, { tool: i.tool_name }));
    return { async: true };
  };

  private afterAlike: HookCallback = async (input) => {
    const i = input as PostToolUseHookInput;
    const res = JSON.stringify(i.tool_response ?? '');
    const ids = new Set(JSON.stringify(i.tool_input).match(/DR-\d+/g) ?? []);
    if (/error|failed|unauthori[sz]ed/i.test(res) && !/"id"/.test(res)) return { async: true };
    for (const d of this.bus.events.filter((e) => e.kind === 'decision_recorded')) {
      const data = d.data as { id: string };
      if (ids.has(data.id)) this.bus.emit('decision_recorded', { ...(d.data as EventData['decision_recorded']), alike: true });
    }
    return { async: true };
  };

  private canUseTool: CanUseTool = async (name, input) => {
    if (name === 'ExitPlanMode') {
      const turn = this.turn;
      if (turn && !turn.planned) {
        return { behavior: 'deny', message: 'Call mcp__harness__submit_plan with your numbered steps before exiting plan mode.' };
      }
      if (turn?.planViolations.length) {
        return { behavior: 'deny', message: `The plan has unresolved violations.\n${violationText(turn.planViolations)}\n${ASK_RULE}` };
      }
      const plan = String((input as { plan?: unknown }).plan ?? '');
      this.bus.emit('approval_requested', { plan });
      return new Promise<PermissionResult>((resolve) => { this.approval = { resolve, input }; });
    }
    return { behavior: 'allow', updatedInput: input };
  };

  interrupt() { void this.q?.interrupt(); }
}

# Reference map for the Scout demo repo.
# Live, the cartographer proposes this on load and the user confirms it.
# This copy is the test fixture for packages/core and the fallback if the
# cartographer's proposal is off on stage.

version: 1

layers:
  - { id: entry,    name: Entry }
  - { id: logic,    name: Logic }
  - { id: data,     name: Data }
  - { id: external, name: External }

# Paths that belong to no domain and never create cross-domain edges.
neutral: ["src/shared/**", "vendor/_calllog.ts"]
ignore: ["node_modules/**", ".git/**", ".harness/**", "fixtures/**", "scripts/**", "decisions/**", "*.json", "*.md", "*.config.ts", ".*", "domains.yaml"]

domains:
  - id: channels
    name: Channels
    purpose: Take requests from HTTP and the CLI
    cells:
      entry: { paths: ["src/channels/routes.ts", "src/channels/cli.ts"] }
      logic: { paths: ["src/channels/validate.ts"] }
    tests: ["test/channels/**"]

  - id: orchestrator
    name: Agent loop
    purpose: Plan each run and call tools in order
    cells:
      logic: { paths: ["src/orchestrator/agent.ts", "src/orchestrator/planner.ts", "src/orchestrator/tool-registry.ts"] }
      data:  { paths: ["src/orchestrator/run-state.ts"], tables: ["runs"] }
    tests: ["test/orchestrator/**"]

  - id: tools
    name: Research tools
    purpose: Look up companies, news and filings
    cells:
      logic:    { paths: ["src/tools/**"] }
      external: { paths: ["vendor/search/**", "vendor/news/**", "vendor/sec-edgar/**", "vendor/enrichment/**"] }
    tests: ["test/tools/**"]

  - id: gateway
    name: Model gateway
    purpose: Every model call, with redaction and cost logging
    cells:
      logic:    { paths: ["src/gateway/complete.ts", "src/gateway/embed.ts", "src/gateway/redact.ts", "src/gateway/providers.ts"] }
      data:     { paths: ["src/gateway/cost-ledger.ts"], tables: ["cost_log"] }
      external: { paths: ["vendor/llm-openai/**", "vendor/llm-anthropic/**", "vendor/embeddings/**"] }
    tests: ["test/gateway/**"]

  - id: memory
    name: Memory
    purpose: Store and retrieve notes about each company
    cells:
      logic: { paths: ["src/memory/retrieve.ts", "src/memory/vector-index.ts"] }
      data:  { paths: ["src/memory/notes-store.ts"], tables: ["notes", "embeddings"] }
    tests: ["test/memory/**"]

  - id: outreach
    name: Outreach
    purpose: Draft emails and keep the CRM in sync
    cells:
      logic:    { paths: ["src/outreach/draft-email.ts", "src/outreach/send.ts"] }
      data:     { paths: ["src/outreach/crm-sync.ts", "src/outreach/outreach-log.ts"], tables: ["contacts", "outreach_log"] }
      external: { paths: ["vendor/crm/**", "vendor/email/**"] }
    tests: ["test/outreach/**"]

# Seeded by the cartographer on load (source: cartographer), confirmed by the user.
# Runtime decisions get the next free id (DR-4, DR-5, ...) and live in decisions/.
invariants:
  - id: DR-1
    rule: Model providers are only called through the model gateway
    kind: only_via
    targets: ["vendor/llm-*/**", "vendor/embeddings/**"]
    allowed_from: [gateway]
    exceptions: []
    source: cartographer

  - id: DR-2
    rule: Each table is written only by the domain that owns it
    kind: owns_writes
    owners: { runs: orchestrator, cost_log: gateway, notes: memory, embeddings: memory, contacts: outreach, outreach_log: outreach }
    exceptions: []
    source: cartographer

  - id: DR-3
    rule: Research tools never depend on outreach
    kind: no_edge
    from: tools
    to: outreach
    exceptions: []
    source: cartographer
import { z } from 'zod';
import YAML from 'yaml';

const LayerSchema = z.object({ id: z.string(), name: z.string() });

/** A confirmed sub-group inside a cell (promoted from an inferred cartographer label). */
const ComponentSchema = z.object({ id: z.string(), name: z.string(), paths: z.array(z.string()) });

const CellSchema = z.object({
  paths: z.array(z.string()).optional(),
  tables: z.array(z.string()).optional(),
  components: z.array(ComponentSchema).optional(),
});

/** Living-map settings (NAVIGATION_PLAN §4.4). Missing thresholds fall back to DEFAULT_THRESHOLDS. */
const CartographySchema = z.object({
  thresholds: z.record(z.string(), z.number()).optional(),
  /**
   * Custom router patterns: `pattern` is a JS regex source matched against `file`'s text, with named groups
   * `method` and `path` (or groups 1 and 2); the handler is the first symbol defined after the match.
   */
  routes: z.array(z.object({ file: z.string(), pattern: z.string() })).optional(),
});

const DomainSchema = z.object({
  id: z.string(),
  name: z.string(),
  purpose: z.string(),
  cells: z.record(z.string(), CellSchema),
  tests: z.array(z.string()).optional(),
});

/** An exception may be written as a bare path string; it is normalized to `{ path }`. */
const ExceptionSchema = z.union([
  z.string().transform((path): { path: string; decision?: string } => ({ path })),
  z.object({ path: z.string(), decision: z.string().optional() }),
]);

const InvariantBase = z.object({
  id: z.string(),
  rule: z.string(),
  exceptions: z.array(ExceptionSchema).default([]),
  source: z.string().optional(),
  /** Decision records (DR ids) that confirmed this invariant. */
  decisions: z.array(z.string()).optional(),
});

const InvariantSchema = z.discriminatedUnion('kind', [
  InvariantBase.extend({
    kind: z.literal('only_via'),
    targets: z.array(z.string()),
    allowed_from: z.array(z.string()),
  }),
  InvariantBase.extend({
    kind: z.literal('owns_writes'),
    owners: z.record(z.string(), z.string()),
  }),
  InvariantBase.extend({
    kind: z.literal('no_edge'),
    from: z.string(),
    to: z.string(),
  }),
]);

/** Schema for a target repo's `domains.yaml`. */
export const DomainMapSchema = z
  .object({
    version: z.number(),
    layers: z.array(LayerSchema),
    neutral: z.array(z.string()).optional(),
    ignore: z.array(z.string()).optional(),
    domains: z.array(DomainSchema),
    invariants: z.array(InvariantSchema).default([]),
    cartography: CartographySchema.optional(),
  })
  .superRefine((map, ctx) => {
    const layers = new Set(map.layers.map((l) => l.id));
    const domains = new Set(map.domains.map((d) => d.id));
    const issue = (path: (string | number)[], message: string) => ctx.addIssue({ code: 'custom', path, message });
    map.domains.forEach((d, i) => {
      for (const layer of Object.keys(d.cells)) {
        if (!layers.has(layer)) issue(['domains', i, 'cells', layer], `unknown layer "${layer}"`);
      }
    });
    map.invariants.forEach((inv, i) => {
      const refs =
        inv.kind === 'only_via' ? inv.allowed_from : inv.kind === 'owns_writes' ? Object.values(inv.owners) : [inv.from, inv.to];
      for (const ref of refs) {
        if (!domains.has(ref)) issue(['invariants', i], `${inv.id} refers to unknown domain "${ref}"`);
      }
    });
  });

export type DomainMap = z.output<typeof DomainMapSchema>;
export type Layer = DomainMap['layers'][number];
export type Domain = DomainMap['domains'][number];
export type Invariant = DomainMap['invariants'][number];
export type InvariantException = Invariant['exceptions'][number];

/** Parse and validate `domains.yaml` text. Throws an Error with a readable message. */
export function parseDomainMap(yamlText: string): DomainMap {
  let raw: unknown;
  try {
    raw = YAML.parse(yamlText);
  } catch (err) {
    throw new Error(`domains.yaml is not valid YAML: ${(err as Error).message}`);
  }
  const result = DomainMapSchema.safeParse(raw);
  if (!result.success) throw new Error(`domains.yaml is invalid:\n${z.prettifyError(result.error)}`);
  return result.data;
}
```

import { db } from "../shared/db";
import { redact } from "./redact";
import { provider } from "./providers";
import { logCost } from "./cost-ledger";
export async function complete(req: { purpose: string; messages: string[] }): Promise<string> {
  const names = db.all("contacts");
  const text = redact(req.messages.join("\n"), names);
  logCost(req.purpose, text.length / 4);
  return provider()(text);
}
export function redact(text: string, _names: unknown[]): string {
  return text.replace(/\d[\d\s.,()-]{6,}\d/g, "[PHONE]");
}
import type { Tool } from "../shared/types";
import { call as enrich } from "../../vendor/enrichment/index";
import { call as filings } from "../../vendor/sec-edgar/index";
import { complete } from "../gateway/complete";
export const companyProfile: Tool = {
  name: "company-profile",
  tags: ["profile"],
  run: async (c) => complete({ purpose: "profile", messages: [enrich(c), filings(c)] }),
};

projection, one SVG layer of precomputed edge paths, ELK layered per expanded
cell in elkjs's worker (lazy, cached, prewarmed), staged interruptible
transitions (fade, one commit + WAAPI FLIP with the camera, enter), zoom LOD
buckets via a store selector, screen-space domain/layer headers. Expanding a
domain widens its column in place, compresses the others to spines, and routes
edges that leave a container through ELK ports and bundled gutter lanes.

synthetic 500-file projection for measurement. v1 stays the default.

class HttpError extends Error {

    readonly status: number,
    message: string,
    readonly details?: unknown,

function send(res: ServerResponse, status: number, body: unknown): void {
  const payload = JSON.stringify(body);
  res.writeHead(status, { "content-type": "application/json; charset=utf-8", "content-length": Buffer.byteLength(payload) });
  res.end(payload);
}

async function readJson(req: IncomingMessage): Promise<unknown> {
  const chunks: Buffer[] = [];
  let size = 0;
  for await (const chunk of req) {
    size += (chunk as Buffer).length;
    if (size > MAX_BODY_BYTES) throw new HttpError(413, "request body too large");
    chunks.push(chunk as Buffer);
  }
  if (size === 0) return undefined;
  try {
    return JSON.parse(Buffer.concat(chunks).toString("utf8"));
  } catch {
    throw new HttpError(400, "body is not valid JSON");
  }
}

import type { Tool } from "../shared/types";
import { tools } from "../tools/index";

/** "Filings," -> "filing", "10-K" -> "10-k". Plural-insensitive so tags read naturally. */
export function normalizeKeyword(word: string): string {
  const w = word.toLowerCase().replace(/[^a-z0-9-]/g, "");
  return w.length > 3 && w.endsWith("s") && !w.endsWith("ss") ? w.slice(0, -1) : w;
}

export class ToolRegistry {
  private readonly byName = new Map<string, Tool>();
  private readonly byTag = new Map<string, Tool[]>();

  constructor(list: Tool[]) {
    for (const tool of list) this.register(tool);
  }

  register(tool: Tool): void {
    if (!/^[a-z][a-z0-9_]*$/.test(tool.name)) throw new Error(`tool name must be snake_case: "${tool.name}"`);
    if (this.byName.has(tool.name)) throw new Error(`tool registered twice: ${tool.name}`);
    this.byName.set(tool.name, tool);
    for (const tag of tool.tags) {
      const key = normalizeKeyword(tag);
      this.byTag.set(key, [...(this.byTag.get(key) ?? []), tool]);
    }
  }

  get(name: string): Tool | undefined {
    return this.byName.get(name);
  }

  has(name: string): boolean {
    return this.byName.has(name);
  }

  list(): Tool[] {
    return [...this.byName.values()];
  }

  /** One line per tool, for the planner prompt. */
  describe(): string {
    return this.list()
      .map((t) => `- ${t.name} [${t.tags.join(", ")}]: ${t.description}`)
      .join("\n");
  }

  /** Tools with a tag that appears as a word in the goal, in registration order. */
  matchGoal(goal: string): Tool[] {
    const words = new Set(goal.split(/[\s,.;:!?()"']+/).filter(Boolean).map(normalizeKeyword));
    const matched = new Set<Tool>();
    for (const word of words) {
      for (const tool of this.byTag.get(word) ?? []) matched.add(tool);
    }
    return this.list().filter((t) => matched.has(t));
  }
}

const client = new Anthropic();

export const newsSummarize: Tool = {
  name: "news_summarize",
  tags: ["news", "summary"],
  description: "Turns the company's latest headlines into talking points for the contact.",

  async run(input, ctx) {
    const headlines = await latestHeadlines(input.company, { limit: 6 });
    if (headlines.length === 0) {
      return { tool: this.name, summary: "", facts: [], sources: [] };
    }

    const contact = [input.contact.name, input.contact.title, input.contact.email, input.contact.phone]
      .filter(Boolean)
      .join(", ");
    const news = headlines.map((h) => `- ${h.title} (${h.publishedAt}). ${h.summary}`).join("\n");

    const response = await client.messages.create({
      model: loadConfig().anthropicModel,
      max_tokens: 2000,
      effort: "low",
      system: `Turn recent news about ${input.company} into two or three talking points for a call with ${contact}. Their goal: ${input.goal}. Keep every figure exact.`,
      messages: [{ role: "user", content: news }],
    });
    ctx.log.debug("summarized news", { headlines: headlines.length });

    return {
      tool: this.name,
      summary: response.content.map((block) => block.text).join(""),
      facts: headlines.map((h) => h.title),
      sources: headlines.map((h) => h.url),
    };
  },
};

function briefPrompt(request: RunRequest, results: ToolResult[], pastNotes: NoteRow[]): string {
  const findings = results
    .filter((r) => r.summary)
    .map((r) => `From ${r.tool}: ${r.summary}\n${r.facts.slice(0, 4).map((f) => `  - ${f}`).join("\n")}`);
  const earlier = pastNotes.map((n) => `- (${n.source}, ${n.createdAt.slice(0, 10)}) ${n.text.split("\n")[0]}`);
  return [
    "Findings:",
    ...(findings.length ? findings : ["(none)"]),
    "",
    "Earlier notes:",
    ...(earlier.length ? earlier : ["(none)"]),

}

/** Serves the built web app; unknown paths get index.html so client-side routes work on reload. */
function serveStatic(pathname: string, res: ServerResponse): void {
  const index = join(WEB_ROOT, "index.html");
  if (!existsSync(index)) {
    res.writeHead(404, { "content-type": "text/plain; charset=utf-8" });
    res.end("The web app isn't built yet. Run `npm run build`, or use `npm run dev` for development.\n");
    return;
  }
  const requested = normalize(join(WEB_ROOT, decodeURIComponent(pathname)));
  const file = requested.startsWith(WEB_ROOT) && existsSync(requested) && statSync(requested).isFile() ? requested : index;
  const immutable = file.includes(`${WEB_ROOT}assets`);
  res.writeHead(200, {
    "content-type": MIME[extname(file)] ?? "application/octet-stream",
    "cache-control": immutable ? "public, max-age=31536000, immutable" : "no-cache",
  });
  res.end(readFileSync(file));
}

async function handle(req: IncomingMessage, res: ServerResponse): Promise<void> {
  const url = new URL(req.url ?? "/", "http://localhost");
  const method = req.method ?? "GET";

  if (method === "GET" && url.pathname === "/health") return send(res, 200, { ok: true });

  if (url.pathname.startsWith("/api/")) {
    const matching = routes.filter(([, pattern]) => pattern.test(url.pathname));
    if (matching.length === 0) throw new HttpError(404, "not found");
    const route = matching.find(([m]) => m === method);
    if (!route) throw new HttpError(405, "method not allowed");
    const [, pattern, handler] = route;
    const params = (pattern.exec(url.pathname) ?? []).slice(1);
    const [status, body] = await handler(params, req, url);
    return send(res, status, body);
  }

  if (method !== "GET" && method !== "HEAD") throw new HttpError(405, "method not allowed");
  serveStatic(url.pathname, res);
}

export function createScoutServer(): Server {
  return createServer((req, res) => {
    handle(req, res).catch((err: unknown) => {
      if (err instanceof HttpError) {
        send(res, err.status, { error: err.message, ...(err.details ? { details: err.details } : {}) });
        return;
      }
      log.error("request failed", { url: req.url, error: err instanceof Error ? err.message : String(err) });
      send(res, 500, { error: "internal error" });

}

export interface ChatProvider {
  readonly name: ModelProviderName;
  readonly model: string;
  chat(messages: ChatMessage[], options?: ChatOptions): Promise<ProviderReply>;
}

// Generous, because thinking tokens count toward the limit on current Claude models.
const DEFAULT_MAX_TOKENS = 4000;

class OpenAIProvider implements ChatProvider {
  readonly name = "openai" as const;
  private readonly client = new OpenAI();

  constructor(readonly model: string) {}

  async chat(messages: ChatMessage[], options: ChatOptions = {}): Promise<ProviderReply> {
    const response = await this.client.chat.completions.create({
      model: this.model,
      messages,
      max_tokens: options.maxTokens ?? DEFAULT_MAX_TOKENS,
      temperature: 0.2,
    });
    const choice = response.choices[0];
    return {
      text: choice?.message.content ?? "",
      provider: this.name,
      model: response.model,
      truncated: choice?.finish_reason === "length",
    };
  }
}

class AnthropicProvider implements ChatProvider {
  readonly name = "anthropic" as const;
  private readonly client = new Anthropic();

  constructor(readonly model: string) {}

  async chat(messages: ChatMessage[], options: ChatOptions = {}): Promise<ProviderReply> {
    // Anthropic takes the system prompt separately and wants user/assistant turns only.
    const system = messages.filter((m) => m.role === "system").map((m) => m.content).join("\n\n");
    const turns = messages
      .filter((m): m is ChatMessage & { role: "user" | "assistant" } => m.role !== "system")
      .map((m) => ({ role: m.role, content: m.content }));
    const response = await this.client.messages.create({
      model: this.model,
      system: system || undefined,
      messages: turns,
      max_tokens: options.maxTokens ?? DEFAULT_MAX_TOKENS,
      effort: options.effort,
    });
    return {
      text: response.content.map((block) => block.text).join(""),
      provider: this.name,
      model: response.model,
      truncated: response.stop_reason === "max_tokens",
    };
  }
}

const providers = new Map<string, ChatProvider>();

/** The configured provider (SCOUT_MODEL_PROVIDER), or a specific one. Instances are reused. */
export function getProvider(name?: ModelProviderName): ChatProvider {
  const config = loadConfig();
  const selected = name ?? config.modelProvider;
  const model = selected === "openai" ? config.openaiModel : config.anthropicModel;
  const key = `${selected}:${model}`;
  let provider = providers.get(key);
  if (!provider) {
    provider = selected === "openai" ? new OpenAIProvider(model) : new AnthropicProvider(model);
    providers.set(key, provider);
  }
  return provider;
}
 * configured provider and records the cost.
 */
export async function complete(request: CompleteRequest): Promise<Completion> {
  if (!PURPOSES.includes(request.purpose)) {
    throw new GatewayError(`unknown purpose "${request.purpose}"; expected one of ${PURPOSES.join(", ")}`);
  }
  if (request.messages.length === 0) throw new GatewayError("messages must not be empty");

  const redacted = redactMessages(request.messages, await knownContactNames());
  const { count } = redacted;
  const messages = count > 0 ? [{ role: "system" as const, content: PLACEHOLDER_NOTE }, ...redacted.messages] : redacted.messages;
  const provider = getProvider();
  const reply = await provider.chat(messages, { maxTokens: request.maxTokens, effort: EFFORT[request.purpose] });

  const cost = await recordCost({
    runId: request.runId,
    purpose: request.purpose,
    provider: reply.provider,
    model: reply.model,
    inputChars: messages.reduce((n, m) => n + m.content.length, 0),
    outputChars: reply.text.length,
  });

  return {
    text: reply.text,
    provider: reply.provider,
    model: reply.model,
    redactions: count,
    truncated: reply.truncated,
    costId: cost.id,
  };
}

/** One step of a `submit_plan` call. Import `to` is a repo path (extension optional) or a specifier relative to `from`. */
export type PlanStep = { n: number; text: string; files: string[]; imports: { from: string; to: string }[] };

export type PlanFootprint = {
  cells: { domain: string; layer: string; steps: number[]; files: string[] }[];
  tests: { domain: string; files: string[] }[];
  unassigned: string[];
  edges: { from: string; to: string; steps: number[]; imports: ImportEdge[] }[];
  delta: FactDelta;
  violations: Violation[];

/** Ghost footprint of a plan: the cells and tests it touches, its new cross-domain edges, and the violations its imports would cause. */
export function planFootprint(map: DomainMap, steps: PlanStep[], exists: Exists, mapper: Mapper = createMapper(map)): PlanFootprint {
  const norm = (p: string) => normalizePath(p) ?? p;
  const planned = withExtra(exists, steps.flatMap((s) => s.files));

  const cells = new Map<string, { domain: string; layer: string; steps: Set<number>; files: Set<string> }>();
  const tests = new Map<string, Set<string>>();
  const unassigned = new Set<string>();
  const edges = new Map<string, { from: string; to: string; steps: Set<number>; imports: ImportEdge[] }>();
  const imports: ImportEdge[] = [];
  const seen = new Set<string>();

  for (const step of steps) {
    const stepImports = step.imports.map((imp) => {
      const from = norm(imp.from);
      const to = (isRelative(imp.to) ? resolveImport(from, imp.to, planned) : resolvePath(imp.to, planned)) ?? norm(imp.to);
      return { from, to };
    });
    // A file that gains an import is edited by the step even if the step didn't list it.
    for (const file of new Set([...step.files.map(norm), ...stepImports.map((i) => i.from)])) {
      const p = mapper.place(file);
      if (p.kind === 'cell') {
        const key = `${p.domain}\u0000${p.layer}`;
        let cell = cells.get(key);
        if (!cell) cells.set(key, (cell = { domain: p.domain, layer: p.layer, steps: new Set(), files: new Set() }));
        cell.steps.add(step.n);
        cell.files.add(file);
      } else if (p.kind === 'test') {
        tests.set(p.domain, (tests.get(p.domain) ?? new Set()).add(file));
      } else if (p.kind === 'unassigned') unassigned.add(file);
    }
    for (const imp of stepImports) {
      const k = `${imp.from}\u0000${imp.to}`;
      if (!seen.has(k)) {

import YAML, { isMap, isSeq, type Node } from 'yaml';
import type { DomainMap } from './schema';

const flow = (value: unknown) => YAML.stringify(value, { collectionStyle: 'flow', lineWidth: 0 }).trimEnd();

/** End of the source line on which `node`'s value ends (before any trailing comment's newline). */
function lineEndAfter(text: string, node: Node): number {
  let p = node.range![1];
  while (p > 0 && /\s/.test(text[p - 1]!)) p--;
  const nl = text.indexOf('\n', p);
  return nl === -1 ? text.length : nl;
}

function column(text: string, offset: number): number {
  return offset - (text.lastIndexOf('\n', offset - 1) + 1);
}

/**
 * Append `value` to the list at `key` of invariant `invariantId`, creating the key if missing.
 * Splices text into the original so comments, spacing and alignment elsewhere are untouched.
 */
function appendToInvariant(yamlText: string, invariantId: string, key: string, value: unknown): string {
  const doc = YAML.parseDocument(yamlText);
  const list = doc.get('invariants');
  const inv = isSeq(list) ? list.items.find((item) => isMap(item) && item.get('id') === invariantId) : undefined;
  if (!isMap(inv) || inv.items.length === 0) throw new Error(`domains.yaml has no invariant ${invariantId}`);
  const splice = (at: number, insert: string) => yamlText.slice(0, at) + insert + yamlText.slice(at);
  const item = flow(value);
  const seq = inv.get(key, true);

  if (isSeq(seq) && seq.flow) {
    const close = yamlText.lastIndexOf(']', seq.range![1] - 1);
    return splice(close, seq.items.length ? `, ${item}` : item);
  }
  if (isSeq(seq)) {
    const last = seq.items.at(-1) as Node | undefined;
    if (!last) throw new Error(`${invariantId}.${key} is malformed`);
    return splice(lineEndAfter(yamlText, last), `\n${' '.repeat(column(yamlText, seq.range![0]))}- ${item}`);
  }
  if (seq !== undefined && seq !== null) throw new Error(`${invariantId}.${key} is not a list`);
  const firstKey = inv.items[0]!.key as Node;
  const lastPair = inv.items.at(-1)!;
  const end = lineEndAfter(yamlText, (lastPair.value ?? lastPair.key) as Node);
  return splice(end, `\n${' '.repeat(column(yamlText, firstKey.range![0]))}${key}: [${item}]`);
}

/** Link decision `decisionId` to an invariant (the user chose to comply). Only the edited line changes. */
export function linkDecision(yamlText: string, invariantId: string, decisionId: string): string {
  return appendToInvariant(yamlText, invariantId, 'decisions', decisionId);
}

/** Add `{ path, decision }` to an invariant's exceptions (the user chose the exception). Only the edited line changes. */
export function addException(yamlText: string, invariantId: string, path: string, decisionId: string): string {
  return appendToInvariant(yamlText, invariantId, 'exceptions', { path, decision: decisionId });
}

/** Next free `DR-n`, above every id used by invariants, their decisions and exceptions, and `existingIds`. */
export function nextDecisionId(map: DomainMap, existingIds: string[]): string {
  const ids = [
    ...existingIds,
    ...map.invariants.flatMap((inv) => [inv.id, ...(inv.decisions ?? []), ...inv.exceptions.flatMap((e) => (e.decision ? [e.decision] : []))]),
  ];
  const max = Math.max(0, ...ids.map((id) => Number(/^DR-(\d+)$/.exec(id)?.[1] ?? 0)));
  return `DR-${max + 1}`;
}

Short answer: Alike is where the decision travels. The harness turns your A/B answer into an enforced decision, but only inside harness sessions on this repo. Alike carries that same decision to every other agent session: a teammate in plain Claude Code, someone in Cursor, you next week without the harness open. Without Alike, the decision only protects people who happen to use the harness.

**The value split, and the line for it:** "Harness decides and enforces. Alike remembers and distributes."

The other session's verification (`VERIFY.md` (d)) shapes how this has to work. Harness sessions deliberately turn Alike's hooks off, so they stay fast and deterministic, and talk to Alike only to write decisions. So reading the memory back has to happen outside the harness, which is exactly the story you want.

**What to show on screen:**

1. **Beat 3, right after you answer "A"** (2–3 s). The harness chat shows the `record_decision` tool call landing:
   - "DR-4 recorded in Alike";
   - anchored to `src/orchestrator/agent.ts`, `src/outreach/outreach-log.ts` and `src/tools/`;
   - alongside `decisions/DR-4.md` committed in git.
   - Say: "My answer is now a rule in the repo, and a memory in Alike."
2. **Alike's own page for DR-4** (about 5 s). Show the title, the outcome, the rationale including the rejected option B, and the exact file paths it's anchored to. The anchors come from the map, not guessed from chat, so Alike gets precise memories. That's the value the harness adds for Alike.
3. **A teammate without the harness: the new beat 4** (about 20 s). Open a plain Claude Code terminal in the Scout copy and type the follow-up ("Also mention any calls we've logged with this contact"). Alike's hooks bring in DR-4, and Claude plans through the run loop, citing the team decision.
   - Say: "My teammate doesn't use our tool. The decision found them anyway."
   - This is a stronger memory beat than "a fresh harness session remembers", which viewers would expect anyway.

**What has to be fixed or checked first:**
- **Repository identity.** Alike anchors decisions to a repository by its `owner/name`. The harness passes that through `HARNESS_REPO_SLUG`, but the fresh copy has no remote. A plain Claude Code session there probably can't tell it's "scout-agent", so Alike wouldn't find DR-4. Fix: `fresh-scout.sh` gives the copy a GitHub-style origin URL with pushing disabled.
- **Memory outlives resets.** The copy resets, but DR-4 stays in Alike after every take:
  - Each take adds a duplicate DR-4, which clutters Alike's page on camera.
  - **The baseline runs in plain Claude Code would be contaminated**, because Alike would feed them DR-4, so the "without harness" timings would be wrong.

  Fix: a per-take repository name (`--take 3` gives `scout-agent-take3`), so each take starts with empty memory. Do the baselines under a name that never gets a decision.
- **Sign-in durability.** `VERIFY.md` says the first Alike sign-in didn't survive a Claude Code restart. Re-run its check (d2) on recording day. The fallback is that the paired `alike` CLI can record decisions without the MCP connection.
- **Whether Alike surfaces DR-4 for this prompt** is unverified. Alike's hooks fire when the session starts, on each prompt, and before tool calls, and DR-4 is anchored to the very files Claude will read, so it should. It needs a rehearsal, and if it doesn't, phrase the prompt to name the brief or the outreach files.

Want me to add the origin URL and `--take` option to `fresh-scout.sh`, rewrite beat 4 in `DEMO_PLAN.md` as the teammate version with these checks, and do a dry run? The dry run would record a test decision in Alike under a throwaway repository name, then see whether plain Claude Code in the copy picks it up. That's the part most likely to surprise us.

describe('edit gate budget', () => {
  // The 20 ms budget is asserted strictly with HARNESS_PERF_STRICT=1 (run this file alone); the full suite runs files
  // in parallel and competes for CPU, so it keeps a 60 ms tripwire against regressions (the old regex took 38–66 ms).
  const BUDGET = process.env.HARNESS_PERF_STRICT === '1' ? 20 : 60;
  const exists = fileExistsIn(fixtureRepo);
  const forbidden = 'import { chat } from "../../vendor/llm-openai/index";\n';
  /** Best of 5 gate calls on texts that are new each run (`i`), so nothing comes from the record cache unless `prime`. */
  const gate = (path: string, text: string, prime: boolean) => {
    const runs: number[] = [];
    for (let i = 0; i <= 5; i++) {
      const old = text + '\n'.repeat(i);
      if (prime) moduleRecord(path, old); // what the server's PostToolUse extraction leaves behind for the next edit
      const t = performance.now();
      const delta = deltaForEdit(path, old, forbidden + old, exists);
      if (i > 0) runs.push(performance.now() - t); // run 0 warms the native binding and wasm
      expect(delta.imports).toEqual([{ from: path, to: 'vendor/llm-openai/index.ts' }]);
    }
    return Math.min(...runs);
  };

  it('deltaForEdit stays under 20 ms on a ~1 MB generated file (woff2-wasm style), parsing both texts', () => {
    const blob = Buffer.alloc(720_000, 7).toString('base64');
    const text = `import { x } from "../gateway/complete";\nexport const wasm = "${blob}";\nexport default wasm;\n`;
    expect(text.length).toBeGreaterThan(950_000);
    expect(gate('src/tools/woff2-wasm.ts', text, false)).toBeLessThan(BUDGET);
  });

  it('deltaForEdit stays under 20 ms on ~1 MB of dense code once the old text is known (as after every write)', () => {
    let text = 'import { complete } from "../gateway/complete";\n';
    for (let i = 0; text.length < 1_000_000; i++) text += `export function f${i}(x: number): number {\n  const y = complete({ purpose: "p${i}", messages: [] });\n  return [1, 2].map((q) => q * x).length + Number(y);\n}\n`;
    expect(gate('src/tools/generated.ts', text, true)).toBeLessThan(BUDGET);
  });
});

import { check } from '../src/rules';
import { createMapper } from '../src/mapper';
import { domainEdges, fileExistsIn, scanRepo, withExtra } from '../src/facts';
import { planFootprint, type PlanStep } from '../src/plan';
import type { EventData, EventKind, HarnessEvent } from '../src/events';
import { fixtureRepo, loadMap } from './helpers';

/** Builds a realistic event log for the demo turn from real core computations over the fixture repo. */
export function demoLog() {
  const map = loadMap();
  const mapper = createMapper(map);
  const facts = scanRepo(fixtureRepo, map);
  const events: HarnessEvent[] = [];
  let turn: string | null = null;
  let n = 0;
  const ev = <K extends EventKind>(kind: K, data: K extends keyof EventData ? EventData[K] : never, extra: Partial<HarnessEvent> = {}) => {
    events.push({ id: `e${n}`, t: 1000 + n++, session: 's1', turn, kind, data: data as Record<string, unknown>, ...extra });
    return events.length - 1;
  };
  const cell = (path: string) => {
    const p = mapper.place(path);
    return p.kind === 'cell' ? { domain: p.domain, layer: p.layer } : undefined;
  };
  const plan = (steps: PlanStep[]) => {
    const fp = planFootprint(map, steps, withExtra(fileExistsIn(fixtureRepo), steps.flatMap((s) => s.files)), mapper);
    ev('planned', { steps, cells: fp.cells, edges: fp.edges, unassigned: fp.unassigned });
    for (const v of fp.violations) ev('plan_violation', { violation: v }, { path: v.file });
    return fp.violations;
  };
  const tenK = (model: string): PlanStep[] => [
    { n: 1, text: 'Add the 10-K tool', files: ['src/tools/filing-summary.ts'], imports: [{ from: 'src/tools/filing-summary.ts', to: model }] },
    { n: 2, text: 'Register it', files: ['src/tools/index.ts'], imports: [] },
  ];

  ev('map_confirmed', { map, source: 'file' });
  ev('repo_scanned', { files: facts.files.map((path) => ({ path, placement: mapper.place(path) })), imports: facts.imports, writes: facts.writes, edges: domainEdges(facts, mapper) });
  ev('violation_found', { violations: check(map, facts, mapper) });

  turn = 't1';
  ev('turn_started', { prompt: "Add a tool that summarizes a prospect's latest 10-K", head: 'abc', baseline: 'abc' });
  ev('looked', { tool: 'Read' }, { path: 'src/tools/news-summarize.ts', cell: cell('src/tools/news-summarize.ts') });
  ev('looked', { tool: 'Read' }, { path: 'src/gateway/complete.ts', cell: cell('src/gateway/complete.ts') });
  const violations = plan(tenK('vendor/llm-openai/index'));
  ev('fork_asked', { violations, text: 'A or B?' });
  ev('fork_answered', { option: 'A', text: 'A, through the gateway', violations });
  ev('decision_recorded', { id: 'DR-4', title: 'Filings go through the gateway', invariant: 'DR-1', option: 'A', paths: ['src/tools/filing-summary.ts'] });
  plan(tenK('src/gateway/complete'));
  ev('approval_requested', { plan: '1. add tool 2. register' });
  ev('plan_approved', {} as never);
  ev('file_assigned', { placement: mapper.place('src/tools/filing-summary.ts') }, { path: 'src/tools/filing-summary.ts' });
  const firstEdit = ev('edited', { added: 12, removed: 0, created: true }, { path: 'src/tools/filing-summary.ts', cell: { domain: 'tools', layer: 'logic' } });
  ev('edge_added', { edge: { from: 'src/tools/filing-summary.ts', to: 'src/gateway/complete.ts' }, from: 'tools', to: 'gateway' }, { path: 'src/tools/filing-summary.ts' });
  ev('edited', { added: 2, removed: 0, created: false }, { path: 'src/tools/index.ts', cell: { domain: 'tools', layer: 'logic' } });
  ev('edited', { added: 3, removed: 1, created: false }, { path: 'src/outreach/draft-email.ts', cell: { domain: 'outreach', layer: 'logic' } });
  ev('turn_ended', { added: 17, removed: 1, files: ['src/tools/filing-summary.ts', 'src/tools/index.ts', 'src/outreach/draft-email.ts'], reason: 'success' });
  turn = null;
  return { map, events, firstEdit };
}

# Reference map for the Scout demo repo.
# Live, the cartographer proposes this on load and the user confirms it.
# This copy is the test fixture for packages/core and the fallback if the
# cartographer's proposal is off on stage.

version: 1

layers:
  - { id: entry,    name: Entry }
  - { id: logic,    name: Logic }
  - { id: data,     name: Data }
  - { id: external, name: External }

# Paths that belong to no domain and never create cross-domain edges.
neutral: ["src/shared/**", "vendor/_calllog.ts"]
ignore: ["node_modules/**", ".git/**", ".harness/**", "fixtures/**", "scripts/**", "decisions/**", "*.json", "*.md", "*.config.ts", ".*", "domains.yaml"]

domains:
  - id: channels
    name: Channels
    purpose: Take requests from HTTP and the CLI
    cells:
      entry: { paths: ["src/channels/routes.ts", "src/channels/cli.ts"] }
      logic: { paths: ["src/channels/validate.ts"] }
    tests: ["test/channels/**"]

  - id: orchestrator
    name: Agent loop
    purpose: Plan each run and call tools in order
    cells:
      logic: { paths: ["src/orchestrator/agent.ts", "src/orchestrator/planner.ts", "src/orchestrator/tool-registry.ts"] }
      data:  { paths: ["src/orchestrator/run-state.ts"], tables: ["runs"] }
    tests: ["test/orchestrator/**"]

  - id: tools
    name: Research tools
    purpose: Look up companies, news and filings
    cells:
      logic:    { paths: ["src/tools/**"] }
      external: { paths: ["vendor/search/**", "vendor/news/**", "vendor/sec-edgar/**", "vendor/enrichment/**"] }
    tests: ["test/tools/**"]

  - id: gateway
    name: Model gateway
    purpose: Every model call, with redaction and cost logging
    cells:
      logic:    { paths: ["src/gateway/complete.ts", "src/gateway/embed.ts", "src/gateway/redact.ts", "src/gateway/providers.ts"] }
      data:     { paths: ["src/gateway/cost-ledger.ts"], tables: ["cost_log"] }
      external: { paths: ["vendor/llm-openai/**", "vendor/llm-anthropic/**", "vendor/embeddings/**"] }
    tests: ["test/gateway/**"]

  - id: memory
    name: Memory
    purpose: Store and retrieve notes about each company
    cells:
      logic: { paths: ["src/memory/retrieve.ts", "src/memory/vector-index.ts"] }
      data:  { paths: ["src/memory/notes-store.ts"], tables: ["notes", "embeddings"] }
    tests: ["test/memory/**"]

  - id: outreach
    name: Outreach
    purpose: Draft emails and keep the CRM in sync
    cells:
      logic:    { paths: ["src/outreach/draft-email.ts", "src/outreach/send.ts"] }
      data:     { paths: ["src/outreach/crm-sync.ts", "src/outreach/outreach-log.ts"], tables: ["contacts", "outreach_log"] }
      external: { paths: ["vendor/crm/**", "vendor/email/**"] }
    tests: ["test/outreach/**"]

# Seeded by the cartographer on load (source: cartographer), confirmed by the user.
# Runtime decisions get the next free id (DR-4, DR-5, ...) and live in decisions/.
invariants:
  - id: DR-1
    rule: Model providers are only called through the model gateway
    kind: only_via
    targets: ["vendor/llm-*/**", "vendor/embeddings/**"]
    allowed_from: [gateway]
    exceptions: []
    source: cartographer

  - id: DR-2
    rule: Each table is written only by the domain that owns it
    kind: owns_writes
    owners: { runs: orchestrator, cost_log: gateway, notes: memory, embeddings: memory, contacts: outreach, outreach_log: outreach }
    exceptions: []
    source: cartographer

  - id: DR-3
    rule: Research tools never depend on outreach
    kind: no_edge
    from: tools
    to: outreach
    exceptions: []
    source: cartographer

cartography:
  routes:
    - file: src/channels/routes.ts
      pattern: '\[\s*"(?<method>[A-Z]+)",\s*/\^(?<path>(?:\\.|[^$])*)\$/'
```

export class ApiError extends Error {
  constructor(
    readonly status: number,
    message: string,
    readonly details: string[] = [],
  ) {
    super(message);
    this.name = "ApiError";
  }
}

/** `path` is the full API path, e.g. "/api/runs", so each call names its route. */
async function request<T>(path: string, init?: RequestInit): Promise<T> {
  let res: Response;
  try {
    res = await fetch(path, { ...init, headers: { "content-type": "application/json", ...init?.headers } });
  } catch {
    throw new ApiError(0, "Scout's server isn't responding. Check that it's running, then try again.");
  }
  const body = (await res.json().catch(() => ({}))) as { error?: string; details?: string[] };
  if (!res.ok) throw new ApiError(res.status, body.error ?? `Request failed with status ${res.status}`, body.details);
  return body as T;
}

<summary>Tool use: **Write**</summary>

```sh
#!/usr/bin/env bash
# One command for a session against Scout: a fresh copy of Scout, Scout's app on :8788,
# and the harness (:4310 server, :5173 shell) pointed at the copy.
#
# Usage: npm run demo [-- options]
#   --no-map    let the cartographer propose the map (default: start from fixtures/scout-agent.domains.yaml)
#   --replace   stop a harness that is already running on :4310 / :5173 first
#   --with-data, --keep, --offline   passed to scripts/fresh-scout.sh
#
# Ctrl+C stops everything. Run it again for a clean slate; the original ../scout-agent is never touched.
set -euo pipefail

here="$(cd "$(dirname "$0")/.." && pwd)"
src="$(cd "${SCOUT_SRC:-$here/../scout-agent}" && pwd)"
run_dir="${SCOUT_RUN_DIR:-$(dirname "$src")/scout-run}"
port="${SCOUT_PORT:-8788}"
slug="${HARNESS_REPO_SLUG:-johnz4021/scout-agent}"

map="--map" replace=0 pass=()
for arg in "$@"; do
  case "$arg" in
    --no-map) map="" ;;
    --replace) replace=1 ;;
    -h|--help) sed -n '2,11p' "$0"; exit 0 ;;
    *) pass+=("$arg") ;;
  esac
done

listening() { lsof -nP -iTCP:"$1" -sTCP:LISTEN -t 2>/dev/null || true; }

busy=""
for p in 4310 5173; do [[ -n "$(listening "$p")" ]] && busy="$busy :$p"; done
if [[ -n "$busy" ]]; then
  if (( replace )); then
    echo "stopping the harness already running on$busy"
    for p in 4310 5173; do pids="$(listening "$p")"; [[ -z "$pids" ]] || kill $pids 2>/dev/null || true; done
    sleep 1
  else
    echo "A harness is already running on$busy (maybe another session's)." >&2
    echo "Stop it, or run: npm run demo -- --replace" >&2
    exit 1
  fi
fi

SCOUT_RUN_DIR="$run_dir" SCOUT_PORT="$port" "$here/scripts/fresh-scout.sh" ${map:+"$map"} ${pass[@]+"${pass[@]}"} >/dev/null
echo "fresh Scout ready at $run_dir (from demo-start)"
echo "  Scout app  http://localhost:$port"
echo "  Harness    http://localhost:5173"
echo

cd "$here"
exec npx concurrently -k -n scout,harness -c green,blue \
  "cd '$run_dir' && PORT=$port npm run --silent dev:api" \
  "HARNESS_REPO='$run_dir' HARNESS_REPO_SLUG='$slug' npm run dev"

```

/** Domains in map order, layers in map order (those with at least one cell), and the cell ids that exist. */
export function gridOf(graph: ContextGraph): ProjectionGrid {
  let g = grids.get(graph);
  if (g) return g;
  const domains: string[] = [];
  const layers = new Map<string, number>();
  const cells: string[] = [];
  for (const id of graph.children[graph.root] ?? []) {
    const d = graph.nodes[id]!;
    if (d.kind !== 'domain') continue;
    domains.push(d.domain!);
    for (const c of graph.children[id] ?? []) {
      const n = graph.nodes[c]!;
      if (n.kind !== 'cell') continue;
      cells.push(c);
      layers.set(n.layer!, n.order);
    }
  }
  g = { domains, layers: [...layers].sort((a, b) => a[1] - b[1]).map(([l]) => l), cells };
  grids.set(graph, g);
  return g;
}

import type { ChatMessage, ContactRow } from "../shared/types";
import { recordCost } from "./cost-ledger";
import { getProvider } from "./providers";
import { redactMessages } from "./redact";

export type Purpose = "plan" | "profile" | "summary" | "brief" | "email";

export const PURPOSES: readonly Purpose[] = ["plan", "profile", "summary", "brief", "email"];

/** Short, routine tasks think less; the brief is the one place depth pays off. */
const EFFORT: Record<Purpose, "low" | "medium"> = {
  plan: "low",
  profile: "low",
  summary: "low",
  brief: "medium",
  email: "low",
};

export interface CompleteRequest {
  purpose: Purpose;
  messages: ChatMessage[];
  runId?: string;
  maxTokens?: number;
}

export interface Completion {
  text: string;
  provider: string;
  model: string;
  redactions: number;
  truncated: boolean;
  costId: string;
}

export class GatewayError extends Error {
  constructor(message: string) {
    super(message);
    this.name = "GatewayError";
  }
}

// Tells the model what the redaction tokens are, so it doesn't treat them as missing data.
const PLACEHOLDER_NOTE =
  "Personal details in this conversation are replaced with placeholders such as [NAME_1], [EMAIL_1] and [PHONE_1]. They stand for real values: use them as written and don't comment on them.";

/** Names of everyone in `contacts`; these are redacted along with emails and phone numbers. */
async function knownContactNames(): Promise<string[]> {
  const rows = await db.query<Pick<ContactRow, "name">>("select name from contacts where name <> ''");
  return rows.map((c) => c.name);
}

/**
 * The one way to call a language model: redacts personal data, sends to the
 * configured provider and records the cost.
 */
export async function complete(request: CompleteRequest): Promise<Completion> {
  if (!PURPOSES.includes(request.purpose)) {
    throw new GatewayError(`unknown purpose "${request.purpose}"; expected one of ${PURPOSES.join(", ")}`);
  }
  if (request.messages.length === 0) throw new GatewayError("messages must not be empty");

  const redacted = redactMessages(request.messages, await knownContactNames());
  const { count } = redacted;
  const messages = count > 0 ? [{ role: "system" as const, content: PLACEHOLDER_NOTE }, ...redacted.messages] : redacted.messages;
  const provider = getProvider();
  const reply = await provider.chat(messages, { maxTokens: request.maxTokens, effort: EFFORT[request.purpose] });

  const cost = await recordCost({
    runId: request.runId,
    purpose: request.purpose,
    provider: reply.provider,
    model: reply.model,
    inputChars: messages.reduce((n, m) => n + m.content.length, 0),
    outputChars: reply.text.length,
  });

  return {

import { enrichCompany, enrichPerson, type CompanyProfile, type PersonProfile } from "../../vendor/enrichment/index";
import { complete } from "../gateway/complete";
import type { Tool } from "../shared/types";

const SYSTEM =
  "You write a two-sentence company profile for a sales rep: what the company does and how big it is, then who the contact is and what they likely care about.";

function leadSentence(company: CompanyProfile): string {
  const industry = company.industry.toLowerCase();
  const size = [
    company.employees ? `about ${company.employees.toLocaleString("en-US")} employees` : "",
    company.revenue ? `revenue of ${company.revenue}` : "",
  ].filter(Boolean);
  return `${company.name} is ${/^[aeiou]/.test(industry) ? "an" : "a"} ${industry} company based in ${company.headquarters}${
    size.length ? `, with ${size.join(" and ")}` : ""
  }.`;
}

function companyLines(company: CompanyProfile): string[] {
  return [
    `Company: ${company.name}${company.domain ? ` (${company.domain})` : ""}`,
    `Industry: ${company.industry}`,
    company.employees ? `Employees: ${company.employees.toLocaleString("en-US")}` : "",
    company.revenue ? `Revenue: ${company.revenue}` : "",
    company.founded ? `Founded: ${company.founded}` : "",
    `Headquarters: ${company.headquarters}`,
    `About: ${company.description}`,
    company.tech.length ? `Uses: ${company.tech.join(", ")}` : "",
  ].filter(Boolean);
}

function personLines(person: PersonProfile, given: { name?: string; title?: string }): string[] {
  const name = person.name ?? given.name;
  const title = person.title ?? given.title;
  return [
    name ? `Contact: ${name}` : "Contact: unknown",
    title ? `Title: ${title}` : "",
    person.seniority ? `Seniority: ${person.seniority}` : "",
  ].filter(Boolean);
}

It wasn't automatic before; now it's one command. From the harness repo:

```
npm run demo
```

That runs everything in one step:
1. Makes a fresh copy of Scout from `demo-start` into `../scout-run` (about 5 seconds).
2. Seeds the copy's database and adds the starting map.
3. Starts Scout's app on http://localhost:8788 and the harness on http://localhost:5173, pointed at the copy.

Ctrl+C stops everything. Running `npm run demo` again gives you a clean slate. The original `../scout-agent` is never touched.

**Options** (after `--`, e.g. `npm run demo -- --no-map`):
- `--no-map`: let the cartographer propose the map, for filming the load beat.
- `--with-data`: copy the original's database (pre-run research) instead of seeding.
- `--keep`: archive the previous copy instead of deleting it.
- `--offline`: use the sample companies.
- `--replace`: stop a harness that's already running.

**Right now you'd need `--replace`.** A harness dev server is running on :4310/:5173 against the other session's test sandbox, so `npm run demo` refuses to start and says so. That's deliberate, so it never kills someone else's session by accident. Stop that one first, or use `--replace` once you're sure you don't need it.

**Tested:**
- It refused correctly while the other harness was running.
- With a stand-in for the harness (so I didn't disturb that session), it made the copy and brought Scout's app up live on :8788.
- The harness command received the right repository settings.
- Ctrl+C took everything down together, and the original stayed clean at `demo-start`.

I haven't run the real harness through it end to end, because the ports are taken.

- Change Scout itself only in the original, then move the `demo-start` tag.

**Not committed:** `CLAUDE.md`, `package.json` (the `demo` script), `scripts/demo.sh`, `scripts/fresh-scout.sh` and the two plan files are all uncommitted in the harness repo, since the other session is merging there. /** Compiled, cached picomatch matcher for a single glob (exact paths match themselves). */
export function globMatcher(glob: string): (path: string) => boolean {
  let m = globCache.get(glob);
  if (!m) {
    m = picomatch(glob, { dot: true });
    globCache.set(glob, m);
  }
  return m;
}

import type { UIState } from '../events';
import type { HistoryTurn } from '../contracts/cartography';

/**
 * Harness turns as history units: the files each turn edited (attributed or not), in log order.
 * Turns that only read are skipped; they say nothing about where change lands.
 */
export function historyFromUI(ui: UIState): HistoryTurn[] {
  const out: HistoryTurn[] = [];
  for (const t of ui.turns) {
    const files = Object.entries(t.paths).filter(([, a]) => a.edits > 0).map(([p]) => p).sort();
    if (files.length) out.push({ id: t.id, source: 'turn', files });
  }
  return out;
}

/**

 */
export function isBulk(files: readonly string[], known: ReadonlySet<string>): boolean {
  const n = files.filter((f) => known.has(f)).length;
  return n > 10 && n > 0.3 * known.size;
