```typescript
// computeJourneys (NAVIGATION_PLAN §2 "Journeys", phase N10): every entry (bin, script, cli, main, route, page) traced
// through the wiring to its sinks, with UI fetch sites linked to the routes they call. Pure, deterministic, browser-safe.
// Names are placeholders here; the server's namer replaces them (inferred until the user confirms).
import type { FileFacts, RouteFact } from '../contracts/facts';
import type { ContextGraph, GraphEdge } from '../contracts/graph';
import type { Journey, JourneyStepKind } from '../contracts/cartography';
import { edgeId } from '../contracts/graph';
import { EXTERNAL_LAYER } from '../graph/build';
import { trace } from '../graph/trace';
import { fnv1a } from '../cartography/util';
import { matchRoute, type FetchSite } from './fetches';

type StepConfidence = Journey['steps'][number]['confidence'];
export type FetchLink = { site: FetchSite; route: RouteFact; confidence: 'syntactic' | 'inferred' };

const byId = (a: string, b: string) => (a < b ? -1 : a > b ? 1 : 0);

/** `journey:<slug>` from an entry: routes use `<method> <path>`, others `<kind> <label>`; `{}` reads as `id`. */
export function journeySlug(entry: { kind: string; label: string }): string {
  const text = entry.kind === 'route' ? entry.label : `${entry.kind} ${entry.label}`;
  return text.toLowerCase().replace(/\{\}/g, 'id').replace(/[^a-z0-9]+/g, '-').replace(/^-+|-+$/g, '') || 'entry';
}

/** Content hash of a journey's step list (what a name describes); the name cache is keyed by it. */
export const journeyHash = (j: Pick<Journey, 'steps'>) => fnv1a(j.steps.map((s) => s.node).join('\n'));

/** Each fetch site matched to a route (sites without a match are dropped). */
export function linkFetches(sites: readonly FetchSite[], facts: Readonly<Record<string, FileFacts>>): FetchLink[] {
  const routes = Object.values(facts).flatMap((f) => f.routes).sort((a, b) => byId(a.id, b.id));
  const serving = new Set(routes.map((r) => r.file));
  const out: FetchLink[] = [];
  for (const site of sites) {
    if (serving.has(site.file)) continue; // a server calling its own routes is not a UI flow
    const m = matchRoute(site, routes);
    if (m) out.push({ site, ...m });
  }
  return out;
}

/**
 * Sinks a flow ends at: tables, vendor packages claimed by an `external` cell, and code inside `external` cells. Bare
 * packages nobody claimed (react, node builtins) are plumbing, not destinations; they count only when the map claims
 * no external at all (then every vendor except `node:` builtins).
 */
export function journeySinks(graph: ContextGraph): string[] {
  const all = Object.values(graph.nodes);
  const claimed = all.filter((n) => n.kind === 'table' || ((n.kind === 'vendor' || n.kind === 'file' || n.kind === 'symbol') && n.layer === EXTERNAL_LAYER));
  const chosen = claimed.some((n) => n.kind !== 'table') ? claimed : all.filter((n) => n.kind === 'table' || (n.kind === 'vendor' && !n.id.startsWith('vendor:node:')));
  return chosen.map((n) => n.id).sort(byId);
}

/**
 * One journey per entry, sorted by id.
 * - Route entries start at the route; when UI code fetches it, the journey starts there instead: the UI symbol that calls
 *   the fetch site (`page`), the site (`fetch`), then the route. Only the first site (syntactic before inferred, then by id)
 *   is drawn; a route nobody fetches starts at the route.
 * - Other entries start at the entry, then its symbol (or file).
 * - From the start, `trace` (calls ∪ handles ∪ implements, plus the fetch → route links) finds the shortest chains to
 *   each sink. The longest chain is the main path; the others are branches that leave it where they diverge.
 * Step confidence is that of the edge into the step (`handles` and the first step: syntactic; `implements`: dispatch;
 * a fetch link: its match confidence).
 */
export function computeJourneys(graph: ContextGraph, facts: Readonly<Record<string, FileFacts>>, sites: readonly FetchSite[] = []): Journey[] {
  const links = linkFetches(sites, facts).filter((l) => graph.nodes[l.site.from] && graph.nodes[l.route.id]);
  // Fetch links ride along as `handles` edges so `trace` walks them (trace walks calls/handles forward); never shown.
  const extra: GraphEdge[] = links.map((l) => ({ id: edgeId('fetches', l.site.from, l.route.id), kind: 'handles', from: l.site.from, to: l.route.id, count: 1, owner: l.site.file }));
  const g: ContextGraph = extra.length ? { ...graph, edges: [...graph.edges, ...extra] } : graph;
  const sinks = journeySinks(graph);

  const conf = new Map<string, StepConfidence>();
  const key = (a: string, b: string) => `${a}\u0000${b}`;
  const callers = new Map<string, string[]>();
  for (const e of graph.edges) {
    if (e.kind === 'calls') {
      if (!conf.has(key(e.from, e.to))) conf.set(key(e.from, e.to), e.confidence ?? 'syntactic');
      (callers.get(e.to) ?? callers.set(e.to, []).get(e.to)!).push(e.from);
    } else if (e.kind === 'handles') conf.set(key(e.from, e.to), 'syntactic');
    else if (e.kind === 'implements') conf.set(key(e.to, e.from), 'dispatch');
  }
  for (const l of links) conf.set(key(l.site.from, l.route.id), l.confidence);
  const siteIds = new Set(links.map((l) => l.site.from));

  const routes = new Map(Object.values(facts).flatMap((f) => f.routes).map((r) => [`entry:route:${r.method} ${r.path}`, r]));
  const entries = [...new Map(Object.values(facts).flatMap((f) => f.entries).map((e) => [e.id, e])).values()].sort((a, b) => byId(a.id, b.id));
  const used = new Map<string, number>();
  const out: Journey[] = [];

  for (const entry of entries) {
    const prefix: { node: string; kind: JourneyStepKind }[] = [];
    let start: string;
    const route = entry.kind === 'route' ? routes.get(entry.id) : undefined;
    if (route && graph.nodes[route.id]) {
      start = route.id;
      const hits = links.filter((l) => l.route.id === route.id)
        .sort((a, b) => (a.confidence === b.confidence ? 0 : a.confidence === 'syntactic' ? -1 : 1) || byId(a.site.from, b.site.from));
      const first = hits[0];
      if (first) {
        const page = pageFor(graph, callers, first.site.from);
        if (page) prefix.push({ node: page, kind: 'page' });
        prefix.push({ node: first.site.from, kind: 'fetch' });
      }
    } else {
      start = entry.symbol && graph.nodes[entry.symbol] ? entry.symbol : entry.file;
      prefix.push({ node: entry.id, kind: 'entry' });
    }

    const paths = graph.nodes[start] ? trace(g, start, sinks) : [];
    let main = paths[0] ?? [start];
    for (const p of paths) if (p.length > main.length) main = p;
    const nodes = [...prefix.map((p) => p.node), ...main];
    const steps: Journey['steps'] = nodes.map((node, i) => {
      const pre = prefix[i];
      const kind: JourneyStepKind = pre?.kind ?? stepKind(graph, node, siteIds, entry.kind === 'page' && i === prefix.length);
      const into = i === 0 ? 'syntactic' : (conf.get(key(nodes[i - 1]!, node)) ?? (pre?.kind === 'fetch' ? 'syntactic' : 'syntactic'));
      return { node, kind, confidence: into };
    });
    const branches: Journey['branches'] = [];
    for (const p of paths) {
      if (p === main) continue;
      let i = 0;
      while (i < p.length && i < main.length && p[i] === main[i]) i++;
      if (i === 0 || i >= p.length) continue;
      branches.push({ from: prefix.length + i - 1, steps: p.slice(i) });
    }

    const slug = journeySlug(entry);
    const n = (used.get(slug) ?? 0) + 1;
    used.set(slug, n);
    out.push({
      id: `journey:${n > 1 ? `${slug}-${n}` : slug}`,
      name: route ? `${route.method} ${route.path}` : `${entry.kind} ${entry.label}`,
      inferred: true,
      entry: entry.id,
      steps,
      branches,
    });
  }
  return out.sort((a, b) => byId(a.id, b.id));
}

/** The UI symbol behind a fetch site: a caller of it (components first, then by id), or null when nothing calls it. */
function pageFor(graph: ContextGraph, callers: Map<string, string[]>, site: string): string | null {
  const list = [...new Set(callers.get(site) ?? [])].filter((c) => c !== site && graph.nodes[c]);
  list.sort((a, b) => {
    const ca = graph.nodes[a]!.symbol?.kind === 'component' ? 0 : 1;
    const cb = graph.nodes[b]!.symbol?.kind === 'component' ? 0 : 1;
    return ca - cb || byId(a, b);
  });
  return list[0] ?? null;
}

function stepKind(graph: ContextGraph, id: string, sites: ReadonlySet<string>, page: boolean): JourneyStepKind {
  if (id.startsWith('entry:')) return 'entry';
  if (id.startsWith('route:')) return 'route';
  if (id.startsWith('table:')) return 'table';
  const n = graph.nodes[id];
  if (id.startsWith('vendor:') || n?.layer === EXTERNAL_LAYER) return 'vendor';
  if (sites.has(id)) return 'fetch';
  return page ? 'page' : 'symbol';
}
```

```typescript
// SemanticResolver fallback: the TS 6 compiler bundled with ts-morph. Stable API, slower to open and heavier on memory
// than tsgo; chosen automatically when TypeScript 7 can't load on this platform.
import { existsSync } from 'node:fs';
import { join, relative, sep } from 'node:path';
import type { Node, Program, Project, SourceFile, TypeChecker } from 'ts-morph';
import { isAbstract, kindTable, packageOf, qualifiedName, type DeclNode } from './names';
import type { DeclInfo, ResolverOptions, SemanticResolver } from './types';

const posix = (p: string) => p.split(sep).join('/');

export async function createTsMorphResolver({ root, files }: ResolverOptions): Promise<SemanticResolver> {
  const { Project: ProjectCtor, ts } = await import('ts-morph');
  const kindOf = kindTable(ts.SyntaxKind as unknown as Record<string, unknown>);
  const abs = (rel: string) => join(root, rel);
  const tsconfig = join(root, 'tsconfig.json');
  const project: Project = existsSync(tsconfig)
    ? new ProjectCtor({ tsConfigFilePath: tsconfig })
    : new ProjectCtor({
        compilerOptions: {
          allowJs: true, checkJs: false, jsx: ts.JsxEmit.Preserve, module: ts.ModuleKind.ESNext, target: ts.ScriptTarget.ES2022,
          moduleResolution: ts.ModuleResolutionKind.Bundler, skipLibCheck: true, noEmit: true, esModuleInterop: true, resolveJsonModule: true,
        },
      });
  if (!existsSync(tsconfig)) for (const f of files) project.addSourceFileAtPathIfExists(abs(f));

  let program: ReturnType<Program['compilerObject']['getTypeChecker']> extends never ? never : import('ts-morph').ts.Program | null = null;
  let checker: TypeChecker['compilerObject'] | null = null;
  const decls = new Map<import('ts-morph').ts.Node, DeclInfo>();
  const current = () => {
    if (!program) {
      program = project.getProgram().compilerObject;
      checker = program.getTypeChecker();
      decls.clear();
    }
    return { program, checker: checker! };
  };

  /** Innermost node containing `pos` (positions point at identifiers, never into trivia). */
  const nodeAt = (sf: import('ts-morph').ts.SourceFile, pos: number) => {
    let n: import('ts-morph').ts.Node = sf;
    for (;;) {
      const c: import('ts-morph').ts.Node | undefined = ts.forEachChild(n, (ch) => (ch.pos <= pos && pos < ch.end ? ch : undefined));
      if (!c) return n;
      n = c;
    }
  };

  const classify = (d: import('ts-morph').ts.Declaration): DeclInfo => {
    let info = decls.get(d);
    if (info) return info;
    const fileName = d.getSourceFile().fileName;
    const pkg = packageOf(fileName);
    const rel = posix(relative(root, fileName));
    if (fileName.includes('/node_modules/')) info = pkg ? { where: 'package', pkg } : { where: 'lib' };
    else if (!rel || rel.startsWith('..')) info = { where: 'lib' };
    else info = { where: 'repo', file: rel, name: qualifiedName(d as unknown as DeclNode, kindOf), abstract: isAbstract(d as unknown as DeclNode, kindOf) };
    decls.set(d, info);
    return info;
  };

  const sourceFile = (rel: string): SourceFile | undefined => project.getSourceFile(abs(rel)) ?? (() => {
    const sf = project.addSourceFileAtPathIfExists(abs(rel));
    if (sf) program = null;
    return sf;
  })();

  return {
    impl: 'ts-morph',
    declarationsAt(file, positions) {
      if (!positions.length) return [];
      if (!sourceFile(file)) return positions.map(() => null);
      const { program: p, checker: c } = current();
      const sf = p.getSourceFile(abs(file));
      if (!sf) return positions.map(() => null);
      return positions.map((pos) => {
        try {
          let s = c.getSymbolAtLocation(nodeAt(sf, pos));
          if (s && s.flags & ts.SymbolFlags.Alias) s = c.getAliasedSymbol(s);
          const d = s?.declarations?.[0] ?? s?.valueDeclaration;
          return d ? classify(d) : null;
        } catch {
          return null;
        }
      });
    },
    update({ changed, created, deleted }) {
      for (const f of changed) project.getSourceFile(abs(f))?.refreshFromFileSystemSync();
      for (const f of created) project.addSourceFileAtPathIfExists(abs(f));
      for (const f of deleted) {
        const sf = project.getSourceFile(abs(f));
        if (sf) project.removeSourceFile(sf);
      }
      if (changed.length || created.length || deleted.length) program = null;
    },
    close() {
      program = null;
      checker = null;
      decls.clear();
    },
  };
}

export type { Node };
```

```typescript
// The browser's ELK: elkjs's own worker script, loaded on the first layout only (v1 never pulls it in).
import type { ElkNode } from 'elkjs/lib/elk-api';
import { cachedLayout, type ElkApi } from './containers';

let elk: Promise<ElkApi> | null = null;

function getElk(): Promise<ElkApi> {
  elk ??= Promise.all([import('elkjs/lib/elk-api.js'), import('elkjs/lib/elk-worker.min.js?url')]).then(([api, url]) => {
    const ELK = api.default;
    return new ELK({ workerFactory: () => new Worker(url.default) }) as unknown as ElkApi;
  });
  return elk;
}

export const layoutContainer = cachedLayout(getElk);
export const clearLayoutCache = () => layoutContainer.cache.clear();

/** Boot the worker and JIT ELK before the first expand (the cold first layout took ~160 ms on the M1). */
export const warmElk = () =>
  getElk().then((api) => api.layout({ id: 'warm', layoutOptions: { 'elk.algorithm': 'layered' }, children: [{ id: 'a', width: 10, height: 10 }, { id: 'b', width: 10, height: 10 }], edges: [{ id: 'e', sources: ['a'], targets: ['b'] }] } as ElkNode));
```

```typescript
// Where Tier 2 asks the checker: every call/new site (oxc gives positions) attributed to the enclosing Tier 1 symbol,
// and every place a class or a typed object literal implements a type (`implements I`, `extends B`, `const x: I = {…}`,
// `{…} satisfies I`). Node-only (oxc-parser).
import { parseSync, visitorKeys } from 'oxc-parser';
import type { SymbolFact } from '../../contracts/facts';
import { parseName } from '../record';

/** A call or `new`: `at` is the callee identifier (or member name) offset; `from` the enclosing symbol id or the file. */
export type CallSite = { at: number; from: string };
/** A type a class/object implements: `at` is its name; `members` maps member names to the implementing symbol ids. */
export type ImplSite = { at: number; members: { name: string; id: string }[] };

type N = { type: string; start: number; end: number; [key: string]: any };
const WRAPPERS = new Set(['TSAsExpression', 'TSSatisfiesExpression', 'TSNonNullExpression', 'ParenthesizedExpression', 'TSTypeAssertion', 'TSInstantiationExpression', 'ChainExpression']);
const FN = new Set(['ArrowFunctionExpression', 'FunctionExpression']);
const unwrap = (n: N | null | undefined): N | null => {
  let x = n ?? null;
  while (x && WRAPPERS.has(x.type)) x = x.expression;
  return x;
};
const keyName = (key: N, computed: boolean): string | null => {
  if (!computed && key.type === 'Identifier') return key.name;
  if (key.type === 'PrivateIdentifier') return `#${key.name}`;
  return key.type === 'Literal' && typeof key.value === 'string' ? key.value : null;
};
/** Offset of the name a callee or type reference ends in: `f`, `a.b.f`, `new ns.C`, `I<T>`, `ns.I`. */
function namePos(n: N | null | undefined): number | null {
  const x = unwrap(n);
  if (!x) return null;
  if (x.type === 'Identifier') return x.start;
  if (x.type === 'MemberExpression') return !x.computed ? x.property.start : x.property.type === 'Literal' && typeof x.property.value === 'string' ? x.property.start : null;
  if (x.type === 'TSQualifiedName') return x.right.start;
  if (x.type === 'TSTypeReference') return namePos(x.typeName);
  return null;
}

/**
 * Call and implementation sites of `source`. `symbols` are the file's Tier 1 symbols for this exact text: calls are
 * attributed to the innermost one whose span contains them, and implementing members must be one of them.
 */
export function scanSites(path: string, source: string, symbols: readonly SymbolFact[]): { calls: CallSite[]; impls: ImplSite[] } {
  const calls: CallSite[] = [];
  const impls: ImplSite[] = [];
  const r = parseSync(parseName(path), source);
  if (r.errors.length) return { calls, impls };
  const ids = new Set(symbols.map((s) => s.id));
  const enclosing = (at: number): string => {
    let best: SymbolFact | null = null;
    for (const s of symbols) {
      if (s.span.start <= at && at < s.span.end && (!best || s.span.end - s.span.start < best.span.end - best.span.start)) best = s;
    }
    return best?.id ?? path;
  };
  const owned = (owner: string, keys: string[]) =>
    keys.flatMap((name) => (ids.has(`${path}#${owner}.${name}`) ? [{ name, id: `${path}#${owner}.${name}` }] : []));
  const implement = (type: N | null | undefined, owner: string, keys: string[]) => {
    const at = namePos(type);
    const members = owned(owner, keys);
    if (at !== null && members.length) impls.push({ at, members });
  };
  const classKeys = (body: N[]) =>
    body.flatMap((m) => {
      const key = m.key ? keyName(m.key, m.computed) : null;
      if (!key) return [];
      if (m.type === 'MethodDefinition' || m.type === 'TSAbstractMethodDefinition') return [m.kind === 'constructor' ? 'constructor' : key];
      return m.type === 'PropertyDefinition' && FN.has(unwrap(m.value)?.type ?? '') ? [key] : [];
    });
  const objectKeys = (obj: N) =>
    (obj.properties as N[]).flatMap((p) => {
      const key = p.type === 'Property' ? keyName(p.key, p.computed) : null;
      return key && (p.method || FN.has(unwrap(p.value)?.type ?? '')) ? [key] : [];
    });
  const klass = (c: N, name: string) => {
    const keys = classKeys(c.body.body as N[]);
    for (const i of (c.implements ?? []) as N[]) implement(i.expression, name, keys);
    if (c.superClass) implement(c.superClass, name, keys);
  };

  const visit = (node: N | null | undefined, name: string | null): void => {
    if (!node || typeof node.type !== 'string') return;
    switch (node.type) {
      case 'CallExpression':
      case 'NewExpression': {
        const at = namePos(node.callee);
        if (at !== null && unwrap(node.callee)?.type !== 'Super') calls.push({ at, from: enclosing(at) });
        break;
      }
      case 'ClassDeclaration':
      case 'ClassExpression':
        klass(node, node.id?.name ?? name ?? 'default');
        break;
      case 'VariableDeclarator': {
        if (node.id.type !== 'Identifier') break;
        const init = unwrap(node.init);
        if (init?.type === 'ClassExpression') {
          for (const key of visitorKeys[init.type] ?? []) walk(init[key], node.id.name);
          klass(init, node.id.name);
          walk(node.init === init ? null : node.init, null);
          return;
        }
        if (init?.type === 'ObjectExpression') {
          const keys = objectKeys(init);
          const ann = node.id.typeAnnotation?.typeAnnotation;
          if (ann?.type === 'TSTypeReference') implement(ann, node.id.name, keys);
          for (let x: N | null = node.init; x && x !== init; x = x.expression) if (x.type === 'TSSatisfiesExpression') implement(x.typeAnnotation, node.id.name, keys);
        }
        break;
      }
      case 'ExportDefaultDeclaration': {
        const d = node.declaration as N;
        if (d.type === 'TSSatisfiesExpression' && unwrap(d)?.type === 'ObjectExpression') implement(d.typeAnnotation, 'default', objectKeys(unwrap(d)!));
        break;
      }
    }
    for (const key of visitorKeys[node.type] ?? []) walk(node[key], null);
  };
  const walk = (child: unknown, name: string | null) => {
    if (Array.isArray(child)) for (const c of child) visit(c as N, name);
    else if (child && typeof child === 'object') visit(child as N, name);
  };
  visit(r.program as unknown as N, null);
  return { calls, impls };
}
```

```typescript
// Tier 2 facts for one file: ask the resolver about every call site and implementation site, then express the answers
// in Tier 1 ids. The result replaces the file's syntactic calls in buildGraph, so it keeps what Tier 1 knew that the
// checker didn't contradict: vendor/table calls, and syntactic guesses in symbols where the checker gave up.
import type { CallFact, FileFacts, SemanticFacts } from '../../contracts/facts';
import { settleCalls } from '../extract';
import { hashText } from '../hash';
import { BULK_MIN, isMinified } from '../record';
import { scanSites } from './sites';
import type { SemanticResolver } from './types';

export type ResolveStats = { sites: number; typed: number; dispatch: number; unresolved: number; implements: number };

export const emptyStats = (): ResolveStats => ({ sites: 0, typed: 0, dispatch: 0, unresolved: 0, implements: 0 });

const byKey = (a: { from: string; to: string }, b: { from: string; to: string }) =>
  a.from < b.from ? -1 : a.from > b.from ? 1 : a.to < b.to ? -1 : a.to > b.to ? 1 : 0;

/**
 * SemanticFacts for `facts.path` at `facts.hash`, or null when `source` isn't the text those facts describe (the file
 * moved on; a newer request follows) or is too large/minified for symbols. `symbolsOf` gives Tier 1 symbol names per
 * file, for trimming qualified names to symbols that exist (`settleCalls`).
 */
export function semanticFacts(
  resolver: SemanticResolver,
  facts: FileFacts,
  source: string,
  symbolsOf: (file: string) => ReadonlySet<string> | null,
): { facts: SemanticFacts; stats: ResolveStats } | null {
  if (hashText(source) !== facts.hash || source.length > BULK_MIN || isMinified(source)) return null;
  const path = facts.path;
  const { calls: sites, impls } = scanSites(path, source, facts.symbols);
  const decls = resolver.declarationsAt(path, [...sites.map((s) => s.at), ...impls.map((s) => s.at)]);
  const stats = emptyStats();
  stats.sites = sites.length;

  const vendors = new Set(facts.imports.filter((i) => i.to.startsWith('vendor:')).map((i) => i.to));
  const raw: CallFact[] = [];
  const gaveUp = new Set<string>(); // symbols with a call the checker couldn't resolve
  sites.forEach((site, i) => {
    const d = decls[i];
    if (!d) {
      stats.unresolved++;
      gaveUp.add(site.from);
    } else if (d.where === 'repo') {
      raw.push({ from: site.from, to: `${d.file}#${d.name}`, confidence: d.abstract ? 'dispatch' : 'typed', count: 1 });
    } else if (d.where === 'package' && vendors.has(`vendor:${d.pkg}`)) {
      raw.push({ from: site.from, to: `vendor:${d.pkg}`, confidence: 'typed', count: 1 });
    }
  });
  const typed = settleCalls(raw, symbolsOf);
  for (const c of typed) c.confidence === 'dispatch' ? stats.dispatch++ : stats.typed++;

  const seen = new Set(typed.map((c) => `${c.from}\u0000${c.to}`));
  const kept = facts.calls.filter((c) => {
    if (seen.has(`${c.from}\u0000${c.to}`)) return false;
    return c.to.startsWith('vendor:') || c.to.startsWith('table:') || gaveUp.has(c.from);
  });

  const implementsOut = new Map<string, { from: string; to: string }>();
  impls.forEach((site, i) => {
    const d = decls[sites.length + i];
    if (d?.where !== 'repo') return;
    const names = symbolsOf(d.file);
    for (const m of site.members) {
      const target = `${d.name}.${m.name}`;
      if (names?.has(target)) implementsOut.set(`${m.id}\u0000${d.file}#${target}`, { from: m.id, to: `${d.file}#${target}` });
    }
  });
  stats.implements = implementsOut.size;

  return {
    facts: { path, hash: facts.hash, calls: [...typed, ...kept].sort(byKey), implements: [...implementsOut.values()].sort(byKey) },
    stats,
  };
}
```

```typescript
// Pick a SemanticResolver: TypeScript 7 (tsgo) first; the TS 6 / ts-morph fallback when TS 7 can't load or start.
import { createTsgoResolver } from './tsgo';
import { createTsMorphResolver } from './tsmorph';
import type { ResolverImpl, ResolverOptions, SemanticResolver } from './types';

export type ResolverChoice = ResolverImpl | 'auto';

export async function openResolver(opts: ResolverOptions, prefer: ResolverChoice = 'auto'): Promise<{ resolver: SemanticResolver; fallback: string | null }> {
  let fallback: string | null = null;
  if (prefer !== 'ts-morph') {
    try {
      return { resolver: await createTsgoResolver(opts), fallback };
    } catch (e) {
      if (prefer === 'tsgo') throw e;
      fallback = `TypeScript 7 unavailable (${(e as Error).message.split('\n')[0]}); using TS 6 via ts-morph`;
    }
  }
  return { resolver: await createTsMorphResolver(opts), fallback };
}
```

```typescript
// The deterministic domain × layer grid at every depth (NAVIGATION_PLAN §1.2, §3.3). An open column widens to fit
// its containers, the other columns compress to spines, rows grow to the tallest container. Expanded containers are
// laid out by ELK bottom-up; edges route inside containers (ELK), leave through ports, and continue through the
// gutters. Edge declutter: only edges touching the focus region, plus every violation, new and ghost edge, are drawn
// in full; the rest fade (inside containers) or merge into one faint trunk per column pair with a count.
import type { EdgeStatus, Projection, ViolationState, VisibleEdge, VisibleNode } from '@harness/core/view';
import { PAD, SIZE, portKey, type Box, type ChildSpec, type ContainerInput, type ContainerLayout, type LayoutFn, type Pt, type Side } from './containers';

export const COL_W = 236;
export const SPINE_W = 64;
export const ROW_H = 132;
export const ROW_H_SPINE = 92; // rows with no open container shrink while a column is open
export const GAP_X = 56;
export const GAP_Y = 42;
/** Open tracks grow in steps, so a container that grows a little does not move its neighbours. */
export const STEP = 24;
export const UNASSIGNED = 'unassigned';
export const UNASSIGNED_COL = '__unassigned';

export type Meta = { domains: { id: string; name: string; purpose: string }[]; layers: { id: string; name: string }[] };

export type NodeType = 'band' | 'cell' | 'spine' | 'container' | 'file' | 'group' | 'chip';
export type FrameNode = Box & { id: string; type: NodeType; z: number };
export type FrameEdge = {
  id: string;
  d: string;
  status: EdgeStatus;
  violation: ViolationState;
  count: number;
  steps: number[];
  mid: Pt;
  from: string;
  to: string;
  /** Drawn faintly: outside the focus region. A trunk merges several such edges between two columns. */
  faint: boolean;
  trunk: string[] | null;
};
export type Col = { id: string; name: string; purpose: string; x: number; w: number; spine: boolean; open: boolean; index: number };
export type Row = { id: string; name: string; y: number; h: number };
export type Frame = {
  nodes: FrameNode[];
  boxes: Record<string, FrameNode>;
  edges: FrameEdge[];
  cols: Col[];
  rows: Row[];
  bounds: Box;
  focus: Box | null;
  gutters: { x: number[]; y: number[] };
  key: string;
};

const CONTAINER_KINDS = new Set(['cell', 'group', 'unassigned']);
const isContainer = (n: VisibleNode | undefined) => !!n && n.expanded && CONTAINER_KINDS.has(n.kind);

/** Index helpers over a projection: visible nodes by id, drawn nodes, columns. */
export function indexOf(p: Projection) {
  const byId = new Map(p.nodes.map((n) => [n.id, n]));
  const showUnassigned = (() => {
    const u = byId.get(UNASSIGNED);
    return !!u && (u.rollup.leaves > 0 || u.expanded);
  })();
  const drawn = (id: string) => {
    const n = byId.get(id);
    if (!n) return false;
    if (n.kind === 'cell') return true;
    if (id === UNASSIGNED) return showUnassigned;
    return isContainer(byId.get(n.parent ?? ''));
  };
  /** Column id of a node: its domain, or the Unassigned column. */
  const colId = (id: string): string | null => {
    const n = byId.get(id);
    if (!n) return null;
    if (n.domain) return n.domain;
    for (let x: VisibleNode | undefined = n; x; x = byId.get(x.parent ?? '')) if (x.id === UNASSIGNED) return UNASSIGNED_COL;
    return null;
  };
  /** ELK containers above a node, innermost first. */
  const containers = (id: string): string[] => {
    const out: string[] = [];
    for (let x = byId.get(byId.get(id)?.parent ?? ''); x; x = byId.get(x.parent ?? '')) if (isContainer(x)) out.push(x.id);
    return out;
  };
  return { byId, drawn, colId, containers, showUnassigned };
}

/** Expanded containers, deepest first (the bottom-up layout order). */
export function containerOrder(p: Projection): string[][] {
  const levels = new Map<number, string[]>();
  for (const n of p.nodes) if (isContainer(n)) (levels.get(n.depth) ?? levels.set(n.depth, []).get(n.depth)!).push(n.id);
  return [...levels].sort((a, b) => b[0] - a[0]).map(([, ids]) => ids);
}

/**
 * ELK input for one container: its drawn children (an open child container enters with its laid-out size and its
 * ports at fixed positions), the edges between its children, and a port for every edge that leaves or enters it.
 * A port faces the other end's column; within a column, out on the right and in on the left (ELK's flow is rightward).
 */
export function containerInput(p: Projection, id: string, done: ReadonlyMap<string, ContainerLayout>, colIndex: (col: string | null) => number): ContainerInput {
  const ix = indexOf(p);
  const children: ChildSpec[] = [];
  for (const n of p.nodes) {
    if (n.parent !== id || !ix.drawn(n.id)) continue;
    const sub = done.get(n.id);
    if (sub) {
      children.push({ id: n.id, w: sub.w, h: sub.h, ports: Object.entries(sub.ports).map(([key, q]) => ({ id: key, at: q.at, side: q.side })) });
    } else {
      const s = n.kind === 'file' ? SIZE.file : n.kind === 'group' ? SIZE.group : SIZE.chip;
      children.push({ id: n.id, w: s.w, h: s.h, ports: [] });
    }
  }
  const mine = new Set(children.map((c) => c.id));
  const here = ix.colId(id);
  /** The child of this container holding `x`, as an ELK endpoint (the child, or the child container's port). */
  const ref = (x: string, e: string): string | null => {
    if (mine.has(x)) return x;
    const chain = ix.containers(x);
    const i = chain.indexOf(id);
    if (i <= 0) return null;
    return portKey(e, chain[i - 1]!);
  };
  const edges: ContainerInput['edges'] = [];
  const ports: ContainerInput['ports'] = [];
  for (const e of drawnEdges(p)) {
    const a = ref(e.from, e.id);
    const b = ref(e.to, e.id);
    if (a && b) {
      if (a !== b) edges.push({ id: e.id, from: a, to: b });
    } else if (a || b) {
      const out = !!a;
      const peerCol = colIndex(ix.colId(out ? e.to : e.from));
      const selfCol = colIndex(here);
      const side: Side = peerCol > selfCol ? 'right' : peerCol < selfCol ? 'left' : out ? 'right' : 'left';
      ports.push({ key: portKey(e.id, id), edge: e.id, node: (a ?? b)!, side, direction: out ? 'out' : 'in' });
    }
  }
  return { id, children, edges, ports };
}

/** Edges whose two ends are drawn (tests, shared code and bare vendors are not drawn on the grid). */
export function drawnEdges(p: Projection): VisibleEdge[] {
  const ix = indexOf(p);
  return p.edges.filter((e) => ix.drawn(e.from) && ix.drawn(e.to));
}

export function columnIndex(p: Projection) {
  const order = [...p.grid.domains, UNASSIGNED_COL];
  return (col: string | null) => (col === null ? -1 : order.indexOf(col));
}

/** Lay out every expanded container bottom-up (siblings in parallel). */
export async function layoutAll(p: Projection, layout: LayoutFn): Promise<Map<string, ContainerLayout>> {
  const done = new Map<string, ContainerLayout>();
  const colIndex = columnIndex(p);
  for (const level of containerOrder(p)) {
    const ls = await Promise.all(level.map((id) => layout(containerInput(p, id, done, colIndex))));
    for (const l of ls) done.set(l.id, l);
  }
  return done;
}

const up = (n: number, step = STEP) => Math.ceil(n / step) * step;

export type FrameInput = {
  projection: Projection;
  meta: Meta;
  layouts: ReadonlyMap<string, ContainerLayout>;
  /** Roots of the focus region (edges touching them are drawn in full); null = everything. */
  region: readonly string[] | null;
  key: string;
};

export function buildFrame({ projection: p, meta, layouts, region, key }: FrameInput): Frame {
  const ix = indexOf(p);
  const cells = p.nodes.filter((n) => n.kind === 'cell');
  const openCol = new Set(cells.filter((n) => n.expanded).map((n) => n.domain!));
  const unassigned = ix.byId.get(UNASSIGNED);
  if (ix.showUnassigned && unassigned?.expanded) openCol.add(UNASSIGNED_COL);
  const any = openCol.size > 0;
  const dmeta = new Map(meta.domains.map((d) => [d.id, d]));
  const lmeta = new Map(meta.layers.map((l) => [l.id, l]));

  // ---- tracks
  const colIds = [...p.grid.domains, ...(ix.showUnassigned ? [UNASSIGNED_COL] : [])];
  const cols: Col[] = [];
  let x = 0;
  colIds.forEach((id, i) => {
    const open = openCol.has(id);
    let w = open ? COL_W : any ? SPINE_W : COL_W;
    if (open) {
      for (const c of cells) if (c.domain === id && c.expanded) w = Math.max(w, layouts.get(c.id)?.w ?? 0);
      if (id === UNASSIGNED_COL) w = Math.max(w, layouts.get(UNASSIGNED)?.w ?? 0);
      w = up(w);
    }
    const d = dmeta.get(id);
    cols.push({ id, name: d?.name ?? (id === UNASSIGNED_COL ? 'Unassigned' : id), purpose: d?.purpose ?? 'Files that match no cell in domains.yaml', x, w, spine: any && !open, open, index: i });
    x += w + GAP_X;
  });
  const rows: Row[] = [];
  let y = 0;
  for (const l of p.grid.layers) {
    let h = any ? ROW_H_SPINE : ROW_H;
    for (const c of cells) if (c.layer === l && c.expanded) h = Math.max(h, up(layouts.get(c.id)?.h ?? 0));
    rows.push({ id: l, name: lmeta.get(l)?.name ?? l, y, h });
    y += h + GAP_Y;
  }
  const width = Math.max(0, x - GAP_X);
  const height = Math.max(0, y - GAP_Y);
  const colOf = new Map(cols.map((c) => [c.id, c]));
  const rowOf = new Map(rows.map((r, j) => [r.id, { ...r, index: j }]));

  // ---- boxes: bands and grid cells, then container children (parents before children: projection pre-order)
  const nodes: FrameNode[] = [];
  const boxes: Record<string, FrameNode> = {};
  const add = (n: FrameNode) => { nodes.push(n); boxes[n.id] = n; };
  let focus: Box | null = null;
  for (const c of cols) {
    if (!c.open) continue;
    const id = c.id === UNASSIGNED_COL ? `band:${UNASSIGNED}` : `domain:${c.id}`;
    const b = { x: c.x - 14, y: -14, w: c.w + 28, h: height + 28 };
    add({ id, type: 'band', z: 0, ...b });
    focus = focus ? union(focus, b) : b;
  }
  for (const n of p.nodes) {
    if (n.kind === 'cell') {
      const c = colOf.get(n.domain!)!;
      const r = rowOf.get(n.layer!)!;
      add({ id: n.id, type: n.expanded ? 'container' : c.spine ? 'spine' : 'cell', z: 1, x: c.x, y: r.y, w: c.w, h: r.h });
    } else if (n.id === UNASSIGNED && ix.showUnassigned) {
      const c = colOf.get(UNASSIGNED_COL)!;
      const h = n.expanded ? Math.max(height, layouts.get(UNASSIGNED)?.h ?? 0) : height;
      add({ id: n.id, type: n.expanded ? 'container' : c.spine ? 'spine' : 'cell', z: 1, x: c.x, y: 0, w: c.w, h });
    } else if (ix.drawn(n.id)) {
      const parent = boxes[n.parent!];
      const b = layouts.get(n.parent!)?.nodes[n.id];
      if (!parent || !b) continue;
      const type: NodeType = isContainer(n) ? 'container' : n.kind === 'file' ? 'file' : n.kind === 'group' ? 'group' : 'chip';
      add({ id: n.id, type, z: n.depth, x: parent.x + b.x, y: parent.y + b.y, w: b.w, h: b.h });
    }
  }

  // ---- gutters and lanes
  const colGutter = (g: number) => (g <= 0 ? -GAP_X / 2 : cols[g - 1]!.x + cols[g - 1]!.w + GAP_X / 2);
  const rowGutter = (g: number) => (g <= 0 ? -GAP_Y / 2 : rows[g - 1]!.y + rows[g - 1]!.h + GAP_Y / 2);
  const used = new Map<string, number>();
  const take = (k: string) => { const n = used.get(k) ?? 0; used.set(k, n + 1); return n; };
  const lane = (i: number, s: number) => (i === 0 ? 0 : (i % 2 ? 1 : -1) * Math.ceil(i / 2) * s);
  const colAt = (px: number) => { let i = 0; while (i < cols.length - 1 && px > cols[i]!.x + cols[i]!.w + GAP_X / 2) i++; return i; };
  const rowAt = (py: number) => { let j = 0; while (j < rows.length - 1 && py > rows[j]!.y + rows[j]!.h + GAP_Y / 2) j++; return j; };

  type Anchor = { p: Pt; side: Side; col: number; row: number };
  const abs = (c: string, q: Pt): Pt => ({ x: boxes[c]!.x + q.x, y: boxes[c]!.y + q.y });
  const boxAnchor = (self: string, other: Pt): Anchor | null => {
    const b = boxes[self];
    if (!b) return null;
    const col = colAt(b.x + b.w / 2);
    const row = rowAt(b.y + Math.min(b.h / 2, 60));
    const oc = colAt(other.x);
    const or = rowAt(other.y);
    const side: Side = oc > col ? 'right' : oc < col ? 'left' : or > row ? 'bottom' : 'top';
    const k = take(`port:${self}:${side}`);
    const p = side === 'right' || side === 'left'
      ? { x: side === 'right' ? b.x + b.w : b.x, y: b.y + Math.min(b.h / 2, 60) + lane(k, 10) }
      : { x: b.x + b.w / 2 + lane(k, 10), y: side === 'bottom' ? b.y + b.h : b.y };

  // at the ports. Rule-crossing edges get their own trunk and stay distinct.
  const bundled = new Map<string, number>();
  const laneFor = (k: string, bundle: string) => {
    const kk = `${k}|${bundle}`;
    let i = bundled.get(kk);
    if (i === undefined) bundled.set(kk, (i = take(k)));
    return i;
  };
  const route = (A: Anchor, B: Anchor, bundle: string): Pt[] => {
    const hA = A.side === 'left' || A.side === 'right';
    const hB = B.side === 'left' || B.side === 'right';
    const gxOf = (a: Anchor) => (a.side === 'right' ? a.col + 1 : a.col);
    const gyOf = (a: Anchor) => (a.side === 'bottom' ? a.row + 1 : a.row);
    const gx = (g: number) => colGutter(g) + lane(laneFor(`col:${g}`, bundle), 7);
    const gy = (g: number) => rowGutter(g) + lane(laneFor(`row:${g}`, bundle), 6);
    if (hA && hB) {
      const g1 = gxOf(A);
      const g2 = gxOf(B);
      if (g1 === g2) {
        if (Math.abs(A.p.y - B.p.y) < 1) return [A.p, B.p];
        const x1 = gx(g1);
        return [A.p, { x: x1, y: A.p.y }, { x: x1, y: B.p.y }, B.p];
      }
      const rg = B.row > A.row ? B.row : B.row < A.row ? B.row + 1 : A.row + 1; // run across next to the target
      const x1 = gx(g1);
      const yy = gy(rg);
      const x2 = gx(g2);
      return [A.p, { x: x1, y: A.p.y }, { x: x1, y: yy }, { x: x2, y: yy }, { x: x2, y: B.p.y }, B.p];
    }
    if (!hA && !hB) {
      const g1 = gyOf(A);
      const g2 = gyOf(B);
      if (g1 === g2) {
        const y1 = gy(g1);
        return [A.p, { x: A.p.x, y: y1 }, { x: B.p.x, y: y1 }, B.p];
      }
      const y1 = gy(g1);
      const xx = gx(A.col + 1);
      const y2 = gy(g2);
      return [A.p, { x: A.p.x, y: y1 }, { x: xx, y: y1 }, { x: xx, y: y2 }, { x: B.p.x, y: y2 }, B.p];
    }
    if (hA) {
      const x1 = gx(gxOf(A));
      const y2 = gy(gyOf(B));
      return [A.p, { x: x1, y: A.p.y }, { x: x1, y: y2 }, { x: B.p.x, y: y2 }, B.p];
    }
    const y1 = gy(gyOf(A));
    const x2 = gx(gxOf(B));
    return [A.p, { x: A.p.x, y: y1 }, { x: x2, y: y1 }, { x: x2, y: B.p.y }, B.p];
  };

  // ---- declutter
  const roots = region ? new Set(region) : null;
  const inRegion = (id: string) => {
    if (!roots) return true;
    for (let n = ix.byId.get(id); n; n = ix.byId.get(n.parent ?? '')) if (roots.has(n.id)) return true;
    return false;
  };
  const loud = (e: VisibleEdge) => e.status !== 'existing' || e.violation !== null;
  const drawn = drawnEdges(p).filter((e) => boxes[e.from] && boxes[e.to]);
  const full: VisibleEdge[] = [];
  const faintInside: VisibleEdge[] = [];
  const trunks = new Map<string, VisibleEdge[]>();
  for (const e of drawn) {
    if (loud(e) || inRegion(e.from) || inRegion(e.to)) full.push(e);
    else if (ix.containers(e.from).length || ix.containers(e.to).length) faintInside.push(e);
    else {
      const k = `trunk:${ix.colId(e.from)}>${ix.colId(e.to)}`;
      (trunks.get(k) ?? trunks.set(k, []).get(k)!).push(e);
    }
  }

  const pathOf = (e: VisibleEdge, bundle: string): Pt[] | null => {
    const ca = ix.containers(e.from);
    const cb = ix.containers(e.to);
    const shared = ca.find((c) => cb.includes(c)) ?? null;
    const ownA = shared ? ca.slice(0, ca.indexOf(shared)) : ca;
    const ownB = shared ? cb.slice(0, cb.indexOf(shared)) : cb;
    const seg = (c: string) => (layouts.get(c)?.edges[e.id] ?? []).map((q) => abs(c, q));
    const segA = ownA.flatMap(seg);
    const segB = [...ownB].reverse().flatMap(seg);
    if (shared) return [...segA, ...seg(shared), ...segB];
    const outer = (chain: string[], self: string, other: Pt): Anchor | null => {

  const bundleOf = (e: VisibleEdge) => {

  };

  const edges: FrameEdge[] = [];
  const push = (e: VisibleEdge, pts: Pt[] | null, faint: boolean, trunk: string[] | null, id = e.id, count = e.count) => {
    if (!pts || pts.length < 2) return;
    pts = dedupe(pts);
    edges.push({ id, d: roundedPath(pts, 8), status: e.status, violation: e.violation, count, steps: e.steps, mid: midpoint(pts), from: e.from, to: e.to, faint, trunk });
  };
  // Lanes are taken in a fixed order (existing, new, ghost; then faint) so they stay put as a turn adds edges.
  const rank = { existing: 0, new: 1, ghost: 2 } as const;
  for (const e of [...full].sort((a, b) => rank[a.status] - rank[b.status] || a.id.localeCompare(b.id))) push(e, pathOf(e, bundleOf(e)), false, null);
  for (const e of faintInside.sort((a, b) => a.id.localeCompare(b.id))) push(e, pathOf(e, bundleOf(e)), true, null);
  for (const [k, list] of [...trunks].sort(([a], [b]) => a.localeCompare(b))) {
    const rep = [...list].sort((a, b) => b.count - a.count || a.id.localeCompare(b.id))[0]!;

  if (roots && !focus) for (const r of roots) if (boxes[r]) focus = focus ? union(focus, boxes[r]!) : boxes[r]!;
  return {
    nodes, boxes, edges, cols, rows, key,
    bounds: { x: -GAP_X / 2, y: -GAP_Y / 2, w: width + GAP_X, h: Math.max(height, ...nodes.map((n) => n.y + n.h)) + GAP_Y },
    focus,
    gutters: { x: cols.map((_, g) => colGutter(g)).concat(colGutter(cols.length)), y: rows.map((_, g) => rowGutter(g)).concat(rowGutter(rows.length)) },
  };
}

export const union = (a: Box, b: Box): Box => {
  const x = Math.min(a.x, b.x);
  const y = Math.min(a.y, b.y);
  return { x, y, w: Math.max(a.x + a.w, b.x + b.w) - x, h: Math.max(a.y + a.h, b.y + b.h) - y };
};

function dedupe(pts: Pt[]): Pt[] {
  const out: Pt[] = [];
  for (const p of pts) {
    const q = out[out.length - 1];
    if (q && Math.abs(q.x - p.x) < 0.5 && Math.abs(q.y - p.y) < 0.5) continue;
    out.push(p);
  }
  return out;
}

function midpoint(pts: Pt[]): Pt {
  let total = 0;
  for (let i = 1; i < pts.length; i++) total += Math.hypot(pts[i]!.x - pts[i - 1]!.x, pts[i]!.y - pts[i - 1]!.y);
  let half = total / 2;
  for (let i = 1; i < pts.length; i++) {
    const a = pts[i - 1]!;
    const b = pts[i]!;
    const d = Math.hypot(b.x - a.x, b.y - a.y);
    if (half <= d && d > 0) return { x: a.x + ((b.x - a.x) * half) / d, y: a.y + ((b.y - a.y) * half) / d };
    half -= d;
  }
  return pts[0]!;
}

export function roundedPath(pts: Pt[], r: number): string {
  const f = (n: number) => n.toFixed(1);
  let d = `M${f(pts[0]!.x)},${f(pts[0]!.y)}`;
  for (let i = 1; i < pts.length - 1; i++) {
    const p = pts[i - 1]!;
    const c = pts[i]!;
    const n = pts[i + 1]!;
    const d1 = Math.hypot(c.x - p.x, c.y - p.y);
    const d2 = Math.hypot(n.x - c.x, n.y - c.y);
    const rr = Math.min(r, d1 / 2, d2 / 2);
    if (rr < 0.5) { d += `L${f(c.x)},${f(c.y)}`; continue; }
    const ax = c.x - ((c.x - p.x) / d1) * rr;
    const ay = c.y - ((c.y - p.y) / d1) * rr;
    const bx = c.x + ((n.x - c.x) / d2) * rr;
    const by = c.y + ((n.y - c.y) / d2) * rr;
    d += `L${f(ax)},${f(ay)}Q${f(c.x)},${f(c.y)} ${f(bx)},${f(by)}`;
  }
  const last = pts[pts.length - 1]!;
  return `${d}L${f(last.x)},${f(last.y)}`;
}

/** Stroke width by count (aggregated edges read heavier). */
export const strokeFor = (count: number) => 1.5 + Math.min(3, Math.log2(Math.max(1, count))) * 0.75;

export { PAD };
```

```typescript
// Per-key debounce with batching: each key waits `ms` after its last `push`; keys that come due together flush as one
// batch (one snapshot update in the resolver). Only the latest value per key is kept.

export class KeyedDebounce<T> {
  private latest = new Map<string, T>();
  private timers = new Map<string, ReturnType<typeof setTimeout>>();
  private due = new Map<string, T>();
  private flushing: ReturnType<typeof setTimeout> | null = null;

  constructor(private ms: number, private flush: (batch: Map<string, T>) => void) {}

  push(key: string, value: T) {
    this.latest.set(key, value);
    this.due.delete(key); // a newer value restarts the wait even if the old one was about to flush
    clearTimeout(this.timers.get(key));
    this.timers.set(key, setTimeout(() => {
      this.timers.delete(key);
      if (!this.latest.has(key)) return;
      this.due.set(key, this.latest.get(key)!);
      this.latest.delete(key);
      this.flushing ??= setTimeout(() => this.drain(), 0);
    }, this.ms));
  }

  /** Keys waiting (not yet flushed). */
  get pending(): number {
    return this.latest.size + this.due.size;
  }

  /** Drop everything queued (e.g. a full reload supersedes it). */
  clear() {
    for (const t of this.timers.values()) clearTimeout(t);
    if (this.flushing) clearTimeout(this.flushing);
    this.timers.clear();
    this.latest.clear();
    this.due.clear();
    this.flushing = null;
  }

  private drain() {
    this.flushing = null;
    if (!this.due.size) return;
    const batch = this.due;
    this.due = new Map();
    this.flush(batch);
  }
}
```

````typescript
// The auditor agent (NAVIGATION_PLAN §4.6): a separate, read-only Agent SDK session that reads a finished turn against
// the standing decisions the pre-filter picked, and returns advisory findings. It never edits anything and never
// blocks the coding session. The model call is behind `Auditor` so tests inject a fake.
import { query } from '@anthropic-ai/claude-agent-sdk';
import type { Invariant, RawFinding, RelevantDecision, TurnSurface } from '@harness/core';

export type AuditInput = {
  root: string;
  surface: TurnSurface;
  decisions: RelevantDecision[]; // the pre-filter's picks (never empty when the auditor runs)
  invariants: Invariant[];
  diff: string; // numberDiff output: new-file line numbers on every line
};
export type AuditorResult = { findings: RawFinding[]; cost: number | null };
export type Auditor = (input: AuditInput) => Promise<AuditorResult>;

export const FINDINGS_SCHEMA = {
  type: 'object',
  additionalProperties: false,
  required: ['findings'],
  properties: {
    findings: {
      type: 'array',
      description: 'Usually empty. One entry per likely contradiction of a standing decision\'s rationale.',
      items: {
        type: 'object',
        additionalProperties: false,
        required: ['decision', 'files', 'lines', 'text', 'confidence'],
        properties: {
          decision: { type: 'string', description: 'The DR id of the standing decision the change contradicts, e.g. "DR-4".' },
          files: { type: 'array', items: { type: 'string' }, description: 'Repo-relative paths of the changed files involved.' },
          lines: {
            type: 'array',
            items: { type: 'object', additionalProperties: false, required: ['path', 'line'], properties: { path: { type: 'string' }, line: { type: 'integer' } } },
            description: 'The exact lines (new-file line numbers, as shown in the diff) that contradict the decision.',
          },
          text: { type: 'string', description: 'One or two sentences: what the decision says (cite it) and what the line does instead. Plain and specific.' },
          confidence: { type: 'string', enum: ['low', 'medium', 'high'] },
        },
      },
    },
  },
} as const;

const list = (xs: readonly string[], none = '(none)') => (xs.length ? xs.map((x) => `- ${x}`) : [none]);

/** The auditor's prompt: its job, what not to report, the decisions that matter, invariants, the turn's diff and fact delta. */
export function buildAuditPrompt(input: AuditInput): string {
  const s = input.surface;
  const what = s.source === 'plan' ? 'a submitted plan (nothing is written yet)' : 'a finished coding turn';
  return [
    `You are the auditor for this repo. You review ${what} against the user's standing architecture decisions.`,
    '',
    '## Your job',
    '- Flag only LIKELY contradictions of a standing decision\'s *rationale* (its intent, the reason it was made) that the three rule kinds (only_via, owns_writes, no_edge) cannot express. Example: a decision says filings must keep exact figures by using a filings redaction mode; new code sends filings through the gateway without that mode.',
    '- Cite the decision id and the exact changed lines (the new-file line numbers shown in the diff). Every finding must be about a file this turn changed.',
    '- NEVER restate a rule violation: the deterministic checker already catches imports and table writes that break an invariant (listed below). Do not report style, bugs, tests, naming or anything unrelated to a listed decision.',
    '- Empty is the expected answer most of the time. Report nothing unless the contradiction is concrete; when unsure, use low confidence or leave it out.',
    '- You may Read/Grep/Glob files to check context (e.g. what an option or mode does). Do not modify anything.',
    '',
    `## The turn: "${s.prompt.trim().slice(0, 400)}"`,
    '',
    '## Plan steps',
    ...list(s.plan.map((p) => `${p.n}. ${p.text}${p.files.length ? ` (${p.files.join(', ')})` : ''}`)),
    '',
    '## Standing decisions to check (picked because they bear on what the turn touched)',
    ...input.decisions.flatMap(({ decision: d, reasons }) => [
      `### ${d.id}: ${d.title}`,
      `Outcome: ${d.outcome}`,
      d.invariant ? `Linked invariant: ${d.invariant}` : 'Linked invariant: none',
      `Anchored to: ${d.paths.join(', ') || '-'}`,
      `Why it was picked: ${reasons.map((r) => `${r.kind} (${r.detail})`).join('; ')}`,
      'Rationale:',
      d.rationale.trim().split('\n').map((l) => `> ${l}`).join('\n'),
      '',
    ]),
    '## Invariants (enforced by the checker; context only)',
    ...list(input.invariants.map((i) => `${i.id} [${i.kind}]: ${i.rule}`)),
    '',
    '## Violations the checker already raised for this turn (do NOT report these again)',
    ...list(s.violations.map((v) => `${v.invariant}: ${v.reason}`)),
    '',
    '## Fact delta (new in the changed files)',
    ...list([
      ...s.delta.calls.map((c) => `call ${c.from} → ${c.to}`),
      ...s.delta.imports.map((i) => `import ${i.from} → ${i.to}`),
      ...s.delta.writes.map((w) => `write ${w.file} → table ${w.table}`),
    ]),
    '',
    `## Changed files: ${s.files.join(', ') || '(none)'}`,
    `Changed symbols: ${s.symbols.join(', ') || '(none)'}`,
    '',
    s.source === 'plan' ? '## Diff\n(none: this is a plan review)' : '## Diff (new-file line numbers on the left)',
    ...(s.source === 'plan' ? [] : ['```', input.diff.trimEnd() || '(empty)', '```']),
  ].join('\n');
}

/**
 * The real auditor: a read-only Agent SDK query with structured output, on the strongest model.
 * Model: `HARNESS_AUDITOR_MODEL` (default `claude-opus-5-5`).
 */
export const sdkAuditor: Auditor = async (input) => {
  const q = query({
    prompt: buildAuditPrompt(input),
    options: {
      cwd: input.root,
      model: process.env.HARNESS_AUDITOR_MODEL ?? 'claude-opus-5-5',
      effort: 'high',
      tools: ['Read', 'Grep', 'Glob'],
      allowedTools: ['Read', 'Grep', 'Glob'],
      permissionMode: 'dontAsk',
      settingSources: [],
      strictMcpConfig: true,
      outputFormat: { type: 'json_schema', schema: FINDINGS_SCHEMA as unknown as Record<string, unknown> },
      maxTurns: 20,
    },
  });
  for await (const m of q) {
    if (m.type !== 'result') continue;
    if (m.subtype !== 'success' || !m.structured_output) throw Object.assign(new Error(`auditor ${m.subtype}`), { cost: m.total_cost_usd });
    const out = m.structured_output as { findings?: RawFinding[] };
    return { findings: out.findings ?? [], cost: m.total_cost_usd };
  }
  throw new Error('auditor returned no result');
};
````

```typescript
// The semantic child's state: Tier 1 facts per file, the resolver, and what it last reported per file. Runs in the
// child process (worker.ts); usable in-process for tests.
import { readFileSync } from 'node:fs';
import { join } from 'node:path';
import type { FileFacts, SemanticFacts } from '../../contracts/facts';
import { emptyStats, semanticFacts, type ResolveStats } from './resolve';
import type { SemanticResolver } from './types';

/** At most this many importers are re-resolved after an edit (their typed targets may have moved). */
export const MAX_IMPORTERS = 100;

export class SemanticEngine {
  private facts = new Map<string, FileFacts>();
  private last = new Map<string, string>(); // path → hash + result signature last emitted
  readonly totals: ResolveStats = emptyStats();

  constructor(private root: string, private resolver: SemanticResolver, private emit: (facts: SemanticFacts) => void) {}

  get impl() { return this.resolver.impl; }

  /** Replace all Tier 1 facts (a full scan). Nothing is resolved until `resolveAll`. */
  setFacts(list: readonly FileFacts[]) {
    this.facts = new Map(list.map((f) => [f.path, f]));
    this.last.clear();
    Object.assign(this.totals, emptyStats());
  }

  paths() { return [...this.facts.keys()].sort(); }

  /** Resolve every file, yielding to the event loop between files; `progress(done, total)` after each one. */
  async resolveAll(progress?: (done: number, total: number) => void) {
    const paths = this.paths();
    for (let i = 0; i < paths.length; i++) {
      const s = this.resolve(paths[i]!);
      if (s) for (const k of Object.keys(s) as (keyof ResolveStats)[]) this.totals[k] += s[k];
      progress?.(i + 1, paths.length);
      if (i % 8 === 7) await new Promise((r) => setImmediate(r));
    }
  }

  /**
   * New Tier 1 facts for edited files (and deletions): update the resolver's snapshot, re-resolve those files and their
   * direct importers (a renamed export moves their typed targets). Returns the paths that were re-resolved.
   */
  update(changed: readonly FileFacts[], deleted: readonly string[] = []): string[] {
    const created = changed.filter((f) => !this.facts.has(f.path)).map((f) => f.path);
    for (const f of changed) this.facts.set(f.path, f);
    for (const p of deleted) {
      this.facts.delete(p);
      this.last.delete(p);
    }
    this.resolver.update({ changed: changed.filter((f) => !created.includes(f.path)).map((f) => f.path), created, deleted });
    const touched = new Set([...changed.map((f) => f.path), ...deleted]);
    const importers: string[] = [];
    for (const f of this.facts.values()) {
      if (!touched.has(f.path) && f.imports.some((i) => touched.has(i.to))) importers.push(f.path);
    }
    const todo = [...changed.map((f) => f.path), ...importers.sort().slice(0, MAX_IMPORTERS)];
    for (const p of todo) this.resolve(p);
    return todo;
  }

  /** Resolve one file against its current text; emits when the result differs from what was last reported. */
  resolve(path: string): ResolveStats | null {
    const facts = this.facts.get(path);
    if (!facts) return null;
    let source: string;
    try {
      source = readFileSync(join(this.root, path), 'utf8');
    } catch {
      return null;
    }
    const names = new Map<string, ReadonlySet<string> | null>();
    const symbolsOf = (file: string) => {
      if (!names.has(file)) {
        const f = this.facts.get(file);
        names.set(file, f ? new Set(f.symbols.map((s) => s.name)) : null);
      }
      return names.get(file)!;
    };
    const r = semanticFacts(this.resolver, facts, source, symbolsOf);
    if (!r) return null;
    const sig = `${r.facts.hash}|${JSON.stringify(r.facts.calls)}|${JSON.stringify(r.facts.implements)}`;
    if (this.last.get(path) !== sig) {
      this.last.set(path, sig);
      this.emit(r.facts);
    }
    return r.stats;
  }

  close() { this.resolver.close(); }
}
```

```typescript
// Node-side inputs and memory for the auditor: the turn's git diff vs its baseline, standing decisions, and the
// dismissal memory under .harness/audit/dismissed.json (a dismissed finding is never raised again).
import { execFileSync } from 'node:child_process';
import { existsSync, mkdirSync, readFileSync, writeFileSync } from 'node:fs';
import { join } from 'node:path';
import { findingSignature, numberDiff, type AuditDecision, type DismissedFinding, type FindingState } from '@harness/core';
import { listDecisions } from '../decisions';

const run = (root: string, args: string[]): string => {
  try { return execFileSync('git', args, { cwd: root, encoding: 'utf8', stdio: ['ignore', 'pipe', 'pipe'], maxBuffer: 32 << 20 }); }
  catch (e) { return String((e as { stdout?: string }).stdout ?? ''); } // `--no-index` exits 1 when files differ
};

/**
 * The turn's diff for `files`, numbered by new-file line: `git diff <baseline>` for files the baseline knows, and a
 * whole-file diff for files created since (untracked, so the baseline snapshot doesn't have them).
 */
export function turnDiff(root: string, baseline: string | null, files: readonly string[], maxLinesPerFile = 300): string {
  const parts: string[] = [];
  for (const f of files) {
    let d = baseline ? run(root, ['diff', '--no-color', '--no-ext-diff', '-U3', baseline, '--', f]) : '';
    if (!d.trim() && existsSync(join(root, f)) && !run(root, ['ls-files', '--', f]).trim()) {
      d = run(root, ['diff', '--no-color', '--no-index', '--', '/dev/null', f]);
    }
    if (d.trim()) parts.push(d.trimEnd());
  }
  return numberDiff(parts.join('\n'), maxLinesPerFile);
}

/** Standing decisions (status `made`) as the auditor reads them. */
export function standingDecisions(root: string): AuditDecision[] {
  return listDecisions(root)
    .filter((d) => d.status === 'made')
    .map((d) => ({ id: d.id, title: d.title, outcome: d.outcome ?? '', rationale: d.rationale ?? '', invariant: d.invariant ?? '', paths: d.anchors?.paths ?? [] }));
}

const dismissedPath = (root: string) => join(root, '.harness', 'audit', 'dismissed.json');

export function loadDismissed(root: string): DismissedFinding[] {
  const p = dismissedPath(root);
  if (!existsSync(p)) return [];
  try { return (JSON.parse(readFileSync(p, 'utf8')) as { dismissed?: DismissedFinding[] }).dismissed ?? []; }
  catch { return []; }
}

/** Remember a dismissed finding (signature + decision + files + text). Idempotent by signature. */
export function rememberDismissed(root: string, f: Pick<FindingState, 'id' | 'decision' | 'files' | 'text'>): DismissedFinding {
  const all = loadDismissed(root);
  const entry: DismissedFinding = { signature: findingSignature(f), decision: f.decision, files: [...f.files].sort(), text: f.text, id: f.id, at: Date.now() };
  if (!all.some((d) => d.signature === entry.signature)) all.push(entry);
  mkdirSync(join(root, '.harness', 'audit'), { recursive: true });
  writeFileSync(dismissedPath(root), JSON.stringify({ dismissed: all }, null, 2));
  return entry;
}
```

```typescript
// Messages between the server (client.ts) and the semantic child (worker.ts). Types only.
import type { FileFacts, SemanticFacts } from '../../contracts/facts';
import type { ResolveStats } from './resolve';
import type { ResolverChoice } from './open';
import type { ResolverImpl } from './types';

export type ToWorker =
  /** Full (re)load after a scan: (re)open the project and resolve every file. */
  | { type: 'load'; root: string; prefer: ResolverChoice; facts: FileFacts[] }
  /** Debounced edits: new Tier 1 facts for changed files, and deleted paths. */
  | { type: 'update'; facts: FileFacts[]; deleted: string[] }
  | { type: 'close' };

export type Memory = { rss: number; heapUsed: number };

export type FromWorker =
  | { type: 'ready'; impl: ResolverImpl; fallback: string | null; openMs: number; files: number }
  | { type: 'resolved'; facts: SemanticFacts }
  | { type: 'progress'; done: number; total: number }
  | { type: 'loaded'; ms: number; files: number; stats: ResolveStats; memory: Memory }
  | { type: 'updated'; ms: number; paths: string[] }
  | { type: 'error'; message: string };
```

```typescript
// Map between v2 node ids and the shell's inspector selection (shared with v1, so the inspector stays one component).
import type { VisibleNode } from '@harness/core/view';
import type { Selection } from '../store';

export function selectionFor(n: Pick<VisibleNode, 'id' | 'kind' | 'domain' | 'layer'>): Selection {
  if (n.kind === 'cell') return { cell: `${n.domain}/${n.layer}` };
  if (n.kind === 'file') return { file: n.id };
  if (n.id === 'unassigned') return { unassigned: true };
  return { node: n.id };
}

/** The node a selection points at (edges select no node). */
export function selectedNode(s: Selection | null): string | null {
  if (!s) return null;
  if ('cell' in s) return `cell:${s.cell}`;
  if ('file' in s) return s.file;
  if ('node' in s) return s.node;
  if ('unassigned' in s) return 'unassigned';
  return null;
}

export const selectedEdge = (s: Selection | null): string | null => (s && 'link' in s ? s.link : null);
```

```typescript
// The semantic child process (NAVIGATION_PLAN §3.1 Tier 2). Forked by client.ts with a heap cap; talks over IPC.
// Messages are handled one at a time, so an edit that arrives during the initial load waits for it to finish.
import { SemanticEngine } from './engine';
import { openResolver } from './open';
import type { FromWorker, ToWorker } from './protocol';

let engine: SemanticEngine | null = null;
const send = (m: FromWorker) => process.send?.(m);
const memory = () => {
  const m = process.memoryUsage();
  return { rss: m.rss, heapUsed: m.heapUsed };
};

async function handle(msg: ToWorker) {
  if (msg.type === 'close') {
    engine?.close();
    process.exit(0);
  }
  if (msg.type === 'load') {
    engine?.close(); // a rescan may follow a tsconfig/package.json change: reopen the project
    engine = null;
    const t0 = performance.now();
    const { resolver, fallback } = await openResolver({ root: msg.root, files: msg.facts.map((f) => f.path) }, msg.prefer);
    engine = new SemanticEngine(msg.root, resolver, (facts) => send({ type: 'resolved', facts }));
    engine.setFacts(msg.facts);
    send({ type: 'ready', impl: resolver.impl, fallback, openMs: Math.round(performance.now() - t0), files: msg.facts.length });
    const t1 = performance.now();
    let lastProgress = 0;
    await engine.resolveAll((done, total) => {
      const now = performance.now();
      if (done === total || now - lastProgress > 250) {
        lastProgress = now;
        send({ type: 'progress', done, total });
      }
    });
    send({ type: 'loaded', ms: Math.round(performance.now() - t1), files: msg.facts.length, stats: engine.totals, memory: memory() });
    return;
  }
  if (!engine) return;
  const t0 = performance.now();
  const paths = engine.update(msg.facts, msg.deleted);
  send({ type: 'updated', ms: Math.round((performance.now() - t0) * 10) / 10, paths });
}

let chain = Promise.resolve();
process.on('message', (msg: ToWorker) => {
  chain = chain.then(() => handle(msg)).catch((e: Error) => send({ type: 'error', message: e.stack ?? e.message }));
});
process.on('disconnect', () => {
  engine?.close();
  process.exit(0);
});
```

```typescript
// Server side of Tier 2: forks the semantic child (heap-capped), feeds it Tier 1 facts, debounces edits per file
// (~150 ms) and hands back results whose hash is still current. Never blocks the caller: every call returns at once.
import { fork, type ChildProcess } from 'node:child_process';
import { createRequire } from 'node:module';
import { fileURLToPath, pathToFileURL } from 'node:url';
import type { FileFacts, SemanticFacts } from '../../contracts/facts';
import { KeyedDebounce } from './debounce';
import type { ResolverChoice } from './open';
import type { FromWorker, Memory, ToWorker } from './protocol';
import type { ResolveStats } from './resolve';
import type { ResolverImpl } from './types';

export const SEMANTIC_DEBOUNCE_MS = 150;

export type SemanticStatus = {
  state: 'idle' | 'opening' | 'resolving' | 'ready' | 'failed';
  impl: ResolverImpl | null;
  fallback: string | null;
  done: number;
  total: number;
  openMs: number | null;
  loadMs: number | null;
  lastUpdateMs: number | null;
  stats: ResolveStats | null;
  memory: Memory | null;
  error: string | null;
};

export type SemanticClientOptions = {
  root: string;
  /** `HARNESS_SEMANTIC_IMPL` (tsgo | ts-morph | auto) by default. */
  prefer?: ResolverChoice;
  /** Child heap cap in MB (`HARNESS_SEMANTIC_HEAP`, default 1536). tsgo's own Go process is not under it. */
  heapMb?: number;
  debounceMs?: number;
  onResolved(facts: SemanticFacts): void;
  onStatus?(status: SemanticStatus): void;
};

const WORKER = fileURLToPath(new URL('./worker.ts', import.meta.url));
/** The child runs TypeScript sources through tsx, like the server itself. */
const loader = () => pathToFileURL(createRequire(import.meta.url).resolve('tsx')).href;

export function startSemantic(opts: SemanticClientOptions) {
  const prefer = opts.prefer ?? ((process.env.HARNESS_SEMANTIC_IMPL as ResolverChoice | undefined) || 'auto');
  const heap = opts.heapMb ?? Number(process.env.HARNESS_SEMANTIC_HEAP ?? 1536);
  const latest = new Map<string, string | null>(); // path → current Tier 1 hash (null: deleted)
  const status: SemanticStatus = { state: 'idle', impl: null, fallback: null, done: 0, total: 0, openMs: null, loadMs: null, lastUpdateMs: null, stats: null, memory: null, error: null };
  let child: ChildProcess | null = null;
  let inflight = 0;
  let closing = false;
  const waiters: (() => void)[] = [];
  const settle = () => {
    if (inflight > 0 || debounce.pending > 0) return;
    for (const w of waiters.splice(0)) w();
  };
  const report = () => opts.onStatus?.({ ...status });

  const send = (m: ToWorker) => {
    if (!child?.connected) return false;
    child.send(m);
    return true;
  };

  const debounce = new KeyedDebounce<FileFacts | null>(opts.debounceMs ?? SEMANTIC_DEBOUNCE_MS, (batch) => {
    const facts: FileFacts[] = [];
    const deleted: string[] = [];
    for (const [path, f] of batch) (f ? facts.push(f) : deleted.push(path));
    if (send({ type: 'update', facts, deleted })) inflight++;
    settle();
  });

  function spawn(): ChildProcess {
    const c = fork(WORKER, [], { execArgv: ['--import', loader(), `--max-old-space-size=${heap}`], stdio: ['ignore', 'inherit', 'inherit', 'ipc'], serialization: 'advanced' });
    c.on('message', (m: FromWorker) => {
      switch (m.type) {
        case 'resolved':
          if (latest.get(m.facts.path) === m.facts.hash) opts.onResolved(m.facts);
          return;
        case 'ready':
          Object.assign(status, { state: 'resolving', impl: m.impl, fallback: m.fallback, openMs: m.openMs, total: m.files, done: 0 });
          break;
        case 'progress':
          Object.assign(status, { done: m.done, total: m.total });
          break;
        case 'loaded':
          Object.assign(status, { state: 'ready', loadMs: m.ms, stats: m.stats, memory: m.memory });
          inflight--;
          break;
        case 'updated':
          status.lastUpdateMs = m.ms;
          inflight--;
          break;
        case 'error':
          status.error = m.message.split('\n')[0] ?? m.message;
          if (status.state === 'opening') { status.state = 'failed'; inflight = Math.max(0, inflight - 1); }
          break;
      }
      report();
      settle();
    });
    c.on('exit', (code, signal) => {
      if (child === c) child = null;
      inflight = 0;
      if (!closing) {
        Object.assign(status, { state: 'failed', error: status.error ?? `semantic process exited (${signal ?? code})` });
        report();
      }
      settle();
    });
    return c;
  }

  return {
    /** Full (re)load after a scan: (re)opens the project and resolves every file in the background. */
    load(facts: readonly FileFacts[], root = opts.root) {
      debounce.clear();
      latest.clear();
      for (const f of facts) latest.set(f.path, f.hash);
      child ??= spawn();
      Object.assign(status, { state: 'opening', done: 0, total: facts.length, error: null });
      if (send({ type: 'load', root, prefer, facts: [...facts] })) inflight++;
      report();
    },
    /** A file's Tier 1 facts changed (null: deleted). Resolved ~150 ms after its last change. */
    changed(path: string, facts: FileFacts | null) {
      latest.set(path, facts?.hash ?? null);
      if (child) debounce.push(path, facts);
    },
    status: (): SemanticStatus => ({ ...status }),
    /** Resolves when nothing is queued or in flight (tests, acceptance runs). */
    idle(): Promise<void> {
      return new Promise((resolve) => {
        waiters.push(resolve);
        settle();
      });
    },
    async close() {
      closing = true;
      debounce.clear();
      const c = child;
      child = null;
      if (!c) return;
      await new Promise<void>((resolve) => {
        const t = setTimeout(() => { c.kill('SIGKILL'); resolve(); }, 2000);
        c.once('exit', () => { clearTimeout(t); resolve(); });
        if (c.connected) c.send({ type: 'close' } satisfies ToWorker);
        else c.kill();
      });
      settle();
    },
  };
}

export type SemanticClient = ReturnType<typeof startSemantic>;
```
