```typescript
// The v2 map (N3/N4): the real pipeline (reduce → graphOf → activityFor → project), per-container ELK in a worker,
// the deterministic grid, one SVG layer of precomputed edges, staged FLIP transitions and a van Wijk camera, on a
// React Flow viewport with memoized DOM nodes. Navigation: expand in place, breadcrumbs, history, ⌘K, arrows, minimap.
import { memo, useCallback, useEffect, useLayoutEffect, useMemo, useRef, useState } from 'react';
import { flushSync } from 'react-dom';
import { Background, BackgroundVariant, MiniMap, ReactFlow, ReactFlowProvider, ViewportPortal, useReactFlow, useStoreApi, type Node, type Viewport } from '@xyflow/react';
import '@xyflow/react/dist/base.css';
import '@fontsource/barlow/300.css';
import '@fontsource/barlow/400-italic.css';
import '@fontsource/barlow/700.css';
import '@fontsource/jetbrains-mono/600.css';
import './v2.css';
import { fileOf, type Rollup } from '@harness/core/view';
import { useView } from '../derive';
import { useStore } from '../store';
import { buildFrame, layoutAll, strokeFor, union, UNASSIGNED, UNASSIGNED_COL, type Frame, type FrameNode } from './layout/frame';
import { clearLayoutCache, layoutContainer, warmElk } from './layout/elk';
import type { Box } from './layout/containers';
import { dive, neighbour, up, type Dir } from './nav';
import { NavBar } from './NavBar';
import { nodeTypes, useLod } from './nodes';
import { Palette } from './Palette';
import { useScene, type Scene } from './pipeline';
import { selectedEdge, selectedNode, selectionFor } from './select';
import { useV2 } from './store';
import { Transitioner, reducedMotion, T_MOVE, type Enter, type TransitionStats } from './transition';

const params = new URLSearchParams(location.search);
export const COMP = params.has('comp');

export type Insets = { top: number; right: number; bottom: number; left: number };
const DEFAULT_INSETS: Insets = { top: 70, right: 28, bottom: 24, left: 96 };

type Shown = { frame: Frame; enter: Enter };
type Stats = { layoutMs: number; pipelineMs: number; elk: { id: string; files: number; ms: number }[]; transition: TransitionStats | null };

export default function MapV2({ insets = DEFAULT_INSETS, chrome = true }: { insets?: Insets; chrome?: boolean }) {
  return (
    <ReactFlowProvider>
      <Inner insets={insets} chrome={chrome} />
    </ReactFlowProvider>
  );
}

function viewportFor(b: Box, W: number, H: number, ins: Insets, maxZoom = 1.25): Viewport {
  const aw = Math.max(50, W - ins.left - ins.right);
  const ah = Math.max(50, H - ins.top - ins.bottom);
  const zoom = Math.max(0.08, Math.min(maxZoom, aw / b.w, ah / b.h));
  return { zoom, x: ins.left + (aw - b.w * zoom) / 2 - b.x * zoom, y: ins.top + (ah - b.h * zoom) / 2 - b.y * zoom };
}

/** Roots of the focus region: the selected node, else what is open, else everything (null). */
function regionOf(scene: Scene, sel: string | null): string[] | null {
  const ids = new Set(scene.projection.nodes.map((n) => n.id));
  if (sel && ids.has(sel)) return [sel];
  const open = scene.open.filter((id) => ids.has(id));
  return open.length ? open : null;
}

function Inner({ insets, chrome }: { insets: Insets; chrome: boolean }) {
  const scene = useScene();
  const v = useView();
  const rf = useReactFlow();
  const rootRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
  const [shown, setShown] = useState<Shown | null>(null);
  const stats = useRef<Stats>({ layoutMs: 0, pipelineMs: 0, elk: [], transition: null });
  const insetsRef = useRef(insets);
  insetsRef.current = insets;
  const sel = useStore((s) => selectedNode(s.selection));
  const sceneRef = useRef(scene);
  sceneRef.current = scene;

  const flyTo = useCallback((b: Box, animate: boolean, maxZoom?: number) => {
    const el = rootRef.current;
    if (!el) return;
    const { width: W, height: H } = el.getBoundingClientRect();
    void rf.setViewport(viewportFor(b, W, H, insetsRef.current, maxZoom), { duration: animate && !reducedMotion() ? T_MOVE + 150 : 0, interpolate: 'smooth' });
  }, [rf]);

  const camera = useCallback((next: Frame, prev: Frame | null, animate: boolean) => {
    const fly = useV2.getState().fly;
    const target = fly ? next.boxes[fly] : undefined;
    if (target) {
      useV2.setState({ fly: null });
      const ctx = next.focus ? union(next.focus, target) : target;
      flyTo(ctx.w * ctx.h > target.w * target.h * 40 ? pad(target, 260) : pad(ctx, 40), animate);
      return;
    }
    if (prev && prev.key === next.key) return; // the camera moves when the view changes, not on every event
    if (next.focus) flyTo(pad(next.focus, 30), animate);
    else flyTo(next.bounds, animate);
  }, [flyTo]);

  const tr = useMemo(() => new Transitioner({
    root: () => rootRef.current,
    commit: (frame, enter) => flushSync(() => {
      const s = sceneRef.current;
      if (s) publish(s);
      setShown({ frame, enter });
    }),
    camera,
  }), [camera]);

  // Lay out every expanded container (worker, cached, bottom-up), then hand the frame to the transitioner.
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!scene || !v.ui.map) return;
    let live = true;
    const map = v.ui.map;
    const t0 = performance.now();
    void layoutAll(scene.projection, layoutContainer).then((layouts) => {
      if (!live) return;
      stats.current.layoutMs = performance.now() - t0;
      stats.current.elk = [...layouts.values()].map((l) => ({ id: l.id, files: Object.keys(l.nodes).length, ms: +l.ms.toFixed(1) }));
      const meta = { domains: map.domains.map((d) => ({ id: d.id, name: d.name, purpose: d.purpose })), layers: map.layers.map((l) => ({ id: l.id, name: l.name })) };
      tr.go(buildFrame({ projection: scene.projection, meta, layouts, region: regionOf(scene, sel), key: scene.key }));
    });
    return () => { live = false; };
  }, [scene, sel, tr, v.ui.map]);

  // A fly request for a node already on screen (history, breadcrumbs to the same layout).
  const fly = useV2((s) => s.fly);
  useEffect(() => {
    const f = tr.shown;
    if (!fly || !f?.boxes[fly] || f.key !== sceneRef.current?.key) return;
    useV2.setState({ fly: null });
    flyTo(pad(f.boxes[fly]!, 220), true);
  }, [fly, tr, flyTo, shown]);

  useEffect(() => () => tr.cancel(), [tr]);
  useEffect(() => { void warmElk(); }, []);
  useKeys(tr, rootRef);
  useBenchApi(tr, stats, rf);

  const rfNodes = useMemo<Node[]>(() => {
    if (!shown) return [];
    const { frame, enter } = shown;
    return frame.nodes.map((n) => ({
      id: n.id,
      type: n.type,
      position: { x: n.x, y: n.y },
      data: {},
      width: n.w,
      height: n.h,
      style: { width: n.w, height: n.h },
      zIndex: n.z,
      draggable: false,
      selectable: false,
      connectable: false,
      focusable: n.type !== 'band',
      ariaLabel: ariaFor(n),
      className: enter.nodes.has(n.id) ? 'v2-enter' : undefined,
    }));
  }, [shown]);

  const select = useStore((s) => s.select);
  const onNodeClick = useCallback((ev: React.MouseEvent, node: Node) => {
    ev.stopPropagation();
    const n = useV2.getState().nodes[node.id];
    if (!n) return;
    useV2.getState().setFocus(node.id);
    const cur = useStore.getState().selection;
    select(selectedNode(cur) === node.id ? null : selectionFor(n));
  }, [select]);
  const onNodeDoubleClick = useCallback((_: unknown, node: Node) => {
    const s = sceneRef.current;
    if (!s) return;
    const st = useV2.getState();
    const id = node.id.startsWith('band:') ? UNASSIGNED : node.id;
    st.go(dive(s.graph, { open: st.open, focus: st.focus }, id));
  }, []);

  const theme = useV2((s) => s.theme);
  const minimap = useV2((s) => s.minimap);
  return (
    <div ref={rootRef} className={`v2-map theme-${theme}`} data-theme={theme}>
      <ReactFlow
        nodes={rfNodes}
        edges={[]}
        nodeTypes={nodeTypes}
        nodesDraggable={false}
        nodesConnectable={false}
        elementsSelectable={false}
        zoomOnDoubleClick={false}
        onNodeDoubleClick={onNodeDoubleClick}
        onNodeClick={onNodeClick}
        onPaneClick={() => select(null)}
        minZoom={0.08}
        maxZoom={2.5}
        proOptions={{ hideAttribution: true }}
        onlyRenderVisibleElements={params.get('visible') === '1'}
      >
        {theme === 'control' && <Background variant={BackgroundVariant.Dots} gap={28} size={1.3} color="var(--v2-dots)" />}
        {shown && (
          <ViewportPortal>
            <EdgeLayer frame={shown.frame} enter={shown.enter} />
            <Cursor frame={shown.frame} />
          </ViewportPortal>
        )}
        {chrome && minimap && (
          <MiniMap
            className="v2-minimap"
            pannable
            zoomable
            ariaLabel="Minimap"
            nodeColor={(n) => miniColor(n.id, n.type)}
            nodeStrokeWidth={0}
            maskColor="var(--v2-mini-mask)"
          />
        )}
      </ReactFlow>
      {shown && <Headers frame={shown.frame} insets={insets} />}
      {chrome && <NavBar />}
      {chrome && <Palette />}
      {!v.ui.map && <Empty />}
    </div>
  );
}

const pad = (b: Box, p: number): Box => ({ x: b.x - p, y: b.y - p, w: b.w + 2 * p, h: b.h + 2 * p });

function ariaFor(n: FrameNode): string {
  const vn = useV2.getState().nodes[n.id];
  if (!vn) return n.id;
  return `${vn.kind} ${vn.label}${vn.rollup.violation ? `, crosses ${vn.rollup.rules.join(' ')}` : ''}${vn.rollup.edited ? ', edited' : ''}`;
}

function miniColor(id: string, type: string | undefined): string {
  const n = useV2.getState().nodes[id];
  if (type === 'band') return 'var(--v2-mini-band)';
  if (!n) return 'var(--v2-mini-node)';
  const r = n.rollup;
  if (r.violation === 'new') return 'var(--v2-red)';
  if (r.cursor) return 'var(--v2-agent)';
  if (r.edited) return r.unplanned ? 'var(--v2-amber)' : 'var(--v2-agent)';
  if (r.violation) return 'var(--v2-red-wash)';
  return 'var(--v2-mini-node)';
}

/** Publish the projection by id (structural sharing) so node components re-render only for their own changes. */
function publish(s: Scene) {
  const symbols: Record<string, number> = {};
  for (const n of s.projection.nodes) {
    if (n.kind !== 'file') continue;
    const d = s.activity.leaves[n.id]?.symbols;
    const k = d ? new Set([...d.added, ...d.removed, ...d.sig, ...d.body, ...d.renamed.map((r) => r[1])]).size : 0;
    if (k) symbols[n.id] = k;
  }
  useV2.getState().publish({ nodes: s.projection.nodes, edges: s.projection.edges, hot: hotOf(s), symbols, cursor: s.projection.cursor });
}

const heat = (r: Rollup | undefined) => (!r ? 9 : r.violation === 'new' ? 0 : r.violation ? 1 : r.cursor ? 2 : r.edited ? 3 : r.ghostSteps.length ? 4 : r.looked ? 5 : 9);
const leafHeat = (s: Scene, id: string) => {
  const l = s.activity.leaves[id];
  return !l ? 9 : l.violation === 'new' ? 0 : l.violation ? 1 : l.cursor ? 2 : l.edited ? 3 : l.ghostSteps.length ? 4 : l.looked ? 5 : 9;
};
/** Collapsed cells list the children that matter this turn first (as v1 did), then the rest by order. */
function hotOf(s: Scene): Record<string, string[]> {
  const out: Record<string, string[]> = {};
  for (const n of s.projection.nodes) {
    if (n.expanded || (n.kind !== 'cell' && n.id !== UNASSIGNED)) continue;
    const kids = (s.graph.children[n.id] ?? []).filter((k) => s.graph.nodes[k]!.kind !== 'table' || true);
    out[n.id] = kids.map((k, i) => ({ k, i, h: leafHeat(s, k) })).sort((a, b) => a.h - b.h || a.i - b.i).slice(0, 8).map((x) => s.graph.nodes[x.k]!.label);
  }
  return out;
}
void heat;

// ---------------------------------------------------------------- keyboard: Enter dives, Esc goes up, arrows move, ⌘K, ⌘[ ⌘], m

function useKeys(tr: Transitioner, rootRef: React.RefObject<HTMLDivElement>) {
  useEffect(() => {
    const onKey = (e: KeyboardEvent) => {
      const target = e.target as HTMLElement | null;
      const typing = !!target?.closest('textarea, input, [contenteditable]');
      const st = useV2.getState();
      const meta = e.metaKey || e.ctrlKey;
      if (meta && e.key.toLowerCase() === 'k') { e.preventDefault(); st.setPalette(!st.palette); return; }
      if (typing || st.palette) return;
      if (meta && e.key === '[') { e.preventDefault(); st.goBack(); return; }
      if (meta && e.key === ']') { e.preventDefault(); st.goForward(); return; }
      if (meta || e.altKey) return;
      const scene = useSceneRef.current;
      if (!scene) return;
      const place = { open: st.open, focus: st.focus };
      if (e.key === 'Escape') {
        if (useStore.getState().selection) return; // the inspector closes first
        e.preventDefault();
        st.go(up(scene.graph, place));
      } else if (e.key === 'Enter') {
        const id = target?.closest<HTMLElement>('.react-flow__node')?.dataset.id ?? st.focus;
        if (!id) return;
        e.preventDefault();
        st.go(dive(scene.graph, place, id.startsWith('band:') ? UNASSIGNED : id));
      } else if (e.key.startsWith('Arrow')) {
        const f = tr.shown;
        if (!f) return;
        const dir = e.key.slice(5).toLowerCase() as Dir;
        const next = neighbour(f, st.focus, dir);
        if (!next) return;
        e.preventDefault();
        st.setFocus(next);
        rootRef.current?.querySelector<HTMLElement>(`.react-flow__node[data-id="${CSS.escape(next)}"]`)?.focus({ preventScroll: true });
      } else if (e.key === 'm') st.toggleMinimap();
    };
    window.addEventListener('keydown', onKey, true);
    return () => window.removeEventListener('keydown', onKey, true);
  }, [tr, rootRef]);
}

/** The latest scene for event handlers outside React's render (keyboard, palette). */
export const useSceneRef: { current: Scene | null } = { current: null };

function SceneRef() {
  const scene = useScene();
  useSceneRef.current = scene;
  return null;
}
export { SceneRef };

// ---------------------------------------------------------------- edges: one SVG of precomputed paths

const EdgeLayer = memo(function EdgeLayer({ frame, enter }: { frame: Frame; enter: Enter }) {
  const lod = useLod();
  const sel = useStore((s) => selectedEdge(s.selection));
  const select = useStore((s) => s.select);
  return (
    <svg className="v2-edges" width={1} height={1}>
      <defs>
        {(['existing', 'new', 'ghost', 'violation'] as const).map((k) => (
          <marker key={k} id={`v2-arrow-${k}`} viewBox="0 0 10 10" refX="9" refY="5" markerWidth="8" markerHeight="8" markerUnits="userSpaceOnUse" orient="auto-start-reverse">
            <path d="M0,1 L9,5 L0,9 z" className={`v2-arrowhead is-${k}`} />
          </marker>
        ))}
      </defs>
      <path className="v2-ticks" d={frame.gutters.x.flatMap((x) => frame.gutters.y.map((y) => `M${x - 6},${y}h12M${x},${y - 6}v12`)).join('')} />
      {frame.edges.map((e) => {
        const kind = e.violation ? 'violation' : e.status;
        const entering = enter.edges.has(e.id);
        const id = e.trunk ? e.trunk[0]! : e.id;
        return (
          <g
            key={entering ? `${e.id}#${enter.seq}` : e.id}
            data-edge={e.id}
            className={`v2-edge is-${e.status} ${e.violation ? `is-violation is-violation-${e.violation}` : ''} ${e.faint ? 'is-faint' : ''} ${e.trunk ? 'is-trunk' : ''} ${entering ? 'is-enter' : ''} ${sel === id ? 'is-selected' : ''}`}
            onClick={(ev) => { ev.stopPropagation(); select(sel === id ? null : { link: id }); }}
          >
            <title>{e.trunk ? `${e.count} imports between these columns` : `${e.count} ${e.count === 1 ? 'link' : 'links'}`}</title>
            <path className="v2-edge-hit" d={e.d} />
            <path
              className="v2-edge-line"
              d={e.d}
              style={{ strokeWidth: e.faint ? undefined : strokeFor(e.count) }}
              markerEnd={e.trunk ? undefined : `url(#v2-arrow-${kind})`}
              {...(entering && e.status !== 'ghost' ? { pathLength: 1 } : {})}
            />
            {enter.pulse.has(e.id) && !reducedMotion() && <circle key={enter.seq} className="v2-pulse" r={4.5} style={{ offsetPath: `path('${e.d}')` }} />}
            {lod !== 'far' && (e.count > 1 || e.steps.length > 0) && (
              <g className="v2-edge-tag" transform={`translate(${e.mid.x.toFixed(1)},${e.mid.y.toFixed(1)})`}>
                <rect x={-13} y={-10} width={26} height={20} rx={10} />
                <text textAnchor="middle" dy="0.35em">{e.steps.length ? e.steps.join(',') : e.count}</text>
              </g>
            )}
          </g>
        );
      })}
    </svg>
  );
});

function Cursor({ frame }: { frame: Frame }) {
  const c = useV2((s) => s.cursor);
  const ui = useView().ui;
  const b = c ? frame.boxes[c.node] : undefined;
  if (!c || !b) return null;
  const path = fileOf(c.leaf) ?? ui.cursor?.path ?? c.leaf;
  const name = path.split('/').filter(Boolean).pop();
  const inBox = b.h > 60 && b.w > 120;
  return (
    <div className="v2-cursor" style={{ transform: `translate(${b.x + (inBox ? 10 : -6)}px, ${b.y + b.h - (inBox ? 12 : 0)}px)` }} aria-live="polite">
      <span className="v2-cursor-avatar" aria-hidden="true">C</span>
      <span className="v2-cursor-label">Claude · {c.verb} <code>{name}</code></span>
    </div>
  );
}

function Empty() {
  const conn = useStore((s) => s.conn);
  return (
    <div className="v2-empty">
      <p className="v2-empty-title">{conn === 'down' ? 'Waiting for the Harness server' : 'Reading the repo'}</p>
      <p>{conn === 'down' ? 'Start it with HARNESS_REPO=<path> npm run dev. This page reconnects on its own.' : 'The map appears once domains.yaml is loaded or proposed.'}</p>
    </div>
  );
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------- screen-space headers (crisp at any zoom)

function Headers({ frame, insets }: { frame: Frame; insets: Insets }) {
  const store = useStoreApi();
  const colRefs = useRef<(HTMLButtonElement | null)[]>([]);
  const rowRefs = useRef<(HTMLDivElement | null)[]>([]);
  const nodes = useV2((s) => s.nodes);

  useLayoutEffect(() => {
    const place = ([tx, ty, k]: [number, number, number]) => {
      frame.cols.forEach((c, i) => {
        const el = colRefs.current[i];
        if (!el) return;
        const w = c.spine ? Math.max(c.w * k, 120) : c.w * k;
        el.style.transform = `translate(${(tx + (c.x + c.w / 2) * k - w / 2).toFixed(1)}px, 0)`;
        el.style.width = `${w.toFixed(1)}px`;
      });
      frame.rows.forEach((r, j) => {
        const el = rowRefs.current[j];
        if (!el) return;
        el.style.transform = `translate(0, ${(ty + r.y * k).toFixed(1)}px)`;
        el.style.height = `${(r.h * k).toFixed(1)}px`;
      });
    };
    place(store.getState().transform);
    return store.subscribe((s, p) => { if (s.transform !== p.transform) place(s.transform); });
  }, [frame, store]);

  const toggle = (col: string) => {
    const scene = useSceneRef.current;
    if (!scene) return;
    const st = useV2.getState();
    st.go(dive(scene.graph, { open: st.open, focus: st.focus }, col === UNASSIGNED_COL ? UNASSIGNED : `domain:${col}`));
  };

  return (
    <div className="v2-headers" style={{ ['--hdr-h' as string]: `${insets.top - 12}px`, ['--lbl-w' as string]: `${insets.left - 12}px` }}>
      <div className="v2-colheads">
        {frame.cols.map((c, i) => {
          const r = nodes[c.id === UNASSIGNED_COL ? UNASSIGNED : `domain:${c.id}`]?.rollup;
          const cellRollups = frame.nodes.filter((n) => n.id.startsWith(`cell:${c.id}/`)).map((n) => nodes[n.id]?.rollup);
          return (
            <button
              key={c.id}
              ref={(el) => { colRefs.current[i] = el; }}
              type="button"
              className={`v2-colhead ${c.spine ? 'is-spine' : ''} ${c.open ? 'is-expanded' : ''} ${c.id === UNASSIGNED_COL ? 'is-unassigned' : ''}`}
              onClick={() => toggle(c.id)}
              title={`${c.purpose}\n${c.open ? 'Click to close' : 'Click to open'}`}
              aria-expanded={c.open}
            >
              <span className="v2-colhead-title">
                <Ring cells={cellRollups} />
                <span className="v2-colhead-name">{c.name}</span>
              </span>
              {c.open && <span className="v2-colhead-purpose">{c.purpose}</span>}
              {r && (r.violation || r.edited || r.ghostSteps.length > 0) && (
                <span className="v2-colhead-marks" aria-hidden="true">
                  {r.edited && <i className={r.unplanned ? 'is-unplanned' : 'is-edited'} />}
                  {r.ghostSteps.length > 0 && <i className="is-ghost" />}
                  {r.violation && <i className={`is-${r.violation}-violation`} />}
                </span>
              )}
            </button>
          );
        })}
      </div>
      <div className="v2-rowheads">
        {frame.rows.map((r, j) => (
          <div key={r.id} ref={(el) => { rowRefs.current[j] = el; }} className="v2-rowhead">
            <span>{r.name}</span>
          </div>
        ))}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

/** Control Room: a static ring per domain showing the state mix of its cells (no motion). */
function Ring({ cells }: { cells: (Rollup | undefined)[] }) {
  const parts: [string, number][] = [
    ['var(--v2-red)', cells.filter((r) => r?.violation).length],
    ['var(--v2-amber)', cells.filter((r) => r?.unplanned).length],
    ['var(--v2-agent)', cells.filter((r) => r && r.edited && !r.unplanned && !r.violation).length],
    ['color-mix(in srgb, var(--v2-agent) 45%, transparent)', cells.filter((r) => r && !r.edited && !r.violation && (r.looked || r.ghostSteps.length > 0)).length],
  ];
  const total = Math.max(1, cells.length);
  let at = 0;
  const stops = parts.filter(([, n]) => n > 0).map(([color, n]) => {
    const from = (at / total) * 360;
    at += n;
    return `${color} ${from}deg ${(at / total) * 360}deg`;
  });
  stops.push(`var(--v2-line) ${(at / total) * 360}deg 360deg`);
  return <span className="v2-ring" aria-hidden="true" style={{ background: `conic-gradient(${stops.join(', ')})` }} />;
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------- measurement hooks (Playwright)

type FrameStats = { frames: number; fps: number; p50: number; p95: number; p99: number; max: number; domNodes: number };
type Bench = {
  ready: () => boolean;
  count: () => number;
  frame: () => { nodes: number; edges: number; key: string } | null;
  stats: () => Stats & { reducedMotion: boolean };
  zoom: (ms?: number) => Promise<FrameStats>;
  toggle: (id: string) => Promise<TransitionStats & { layoutMs: number }>;
  relayout: () => Promise<number>;
};

function measureFrames(ms: number, step: (p: number) => void): Promise<FrameStats> {
  return new Promise((resolve) => {
    const times: number[] = [];
    const t0 = performance.now();
    const frame = (t: number) => {
      times.push(t);
      const p = Math.min(1, (t - t0) / ms);
      step(p);
      if (p < 1) requestAnimationFrame(frame);
      else {
        const dts = times.slice(1).map((x, i) => x - times[i]!).sort((a, b) => a - b);
        const q = (f: number) => +dts[Math.min(dts.length - 1, Math.floor(dts.length * f))]!.toFixed(2);
        resolve({ frames: times.length, fps: +((1000 * (times.length - 1)) / (times.at(-1)! - times[0]!)).toFixed(1), p50: q(0.5), p95: q(0.95), p99: q(0.99), max: q(1), domNodes: document.querySelectorAll('.react-flow__node').length });
      }
    };
    requestAnimationFrame(frame);
  });
}

function useBenchApi(tr: Transitioner, stats: React.MutableRefObject<Stats>, rf: ReturnType<typeof useReactFlow>) {
  useEffect(() => {
    const api: Bench = {
      ready: () => !!tr.shown,
      count: () => document.querySelectorAll('.react-flow__node').length,
      frame: () => (tr.shown ? { nodes: tr.shown.nodes.length, edges: tr.shown.edges.length, key: tr.shown.key } : null),
      stats: () => ({ ...stats.current, transition: tr.last, reducedMotion: reducedMotion() }),
      zoom: (ms = 3000) => {
        const b = tr.shown!.bounds;
        const cx = b.x + b.w / 2;
        const cy = b.y + b.h / 2;
        const el = document.querySelector('.v2-map')!.getBoundingClientRect();
        return measureFrames(ms, (p) => {
          const z = 0.2 + 1.2 * Math.sin(p * Math.PI); // far → near → far, crossing every LOD bucket twice
          void rf.setViewport({ zoom: z, x: el.width / 2 - (cx + (p - 0.5) * b.w * 0.4) * z, y: el.height / 2 - cy * z });
        });
      },
      toggle: (id) => new Promise((resolve) => {
        tr.onDone = (s) => {
          tr.onDone = null;
          resolve({ ...s, layoutMs: +stats.current.layoutMs.toFixed(1) });
        };
        const scene = useSceneRef.current!;
        const st = useV2.getState();
        st.go(dive(scene.graph, { open: st.open, focus: st.focus }, id.includes(':') ? id : `domain:${id}`));
      }),
      relayout: async () => { clearLayoutCache(); return 0; },
    };
    (window as unknown as { __v2: Bench }).__v2 = api;
  }, [tr, stats, rf]);
}
```

```typescript
// Where you are and how to move: back/forward (⌘[ ⌘]), breadcrumbs (System › Domain › Cell › Group › File),
// the ⌘K search and the minimap toggle.
import { useStore } from '../store';
import { ancestors, jump } from './nav';
import { useScene } from './pipeline';
import { useV2 } from './store';

const CRUMB = new Set(['domain', 'cell', 'group', 'file', 'unassigned']);
const mac = typeof navigator !== 'undefined' && /Mac|iPhone|iPad/.test(navigator.platform);
const mod = mac ? '⌘' : 'Ctrl+';

export function NavBar() {
  const scene = useScene();
  const open = useV2((s) => s.open);
  const focus = useV2((s) => s.focus);
  const back = useV2((s) => s.back.length);
  const forward = useV2((s) => s.forward.length);
  const minimap = useV2((s) => s.minimap);
  const st = useV2.getState();
  const select = useStore((s) => s.select);
  const graph = scene?.graph;

  const at = focus && graph?.nodes[focus] ? focus : scene?.open.at(-1) ?? null;
  const path = graph && at ? ancestors(graph, at).filter((id) => CRUMB.has(graph.nodes[id]!.kind)) : [];
  const goTo = (id: string | null) => {
    if (!graph) return;
    select(null);
    if (!id) return st.go({ open: [], focus: null });
    st.go(jump(graph, { open, focus }, id), id);
  };

  return (
    <nav className="v2-nav" aria-label="Map navigation">
      <span className="v2-nav-hist">
        <button type="button" className="v2-nav-btn" disabled={!back} onClick={st.goBack} title={`Back (${mod}[)`} aria-label="Back">‹</button>
        <button type="button" className="v2-nav-btn" disabled={!forward} onClick={st.goForward} title={`Forward (${mod}])`} aria-label="Forward">›</button>
      </span>
      <ol className="v2-crumbs">
        <li>{path.length ? <button type="button" onClick={() => goTo(null)}>System</button> : <span aria-current="location">System</span>}</li>
        {path.map((id, i) => {
          const n = graph!.nodes[id]!;
          const last = i === path.length - 1;
          return (
            <li key={id}>
              {last ? <span aria-current="location">{n.label}</span> : <button type="button" onClick={() => goTo(id)}>{n.label}</button>}
            </li>
          );
        })}
      </ol>
      <span className="v2-nav-tools">
        <button type="button" className="v2-nav-search" onClick={() => st.setPalette(true)} title="Find a domain, cell, file, symbol, route, decision or turn">
          Find <kbd>{mod}K</kbd>
        </button>
        <button type="button" className={`v2-nav-btn ${minimap ? 'is-on' : ''}`} onClick={st.toggleMinimap} aria-pressed={minimap} title="Minimap (m)">
          <svg viewBox="0 0 16 16" width="16" height="16" aria-hidden="true"><rect x="1.5" y="3" width="13" height="10" rx="1.5" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth="1.3" /><rect x="8" y="7.5" width="5" height="4" fill="currentColor" /></svg>
        </button>
      </span>
    </nav>
  );
}

```

```markdown
# Alike integration: current state and proposed redesign

Oct 11, 2026. A note for whoever owns the harness server. It proposes changes to how Harness uses Alike, motivated by demo beats 3 and 4 in `DEMO_PLAN.md`. Nothing here is decided. Check every Alike API detail against Alike's docs and `VERIFY.md` before building; items marked **unverified** are assumptions.

## The value we want to show

- **Alike on its own (basic memory):** it remembers what was decided, attaches it to code paths, and gives it to any agent working there. It is advisory: it can't tell whether the code still follows the decision, and a file created later has no anchor.
- **Alike plus Harness (architectural memory):** the decision is attached to the architecture, e.g. "research tools never read outreach data", not to the files involved that day. So:
  1. it covers code that doesn't exist yet;
  2. it shapes the plan before any code (the rejected approach shows struck through);
  3. it is checked against the code (load scan, edit gate, auditor);
  4. it has provenance on the map ("decided in session 1, DR-4").
- **Alike's part:** carrying the decision to agents and teammates who never open Harness.

**Pitch line:** "Alike remembers what we decided. The harness makes it part of the architecture, so it holds for code nobody has written yet."

## What Harness does today

Code: `apps/server/src/decisions.ts` (`recordFork`, `repoAnchor`) and `apps/server/src/session.ts` (`notes`, `afterAlike`).

- **Write only.** After a fork is answered, `recordFork` writes `decisions/DR-n.md`, updates `domains.yaml` and commits both. It then queues an instruction asking Claude to call `mcp__alike__record_decision` with exact arguments. A PostToolUse hook re-emits `decision_recorded` with `alike: true`, and the inspector shows "in Alike".
- **Anchors are the files that broke the rule.** `anchors: [{ kind: 'path', label: 'governs', path, repository }]`, one per violating file. With option A that file usually never gets written (beat 3's planned `src/tools/outreach-history.ts`). So in Alike the decision points at a path that doesn't exist, and a teammate's agent touching any other research tool won't be shown it.
- **The decision text is mostly the violation**, not the principle. The title is the user's first sentence when it's long enough, otherwise "`<file>` follows DR-3: …".
- **Recording depends on the model.** Claude has to make the tool call, which adds a step to the coding turn and can silently not happen ("If the Alike tools are unavailable, skip this silently").
- **Nothing reads Alike back.** The session brief uses `decisions/` in git only. Alike's hooks are deliberately off in harness sessions (`settingSources: ['project','local']`, VERIFY.md item 4).
- **Repository identity:** `HARNESS_REPO_SLUG`, else the origin remote, else `<git user>/<folder>`. The demo's fresh copies (`scripts/fresh-scout.sh`) have no remote, so `npm run demo` passes `HARNESS_REPO_SLUG`.

## Proposed changes

Roughly in order of value for the demo.

1. **Anchor decisions to the architecture.** For a decision on an `only_via` or `no_edge` invariant, anchor to the path globs of the cells on both sides of the rule: for DR-4, `src/tools/**` (Research tools › Logic) and `src/outreach/**`. Add the files where the chosen approach lives (e.g. `src/orchestrator/agent.ts`). For `owns_writes`, anchor to the owner's data cell and its `schema.sql`. Then Alike surfaces DR-4 whenever any agent touches any research tool, including ones written later.
   - **Unverified:** whether Alike path anchors accept globs or folders. If not, anchor to every existing file in those cells, and re-anchor when the cell gains files (the cartographer's turn-end pass is a natural place).
2. **Record the principle, not the incident.**
   - Title and outcome come from the invariant plus the user's answer: "DR-4: Research tools never read outreach data; the run loop passes outreach context in."
   - The rationale names the rejected option explicitly ("Rejected: a research tool that imports outreach code") and the invariant it refines (DR-3).
   - Beat 3 has the user answer in that form; Harness should still compose a principle when they just type "A".
3. **Record deterministically, off the model.** Write to Alike from the server, not by asking Claude to make a tool call. The paired `~/.alike/bin/alike` CLI can call `record_decision` (VERIFY.md (d)), or use Alike's HTTP API if there is one (**unverified**).
   - Run it asynchronously after the commit, never in the hot path, and emit `decision_recorded { alike: true }` when it succeeds.
   - This removes a model step from the turn and makes "in Alike" reliable on camera.
   - Keep the MCP path as a fallback.
4. **Read decisions back.**
   - At session start, fetch this repository's standing decisions from Alike (the Build Plan suggested `resolve_work_item`; **unverified** which call fits). Merge them with `decisions/`.
   - **Decisions Harness made** (they carry a DR id) are already known; just confirm they match.
   - **Decisions made elsewhere,** e.g. a teammate's plain Claude Code conversation that Alike captured, show as *proposed* rules on the map: dashed, marked "from Alike". Accepting one turns it into an invariant through the cartographer's proposal flow (NAVIGATION_PLAN §4.5); rejecting it is recorded.

   That closes the loop. Alike's conversational memory becomes enforced architecture (with your consent), and goes back to Alike with exact anchors.
5. **Show it on the map.**
   - **Plans:** a planned edge that a standing decision rejects is drawn struck through: "rejected in DR-4, session 1" (beat 4). The ledger's `rejectedOptionsBlocked` already counts it.
   - **Inspector:** a decision links to its Alike page and lists where it's anchored.
   - **Turn summary:** "1 decision recorded in Alike" alongside the ledger.
6. **Repository identity for fresh copies and takes.**
   - **Teammate beat:** Alike's hooks in a plain Claude Code session probably identify the repository by its git remote, and the copy has none. `fresh-scout.sh` should give the copy an origin URL for `johnz4021/scout-agent` with pushing disabled (`git remote set-url --push origin no-push`).
   - **Per-take slug:** decisions outlive a copy reset, so each take adds another DR-4 to Alike. A `--take N` option should set `HARNESS_REPO_SLUG=johnz4021/scout-agent-takeN` and the matching origin.
   - **Baselines:** the plain Claude Code baselines (DEMO_PLAN "Baselines") must run under a slug that never received a decision. Otherwise Alike feeds them DR-4 and the "without harness" timings are wrong.
7. **Lifecycle (later).** When a rule is loosened, retired or excepted (NAVIGATION_PLAN §4.4 "rule erosion"), update or retire the Alike decision too (**unverified** whether Alike supports updates). Dedupe by DR id so replays and retries don't create copies.

## Open questions for Alike

- Do path anchors accept globs or folders?
- Is there a server-side or HTTP way to record and read decisions without an agent session? (This was on the Build Plan's "ask at the event" list.)
- How do Alike's hooks pick the repository: remote URL, folder, something else?
- Can decisions be updated, retired or deleted (for rule changes and take resets)?
- Is there a stable URL per decision, for linking from the inspector?

## Done when

- **Beat 3:** answering A shows "DR-4 in Alike" within a few seconds, recorded by the server. Alike's page shows the principle, the rejected option, and anchors covering `src/tools/**` and `src/outreach/**`.
- **Beat 4:** in a fresh session, "Can we build a research tool that reads our past emails…" plans without the tool, shows the struck-through edge citing DR-4, and the ledger counts one rejected option blocked.
- **Teammate moment:** plain Claude Code in a fresh copy (same take slug), touching any file in `src/tools/`, is given DR-4 by Alike.
- **Isolation:** a new take (`--take N+1`) starts with no DR-4 in Alike, and baselines run with no decisions.

```

```typescript
// ⌘K: find a domain, cell, group, file, symbol, route, decision or turn. Jumping opens the containers on the way,
// focuses and selects the target, and flies the camera there.
import { useEffect, useMemo, useRef, useState } from 'react';
import { fileOf, type ContextGraph, type UIState } from '@harness/core/view';
import { useView } from '../derive';
import { useStore } from '../store';
import { jump } from './nav';
import { useScene } from './pipeline';
import { selectionFor } from './select';
import { useV2 } from './store';

type Item = { key: string; kind: string; label: string; sub: string; hay: string; rank: number; run: () => void };

const RANK: Record<string, number> = { domain: 0, cell: 1, group: 2, file: 3, route: 4, symbol: 5, decision: 6, turn: 7 };
const KIND_LABEL: Record<string, string> = { domain: 'Domain', cell: 'Cell', group: 'Folder', file: 'File', route: 'Route', symbol: 'Symbol', decision: 'Decision', turn: 'Turn' };

function isMember(g: ContextGraph, id: string) {
  const n = g.nodes[id]!;
  const p = n.parent ? g.nodes[n.parent] : undefined;
  return (n.symbol?.kind === 'property' || n.symbol?.kind === 'method') && p?.symbol?.kind === 'type';
}

function itemsOf(graph: ContextGraph, ui: UIState, go: (id: string) => void, setTurn: (id: string | null) => void): Item[] {
  const out: Item[] = [];
  const domainName = (d?: string) => (d && graph.nodes[`domain:${d}`]?.label) || d || '';
  for (const n of Object.values(graph.nodes)) {
    let kind: string = n.kind;
    let sub = '';
    if (n.kind === 'domain') sub = 'Domain';
    else if (n.kind === 'cell') sub = `${domainName(n.domain)} cell`;
    else if (n.kind === 'group') sub = `${domainName(n.domain)} · ${n.path ?? ''}`;
    else if (n.kind === 'file') sub = n.path ?? n.id;
    else if (n.kind === 'route') sub = fileOf(n.parent ?? '') ?? '';
    else if (n.kind === 'symbol') { if (isMember(graph, n.id)) continue; sub = fileOf(n.id) ?? ''; }
    else continue;
    const label = n.kind === 'cell' ? `${domainName(n.domain)} · ${n.label}` : n.kind === 'symbol' ? n.id.slice(n.id.indexOf('#') + 1) : n.label;
    if (n.kind === 'group' && n.id === 'group:vendors') continue;
    kind = n.kind;
    out.push({ key: n.id, kind, label, sub, hay: `${label} ${sub}`.toLowerCase(), rank: RANK[kind] ?? 9, run: () => go(n.id) });
  }
  for (const d of ui.decisions) {
    const target = d.paths.find((p) => graph.nodes[p]);
    out.push({ key: `dec:${d.id}`, kind: 'decision', label: `${d.id} ${d.title}`, sub: d.paths.join(', ') || d.invariant, hay: `${d.id} ${d.title} ${d.invariant} ${d.paths.join(' ')}`.toLowerCase(), rank: RANK.decision!, run: () => (target ? go(target) : undefined) });
  }
  ui.turns.forEach((t, i) => {
    out.push({ key: `turn:${t.id}`, kind: 'turn', label: `Turn ${i + 1}`, sub: t.prompt, hay: `turn ${i + 1} ${t.prompt}`.toLowerCase(), rank: RANK.turn!, run: () => setTurn(i === ui.turns.length - 1 ? null : t.id) });
  });
  return out;
}

function search(items: Item[], q: string): Item[] {
  const terms = q.toLowerCase().split(/\s+/).filter(Boolean);
  if (!terms.length) return items.filter((i) => i.kind === 'domain' || i.kind === 'turn' || i.kind === 'decision').sort((a, b) => a.rank - b.rank);
  const scored: { i: Item; s: number }[] = [];
  for (const i of items) {
    if (!terms.every((t) => i.hay.includes(t))) continue;
    const l = i.label.toLowerCase();
    const s = (l === terms[0] ? 0 : l.startsWith(terms[0]!) ? 10 : l.includes(terms[0]!) ? 20 : 40) + i.rank * 2 + Math.min(20, l.length / 4);
    scored.push({ i, s });
  }
  return scored.sort((a, b) => a.s - b.s || a.i.label.localeCompare(b.i.label)).slice(0, 40).map((x) => x.i);
}

export function Palette() {
  const open = useV2((s) => s.palette);
  if (!open) return null;
  return <PaletteBody />;
}

function PaletteBody() {
  const scene = useScene();
  const ui = useView().ui;
  const select = useStore((s) => s.select);
  const setTurn = useStore((s) => s.setTurn);
  const [q, setQ] = useState('');
  const [at, setAt] = useState(0);
  const input = useRef<HTMLInputElement>(null);
  const close = () => useV2.getState().setPalette(false);

  const items = useMemo(() => {
    if (!scene) return [];
    const go = (id: string) => {
      const st = useV2.getState();
      const next = jump(scene.graph, { open: st.open, focus: st.focus }, id);
      st.go(next, next.focus);
      const n = next.focus ? scene.graph.nodes[next.focus] : undefined;
      if (n) select(selectionFor(n));
    };
    return itemsOf(scene.graph, ui, go, setTurn);
  }, [scene, ui, select, setTurn]);
  const results = useMemo(() => search(items, q), [items, q]);

  useEffect(() => { input.current?.focus(); }, []);
  useEffect(() => setAt(0), [q]);

  const choose = (i: Item | undefined) => {
    if (!i) return;
    close();
    i.run();
  };

  return (
    <div className="v2-palette-scrim" onMouseDown={close}>
      <div className="v2-palette" role="dialog" aria-label="Find on the map" onMouseDown={(e) => e.stopPropagation()}>
        <input
          ref={input}
          className="v2-palette-input"
          value={q}
          placeholder="Find a domain, file, symbol, route, decision or turn"
          aria-label="Search the map"
          onChange={(e) => setQ(e.target.value)}
          onKeyDown={(e) => {
            if (e.key === 'Escape') { e.preventDefault(); close(); }
            else if (e.key === 'ArrowDown') { e.preventDefault(); setAt((a) => Math.min(results.length - 1, a + 1)); }
            else if (e.key === 'ArrowUp') { e.preventDefault(); setAt((a) => Math.max(0, a - 1)); }
            else if (e.key === 'Enter') { e.preventDefault(); choose(results[at]); }
          }}
        />
        <ul className="v2-palette-list" role="listbox">
          {results.length === 0 && <li className="v2-palette-none">Nothing matches “{q}”.</li>}
          {results.map((r, i) => (
            <li key={r.key} role="option" aria-selected={i === at} className={i === at ? 'is-active' : ''} onMouseEnter={() => setAt(i)} onClick={() => choose(r)}>
              <span className={`v2-palette-kind k-${r.kind}`}>{KIND_LABEL[r.kind] ?? r.kind}</span>
              <span className="v2-palette-label">{r.label}</span>
              <span className="v2-palette-sub">{r.sub}</span>
            </li>
          ))}
        </ul>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

```

I've rewritten beats 3 and 4 in `DEMO_PLAN.md` and written the Alike note as `ALIKE_INTEGRATION.md` in the harness repo.

**Beat 3: the decision is made.**
- You type: "Can we add a research tool that checks whether we've already emailed this contact?"
- The planned tool's edge into Outreach goes red, and Claude asks A or B.
- You answer with the principle: "A. Research tools never read outreach data; the run loop passes it in."
- On screen: DR-4 is committed to git, the chat shows it landing in Alike, and there's a 3-second cut to its Alike page.

**Beat 4: memory stops something being built.**
- In a fresh session you type: "Can we build a research tool that reads our past emails with this contact and suggests a personalized opener?"
- The tool you asked for doesn't get built. Its edge shows struck through, "rejected in DR-4, session 1", and Claude builds the opener through the run loop instead.
- The ledger's rejected-options counter goes to 1.
- The point to land: a different feature, in a file that didn't exist when you decided, still caught, because the memory is tied to the architecture rather than to files.

**Also updated:**
- The optional teammate moment for Alike in the extended cut.
- The pitch line: "Alike remembers what we decided; the harness makes it part of the architecture, so it holds for code nobody has written yet."
- The rehearsal checks (either resolution of beat 4 works).
- What the beats need from the harness: a struck-through rejected edge, with a fallback if it isn't built.

**`ALIKE_INTEGRATION.md`** is not done in the harness yet. It covers the current state, the redesign, open questions for Alike, and done-when checks for the beats. Today the harness only writes to Alike, by asking Claude to make a tool call, and anchors each decision to the file that broke the rule. With option A that's usually a file that never gets created, so in Alike the decision points at nothing and a teammate's agent wouldn't be shown it. The proposed changes:
1. **Anchor decisions to the architecture**, i.e. the folders on both sides of the rule, so they cover future files.
2. **Record the principle**, including the rejected option, not the one-off incident.
3. **Record from the server, not through Claude,** so "in Alike" is reliable and adds no step to the coding turn.
4. **Read decisions back from Alike at session start**, so a teammate's decision captured elsewhere shows up as a proposed rule you can accept.
5. **Show it on the map:** the struck-through rejected edge, plus a link to the decision's Alike page.
6. **Keep demo takes separate.** Each take gets its own repository name, so DR-4 doesn't pile up in Alike across takes, and the baseline runs aren't fed a decision.
7. **Later:** update or retire Alike decisions when rules change, and stop retries from recording duplicates.

Points 6 and 7 are flagged as needed before recording, along with the open questions about what Alike supports.

All of this is uncommitted in the harness repo: `DEMO_PLAN.md`, `ALIKE_INTEGRATION.md`, `CLAUDE.md`, `DEMO_REPO_SPEC.md`, `package.json` and the two scripts. Point the other session at `ALIKE_INTEGRATION.md`, and tell it the struck-through rejected edge is now needed for beat 4.

```bash
type EdgeDetail = {
  from: string; // domain ids
  to: string;
  where: string; // "Logic to External"
  state: 'existing' | 'new' | 'ghost';
  gate: boolean; // a ghost the edit gate blocked (not planned)
  violation: boolean;
  steps: number[];
  files: ImportEdge[];
};

function EdgeBody({ v, edge, pair, map, openFile }: { v: View; edge: string; pair: string; map: DomainMap; openFile: (p: string) => void }) {
  const seg = edgeSegments(v.ui, v.turn, v.edges).find((s) => s.edgeKey === edge && s.pair === pair);
  const [from, to] = edge.split('->') as [string, string];
  const [srcCell, dstCell] = pair.split('=>') as [string, string];
  const layerName = (k: string) => map.layers.find((l) => l.id === k.split('/')[1])?.name ?? '';
  const d: EdgeDetail = {
    from, to, where: `${layerName(srcCell)} to ${layerName(dstCell)}`, state: seg?.state ?? 'existing', gate: false,
    violation: !!seg?.violation, steps: seg?.steps ?? [], files: seg?.files ?? [],
  };
  return <EdgeView v={v} d={d} map={map} openFile={openFile} />;
}

/** A v2 edge: the projected edge's leaf edges (imports, calls, writes, planned or gate-blocked imports). */
function LinkBody({ v, id, map, openFile }: { v: View; id: string; map: DomainMap; openFile: (p: string) => void }) {
  const e = useV2((s) => s.edges[id]);
  const nodes = useV2((s) => s.nodes);
  if (!e) return <p className="insp-note">This link is not on the map at this point of the log.</p>;
  const a = nodes[e.from];
  const b = nodes[e.to];
  const files: ImportEdge[] = [];
  for (const leaf of e.leafEdges) {
    const [, f, t] = leaf.split('|') as [string, string, string];
    if (!files.some((x) => x.from === f && x.to === t)) files.push({ from: f, to: t });
  }
  const d: EdgeDetail = {
    from: a?.domain ?? e.from, to: b?.domain ?? e.to, where: `${a?.label ?? e.from} to ${b?.label ?? e.to}`,
    state: e.status, gate: e.leafEdges.every((l) => l.startsWith('gate|')), violation: e.violation !== null, steps: e.steps, files,
  };
  return <EdgeView v={v} d={d} map={map} openFile={openFile} kinds={e.kinds} />;
}

function EdgeView({ v, d, map, openFile, kinds }: { v: View; d: EdgeDetail; map: DomainMap; openFile: (p: string) => void; kinds?: string[] }) {
  const { from, to, files } = d;
  const name = (id: string) => map.domains.find((x) => x.id === id)?.name ?? id;
  const vios = turnViolations(v).filter(({ v: x }) => files.some((f) => f.from === x.file && (!x.target || x.target === f.to)));
  const invs = map.invariants.filter(
    (i) => (i.kind === 'no_edge' && i.from === from && i.to === to) || (i.kind === 'only_via' && files.some((f) => i.targets.some((t) => globRe(t).test(f.to)))),
  );
  const prov = provenance(v.ui, { edge: `${from}->${to}` });
  const state = d.state === 'ghost'
    ? d.gate ? 'Blocked at edit: the import was never written' : `Planned in ${stepList(d.steps)}, not built yet`
    : d.state === 'new' ? `Added in turn ${v.turnIndex}` : 'On the map before this turn';
  const what = kinds && kinds.some((k) => k !== 'imports') ? 'Links' : 'Imports';
  return (
    <>
      <h2 className="insp-title">{name(from)} <span className="insp-arrow">→</span> {name(to)}</h2>
      <p className="insp-sub">{d.where}. Derived from {kinds?.join(', ') || 'imports'}; flow down a column is not drawn.</p>
      <p className={`insp-state ${d.violation ? 'is-red' : ''}`}>{state}</p>
      {vios.length > 0 && <Section title="Rules crossed">{vios.map(({ v: x, source }, i) => <ViolationItem key={i} v={x} source={source} />)}</Section>}
      <Section title={`${what} (${files.length})`}>
        <ul className="insp-imports">
          {files.map((f, i) => (
            <li key={i}>
              <button className="link" onClick={() => openFile(f.from.split('#')[0]!)}>{f.from}</button>
              <span className="insp-arrow">→</span>
              <button className="link" onClick={() => openFile(f.to.split('#')[0]!)}>{f.to}</button>
            </li>
          ))}
        </ul>
      </Section>
      {invs.length > 0 && <Section title="Rules on this dependency">{invs.map((i) => <InvariantItem key={i.id} inv={i} />)}</Section>}
      <Provenance prov={prov} scope={`${name(from)} → ${name(to)}`} />
    </>
  );
}

/** One file (v2): where it sits, what the turn did to it, the rules it crosses, its imports and its code. */
function FileBody({ v, path, map, openFile }: { v: View; path: string; map: DomainMap; openFile: (p: string) => void }) {
  const node = useV2((s) => s.nodes[path]);
  const p = v.ui.files[path];
  const pa = v.turn?.paths[path];
  const r = node?.rollup;
  const domain = p && 'domain' in p ? map.domains.find((d) => d.id === p.domain) : undefined;
  const layer = p?.kind === 'cell' ? map.layers.find((l) => l.id === p.layer) : undefined;
  const vios = turnViolations(v).filter(({ v: x }) => x.file === path);
  const out = v.ui.facts[path]?.imports.map((i) => i.to) ?? [];
  const into = Object.values(v.ui.facts).filter((f) => f.imports.some((i) => i.to === path)).map((f) => f.path).sort();
  const sym = pa?.symbols;
  const changed = sym ? [...sym.added.map((s) => ['added', s]), ...sym.sig.map((s) => ['signature', s]), ...sym.body.map((s) => ['body', s]), ...sym.removed.map((s) => ['removed', s])] : [];
  const state: string[] = [];
  if (r?.edited || pa?.edits) state.push(r?.unplanned ? 'Edited without being planned' : pa?.created ? 'Created this turn' : 'Edited this turn');
  if (r?.ghostSteps.length) state.push(`Planned in ${stepList(r.ghostSteps)}${r.plannedNew ? ', not created yet' : ''}`);
  if ((r?.looked || pa?.looked) && !(r?.edited || pa?.edits)) state.push('Looked at this turn');
  const prov = p?.kind === 'cell' ? provenance(v.ui, { cell: `${p.domain}/${p.layer}` }) : null;
  return (
    <>
      <h2 className="insp-title insp-path">{path}</h2>
      <p className="insp-sub">{domain ? `${domain.name}${layer ? `, ${layer.name}` : ' tests'}` : p?.kind === 'neutral' ? 'Shared code' : 'Unassigned'}</p>
      {state.length > 0 && <p className={`insp-state ${r?.unplanned ? 'is-amber' : ''}`}>{state.join('. ')}{pa?.edits ? `: +${pa.added} −${pa.removed}` : ''}</p>}
      <button className="btn insp-open" onClick={() => openFile(path)}>Show code</button>
      {vios.length > 0 && <Section title="Rules crossed">{vios.map(({ v: x, source }, i) => <ViolationItem key={i} v={x} source={source} />)}</Section>}
      {changed.length > 0 && (
        <Section title={`Symbols changed (${changed.length})`}>
          <ul className="insp-files">{changed.map(([k, id]) => <li key={`${k}${id}`}><code>{id!.slice(id!.indexOf('#') + 1)}</code> <span className="insp-mark">{k}</span></li>)}</ul>
        </Section>
      )}
      <Section title={`Imports (${out.length})`}><FileList files={out.filter((x) => !x.startsWith('vendor:'))} openFile={openFile} /></Section>
      <Section title={`Imported by (${into.length})`}><FileList files={into} openFile={openFile} /></Section>
      {prov && <Provenance prov={prov} />}
    </>
  );
}

/** A domain, folder, or the tests of a domain (v2). */
function NodeBody({ v, id, map, openFile }: { v: View; id: string; map: DomainMap; openFile: (p: string) => void }) {
  const node = useV2((s) => s.nodes[id]);
  const domain = map.domains.find((d) => d.id === (node?.domain ?? id.replace(/^domain:/, '')));
  if (node?.kind === 'domain' && domain) {
    const files = Object.entries(v.ui.files).filter(([, p]) => p.kind === 'cell' && p.domain === domain.id).map(([f]) => f);
    const invs = invariantsFor(map, domain.id, files);
    return (
      <>
        <h2 className="insp-title">{domain.name}</h2>
        <p className="insp-sub">{domain.purpose}</p>
        <Section title="Cells">
          <ul className="insp-files">
            {map.layers.filter((l) => l.id in domain.cells).map((l) => (
              <li key={l.id}>{l.name} <span className="insp-note">{files.filter((f) => { const p = v.ui.files[f]; return p?.kind === 'cell' && p.layer === l.id; }).length} files</span></li>
            ))}
          </ul>
        </Section>
        {invs.length > 0 && <Section title="Rules for this domain">{invs.map((i) => <InvariantItem key={i.id} inv={i} />)}</Section>}
      </>
    );
  }
  const prefix = node?.path ? `${node.path}/` : null;
  const files = prefix ? Object.keys(v.ui.files).filter((f) => f.startsWith(prefix)).sort() : node?.kind === 'tests' && domain ? Object.entries(v.ui.files).filter(([, p]) => p.kind === 'test' && p.domain === domain.id).map(([f]) => f).sort() : [];
  return (
    <>
      <h2 className="insp-title">{node?.label ?? id}</h2>
      {domain && <p className="insp-sub">{domain.name}</p>}
      <Section title={`Files (${files.length})`}><FileList files={files} openFile={openFile} /></Section>
    </>
  );
}
```

```typescript
// Tier 2 on the server (NAVIGATION_PLAN §3.1, N8): the semantic child process is fed from the bus (`repo_scanned` →
// full load, `facts_changed` → debounced per-file update) and its results come back as `facts_resolved` events, keyed
// by the file's content hash. Nothing here runs a model or blocks a hook. HARNESS_SEMANTIC=0 turns it off.
import {
  buildGraph, startSemantic,
  type ContextGraph, type DomainMap, type EventData, type FileFacts, type HarnessEvent, type SemanticFacts, type SemanticStatus,
} from '@harness/core';
import type { Bus } from './bus';
import type { Repo } from './repo';

/**
 * Current Tier 2 facts per file (only those whose hash matches the file's current Tier 1 facts), kept in step with
 * the bus. One per repo: the graph tools and the living map read the same store.
 */
export class SemanticStore {
  readonly facts: Record<string, SemanticFacts> = {};
  /** Bumped on every event that changes the facts the graph is built from. */
  version = 0;
  private graphCache: { version: number; map: DomainMap; graph: ContextGraph } | null = null;

  constructor(private repo: Repo, bus: Bus) {
    // Seed from the log since the last scan, so a store created mid-session agrees with the shell's reducer.
    const from = bus.events.findLastIndex((e) => e.kind === 'repo_scanned');
    for (const e of bus.events.slice(Math.max(0, from))) this.apply(e);
    bus.on((e) => this.apply(e));
  }

  private apply(e: HarnessEvent) {
    switch (e.kind) {
      case 'repo_scanned':
        for (const k of Object.keys(this.facts)) delete this.facts[k];
        break;
      case 'facts_changed': {
        const f = (e.data as EventData['facts_changed']).facts;
        const path = f?.path ?? e.path;
        if (path && this.facts[path] && this.facts[path]!.hash !== f?.hash) delete this.facts[path];
        break;
      }
      case 'facts_resolved': {
        const f = (e.data as EventData['facts_resolved']).facts;
        if (this.repo.fileFacts.get(f.path)?.hash !== f.hash) return;
        this.facts[f.path] = f;
        break;
      }
      case 'map_confirmed':
        break;
      default:
        return;
    }
    this.version++;
  }

  /** Tier 1 facts with Tier 2 calls swapped in where current (what buildGraph does), for consumers of FileFacts. */
  merged(): Record<string, FileFacts> {
    const out: Record<string, FileFacts> = {};
    for (const [path, f] of this.repo.fileFacts) {
      const s = this.facts[path];
      out[path] = s && s.hash === f.hash ? { ...f, calls: s.calls } : f;
    }
    return out;
  }

  /** The same graph the shell projects (`buildGraph(map, facts, semantic)`), rebuilt only after a change. */
  graph(): ContextGraph {
    const c = this.graphCache;
    if (c && c.version === this.version && c.map === this.repo.map) return c.graph;
    const graph = buildGraph(this.repo.map, Object.fromEntries(this.repo.fileFacts), this.facts);
    this.graphCache = { version: this.version, map: this.repo.map, graph };
    return graph;
  }

  /** Files with current Tier 2 facts, of all files with Tier 1 facts. */
  coverage() {
    let typed = 0;
    for (const [path, f] of this.repo.fileFacts) if (this.facts[path]?.hash === f.hash) typed++;
    return { typed, files: this.repo.fileFacts.size };
  }
}

const stores = new WeakMap<Repo, SemanticStore>();
export function semanticStore(repo: Repo, bus: Bus): SemanticStore {
  let s = stores.get(repo);
  if (!s) stores.set(repo, (s = new SemanticStore(repo, bus)));
  return s;
}

export type Semantic = { status(): SemanticStatus; idle(): Promise<void>; close(): Promise<void> };

/** Start Tier 2 for this repo (null when HARNESS_SEMANTIC=0). Attach before the first scan. */
export function attachSemantic(bus: Bus, repo: Repo, opts: { onStatus?: (s: SemanticStatus) => void; log?: (line: string) => void } = {}): Semantic | null {
  if (process.env.HARNESS_SEMANTIC === '0') return null;
  semanticStore(repo, bus);
  let lastState: SemanticStatus['state'] | null = null;
  const client = startSemantic({
    root: repo.root,
    onResolved(facts) {
      if (repo.fileFacts.get(facts.path)?.hash !== facts.hash) return; // stale: a newer edit is on its way
      bus.emit('facts_resolved', { facts }, { path: facts.path, turn: null });
    },
    onStatus(s) {
      opts.onStatus?.(s);
      if (s.state === lastState) return;
      lastState = s.state;
      if (s.state === 'ready' && s.stats) {
        opts.log?.(`Tier 2 (${s.impl}): ${s.total} files, ${s.stats.typed} typed + ${s.stats.dispatch} dispatch call edges, ${s.stats.implements} implements · open ${s.openMs} ms, resolve ${s.loadMs} ms`);
      } else if (s.state === 'failed') {
        opts.log?.(`Tier 2 failed: ${s.error}`);
      } else if (s.fallback && s.state === 'resolving') opts.log?.(s.fallback);
    },
  });
  const off = bus.on((e) => {
    if (e.kind === 'repo_scanned') client.load([...repo.fileFacts.values()]);
    else if (e.kind === 'facts_changed') {
      const f = (e.data as EventData['facts_changed']).facts;
      const path = f?.path ?? e.path;
      if (path) client.changed(path, f);
    }
  });
  return {
    status: () => client.status(),
    idle: () => client.idle(),
    async close() {
      off();
      await client.close();
    },
  };
}
```

```text
// autoExpand (NAVIGATION_PLAN §1.3): Furnas degree of interest = a-priori importance − tree distance from focus.
import type { TurnActivity } from '../contracts/api';
import type { ContextGraph, LeafActivity } from '../contracts/graph';
import { byId, pathTo } from './util';

/** A-priori importance of a leaf: cursor ≫ new violation > ghost/planned > edited > looked > existing violation > rest. */
export function importance(l: LeafActivity): number {
  if (l.cursor) return 100;
  if (l.violation === 'new') return 8;
  if (l.ghostSteps.length || l.planned) return 6;
  if (l.edited) return 5;
  if (l.looked) return 4;
  if (l.violation === 'existing') return 2;
  return 0;
}
```

```typescript
// the deterministic rule proposals (reinforcement, promote). No model anywhere.
import { describe, expect, it } from 'vitest';
import {
  acceptFindings, amendedRuleText, changeRuleProposal, factDelta, findingSignature, isDismissed, manualRuleProposal, nextFindingId,
  normalizeFindingText, numberDiff, reinforcedRuleText, reinforcementSignal, reinforcements, relevantDecisions, setRuleText, turnSurface, planSurface,
  type AuditDecision, type DismissedFinding, type RawFinding, type TurnSurface,

import { loadMap, mapYaml } from './helpers';

const map = loadMap();

const DR4: AuditDecision = {
  id: 'DR-4', title: 'Filings go through the gateway', outcome: 'Route filings through complete() with a filings redaction mode', invariant: 'DR-1',
  paths: ['src/tools/filing-summarize.ts'],
  rationale: 'The user chose A, in their words: "A — go through the gateway, and give redaction a filings mode so the figures survive."',
};
const DR5: AuditDecision = { id: 'DR-5', title: 'Research tools stay out of outreach', outcome: 'Keep tools independent', invariant: 'DR-3', paths: ['src/tools/company-profile.ts'], rationale: 'So research runs without CRM credentials.' };
const DR6: AuditDecision = { id: 'DR-6', title: 'Every model call is costed', outcome: 'Always call logCost', invariant: '', paths: ['src/gateway/cost-ledger.ts'], rationale: 'Usage must reconcile with the invoice: nothing skips logCost.' };
const DR7: AuditDecision = { id: 'DR-7', title: 'Notes are written by memory only', outcome: 'Use notes-store', invariant: 'DR-2', paths: ['src/memory/notes-store.ts'], rationale: 'One writer for notes.' };
const ALL = [DR7, DR6, DR5, DR4];

const surface = (over: Partial<TurnSurface>): TurnSurface => ({
  turn: 't1', prompt: 'p', baseline: null, source: 'turn', files: [], created: [], symbols: [], delta: { calls: [], imports: [], writes: [] }, plan: [], violations: [], ...over,
});

describe('relevantDecisions (pre-filter)', () => {
  it('a new filings tool calling complete(): the DR-1 decision (via the gateway) and the tools-side DR-3 decision, with reasons', () => {
    const s = surface({

      delta: { calls: [{ from: 'src/tools/filings-digest.ts#filingsDigest.run', to: 'src/gateway/complete.ts#complete' }], imports: [{ from: 'src/tools/filings-digest.ts', to: 'src/gateway/complete.ts' }], writes: [] },

describe('finding signatures and dismissal memory', () => {
  const f: RawFinding = { decision: 'DR-4', files: ['src/tools/filings-digest.ts'], lines: [{ path: 'src/tools/filings-digest.ts', line: 7 }], text: 'DR-4 says filings use redaction: "filings"; line 7 calls complete() without it.', confidence: 'high' };

  it('ignores line numbers, case, punctuation and file order', () => {
    expect(normalizeFindingText('Line 7 calls COMPLETE() — src/a.ts:12 without it!')).toBe('calls complete src a ts without it');
    expect(findingSignature(f)).toBe(findingSignature({ ...f, text: 'DR-4 says filings use redaction "filings". Line 31 calls complete() without it' }));
    expect(findingSignature(f)).not.toBe(findingSignature({ ...f, decision: 'DR-5' }));
    expect(findingSignature({ ...f, files: ['b', 'a'] })).toBe(findingSignature({ ...f, files: ['a', 'b', 'a'] }));
  });

  it('a dismissed finding stays dismissed, including close rephrasings for the same decision and files', () => {
    const d: DismissedFinding[] = [{ signature: findingSignature(f), decision: f.decision, files: f.files, text: f.text }];
    expect(isDismissed(f, d)).toBe(true);
    expect(isDismissed({ ...f, text: 'DR-4 says filings use redaction "filings"; this new line calls complete() without it.' }, d)).toBe(true);
    expect(isDismissed({ ...f, text: 'The digest caches figures in memory, against DR-4.' }, d)).toBe(false);
    expect(isDismissed({ ...f, files: ['src/tools/other.ts'] }, d)).toBe(false);
  });

  it('acceptFindings keeps only cited, changed-file, new findings and cleans them up', () => {
    const raw: RawFinding[] = [
      f,
      { ...f, decision: 'DR-9' }, // not sent
      { ...f, decision: null }, // no decision
      { ...f, files: ['src/untouched.ts'], lines: [{ path: 'src/untouched.ts', line: 1 }] }, // not a changed file
      { ...f, text: '  ' },
      { ...f, text: f.text.replace('7', '8') }, // duplicate of the first (line numbers don't count)
      { decision: 'DR-4', files: [], lines: [{ path: './src/tools/filings-digest.ts', line: 3.7 }, { path: 'src/other.ts', line: 2 }, { path: 'src/tools/filings-digest.ts', line: -1 }], text: 'Second finding on the cache.', confidence: 'certain' as never },
    ];
    const out = acceptFindings(raw, { decisions: ['DR-4'], files: ['src/tools/filings-digest.ts'], dismissed: [], open: [] });
    expect(out).toEqual([
      f,
      { decision: 'DR-4', files: ['src/tools/filings-digest.ts'], lines: [{ path: 'src/tools/filings-digest.ts', line: 3 }], text: 'Second finding on the cache.', confidence: 'low' },
    ]);
    expect(acceptFindings([f], { decisions: ['DR-4'], files: f.files, dismissed: [], open: [f] })).toEqual([]); // already open
    expect(acceptFindings([f], { decisions: ['DR-4'], files: f.files, dismissed: [{ signature: findingSignature(f), decision: 'DR-4', files: f.files, text: f.text }], open: [] })).toEqual([]);
    expect(nextFindingId(['AF-2', 'AF-10', 'MP-40'])).toBe('AF-11');
    expect(nextFindingId([])).toBe('AF-1');
  });
});

  const events: HarnessEvent[] = [
    ev('map_confirmed', { map, source: 'fixture' }),

    ev('edited', { added: 3, removed: 0, created: false, symbols: { ...emptySymbolDiff(), body: ['src/tools/company-profile.ts#companyProfile.run'] } }, { turn: 't1', path: 'src/tools/company-profile.ts' }),
    ev('facts_changed', { facts: after }, { turn: 't1', path: 'src/tools/company-profile.ts' }),

    expect(rule).toBe('Model providers are only called through the model gateway; DR-4: Filings go through the gateway with redaction: "filings"');
```

```text
export function turnLedger(s: UIState, turn: TurnState): TurnLedger {
  const findings = turnFindings(s, turn);
  const review = new Set(findings.filter((f) => f.severity <= 3).map((f) => (f.cell ? cellKey(f.cell) : `file:${f.files[0]}`)));
  // A fork counts once per distinct plan violation it resolved, if it was answered before any edit in the turn.
  let forks = 0;
  for (const f of turn.forks) {
    if (f.answered === null || !f.beforeCode) continue;
    forks += new Set(f.violations.map(vkey).filter((k) => turn.violationsSeen.some((x) => x.source === 'plan' && vkey(x.v) === k))).size;
  }
  const rejected = new Set(turn.violationsSeen.filter((x) => x.v.decision).map((x) => vkey(x.v))).size;
  return {
    turn: turn.id,
    linesChanged: turn.numstat ? turn.numstat.added + turn.numstat.removed : null,
    cellsToReview: review.size,
    forksCaughtBeforeCode: forks,
    rejectedOptionsBlocked: rejected,
    findings,
  };
}

export function ledger(s: UIState): Ledger {
  const turns = s.turns.map((t) => turnLedger(s, t));
  const sum = (f: (t: TurnLedger) => number) => turns.reduce((a, t) => a + f(t), 0);
  return {
    turns,
    session: {
      linesChanged: sum((t) => t.linesChanged ?? 0),
      cellsToReview: sum((t) => t.cellsToReview),
      forksCaughtBeforeCode: sum((t) => t.forksCaughtBeforeCode),
      rejectedOptionsBlocked: sum((t) => t.rejectedOptionsBlocked),
    },
  };
}
export type ToolContext = { company: string };
export type Tool = { name: string; tags: string[]; run(input: string, ctx: ToolContext): Promise<string> };
import { logCall } from "../_calllog";
export function call(input: string): string {
  logCall("sec-edgar", "call", input);
  return input;
}
```

```typescript
// Read-only graph queries for the agent (NAVIGATION_PLAN §3.4): `graph_neighbors`, `trace`, `symbols_in`. They answer
// from the same ContextGraph the user sees (Tier 1 + current Tier 2), deterministically and without a model call.
import { MAX_TRACE_PATHS, fileOf, trace, type ContextGraph, type DomainMap, type EdgeKind, type FileFacts, type GraphEdge } from '@harness/core';

export const MAX_LINES = 80;

type Index = { out: Map<string, GraphEdge[]>; in: Map<string, GraphEdge[]> };
const indexes = new WeakMap<ContextGraph, Index>();
function indexOf(g: ContextGraph): Index {
  let ix = indexes.get(g);
  if (ix) return ix;
  ix = { out: new Map(), in: new Map() };
  for (const e of g.edges) {
    (ix.out.get(e.from) ?? ix.out.set(e.from, []).get(e.from)!).push(e);
    (ix.in.get(e.to) ?? ix.in.set(e.to, []).get(e.to)!).push(e);
  }
  indexes.set(g, ix);
  return ix;
}

/** The node itself and everything under it. */
function subtree(g: ContextGraph, id: string): string[] {
  const out: string[] = [];
  const walk = (n: string) => { out.push(n); for (const c of g.children[n] ?? []) walk(c); };
  walk(id);
  return out;
}

/** The container that places a node on the map: its cell, or Shared / Unassigned / Vendors / a domain's tests. */
function placeOf(g: ContextGraph, id: string): string | null {
  for (let n: string | null = id; n; n = g.nodes[n]?.parent ?? null) {
    const k = g.nodes[n]?.kind;
    if (k === 'cell' || k === 'neutral' || k === 'unassigned' || k === 'tests' || (k === 'group' && g.nodes[n]!.parent === g.root)) return n;
  }
  return null;
}

function placeLabel(g: ContextGraph, map: DomainMap, id: string): string {
  const p = placeOf(g, id);
  const n = p ? g.nodes[p] : null;
  if (!n) return '';
  if (n.kind === 'cell' || n.kind === 'tests') {
    const d = map.domains.find((x) => x.id === n.domain)?.name ?? n.domain;
    return `${d} · ${n.label}`;
  }
  return n.label;
}

const describe = (e: GraphEdge) => {
  const bits: string[] = [];
  if (e.confidence) bits.push(e.confidence);
  if (e.typeOnly) bits.push('type-only');
  if (e.count > 1) bits.push(`×${e.count}`);
  return bits.length ? `${e.kind} (${bits.join(' ')})` : e.kind;
};

/**
 * A node id for user/agent input: an exact id, a repo path (`./x`, trailing `/`), `METHOD /path` for routes, a
 * package name for vendors, or a symbol name (`newsSummarize.run`, `#runAgent`) when it is unique.
 */
export function findNode(g: ContextGraph, input: string, rel: (p: string) => string | null = (p) => p): { id: string } | { error: string } {
  const raw = input.trim();
  const tries = [raw, raw.replace(/^\.\//, '').replace(/\/$/, ''), rel(raw) ?? '', `route:${raw}`, `vendor:${raw}`, `table:${raw}`];
  for (const t of tries) if (t && g.nodes[t]) return { id: t };
  const hash = raw.indexOf('#');
  if (hash > 0) {
    const file = rel(raw.slice(0, hash)) ?? raw.slice(0, hash);
    if (g.nodes[`${file}#${raw.slice(hash + 1)}`]) return { id: `${file}#${raw.slice(hash + 1)}` };
  }
  const name = raw.replace(/^#/, '');
  const hits = Object.keys(g.nodes).filter((id) => g.nodes[id]!.kind === 'symbol' && (id.endsWith(`#${name}`) || id.endsWith(`.${name}`)));
  if (hits.length === 1) return { id: hits[0]! };
  if (hits.length > 1) return { error: `"${input}" matches ${hits.length} symbols: ${hits.slice(0, 8).join(', ')}${hits.length > 8 ? ', …' : ''}. Use a full id (path#name).` };
  // A directory: its group node, if the map has one.
  const dir = raw.replace(/^\.\//, '').replace(/\/$/, '');
  const group = Object.keys(g.nodes).find((id) => g.nodes[id]!.kind === 'group' && g.nodes[id]!.path === dir);
  if (group) return { id: group };
  return { error: `No node "${input}". Use a repo path, path#symbol, a route like "POST /api/runs", vendor:<pkg>, domain:<id> or cell:<domain>/<layer>.` };
}

/** Leaf edges around a node (and everything under it), up to `hops` away, optionally only some edge kinds. */
export function neighborsText(g: ContextGraph, map: DomainMap, id: string, kinds?: readonly EdgeKind[], hops = 1): string {
  const ix = indexOf(g);
  const start = new Set(subtree(g, id));
  const ok = (e: GraphEdge) => !kinds?.length || kinds.includes(e.kind);
  const lines: string[] = [];
  const label = (n: string) => `${n}${placeLabel(g, map, n) ? `  [${placeLabel(g, map, n)}]` : ''}`;
  const out: string[] = [];
  const inc: string[] = [];
  for (const n of start) {
    for (const e of ix.out.get(n) ?? []) if (ok(e) && !start.has(e.to)) out.push(`  → ${describe(e)}  ${label(e.to)}${n === id ? '' : `  (from ${n})`}`);
    for (const e of ix.in.get(n) ?? []) if (ok(e) && !start.has(e.from)) inc.push(`  ← ${describe(e)}  ${label(e.from)}${n === id ? '' : `  (to ${n})`}`);
  }
  lines.push(`${label(id)}`);
  lines.push(`Outgoing (${out.length}):`, ...out.sort(), `Incoming (${inc.length}):`, ...inc.sort());

  if (hops > 1) {
    const seen = new Set(start);
    let frontier = [...start];
    for (let h = 1; h <= Math.min(hops, 3); h++) {
      const next: string[] = [];
      for (const n of frontier) {
        for (const e of [...(ix.out.get(n) ?? []), ...(ix.in.get(n) ?? [])]) {
          if (!ok(e)) continue;
          const other = e.from === n ? e.to : e.from;
          if (seen.has(other)) continue;
          seen.add(other);
          next.push(other);
        }
      }
      if (h > 1 && next.length) lines.push(`${h} hops (${next.length}):`, ...next.sort().map((n) => `  ${label(n)}`));
      frontier = next;
    }
  }
  return cap(lines);
}

const cap = (lines: string[]) => (lines.length > MAX_LINES ? [...lines.slice(0, MAX_LINES), `… ${lines.length - MAX_LINES} more lines`] : lines).join('\n');

/** Sinks for `to`: a node and everything under it, or every node under a path prefix (`vendor/llm-openai`). */
export function sinksFor(g: ContextGraph, to: string, rel: (p: string) => string | null = (p) => p): string[] | { error: string } {
  const prefix = (rel(to) ?? to).replace(/^\.\//, '').replace(/\/$/, '');
  const under = Object.keys(g.nodes).filter((id) => {
    const f = fileOf(id);
    return f !== null && (f === prefix || f.startsWith(`${prefix}/`));
  });
  if (under.length) return under;
  const hit = findNode(g, to, rel);
  return 'error' in hit ? hit : subtree(g, hit.id);
}

/**
 * Shortest call chains from `from` (a symbol, route or file: a file traces from each of its symbols and routes) to
 * `to` (default: vendors, tables and anything in an `external` cell). Consecutive hops inside one cell are collapsed;
 * a hop from an interface member to an implementation is labelled "via registry".
 */
export function traceText(g: ContextGraph, map: DomainMap, from: string, sinks?: readonly string[], coverage?: { typed: number; files: number }): string {
  const starts = g.nodes[from]?.kind === 'file' ? subtree(g, from).filter((n) => n === from || ['symbol', 'route', 'entry'].includes(g.nodes[n]!.kind)) : [from];
  const best = new Map<string, string[]>();
  for (const s of starts) {
    for (const p of trace(g, s, sinks)) {
      const sink = p[p.length - 1]!;
      const cur = best.get(sink);
      if (!cur || p.length < cur.length) best.set(sink, p);
    }
  }
  const paths = [...best.values()].sort((a, b) => a.length - b.length || (a.at(-1)! < b.at(-1)! ? -1 : 1)).slice(0, MAX_TRACE_PATHS);
  const tier = coverage ? (coverage.typed ? `typed calls for ${coverage.typed}/${coverage.files} files` : 'syntactic calls only (typed calls not ready yet)') : '';
  const note = `Follows calls, route handlers and interface dispatch${tier ? ` (${tier})` : ''}. Dispatch the checker can't see (dynamic keys, DI) is missing, so a trace is never complete.`;
  if (!paths.length) return `No call chain from ${from}${sinks ? ' to the given target' : ' to a vendor, table or external cell'}.\n${note}`;
  return [`${paths.length} chain(s) from ${from}:`, ...paths.flatMap((p, i) => renderChain(g, map, p, i + 1)), '', note].join('\n');
}

type Hop = 'calls' | 'handles' | 'writes' | 'dispatch';
function hopKind(g: ContextGraph, a: string, b: string): { kind: Hop; edge?: GraphEdge } {
  const ix = indexOf(g);
  const fwd = (ix.out.get(a) ?? []).find((e) => e.to === b && (e.kind === 'calls' || e.kind === 'handles' || e.kind === 'writes'));
  if (fwd) return { kind: fwd.kind as Hop, edge: fwd };
  return { kind: 'dispatch' }; // implements walked backwards: interface member → implementation
}

export function renderChain(g: ContextGraph, map: DomainMap, path: readonly string[], n: number): string[] {
  type Group = { nodes: string[]; via: Hop | null; edge?: GraphEdge };
  const groups: Group[] = [];
  path.forEach((id, i) => {
    const h = i ? hopKind(g, path[i - 1]!, id) : null;
    const last = groups[groups.length - 1];
    if (last && h?.kind !== 'dispatch' && placeOf(g, last.nodes[0]!) === placeOf(g, id)) last.nodes.push(id);
    else groups.push({ nodes: [id], via: h?.kind ?? null, edge: h?.edge });
  });
  return groups.map((grp, i) => {
    const where = placeLabel(g, map, grp.nodes[0]!);
    const body = grp.nodes.length === 1 ? grp.nodes[0]! : `${grp.nodes[0]} → … → ${grp.nodes[grp.nodes.length - 1]}`;
    const inCell = grp.nodes.length > 1 ? ` · ${grp.nodes.length - 1} hop(s) in cell` : '';
    const how = grp.via === 'dispatch' ? '⇢ via registry → ' : '→ ';
    const conf = grp.edge?.confidence && grp.edge.confidence !== 'typed' ? ` (${grp.edge.confidence})` : '';
    return i === 0 ? `${n}. ${body}  [${where}${inCell}]` : `   ${how}${body}  [${where}${inCell}]${conf}`;
  });
}

/** Symbols, routes and entries of a file (with line numbers), or the files under a directory with their symbol counts. */
export function symbolsText(g: ContextGraph, map: DomainMap, facts: ReadonlyMap<string, FileFacts>, path: string, text: (p: string) => string | null): string {
  const p = path.replace(/^\.\//, '').replace(/\/$/, '');
  const f = facts.get(p);
  if (!f) {
    const files = [...facts.keys()].filter((x) => x.startsWith(`${p}/`)).sort();
    if (!files.length) return `No code file or directory "${path}" with facts.`;
    return cap([`${p}/ · ${files.length} file(s):`, ...files.map((x) => `  ${x}  ${facts.get(x)!.symbols.length} symbols  [${placeLabel(g, map, x)}]`)]);
  }
  const src = text(p);
  const lineOf = (at: number) => (src ? src.slice(0, at).split('\n').length : 0);
  const ix = indexOf(g);
  const depth = (s: { parent: string | null }) => { let d = 0; for (let q = s.parent; q; q = f.symbols.find((x) => x.id === q)?.parent ?? null) d++; return d; };
  const lines = [`${p}  [${placeLabel(g, map, p)}] · ${f.symbols.length} symbols`];
  for (const s of f.symbols) {
    const out = (ix.out.get(s.id) ?? []).filter((e) => e.kind === 'calls');
    const impl = (ix.out.get(s.id) ?? []).filter((e) => e.kind === 'implements').map((e) => e.to);
    const calls = out.length ? ` · calls ${out.length}` : '';
    lines.push(`${'  '.repeat(depth(s) + 1)}${s.kind} ${s.name}${s.exported ? ' (exported)' : ''} :${lineOf(s.span.start)}${calls}${impl.length ? ` · implements ${impl.join(', ')}` : ''}`);
  }
  for (const r of f.routes) lines.push(`  route ${r.method} ${r.path}${r.handler ? ` → ${r.handler}` : ''}`);
  for (const e of f.entries) lines.push(`  entry ${e.kind}: ${e.label}`);
  return cap(lines);
}
```

```text
- get_entity : Get a single entity by its URN (e.g. urn:alike:task:abc123) — and, with `include`, the richest single view of it in the Alike world model. Bare call r
- get_briefing : Call this at the START of a session and whenever the user asks how their day looks, what's going on, what they're working on, or whether anything need
- record_decision : Record a decision the user (or the session) just made, so it is remembered and served to future sessions on the same work. Call when something gets DE
- resolve_work_item : Resolve what the user is working on to a SINGLE canonical task, creating one only if none exists — so multiple agents on the same work converge on ONE
```
