```text
type Store = {
  events: HarnessEvent[];
  /** null = live; otherwise the number of events to reduce (replay). */
  replay: number | null;
  /** Streaming assistant text not yet committed as a `chat` event. */
  delta: string;
  busy: boolean;
  conn: Conn;
  repo: string;
  draft: string;
  focusTick: number;
  selection: Selection | null;
  /** null = latest turn. */
  turn: string | null;
  hover: string | null;

  hello(events: HarnessEvent[], busy: boolean): void;
  append(e: HarnessEvent): void;
  addDelta(text: string): void;
  setBusy(b: boolean): void;
  setConn(c: Conn): void;
  setRepo(r: string): void;
  setDraft(d: string, focus?: boolean): void;
  select(s: Selection | null): void;
  setTurn(id: string | null): void;
  setReplay(i: number | null): void;
  setHover(h: string | null): void;
};

export const useStore = create<Store>((set) => ({
  events: [],
  replay: null,
  delta: '',
  busy: false,
  conn: 'connecting',
  repo: '',
  draft: '',
  focusTick: 0,
  selection: null,
  turn: null,
  hover: null,

  hello: (events, busy) => set({ events, busy, delta: '' }),
  append: (e) =>
    set((s) => {
      if (s.events.length && s.events[s.events.length - 1]!.id === e.id) return s;
      const clear = e.kind === 'chat' && (e.data as { role?: string } | undefined)?.role === 'assistant';
      return { events: [...s.events, e], ...(clear ? { delta: '' } : {}) };
    }),
  addDelta: (text) => set((s) => ({ delta: s.delta + text })),
  setBusy: (busy) => set(busy ? { busy } : { busy, delta: '' }),
  setConn: (conn) => set({ conn }),
  setRepo: (repo) => set({ repo }),
  setDraft: (draft, focus) => set((s) => ({ draft, focusTick: focus ? s.focusTick + 1 : s.focusTick })),
  select: (selection) => set({ selection }),
  setTurn: (turn) => set({ turn }),
  setReplay: (replay) => set({ replay }),
  setHover: (hover) => set({ hover }),
}));
import type { HarnessEvent } from '@harness/core/view';
import { useStore } from './store';

type ServerMsg =
  | { type: 'hello'; events: HarnessEvent[]; busy: boolean; session: string }
  | { type: 'event'; event: HarnessEvent }
  | { type: 'delta'; text: string }
  | { type: 'busy'; busy: boolean };

const params = new URLSearchParams(location.search);
/** Dev-only: `?fake=1` loads /fake-events.json at once, `?fake=play` streams it; `&at=N` opens the replay at N. */
export const fakeMode = params.get('fake');

export function connect() {
  if (fakeMode) return loadFake(fakeMode === 'play', fakeMode);
  void fetch('/api/info')
    .then((r) => r.json() as Promise<{ repo: string }>)
    .then((i) => useStore.getState().setRepo(i.repo))
    .catch(() => {});
  openSocket(500);
}

function openSocket(delay: number) {
  const ws = new WebSocket(`${location.protocol === 'https:' ? 'wss' : 'ws'}://${location.host}/ws`);
  let opened = false;
  ws.onopen = () => {
    opened = true;
    useStore.getState().setConn('open');
  };
  ws.onmessage = (m) => {
    const msg = JSON.parse(String(m.data)) as ServerMsg;
    const s = useStore.getState();
    if (msg.type === 'hello') s.hello(msg.events, msg.busy);
    else if (msg.type === 'event') s.append(msg.event);
    else if (msg.type === 'delta') s.addDelta(msg.text);
    else if (msg.type === 'busy') s.setBusy(msg.busy);
  };
  ws.onclose = () => {
    useStore.getState().setConn('down');
    const next = opened ? 500 : Math.min(delay * 2, 8000);
    setTimeout(() => openSocket(next), opened ? 500 : delay);
  };
}

async function loadFake(play: boolean, fakeMode: string) {
  const st = useStore.getState();
  st.setConn('fake');
  st.setRepo('scout-agent (fake turn)');
  const file = fakeMode === '1' || fakeMode === 'play' ? 'fake' : fakeMode; // `?fake=comp` → /comp-events.json
  const events = (await (await fetch(`/${file}-events.json`)).json()) as HarnessEvent[];
  const at = params.get('at');
  if (!play) {
    st.hello(events, false);
    if (at !== null) st.setReplay(Math.max(0, Math.min(events.length, Number(at))));
    return;
  }
  st.hello([], false);
  for (let i = 0; i < events.length; i++) {
    const e = events[i]!;
    const prev = events[i - 1];
    const gap = prev ? Math.max(20, Math.min(900, (e.t - prev.t) / 3)) : 0;
    await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, e.kind === 'file_assigned' ? 15 : gap));
    useStore.getState().append(e);
  }
}

async function post(path: string, body?: unknown) {
  if (fakeMode) return;
  await fetch(path, { method: 'POST', headers: { 'content-type': 'application/json' }, body: JSON.stringify(body ?? {}) });
}

  chat: (text: string) => post('/api/chat', { text }),

  interrupt: () => post('/api/interrupt'),
  confirmMap: () => post('/api/map/confirm'),
  fallbackMap: () => post('/api/map/fallback'),

    return r.ok ? r.text() : null;
  },
};
import { useEffect, useRef, useState } from 'react';

export const reducedMotion = () => typeof matchMedia !== 'undefined' && matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)').matches;

/** Counts up (or down) to `value` over ~400 ms whenever it changes. */
export function useTween(value: number, ms = 400): number {
  const [shown, setShown] = useState(value);
  const from = useRef(value);
  useEffect(() => {
    if (reducedMotion() || from.current === value) {
      from.current = value;
      setShown(value);
      return;
    }
    const start = performance.now();
    const a = from.current;
    let raf = 0;
    const step = (now: number) => {
      const k = Math.min(1, (now - start) / ms);
      const eased = 1 - (1 - k) ** 3;
      setShown(Math.round(a + (value - a) * eased));
      if (k < 1) raf = requestAnimationFrame(step);
      else from.current = value;
    };
    raf = requestAnimationFrame(step);
    return () => {
      cancelAnimationFrame(raf);
      from.current = value;
    };
  }, [value, ms]);
  return shown;
}

/** True for a moment after `key` changes (not on mount). */
export function useFlash(key: unknown, ms = 650): boolean {
  const [on, setOn] = useState(false);
  const first = useRef(true);
  useEffect(() => {
    if (first.current) {
      first.current = false;
      return;
    }
    setOn(true);
    const t = setTimeout(() => setOn(false), ms);
    return () => clearTimeout(t);
  }, [key, ms]);
  return on;
}

export function useSize<T extends HTMLElement>() {
  const ref = useRef<T>(null);
  const [size, setSize] = useState({ w: 0, h: 0 });
  useEffect(() => {
    const el = ref.current;
    if (!el) return;
    const ro = new ResizeObserver(([e]) => {
      if (e) setSize({ w: e.contentRect.width, h: e.contentRect.height });
    });
    ro.observe(el);
    return () => ro.disconnect();
  }, []);
  return [ref, size] as const;
}
```

```text
// The v2 map (N3/N4): the real pipeline (reduce → graphOf → activityFor → project), per-container ELK in a worker,
// the deterministic grid, one SVG layer of precomputed edges, staged FLIP transitions and a van Wijk camera, on a
// React Flow viewport with memoized DOM nodes. Navigation: expand in place, breadcrumbs, history, ⌘K, arrows, minimap.
import { memo, useCallback, useEffect, useLayoutEffect, useMemo, useRef, useState } from 'react';
import { flushSync } from 'react-dom';
import { Background, BackgroundVariant, MiniMap, ReactFlow, ReactFlowProvider, ViewportPortal, useReactFlow, useStore as useFlow, useStoreApi, type Node, type Viewport } from '@xyflow/react';
import '@xyflow/react/dist/base.css';
import '@fontsource/barlow/300.css';
import '@fontsource/barlow/400-italic.css';
import '@fontsource/barlow/700.css';
import '@fontsource/jetbrains-mono/600.css';
import './v2.css';
import { fileOf, type Rollup } from '@harness/core/view';
import { useView } from '../derive';
import { useStore } from '../store';
import { buildFrame, GAP_X, layoutAll, strokeFor, union, UNASSIGNED, UNASSIGNED_COL, type Frame, type FrameEdge, type FrameNode } from './layout/frame';
import { clearLayoutCache, layoutContainer, warmElk } from './layout/elk';
import type { Box } from './layout/containers';
import { dive, neighbour, up, type Dir } from './nav';
import { NavBar } from './NavBar';
import { nodeTypes, useLod } from './nodes';
import { Palette } from './Palette';
import { hotLabels, useScene, type Scene } from './pipeline';
import { selectedEdge, selectedNode, selectionFor } from './select';
import { useV2 } from './store';
import { Transitioner, reducedMotion, T_MOVE, type Enter, type TransitionStats } from './transition';

const params = new URLSearchParams(location.search);
export const COMP = params.has('comp');

export type Insets = { top: number; right: number; bottom: number; left: number };
const DEFAULT_INSETS: Insets = { top: 116, right: 28, bottom: 24, left: 96 };

type Shown = { frame: Frame; enter: Enter };
type Stats = { layoutMs: number; pipelineMs: number; elk: { id: string; files: number; ms: number }[]; transition: TransitionStats | null };

export default function MapV2({ insets = DEFAULT_INSETS, chrome = true }: { insets?: Insets; chrome?: boolean }) {
  return (
    <ReactFlowProvider>
      <Inner insets={insets} chrome={chrome} />
    </ReactFlowProvider>
  );
}

/**
 * Fit a box, but never below `minZoom` (projector legibility: 16 px file labels stay at 13 px or more). When the box
 * does not fit at that zoom, centre on `anchor` (the agent, or the target) and keep the box's top-left in view.
 */
function viewportFor(b: Box, W: number, H: number, ins: Insets, opts: { maxZoom?: number; minZoom?: number; anchor?: Box } = {}): Viewport {
  const aw = Math.max(50, W - ins.left - ins.right);
  const ah = Math.max(50, H - ins.top - ins.bottom);
  const fit = Math.min(opts.maxZoom ?? 1.25, aw / b.w, ah / b.h);
  const zoom = Math.max(0.08, opts.minZoom ? Math.max(fit, opts.minZoom) : fit);
  if (zoom === fit || !opts.minZoom) return { zoom, x: ins.left + (aw - b.w * zoom) / 2 - b.x * zoom, y: ins.top + (ah - b.h * zoom) / 2 - b.y * zoom };
  const a = opts.anchor ?? b;
  const axis = (start: number, size: number, aStart: number, aSize: number, avail: number, inset: number) => {
    if (size * zoom <= avail) return inset + (avail - size * zoom) / 2 - start * zoom;
    const centred = inset + avail / 2 - (aStart + aSize / 2) * zoom;
    return Math.min(inset - start * zoom, Math.max(inset + avail - (start + size) * zoom, centred));
  };
  return { zoom, x: axis(b.x, b.w, a.x, a.w, aw, ins.left), y: axis(b.y, b.h, a.y, a.h, ah, ins.top) };
}

/** Zoom floor for views below System level (16 px file labels at 0.82 are about 13 px). */
const READABLE = 0.82;

/** Roots of the focus region: the selected node, else what is open, else everything (null). */
function regionOf(scene: Scene, sel: string | null): string[] | null {
  const ids = new Set(scene.projection.nodes.map((n) => n.id));
  if (sel && ids.has(sel)) return [sel];
  const open = scene.open.filter((id) => ids.has(id));
  if (open.length) return open;
  // A plan that declines an approach (beat 4): the struck-through edge leads; quiet edges recede to trunks.
  return scene.projection.edges.some((e) => e.decision) ? [] : null;
}

function Inner({ insets, chrome }: { insets: Insets; chrome: boolean }) {
  const scene = useScene();
  const v = useView();
  const rf = useReactFlow();
  const rootRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
  const [shown, setShown] = useState<Shown | null>(null);
  const stats = useRef<Stats>({ layoutMs: 0, pipelineMs: 0, elk: [], transition: null });
  const insetsRef = useRef(insets);
  insetsRef.current = insets;
  const sel = useStore((s) => selectedNode(s.selection));
  const sceneRef = useSceneRef;
  sceneRef.current = scene;

  const flyTo = useCallback((b: Box, animate: boolean, opts?: Parameters<typeof viewportFor>[4]) => {
    const el = rootRef.current;
    if (!el) return;
    const { width: W, height: H } = el.getBoundingClientRect();
    if (!W || !H) return;
    const ins = insetsRef.current;
    const inspector = useStore.getState().selection ? 400 : 0; // the inspector panel covers the right of the stage
    void rf.setViewport(viewportFor(b, W, H, { ...ins, right: ins.right + inspector }, opts), { duration: animate && !reducedMotion() ? T_MOVE + 150 : 0, interpolate: "smooth" });
  }, [rf]);

  const camera = useCallback((next: Frame, prev: Frame | null, animate: boolean) => {
    const fly = useV2.getState().fly;
    const target = fly ? next.boxes[fly] : undefined;
    if (target) {
      useV2.setState({ fly: null });
      flyTo(pad(next.focus ? union(next.focus, target) : target, 30), animate, { minZoom: READABLE, anchor: pad(target, 40) });
      return;
    }
    if (prev && prev.key === next.key) return; // the camera moves when the view changes, not on every event
    if (!next.focus) return flyTo(next.bounds, animate);
    const c = useV2.getState().cursor;
    const at = c ? next.boxes[c.node] : undefined;
    const inFocus = !!at && at.x >= next.focus.x && at.x <= next.focus.x + next.focus.w;
    flyTo(pad(next.focus, 30), animate, { minZoom: READABLE, anchor: inFocus && at ? pad(at, 60) : { ...next.focus, h: 1 } });
  }, [flyTo]);

  const tr = useMemo(() => new Transitioner({
    root: () => rootRef.current,
    commit: (frame, enter) => flushSync(() => {
      const s = sceneRef.current;
      if (s) publish(s);
      setShown({ frame, enter });
    }),
    camera,
  }), [camera]);

  // Lay out every expanded container (worker, cached, bottom-up), then hand the frame to the transitioner.
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!scene || !v.ui.map) return;
    let live = true;
    const map = v.ui.map;
    const t0 = performance.now();
    void layoutAll(scene.projection, layoutContainer).then((layouts) => {
      if (!live) return;
      stats.current.layoutMs = performance.now() - t0;
      stats.current.elk = [...layouts.values()].map((l) => ({ id: l.id, files: Object.keys(l.nodes).length, ms: +l.ms.toFixed(1) }));
      const meta = { domains: map.domains.map((d) => ({ id: d.id, name: d.name, purpose: d.purpose })), layers: map.layers.map((l) => ({ id: l.id, name: l.name })) };
      tr.go(buildFrame({ projection: scene.projection, meta, layouts, region: regionOf(scene, sel), key: scene.key }));
    });
    return () => { live = false; };
  }, [scene, sel, tr, v.ui.map]);

  // A fly request for a node already on screen (history, breadcrumbs to the same layout).
  const fly = useV2((s) => s.fly);
  useEffect(() => {
    const f = tr.shown;
    if (!fly || !f?.boxes[fly] || f.key !== sceneRef.current?.key) return;
    useV2.setState({ fly: null });
    flyTo(pad(f.focus ? union(f.focus, f.boxes[fly]!) : f.boxes[fly]!, 30), true, { minZoom: READABLE, anchor: pad(f.boxes[fly]!, 40) });
  }, [fly, tr, flyTo, shown]);

  useEffect(() => () => tr.cancel(), [tr]);
  useEffect(() => { void warmElk(); }, []);
  useKeys(tr, rootRef);
  useBenchApi(tr, stats, rf);

  const rfNodes = useMemo<Node[]>(() => {
    if (!shown) return [];
    const { frame, enter } = shown;
    return frame.nodes.map((n) => ({
      id: n.id,
      type: n.type,
      position: { x: n.x, y: n.y },
      data: {},
      width: n.w,
      height: n.h,
      style: { width: n.w, height: n.h },
      zIndex: n.z,
      draggable: false,
      selectable: false,
      connectable: false,
      focusable: n.type !== 'band',
      ariaLabel: ariaFor(n),
      className: enter.nodes.has(n.id) ? 'v2-enter' : undefined,
    }));
  }, [shown]);

  const select = useStore((s) => s.select);
  const onNodeClick = useCallback((ev: React.MouseEvent, node: Node) => {
    ev.stopPropagation();
    const n = useV2.getState().nodes[node.id];
    if (!n) return;
    useV2.getState().setFocus(node.id);
    const cur = useStore.getState().selection;
    select(selectedNode(cur) === node.id ? null : selectionFor(n));
  }, [select]);
  const onNodeDoubleClick = useCallback((_: unknown, node: Node) => {
    const s = sceneRef.current;
    if (!s) return;
    const st = useV2.getState();
    const id = node.id.startsWith('band:') ? UNASSIGNED : node.id;
    st.go(dive(s.graph, { open: st.open, focus: st.focus }, id));
  }, []);

  const theme = useV2((s) => s.theme);
  const minimap = useV2((s) => s.minimap);
  const open = useV2((s) => s.open);
  return (
    <div ref={rootRef} className={`v2-map theme-${theme}`} data-theme={theme}>
      <ReactFlow
        nodes={rfNodes}
        edges={[]}
        nodeTypes={nodeTypes}
        nodesDraggable={false}
        nodesConnectable={false}
        elementsSelectable={false}
        zoomOnDoubleClick={false}
        onNodeDoubleClick={onNodeDoubleClick}
        onNodeClick={onNodeClick}
        onPaneClick={() => select(null)}
        minZoom={0.08}
        maxZoom={2.5}
        proOptions={{ hideAttribution: COMP }}
        onlyRenderVisibleElements={params.get('visible') === '1'}
      >
        {theme === 'control' && <Background variant={BackgroundVariant.Dots} gap={28} size={1.3} color="var(--v2-dots)" />}
        {shown && (
          <ViewportPortal>
            <EdgeLayer frame={shown.frame} enter={shown.enter} />
            <RejectedTop frame={shown.frame} />
            <Cursor frame={shown.frame} />
          </ViewportPortal>
        )}
        {chrome && minimap && open.length > 0 && (
          <MiniMap
            className="v2-minimap"
            style={{ width: 168, height: 108 }}
            pannable
            zoomable
            ariaLabel="Minimap"
            nodeColor={(n) => miniColor(n.id, n.type)}
            nodeStrokeWidth={0}
            maskColor="var(--v2-mini-mask)"
          />
        )}
      </ReactFlow>
      {shown && <Headers frame={shown.frame} insets={insets} />}
      {chrome && <NavBar />}
      {chrome && <Palette />}
      {!v.ui.map && <Empty />}
    </div>
  );
}

const pad = (b: Box, p: number): Box => ({ x: b.x - p, y: b.y - p, w: b.w + 2 * p, h: b.h + 2 * p });

function ariaFor(n: FrameNode): string {
  const vn = useV2.getState().nodes[n.id];
  if (!vn) return n.id;
  return `${vn.kind} ${vn.label}${vn.rollup.violation ? `, crosses ${vn.rollup.rules.join(' ')}` : ''}${vn.rollup.edited ? ', edited' : ''}`;
}

function miniColor(id: string, type: string | undefined): string {
  const n = useV2.getState().nodes[id];
  if (type === 'band') return 'var(--v2-mini-band)';
  if (!n) return 'var(--v2-mini-node)';
  const r = n.rollup;
  if (r.violation === 'new') return 'var(--v2-red)';
  if (r.cursor) return 'var(--v2-agent)';
  if (r.edited) return r.unplanned ? 'var(--v2-amber)' : 'var(--v2-agent)';
  if (r.violation) return 'var(--v2-red-wash)';
  return 'var(--v2-mini-node)';
}

/** Publish the projection by id (structural sharing) so node components re-render only for their own changes. */
function publish(s: Scene) {
  const symbols: Record<string, number> = {};
  for (const n of s.projection.nodes) {
    if (n.kind !== 'file') continue;
    const d = s.activity.leaves[n.id]?.symbols;
    const k = d ? new Set([...d.added, ...d.removed, ...d.sig, ...d.body, ...d.renamed.map((r) => r[1])]).size : 0;
    if (k) symbols[n.id] = k;
  }
  const columns: Record<string, string[]> = {};
  for (const n of s.projection.nodes) {
    const c = n.kind === 'table' ? s.graph.nodes[n.id]?.columns : undefined;
    if (c?.length) columns[n.id] = c;
  }
  useV2.getState().publish({ columns, nodes: s.projection.nodes, edges: s.projection.edges, hot: hotLabels(s.graph, s.activity, s.projection), symbols, cursor: s.projection.cursor });
}


// ---------------------------------------------------------------- keyboard: Enter dives, Esc goes up, arrows move, ⌘K, ⌘[ ⌘], m

function useKeys(tr: Transitioner, rootRef: React.RefObject<HTMLDivElement>) {
  useEffect(() => {
    const onKey = (e: KeyboardEvent) => {
      const target = e.target as HTMLElement | null;
      const typing = !!target?.closest('textarea, input, [contenteditable]');
      const st = useV2.getState();
      const meta = e.metaKey || e.ctrlKey;
      if (meta && e.key.toLowerCase() === 'k') { e.preventDefault(); st.setPalette(!st.palette); return; }
      if (typing || st.palette) return;
      if (meta && e.key === '[') { e.preventDefault(); st.goBack(); return; }
      if (meta && e.key === ']') { e.preventDefault(); st.goForward(); return; }
      if (meta || e.altKey) return;
      const scene = useSceneRef.current;
      if (!scene) return;
      const place = { open: st.open, focus: st.focus };
      if (e.key === 'Escape') {
        if (useStore.getState().selection) return; // the inspector closes first
        e.preventDefault();
        st.go(up(scene.graph, place));
      } else if (e.key === 'Enter') {
        const id = target?.closest<HTMLElement>('.react-flow__node')?.dataset.id ?? st.focus;
        if (!id) return;
        e.preventDefault();
        st.go(dive(scene.graph, place, id.startsWith('band:') ? UNASSIGNED : id));
      } else if (e.key.startsWith('Arrow')) {
        const f = tr.shown;
        if (!f) return;
        const dir = e.key.slice(5).toLowerCase() as Dir;
        const next = neighbour(f, st.focus, dir);
        if (!next) return;
        e.preventDefault();
        st.setFocus(next);
        rootRef.current?.querySelector<HTMLElement>(`.react-flow__node[data-id="${CSS.escape(next)}"]`)?.focus({ preventScroll: true });
      } else if (e.key === 'm') st.toggleMinimap();
    };
    window.addEventListener('keydown', onKey, true);
    return () => window.removeEventListener('keydown', onKey, true);
  }, [tr, rootRef]);
}

/** The latest scene for event handlers outside React's render (keyboard, palette, headers). */
export const useSceneRef: { current: Scene | null } = { current: null };

// ---------------------------------------------------------------- edges: one SVG of precomputed paths

const EdgeLayer = memo(function EdgeLayer({ frame, enter }: { frame: Frame; enter: Enter }) {
  const lod = useLod();
  const sel = useStore((s) => selectedEdge(s.selection));
  const select = useStore((s) => s.select);
  return (
    <svg className="v2-edges" width={1} height={1}>
      <defs>
        {(['existing', 'new', 'ghost', 'violation', 'rejected'] as const).map((k) => (
          <marker key={k} id={`v2-arrow-${k}`} viewBox="0 0 10 10" refX="9" refY="5" markerWidth="8" markerHeight="8" markerUnits="userSpaceOnUse" orient="auto-start-reverse">
            <path d="M0,1 L9,5 L0,9 z" className={`v2-arrowhead is-${k}`} />
          </marker>
        ))}
      </defs>
      <path className="v2-ticks" d={frame.gutters.x.flatMap((x) => frame.gutters.y.map((y) => `M${x - 6},${y}h12M${x},${y - 6}v12`)).join('')} />
      {frame.edges.map((e) => {
        if (e.decision) return <Rejected key={e.id} e={e} enter={enter} sel={sel} onSelect={() => select(sel === e.id ? null : { link: e.id })} />;
        const kind = e.violation ? 'violation' : e.status;
        const entering = enter.edges.has(e.id);
        const id = e.trunk ? e.trunk[0]! : e.id;
        return (
          <g
            key={entering ? `${e.id}#${enter.seq}` : e.id}
            data-edge={e.id}
            className={`v2-edge is-${e.status} ${e.violation ? `is-violation is-violation-${e.violation}` : ''} ${e.faint ? 'is-faint' : ''} ${e.trunk ? 'is-trunk' : ''} ${entering ? 'is-enter' : ''} ${sel === id ? 'is-selected' : ''}`}
            onClick={(ev) => { ev.stopPropagation(); select(sel === id ? null : { link: id }); }}
          >
            <title>{e.trunk ? `${e.count} imports between these columns` : `${e.count} ${e.count === 1 ? 'link' : 'links'}`}</title>
            <path className="v2-edge-hit" d={e.d} />
            <path
              className="v2-edge-line"
              d={e.d}
              style={{ strokeWidth: e.faint ? undefined : strokeFor(e.count) }}
              markerEnd={e.trunk ? undefined : `url(#v2-arrow-${kind})`}
              {...(entering && e.status !== 'ghost' ? { pathLength: 1 } : {})}
            />
            {enter.pulse.has(e.id) && !reducedMotion() && <Pulse key={enter.seq} d={e.d} />}
            {lod !== 'far' && (e.count > 1 || e.steps.length > 0) && (
              <g className="v2-edge-tag" transform={`translate(${e.mid.x.toFixed(1)},${e.mid.y.toFixed(1)})`}>
                <rect x={-13} y={-10} width={26} height={20} rx={10} />
                <text textAnchor="middle" dy="0.35em">{e.steps.length ? e.steps.join(',') : e.count}</text>
              </g>
            )}
          </g>
        );
      })}
    </svg>
  );
});

export const rejectedLabel = (d: { id: string; session: number }) => `rejected in ${d.id}${d.session ? `, session ${d.session}` : ''}`;

/**
 * Beat 4's hero: an approach a standing decision rules out. Drawn struck through in ink (not red: nothing is being
 * crossed, it is being declined), with a slash across its middle and a label that stays readable at any zoom.
 */
function Rejected({ e, enter, sel, onSelect }: { e: FrameEdge; enter: Enter; sel: string | null; onSelect: () => void }) {
  return (
    <g data-edge={e.id} className={`v2-edge is-rejected ${enter.edges.has(e.id) ? 'is-enter' : ''} ${sel === e.id ? 'is-selected' : ''}`} onClick={(ev) => { ev.stopPropagation(); onSelect(); }}>
      <title>{`${rejectedLabel(e.decision!)}: ${e.count} planned ${e.count === 1 ? 'link' : 'links'} not built`}</title>
      <path className="v2-edge-hit" d={e.d} />
      <path className="v2-edge-line" d={e.d} markerEnd="url(#v2-arrow-rejected)" />
    </g>
  );
}

/** The strike and the label of rejected edges, above the nodes and at a constant on-screen size (about 15 px). */
function RejectedTop({ frame }: { frame: Frame }) {
  const k = useFlow((s) => s.transform[2]);
  const sel = useStore((s) => selectedEdge(s.selection));
  const select = useStore((s) => s.select);
  const list = frame.edges.filter((e) => e.decision);
  if (!list.length) return null;
  const z = 1 / Math.max(k, 0.2);
  return (
    <svg className="v2-edges is-top" width={1} height={1}>
      {list.map((e) => {
        const label = rejectedLabel(e.decision!);
        const fs = 15 * z;
        const w = label.length * fs * 0.5 + 24 * z;
        const h = 28 * z;
        const s = 10 * z;
        const { x, y } = e.mid;
        return (
          <g key={e.id} className={`v2-rejected ${sel === e.id ? 'is-selected' : ''}`} onClick={(ev) => { ev.stopPropagation(); select(sel === e.id ? null : { link: e.id }); }}>
            <path className="v2-strike" d={`M${x - s},${y + s}L${x + s},${y - s}M${x - s + 7 * z},${y + s}L${x + s + 7 * z},${y - s}`} style={{ strokeWidth: 3.5 * z }} />
            <g transform={`translate(${(x - w / 2).toFixed(1)},${(y - h - 14 * z).toFixed(1)})`} className="v2-rejected-tag">
              <rect width={w} height={h} rx={h / 2} />
              <text x={w / 2} y={h / 2} dy="0.35em" textAnchor="middle" style={{ fontSize: fs }}>{label}</text>
            </g>
          </g>
        );
      })}
    </svg>
  );
}

/** One dot that travels once along an edge that was just added (never loops). */
function Pulse({ d }: { d: string }) {
  const ref = useRef<SVGCircleElement>(null);
  useEffect(() => {
    const c = ref.current;
    if (!c) return;
    const path = document.createElementNS('http://www.w3.org/2000/svg', 'path');
    path.setAttribute('d', d);
    const len = path.getTotalLength();
    const t0 = performance.now() + 320; // after the draw-in starts
    let raf = 0;
    const step = (t: number) => {
      const k = Math.max(0, Math.min(1, (t - t0) / 900));
      const p = path.getPointAtLength(len * (1 - (1 - k) ** 2));
      c.setAttribute('cx', p.x.toFixed(1));
      c.setAttribute('cy', p.y.toFixed(1));
      c.style.opacity = String(k < 0.85 ? 1 : (1 - k) / 0.15);
      if (k < 1) raf = requestAnimationFrame(step);
    };
    raf = requestAnimationFrame(step);
    return () => cancelAnimationFrame(raf);
  }, [d]);
  return <circle ref={ref} className="v2-pulse" r={5} cx={-9999} cy={-9999} />;
}

function Cursor({ frame }: { frame: Frame }) {
  const c = useV2((s) => s.cursor);
  const ui = useView().ui;
  const b = c ? frame.boxes[c.node] : undefined;
  if (!c || !b) return null;
  const path = fileOf(c.leaf) ?? ui.cursor?.path ?? c.leaf;
  const name = path.split('/').filter(Boolean).pop();
  const inBox = b.h > 60 && b.w > 120;
  return (
    <div className="v2-cursor" style={{ transform: `translate(${b.x + (inBox ? 10 : -6)}px, ${b.y + b.h - (inBox ? 12 : 0)}px)` }} aria-live="polite">
      <span className="v2-cursor-avatar" aria-hidden="true">C</span>
      <span className="v2-cursor-label">Claude · {c.verb} <code>{name}</code></span>
    </div>
  );
}

function Empty() {
  const conn = useStore((s) => s.conn);
  return (
    <div className="v2-empty">
      <p className="v2-empty-title">{conn === 'down' ? 'Waiting for the Interpretability server' : 'Reading the repo'}</p>
      <p>{conn === 'down' ? 'Start it with HARNESS_REPO=<path> npm run dev. This page reconnects on its own.' : 'The map appears once domains.yaml is loaded or proposed.'}</p>
    </div>
  );
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------- screen-space headers (crisp at any zoom)

function Headers({ frame, insets }: { frame: Frame; insets: Insets }) {
  const store = useStoreApi();
  const colRefs = useRef<(HTMLButtonElement | null)[]>([]);
  const rowRefs = useRef<(HTMLDivElement | null)[]>([]);
  const nodes = useV2((s) => s.nodes);

  useLayoutEffect(() => {
    const place = ([tx, ty, k]: [number, number, number]) => {
      frame.cols.forEach((c, i) => {
        const el = colRefs.current[i];
        if (!el) return;
        const w = c.spine ? (c.w + GAP_X) * k - 6 : c.w * k;
        el.style.transform = `translate(${(tx + (c.x + c.w / 2) * k - w / 2).toFixed(1)}px, 0)`;
        el.style.width = `${w.toFixed(1)}px`;
      });
      frame.rows.forEach((r, j) => {
        const el = rowRefs.current[j];
        if (!el) return;
        el.style.transform = `translate(0, ${(ty + r.y * k).toFixed(1)}px)`;
        el.style.height = `${(r.h * k).toFixed(1)}px`;
      });
    };
    place(store.getState().transform);
    return store.subscribe((s, p) => { if (s.transform !== p.transform) place(s.transform); });
  }, [frame, store]);

  const toggle = (col: string) => {

  return (
    <div className="v2-headers" style={{ ['--hdr-h' as string]: `${insets.top - 56}px`, ['--lbl-w' as string]: `${insets.left - 12}px` }}>
      <div className="v2-colheads">
        {frame.cols.map((c, i) => {
          const r = nodes[c.id === UNASSIGNED_COL ? UNASSIGNED : `domain:${c.id}`]?.rollup;
          const cellRollups = frame.nodes.filter((n) => n.id.startsWith(`cell:${c.id}/`)).map((n) => nodes[n.id]?.rollup);
          return (

              ref={(el) => { colRefs.current[i] = el; }}
              type="button"
              className={`v2-colhead ${c.spine ? 'is-spine' : ''} ${c.open ? 'is-expanded' : ''} ${c.id === UNASSIGNED_COL ? 'is-unassigned' : ''}`}
              onClick={() => toggle(c.id)}
              title={`${c.purpose}\n${c.open ? 'Click to close' : 'Click to open'}`}
              aria-expanded={c.open}
            >
              <span className="v2-colhead-title">
                <Ring cells={cellRollups} />
                <span className="v2-colhead-name">{c.name}</span>
              </span>
              {c.open && <span className="v2-colhead-purpose">{c.purpose}</span>}
              {r && (r.violation || r.edited || r.ghostSteps.length > 0) && (
                <span className="v2-colhead-marks" aria-hidden="true">
                  {r.edited && <i className={r.unplanned ? 'is-unplanned' : 'is-edited'} />}
                  {r.ghostSteps.length > 0 && <i className="is-ghost" />}

          <div key={r.id} ref={(el) => { rowRefs.current[j] = el; }} className="v2-rowhead">
            <span>{r.name}</span>
          </div>
        ))}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

/** Control Room: a static ring per domain showing the state mix of its cells (no motion). */
function Ring({ cells }: { cells: (Rollup | undefined)[] }) {
  const parts: [string, number][] = [
    ['var(--v2-red)', cells.filter((r) => r?.violation).length],
    ['var(--v2-amber)', cells.filter((r) => r?.unplanned).length],
    ['var(--v2-agent)', cells.filter((r) => r && r.edited && !r.unplanned && !r.violation).length],
    ['color-mix(in srgb, var(--v2-agent) 45%, transparent)', cells.filter((r) => r && !r.edited && !r.violation && (r.looked || r.ghostSteps.length > 0)).length],
  ];
  const total = Math.max(1, cells.length);
  let at = 0;
  const stops = parts.filter(([, n]) => n > 0).map(([color, n]) => {
    const from = (at / total) * 360;
    at += n;
    return `${color} ${from}deg ${(at / total) * 360}deg`;
  });
  stops.push(`var(--v2-line) ${(at / total) * 360}deg 360deg`);
  return <span className="v2-ring" aria-hidden="true" style={{ background: `conic-gradient(${stops.join(', ')})` }} />;
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------- measurement hooks (Playwright)

type FrameStats = { frames: number; fps: number; p50: number; p95: number; p99: number; max: number; domNodes: number };
type Bench = {
  ready: () => boolean;
  count: () => number;
  frame: () => { nodes: number; edges: number; key: string } | null;
  stats: () => Stats & { reducedMotion: boolean };
  zoom: (ms?: number) => Promise<FrameStats>;
  toggle: (id: string) => Promise<TransitionStats & { layoutMs: number }>;
  relayout: () => Promise<number>;
};

function measureFrames(ms: number, step: (p: number) => void): Promise<FrameStats> {
  return new Promise((resolve) => {
    const times: number[] = [];
    const t0 = performance.now();
    const frame = (t: number) => {
      times.push(t);
      const p = Math.min(1, (t - t0) / ms);
      step(p);
      if (p < 1) requestAnimationFrame(frame);
      else {
        const dts = times.slice(1).map((x, i) => x - times[i]!).sort((a, b) => a - b);
        const q = (f: number) => +dts[Math.min(dts.length - 1, Math.floor(dts.length * f))]!.toFixed(2);
        resolve({ frames: times.length, fps: +((1000 * (times.length - 1)) / (times.at(-1)! - times[0]!)).toFixed(1), p50: q(0.5), p95: q(0.95), p99: q(0.99), max: q(1), domNodes: document.querySelectorAll('.react-flow__node').length });
      }
    };
    requestAnimationFrame(frame);
  });
}

function useBenchApi(tr: Transitioner, stats: React.MutableRefObject<Stats>, rf: ReturnType<typeof useReactFlow>) {
  useEffect(() => {
    const api: Bench = {
      ready: () => !!tr.shown,
      count: () => document.querySelectorAll('.react-flow__node').length,
      frame: () => (tr.shown ? { nodes: tr.shown.nodes.length, edges: tr.shown.edges.length, key: tr.shown.key } : null),
      stats: () => ({ ...stats.current, transition: tr.last, reducedMotion: reducedMotion() }),
      zoom: (ms = 3000) => {
        const b = tr.shown!.bounds;
        const cx = b.x + b.w / 2;
        const cy = b.y + b.h / 2;
        const el = document.querySelector('.v2-map')!.getBoundingClientRect();
        return measureFrames(ms, (p) => {
          const z = 0.2 + 1.2 * Math.sin(p * Math.PI); // far → near → far, crossing every LOD bucket twice
          void rf.setViewport({ zoom: z, x: el.width / 2 - (cx + (p - 0.5) * b.w * 0.4) * z, y: el.height / 2 - cy * z });
        });
      },
      toggle: (id) => new Promise((resolve) => {
        tr.onDone = (s) => {
          tr.onDone = null;
          resolve({ ...s, layoutMs: +stats.current.layoutMs.toFixed(1) });
        };
        const scene = useSceneRef.current!;
        const st = useV2.getState();
        st.go(dive(scene.graph, { open: st.open, focus: st.focus }, id.includes(':') ? id : `domain:${id}`));
      }),
      relayout: async () => { clearLayoutCache(); return 0; },
    };
    (window as unknown as { __v2: Bench }).__v2 = api;
  }, [tr, stats, rf]);
}
```

```text
/** One line for the proposal card: "turns would light 1.2 cells instead of 1.5 · 3 files placed · no decisions broken". */
export function describeScores(current: MapScore, next: MapScore): string {
  const parts = [`turns would light ${next.cellsLitMean} cell${next.cellsLitMean === 1 ? '' : 's'} instead of ${current.cellsLitMean}`];
  const placed = current.unassigned - next.unassigned;
  if (placed > 0) parts.push(`${placed} file${placed === 1 ? '' : 's'} placed`);
  if (next.churnFiles) parts.push(`${next.churnFiles} file${next.churnFiles === 1 ? '' : 's'} move`);
  parts.push(`modularity ${current.modularity} → ${next.modularity}`);
  parts.push(next.decisionsBroken ? `${next.decisionsBroken} decision${next.decisionsBroken === 1 ? '' : 's'} broken` : 'no decisions broken');
  return parts.join(' · ');

// The instant, faint placement guess for an unassigned file (NAVIGATION_PLAN §4.3). Deterministic; never a model.
import { createMapper } from '../mapper';
import type { DomainMap } from '../schema';
import type { FileFacts } from '../contracts/facts';
import { topFolder } from './drift';
import { layerFor } from './skeleton';
import { dirOf, majority, repoImports } from './util';

/** `basis` says why: already placed, folder siblings, import neighbours, or a new top-level folder (`domain` may not exist yet). */
export type PlacementGuess = { domain: string; layer: string; basis: 'cell' | 'siblings' | 'imports' | 'folder' };

/**
 * Guess a cell for `path`: its placement if it already has one; else the majority cell of files in the same folder
 * (then the parent folder); else the majority domain of what it imports and what imports it; else, for a folder
 * the map knows nothing about, a new domain named after it. Null for neutral, ignored and test files.
 */
export function instantGuess(map: DomainMap, facts: Readonly<Record<string, FileFacts>>, path: string): PlacementGuess | null {
  const mapper = createMapper(map);
  const own = mapper.place(path);
  if (own.kind === 'cell') return { domain: own.domain, layer: own.layer, basis: 'cell' };
  if (own.kind !== 'unassigned') return null;

  const paths = Object.keys(facts).filter((p) => p !== path).sort();
  const cellOf = (p: string) => { const pl = mapper.place(p); return pl.kind === 'cell' ? pl : null; };
  const layers = map.layers.map((l) => l.id);
  const fitLayer = (domain: string | null, fallback: string[]) => {
    const want = layerFor(path, facts[path]);
    const cells = domain ? Object.keys(map.domains.find((d) => d.id === domain)?.cells ?? {}) : layers;
    if (cells.includes(want)) return want;
    return majority(fallback.filter((l) => cells.includes(l))) ?? (cells.includes('logic') ? 'logic' : cells[0] ?? layers[0]!);
  };

  for (const dir of [dirOf(path), dirOf(dirOf(path))]) {
    if (!dir) continue;
    const sibs = paths.filter((p) => dirOf(p) === dir).map(cellOf).filter((c) => !!c);
    const best = majority(sibs.map((c) => `${c.domain}\u0000${c.layer}`));
    if (best) { const [domain, layer] = best.split('\u0000') as [string, string]; return { domain, layer, basis: 'siblings' }; }
  }

  const imports = facts[path] ? repoImports(facts[path]!) : [];
  const importers = paths.filter((p) => repoImports(facts[p]!).includes(path));
  const neighbours = [...imports, ...importers].map(cellOf).filter((c) => !!c);
  const domain = majority(neighbours.map((c) => c.domain));
  if (domain) return { domain, layer: fitLayer(domain, neighbours.filter((c) => c.domain === domain).map((c) => c.layer)), basis: 'imports' };

  const top = topFolder(path);
  if (top && !paths.some((p) => p.startsWith(`${top}/`) && cellOf(p))) {
    const slug = top.split('/').at(-1)!;
    return { domain: slug, layer: fitLayer(null, []), basis: 'folder' };
  }
  return null;
}
}

export type LivingMap = ReturnType<typeof attachLivingMap>;

/** HTTP endpoints, mounted under /api by the server. */
export function livingMapRoutes(lm: LivingMap) {
  const r = new Hono();
  const reply = (c: { json: (b: unknown, s?: 200 | 400 | 404 | 409) => Response }, res: Result) => (res.ok ? c.json(res) : c.json({ error: res.error }, res.status));
  r.post('/proposals/:id/accept', async (c) => {
    const body = await c.req.json<{ candidate?: number }>().catch(() => ({} as { candidate?: number }));
    return reply(c, lm.accept(c.req.param('id'), body.candidate));
  });
  r.post('/proposals/:id/reject', async (c) => {
    const body = await c.req.json<{ reason?: string }>().catch(() => ({} as { reason?: string }));
    return reply(c, lm.reject(c.req.param('id'), body.reason));
  });
  r.post('/living-map/survey', (c) => c.json({ ok: true, ...lm.survey() }));
  return r;
}
  };
}

  r.post('/findings/:id/dismiss', (c) => reply(c, a.dismiss(c.req.param('id'))));
  r.post('/findings/:id/promote', (c) => reply(c, a.promote(c.req.param('id'))));
  r.post('/audit/turns/:turn', (c) => { void a.run(c.req.param('turn')); return c.json({ ok: true, queued: true }); });
  return r;
}
```

```text
// Custom React Flow nodes. Each is memoized and reads only its own slice of the projection from the v2 store, plus
// the zoom bucket, so a zoom re-renders a node only when its level of detail changes.
import { memo } from 'react';
import { useStore as useFlow, type NodeProps } from '@xyflow/react';
import type { Rollup, VisibleNode } from '@harness/core/view';
import { useTween } from '../hooks';
import { useStore } from '../store';
import { selectedNode } from './select';
import { useV2 } from './store';

export type Lod = 'far' | 'mid' | 'near';
export const lodOf = (zoom: number): Lod => (zoom < 0.36 ? 'far' : zoom < 0.72 ? 'mid' : 'near');
export const useLod = () => useFlow((s) => lodOf(s.transform[2]));

const base = (p: string) => p.split('/').pop() ?? p;

function stateClasses(r: Rollup, ghost: boolean) {
  const c: string[] = [];
  if (r.looked && !r.edited) c.push('is-looked');
  if (r.edited) c.push(r.unplanned ? 'is-unplanned' : 'is-edited');
  if (ghost) c.push('is-ghost');
  if (r.violation === 'existing') c.push('is-violation');
  if (r.violation === 'new') c.push('is-new-violation');
  if (r.cursor) c.push('is-cursor');
  return c.join(' ');
}

function useMarks(id: string) {
  const focus = useV2((s) => s.focus === id);
  const selected = useStore((s) => selectedNode(s.selection) === id);
  return `${focus ? 'is-focus' : ''} ${selected ? 'is-selected' : ''}`;
}

function Steps({ steps }: { steps: number[] }) {
  if (!steps.length) return null;
  return (
    <span className="v2-steps" aria-label={`Planned in step ${steps.join(', ')}`}>
      {steps.map((n) => <span key={n} className="v2-step">{n}</span>)}
    </span>
  );
}

/** +/− badge, ticking up as edits land. */
function Diff({ r }: { r: Rollup }) {
  const added = useTween(r.added);
  const removed = useTween(r.removed);
  if (!r.edited) return null;
  return (
    <span className="v2-diff">
      <span className="plus">+{added}</span>
      <span className="minus">−{removed}</span>
    </span>
  );
}

/** Existing crossings: a ring badge with the rule ids and file count. New crossings: a solid badge naming the file. */
function Violations({ r, compact = false }: { r: Rollup; compact?: boolean }) {
  if (!r.violation) return null;
  const existing = r.violationFiles.filter((f) => !r.newViolationFiles.includes(f));
  return (
    <span className="v2-vmarks">
      {r.newViolationFiles.length > 0 && (
        <span className="v2-vmark is-new" title={r.newViolationFiles.join('\n')}>
          <b>new</b>{!compact && <> {r.newViolationFiles.map(base).join(', ')}</>}
        </span>
      )}
      {(existing.length > 0 || (!r.newViolationFiles.length && r.rules.length > 0)) && (
        <span className="v2-vmark" title={[...r.rules, ...existing].join('\n')}>
          {compact ? existing.length || r.rules.length : `${r.rules.join(' ')}${existing.length > 1 ? ` · ${existing.length}` : ''}`}
        </span>
      )}
    </span>
  );
}

const useNode = (id: string) => useV2((s) => s.nodes[id]) as VisibleNode | undefined;

export const FileNode = memo(function FileNode({ id }: NodeProps) {
  const n = useNode(id);
  const lod = useLod();
  const marks = useMarks(id);
  const syms = useV2((s) => s.symbols[id] ?? 0);
  if (!n) return null;
  const r = n.rollup;
  const ghost = r.ghostSteps.length > 0;
  return (
    <div className={`v2-file ${stateClasses(r, ghost)} ${r.plannedNew ? 'is-planned-new' : ''} lod-${lod} ${marks}`} title={n.path ?? n.id}>
      {lod !== 'far' && <span className="v2-file-name">{n.label}</span>}
      {lod !== 'far' && (
        <span className="v2-file-meta">
          {syms > 0 && <span className="v2-syms" title={`${syms} symbol${syms === 1 ? '' : 's'} changed`}>ƒ{syms}</span>}
          <Diff r={r} />
        </span>
      )}
      <Steps steps={r.ghostSteps} />
      {lod !== 'far' && <Violations r={r} />}
    </div>
  );
});

export const CellNode = memo(function CellNode({ id }: NodeProps) {
  const n = useNode(id);
  const lod = useLod();
  const marks = useMarks(id);
  const hot = useV2((s) => s.hot[id]);
  if (!n) return null;
  const r = n.rollup;
  const ghost = r.ghostSteps.length > 0 && !r.edited;
  const names = hot ?? n.preview;
  const room = lod === 'near' ? 4 : 2;
  const shown = names.slice(0, room);
  const more = r.leaves - shown.length;
  return (
    <div className={`v2-cell ${stateClasses(r, ghost)} lod-${lod} ${marks}`}>
      {lod === 'far' ? (
        <span className="v2-cell-count is-big">{r.leaves}</span>
      ) : (
        <>
          <span className="v2-cell-files">
            {shown.map((f, i) => <span key={`${f}${i}`} className="v2-cell-file">{f.replace(/\.[cm]?[jt]sx?$/, "")}</span>)}
            {more > 0 && <span className="v2-cell-more">+{more} more</span>}
          </span>
          <span className="v2-cell-foot">
            <span className="v2-cell-count">{r.leaves} {r.leaves === 1 ? 'file' : 'files'}</span>
            <Diff r={r} />
          </span>
        </>
      )}
      {ghost && <Steps steps={r.ghostSteps} />}
      <Violations r={r} compact={lod === 'far'} />
    </div>
  );
});

/** A compressed column's cell: no text, only the state it carries (fill, ghost dash, rule marks, count). */
export const SpineNode = memo(function SpineNode({ id }: NodeProps) {
  const n = useNode(id);
  const marks = useMarks(id);
  if (!n) return null;
  const r = n.rollup;
  const ghost = r.ghostSteps.length > 0 && !r.edited;
  return (
    <div className={`v2-spine ${stateClasses(r, ghost)} ${marks}`} title={`${n.label}: ${r.leaves} files`}>
      <span className="v2-spine-count">{r.leaves}</span>
      {ghost && <Steps steps={r.ghostSteps} />}
      <Violations r={r} compact />
    </div>
  );
});

export const ContainerNode = memo(function ContainerNode({ id }: NodeProps) {
  const n = useNode(id);
  const lod = useLod();
  const marks = useMarks(id);
  if (!n) return null;
  const r = n.rollup;
  return (
    <div className={`v2-container is-${n.kind} ${r.violation ? `has-${r.violation}` : ''} ${r.edited ? 'has-edits' : ''} lod-${lod} ${marks}`}>
      <span className="v2-container-head">
        <span className="v2-container-name">{n.kind === 'group' ? n.label : n.label}</span>
        <span className="v2-container-count">{r.leaves} {r.leaves === 1 ? 'file' : 'files'}</span>
        <Diff r={r} />
      </span>
    </div>
  );
});

/** A collapsed directory or component inside an open cell. */
export const GroupNode = memo(function GroupNode({ id }: NodeProps) {
  const n = useNode(id);
  const lod = useLod();
  const marks = useMarks(id);
  if (!n) return null;
  const r = n.rollup;
  const ghost = r.ghostSteps.length > 0 && !r.edited;
  return (
    <div className={`v2-group ${stateClasses(r, ghost)} lod-${lod} ${marks}`} title={n.preview.join(', ')}>
      {lod !== 'far' && <span className="v2-group-name">{n.label}</span>}
      {lod !== 'far' && <span className="v2-group-count">{r.leaves} files <Diff r={r} /></span>}
      {ghost && <Steps steps={r.ghostSteps} />}
      {lod !== 'far' && <Violations r={r} compact />}
    </div>
  );
});

/** Tables, vendors and routes inside an open cell. */
export const ChipNode = memo(function ChipNode({ id }: NodeProps) {
  const n = useNode(id);
  const lod = useLod();
  const marks = useMarks(id);
  const cols = useV2((s) => s.columns[id]);
  if (!n) return null;
  return (
    <div className={`v2-chip is-${n.kind} ${stateClasses(n.rollup, false)} ${marks}`} title={cols?.join(', ')}>
      {lod !== 'far' && <><span className="v2-chip-kind">{n.kind}</span><span className="v2-chip-name">{n.label}</span></>}
      {lod !== 'far' && cols && <span className="v2-chip-cols">{cols.length} columns</span>}
    </div>
  );
});

/** The open column: the next step down the depth lightness ramp. */
export const BandNode = memo(function BandNode() {
  return <div className="v2-band" />;
});

export const nodeTypes = { file: FileNode, cell: CellNode, spine: SpineNode, container: ContainerNode, group: GroupNode, chip: ChipNode, band: BandNode };
import { create } from 'zustand';
import type { ProjectionCursor, VisibleEdge, VisibleNode } from '@harness/core/view';

export type Theme = 'atlas' | 'control' | 'strata';
const params = new URLSearchParams(location.search);
const themeParam = params.get('theme');
export const initialTheme: Theme = themeParam === 'control' || themeParam === 'strata' ? themeParam : 'atlas';

/** Where you are: the containers you opened (domains, cells, groups) and the node you are on. View-only state. */
export type Place = { open: string[]; focus: string | null };

const readMinimap = () => {
  try { return localStorage.getItem('harness.minimap') !== '0'; } catch { return true; }
};

/**
 * View-only state for the v2 map: what is open, the focused node, history, chrome toggles. Plus the current
 * projection's nodes and edges published by id with structural sharing, so each node component re-renders only when
 * its own slice changes. Nothing here duplicates what the event log says.
 */
type V2Store = {
  open: string[];
  focus: string | null;
  back: Place[];
  forward: Place[];
  theme: Theme;
  minimap: boolean;
  palette: boolean;
  /** A node to fly the camera to once it is laid out (⌘K, breadcrumbs). */
  fly: string | null;
  nodes: Record<string, VisibleNode>;
  edges: Record<string, VisibleEdge>;
  hot: Record<string, string[]>;
  /** File id → how many of its symbols this turn changed. */
  symbols: Record<string, number>;
  /** Table id → its columns, from the schema file that defines it. */
  columns: Record<string, string[]>;
  cursor: ProjectionCursor | null;

  /** Navigate to a place (pushes history unless it is the same place). */
  go(next: Partial<Place>, fly?: string | null): void;
  setFocus(id: string | null): void;
  goBack(): void;
  goForward(): void;
  setPalette(open: boolean): void;
  toggleMinimap(): void;
  publish(p: { nodes: VisibleNode[]; edges: VisibleEdge[]; hot: Record<string, string[]>; symbols: Record<string, number>; columns: Record<string, string[]>; cursor: ProjectionCursor | null }): void;
};

const same = (a: unknown, b: unknown) => a === b || JSON.stringify(a) === JSON.stringify(b);
const samePlace = (a: Place, b: Place) => a.focus === b.focus && a.open.join() === b.open.join();
const HISTORY = 50;

export const useV2 = create<V2Store>((set, get) => ({
  open: (params.get('expand') ?? '').split(',').filter(Boolean).map((d) => (d.includes(':') ? d : `domain:${d}`)),
  focus: null,
  back: [],
  forward: [],
  theme: initialTheme,
  minimap: readMinimap(),
  palette: false,
  fly: null,
  nodes: {},
  edges: {},
  hot: {},
  symbols: {},
  columns: {},
  cursor: null,

  go: (next, fly = null) => {
    const s = get();
    const cur: Place = { open: s.open, focus: s.focus };
    const to: Place = { open: next.open ?? s.open, focus: next.focus === undefined ? s.focus : next.focus };
    if (samePlace(cur, to)) { if (fly) set({ fly }); return; }
    set({ ...to, back: [...s.back, cur].slice(-HISTORY), forward: [], fly });
  },
  setFocus: (focus) => set({ focus }),
  goBack: () => {
    const s = get();
    const prev = s.back.at(-1);
    if (!prev) return;
    set({ ...prev, back: s.back.slice(0, -1), forward: [{ open: s.open, focus: s.focus }, ...s.forward], fly: prev.focus });
  },
  goForward: () => {
    const s = get();
    const next = s.forward[0];
    if (!next) return;
    set({ ...next, forward: s.forward.slice(1), back: [...s.back, { open: s.open, focus: s.focus }], fly: next.focus });
  },
  setPalette: (palette) => set({ palette }),
  toggleMinimap: () => set((s) => {
    try { localStorage.setItem('harness.minimap', s.minimap ? '0' : '1'); } catch { /* private mode */ }
    return { minimap: !s.minimap };
  }),
  publish: (p) => {
    const prev = get();
    const nodes: Record<string, VisibleNode> = {};
    for (const n of p.nodes) {
      const o = prev.nodes[n.id];
      nodes[n.id] = o && same(o, n) ? o : n;
    }
    const edges: Record<string, VisibleEdge> = {};
    for (const e of p.edges) {
      const o = prev.edges[e.id];
      edges[e.id] = o && same(o, e) ? o : e;
    }
    const hot: Record<string, string[]> = {};
    for (const [k, v] of Object.entries(p.hot)) hot[k] = prev.hot[k] && same(prev.hot[k], v) ? prev.hot[k]! : v;
    set({ nodes, edges, hot, symbols: same(prev.symbols, p.symbols) ? prev.symbols : p.symbols, columns: same(prev.columns, p.columns) ? prev.columns : p.columns, cursor: same(prev.cursor, p.cursor) ? prev.cursor : p.cursor });
  },
}));
// The real pipeline wired to the stores: ui = reduce(events, upTo) → graph = graphOf(ui) (memoized) →
// activity = activityFor(ui, graph, turn) → projection = project(graph, view, activity).
import { useMemo } from 'react';
import { useView } from '../derive';
import { graphMemo, sceneOf, type Scene } from './scene';
import { useV2 } from './store';

export { hotLabels, type Scene } from './scene';

const memoGraph = graphMemo();

/** The scene for the current events, replay index, selected turn and open set. */
export function useScene(): Scene | null {
  const v = useView();
  const open = useV2((s) => s.open);
  const graph = useMemo(() => memoGraph(v.ui), [v.ui]);
  return useMemo(() => (graph ? sceneOf(v.ui, graph, v.turn?.id ?? null, open) : null), [v.ui, v.turn, graph, open]);
}
// The pipeline's pure half (NAVIGATION_PLAN §3): graph = graphOf(ui) memoized on its inputs, the view for what is
// open, activity and projection. No React and no stores, so the layout tests run it in node.
import {
  activityFor, buildGraph, graphFacts, project,
  type ContextGraph, type FileFacts, type LeafActivity, type Projection, type TurnActivity, type UIState, type ViewState,
} from '@harness/core/view';

const sameImports = (a: FileFacts['imports'], b: FileFacts['imports']) =>
  a === b || (a.length === b.length && a.every((x, i) => x.to === b[i]!.to && x.typeOnly === b[i]!.typeOnly));

/** Same graph inputs: facts by content hash (stubs and edge-adjusted files compare their imports), map and Tier 2 by hash. */
export function sameInputs(a: Record<string, FileFacts>, b: Record<string, FileFacts>): boolean {
  const ka = Object.keys(a);
  if (ka.length !== Object.keys(b).length) return false;
  for (const k of ka) {
    const x = a[k]!;
    const y = b[k];
    if (!y) return false;
    if (x === y) continue;
    if (x.hash !== y.hash || !sameImports(x.imports, y.imports) || x.writes.length !== y.writes.length) return false;
  }
  return true;
}

const semKey = (ui: UIState) => Object.values(ui.semantic).map((s) => `${s.path}@${s.hash}`).sort().join('|');

/**
 * graphOf(ui), rebuilt only when what it is built from changes. Replay re-reduces the log, so UIState objects are
 * new on every event; the facts inside them are the events' own objects, so most comparisons are by reference.
 */
export function graphMemo() {
  let last: { map: unknown; mapJson: string; facts: Record<string, FileFacts>; sem: string; graph: ContextGraph } | null = null;
  return (ui: UIState): ContextGraph | null => {
    if (!ui.map) return (last = null);
    const facts = graphFacts(ui);
    const sem = semKey(ui);
    const mapJson = last && last.map === ui.map ? last.mapJson : JSON.stringify(ui.map);
    if (last && last.mapJson === mapJson && last.sem === sem && sameInputs(last.facts, facts)) {
      last.map = ui.map;
      return last.graph;
    }
    const graph = buildGraph(ui.map, facts, ui.semantic);
    last = { map: ui.map, mapJson, facts, sem, graph };
    return graph;
  };
}

/** Opened ids that still exist, each with the containers above it (a group needs its cell open). */
export function normalizeOpen(graph: ContextGraph, open: readonly string[]): string[] {
  const out = new Set<string>();
  for (const id of open) {
    const n = graph.nodes[id];
    if (!n || !(graph.children[id]?.length)) continue;
    if (n.kind !== 'domain' && n.kind !== 'cell' && n.kind !== 'group' && n.kind !== 'unassigned') continue;
    out.add(id);
  }
  return [...out];
}

/**
 * The projection's view for what is open. System level is "every domain expanded one level" (cells visible, the
 * parity view). Opening a domain opens all its cells; opening a cell or group opens it and the containers above it.
 */
export function viewFor(graph: ContextGraph, open: readonly string[]): ViewState {
  const expanded = new Set<string>();
  for (const id of graph.children[graph.root] ?? []) if (graph.nodes[id]!.kind === 'domain') expanded.add(id);
  for (const id of normalizeOpen(graph, open)) {
    const n = graph.nodes[id]!;
    if (n.kind === 'domain') for (const c of graph.children[id] ?? []) if (graph.nodes[c]!.kind === 'cell') expanded.add(c);
    for (let p: string | null = id; p && p !== graph.root; p = graph.nodes[p]?.parent ?? null) expanded.add(p);
  }
  return { expanded: [...expanded], focus: null, lens: { kinds: [], turnOnly: false }, budget: 50, follow: false };
}

const heat = (l: LeafActivity | undefined) =>
  !l ? 9 : l.violation === 'new' ? 0 : l.violation ? 1 : l.cursor ? 2 : l.edited ? 3 : l.ghostSteps.length ? 4 : l.looked ? 5 : 9;

/** Collapsed cells list their children with the ones that matter this turn first (as v1 did), then by order. */
export function hotLabels(graph: ContextGraph, activity: TurnActivity, p: Projection, max = 8): Record<string, string[]> {
  const out: Record<string, string[]> = {};
  for (const n of p.nodes) {
    if (n.expanded || (n.kind !== 'cell' && n.kind !== 'unassigned')) continue;
    const kids = graph.children[n.id] ?? [];
    const ranked = kids.map((k, i) => ({ k, i, h: heat(activity.leaves[k]) })).sort((a, b) => a.h - b.h || a.i - b.i);
    out[n.id] = ranked.slice(0, max).map((x) => graph.nodes[x.k]!.label);
  }
  return out;
}

export type Scene = {
  ui: UIState;
  graph: ContextGraph;
  activity: TurnActivity;
  projection: Projection;
  open: string[];
  /** Layout key: what is open (positions depend on nothing else but content). */
  key: string;
};

export function sceneOf(ui: UIState, graph: ContextGraph, turn: string | null, open: readonly string[]): Scene {
  const activity = activityFor(ui, graph, turn);
  const opened = normalizeOpen(graph, open);
  const projection = project(graph, viewFor(graph, opened), activity);
  return { ui, graph, activity, projection, open: opened, key: opened.join(',') };
}
// Map between v2 node ids and the shell's inspector selection (shared with v1, so the inspector stays one component).
import type { VisibleNode } from '@harness/core/view';
import type { Selection } from '../store';

export function selectionFor(n: Pick<VisibleNode, 'id' | 'kind' | 'domain' | 'layer'>): Selection {
  if (n.kind === 'cell') return { cell: `${n.domain}/${n.layer}` };
  if (n.kind === 'file') return { file: n.id };
  if (n.id === 'unassigned') return { unassigned: true };
  return { node: n.id };
}

/** The node a selection points at (edges select no node). */
export function selectedNode(s: Selection | null): string | null {
  if (!s) return null;
  if ('cell' in s) return `cell:${s.cell}`;
  if ('file' in s) return s.file;
  if ('node' in s) return s.node;
  if ('unassigned' in s) return 'unassigned';
  return null;
}

export const selectedEdge = (s: Selection | null): string | null => (s && 'link' in s ? s.link : null);
// Navigation over the containment tree (NAVIGATION_PLAN §3.3): dive, go up, jump, spatial neighbours. Pure: every
// function maps (graph, open, focus) to the next place; the store applies it and keeps history.
import { fileOf, type ContextGraph } from '@harness/core/view';
import type { Frame } from './layout/frame';
import type { Place } from './store';

const OPENABLE = new Set(['domain', 'cell', 'group', 'unassigned']);

export function ancestors(graph: ContextGraph, id: string): string[] {
  const out: string[] = [];
  for (let n: string | null = id; n && n !== graph.root; n = graph.nodes[n]?.parent ?? null) out.push(n);
  return out.reverse(); // top-down, including id
}

/** Is `id` drawn inside an open container (or is it one)? Domains open all of their cells. */
export function isOpen(graph: ContextGraph, open: readonly string[], id: string): boolean {
  if (open.includes(id)) return true;
  const n = graph.nodes[id];
  return n?.kind === 'cell' && !!n.domain && open.includes(`domain:${n.domain}`);
}

/** Remove a container (and anything opened inside it). Closing one cell of an open domain keeps its other cells open. */
export function close(graph: ContextGraph, open: readonly string[], id: string): string[] {
  const n = graph.nodes[id];
  let next = open.filter((o) => o !== id && !ancestors(graph, o).includes(id));
  if (n?.kind === 'cell' && n.domain && next.includes(`domain:${n.domain}`)) {
    const siblings = (graph.children[`domain:${n.domain}`] ?? []).filter((c) => c !== id && graph.nodes[c]!.kind === 'cell');
    next = [...next.filter((o) => o !== `domain:${n.domain}`), ...siblings];
  }
  return next;
}

/** Dive into a node: open it if it is a container (a domain replaces its cells), else just focus it. */
export function dive(graph: ContextGraph, place: Place, id: string): Place {
  const n = graph.nodes[id];
  if (!n || !OPENABLE.has(n.kind) || !(graph.children[id]?.length)) return { ...place, focus: id };
  if (isOpen(graph, place.open, id)) return { open: close(graph, place.open, id), focus: id };
  let open = [...place.open];
  if (n.kind === 'domain') open = open.filter((o) => graph.nodes[o]?.domain !== n.domain || o === id);
  return { open: [...open, id], focus: id };
}

/** Esc: close the deepest open container holding the focus and focus it; at the top, close the last opened. */
export function up(graph: ContextGraph, place: Place): Place {
  const { open, focus } = place;
  if (focus) {
    const path = ancestors(graph, focus);
    for (let i = path.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
      const a = path[i]!;
      if (!isOpen(graph, open, a)) continue;
      return { open: close(graph, open, a), focus: a };
    }
    if (graph.nodes[focus]?.kind !== 'domain') {
      const dom = path.find((p) => graph.nodes[p]?.kind === 'domain' || p === 'unassigned');
      if (dom && dom !== focus) return { open, focus: dom };
    }
    return { open, focus: null };
  }
  if (open.length) return { open: open.slice(0, -1), focus: null };
  return place;
}

/** ⌘K jump: open the containers on the way to a node (symbols and routes land on their file) and focus it. */
export function jump(graph: ContextGraph, place: Place, id: string): Place {
  let target = id;
  const n = graph.nodes[id];
  if (n && (n.kind === 'symbol' || n.kind === 'route' || n.kind === 'entry')) target = fileOf(id) ?? n.parent ?? id;
  const t = graph.nodes[target];
  if (!t) return place;
  if (t.kind === 'domain') return isOpen(graph, place.open, target) ? { ...place, focus: target } : dive(graph, place, target);
  const path = ancestors(graph, target);
  // the innermost container to open: the node itself when it is a cell or group, else its parent container
  const own = OPENABLE.has(t.kind) ? target : null;
  const inner = own ?? [...path].reverse().find((p) => p !== target && OPENABLE.has(graph.nodes[p]?.kind ?? '') && graph.nodes[p]!.kind !== 'domain');
  const open = [...place.open];
  if (inner && !isOpen(graph, open, inner)) open.push(inner);
  return { open, focus: target };
}

export type Dir = 'left' | 'right' | 'up' | 'down';
const FOCUSABLE = new Set(['cell', 'spine', 'container', 'file', 'group', 'chip']);

/** The nearest drawn node in a direction (cost: distance along it plus twice the sideways offset). */
export function neighbour(frame: Frame, from: string | null, dir: Dir): string | null {
  const nodes = frame.nodes.filter((n) => FOCUSABLE.has(n.type));
  const cur = from ? frame.boxes[from] : undefined;
  if (!cur) return nodes[0]?.id ?? null;
  const cx = cur.x + cur.w / 2;
  const cy = cur.y + cur.h / 2;
  const [dx, dy] = dir === 'left' ? [-1, 0] : dir === 'right' ? [1, 0] : dir === 'up' ? [0, -1] : [0, 1];
  let best: string | null = null;
  let cost = Infinity;
  for (const n of nodes) {
    if (n.id === from) continue;
    const nx = n.x + n.w / 2;
    const ny = n.y + n.h / 2;
    const ahead = dx ? (dx > 0 ? n.x - (cur.x + cur.w) : cur.x - (n.x + n.w)) : dy > 0 ? n.y - (cur.y + cur.h) : cur.y - (n.y + n.h);
    if (ahead < -1) continue;
    const side = dx ? Math.abs(ny - cy) : Math.abs(nx - cx);
    const c = Math.max(0, ahead) + 2 * side;
    if (c < cost) { cost = c; best = n.id; }
  }
  return best;
}
```

67	- **Parser: oxc-parser** replaces the regex parser.

74	- **Syntactic call edges** come from import bindings. Against typed edges on Scout they score 91–97% precision and 68–88% recall; the misses are mostly method calls.
75	- **Adapters:**
76	  - Writes: Scout's `db.insert/update`, Prisma, Drizzle, Knex, raw SQL (TypeORM comes in Tier 2).
77	  - Routes: Express, Hono, Fastify, Koa, and Next.js `app/` and `pages/`.
78	  - Entries: package.json `bin`/`scripts`, routes, UI routes.
79	  - Custom routers (like Scout's table of routes) use a pattern the user confirms in `domains.yaml`.
80	- **Size cap:** files over ~500 KB or minified use only the import/export record (2.6 ms at 972 KB).
81	- **`check()` keeps its signature.** The gate still checks only imports and writes. A `calls` field can be added to `FactDelta` later.

99	| Kind | Id example |

101	| file | `src/tools/news-summarize.ts` |

110	- `contains`
111	- `imports` (with a typeOnly flag)
112	- `calls` (with `{ confidence: syntactic | typed | dispatch, count }`)
113	- `implements`
114	- `handles`
115	- `writes` and `reads`
116	- `uses`
117	- `fetches`

120	**Which symbols an edit changed.** Each symbol gets two hashes:
121	- `sigHash`: its normalized signature;
122	- `bodyHash`: its whitespace-normalized body.
123	
124	Compare them before and after the edit to classify each symbol as added, removed, signature changed, body changed, or renamed. Renamed means removed plus added with the same `bodyHash`. Measured cost is 1.6–2.4 ms per file, done in PostToolUse, which doesn't block. `edited` events gain `symbols: { added, removed, sig, body, renamed }`. Diffing a file's outgoing edges gives `call_added` and `call_removed` events, which work like `edge_added`.

129	
130	- `buildGraph(map, facts, semantic?) → ContextGraph` builds the containment tree and the leaf edges. Files group by directory inside a cell when a cell holds more than about 12 files.
131	- `ViewState = { expanded: Set<id>, focus: id | null, lens: { kinds, turnOnly }, budget, follow }` is view-only state that lives in the shell. Replay reproduces the graph and activity. It reproduces the camera too, if we choose to log view events (decision D5).
132	- `project(graph, view, activity) → Projection` returns:

134	  - aggregated edges, with count, kinds, worst status, ghost or new, and their own lane;
135	  - ports for edges that cross a boundary.
136	- `autoExpand(graph, activity, focus, budget) → expanded`: the DOI expansion used by Follow mode and the opening view.
137	- `trace(graph, from, sinks) → path[]`: shortest paths over `calls ∪ implements ∪ handles`. Hops within one cell are collapsed, and interface dispatch shows as "via registry".
138	- **Parity:** today's `cellViews` and `edgeViews` become `project()` with nothing expanded. Property tests over the demo log prove they give identical output.
139	- The activity reducer adds per-file and per-symbol state alongside the per-cell state it already tracks.

```text
  function dismiss(id: string): Result {
    const f = reduce(bus.events).findings[id];
    if (!f) return { ok: false, status: 404, error: `No finding ${id}.` };
    if (f.status !== 'open') return { ok: false, status: 409, error: `${id} is already ${f.status}.` };
    rememberDismissed(repo.root, f);
    bus.emit('audit_resolved', { id, outcome: 'dismissed' }, { turn: null });
    return { ok: true };
  }

  /**
   * Promote a finding into a rule proposal. If its decision is linked to an invariant, the proposal amends that rule's
   * text with the decision (a candidate map, so accept commits it); otherwise it is manual (rule text, no candidate).
   * See packages/core/src/audit/rules.ts for why the three rule kinds rarely express these.
   */
  function promote(id: string): Result {
    const ui = reduce(bus.events);
    const f = ui.findings[id];
    if (!f) return { ok: false, status: 404, error: `No finding ${id}.` };
    if (f.status !== 'open') return { ok: false, status: 409, error: `${id} is already ${f.status}.` };
    if (!repo.map || !repo.hasMap()) return { ok: false, status: 409, error: 'No confirmed map yet.' };
    const decision = f.decision ? standingDecisions(repo.root).find((d) => d.id === f.decision) : undefined;
    const inv = decision?.invariant ? repo.map.invariants.find((i) => i.id === decision.invariant) : undefined;
    const base = {
      id: nextProposalId(ui), yaml: repo.mapText, map: repo.map, facts: facts(), history: historyFromUI(ui), trigger: [],
      scope: [...(inv ? [`rule:${inv.id}`] : []), ...f.files],
    };
    const rule = inv && decision ? amendedRuleText(inv.rule, decision) : null;
    const proposal = inv && rule && rule !== inv.rule
      ? changeRuleProposal({ ...base, invariant: inv.id, rule, rationale: `Promoted from ${id}: ${f.text} The three rule kinds can't check ${decision!.id} directly; accepting states it in ${inv.id}'s rule text, and the auditor keeps checking it.` })
      : manualRuleProposal({ ...base, invariant: id, rule: decision ? `${decision.id}: ${decision.title}` : f.text, rationale: `Promoted from ${id}: ${f.text} No rule kind can express this, so there is no candidate map: write the rule into domains.yaml by hand, or reject.` });
    emitProposal(proposal, `Auditor proposal ${proposal.id} (from ${id}): ${summarizeChanges(proposal.changes)}${proposal.candidates.length ? '' : ' (manual)'}`);
    bus.emit('audit_resolved', { id, outcome: 'promoted' }, { turn: null });
    return { ok: true, proposal: proposal.id, manual: !proposal.candidates.length };
  }

  const off = bus.on((e) => {
    if (e.kind === 'turn_ended' && e.turn) {
      const turn = e.turn;
      enqueue(() => { reinforce(); return auditTurn(turn); });
    } else if (e.kind === 'planned' && plans && e.turn) {
      const turn = e.turn;
      enqueue(() => auditPlan(turn));
    }
  });

  return {
    /** Audit a finished turn now (also runs automatically at every turn end). */
    run(turnId: string) { return enqueue(() => auditTurn(turnId)) as Promise<unknown>; },
    auditTurn,
    auditPlan,
    reinforce,
    dismiss,
    promote,
    /** Resolves once no audit is queued or running (for tests and shutdown). */
    async idle() { while (work.size) await Promise.allSettled([...work]); },
    detach: off,
  };
```
