// The deterministic domain × layer grid at every depth (NAVIGATION_PLAN §1.2, §3.3). An open column widens to fit
// its containers, the other columns compress to spines, rows grow to the tallest container. Expanded containers are
// laid out by ELK bottom-up; edges route inside containers (ELK), leave through ports, and continue through the
// gutters. Edge declutter: only edges touching the focus region, plus every violation, new and ghost edge, are drawn
// in full; the rest fade (inside containers) or merge into one faint trunk per column pair with a count.
import type { EdgeStatus, Projection, ViolationState, VisibleEdge, VisibleNode } from '@harness/core/view';
import { PAD, SIZE, portKey, type Box, type ChildSpec, type ContainerInput, type ContainerLayout, type LayoutFn, type Pt, type Side } from './containers';

export const COL_W = 236;
export const SPINE_W = 64;
export const ROW_H = 132;
export const ROW_H_SPINE = 92; // rows with no open container shrink while a column is open
export const GAP_X = 56;
export const GAP_Y = 42;
/** Open tracks grow in steps, so a container that grows a little does not move its neighbours. */
export const STEP = 24;
export const UNASSIGNED = 'unassigned';
export const UNASSIGNED_COL = '__unassigned';

export type Meta = { domains: { id: string; name: string; purpose: string }[]; layers: { id: string; name: string }[] };

export type NodeType = 'band' | 'cell' | 'spine' | 'container' | 'file' | 'group' | 'chip';
export type FrameNode = Box & { id: string; type: NodeType; z: number };
export type FrameEdge = {
  id: string;
  d: string;
  status: EdgeStatus;
  violation: ViolationState;
  count: number;
  steps: number[];
  mid: Pt;
  from: string;
  to: string;
  /** Drawn faintly: outside the focus region. A trunk merges several such edges between two columns. */
  faint: boolean;
  /** A ghost a standing decision rules out: drawn struck through, "rejected in DR-4, session 1". */
  decision: { id: string; session: number } | null;
  trunk: string[] | null;
};
export type Col = { id: string; name: string; purpose: string; x: number; w: number; spine: boolean; open: boolean; index: number };
export type Row = { id: string; name: string; y: number; h: number };
export type Frame = {
  nodes: FrameNode[];
  boxes: Record<string, FrameNode>;
  edges: FrameEdge[];
  cols: Col[];
  rows: Row[];
  bounds: Box;
  focus: Box | null;
  gutters: { x: number[]; y: number[] };
  key: string;
};

const CONTAINER_KINDS = new Set(['cell', 'group', 'unassigned']);
const isContainer = (n: VisibleNode | undefined) => !!n && n.expanded && CONTAINER_KINDS.has(n.kind);

/** Index helpers over a projection: visible nodes by id, drawn nodes, columns. */
export function indexOf(p: Projection) {
  const byId = new Map(p.nodes.map((n) => [n.id, n]));
  const showUnassigned = (() => {
    const u = byId.get(UNASSIGNED);
    return !!u && (u.rollup.leaves > 0 || u.expanded);
  })();
  const drawn = (id: string) => {
    const n = byId.get(id);
    if (!n) return false;
    if (n.kind === 'cell') return true;
    if (id === UNASSIGNED) return showUnassigned;
    return isContainer(byId.get(n.parent ?? ''));
  };
  /** Column id of a node: its domain, or the Unassigned column. */
  const colId = (id: string): string | null => {
    const n = byId.get(id);
    if (!n) return null;
    if (n.domain) return n.domain;
    for (let x: VisibleNode | undefined = n; x; x = byId.get(x.parent ?? '')) if (x.id === UNASSIGNED) return UNASSIGNED_COL;
    return null;
  };
  /** ELK containers above a node, innermost first. */
  const containers = (id: string): string[] => {
    const out: string[] = [];
    for (let x = byId.get(byId.get(id)?.parent ?? ''); x; x = byId.get(x.parent ?? '')) if (isContainer(x)) out.push(x.id);
    return out;
  };
  return { byId, drawn, colId, containers, showUnassigned };
}

/** Expanded containers, deepest first (the bottom-up layout order). */
export function containerOrder(p: Projection): string[][] {
  const levels = new Map<number, string[]>();
  for (const n of p.nodes) if (isContainer(n)) (levels.get(n.depth) ?? levels.set(n.depth, []).get(n.depth)!).push(n.id);
  return [...levels].sort((a, b) => b[0] - a[0]).map(([, ids]) => ids);
}

/**
 * ELK input for one container: its drawn children (an open child container enters with its laid-out size and its
 * ports at fixed positions), the edges between its children, and a port for every edge that leaves or enters it.
 * A port faces the other end's column; within a column, out on the right and in on the left (ELK's flow is rightward).
 */
export function containerInput(p: Projection, id: string, done: ReadonlyMap<string, ContainerLayout>, colIndex: (col: string | null) => number): ContainerInput {
  const ix = indexOf(p);
  const children: ChildSpec[] = [];
  for (const n of p.nodes) {
    if (n.parent !== id || !ix.drawn(n.id)) continue;
    const sub = done.get(n.id);
    if (sub) {
      children.push({ id: n.id, w: sub.w, h: sub.h, ports: Object.entries(sub.ports).map(([key, q]) => ({ id: key, at: q.at, side: q.side })) });
    } else {
      const s = n.kind === 'file' ? SIZE.file : n.kind === 'group' ? SIZE.group : SIZE.chip;
      children.push({ id: n.id, w: s.w, h: s.h, ports: [] });
    }
  }
  const mine = new Set(children.map((c) => c.id));
  const here = ix.colId(id);
  /** The child of this container holding `x`, as an ELK endpoint (the child, or the child container's port). */
  const ref = (x: string, e: string): string | null => {
    if (mine.has(x)) return x;
    const chain = ix.containers(x);
    const i = chain.indexOf(id);
    if (i <= 0) return null;
    return portKey(e, chain[i - 1]!);
  };
  const edges: ContainerInput['edges'] = [];
  const ports: ContainerInput['ports'] = [];
  for (const e of drawnEdges(p)) {
    const a = ref(e.from, e.id);
    const b = ref(e.to, e.id);
    if (a && b) {
      if (a !== b) edges.push({ id: e.id, from: a, to: b });
    } else if (a || b) {
      const out = !!a;
      const peerCol = colIndex(ix.colId(out ? e.to : e.from));
      const selfCol = colIndex(here);
      const side: Side = peerCol > selfCol ? 'right' : peerCol < selfCol ? 'left' : out ? 'right' : 'left';
      ports.push({ key: portKey(e.id, id), edge: e.id, node: (a ?? b)!, side, direction: out ? 'out' : 'in' });
    }
  }
  return { id, children, edges, ports };
}

/** Edges whose two ends are drawn (tests, shared code and bare vendors are not drawn on the grid). */
export function drawnEdges(p: Projection): VisibleEdge[] {
  const ix = indexOf(p);
  return p.edges.filter((e) => ix.drawn(e.from) && ix.drawn(e.to));
}

export function columnIndex(p: Projection) {
  const order = [...p.grid.domains, UNASSIGNED_COL];
  return (col: string | null) => (col === null ? -1 : order.indexOf(col));
}

/** Lay out every expanded container bottom-up (siblings in parallel). */
export async function layoutAll(p: Projection, layout: LayoutFn): Promise<Map<string, ContainerLayout>> {
  const done = new Map<string, ContainerLayout>();
  const colIndex = columnIndex(p);
  for (const level of containerOrder(p)) {
    const ls = await Promise.all(level.map((id) => layout(containerInput(p, id, done, colIndex))));
    for (const l of ls) done.set(l.id, l);
  }
  return done;
}

const up = (n: number, step = STEP) => Math.ceil(n / step) * step;

export type FrameInput = {
  projection: Projection;
  meta: Meta;
  layouts: ReadonlyMap<string, ContainerLayout>;
  /** Roots of the focus region (edges touching them are drawn in full); null = everything. */
  region: readonly string[] | null;
  key: string;
};

export function buildFrame({ projection: p, meta, layouts, region, key }: FrameInput): Frame {
  const ix = indexOf(p);
  const cells = p.nodes.filter((n) => n.kind === 'cell');
  const openCol = new Set(cells.filter((n) => n.expanded).map((n) => n.domain!));
  const unassigned = ix.byId.get(UNASSIGNED);
  if (ix.showUnassigned && unassigned?.expanded) openCol.add(UNASSIGNED_COL);
  const any = openCol.size > 0;
  const dmeta = new Map(meta.domains.map((d) => [d.id, d]));
  const lmeta = new Map(meta.layers.map((l) => [l.id, l]));

  // ---- tracks
  const colIds = [...p.grid.domains, ...(ix.showUnassigned ? [UNASSIGNED_COL] : [])];
  const cols: Col[] = [];
  let x = 0;
  colIds.forEach((id, i) => {
    const open = openCol.has(id);
    let w = open ? COL_W : any ? SPINE_W : COL_W;
    if (open) {
      for (const c of cells) if (c.domain === id && c.expanded) w = Math.max(w, layouts.get(c.id)?.w ?? 0);
      if (id === UNASSIGNED_COL) w = Math.max(w, layouts.get(UNASSIGNED)?.w ?? 0);
      w = up(w);
    }
    const d = dmeta.get(id);
    cols.push({ id, name: d?.name ?? (id === UNASSIGNED_COL ? 'Unassigned' : id), purpose: d?.purpose ?? 'Files that match no cell in domains.yaml', x, w, spine: any && !open, open, index: i });
    x += w + GAP_X;
  });
  const rows: Row[] = [];
  let y = 0;
  for (const l of p.grid.layers) {
    let h = any ? ROW_H_SPINE : ROW_H;
    for (const c of cells) if (c.layer === l && c.expanded) h = Math.max(h, up(layouts.get(c.id)?.h ?? 0));
    rows.push({ id: l, name: lmeta.get(l)?.name ?? l, y, h });
    y += h + GAP_Y;
  }
  const width = Math.max(0, x - GAP_X);
  const height = Math.max(0, y - GAP_Y);
  const colOf = new Map(cols.map((c) => [c.id, c]));
  const rowOf = new Map(rows.map((r, j) => [r.id, { ...r, index: j }]));

  // ---- boxes: bands and grid cells, then container children (parents before children: projection pre-order)
  const nodes: FrameNode[] = [];
  const boxes: Record<string, FrameNode> = {};
  const add = (n: FrameNode) => { nodes.push(n); boxes[n.id] = n; };
  let focus: Box | null = null;
  for (const c of cols) {
    if (!c.open) continue;
    const id = c.id === UNASSIGNED_COL ? `band:${UNASSIGNED}` : `domain:${c.id}`;
    const b = { x: c.x - 14, y: -14, w: c.w + 28, h: height + 28 };
    add({ id, type: 'band', z: 0, ...b });
    focus = focus ? union(focus, b) : b;
  }
  for (const n of p.nodes) {
    if (n.kind === 'cell') {
      const c = colOf.get(n.domain!)!;
      const r = rowOf.get(n.layer!)!;
      add({ id: n.id, type: n.expanded ? 'container' : c.spine ? 'spine' : 'cell', z: 1, x: c.x, y: r.y, w: c.w, h: r.h });
    } else if (n.id === UNASSIGNED && ix.showUnassigned) {
      const c = colOf.get(UNASSIGNED_COL)!;
      const h = n.expanded ? Math.max(height, layouts.get(UNASSIGNED)?.h ?? 0) : height;
      add({ id: n.id, type: n.expanded ? 'container' : c.spine ? 'spine' : 'cell', z: 1, x: c.x, y: 0, w: c.w, h });
    } else if (ix.drawn(n.id)) {
      const parent = boxes[n.parent!];
      const b = layouts.get(n.parent!)?.nodes[n.id];
      if (!parent || !b) continue;
      const type: NodeType = isContainer(n) ? 'container' : n.kind === 'file' ? 'file' : n.kind === 'group' ? 'group' : 'chip';
      add({ id: n.id, type, z: n.depth, x: parent.x + b.x, y: parent.y + b.y, w: b.w, h: b.h });
    }
  }

  // ---- gutters and lanes
  const colGutter = (g: number) => (g <= 0 ? -GAP_X / 2 : cols[g - 1]!.x + cols[g - 1]!.w + GAP_X / 2);
  const rowGutter = (g: number) => (g <= 0 ? -GAP_Y / 2 : rows[g - 1]!.y + rows[g - 1]!.h + GAP_Y / 2);
  const used = new Map<string, number>();
  const take = (k: string) => { const n = used.get(k) ?? 0; used.set(k, n + 1); return n; };
  const lane = (i: number, s: number) => (i === 0 ? 0 : (i % 2 ? 1 : -1) * Math.ceil(i / 2) * s);
  const colAt = (px: number) => { let i = 0; while (i < cols.length - 1 && px > cols[i]!.x + cols[i]!.w + GAP_X / 2) i++; return i; };
  const rowAt = (py: number) => { let j = 0; while (j < rows.length - 1 && py > rows[j]!.y + rows[j]!.h + GAP_Y / 2) j++; return j; };

  type Anchor = { p: Pt; side: Side; col: number; row: number };
  const abs = (c: string, q: Pt): Pt => ({ x: boxes[c]!.x + q.x, y: boxes[c]!.y + q.y });
  const boxAnchor = (self: string, other: Pt): Anchor | null => {
    const b = boxes[self];
    if (!b) return null;
    const col = colAt(b.x + b.w / 2);
    const row = rowAt(b.y + Math.min(b.h / 2, 60));
    const oc = colAt(other.x);
    const or = rowAt(other.y);
    const side: Side = oc > col ? 'right' : oc < col ? 'left' : or > row ? 'bottom' : 'top';
    const k = take(`port:${self}:${side}`);
    const p = side === 'right' || side === 'left'
      ? { x: side === 'right' ? b.x + b.w : b.x, y: b.y + Math.min(b.h / 2, 60) + lane(k, 10) }
      : { x: b.x + b.w / 2 + lane(k, 10), y: side === 'bottom' ? b.y + b.h : b.y };
    return { p, side, col, row };
  };
  const center = (id: string): Pt => { const b = boxes[id]!; return { x: b.x + b.w / 2, y: b.y + Math.min(b.h / 2, 60) }; };

  // Edges between the same two containers (same status) share one lane in every gutter: a trunk that fans out only
  // at the ports. Rule-crossing edges get their own trunk and stay distinct.
  const bundled = new Map<string, number>();
  const laneFor = (k: string, bundle: string) => {
    const kk = `${k}|${bundle}`;
    let i = bundled.get(kk);
    if (i === undefined) bundled.set(kk, (i = take(k)));
    return i;
  };
  const route = (A: Anchor, B: Anchor, bundle: string): Pt[] => {
    const hA = A.side === 'left' || A.side === 'right';
    const hB = B.side === 'left' || B.side === 'right';
    const gxOf = (a: Anchor) => (a.side === 'right' ? a.col + 1 : a.col);
    const gyOf = (a: Anchor) => (a.side === 'bottom' ? a.row + 1 : a.row);
    const gx = (g: number) => colGutter(g) + lane(laneFor(`col:${g}`, bundle), 7);
    const gy = (g: number) => rowGutter(g) + lane(laneFor(`row:${g}`, bundle), 6);
    if (hA && hB) {
      const g1 = gxOf(A);
      const g2 = gxOf(B);
      if (g1 === g2) {
        if (Math.abs(A.p.y - B.p.y) < 1) return [A.p, B.p];
        const x1 = gx(g1);
        return [A.p, { x: x1, y: A.p.y }, { x: x1, y: B.p.y }, B.p];
      }
      const rg = B.row > A.row ? B.row : B.row < A.row ? B.row + 1 : A.row + 1; // run across next to the target
      const x1 = gx(g1);
      const yy = gy(rg);
      const x2 = gx(g2);
      return [A.p, { x: x1, y: A.p.y }, { x: x1, y: yy }, { x: x2, y: yy }, { x: x2, y: B.p.y }, B.p];
    }
    if (!hA && !hB) {
      const g1 = gyOf(A);
      const g2 = gyOf(B);
      if (g1 === g2) {
        const y1 = gy(g1);
        return [A.p, { x: A.p.x, y: y1 }, { x: B.p.x, y: y1 }, B.p];
      }
      const y1 = gy(g1);
      const xx = gx(A.col + 1);
      const y2 = gy(g2);
      return [A.p, { x: A.p.x, y: y1 }, { x: xx, y: y1 }, { x: xx, y: y2 }, { x: B.p.x, y: y2 }, B.p];
    }
    if (hA) {
      const x1 = gx(gxOf(A));
      const y2 = gy(gyOf(B));
      return [A.p, { x: x1, y: A.p.y }, { x: x1, y: y2 }, { x: B.p.x, y: y2 }, B.p];
    }
    const y1 = gy(gyOf(A));
    const x2 = gx(gxOf(B));
    return [A.p, { x: A.p.x, y: y1 }, { x: x2, y: y1 }, { x: x2, y: B.p.y }, B.p];
  };

  // ---- declutter
  const roots = region ? new Set(region) : null;
  const inRegion = (id: string) => {
    if (!roots) return true;
    for (let n = ix.byId.get(id); n; n = ix.byId.get(n.parent ?? '')) if (roots.has(n.id)) return true;
    return false;
  };
  const loud = (e: VisibleEdge) => e.status !== 'existing' || e.violation !== null || !!e.decision;
  const drawn = drawnEdges(p).filter((e) => boxes[e.from] && boxes[e.to]);
  const full: VisibleEdge[] = [];
  const faintInside: VisibleEdge[] = [];
  const trunks = new Map<string, VisibleEdge[]>();
  for (const e of drawn) {
    if (loud(e) || inRegion(e.from) || inRegion(e.to)) full.push(e);
    else if (ix.containers(e.from).length || ix.containers(e.to).length) faintInside.push(e);
    else {
      const k = `trunk:${ix.colId(e.from)}>${ix.colId(e.to)}`;
      (trunks.get(k) ?? trunks.set(k, []).get(k)!).push(e);
    }
  }

  const pathOf = (e: VisibleEdge, bundle: string): Pt[] | null => {
    const ca = ix.containers(e.from);
    const cb = ix.containers(e.to);
    const shared = ca.find((c) => cb.includes(c)) ?? null;
    const ownA = shared ? ca.slice(0, ca.indexOf(shared)) : ca;
    const ownB = shared ? cb.slice(0, cb.indexOf(shared)) : cb;
    const seg = (c: string) => (layouts.get(c)?.edges[e.id] ?? []).map((q) => abs(c, q));
    const segA = ownA.flatMap(seg);
    const segB = [...ownB].reverse().flatMap(seg);
    if (shared) return [...segA, ...seg(shared), ...segB];
    const outer = (chain: string[], self: string, other: Pt): Anchor | null => {
      const c = chain.at(-1);
      if (!c) return boxAnchor(self, other);
      const q = layouts.get(c)?.ports[portKey(e.id, c)];
      if (!q) return null;
      const pt = abs(c, q.at);
      return { p: pt, side: q.side, col: colAt(pt.x), row: rowAt(pt.y) };
    };
    const A = outer(ownA, e.from, center(e.to));
    const B = outer(ownB, e.to, center(e.from));
    if (!A || !B) return null;
    return [...segA, ...route(A, B, bundle), ...segB];
  };
  const bundleOf = (e: VisibleEdge) => {
    const top = (id: string) => ix.containers(id).at(-1) ?? id;
    return `${top(e.from)}>${top(e.to)}|${e.status}|${e.violation ?? ''}`;
  };

  const edges: FrameEdge[] = [];
  const push = (e: VisibleEdge, pts: Pt[] | null, faint: boolean, trunk: string[] | null, id = e.id, count = e.count) => {
    if (!pts || pts.length < 2) return;
    pts = dedupe(pts);
    edges.push({ id, d: roundedPath(pts, 8), status: e.status, violation: e.violation, count, steps: e.steps, mid: midpoint(pts), from: e.from, to: e.to, faint, trunk, decision: e.decision ?? null });
  };
  // Lanes are taken in a fixed order (existing, new, ghost; then faint) so they stay put as a turn adds edges.
  const rank = { existing: 0, new: 1, ghost: 2 } as const;
  for (const e of [...full].sort((a, b) => rank[a.status] - rank[b.status] || a.id.localeCompare(b.id))) push(e, pathOf(e, bundleOf(e)), false, null);
  for (const e of faintInside.sort((a, b) => a.id.localeCompare(b.id))) push(e, pathOf(e, bundleOf(e)), true, null);
  for (const [k, list] of [...trunks].sort(([a], [b]) => a.localeCompare(b))) {
    const rep = [...list].sort((a, b) => b.count - a.count || a.id.localeCompare(b.id))[0]!;
    push(rep, pathOf(rep, k), true, list.map((e) => e.id), k, list.reduce((s, e) => s + e.count, 0));
  }

  if (roots && !focus) for (const r of roots) if (boxes[r]) focus = focus ? union(focus, boxes[r]!) : boxes[r]!;
  return {
    nodes, boxes, edges, cols, rows, key,
    bounds: { x: -GAP_X / 2, y: -GAP_Y / 2, w: width + GAP_X, h: Math.max(height, ...nodes.map((n) => n.y + n.h)) + GAP_Y },
    focus,
    gutters: { x: cols.map((_, g) => colGutter(g)).concat(colGutter(cols.length)), y: rows.map((_, g) => rowGutter(g)).concat(rowGutter(rows.length)) },
  };
}

export const union = (a: Box, b: Box): Box => {
  const x = Math.min(a.x, b.x);
  const y = Math.min(a.y, b.y);
  return { x, y, w: Math.max(a.x + a.w, b.x + b.w) - x, h: Math.max(a.y + a.h, b.y + b.h) - y };
};

function dedupe(pts: Pt[]): Pt[] {
  const out: Pt[] = [];
  for (const p of pts) {
    const q = out[out.length - 1];
    if (q && Math.abs(q.x - p.x) < 0.5 && Math.abs(q.y - p.y) < 0.5) continue;
    out.push(p);
  }
  return out;
}

function midpoint(pts: Pt[]): Pt {
  let total = 0;
  for (let i = 1; i < pts.length; i++) total += Math.hypot(pts[i]!.x - pts[i - 1]!.x, pts[i]!.y - pts[i - 1]!.y);
  let half = total / 2;
  for (let i = 1; i < pts.length; i++) {
    const a = pts[i - 1]!;
    const b = pts[i]!;
    const d = Math.hypot(b.x - a.x, b.y - a.y);
    if (half <= d && d > 0) return { x: a.x + ((b.x - a.x) * half) / d, y: a.y + ((b.y - a.y) * half) / d };
    half -= d;
  }
  return pts[0]!;
}

export function roundedPath(pts: Pt[], r: number): string {
  const f = (n: number) => n.toFixed(1);
  let d = `M${f(pts[0]!.x)},${f(pts[0]!.y)}`;
  for (let i = 1; i < pts.length - 1; i++) {
    const p = pts[i - 1]!;
    const c = pts[i]!;
    const n = pts[i + 1]!;
    const d1 = Math.hypot(c.x - p.x, c.y - p.y);
    const d2 = Math.hypot(n.x - c.x, n.y - c.y);
    const rr = Math.min(r, d1 / 2, d2 / 2);
    if (rr < 0.5) { d += `L${f(c.x)},${f(c.y)}`; continue; }
    const ax = c.x - ((c.x - p.x) / d1) * rr;
    const ay = c.y - ((c.y - p.y) / d1) * rr;
    const bx = c.x + ((n.x - c.x) / d2) * rr;
    const by = c.y + ((n.y - c.y) / d2) * rr;
    d += `L${f(ax)},${f(ay)}Q${f(c.x)},${f(c.y)} ${f(bx)},${f(by)}`;
  }
  const last = pts[pts.length - 1]!;
  return `${d}L${f(last.x)},${f(last.y)}`;
}

/** Stroke width by count (aggregated edges read heavier). */
export const strokeFor = (count: number) => 1.5 + Math.min(3, Math.log2(Math.max(1, count))) * 0.75;

export { PAD };
// Per-container ELK layout (NAVIGATION_PLAN §3.3): one layered run per expanded container, bottom-up (an open group
// is laid out first and enters its cell's run as a fixed-size node with fixed ports), cached by the container's input.
// The ELK instance is injected: the browser uses elkjs's worker, tests use the bundled build in node.
import type { ElkExtendedEdge, ElkNode, ElkPort } from 'elkjs/lib/elk-api';

export type Pt = { x: number; y: number };
export type Box = { x: number; y: number; w: number; h: number };
export type Side = 'top' | 'right' | 'bottom' | 'left';

/** Fixed sizes per kind (layout never depends on zoom or text, so positions stay put). */
export const SIZE = {
  file: { w: 220, h: 42 },
  chip: { w: 220, h: 34 }, // tables, vendors, routes
  group: { w: 220, h: 50 }, // a collapsed group
} as const;
export const PAD = { top: 46, left: 18, right: 18, bottom: 18 };

export type ChildSpec = { id: string; w: number; h: number; ports: { id: string; at: Pt; side: Side }[] };
export type ContainerInput = {
  id: string;
  children: ChildSpec[]; // sorted by model order
  edges: { id: string; from: string; to: string }[]; // child ids, or a child's port id
  /** Edges leaving (out) or entering (in) this container; `node` is the child (or child port) inside it. */
  ports: { key: string; edge: string; node: string; side: Side; direction: 'out' | 'in' }[];
};

export type ContainerLayout = {
  id: string;
  w: number;
  h: number;
  nodes: Record<string, Box>; // relative to the container
  /** Every route this container draws, by projection edge id, in edge direction (child → port for out, port → child for in). */
  edges: Record<string, Pt[]>;
  ports: Record<string, { at: Pt; side: Side }>; // by port key, relative to the container
  ms: number;
};

export const portKey = (edge: string, container: string) => `${edge}|${container}`;

const ELK_SIDE = { top: 'NORTH', right: 'EAST', bottom: 'SOUTH', left: 'WEST' } as const;

export function elkGraph(c: ContainerInput): ElkNode {
  const edges: ElkExtendedEdge[] = c.edges.map((e) => ({ id: e.id, sources: [e.from], targets: [e.to] }));
  const ports: ElkPort[] = c.ports.map((p, i) => {
    edges.push(p.direction === 'out' ? { id: `pe:${i}`, sources: [p.node], targets: [p.key] } : { id: `pe:${i}`, sources: [p.key], targets: [p.node] });
    return { id: p.key, width: 2, height: 2, layoutOptions: { 'elk.port.side': ELK_SIDE[p.side], 'elk.port.index': String(i) } };
  });
  const node: ElkNode = {
    id: c.id,
    layoutOptions: {
      'elk.algorithm': 'layered',
      'elk.direction': 'RIGHT',
      'elk.edgeRouting': 'ORTHOGONAL',
      'elk.randomSeed': '1',
      'elk.portConstraints': 'FIXED_SIDE',
      'elk.layered.considerModelOrder.strategy': 'NODES_AND_EDGES',
      // Model order as a tie-break only: forcing it cost 2.6× on a 300-file cell for little extra stability.
      'elk.layered.crossingMinimization.forceNodeModelOrder': 'false',
      'elk.layered.thoroughness': c.children.length > 100 ? '3' : '7',
      'elk.padding': `[top=${PAD.top},left=${PAD.left},bottom=${PAD.bottom},right=${PAD.right}]`,
      'elk.spacing.nodeNode': '12',
      'elk.spacing.componentComponent': '14',
      'elk.layered.spacing.nodeNodeBetweenLayers': '44',
      'elk.layered.spacing.edgeNodeBetweenLayers': '14',
      'elk.spacing.edgeEdge': '8',
      'elk.aspectRatio': '1.4',
    },
    ports,
    children: c.children.map((ch) => ({
      id: ch.id,
      width: ch.w,
      height: ch.h,
      ...(ch.ports.length
        ? {
            layoutOptions: { 'elk.portConstraints': 'FIXED_POS' },
            ports: ch.ports.map((p) => ({ id: p.id, x: p.at.x - 1, y: p.at.y - 1, width: 2, height: 2, layoutOptions: { 'elk.port.side': ELK_SIDE[p.side] } })),
          }
        : {}),
    })),
    edges,
  };
  // Wrapped in a root so the container's ports are real external ports (ELK rejects edges to the root's own ports).
  return { id: `root:${c.id}`, layoutOptions: { 'elk.algorithm': 'layered', 'elk.padding': '[top=0,left=0,bottom=0,right=0]' }, children: [node] };
}

function sectionPoints(e: ElkExtendedEdge): Pt[] {
  const s = e.sections?.[0];
  if (!s) return [];
  return [s.startPoint, ...(s.bendPoints ?? []), s.endPoint].map((p) => ({ x: p.x, y: p.y }));
}

export function readLayout(c: ContainerInput, root: ElkNode, ms: number): ContainerLayout {
  const out = root.children?.[0] ?? root;
  const nodes: ContainerLayout['nodes'] = {};
  for (const n of out.children ?? []) nodes[n.id] = { x: n.x ?? 0, y: n.y ?? 0, w: n.width ?? 0, h: n.height ?? 0 };
  const edges: ContainerLayout['edges'] = {};
  const ports: ContainerLayout['ports'] = {};
  const portAt = new Map((out.ports ?? []).map((p) => [p.id, { x: (p.x ?? 0) + (p.width ?? 0) / 2, y: (p.y ?? 0) + (p.height ?? 0) / 2 }]));
  const w = out.width ?? 0;
  const h = out.height ?? 0;
  for (const p of c.ports) {
    const at = portAt.get(p.key) ?? { x: p.side === 'left' ? 0 : w, y: h / 2 };
    // snap to the border on the declared side (ELK centres a 2 px port on it)
    if (p.side === 'left') at.x = 0;
    if (p.side === 'right') at.x = w;
    if (p.side === 'top') at.y = 0;
    if (p.side === 'bottom') at.y = h;
    ports[p.key] = { at, side: p.side };
  }
  for (const e of out.edges ?? []) {
    if (e.id.startsWith('pe:')) {
      const p = c.ports[Number(e.id.slice(3))]!;
      const pts = sectionPoints(e);
      const at = ports[p.key]!.at;
      if (pts.length) pts[p.direction === 'out' ? pts.length - 1 : 0] = { ...at };
      edges[p.edge] = pts;
    } else edges[e.id] = sectionPoints(e);
  }
  return { id: c.id, w, h, nodes, edges, ports, ms };
}

export type ElkApi = { layout(g: ElkNode): Promise<ElkNode> };
export type LayoutFn = (c: ContainerInput) => Promise<ContainerLayout>;

/** A layout function over an ELK instance, cached by the container's whole input (children, sizes, edges, ports). */
export function cachedLayout(getElk: () => Promise<ElkApi>, cache = new Map<string, ContainerLayout>()): LayoutFn & { cache: Map<string, ContainerLayout> } {
  const fn = async (c: ContainerInput) => {
    const key = JSON.stringify(c);
    const hit = cache.get(key);
    if (hit) return hit;
    const api = await getElk();
    const t0 = performance.now();
    const out = await api.layout(elkGraph(c));
    const l = readLayout(c, out, performance.now() - t0);
    cache.set(key, l);
    return l;
  };
  return Object.assign(fn, { cache });
}
// The browser's ELK: elkjs's own worker script, loaded on the first layout only (v1 never pulls it in).
import type { ElkNode } from 'elkjs/lib/elk-api';
import { cachedLayout, type ElkApi } from './containers';

let elk: Promise<ElkApi> | null = null;

function getElk(): Promise<ElkApi> {
  elk ??= Promise.all([import('elkjs/lib/elk-api.js'), import('elkjs/lib/elk-worker.min.js?url')]).then(([api, url]) => {
    const ELK = api.default;
    return new ELK({ workerFactory: () => new Worker(url.default) }) as unknown as ElkApi;
  });
  return elk;
}

export const layoutContainer = cachedLayout(getElk);
export const clearLayoutCache = () => layoutContainer.cache.clear();

/** Boot the worker and JIT ELK before the first expand (the cold first layout took ~160 ms on the M1). */
export const warmElk = () =>
  getElk().then((api) => api.layout({ id: 'warm', layoutOptions: { 'elk.algorithm': 'layered' }, children: [{ id: 'a', width: 10, height: 10 }, { id: 'b', width: 10, height: 10 }], edges: [{ id: 'e', sources: ['a'], targets: ['b'] }] } as ElkNode));

import type { HarnessEvent } from '@harness/core/view';
import { useStore } from './store';

type ServerMsg =
  | { type: 'hello'; events: HarnessEvent[]; busy: boolean; session: string }
  | { type: 'event'; event: HarnessEvent }
  | { type: 'delta'; text: string }
  | { type: 'busy'; busy: boolean };

const params = new URLSearchParams(location.search);
/** Dev-only: `?fake=1` loads /fake-events.json at once, `?fake=play` streams it; `&at=N` opens the replay at N. */
export const fakeMode = params.get('fake');

export function connect() {
  if (fakeMode) return loadFake(fakeMode === 'play', fakeMode);
  void fetch('/api/info')
    .then((r) => r.json() as Promise<{ repo: string }>)
    .then((i) => useStore.getState().setRepo(i.repo))
    .catch(() => {});
  openSocket(500);
}

function openSocket(delay: number) {
  const ws = new WebSocket(`${location.protocol === 'https:' ? 'wss' : 'ws'}://${location.host}/ws`);
  let opened = false;
  ws.onopen = () => {
    opened = true;
    useStore.getState().setConn('open');
  };
  ws.onmessage = (m) => {
    const msg = JSON.parse(String(m.data)) as ServerMsg;
    const s = useStore.getState();
    if (msg.type === 'hello') s.hello(msg.events, msg.busy);
    else if (msg.type === 'event') s.append(msg.event);
    else if (msg.type === 'delta') s.addDelta(msg.text);
    else if (msg.type === 'busy') s.setBusy(msg.busy);
  };
  ws.onclose = () => {
    useStore.getState().setConn('down');
    const next = opened ? 500 : Math.min(delay * 2, 8000);
    setTimeout(() => openSocket(next), opened ? 500 : delay);
  };
}

async function loadFake(play: boolean, fakeMode: string) {
  const st = useStore.getState();
  st.setConn('fake');
  st.setRepo('scout-agent (fake turn)');
  const file = fakeMode === '1' || fakeMode === 'play' ? 'fake' : fakeMode; // `?fake=comp` → /comp-events.json
  const events = (await (await fetch(`/${file}-events.json`)).json()) as HarnessEvent[];
  const at = params.get('at');
  if (!play) {
    st.hello(events, false);
    if (at !== null) st.setReplay(Math.max(0, Math.min(events.length, Number(at))));
    return;
  }
  st.hello([], false);
  for (let i = 0; i < events.length; i++) {
    const e = events[i]!;
    const prev = events[i - 1];
    const gap = prev ? Math.max(20, Math.min(900, (e.t - prev.t) / 3)) : 0;
    await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, e.kind === 'file_assigned' ? 15 : gap));
    useStore.getState().append(e);
  }
}

async function post(path: string, body?: unknown) {
  if (fakeMode) return;
  await fetch(path, { method: 'POST', headers: { 'content-type': 'application/json' }, body: JSON.stringify(body ?? {}) });
}

export const api = {
  chat: (text: string) => post('/api/chat', { text }),
  approve: () => post('/api/approve'),
  interrupt: () => post('/api/interrupt'),
  confirmMap: () => post('/api/map/confirm'),
  fallbackMap: () => post('/api/map/fallback'),

  },
};
import { useEffect, useRef, useState } from 'react';

export const reducedMotion = () => typeof matchMedia !== 'undefined' && matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)').matches;

/** Counts up (or down) to `value` over ~400 ms whenever it changes. */
export function useTween(value: number, ms = 400): number {
  const [shown, setShown] = useState(value);
  const from = useRef(value);
  useEffect(() => {
    if (reducedMotion() || from.current === value) {
      from.current = value;
      setShown(value);
      return;
    }
    const start = performance.now();
    const a = from.current;
    let raf = 0;
    const step = (now: number) => {
      const k = Math.min(1, (now - start) / ms);
      const eased = 1 - (1 - k) ** 3;
      setShown(Math.round(a + (value - a) * eased));
      if (k < 1) raf = requestAnimationFrame(step);
      else from.current = value;
    };
    raf = requestAnimationFrame(step);
    return () => {
      cancelAnimationFrame(raf);
      from.current = value;
    };
  }, [value, ms]);
  return shown;
}

/** True for a moment after `key` changes (not on mount). */
export function useFlash(key: unknown, ms = 650): boolean {
  const [on, setOn] = useState(false);
  const first = useRef(true);
  useEffect(() => {
    if (first.current) {
      first.current = false;
      return;
    }
    setOn(true);
    const t = setTimeout(() => setOn(false), ms);
    return () => clearTimeout(t);
  }, [key, ms]);
  return on;
}

export function useSize<T extends HTMLElement>() {
  const ref = useRef<T>(null);
  const [size, setSize] = useState({ w: 0, h: 0 });
  useEffect(() => {
    const el = ref.current;
    if (!el) return;
    const ro = new ResizeObserver(([e]) => {
      if (e) setSize({ w: e.contentRect.width, h: e.contentRect.height });
    });
    ro.observe(el);
    return () => ro.disconnect();
  }, []);
  return [ref, size] as const;
}

  goBack(): void;
  goForward(): void;

  publish(p: { nodes: VisibleNode[]; edges: VisibleEdge[]; hot: Record<string, string[]>; symbols: Record<string, number>; columns: Record<string, string[]>; cursor: ProjectionCursor | null }): void;
};

const same = (a: unknown, b: unknown) => a === b || JSON.stringify(a) === JSON.stringify(b);
const samePlace = (a: Place, b: Place) => a.focus === b.focus && a.open.join() === b.open.join();
const HISTORY = 50;

export const useV2 = create<V2Store>((set, get) => ({
  open: (params.get('expand') ?? '').split(',').filter(Boolean).map((d) => (d.includes(':') ? d : `domain:${d}`)),
  focus: null,
  back: [],
  forward: [],
  theme: initialTheme,
  minimap: readMinimap(),
  palette: false,
  fly: null,
  nodes: {},
  edges: {},
  hot: {},
  symbols: {},
  columns: {},
  cursor: null,

  go: (next, fly = null) => {
    const s = get();
    const cur: Place = { open: s.open, focus: s.focus };
    const to: Place = { open: next.open ?? s.open, focus: next.focus === undefined ? s.focus : next.focus };
    if (samePlace(cur, to)) { if (fly) set({ fly }); return; }
    set({ ...to, back: [...s.back, cur].slice(-HISTORY), forward: [], fly });
  },
  setFocus: (focus) => set({ focus }),
  goBack: () => {
    const s = get();
    const prev = s.back.at(-1);
    if (!prev) return;
    set({ ...prev, back: s.back.slice(0, -1), forward: [{ open: s.open, focus: s.focus }, ...s.forward], fly: prev.focus });
  },
  goForward: () => {
    const s = get();
    const next = s.forward[0];
    if (!next) return;
    set({ ...next, forward: s.forward.slice(1), back: [...s.back, { open: s.open, focus: s.focus }], fly: next.focus });
  },
  setPalette: (palette) => set({ palette }),
  toggleMinimap: () => set((s) => {
    try { localStorage.setItem('harness.minimap', s.minimap ? '0' : '1'); } catch { /* private mode */ }
    return { minimap: !s.minimap };
  }),
  publish: (p) => {
    const prev = get();
    const nodes: Record<string, VisibleNode> = {};
    for (const n of p.nodes) {
      const o = prev.nodes[n.id];
      nodes[n.id] = o && same(o, n) ? o : n;
    }
    const edges: Record<string, VisibleEdge> = {};
    for (const e of p.edges) {
      const o = prev.edges[e.id];
      edges[e.id] = o && same(o, e) ? o : e;
    }
    const hot: Record<string, string[]> = {};
    for (const [k, v] of Object.entries(p.hot)) hot[k] = prev.hot[k] && same(prev.hot[k], v) ? prev.hot[k]! : v;
    set({ nodes, edges, hot, symbols: same(prev.symbols, p.symbols) ? prev.symbols : p.symbols, columns: same(prev.columns, p.columns) ? prev.columns : p.columns, cursor: same(prev.cursor, p.cursor) ? prev.cursor : p.cursor });
  },

/** The scene for the current events, replay index, selected turn and open set. */
export function useScene(): Scene | null {

  const open = useV2((s) => s.open);
  const graph = useMemo(() => memoGraph(v.ui), [v.ui]);
  return useMemo(() => (graph ? sceneOf(v.ui, graph, v.turn?.id ?? null, open) : null), [v.ui, v.turn, graph, open]);
}
// Map between v2 node ids and the shell's inspector selection (shared with v1, so the inspector stays one component).
import type { VisibleNode } from '@harness/core/view';
import type { Selection } from '../store';

export function selectionFor(n: Pick<VisibleNode, 'id' | 'kind' | 'domain' | 'layer'>): Selection {
  if (n.kind === 'cell') return { cell: `${n.domain}/${n.layer}` };
  if (n.kind === 'file') return { file: n.id };
  if (n.id === 'unassigned') return { unassigned: true };
  return { node: n.id };
}

/** The node a selection points at (edges select no node). */
export function selectedNode(s: Selection | null): string | null {
  if (!s) return null;
  if ('cell' in s) return `cell:${s.cell}`;
  if ('file' in s) return s.file;
  if ('node' in s) return s.node;
  if ('unassigned' in s) return 'unassigned';
  return null;
}

export const selectedEdge = (s: Selection | null): string | null => (s && 'link' in s ? s.link : null);

327	      for (const ed of p.edges) turn.plannedEdges[edgeKey(ed.from, ed.to)] = ed;
328	      turn.unassigned = p.unassigned;

331	      break;
332	    }
333	    case 'plan_violation': {

336	      turn?.violationsSeen.push({ v: violation, source: 'plan' });

338	    }
339	    case 'gate_blocked': {
340	      const { violation } = d as EventData['gate_blocked'];

344	    }
345	    case 'fork_asked': {
346	      const { violations } = d as EventData['fork_asked'];
347	      s.pendingFork = { turn: e.turn, violations };

350	    }
351	    case 'fork_answered': {

355	      if (f) { f.answered = index; f.option = option; f.beforeCode = f.beforeCode && turn!.firstEditAt === null; }

357	      break;
358	    }
359	    case 'approval_requested':
360	      s.awaitingApproval = { turn: e.turn, plan: (d as EventData['approval_requested']).plan };
361	      break;
362	    case 'plan_approved':
363	      s.awaitingApproval = null;
364	      if (turn) turn.approved = true;
365	      break;
366	    case 'edited': {
367	      const ed = d as EventData['edited'];
368	      if (s.cursor && e.path && !ed.unattributed) s.cursor = { cell: e.cell ?? null, path: e.path, verb: 'editing' };
369	      if (!turn || !e.path) break;
370	      if (turn.firstEditAt === null) turn.firstEditAt = index;
371	      const pa = pathActivity(turn, e.path);
372	      pa.added += ed.added;
373	      pa.removed += ed.removed;
374	      pa.edits += 1;
375	      if (ed.created) pa.created = true;
376	      if (ed.unattributed) pa.unattributed = true;
377	      if (ed.symbols) pa.symbols = mergeSymbols(pa.symbols, ed.symbols);
378	      const placement = s.files[e.path];
379	      if (placement?.kind === 'test') { push(turn.tests, placement.domain, e.path); break; }
380	      if (!e.cell) { if (!turn.unassigned.includes(e.path)) turn.unassigned.push(e.path); break; }
381	      const k = cellKey(e.cell);
382	      const c = (turn.edited[k] ??= { added: 0, removed: 0, files: [], created: [], unattributed: false });
383	      c.added += ed.added;
384	      c.removed += ed.removed;
385	      if (!c.files.includes(e.path)) c.files.push(e.path);
386	      if (ed.created && !c.created.includes(e.path)) c.created.push(e.path);
387	      if (ed.unattributed) c.unattributed = true;

395	      if (!cur.files.some((f) => f.from === edge.from && f.to === edge.to)) cur.files.push(edge);
396	      push(s.edgeOrigin, k, { turn: e.turn, at: index });
397	      turn?.edgesAdded.push({ from, to, edge });
398	      break;
399	    }
400	    case 'edge_removed': {
401	      const { edge, from, to } = d as EventData['edge_removed'];
402	      const k = edgeKey(from, to);
403	      const cur = s.edges[k];
404	      if (cur) {
405	        cur.files = cur.files.filter((f) => !(f.from === edge.from && f.to === edge.to));
406	        if (!cur.files.length) delete s.edges[k];

408	      turn?.edgesRemoved.push({ from, to, edge });

410	    }
411	    case 'decision_recorded': {

414	      if (existing) Object.assign(existing, dec); // the Alike confirmation re-emits with alike: true
415	      else s.decisions.push({ ...dec, turn: e.turn, at: index, session: e.session });
416	      if (turn && !turn.decisions.includes(dec.id)) turn.decisions.push(dec.id);

418	    }
419	    case 'turn_ended': {

421	      const { added, removed } = d as EventData['turn_ended'];
422	      turn.endedAt = e.t;
423	      turn.numstat = { added, removed };
424	      s.awaitingApproval = null;
425	      if (s.current === turn.id) s.cursor = null;
426	      break;
427	    }
428	    case 'error':

430	      break;
431	    case 'test_result':

433	  }
434	  return s;
435	}

437	/** 1-based session number for "decided in session N", or 0 if unknown. */
438	export const sessionNumber = (s: UIState, session: string) => s.sessions.indexOf(session) + 1;
439	
440	/** UI state = reduce(events). Replay is `reduce(events, i)`: the state after the first `i` events. */
441	export function reduce(events: readonly HarnessEvent[], upTo = events.length): UIState {
442	  const s = initialState();
443	  const n = Math.min(upTo, events.length);
444	  for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) apply(s, events[i]!, i);
445	  return s;
446	}

450	export type CellView = {
451	  cell: Cell;
452	  looked: boolean;
453	  edited: boolean;
454	  ghost: number[] | null; // planned step numbers while not yet edited
455	  unplanned: boolean; // amber: edited but not in this turn's plan
456	  violation: 'existing' | 'new' | null;
457	  violationFiles: string[];
458	  newViolationFiles: string[];
459	  added: number;
460	  removed: number;
461	};
462	
463	/** Per-cell visual state for one turn (defaults to the latest), plus load-time violations. */
464	export function cellViews(s: UIState, turnId: string | null = s.turns.at(-1)?.id ?? null): Record<string, CellView> {
465	  const out: Record<string, CellView> = {};
466	  const map = s.map;
467	  if (!map) return out;
468	  const turn = turnId ? s.turns.find((t) => t.id === turnId) ?? null : null;
469	  const hasPlan = !!turn && Object.keys(turn.planned).length > 0;
470	
471	  for (const dom of map.domains) {
472	    for (const layer of map.layers) {
473	      if (!(layer.id in dom.cells)) continue;
474	      const cell = { domain: dom.id, layer: layer.id };
475	      const k = cellKey(cell);
476	      const edited = turn?.edited[k];
477	      const planned = turn?.planned[k];
478	      out[k] = {
479	        cell,
480	        looked: !!turn?.looked[k]?.length,
481	        edited: !!edited,
482	        ghost: planned && !edited ? planned.steps : null,
483	        unplanned: hasPlan && !!edited && !planned,
484	        violation: null,
485	        violationFiles: [],
486	        newViolationFiles: [],
487	        added: edited?.added ?? 0,
488	        removed: edited?.removed ?? 0,
489	      };
490	    }
491	  }
492	  const mark = (file: string, isNew: boolean, planCell?: Cell) => {
493	    const p = s.files[file];
494	    const cell = p?.kind === 'cell' ? { domain: p.domain, layer: p.layer } : planCell;
495	    if (!cell) return;
496	    const v = out[cellKey(cell)];
497	    if (!v) return;
498	    if (isNew) {
499	      v.violation = 'new';
500	      if (!v.newViolationFiles.includes(file)) v.newViolationFiles.push(file);
501	    } else {
502	      v.violation ??= 'existing';
503	      if (!v.violationFiles.includes(file)) v.violationFiles.push(file);
504	    }
505	  };
506	  for (const v of s.violations) mark(v.file, false);
507	  if (turn) {
508	    const plannedCellOf = (file: string) => Object.values(turn.planned).find((c) => c.files.includes(file))?.cell;
509	    for (const v of [...turn.planViolations, ...turn.gateBlocks]) {
510	      if (s.violations.some((x) => x.file === v.file && x.invariant === v.invariant)) continue; // already on the map before this turn
511	      mark(v.file, true, plannedCellOf(v.file));
512	    }
513	  }
514	  return out;
515	}
516	
517	export type EdgeView = {
518	  from: string;
519	  to: string;
520	  state: 'existing' | 'ghost' | 'new';
521	  violation: boolean;
522	  steps: number[];
523	  files: ImportEdge[];
524	};

526	/**
527	 * Edges for one turn. A planned edge always gets its own `ghost` entry, even when a solid edge between the same
528	 * domains exists, so a plan that repeats an existing violation still looks different from the map before the turn.
529	 */
530	export function edgeViews(s: UIState, turnId: string | null = s.turns.at(-1)?.id ?? null): EdgeView[] {
531	  const turn = turnId ? s.turns.find((t) => t.id === turnId) ?? null : null;
532	  const violating = (from: string, files: ImportEdge[], list: Violation[]) =>
533	    list.some((v) => files.some((f) => f.from === v.file && (!v.target || v.target === f.to)));
534	  const out: EdgeView[] = [];
535	  const addedThisTurn = new Set(turn?.edgesAdded.map((x) => edgeKey(x.from, x.to)) ?? []);
536	  for (const [k, e] of Object.entries(s.edges)) {
537	    out.push({ from: e.from, to: e.to, state: addedThisTurn.has(k) ? 'new' : 'existing', violation: violating(e.from, e.files, s.violations), steps: [], files: e.files });
538	  }
539	  if (turn) {
540	    for (const pe of Object.values(turn.plannedEdges)) {
541	      const built = pe.imports.every((imp) => s.edges[edgeKey(pe.from, pe.to)]?.files.some((f) => f.from === imp.from && f.to === imp.to));
542	      if (built) continue;
543	      out.push({ from: pe.from, to: pe.to, state: 'ghost', violation: violating(pe.from, pe.imports, turn.planViolations), steps: pe.steps, files: pe.imports });
544	    }
545	  }
546	  return out;
547	}

549	/** Decisions and turns behind an edge or a cell, for the inspector. */
550	export function provenance(s: UIState, target: { edge: string } | { cell: string }) {
551	  const origins = 'edge' in target ? s.edgeOrigin[target.edge] ?? [] : s.cellOrigin[target.cell] ?? [];
552	  const turnIds = [...new Set(origins.map((o) => o.turn).filter((x): x is string => !!x))];
553	  const turns = turnIds.map((id) => ({ id, index: s.turns.findIndex((t) => t.id === id) + 1, prompt: s.turns.find((t) => t.id === id)?.prompt ?? '' }));
554	  const decisions = s.decisions.filter((d) => d.turn && turnIds.includes(d.turn));
555	  return { turns, decisions };
556	}

// The v2 map (N3/N4): the real pipeline (reduce → graphOf → activityFor → project), per-container ELK in a worker,
// the deterministic grid, one SVG layer of precomputed edges, staged FLIP transitions and a van Wijk camera, on a
// React Flow viewport with memoized DOM nodes. Navigation: expand in place, breadcrumbs, history, ⌘K, arrows, minimap.
import { memo, useCallback, useEffect, useLayoutEffect, useMemo, useRef, useState } from 'react';
import { flushSync } from 'react-dom';
import { Background, BackgroundVariant, MiniMap, ReactFlow, ReactFlowProvider, ViewportPortal, useReactFlow, useStore as useFlow, useStoreApi, type Node, type Viewport } from '@xyflow/react';
import '@xyflow/react/dist/base.css';
import '@fontsource/barlow/300.css';
import '@fontsource/barlow/400-italic.css';
import '@fontsource/barlow/700.css';
import '@fontsource/jetbrains-mono/600.css';
import './v2.css';
import { fileOf, type Rollup } from '@harness/core/view';
import { useView } from '../derive';
import { useStore } from '../store';
import { buildFrame, GAP_X, layoutAll, strokeFor, union, UNASSIGNED, UNASSIGNED_COL, type Frame, type FrameEdge, type FrameNode } from './layout/frame';
import { clearLayoutCache, layoutContainer, warmElk } from './layout/elk';
import type { Box } from './layout/containers';
import { dive, neighbour, up, type Dir } from './nav';
import { NavBar } from './NavBar';
import { nodeTypes, useLod } from './nodes';
import { Palette } from './Palette';
import { hotLabels, useScene, type Scene } from './pipeline';
import { selectedEdge, selectedNode, selectionFor } from './select';
import { useV2 } from './store';
import { Transitioner, reducedMotion, T_MOVE, type Enter, type TransitionStats } from './transition';

const params = new URLSearchParams(location.search);
export const COMP = params.has('comp');

export type Insets = { top: number; right: number; bottom: number; left: number };
const DEFAULT_INSETS: Insets = { top: 116, right: 28, bottom: 24, left: 96 };

type Shown = { frame: Frame; enter: Enter };
type Stats = { layoutMs: number; pipelineMs: number; elk: { id: string; files: number; ms: number }[]; transition: TransitionStats | null };

export default function MapV2({ insets = DEFAULT_INSETS, chrome = true }: { insets?: Insets; chrome?: boolean }) {
  return (
    <ReactFlowProvider>
      <Inner insets={insets} chrome={chrome} />
    </ReactFlowProvider>
  );
}

/**
 * Fit a box, but never below `minZoom` (projector legibility: 16 px file labels stay at 13 px or more). When the box
 * does not fit at that zoom, centre on `anchor` (the agent, or the target) and keep the box's top-left in view.
 */
function viewportFor(b: Box, W: number, H: number, ins: Insets, opts: { maxZoom?: number; minZoom?: number; anchor?: Box } = {}): Viewport {
  const aw = Math.max(50, W - ins.left - ins.right);
  const ah = Math.max(50, H - ins.top - ins.bottom);
  const fit = Math.min(opts.maxZoom ?? 1.25, aw / b.w, ah / b.h);
  const zoom = Math.max(0.08, opts.minZoom ? Math.max(fit, opts.minZoom) : fit);
  if (zoom === fit || !opts.minZoom) return { zoom, x: ins.left + (aw - b.w * zoom) / 2 - b.x * zoom, y: ins.top + (ah - b.h * zoom) / 2 - b.y * zoom };
  const a = opts.anchor ?? b;
  const axis = (start: number, size: number, aStart: number, aSize: number, avail: number, inset: number) => {
    if (size * zoom <= avail) return inset + (avail - size * zoom) / 2 - start * zoom;
    const centred = inset + avail / 2 - (aStart + aSize / 2) * zoom;
    return Math.min(inset - start * zoom, Math.max(inset + avail - (start + size) * zoom, centred));
  };
  return { zoom, x: axis(b.x, b.w, a.x, a.w, aw, ins.left), y: axis(b.y, b.h, a.y, a.h, ah, ins.top) };
}

/** Zoom floor for views below System level (16 px file labels at 0.82 are about 13 px). */
const READABLE = 0.82;

/** Roots of the focus region: the selected node, else what is open, else everything (null). */
function regionOf(scene: Scene, sel: string | null): string[] | null {
  const ids = new Set(scene.projection.nodes.map((n) => n.id));
  if (sel && ids.has(sel)) return [sel];
  const open = scene.open.filter((id) => ids.has(id));
  if (open.length) return open;
  // A plan that declines an approach (beat 4): the struck-through edge leads; quiet edges recede to trunks.
  return scene.projection.edges.some((e) => e.decision) ? [] : null;
}

function Inner({ insets, chrome }: { insets: Insets; chrome: boolean }) {
  const scene = useScene();
  const v = useView();
  const rf = useReactFlow();
  const rootRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
  const [shown, setShown] = useState<Shown | null>(null);
  const stats = useRef<Stats>({ layoutMs: 0, pipelineMs: 0, elk: [], transition: null });
  const insetsRef = useRef(insets);
  insetsRef.current = insets;
  const sel = useStore((s) => selectedNode(s.selection));
  const sceneRef = useSceneRef;
  sceneRef.current = scene;

  const flyTo = useCallback((b: Box, animate: boolean, opts?: Parameters<typeof viewportFor>[4]) => {
    const el = rootRef.current;
    if (!el) return;
    const { width: W, height: H } = el.getBoundingClientRect();
    if (!W || !H) return;
    const ins = insetsRef.current;
    const inspector = useStore.getState().selection ? 400 : 0; // the inspector panel covers the right of the stage
    void rf.setViewport(viewportFor(b, W, H, { ...ins, right: ins.right + inspector }, opts), { duration: animate && !reducedMotion() ? T_MOVE + 150 : 0, interpolate: "smooth" });
  }, [rf]);

  const camera = useCallback((next: Frame, prev: Frame | null, animate: boolean) => {
    const fly = useV2.getState().fly;
    const target = fly ? next.boxes[fly] : undefined;
    if (target) {
      useV2.setState({ fly: null });
      flyTo(pad(next.focus ? union(next.focus, target) : target, 30), animate, { minZoom: READABLE, anchor: pad(target, 40) });
      return;
    }
    if (prev && prev.key === next.key) return; // the camera moves when the view changes, not on every event
    if (!next.focus) return flyTo(next.bounds, animate);
    const c = useV2.getState().cursor;
    const at = c ? next.boxes[c.node] : undefined;
    const inFocus = !!at && at.x >= next.focus.x && at.x <= next.focus.x + next.focus.w;
    flyTo(pad(next.focus, 30), animate, { minZoom: READABLE, anchor: inFocus && at ? pad(at, 60) : { ...next.focus, h: 1 } });
  }, [flyTo]);

  const tr = useMemo(() => new Transitioner({
    root: () => rootRef.current,
    commit: (frame, enter) => flushSync(() => {
      const s = sceneRef.current;
      if (s) publish(s);
      setShown({ frame, enter });
    }),
    camera,
  }), [camera]);

  // Lay out every expanded container (worker, cached, bottom-up), then hand the frame to the transitioner.
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!scene || !v.ui.map) return;
    let live = true;
    const map = v.ui.map;
    const t0 = performance.now();
    void layoutAll(scene.projection, layoutContainer).then((layouts) => {
      if (!live) return;
      stats.current.layoutMs = performance.now() - t0;
      stats.current.elk = [...layouts.values()].map((l) => ({ id: l.id, files: Object.keys(l.nodes).length, ms: +l.ms.toFixed(1) }));
      const meta = { domains: map.domains.map((d) => ({ id: d.id, name: d.name, purpose: d.purpose })), layers: map.layers.map((l) => ({ id: l.id, name: l.name })) };
      tr.go(buildFrame({ projection: scene.projection, meta, layouts, region: regionOf(scene, sel), key: scene.key }));
    });
    return () => { live = false; };
  }, [scene, sel, tr, v.ui.map]);

  // A fly request for a node already on screen (history, breadcrumbs to the same layout).
  const fly = useV2((s) => s.fly);
  useEffect(() => {
    const f = tr.shown;
    if (!fly || !f?.boxes[fly] || f.key !== sceneRef.current?.key) return;
    useV2.setState({ fly: null });
    flyTo(pad(f.focus ? union(f.focus, f.boxes[fly]!) : f.boxes[fly]!, 30), true, { minZoom: READABLE, anchor: pad(f.boxes[fly]!, 40) });
  }, [fly, tr, flyTo, shown]);

  useEffect(() => () => tr.cancel(), [tr]);
  useEffect(() => { void warmElk(); }, []);
  useKeys(tr, rootRef);
  useBenchApi(tr, stats, rf);

  const rfNodes = useMemo<Node[]>(() => {
    if (!shown) return [];
    const { frame, enter } = shown;
    return frame.nodes.map((n) => ({
      id: n.id,
      type: n.type,
      position: { x: n.x, y: n.y },
      data: {},
      width: n.w,
      height: n.h,
      style: { width: n.w, height: n.h },
      zIndex: n.z,
      draggable: false,
      selectable: false,
      connectable: false,
      focusable: n.type !== 'band',
      ariaLabel: ariaFor(n),
      className: enter.nodes.has(n.id) ? 'v2-enter' : undefined,
    }));
  }, [shown]);

  const select = useStore((s) => s.select);
  const onNodeClick = useCallback((ev: React.MouseEvent, node: Node) => {
    ev.stopPropagation();
    const n = useV2.getState().nodes[node.id];
    if (!n) return;
    useV2.getState().setFocus(node.id);
    const cur = useStore.getState().selection;
    select(selectedNode(cur) === node.id ? null : selectionFor(n));
  }, [select]);
  const onNodeDoubleClick = useCallback((_: unknown, node: Node) => {
    const s = sceneRef.current;
    if (!s) return;
    const st = useV2.getState();
    const id = node.id.startsWith('band:') ? UNASSIGNED : node.id;
    st.go(dive(s.graph, { open: st.open, focus: st.focus }, id));
  }, []);

  const theme = useV2((s) => s.theme);
  const minimap = useV2((s) => s.minimap);
  const open = useV2((s) => s.open);
  return (
    <div ref={rootRef} className={`v2-map theme-${theme}`} data-theme={theme}>
      <ReactFlow
        nodes={rfNodes}
        edges={[]}
        nodeTypes={nodeTypes}
        nodesDraggable={false}
        nodesConnectable={false}
        elementsSelectable={false}
        zoomOnDoubleClick={false}
        onNodeDoubleClick={onNodeDoubleClick}
        onNodeClick={onNodeClick}
        onPaneClick={() => select(null)}
        minZoom={0.08}
        maxZoom={2.5}
        proOptions={{ hideAttribution: COMP }}
        onlyRenderVisibleElements={params.get('visible') === '1'}
      >
        {theme === 'control' && <Background variant={BackgroundVariant.Dots} gap={28} size={1.3} color="var(--v2-dots)" />}
        {shown && (
          <ViewportPortal>
            <EdgeLayer frame={shown.frame} enter={shown.enter} />
            <RejectedTop frame={shown.frame} />
            <Cursor frame={shown.frame} />
          </ViewportPortal>
        )}
        {chrome && minimap && open.length > 0 && (
          <MiniMap
            className="v2-minimap"
            style={{ width: 168, height: 108 }}
            pannable
            zoomable
            ariaLabel="Minimap"
            nodeColor={(n) => miniColor(n.id, n.type)}
            nodeStrokeWidth={0}
            maskColor="var(--v2-mini-mask)"
          />
        )}
      </ReactFlow>
      {shown && <Headers frame={shown.frame} insets={insets} />}
      {chrome && <NavBar />}
      {chrome && <Palette />}
      {!v.ui.map && <Empty />}
    </div>
  );
}

const pad = (b: Box, p: number): Box => ({ x: b.x - p, y: b.y - p, w: b.w + 2 * p, h: b.h + 2 * p });

function ariaFor(n: FrameNode): string {
  const vn = useV2.getState().nodes[n.id];
  if (!vn) return n.id;
  return `${vn.kind} ${vn.label}${vn.rollup.violation ? `, crosses ${vn.rollup.rules.join(' ')}` : ''}${vn.rollup.edited ? ', edited' : ''}`;
}

function miniColor(id: string, type: string | undefined): string {
  const n = useV2.getState().nodes[id];
  if (type === 'band') return 'var(--v2-mini-band)';
  if (!n) return 'var(--v2-mini-node)';
  const r = n.rollup;
  if (r.violation === 'new') return 'var(--v2-red)';
  if (r.cursor) return 'var(--v2-agent)';
  if (r.edited) return r.unplanned ? 'var(--v2-amber)' : 'var(--v2-agent)';
  if (r.violation) return 'var(--v2-red-wash)';
  return 'var(--v2-mini-node)';
}

/** Publish the projection by id (structural sharing) so node components re-render only for their own changes. */
function publish(s: Scene) {
  const symbols: Record<string, number> = {};
  for (const n of s.projection.nodes) {
    if (n.kind !== 'file') continue;
    const d = s.activity.leaves[n.id]?.symbols;
    const k = d ? new Set([...d.added, ...d.removed, ...d.sig, ...d.body, ...d.renamed.map((r) => r[1])]).size : 0;
    if (k) symbols[n.id] = k;
  }
  const columns: Record<string, string[]> = {};
  for (const n of s.projection.nodes) {
    const c = n.kind === 'table' ? s.graph.nodes[n.id]?.columns : undefined;
    if (c?.length) columns[n.id] = c;
  }
  useV2.getState().publish({ columns, nodes: s.projection.nodes, edges: s.projection.edges, hot: hotLabels(s.graph, s.activity, s.projection), symbols, cursor: s.projection.cursor });
}


// ---------------------------------------------------------------- keyboard: Enter dives, Esc goes up, arrows move, ⌘K, ⌘[ ⌘], m

function useKeys(tr: Transitioner, rootRef: React.RefObject<HTMLDivElement>) {
  useEffect(() => {
    const onKey = (e: KeyboardEvent) => {
      const target = e.target as HTMLElement | null;
      const typing = !!target?.closest('textarea, input, [contenteditable]');
      const st = useV2.getState();
      const meta = e.metaKey || e.ctrlKey;
      if (meta && e.key.toLowerCase() === 'k') { e.preventDefault(); st.setPalette(!st.palette); return; }
      if (typing || st.palette) return;
      if (meta && e.key === '[') { e.preventDefault(); st.goBack(); return; }
      if (meta && e.key === ']') { e.preventDefault(); st.goForward(); return; }
      if (meta || e.altKey) return;
      const scene = useSceneRef.current;
      if (!scene) return;
      const place = { open: st.open, focus: st.focus };
      if (e.key === 'Escape') {
        if (useStore.getState().selection) return; // the inspector closes first
        e.preventDefault();
        st.go(up(scene.graph, place));
      } else if (e.key === 'Enter') {
        const id = target?.closest<HTMLElement>('.react-flow__node')?.dataset.id ?? st.focus;
        if (!id) return;
        e.preventDefault();
        st.go(dive(scene.graph, place, id.startsWith('band:') ? UNASSIGNED : id));
      } else if (e.key.startsWith('Arrow')) {
        const f = tr.shown;
        if (!f) return;
        const dir = e.key.slice(5).toLowerCase() as Dir;
        const next = neighbour(f, st.focus, dir);
        if (!next) return;
        e.preventDefault();
        st.setFocus(next);
        rootRef.current?.querySelector<HTMLElement>(`.react-flow__node[data-id="${CSS.escape(next)}"]`)?.focus({ preventScroll: true });
      } else if (e.key === 'm') st.toggleMinimap();
    };
    window.addEventListener('keydown', onKey, true);
    return () => window.removeEventListener('keydown', onKey, true);
  }, [tr, rootRef]);
}

/** The latest scene for event handlers outside React's render (keyboard, palette, headers). */
export const useSceneRef: { current: Scene | null } = { current: null };

// ---------------------------------------------------------------- edges: one SVG of precomputed paths

const EdgeLayer = memo(function EdgeLayer({ frame, enter }: { frame: Frame; enter: Enter }) {
  const lod = useLod();
  const sel = useStore((s) => selectedEdge(s.selection));
  const select = useStore((s) => s.select);
  return (
    <svg className="v2-edges" width={1} height={1}>
      <defs>
        {(['existing', 'new', 'ghost', 'violation', 'rejected'] as const).map((k) => (
          <marker key={k} id={`v2-arrow-${k}`} viewBox="0 0 10 10" refX="9" refY="5" markerWidth="8" markerHeight="8" markerUnits="userSpaceOnUse" orient="auto-start-reverse">
            <path d="M0,1 L9,5 L0,9 z" className={`v2-arrowhead is-${k}`} />
          </marker>
        ))}
      </defs>
      <path className="v2-ticks" d={frame.gutters.x.flatMap((x) => frame.gutters.y.map((y) => `M${x - 6},${y}h12M${x},${y - 6}v12`)).join('')} />
      {frame.edges.map((e) => {
        if (e.decision) return <Rejected key={e.id} e={e} enter={enter} sel={sel} onSelect={() => select(sel === e.id ? null : { link: e.id })} />;
        const kind = e.violation ? 'violation' : e.status;
        const entering = enter.edges.has(e.id);
        const id = e.trunk ? e.trunk[0]! : e.id;
        return (
          <g
            key={entering ? `${e.id}#${enter.seq}` : e.id}
            data-edge={e.id}
            className={`v2-edge is-${e.status} ${e.violation ? `is-violation is-violation-${e.violation}` : ''} ${e.faint ? 'is-faint' : ''} ${e.trunk ? 'is-trunk' : ''} ${entering ? 'is-enter' : ''} ${sel === id ? 'is-selected' : ''}`}
            onClick={(ev) => { ev.stopPropagation(); select(sel === id ? null : { link: id }); }}
          >
            <title>{e.trunk ? `${e.count} imports between these columns` : `${e.count} ${e.count === 1 ? 'link' : 'links'}`}</title>
            <path className="v2-edge-hit" d={e.d} />
            <path
              className="v2-edge-line"
              d={e.d}
              style={{ strokeWidth: e.faint ? undefined : strokeFor(e.count) }}
              markerEnd={e.trunk ? undefined : `url(#v2-arrow-${kind})`}
              {...(entering && e.status !== 'ghost' ? { pathLength: 1 } : {})}
            />
            {enter.pulse.has(e.id) && !reducedMotion() && <Pulse key={enter.seq} d={e.d} />}
            {lod !== 'far' && (e.count > 1 || e.steps.length > 0) && (
              <g className="v2-edge-tag" transform={`translate(${e.mid.x.toFixed(1)},${e.mid.y.toFixed(1)})`}>
                <rect x={-13} y={-10} width={26} height={20} rx={10} />
                <text textAnchor="middle" dy="0.35em">{e.steps.length ? e.steps.join(',') : e.count}</text>
              </g>
            )}
          </g>
        );
      })}
    </svg>
  );
});

export const rejectedLabel = (d: { id: string; session: number }) => `rejected in ${d.id}${d.session ? `, session ${d.session}` : ''}`;

/**
 * Beat 4's hero: an approach a standing decision rules out. Drawn struck through in ink (not red: nothing is being
 * crossed, it is being declined), with a slash across its middle and a label that stays readable at any zoom.
 */
function Rejected({ e, enter, sel, onSelect }: { e: FrameEdge; enter: Enter; sel: string | null; onSelect: () => void }) {
  return (
    <g data-edge={e.id} className={`v2-edge is-rejected ${enter.edges.has(e.id) ? 'is-enter' : ''} ${sel === e.id ? 'is-selected' : ''}`} onClick={(ev) => { ev.stopPropagation(); onSelect(); }}>
      <title>{`${rejectedLabel(e.decision!)}: ${e.count} planned ${e.count === 1 ? 'link' : 'links'} not built`}</title>
      <path className="v2-edge-hit" d={e.d} />
      <path className="v2-edge-line" d={e.d} markerEnd="url(#v2-arrow-rejected)" />
    </g>
  );
}

/** The strike and the label of rejected edges, above the nodes and at a constant on-screen size (about 15 px). */
function RejectedTop({ frame }: { frame: Frame }) {
  const k = useFlow((s) => s.transform[2]);
  const sel = useStore((s) => selectedEdge(s.selection));
  const select = useStore((s) => s.select);
  const list = frame.edges.filter((e) => e.decision);
  if (!list.length) return null;
  const z = 1 / Math.max(k, 0.2);
  return (
    <svg className="v2-edges is-top" width={1} height={1}>
      {list.map((e) => {
        const label = rejectedLabel(e.decision!);
        const fs = 15 * z;
        const w = label.length * fs * 0.5 + 24 * z;
        const h = 28 * z;
        const s = 10 * z;
        const { x, y } = e.mid;
        return (
          <g key={e.id} className={`v2-rejected ${sel === e.id ? 'is-selected' : ''}`} onClick={(ev) => { ev.stopPropagation(); select(sel === e.id ? null : { link: e.id }); }}>
            <path className="v2-strike" d={`M${x - s},${y + s}L${x + s},${y - s}M${x - s + 7 * z},${y + s}L${x + s + 7 * z},${y - s}`} style={{ strokeWidth: 3.5 * z }} />
            <g transform={`translate(${(x - w / 2).toFixed(1)},${(y - h - 14 * z).toFixed(1)})`} className="v2-rejected-tag">
              <rect width={w} height={h} rx={h / 2} />
              <text x={w / 2} y={h / 2} dy="0.35em" textAnchor="middle" style={{ fontSize: fs }}>{label}</text>
            </g>
          </g>
        );
      })}
    </svg>
  );
}

/** One dot that travels once along an edge that was just added (never loops). */
function Pulse({ d }: { d: string }) {
  const ref = useRef<SVGCircleElement>(null);
  useEffect(() => {
    const c = ref.current;
    if (!c) return;
    const path = document.createElementNS('http://www.w3.org/2000/svg', 'path');
    path.setAttribute('d', d);
    const len = path.getTotalLength();
    const t0 = performance.now() + 320; // after the draw-in starts
    let raf = 0;
    const step = (t: number) => {
      const k = Math.max(0, Math.min(1, (t - t0) / 900));
      const p = path.getPointAtLength(len * (1 - (1 - k) ** 2));
      c.setAttribute('cx', p.x.toFixed(1));
      c.setAttribute('cy', p.y.toFixed(1));
      c.style.opacity = String(k < 0.85 ? 1 : (1 - k) / 0.15);
      if (k < 1) raf = requestAnimationFrame(step);
    };
    raf = requestAnimationFrame(step);
    return () => cancelAnimationFrame(raf);
  }, [d]);
  return <circle ref={ref} className="v2-pulse" r={5} cx={-9999} cy={-9999} />;
}

function Cursor({ frame }: { frame: Frame }) {
  const c = useV2((s) => s.cursor);
  const ui = useView().ui;
  const b = c ? frame.boxes[c.node] : undefined;
  if (!c || !b) return null;
  const path = fileOf(c.leaf) ?? ui.cursor?.path ?? c.leaf;
  const name = path.split('/').filter(Boolean).pop();
  const inBox = b.h > 60 && b.w > 120;
  return (
    <div className="v2-cursor" style={{ transform: `translate(${b.x + (inBox ? 10 : -6)}px, ${b.y + b.h - (inBox ? 12 : 0)}px)` }} aria-live="polite">
      <span className="v2-cursor-avatar" aria-hidden="true">C</span>
      <span className="v2-cursor-label">Claude · {c.verb} <code>{name}</code></span>
    </div>
  );
}

function Empty() {
  const conn = useStore((s) => s.conn);
  return (
    <div className="v2-empty">
      <p className="v2-empty-title">{conn === 'down' ? 'Waiting for the Interpretability server' : 'Reading the repo'}</p>
      <p>{conn === 'down' ? 'Start it with HARNESS_REPO=<path> npm run dev. This page reconnects on its own.' : 'The map appears once domains.yaml is loaded or proposed.'}</p>
    </div>
  );
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------- screen-space headers (crisp at any zoom)

function Headers({ frame, insets }: { frame: Frame; insets: Insets }) {
  const store = useStoreApi();
  const colRefs = useRef<(HTMLButtonElement | null)[]>([]);
  const rowRefs = useRef<(HTMLDivElement | null)[]>([]);
  const nodes = useV2((s) => s.nodes);

  useLayoutEffect(() => {
    const place = ([tx, ty, k]: [number, number, number]) => {
      frame.cols.forEach((c, i) => {
        const el = colRefs.current[i];
        if (!el) return;
        const w = c.spine ? (c.w + GAP_X) * k - 6 : c.w * k;
        el.style.transform = `translate(${(tx + (c.x + c.w / 2) * k - w / 2).toFixed(1)}px, 0)`;
        el.style.width = `${w.toFixed(1)}px`;
      });
      frame.rows.forEach((r, j) => {
        const el = rowRefs.current[j];
        if (!el) return;
        el.style.transform = `translate(0, ${(ty + r.y * k).toFixed(1)}px)`;
        el.style.height = `${(r.h * k).toFixed(1)}px`;
      });
    };
    place(store.getState().transform);
    return store.subscribe((s, p) => { if (s.transform !== p.transform) place(s.transform); });
  }, [frame, store]);

  const toggle = (col: string) => {
    const scene = useSceneRef.current;
    if (!scene) return;
    const st = useV2.getState();
    st.go(dive(scene.graph, { open: st.open, focus: st.focus }, col === UNASSIGNED_COL ? UNASSIGNED : `domain:${col}`));
  };

  return (
    <div className="v2-headers" style={{ ['--hdr-h' as string]: `${insets.top - 56}px`, ['--lbl-w' as string]: `${insets.left - 12}px` }}>
      <div className="v2-colheads">
        {frame.cols.map((c, i) => {
          const r = nodes[c.id === UNASSIGNED_COL ? UNASSIGNED : `domain:${c.id}`]?.rollup;
          const cellRollups = frame.nodes.filter((n) => n.id.startsWith(`cell:${c.id}/`)).map((n) => nodes[n.id]?.rollup);
          return (
            <button
              key={c.id}
              ref={(el) => { colRefs.current[i] = el; }}
              type="button"
              className={`v2-colhead ${c.spine ? 'is-spine' : ''} ${c.open ? 'is-expanded' : ''} ${c.id === UNASSIGNED_COL ? 'is-unassigned' : ''}`}
              onClick={() => toggle(c.id)}
              title={`${c.purpose}\n${c.open ? 'Click to close' : 'Click to open'}`}
              aria-expanded={c.open}
            >
              <span className="v2-colhead-title">
                <Ring cells={cellRollups} />
                <span className="v2-colhead-name">{c.name}</span>
              </span>
              {c.open && <span className="v2-colhead-purpose">{c.purpose}</span>}
              {r && (r.violation || r.edited || r.ghostSteps.length > 0) && (
                <span className="v2-colhead-marks" aria-hidden="true">
                  {r.edited && <i className={r.unplanned ? 'is-unplanned' : 'is-edited'} />}
                  {r.ghostSteps.length > 0 && <i className="is-ghost" />}
                  {r.violation && <i className={`is-${r.violation}-violation`} />}
                </span>
              )}
            </button>
          );
        })}
      </div>
      <div className="v2-rowheads">
        {frame.rows.map((r, j) => (
          <div key={r.id} ref={(el) => { rowRefs.current[j] = el; }} className="v2-rowhead">
            <span>{r.name}</span>
          </div>
        ))}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

/** Control Room: a static ring per domain showing the state mix of its cells (no motion). */
function Ring({ cells }: { cells: (Rollup | undefined)[] }) {
  const parts: [string, number][] = [
    ['var(--v2-red)', cells.filter((r) => r?.violation).length],
    ['var(--v2-amber)', cells.filter((r) => r?.unplanned).length],
    ['var(--v2-agent)', cells.filter((r) => r && r.edited && !r.unplanned && !r.violation).length],
    ['color-mix(in srgb, var(--v2-agent) 45%, transparent)', cells.filter((r) => r && !r.edited && !r.violation && (r.looked || r.ghostSteps.length > 0)).length],
  ];
  const total = Math.max(1, cells.length);
  let at = 0;
  const stops = parts.filter(([, n]) => n > 0).map(([color, n]) => {
    const from = (at / total) * 360;
    at += n;
    return `${color} ${from}deg ${(at / total) * 360}deg`;
  });
  stops.push(`var(--v2-line) ${(at / total) * 360}deg 360deg`);
  return <span className="v2-ring" aria-hidden="true" style={{ background: `conic-gradient(${stops.join(', ')})` }} />;
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------- measurement hooks (Playwright)

type FrameStats = { frames: number; fps: number; p50: number; p95: number; p99: number; max: number; domNodes: number };
type Bench = {
  ready: () => boolean;
  count: () => number;
  frame: () => { nodes: number; edges: number; key: string } | null;
  stats: () => Stats & { reducedMotion: boolean };
  zoom: (ms?: number) => Promise<FrameStats>;
  toggle: (id: string) => Promise<TransitionStats & { layoutMs: number }>;
  relayout: () => Promise<number>;
};

function measureFrames(ms: number, step: (p: number) => void): Promise<FrameStats> {
  return new Promise((resolve) => {
    const times: number[] = [];
    const t0 = performance.now();
    const frame = (t: number) => {
      times.push(t);
      const p = Math.min(1, (t - t0) / ms);
      step(p);
      if (p < 1) requestAnimationFrame(frame);
      else {
        const dts = times.slice(1).map((x, i) => x - times[i]!).sort((a, b) => a - b);
        const q = (f: number) => +dts[Math.min(dts.length - 1, Math.floor(dts.length * f))]!.toFixed(2);
        resolve({ frames: times.length, fps: +((1000 * (times.length - 1)) / (times.at(-1)! - times[0]!)).toFixed(1), p50: q(0.5), p95: q(0.95), p99: q(0.99), max: q(1), domNodes: document.querySelectorAll('.react-flow__node').length });
      }
    };
    requestAnimationFrame(frame);
  });
}

function useBenchApi(tr: Transitioner, stats: React.MutableRefObject<Stats>, rf: ReturnType<typeof useReactFlow>) {
  useEffect(() => {
    const api: Bench = {
      ready: () => !!tr.shown,
      count: () => document.querySelectorAll('.react-flow__node').length,
      frame: () => (tr.shown ? { nodes: tr.shown.nodes.length, edges: tr.shown.edges.length, key: tr.shown.key } : null),
      stats: () => ({ ...stats.current, transition: tr.last, reducedMotion: reducedMotion() }),
      zoom: (ms = 3000) => {
        const b = tr.shown!.bounds;
        const cx = b.x + b.w / 2;
        const cy = b.y + b.h / 2;
        const el = document.querySelector('.v2-map')!.getBoundingClientRect();
        return measureFrames(ms, (p) => {
          const z = 0.2 + 1.2 * Math.sin(p * Math.PI); // far → near → far, crossing every LOD bucket twice
          void rf.setViewport({ zoom: z, x: el.width / 2 - (cx + (p - 0.5) * b.w * 0.4) * z, y: el.height / 2 - cy * z });
        });
      },
      toggle: (id) => new Promise((resolve) => {
        tr.onDone = (s) => {
          tr.onDone = null;
          resolve({ ...s, layoutMs: +stats.current.layoutMs.toFixed(1) });
        };
        const scene = useSceneRef.current!;
        const st = useV2.getState();
        st.go(dive(scene.graph, { open: st.open, focus: st.focus }, id.includes(':') ? id : `domain:${id}`));
      }),
      relayout: async () => { clearLayoutCache(); return 0; },
    };
    (window as unknown as { __v2: Bench }).__v2 = api;
  }, [tr, stats, rf]);
}

// Custom React Flow nodes. Each is memoized and reads only its own slice of the projection from the v2 store, plus
// the zoom bucket, so a zoom re-renders a node only when its level of detail changes.
import { memo } from 'react';
import { useStore as useFlow, type NodeProps } from '@xyflow/react';
import type { Rollup, VisibleNode } from '@harness/core/view';
import { useTween } from '../hooks';
import { useStore } from '../store';
import { selectedNode } from './select';
import { useV2 } from './store';

export type Lod = 'far' | 'mid' | 'near';
export const lodOf = (zoom: number): Lod => (zoom < 0.36 ? 'far' : zoom < 0.72 ? 'mid' : 'near');
export const useLod = () => useFlow((s) => lodOf(s.transform[2]));

const base = (p: string) => p.split('/').pop() ?? p;

function stateClasses(r: Rollup, ghost: boolean) {
  const c: string[] = [];
  if (r.looked && !r.edited) c.push('is-looked');
  if (r.edited) c.push(r.unplanned ? 'is-unplanned' : 'is-edited');
  if (ghost) c.push('is-ghost');
  if (r.violation === 'existing') c.push('is-violation');
  if (r.violation === 'new') c.push('is-new-violation');
  if (r.cursor) c.push('is-cursor');
  return c.join(' ');
}

function useMarks(id: string) {
  const focus = useV2((s) => s.focus === id);
  const selected = useStore((s) => selectedNode(s.selection) === id);
  return `${focus ? 'is-focus' : ''} ${selected ? 'is-selected' : ''}`;
}

function Steps({ steps }: { steps: number[] }) {
  if (!steps.length) return null;
  return (
    <span className="v2-steps" aria-label={`Planned in step ${steps.join(', ')}`}>
      {steps.map((n) => <span key={n} className="v2-step">{n}</span>)}
    </span>
  );
}

/** +/− badge, ticking up as edits land. */
function Diff({ r }: { r: Rollup }) {
  const added = useTween(r.added);
  const removed = useTween(r.removed);
  if (!r.edited) return null;
  return (
    <span className="v2-diff">
      <span className="plus">+{added}</span>
      <span className="minus">−{removed}</span>
    </span>
  );
}

/** Existing crossings: a ring badge with the rule ids and file count. New crossings: a solid badge naming the file. */
function Violations({ r, compact = false }: { r: Rollup; compact?: boolean }) {
  if (!r.violation) return null;
  const existing = r.violationFiles.filter((f) => !r.newViolationFiles.includes(f));
  return (
    <span className="v2-vmarks">
      {r.newViolationFiles.length > 0 && (
        <span className="v2-vmark is-new" title={r.newViolationFiles.join('\n')}>
          <b>new</b>{!compact && <> {r.newViolationFiles.map(base).join(', ')}</>}
        </span>
      )}
      {(existing.length > 0 || (!r.newViolationFiles.length && r.rules.length > 0)) && (
        <span className="v2-vmark" title={[...r.rules, ...existing].join('\n')}>
          {compact ? existing.length || r.rules.length : `${r.rules.join(' ')}${existing.length > 1 ? ` · ${existing.length}` : ''}`}
        </span>
      )}
    </span>
  );
}

const useNode = (id: string) => useV2((s) => s.nodes[id]) as VisibleNode | undefined;

export const FileNode = memo(function FileNode({ id }: NodeProps) {
  const n = useNode(id);
  const lod = useLod();
  const marks = useMarks(id);
  const syms = useV2((s) => s.symbols[id] ?? 0);
  if (!n) return null;
  const r = n.rollup;
  const ghost = r.ghostSteps.length > 0;
  return (
    <div className={`v2-file ${stateClasses(r, ghost)} ${r.plannedNew ? 'is-planned-new' : ''} lod-${lod} ${marks}`} title={n.path ?? n.id}>
      {lod !== 'far' && <span className="v2-file-name">{n.label}</span>}
