// The pipeline's pure half (NAVIGATION_PLAN §3): graph = graphOf(ui) memoized on its inputs, the view for what is
// open, activity and projection. No React and no stores, so the layout tests run it in node.
import {
  activityFor, buildGraph, graphFacts, project,
  type ContextGraph, type FileFacts, type LeafActivity, type Projection, type TurnActivity, type UIState, type ViewState,
} from '@harness/core/view';

const sameImports = (a: FileFacts['imports'], b: FileFacts['imports']) =>
  a === b || (a.length === b.length && a.every((x, i) => x.to === b[i]!.to && x.typeOnly === b[i]!.typeOnly));

/** Same graph inputs: facts by content hash (stubs and edge-adjusted files compare their imports), map and Tier 2 by hash. */
export function sameInputs(a: Record<string, FileFacts>, b: Record<string, FileFacts>): boolean {
  const ka = Object.keys(a);
  if (ka.length !== Object.keys(b).length) return false;
  for (const k of ka) {
    const x = a[k]!;
    const y = b[k];
    if (!y) return false;
    if (x === y) continue;
    if (x.hash !== y.hash || !sameImports(x.imports, y.imports) || x.writes.length !== y.writes.length) return false;
  }
  return true;
}

const semKey = (ui: UIState) => Object.values(ui.semantic).map((s) => `${s.path}@${s.hash}`).sort().join('|');

/**
 * graphOf(ui), rebuilt only when what it is built from changes. Replay re-reduces the log, so UIState objects are
 * new on every event; the facts inside them are the events' own objects, so most comparisons are by reference.
 */
export function graphMemo() {
  let last: { map: unknown; mapJson: string; facts: Record<string, FileFacts>; sem: string; graph: ContextGraph } | null = null;
  return (ui: UIState): ContextGraph | null => {
    if (!ui.map) return (last = null);
    const facts = graphFacts(ui);
    const sem = semKey(ui);
    const mapJson = last && last.map === ui.map ? last.mapJson : JSON.stringify(ui.map);
    if (last && last.mapJson === mapJson && last.sem === sem && sameInputs(last.facts, facts)) {
      last.map = ui.map;
      return last.graph;
    }
    const graph = buildGraph(ui.map, facts, ui.semantic);
    last = { map: ui.map, mapJson, facts, sem, graph };
    return graph;
  };
}

/** Opened ids that still exist, each with the containers above it (a group needs its cell open). */
export function normalizeOpen(graph: ContextGraph, open: readonly string[]): string[] {
  const out = new Set<string>();
  for (const id of open) {
    const n = graph.nodes[id];
    if (!n || !(graph.children[id]?.length)) continue;
    if (n.kind !== 'domain' && n.kind !== 'cell' && n.kind !== 'group' && n.kind !== 'unassigned') continue;
    out.add(id);
  }
  return [...out];
}

/**
 * The projection's view for what is open. System level is "every domain expanded one level" (cells visible, the
 * parity view). Opening a domain opens all its cells; opening a cell or group opens it and the containers above it.
 */
export function viewFor(graph: ContextGraph, open: readonly string[]): ViewState {
  const expanded = new Set<string>();
  for (const id of graph.children[graph.root] ?? []) if (graph.nodes[id]!.kind === 'domain') expanded.add(id);
  for (const id of normalizeOpen(graph, open)) {
    const n = graph.nodes[id]!;
    if (n.kind === 'domain') for (const c of graph.children[id] ?? []) if (graph.nodes[c]!.kind === 'cell') expanded.add(c);
    for (let p: string | null = id; p && p !== graph.root; p = graph.nodes[p]?.parent ?? null) expanded.add(p);
  }
  return { expanded: [...expanded], focus: null, lens: { kinds: [], turnOnly: false }, budget: 50, follow: false };
}

const heat = (l: LeafActivity | undefined) =>
  !l ? 9 : l.violation === 'new' ? 0 : l.violation ? 1 : l.cursor ? 2 : l.edited ? 3 : l.ghostSteps.length ? 4 : l.looked ? 5 : 9;

/** Collapsed cells list their children with the ones that matter this turn first (as v1 did), then by order. */
export function hotLabels(graph: ContextGraph, activity: TurnActivity, p: Projection, max = 8): Record<string, string[]> {
  const out: Record<string, string[]> = {};
  for (const n of p.nodes) {
    if (n.expanded || (n.kind !== 'cell' && n.kind !== 'unassigned')) continue;
    const kids = graph.children[n.id] ?? [];
    const ranked = kids.map((k, i) => ({ k, i, h: heat(activity.leaves[k]) })).sort((a, b) => a.h - b.h || a.i - b.i);
    out[n.id] = ranked.slice(0, max).map((x) => graph.nodes[x.k]!.label);
  }
  return out;
}

export type Scene = {
  ui: UIState;
  graph: ContextGraph;
  activity: TurnActivity;
  projection: Projection;
  open: string[];
  /** Layout key: what is open (positions depend on nothing else but content). */
  key: string;
};

export function sceneOf(ui: UIState, graph: ContextGraph, turn: string | null, open: readonly string[]): Scene {
  const activity = activityFor(ui, graph, turn);
  const opened = normalizeOpen(graph, open);
  const projection = project(graph, viewFor(graph, opened), activity);
  return { ui, graph, activity, projection, open: opened, key: opened.join(',') };
}
import {
  cellKey, cellViews, edgeViews, ledger, reduce, turnLedger,
  type CellView, type EdgeView, type HarnessEvent, type Ledger, type TurnLedger, type TurnState, type UIState, type Violation,
} from '@harness/core/view';
import { useStore } from './store';

/** Everything the UI shows, as a pure function of (events, replay index, selected turn). */
export type View = {
  ui: UIState;
  upTo: number;
  live: boolean;
  turn: TurnState | null;
  turnIndex: number; // 1-based, 0 when no turn
  cells: Record<string, CellView>;
  edges: EdgeView[];
  ledger: Ledger;
  turnLedger: TurnLedger | null;
  /** cellKey → files placed there (product files only; tests are listed under their domain). */
  cellFiles: Record<string, string[]>;
  testFiles: Record<string, string[]>;
  unassigned: string[];
  proposal: { domains: number; rules: number } | null;
  steps: { done: number; total: number };
  turnStarts: number[];
};

let reduceCache: { events: readonly HarnessEvent[]; upTo: number; ui: UIState } | null = null;
let viewCache: { ui: UIState; turnSel: string | null; view: View } | null = null;

function reduced(events: readonly HarnessEvent[], upTo: number): UIState {
  if (reduceCache && reduceCache.events === events && reduceCache.upTo === upTo) return reduceCache.ui;
  const ui = reduce(events, upTo);
  reduceCache = { events, upTo, ui };
  return ui;
}

export function deriveView(events: readonly HarnessEvent[], replay: number | null, turnSel: string | null): View {
  const upTo = replay ?? events.length;
  const ui = reduced(events, upTo);
  if (viewCache && viewCache.ui === ui && viewCache.turnSel === turnSel) return viewCache.view;

  const turn = (turnSel && ui.turns.find((t) => t.id === turnSel)) || ui.turns.at(-1) || null;
  const cellFiles: Record<string, string[]> = {};
  const testFiles: Record<string, string[]> = {};
  const unassigned: string[] = [];
  for (const [path, p] of Object.entries(ui.files)) {
    if (p.kind === 'cell') (cellFiles[cellKey(p)] ??= []).push(path);
    else if (p.kind === 'test') (testFiles[p.domain] ??= []).push(path);
    else if (p.kind === 'unassigned') unassigned.push(path);
  }
  for (const list of Object.values(cellFiles)) list.sort();

  let proposed = -1;
  let confirmed = -1;
  const turnStarts: number[] = [];
  for (let i = 0; i < events.length; i++) {
    const k = events[i]!.kind;
    if (k === 'turn_started') turnStarts.push(i);
    if (i >= upTo) continue;
    if (k === 'map_proposed') proposed = i;
    if (k === 'map_confirmed') confirmed = i;
  }
  const proposal = proposed > confirmed && ui.map ? { domains: ui.map.domains.length, rules: ui.map.invariants.length } : null;

  const l = ledger(ui);
  const view: View = {
    ui,
    upTo,
    live: replay === null,
    turn,
    turnIndex: turn ? ui.turns.indexOf(turn) + 1 : 0,
    cells: cellViews(ui, turn?.id ?? null),
    edges: edgeViews(ui, turn?.id ?? null),
    ledger: l,
    turnLedger: turn ? turnLedger(ui, turn) : null,
    cellFiles,
    testFiles,
    unassigned,
    proposal,
    steps: turn ? stepProgress(turn) : { done: 0, total: 0 },
    turnStarts,
  };
  viewCache = { ui, turnSel, view };
  return view;
}

/** "3 of 6 steps": a step is done when every cell it plans has been edited (or, for a step with no cells, its files). */
function stepProgress(turn: TurnState) {
  const editedFiles = new Set([
    ...Object.values(turn.edited).flatMap((c) => c.files),
    ...Object.values(turn.tests).flat(),
    ...turn.unassigned,
  ]);
  let done = 0;
  for (const step of turn.steps) {
    const cells = Object.entries(turn.planned).filter(([, c]) => c.steps.includes(step.n)).map(([k]) => k);
    const ok = cells.length ? cells.every((k) => !!turn.edited[k]) : step.files.length > 0 && step.files.every((f) => editedFiles.has(f));
    if (ok) done++;
  }
  return { done, total: turn.steps.length };
}

export function useView(): View {
  const events = useStore((s) => s.events);
  const replay = useStore((s) => s.replay);
  const turnSel = useStore((s) => s.turn);
  return deriveView(events, replay, turnSel);
}

/** Violations relevant to the selected turn (load-time plus this turn's plan and gate), for the inspector. */
export function turnViolations(v: View): { v: Violation; source: 'load' | 'plan' | 'gate' }[] {
  const out: { v: Violation; source: 'load' | 'plan' | 'gate' }[] = v.ui.violations.map((x) => ({ v: x, source: 'load' as const }));
  for (const x of v.turn?.planViolations ?? []) out.push({ v: x, source: 'plan' });
  for (const x of v.turn?.gateBlocks ?? []) out.push({ v: x, source: 'gate' });
  return out;
}

export const basename = (p: string) => p.split('/').pop() ?? p;
export const stem = (p: string) => {
  const parts = p.split('/');
  const last = parts.pop() ?? p;
  // vendor/<name>/index.ts reads better as its folder name
  if (/^index\.[tj]sx?$/.test(last) && parts.length) return parts.pop()!;
  return last.replace(/\.[tj]sx?$/, '');
};

# Contracts for the NAVIGATION_PLAN lanes

These files are the shared interfaces. Lanes build against them in parallel. Change a contract only with the integrator's sign-off, because every lane depends on it.

| File | Defines |
| --- | --- |
| `facts.ts` | `FileFacts` (Tier 1, per file), `SemanticFacts` (Tier 2), `SymbolFact`, `CallFact`, `RouteFact`, `EntryFact`, `SymbolDiff` |
| `graph.ts` | `ContextGraph`, `GraphNode`, `GraphEdge`, `ViewState`, `LeafActivity`, `Rollup` (with `rules`, `plannedNew`), `Projection` (nodes with `preview`, edges, ports with `peer`, `cursor`, `grid`), plus id helpers |
| `cartography.ts` | `DriftSignal`, `HistoryTurn`, `MapScore`, `MapProposal`, `ProposalChange`, `Label`, `AuditFinding`, `DEFAULT_THRESHOLDS` |
| `api.ts` | The signatures each lane implements (`BuildGraph`, `Project`, `ScoreMap`, `DetectDrift`, …) and `TurnActivity` |

The event kinds and reducer support for all new events (`facts_changed`, `facts_resolved`, `call_added`, `drift_detected`, `map_proposed { proposal }`, `map_proposal_resolved`, `labels_updated`, `audit_finding`, `maintenance_run`, and `edited.symbols`) are already in `../events.ts`. Lanes **emit** these events. They do not change the reducer; ask the integrator if a lane needs reducer state that isn't there.

Shared test fixture: `test/scout-facts.ts` gives `FileFacts` for `test/fixture-repo`, with hand-written symbols, calls and routes for the files the demo touches.

## File ownership

| Lane | Owns | May append to |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Facts (N1) | `src/facts.ts`, `src/imports.ts`, `src/writes.ts`, `src/facts/**`; server `repo.ts`, `git.ts` | `src/index.ts`, `src/view.ts` (exports), `packages/core/package.json` |
| Graph (N2) | `src/graph/**` | `src/index.ts`, `src/view.ts` |
| Cartography (N5 engine) | `src/cartography/**`; server `living-map/**` | `src/index.ts`, `src/view.ts`; server `index.ts` (a small wiring block) |
| Renderer (N0 → N3/N4) | `apps/shell/**` (new work under `src/v2/`) | `apps/shell/package.json` |

`events.ts`, `rules.ts`, `schema.ts` and `contracts/**` belong to the integrator.
// Contract (NAVIGATION_PLAN §3.1): per-file facts shared by the facts tiers, the reducer, the graph and the
// cartographer. Ids never contain line numbers, so they stay stable across edits that shift code.
// Browser-safe: types only.

export type SymbolKind = 'function' | 'class' | 'method' | 'const' | 'type' | 'property' | 'component';

/** A definition in a file. `id` = `<path>#<qualified name>` (e.g. `src/tools/news-summarize.ts#newsSummarize.run`). */
export type SymbolFact = {
  id: string;
  file: string;
  name: string; // qualified within the file: `newsSummarize.run`; duplicates get `~2`, anonymous callbacks `<cb1>`
  kind: SymbolKind;
  exported: boolean;
  parent: string | null; // enclosing symbol id, or null at top level
  span: { start: number; end: number }; // JS string (UTF-16) offsets in the current text; never part of the id
  sigHash: string; // normalized params, types, modifiers, export flag
  bodyHash: string; // whitespace-normalized body text
};

export type CallConfidence = 'syntactic' | 'typed' | 'dispatch';

/**
 * A call (or `new`) from code in one file. `from` is a symbol id, or the file path for top-level code.
 * `to` is a symbol id, a file path (unresolved member), `vendor:<x>` or `table:<x>`.
 */
export type CallFact = { from: string; to: string; confidence: CallConfidence; count: number };

/** `id` = `route:<METHOD> <path>` with params normalized to `{}` (e.g. `route:POST /api/runs/{}`). */
export type RouteFact = { id: string; method: string; path: string; file: string; handler: string | null };

export type EntryKind = 'bin' | 'script' | 'route' | 'page' | 'cli' | 'main';
/** `id` = `entry:<kind>:<label>` (e.g. `entry:bin:scout`, `entry:page:/runs/{}`). */
export type EntryFact = { id: string; kind: EntryKind; file: string; symbol: string | null; label: string };

/** A table write found by a write adapter (Scout `db.insert`, Prisma, Drizzle, Knex, raw SQL, …). */
export type WriteSite = { table: string; symbol: string | null; via: string };

/** Everything Tier 1 knows about one file. Replaced wholesale when the file changes. */
export type FileFacts = {
  path: string;
  hash: string; // content hash; Tier 2 results for an older hash are ignored
  imports: { to: string; typeOnly: boolean }[]; // resolved repo paths, or `vendor:<pkg>` for bare imports
  writes: WriteSite[];
  /** Table reads (`db.get/where("t")`, SQL `FROM/JOIN t`, ORM finds). Optional for older logs. */
  reads?: WriteSite[];
  /** Tables a schema file defines (`CREATE TABLE`), with their columns. Optional; only for `.sql` files. */
  tables?: { name: string; columns: string[] }[];
  symbols: SymbolFact[];
  calls: CallFact[];
  routes: RouteFact[];
  entries: EntryFact[];
};

/** Tier 2 (typed) facts for one file at one content hash. */
export type SemanticFacts = {
  path: string;
  hash: string;
  calls: CallFact[]; // confidence 'typed' or 'dispatch'
  implements: { from: string; to: string }[]; // implementation symbol → interface/type member symbol
};

/** Which symbols an edit changed (sigHash/bodyHash comparison). */
export type SymbolDiff = {
  added: string[];
  removed: string[];
  sig: string[]; // signature changed (callers are affected)
  body: string[]; // body changed only
  renamed: [string, string][]; // [old id, new id], same bodyHash
};

export const emptySymbolDiff = (): SymbolDiff => ({ added: [], removed: [], sig: [], body: [], renamed: [] });
// Contract (NAVIGATION_PLAN §1, §3.2): one containment tree plus leaf edges; every level is a projection.
// Browser-safe: types and id helpers only. Implementations live in src/graph/ (Graph lane).
import type { CallConfidence, SymbolDiff } from './facts';

export type NodeKind =
  | 'repo'
  | 'domain'
  | 'cell'
  | 'group' // a directory or confirmed component inside a cell
  | 'file'
  | 'symbol'
  | 'table'
  | 'vendor' // bare package or external service not claimed by a cell
  | 'route'

  | 'neutral' // shared code (domains.yaml `neutral`): never creates edges

export type GraphNode = {

export type EdgeKind = 'imports' | 'calls' | 'implements' | 'handles' | 'writes' | 'reads' | 'uses' | 'fetches' | 'starts';

/** View-only state held by the shell (not in the event log unless D5 says so). */

export type ViolationState = 'existing' | 'new' | null;
export type ProposalMark = 'add' | 'move_in' | 'move_out' | 'remove' | 'rename' | null;

/** Agent and map activity for one leaf (file or symbol id) in the selected turn. */
export type LeafActivity = {

  planned: boolean;
  unplanned: boolean; // edited, the turn has a plan, and this leaf is not in it
  violation: ViolationState;
  cursor: boolean;
  symbols: SymbolDiff | null; // for files: which symbols the turn changed
  audit: number; // open advisory findings
  proposal: ProposalMark; // pending cartographer proposal touching this leaf
  touchedDecisions: string[]; // decisions whose protected code this turn's plan/edits touch here (beat 4 markers)
};

/** Activity rolled up to a visible node: booleans OR, counts sum, severity MAX (never averaged). */
export type Rollup = {
  looked: boolean;
  edited: boolean;
  added: number;
  removed: number;
  ghostSteps: number[];
  unplanned: boolean;
  violation: ViolationState;
  violationFiles: string[];
  newViolationFiles: string[];
  cursor: boolean;
  audit: number;
  proposal: ProposalMark;
  rules: string[]; // invariant ids crossed underneath (existing or new), sorted
  plannedNew: boolean; // contains a planned leaf that does not exist yet
  leaves: number; // files (or symbols) underneath; interface members are not counted
};

export type VisibleNode = {
  id: string;
  kind: NodeKind;
  parent: string | null; // nearest visible ancestor
  label: string;
  depth: number;
  expanded: boolean;
  expandable: boolean;
  order: number;
  domain?: string;
  layer?: string;
  path?: string;
  preview: string[]; // collapsed containers: labels of up to 4 children, by order
  rollup: Rollup;
};

export type EdgeStatus = 'existing' | 'new' | 'ghost';

/** Leaf edges aggregated to their nearest visible endpoints. A ghost edge never merges with a solid one. */
export type VisibleEdge = {
  id: string;
  from: string; // visible node ids
  to: string;
  kinds: EdgeKind[];
  count: number;
  status: EdgeStatus;
  violation: ViolationState;
  confidence: CallConfidence | null; // weakest confidence among its call edges, null if none
  steps: number[]; // plan steps, for ghost edges
  /**
   * Set on a ghost edge that a standing decision rules out (a plan's `avoided` approach, or a plan/gate violation
   * citing a decision): drawn struck through, labelled "rejected in DR-4, session 1" (1-based session number).
   */
  decision?: { id: string; session: number } | null;
  leafEdges: string[]; // GraphEdge ids (or plan import keys for ghosts)
};

/** Where an aggregated edge crosses out of an expanded container. `peer` is the visible node at the other end; the side is the layout's call. */
export type Port = { container: string; edge: string; peer: string; direction: 'out' | 'in' };

/** The visible node carrying the agent cursor, the leaf (or cell) it is on, and what it is doing. */
export type ProjectionCursor = { node: string; leaf: string; verb: string };
/** The grid the projection is drawn on, in map order: domain ids, layer ids that have cells, and the cell ids that exist. */
export type ProjectionGrid = { domains: string[]; layers: string[]; cells: string[] };

export type Projection = { nodes: VisibleNode[]; edges: VisibleEdge[]; ports: Port[]; cursor: ProjectionCursor | null; grid: ProjectionGrid };

// ---------------------------------------------------------------- ids

export const ROOT_ID = 'repo';
export const UNASSIGNED_ID = 'unassigned';
export const NEUTRAL_ID = 'neutral';
export const domainId = (domain: string) => `domain:${domain}`;
export const cellId = (domain: string, layer: string) => `cell:${domain}/${layer}`;
export const groupId = (domain: string, layer: string, dir: string) => `group:${domain}/${layer}/${dir}`;
export const testsId = (domain: string) => `tests:${domain}`;
export const tableId = (table: string) => `table:${table}`;
export const vendorId = (name: string) => `vendor:${name}`;
export const symbolId = (path: string, qualified: string) => `${path}#${qualified}`;
export const edgeId = (kind: EdgeKind, from: string, to: string) => `${kind}|${from}|${to}`;

/** The file a leaf id belongs to: `src/a.ts#f.g` → `src/a.ts`; file ids are returned as-is; others → null. */
export function fileOf(id: string): string | null {
  if (/^(domain|cell|group|tests|table|vendor|route|entry|journey):/.test(id) || id === ROOT_ID || id === UNASSIGNED_ID || id === NEUTRAL_ID) return null;
  const i = id.indexOf('#');
  return i === -1 ? id : id.slice(0, i);
}
// Contract: the functions each lane implements, by signature. Lanes export these names from their own
// modules and re-export them from src/index.ts (and src/view.ts if browser-safe). Pure and deterministic.
import type { DomainMap } from '../schema';
import type { UIState } from '../events';
import type { FileFacts, SemanticFacts, SymbolDiff, SymbolFact } from './facts';
import type { ContextGraph, LeafActivity, Projection, ViewState, ViolationState } from './graph';
import type { DriftSignal, DriftThresholds, HistoryTurn, MapScore, ProposalChange } from './cartography';

/** The selected turn's activity, keyed by leaf id (file path or symbol id), plus plan edges. */
export type TurnActivity = {
  turn: string | null;
  leaves: Record<string, LeafActivity>;
  /**
   * file → file planned imports not built yet; gate-blocked imports join with `steps: []`, violation `new` and
   * `source: 'gate'`; approaches the plan avoids (`source: 'avoided'`) join between their nodes (files, or the cell a
   * missing file or a domain maps to). `decision` marks a ghost a standing decision rules out (drawn struck through).
   */
  plannedEdges: { from: string; to: string; steps: number[]; violation: ViolationState; source?: 'gate' | 'avoided'; decision?: { id: string; session: number } | null }[];
  addedEdges: string[]; // GraphEdge ids added this turn
  cursor: string | null; // leaf id the agent is on (its cell when the path is not a leaf, e.g. a searched directory)
  verb: string | null; // what the agent is doing there ('reading' | 'searching' | 'editing')
  /** Leaf id → invariant ids it crosses (current violations and this turn's plan/gate ones). */
  rules: Record<string, string[]>;
  /** Planned leaves that do not exist yet (no placement and no facts). */
  plannedNew: string[];
  /** Current (map-level) violations: files that have one, and the `imports` GraphEdge ids they target. */
  violations: { files: string[]; edges: string[] };
};

// ---- Graph lane (src/graph/, browser-safe) ----
/** Containment tree + leaf edges from the map and per-file facts (Tier 2 merged in when its hash matches). */
export type BuildGraph = (map: DomainMap, facts: Readonly<Record<string, FileFacts>>, semantic?: Readonly<Record<string, SemanticFacts>>) => ContextGraph;
export type ActivityFor = (ui: UIState, graph: ContextGraph, turnId?: string | null) => TurnActivity;
/** Visible nodes/edges/ports for a view. With `expanded: []` it must agree with cellViews/edgeViews (parity tests). */
export type Project = (graph: ContextGraph, view: ViewState, activity: TurnActivity) => Projection;
/** DOI expansion: importance (planned, violating, cursor, edited) minus distance from focus, within `budget`. */
export type AutoExpand = (graph: ContextGraph, activity: TurnActivity, focus: string | null, budget: number) => string[];
/** Shortest call chains from `from` to sinks (vendors, tables) over calls ∪ implements ∪ handles. */
export type Trace = (graph: ContextGraph, from: string, sinks?: readonly string[]) => string[][];

// ---- Facts lane (src/facts/ for extraction is node-only; diffSymbols is browser-safe) ----
export type ExtractFacts = (path: string, source: string, resolve: (from: string, spec: string) => string | null) => FileFacts;
export type DiffSymbols = (before: readonly SymbolFact[], after: readonly SymbolFact[]) => SymbolDiff;

// ---- Cartography lane (src/cartography/, browser-safe) ----
export type ScoreMap = (
  map: DomainMap,
  facts: Readonly<Record<string, FileFacts>>,
  history: readonly HistoryTurn[],
  opts?: { current?: DomainMap; decisionPaths?: Readonly<Record<string, string[]>> },
) => MapScore;
export type DetectDrift = (
  map: DomainMap,
  facts: Readonly<Record<string, FileFacts>>,
  ui: UIState,
  history: readonly HistoryTurn[],
  thresholds: DriftThresholds,
  previous?: readonly DriftSignal[],
) => DriftSignal[];
export type DiffMaps = (current: DomainMap, next: DomainMap, files: readonly string[]) => ProposalChange[];

import { writeFileSync } from 'node:fs';
import { join } from 'node:path';
import { randomUUID } from 'node:crypto';
import {
  query, type Query, type SDKUserMessage, type HookCallback, type PreToolUseHookInput, type PostToolUseHookInput,
  type CanUseTool, type PermissionResult, type McpServerConfig,
} from '@anthropic-ai/claude-agent-sdk';
import { applyEdit, deltaForEdit, check, withExtra, type PlanStep, type Violation, type EventData } from '@harness/core';
import { harnessTools, violationText, decidedText, splitDecided, ASK_RULE } from './harness-tools';
import { listDecisions, parseOption, recordFork, recordInAlike } from './decisions';
import { baseline, numstat, type Baseline } from './git';
import type { Repo } from './repo';
import type { Bus } from './bus';

const PLAN_RULES = [
  'Explore read-only, briefly. Then, before editing anything, call mcp__interpretability__submit_plan with numbered steps.',
  'Each step lists the exact repo-relative file paths it will create or modify, and every new import it adds as { from: path, to: path }.',
  'If the result contains violations: ' + ASK_RULE,
  'If a violation is ALREADY DECIDED in a standing decision (DR-n), do not ask: plan it the decided way and resubmit.',
  'If a standing decision rules out the obvious approach, plan the decided way and list the avoided approach in `avoided` with the decision id.',
  'After the user answers, resubmit the plan with mcp__interpretability__submit_plan, then call ExitPlanMode.',
  'If there are no violations, call ExitPlanMode with a short plan.',
].join('\n');

/** Push-based prompt stream fed by the chat pane. */
class Inbox implements AsyncIterable<SDKUserMessage> {
  private queue: SDKUserMessage[] = [];
  private wake: (() => void) | null = null;
  push(text: string) {
    this.queue.push({ type: 'user', message: { role: 'user', content: text }, parent_tool_use_id: null });
    this.wake?.();
  }
  async *[Symbol.asyncIterator]() {
    while (true) {
      while (this.queue.length) yield this.queue.shift()!;
      await new Promise<void>((r) => (this.wake = r));
      this.wake = null;
    }
  }
}

type Turn = {
  id: string;
  prompt: string;
  base: Baseline;
  planned: boolean;
  steps: PlanStep[];
  planViolations: Violation[]; // from the latest submit_plan
  gateBlocks: Violation[]; // since the last answer
  forkOpen: Violation[] | null; // asked, awaiting the user's A/B
  lastText: string;
};

/** If a shell command writes a file inside the repo, a short description of how; otherwise null. */
export function bashWriteTarget(cmd: string, rel: (p: string) => string | null): string | null {
  const inRepo = (p: string) => !!p && !p.startsWith('/dev/') && rel(p.replace(/^['"]|['"]$/g, '')) !== null;
  // Redirects to a file: `> f`, `>> f`, `cat <<EOF > f` (not 2>&1, >&2, >/dev/null).
  // `=>` and `->` (arrow functions, prose) are not redirects.
  for (const m of cmd.matchAll(/(?:^|[^0-9&>=-])>>?\s*([^\s;&|<>()]+)/g)) if (!m[1]!.startsWith('&') && inRepo(m[1]!)) return `redirect to ${m[1]}`;
  for (const m of cmd.matchAll(/\btee\s+(?:-a\s+)?([^\s;&|<>()]+)/g)) if (inRepo(m[1]!)) return `tee ${m[1]}`;
  if (/\b(sed|perl)\s+(-[a-zA-Z]*\s+)*-[a-zA-Z]*i/.test(cmd)) return 'in-place edit';
  if (/\b(python3?|node|ruby|perl|deno|bun)\b[\s\S]*(open\([^)]*['"][wa]\+?['"]|write_text|writeFileSync|appendFileSync|\.write\(|fs\.write)/.test(cmd)) return 'script that writes files';
  return null;
}

export type Ephemeral = (msg: { type: 'delta'; text: string } | { type: 'busy'; busy: boolean }) => void;

export class Session {
  private inbox = new Inbox();
  private q: Query | null = null;
  private turn: Turn | null = null;
  private approval: { resolve: (r: PermissionResult) => void; input: Record<string, unknown> } | null = null;
  private notes: string[] = [];
  busy = false;

  constructor(private repo: Repo, private bus: Bus, private ephemeral: Ephemeral) {}

  brief(): string {
    const m = this.repo.map;
    const domains = m.domains.map((d) => {
      const cells = Object.entries(d.cells).map(([layer, c]) => `    ${layer}: ${[...(c.paths ?? []), ...(c.tables ?? []).map((t) => `table ${t}`)].join(', ')}`);
      return `- ${d.name} (${d.id}): ${d.purpose}\n${cells.join('\n')}`;
    });
    // Rejected map proposals are cartographer memory, not standing decisions for the coding agent.
    const decisions = listDecisions(this.repo.root).filter((d) => d.status !== 'rejected').map((d) =>
      `- ${d.id}: ${d.title}\n  Outcome: ${d.outcome}\n  Rejected: ${d.rejected}\n  ${d.rationale.replace(/\n+/g, '\n  ')}`);
    // Seeded invariants are deliberately not listed (SPEC §6): they are enforced at plan and edit time.
    return [
      '# Interpretability',
      'You are working inside Interpretability, which shows the user a live domain × layer map of this repo and checks every plan and edit against its architecture rules.',
      '',
      '## Map (domains.yaml)',
      `Layers: ${m.layers.map((l) => l.id).join(', ')}`,
      ...domains,
      '',
      '## Standing decisions the user has made',
      decisions.length ? decisions.join('\n') : '(none yet)',
      '',
      '## Rules',
      PLAN_RULES,
      'Change files only with the Edit and Write tools, never through Bash (no heredocs, `sed -i` or scripts that write files): Interpretability checks each Edit/Write against the rules.',
      'If an edit is denied with options A and B: ' + ASK_RULE,
    ].join('\n');
  }

  start() {
    const alike: Record<string, McpServerConfig> = process.env.HARNESS_ALIKE === '0' ? {} : { alike: { type: 'http', url: 'https://alike.network/api-general/mcp' } };
    this.q = query({
      prompt: this.inbox,
      options: {
        cwd: this.repo.root,
        permissionMode: 'plan',
        planModeInstructions: PLAN_RULES,
        // User settings carry Alike's own hooks (network calls); keep the hot path deterministic. See VERIFY.md.
        settingSources: ['project', 'local'],
        strictMcpConfig: true,
        systemPrompt: { type: 'preset', preset: 'claude_code', append: this.brief() },
        mcpServers: {
          interpretability: harnessTools(this.repo, this.bus, {
            onPlan: (steps, violations) => this.onPlan(steps, violations),
            takeNotes: () => this.notes.splice(0),
          }),
          ...alike,
        },
        // No allowedTools: canUseTool approves everything except ExitPlanMode, which waits for the user.
        disallowedTools: ['AskUserQuestion'],
        includePartialMessages: true,
        hooks: {
          PreToolUse: [
            { matcher: 'Read|Grep|Glob', hooks: [this.observeRead] },
            { matcher: 'Bash', hooks: [this.observeBash, this.gateBash] },
            { matcher: 'Edit|Write', hooks: [this.gate] },
          ],
          PostToolUse: [
            { matcher: 'Edit|Write', hooks: [this.afterEdit] },
            { matcher: 'mcp__alike__record_decision', hooks: [this.afterAlike] },
          ],
        },
        canUseTool: this.canUseTool,
        stderr: (d) => { if (process.env.HARNESS_DEBUG) process.stderr.write(d); },
      },
    });
    void this.loop();
  }

  private async loop() {
    try {
      for await (const m of this.q!) {
        if (m.type === 'stream_event') {
          const ev = m.event as { type: string; delta?: { type: string; text?: string } };
          if (ev.type === 'content_block_delta' && ev.delta?.type === 'text_delta' && ev.delta.text) this.ephemeral({ type: 'delta', text: ev.delta.text });
        } else if (m.type === 'assistant' && !m.parent_tool_use_id) {
          const t = m.message.content.filter((b) => b.type === 'text').map((b) => (b as { text: string }).text).join('\n').trim();
          if (t) {
            this.bus.emit('chat', { role: 'assistant', text: t });
            if (this.turn) this.turn.lastText = t;
          }
        } else if (m.type === 'result') {
          this.onResult(m.subtype);
        }
      }
    } catch (e) {
      this.bus.emit('error', { message: `Session ended: ${(e as Error).message}` });
    }
  }

  // ---------------------------------------------------------------- chat input

  userMessage(text: string) {
    const t = text.trim();
    if (!t) return;
    if (this.approval) {
      this.bus.emit('chat', { role: 'user', text: t });
      if (/^(approve|approved|lgtm|yes|ok|go|ship it)\b/i.test(t)) this.approve();
      else this.rejectPlan(t);
      return;
    }
    if (this.turn?.forkOpen) {
      const violations = this.turn.forkOpen;
      const option = parseOption(t);
      this.bus.emit('chat', { role: 'user', text: t });
      this.bus.emit('fork_answered', { option, text: t, violations });
      this.turn.forkOpen = null;
      this.turn.planViolations = [];
      this.turn.gateBlocks = [];
      const { decisions, forAlike } = recordFork(this.repo, this.bus, violations, option, t, this.turn.prompt);
      // The server records in Alike itself, off the turn; only if the CLI fails does the session get an MCP note.
      if (process.env.HARNESS_ALIKE !== '0') void recordInAlike(this.repo, this.bus, forAlike).then((notes) => this.notes.push(...notes));
      const ids = decisions.map((d) => d.id).join(', ');
      this.send(`${t}\n\n[Interpretability: recorded as ${ids || 'a decision'} in decisions/ and domains.yaml. ` +
        (option === 'B' ? `${violations[0]?.file} is now an exception. ` : '') +
        'Resubmit the plan with mcp__interpretability__submit_plan, then exit plan mode.]');
      return;
    }
    if (!this.turn) this.startTurn(t);
    this.bus.emit('chat', { role: 'user', text: t });
    this.send(t);
  }

  private send(text: string) {
    this.busy = true;
    this.ephemeral({ type: 'busy', busy: true });
    this.inbox.push(text);
  }

  private startTurn(prompt: string) {
    const id = `t${randomUUID().slice(0, 6)}`;
    this.turn = { id, prompt, base: baseline(this.repo.root), planned: false, steps: [], planViolations: [], gateBlocks: [], forkOpen: null, lastText: '' };
    this.bus.turn = id;
    this.bus.emit('turn_started', { prompt, head: this.turn.base.head, baseline: this.turn.base.snapshot });
  }

  approve() {
    if (!this.approval) return;
    const { resolve, input } = this.approval;
    this.approval = null;
    this.bus.emit('plan_approved', {} as never);
    resolve({ behavior: 'allow', updatedInput: input });
    void this.q?.setPermissionMode('acceptEdits');
  }

  private rejectPlan(feedback: string) {
    if (!this.approval) return;
    const { resolve } = this.approval;
    this.approval = null;
    resolve({ behavior: 'deny', message: `The user did not approve the plan yet. Their feedback: ${feedback}` });
  }

  private onPlan(steps: PlanStep[], violations: Violation[]) {
    if (!this.turn) return;
    this.turn.planned = true;
    this.turn.steps = steps;
    this.turn.planViolations = violations;
  }

  private onResult(subtype: string) {
    this.busy = false;
    this.ephemeral({ type: 'busy', busy: false });
    const turn = this.turn;
    if (!turn) return;
    if (subtype !== 'success') this.bus.emit('error', { message: `Turn ended with ${subtype}` });
    // Only undecided violations are forks; decision-backed ones were answered before (beat 4) and never re-asked.
    const open = splitDecided([...turn.planViolations, ...turn.gateBlocks]).open;
    if (open.length && subtype === 'success') {
      // Claude stopped to ask: the turn stays open until the user answers.
      turn.forkOpen = open;
      this.bus.emit('fork_asked', { violations: open, text: turn.lastText });
      return;
    }
    this.endTurn(subtype);
  }

  private endTurn(reason: string) {
    const turn = this.turn!;
    const stat = numstat(this.repo.root, turn.base);
    this.bus.emit('turn_ended', { ...stat, reason });
    const events = this.bus.events.filter((e) => e.turn === turn.id);
    writeFileSync(join(this.repo.root, '.harness/turns', `${turn.id}.json`), JSON.stringify({ id: turn.id, prompt: turn.prompt, baseline: turn.base, steps: turn.steps, numstat: stat, events }, null, 2));
    this.turn = null;
    this.bus.turn = null;
    this.repo.recheck();
    void this.q?.setPermissionMode('plan');
  }

  // ---------------------------------------------------------------- hooks

  private observeRead: HookCallback = async (input) => {
    const i = input as PreToolUseHookInput;
    const ti = i.tool_input as { file_path?: string; path?: string };
    if (i.tool_name === 'Read' && ti.file_path) {
      const rel = this.repo.rel(ti.file_path);
      if (rel) this.bus.emit('looked', { tool: 'Read' }, { path: rel, cell: this.repo.cellOf(rel) });
    } else {
      const rel = this.repo.rel(ti.path ?? this.repo.root);
      if (rel) this.bus.emit('cursor', { verb: 'searching' }, { path: rel, cell: this.repo.cellOf(rel) ?? this.repo.cellForDir(rel) });
    }
    return { async: true };
  };

  /** Claude often reads with `cat`/`sed`/`grep` in Bash: any repo file named in the command counts as looked at. */
  private observeBash: HookCallback = async (input) => {
    const cmd = String((input as PreToolUseHookInput & { tool_input: { command?: string } }).tool_input.command ?? '');
    if (/(^|[;&|]\s*)(cat|head|tail|sed|grep|rg|less|wc|nl|awk)\b/.test(cmd)) {
      for (const token of new Set(cmd.split(/[\s'";|&()<>]+/))) {
        const rel = /[\w-]\.\w+$/.test(token) ? this.repo.rel(token) : null;
        if (rel && this.repo.facts.files.includes(rel)) this.bus.emit('looked', { tool: 'Bash' }, { path: rel, cell: this.repo.cellOf(rel) });
      }
    }
    return { async: true };
  };

  /**
   * Edits made through Bash (heredocs, `sed -i`, inline scripts) would skip the edit gate. Deny commands that
   * write files inside the repo and ask for Edit/Write instead; tests, git and reads pass. The watcher still
   * records anything that slips through, as an unattributed edit.
   */
  private gateBash: HookCallback = async (input) => {
    const cmd = String((input as PreToolUseHookInput & { tool_input: { command?: string } }).tool_input.command ?? '');
    const target = bashWriteTarget(cmd, (p) => this.repo.rel(p));
    if (!target) return {};
    return {
      hookSpecificOutput: {
        hookEventName: 'PreToolUse',
        permissionDecision: 'deny',
        permissionDecisionReason: `Interpretability: change files in this repo with the Edit or Write tool, not through Bash (${target}), so every edit can be checked against the architecture rules. Make this change with Edit/Write instead.`,
      },
    };
  };

  /** The edit gate: same checker as load and plan, on the imports/writes this edit would add. */
  private gate: HookCallback = async (input) => {
    const i = input as PreToolUseHookInput;
    const ti = i.tool_input as { file_path?: string; content?: string; old_string?: string; new_string?: string; replace_all?: boolean };
    if (!ti.file_path) return {};
    const rel = this.repo.rel(ti.file_path);
    if (!rel) return {}; // outside the repo, e.g. Claude's own plan file
    const old = this.repo.current(rel);
    let next: string;
    try {
      next = i.tool_name === 'Write' ? ti.content ?? '' : applyEdit(old ?? '', ti.old_string ?? '', ti.new_string ?? '', ti.replace_all);
    } catch {
      return {}; // the Edit will fail on its own
    }
    const delta = deltaForEdit(rel, old, next, withExtra(this.repo.exists, [rel]));
    const violations = check(this.repo.map, delta, this.repo.mapper);
    this.bus.emit('cursor', { verb: 'editing' }, { path: rel, cell: this.repo.cellOf(rel) });
    if (!violations.length) {
      this.repo.markPending(rel);
      return {};
    }
    for (const v of violations) this.bus.emit('gate_blocked', { violation: v, tool: i.tool_name }, { path: rel, cell: this.repo.cellOf(rel) });
    this.turn?.gateBlocks.push(...violations);
    const { open, decided } = splitDecided(violations);
    const why = [
      'Interpretability blocked this edit.',
      ...(open.length ? [violationText(open), ASK_RULE] : []),
      ...(decided.length ? [...decided.map((v) => v.reason), decidedText(this.repo.root, decided)] : []),
    ];
    return {
      hookSpecificOutput: {
        hookEventName: 'PreToolUse',
        permissionDecision: 'deny',
        permissionDecisionReason: why.join('\n'),
      },
    };
  };

  private afterEdit: HookCallback = async (input) => {
    const i = input as PostToolUseHookInput;
    const ti = i.tool_input as { file_path?: string };
    const rel = ti.file_path ? this.repo.rel(ti.file_path) : null;
    if (rel) setImmediate(() => this.repo.fileChanged(rel, { tool: i.tool_name }));
    return { async: true };
  };

  private afterAlike: HookCallback = async (input) => {
    const i = input as PostToolUseHookInput;
    const res = JSON.stringify(i.tool_response ?? '');
    const ids = new Set(JSON.stringify(i.tool_input).match(/DR-\d+/g) ?? []);
    if (/error|failed|unauthori[sz]ed/i.test(res) && !/"id"/.test(res)) return { async: true };
    for (const d of this.bus.events.filter((e) => e.kind === 'decision_recorded')) {
      const data = d.data as { id: string };
      if (ids.has(data.id)) this.bus.emit('decision_recorded', { ...(d.data as EventData['decision_recorded']), alike: true });
    }
    return { async: true };
  };

  private canUseTool: CanUseTool = async (name, input) => {
    if (name === 'ExitPlanMode') {
      const turn = this.turn;
      if (turn && !turn.planned) {
        return { behavior: 'deny', message: 'Call mcp__interpretability__submit_plan with your numbered steps before exiting plan mode.' };
      }
      if (turn?.planViolations.length) {
        const { open, decided } = splitDecided(turn.planViolations);
        if (open.length) return { behavior: 'deny', message: `The plan has unresolved violations.\n${violationText(open)}\n${ASK_RULE}` };
        return { behavior: 'deny', message: `The plan crosses a decided rule.\n${decidedText(this.repo.root, decided)}\nResubmit the plan with mcp__interpretability__submit_plan.` };
      }
      const plan = String((input as { plan?: unknown }).plan ?? '');
      this.bus.emit('approval_requested', { plan });
      return new Promise<PermissionResult>((resolve) => { this.approval = { resolve, input }; });
    }
    return { behavior: 'allow', updatedInput: input };
  };

  interrupt() { void this.q?.interrupt(); }
}

// Staged, interruptible transitions between two laid-out frames (NAVIGATION_PLAN §3.3):
//   0–150 ms   fade out edges that will change and nodes that will go
//   150–450 ms one commit, then FLIP the moved nodes with the Web Animations API; the camera flies in parallel
//   450–650 ms new nodes fade in and changed edges draw in (CSS, keyed on the commit)
// A new request at any point cancels the pending stage and starts from what is on screen.
import type { Frame } from './layout/frame';

export const reducedMotion = () => typeof matchMedia !== 'undefined' && matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)').matches;

export const T_FADE = 150;
export const T_MOVE = 300;
export const T_ENTER = 200;
const EASE = 'cubic-bezier(0.25, 0.8, 0.3, 1)';
const FADE_ID = 'v2-fade';

/** What enters with a commit: new nodes, changed edges, and edges that just became new (one pulse each, never looping). */
export type Enter = { nodes: Set<string>; edges: Set<string>; pulse: Set<string>; seq: number };
export type TransitionStats = { commitMs: number; commitToFrameMs: number; moved: number; entered: number; removed: number; animated: boolean };

export type TransitionHooks = {
  root(): HTMLElement | null;
  /** Must commit synchronously (flushSync): content and positions land in one React commit. */
  commit(next: Frame, enter: Enter): void;
  camera(next: Frame, prev: Frame | null, animate: boolean): void;
};

const sel = (attr: string, id: string) => `[${attr}="${CSS.escape(id)}"]`;

export class Transitioner {
  private timers: number[] = [];
  private seq = 0;
  shown: Frame | null = null;
  last: TransitionStats | null = null;
  onDone: ((s: TransitionStats) => void) | null = null;

  constructor(private hooks: TransitionHooks) {}

  cancel() {
    for (const t of this.timers) clearTimeout(t);
    this.timers = [];
    const root = this.hooks.root();
    if (!root) return;
    root.classList.remove('is-moving');
    for (const a of root.getAnimations({ subtree: true })) {
      if (a.id === FADE_ID) a.cancel();
      else if (a instanceof CSSAnimation || a instanceof CSSTransition) continue;
      else a.finish();
    }
  }

  go(next: Frame) {
    this.cancel();
    const prev = this.shown;
    const root = this.hooks.root();
    const animate = !!prev && !!root && !reducedMotion();
    const prevEdges = new Map(prev?.edges.map((e) => [e.id, e.d]) ?? []);
    const nextEdges = new Map(next.edges.map((e) => [e.id, e.d]));
    const changedEdges = [...prevEdges].filter(([id, d]) => nextEdges.get(id) !== d).map(([id]) => id);
    const removed = prev ? prev.nodes.filter((n) => !next.boxes[n.id]).map((n) => n.id) : [];
    const prevStatus = new Map(prev?.edges.map((e) => [e.id, e.status]) ?? []);
    const enter: Enter = {
      nodes: new Set(prev ? next.nodes.filter((n) => !prev.boxes[n.id]).map((n) => n.id) : []),
      edges: new Set(prev ? next.edges.filter((e) => prevEdges.get(e.id) !== e.d).map((e) => e.id) : []),
      pulse: new Set(prev ? next.edges.filter((e) => e.status === 'new' && prevStatus.get(e.id) !== 'new').map((e) => e.id) : []),
      seq: ++this.seq,
    };
    // Strata's depth fade, for transitions only: while the view changes, everything outside the focus recedes.
    if (animate && root && prev && prev.key !== next.key) {
      root.classList.add('is-moving');
      this.timers.push(window.setTimeout(() => root.classList.remove('is-moving'), T_FADE + T_MOVE + T_ENTER));
    }

    if (animate && root) {
      for (const id of changedEdges) root.querySelector(sel('data-edge', id))?.animate([{ opacity: 1 }, { opacity: 0 }], { duration: T_FADE, fill: 'forwards', easing: 'ease-out', id: FADE_ID });
      for (const id of removed) root.querySelector(`.react-flow__node${sel('data-id', id)}`)?.animate([{ opacity: 1 }, { opacity: 0 }], { duration: T_FADE, fill: 'forwards', easing: 'ease-out', id: FADE_ID });
    }
    const run = () => this.commit(prev, next, enter, animate, removed.length);
    if (animate && (changedEdges.length || removed.length)) this.timers.push(window.setTimeout(run, T_FADE));
    else run();
  }

  private commit(prev: Frame | null, next: Frame, enter: Enter, animate: boolean, removed: number) {
    const root = this.hooks.root();
    if (root) for (const a of root.getAnimations({ subtree: true })) if (a.id === FADE_ID) a.cancel();
    const t0 = performance.now();
    this.hooks.commit(next, enter);
    const commitMs = performance.now() - t0;
    this.shown = next;

    let moved = 0;
    if (animate && prev && root) {
      for (const n of next.nodes) {
        const a = prev.boxes[n.id];
        if (!a) continue;
        const posChanged = Math.abs(a.x - n.x) > 0.5 || Math.abs(a.y - n.y) > 0.5;
        const sizeChanged = Math.abs(a.w - n.w) > 0.5 || Math.abs(a.h - n.h) > 0.5;
        if (!posChanged && !sizeChanged) continue;
        const el = root.querySelector<HTMLElement>(`.react-flow__node${sel('data-id', n.id)}`);
        if (!el) continue;
        moved++;
        const from: Keyframe = { transform: `translate(${a.x}px, ${a.y}px)` };
        const to: Keyframe = { transform: `translate(${n.x}px, ${n.y}px)` };
        if (sizeChanged) Object.assign(from, { width: `${a.w}px`, height: `${a.h}px` }), Object.assign(to, { width: `${n.w}px`, height: `${n.h}px` });
        el.animate([from, to], { duration: T_MOVE, easing: EASE });
      }
    }
    this.hooks.camera(next, prev, animate);
    const stats: TransitionStats = { commitMs, commitToFrameMs: 0, moved, entered: enter.nodes.size, removed, animated: animate };
    requestAnimationFrame(() => {
      stats.commitToFrameMs = performance.now() - t0;
      this.last = stats;
      const done = () => this.onDone?.(stats);
      if (animate) this.timers.push(window.setTimeout(done, T_MOVE + T_ENTER));
      else done();
    });
  }
}
// Where you are and how to move: back/forward (⌘[ ⌘]), breadcrumbs (System › Domain › Cell › Group › File),
// the ⌘K search and the minimap toggle.
import { useStore } from '../store';
import { ancestors, jump } from './nav';
import { useScene } from './pipeline';
import { useV2 } from './store';

const CRUMB = new Set(['domain', 'cell', 'group', 'file', 'unassigned']);
const mac = typeof navigator !== 'undefined' && /Mac|iPhone|iPad/.test(navigator.platform);
const mod = mac ? '⌘' : 'Ctrl+';

export function NavBar() {
  const scene = useScene();
  const open = useV2((s) => s.open);
  const focus = useV2((s) => s.focus);
  const back = useV2((s) => s.back.length);
  const forward = useV2((s) => s.forward.length);
  const minimap = useV2((s) => s.minimap);
  const st = useV2.getState();
  const select = useStore((s) => s.select);
  const graph = scene?.graph;

  const at = focus && graph?.nodes[focus] ? focus : scene?.open.at(-1) ?? null;
  const path = graph && at ? ancestors(graph, at).filter((id) => CRUMB.has(graph.nodes[id]!.kind)) : [];
  const goTo = (id: string | null) => {
    if (!graph) return;
    select(null);
    if (!id) return st.go({ open: [], focus: null });
    const next = jump(graph, { open, focus }, id);
    st.go(next, next.focus);
  };

  return (
    <nav className="v2-nav" aria-label="Map navigation">
      <span className="v2-nav-hist">
        <button type="button" className="v2-nav-btn" disabled={!back} onClick={st.goBack} title={`Back (${mod}[)`} aria-label="Back">‹</button>
        <button type="button" className="v2-nav-btn" disabled={!forward} onClick={st.goForward} title={`Forward (${mod}])`} aria-label="Forward">›</button>
      </span>
      <ol className="v2-crumbs">
        <li>{path.length ? <button type="button" onClick={() => goTo(null)}>System</button> : <span aria-current="location">System</span>}</li>
        {path.map((id, i) => {
          const n = graph!.nodes[id]!;
          const last = i === path.length - 1;
          return (
            <li key={id}>
              {last ? <span aria-current="location">{n.label}</span> : <button type="button" onClick={() => goTo(id)}>{n.label}</button>}
            </li>
          );
        })}
      </ol>
      <span className="v2-nav-tools">
        <button type="button" className="v2-nav-search" onClick={() => st.setPalette(true)} title="Find a domain, cell, file, symbol, route, decision or turn">
          Find <kbd>{mod}K</kbd>
        </button>
        <button type="button" className={`v2-nav-btn ${minimap ? 'is-on' : ''}`} onClick={st.toggleMinimap} aria-pressed={minimap} title="Minimap (m)">
          <svg viewBox="0 0 16 16" width="16" height="16" aria-hidden="true"><rect x="1.5" y="3" width="13" height="10" rx="1.5" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth="1.3" /><rect x="8" y="7.5" width="5" height="4" fill="currentColor" /></svg>
        </button>
      </span>
    </nav>

// ⌘K: find a domain, cell, group, file, symbol, route, decision or turn. Jumping opens the containers on the way,
// focuses and selects the target, and flies the camera there.
import { useEffect, useMemo, useRef, useState } from 'react';
import { fileOf, type ContextGraph, type UIState } from '@harness/core/view';
import { useView } from '../derive';
import { useStore } from '../store';
import { jump } from './nav';
import { useScene } from './pipeline';
import { selectionFor } from './select';
import { useV2 } from './store';

type Item = { key: string; kind: string; label: string; sub: string; hay: string; rank: number; run: () => void };

const RANK: Record<string, number> = { domain: 0, cell: 1, group: 2, file: 3, route: 4, symbol: 5, decision: 6, turn: 7 };
const KIND_LABEL: Record<string, string> = { domain: 'Domain', cell: 'Cell', group: 'Folder', file: 'File', route: 'Route', symbol: 'Symbol', decision: 'Decision', turn: 'Turn' };

function isMember(g: ContextGraph, id: string) {
  const n = g.nodes[id]!;
  const p = n.parent ? g.nodes[n.parent] : undefined;
  return (n.symbol?.kind === 'property' || n.symbol?.kind === 'method') && p?.symbol?.kind === 'type';
}

function itemsOf(graph: ContextGraph, ui: UIState, go: (id: string) => void, setTurn: (id: string | null) => void): Item[] {
  const out: Item[] = [];
  const domainName = (d?: string) => (d && graph.nodes[`domain:${d}`]?.label) || d || '';
  for (const n of Object.values(graph.nodes)) {
    let kind: string = n.kind;
    let sub = '';
    if (n.kind === 'domain') sub = 'Domain';
    else if (n.kind === 'cell') sub = `${domainName(n.domain)} cell`;
    else if (n.kind === 'group') sub = `${domainName(n.domain)} · ${n.path ?? ''}`;
    else if (n.kind === 'file') sub = n.path ?? n.id;
    else if (n.kind === 'route') sub = fileOf(n.parent ?? '') ?? '';
    else if (n.kind === 'symbol') { if (isMember(graph, n.id)) continue; sub = fileOf(n.id) ?? ''; }
    else continue;
    const label = n.kind === 'cell' ? `${domainName(n.domain)} · ${n.label}` : n.kind === 'symbol' ? n.id.slice(n.id.indexOf('#') + 1) : n.label;
    if (n.kind === 'group' && n.id === 'group:vendors') continue;
    kind = n.kind;
    out.push({ key: n.id, kind, label, sub, hay: `${label} ${sub}`.toLowerCase(), rank: RANK[kind] ?? 9, run: () => go(n.id) });
  }
  for (const d of ui.decisions) {
    const target = d.paths.find((p) => graph.nodes[p]);
    out.push({ key: `dec:${d.id}`, kind: 'decision', label: `${d.id} ${d.title}`, sub: d.paths.join(', ') || d.invariant, hay: `${d.id} ${d.title} ${d.invariant} ${d.paths.join(' ')}`.toLowerCase(), rank: RANK.decision!, run: () => (target ? go(target) : undefined) });
  }
  ui.turns.forEach((t, i) => {
    out.push({ key: `turn:${t.id}`, kind: 'turn', label: `Turn ${i + 1}`, sub: t.prompt, hay: `turn ${i + 1} ${t.prompt}`.toLowerCase(), rank: RANK.turn!, run: () => setTurn(i === ui.turns.length - 1 ? null : t.id) });
  });
  return out;
}

function search(items: Item[], q: string): Item[] {
  const terms = q.toLowerCase().split(/\s+/).filter(Boolean);
  if (!terms.length) return items.filter((i) => i.kind === 'domain' || i.kind === 'turn' || i.kind === 'decision').sort((a, b) => a.rank - b.rank);
  const scored: { i: Item; s: number }[] = [];
  for (const i of items) {
    if (!terms.every((t) => i.hay.includes(t))) continue;
    const l = i.label.toLowerCase();
    const s = (l === terms[0] ? 0 : l.startsWith(terms[0]!) ? 10 : l.includes(terms[0]!) ? 20 : 40) + i.rank * 2 + Math.min(20, l.length / 4);
    scored.push({ i, s });
  }
  return scored.sort((a, b) => a.s - b.s || a.i.label.localeCompare(b.i.label)).slice(0, 40).map((x) => x.i);
}

export function Palette() {
  const open = useV2((s) => s.palette);
  if (!open) return null;
  return <PaletteBody />;
}

function PaletteBody() {
  const scene = useScene();
  const ui = useView().ui;
  const select = useStore((s) => s.select);
  const setTurn = useStore((s) => s.setTurn);
  const [q, setQ] = useState('');
  const [at, setAt] = useState(0);
  const input = useRef<HTMLInputElement>(null);
  const close = () => useV2.getState().setPalette(false);

  const items = useMemo(() => {
    if (!scene) return [];
    const go = (id: string) => {
      const st = useV2.getState();
      const next = jump(scene.graph, { open: st.open, focus: st.focus }, id);
      st.go(next, next.focus);
      const n = next.focus ? scene.graph.nodes[next.focus] : undefined;
      if (n) select(selectionFor(n));
    };
    return itemsOf(scene.graph, ui, go, setTurn);
  }, [scene, ui, select, setTurn]);
  const results = useMemo(() => search(items, q), [items, q]);

  useEffect(() => { input.current?.focus(); }, []);
  useEffect(() => setAt(0), [q]);

  const choose = (i: Item | undefined) => {
    if (!i) return;
    close();
    i.run();
  };

  return (
    <div className="v2-palette-scrim" onMouseDown={close}>
      <div className="v2-palette" role="dialog" aria-label="Find on the map" onMouseDown={(e) => e.stopPropagation()}>
        <input
          ref={input}
          className="v2-palette-input"
          value={q}
          placeholder="Find a domain, file, symbol, route, decision or turn"
          aria-label="Search the map"
          onChange={(e) => setQ(e.target.value)}
          onKeyDown={(e) => {
            if (e.key === 'Escape') { e.preventDefault(); close(); }
            else if (e.key === 'ArrowDown') { e.preventDefault(); setAt((a) => Math.min(results.length - 1, a + 1)); }
            else if (e.key === 'ArrowUp') { e.preventDefault(); setAt((a) => Math.max(0, a - 1)); }
            else if (e.key === 'Enter') { e.preventDefault(); choose(results[at]); }
          }}
        />
        <ul className="v2-palette-list" role="listbox">
          {results.length === 0 && <li className="v2-palette-none">Nothing matches “{q}”.</li>}
          {results.map((r, i) => (
            <li key={r.key} role="option" aria-selected={i === at} className={i === at ? 'is-active' : ''} onMouseEnter={() => setAt(i)} onClick={() => choose(r)}>
              <span className={`v2-palette-kind k-${r.kind}`}>{KIND_LABEL[r.kind] ?? r.kind}</span>
              <span className="v2-palette-label">{r.label}</span>
              <span className="v2-palette-sub">{r.sub}</span>
            </li>
          ))}
        </ul>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}
import {
  cellKey, cellViews, edgeViews, ledger, reduce, turnLedger,
  type CellView, type EdgeView, type HarnessEvent, type Ledger, type TurnLedger, type TurnState, type UIState, type Violation,
} from '@harness/core/view';
import { useStore } from './store';

/** Everything the UI shows, as a pure function of (events, replay index, selected turn). */
export type View = {
  ui: UIState;
  upTo: number;
  live: boolean;
  turn: TurnState | null;
  turnIndex: number; // 1-based, 0 when no turn
  cells: Record<string, CellView>;
  edges: EdgeView[];
  ledger: Ledger;
  turnLedger: TurnLedger | null;
  /** cellKey → files placed there (product files only; tests are listed under their domain). */
  cellFiles: Record<string, string[]>;
  testFiles: Record<string, string[]>;
  unassigned: string[];
  proposal: { domains: number; rules: number } | null;
  steps: { done: number; total: number };
  turnStarts: number[];
};

let reduceCache: { events: readonly HarnessEvent[]; upTo: number; ui: UIState } | null = null;
let viewCache: { ui: UIState; turnSel: string | null; view: View } | null = null;

function reduced(events: readonly HarnessEvent[], upTo: number): UIState {
  if (reduceCache && reduceCache.events === events && reduceCache.upTo === upTo) return reduceCache.ui;
  const ui = reduce(events, upTo);
  reduceCache = { events, upTo, ui };
  return ui;
}

export function deriveView(events: readonly HarnessEvent[], replay: number | null, turnSel: string | null): View {
  const upTo = replay ?? events.length;
  const ui = reduced(events, upTo);
  if (viewCache && viewCache.ui === ui && viewCache.turnSel === turnSel) return viewCache.view;

  const turn = (turnSel && ui.turns.find((t) => t.id === turnSel)) || ui.turns.at(-1) || null;
  const cellFiles: Record<string, string[]> = {};
  const testFiles: Record<string, string[]> = {};
  const unassigned: string[] = [];
  for (const [path, p] of Object.entries(ui.files)) {
    if (p.kind === 'cell') (cellFiles[cellKey(p)] ??= []).push(path);
    else if (p.kind === 'test') (testFiles[p.domain] ??= []).push(path);
    else if (p.kind === 'unassigned') unassigned.push(path);
  }
  for (const list of Object.values(cellFiles)) list.sort();

  let proposed = -1;
  let confirmed = -1;
  const turnStarts: number[] = [];
  for (let i = 0; i < events.length; i++) {
    const k = events[i]!.kind;
    if (k === 'turn_started') turnStarts.push(i);
    if (i >= upTo) continue;
    if (k === 'map_proposed') proposed = i;
    if (k === 'map_confirmed') confirmed = i;
  }
  const proposal = proposed > confirmed && ui.map ? { domains: ui.map.domains.length, rules: ui.map.invariants.length } : null;

  const l = ledger(ui);
  const view: View = {
    ui,
    upTo,
    live: replay === null,
    turn,
    turnIndex: turn ? ui.turns.indexOf(turn) + 1 : 0,
    cells: cellViews(ui, turn?.id ?? null),
    edges: edgeViews(ui, turn?.id ?? null),
    ledger: l,
    turnLedger: turn ? turnLedger(ui, turn) : null,
    cellFiles,
    testFiles,
    unassigned,
    proposal,
    steps: turn ? stepProgress(turn) : { done: 0, total: 0 },
    turnStarts,
  };
  viewCache = { ui, turnSel, view };
  return view;
}

/** "3 of 6 steps": a step is done when every cell it plans has been edited (or, for a step with no cells, its files). */
function stepProgress(turn: TurnState) {
  const editedFiles = new Set([
    ...Object.values(turn.edited).flatMap((c) => c.files),
    ...Object.values(turn.tests).flat(),
    ...turn.unassigned,
  ]);
  let done = 0;
  for (const step of turn.steps) {
    const cells = Object.entries(turn.planned).filter(([, c]) => c.steps.includes(step.n)).map(([k]) => k);
    const ok = cells.length ? cells.every((k) => !!turn.edited[k]) : step.files.length > 0 && step.files.every((f) => editedFiles.has(f));
    if (ok) done++;
  }
  return { done, total: turn.steps.length };
}

export function useView(): View {
  const events = useStore((s) => s.events);
  const replay = useStore((s) => s.replay);
  const turnSel = useStore((s) => s.turn);
  return deriveView(events, replay, turnSel);
}

/** Violations relevant to the selected turn (load-time plus this turn's plan and gate), for the inspector. */
export function turnViolations(v: View): { v: Violation; source: 'load' | 'plan' | 'gate' }[] {
  const out: { v: Violation; source: 'load' | 'plan' | 'gate' }[] = v.ui.violations.map((x) => ({ v: x, source: 'load' as const }));
  for (const x of v.turn?.planViolations ?? []) out.push({ v: x, source: 'plan' });
  for (const x of v.turn?.gateBlocks ?? []) out.push({ v: x, source: 'gate' });
  return out;
}

export const basename = (p: string) => p.split('/').pop() ?? p;
export const stem = (p: string) => {
  const parts = p.split('/');
  const last = parts.pop() ?? p;
  // vendor/<name>/index.ts reads better as its folder name
  if (/^index\.[tj]sx?$/.test(last) && parts.length) return parts.pop()!;
  return last.replace(/\.[tj]sx?$/, '');
};

import { api, fakeMode } from '../connection';

import { useStore } from '../store';

export function ChatPane() {

  return (
    <aside className="chat">
      <div className="chat-head">
        <span className="chat-title">Claude Code</span>
        <span className={`chat-state ${busy ? 'is-busy' : ''}`}>
          {replaying ? 'Replaying' : conn === 'down' ? 'Offline' : busy ? 'Working' : 'Ready'}
        </span>
      </div>

      <div className="chat-log" ref={scroller}>
        {empty && (
          <div className="chat-empty">
            <p>Ask Claude to change something. The map shows what it plans and what it does.</p>
            <p className="chat-example">“Add a tool that summarizes a prospect's latest 10-K.”</p>
          </div>

        {busy && v.live && delta && (
          <div className="msg msg-assistant msg-streaming">
            <Markdown text={delta} />
          </div>
        )}
        {v.ui.errors.map((e, i) => (
          <div key={`e${i}`} className="msg msg-note">{e}</div>
        ))}

      {v.ui.pendingFork && <ForkCard />}
      {v.ui.awaitingApproval && !v.ui.pendingFork && <ApprovalCard plan={v.ui.awaitingApproval.plan} disabled={replaying} />}
      <Composer disabled={replaying || conn === 'down'} busy={busy && v.live} why={replaying ? 'Replaying. Go live to send.' : 'Waiting for the server.'} />
    </aside>
  );
}

function ForkCard() {
  const v = useView();
  const setDraft = useStore((s) => s.setDraft);
  const fork = v.ui.pendingFork!;
  const first = fork.violations[0];
  if (!first) return null;
  return (

      <p className="card-kicker">{first.invariant} would be crossed</p>

            <span>{first.options[i]}</span>

      </div>
      <p className="card-hint">Pick one and add your reason. It becomes a decision later sessions follow.</p>

      <p className="card-kicker">Plan ready</p>
      {plan.trim() && (
        <div className="card-plan">

function Composer({ disabled, busy, why }: { disabled: boolean; busy: boolean; why: string }) {

  const setDraft = useStore((s) => s.setDraft);
  const ta = useRef<HTMLTextAreaElement>(null);

  useEffect(() => {
    const el = ta.current;
    if (!el || !focusTick) return;
    el.focus();
    el.setSelectionRange(el.value.length, el.value.length);
  }, [focusTick]);

  useLayoutEffect(() => {
    const el = ta.current;
    if (!el) return;
    el.style.height = 'auto';
    el.style.height = `${Math.min(160, el.scrollHeight)}px`;
  }, [draft]);

  const send = () => {
    const t = draft.trim();
    if (!t || disabled) return;
    void api.chat(t);
    setDraft('');
  };

  return (
    <div className="composer">
      <textarea
        ref={ta}
        rows={1}
        value={draft}
        disabled={disabled}
        placeholder={disabled ? why : fakeMode ? 'Fake log loaded; sending is off.' : 'Message Claude'}
        onChange={(e) => setDraft(e.target.value)}
        onKeyDown={(e) => {
          if (e.key === 'Enter' && !e.shiftKey && !e.nativeEvent.isComposing) {
            e.preventDefault();
            send();
          }
        }}
      />
      {busy ? (
        <button className="btn btn-stop" onClick={() => void api.interrupt()}>Stop</button>
      ) : (
        <button className="btn btn-primary" disabled={disabled || !draft.trim()} onClick={send}>Send</button>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}
import { Fragment, type ReactNode } from 'react';

/** Just enough markdown for chat: fenced code, headings, lists, paragraphs, `code`, **bold**, *italic*. */
export function Markdown({ text }: { text: string }) {
  const blocks: ReactNode[] = [];
  const lines = text.replace(/\r\n/g, '\n').split('\n');
  let i = 0;
  let key = 0;
  while (i < lines.length) {
    const line = lines[i]!;
    const fence = line.match(/^\s*```(\w*)/);
    if (fence) {
      const body: string[] = [];
      i++;
      while (i < lines.length && !/^\s*```/.test(lines[i]!)) body.push(lines[i++]!);
      i++;
      blocks.push(<pre key={key++} className="md-pre"><code>{body.join('\n')}</code></pre>);
      continue;
    }
    if (!line.trim()) { i++; continue; }
    const heading = line.match(/^(#{1,4})\s+(.*)/);
    if (heading) {
      blocks.push(<p key={key++} className="md-h">{inline(heading[2]!)}</p>);
      i++;
      continue;
    }
    if (/^\s*([-*]|\d+[.)])\s+/.test(line)) {
      const ordered = /^\s*\d+[.)]/.test(line);
      const items: string[] = [];
      while (i < lines.length && /^\s*([-*]|\d+[.)])\s+/.test(lines[i]!)) {
        let item = lines[i]!.replace(/^\s*([-*]|\d+[.)])\s+/, '');
        i++;
        while (i < lines.length && /^\s{2,}\S/.test(lines[i]!) && !/^\s*([-*]|\d+[.)])\s+/.test(lines[i]!)) item += ' ' + lines[i++]!.trim();
        items.push(item);
      }
      const Tag = ordered ? 'ol' : 'ul';
      blocks.push(<Tag key={key++} className="md-list">{items.map((it, j) => <li key={j}>{inline(it)}</li>)}</Tag>);
      continue;
    }
    const para: string[] = [];
    while (i < lines.length && lines[i]!.trim() && !/^\s*(```|#{1,4}\s|[-*]\s|\d+[.)]\s)/.test(lines[i]!)) para.push(lines[i++]!);
    blocks.push(<p key={key++}>{inline(para.join(' '))}</p>);
  }
  return <div className="md">{blocks}</div>;
}

function inline(s: string): ReactNode[] {
  const out: ReactNode[] = [];
  const re = /(`[^`]+`)|(\*\*[^*]+\*\*)|(\*[^*\s][^*]*\*)/g;
  let last = 0;
  let m: RegExpExecArray | null;
  let k = 0;
  while ((m = re.exec(s))) {
    if (m.index > last) out.push(<Fragment key={k++}>{s.slice(last, m.index)}</Fragment>);
    const t = m[0];
    if (m[1]) out.push(<code key={k++}>{t.slice(1, -1)}</code>);
    else if (m[2]) out.push(<strong key={k++}>{t.slice(2, -2)}</strong>);
    else out.push(<em key={k++}>{t.slice(1, -1)}</em>);
    last = m.index + t.length;
  }
  if (last < s.length) out.push(<Fragment key={k++}>{s.slice(last)}</Fragment>);
  return out;
}
import { useEffect, useState, type ReactNode } from 'react';
import { provenance, type DomainMap, type ImportEdge, type Invariant, type Violation } from '@harness/core/view';
import { api } from '../connection';
import { turnViolations, useView, type View } from '../derive';
import { edgeSegments, globRe, invariantsFor } from '../layout';
import { useStore, type Selection } from '../store';
import { useV2 } from '../v2/store';

export function Inspector() {
  const selection = useStore((s) => s.selection);
  const select = useStore((s) => s.select);
  const v = useView();
  const [file, setFile] = useState<string | null>(null);

  useEffect(() => setFile(null), [selection]);
  useEffect(() => {
    const onKey = (e: KeyboardEvent) => {
      if (e.key === 'Escape') select(null);
    };
    addEventListener('keydown', onKey);
    return () => removeEventListener('keydown', onKey);
  }, [select]);

  if (!selection || !v.ui.map) return null;
  return (
    <aside className="inspector" aria-label="Inspector" onClick={(e) => e.stopPropagation()}>
      <button className="inspector-close" aria-label="Close inspector" onClick={() => select(null)}>×</button>
      {file ? (
        <FilePreview path={file} onBack={() => setFile(null)} />
      ) : (
        <Body v={v} sel={selection} map={v.ui.map} openFile={setFile} />
      )}
    </aside>
  );
}

function Body({ v, sel, map, openFile }: { v: View; sel: Selection; map: DomainMap; openFile: (p: string) => void }) {
  if ('unassigned' in sel) {
    const files = [...new Set([...v.unassigned, ...(v.turn?.unassigned ?? [])])].sort();
    return (
      <>
        <h2 className="insp-title">Unassigned</h2>
        <p className="insp-sub">Files that match no cell in domains.yaml. Add their paths to a domain to place them.</p>
        <Section title="Files"><FileList files={files} openFile={openFile} /></Section>
      </>
    );
  }
  if ('cell' in sel) return <CellBody v={v} k={sel.cell} map={map} openFile={openFile} />;
  if ('file' in sel) return <FileBody v={v} path={sel.file} map={map} openFile={openFile} />;
  if ('node' in sel) return <NodeBody v={v} id={sel.node} map={map} openFile={openFile} />;
  if ('link' in sel) return <LinkBody v={v} id={sel.link} map={map} openFile={openFile} />;
  return <EdgeBody v={v} edge={sel.edge} pair={sel.pair} map={map} openFile={openFile} />;
}

function CellBody({ v, k, map, openFile }: { v: View; k: string; map: DomainMap; openFile: (p: string) => void }) {
  const [domainId, layerId] = k.split('/') as [string, string];
  const domain = map.domains.find((d) => d.id === domainId);
  const layer = map.layers.find((l) => l.id === layerId);
  const cell = domain?.cells[layerId];
  const view = v.cells[k];
  const files = v.cellFiles[k] ?? [];
  const edited = v.turn?.edited[k];
  const planned = v.turn?.planned[k];
  const plannedNew = (planned?.files ?? []).filter((f) => !files.includes(f));
  const tests = v.testFiles[domainId] ?? [];
  const invs = invariantsFor(map, domainId, files);
  const vios = turnViolations(v).filter(({ v: x }) => cellOfFile(v, x.file) === k);
  const prov = provenance(v.ui, { cell: k });

  const state: string[] = [];
  if (view?.edited) state.push(view.unplanned ? 'Edited without being planned' : 'Edited this turn');
  if (view?.ghost) state.push(`Planned in ${stepList(view.ghost)}`);
  if (view?.looked && !view.edited) state.push('Looked at this turn');

  return (
    <>
      <h2 className="insp-title">{domain?.name ?? domainId} <span className="insp-layer">{layer?.name ?? layerId}</span></h2>
      {domain && <p className="insp-sub">{domain.purpose}</p>}
      {state.length > 0 && <p className={`insp-state ${view?.unplanned ? 'is-amber' : ''}`}>{state.join('. ')}{edited ? `: +${edited.added} −${edited.removed}` : ''}</p>}

      {vios.length > 0 && (
        <Section title="Rules crossed">
          {vios.map(({ v: x, source }, i) => <ViolationItem key={i} v={x} source={source} />)}
        </Section>
      )}

      <Section title={`Files (${files.length})`}>
        <FileList files={files} openFile={openFile} marks={(f) => (edited?.created.includes(f) ? 'created' : edited?.files.includes(f) ? 'edited' : null)} />
        {plannedNew.length > 0 && (
          <p className="insp-note">Planned, not created yet: {plannedNew.map((f) => <code key={f}>{f}</code>)}</p>
        )}
      </Section>

      {(cell?.paths?.length || cell?.tables?.length) && (
        <Section title="Defined by">
          {cell?.paths?.map((p) => <code key={p} className="insp-glob">{p}</code>)}
          {cell?.tables?.length ? <p className="insp-note">Owns tables {cell.tables.map((t) => <code key={t}>{t}</code>)}</p> : null}
        </Section>
      )}

      {invs.length > 0 && <Section title="Rules for this domain">{invs.map((i) => <InvariantItem key={i.id} inv={i} />)}</Section>}

      {tests.length > 0 && (
        <Section title={`Tests for ${domain?.name ?? domainId}`}><FileList files={tests} openFile={openFile} /></Section>
      )}

}

/** What the inspector shows for an edge, from v1's cell-pair segments or a v2 projected edge. */
type EdgeDetail = {

  to: string;

  state: 'existing' | 'new' | 'ghost';
  gate: boolean; // a ghost the edit gate blocked (never planned)
  decision?: { id: string; session: number } | null; // a ghost a standing decision rules out
  violation: boolean;
  steps: number[];

function EdgeBody({ v, edge, pair, map, openFile }: { v: View; edge: string; pair: string; map: DomainMap; openFile: (p: string) => void }) {
  const seg = edgeSegments(v.ui, v.turn, v.edges).find((s) => s.edgeKey === edge && s.pair === pair);
  const [from, to] = edge.split('->') as [string, string];
  const [srcCell, dstCell] = pair.split('=>') as [string, string];
  const layerName = (k: string) => map.layers.find((l) => l.id === k.split('/')[1])?.name ?? '';
  const d: EdgeDetail = {
    from, to, where: `${layerName(srcCell)} to ${layerName(dstCell)}`, state: seg?.state ?? 'existing', gate: false,
    violation: !!seg?.violation, steps: seg?.steps ?? [], files: seg?.files ?? [],
  };
  return <EdgeView v={v} d={d} map={map} openFile={openFile} />;
}

/** A v2 edge: the projected edge's leaf edges (imports, calls, writes; planned or gate-blocked imports for ghosts). */
function LinkBody({ v, id, map, openFile }: { v: View; id: string; map: DomainMap; openFile: (p: string) => void }) {
  const e = useV2((s) => s.edges[id]);
  const nodes = useV2((s) => s.nodes);
  if (!e) return <p className="insp-note">This link is not on the map at this point of the log.</p>;
  const a = nodes[e.from];
  const b = nodes[e.to];
  const files: ImportEdge[] = [];
  for (const leaf of e.leafEdges) {
    const [, f, t] = leaf.split('|') as [string, string, string];
    if (!files.some((x) => x.from === f && x.to === t)) files.push({ from: f, to: t });
  }
  const d: EdgeDetail = {
    from: a?.domain ?? e.from, to: b?.domain ?? e.to, where: `${a?.label ?? e.from} to ${b?.label ?? e.to}`,
    state: e.status, gate: e.leafEdges.every((l) => l.startsWith('gate|')), violation: e.violation !== null, steps: e.steps, files, decision: e.decision ?? null,
  };
  return <EdgeView v={v} d={d} map={map} openFile={openFile} kinds={e.kinds} />;
}

function EdgeView({ v, d, map, openFile, kinds }: { v: View; d: EdgeDetail; map: DomainMap; openFile: (p: string) => void; kinds?: string[] }) {

  const vios = turnViolations(v).filter(({ v: x }) => files.some((f) => f.from === x.file && (!x.target || x.target === f.to)));
  const invs = map.invariants.filter(

  );

    : d.state === 'ghost'
    ? d.gate ? 'Blocked at edit: the import was never written' : `Planned in ${stepList(d.steps)}, not built yet`
    : d.state === 'new' ? `Added in turn ${v.turnIndex}` : 'On the map before this turn';
