      <p className="insp-sub">{d.where}. Derived from {imports ? 'imports' : kinds!.join(', ')}; flow down a column is not drawn.</p>
      <p className={`insp-state ${d.decision ? 'is-decided' : d.violation ? 'is-red' : ''}`}>{state}</p>
      {vios.length > 0 && <Section title="Rules crossed">{vios.map(({ v: x, source }, i) => <ViolationItem key={i} v={x} source={source} />)}</Section>}
      <Section title={`${imports ? 'Imports' : 'Links'} (${files.length})`}>
        <ul className="insp-imports">
          {files.map((f, i) => (
            <li key={i}>
              <button className="link" onClick={() => openFile(f.from.split('#')[0]!)}>{f.from}</button>
              <span className="insp-arrow">→</span>
              <button className="link" onClick={() => openFile(f.to.split('#')[0]!)}>{f.to}</button>
            </li>
          ))}
        </ul>
      </Section>
      {invs.length > 0 && <Section title="Rules on this dependency">{invs.map((i) => <InvariantItem key={i.id} inv={i} />)}</Section>}
      <Provenance prov={prov} scope={`${name(from)} → ${name(to)}`} />
    </>
  );
}

/** One file (v2): where it sits, what the turn did to it, the rules it crosses, its imports and its code. */
function FileBody({ v, path, map, openFile }: { v: View; path: string; map: DomainMap; openFile: (p: string) => void }) {
  const node = useV2((s) => s.nodes[path]);
  const p = v.ui.files[path];
  const pa = v.turn?.paths[path];
  const r = node?.rollup;
  const domain = p && 'domain' in p ? map.domains.find((d) => d.id === p.domain) : undefined;
  const layer = p?.kind === 'cell' ? map.layers.find((l) => l.id === p.layer) : undefined;
  const vios = turnViolations(v).filter(({ v: x }) => x.file === path);
  const out = (v.ui.facts[path]?.imports.map((i) => i.to) ?? []).filter((x) => !x.startsWith('vendor:'));
  const into = Object.values(v.ui.facts).filter((f) => f.imports.some((i) => i.to === path)).map((f) => f.path).sort();
  const sym = pa?.symbols;
  const changed: [string, string][] = sym
    ? [...sym.added.map((s) => ['added', s] as [string, string]), ...sym.sig.map((s) => ['signature', s] as [string, string]), ...sym.body.map((s) => ['body', s] as [string, string]), ...sym.removed.map((s) => ['removed', s] as [string, string])]
    : [];
  const edited = !!(r?.edited || pa?.edits);
  const state: string[] = [];
  if (edited) state.push(r?.unplanned ? 'Edited without being planned' : pa?.created ? 'Created this turn' : 'Edited this turn');
  if (r?.ghostSteps.length) state.push(`Planned in ${stepList(r.ghostSteps)}${r.plannedNew ? ', not created yet' : ''}`);
  if ((r?.looked || pa?.looked) && !edited) state.push('Looked at this turn');
  const prov = p?.kind === 'cell' ? provenance(v.ui, { cell: `${p.domain}/${p.layer}` }) : null;
  return (
    <>
      <h2 className="insp-title insp-path">{path}</h2>
      <p className="insp-sub">{domain ? `${domain.name}${layer ? `, ${layer.name}` : ' tests'}` : p?.kind === 'neutral' ? 'Shared code' : 'Unassigned'}</p>
      {state.length > 0 && <p className={`insp-state ${r?.unplanned ? 'is-amber' : ''}`}>{state.join('. ')}{pa?.edits ? `: +${pa.added} −${pa.removed}` : ''}</p>}
      <button className="btn insp-open" onClick={() => openFile(path)}>Show code</button>
      {vios.length > 0 && <Section title="Rules crossed">{vios.map(({ v: x, source }, i) => <ViolationItem key={i} v={x} source={source} />)}</Section>}
      {changed.length > 0 && (
        <Section title={`Symbols changed (${changed.length})`}>
          <ul className="insp-files">{changed.map(([k, id]) => <li key={`${k}${id}`}><code>{id.slice(id.indexOf('#') + 1)}</code> <span className="insp-mark">{k}</span></li>)}</ul>
        </Section>
      )}
      <Section title={`Imports (${out.length})`}><FileList files={out} openFile={openFile} /></Section>
      <Section title={`Imported by (${into.length})`}><FileList files={into} openFile={openFile} /></Section>
      {prov && <Provenance prov={prov} />}
    </>
  );
}

/** A domain, a folder, or a domain's tests (v2). */
function NodeBody({ v, id, map, openFile }: { v: View; id: string; map: DomainMap; openFile: (p: string) => void }) {
  const node = useV2((s) => s.nodes[id]);
  const domain = map.domains.find((d) => d.id === (node?.domain ?? id.replace(/^domain:/, '')));
  if (id.startsWith('domain:') && domain) {
    const files = Object.entries(v.ui.files).filter(([, p]) => p.kind === 'cell' && p.domain === domain.id).map(([f]) => f);
    const invs = invariantsFor(map, domain.id, files);
    const count = (layer: string) => files.filter((f) => { const p = v.ui.files[f]; return p?.kind === 'cell' && p.layer === layer; }).length;
    return (
      <>
        <h2 className="insp-title">{domain.name}</h2>
        <p className="insp-sub">{domain.purpose}</p>
        <Section title="Cells">
          <ul className="insp-files">
            {map.layers.filter((l) => l.id in domain.cells).map((l) => <li key={l.id}>{l.name} <span className="insp-note">{count(l.id)} files</span></li>)}
          </ul>
        </Section>
        {invs.length > 0 && <Section title="Rules for this domain">{invs.map((i) => <InvariantItem key={i.id} inv={i} />)}</Section>}
      </>
    );
  }
  const columns = useV2((s) => s.columns[id]);
  if (node?.kind === 'table') {
    return (
      <>
        <h2 className="insp-title">{node.label} <span className="insp-layer">table</span></h2>
        {domain && <p className="insp-sub">Owned by {domain.name}</p>}
        <Section title={`Columns (${columns?.length ?? 0})`}>
          {columns?.length ? <ul className="insp-files">{columns.map((c) => <li key={c}><code>{c}</code></li>)}</ul> : <p className="insp-note">No schema file defines it.</p>}
        </Section>
      </>
    );
  }
  const prefix = node?.path ? `${node.path}/` : null;
  const files = prefix
    ? Object.keys(v.ui.files).filter((f) => f.startsWith(prefix)).sort()
    : node?.kind === 'tests' && domain ? Object.entries(v.ui.files).filter(([, p]) => p.kind === 'test' && p.domain === domain.id).map(([f]) => f).sort() : [];
  return (
    <>
      <h2 className="insp-title">{node?.label ?? id}</h2>
      {domain && <p className="insp-sub">{domain.name}</p>}
      <Section title={`Files (${files.length})`}><FileList files={files} openFile={openFile} /></Section>
    </>
  );
}

function cellOfFile(v: View, file: string): string | null {
  const p = v.ui.files[file];
  if (p?.kind === 'cell') return `${p.domain}/${p.layer}`;
  const planned = v.turn && Object.entries(v.turn.planned).find(([, c]) => c.files.includes(file));
  return planned ? planned[0] : null;
}

function Section({ title, children }: { title: string; children: ReactNode }) {
  return (
    <section className="insp-section">
      <h3>{title}</h3>
      {children}
    </section>
  );
}

function FileList({ files, openFile, marks }: { files: string[]; openFile: (p: string) => void; marks?: (f: string) => string | null }) {
  if (!files.length) return <p className="insp-note">None.</p>;
  return (
    <ul className="insp-files">
      {files.map((f) => {
        const m = marks?.(f);
        return (
          <li key={f}>
            <button className="link" onClick={() => openFile(f)}>{f}</button>
            {m && <span className={`insp-mark mark-${m}`}>{m}</span>}
          </li>
        );
      })}
    </ul>
  );
}

function ViolationItem({ v, source }: { v: Violation; source: 'load' | 'plan' | 'gate' }) {
  const where = source === 'load' ? 'Found on load' : source === 'plan' ? 'In this turn’s plan' : 'Blocked at edit';
  return (
    <div className={`insp-violation ${source === 'load' ? '' : 'is-new'}`}>
      <p className="insp-vio-head"><strong>{v.invariant}</strong> {where}</p>
      <p>{v.reason}</p>
      <code className="insp-glob">{v.detail}</code>
    </div>
  );
}

function InvariantItem({ inv }: { inv: Invariant }) {
  return (
    <div className="insp-inv">
      <p><strong>{inv.id}</strong> {inv.rule}</p>
      {(inv.decisions?.length || inv.exceptions.length) ? (
        <p className="insp-note">
          {inv.decisions?.length ? <>Confirmed by {inv.decisions.join(', ')}. </> : null}
          {inv.exceptions.length ? <>Exceptions: {inv.exceptions.map((e) => <code key={e.path}>{e.path}{e.decision ? ` (${e.decision})` : ''}</code>)}</> : null}
        </p>
      ) : null}
    </div>
  );
}

function Provenance({ prov, scope }: { prov: ReturnType<typeof provenance>; scope?: string }) {
  if (!prov.turns.length && !prov.decisions.length) {
    return <Section title="History"><p className="insp-note">No changes this session.</p></Section>;
  }
  return (
    <Section title="History">
      <ul className="insp-prov">
        {prov.turns.map((t) => {
          const decs = prov.decisions.filter((d) => d.turn === t.id);
          return (
            <li key={t.id}>
              <span>{scope ? `${scope} changed in turn ${t.index}` : `Changed in turn ${t.index}`}{decs.length ? `, under ${decs.map((d) => d.id).join(', ')}` : ''}</span>
              <span className="insp-prov-prompt">{t.prompt}</span>
              {decs.map((d) => (
                <span key={d.id} className="insp-prov-dec">
                  <strong>{d.id}</strong> {d.title}{d.alike ? ' · in Alike' : ''}
                </span>
              ))}
            </li>
          );
        })}
      </ul>
    </Section>
  );
}

function FilePreview({ path, onBack }: { path: string; onBack: () => void }) {
  const [text, setText] = useState<string | null | undefined>(undefined);
  useEffect(() => {
    let live = true;
    setText(undefined);
    api.file(path).then((t) => live && setText(t)).catch(() => live && setText(null));
    return () => {
      live = false;
    };
  }, [path]);
  return (
    <>
      <button className="link insp-back" onClick={onBack}>Back</button>
      <h2 className="insp-title insp-path">{path}</h2>
      {text === undefined && <p className="insp-note">Loading…</p>}
      {text === null && <p className="insp-note">Not on disk. It may be planned but not created yet.</p>}
      {typeof text === 'string' && (
        <pre className="insp-code">
          {text.split('\n').map((l, i) => (
            <span key={i} className="code-line"><span className="code-no">{i + 1}</span>{l || ' '}{'\n'}</span>
          ))}
        </pre>
      )}
    </>
  );
}

const stepList = (steps: number[]) =>
  steps.length === 1 ? `step ${steps[0]}` : `steps ${steps.slice(0, -1).join(', ')} and ${steps[steps.length - 1]}`;

import { createSdkMcpServer, tool } from '@anthropic-ai/claude-agent-sdk';
import { z } from 'zod';
import { planFootprint, withExtra, type PlanStep, type Violation } from '@harness/core';
import { listDecisions } from './decisions';
import { findNode, neighborsText, sinksFor, symbolsText, traceText } from './graph-tools';
import { semanticStore } from './semantic';
import type { Repo } from './repo';
import type { Bus } from './bus';

const text = (t: string) => ({ content: [{ type: 'text' as const, text: t }] });

export function violationText(vs: Violation[]): string {
  return vs.map((v) => `${v.reason}\n  (A) ${v.options[0]}\n  (B) ${v.options[1]}`).join('\n');
}

/**
 * Beat 4: a violation of an invariant with a linked decision is not a fork. Claude is told what was decided and to
 * plan that way, never to ask again. One line per decision, from decisions/DR-n.md.
 */
export function decidedText(root: string, vs: readonly Violation[]): string {
  const records = new Map(listDecisions(root).map((d) => [d.id, d]));
  return [...new Set(vs.flatMap((v) => (v.decision ? [v.decision] : [])))].map((id) => {
    const d = records.get(id);
    const outcome = d?.outcome ?? vs.find((v) => v.decision === id)!.options[0];
    return `Already decided in ${id}${d ? ` (${d.title})` : ''}: ${outcome}. Plan it the decided way and resubmit; do not ask the user.`;
  }).join('\n');
}

/** Undecided violations are forks (ask A or B); decided ones are replanned without asking. */
export const splitDecided = (vs: readonly Violation[]) => ({ open: vs.filter((v) => !v.decision), decided: vs.filter((v) => !!v.decision) });

export const ASK_RULE =
  'Stop and ask the user to choose A or B, in one short message that names both options, then wait for the answer. ' +
  'Never work around a violation or try another route.';

export type PlanHooks = {
  /** Called after each submit_plan with its violations, so the session can track the fork. */
  onPlan(steps: PlanStep[], violations: Violation[]): void;
  /** Instructions queued for the next tool result (e.g. recording a decision in Alike). */
  takeNotes(): string[];
};

export type PlanInput = {
  steps: { n: number; text: string; files: string[]; imports: { from: string; to: string }[] }[];
  avoided?: { from: string; to: string; decision: string; reason: string }[];
};

/** `submit_plan`: footprint, plan check (the one checker), `planned` + `plan_violation` events, and the tool's reply. */
export function submitPlan(repo: Repo, bus: Bus, hooks: PlanHooks, { steps, avoided: avoidedIn }: PlanInput): string {
  const cellName = (domain: string, layer: string) =>
    `${repo.map.domains.find((d) => d.id === domain)?.name ?? domain} · ${repo.map.layers.find((l) => l.id === layer)?.name ?? layer}`;
  const norm = (p: string) => repo.rel(p) ?? p.replace(/^\.\//, '');
  const clean: PlanStep[] = steps.map((s) => ({
    n: s.n, text: s.text, files: s.files.map(norm),
    imports: s.imports.map((i) => ({ from: norm(i.from), to: i.to.startsWith('.') ? i.to : norm(i.to) })),
  }));
  const exists = withExtra(repo.exists, clean.flatMap((s) => s.files));
  const fp = planFootprint(repo.map, clean, exists, repo.mapper);
  // Avoided approaches must cite a decision that exists in decisions/; unknown ids are dropped (and said so).
  const known = new Set(listDecisions(repo.root).map((d) => d.id));
  const end = (x: string) => (x.startsWith('domain:') ? x : norm(x));
  const avoided = (avoidedIn ?? []).filter((a) => known.has(a.decision.trim())).map((a) => ({ from: end(a.from), to: end(a.to), decision: a.decision.trim(), reason: a.reason }));
  const dropped = (avoidedIn ?? []).filter((a) => !known.has(a.decision.trim()));
  bus.emit('planned', {
    steps: clean,
    cells: fp.cells.map((c) => ({ domain: c.domain, layer: c.layer, steps: c.steps, files: c.files })),
    edges: fp.edges.map((e) => ({ from: e.from, to: e.to, steps: e.steps, imports: e.imports })),
    unassigned: fp.unassigned,
    ...(avoided.length ? { avoided } : {}),
  });
  for (const v of fp.violations) bus.emit('plan_violation', { violation: v }, { path: v.file, cell: repo.cellOf(v.file) });
  hooks.onPlan(clean, fp.violations);

  const lines = [
    `Plan recorded: ${clean.length} step(s).`,
    `Cells: ${fp.cells.map((c) => `${cellName(c.domain, c.layer)} (steps ${c.steps.join(', ')})`).join('; ') || 'none'}.`,
    `New cross-domain dependencies: ${fp.edges.map((e) => `${e.from} → ${e.to}`).join('; ') || 'none'}.`,
  ];
  if (fp.unassigned.length) lines.push(`Files outside every domain: ${fp.unassigned.join(', ')}.`);
  if (avoided.length) lines.push(`Avoided (per standing decisions): ${avoided.map((a) => `${a.from} → ${a.to} (${a.decision})`).join('; ')}.`);
  if (dropped.length) lines.push(`Not recorded as avoided (no such decision in decisions/): ${dropped.map((a) => `${a.from} → ${a.to} (${a.decision})`).join('; ')}.`);
  const { open, decided } = splitDecided(fp.violations);
  if (open.length) {
    lines.push('', `VIOLATIONS (${open.length}):`, violationText(open), '', ASK_RULE + ' Do not exit plan mode until the user has answered and you have resubmitted the plan.');
  }
  if (decided.length) {
    lines.push('', `ALREADY DECIDED (${decided.length}):`, ...decided.map((v) => v.reason), decidedText(repo.root, decided),
      'Do not exit plan mode until a resubmitted plan no longer crosses it.');
  }
  if (!fp.violations.length) lines.push('No violations. Exit plan mode when ready.');
  const notes = hooks.takeNotes();
  if (notes.length) lines.push('', ...notes);
  return lines.join('\n');
}

export function harnessTools(repo: Repo, bus: Bus, hooks: PlanHooks) {

  return createSdkMcpServer({
    name: 'interpretability',

Numbered steps; each lists the exact repo-relative file paths it will create or modify, and every new import it adds as { from: path, to: path }. If a standing decision rules out the obvious approach, list that approach in `avoided` ({ from, to: repo paths or domain:<id>, decision: "DR-n", reason }). Returns the architecture footprint and any rule violations.',
        {

            n: z.number().int(),

        },

      }, { alwaysLoad: true }),
      tool('domain', 'A domain: purpose, cells with their paths and tables, files, and the rules that involve it.', { id: z.string() }, async ({ id }) => {
        const d = repo.map.domains.find((x) => x.id === id || x.name.toLowerCase() === id.toLowerCase());
        if (!d) return text(`No domain "${id}". Domains: ${repo.map.domains.map((x) => x.id).join(', ')}`);

        return text(JSON.stringify({ id: d.id, name: d.name, purpose: d.purpose, cells: d.cells, files, rules }, null, 2));

        return text(hits.length ? hits.map((d) => `${d.id}: ${d.title}\nOutcome: ${d.outcome}\nRejected: ${d.rejected}\n${d.rationale}`).join('\n\n') : 'No standing decisions for these paths.');
      }),
      // ---- graph tools (NAVIGATION_PLAN §3.4): the graph the user sees, no model calls; not in the brief.
      tool(
        'graph_neighbors',
        'Edges around a node of the live architecture graph (the one the user sees): imports, calls (syntactic | typed | dispatch), implements, handles, writes, uses. `id`: a repo path, path#symbol, a route like "POST /api/runs", vendor:<pkg>, domain:<id> or cell:<domain>/<layer>. Read-only.',
        {

          kinds: z.array(z.enum(['imports', 'calls', 'implements', 'handles', 'writes', 'reads', 'uses', 'fetches', 'starts'])).optional(),
          hops: z.number().int().min(1).max(3).optional(),
        },
        async ({ id, kinds, hops }) => {
          const g = store.graph();
          const hit = findNode(g, id, rel);
          return text('error' in hit ? hit.error : neighborsText(g, repo.map, hit.id, kinds, hops ?? 1));
        },
      ),
      tool(
        'trace',
        'Shortest call chains from a symbol, route or file to where they end: vendors, tables and external cells, or `to` (a node, or a path prefix like vendor/llm-openai). Follows calls, route handlers and interface dispatch ("via registry"); hops inside one cell are collapsed. Read-only.',
        { from: z.string(), to: z.string().optional() },
        async ({ from, to }) => {
          const g = store.graph();

        { path: z.string() },
        async ({ path }) => text(symbolsText(store.graph(), repo.map, repo.fileFacts, repo.rel(path) ?? path, (p) => repo.current(p))),
      ),
    ],
  });
}
import { existsSync, mkdirSync, readdirSync, readFileSync, writeFileSync } from 'node:fs';
import { basename, join } from 'node:path';
import { parse as parseYaml, stringify as stringifyYaml } from 'yaml';
import { linkDecision, addException, nextDecisionId, globMatcher, type Violation, type Invariant, type EventData } from '@harness/core';
import { commitPaths } from './git';
import { alikeDecision, recordDecision, repoSlug, mcpInstruction, type AlikeDecision, type ExecFn } from './alike';
import type { Repo } from './repo';
import type { Bus } from './bus';

export type DecisionRecord = {
  id: string;
  title: string;
  outcome: string;
  status: string;
  type: string;
  invariant: string;
  anchors: { paths: string[] };
  rejected: string;
  rationale: string;
  alike_urn?: string; // set once the decision is in Alike; never recorded twice
};

/** Read `decisions/DR-*.md` (front matter + body). */
export function listDecisions(root: string): DecisionRecord[] {
  const dir = join(root, 'decisions');
  if (!existsSync(dir)) return [];
  const out: DecisionRecord[] = [];
  for (const f of readdirSync(dir).filter((f) => /^DR-\d+\.md$/.test(f))) {
    const text = readFileSync(join(dir, f), 'utf8');
    const m = /^---\n([\s\S]*?)\n---\n?([\s\S]*)$/.exec(text);
    if (!m) continue;
    const fm = parseYaml(m[1]!) as Omit<DecisionRecord, 'rationale'>;
    out.push({ ...fm, rationale: m[2]!.trim() });
  }
  return out.sort((a, b) => Number(a.id.slice(3)) - Number(b.id.slice(3)));
}

/** Parse which option the user picked. Explicit A/B wins; "exception" leans B; otherwise A (comply). */
export function parseOption(text: string): 'A' | 'B' {
  const t = text.trim();
  const m = /^\(?\s*(?:option\s+)?([ab])\b/i.exec(t) ?? /\b(?:option|choose|pick|go with)\s+\(?([ab])\b/i.exec(t);
  if (m) return m[1]!.toUpperCase() as 'A' | 'B';
  return /\bexception\b/i.test(t) ? 'B' : 'A';
}

/** The decision in the user's own words: their answer minus the "A —" prefix, first sentence, if it says something. */
export function titleFromAnswer(answer: string): string | null {
  const t = answer.trim().replace(/^\(?\s*(?:option\s+)?[ab]\b\)?\s*[—–:,.-]*\s*/i, '');
  const first = (t.split(/(?<=[.!?])\s/)[0] ?? '').replace(/[.!?]+$/, '').trim();
  if (first.length < 12) return null;
  const s = first[0]!.toUpperCase() + first.slice(1);
  return s.length > 100 ? s.slice(0, 99).replace(/\s+\S*$/, '') + '…' : s;
}

/**
 * An answered fork becomes a standing decision (SPEC §8): write decisions/DR-n.md, update domains.yaml
 * (A links the decision to the invariant, B adds an exception), commit just those two files, emit
 * `decision_recorded`, and return the instruction that asks Claude to record it in Alike.
 */
export function recordFork(repo: Repo, bus: Bus, violations: Violation[], option: 'A' | 'B', answer: string, prompt: string) {
  const existing = listDecisions(repo.root).map((d) => d.id);
  const byInvariant = new Map<string, Violation[]>();
  for (const v of violations) byInvariant.set(v.invariant, [...(byInvariant.get(v.invariant) ?? []), v]);

  const made: DecisionRecord[] = [];
  let yamlText = repo.mapText;
  for (const [invariantId, vs] of byInvariant) {
    const inv = repo.map.invariants.find((i) => i.id === invariantId);
    if (!inv) continue;
    const id = nextDecisionId(repo.map, [...existing, ...made.map((d) => d.id)]);
    const files = [...new Set(vs.map((v) => v.file))];
    const v0 = vs[0]!;
    const [chosen, rejected] = option === 'A' ? [v0.options[0], v0.options[1]] : [v0.options[1], v0.options[0]];
    // The principle, not the incident: the user's own sentence, else the rule they upheld.
    const title = titleFromAnswer(answer) ?? (option === 'A' ? inv.rule : `Exception to ${inv.id} for ${files.join(', ')}`);
    const rec: DecisionRecord = {
      id, title, outcome: chosen, status: 'made', type: 'standing', invariant: inv.id,
      anchors: { paths: files }, rejected,
      rationale: [
        `The user chose ${option}, in their words: "${answer.trim()}"`,
        '',
        `Asked during: "${prompt.trim()}"`,
        '',
        `What triggered it: ${v0.reason}`,
        '',
        `Rejected: ${rejected}`,
      ].join('\n'),
    };
    made.push(rec);
    yamlText = option === 'A' ? linkDecision(yamlText, inv.id, id) : addException(yamlText, inv.id, files[0]!, id);
  }
  if (!made.length) return { decisions: [], forAlike: [] };

  mkdirSync(join(repo.root, 'decisions'), { recursive: true });
  const paths: string[] = ['domains.yaml'];
  for (const d of made) {
    const { rationale, ...fm } = d;
    const rel = `decisions/${d.id}.md`;
    writeFileSync(join(repo.root, rel), `---\n${stringifyYaml(fm).trim()}\n---\n\n${rationale}\n`);
    paths.push(rel);
  }
  writeFileSync(repo.mapPath, yamlText);
  try { commitPaths(repo.root, paths, `docs(decisions): ${made.map((d) => d.id).join(', ')} ${made[0]!.title}`.slice(0, 100)); }
  catch (e) { bus.emit('error', { message: `Could not commit ${paths.join(', ')}: ${(e as Error).message}` }); }

  repo.setMap(yamlText);
  bus.emit('map_confirmed', { map: repo.map, source: 'file' });
  for (const d of made) {
    bus.emit('decision_recorded', { id: d.id, title: d.title, invariant: d.invariant, option, paths: d.anchors.paths, alike: false });
  }

  const session = sessionNumber(bus);
  const invariants = new Map(repo.map.invariants.map((i) => [i.id, i] as [string, Invariant]));
  const forAlike = made.map((d) => ({
    id: d.id,
    decision: alikeDecision(repo.map, {
      id: d.id, title: d.title, outcome: d.outcome, rejected: d.rejected, option, invariant: invariants.get(d.invariant)!,
      files: d.anchors.paths, answer, session,
    }, repoSlug(repo.root), (glob) => concreteFolders(repo.facts.files, glob)),
  }));
  return { decisions: made, forAlike };
}

/** 1-based number of the current coding session ("decided in session 2"). */
function sessionNumber(bus: Bus): number {
  const seen: string[] = [];
  for (const e of bus.events) if (!seen.includes(e.session)) seen.push(e.session);
  if (!seen.includes(bus.session)) seen.push(bus.session);
  return seen.indexOf(bus.session) + 1;
}

/** Folders Alike can anchor for a glob it can't take: `vendor/llm-*` + `/**` → `vendor/llm-anthropic/`, … */
function concreteFolders(files: readonly string[], glob: string): string[] {
  const match = globMatcher(glob);
  const depth = glob.split('/').findIndex((seg) => /[*?[{]/.test(seg));
  const out = new Set<string>();
  for (const f of files) {
    if (!match(f)) continue;
    const parts = f.split('/');
    out.add(depth >= 0 && depth < parts.length - 1 ? `${parts.slice(0, depth + 1).join('/')}/` : f);
  }
  return [...out].sort();
}

/**
 * Record decisions in Alike from the server (async, after the commit; never in the hot path). On success the
 * URN is written into the DR file (committed alone) and `decision_recorded { alike: true, urn }` is emitted.
 * Returns MCP fallback instructions for any decision the CLI couldn't record.
 */
export async function recordInAlike(repo: Repo, bus: Bus, items: { id: string; decision: AlikeDecision }[], exec?: ExecFn): Promise<string[]> {
  const fallback: string[] = [];
  for (const { id, decision } of items) {
    const rel = `decisions/${id}.md`;
    const path = join(repo.root, rel);
    if (!existsSync(path)) continue;
    const before = listDecisions(repo.root).find((d) => d.id === id);
    if (before?.alike_urn) continue;
    try {
      const urn = await recordDecision(decision, exec);
      const text = readFileSync(path, 'utf8');
      writeFileSync(path, text.replace(/\n---\n/, `\nalike_urn: ${urn}\n---\n`));
      try { commitPaths(repo.root, [rel], `docs(decisions): ${id} recorded in Alike`); } catch { /* the URN stays in the working tree */ }
      const prev = bus.events.find((e) => e.kind === 'decision_recorded' && (e.data as { id: string }).id === id);
      if (prev) bus.emit('decision_recorded', { ...(prev.data as EventData['decision_recorded']), alike: true, urn }, { turn: prev.turn });
    } catch (e) {
      bus.emit('error', { message: `Alike didn't record ${id} (${(e as Error).message.split('\n')[0]}); asking the session instead.` });
      fallback.push(mcpInstruction(decision));
    }
  }
  return fallback;
}

const HARNESS_PATHS = [':(exclude)domains.yaml', ':(exclude)decisions', ':(exclude).harness'];

export function git(repo: string, args: string[]): string {
  return execFileSync('git', args, { cwd: repo, encoding: 'utf8', stdio: ['ignore', 'pipe', 'pipe'] }).trim();
}

function tryGit(repo: string, args: string[]): string {
  try { return git(repo, args); } catch { return ''; }
}

export type Baseline = { head: string; snapshot: string; untracked: string[] };

/** Turn baseline: HEAD plus a `git stash create` snapshot of the working tree (no stash entry is stored). */
export function baseline(repo: string): Baseline {
  const head = tryGit(repo, ['rev-parse', 'HEAD']);
  const snapshot = tryGit(repo, ['stash', 'create']) || head;
  const untracked = untrackedFiles(repo);
  return { head, snapshot, untracked };
}

function untrackedFiles(repo: string): string[] {
  return tryGit(repo, ['ls-files', '--others', '--exclude-standard']).split('\n').filter(Boolean);
}

/** Lines added/removed since the baseline, including files created during the turn (untracked). */
export function numstat(repo: string, base: Baseline): { added: number; removed: number; files: string[] } {
  let added = 0, removed = 0;
  const files: string[] = [];
  const parse = (out: string, name?: string) => {
    for (const line of out.split('\n')) {
      const [a, r, ...rest] = line.split('\t');
      if (!rest.length) continue;
      added += Number(a) || 0;
      removed += Number(r) || 0;
      files.push(name ?? rest.join('\t'));
    }
  };
  if (base.snapshot) parse(tryGit(repo, ['diff', '--numstat', base.snapshot, '--', '.', ...HARNESS_PATHS]));
  const before = new Set(base.untracked);
  for (const f of untrackedFiles(repo)) {
    if (before.has(f) || f.startsWith('decisions/') || f.startsWith('.harness/') || f === 'domains.yaml') continue;
    // --no-index exits 1 when files differ, so read stdout from the error.
    try { execFileSync('git', ['diff', '--no-index', '--numstat', '/dev/null', f], { cwd: repo, encoding: 'utf8' }); }
    catch (e) { parse(String((e as { stdout?: string }).stdout ?? ''), f); }
  }
  return { added, removed, files };
}

export function commitPaths(repo: string, paths: string[], message: string) {
  git(repo, ['add', '--', ...paths]);
  git(repo, ['commit', '-q', '-m', message, '--', ...paths]);
}

/** Push-based prompt stream fed by the chat pane. */
class Inbox implements AsyncIterable<SDKUserMessage> {
  private queue: SDKUserMessage[] = [];
  private wake: (() => void) | null = null;
  push(text: string) {
    this.queue.push({ type: 'user', message: { role: 'user', content: text }, parent_tool_use_id: null });

  }
  async *[Symbol.asyncIterator]() {
    while (true) {

/** If a shell command writes a file inside the repo, a short description of how; otherwise null. */
export function bashWriteTarget(cmd: string, rel: (p: string) => string | null): string | null {
  const inRepo = (p: string) => !!p && !p.startsWith('/dev/') && rel(p.replace(/^['"]|['"]$/g, '')) !== null;
  // Redirects to a file: `> f`, `>> f`, `cat <<EOF > f` (not 2>&1, >&2, >/dev/null).

          interpretability: harnessTools(this.repo, this.bus, {
            onPlan: (steps, violations) => this.onPlan(steps, violations),
            takeNotes: () => this.notes.splice(0),
          }),
          ...alike,
        },
        // No allowedTools: canUseTool approves everything except ExitPlanMode, which waits for the user.
        disallowedTools: ['AskUserQuestion'],
        includePartialMessages: true,
        hooks: {
          PreToolUse: [
            { matcher: 'Read|Grep|Glob', hooks: [this.observeRead] },
            { matcher: 'Bash', hooks: [this.observeBash, this.gateBash] },
            { matcher: 'Edit|Write', hooks: [this.gate] },
          ],
          PostToolUse: [
            { matcher: 'Edit|Write', hooks: [this.afterEdit] },
            { matcher: 'mcp__alike__record_decision', hooks: [this.afterAlike] },
          ],
        },
        canUseTool: this.canUseTool,
        stderr: (d) => { if (process.env.HARNESS_DEBUG) process.stderr.write(d); },
      },
    });
    void this.loop();
  }

  private async loop() {
    try {
      for await (const m of this.q!) {
        if (m.type === 'stream_event') {
          const ev = m.event as { type: string; delta?: { type: string; text?: string } };
          if (ev.type === 'content_block_delta' && ev.delta?.type === 'text_delta' && ev.delta.text) this.ephemeral({ type: 'delta', text: ev.delta.text });
        } else if (m.type === 'assistant' && !m.parent_tool_use_id) {
          const t = m.message.content.filter((b) => b.type === 'text').map((b) => (b as { text: string }).text).join('\n').trim();
          if (t) {
            this.bus.emit('chat', { role: 'assistant', text: t });
            if (this.turn) this.turn.lastText = t;
          }
        } else if (m.type === 'result') {
          this.onResult(m.subtype);
        }
      }
    } catch (e) {
      this.bus.emit('error', { message: `Session ended: ${(e as Error).message}` });
    }
  }

  // ---------------------------------------------------------------- chat input

  userMessage(text: string) {
    const t = text.trim();
    if (!t) return;
    if (this.approval) {
      this.bus.emit('chat', { role: 'user', text: t });
      if (/^(approve|approved|lgtm|yes|ok|go|ship it)\b/i.test(t)) this.approve();
      else this.rejectPlan(t);
      return;
    }
    if (this.turn?.forkOpen) {
      const violations = this.turn.forkOpen;
      const option = parseOption(t);
      this.bus.emit('chat', { role: 'user', text: t });
      this.bus.emit('fork_answered', { option, text: t, violations });
      this.turn.forkOpen = null;
      this.turn.planViolations = [];
      this.turn.gateBlocks = [];
      const { decisions, forAlike } = recordFork(this.repo, this.bus, violations, option, t, this.turn.prompt);
      // The server records in Alike itself, off the turn; only if the CLI fails does the session get an MCP note.
      if (process.env.HARNESS_ALIKE !== '0') void recordInAlike(this.repo, this.bus, forAlike).then((notes) => this.notes.push(...notes));
      const ids = decisions.map((d) => d.id).join(', ');
      this.send(`${t}\n\n[Interpretability: recorded as ${ids || 'a decision'} in decisions/ and domains.yaml. ` +
        (option === 'B' ? `${violations[0]?.file} is now an exception. ` : '') +
        'Resubmit the plan with mcp__interpretability__submit_plan, then exit plan mode.]');
      return;
    }
    if (!this.turn) this.startTurn(t);
    this.bus.emit('chat', { role: 'user', text: t });
    this.send(t);
  }

  private send(text: string) {
    this.busy = true;
    this.ephemeral({ type: 'busy', busy: true });
    this.inbox.push(text);
  }

  private startTurn(prompt: string) {
    const id = `t${randomUUID().slice(0, 6)}`;
    this.turn = { id, prompt, base: baseline(this.repo.root), planned: false, steps: [], planViolations: [], gateBlocks: [], forkOpen: null, lastText: '' };
    this.bus.turn = id;
    this.bus.emit('turn_started', { prompt, head: this.turn.base.head, baseline: this.turn.base.snapshot });
  }

  approve() {
    if (!this.approval) return;
    const { resolve, input } = this.approval;
    this.approval = null;
    this.bus.emit('plan_approved', {} as never);
    resolve({ behavior: 'allow', updatedInput: input });
    void this.q?.setPermissionMode('acceptEdits');
  }

  private rejectPlan(feedback: string) {
    if (!this.approval) return;
    const { resolve } = this.approval;
    this.approval = null;
    resolve({ behavior: 'deny', message: `The user did not approve the plan yet. Their feedback: ${feedback}` });
  }

  private onPlan(steps: PlanStep[], violations: Violation[]) {
    if (!this.turn) return;
    this.turn.planned = true;
    this.turn.steps = steps;
    this.turn.planViolations = violations;
  }

  private onResult(subtype: string) {
    this.busy = false;
    this.ephemeral({ type: 'busy', busy: false });
    const turn = this.turn;
    if (!turn) return;
    if (subtype !== 'success') this.bus.emit('error', { message: `Turn ended with ${subtype}` });
    // Only undecided violations are forks; decision-backed ones were answered before (beat 4) and never re-asked.
    const open = splitDecided([...turn.planViolations, ...turn.gateBlocks]).open;
    if (open.length && subtype === 'success') {
      // Claude stopped to ask: the turn stays open until the user answers.
      turn.forkOpen = open;
      this.bus.emit('fork_asked', { violations: open, text: turn.lastText });
      return;
    }
    this.endTurn(subtype);
  }

  private endTurn(reason: string) {
    const turn = this.turn!;
    const stat = numstat(this.repo.root, turn.base);
    this.bus.emit('turn_ended', { ...stat, reason });
    const events = this.bus.events.filter((e) => e.turn === turn.id);
    writeFileSync(join(this.repo.root, '.harness/turns', `${turn.id}.json`), JSON.stringify({ id: turn.id, prompt: turn.prompt, baseline: turn.base, steps: turn.steps, numstat: stat, events }, null, 2));
    this.turn = null;
    this.bus.turn = null;
    this.repo.recheck();
    void this.q?.setPermissionMode('plan');
  }

  // ---------------------------------------------------------------- hooks

  private observeRead: HookCallback = async (input) => {
    const i = input as PreToolUseHookInput;
    const ti = i.tool_input as { file_path?: string; path?: string };
    if (i.tool_name === 'Read' && ti.file_path) {
      const rel = this.repo.rel(ti.file_path);
      if (rel) this.bus.emit('looked', { tool: 'Read' }, { path: rel, cell: this.repo.cellOf(rel) });
    } else {
      const rel = this.repo.rel(ti.path ?? this.repo.root);
      if (rel) this.bus.emit('cursor', { verb: 'searching' }, { path: rel, cell: this.repo.cellOf(rel) ?? this.repo.cellForDir(rel) });
    }
    return { async: true };
  };

  /** Claude often reads with `cat`/`sed`/`grep` in Bash: any repo file named in the command counts as looked at. */
  private observeBash: HookCallback = async (input) => {
    const cmd = String((input as PreToolUseHookInput & { tool_input: { command?: string } }).tool_input.command ?? '');
    if (/(^|[;&|]\s*)(cat|head|tail|sed|grep|rg|less|wc|nl|awk)\b/.test(cmd)) {
      for (const token of new Set(cmd.split(/[\s'";|&()<>]+/))) {
        const rel = /[\w-]\.\w+$/.test(token) ? this.repo.rel(token) : null;
        if (rel && this.repo.facts.files.includes(rel)) this.bus.emit('looked', { tool: 'Bash' }, { path: rel, cell: this.repo.cellOf(rel) });
      }
    }
    return { async: true };
  };

  /**
   * Edits made through Bash (heredocs, `sed -i`, inline scripts) would skip the edit gate. Deny commands that
   * write files inside the repo and ask for Edit/Write instead; tests, git and reads pass. The watcher still
   * records anything that slips through, as an unattributed edit.
   */
  private gateBash: HookCallback = async (input) => {
    const cmd = String((input as PreToolUseHookInput & { tool_input: { command?: string } }).tool_input.command ?? '');
    const target = bashWriteTarget(cmd, (p) => this.repo.rel(p));
    if (!target) return {};
    return {
      hookSpecificOutput: {
        hookEventName: 'PreToolUse',
        permissionDecision: 'deny',
        permissionDecisionReason: `Interpretability: change files in this repo with the Edit or Write tool, not through Bash (${target}), so every edit can be checked against the architecture rules. Make this change with Edit/Write instead.`,
      },
    };
  };

  /** The edit gate: same checker as load and plan, on the imports/writes this edit would add. */
  private gate: HookCallback = async (input) => {
    const i = input as PreToolUseHookInput;
    const ti = i.tool_input as { file_path?: string; content?: string; old_string?: string; new_string?: string; replace_all?: boolean };
    if (!ti.file_path) return {};
    const rel = this.repo.rel(ti.file_path);
    if (!rel) return {}; // outside the repo, e.g. Claude's own plan file
    const old = this.repo.current(rel);
    let next: string;
    try {
      next = i.tool_name === 'Write' ? ti.content ?? '' : applyEdit(old ?? '', ti.old_string ?? '', ti.new_string ?? '', ti.replace_all);
    } catch {
      return {}; // the Edit will fail on its own
    }
    const delta = deltaForEdit(rel, old, next, withExtra(this.repo.exists, [rel]));
    const violations = check(this.repo.map, delta, this.repo.mapper);
    this.bus.emit('cursor', { verb: 'editing' }, { path: rel, cell: this.repo.cellOf(rel) });
    if (!violations.length) {
      this.repo.markPending(rel);
      return {};
    }
    for (const v of violations) this.bus.emit('gate_blocked', { violation: v, tool: i.tool_name }, { path: rel, cell: this.repo.cellOf(rel) });
    this.turn?.gateBlocks.push(...violations);
    const { open, decided } = splitDecided(violations);
    const why = [
      'Interpretability blocked this edit.',
      ...(open.length ? [violationText(open), ASK_RULE] : []),
      ...(decided.length ? [...decided.map((v) => v.reason), decidedText(this.repo.root, decided)] : []),
    ];
    return {
      hookSpecificOutput: {
        hookEventName: 'PreToolUse',
        permissionDecision: 'deny',
        permissionDecisionReason: why.join('\n'),
      },
    };
  };

  private afterEdit: HookCallback = async (input) => {
    const i = input as PostToolUseHookInput;
    const ti = i.tool_input as { file_path?: string };
    const rel = ti.file_path ? this.repo.rel(ti.file_path) : null;
    if (rel) setImmediate(() => this.repo.fileChanged(rel, { tool: i.tool_name }));
    return { async: true };
  };

  private afterAlike: HookCallback = async (input) => {
    const i = input as PostToolUseHookInput;
    const res = JSON.stringify(i.tool_response ?? '');
    const ids = new Set(JSON.stringify(i.tool_input).match(/DR-\d+/g) ?? []);
    if (/error|failed|unauthori[sz]ed/i.test(res) && !/"id"/.test(res)) return { async: true };
    for (const d of this.bus.events.filter((e) => e.kind === 'decision_recorded')) {
      const data = d.data as { id: string };
      if (ids.has(data.id)) this.bus.emit('decision_recorded', { ...(d.data as EventData['decision_recorded']), alike: true });
    }
    return { async: true };
  };

  private canUseTool: CanUseTool = async (name, input) => {
    if (name === 'ExitPlanMode') {
      const turn = this.turn;
      if (turn && !turn.planned) {
        return { behavior: 'deny', message: 'Call mcp__interpretability__submit_plan with your numbered steps before exiting plan mode.' };
      }
      if (turn?.planViolations.length) {
        const { open, decided } = splitDecided(turn.planViolations);
        if (open.length) return { behavior: 'deny', message: `The plan has unresolved violations.\n${violationText(open)}\n${ASK_RULE}` };
        return { behavior: 'deny', message: `The plan crosses a decided rule.\n${decidedText(this.repo.root, decided)}\nResubmit the plan with mcp__interpretability__submit_plan.` };
      }
      const plan = String((input as { plan?: unknown }).plan ?? '');
      this.bus.emit('approval_requested', { plan });
      return new Promise<PermissionResult>((resolve) => { this.approval = { resolve, input }; });
    }
    return { behavior: 'allow', updatedInput: input };
  };

  interrupt() { void this.q?.interrupt(); }
}

// buildGraph (NAVIGATION_PLAN §3.2): one containment tree plus leaf edges, from domains.yaml and per-file facts.
// Pure and browser-safe (the mapper only needs picomatch).
import { createMapper, matchesAny, type Placement } from '../mapper';
import type { DomainMap } from '../schema';
import type { UIState } from '../events';
import type { CallConfidence, CallFact, FileFacts, SemanticFacts } from '../contracts/facts';
import {
  NEUTRAL_ID, ROOT_ID, UNASSIGNED_ID, cellId, domainId, edgeId, fileOf, groupId, tableId, testsId,
  type ContextGraph, type EdgeKind, type GraphEdge, type GraphNode, type NodeKind,
} from '../contracts/graph';

/** Top-level container for bare packages no `external` cell claims. */
export const VENDORS_ID = 'group:vendors';
/** A container holding more files than this is split into directory groups. */
export const GROUP_THRESHOLD = 12;
/** The layer whose cells hold external services; vendor packages and trace sinks live there. */
export const EXTERNAL_LAYER = 'external';

const KIND_RANK: Partial<Record<NodeKind, number>> = { group: 0, file: 1, table: 2, vendor: 3, symbol: 4, route: 5, entry: 6 };

const emptyFacts = (path: string): FileFacts => ({ path, hash: '', imports: [], writes: [], symbols: [], calls: [], routes: [], entries: [] });
const isPseudo = (id: string) => id.startsWith('vendor:') || id.startsWith('table:');
const normalize = (p: string) => p.replace(/\\/g, '/').split('/').filter((s) => s && s !== '.').join('/');

/**
 * Containment: repo → domain → cell → (group) → file → symbol (nested by `parent`), with routes and entries under
 * their file and tables under the cell that lists them. Test files sit in `tests:<domain>` under their domain;
 * files matching no cell in `unassigned`, shared code in `neutral` (both top-level, created when non-empty).
 * Bare packages (`vendor:<pkg>`) go into the `external` cell that claims them (a glob matching `<pkg>` or
 * `node_modules/<pkg>/…`, importing domains first), else into the top-level `group:vendors`.
 * A cell with confirmed `components` groups matching files by component; any container with more than
 * GROUP_THRESHOLD remaining files groups them by directory (recursively).
 * Leaf edges: imports (file→file), uses (file→vendor), calls, implements, handles (route→handler), writes (→table).
 * Tier 2 calls replace a file's syntactic calls when `semantic[path].hash === facts[path].hash`.
 */
export function buildGraph(
  map: DomainMap,
  facts: Readonly<Record<string, FileFacts>>,
  semantic: Readonly<Record<string, SemanticFacts>> = {},
): ContextGraph {
  const mapper = createMapper(map);
  const nodes: Record<string, GraphNode> = {};
  const children: Record<string, string[]> = {};
  const rank = new Map<string, number>();
  const add = (n: Omit<GraphNode, 'order'>, r: number): GraphNode => {
    const cur = nodes[n.id];
    if (cur) return cur;
    const node = n as GraphNode;
    node.order = 0;
    nodes[n.id] = node;
    rank.set(n.id, r);
    if (n.parent) (children[n.parent] ??= []).push(n.id);
    return node;
  };
  /** Copy a container's domain/layer onto a node (no spread: this runs per symbol). */
  const scoped = <T extends Omit<GraphNode, 'order'>>(n: T, from: GraphNode): T => {
    if (from.domain) n.domain = from.domain;
    if (from.layer) n.layer = from.layer;
    return n;
  };

  // ---- skeleton: domains in map order, cells in layer order (their order is the grid position)
  add({ id: ROOT_ID, kind: 'repo', parent: null, label: 'repo' }, 0);
  const layerIdx = new Map(map.layers.map((l, i) => [l.id, i]));
  map.domains.forEach((d, i) => {
    add({ id: domainId(d.id), kind: 'domain', parent: ROOT_ID, label: d.name, domain: d.id }, i);
    for (const l of map.layers) {
      if (l.id in d.cells) add({ id: cellId(d.id, l.id), kind: 'cell', parent: domainId(d.id), label: l.name, domain: d.id, layer: l.id }, layerIdx.get(l.id)!);
    }
  });
  const nd = map.domains.length;
  const ensureTop = (id: string) => {
    if (id === UNASSIGNED_ID) return add({ id, kind: 'unassigned', parent: ROOT_ID, label: 'Unassigned' }, nd);
    if (id === NEUTRAL_ID) return add({ id, kind: 'neutral', parent: ROOT_ID, label: 'Shared' }, nd + 1);
    return add({ id: VENDORS_ID, kind: 'group', parent: ROOT_ID, label: 'Vendors' }, nd + 2);
  };
  const ensureTests = (domain: string) =>
    add({ id: testsId(domain), kind: 'tests', parent: domainId(domain), label: 'Tests', domain }, map.layers.length);

  // ---- files: every path with facts plus every repo path they import
# Reference map for the Scout demo repo.

neutral: ["src/shared/**", "vendor/_calllog.ts", "web/src/shared/**"]
ignore: ["node_modules/**", ".git/**", ".harness/**", "fixtures/**", "scripts/**", "decisions/**", "*.json", "*.md", "*.config.ts", ".*", "domains.yaml", "web/dist/**", "web/public/**", "web/vite.config.ts", "web/tsconfig.json", ".scout/**"]

domains:
  - id: channels
    name: Channels

      ui:    { paths: ["web/index.html", "web/src/main.tsx", "web/src/app/**"] }

import { withExtra, type Exists, type FactDelta, type ImportEdge } from './facts';
import { isRelative, normalizePath, resolveImport, resolvePath } from './imports';
import { createMapper, type Mapper } from './mapper';
import { check, type Violation } from './rules';
import type { DomainMap } from './schema';

/** One step of a `submit_plan` call. Import `to` is a repo path (extension optional) or a specifier relative to `from`. */
/** `symbols`: optional `path#qualified.name` ids the step changes or adds (drives symbol-level ghosts). */
export type PlanStep = { n: number; text: string; files: string[]; imports: { from: string; to: string }[]; symbols?: string[] };

export type PlanFootprint = {
  cells: { domain: string; layer: string; steps: number[]; files: string[] }[];
  tests: { domain: string; files: string[] }[];
  unassigned: string[];
  edges: { from: string; to: string; steps: number[]; imports: ImportEdge[] }[];
  delta: FactDelta;
  violations: Violation[];
};

/** Ghost footprint of a plan: the cells and tests it touches, its new cross-domain edges, and the violations its imports would cause. */
export function planFootprint(map: DomainMap, steps: PlanStep[], exists: Exists, mapper: Mapper = createMapper(map)): PlanFootprint {
  const norm = (p: string) => normalizePath(p) ?? p;
  const planned = withExtra(exists, steps.flatMap((s) => s.files));

  const cells = new Map<string, { domain: string; layer: string; steps: Set<number>; files: Set<string> }>();
  const tests = new Map<string, Set<string>>();
  const unassigned = new Set<string>();
  const edges = new Map<string, { from: string; to: string; steps: Set<number>; imports: ImportEdge[] }>();
  const imports: ImportEdge[] = [];
  const seen = new Set<string>();

  for (const step of steps) {
    const stepImports = step.imports.map((imp) => {
      const from = norm(imp.from);
      const to = (isRelative(imp.to) ? resolveImport(from, imp.to, planned) : resolvePath(imp.to, planned)) ?? norm(imp.to);
      return { from, to };
    });
    // A file that gains an import is edited by the step even if the step didn't list it.
    for (const file of new Set([...step.files.map(norm), ...stepImports.map((i) => i.from)])) {
      const p = mapper.place(file);
      if (p.kind === 'cell') {
        const key = `${p.domain}\u0000${p.layer}`;
        let cell = cells.get(key);
        if (!cell) cells.set(key, (cell = { domain: p.domain, layer: p.layer, steps: new Set(), files: new Set() }));
        cell.steps.add(step.n);
        cell.files.add(file);
      } else if (p.kind === 'test') {
        tests.set(p.domain, (tests.get(p.domain) ?? new Set()).add(file));
      } else if (p.kind === 'unassigned') unassigned.add(file);
    }
    for (const imp of stepImports) {
      const k = `${imp.from}\u0000${imp.to}`;
      if (!seen.has(k)) {
        seen.add(k);
        imports.push(imp);
      }
      const a = mapper.place(imp.from);
      const b = mapper.place(imp.to);
      if (a.kind !== 'cell' || b.kind !== 'cell' || a.domain === b.domain) continue;
      const key = `${a.domain}\u0000${b.domain}`;
      let edge = edges.get(key);
      if (!edge) edges.set(key, (edge = { from: a.domain, to: b.domain, steps: new Set(), imports: [] }));
      edge.steps.add(step.n);
      if (!edge.imports.some((i) => i.from === imp.from && i.to === imp.to)) edge.imports.push(imp);
    }
  }

  const domainIdx = (id: string) => map.domains.findIndex((d) => d.id === id);
  const layerIdx = (id: string) => map.layers.findIndex((l) => l.id === id);
  const sorted = (s: Set<number>) => [...s].sort((a, b) => a - b);
  const delta: FactDelta = { imports, writes: [] };

  return {
    cells: [...cells.values()]
      .sort((a, b) => domainIdx(a.domain) - domainIdx(b.domain) || layerIdx(a.layer) - layerIdx(b.layer))
      .map((c) => ({ domain: c.domain, layer: c.layer, steps: sorted(c.steps), files: [...c.files] })),
    tests: [...tests].sort(([a], [b]) => domainIdx(a) - domainIdx(b)).map(([domain, files]) => ({ domain, files: [...files] })),
    unassigned: [...unassigned],
    edges: [...edges.values()].map((e) => ({ from: e.from, to: e.to, steps: sorted(e.steps), imports: e.imports })),
    delta,
    violations: check(map, delta, mapper),
  };
}
import type { FactDelta } from './facts';
import { createMapper, matchesAny, type Mapper } from './mapper';
import type { DomainMap, Invariant } from './schema';

export type Violation = {
  invariant: string;
  kind: Invariant['kind'];
  /** One plain sentence naming the file and the rule. */
  reason: string;
  file: string;
  /** Short fact, e.g. `src/a.ts → vendor/b/index.ts` or `src/a.ts writes "runs"`. */
  detail: string;
  /** [A: comply, B: add an exception and record why]. */
  options: [string, string];
  /** Imported file or written table. */
  target?: string;
  /** Latest decision linked to the invariant, if any. */
  decision?: string;
};

const lowerFirst = (s: string) => s.charAt(0).toLowerCase() + s.slice(1);

/**
 * THE invariant checker: the violations a set of added imports and writes would cause.
 * Used on load (whole-repo facts), on `submit_plan`, and in the edit hook.
 * Ignored files never violate; neutral files have no domain, so they are exempt from
 * `only_via` and `no_edge` but still bound by `owns_writes`. Test files are bound by import rules only.
 */
export function check(map: DomainMap, delta: FactDelta, mapper: Mapper = createMapper(map)): Violation[] {
  const domainName = (id: string) => map.domains.find((d) => d.id === id)?.name ?? id;
  const found = new Map<string, Violation>();

  const add = (inv: Invariant, file: string, target: string, fact: string, detail: string, optionA: string) => {
    if (inv.exceptions.some((e) => matchesAny([e.path], file))) return;
    const decision = inv.decisions?.at(-1);
    const v: Violation = {
      invariant: inv.id,
      kind: inv.kind,
      reason: `${decision ? `You decided this in ${decision}. ` : ''}${file} ${fact}, but ${inv.id}: ${inv.rule}.`,
      file,
      detail,
      options: [optionA, `Add an exception for ${file} and record why`],
      target,
      ...(decision ? { decision } : {}),
    };
    found.set(`${inv.id}\u0000${file}\u0000${target}`, v);
  };

  for (const inv of map.invariants) {
    if (inv.kind === 'owns_writes') {
      for (const w of delta.writes) {
        const owner = inv.owners[w.table];
        // Test files seed fixture rows; that is setup, not a product write.
        if (!owner || mapper.isIgnored(w.file) || mapper.place(w.file).kind === 'test' || mapper.domainOf(w.file) === owner) continue;
        add(inv, w.file, w.table, `writes "${w.table}"`, `${w.file} writes "${w.table}"`,
          `Ask the ${domainName(owner)} domain to write ${w.table} (call its function) instead of writing it here`);
      }
      continue;
    }
    for (const imp of delta.imports) {
      const p = mapper.place(imp.from);
      if (p.kind === 'ignored' || p.kind === 'neutral') continue;
      const from = mapper.domainOf(imp.from);
      const fact = `imports ${imp.to}`;
      const detail = `${imp.from} → ${imp.to}`;
      if (inv.kind === 'only_via') {
        if (!matchesAny(inv.targets, imp.to) || (from !== null && inv.allowed_from.includes(from))) continue;
        add(inv, imp.from, imp.to, fact, detail, onlyViaOption(map, inv.allowed_from, imp.to));
      } else if (from === inv.from && mapper.domainOf(imp.to) === inv.to) {
        add(inv, imp.from, imp.to, fact, detail, `Remove the dependency from ${domainName(inv.from)} on ${domainName(inv.to)}`);
      }
    }
  }

  return [...found.values()].sort(
    (a, b) => a.file.localeCompare(b.file) || a.invariant.localeCompare(b.invariant) || (a.target ?? '').localeCompare(b.target ?? ''),
  );
}

function onlyViaOption(map: DomainMap, allowed: string[], target: string): string {
  const domains = allowed.flatMap((id) => map.domains.filter((d) => d.id === id));
  const only = domains.length === 1 ? domains[0] : undefined;
  if (only) return `Route it through the ${only.name} (${lowerFirst(only.purpose)}) instead of importing ${target} directly`;
  if (domains.length === 0) return `Remove the import of ${target}`;
  return `Route it through the ${domains.map((d) => d.name).join(' or ')} domain instead of importing ${target} directly`;
}
// Alike integration (ALIKE_INTEGRATION.md, redesigned against Alike's verified capabilities):
// the server records each decision itself through the paired CLI (`alike it`), off the hot path and with no
// model step; anchors are architectural (cell folders, never globs — Alike matches folder prefixes only);
// the URN goes back into the DR file so a decision is recorded once. The MCP instruction is only a fallback.
import { execFile } from 'node:child_process';
import { homedir } from 'node:os';
import { join } from 'node:path';
import type { DomainMap, Invariant } from '@harness/core';
import { git } from './git';

export type AlikeAnchor =
  | { kind: 'path'; label: string; path: string; repository: string }
  | { kind: 'situation'; label: string; text: string };

export type AlikeDecision = {
  title: string;
  outcome: string;
  rationale: string;
  decision_type: 'standing';
  status: 'made';
  anchors: AlikeAnchor[];
};

/** What Interpretability knows about a decision when it records it. */
export type DecisionInput = {
  id: string;
  title: string;
  outcome: string;
  rejected: string;
  option: 'A' | 'B';
  invariant: Invariant;
  files: string[]; // files the fork was about
  answer: string;
  session: number; // 1-based Interpretability session number
};

const MAX_PATH_ANCHORS = 20; // Alike: at most 20 path + machine_path anchors

/**
 * `owner/name` as Alike's hooks see it: HARNESS_REPO_SLUG, else the origin remote, lowercased.
 * Null when there is neither — Alike's own fallback (the bare folder name) can't hold path anchors.
 */
export function repoSlug(root: string): string | null {
  if (process.env.HARNESS_REPO_SLUG) return process.env.HARNESS_REPO_SLUG.toLowerCase();
  try {
    const m = /[:/]([^/:]+\/[^/]+?)(?:\.git)?\/?$/.exec(git(root, ['remote', 'get-url', 'origin']));
    if (m) return m[1]!.toLowerCase();
  } catch { /* no remote */ }
  return null;
}

/** A cell path glob as Alike anchors: `src/tools/**` → `src/tools/`; plain files stay; other wildcards → null. */
export function anchorPath(glob: string): string | null {
  if (glob.endsWith('/**')) {
    const dir = glob.slice(0, -3);
    return /[*?[{]/.test(dir) ? null : `${dir}/`;
  }
  return /[*?[{]/.test(glob) ? null : glob;
}

/** Folder/file anchors for a domain's cells, logic first (it's where rules usually bite). */
function domainPaths(map: DomainMap, domainId: string, expand: (glob: string) => string[]): string[] {
  const d = map.domains.find((x) => x.id === domainId);
  if (!d) return [];
  const order = (layer: string) => (layer === 'logic' ? 0 : layer === 'data' ? 1 : layer === 'ui' ? 2 : 3);
  const out: string[] = [];
  for (const [, cell] of Object.entries(d.cells).sort(([a], [b]) => order(a) - order(b))) {
    for (const g of cell.paths ?? []) {
      const p = anchorPath(g);
      out.push(...(p ? [p] : expand(g)));
    }
  }
  return out;
}

/**
 * The architecture a decision governs, as Alike anchors: for `no_edge`, both domains' cells (the `from` side
 * governs, the `to` side is context); for `only_via`, the guarded targets plus the allowed domains; for
 * `owns_writes`, the owners' data cells. An exception (option B) also anchors the excepted file.
 * `expand` turns a glob Alike can't take (e.g. `vendor/llm-*` + `/**`) into concrete folders.
 */
export function decisionAnchors(map: DomainMap, d: DecisionInput, repository: string | null, expand: (glob: string) => string[] = () => []): AlikeAnchor[] {
  const governs = new Set<string>();
  const context = new Set<string>();
  const inv = d.invariant;
  if (inv.kind === 'no_edge') {
    for (const p of domainPaths(map, inv.from, expand)) governs.add(p);
    for (const p of domainPaths(map, inv.to, expand)) context.add(p);
  } else if (inv.kind === 'only_via') {
    for (const g of inv.targets) for (const p of anchorPath(g) ? [anchorPath(g)!] : expand(g)) governs.add(p);
    for (const dom of inv.allowed_from) for (const p of domainPaths(map, dom, expand)) context.add(p);
  } else {
    for (const owner of new Set(Object.values(inv.owners))) {
      const cell = map.domains.find((x) => x.id === owner)?.cells.data;
      for (const g of cell?.paths ?? []) for (const p of anchorPath(g) ? [anchorPath(g)!] : expand(g)) governs.add(p);
    }
  }
  if (d.option === 'B') for (const f of d.files) governs.add(f);

  const anchors: AlikeAnchor[] = [];
  if (repository) {
    const push = (path: string, label: string) => {
      if (anchors.length < MAX_PATH_ANCHORS && !anchors.some((a) => a.kind === 'path' && a.path === path)) anchors.push({ kind: 'path', label, path, repository });
    };
    for (const p of governs) push(p, 'governs');
    for (const p of context) push(p, 'context');
  }
  anchors.push({ kind: 'situation', label: 'applies_when', text: situationFor(map, inv) });
  return anchors;
}

function situationFor(map: DomainMap, inv: Invariant): string {
  const name = (id: string) => map.domains.find((d) => d.id === id)?.name ?? id;
  if (inv.kind === 'no_edge') return `Adding or changing code in ${name(inv.from)} that would depend on ${name(inv.to)}`;
  if (inv.kind === 'only_via') return `Adding code that calls ${inv.targets.join(', ')} from outside ${inv.allowed_from.map(name).join(', ')}`;
  return `Adding code that writes ${Object.keys(inv.owners).join(', ')}`;
}

/** The principle, not the incident: title and rationale an agent elsewhere can act on. */
export function alikeDecision(map: DomainMap, d: DecisionInput, repository: string | null, expand?: (glob: string) => string[]): AlikeDecision {
  return {
    title: `${d.id}: ${d.title}`,
    outcome: d.outcome,
    rationale: [
      `Refines ${d.invariant.id} (${d.invariant.rule}).`,
      `Chosen: ${d.outcome}.`,
      `Rejected: ${d.rejected}.`,
      `In the user's words: "${d.answer.trim()}".`,
      `Decided in Interpretability session ${d.session}.`,
    ].join(' '),
    decision_type: 'standing',
    status: 'made',
    anchors: decisionAnchors(map, d, repository, expand),
  };
}

export type ExecFn = (file: string, args: string[]) => Promise<{ stdout: string }>;

const defaultExec: ExecFn = (file, args) =>
  new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    execFile(file, args, { timeout: 30_000, maxBuffer: 1 << 20 }, (err, stdout, stderr) => {
      if (err) reject(Object.assign(err, { stderr: String(stderr) }));
      else resolve({ stdout: String(stdout) });
    });
  });

export const alikeCli = () => process.env.HARNESS_ALIKE_CLI ?? join(homedir(), '.alike', 'bin', 'alike');

/** Record one decision with the paired CLI. Resolves to its URN, or rejects with the CLI's error. */
export async function recordDecision(decision: AlikeDecision, exec: ExecFn = defaultExec): Promise<string> {
  const { title, ...rest } = decision;
  const { stdout } = await exec(alikeCli(), ['it', title, '--json', JSON.stringify(rest)]);
  const urn = /urn:alike:decision:[0-9a-f]+/.exec(stdout)?.[0];
  if (!urn) throw new Error(`alike it returned no decision URN: ${stdout.slice(0, 200)}`);
  return urn;
}

/** The old path, kept as a fallback when the CLI is missing or fails: ask the coding session to call MCP. */
export function mcpInstruction(decision: AlikeDecision): string {
  return `Record this decision in Alike now: call mcp__alike__record_decision with exactly these arguments: ${JSON.stringify(decision)}. If the Alike tools are unavailable, skip this silently.`;
}

const scanned = new Map((base.find((e) => e.kind === 'repo_scanned')?.data as EventData['repo_scanned'] | undefined)?.fileFacts?.map((f) => [f.path, f]) ?? []);
function factsAfter(path: string, created?: { imports: string[]; symbols: string[] }): FileFacts {

  if (prev && !created) return { ...prev, hash: `${prev.hash}+${n}` };
  const sym = (name: string, parent: string | null): SymbolFact => ({
    id: `${path}#${name}`, file: path, name, kind: parent ? 'method' : 'const', exported: !parent, parent: parent && `${path}#${parent}`,

import { existsSync, readFileSync, realpathSync } from 'node:fs';
import { join, relative, isAbsolute } from 'node:path';
import { watch, type FSWatcher } from 'chokidar';
import { diffLines } from 'diff';
import {
  parseDomainMap, createMapper, listRepoFiles, scanRepoFacts, factsForSource, domainEdges, check, fileExistsIn, createFactsIndex,
  settleCalls, diffSymbols, moduleRecord,
  type CallFact, type DomainMap, type Facts, type FileFacts, type ImportEdge, type Violation, type Placement, type SymbolDiff,
} from '@harness/core';
import type { Bus } from './bus';

const CODE = /\.(ts|tsx|js|jsx|mjs|cjs|mts)$/;
/** Files that change how imports resolve or what the entries are: a change rescans facts (domains.yaml reloads the map). */
const CONFIG = /(^|\/)(package\.json|tsconfig[^/]*\.json|jsconfig\.json|pnpm-workspace\.yaml)$/;
export const isConfigFile = (rel: string) => rel === 'domains.yaml' || CONFIG.test(rel);
/** Importers re-linked after one file's exports or symbols change (re-exports are followed up to 4 barrels deep). */
export const MAX_RELINK = 200;

const callKey = (c: { from: string; to: string }) => `${c.from}\u0000${c.to}`;
/** Export names, re-export targets and `export *` of a module record: what importers link through. */
const exportShape = (path: string, text: string | null | undefined) => {
  if (text == null) return '';
  const r = moduleRecord(path, text);
  return JSON.stringify([[...r.exports].sort(([a], [b]) => (a < b ? -1 : 1)), r.stars]);
};
const isBarrel = (path: string, text: string | null) => {
  if (text === null) return false;
  const r = moduleRecord(path, text);
  return r.stars.length > 0 || [...r.exports.values()].some((t) => 'spec' in t);
};

export class Repo {
  readonly root: string;
  map!: DomainMap;
  mapText = '';
  mapper!: ReturnType<typeof createMapper>;
  facts: Facts = { files: [], imports: [], writes: [] };
  /** Tier 1 facts per code file (NAVIGATION_PLAN §3.1); the previous value is diffed on every change. */
  fileFacts = new Map<string, FileFacts>();
  private index!: ReturnType<typeof createFactsIndex>;
  violations: Violation[] = [];
  private contents = new Map<string, string>();
  private pending = new Map<string, NodeJS.Timeout>(); // paths a hook is editing; the watcher leaves them alone
  private watcher: FSWatcher | null = null;
  private configQueue = new Set<string>();
  private configTimer: NodeJS.Timeout | null = null;
  exists: ReturnType<typeof fileExistsIn>;

  constructor(root: string, private bus: Bus) {
    this.root = realpathSync(root);
    this.exists = fileExistsIn(this.root);
  }

  get mapPath() { return join(this.root, 'domains.yaml'); }
  hasMap() { return existsSync(this.mapPath); }

  /** Load (or reload) domains.yaml text. */
  setMap(text: string) {
    const map = parseDomainMap(text); // throws before anything changes
    this.mapText = text;
    this.map = map;
    this.mapper = createMapper(this.map);
    this.index = createFactsIndex(this.root, this.map, this.exists, (p) => this.current(p));
  }

  loadMapFile() { this.setMap(readFileSync(this.mapPath, 'utf8')); }

  /** Repo-relative POSIX path for an absolute path from a hook, or null if it is outside the repo. */
  rel(p: string): string | null {
    let abs = isAbsolute(p) ? p : join(this.root, p);
    try { abs = realpathSync(abs); } catch {
      // New file: resolve the parent instead.
      const i = abs.lastIndexOf('/');
      try { abs = join(realpathSync(abs.slice(0, i)), abs.slice(i + 1)); } catch { /* keep as is */ }
    }
    const r = relative(this.root, abs);
    if (!r || r.startsWith('..') || isAbsolute(r)) return null;
    return r.split('\\').join('/');
  }

  place(path: string): Placement { return this.mapper.place(path); }

  cellOf(path: string) {
    const p = this.place(path);
    return p.kind === 'cell' ? { domain: p.domain, layer: p.layer } : null;
  }

  /** Placement for a directory (Grep/Glob path): the single cell all known files under it share, if any. */
  cellForDir(dir: string) {
    const prefix = dir.replace(/\/$/, '') + '/';
    let found: { domain: string; layer: string } | null = null;
    for (const f of this.facts.files) {
      if (!f.startsWith(prefix)) continue;
      const c = this.cellOf(f);
      if (!c) continue;
      if (found && (found.domain !== c.domain || found.layer !== c.layer)) return null;
      found = c;
    }
    return found;
  }

  /** Every non-ignored file under the current map. */
  listFiles() { return listRepoFiles(this.root, this.map, this.mapper); }

  /** Full fact scan → `repo_scanned` (with Tier 1 `fileFacts`) + `violation_found`. */
  scan() {
    this.exists.clear();
    const { fileFacts, ...facts } = scanRepoFacts(this.root, this.map);
    this.facts = facts;
    this.fileFacts = new Map(Object.entries(fileFacts));
    this.contents.clear();
    for (const f of this.facts.files) {
      if (CODE.test(f)) this.contents.set(f, readFileSync(join(this.root, f), 'utf8'));
    }
    this.bus.emit('repo_scanned', {
      files: this.facts.files.map((path) => ({ path, placement: this.place(path) })),
      imports: this.facts.imports,
      writes: this.facts.writes,
      edges: domainEdges(this.facts, this.mapper),
      fileFacts: [...this.fileFacts.values()],
    }, { turn: null });
    this.recheck();
  }

  /**
   * Tier 1 facts for a changed code file (null when deleted), calls settled against the rest of the repo. If the new
   * text doesn't parse (mid-edit), symbols, calls, routes and entries stay as they were instead of reading as removed.
   */
  private refreshFacts(path: string, text: string | null): { prev: FileFacts | null; next: FileFacts | null; parsed: boolean } {
    const prev = this.fileFacts.get(path) ?? null;
    if (text === null) {
      this.fileFacts.delete(path);
      return { prev, next: null, parsed: true };
    }
    const { facts, parsed } = this.index.extract(path, text);
    if (!parsed && prev) Object.assign(facts, { symbols: prev.symbols, calls: prev.calls, routes: prev.routes, entries: prev.entries });
    else {
      const names = (file: string) => {
        const f = file === path ? facts : this.fileFacts.get(file);
        return f ? new Set(f.symbols.map((s) => s.name)) : null;
      };
      facts.calls = settleCalls(facts.calls, names);
    }
    this.fileFacts.set(path, facts);
    return { prev, next: facts, parsed };
  }

  /** `call_added` / `call_removed` for one file's outgoing call edges, diffed like imports. */
  private emitCallDiff(path: string, before: readonly CallFact[], after: readonly CallFact[]) {
    const oldCalls = new Set(before.map(callKey));
    const newCalls = new Set(after.map(callKey));
    for (const c of after) if (!oldCalls.has(callKey(c))) this.bus.emit('call_added', { from: c.from, to: c.to, confidence: c.confidence }, { path });
    for (const c of before) if (!newCalls.has(callKey(c))) this.bus.emit('call_removed', { from: c.from, to: c.to, confidence: c.confidence }, { path });
  }

  /**
   * Barrel relink (Tier 1): `changed`'s exports or symbol names changed, so calls its importers resolved through it (or
   * through barrels re-exporting it) may now point elsewhere. Re-extract those importers from their current text and
   * publish the ones whose calls or imports moved. Returns the re-linked paths.
   */
  relink(changed: string): string[] {
    const affected = new Set<string>();
    let frontier = new Set([changed]);
    for (let depth = 0; depth < 4 && frontier.size; depth++) {
      const next = new Set<string>();
      for (const [p, f] of this.fileFacts) {
        if (p === changed || affected.has(p) || !f.imports.some((i) => frontier.has(i.to))) continue;
        affected.add(p);
        if (isBarrel(p, this.current(p))) next.add(p);
      }
      frontier = next;
    }
    const moved: string[] = [];
    for (const p of [...affected].sort().slice(0, MAX_RELINK)) {
      const text = this.current(p);
      if (text === null) continue;
      const { prev, next } = this.refreshFacts(p, text);
      if (!prev || !next) continue;
      const same = JSON.stringify(prev.calls.map(callKey).sort()) === JSON.stringify(next.calls.map(callKey).sort())
        && JSON.stringify(prev.imports) === JSON.stringify(next.imports);
      if (same) continue;
      moved.push(p);
      this.bus.emit('facts_changed', { facts: next }, { path: p, cell: this.cellOf(p) });
      this.emitCallDiff(p, prev.calls, next.calls);
    }
    return moved;
  }

  /**
   * A config file changed on disk (watcher): `domains.yaml` reloads the map unless its text is what Interpretability itself last
   * loaded (every Interpretability write goes through `setMap`, so its own writes never rescan); `package.json`, `tsconfig*.json`
   * and `pnpm-workspace.yaml` rebuild the resolver and entries. Either way the facts are rescanned once.
   * Returns whether a rescan ran.
   */
  applyConfigChanges(paths: readonly string[]): boolean {
    let rescan = false;
    if (paths.includes('domains.yaml')) {
      let text: string | null = null;
      try { text = readFileSync(this.mapPath, 'utf8'); } catch { /* deleted: keep the map in memory */ }
      if (text !== null && text !== this.mapText) {
        try {
          this.setMap(text);
          this.bus.emit('map_confirmed', { map: this.map, source: 'file' }, { turn: null });
          rescan = true;
        } catch (e) {
          this.bus.emit('error', { message: `domains.yaml changed on disk but is invalid; keeping the previous map. ${(e as Error).message}` }, { turn: null });
        }
      }
    }
    if (paths.some((p) => p !== 'domains.yaml')) {

  startWatcher() {

      if (/(^|\/)(node_modules|\.git|\.harness)(\/|$)/.test(r)) return true;
      const rel = r.split('\\').join('/');
      return !isConfigFile(rel) && this.mapper.isIgnored(rel);
    };
    this.watcher = watch(this.root, { ignored, ignoreInitial: true, awaitWriteFinish: { stabilityThreshold: 120, pollInterval: 40 } });

      const r = this.rel(abs);
      if (!r || this.pending.has(r)) return;
      if (isConfigFile(r)) return this.configChanged(r);
      this.fileChanged(r, { unattributed: true });
    };
    this.watcher.on('add', handle).on('change', handle).on('unlink', handle);
  }

  async close() {

import { appendFileSync, existsSync, mkdirSync, readFileSync, writeFileSync } from 'node:fs';
import { join } from 'node:path';
import { randomUUID } from 'node:crypto';
import type { HarnessEvent, EventKind, EventData, Cell } from '@harness/core';

type Listener = (e: HarnessEvent) => void;

/** Append-only event log: `.harness/events.jsonl` in the target repo, broadcast to every listener. */
export class Bus {
  readonly events: HarnessEvent[] = [];
  readonly session = randomUUID().slice(0, 8);
  turn: string | null = null;
  private listeners = new Set<Listener>();
  private file: string;

  constructor(repo: string, opts: { fresh?: boolean } = {}) {
    const dir = join(repo, '.harness');
    mkdirSync(join(dir, 'turns'), { recursive: true });
    // Keep .harness/ out of the target's git without touching its .gitignore.
    if (!existsSync(join(dir, '.gitignore'))) writeFileSync(join(dir, '.gitignore'), '*\n');
    this.file = join(dir, 'events.jsonl');
    if (opts.fresh) writeFileSync(this.file, '');
    else if (existsSync(this.file)) {
      for (const line of readFileSync(this.file, 'utf8').split('\n')) {
        if (line.trim()) this.events.push(JSON.parse(line) as HarnessEvent);
      }
    }
  }

  emit<K extends EventKind>(kind: K, data: K extends keyof EventData ? EventData[K] : never, extra: { cell?: Cell | null; path?: string; turn?: string | null } = {}): HarnessEvent {
    const e: HarnessEvent = {
      id: randomUUID().slice(0, 12),
      t: Date.now(),
      session: this.session,
      turn: extra.turn === undefined ? this.turn : extra.turn,
      kind,
      ...(extra.cell ? { cell: extra.cell } : {}),
      ...(extra.path ? { path: extra.path } : {}),
      data: data as Record<string, unknown>,
    };
    this.events.push(e);
    appendFileSync(this.file, JSON.stringify(e) + '\n');
    for (const l of this.listeners) l(e);
    return e;
  }

  on(l: Listener) {
    this.listeners.add(l);
    return () => this.listeners.delete(l);
  }
}
import { execFileSync } from 'node:child_process';

/** Paths Interpretability itself writes; never counted as the coding session's work. */
const HARNESS_PATHS = [':(exclude)domains.yaml', ':(exclude)decisions', ':(exclude).harness'];

export function git(repo: string, args: string[]): string {
  return execFileSync('git', args, { cwd: repo, encoding: 'utf8', stdio: ['ignore', 'pipe', 'pipe'] }).trim();
}

function tryGit(repo: string, args: string[]): string {
  try { return git(repo, args); } catch { return ''; }
}

export type Baseline = { head: string; snapshot: string; untracked: string[] };

/** Turn baseline: HEAD plus a `git stash create` snapshot of the working tree (no stash entry is stored). */
export function baseline(repo: string): Baseline {
  const head = tryGit(repo, ['rev-parse', 'HEAD']);
  const snapshot = tryGit(repo, ['stash', 'create']) || head;
  const untracked = untrackedFiles(repo);
  return { head, snapshot, untracked };
}

function untrackedFiles(repo: string): string[] {
  return tryGit(repo, ['ls-files', '--others', '--exclude-standard']).split('\n').filter(Boolean);
}

/** Lines added/removed since the baseline, including files created during the turn (untracked). */
export function numstat(repo: string, base: Baseline): { added: number; removed: number; files: string[] } {
  let added = 0, removed = 0;
  const files: string[] = [];
  const parse = (out: string, name?: string) => {
    for (const line of out.split('\n')) {
      const [a, r, ...rest] = line.split('\t');
      if (!rest.length) continue;
      added += Number(a) || 0;
      removed += Number(r) || 0;
      files.push(name ?? rest.join('\t'));
    }
  };
  if (base.snapshot) parse(tryGit(repo, ['diff', '--numstat', base.snapshot, '--', '.', ...HARNESS_PATHS]));
  const before = new Set(base.untracked);
  for (const f of untrackedFiles(repo)) {
    if (before.has(f) || f.startsWith('decisions/') || f.startsWith('.harness/') || f === 'domains.yaml') continue;
    // --no-index exits 1 when files differ, so read stdout from the error.
    try { execFileSync('git', ['diff', '--no-index', '--numstat', '/dev/null', f], { cwd: repo, encoding: 'utf8' }); }
    catch (e) { parse(String((e as { stdout?: string }).stdout ?? ''), f); }
  }
  return { added, removed, files };
}

/** Commit only Interpretability's own files, so the coding session's uncommitted edits stay out (SPEC §8). */
export function commitPaths(repo: string, paths: string[], message: string) {
  git(repo, ['add', '--', ...paths]);
  git(repo, ['commit', '-q', '-m', message, '--', ...paths]);
}
