import { existsSync, readFileSync, writeFileSync } from 'node:fs';
import { join, resolve, dirname } from 'node:path';
import { fileURLToPath } from 'node:url';
import { Hono } from 'hono';
import { serve } from '@hono/node-server';
import { serveStatic } from '@hono/node-server/serve-static';
import { WebSocketServer, type WebSocket } from 'ws';
import { Bus } from './bus';
import { Repo } from './repo';
import { Session } from './session';
import { commitPaths } from './git';
import { attachLivingMap, livingMapRoutes, onboardingSkeleton, proposeOnboarding, sdkProposer } from './living-map'; // living map (NAVIGATION_PLAN §4)
import { attachSemantic } from './semantic'; // Tier 2 semantic facts (NAVIGATION_PLAN §3.1)
import { attachAuditor, auditorRoutes } from './auditor'; // auditor (N9)
import { attachJourneys, journeyRoutes } from './journeys'; // journeys (N10)

const here = dirname(fileURLToPath(import.meta.url));
const REPO = process.env.HARNESS_REPO ? resolve(process.env.INIT_CWD ?? process.cwd(), process.env.HARNESS_REPO) : '';
if (!REPO || !existsSync(REPO)) {
  console.error(`Set HARNESS_REPO to the target repo (got "${process.env.HARNESS_REPO ?? ''}").`);
  process.exit(1);
}
const PORT = Number(process.env.PORT ?? 4310);
const FALLBACK_MAP = resolve(here, '../../../fixtures/scout-agent.domains.yaml');

const bus = new Bus(REPO, { fresh: process.env.HARNESS_FRESH === '1' });
const sockets = new Set<WebSocket>();
const broadcast = (msg: unknown) => {
  const s = JSON.stringify(msg);
  for (const ws of sockets) if (ws.readyState === ws.OPEN) ws.send(s);
};
bus.on((event) => broadcast({ type: 'event', event }));

const repo = new Repo(REPO, bus);
// Tier 2 runs in a child process fed by repo_scanned / facts_changed; its status is ephemeral (not in the log).
const semantic = attachSemantic(bus, repo, { onStatus: (status) => broadcast({ type: 'semantic', status }), log: (l) => console.log(l) });
let session: Session | null = null;
let proposal: { yaml: string; source: 'cartographer' | 'fixture' } | null = null;
let busy = false;

function startSession() {
  repo.scan();
  repo.startWatcher();
  session = new Session(repo, bus, (m) => {
    if (m.type === 'busy') busy = m.busy;
    broadcast(m);
  });
  session.start();
}

/**
 * Load: use domains.yaml if present. Otherwise show the instant skeleton, then the best of the cartographer's K scored
 * candidates (HARNESS_CARTOGRAPHER=0, or a failed/empty run: the reference map), and wait for Confirm.
 */
async function load() {
  if (repo.hasMap()) {
    repo.loadMapFile();
    bus.emit('map_confirmed', { map: repo.map, source: 'file' }, { turn: null });
    startSession();
    return;
  }
  // ---- living map: the instant deterministic skeleton while the cartographer works (NAVIGATION_PLAN §4.2) ----
  showProposal(onboardingSkeleton(repo.root), 'cartographer');
  let yaml: string;
  let source: 'cartographer' | 'fixture' = 'cartographer';
  try {
    if (process.env.HARNESS_CARTOGRAPHER === '0') throw new Error('disabled');
    const k = Number(process.env.HARNESS_CARTOGRAPHER_K ?? 4);
    const best = await proposeOnboarding({ root: repo.root, bus, proposer: sdkProposer, k });
    if (!best) throw new Error('no valid candidate map');
    yaml = best.yaml;
    const s = best.score;
    bus.emit('chat', {
      role: 'system',
      text: `Cartographer: best of ${best.scored} scored candidate map(s): ${best.candidate.title} · a typical commit lights ${s.cellsLitMean.toFixed(1)} cells (skeleton ${best.skeleton.cellsLitMean.toFixed(1)}); ${s.unassigned} files unassigned.`,
    }, { turn: null });
  } catch (e) {
    if ((e as Error).message !== 'disabled') bus.emit('error', { message: `Cartographer failed, using the reference map: ${(e as Error).message}` }, { turn: null });
    yaml = readFileSync(FALLBACK_MAP, 'utf8');
    source = 'fixture';
  }
  // ---- end living map ----
  if (session) return; // the user confirmed the skeleton before the cartographer answered
  showProposal(yaml, source);
}

function showProposal(yaml: string, source: 'cartographer' | 'fixture') {
  repo.setMap(yaml);
  proposal = { yaml, source };
  bus.emit('map_proposed', { map: repo.map, yaml }, { turn: null });
  // The shell plays the map assembling: one file_assigned per file, ~15 ms apart.
  const files = repo.listFiles();
  files.forEach((path, i) => setTimeout(() => bus.emit('file_assigned', { placement: repo.place(path) }, { path, turn: null }), i * 15));
}

const app = new Hono();

// ---- living map (NAVIGATION_PLAN §4): drift → cartographer proposals, accept/reject, survey ----
const living = attachLivingMap({ bus, repo });
app.route('/api', livingMapRoutes(living));
// ---- end living map ----
// ---- auditor + journeys (NAVIGATION_PLAN §4.6, N9/N10): advisory findings after each turn; journeys on load/turn end ----
const auditorLoop = attachAuditor({ bus, repo });
app.route('/api', auditorRoutes(auditorLoop));
const journeysLoop = attachJourneys({ bus, repo });
app.route('/api', journeyRoutes(journeysLoop));
// ---- end auditor + journeys ----
app.get('/api/info', (c) => c.json({ repo: REPO, session: bus.session, busy, proposal: !!proposal }));
app.get('/api/events', (c) => c.json(bus.events));
app.get('/api/semantic', (c) => c.json(semantic?.status() ?? { state: 'off' }));
app.post('/api/chat', async (c) => {
  const { text } = await c.req.json<{ text: string }>();
  if (!session) return c.json({ error: 'Confirm the map first.' }, 409);
  session.userMessage(text);
  return c.json({ ok: true });
});
app.post('/api/approve', (c) => { session?.approve(); return c.json({ ok: true }); });
app.post('/api/interrupt', (c) => { session?.interrupt(); return c.json({ ok: true }); });
app.post('/api/map/confirm', (c) => {
  if (!proposal) return c.json({ error: 'No proposal pending.' }, 409);
  writeFileSync(repo.mapPath, proposal.yaml);
  try { commitPaths(repo.root, ['domains.yaml'], 'docs: add domains.yaml architecture map'); }
  catch (e) { bus.emit('error', { message: `Could not commit domains.yaml: ${(e as Error).message}` }, { turn: null }); }
  repo.setMap(proposal.yaml);
  bus.emit('map_confirmed', { map: repo.map, source: proposal.source }, { turn: null });
  proposal = null;
  startSession();
  return c.json({ ok: true });
});
app.post('/api/map/fallback', (c) => {
  if (!proposal) return c.json({ error: 'No proposal pending.' }, 409);
  showProposal(readFileSync(FALLBACK_MAP, 'utf8'), 'fixture');
  return c.json({ ok: true });
});
app.get('/api/file', (c) => {
  const p = c.req.query('path') ?? '';
  const rel = repo.rel(p);
  if (!rel || !existsSync(join(repo.root, rel))) return c.json({ error: 'not found' }, 404);
  return c.text(readFileSync(join(repo.root, rel), 'utf8'));
});

const shellDist = resolve(here, '../../shell/dist');
if (existsSync(shellDist)) app.use('/*', serveStatic({ root: shellDist }));

const server = serve({ fetch: app.fetch, port: PORT }, () => console.log(`Interpretability server on http://localhost:${PORT} · repo ${REPO}`));
const wss = new WebSocketServer({ server: server as never, path: '/ws' });
wss.on('connection', (ws) => {
  sockets.add(ws);
  ws.send(JSON.stringify({ type: 'hello', events: bus.events, busy, session: bus.session }));
  ws.on('close', () => sockets.delete(ws));
});

void load();

const shutdown = async () => { await semantic?.close(); await repo.close(); process.exit(0); };
process.on('SIGINT', shutdown);
process.on('SIGTERM', shutdown);

// Beat 4 (DEMO_PLAN): a violation of an invariant that already has a decision is not a fork. submit_plan and the
// edit gate tell Claude what was decided; the session never asks the user again. Plus submit_plan's `avoided`.
import { afterAll, describe, expect, it } from 'vitest';
import { cpSync, mkdirSync, mkdtempSync, realpathSync, rmSync, writeFileSync } from 'node:fs';
import { tmpdir } from 'node:os';
import { join } from 'node:path';
import { execFileSync } from 'node:child_process';
import { Bus } from '../../../apps/server/src/bus';
import { Repo } from '../../../apps/server/src/repo';
import { Session } from '../../../apps/server/src/session';
import { submitPlan, type PlanHooks } from '../../../apps/server/src/harness-tools';
import type { EventData, HarnessEvent } from '../src/events';
import { linkDecision } from '../src/mapedit';
import type { Violation } from '../src/rules';
import { fixtureRepo, mapYaml } from './helpers';

const dirs: string[] = [];
afterAll(() => { for (const d of dirs) rmSync(d, { recursive: true, force: true }); });

const DR4 = `---
id: DR-4
title: Research tools never read outreach data; the run loop passes it in
outcome: Keep research tools out of outreach data, and have the run loop pass outreach context in
status: made
type: standing
invariant: DR-3
anchors:
  paths:
    - src/tools/outreach-history.ts
rejected: Add an exception for this tool
---

The user chose A.
`;

function setup() {
  const root = realpathSync(mkdtempSync(join(process.env.HARNESS_TEST_TMP ?? tmpdir(), 'harness-dr-')));
  dirs.push(root);
  cpSync(fixtureRepo, root, { recursive: true });
  writeFileSync(join(root, 'domains.yaml'), linkDecision(mapYaml, 'DR-3', 'DR-4'));
  mkdirSync(join(root, 'decisions'));
  writeFileSync(join(root, 'decisions/DR-4.md'), DR4);
  execFileSync('git', ['init', '-q'], { cwd: root });
  const bus = new Bus(root, { fresh: true });
  const repo = new Repo(root, bus);
  repo.loadMapFile();
  repo.scan();
  const planned: { violations: Violation[] }[] = [];
  const hooks: PlanHooks = { onPlan: (_s, violations) => planned.push({ violations }), takeNotes: () => [] };
  const of = <K extends keyof EventData>(kind: K) => bus.events.filter((e): e is HarnessEvent & { data: EventData[K] } => e.kind === kind).map((e) => e.data);
  return { root, bus, repo, hooks, planned, of };
}

// A new research tool importing outreach: DR-3 (tools never depend on outreach), already decided in DR-4.
const TOOL_PLAN = {
  steps: [{ n: 1, text: 'Add the tool', files: ['src/tools/outreach-history.ts'], imports: [{ from: 'src/tools/outreach-history.ts', to: 'src/outreach/outreach-log.ts' }] }],
};

describe('decision-backed violations (beat 4)', () => {
  it('submit_plan says it is already decided and not to ask; undecided ones still ask A or B', () => {
    const { repo, bus, hooks, planned } = setup();
    const out = submitPlan(repo, bus, hooks, TOOL_PLAN);
    expect(planned[0]!.violations.map((v) => `${v.invariant} ${v.decision}`)).toEqual(['DR-3 DR-4']);
    expect(out).toContain('ALREADY DECIDED (1):');
    expect(out).toContain('Already decided in DR-4 (Research tools never read outreach data; the run loop passes it in): Keep research tools out of outreach data, and have the run loop pass outreach context in. Plan it the decided way and resubmit; do not ask the user.');
    expect(out).not.toContain('Stop and ask the user');

    const undecided = submitPlan(repo, bus, hooks, {
      steps: [{ n: 1, text: 'x', files: ['src/tools/x.ts'], imports: [{ from: 'src/tools/x.ts', to: 'vendor/llm-openai/index.ts' }] }],
    });
    expect(undecided).toContain('VIOLATIONS (1):');
    expect(undecided).toContain('Stop and ask the user');
    expect(undecided).not.toContain('ALREADY DECIDED');
  });

  it('the session never opens a fork for them, and the gate\'s deny reason cites the decision', async () => {
    const { root, repo, bus, of } = setup();
    const session = new Session(repo, bus, () => {});
    type Inner = { turn: { planViolations: Violation[]; gateBlocks: Violation[] } | null; onResult(s: string): void; gate: (i: unknown, id: undefined, o: { signal: AbortSignal }) => Promise<{ hookSpecificOutput?: { permissionDecisionReason?: string } }> };
    const s = session as unknown as Inner;
    session.userMessage('Can we build a research tool that reads our past emails?');

    const res = await s.gate({ tool_name: 'Write', tool_input: { file_path: join(root, 'src/tools/opener.ts'), content: 'import { recentOutreach } from "../outreach/outreach-log";\nexport const x = recentOutreach;\n' } }, undefined, { signal: new AbortController().signal });
    const reason = res.hookSpecificOutput!.permissionDecisionReason!;
    expect(reason).toContain('You decided this in DR-4.');
    expect(reason).toContain('Already decided in DR-4');
    expect(reason).not.toContain('Stop and ask the user');
    expect(of('gate_blocked')).toHaveLength(1);

    s.onResult('success');
    expect(of('fork_asked')).toHaveLength(0);
    expect(of('turn_ended')).toHaveLength(1);
  });

  it('an undecided violation still forks', () => {
    const { repo, bus, of } = setup();
    const session = new Session(repo, bus, () => {});
    const s = session as unknown as { turn: { planViolations: Violation[] } | null; onResult(s: string): void };
    session.userMessage('Call OpenAI from a tool');
    s.turn!.planViolations = [{ invariant: 'DR-1', kind: 'only_via', reason: 'r', file: 'src/tools/x.ts', detail: 'd', options: ['a', 'b'] }];
    s.onResult('success');
    expect(of('fork_asked')).toHaveLength(1);
  });
});

describe('submit_plan avoided', () => {
  it('records avoided approaches that cite a known decision, and drops unknown ones with a note', () => {
    const { repo, bus, hooks, of } = setup();
    const out = submitPlan(repo, bus, hooks, {
      steps: [{ n: 1, text: 'Pass past emails into the draft', files: ['src/orchestrator/agent.ts', 'src/outreach/draft-email.ts'], imports: [] }],
      avoided: [
        { from: './src/tools/opener.ts', to: 'domain:outreach', decision: 'DR-4', reason: 'Research tools never read outreach data' },
        { from: 'domain:tools', to: 'domain:outreach', decision: 'DR-9', reason: 'made up' },
      ],
    });
    expect(of('planned').at(-1)!.avoided).toEqual([{ from: 'src/tools/opener.ts', to: 'domain:outreach', decision: 'DR-4', reason: 'Research tools never read outreach data' }]);
    expect(out).toContain('Avoided (per standing decisions): src/tools/opener.ts → domain:outreach (DR-4).');
    expect(out).toContain('Not recorded as avoided (no such decision in decisions/): domain:tools → domain:outreach (DR-9).');
    expect(out).toContain('No violations.');
  });
});
// Server-side Alike recording (apps/server/src/alike.ts, decisions.ts). A fake CLI only — never the real Alike.
import { mkdtempSync, readFileSync, writeFileSync, mkdirSync } from 'node:fs';
import { tmpdir } from 'node:os';
import { join } from 'node:path';
import { execFileSync } from 'node:child_process';
import { afterEach, describe, expect, it } from 'vitest';
import { anchorPath, decisionAnchors, alikeDecision, repoSlug, type DecisionInput } from '../../../apps/server/src/alike';
import { recordInAlike } from '../../../apps/server/src/decisions';
import { Bus } from '../../../apps/server/src/bus';
import type { Repo } from '../../../apps/server/src/repo';
import { loadMap } from './helpers';

const map = loadMap();
const inv = (id: string) => map.invariants.find((i) => i.id === id)!;
const dr4 = (over: Partial<DecisionInput> = {}): DecisionInput => ({
  id: 'DR-4',
  title: 'Research tools never read outreach data; the run loop passes outreach context in',
  outcome: 'Remove the dependency from Research tools on Outreach',
  rejected: 'Add an exception for src/tools/outreach-history.ts and record why',
  option: 'A',
  invariant: inv('DR-3'),
  files: ['src/tools/outreach-history.ts'],
  answer: 'A. Research tools never read outreach data; the run loop passes it in.',
  session: 1,
  ...over,
});

describe('anchors', () => {
  it('turns cell globs into folder prefixes and refuses other wildcards', () => {
    expect(anchorPath('src/tools/**')).toBe('src/tools/');
    expect(anchorPath('src/channels/routes.ts')).toBe('src/channels/routes.ts');
    expect(anchorPath('vendor/llm-*/**')).toBeNull();
    expect(anchorPath('src/*.ts')).toBeNull();
  });

  it('anchors a no_edge decision to both domains (governs / context) plus a situation, never the unwritten file', () => {
    const a = decisionAnchors(map, dr4(), 'johnz4021/scout-agent-take3');
    const governs = a.filter((x) => x.kind === 'path' && x.label === 'governs').map((x) => (x as { path: string }).path);
    const context = a.filter((x) => x.kind === 'path' && x.label === 'context').map((x) => (x as { path: string }).path);
    expect(governs[0]).toBe('src/tools/'); // logic cell first
    expect(governs).toEqual(expect.arrayContaining(['web/src/features/tools/', 'vendor/search/']));
    expect(context).toEqual(expect.arrayContaining(['src/outreach/draft-email.ts', 'src/outreach/outreach-log.ts', 'src/outreach/schema.sql']));
    expect(governs).not.toContain('src/tools/outreach-history.ts');
    expect(a.filter((x) => x.kind === 'path').length).toBeLessThanOrEqual(20);
    expect(a.every((x) => x.kind !== 'path' || x.repository === 'johnz4021/scout-agent-take3')).toBe(true);
    expect(a.at(-1)).toEqual({ kind: 'situation', label: 'applies_when', text: 'Adding or changing code in Research tools that would depend on Outreach' });
  });

  it('expands only_via targets Alike cannot glob, anchors exceptions, and keeps only the situation without a repository', () => {
    const files = ['vendor/llm-openai/index.ts', 'vendor/llm-anthropic/index.ts', 'vendor/embeddings/index.ts'];
    const expand = (g: string) => (g === 'vendor/llm-*/**' ? ['vendor/llm-anthropic/', 'vendor/llm-openai/'] : []);
    const a = decisionAnchors(map, dr4({ invariant: inv('DR-1'), option: 'B', files: ['src/tools/news-summarize.ts'] }), 'o/r', expand);
    const paths = a.filter((x) => x.kind === 'path').map((x) => (x as { path: string }).path);
    expect(paths).toEqual(expect.arrayContaining(['vendor/llm-anthropic/', 'vendor/llm-openai/', 'vendor/embeddings/', 'src/tools/news-summarize.ts']));
    expect(files.length).toBe(3);
    expect(decisionAnchors(map, dr4(), null).map((x) => x.kind)).toEqual(['situation']);
  });

  it('states the principle and the rejected option in the decision', () => {
    const d = alikeDecision(map, dr4(), 'o/r');
    expect(d.title).toBe('DR-4: Research tools never read outreach data; the run loop passes outreach context in');
    expect(d.rationale).toContain('Refines DR-3 (Research tools never depend on outreach).');
    expect(d.rationale).toContain('Rejected: Add an exception for src/tools/outreach-history.ts');
    expect(d.rationale).toContain('Decided in Interpretability session 1.');
    expect(d).toMatchObject({ decision_type: 'standing', status: 'made' });
  });
});

describe('recordInAlike', () => {
  const dirs: string[] = [];
  afterEach(() => { delete process.env.HARNESS_REPO_SLUG; });

  function repoWithDecision() {
    const root = mkdtempSync(join(process.env.HARNESS_TEST_TMP ?? tmpdir(), 'alike-'));
    dirs.push(root);
    mkdirSync(join(root, 'decisions'));
    writeFileSync(join(root, 'decisions/DR-4.md'), '---\nid: DR-4\ntitle: x\nstatus: made\n---\n\nwhy\n');
    execFileSync('git', ['init', '-q'], { cwd: root });
    execFileSync('git', ['-c', 'user.email=t@t', '-c', 'user.name=t', 'add', '-A'], { cwd: root });
    execFileSync('git', ['-c', 'user.email=t@t', '-c', 'user.name=t', 'commit', '-qm', 'init'], { cwd: root });
    const bus = new Bus(root, { fresh: true });
    bus.emit('decision_recorded', { id: 'DR-4', title: 'x', invariant: 'DR-3', option: 'A', paths: [], alike: false });
    return { root, bus, repo: { root } as Repo };
  }

  it('records once through the CLI, writes the URN into the DR file, commits it alone, and emits alike: true', async () => {
    const { root, bus, repo } = repoWithDecision();
    const calls: string[][] = [];
    const urn = 'urn:alike:decision:' + 'ab'.repeat(32);
    const exec = async (_f: string, args: string[]) => { calls.push(args); return { stdout: JSON.stringify({ outcome: 'created', id: 'u1', urn }) }; };
    const items = [{ id: 'DR-4', decision: alikeDecision(map, dr4(), 'o/r') }];
    expect(await recordInAlike(repo, bus, items, exec)).toEqual([]);
    expect(calls[0]![0]).toBe('it');
    expect(calls[0]![1]).toBe('DR-4: Research tools never read outreach data; the run loop passes outreach context in');
    expect(JSON.parse(calls[0]![3]!).anchors.length).toBeGreaterThan(1);
    expect(readFileSync(join(root, 'decisions/DR-4.md'), 'utf8')).toContain(`alike_urn: ${urn}`);
    expect(execFileSync('git', ['log', '-1', '--format=%s', '--name-only'], { cwd: root, encoding: 'utf8' })).toContain('decisions/DR-4.md');
    expect(bus.events.at(-1)!.data).toMatchObject({ id: 'DR-4', alike: true, urn });
    await recordInAlike(repo, bus, items, exec); // dedupe: the URN is already there
    expect(calls).toHaveLength(1);
  });

  it('falls back to an MCP instruction when the CLI fails', async () => {
    const { bus, repo } = repoWithDecision();
    const exec = async () => { throw new Error('alike: not paired'); };
    const notes = await recordInAlike(repo, bus, [{ id: 'DR-4', decision: alikeDecision(map, dr4(), 'o/r') }], exec);
    expect(notes[0]).toContain('mcp__alike__record_decision');
    expect(bus.events.some((e) => e.kind === 'error' && String((e.data as { message: string }).message).includes('not paired'))).toBe(true);
  });

  it('takes the repository from HARNESS_REPO_SLUG, lowercased, else from origin', () => {
    const { root } = repoWithDecision();
    expect(repoSlug(root)).toBeNull();
    execFileSync('git', ['remote', 'add', 'origin', 'git@github.com:JohnZ4021/Scout-Agent.git'], { cwd: root });
    expect(repoSlug(root)).toBe('johnz4021/scout-agent');
    process.env.HARNESS_REPO_SLUG = 'JohnZ4021/scout-agent-take3';
    expect(repoSlug(root)).toBe('johnz4021/scout-agent-take3');
  });
});
import { describe, expect, it } from 'vitest';
import { reduce, type HarnessEvent } from '../src/events';
import { ledger, turnFindings } from '../src/ledger';
import type { Violation } from '../src/rules';
import { demoLog } from './turn-log';

describe('ledger (SPEC §9)', () => {
  it('counts the demo turn exactly', () => {
    const { events } = demoLog();
    const l = ledger(reduce(events));
    expect(l.turns).toHaveLength(1);
    expect(l.turns[0]).toMatchObject({ linesChanged: 18, forksCaughtBeforeCode: 1, rejectedOptionsBlocked: 0 });
    // invariant hit (tools/logic) · unplanned edit (outreach/logic); the tools→gateway edge already existed
    // at domain level but is new this turn, and lands in tools/logic too.
    expect(l.turns[0]!.cellsToReview).toBe(2);
    expect(l.session).toEqual({ linesChanged: 18, cellsToReview: 2, forksCaughtBeforeCode: 1, rejectedOptionsBlocked: 0 });
  });

  it('ranks findings loudest first', () => {
    const { events } = demoLog();
    const s = reduce(events);
    const f = turnFindings(s, s.turns[0]!);
    expect(f.map((x) => x.severity)).toEqual([...f.map((x) => x.severity)].sort());
    expect(f[0]).toMatchObject({ severity: 1, kind: 'invariant', invariant: 'DR-1' });
    expect(f.some((x) => x.kind === 'unplanned' && x.cell?.domain === 'outreach')).toBe(true);
  });

  it('lines changed is null until the turn ends', () => {
    const { events } = demoLog();
    const l = ledger(reduce(events, events.length - 1));
    expect(l.turns[0]!.linesChanged).toBeNull();
    expect(l.session.linesChanged).toBe(0);
  });

  it('does not count a fork answered after code was written', () => {
    const { events, firstEdit } = demoLog();
    // Move the fork question and answer after the first edit.
    const fork = events.filter((e) => e.kind === 'fork_asked' || e.kind === 'fork_answered');
    const rest = events.filter((e) => !fork.includes(e));
    const at = rest.findIndex((e) => e === events[firstEdit]) + 1;
    const reordered: HarnessEvent[] = [...rest.slice(0, at), ...fork, ...rest.slice(at)];
    expect(ledger(reduce(reordered)).turns[0]!.forksCaughtBeforeCode).toBe(0);
  });

  it('counts violations that cite an existing decision as rejected options blocked', () => {
    const { events } = demoLog();
    const v: Violation = { invariant: 'DR-1', kind: 'only_via', reason: 'You decided this in DR-4. …', file: 'src/tools/earnings.ts', detail: '', options: ['A', 'B'], target: 'vendor/llm-openai/index.ts', decision: 'DR-4' };
    const t2: HarnessEvent[] = [
      { id: 'x1', t: 1, session: 's1', turn: 't2', kind: 'turn_started', data: { prompt: 'earnings calls', head: '', baseline: '' } },
      { id: 'x2', t: 2, session: 's1', turn: 't2', kind: 'gate_blocked', path: v.file, data: { violation: v, tool: 'Write' } },
      { id: 'x3', t: 3, session: 's1', turn: 't2', kind: 'gate_blocked', path: v.file, data: { violation: v, tool: 'Write' } },
      { id: 'x4', t: 4, session: 's1', turn: 't2', kind: 'turn_ended', data: { added: 0, removed: 0, files: [], reason: 'success' } },
    ];
    const l = ledger(reduce([...events, ...t2]));
    expect(l.turns[1]).toMatchObject({ rejectedOptionsBlocked: 1, linesChanged: 0, forksCaughtBeforeCode: 0 });
    expect(l.session.rejectedOptionsBlocked).toBe(1);
  });
});

describe('ledger: avoided approaches', () => {
  it('counts a plan that avoids a decided-against approach as a rejected option blocked', () => {
    const { events } = demoLog();
    const t3: HarnessEvent[] = [
      { id: 'y1', t: 1, session: 's2', turn: 't3', kind: 'turn_started', data: { prompt: 'opener from past emails', head: '', baseline: '' } },
      { id: 'y2', t: 2, session: 's2', turn: 't3', kind: 'planned', data: { steps: [], cells: [], edges: [], unassigned: [],
        avoided: [{ from: 'domain:tools', to: 'domain:outreach', decision: 'DR-4', reason: 'research tools never read outreach data' }] } },
      { id: 'y3', t: 3, session: 's2', turn: 't3', kind: 'turn_ended', data: { added: 0, removed: 0, files: [], reason: 'success' } },
    ];
    const l = ledger(reduce([...events, ...t3]));
    expect(l.turns.at(-1)!.rejectedOptionsBlocked).toBe(1);
  });
});

// buildGraph (NAVIGATION_PLAN §3.2): one containment tree plus leaf edges, from domains.yaml and per-file facts.
// Pure and browser-safe (the mapper only needs picomatch).
import { createMapper, matchesAny, type Placement } from '../mapper';
import type { DomainMap } from '../schema';
import type { UIState } from '../events';
import type { CallConfidence, CallFact, FileFacts, SemanticFacts } from '../contracts/facts';
import {
  NEUTRAL_ID, ROOT_ID, UNASSIGNED_ID, cellId, domainId, edgeId, fileOf, groupId, tableId, testsId,
  type ContextGraph, type EdgeKind, type GraphEdge, type GraphNode, type NodeKind,
} from '../contracts/graph';

/** Top-level container for bare packages no `external` cell claims. */
export const VENDORS_ID = 'group:vendors';
/** A container holding more files than this is split into directory groups. */
export const GROUP_THRESHOLD = 12;
/** The layer whose cells hold external services; vendor packages and trace sinks live there. */
export const EXTERNAL_LAYER = 'external';

const KIND_RANK: Partial<Record<NodeKind, number>> = { group: 0, file: 1, table: 2, vendor: 3, symbol: 4, route: 5, entry: 6 };

const emptyFacts = (path: string): FileFacts => ({ path, hash: '', imports: [], writes: [], symbols: [], calls: [], routes: [], entries: [] });
const isPseudo = (id: string) => id.startsWith('vendor:') || id.startsWith('table:');
const normalize = (p: string) => p.replace(/\\/g, '/').split('/').filter((s) => s && s !== '.').join('/');

/**
 * Containment: repo → domain → cell → (group) → file → symbol (nested by `parent`), with routes and entries under
 * their file and tables under the cell that lists them. Test files sit in `tests:<domain>` under their domain;
 * files matching no cell in `unassigned`, shared code in `neutral` (both top-level, created when non-empty).
 * Bare packages (`vendor:<pkg>`) go into the `external` cell that claims them (a glob matching `<pkg>` or
 * `node_modules/<pkg>/…`, importing domains first), else into the top-level `group:vendors`.
 * A cell with confirmed `components` groups matching files by component; any container with more than
 * GROUP_THRESHOLD remaining files groups them by directory (recursively).
 * Leaf edges: imports (file→file), uses (file→vendor), calls, implements, handles (route→handler), writes (→table).
 * Tier 2 calls replace a file's syntactic calls when `semantic[path].hash === facts[path].hash`.
 */
export function buildGraph(
  map: DomainMap,
  facts: Readonly<Record<string, FileFacts>>,
  semantic: Readonly<Record<string, SemanticFacts>> = {},
): ContextGraph {
  const mapper = createMapper(map);
  const nodes: Record<string, GraphNode> = {};
  const children: Record<string, string[]> = {};
  const rank = new Map<string, number>();
  const add = (n: Omit<GraphNode, 'order'>, r: number): GraphNode => {
    const cur = nodes[n.id];
    if (cur) return cur;
    const node = n as GraphNode;
    node.order = 0;
    nodes[n.id] = node;
    rank.set(n.id, r);
    if (n.parent) (children[n.parent] ??= []).push(n.id);
    return node;
  };
  /** Copy a container's domain/layer onto a node (no spread: this runs per symbol). */
  const scoped = <T extends Omit<GraphNode, 'order'>>(n: T, from: GraphNode): T => {
    if (from.domain) n.domain = from.domain;
    if (from.layer) n.layer = from.layer;
    return n;
  };

  // ---- skeleton: domains in map order, cells in layer order (their order is the grid position)
  add({ id: ROOT_ID, kind: 'repo', parent: null, label: 'repo' }, 0);
  const layerIdx = new Map(map.layers.map((l, i) => [l.id, i]));
  map.domains.forEach((d, i) => {
    add({ id: domainId(d.id), kind: 'domain', parent: ROOT_ID, label: d.name, domain: d.id }, i);
    for (const l of map.layers) {
      if (l.id in d.cells) add({ id: cellId(d.id, l.id), kind: 'cell', parent: domainId(d.id), label: l.name, domain: d.id, layer: l.id }, layerIdx.get(l.id)!);
    }
  });
  const nd = map.domains.length;
  const ensureTop = (id: string) => {
    if (id === UNASSIGNED_ID) return add({ id, kind: 'unassigned', parent: ROOT_ID, label: 'Unassigned' }, nd);
    if (id === NEUTRAL_ID) return add({ id, kind: 'neutral', parent: ROOT_ID, label: 'Shared' }, nd + 1);
    return add({ id: VENDORS_ID, kind: 'group', parent: ROOT_ID, label: 'Vendors' }, nd + 2);
  };
  const ensureTests = (domain: string) =>
    add({ id: testsId(domain), kind: 'tests', parent: domainId(domain), label: 'Tests', domain }, map.layers.length);

  // ---- files: every path with facts plus every repo path they import
  const paths = new Set<string>();
  for (const [path, f] of Object.entries(facts)) {
    paths.add(path);
    for (const i of f.imports) if (!isPseudo(i.to)) paths.add(i.to);
  }
  const placement = new Map<string, Placement>();
  const byContainer = new Map<string, string[]>();
  for (const path of [...paths].sort()) {
    const p = mapper.place(path);
    if (p.kind === 'ignored') continue;
    placement.set(path, p);
    const c = p.kind === 'cell' ? cellId(p.domain, p.layer) : p.kind === 'test' ? ensureTests(p.domain).id : ensureTop(p.kind === 'neutral' ? NEUTRAL_ID : UNASSIGNED_ID).id;
    const list = byContainer.get(c) ?? [];
    list.push(path);
    byContainer.set(c, list);
  }

  const putFile = (path: string, parent: string) => {
    const p = placement.get(path)!;
    const n: Omit<GraphNode, 'order'> = { id: path, kind: 'file', parent, label: fileLabel(path), path };
    if (p.kind === 'cell' || p.kind === 'test') n.domain = p.domain;
    if (p.kind === 'cell') n.layer = p.layer;
    add(n, KIND_RANK.file!);
  };
  /** Directory groups for a container holding too many files; recursive, files directly in the common dir stay put. */
  const groupByDir = (parent: string, files: string[], gid: (dir: string) => string, scope: Pick<GraphNode, 'domain' | 'layer'>) => {
    if (files.length <= GROUP_THRESHOLD) { for (const f of files) putFile(f, parent); return; }
    const prefix = commonDir(files);
    const dirs = new Map<string, string[]>();
    for (const f of files) {
      const rest = prefix ? f.slice(prefix.length + 1) : f;
      const i = rest.indexOf('/');
      if (i < 0) { putFile(f, parent); continue; }
      const dir = (prefix ? `${prefix}/` : '') + rest.slice(0, i);
      const list = dirs.get(dir) ?? [];
      list.push(f);
      dirs.set(dir, list);
    }
    for (const [dir, list] of dirs) {
      const id = gid(dir);
      add({ id, kind: 'group', parent, label: `${dir.slice(prefix ? prefix.length + 1 : 0)}/`, path: dir, ...scope }, KIND_RANK.group!);
      groupByDir(id, list, gid, scope);
    }
  };
  for (const [container, files] of byContainer) {
    const n = nodes[container]!;
    if (n.kind === 'cell') {
      const { domain, layer } = n as Required<Pick<GraphNode, 'domain' | 'layer'>>;
      const comps = map.domains.find((d) => d.id === domain)?.cells[layer]?.components ?? [];
      const rest: string[] = [];
      for (const f of files) {
        const comp = comps.find((c) => matchesAny(c.paths, f));
        if (!comp) { rest.push(f); continue; }
        const id = groupId(domain, layer, comp.id);
        add({ id, kind: 'group', parent: container, label: comp.name, domain, layer }, KIND_RANK.group!);
        putFile(f, id);
      }
      groupByDir(container, rest, (dir) => groupId(domain, layer, dir), { domain, layer });
    } else {
      groupByDir(container, files, (dir) => `group:${container}/${dir}`, n.domain ? { domain: n.domain } : {});
    }
  }

  // ---- symbols, routes, entries (under their file; symbols nested by parent)
  for (const path of placement.keys()) {
    const f = facts[path];
    if (!f) continue;
    const file = nodes[path]!;
    const own = f.symbols.some((s) => s.parent) ? new Set(f.symbols.map((s) => s.id)) : null;
    for (const s of f.symbols) {
      const nested = !!s.parent && !!own?.has(s.parent);
      add(scoped({
        id: s.id, kind: 'symbol', parent: nested ? s.parent : path,
        label: nested ? s.name.slice(s.name.lastIndexOf('.') + 1) : s.name, symbol: { kind: s.kind, exported: s.exported },
      }, file), KIND_RANK.symbol!);
    }
    for (const r of f.routes) add(scoped({ id: r.id, kind: 'route', parent: path, label: `${r.method} ${r.path}` }, file), KIND_RANK.route!);
    for (const e of f.entries) add(scoped({ id: e.id, kind: 'entry', parent: path, label: e.label }, file), KIND_RANK.entry!);
  }

  // ---- tables: under the cell that lists them, else unassigned
  map.domains.forEach((d) => {
    for (const [layer, cell] of Object.entries(d.cells)) {
      for (const t of cell.tables ?? []) add({ id: tableId(t), kind: 'table', parent: cellId(d.id, layer), label: t, domain: d.id, layer }, KIND_RANK.table!);
    }
  });
  const ensureTable = (id: string) => nodes[id] ?? add({ id, kind: 'table', parent: ensureTop(UNASSIGNED_ID).id, label: id.slice(6) }, KIND_RANK.table!);

  // ---- table columns, from schema files (`CREATE TABLE`); the table stays under the cell that lists it
  for (const path of placement.keys()) {
    for (const t of facts[path]?.tables ?? []) ensureTable(tableId(t.name)).columns = [...t.columns];
  }

  // ---- vendors: claimed by an `external` cell (importing domains first), else the top-level Vendors group
  const callsOf = (path: string, f: FileFacts): CallFact[] => {
    const s = semantic[path];
    return s && s.hash === f.hash ? s.calls : f.calls;
  };
  const importers = new Map<string, Set<string>>();
  const noteVendor = (v: string, from: string) => {
    const set = importers.get(v) ?? new Set<string>();
    const d = mapper.domainOf(fileOf(from) ?? from);
    if (d) set.add(d);
    importers.set(v, set);
  };
  for (const path of placement.keys()) {
    const f = facts[path];
    if (!f) continue;
    for (const i of f.imports) if (i.to.startsWith('vendor:')) noteVendor(i.to, path);
    for (const c of callsOf(path, f)) if (c.to.startsWith('vendor:')) noteVendor(c.to, c.from);
  }
  const externals = map.domains.flatMap((d) => (d.cells[EXTERNAL_LAYER] ? [{ domain: d.id, globs: d.cells[EXTERNAL_LAYER]!.paths ?? [] }] : []));
  for (const [v, doms] of [...importers].sort(([a], [b]) => (a < b ? -1 : 1))) {
    const pkg = v.slice(7);
    const claims = (g: string[]) => matchesAny(g, pkg) || matchesAny(g, `node_modules/${pkg}`) || matchesAny(g, `node_modules/${pkg}/index.js`);
    const owner = externals.find((e) => doms.has(e.domain) && claims(e.globs)) ?? externals.find((e) => claims(e.globs));
    if (owner) add({ id: v, kind: 'vendor', parent: cellId(owner.domain, EXTERNAL_LAYER), label: pkg, domain: owner.domain, layer: EXTERNAL_LAYER }, KIND_RANK.vendor!);
    else add({ id: v, kind: 'vendor', parent: ensureTop(VENDORS_ID).id, label: pkg }, KIND_RANK.vendor!);
  }

  // ---- leaf edges, grouped by owner file (in path order) and sorted by id within it
  const edges: GraphEdge[] = [];
  const seen = new Map<string, Map<string, GraphEdge[]>>(); // from → to → edges (one per kind); avoids hashing new id strings
  const local: GraphEdge[] = [];
  const resolve = (id: string): string | null => {
    if (nodes[id]) return id;
    if (id.startsWith('table:')) return ensureTable(id).id;
    const f = fileOf(id);
    return f && nodes[f] ? f : null;
  };
  const edge = (kind: EdgeKind, from: string | null, to: string | null, owner: string, count: number, typeOnly?: boolean, confidence?: CallConfidence) => {
    if (!from || !to) return;
    const row = seen.get(from) ?? seen.set(from, new Map()).get(from)!;
    const same = row.get(to);
    const cur = same?.find((x) => x.kind === kind);
    if (cur) {
      cur.count += count;
      if (typeOnly === false) cur.typeOnly = false;
      return;
    }
    const e: GraphEdge = { id: edgeId(kind, from, to), kind, from, to, count, owner };
    if (typeOnly !== undefined) e.typeOnly = typeOnly;
    if (confidence) e.confidence = confidence;
    if (same) same.push(e);
    else row.set(to, [e]);
    local.push(e);
  };
  for (const path of placement.keys()) {
    const f = facts[path];
    if (!f) continue;
    for (const i of f.imports) edge(i.to.startsWith('vendor:') ? 'uses' : 'imports', path, resolve(i.to), path, 1, i.typeOnly);
    for (const c of callsOf(path, f)) edge('calls', resolve(c.from), resolve(c.to), path, c.count, undefined, c.confidence);
    const s = semantic[path];
    if (s && s.hash === f.hash) for (const im of s.implements) edge('implements', resolve(im.from), resolve(im.to), path, 1);
    for (const w of f.writes) edge('writes', w.symbol ? resolve(w.symbol) : path, ensureTable(tableId(w.table)).id, path, 1);
    for (const r of f.reads ?? []) edge('reads', r.symbol ? resolve(r.symbol) : path, ensureTable(tableId(r.table)).id, path, 1);
    for (const r of f.routes) if (r.handler) edge('handles', r.id, resolve(r.handler), path, 1);
    if (!local.length) continue;
    for (const e of local.sort((a, b) => (a.id < b.id ? -1 : 1))) edges.push(e);
    local.length = 0;
  }

  // ---- children, sorted by (rank, id); `order` is the sibling index (domains/cells: their grid index)
  for (const [parent, list] of Object.entries(children)) {
    list.sort((a, b) => rank.get(a)! - rank.get(b)! || (a < b ? -1 : a > b ? 1 : 0));
    const grid = parent === ROOT_ID || nodes[parent]!.kind === 'domain';
    for (let i = 0; i < list.length; i++) nodes[list[i]!]!.order = grid ? rank.get(list[i]!)! : i;
  }
  return { root: ROOT_ID, nodes, children, edges };
}

/** A file's label: its name, with the folder for index files (`vendor/news/index.ts` → `news/index.ts`). */
export function fileLabel(path: string): string {
  const parts = path.split('/');
  const name = parts.pop()!;
  return /^index\.[cm]?[jt]sx?$/.test(name) && parts.length ? `${parts.pop()}/${name}` : name;
}

/** Longest common directory of sorted paths (the common prefix of the first and last, cut at a `/`). */
function commonDir(sorted: string[]): string {
  const a = sorted[0]!;
  const b = sorted[sorted.length - 1]!;
  let i = 0;
  while (i < a.length && a[i] === b[i]) i++;
  return a.slice(0, Math.max(0, a.lastIndexOf('/', i - 1)));
}

/**
 * The facts the graph is built from: `ui.facts`, plus empty stubs for every file the log knows about but has no
 * facts for (placed files, files a turn touched or planned, planned import endpoints), so ghosts and fresh files
 * have a leaf. Cross-domain cell→cell imports follow `ui.edges` (the reducer's record of edge_added/removed), so
 * logs without `facts_changed` still project the same edges as `edgeViews`. A no-op when facts are current.
 */
export function graphFacts(ui: UIState): Record<string, FileFacts> {
  const out: Record<string, FileFacts> = { ...ui.facts };
  const stub = (path: string) => { if (!out[path] && !isPseudo(path)) out[path] = emptyFacts(path); };
  for (const [path, p] of Object.entries(ui.files)) if (p.kind !== 'ignored') stub(path);
  for (const t of ui.turns) {
    for (const p of Object.keys(t.paths)) stub(p);
    for (const c of Object.values(t.planned)) c.files.forEach(stub);
    t.unassigned.forEach(stub);
    for (const files of Object.values(t.tests)) files.forEach(stub);
    for (const s of t.steps) for (const f of [...s.files, ...s.imports.map((i) => i.from)]) stub(normalize(fileOf(f) ?? f));
    for (const e of Object.values(t.plannedEdges)) for (const i of e.imports) { stub(i.from); stub(i.to); }
    for (const e of t.edgesAdded) { stub(e.edge.from); stub(e.edge.to); }
  }
  if (!ui.map) return out;
  const mapper = createMapper(ui.map);
  const want = new Map<string, Set<string>>();
  for (const e of Object.values(ui.edges)) for (const f of e.files) { stub(f.from); stub(f.to); (want.get(f.from) ?? want.set(f.from, new Set()).get(f.from)!).add(f.to); }
  const cross = (a: string, b: string) => {
    const pa = mapper.place(a);
    const pb = mapper.place(b);
    return pa.kind === 'cell' && pb.kind === 'cell' && pa.domain !== pb.domain;
  };
  for (const [path, f] of Object.entries(out)) {
    const w = want.get(path);
    const keep = f.imports.filter((i) => isPseudo(i.to) || !cross(path, i.to) || !!w?.has(i.to));
    const extra = [...(w ?? [])].filter((to) => !f.imports.some((i) => i.to === to)).sort();
    if (keep.length !== f.imports.length || extra.length) out[path] = { ...f, imports: [...keep, ...extra.map((to) => ({ to, typeOnly: false }))] };
  }
  return out;
}

/** The context graph for a UI state (null before a map exists). */
export function graphOf(ui: UIState): ContextGraph | null {
  return ui.map ? buildGraph(ui.map, graphFacts(ui), ui.semantic) : null;
}
// trace (NAVIGATION_PLAN §2 "Wiring trace"): shortest call chains from a symbol, route or file to its sinks.
import type { ContextGraph } from '../contracts/graph';
import { EXTERNAL_LAYER } from './build';
import { byId } from './util';

export const MAX_TRACE_PATHS = 5;

const adjacency = new WeakMap<ContextGraph, Map<string, { to: string; sinkOnly: boolean }[]>>();

/** calls and handles forward, implements from the interface member to each implementation, writes into tables. */
function adjacencyOf(g: ContextGraph) {
  let adj = adjacency.get(g);
  if (adj) return adj;
  adj = new Map();
  const link = (a: string, b: string, sinkOnly: boolean) => {
    const list = adj!.get(a) ?? adj!.set(a, []).get(a)!;
    if (!list.some((x) => x.to === b)) list.push({ to: b, sinkOnly });
  };
  for (const e of g.edges) {
    if (e.kind === 'calls' || e.kind === 'handles') link(e.from, e.to, false);
    else if (e.kind === 'implements') link(e.to, e.from, false);
    else if (e.kind === 'writes') link(e.from, e.to, true);
  }
  for (const list of adj.values()) list.sort((x, y) => byId(x.to, y.to));
  adjacency.set(g, adj);
  return adj;
}

/**
 * BFS over calls ∪ implements ∪ handles (plus writes into a table sink). Default sinks: vendor and table nodes,
 * and anything inside an `external` cell. Sinks end a chain. Returns at most MAX_TRACE_PATHS shortest chains
 * (one per sink, nearest first, ties by sink id), each starting at `from`. Dispatch through a registry shows up
 * as an interface member followed by an implementation (`implements` walked backwards).
 */
export function trace(graph: ContextGraph, from: string, sinks?: readonly string[]): string[][] {
  if (!graph.nodes[from]) return [];
  const adj = adjacencyOf(graph);
  const given = sinks ? new Set(sinks) : null;
  const isSink = (id: string) => {
    if (given) return given.has(id);
    const n = graph.nodes[id];
    return id.startsWith('vendor:') || id.startsWith('table:') || n?.layer === EXTERNAL_LAYER;
  };
  const parent = new Map<string, string | null>([[from, null]]);
  const found: string[] = [];
  let frontier = [from];
  while (frontier.length && found.length < MAX_TRACE_PATHS) {
    const next: string[] = [];
    const reached: string[] = [];
    for (const id of frontier) {
      for (const { to, sinkOnly } of adj.get(id) ?? []) {
        if (parent.has(to) || (sinkOnly && !isSink(to))) continue;
        parent.set(to, id);
        if (isSink(to)) reached.push(to);
        else next.push(to);
      }
    }
    found.push(...reached.sort(byId));
    frontier = next;
  }
  return found.slice(0, MAX_TRACE_PATHS).map((sink) => {
    const path: string[] = [];
    for (let n: string | null = sink; n !== null; n = parent.get(n) ?? null) path.push(n);
    return path.reverse();
  });
}
// Lazy per-graph indexes, cached by identity (graphs are treated as immutable once built).
import type { ContextGraph, GraphEdge } from '../contracts/graph';

const memo = <T>(build: (g: ContextGraph) => T) => {
  const cache = new WeakMap<ContextGraph, T>();
  return (g: ContextGraph): T => {
    let v = cache.get(g);
    if (v === undefined) cache.set(g, (v = build(g)));
    return v;
  };
};

/** from → leaf edges, in graph order. */
export const outEdges = memo((g) => {
  const out = new Map<string, GraphEdge[]>();
  for (const e of g.edges) {
    const list = out.get(e.from);
    if (list) list.push(e);
    else out.set(e.from, [e]);
  }
  return out;
});

export const edgeIds = memo((g) => new Set(g.edges.map((e) => e.id)));

/** An exported interface's member (a property or method under a `type` symbol): kept in the graph, never counted. */
export function isMember(g: ContextGraph, id: string): boolean {
  const n = g.nodes[id];
  if (n?.kind !== 'symbol' || (n.symbol?.kind !== 'property' && n.symbol?.kind !== 'method')) return false;
  const p = n.parent ? g.nodes[n.parent] : undefined;
  return p?.kind === 'symbol' && p.symbol?.kind === 'type';
}

/** Files in a subtree (a file counts itself) and symbols strictly below a node (interface members excluded); memoized for containers only. */
export const subtreeCounts = memo((g) => {
  const cache = new Map<string, { files: number; symbols: number }>();
  const count = (id: string): { files: number; symbols: number } => {
    const kids = g.children[id];
    const self = g.nodes[id]!.kind === 'file' ? 1 : 0;
    if (!kids?.length) return { files: self, symbols: 0 };
    let c = cache.get(id);
    if (c) return c;
    c = { files: self, symbols: 0 };
    for (const k of kids) {
      if (isMember(g, k)) continue;
      const s = count(k);
      c.files += s.files;
      c.symbols += s.symbols + (g.nodes[k]!.kind === 'symbol' ? 1 : 0);
    }
    cache.set(id, c);
    return c;
  };
  return count;
});

/** Ancestors of `id` from the root down, including `id`. */
export function pathTo(g: ContextGraph, id: string): string[] {
  const out: string[] = [];
  for (let n: string | null = id; n; n = g.nodes[n]?.parent ?? null) out.push(n);
  return out.reverse();
}

export const byId = (a: string, b: string) => (a < b ? -1 : a > b ? 1 : 0);

251	2. In plain Claude Code, without Interpretability (`claude --safe-mode --model opus`), run the beat 2, 3 and 4 prompts exactly as typed above. Time each one. Beat 1's comparison is filmed live, not measured here.
252	3. Record what it built:
253	   - did it make a second ledger, the bypass, or the global widening?
254	   - did beat 4's change break the 10-K summaries, and how long did it take to notice and fix?
255	   - how many lines would you have had to read?

258	## Recording setup
259	
260	**Screen**
261	- 1920×1080 at 125% browser zoom, one browser window, no bookmarks bar. Do Not Disturb on, Dock hidden.
262	- Tabs: Interpretability (http://localhost:5173), Scout's app (http://localhost:8788), Alike.
263	- **Beat 1's split screen:** a terminal on the left (large font, about 18 pt, colours close to the shell's) running plain Claude Code in `../scout-run`, and the browser on the right. Record both in one capture.
264	
265	**Scout during recording: always a fresh copy**
266	
267	`../scout-agent` is the untouched original, pinned at `demo-start`. Every session runs against a disposable clone:
268	
269	```
270	npm run demo -- --take 7        # fresh copy at demo-start, Scout's app on :8788, Interpretability on :5173
271	```
272	
273	- Ctrl+C stops everything; `npm run demo` again is a clean slate.
274	- **Options:**
275	  - `--no-map` films the cartographer.
276	  - `--with-data` copies the original's database (pre-run research).
277	  - `--keep` archives the previous copy.
278	  - `--offline` uses the sample companies.
279	  - `--take N` gives the copy its own Alike repository.
280	- **Ports:** Scout is served by `dev:api` on :8788 and reloads server code. Run `npm run build` in the copy if the agent edits `web/`.
281	
282	**Beats 3 → 4 → 4b run in one copy.** Don't reset between them. To retake beat 4 without redoing beat 3:
283	1. After a good beat 3, stop with Ctrl+C. The copy keeps DR-4 and beat 3's build committed on its `session` branch.
284	2. Archive it: `npm run demo -- --keep --take N` makes a new copy and leaves the old one at `../scout-run-<time>`.
285	3. Start beat 4 from the checkpoint: `SCOUT_SRC=../scout-run-<time> SCOUT_REF=session npm run demo -- --no-map --take N`.
286	   - Use the same take number, so Alike holds the same DR-4.
287	   - `--no-map` keeps the checkpoint's `domains.yaml`, which links DR-4 to DR-1; the default would overwrite it with the fixture.
288	
289	**Takes:** record each beat as its own take, and do the voiceover afterwards.
290	
291	**Changing Scout itself** (not a take) happens in `../scout-agent`; then `git tag -f demo-start`.
292	
293	**Cost:** a live Scout run costs about 2–3 cents, and the agent turns are the main spend. Budget about 10 takes.

1	// computeJourneys (NAVIGATION_PLAN §2 "Journeys", phase N10): every entry (bin, script, cli, main, route, page) traced
2	// through the wiring to its sinks, with UI fetch sites linked to the routes they call. Pure, deterministic, browser-safe.
3	// Names are placeholders here; the server's namer replaces them (inferred until the user confirms).
4	import type { FileFacts, RouteFact } from '../contracts/facts';
5	import type { ContextGraph, GraphEdge } from '../contracts/graph';
6	import type { Journey, JourneyStepKind } from '../contracts/cartography';
7	import { edgeId } from '../contracts/graph';
8	import { EXTERNAL_LAYER } from '../graph/build';
9	import { trace } from '../graph/trace';
10	import { fnv1a } from '../cartography/util';
11	import { matchRoute, type FetchSite } from './fetches';
12	import type { InferredEdge } from './dispatch';
13	
14	type StepConfidence = Journey['steps'][number]['confidence'];
15	export type FetchLink = { site: FetchSite; route: RouteFact; confidence: 'syntactic' | 'inferred' };
16	
17	const byId = (a: string, b: string) => (a < b ? -1 : a > b ? 1 : 0);
18	
19	/** `journey:<slug>` from an entry: routes use `<method> <path>`, others `<kind> <label>`; `{}` reads as `id`. */
20	export function journeySlug(entry: { kind: string; label: string }): string {
21	  const text = entry.kind === 'route' ? entry.label : `${entry.kind} ${entry.label}`;
22	  return text.toLowerCase().replace(/\{\}/g, 'id').replace(/[^a-z0-9]+/g, '-').replace(/^-+|-+$/g, '') || 'entry';
23	}
24	
25	/** Content hash of a journey's step list (what a name describes); the name cache is keyed by it. */
26	export const journeyHash = (j: Pick<Journey, 'steps'>) => fnv1a(j.steps.map((s) => s.node).join('\n'));
27	
28	/** Each fetch site matched to a route (sites without a match are dropped). */
29	export function linkFetches(sites: readonly FetchSite[], facts: Readonly<Record<string, FileFacts>>): FetchLink[] {
30	  const routes = Object.values(facts).flatMap((f) => f.routes).sort((a, b) => byId(a.id, b.id));
31	  const serving = new Set(routes.map((r) => r.file));
32	  const out: FetchLink[] = [];
33	  for (const site of sites) {
34	    if (serving.has(site.file)) continue; // a server calling its own routes is not a UI flow
35	    const m = matchRoute(site, routes);
36	    if (m) out.push({ site, ...m });
37	  }
38	  return out;
39	}
40	
41	/**
42	 * Sinks a flow ends at: tables, vendor packages claimed by an `external` cell, and code inside `external` cells. Bare
43	 * packages nobody claimed (react, node builtins) are plumbing, not destinations; they count only when the map claims
44	 * no external at all (then every vendor except `node:` builtins).
45	 */
46	export function journeySinks(graph: ContextGraph): string[] {
47	  const all = Object.values(graph.nodes);
48	  const claimed = all.filter((n) => n.kind === 'table' || ((n.kind === 'vendor' || n.kind === 'file' || n.kind === 'symbol') && n.layer === EXTERNAL_LAYER));
49	  const chosen = claimed.some((n) => n.kind !== 'table') ? claimed : all.filter((n) => n.kind === 'table' || (n.kind === 'vendor' && !n.id.startsWith('vendor:node:')));
50	  return chosen.map((n) => n.id).sort(byId);
51	}
52	
53	/** Most branches kept per journey (deterministic order: by divergence point, then by steps). */
54	export const MAX_BRANCHES = 16;
55	/** Most outside-service sinks traced one by one (trace stops after MAX_TRACE_PATHS sinks; deep services need their own run). */
56	const MAX_DEEP_SINKS = 50;
57	
58	/**
59	 * One journey per entry, sorted by id.
60	 * - Route entries start at the route; when UI code fetches it, the journey starts there instead: the UI symbol that calls
61	 *   the fetch site (`page`), the site (`fetch`), then the route. Only the first site (syntactic before inferred, then by id)
62	 *   is drawn; a route nobody fetches starts at the route.
63	 * - Other entries start at the entry, then its symbol (or file).
64	 * - Paths come from core `trace` over calls ∪ handles ∪ implements, plus the fetch → route links and `inferred` dispatch
65	 *   edges (see dispatch.ts), on a copy of the graph: the nearest sinks, plus each outside service traced on its own.
66	 * - The main path is the best one by: most domains crossed, then ending at an outside service rather than a table, then
67	 *   length. When the flow reaches a dispatch hub (an interface member with several implementations, e.g. a tool
68	 *   registry's `Tool.run`), the main path goes through the hub and its best implementation, and every other
69	 *   implementation's best path is a branch at the hub. Other paths are branches where they leave the main path.
70	 * - A route that reaches no sink still shows its handler and what it calls.
71	 * Step confidence is that of the edge into the step (`handles` and the first step: syntactic; dispatch: `dispatch`;
72	 * an inferred instance call or a fetch link: its confidence).
73	 */
74	export function computeJourneys(graph: ContextGraph, facts: Readonly<Record<string, FileFacts>>, sites: readonly FetchSite[] = [], inferred: readonly InferredEdge[] = []): Journey[] {
75	  const links = linkFetches(sites, facts).filter((l) => graph.nodes[l.site.from] && graph.nodes[l.route.id]);
76	  const known = (e: { from: string; to: string }) => !!graph.nodes[e.from] && !!graph.nodes[e.to];
77	  // Fetch links ride along as `handles` edges so `trace` walks them; inferred dispatch as calls/implements. Never shown.
78	  const extra: GraphEdge[] = [
79	    ...links.map((l): GraphEdge => ({ id: edgeId('fetches', l.site.from, l.route.id), kind: 'handles', from: l.site.from, to: l.route.id, count: 1, owner: l.site.file })),
80	    ...inferred.filter(known).map((e): GraphEdge => ({ id: edgeId(e.kind, e.from, e.to), kind: e.kind, from: e.from, to: e.to, count: 1, owner: '', confidence: 'dispatch' })),
81	  ];
82	  const g: ContextGraph = extra.length ? { ...graph, edges: [...graph.edges, ...extra] } : graph;
83	  const sinks = journeySinks(graph);
84	  const deep = sinks.filter((s) => !s.startsWith('table:')).slice(0, MAX_DEEP_SINKS);
85	
86	  const conf = new Map<string, StepConfidence>();
87	  const key = (a: string, b: string) => `${a}\u0000${b}`;
88	  const callers = new Map<string, string[]>();
89	  const callees = new Map<string, string[]>();
90	  const impls = new Map<string, string[]>(); // interface member → implementations
91	  for (const e of g.edges) {

93	      if (!conf.has(key(e.from, e.to))) conf.set(key(e.from, e.to), e.confidence ?? 'syntactic');
94	      (callers.get(e.to) ?? callers.set(e.to, []).get(e.to)!).push(e.from);
95	      (callees.get(e.from) ?? callees.set(e.from, []).get(e.from)!).push(e.to);

107	  /** Paths from `from` to sinks: the nearest few, plus one per outside service. Deduplicated, in a stable order. */

113	  };

115	  const better = (a: string[], b: string[]) => {

117	    if (d) return d > 0;
118	    const v = (a.at(-1)!.startsWith('table:') ? 0 : 1) - (b.at(-1)!.startsWith('table:') ? 0 : 1);
119	    if (v) return v > 0;

123	  const best = (ps: string[][]) => ps.reduce<string[] | null>((m, p) => (!m || better(p, m) ? p : m), null);

125	  const routes = new Map(Object.values(facts).flatMap((f) => f.routes).map((r) => [`entry:route:${r.method} ${r.path}`, r]));
126	  const entries = [...new Map(Object.values(facts).flatMap((f) => f.entries).map((e) => [e.id, e])).values()].sort((a, b) => byId(a.id, b.id));
127	  const used = new Map<string, number>();
128	  const out: Journey[] = [];
129	
130	  for (const entry of entries) {

132	    let start: string;
133	    const route = entry.kind === 'route' ? routes.get(entry.id) : undefined;
134	    if (route && graph.nodes[route.id]) {
135	      start = route.id;
136	      const hits = links.filter((l) => l.route.id === route.id)
137	        .sort((a, b) => (a.confidence === b.confidence ? 0 : a.confidence === 'syntactic' ? -1 : 1) || byId(a.site.from, b.site.from));
138	      const first = hits[0];
139	      if (first) {
140	        const page = pageFor(graph, callers, first.site.from);

144	    } else {

146	      prefix.push({ node: entry.id, kind: 'entry' });
147	    }

149	    // Where the flow starts: the start itself, or (an entry file with no top-level calls, e.g. a page whose component

151	    let head = [start];
152	    let paths = graph.nodes[start] ? reach(start) : [];
153	    if (!paths.length && graph.nodes[start]?.kind === 'file') {

159	      }
160	    }
161	    const from = head.at(-1)!;
162	
163	    // Through a dispatch hub: the hub's best implementation is the main path; the other implementations are branches.
164	    const alternatives: string[][] = [...paths];
165	    let main = best(paths);
166	    const toHub = hubs.length && graph.nodes[from] ? trace(g, from, hubs)[0] : undefined;
167	    if (toHub) {

173	      if (hubMain && (!main || domains(hubMain) >= domains(main))) main = hubMain;
174	      alternatives.push(...viaImpl);
175	    }
176	    // No sink reached (reads aren't walked): a route still shows its handler and what it calls.
177	    main ??= route?.handler && graph.nodes[route.handler] && start === route.id ? [start, ...followCalls(graph, callees, route.handler)] : [from];

179	    const nodes = [...prefix.map((p) => p.node), ...head.slice(0, -1), ...main];
180	    const offset = nodes.length - main.length;
181	    const steps: Journey['steps'] = nodes.map((node, i) => {
182	      const pre = prefix[i];
183	      const isPage = entry.kind === 'page' && (i === prefix.length || (i === prefix.length + 1 && graph.nodes[node]?.symbol?.kind === 'component'));

188	    const branches = new Map<string, Journey['branches'][number]>();

191	      while (i < p.length && i < main.length && p[i] === main[i]) i++;
192	      if (i === 0 || i >= p.length) continue;
193	      const b = { from: offset + i - 1, steps: p.slice(i) };
194	      branches.set(`${b.from}\n${b.steps.join('\n')}`, b);

196	
197	    const slug = journeySlug(entry);
198	    const n = (used.get(slug) ?? 0) + 1;
199	    used.set(slug, n);
200	    out.push({
201	      id: `journey:${n > 1 ? `${slug}-${n}` : slug}`,
202	      name: route ? `${route.method} ${route.path}` : `${entry.kind} ${entry.label}`,
203	      inferred: true,
204	      entry: entry.id,
205	      steps,
206	      branches: [...branches.values()].sort((a, b) => a.from - b.from || byId(a.steps.join('\n'), b.steps.join('\n'))).slice(0, MAX_BRANCHES),

209	  return out.sort((a, b) => byId(a.id, b.id));

211	/**
212	 * `from`, then up to `hops` calls onward, each the first callee (by id) in another file — the handler's real work,
213	 * when no sink is reachable (e.g. a GET that only reads). Stops at a cycle or when nothing is called outside the file.
214	 */
215	function followCalls(graph: ContextGraph, callees: Map<string, string[]>, from: string, hops = 2): string[] {
216	  const out = [from];
217	  for (let cur = from; out.length <= hops;) {
218	    const here = cur.split('#')[0];
219	    const next = [...new Set(callees.get(cur) ?? [])].sort(byId).find((id) => graph.nodes[id] && id.split('#')[0] !== here && !out.includes(id));
220	    if (!next) break;
221	    out.push(next);
222	    cur = next;
223	  }
224	  return out;
225	}
226	
227	/** The UI symbol behind a fetch site: a caller of it (components first, then by id), or null when nothing calls it. */
228	function pageFor(graph: ContextGraph, callers: Map<string, string[]>, site: string): string | null {
229	  const list = [...new Set(callers.get(site) ?? [])].filter((c) => c !== site && graph.nodes[c]);
230	  list.sort((a, b) => {
231	    const ca = graph.nodes[a]!.symbol?.kind === 'component' ? 0 : 1;
232	    const cb = graph.nodes[b]!.symbol?.kind === 'component' ? 0 : 1;
233	    return ca - cb || byId(a, b);
234	  });
235	  return list[0] ?? null;
236	}
237	
238	function stepKind(graph: ContextGraph, id: string, sites: ReadonlySet<string>, page: boolean): JourneyStepKind {
239	  if (id.startsWith('entry:')) return 'entry';
240	  if (id.startsWith('route:')) return 'route';
241	  if (id.startsWith('table:')) return 'table';
242	  const n = graph.nodes[id];
243	  if (id.startsWith('vendor:') || n?.layer === EXTERNAL_LAYER) return 'vendor';
244	  if (sites.has(id)) return 'fetch';
245	  return page ? 'page' : 'symbol';
246	}
247	// UI → API links for journeys (NAVIGATION_PLAN §2 "Journeys"): `fetch` call sites (direct, through a small wrapper
248	// such as Scout's `request(path)`, or axios/ky) with their URL literal, matched to route facts. Pure and browser-safe:
249	// it scans source text, using the file's symbol spans only to name the enclosing symbol.
250	import type { RouteFact, SymbolFact } from '../contracts/facts';
251	
252	/** A call that sends an HTTP request to a URL known (at least in part) from the source text. */
253	export type FetchSite = {
254	  file: string;
255	  from: string; // enclosing symbol id, or the file path for top-level code
256	  method: string; // upper case; GET when the call doesn't say
257	  url: string; // path only, query dropped, `${…}` → `{}`
258	  exact: boolean; // the whole URL is literal text at the call (no template holes, no wrapper prefix)
259	  via: string | null; // wrapper or client the call goes through (`request`, `axios.post`), null for a direct fetch
260	};
261	
262	export type SourceFile = { path: string; source: string; symbols: readonly SymbolFact[] };
263	
264	const CLIENT = /(?<![\w$.])(?:(fetch|\$fetch|ofetch)|(axios|ky)\s*\.\s*(get|post|put|patch|delete|head|options))\s*(?:<[^()]*?>)?\s*\(/g;
265	const QUOTES = new Set(['"', "'", '`']);
266	
267	/** Read a string or template literal starting at `i` (the quote). Template holes become `{}`; `holes` counts them. */
268	function readString(src: string, i: number): { value: string; end: number; holes: number; tail: string } | null {
269	  const q = src[i];
270	  if (!q || !QUOTES.has(q)) return null;
271	  let value = '';
272	  let holes = 0;
273	  let tail = ''; // literal text after the last hole
274	  for (let j = i + 1; j < src.length; j++) {
275	    const c = src[j]!;
276	    if (c === '\\') { value += src[j + 1] ?? ''; tail += src[j + 1] ?? ''; j++; continue; }
277	    if (c === q) return { value, end: j + 1, holes, tail: holes ? tail : value };
278	    if (q !== '`' && c === '\n') return null;
279	    if (q === '`' && c === '$' && src[j + 1] === '{') {
280	      let depth = 1;
281	      j += 2;
282	      for (; j < src.length && depth; j++) {
283	        const d = src[j]!;
284	        if (d === '{') depth++;
285	        else if (d === '}') depth--;
286	        else if (QUOTES.has(d)) { const s = readString(src, j); if (s) j = s.end - 1; }
287	      }
288	      j--;
289	      value += '{}';
290	      holes++;
291	      tail = '';
292	      continue;
293	    }
294	    value += c;
295	    tail += c;
296	  }
297	  return null;
298	}
299	
300	/** Index just past the `)` that closes the call whose `(` is at `open - 1`, skipping strings; src.length if unbalanced. */
301	function argsEnd(src: string, open: number): number {
302	  let depth = 1;
303	  for (let j = open; j < src.length; j++) {
304	    const c = src[j]!;
305	    if (QUOTES.has(c)) { const s = readString(src, j); if (s) { j = s.end - 1; continue; } }
306	    if (c === '(' || c === '[' || c === '{') depth++;
307	    else if (c === ')' || c === ']' || c === '}') { depth--; if (!depth) return j + 1; }
308	  }
309	  return src.length;
310	}
311	
312	const skipWs = (src: string, i: number) => { while (i < src.length && /\s/.test(src[i]!)) i++; return i; };
313	
314	/** Path part of a URL: origin, query and hash dropped, slashes collapsed. Null unless it is a path (starts with `/`). */
315	export function urlPath(raw: string): string | null {
316	  let u = raw.trim().replace(/^https?:\/\/[^/]+/, '');
317	  u = u.replace(/[?#].*$/, '').replace(/\/{2,}/g, '/');
318	  if (!u.startsWith('/')) return null;
319	  return u.length > 1 ? u.replace(/\/$/, '') : u;
320	}
321	
322	function enclosing(file: SourceFile, at: number): string {
323	  let best: SymbolFact | null = null;
324	  for (const s of file.symbols) {
325	    if (s.kind === 'type' || s.span.end <= s.span.start || at < s.span.start || at >= s.span.end) continue;
326	    if (!best || s.span.end - s.span.start < best.span.end - best.span.start) best = s;
327	  }
328	  return best?.id ?? file.path;
329	}
330	
331	const shortName = (id: string) => (id.includes('#') ? id.slice(id.indexOf('#') + 1).split('.').at(-1)! : null);
332	
333	/** Without symbol spans: the name of the nearest function-like definition before `at` (`function f(`, `f = (…) =>`, `f(…) {`). */
334	function definedBefore(src: string, at: number): string | null {
335	  const head = src.slice(Math.max(0, at - 2000), at);
336	  let name: string | null = null;
337	  for (const m of head.matchAll(/\bfunction\s*\*?\s*([A-Za-z_$][\w$]*)|([A-Za-z_$][\w$]*)\s*[:=]\s*(?:async\s*)?(?:function\b|\([^()]*\)\s*(?::[^=]*?)?=>|[A-Za-z_$][\w$]*\s*=>)/g)) name = m[1] ?? m[2] ?? name;
338	  return name;
339	}
340	
341	type Wrapper = { name: string; prefix: string; method: string | null; symbol: string };
342	
343	/**
344	 * Every fetch site in `files`:
345	 * 1. direct calls (`fetch`, `$fetch`, `ofetch`, `axios.<m>`, `ky.<m>`) whose first argument is a URL literal;
346	 * 2. wrappers: a function whose `fetch` takes a non-literal URL (`fetch(path)`, ``fetch(`/api${path}`)``) is a wrapper
347	 *    with that prefix; calls to it by name, anywhere, with a URL literal first argument are sites (`via` = its name).
348	 * The method comes from the client name (`axios.post`) or a `method: "POST"` in the call's arguments; else GET.
349	 * Sorted by file, then position.
350	 */
351	export function findFetchSites(files: readonly SourceFile[]): FetchSite[] {
352	  const wrappers = new Map<string, Wrapper>();
353	  const sites: (FetchSite & { at: number })[] = [];
354	  const methodIn = (src: string, from: number, to: number) => /\bmethod\s*:\s*["'`]([A-Za-z]+)["'`]/.exec(src.slice(from, to))?.[1]?.toUpperCase() ?? null;
355	
356	  for (const f of files) {
357	    const src = f.source;
358	    if (!/fetch|axios|ky\s*\./.test(src)) continue;
359	    for (const m of src.matchAll(CLIENT)) {
360	      const open = m.index + m[0].length;
361	      const end = argsEnd(src, open);
362	      const a = skipWs(src, open);
363	      const str = readString(src, a);
364	      const client = m[1] ?? `${m[2]}.${m[3]}`;
365	      const fixed = m[3] ? m[3].toUpperCase() : null;
366	      const from = enclosing(f, m.index);
367	      if (str) {
368	        // `${…}` right after a literal prefix that doesn't end in `/` (e.g. `/api${path}`): a wrapper, not a site.
369	        const lead = str.value.indexOf('{}');
370	        if (str.holes && lead >= 0 && !str.value.slice(0, lead).endsWith('/') && str.tail === '' && str.holes === 1) {
371	          const name = shortName(from) ?? definedBefore(src, m.index);
372	          if (name) wrappers.set(name, { name, prefix: str.value.slice(0, lead), method: fixed ?? methodIn(src, str.end, end), symbol: from });
373	          continue;
374	        }
375	        const url = urlPath(str.value);
376	        if (url) sites.push({ file: f.path, from, method: fixed ?? methodIn(src, str.end, end) ?? 'GET', url, exact: str.holes === 0, via: client === 'fetch' ? null : client, at: m.index });
377	      } else if (/^[A-Za-z_$][\w$]*\s*[,)]/.test(src.slice(a, a + 80))) {
378	        const name = shortName(from) ?? definedBefore(src, m.index);
379	        if (name) wrappers.set(name, { name, prefix: '', method: fixed ?? methodIn(src, a, end), symbol: from });
380	      }
381	    }
382	  }
383	
384	  if (wrappers.size) {
385	    const names = [...wrappers.keys()].map((n) => n.replace(/[$]/g, '\\$')).join('|');
386	    const call = new RegExp(`(?<![\\w$])(${names})\\s*(?:<[^()]*?>)?\\s*\\(`, 'g');
387	    for (const f of files) {
388	      const src = f.source;
389	      for (const m of src.matchAll(call)) {
390	        if (/\bfunction\s*\*?\s*$/.test(src.slice(Math.max(0, m.index - 12), m.index))) continue; // the definition
391	        const w = wrappers.get(m[1]!)!;
392	        const open = m.index + m[0].length;
393	        const a = skipWs(src, open);
394	        const str = readString(src, a);
395	        if (!str) continue;
396	        const url = urlPath(w.prefix + str.value);
397	        if (!url) continue;
398	        const from = enclosing(f, m.index);
399	        if (from === w.symbol && from.includes('#')) continue; // a wrapper calling itself
400	        sites.push({ file: f.path, from, method: w.method ?? methodIn(src, str.end, argsEnd(src, open)) ?? 'GET', url, exact: str.holes === 0 && w.prefix === '', via: w.name, at: m.index });
401	      }
402	    }
403	  }
404	  return sites
405	    .sort((x, y) => (x.file < y.file ? -1 : x.file > y.file ? 1 : x.at - y.at))
406	    .map(({ at: _at, ...s }) => s);
407	}

409	const segs = (p: string) => p.split('/').filter(Boolean);
410	const segRe = (s: string) => new RegExp(`^${s.split('{}').map((x) => x.replace(/[.*+?^${}()|[\]\\]/g, '\\$&')).join('[^/]+')}$`);

412	/**
413	 * The route a site calls: same number of path segments, each equal or matched through a `{}` on either side, and the
414	 * same method (a route with method ANY matches any). Among matches the one with the fewest wildcards wins (then id).
415	 * `syntactic` when the site's URL is exact and matched a route segment-for-segment with no wildcard on the site side;
416	 * otherwise `inferred`.
417	 */
418	export function matchRoute(site: Pick<FetchSite, 'method' | 'url' | 'exact'>, routes: readonly RouteFact[]): { route: RouteFact; confidence: 'syntactic' | 'inferred' } | null {
419	  const want = segs(site.url);
420	  let best: { route: RouteFact; wild: number; siteWild: boolean } | null = null;
421	  for (const r of routes) {
422	    if (r.method !== site.method && r.method !== 'ANY') continue;
423	    const have = segs(r.path);
424	    if (have.length !== want.length) continue;
425	    let wild = 0;
426	    let siteWild = false;
427	    let ok = true;
428	    for (let i = 0; i < have.length && ok; i++) {
429	      const [h, w] = [have[i]!, want[i]!];
430	      if (h === w) continue;
431	      if (h === '{}') { wild++; continue; }
432	      if (w.includes('{}') && segRe(w).test(h)) { wild++; siteWild = true; continue; }
433	      if (h.includes('{}') && segRe(h).test(w)) { wild++; continue; }
434	      ok = false;
435	    }
436	    if (!ok) continue;
437	    if (!best || wild < best.wild || (wild === best.wild && r.id < best.route.id)) best = { route: r, wild, siteWild };
438	  }
439	  if (!best) return null;
440	  const exact = site.exact && !best.siteWild && best.route.method !== 'ANY';
441	  return { route: best.route, confidence: exact ? 'syntactic' : 'inferred' };
442	}
443	// Syntactic stand-ins for dispatch that Tier 1 call facts can't see, so journeys can pass through registries and
444	// module-level clients (NAVIGATION_PLAN §3.1 "Tier 2" will produce typed `implements` and calls; when its edges are in the
445	// graph they are used as they are). Pure and browser-safe; used only for journeys, never by the gate or the map.
446	import type { FileFacts, SymbolFact } from '../contracts/facts';
447	import type { SourceFile } from './fetches';
448	
449	/** An edge journeys add on a copy of the graph: interface dispatch (`calls` to a member, `implements` from each implementation) or a call through a module-level instance. */
450	export type InferredEdge = { kind: 'calls' | 'implements'; from: string; to: string; confidence: 'dispatch' | 'inferred' };

452	const last = (name: string) => name.slice(name.lastIndexOf('.') + 1);
453	const esc = (s: string) => s.replace(/[.*+?^${}()|[\]\\]/g, '\\$&');
454	
455	function innermost(symbols: readonly SymbolFact[], at: number): SymbolFact | null {
456	  let best: SymbolFact | null = null;
457	  for (const s of symbols) {
458	    if (s.kind === 'type' || s.span.end <= s.span.start || at < s.span.start || at >= s.span.end) continue;
459	    if (!best || s.span.end - s.span.start < best.span.end - best.span.start) best = s;
460	  }
461	  return best;
462	}
463	
464	/**
465	 * 1. **Interface dispatch.** A method member `I.m` of an interface/type with at least two implementations — methods named
466	 *    `m` on a const or class in a file that is I's file or imports it — becomes a hub: each implementation `implements`
467	 *    it, and every symbol whose own code calls `.m(` from a file that imports I's file (directly or through one file)
468	 *    `calls` it (confidence `dispatch`). Scout: `runAgent` → `Tool.run` → each tool's `run`; `complete` → `ChatProvider.chat`.
469	 * 2. **Module-level instances.** `const client = new Anthropic()` at the top of a file: a symbol in that file that uses
470	 *    `client.` calls what the instance was made from (confidence `inferred`). Scout: `newsSummarize.run` → `Anthropic`.
471	 * Deterministic: edges sorted and deduplicated.
472	 */
473	export function inferDispatch(files: readonly SourceFile[], facts: Readonly<Record<string, FileFacts>>): InferredEdge[] {
474	  const out = new Map<string, InferredEdge>();
475	  const add = (e: InferredEdge) => { if (e.from !== e.to) out.set(`${e.kind}|${e.from}|${e.to}`, e); };
476	  const byId = new Map(Object.values(facts).flatMap((f) => f.symbols.map((s) => [s.id, s] as const)));
477	  const imports = (path: string) => new Set((facts[path]?.imports ?? []).map((i) => i.to));
478	  const sees = (path: string, target: string) => {
479	    if (path === target) return true;
480	    const direct = imports(path);
481	    return direct.has(target) || [...direct].some((d) => imports(d).has(target));
482	  };
483	
484	  const source = new Map(files.map((f) => [f.path, f.source]));
485	  /** The owner is declared as the interface: `const x: I = {` or `class X implements I`. */
486	  const declaredAs = (owner: SymbolFact, iface: string) => {
487	    const text = source.get(owner.file);
488	    if (!text || owner.span.end <= owner.span.start) return false;
489	    const lineStart = text.lastIndexOf('\n', owner.span.start) + 1;
490	    const open = text.slice(lineStart, owner.span.end).search(/[={]/);
491	    const header = text.slice(lineStart, open < 0 ? owner.span.end : lineStart + open + 1);
492	    return new RegExp(`(?::\\s*(?:[\\w$]+\\.)?${esc(iface)}\\b|\\bimplements\\s+[^{]*\\b${esc(iface)}\\b)`).test(header);
493	  };
494	  /** `receiver` is bound by an import in `text` (a module object such as `api`, not an instance). */
495	  const imported = (text: string, receiver: string) => new RegExp(`\\bimport\\b[^;]*\\b${esc(receiver)}\\b[^;]*\\bfrom\\b`).test(text);
496	
497	  // 1. interface members with ≥ 2 implementations
498	  const members = Object.values(facts).flatMap((f) => f.symbols.filter((s) => s.kind === 'method' && s.parent && byId.get(s.parent)?.kind === 'type'));
499	  for (const member of members.sort((a, b) => (a.id < b.id ? -1 : 1))) {
500	    const m = last(member.name);
501	    const iface = byId.get(member.parent!)!.name;
502	    const impls = Object.values(facts).filter((f) => f.path === member.file || imports(f.path).has(member.file)).flatMap((f) => f.symbols.filter((s) => {
503	      const owner = s.parent ? byId.get(s.parent) : undefined;
504	      return s.kind === 'method' && last(s.name) === m && s.id !== member.id && !!owner && (owner.kind === 'const' || owner.kind === 'class') && declaredAs(owner, iface);
505	    }));
506	    if (impls.length < 2) continue;
507	    for (const s of impls) add({ kind: 'implements', from: s.id, to: member.id, confidence: 'dispatch' });
508	    const call = new RegExp(`([A-Za-z_$][\\w$]*)?\\s*\\??\\.\\s*${esc(m)}\\s*\\(`, 'g');
509	    for (const file of files) {
510	      if (!sees(file.path, member.file)) continue;
511	      for (const hit of file.source.matchAll(call)) {
512	        if (hit[1] && imported(file.source, hit[1])) continue;
513	        const at = innermost(file.symbols, hit.index);
514	        if (at && !impls.some((s) => s.id === at.id) && at.id !== member.id) add({ kind: 'calls', from: at.id, to: member.id, confidence: 'dispatch' });
515	      }
516	    }
517	  }
518	
519	  // 2. module-level instances
520	  for (const file of files) {
521	    const f = facts[file.path];
522	    if (!f) continue;
523	    for (const d of file.source.matchAll(/^(?:export\s+)?(?:const|let|var)\s+([A-Za-z_$][\w$]*)\s*(?::[^=\n]+)?=\s*new\s+([A-Za-z_$][\w$]*)/gm)) {
524	      const [, v, ctor] = d as unknown as [string, string, string];
525	      const inside = innermost(file.symbols, d.index);
526	      if (inside && inside.name !== v) continue; // only top-level declarations
527	      const target = f.calls.find((c) => c.from === file.path && (c.to.endsWith(`#${ctor}`) || c.to.endsWith(`.${ctor}`)))?.to;
528	      if (!target) continue;
529	      for (const use of file.source.matchAll(new RegExp(`(?<![\\w$.])${esc(v)}\\s*\\??\\.`, 'g'))) {
530	        const at = innermost(file.symbols, use.index);
531	        if (at) add({ kind: 'calls', from: at.id, to: target, confidence: 'inferred' });
532	      }
533	    }
534	  }
535	  return [...out.values()].sort((a, b) => (`${a.kind}|${a.from}|${a.to}` < `${b.kind}|${b.from}|${b.to}` ? -1 : 1));
536	}
537	// Journeys (NAVIGATION_PLAN §2, phase N10), computation only: pure and browser-safe. Naming is the server's
538	// (apps/server/src/journeys): an injectable namer, cached by journeyHash, inferred until confirmed.
539	export { computeJourneys, linkFetches, journeySinks, journeySlug, journeyHash, MAX_BRANCHES, type FetchLink } from './compute';
