import { useEffect, useLayoutEffect, useRef } from 'react';
import { api, fakeMode } from '../connection';
import { useView } from '../derive';
import { useStore } from '../store';
import { Markdown } from './Markdown';

export function ChatPane() {
  const v = useView();
  const delta = useStore((s) => s.delta);
  const busy = useStore((s) => s.busy);
  const conn = useStore((s) => s.conn);
  const scroller = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
  const chat = v.ui.chat;
  const replaying = !v.live;

  useLayoutEffect(() => {
    const el = scroller.current;
    if (el) el.scrollTop = el.scrollHeight;
  }, [chat.length, delta, v.ui.errors.length, v.ui.pendingFork, v.ui.awaitingApproval]);

  const empty = !chat.length && !delta;
  return (
    <aside className="chat">
      <div className="chat-head">
        <span className="chat-title">Claude Code</span>
        <span className={`chat-state ${busy ? 'is-busy' : ''}`}>
          {replaying ? 'Replaying' : conn === 'down' ? 'Offline' : busy ? 'Working' : 'Ready'}
        </span>
      </div>

      <div className="chat-log" ref={scroller}>
        {empty && (
          <div className="chat-empty">
            <p>Ask Claude to change something. The map shows what it plans and what it does.</p>
            <p className="chat-example">“Add a tool that summarizes a prospect's latest 10-K.”</p>
          </div>
        )}
        {chat.map((m, i) => (
          <div key={i} className={`msg msg-${m.role}`}>
            {m.role === 'assistant' ? <Markdown text={m.text} /> : <p>{m.text}</p>}
          </div>
        ))}
        {busy && v.live && delta && (
          <div className="msg msg-assistant msg-streaming">
            <Markdown text={delta} />
          </div>
        )}
        {v.ui.errors.map((e, i) => (
          <div key={`e${i}`} className="msg msg-note">{e}</div>
        ))}
      </div>

      {v.ui.pendingFork && <ForkCard />}
      {v.ui.awaitingApproval && !v.ui.pendingFork && <ApprovalCard plan={v.ui.awaitingApproval.plan} disabled={replaying} />}
      <Composer disabled={replaying || conn === 'down'} busy={busy && v.live} why={replaying ? 'Replaying. Go live to send.' : 'Waiting for the server.'} />
    </aside>
  );
}

function ForkCard() {
  const v = useView();
  const setDraft = useStore((s) => s.setDraft);
  const fork = v.ui.pendingFork!;
  const first = fork.violations[0];
  if (!first) return null;
  return (
    <section className="card card-fork" aria-label="Choose how to proceed">
      <p className="card-kicker">{first.invariant} would be crossed</p>
      <p className="card-reason">{first.reason}</p>
      <div className="fork-options">
        {(['A', 'B'] as const).map((opt, i) => (
          <button key={opt} className="fork-option" disabled={!v.live} onClick={() => setDraft(`${opt} — `, true)}>
            <span className="fork-letter">{opt}</span>
            <span>{first.options[i]}</span>
          </button>
        ))}
      </div>
      <p className="card-hint">Pick one and add your reason. It becomes a decision later sessions follow.</p>
    </section>
  );
}

function ApprovalCard({ plan, disabled }: { plan: string; disabled: boolean }) {
  return (
    <section className="card card-approve" aria-label="Plan waiting for approval">
      <p className="card-kicker">Plan ready</p>
      {plan.trim() && (
        <div className="card-plan">
          <Markdown text={plan} />
        </div>
      )}
      <div className="card-actions">
        <button className="btn btn-primary" disabled={disabled} onClick={() => void api.approve()}>Approve plan</button>
        <span className="card-hint">or reply with changes</span>
      </div>
    </section>
  );
}

function Composer({ disabled, busy, why }: { disabled: boolean; busy: boolean; why: string }) {
  const draft = useStore((s) => s.draft);
  const focusTick = useStore((s) => s.focusTick);
  const setDraft = useStore((s) => s.setDraft);
  const ta = useRef<HTMLTextAreaElement>(null);

  useEffect(() => {
    const el = ta.current;
    if (!el || !focusTick) return;
    el.focus();
    el.setSelectionRange(el.value.length, el.value.length);
  }, [focusTick]);

  useLayoutEffect(() => {
    const el = ta.current;
    if (!el) return;
    el.style.height = 'auto';
    el.style.height = `${Math.min(160, el.scrollHeight)}px`;
  }, [draft]);

  const send = () => {
    const t = draft.trim();
    if (!t || disabled) return;
    void api.chat(t);
    setDraft('');
  };

  return (
    <div className="composer">
      <textarea
        ref={ta}
        rows={1}
        value={draft}
        disabled={disabled}
        placeholder={disabled ? why : fakeMode ? 'Fake log loaded; sending is off.' : 'Message Claude'}
        onChange={(e) => setDraft(e.target.value)}
        onKeyDown={(e) => {
          if (e.key === 'Enter' && !e.shiftKey && !e.nativeEvent.isComposing) {
            e.preventDefault();
            send();
          }
        }}
      />
      {busy ? (
        <button className="btn btn-stop" onClick={() => void api.interrupt()}>Stop</button>
      ) : (
        <button className="btn btn-primary" disabled={disabled || !draft.trim()} onClick={send}>Send</button>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}
import { cellKey } from '@harness/core/view';
import { useView, type View } from '../derive';
import { useStore } from '../store';

function phase(v: View): string {
  const t = v.turn;
  if (!t) return '';
  if (t.endedAt !== null) return 'Done';
  if (v.ui.pendingFork?.turn === t.id) return 'Waiting for your choice';
  if (v.ui.awaitingApproval?.turn === t.id) return 'Waiting for approval';
  if (t.approved) return 'Building';
  if (t.steps.length) return 'Planning';
  return 'Exploring';
}

export function TurnSummary() {
  const v = useView();
  const setTurn = useStore((s) => s.setTurn);
  const select = useStore((s) => s.select);
  const selection = useStore((s) => s.selection);
  const turn = v.turn;

  if (!turn) {
    return (
      <section className="summary summary-empty">
        <p>Ask Claude to change something; the map shows what it plans and does.</p>
      </section>
    );
  }

  const findings = v.turnLedger?.findings ?? [];
  const selCell = selection && 'cell' in selection ? selection.cell : null;

  return (
    <section className="summary">
      <div className="summary-turn">
        <div className="turn-tabs" role="tablist" aria-label="Turns">
          {v.ui.turns.map((t, i) => (
            <button
              key={t.id}
              role="tab"
              aria-selected={t.id === turn.id}
              className={`turn-tab ${t.id === turn.id ? 'is-active' : ''}`}
              onClick={() => setTurn(i === v.ui.turns.length - 1 ? null : t.id)}
            >
              Turn {i + 1}
            </button>
          ))}
          <span className="turn-phase">{phase(v)}</span>
        </div>
        <p className="turn-prompt">{turn.prompt}</p>
        {v.steps.total > 0 && (
          <div className="steps" aria-label={`${v.steps.done} of ${v.steps.total} steps`}>
            <span className="steps-bar">
              {Array.from({ length: v.steps.total }, (_, i) => <span key={i} className={`steps-seg ${i < v.steps.done ? 'is-done' : ''}`} />)}
            </span>
            <span className="steps-text">{v.steps.done} of {v.steps.total} steps</span>
          </div>
        )}
      </div>
      <ol className="findings" aria-label="Findings, loudest first">
        {findings.length === 0 && <li className="finding finding-none">Nothing to review yet.</li>}
        {findings.map((f, i) => {
          const res = f.kind === 'invariant' ? resolution(v, f.invariant, f.files[0]) : null;
          return (
          <li key={i}>
            <button
              className={`finding sev-${f.severity} ${res ? 'is-resolved' : ''} ${f.cell && selCell === cellKey(f.cell) ? 'is-selected' : ''}`}
              disabled={!f.cell}
              onClick={(e) => {
                e.stopPropagation();
                if (f.cell) select({ cell: cellKey(f.cell) });
              }}
            >
              <span className="finding-mark" aria-hidden="true" />
              <span className="finding-text">{f.text}</span>
              {f.invariant && <span className="finding-tag">{res ? `${f.invariant}, answered ${res}` : f.invariant}</span>}
            </button>
          </li>
          );
        })}
      </ol>
    </section>
  );
}


/** "A · DR-4" when a fork in this turn answered the violation before code; null while it is open. */
function resolution(v: View, invariant: string | undefined, file: string | undefined): string | null {
  const t = v.turn;
  if (!t || !invariant) return null;
  const fork = t.forks.find((f) => f.answered !== null && f.violations.some((x) => x.invariant === invariant && x.file === file));
  if (!fork) return null;
  const dec = v.ui.decisions.find((d) => d.turn === t.id && d.invariant === invariant && d.paths.includes(file ?? ''));
  return `${fork.option}${dec ? ` (${dec.id})` : ''}`;
}
import { useView } from '../derive';
import { useTween } from '../hooks';
import { useStore } from '../store';

export function Header() {
  const repo = useStore((s) => s.repo);
  const conn = useStore((s) => s.conn);
  const name = repo.split('/').filter(Boolean).pop() ?? '';
  return (

import { useView } from '../derive';
import { useTween } from '../hooks';
import { useStore } from '../store';

export function Header() {
  const repo = useStore((s) => s.repo);
  const conn = useStore((s) => s.conn);
  const name = repo.split('/').filter(Boolean).pop() ?? '';
  return (
    <header className="top">
      <div className="brand">
        <span className="brand-mark" aria-hidden="true">
          <span /><span /><span /><span />
        </span>
        <span className="brand-name">Interpretability</span>
        {name && <span className="brand-repo">{name}</span>}
        {conn === 'down' && <span className="conn-down">Server not reachable. Reconnecting…</span>}
      </div>
      <Ledger />
    </header>
  );
}

function Ledger() {
  const v = useView();
  const s = v.ledger.session;
  const t = v.turnLedger;
  const items: { label: string; value: number; turn: number | null }[] = [
    { label: 'Lines changed', value: s.linesChanged, turn: t ? t.linesChanged : null },
    { label: 'Cells to review', value: s.cellsToReview, turn: t?.cellsToReview ?? null },
    { label: 'Forks caught before code', value: s.forksCaughtBeforeCode, turn: t?.forksCaughtBeforeCode ?? null },
    { label: 'Rejected options blocked', value: s.rejectedOptionsBlocked, turn: t?.rejectedOptionsBlocked ?? null },
  ];
  return (
    <dl className="ledger" aria-label="Session ledger">
      {items.map((it) => (
        <Counter key={it.label} {...it} turnIndex={v.turnIndex} />
      ))}
    </dl>
  );
}

function Counter({ label, value, turn, turnIndex }: { label: string; value: number; turn: number | null; turnIndex: number }) {
  const shown = useTween(value, 600);
  return (
    <div className="counter">
      <dd className="counter-value">{shown.toLocaleString()}</dd>
      <dt className="counter-label">{label}</dt>
      {turnIndex > 0 && <dd className="counter-turn">{turn === null ? '–' : turn.toLocaleString()} in turn {turnIndex}</dd>}
    </div>
  );
}

/* ------------------------------------------------------------ map */
.v2-map {
  position: relative; flex: 1; min-height: 0; height: 100%;
  background: var(--v2-ground); color: var(--v2-ink); font-family: var(--v2-sans);
  --ease: cubic-bezier(0.25, 0.8, 0.3, 1);
}
.v2-map .react-flow { background: transparent; }
.v2-map .react-flow__node { cursor: default; }
.v2-map .react-flow__viewport-portal { pointer-events: none; }
[data-theme='strata'] .v2-map { background: linear-gradient(180deg, #e7ebf0 0%, #d7dee6 100%); }

/* band: the open domain's column */
.v2-band { width: 100%; height: 100%; background: var(--v2-band); border-radius: calc(var(--v2-r-cell) + 6px); }
.v2-band-name { display: none; }
[data-theme='atlas'] .v2-band { box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px var(--v2-line-soft); }
[data-theme='control'] .v2-band { box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px #1a2a3d; }
[data-theme='strata'] .v2-band { box-shadow: 0 1px 0 rgb(255 255 255 / 0.8) inset, 0 40px 80px -30px rgb(20 32 52 / 0.35), 0 0 0 1px rgb(20 32 52 / 0.06); }

/* collapsed cell (System level) */
.v2-cell {
  position: relative; width: 100%; height: 100%; box-sizing: border-box;
  display: flex; flex-direction: column; justify-content: space-between;
  padding: 12px 14px 10px; border-radius: var(--v2-r-cell);
  background: var(--v2-cell); border: 1px solid var(--v2-line-soft);
}
.v2-cell-files { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 3px; min-width: 0; }
.v2-cell-file { font: 500 15px/1.25 var(--v2-mono); white-space: nowrap; overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; }
.v2-cell-more { font-size: 13px; color: var(--v2-ink-3); }
.v2-cell-foot { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: baseline; font-size: 13px; color: var(--v2-ink-2); }
.v2-cell.lod-near .v2-cell-file { font-size: 17px; }
.v2-cell.lod-mid .v2-cell-file { font-size: 24px; }
.v2-cell.lod-mid .v2-cell-foot { font-size: 18px; }
.v2-cell-count.is-big { font: 600 44px/1 var(--v2-head); color: var(--v2-ink-2); margin: auto; }

/* spine: a compressed column's cell, state only */
.v2-spine {
  position: relative; width: 100%; height: 100%; box-sizing: border-box; border-radius: var(--v2-r-cell);
  background: var(--v2-cell); border: 1px solid var(--v2-line-soft);
  display: flex; align-items: flex-end; justify-content: center; padding-bottom: 8px;
}
.v2-spine-count { font: 600 15px/1 var(--v2-head); color: var(--v2-ink-3); font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }
.v2-spine.is-edited .v2-spine-count, .v2-spine.is-unplanned .v2-spine-count { color: inherit; }

/* container: an expanded cell holding files */
.v2-container {
  width: 100%; height: 100%; box-sizing: border-box; border-radius: var(--v2-r-cell);
  background: var(--v2-container); border: 1px solid var(--v2-line);
}
.v2-container.has-new { border-color: var(--v2-red); }
.v2-container-head { display: flex; align-items: baseline; gap: 10px; padding: 11px 16px 0 18px; }
.v2-container-name { font: 600 19px/1 var(--v2-head); letter-spacing: 0.01em; }
.v2-container-count { font-size: 13.5px; color: var(--v2-ink-3); }
.v2-container .v2-diff { margin-left: auto; }

/* file */
.v2-file {
  position: relative; width: 100%; height: 100%; box-sizing: border-box;
  display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; padding: 0 12px;
  border-radius: var(--v2-r-file); background: var(--v2-file); border: 1px solid var(--v2-line);
}
.v2-file-name { font: 500 16px/1 var(--v2-mono); white-space: nowrap; overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; min-width: 0; flex: 1; }
.v2-file-meta { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; }
.v2-file.lod-far { padding: 0; }

/* ------------------------------------------------------------ states (cells, spines, files) */
.is-looked { border: 1.5px dashed var(--v2-agent); }
.is-edited { background: var(--v2-agent); border-color: var(--v2-agent); color: var(--v2-agent-ink); }
.is-edited .v2-cell-foot, .is-edited .v2-cell-more { color: inherit; opacity: 0.85; }
.is-unplanned { background: var(--v2-amber); border-color: var(--v2-amber); color: var(--v2-amber-ink); }
.is-unplanned .v2-cell-foot { color: var(--v2-amber-ink); }
.is-ghost { border: 1.5px dashed color-mix(in srgb, var(--v2-agent) 60%, transparent); background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--v2-agent-wash) 55%, var(--v2-file)); }
.v2-file.is-planned-new { background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--v2-agent-wash) 40%, transparent); }
.v2-file.is-planned-new .v2-file-name { font-style: italic; }
.is-violation { box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 2px var(--v2-red); }
.is-new-violation { box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 2.5px var(--v2-red); border-color: var(--v2-red); }
.v2-file.is-cursor { outline: 2.5px solid var(--v2-agent); outline-offset: 3px; box-shadow: var(--v2-glow); }
.v2-file.is-cursor.is-new-violation { box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 2.5px var(--v2-red), var(--v2-glow); }

.v2-diff { display: inline-flex; gap: 6px; font: 600 13.5px/1 var(--v2-mono); font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }
.v2-diff .plus, .v2-diff .minus { opacity: 0.9; }
.v2-container .v2-diff .plus { color: var(--v2-agent); }
.v2-container .v2-diff .minus { color: var(--v2-ink-3); }

.v2-steps { position: absolute; top: -10px; right: 10px; display: flex; gap: 3px; }
.v2-step {
  min-width: 20px; height: 20px; padding: 0 5px; box-sizing: border-box; border-radius: 10px;
  display: grid; place-content: center; font: 700 12px/1 var(--v2-sans);
  background: var(--v2-agent); color: var(--v2-agent-ink); box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px var(--v2-ground);
}

// Journeys (NAVIGATION_PLAN §2, phase N10), server side: compute journeys from the repo's Tier 1 facts and fetch sites
// (pure, in @harness/core), name them with a small model (cached under .harness/journeys/<hash>.json by the hash of
// the step list; inferred until confirmed), and publish `journeys_updated` on load, after turns that change them, and on
// confirm. The namer never blocks anything: placeholder names go out first, model names follow.
import { existsSync, mkdirSync, readFileSync, writeFileSync } from 'node:fs';
import { join } from 'node:path';
import { Hono } from 'hono';
import { query } from '@anthropic-ai/claude-agent-sdk';
import {
  buildGraph, computeJourneys, findFetchSites, inferDispatch, journeyHash, reduce,
  type ContextGraph, type FileFacts, type Journey,
} from '@harness/core';
import type { Bus } from '../bus';
import type { Repo } from '../repo';

export type NamerInput = { root: string; journeys: { id: string; steps: string[] }[] };
export type Namer = (input: NamerInput) => Promise<{ names: { id: string; name: string }[]; cost: number | null }>;

const NAMES_SCHEMA = {
  type: 'object', additionalProperties: false, required: ['names'],
  properties: {
    names: {
      type: 'array',
      items: { type: 'object', additionalProperties: false, required: ['id', 'name'], properties: { id: { type: 'string' }, name: { type: 'string' } } },
    },
  },
} as const;

export function namerPrompt(input: NamerInput): string {
  return [
    'Each block below is a user flow through a codebase: an entry point (UI page, HTTP route, CLI, script) followed by the code it runs, down to the services and tables it ends at.',
    'Give each flow a short product-language name a PM would use: 2–4 words, verb first, sentence case, no code names or URLs (e.g. "Start research", "Send a drafted email", "View usage").',
    'Return one name per id, using the exact ids given.',
    '',
    ...input.journeys.flatMap((j) => [`## ${j.id}`, ...j.steps.map((s, i) => `${i + 1}. ${s}`), '']),
  ].join('\n');
}

/** Real namer: a small, tool-less structured query. Model: `HARNESS_JOURNEY_MODEL` (default `claude-haiku-5-5`). */
export const sdkNamer: Namer = async (input) => {
  const q = query({
    prompt: namerPrompt(input),
    options: {
      cwd: input.root, model: process.env.HARNESS_JOURNEY_MODEL ?? 'claude-haiku-5-5', tools: [], settingSources: [], strictMcpConfig: true,
      outputFormat: { type: 'json_schema', schema: NAMES_SCHEMA as unknown as Record<string, unknown> }, maxTurns: 3,
    },
  });
  for await (const m of q) {
    if (m.type !== 'result') continue;
    if (m.subtype !== 'success' || !m.structured_output) throw Object.assign(new Error(`journey namer ${m.subtype}`), { cost: m.total_cost_usd });
    return { names: (m.structured_output as { names: { id: string; name: string }[] }).names ?? [], cost: m.total_cost_usd };
  }
  throw new Error('journey namer returned no result');
};

/** How a step reads in the namer's prompt: `<kind>: <label>` with the node's path or id for context. */
export function describeStep(graph: ContextGraph, step: Journey['steps'][number]): string {
  const n = graph.nodes[step.node];
  const where = step.node.includes('#') ? step.node : n?.path ?? step.node;
  return `${step.kind}: ${n?.label ?? step.node}${where !== n?.label ? ` (${where})` : ''}`;
}

/** Journeys for the repo's current facts and sources (deterministic; names are placeholders). */
export function journeysFor(repo: Repo): { journeys: Journey[]; graph: ContextGraph } {
  const facts: Record<string, FileFacts> = Object.fromEntries(repo.fileFacts);
  const sources = Object.values(facts).flatMap((f) => {
    const source = repo.current(f.path);
    return source === null ? [] : [{ path: f.path, source, symbols: f.symbols }];
  });
  const graph = buildGraph(repo.map, facts);
  return { journeys: computeJourneys(graph, facts, findFetchSites(sources), inferDispatch(sources, facts)), graph };
}

type Cache = { id: string; hash: string; steps: string[]; name: string };
type Confirmed = Record<string, { name: string; at: number }>;

export type JourneysOptions = { bus: Bus; repo: Repo; namer?: Namer | null };
export type Result = { ok: true; journey: Journey } | { ok: false; status: 404 | 409; error: string };

export function attachJourneys(opts: JourneysOptions) {
  const { bus, repo } = opts;
  const namer = opts.namer === undefined ? (process.env.HARNESS_JOURNEYS === '0' ? null : sdkNamer) : opts.namer;
  const dir = join(repo.root, '.harness', 'journeys');
  const confirmedPath = join(dir, 'confirmed.json');
  const work = new Set<Promise<unknown>>();
  const track = <T>(p: Promise<T>) => { work.add(p); const off = () => { work.delete(p); }; p.then(off, off); return p; };
  let naming = false;
  let again = false;
  let current: { journeys: Journey[]; graph: ContextGraph } | null = null;

  const readJson = <T>(p: string, fallback: T): T => { try { return existsSync(p) ? (JSON.parse(readFileSync(p, 'utf8')) as T) : fallback; } catch { return fallback; } };
  const cached = (hash: string) => readJson<Cache | null>(join(dir, `${hash}.json`), null);
  const confirmed = () => readJson<Confirmed>(confirmedPath, {});

  /** Confirmed names win (inferred: false); then cached model names; else the placeholder (both inferred). */
  function named(js: Journey[]): { journeys: Journey[]; unnamed: Journey[] } {
    const conf = confirmed();
    const unnamed: Journey[] = [];
    const journeys = js.map((j) => {
      const c = conf[j.id];
      if (c) return { ...j, name: c.name, inferred: false };
      const hit = cached(journeyHash(j));
      if (hit) return { ...j, name: hit.name, inferred: true };
      unnamed.push(j);
      return j;
    });
    return { journeys, unnamed };
  }

  const lastEmitted = () => JSON.stringify(reduce(bus.events).journeys);

  function publish(js: Journey[]) {
    if (JSON.stringify(js) !== lastEmitted()) bus.emit('journeys_updated', { journeys: js }, { turn: null });
  }

  /** Recompute, publish if anything changed, and name new journeys in the background. */
  function refresh(): Journey[] {
    if (!repo.map || !repo.hasMap()) return [];
    current = journeysFor(repo);
    const { journeys, unnamed } = named(current.journeys);
    publish(journeys);
    if (unnamed.length && namer) {
      if (naming) again = true;
      else track(name(unnamed));
    }
    return journeys;
  }

  async function name(list: Journey[]) {
    naming = true;
    const t0 = Date.now();
    const graph = current!.graph;
    try {
      const input = { root: repo.root, journeys: list.map((j) => ({ id: j.id, steps: j.steps.map((s) => describeStep(graph, s)) })) };
      const r = await namer!(input);
      mkdirSync(dir, { recursive: true });
      const byId = new Map(r.names.map((n) => [n.id, n.name.trim()]));
      for (const j of list) {
        const n = byId.get(j.id);
        if (!n) continue;
        const hash = journeyHash(j);
        writeFileSync(join(dir, `${hash}.json`), JSON.stringify({ id: j.id, hash, steps: j.steps.map((s) => s.node), name: n } satisfies Cache, null, 2));
      }
      bus.emit('maintenance_run', { agent: 'cartographer', trigger: 'journeys', ms: Date.now() - t0, cost: r.cost, ok: true }, { turn: null });
      if (current) publish(named(current.journeys).journeys);
    } catch (e) {
      bus.emit('maintenance_run', { agent: 'cartographer', trigger: 'journeys', ms: Date.now() - t0, cost: (e as { cost?: number }).cost ?? null, ok: false }, { turn: null });
      bus.emit('error', { message: `Journey naming failed: ${(e as Error).message}` }, { turn: null });
    } finally {
      naming = false;
      if (again) { again = false; schedule(); }
    }
  }

  /** Confirm a journey (optionally renaming it): it is no longer inferred. */
  function confirm(id: string, name?: string): Result {
    const js = reduce(bus.events).journeys;
    const j = js.find((x) => x.id === id);
    if (!j) return { ok: false, status: 404, error: `No journey ${id}.` };
    const text = (name ?? j.name).trim();
    if (!text) return { ok: false, status: 409, error: 'A journey name cannot be empty.' };
    mkdirSync(dir, { recursive: true });
    writeFileSync(confirmedPath, JSON.stringify({ ...confirmed(), [id]: { name: text, at: Date.now() } }, null, 2));
    const next = js.map((x) => (x.id === id ? { ...x, name: text, inferred: false } : x));
    publish(next);
    return { ok: true, journey: next.find((x) => x.id === id)! };
  }

  function schedule() {
    track(new Promise<void>((resolve) => setImmediate(() => {
      try { refresh(); }
      catch (e) { bus.emit('error', { message: `Journeys failed: ${(e as Error).message}` }, { turn: null }); }
      finally { resolve(); }
    })));
  }

  // After a scan (load, map accepted) and after every turn: recompute; emit only when the journeys changed.
  const off = bus.on((e) => { if (e.kind === 'repo_scanned' || e.kind === 'turn_ended') schedule(); });

  return {
    refresh() { schedule(); },
    confirm,
    /** Resolves once no recompute or naming job is in flight (for tests and shutdown). */
    async idle() { while (work.size) await Promise.allSettled([...work]); },
    detach: off,
  };
}

export type JourneysLoop = ReturnType<typeof attachJourneys>;

/** HTTP endpoints, mounted under /api by the server. */
export function journeyRoutes(j: JourneysLoop) {
  const r = new Hono();
  r.post('/journeys/:id/confirm', async (c) => {
    const body = await c.req.json<{ name?: string }>().catch(() => ({} as { name?: string }));
    const id = c.req.param('id');
    const res = j.confirm(id.startsWith('journey:') ? id : `journey:${id}`, body.name); // the bare slug works too
    return res.ok ? c.json(res) : c.json({ error: res.error }, res.status);
  });
  r.post('/journeys/refresh', (c) => { j.refresh(); return c.json({ ok: true }); });
  return r;
}

# Reference map for the Scout demo repo.
# Live, the cartographer proposes this on load and the user confirms it.
# This copy is the test fixture for packages/core and the fallback if the
# cartographer's proposal is off on stage.

version: 1

layers:
  - { id: ui,       name: UI }
  - { id: entry,    name: Entry }
  - { id: logic,    name: Logic }
  - { id: data,     name: Data }
  - { id: external, name: External }

# Paths that belong to no domain and never create cross-domain edges.
neutral: ["src/shared/**", "vendor/_calllog.ts", "web/src/shared/**"]
ignore: ["node_modules/**", ".git/**", ".harness/**", "fixtures/**", "scripts/**", "decisions/**", "*.json", "*.md", "*.config.ts", ".*", "domains.yaml", "web/dist/**", "web/public/**", "web/vite.config.ts", "web/tsconfig.json", ".scout/**"]

domains:
  - id: channels
    name: Channels
    purpose: Take requests from HTTP and the CLI
    cells:
      ui:    { paths: ["web/index.html", "web/src/main.tsx", "web/src/app/**"] }
      entry: { paths: ["src/channels/routes.ts", "src/channels/cli.ts"] }
      logic: { paths: ["src/channels/validate.ts"] }
    tests: ["test/channels/**"]

  - id: orchestrator
    name: Agent loop
    purpose: Plan each run and call tools in order
    cells:
      ui:    { paths: ["web/src/features/runs/**"] }
      logic: { paths: ["src/orchestrator/agent.ts", "src/orchestrator/planner.ts", "src/orchestrator/tool-registry.ts"] }
      data:  { paths: ["src/orchestrator/run-state.ts", "src/orchestrator/schema.sql"], tables: ["runs"] }
    tests: ["test/orchestrator/**"]

  - id: tools
    name: Research tools
    purpose: Look up companies, news and filings
    cells:
      ui:       { paths: ["web/src/features/tools/**"] }
      logic:    { paths: ["src/tools/**"] }
      external: { paths: ["vendor/search/**", "vendor/news/**", "vendor/sec-edgar/**", "vendor/enrichment/**"] }
    tests: ["test/tools/**"]

  - id: gateway
    name: Model gateway
    purpose: Every model call, with redaction and cost logging
    cells:
      ui:       { paths: ["web/src/features/usage/**"] }
      logic:    { paths: ["src/gateway/complete.ts", "src/gateway/embed.ts", "src/gateway/redact.ts", "src/gateway/providers.ts"] }
      data:     { paths: ["src/gateway/cost-ledger.ts", "src/gateway/schema.sql"], tables: ["cost_log"] }
      external: { paths: ["vendor/llm-openai/**", "vendor/llm-anthropic/**", "vendor/embeddings/**"] }
    tests: ["test/gateway/**"]

  - id: memory
    name: Memory
    purpose: Store and retrieve notes about each company
    cells:
      ui:    { paths: ["web/src/features/notes/**"] }
      logic: { paths: ["src/memory/retrieve.ts", "src/memory/vector-index.ts"] }
      data:  { paths: ["src/memory/notes-store.ts", "src/memory/schema.sql"], tables: ["notes", "embeddings"] }
    tests: ["test/memory/**"]

  - id: outreach
    name: Outreach
    purpose: Draft emails and keep the CRM in sync
    cells:
      ui:       { paths: ["web/src/features/outreach/**"] }
      logic:    { paths: ["src/outreach/draft-email.ts", "src/outreach/send.ts"] }
      data:     { paths: ["src/outreach/crm-sync.ts", "src/outreach/outreach-log.ts", "src/outreach/schema.sql"], tables: ["contacts", "outreach_log"] }
      external: { paths: ["vendor/crm/**", "vendor/email/**"] }
    tests: ["test/outreach/**"]

# Seeded by the cartographer on load (source: cartographer), confirmed by the user.
# Runtime decisions get the next free id (DR-4, DR-5, ...) and live in decisions/.
invariants:
  - id: DR-1
    rule: Model providers are only called through the model gateway
    kind: only_via
    targets: ["vendor/llm-*/**", "vendor/embeddings/**"]
    allowed_from: [gateway]
    exceptions: []
    source: cartographer

  - id: DR-2
    rule: Each table is written only by the domain that owns it
    kind: owns_writes
    owners: { runs: orchestrator, cost_log: gateway, notes: memory, embeddings: memory, contacts: outreach, outreach_log: outreach }
    exceptions: []
    source: cartographer

  - id: DR-3
    rule: Research tools never depend on outreach
    kind: no_edge
    from: tools
    to: outreach
    exceptions: []
    source: cartographer

# Scout's HTTP routes are a table of [method, /regex/, handler] entries (see schema.ts for pattern semantics).
cartography:
  routes:
    - { file: "src/channels/routes.ts", pattern: '\[\s*"(?<method>[A-Z]+)",\s*/\^(?<path>(?:\\.|[^$])*)\$/' }

```text
import { useEffect, useState, type ReactNode } from 'react';
import { provenance, type DomainMap, type ImportEdge, type Invariant, type Violation } from '@harness/core/view';
import { api } from '../connection';
import { turnViolations, useView, type View } from '../derive';
import { edgeSegments, globRe, invariantsFor } from '../layout';
import { useStore, type Selection } from '../store';
import { useV2 } from '../v2/store';

export function Inspector() {
  const selection = useStore((s) => s.selection);
  const select = useStore((s) => s.select);
  const v = useView();
  const [file, setFile] = useState<string | null>(null);

  useEffect(() => setFile(null), [selection]);
  useEffect(() => {
    const onKey = (e: KeyboardEvent) => {
      if (e.key === 'Escape') select(null);
    };
    addEventListener('keydown', onKey);
    return () => removeEventListener('keydown', onKey);
  }, [select]);

  if (!selection || !v.ui.map) return null;
  return (
    <aside className="inspector" aria-label="Inspector" onClick={(e) => e.stopPropagation()}>
      <button className="inspector-close" aria-label="Close inspector" onClick={() => select(null)}>×</button>
      {file ? (
        <FilePreview path={file} onBack={() => setFile(null)} />
      ) : (
        <Body v={v} sel={selection} map={v.ui.map} openFile={setFile} />
      )}
    </aside>
  );
}

function Body({ v, sel, map, openFile }: { v: View; sel: Selection; map: DomainMap; openFile: (p: string) => void }) {
  if ('unassigned' in sel) {
    const files = [...new Set([...v.unassigned, ...(v.turn?.unassigned ?? [])])].sort();
    return (
      <>
        <h2 className="insp-title">Unassigned</h2>
        <p className="insp-sub">Files that match no cell in domains.yaml. Add their paths to a domain to place them.</p>
        <Section title="Files"><FileList files={files} openFile={openFile} /></Section>
      </>
    );
  }
  if ('cell' in sel) return <CellBody v={v} k={sel.cell} map={map} openFile={openFile} />;
  if ('file' in sel) return <FileBody v={v} path={sel.file} map={map} openFile={openFile} />;
  if ('node' in sel) return <NodeBody v={v} id={sel.node} map={map} openFile={openFile} />;
  if ('link' in sel) return <LinkBody v={v} id={sel.link} map={map} openFile={openFile} />;
  return <EdgeBody v={v} edge={sel.edge} pair={sel.pair} map={map} openFile={openFile} />;
}

function CellBody({ v, k, map, openFile }: { v: View; k: string; map: DomainMap; openFile: (p: string) => void }) {
  const [domainId, layerId] = k.split('/') as [string, string];
  const domain = map.domains.find((d) => d.id === domainId);
  const layer = map.layers.find((l) => l.id === layerId);
  const cell = domain?.cells[layerId];
  const view = v.cells[k];
  const files = v.cellFiles[k] ?? [];
  const edited = v.turn?.edited[k];
  const planned = v.turn?.planned[k];
  const plannedNew = (planned?.files ?? []).filter((f) => !files.includes(f));
  const tests = v.testFiles[domainId] ?? [];
  const invs = invariantsFor(map, domainId, files);
  const vios = turnViolations(v).filter(({ v: x }) => cellOfFile(v, x.file) === k);
  const prov = provenance(v.ui, { cell: k });

  const state: string[] = [];
  if (view?.edited) state.push(view.unplanned ? 'Edited without being planned' : 'Edited this turn');
  if (view?.ghost) state.push(`Planned in ${stepList(view.ghost)}`);
  if (view?.looked && !view.edited) state.push('Looked at this turn');

  return (
    <>
      <h2 className="insp-title">{domain?.name ?? domainId} <span className="insp-layer">{layer?.name ?? layerId}</span></h2>
      {domain && <p className="insp-sub">{domain.purpose}</p>}
      {state.length > 0 && <p className={`insp-state ${view?.unplanned ? 'is-amber' : ''}`}>{state.join('. ')}{edited ? `: +${edited.added} −${edited.removed}` : ''}</p>}

      {vios.length > 0 && (
        <Section title="Rules crossed">
          {vios.map(({ v: x, source }, i) => <ViolationItem key={i} v={x} source={source} />)}
        </Section>
      )}

      <Section title={`Files (${files.length})`}>
        <FileList files={files} openFile={openFile} marks={(f) => (edited?.created.includes(f) ? 'created' : edited?.files.includes(f) ? 'edited' : null)} />
        {plannedNew.length > 0 && (
          <p className="insp-note">Planned, not created yet: {plannedNew.map((f) => <code key={f}>{f}</code>)}</p>
        )}
      </Section>

      {(cell?.paths?.length || cell?.tables?.length) && (
        <Section title="Defined by">
          {cell?.paths?.map((p) => <code key={p} className="insp-glob">{p}</code>)}
          {cell?.tables?.length ? <p className="insp-note">Owns tables {cell.tables.map((t) => <code key={t}>{t}</code>)}</p> : null}
        </Section>
      )}

      {invs.length > 0 && <Section title="Rules for this domain">{invs.map((i) => <InvariantItem key={i.id} inv={i} />)}</Section>}

      {tests.length > 0 && (
        <Section title={`Tests for ${domain?.name ?? domainId}`}><FileList files={tests} openFile={openFile} /></Section>
      )}

      <Provenance prov={prov} />
    </>
  );
}

/** What the inspector shows for an edge, from v1's cell-pair segments or a v2 projected edge. */
type EdgeDetail = {
  from: string; // domain ids
  to: string;
  where: string; // "Logic to External"
  state: 'existing' | 'new' | 'ghost';
  gate: boolean; // a ghost the edit gate blocked (never planned)
  decision?: { id: string; session: number } | null; // a ghost a standing decision rules out
  violation: boolean;
  steps: number[];
  files: ImportEdge[];
};

function EdgeBody({ v, edge, pair, map, openFile }: { v: View; edge: string; pair: string; map: DomainMap; openFile: (p: string) => void }) {
  const seg = edgeSegments(v.ui, v.turn, v.edges).find((s) => s.edgeKey === edge && s.pair === pair);
  const [from, to] = edge.split('->') as [string, string];
  const [srcCell, dstCell] = pair.split('=>') as [string, string];
  const layerName = (k: string) => map.layers.find((l) => l.id === k.split('/')[1])?.name ?? '';
  const d: EdgeDetail = {
    from, to, where: `${layerName(srcCell)} to ${layerName(dstCell)}`, state: seg?.state ?? 'existing', gate: false,
    violation: !!seg?.violation, steps: seg?.steps ?? [], files: seg?.files ?? [],
  };
  return <EdgeView v={v} d={d} map={map} openFile={openFile} />;
}

/** A v2 edge: the projected edge's leaf edges (imports, calls, writes; planned or gate-blocked imports for ghosts). */
function LinkBody({ v, id, map, openFile }: { v: View; id: string; map: DomainMap; openFile: (p: string) => void }) {
  const e = useV2((s) => s.edges[id]);
  const nodes = useV2((s) => s.nodes);
  if (!e) return <p className="insp-note">This link is not on the map at this point of the log.</p>;
  const a = nodes[e.from];
  const b = nodes[e.to];
  const files: ImportEdge[] = [];
  for (const leaf of e.leafEdges) {
    const [, f, t] = leaf.split('|') as [string, string, string];
    if (!files.some((x) => x.from === f && x.to === t)) files.push({ from: f, to: t });
  }
  const d: EdgeDetail = {
    from: a?.domain ?? e.from, to: b?.domain ?? e.to, where: `${a?.label ?? e.from} to ${b?.label ?? e.to}`,
    state: e.status, gate: e.leafEdges.every((l) => l.startsWith('gate|')), violation: e.violation !== null, steps: e.steps, files, decision: e.decision ?? null,
  };
  return <EdgeView v={v} d={d} map={map} openFile={openFile} kinds={e.kinds} />;
}

function EdgeView({ v, d, map, openFile, kinds }: { v: View; d: EdgeDetail; map: DomainMap; openFile: (p: string) => void; kinds?: string[] }) {
  const { from, to, files } = d;
  const name = (id: string) => map.domains.find((x) => x.id === id)?.name ?? id;
  const vios = turnViolations(v).filter(({ v: x }) => files.some((f) => f.from === x.file && (!x.target || x.target === f.to)));
  const invs = map.invariants.filter(
    (i) => (i.kind === 'no_edge' && i.from === from && i.to === to) || (i.kind === 'only_via' && files.some((f) => i.targets.some((t) => globRe(t).test(f.to)))),
  );
  const prov = provenance(v.ui, { edge: `${from}->${to}` });
  const dec = d.decision && v.ui.decisions.find((x) => x.id === d.decision!.id);
  const state = d.decision
    ? `Rejected in ${d.decision.id}${d.decision.session ? `, session ${d.decision.session}` : ''}${dec ? `: ${dec.title}` : ''}. Not built.`
    : d.state === 'ghost'
    ? d.gate ? 'Blocked at edit: the import was never written' : `Planned in ${stepList(d.steps)}, not built yet`
    : d.state === 'new' ? `Added in turn ${v.turnIndex}` : 'On the map before this turn';
  const imports = !kinds || kinds.every((k) => k === 'imports');
  return (
    <>
      <h2 className="insp-title">{name(from)} <span className="insp-arrow">→</span> {name(to)}</h2>
      <p className="insp-sub">{d.where}. Derived from {imports ? 'imports' : kinds!.join(', ')}; flow down a column is not drawn.</p>
      <p className={`insp-state ${d.decision ? 'is-decided' : d.violation ? 'is-red' : ''}`}>{state}</p>
      {vios.length > 0 && <Section title="Rules crossed">{vios.map(({ v: x, source }, i) => <ViolationItem key={i} v={x} source={source} />)}</Section>}
      <Section title={`${imports ? 'Imports' : 'Links'} (${files.length})`}>
        <ul className="insp-imports">
          {files.map((f, i) => (
            <li key={i}>
              <button className="link" onClick={() => openFile(f.from.split('#')[0]!)}>{f.from}</button>
              <span className="insp-arrow">→</span>
              <button className="link" onClick={() => openFile(f.to.split('#')[0]!)}>{f.to}</button>
            </li>
          ))}
        </ul>
      </Section>
      {invs.length > 0 && <Section title="Rules on this dependency">{invs.map((i) => <InvariantItem key={i.id} inv={i} />)}</Section>}
      <Provenance prov={prov} scope={`${name(from)} → ${name(to)}`} />
    </>
  );
}

/** One file (v2): where it sits, what the turn did to it, the rules it crosses, its imports and its code. */
function FileBody({ v, path, map, openFile }: { v: View; path: string; map: DomainMap; openFile: (p: string) => void }) {
  const node = useV2((s) => s.nodes[path]);
  const p = v.ui.files[path];
  const pa = v.turn?.paths[path];
  const r = node?.rollup;
  const domain = p && 'domain' in p ? map.domains.find((d) => d.id === p.domain) : undefined;
  const layer = p?.kind === 'cell' ? map.layers.find((l) => l.id === p.layer) : undefined;
  const vios = turnViolations(v).filter(({ v: x }) => x.file === path);
  const out = (v.ui.facts[path]?.imports.map((i) => i.to) ?? []).filter((x) => !x.startsWith('vendor:'));
  const into = Object.values(v.ui.facts).filter((f) => f.imports.some((i) => i.to === path)).map((f) => f.path).sort();
  const sym = pa?.symbols;
  const changed: [string, string][] = sym
    ? [...sym.added.map((s) => ['added', s] as [string, string]), ...sym.sig.map((s) => ['signature', s] as [string, string]), ...sym.body.map((s) => ['body', s] as [string, string]), ...sym.removed.map((s) => ['removed', s] as [string, string])]
    : [];
  const edited = !!(r?.edited || pa?.edits);
  const state: string[] = [];
  if (edited) state.push(r?.unplanned ? 'Edited without being planned' : pa?.created ? 'Created this turn' : 'Edited this turn');
  if (r?.ghostSteps.length) state.push(`Planned in ${stepList(r.ghostSteps)}${r.plannedNew ? ', not created yet' : ''}`);
  if ((r?.looked || pa?.looked) && !edited) state.push('Looked at this turn');
  const prov = p?.kind === 'cell' ? provenance(v.ui, { cell: `${p.domain}/${p.layer}` }) : null;
  return (
    <>
      <h2 className="insp-title insp-path">{path}</h2>
      <p className="insp-sub">{domain ? `${domain.name}${layer ? `, ${layer.name}` : ' tests'}` : p?.kind === 'neutral' ? 'Shared code' : 'Unassigned'}</p>
      {state.length > 0 && <p className={`insp-state ${r?.unplanned ? 'is-amber' : ''}`}>{state.join('. ')}{pa?.edits ? `: +${pa.added} −${pa.removed}` : ''}</p>}
      <button className="btn insp-open" onClick={() => openFile(path)}>Show code</button>
      {vios.length > 0 && <Section title="Rules crossed">{vios.map(({ v: x, source }, i) => <ViolationItem key={i} v={x} source={source} />)}</Section>}
      {changed.length > 0 && (
        <Section title={`Symbols changed (${changed.length})`}>
          <ul className="insp-files">{changed.map(([k, id]) => <li key={`${k}${id}`}><code>{id.slice(id.indexOf('#') + 1)}</code> <span className="insp-mark">{k}</span></li>)}</ul>
        </Section>
      )}
      <Section title={`Imports (${out.length})`}><FileList files={out} openFile={openFile} /></Section>
      <Section title={`Imported by (${into.length})`}><FileList files={into} openFile={openFile} /></Section>
      {prov && <Provenance prov={prov} />}
    </>
  );
}

/** A domain, a folder, or a domain's tests (v2). */
function NodeBody({ v, id, map, openFile }: { v: View; id: string; map: DomainMap; openFile: (p: string) => void }) {
  const node = useV2((s) => s.nodes[id]);
  const domain = map.domains.find((d) => d.id === (node?.domain ?? id.replace(/^domain:/, '')));
  if (id.startsWith('domain:') && domain) {
    const files = Object.entries(v.ui.files).filter(([, p]) => p.kind === 'cell' && p.domain === domain.id).map(([f]) => f);
    const invs = invariantsFor(map, domain.id, files);
    const count = (layer: string) => files.filter((f) => { const p = v.ui.files[f]; return p?.kind === 'cell' && p.layer === layer; }).length;
    return (
      <>
        <h2 className="insp-title">{domain.name}</h2>
        <p className="insp-sub">{domain.purpose}</p>
        <Section title="Cells">
          <ul className="insp-files">
            {map.layers.filter((l) => l.id in domain.cells).map((l) => <li key={l.id}>{l.name} <span className="insp-note">{count(l.id)} files</span></li>)}
          </ul>
        </Section>
        {invs.length > 0 && <Section title="Rules for this domain">{invs.map((i) => <InvariantItem key={i.id} inv={i} />)}</Section>}
      </>
    );
  }
  const columns = useV2((s) => s.columns[id]);
  if (node?.kind === 'table') {
    return (
      <>
        <h2 className="insp-title">{node.label} <span className="insp-layer">table</span></h2>
        {domain && <p className="insp-sub">Owned by {domain.name}</p>}
        <Section title={`Columns (${columns?.length ?? 0})`}>
          {columns?.length ? <ul className="insp-files">{columns.map((c) => <li key={c}><code>{c}</code></li>)}</ul> : <p className="insp-note">No schema file defines it.</p>}
        </Section>
      </>
    );
  }
  const prefix = node?.path ? `${node.path}/` : null;
  const files = prefix
    ? Object.keys(v.ui.files).filter((f) => f.startsWith(prefix)).sort()
    : node?.kind === 'tests' && domain ? Object.entries(v.ui.files).filter(([, p]) => p.kind === 'test' && p.domain === domain.id).map(([f]) => f).sort() : [];
  return (
    <>
      <h2 className="insp-title">{node?.label ?? id}</h2>
      {domain && <p className="insp-sub">{domain.name}</p>}
      <Section title={`Files (${files.length})`}><FileList files={files} openFile={openFile} /></Section>
    </>
  );
}

function cellOfFile(v: View, file: string): string | null {
  const p = v.ui.files[file];
  if (p?.kind === 'cell') return `${p.domain}/${p.layer}`;
  const planned = v.turn && Object.entries(v.turn.planned).find(([, c]) => c.files.includes(file));
  return planned ? planned[0] : null;
}

function Section({ title, children }: { title: string; children: ReactNode }) {
  return (
    <section className="insp-section">
      <h3>{title}</h3>
      {children}
    </section>
  );
}

function FileList({ files, openFile, marks }: { files: string[]; openFile: (p: string) => void; marks?: (f: string) => string | null }) {
  if (!files.length) return <p className="insp-note">None.</p>;
  return (
    <ul className="insp-files">
      {files.map((f) => {
        const m = marks?.(f);
        return (
          <li key={f}>
            <button className="link" onClick={() => openFile(f)}>{f}</button>
            {m && <span className={`insp-mark mark-${m}`}>{m}</span>}
          </li>
        );
      })}
    </ul>
  );
}

function ViolationItem({ v, source }: { v: Violation; source: 'load' | 'plan' | 'gate' }) {
  const where = source === 'load' ? 'Found on load' : source === 'plan' ? 'In this turn’s plan' : 'Blocked at edit';
  return (
    <div className={`insp-violation ${source === 'load' ? '' : 'is-new'}`}>
      <p className="insp-vio-head"><strong>{v.invariant}</strong> {where}</p>
      <p>{v.reason}</p>
      <code className="insp-glob">{v.detail}</code>
    </div>
  );
}

function InvariantItem({ inv }: { inv: Invariant }) {
  return (
    <div className="insp-inv">
      <p><strong>{inv.id}</strong> {inv.rule}</p>
      {(inv.decisions?.length || inv.exceptions.length) ? (
        <p className="insp-note">
          {inv.decisions?.length ? <>Confirmed by {inv.decisions.join(', ')}. </> : null}
          {inv.exceptions.length ? <>Exceptions: {inv.exceptions.map((e) => <code key={e.path}>{e.path}{e.decision ? ` (${e.decision})` : ''}</code>)}</> : null}
        </p>
      ) : null}
    </div>
  );
}

function Provenance({ prov, scope }: { prov: ReturnType<typeof provenance>; scope?: string }) {
  if (!prov.turns.length && !prov.decisions.length) {
    return <Section title="History"><p className="insp-note">No changes this session.</p></Section>;
  }
  return (
    <Section title="History">
      <ul className="insp-prov">
        {prov.turns.map((t) => {
          const decs = prov.decisions.filter((d) => d.turn === t.id);
          return (
            <li key={t.id}>
              <span>{scope ? `${scope} changed in turn ${t.index}` : `Changed in turn ${t.index}`}{decs.length ? `, under ${decs.map((d) => d.id).join(', ')}` : ''}</span>
              <span className="insp-prov-prompt">{t.prompt}</span>
              {decs.map((d) => (
                <span key={d.id} className="insp-prov-dec">
                  <strong>{d.id}</strong> {d.title}{d.alike ? ' · in Alike' : ''}
                </span>
              ))}
            </li>
          );
        })}
      </ul>
    </Section>
  );
}

function FilePreview({ path, onBack }: { path: string; onBack: () => void }) {
  const [text, setText] = useState<string | null | undefined>(undefined);
  useEffect(() => {
    let live = true;
    setText(undefined);
    api.file(path).then((t) => live && setText(t)).catch(() => live && setText(null));
    return () => {
      live = false;
    };
  }, [path]);
  return (
    <>
      <button className="link insp-back" onClick={onBack}>Back</button>
      <h2 className="insp-title insp-path">{path}</h2>
      {text === undefined && <p className="insp-note">Loading…</p>}
      {text === null && <p className="insp-note">Not on disk. It may be planned but not created yet.</p>}
      {typeof text === 'string' && (
        <pre className="insp-code">
          {text.split('\n').map((l, i) => (
            <span key={i} className="code-line"><span className="code-no">{i + 1}</span>{l || ' '}{'\n'}</span>
          ))}
        </pre>
      )}
    </>
  );
}

const stepList = (steps: number[]) =>
  steps.length === 1 ? `step ${steps[0]}` : `steps ${steps.slice(0, -1).join(', ')} and ${steps[steps.length - 1]}`;
```

```text
// ⌘K: find a domain, cell, group, file, symbol, route, decision or turn. Jumping opens the containers on the way,
// focuses and selects the target, and flies the camera there.
import { useEffect, useMemo, useRef, useState } from 'react';
import { fileOf, type ContextGraph, type UIState } from '@harness/core/view';
import { useView } from '../derive';
import { useStore } from '../store';
import { jump } from './nav';
import { useScene } from './pipeline';
import { selectionFor } from './select';
import { useV2 } from './store';

type Item = { key: string; kind: string; label: string; sub: string; hay: string; rank: number; run: () => void };

const RANK: Record<string, number> = { domain: 0, cell: 1, group: 2, file: 3, route: 4, symbol: 5, decision: 6, turn: 7 };
const KIND_LABEL: Record<string, string> = { domain: 'Domain', cell: 'Cell', group: 'Folder', file: 'File', route: 'Route', symbol: 'Symbol', decision: 'Decision', turn: 'Turn' };

function isMember(g: ContextGraph, id: string) {
  const n = g.nodes[id]!;
  const p = n.parent ? g.nodes[n.parent] : undefined;
  return (n.symbol?.kind === 'property' || n.symbol?.kind === 'method') && p?.symbol?.kind === 'type';
}

function itemsOf(graph: ContextGraph, ui: UIState, go: (id: string) => void, setTurn: (id: string | null) => void): Item[] {
  const out: Item[] = [];
  const domainName = (d?: string) => (d && graph.nodes[`domain:${d}`]?.label) || d || '';
  for (const n of Object.values(graph.nodes)) {
    let kind: string = n.kind;
    let sub = '';
    if (n.kind === 'domain') sub = 'Domain';
    else if (n.kind === 'cell') sub = `${domainName(n.domain)} cell`;
    else if (n.kind === 'group') sub = `${domainName(n.domain)} · ${n.path ?? ''}`;
    else if (n.kind === 'file') sub = n.path ?? n.id;
    else if (n.kind === 'route') sub = fileOf(n.parent ?? '') ?? '';
    else if (n.kind === 'symbol') { if (isMember(graph, n.id)) continue; sub = fileOf(n.id) ?? ''; }
    else continue;
    const label = n.kind === 'cell' ? `${domainName(n.domain)} · ${n.label}` : n.kind === 'symbol' ? n.id.slice(n.id.indexOf('#') + 1) : n.label;
    if (n.kind === 'group' && n.id === 'group:vendors') continue;
    kind = n.kind;
    out.push({ key: n.id, kind, label, sub, hay: `${label} ${sub}`.toLowerCase(), rank: RANK[kind] ?? 9, run: () => go(n.id) });
  }
  for (const d of ui.decisions) {
    const target = d.paths.find((p) => graph.nodes[p]);
    out.push({ key: `dec:${d.id}`, kind: 'decision', label: `${d.id} ${d.title}`, sub: d.paths.join(', ') || d.invariant, hay: `${d.id} ${d.title} ${d.invariant} ${d.paths.join(' ')}`.toLowerCase(), rank: RANK.decision!, run: () => (target ? go(target) : undefined) });
  }
  ui.turns.forEach((t, i) => {
    out.push({ key: `turn:${t.id}`, kind: 'turn', label: `Turn ${i + 1}`, sub: t.prompt, hay: `turn ${i + 1} ${t.prompt}`.toLowerCase(), rank: RANK.turn!, run: () => setTurn(i === ui.turns.length - 1 ? null : t.id) });
  });
  return out;
}

function search(items: Item[], q: string): Item[] {
  const terms = q.toLowerCase().split(/\s+/).filter(Boolean);
  if (!terms.length) return items.filter((i) => i.kind === 'domain' || i.kind === 'turn' || i.kind === 'decision').sort((a, b) => a.rank - b.rank);
  const scored: { i: Item; s: number }[] = [];
  for (const i of items) {
    if (!terms.every((t) => i.hay.includes(t))) continue;
    const l = i.label.toLowerCase();
    const s = (l === terms[0] ? 0 : l.startsWith(terms[0]!) ? 10 : l.includes(terms[0]!) ? 20 : 40) + i.rank * 2 + Math.min(20, l.length / 4);
    scored.push({ i, s });
  }
  return scored.sort((a, b) => a.s - b.s || a.i.label.localeCompare(b.i.label)).slice(0, 40).map((x) => x.i);
}

export function Palette() {
  const open = useV2((s) => s.palette);
  if (!open) return null;
  return <PaletteBody />;
}

function PaletteBody() {
  const scene = useScene();
  const ui = useView().ui;
  const select = useStore((s) => s.select);
  const setTurn = useStore((s) => s.setTurn);
  const [q, setQ] = useState('');
  const [at, setAt] = useState(0);
  const input = useRef<HTMLInputElement>(null);
  const close = () => useV2.getState().setPalette(false);

  const items = useMemo(() => {
    if (!scene) return [];
    const go = (id: string) => {
      const st = useV2.getState();
      const next = jump(scene.graph, { open: st.open, focus: st.focus }, id);
      st.go(next, next.focus);
      const n = next.focus ? scene.graph.nodes[next.focus] : undefined;
      if (n) select(selectionFor(n));
    };
    return itemsOf(scene.graph, ui, go, setTurn);
  }, [scene, ui, select, setTurn]);
  const results = useMemo(() => search(items, q), [items, q]);

  useEffect(() => { input.current?.focus(); }, []);
  useEffect(() => setAt(0), [q]);

  const choose = (i: Item | undefined) => {
    if (!i) return;
    close();
    i.run();
  };

  return (
    <div className="v2-palette-scrim" onMouseDown={close}>
      <div className="v2-palette" role="dialog" aria-label="Find on the map" onMouseDown={(e) => e.stopPropagation()}>
        <input
          ref={input}
          className="v2-palette-input"
          value={q}
          placeholder="Find a domain, file, symbol, route, decision or turn"
          aria-label="Search the map"
          onChange={(e) => setQ(e.target.value)}
          onKeyDown={(e) => {
            if (e.key === 'Escape') { e.preventDefault(); close(); }
            else if (e.key === 'ArrowDown') { e.preventDefault(); setAt((a) => Math.min(results.length - 1, a + 1)); }
            else if (e.key === 'ArrowUp') { e.preventDefault(); setAt((a) => Math.max(0, a - 1)); }
            else if (e.key === 'Enter') { e.preventDefault(); choose(results[at]); }
          }}
        />
        <ul className="v2-palette-list" role="listbox">
          {results.length === 0 && <li className="v2-palette-none">Nothing matches “{q}”.</li>}
          {results.map((r, i) => (
            <li key={r.key} role="option" aria-selected={i === at} className={i === at ? 'is-active' : ''} onMouseEnter={() => setAt(i)} onClick={() => choose(r)}>
              <span className={`v2-palette-kind k-${r.kind}`}>{KIND_LABEL[r.kind] ?? r.kind}</span>
              <span className="v2-palette-label">{r.label}</span>
              <span className="v2-palette-sub">{r.sub}</span>
            </li>
          ))}
        </ul>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}
// Where you are and how to move: back/forward (⌘[ ⌘]), breadcrumbs (System › Domain › Cell › Group › File),
// the ⌘K search and the minimap toggle.
import { useStore } from '../store';
import { ancestors, jump } from './nav';
import { useScene } from './pipeline';
import { useV2 } from './store';

const CRUMB = new Set(['domain', 'cell', 'group', 'file', 'unassigned']);
const mac = typeof navigator !== 'undefined' && /Mac|iPhone|iPad/.test(navigator.platform);
const mod = mac ? '⌘' : 'Ctrl+';

export function NavBar() {
  const scene = useScene();
  const open = useV2((s) => s.open);
  const focus = useV2((s) => s.focus);
  const back = useV2((s) => s.back.length);
  const forward = useV2((s) => s.forward.length);
  const minimap = useV2((s) => s.minimap);
  const st = useV2.getState();
  const select = useStore((s) => s.select);
  const graph = scene?.graph;

  const at = focus && graph?.nodes[focus] ? focus : scene?.open.at(-1) ?? null;
  const path = graph && at ? ancestors(graph, at).filter((id) => CRUMB.has(graph.nodes[id]!.kind)) : [];
  const goTo = (id: string | null) => {
    if (!graph) return;
    select(null);
    if (!id) return st.go({ open: [], focus: null });
    const next = jump(graph, { open, focus }, id);
    st.go(next, next.focus);
  };

  return (
    <nav className="v2-nav" aria-label="Map navigation">
      <span className="v2-nav-hist">
        <button type="button" className="v2-nav-btn" disabled={!back} onClick={st.goBack} title={`Back (${mod}[)`} aria-label="Back">‹</button>
        <button type="button" className="v2-nav-btn" disabled={!forward} onClick={st.goForward} title={`Forward (${mod}])`} aria-label="Forward">›</button>
      </span>
      <ol className="v2-crumbs">
        <li>{path.length ? <button type="button" onClick={() => goTo(null)}>System</button> : <span aria-current="location">System</span>}</li>
        {path.map((id, i) => {
          const n = graph!.nodes[id]!;
          const last = i === path.length - 1;
          return (
            <li key={id}>
              {last ? <span aria-current="location">{n.label}</span> : <button type="button" onClick={() => goTo(id)}>{n.label}</button>}
            </li>
          );
        })}
      </ol>
      <span className="v2-nav-tools">
        <button type="button" className="v2-nav-search" onClick={() => st.setPalette(true)} title="Find a domain, cell, file, symbol, route, decision or turn">
          Find <kbd>{mod}K</kbd>
        </button>
        <button type="button" className={`v2-nav-btn ${minimap ? 'is-on' : ''}`} onClick={st.toggleMinimap} aria-pressed={minimap} title="Minimap (m)">
          <svg viewBox="0 0 16 16" width="16" height="16" aria-hidden="true"><rect x="1.5" y="3" width="13" height="10" rx="1.5" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth="1.3" /><rect x="8" y="7.5" width="5" height="4" fill="currentColor" /></svg>
        </button>
      </span>
    </nav>
  );
}

import type { ChatMessage } from "../shared/types";

/**
 * Replaces personal data with stable tokens before text leaves the process:
 * `jane@acme.com` -> `[EMAIL_1]`, `+1 (415) 555-0134` -> `[PHONE_1]`, and
 * known contact names -> `[NAME_1]`. The same value gets the same token within
 * one Redactor, so a model can still tell two people apart.
 */

export type RedactionKind = "EMAIL" | "PHONE" | "NAME";

const EMAIL_PATTERN = /[A-Za-z0-9._%+-]+@[A-Za-z0-9.-]+\.[A-Za-z]{2,}/g;

// Seven or more digits with the usual separators: +1 (415) 555-0134,
// 415.555.0134, 020 7946 0958.
const PHONE_PATTERN = /\+?\(?\d(?:[ .,()-]*\d){6,}/g;

const MIN_NAME_PART = 3;

function escapeRegExp(value: string): string {
  return value.replace(/[.*+?^${}()|[\]\\]/g, "\\$&");
}

/** Full names first, then each capitalized part, longest first so "Ann" never eats "Anne". */
function namePattern(names: string[]): RegExp | null {
  const variants = new Set<string>();
  for (const raw of names) {
    const name = raw.trim().replace(/\s+/g, " ");
    if (!name) continue;
    variants.add(name);
    for (const part of name.split(" ")) {
      if (part.length >= MIN_NAME_PART && /^[A-Z]/.test(part)) variants.add(part);
    }
  }
  if (variants.size === 0) return null;
  const alternatives = [...variants].sort((a, b) => b.length - a.length).map(escapeRegExp);
  return new RegExp(`\\b(?:${alternatives.join("|")})\\b`, "g");
}

export class Redactor {
  private readonly tokens = new Map<string, string>();
  private readonly counters: Record<RedactionKind, number> = { EMAIL: 0, PHONE: 0, NAME: 0 };
  private readonly names: RegExp | null;
  private replaced = 0;

  constructor(knownNames: string[] = []) {
    this.names = namePattern(knownNames);
  }

  /** Number of replacements made so far. */
  get count(): number {
    return this.replaced;
  }

  redact(text: string): string {
    let out = text.replace(EMAIL_PATTERN, (m) => this.token("EMAIL", m));
    out = out.replace(PHONE_PATTERN, (m) => this.token("PHONE", m));
    if (this.names) out = out.replace(this.names, (m) => this.token("NAME", m));
    return out;
  }

  private token(kind: RedactionKind, value: string): string {
    this.replaced++;
    const key = `${kind}:${value.toLowerCase()}`;
    let token = this.tokens.get(key);
    if (!token) {
      token = `[${kind}_${++this.counters[kind]}]`;
      this.tokens.set(key, token);
    }
    return token;
  }
}

export function redactText(text: string, knownNames: string[] = []): string {
  return new Redactor(knownNames).redact(text);
}

/** Redacts every message with one Redactor, so tokens stay consistent across the conversation. */
export function redactMessages(messages: ChatMessage[], knownNames: string[] = []): { messages: ChatMessage[]; count: number } {
  const redactor = new Redactor(knownNames);
  const redacted = messages.map((m) => ({ ...m, content: redactor.redact(m.content) }));
  return { messages: redacted, count: redactor.count };
}

import { db } from "../shared/db";
import type { ChatMessage, ContactRow } from "../shared/types";
import { recordCost } from "./cost-ledger";
import { getProvider } from "./providers";
import { redactMessages } from "./redact";

export type Purpose = "plan" | "profile" | "summary" | "brief" | "email";

export const PURPOSES: readonly Purpose[] = ["plan", "profile", "summary", "brief", "email"];

/** Short, routine tasks think less; the brief is the one place depth pays off. */
const EFFORT: Record<Purpose, "low" | "medium"> = {
  plan: "low",
  profile: "low",
  summary: "low",
  brief: "medium",
  email: "low",
};

export interface CompleteRequest {
  purpose: Purpose;
  messages: ChatMessage[];
  runId?: string;
  maxTokens?: number;
}

export interface Completion {
  text: string;
  provider: string;
  model: string;
  redactions: number;
  truncated: boolean;
  costId: string;
}

export class GatewayError extends Error {
  constructor(message: string) {
    super(message);
    this.name = "GatewayError";
  }
}

// Tells the model what the redaction tokens are, so it doesn't treat them as missing data.
const PLACEHOLDER_NOTE =
  "Personal details in this conversation are replaced with placeholders such as [NAME_1], [EMAIL_1] and [PHONE_1]. They stand for real values: use them as written and don't comment on them.";

/** Names of everyone in `contacts`; these are redacted along with emails and phone numbers. */
async function knownContactNames(): Promise<string[]> {
  const rows = await db.query<Pick<ContactRow, "name">>("select name from contacts where name <> ''");
  return rows.map((c) => c.name);
}

/**
 * The one way to call a language model: redacts personal data, sends to the
 * configured provider and records the cost.
 */
export async function complete(request: CompleteRequest): Promise<Completion> {
  if (!PURPOSES.includes(request.purpose)) {
    throw new GatewayError(`unknown purpose "${request.purpose}"; expected one of ${PURPOSES.join(", ")}`);
  }
  if (request.messages.length === 0) throw new GatewayError("messages must not be empty");

  const redacted = redactMessages(request.messages, await knownContactNames());
  const { count } = redacted;
  const messages = count > 0 ? [{ role: "system" as const, content: PLACEHOLDER_NOTE }, ...redacted.messages] : redacted.messages;
  const provider = getProvider();
  const reply = await provider.chat(messages, { maxTokens: request.maxTokens, effort: EFFORT[request.purpose] });

  const cost = await recordCost({
    runId: request.runId,
    purpose: request.purpose,
    provider: reply.provider,
    model: reply.model,
    inputChars: messages.reduce((n, m) => n + m.content.length, 0),
    outputChars: reply.text.length,
  });

  return {
    text: reply.text,
    provider: reply.provider,
    model: reply.model,
    redactions: count,
    truncated: reply.truncated,
    costId: cost.id,
  };
}

/** complete(), parsing the first JSON object in the reply. Returns `fallback` if there isn't a valid one. */
export async function completeJson<T>(request: CompleteRequest, fallback: T): Promise<{ value: T; completion: Completion }> {
  const completion = await complete(request);
  const match = /\{[\s\S]*\}/.exec(completion.text);
  if (!match) return { value: fallback, completion };
  try {
    return { value: JSON.parse(match[0]) as T, completion };
  } catch {
    return { value: fallback, completion };
  }
}
```

// Read-only graph queries for the agent (NAVIGATION_PLAN §3.4): `graph_neighbors`, `trace`, `symbols_in`. They answer
// from the same ContextGraph the user sees (Tier 1 + current Tier 2), deterministically and without a model call.
import { MAX_TRACE_PATHS, fileOf, trace, type ContextGraph, type DomainMap, type EdgeKind, type FileFacts, type GraphEdge } from '@harness/core';

export const MAX_LINES = 80;

type Index = { out: Map<string, GraphEdge[]>; in: Map<string, GraphEdge[]> };
const indexes = new WeakMap<ContextGraph, Index>();
function indexOf(g: ContextGraph): Index {
  let ix = indexes.get(g);
  if (ix) return ix;
  ix = { out: new Map(), in: new Map() };
  for (const e of g.edges) {
    (ix.out.get(e.from) ?? ix.out.set(e.from, []).get(e.from)!).push(e);
    (ix.in.get(e.to) ?? ix.in.set(e.to, []).get(e.to)!).push(e);
  }
  indexes.set(g, ix);
  return ix;
}

/** The node itself and everything under it. */
function subtree(g: ContextGraph, id: string): string[] {
  const out: string[] = [];
  const walk = (n: string) => { out.push(n); for (const c of g.children[n] ?? []) walk(c); };
  walk(id);
  return out;
}

/** The container that places a node on the map: its cell, or Shared / Unassigned / Vendors / a domain's tests. */
function placeOf(g: ContextGraph, id: string): string | null {
  for (let n: string | null = id; n; n = g.nodes[n]?.parent ?? null) {
    const k = g.nodes[n]?.kind;
    if (k === 'cell' || k === 'neutral' || k === 'unassigned' || k === 'tests' || (k === 'group' && g.nodes[n]!.parent === g.root)) return n;
  }
  return null;
}

function placeLabel(g: ContextGraph, map: DomainMap, id: string): string {
  const p = placeOf(g, id);
  const n = p ? g.nodes[p] : null;
  if (!n) return '';
  if (n.kind === 'cell' || n.kind === 'tests') {
    const d = map.domains.find((x) => x.id === n.domain)?.name ?? n.domain;
    return `${d} · ${n.label}`;
  }
  return n.label;
}

const describe = (e: GraphEdge) => {
  const bits: string[] = [];
  if (e.confidence) bits.push(e.confidence);
  if (e.typeOnly) bits.push('type-only');
  if (e.count > 1) bits.push(`×${e.count}`);
  return bits.length ? `${e.kind} (${bits.join(' ')})` : e.kind;
};

/**
 * A node id for user/agent input: an exact id, a repo path (`./x`, trailing `/`), `METHOD /path` for routes, a
 * package name for vendors, or a symbol name (`newsSummarize.run`, `#runAgent`) when it is unique.
 */
export function findNode(g: ContextGraph, input: string, rel: (p: string) => string | null = (p) => p): { id: string } | { error: string } {
  const raw = input.trim();
  const tries = [raw, raw.replace(/^\.\//, '').replace(/\/$/, ''), rel(raw) ?? '', `route:${raw}`, `vendor:${raw}`, `table:${raw}`];
  for (const t of tries) if (t && g.nodes[t]) return { id: t };
  const hash = raw.indexOf('#');
  if (hash > 0) {
    const file = rel(raw.slice(0, hash)) ?? raw.slice(0, hash);
    if (g.nodes[`${file}#${raw.slice(hash + 1)}`]) return { id: `${file}#${raw.slice(hash + 1)}` };
  }
  const name = raw.replace(/^#/, '');
  const hits = Object.keys(g.nodes).filter((id) => g.nodes[id]!.kind === 'symbol' && (id.endsWith(`#${name}`) || id.endsWith(`.${name}`)));
  if (hits.length === 1) return { id: hits[0]! };
  if (hits.length > 1) return { error: `"${input}" matches ${hits.length} symbols: ${hits.slice(0, 8).join(', ')}${hits.length > 8 ? ', …' : ''}. Use a full id (path#name).` };
  // A directory: its group node, if the map has one.
  const dir = raw.replace(/^\.\//, '').replace(/\/$/, '');
  const group = Object.keys(g.nodes).find((id) => g.nodes[id]!.kind === 'group' && g.nodes[id]!.path === dir);
  if (group) return { id: group };
  return { error: `No node "${input}". Use a repo path, path#symbol, a route like "POST /api/runs", vendor:<pkg>, domain:<id> or cell:<domain>/<layer>.` };
}

/** Leaf edges around a node (and everything under it), up to `hops` away, optionally only some edge kinds. */
export function neighborsText(g: ContextGraph, map: DomainMap, id: string, kinds?: readonly EdgeKind[], hops = 1): string {
  const ix = indexOf(g);
  const start = new Set(subtree(g, id));
  const ok = (e: GraphEdge) => !kinds?.length || kinds.includes(e.kind);
  const lines: string[] = [];
  const label = (n: string) => `${n}${placeLabel(g, map, n) ? `  [${placeLabel(g, map, n)}]` : ''}`;
  const out: string[] = [];
  const inc: string[] = [];
  for (const n of start) {
    for (const e of ix.out.get(n) ?? []) if (ok(e) && !start.has(e.to)) out.push(`  → ${describe(e)}  ${label(e.to)}${n === id ? '' : `  (from ${n})`}`);
    for (const e of ix.in.get(n) ?? []) if (ok(e) && !start.has(e.from)) inc.push(`  ← ${describe(e)}  ${label(e.from)}${n === id ? '' : `  (to ${n})`}`);
  }
  lines.push(`${label(id)}`);
  lines.push(`Outgoing (${out.length}):`, ...out.sort(), `Incoming (${inc.length}):`, ...inc.sort());

  if (hops > 1) {
    const seen = new Set(start);
    let frontier = [...start];
    for (let h = 1; h <= Math.min(hops, 3); h++) {
      const next: string[] = [];
      for (const n of frontier) {
        for (const e of [...(ix.out.get(n) ?? []), ...(ix.in.get(n) ?? [])]) {
          if (!ok(e)) continue;
          const other = e.from === n ? e.to : e.from;
          if (seen.has(other)) continue;
          seen.add(other);
          next.push(other);
        }
      }
      if (h > 1 && next.length) lines.push(`${h} hops (${next.length}):`, ...next.sort().map((n) => `  ${label(n)}`));
      frontier = next;
    }
  }
  return cap(lines);
}

const cap = (lines: string[]) => (lines.length > MAX_LINES ? [...lines.slice(0, MAX_LINES), `… ${lines.length - MAX_LINES} more lines`] : lines).join('\n');

/** Sinks for `to`: a node and everything under it, or every node under a path prefix (`vendor/llm-openai`). */
export function sinksFor(g: ContextGraph, to: string, rel: (p: string) => string | null = (p) => p): string[] | { error: string } {
  const prefix = (rel(to) ?? to).replace(/^\.\//, '').replace(/\/$/, '');
  const under = Object.keys(g.nodes).filter((id) => {
    const f = fileOf(id);
    return f !== null && (f === prefix || f.startsWith(`${prefix}/`));
  });
  if (under.length) return under;
  const hit = findNode(g, to, rel);
  return 'error' in hit ? hit : subtree(g, hit.id);
}

/**
 * Shortest call chains from `from` (a symbol, route or file: a file traces from each of its symbols and routes) to
 * `to` (default: vendors, tables and anything in an `external` cell). Consecutive hops inside one cell are collapsed;
 * a hop from an interface member to an implementation is labelled "via registry".
 */
export function traceText(g: ContextGraph, map: DomainMap, from: string, sinks?: readonly string[], coverage?: { typed: number; files: number }): string {
  const starts = g.nodes[from]?.kind === 'file' ? subtree(g, from).filter((n) => n === from || ['symbol', 'route', 'entry'].includes(g.nodes[n]!.kind)) : [from];
  const best = new Map<string, string[]>();
  for (const s of starts) {
    for (const p of trace(g, s, sinks)) {
      const sink = p[p.length - 1]!;
      const cur = best.get(sink);
      if (!cur || p.length < cur.length) best.set(sink, p);
    }
  }
  const paths = [...best.values()].sort((a, b) => a.length - b.length || (a.at(-1)! < b.at(-1)! ? -1 : 1)).slice(0, MAX_TRACE_PATHS);
  const tier = coverage ? (coverage.typed ? `typed calls for ${coverage.typed}/${coverage.files} files` : 'syntactic calls only (typed calls not ready yet)') : '';
  const note = `Follows calls, route handlers and interface dispatch${tier ? ` (${tier})` : ''}. Dispatch the checker can't see (dynamic keys, DI) is missing, so a trace is never complete.`;
  if (!paths.length) return `No call chain from ${from}${sinks ? ' to the given target' : ' to a vendor, table or external cell'}.\n${note}`;
  return [`${paths.length} chain(s) from ${from}:`, ...paths.flatMap((p, i) => renderChain(g, map, p, i + 1)), '', note].join('\n');
}

type Hop = 'calls' | 'handles' | 'writes' | 'dispatch';
function hopKind(g: ContextGraph, a: string, b: string): { kind: Hop; edge?: GraphEdge } {
  const ix = indexOf(g);
  const fwd = (ix.out.get(a) ?? []).find((e) => e.to === b && (e.kind === 'calls' || e.kind === 'handles' || e.kind === 'writes'));
  if (fwd) return { kind: fwd.kind as Hop, edge: fwd };
  return { kind: 'dispatch' }; // implements walked backwards: interface member → implementation
}

export function renderChain(g: ContextGraph, map: DomainMap, path: readonly string[], n: number): string[] {
  type Group = { nodes: string[]; via: Hop | null; edge?: GraphEdge };
  const groups: Group[] = [];
  path.forEach((id, i) => {
    const h = i ? hopKind(g, path[i - 1]!, id) : null;
    const last = groups[groups.length - 1];
    if (last && h?.kind !== 'dispatch' && placeOf(g, last.nodes[0]!) === placeOf(g, id)) last.nodes.push(id);
    else groups.push({ nodes: [id], via: h?.kind ?? null, edge: h?.edge });
  });
  return groups.map((grp, i) => {
    const where = placeLabel(g, map, grp.nodes[0]!);
    const body = grp.nodes.length === 1 ? grp.nodes[0]! : `${grp.nodes[0]} → … → ${grp.nodes[grp.nodes.length - 1]}`;
    const inCell = grp.nodes.length > 1 ? ` · ${grp.nodes.length - 1} hop(s) in cell` : '';
    const how = grp.via === 'dispatch' ? '⇢ via registry → ' : '→ ';
    const conf = grp.edge?.confidence && grp.edge.confidence !== 'typed' ? ` (${grp.edge.confidence})` : '';
    return i === 0 ? `${n}. ${body}  [${where}${inCell}]` : `   ${how}${body}  [${where}${inCell}]${conf}`;
  });
}

/** Symbols, routes and entries of a file (with line numbers), or the files under a directory with their symbol counts. */
export function symbolsText(g: ContextGraph, map: DomainMap, facts: ReadonlyMap<string, FileFacts>, path: string, text: (p: string) => string | null): string {
  const p = path.replace(/^\.\//, '').replace(/\/$/, '');
  const f = facts.get(p);
  if (!f) {
    const files = [...facts.keys()].filter((x) => x.startsWith(`${p}/`)).sort();
    if (!files.length) return `No code file or directory "${path}" with facts.`;
    return cap([`${p}/ · ${files.length} file(s):`, ...files.map((x) => `  ${x}  ${facts.get(x)!.symbols.length} symbols  [${placeLabel(g, map, x)}]`)]);
  }
  const src = text(p);
  const lineOf = (at: number) => (src ? src.slice(0, at).split('\n').length : 0);
  const ix = indexOf(g);
  const depth = (s: { parent: string | null }) => { let d = 0; for (let q = s.parent; q; q = f.symbols.find((x) => x.id === q)?.parent ?? null) d++; return d; };
  const lines = [`${p}  [${placeLabel(g, map, p)}] · ${f.symbols.length} symbols`];
  for (const s of f.symbols) {
    const out = (ix.out.get(s.id) ?? []).filter((e) => e.kind === 'calls');
    const impl = (ix.out.get(s.id) ?? []).filter((e) => e.kind === 'implements').map((e) => e.to);
    const calls = out.length ? ` · calls ${out.length}` : '';
    lines.push(`${'  '.repeat(depth(s) + 1)}${s.kind} ${s.name}${s.exported ? ' (exported)' : ''} :${lineOf(s.span.start)}${calls}${impl.length ? ` · implements ${impl.join(', ')}` : ''}`);
  }
  for (const r of f.routes) lines.push(`  route ${r.method} ${r.path}${r.handler ? ` → ${r.handler}` : ''}`);
  for (const e of f.entries) lines.push(`  entry ${e.kind}: ${e.label}`);
  return cap(lines);
}

// usage: node shot.mjs <url> <out.png> [js-to-eval-after-load] [waitMs]
import { chromium } from 'playwright';
const [url, out, js, wait] = process.argv.slice(2);
const browser = await chromium.launch();
const page = await browser.newPage({ viewport: { width: 1440, height: 900 } });
const logs = [];
page.on('console', (m) => { if (m.type() === 'error' || m.type() === 'warning') logs.push(`${m.type()}: ${m.text()}`); });
page.on('pageerror', (e) => logs.push(`pageerror: ${e.message}`));
await page.goto(url);
await page.waitForFunction(() => window.__v2?.ready?.(), null, { timeout: 20000 }).catch(() => logs.push('not ready'));
await page.waitForTimeout(1200);
if (js) {
  for (const step of js.split(';;')) {
    if (step.startsWith('click:')) await page.click(step.slice(6));
    else if (step.startsWith('wait:')) await page.waitForTimeout(Number(step.slice(5)));
    else if (step.startsWith('key:')) await page.keyboard.press(step.slice(4));
    else await page.evaluate(step);
  }
}
await page.waitForTimeout(Number(wait ?? 1200));
await page.screenshot({ path: out });
console.log(logs.slice(0, 20).join('\n'));
await browser.close();

  plannedEdges: [], addedEdges: [], cursor: null, verb: null, violations: { files: [], edges: [] }, rules: {}, plannedNew: [], ...extra,
});
