```text
// Shared fixture for the NAVIGATION_PLAN lanes: FileFacts for test/fixture-repo (mirrors Scout).
// Imports and writes come from the real scanner; symbols, calls and routes are hand-written for the files the
// demo turns touch, until the Facts lane's extractor replaces them (its tests must reproduce these).
import { scanRepo } from '../src/facts';
import type { FileFacts, SymbolFact, CallFact, RouteFact } from '../src/contracts/facts';
import { fixtureRepo, loadMap } from './helpers';

const sym = (file: string, name: string, kind: SymbolFact['kind'], exported = true, parent: string | null = null): SymbolFact => ({
  id: `${file}#${name}`, file, name, kind, exported, parent, span: { start: 0, end: 0 }, sigHash: `sig:${name}`, bodyHash: `body:${file}#${name}`,
});
const call = (from: string, to: string, confidence: CallFact['confidence'] = 'syntactic'): CallFact => ({ from, to, confidence, count: 1 });

const SYMBOLS: Record<string, SymbolFact[]> = {
  'src/tools/news-summarize.ts': [sym('src/tools/news-summarize.ts', 'newsSummarize', 'const'), sym('src/tools/news-summarize.ts', 'newsSummarize.run', 'method', false, 'src/tools/news-summarize.ts#newsSummarize')],
  'src/tools/company-profile.ts': [sym('src/tools/company-profile.ts', 'companyProfile', 'const'), sym('src/tools/company-profile.ts', 'companyProfile.run', 'method', false, 'src/tools/company-profile.ts#companyProfile')],
  'src/tools/index.ts': [sym('src/tools/index.ts', 'tools', 'const')],
  'src/gateway/complete.ts': [sym('src/gateway/complete.ts', 'complete', 'function')],
  'src/gateway/redact.ts': [sym('src/gateway/redact.ts', 'redact', 'function')],
  'src/gateway/providers.ts': [sym('src/gateway/providers.ts', 'provider', 'function')],
  'src/gateway/cost-ledger.ts': [sym('src/gateway/cost-ledger.ts', 'logCost', 'function')],
  'src/orchestrator/tool-registry.ts': [sym('src/orchestrator/tool-registry.ts', 'registry', 'const')],
  'src/orchestrator/agent.ts': [sym('src/orchestrator/agent.ts', 'runAgent', 'function')],
  'src/channels/routes.ts': [sym('src/channels/routes.ts', 'server', 'const')],
  'vendor/llm-openai/index.ts': [sym('vendor/llm-openai/index.ts', 'chat', 'function')],
  'vendor/news/index.ts': [sym('vendor/news/index.ts', 'call', 'function')],
  'vendor/enrichment/index.ts': [sym('vendor/enrichment/index.ts', 'call', 'function')],
  'vendor/sec-edgar/index.ts': [sym('vendor/sec-edgar/index.ts', 'call', 'function')],
};

const CALLS: Record<string, CallFact[]> = {
  'src/tools/news-summarize.ts': [
    call('src/tools/news-summarize.ts#newsSummarize.run', 'vendor/news/index.ts#call'),
    call('src/tools/news-summarize.ts#newsSummarize.run', 'vendor/llm-openai/index.ts#chat'),
  ],
  'src/tools/company-profile.ts': [
    call('src/tools/company-profile.ts#companyProfile.run', 'src/gateway/complete.ts#complete'),
    call('src/tools/company-profile.ts#companyProfile.run', 'vendor/enrichment/index.ts#call'),
    call('src/tools/company-profile.ts#companyProfile.run', 'vendor/sec-edgar/index.ts#call'),
  ],
  'src/gateway/complete.ts': [
    call('src/gateway/complete.ts#complete', 'src/gateway/redact.ts#redact'),
    call('src/gateway/complete.ts#complete', 'src/gateway/providers.ts#provider'),
    call('src/gateway/complete.ts#complete', 'src/gateway/cost-ledger.ts#logCost'),
  ],
  'src/channels/routes.ts': [call('src/channels/routes.ts#server', 'src/orchestrator/agent.ts#runAgent')],
};

const ROUTES: Record<string, RouteFact[]> = {
  'src/channels/routes.ts': [{ id: 'route:POST /runs', method: 'POST', path: '/runs', file: 'src/channels/routes.ts', handler: 'src/channels/routes.ts#server' }],
};

/** FileFacts for every code file in the fixture repo (hash = 'fixture'). */
export function scoutFacts(): Record<string, FileFacts> {
  const map = loadMap();
  const facts = scanRepo(fixtureRepo, map);
  const out: Record<string, FileFacts> = {};
  for (const path of facts.files.filter((f) => /\.(ts|tsx|js|mjs)$/.test(f))) {
    out[path] = {
      path,
      hash: 'fixture',
      imports: facts.imports.filter((i) => i.from === path).map((i) => ({ to: i.to, typeOnly: false })),
      writes: facts.writes.filter((w) => w.file === path).map((w) => ({ table: w.table, symbol: null, via: 'db' })),
      symbols: SYMBOLS[path] ?? [],
      calls: CALLS[path] ?? [],
      routes: ROUTES[path] ?? [],
      entries: path === 'src/channels/cli.ts' ? [{ id: 'entry:cli:scout', kind: 'cli', file: path, symbol: null, label: 'scout' }] : [],
    };
  }
  return out;
}
```

```text
// Which symbols an edit changed (NAVIGATION_PLAN §3.1). Pure and browser-safe.
import type { SymbolDiff, SymbolFact } from '../contracts/facts';

/**
 * Classify symbols as added, removed, signature-changed or body-changed by comparing hashes.
 * A removed and an added symbol of the same kind with the same `bodyHash` is a rename, listed only under `renamed`.
 */
export function diffSymbols(before: readonly SymbolFact[], after: readonly SymbolFact[]): SymbolDiff {
  const old = new Map(before.map((s) => [s.id, s]));
  const now = new Map(after.map((s) => [s.id, s]));
  const sig: string[] = [];
  const body: string[] = [];
  for (const s of after) {
    const o = old.get(s.id);
    if (!o) continue;
    if (o.sigHash !== s.sigHash) sig.push(s.id);
    else if (o.bodyHash !== s.bodyHash) body.push(s.id);
  }
  const removed = before.filter((s) => !now.has(s.id));
  const added = after.filter((s) => !old.has(s.id));
  const renamed: [string, string][] = [];
  const taken = new Set<string>();
  for (const r of removed) {
    const a = added.find((x) => !taken.has(x.id) && x.kind === r.kind && x.bodyHash === r.bodyHash);
    if (!a) continue;
    taken.add(a.id);
    taken.add(r.id);
    renamed.push([r.id, a.id]);
  }
  return {
    added: added.filter((s) => !taken.has(s.id)).map((s) => s.id),
    removed: removed.filter((s) => !taken.has(s.id)).map((s) => s.id),
    sig,
    body,
    renamed,
  };
```
```text
}
```

```bash
// code a decision protects, and violations on the symbols that use a violating import.
import { describe, expect, it } from 'vitest';
import { activityFor, graphOf, project } from '../src/graph';
import { cellId, domainId, type ViewState } from '../src/contracts/graph';
import { reduce, type HarnessEvent } from '../src/events';
import { demoLog } from './turn-log';
import { scoutFacts } from './scout-facts';

const view = (expanded: string[]): ViewState => ({ expanded, focus: null, lens: { kinds: [], turnOnly: false }, budget: 50, follow: false });

function withTurn(steps: unknown[], more: Record<string, unknown>[] = []) {
  const { events } = demoLog();
  const facts = scoutFacts();
  let k = 0;
  const e = (kind: string, data: Record<string, unknown>, extra: Record<string, unknown> = {}) => ({ id: `m${k++}`, t: 100 + k, session: 's2', turn: 't2', kind, data, ...extra });
  const extra = [
    ...['src/gateway/redact.ts', 'src/gateway/cost-ledger.ts', 'src/tools/news-summarize.ts', 'vendor/news/index.ts'].map((p) => e('facts_changed', { facts: facts[p] }, { path: p, turn: null })),
    e('turn_started', { prompt: 'x', head: '', baseline: '' }),
    e('planned', { steps, cells: [{ domain: 'gateway', layer: 'logic', steps: [1], files: ['src/gateway/redact.ts'] }], edges: [], unassigned: [] }),
    ...more.map((m) => e(m.kind as string, m.data as Record<string, unknown>, (m.extra as Record<string, unknown>) ?? {})),
  ] as unknown as HarnessEvent[];
  const ui = reduce([...events, ...extra]);
  const g = graphOf(ui)!;
  return { ui, g, a: activityFor(ui, g) };
}

const open = (g: NonNullable<ReturnType<typeof graphOf>>, file: string) =>
  view([...g.nodes ? Object.values(g.nodes).filter((n) => n.kind === 'domain').map((n) => n.id) : [], cellId('gateway', 'logic'), file]);

describe('module level', () => {
  it('ghosts a planned symbol that exists, and draws a planned symbol the facts lack as a phantom row', () => {
    const { g, a } = withTurn([{ n: 1, text: 'widen', files: ['src/gateway/redact.ts'], imports: [], symbols: ['src/gateway/redact.ts#redact', 'src/gateway/redact.ts#PHONE_PATTERN'] }]);
    expect(a.leaves['src/gateway/redact.ts#redact']).toMatchObject({ planned: true, ghostSteps: [1] });
    expect(a.leaves['src/gateway/redact.ts#PHONE_PATTERN']).toMatchObject({ planned: true, ghostSteps: [1] });

    expect(collapsed.nodes.some((n) => n.id === 'src/gateway/redact.ts#PHONE_PATTERN')).toBe(false);
    // expanded file: real rows plus the phantom row, last
    const p = project(g, open(g, 'src/gateway/redact.ts'), a);
    const rows = p.nodes.filter((n) => n.parent === 'src/gateway/redact.ts').map((n) => n.id);
    expect(rows).toEqual(['src/gateway/redact.ts#redact', 'src/gateway/redact.ts#PHONE_PATTERN']);
    expect(p.nodes.find((n) => n.id === 'src/gateway/redact.ts#PHONE_PATTERN')).toMatchObject({ kind: 'symbol', label: 'PHONE_PATTERN', rollup: { ghostSteps: [1], plannedNew: true } });
  });

    const { a } = withTurn([{ n: 1, text: 'record', files: [], imports: [], symbols: ['src/gateway/cost-ledger.ts#logCost'] }], [

    expect(a.leaves['src/gateway/cost-ledger.ts']).toMatchObject({ edited: true, unplanned: false });

    const { g, a } = withTurn([{ n: 1, text: 'widen', files: ['src/gateway/redact.ts'], imports: [] }], [{ kind: 'decision_touched', data: touched }]);
    expect(a.leaves['src/gateway/redact.ts']!.touchedDecisions).toEqual(['DR-4']);
    expect(a.leaves['src/gateway/redact.ts#redact']!.touchedDecisions).toEqual(['DR-4']);

    expect(sys.nodes.find((n) => n.id === cellId('gateway', 'logic'))!.rollup.touchedDecisions).toEqual(['DR-4']);
    expect(sys.nodes.find((n) => n.id === cellId('tools', 'logic'))!.rollup.touchedDecisions).toEqual([]);

    expect(a.leaves['src/tools/news-summarize.ts#newsSummarize']?.violation ?? null).toBe(null);
  });
});
```

```typescript
// Decisions protect the code that implements them (DEMO_PLAN beat 4). Pure, deterministic, browser-safe: no model.
//
// 1. `protectsFor`: when the turn that made a decision ends, the files and `path#symbol`s it built to implement the
//    chosen option. 2. `stepTouches` / `editTouches`: whether a plan step or an edit touches that code.
import type { SymbolDiff } from './contracts/facts';
import type { PlanStep } from './plan';
import type { Mapper } from './mapper';

/** What a decision protects: whole files (`paths` with no symbol of theirs in `symbols`) and specific symbols. */
export type Protects = { paths: string[]; symbols: string[] };

/** One path's activity in the decision turn (a subset of the reducer's `PathActivity`). */
export type TurnPath = { edits: number; created: boolean; symbols: SymbolDiff | null };

const fileOf = (id: string) => (id.includes('#') ? id.slice(0, id.indexOf('#')) : id);
const sorted = (xs: Iterable<string>) => [...new Set(xs)].sort();
/** Anonymous callbacks (`<cb1>`) are renumbered by unrelated edits: never protected by id. */
const stable = (id: string) => !/<cb\d*>/.test(id);

/**
 * The code a decision protects, from the turn that made it:
 * - **candidates:** every file the turn edited (`edits > 0`);
 * - **option A** (comply): minus the files that triggered the fork (`violating`, e.g. the new tool) and minus the
 *   other non-test files of the violating files' domain(s) — that side is the feature asking for the shortcut, not
 *   the chosen option. If that leaves no non-test file (the fix lives in the same domain), only the violating files
 *   are dropped;
 * - **option B** (exception): the violating files the turn edited — the exception is what the decision is about;
 * - **tests** the turn added or changed are always kept, as whole files (tests protect the decision too);
 * - **symbols:** for each kept non-test file, what the turn added or changed there (`added`, `sig`, `body`, the new
 *   side of `renamed`; never `removed`, never anonymous callbacks). A file with no such symbol is protected whole.
 */
export function protectsFor(
  paths: Readonly<Record<string, TurnPath>>,
  decision: { paths: readonly string[]; option: 'A' | 'B' },
  mapper: Mapper,
): Protects {
  const edited = Object.keys(paths).filter((p) => paths[p]!.edits > 0).sort();
  const isTest = (p: string) => mapper.place(p).kind === 'test';
  const violating = new Set(decision.paths);
  const tests = edited.filter(isTest);
  const code = edited.filter((p) => !isTest(p));
  let keep: string[];
  if (decision.option === 'B') keep = code.filter((p) => violating.has(p));
  else {
    const sides = new Set(decision.paths.map((p) => mapper.domainOf(p)).filter((d): d is string => !!d));
    const outside = code.filter((p) => !violating.has(p) && !sides.has(mapper.domainOf(p) ?? ''));
    keep = outside.length ? outside : code.filter((p) => !violating.has(p));
  }
  const symbols: string[] = [];
  for (const p of keep) {
    const d = paths[p]!.symbols;
    if (!d) continue;
    const removed = new Set(d.removed);
    for (const s of [...d.added, ...d.sig, ...d.body, ...d.renamed.map((r) => r[1])]) if (stable(s) && !removed.has(s) && fileOf(s) === p) symbols.push(s);
  }
  return { paths: sorted([...keep, ...tests]), symbols: sorted(symbols) };
}

/** What a plan step or an edit touched of a decision's protected code (null: nothing). */
export type Touch = { paths: string[]; symbols: string[] };

/** `a` is `b`, or one contains the other (`x.ts#Redactor` ⊃ `x.ts#Redactor.redact`). */
const related = (a: string, b: string) => a === b || a.startsWith(`${b}.`) || b.startsWith(`${a}.`);

function index(p: Protects) {
  const bySymbolFile = new Map<string, string[]>();
  for (const s of p.symbols) (bySymbolFile.get(fileOf(s)) ?? bySymbolFile.set(fileOf(s), []).get(fileOf(s))!).push(s);
  /** A protected path with no protected symbol is protected whole. */
  const whole = new Set(p.paths.filter((f) => !bySymbolFile.has(f)));
  return { bySymbolFile, whole };
}

const result = (paths: Iterable<string>, symbols: Iterable<string>): Touch | null => {
  const t = { paths: sorted(paths), symbols: sorted(symbols) };
  return t.paths.length || t.symbols.length ? t : null;
};

/**
 * A plan step touches protected code when:
 * - it names (`symbols`) a protected symbol, or one containing or inside it;
 * - it names any symbol in, or edits, a file protected whole;
 * - it edits a file that holds protected symbols (`files`, or an `imports` source) **without naming any symbol in
 *   that file** — the step doesn't say which part changes, so it may change the protected part.
 * A step that names only other symbols in that file doesn't touch it.
 */
export function stepTouches(p: Protects, step: Pick<PlanStep, 'files' | 'imports' | 'symbols'>): Touch | null {
  const { bySymbolFile, whole } = index(p);
  const named = step.symbols ?? [];
  const files = new Set([...step.files, ...step.imports.map((i) => i.from)]);
  const paths = new Set<string>();
  const symbols = new Set<string>();
  for (const s of named) {
    const f = fileOf(s);
    if (whole.has(f)) paths.add(f);
    for (const ps of bySymbolFile.get(f) ?? []) if (related(s, ps)) { symbols.add(ps); paths.add(f); }
  }
  for (const f of files) {
    if (whole.has(f)) paths.add(f);
    else if (bySymbolFile.has(f) && !named.some((s) => fileOf(s) === f)) { paths.add(f); for (const s of bySymbolFile.get(f)!) symbols.add(s); }
  }
  return result(paths, symbols);
}

/**
 * An edit to `path` touches protected code when the file is protected whole (any change), or when its symbol diff
 * changes a protected symbol (or one containing or inside it): `sig`, `body`, `removed`, or the old side of `renamed`.
 * Added symbols never touch a symbol-protected file. Without a symbol diff (not code, or text that didn't parse) only
 * whole-file protection applies.
 */
export function editTouches(p: Protects, path: string, diff: SymbolDiff | null | undefined): Touch | null {
  const { bySymbolFile, whole } = index(p);
  if (whole.has(path)) return result([path], []);
  const protectedHere = bySymbolFile.get(path);
  if (!protectedHere || !diff) return null;
  const changed = [...diff.sig, ...diff.body, ...diff.removed, ...diff.renamed.map((r) => r[0])];
  const symbols = protectedHere.filter((ps) => changed.some((c) => related(c, ps)));
  return symbols.length ? result([path], symbols) : null;
}

/** Everything protected, short: files protected whole, and `path#a, b` for symbols. */
export function protectsSummary(p: Protects): string {
  const { bySymbolFile, whole } = index(p);
  const parts = [...[...bySymbolFile].map(([f, ss]) => `${f}#${ss.map((s) => s.slice(f.length + 1)).join(', ')}`), ...whole];
  return parts.sort().join('; ');
}

/**
 * The reminder Claude gets when a plan or an edit touches protected code (the submit_plan result, or PostToolUse
 * `additionalContext`). Not a block and not a fork: the decision stands, so Claude scopes the change to keep it true.
 */
export function touchText(
  d: { id: string; title: string; outcome: string; session: number | null },
  touch: Touch,
  source: 'plan' | 'edit',
): string {
  const what = source === 'plan' ? 'This plan touches' : 'This edit touches';
  const where = [...touch.symbols, ...touch.paths.filter((f) => !touch.symbols.some((s) => fileOf(s) === f))].join(', ');
  const when = d.session ? ` (decided in session ${d.session})` : '';
  const outcome = d.outcome.trim().replace(/[.\s]+$/, '');
  return `${what} what ${d.id} protects: ${d.title}. ${outcome}. Keep it true${when}: scope the change so it still holds, and extend its test.${where ? ` Protected code here: ${where}.` : ''}`;
}
```

```typescript
// Beat 1 (DEMO_PLAN): the three classes of path to a model provider. Deterministic, pure and browser-safe.
import type { ContextGraph, GraphEdge } from '../contracts/graph';
import type { ProviderPath, ProviderPathClass } from '../contracts/api';
import { fileOf } from '../contracts/graph';
import { createMapper, matchesAny } from '../mapper';
import type { DomainMap } from '../schema';
import type { Violation } from '../rules';

const byId = (a: string, b: string) => (a < b ? -1 : a > b ? 1 : 0);
const RANK: Record<ProviderPathClass, number> = { violation: 0, uncosted: 1, gateway: 2 };

/**
 * Paths from code to a model provider, classified (`ProviderPaths`, contracts/api.ts):
 * - **Providers** are the files an `only_via` invariant guards (`targets`, e.g. `vendor/llm-*`), and the provider SDKs
 *   they use (bare packages, e.g. `vendor:@anthropic-ai/sdk`). The **gateway** is that invariant's `allowed_from`.
 * - A file that imports or calls into a provider file is a caller. From the gateway: `gateway`. Crossing a current
 *   violation (same file and target): `violation`, with the invariant. Test files are skipped.
 * - Any other file that uses a provider SDK directly (not a provider file, not the gateway): `uncosted`, or
 *   `violation` if a current violation names that file.
 * Each path runs from the caller (its calling symbol when a call edge says which) through the provider file (its
 * called symbol) to the SDK when the provider file uses one; `provider` is the last node. Sorted violation →
 * uncosted → gateway, then by nodes.
 */
export function providerPaths(graph: ContextGraph, map: DomainMap, violations: readonly Violation[]): ProviderPath[] {
  const mapper = createMapper(map);
  const guards = map.invariants.flatMap((i) => (i.kind === 'only_via' ? [i] : []));
  if (!guards.length) return [];
  const files = Object.keys(graph.nodes).filter((id) => graph.nodes[id]!.kind === 'file');
  const guardOf = (path: string) => guards.find((g) => matchesAny(g.targets, path));
  const targets = new Set(files.filter((f) => !!guardOf(f)));
  const edgesFrom = new Map<string, GraphEdge[]>();
  for (const e of graph.edges) {
    const f = fileOf(e.from) ?? e.from;
    (edgesFrom.get(f) ?? edgesFrom.set(f, []).get(f)!).push(e);
  }
  const out: ProviderPath[] = [];
  const seen = new Set<string>();
  const push = (cls: ProviderPathClass, nodes: string[], invariant?: string) => {
    const key = `${cls}\n${nodes.join('\n')}`;
    if (seen.has(key)) return;
    seen.add(key);
    out.push({ class: cls, nodes, provider: nodes.at(-1)!, ...(invariant ? { invariant } : {}) });
  };
  const sdksOf = (path: string) => (edgesFrom.get(path) ?? []).filter((e) => (e.kind === 'uses' || e.kind === 'calls') && e.to.startsWith('vendor:') && !e.to.startsWith('vendor:node:')).map((e) => e.to);
  const sdks = new Set([...targets].flatMap(sdksOf));
  const sdkFor = (target: string) => sdksOf(target).sort(byId)[0];
  const skip = (path: string) => { const k = mapper.place(path).kind; return k === 'test' || k === 'ignored'; };
  const violationOf = (file: string, target?: string) => violations.find((v) => v.file === file && (!target || !v.target || v.target === target));

  // Callers of provider files.
  for (const caller of files.sort(byId)) {
    if (targets.has(caller) || skip(caller)) continue;
    const es = edgesFrom.get(caller) ?? [];
    for (const target of [...new Set(es.filter((e) => targets.has(fileOf(e.to) ?? '')).map((e) => fileOf(e.to)!))].sort(byId)) {
      const call = es.filter((e) => e.kind === 'calls' && fileOf(e.to) === target).sort((a, b) => byId(a.from, b.from) || byId(a.to, b.to))[0];
      const sdk = sdkFor(target);
      const nodes = [call?.from ?? caller, call?.to ?? target, ...(sdk ? [sdk] : [])];
      const guard = guardOf(target)!;
      const domain = mapper.domainOf(caller);
      const v = violationOf(caller, target);
      if (v) push('violation', nodes, v.invariant);
      else if (domain && guard.allowed_from.includes(domain)) push('gateway', nodes);
      else push('uncosted', nodes);
    }
  }
  // Direct users of a provider SDK outside the provider files and the gateway.
  for (const user of files.sort(byId)) {
    if (targets.has(user) || skip(user)) continue;
    const domain = mapper.domainOf(user);
    if (domain && guards.some((g) => g.allowed_from.includes(domain))) continue;
    for (const sdk of [...new Set(sdksOf(user).filter((s) => sdks.has(s)))].sort(byId)) {
      const call = (edgesFrom.get(user) ?? []).filter((e) => e.kind === 'calls' && e.to === sdk).sort((a, b) => byId(a.from, b.from))[0];
      const v = violationOf(user);
      if (v) push('violation', [call?.from ?? user, sdk], v.invariant);
      else push('uncosted', [call?.from ?? user, sdk]);
    }
  }
  return out.sort((a, b) => RANK[a.class] - RANK[b.class] || byId(a.nodes.join('\n'), b.nodes.join('\n')));
}
```

```typescript
// View-only state for the overlays and panels (wave 3 lane B): which journey is drawn and where its playback is,
// which trace is on, which panel is open, which proposal candidate is previewed. Nothing here duplicates the log.
import { create } from 'zustand';
import type { ProviderPathClass } from '@harness/core/view';

export type Panel = 'journeys' | 'findings' | 'health' | 'maintenance';
/** `provider`: every path to the model provider, in three classes. `from`: core `trace` from one node. */
export type TraceMode = { mode: 'provider' } | { mode: 'from'; from: string };

type OverlayStore = {
  panel: Panel | null;
  journey: string | null;
  /** 0-based playback position in the journey's steps. */
  step: number;
  playing: boolean;
  trace: TraceMode | null;
  /** A class picked in the legend: the others recede. */
  traceClass: ProviderPathClass | null;
  /** Proposal id → previewed candidate index (default: the proposal's chosen one). */
  candidate: Record<string, number>;
  /** The last assistant message (chat index) that opened the provider trace on its own. */
  autoTraced: number;

  setPanel(p: Panel | null): void;
  togglePanel(p: Panel): void;
  showJourney(id: string | null, play?: boolean): void;
  setStep(step: number): void;
  setPlaying(on: boolean): void;
  setTrace(t: TraceMode | null): void;
  setTraceClass(c: ProviderPathClass | null): void;
  pickCandidate(proposal: string, i: number): void;
};

export const useOverlay = create<OverlayStore>((set) => ({
  panel: null,
  journey: null,
  step: 0,
  playing: false,
  trace: null,
  traceClass: null,
  candidate: {},
  autoTraced: -1,

  setPanel: (panel) => set({ panel }),
  togglePanel: (p) => set((s) => ({ panel: s.panel === p ? null : p })),
  // A journey and a trace are two readings of the same wiring: showing one hides the other.
  showJourney: (journey, play = false) => set({ journey, step: 0, playing: play && !!journey, ...(journey ? { trace: null } : {}) }),
  setStep: (step) => set({ step }),
  setPlaying: (playing) => set({ playing }),
  setTrace: (trace) => set({ trace, traceClass: null, ...(trace ? { journey: null, playing: false } : {}) }),
  setTraceClass: (traceClass) => set({ traceClass }),
  pickCandidate: (proposal, i) => set((s) => ({ candidate: { ...s.candidate, [proposal]: i } })),
}));
```

```typescript
// TEMPORARY STUB — DELETE AT INTEGRATION. Lane C implements `providerPaths` in
// packages/core/src/journeys/provider-paths.ts (exported from @harness/core/view) against the `ProviderPaths` contract.
// Swap the import in ./trace.ts (`providerPaths`) for the core one and delete this file. Same signature, same output type;
// this version only looks one import hop deep, which is enough to draw beat 1's three classes on Scout.
import type { ContextGraph, DomainMap, ProviderPath, ProviderPaths, Violation } from '@harness/core/view';

const PROVIDER_PKG = /(^|\/)(@anthropic-ai\/sdk|openai|@google\/genai)$/;

export const providerPaths: ProviderPaths = (graph: ContextGraph, map: DomainMap, violations: readonly Violation[]): ProviderPath[] => {
  const via = map.invariants.find((i) => i.kind === 'only_via');
  const gateway = via && via.kind === 'only_via' ? via.allowed_from[0] ?? 'gateway' : 'gateway';
  const isProviderFile = (id: string) => /^vendor\/llm-[^/]+\//.test(id) && graph.nodes[id]?.kind === 'file';
  const isProviderPkg = (id: string) => id.startsWith('vendor:') && PROVIDER_PKG.test(id.slice(7));
  const out: ProviderPath[] = [];
  const seen = new Set<string>();
  for (const e of graph.edges) {
    if (e.kind !== 'imports' && e.kind !== 'uses') continue;
    const sink = isProviderFile(e.to) || isProviderPkg(e.to);
    if (!sink || isProviderFile(e.from)) continue;
    const from = graph.nodes[e.from];
    if (!from) continue;
    const v = violations.find((x) => x.file === e.from && (!x.target || x.target === e.to));
    const cls = from.domain === gateway ? 'gateway' : v ? 'violation' : 'uncosted';
    const key = `${e.from}|${e.to}`;
    if (seen.has(key)) continue;
    seen.add(key);
    out.push({ class: cls, nodes: [e.from, e.to], provider: e.to, ...(v ? { invariant: v.invariant } : {}) });
  }
  return out.sort((a, b) => (a.nodes.join() < b.nodes.join() ? -1 : 1));
};
```

```typescript
// Module level (NAVIGATION_PLAN §2, N6): an expanded file is a fixed-width box of symbol rows, in source order
// (nested symbols indented under their class or object). No ELK: rows are deterministic, so a file that gains a
// symbol only grows downward. Calls inside the file run in a lane on the left; edges to the rest of the map leave
// through ports on the right (or left, toward a column on the left) at the row's height, and the cell's ELK run
// continues them from there.
import type { Projection, VisibleNode } from '@harness/core/view';
import { portKey, type ContainerLayout, type Pt, type Side } from './containers';

export const MODULE = { w: 264, head: 44, row: 30, gap: 3, indent: 14, left: 20, bottom: 10 } as const;

export type ModuleIndex = {
  byId: Map<string, VisibleNode>;
  colId(id: string): string | null;
};

/** Rows of an expanded file: every visible node below it, in projection pre-order, with its nesting depth. */
export function moduleRows(p: Projection, file: string, byId: Map<string, VisibleNode>): { id: string; indent: number }[] {
  const base = byId.get(file)?.depth ?? 0;
  const rows: { id: string; indent: number }[] = [];
  for (const n of p.nodes) {
    let inside = false;
    for (let x = byId.get(n.parent ?? ''); x; x = byId.get(x.parent ?? '')) if (x.id === file) { inside = true; break; }
    if (inside) rows.push({ id: n.id, indent: Math.max(0, n.depth - base - 1) });
  }
  return rows;
}

export function moduleLayout(p: Projection, file: string, edges: Projection['edges'], ix: ModuleIndex, colIndex: (col: string | null) => number): ContainerLayout {
  const rows = moduleRows(p, file, ix.byId);
  const nodes: ContainerLayout['nodes'] = {};
  rows.forEach((r, i) => {
    const x = MODULE.left + r.indent * MODULE.indent;
    nodes[r.id] = { x, y: MODULE.head + i * (MODULE.row + MODULE.gap), w: MODULE.w - x - 10, h: MODULE.row };
  });
  const w = MODULE.w;
  const h = MODULE.head + Math.max(1, rows.length) * (MODULE.row + MODULE.gap) - MODULE.gap + MODULE.bottom;
  const out: ContainerLayout = { id: file, w, h, nodes, edges: {}, ports: {}, ms: 0 };
  const self = colIndex(ix.colId(file));
  const used = new Map<string, number>();
  let lane = 0;
  for (const e of edges) {
    const a = nodes[e.from];
    const b = nodes[e.to];
    if (!a && !b) continue;
    if (a && b) {
      // inside the file: down (or up) a lane on the left, entering the target row from the left
      const lx = 4 + (lane++ % 4) * 4;
      const ya = a.y + a.h / 2;
      const yb = b.y + b.h / 2;
      out.edges[e.id] = [{ x: a.x, y: ya }, { x: lx, y: ya }, { x: lx, y: yb }, { x: b.x, y: yb }];
      continue;
    }
    const isOut = !!a;
    const row = (a ?? b)!;
    const peer = colIndex(ix.colId(isOut ? e.to : e.from));
    const side: Side = peer > self ? 'right' : peer < self ? 'left' : isOut ? 'right' : 'left';
    const k = `${isOut ? e.from : e.to}:${side}`;
    const nth = used.get(k) ?? 0;
    used.set(k, nth + 1);
    const y = row.y + row.h / 2 + Math.min(10, nth * 4) * (nth % 2 ? 1 : -1);
    const at: Pt = { x: side === 'right' ? w : 0, y };
    const edge: Pt = { x: side === 'right' ? row.x + row.w : row.x, y };
    out.ports[portKey(e.id, file)] = { at, side };
    out.edges[e.id] = isOut ? [edge, at] : [at, edge];
  }
  return out;
}
```

```typescript
// Where overlay marks sit on the current frame: any graph node resolves to its nearest drawn ancestor's box (a file at
// System level lands on its cell), and paths are drawn as curves between box edges. Pure; no React.
import type { ContextGraph } from '@harness/core/view';
import type { Frame } from '../layout/frame';
import type { Box } from '../layout/containers';

export type Pt = { x: number; y: number };

/** The drawn box for a node: itself, or the nearest ancestor on the frame. Null for code that is never drawn (shared code, bare packages). */
export function boxOf(frame: Frame, graph: ContextGraph, id: string): (Box & { id: string }) | null {
  for (let cur: string | null = id; cur; cur = graph.nodes[cur]?.parent ?? null) {
    const b = frame.boxes[cur];
    if (b) return { x: b.x, y: b.y, w: b.w, h: b.h, id: cur };
    if (cur === graph.root) break;
  }
  return null;
}

export const centre = (b: Box): Pt => ({ x: b.x + b.w / 2, y: b.y + b.h / 2 });

export function unionBox(boxes: readonly Box[]): Box | null {
  if (!boxes.length) return null;
  const x = Math.min(...boxes.map((b) => b.x));
  const y = Math.min(...boxes.map((b) => b.y));
  return { x, y, w: Math.max(...boxes.map((b) => b.x + b.w)) - x, h: Math.max(...boxes.map((b) => b.y + b.h)) - y };
}

export const padBox = (b: Box, p: number): Box => ({ x: b.x - p, y: b.y - p, w: b.w + 2 * p, h: b.h + 2 * p });

type Side = 'l' | 'r' | 't' | 'b';
const normal: Record<Side, Pt> = { l: { x: -1, y: 0 }, r: { x: 1, y: 0 }, t: { x: 0, y: -1 }, b: { x: 0, y: 1 } };

/** The side of `a` facing `b`, judged by centres (horizontal wins when the boxes overlap vertically). */
function facing(a: Box, b: Box): Side {
  const ca = centre(a);
  const cb = centre(b);
  const dx = cb.x - ca.x;
  const dy = cb.y - ca.y;
  const overlapY = a.y < b.y + b.h && b.y < a.y + a.h;
  const overlapX = a.x < b.x + b.w && b.x < a.x + a.w;
  if (overlapX && !overlapY) return dy > 0 ? 'b' : 't';
  if (overlapY && !overlapX) return dx > 0 ? 'r' : 'l';
  return Math.abs(dx) * 0.8 > Math.abs(dy) ? (dx > 0 ? 'r' : 'l') : dy > 0 ? 'b' : 't';
}

function port(b: Box, s: Side, shift: number): Pt {
  const c = centre(b);
  if (s === 'l') return { x: b.x, y: c.y + shift };
  if (s === 'r') return { x: b.x + b.w, y: c.y + shift };
  if (s === 't') return { x: c.x + shift, y: b.y };
  return { x: c.x + shift, y: b.y + b.h };
}

/**
 * A smooth curve from box `a` to box `b`, leaving and entering through the facing sides. `lane` shifts both ends
 * along their side (px), so parallel paths between the same boxes stay apart.
 */
export function link(a: Box, b: Box, lane = 0): { d: string; from: Pt; to: Pt; mid: Pt } {
  const sa = facing(a, b);
  const sb = facing(b, a);
  const p = port(a, sa, lane);
  const q = port(b, sb, lane);
  const dist = Math.hypot(q.x - p.x, q.y - p.y);
  const k = Math.max(24, Math.min(140, dist * 0.42));
  const c1 = { x: p.x + normal[sa].x * k, y: p.y + normal[sa].y * k };
  const c2 = { x: q.x + normal[sb].x * k, y: q.y + normal[sb].y * k };
  const mid = {
    x: 0.125 * p.x + 0.375 * c1.x + 0.375 * c2.x + 0.125 * q.x,
    y: 0.125 * p.y + 0.375 * c1.y + 0.375 * c2.y + 0.125 * q.y,
  };
  const f = (n: number) => n.toFixed(1);
  return { d: `M${f(p.x)},${f(p.y)} C${f(c1.x)},${f(c1.y)} ${f(c2.x)},${f(c2.y)} ${f(q.x)},${f(q.y)}`, from: p, to: q, mid };
}

/** A small box around a point (for waypoints that have no drawn node). */
export const pointBox = (p: Pt, r = 9): Box => ({ x: p.x - r, y: p.y - r, w: 2 * r, h: 2 * r });
```

```typescript
// A journey drawn on the current frame (NAVIGATION_PLAN §2 "Journeys"): consecutive steps that land on the same drawn
// box share one numbered stop; steps in code that is never drawn (shared code such as the fetch client or the tool
// registry's interface) become waypoints between their neighbours. Pure.
import type { ContextGraph, DomainMap, Journey } from '@harness/core/view';
import type { Frame } from '../layout/frame';
import type { Box } from '../layout/containers';
import { boxOf, centre, pointBox, type Pt } from './geometry';

type Step = Journey['steps'][number];

export type Stop = {
  steps: number[]; // 0-based step indices
  box: Box;
  /** The drawn node it sits on, or null for a waypoint. */
  node: string | null;
  waypoint: boolean;
  /** Entered through dispatch or an inferred call: the segment into it is dashed. */
  weak: boolean;
  hub: boolean; // the registry hub ("via registry")
};

/** The registry hub: an interface member reached by dispatch and left by dispatch (Scout: `Tool.run`). */
export const isHub = (j: Journey, i: number) => j.steps[i]?.confidence === 'dispatch' && j.steps[i + 1]?.confidence === 'dispatch';
const weakStep = (s: Step | undefined) => s?.confidence === 'dispatch' || s?.confidence === 'inferred';

export function journeyStops(j: Journey, graph: ContextGraph, frame: Frame): Stop[] {
  const raw = j.steps.map((s, i) => ({ i, b: boxOf(frame, graph, s.node) }));
  const stops: Stop[] = [];
  for (const { i, b } of raw) {
    const hub = isHub(j, i);
    const last = stops.at(-1);
    if (b && last && !last.waypoint && last.node === b.id && !hub && !last.hub) { last.steps.push(i); continue; }
    stops.push({ steps: [i], box: b ?? { x: 0, y: 0, w: 0, h: 0 }, node: b?.id ?? null, waypoint: !b, weak: weakStep(j.steps[i]), hub });
  }
  // Waypoints (and a hub sharing its neighbour's box) sit between the drawn stops on either side.
  stops.forEach((s, k) => {
    if (!s.waypoint && !(s.hub && (stops[k - 1]?.node === s.node || stops[k + 1]?.node === s.node))) return;
    const prev = stops.slice(0, k).reverse().find((x) => !x.waypoint && !x.hub);
    const next = stops.slice(k + 1).find((x) => !x.waypoint && !x.hub);
    const a = prev ? centre(prev.box) : next ? centre(next.box) : { x: 0, y: 0 };
    const b = next ? centre(next.box) : a;
    let p: Pt = { x: (a.x + b.x) / 2, y: (a.y + b.y) / 2 };
    // Between two boxes in the same row, the midpoint falls in the gutter; nudge it off the boxes' shared edge.
    if (prev && next && Math.abs(a.y - b.y) < 4) p = { x: p.x, y: p.y - Math.min(prev.box.h, next.box.h) / 2 - 18 };
    s.box = pointBox(p, s.hub ? 12 : 9);
    s.waypoint = true;
    s.node = null;
  });
  return stops;
}

/** Index of the stop holding a step. */
export const stopOf = (stops: readonly Stop[], step: number) => stops.findIndex((s) => s.steps.includes(step));

const PROVIDER_FILE = /^vendor\/llm-([^/]+)\//;

/** How a step reads in the rail and the player: product words first, the code name second. */
export function stepCaption(j: Journey, i: number, graph: ContextGraph, map: DomainMap | null): { title: string; sub: string } {
  const s = j.steps[i]!;
  const n = graph.nodes[s.node];
  const code = s.node.includes('#') ? s.node.slice(s.node.indexOf('#') + 1) : n?.label ?? s.node;
  const domain = n?.domain ? map?.domains.find((d) => d.id === n.domain)?.name ?? n.domain : null;
  const file = s.node.split('#')[0]!;
  if (isHub(j, i)) return { title: 'via registry', sub: code };
  if (s.kind === 'page') return { title: 'UI page', sub: code };
  if (s.kind === 'fetch') return { title: 'fetch', sub: code };
  if (s.kind === 'route' || s.kind === 'entry') return { title: n?.label ?? s.node.replace(/^(route|entry):(route:)?/, ''), sub: s.kind };
  if (s.kind === 'table') return { title: `table ${n?.label ?? s.node.slice(6)}`, sub: domain ?? '' };
  const prov = PROVIDER_FILE.exec(file);
  if (s.kind === 'vendor' && prov) return { title: prov[1] === 'anthropic' ? 'Claude' : prov[1]!, sub: `${code} · ${file}` };
  if (s.kind === 'vendor') return { title: n?.label ?? code, sub: domain ? `${domain} · external` : 'external' };
  return { title: domain ?? 'code', sub: code };
}
```

```typescript
// Beat 1's trace, computed client-side: the three classes of path to the model provider (the shared `ProviderPaths`
// contract), or core `trace` from one node over graphOf(ui) (Tier 2 calls are already merged in when current).
import { fileOf, trace, type ContextGraph, type DomainMap, type ProviderPath, type ProviderPathClass, type Violation } from '@harness/core/view';
// TODO(integration): replace with `import { providerPaths } from '@harness/core/view'` once lane C lands, then delete the stub.
import { providerPaths } from './provider-paths-stub';

export const CLASS_ORDER: ProviderPathClass[] = ['gateway', 'violation', 'uncosted'];

const memo = new WeakMap<ContextGraph, { key: string; paths: ProviderPath[] }>();

/** Paths to the provider for this graph and the current violations (memoized per graph). */
export function pathsToProvider(graph: ContextGraph, map: DomainMap, violations: readonly Violation[]): ProviderPath[] {
  const key = violations.map((v) => `${v.invariant}|${v.file}|${v.target ?? ''}`).join('\n');
  const hit = memo.get(graph);
  if (hit && hit.key === key) return hit.paths;
  const paths = providerPaths(graph, map, violations);
  memo.set(graph, { key, paths });
  return paths;
}

export type ClassSummary = { cls: ProviderPathClass; paths: ProviderPath[]; callers: string[]; providers: string[]; invariants: string[] };

/** One legend row per class present, in a fixed order: callers are the files the paths start from. */
export function summarize(paths: readonly ProviderPath[]): ClassSummary[] {
  return CLASS_ORDER.map((cls) => {
    const ps = paths.filter((p) => p.class === cls);
    const uniq = (xs: string[]) => [...new Set(xs)].sort();
    return {
      cls, paths: ps,
      callers: uniq(ps.map((p) => fileOf(p.nodes[0]!) ?? p.nodes[0]!)),
      providers: uniq(ps.map((p) => fileOf(p.provider) ?? p.provider)),
      invariants: uniq(ps.flatMap((p) => (p.invariant ? [p.invariant] : []))),
    };
  }).filter((s) => s.paths.length > 0);
}

/** A short name for a file or package: `vendor/search/index.ts` → `vendor/search`, `src/tools/a.ts` → `a.ts`, `vendor:@x/y` → `@x/y`. */
export function shortName(id: string): string {
  if (id.startsWith('vendor:')) return id.slice(7);
  const f = fileOf(id) ?? id;
  const m = /^(vendor\/[^/]+)\/index\.[cm]?[jt]sx?$/.exec(f);
  return m ? m[1]! : f.split('/').pop()!;
}

/** Core trace from a node, as drawable paths. A hop that crosses a current violation is marked so it can be red. */
export function traceFrom(graph: ContextGraph, from: string, violations: readonly Violation[]): { nodes: string[]; red: boolean[] }[] {
  return trace(graph, from).map((nodes) => ({
    nodes,
    red: nodes.map((n, i) => {
      if (!i) return false;
      const a = fileOf(nodes[i - 1]!);
      const b = fileOf(n);
      return violations.some((v) => v.file === a && (!v.target || v.target === b));
    }),
  }));
}
```

```text
// Tier 2 on the server (NAVIGATION_PLAN §3.1, N8): the semantic child process is fed from the bus (`repo_scanned` →
// full load, `facts_changed` → debounced per-file update) and its results come back as `facts_resolved` events, keyed
// by the file's content hash. Nothing here runs a model or blocks a hook. HARNESS_SEMANTIC=0 turns it off.
import {
  buildGraph, startSemantic,
  type ContextGraph, type DomainMap, type EventData, type FileFacts, type HarnessEvent, type SemanticFacts, type SemanticStatus,
} from '@harness/core';
import type { Bus } from './bus';
import type { Repo } from './repo';

/**
 * Current Tier 2 facts per file (only those whose hash matches the file's current Tier 1 facts), kept in step with
 * the bus. One per repo: the graph tools and the living map read the same store.
 */
export class SemanticStore {
  readonly facts: Record<string, SemanticFacts> = {};
  /** Bumped on every event that changes the facts the graph is built from. */
  version = 0;
  private graphCache: { version: number; map: DomainMap; graph: ContextGraph } | null = null;

  constructor(private repo: Repo, bus: Bus) {
    // Seed from the log since the last scan, so a store created mid-session agrees with the shell's reducer.
    const from = bus.events.findLastIndex((e) => e.kind === 'repo_scanned');
    for (const e of bus.events.slice(Math.max(0, from))) this.apply(e);
    bus.on((e) => this.apply(e));
  }

  private apply(e: HarnessEvent) {
    switch (e.kind) {
      case 'repo_scanned':
        for (const k of Object.keys(this.facts)) delete this.facts[k];
        break;
      case 'facts_changed': {
        const f = (e.data as EventData['facts_changed']).facts;
        const path = f?.path ?? e.path;
        if (path && this.facts[path] && this.facts[path]!.hash !== f?.hash) delete this.facts[path];
        break;
      }
      case 'facts_resolved': {
        const f = (e.data as EventData['facts_resolved']).facts;
        if (this.repo.fileFacts.get(f.path)?.hash !== f.hash) return;
        this.facts[f.path] = f;
        break;
      }
      case 'map_confirmed':
        break;
      default:
        return;
    }
    this.version++;
  }

  /** Tier 1 facts with Tier 2 calls swapped in where current (what buildGraph does), for consumers of FileFacts. */
  merged(): Record<string, FileFacts> {
    const out: Record<string, FileFacts> = {};
    for (const [path, f] of this.repo.fileFacts) {
      const s = this.facts[path];
      out[path] = s && s.hash === f.hash ? { ...f, calls: s.calls } : f;
    }
    return out;
  }

  /** The same graph the shell projects (`buildGraph(map, facts, semantic)`), rebuilt only after a change. */
  graph(): ContextGraph {
    const c = this.graphCache;
    if (c && c.version === this.version && c.map === this.repo.map) return c.graph;
    const graph = buildGraph(this.repo.map, Object.fromEntries(this.repo.fileFacts), this.facts);
    this.graphCache = { version: this.version, map: this.repo.map, graph };
    return graph;
  }
```

```typescript
// Badges a node carries on its top-right edge, next to the plan step numbers. One component so every node kind (cell,
// spine, container, file, module, symbol, group) shows the same marks at every depth.
//
// Extension point for other lanes (overlays/panels): push a renderer onto `badgeSlots`; it receives the visible node
// and the zoom bucket and returns a badge or null. Keep badges small (≤ 20 px tall) and pure (no store writes).
import type { ReactNode } from 'react';
import type { VisibleNode } from '@harness/core/view';
import { useView } from '../derive';
import type { Lod } from './nodes';

export type BadgeSlot = (n: VisibleNode, lod: Lod) => ReactNode;
export const badgeSlots: BadgeSlot[] = [];

/** "DR-4" on code a standing decision protects, when the turn's plan or edits touch it (beat 4). Decision ink, a shield. */
export function DecisionMarks({ ids, compact = false }: { ids: string[]; compact?: boolean }) {
  const ui = useView().ui;
  if (!ids.length) return null;
  const title = ids.map((id) => {
    const d = ui.decisions.find((x) => x.id === id);
    return `Touches what ${id} protects${d ? `: ${d.title}` : ''}`;
  }).join('\n');
  return (
    <span className="v2-drmarks" title={title} aria-label={title}>
      {ids.map((id) => (
        <span key={id} className="v2-drmark">
          <svg viewBox="0 0 12 14" width="11" height="13" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M6 0.6 11.2 2.6v4.1c0 3.1-2.2 5.6-5.2 6.7C3 12.3 0.8 9.8 0.8 6.7V2.6Z" /></svg>
          {!compact && id}
        </span>
      ))}
    </span>
  );
}

export function NodeBadges({ n, lod, compact = false }: { n: VisibleNode; lod: Lod; compact?: boolean }) {
  const extra = badgeSlots.map((slot, i) => <span key={i}>{slot(n, lod)}</span>);
  if (!n.rollup.touchedDecisions.length && !badgeSlots.length) return null;
  return (
    <span className="v2-badges">
      <DecisionMarks ids={n.rollup.touchedDecisions} compact={compact} />
      {extra}
    </span>
  );
}
```

You're right that it's the stronger moment: plain Claude Code makes the reasonable change and silently breaks the 10-K summaries, while the Interpretability session makes the same request and keeps them working. That's your funnel story on screen. The micromanagement worry is solvable: almost all of it can be scripted, and you don't have to record both sides at once.

**Make setup one command.** Run `npm run demo -- --compare`, starting from your beat-3 checkpoint. It would:
1. make two copies of the checkpoint: `../scout-run` for Interpretability and `../scout-cc` for plain Claude Code;
2. start both Scout apps (:8788 and :8789) and Interpretability, all in that one terminal;
3. open one extra Terminal window already running plain Claude Code in `../scout-cc`. It runs in safe mode (no Alike), with edits auto-accepted so there are no approval prompts, on the same model.

Ctrl+C in the main terminal stops the servers; you close the Claude Code window. Your only jobs are pasting the prompt in two places and clicking "Start research" in two browser tabs.

**Record the two sides one after the other**, not at once. This is what really removes the juggling:
- **Take A (one terminal on screen):** paste "Can we redact every long number?" into plain Claude Code. Let it finish, then start a Symbotic run in its Scout tab (:8789). The 10-K step comes back as `$[PHONE_1]`.
- **Take B (browser only):** the same prompt in Interpretability. DR-4 lights up and the change is scoped. Run Symbotic in :8788, and the 10-K step shows real figures.
- **In the edit:** put A and B side by side, sped up equally, ending on the two 10-K results next to each other.
- **Say:** "Same request, same model. Plain Claude Code made a reasonable change and broke a feature nobody was looking at. With the decision on the map, it didn't."

**Two things to know:**
- **It might not break.** The plain Claude Code copy contains `decisions/DR-4.md` and the beat-3 test. Stock Claude Code might read the decision or run the tests and avoid the breakage. That's fair to keep either way, but rehearse it twice. If it reliably avoids the trap, the beat becomes "it only worked because it happened to read the file", which is weaker.
- **Cost:** each side's research run takes about 75 seconds and a few cents. The Symbotic runs can happen in both tabs at once while you're not recording.

```bash
function domainPaths(map: DomainMap, domainId: string, expand: (glob: string) => string[], files?: readonly string[]): string[] {
  const d = map.domains.find((x) => x.id === domainId);
```

```typescript
// Shared bits for world-space overlay layers: a constant on-screen size factor, the spotlight wash, and labels that stay
// readable at any zoom.
import { useId } from 'react';
import { useStore as useFlow } from '@xyflow/react';
import type { Box } from '../layout/containers';
import { padBox } from './geometry';

/** World units per screen pixel at the current zoom (clamped, so labels never balloon when zoomed far out). */
export const useInv = () => useFlow((s) => 1 / Math.max(s.transform[2], 0.25));

/** Dims everything except `holes` (the boxes a journey or trace passes through). */
export function Spotlight({ bounds, holes }: { bounds: Box; holes: Box[] }) {
  const id = useId().replace(/:/g, '');
  const b = padBox(bounds, 400);
  return (
    <g className="ov-spotlight" aria-hidden="true">
      <mask id={`ov-m-${id}`} maskUnits="userSpaceOnUse" x={b.x} y={b.y} width={b.w} height={b.h}>
        <rect x={b.x} y={b.y} width={b.w} height={b.h} fill="white" />
        {holes.map((h, i) => {
          const p = padBox(h, 4);
          return <rect key={i} x={p.x} y={p.y} width={p.w} height={p.h} rx={4} fill="black" />;
        })}
      </mask>
      <rect x={b.x} y={b.y} width={b.w} height={b.h} className="ov-wash" mask={`url(#ov-m-${id})`} />
    </g>
  );
}

/** A pill label centred on (x, y), at about `px` screen pixels. */
export function Tag({ x, y, text, inv, px = 13, className = '', onClick, title }: { x: number; y: number; text: string; inv: number; px?: number; className?: string; onClick?: () => void; title?: string }) {
  const fs = px * inv;
  const w = text.length * fs * 0.56 + 18 * inv;
  const h = fs + 12 * inv;
  return (
    <g className={`ov-tag ${className} ${onClick ? 'is-click' : ''}`} transform={`translate(${(x - w / 2).toFixed(1)},${(y - h / 2).toFixed(1)})`} onClick={onClick ? (e) => { e.stopPropagation(); onClick(); } : undefined}>
      {title && <title>{title}</title>}
      <rect width={w} height={h} rx={h / 2} />
      <text x={w / 2} y={h / 2} dy="0.35em" textAnchor="middle" style={{ fontSize: fs }}>{text}</text>
    </g>
  );
}
```

```typescript
// The overlays' camera: fit a box (a journey, a trace) or reveal one (the playback's current stop), leaving room for
// the drawer, the inspector and the player. Moves only when asked; never loops.
import { useCallback } from 'react';
import { useReactFlow, useStoreApi } from '@xyflow/react';
import { useStore } from '../../store';
import type { Box } from '../layout/containers';
import { reducedMotion } from '../transition';
import { useOverlay } from './state';

const DRAWER = 344;

function insets() {
  return {
    top: 112,
    left: 96 + (useOverlay.getState().panel ? DRAWER : 0),
    right: 28 + (useStore.getState().selection ? 400 : 0),
    bottom: 104,
  };
}

export function useCamera() {
  const rf = useReactFlow();
  const store = useStoreApi();
  const fit = useCallback((b: Box, maxZoom = 1.1) => {
    const { width: W, height: H } = store.getState();
    if (!W || !H) return;
    const ins = insets();
    const aw = Math.max(80, W - ins.left - ins.right);
    const ah = Math.max(80, H - ins.top - ins.bottom);
    const zoom = Math.max(0.12, Math.min(maxZoom, aw / b.w, ah / b.h));
    void rf.setViewport({ zoom, x: ins.left + (aw - b.w * zoom) / 2 - b.x * zoom, y: ins.top + (ah - b.h * zoom) / 2 - b.y * zoom }, { duration: reducedMotion() ? 0 : 520, interpolate: 'smooth' });
  }, [rf, store]);
  /** Pan (same zoom) only if `b` is not already comfortably on screen. */
  const reveal = useCallback((b: Box) => {
    const { width: W, height: H, transform: [tx, ty, k] } = store.getState();
    if (!W || !H) return;
    const ins = insets();
    const sx = b.x * k + tx;
    const sy = b.y * k + ty;
    const inside = sx >= ins.left && sy >= ins.top && sx + b.w * k <= W - ins.right && sy + b.h * k <= H - ins.bottom;
    if (inside) return;
    const cx = ins.left + (W - ins.left - ins.right) / 2;
    const cy = ins.top + (H - ins.top - ins.bottom) / 2;
    void rf.setViewport({ zoom: k, x: cx - (b.x + b.w / 2) * k, y: cy - (b.y + b.h / 2) * k }, { duration: reducedMotion() ? 0 : 420, interpolate: 'smooth' });
  }, [rf, store]);
  return { fit, reveal };
}
```

```typescript
// Beat 1: a journey drawn over the map at any level. Numbered stops on the path's visible nodes, the segment into a
// dispatch or inferred step dashed, the registry hub labelled "via registry", branches leaving at their step, and
// step-by-step playback (the stops up to the current step are lit; the rest wait in outline).
import { useMemo } from 'react';
import type { ContextGraph, DomainMap, Journey } from '@harness/core/view';
import type { Frame } from '../layout/frame';
import { boxOf, centre, link, unionBox, type Pt } from './geometry';
import { journeyStops, stepCaption, stopOf, type Stop } from './journey';
import { useOverlay } from './state';
import { Spotlight, Tag, useInv } from './svg';

const range = (s: number[]) => (s.length === 1 ? `${s[0]! + 1}` : `${s[0]! + 1}–${s.at(-1)! + 1}`);

export function useJourneyStops(j: Journey | null, graph: ContextGraph | null, frame: Frame) {
  return useMemo(() => (j && graph ? journeyStops(j, graph, frame) : []), [j, graph, frame]);
}

export function JourneyLayer({ j, graph, frame, map }: { j: Journey; graph: ContextGraph; frame: Frame; map: DomainMap | null }) {
  const step = useOverlay((s) => s.step);
  const setStep = useOverlay((s) => s.setStep);
  const inv = useInv();
  const stops = useJourneyStops(j, graph, frame);
  const at = Math.max(0, stopOf(stops, step));

  const branches = useMemo(() => {
    const seen = new Set<string>();
    const out: { from: number; boxes: ReturnType<typeof boxOf>[]; label: string }[] = [];
    for (const b of j.branches) {
      const k = stopOf(stops, b.from);
      if (k < 0) continue;
      const boxes = b.steps.map((n) => boxOf(frame, graph, n)).filter((x, i, a): x is NonNullable<typeof x> => !!x && x.id !== a[i - 1]?.id && x.id !== stops[k]!.node);
      if (!boxes.length) continue;
      const key = `${k}|${boxes.map((x) => x!.id).join('>')}`;
      if (seen.has(key)) continue;
      seen.add(key);
      const last = b.steps.at(-1)!;
      out.push({ from: k, boxes, label: graph.nodes[last]?.label ?? last });
    }
    return out;
  }, [j, stops, frame, graph]);

  if (!stops.length) return null;
  const bounds = unionBox([frame.bounds, ...stops.map((s) => s.box)])!;
  const holes = [...stops.filter((s) => !s.waypoint).map((s) => s.box), ...branches.flatMap((b) => b.boxes.map((x) => x!))];
  const cur = stops[at]!;
  const cap = stepCaption(j, step, graph, map);

  return (
    <svg className="ov-svg" width={1} height={1}>
      <Spotlight bounds={bounds} holes={holes} />
      {branches.map((b, i) => {
        const chain = [stops[b.from]!.box, ...b.boxes.map((x) => x!)];
        const active = b.from <= at;
        const end = centre(chain.at(-1)!);
        return (
          <g key={i} className={`ov-branch ${b.from === at ? 'is-now' : ''} ${active ? '' : 'is-later'}`}>
            {chain.slice(1).map((bx, k) => <path key={k} d={link(chain[k]!, bx, -10).d} />)}
            {b.from === at && <Tag x={end.x} y={chain.at(-1)!.y + chain.at(-1)!.h + 14 * inv} text={b.label} inv={inv} px={11} className="is-branch" />}
          </g>
        );
      })}
      {stops.slice(1).map((s, k) => {
        const prev = stops[k]!;
        const lit = k + 1 <= at;
        const l = link(prev.box, s.box);
        return <path key={k} d={l.d} className={`ov-jseg ${lit ? 'is-lit' : ''} ${s.weak ? 'is-weak' : ''} ${k + 1 === at ? 'is-now' : ''}`} />;
      })}
      {stops.map((s, k) => <StopMark key={k} s={s} k={k} at={at} inv={inv} j={j} graph={graph} map={map} onPick={() => setStep(s.steps[0]!)} />)}
      <Caption p={{ x: cur.box.x + cur.box.w / 2, y: cur.box.y + cur.box.h }} inv={inv} title={`${step + 1}. ${cap.title}`} sub={cap.sub} />
    </svg>
  );
}

function StopMark({ s, k, at, inv, j, graph, map, onPick }: { s: Stop; k: number; at: number; inv: number; j: Journey; graph: ContextGraph; map: DomainMap | null; onPick: () => void }) {
  const state = k < at ? 'is-done' : k === at ? 'is-now' : 'is-later';
  const r = 13 * inv;
  if (s.waypoint) {
    const c = centre(s.box);
    const cap = stepCaption(j, s.steps[0]!, graph, map);
    return (
      <g className={`ov-waypoint ${state} ${s.hub ? 'is-hub' : ''}`} onClick={(e) => { e.stopPropagation(); onPick(); }}>
        <title>{`${range(s.steps)}. ${cap.title} · ${cap.sub}`}</title>
        {s.hub
          ? <rect x={c.x - r} y={c.y - r} width={2 * r} height={2 * r} transform={`rotate(45 ${c.x} ${c.y})`} />
          : <circle cx={c.x} cy={c.y} r={r} />}
        <text x={c.x} y={c.y} dy="0.35em" textAnchor="middle" style={{ fontSize: 12 * inv }}>{range(s.steps)}</text>
        <Tag x={c.x} y={c.y - r - 13 * inv} text={s.hub ? 'via registry' : cap.title} inv={inv} px={12} className={s.hub ? 'is-hub' : 'is-quiet'} />
      </g>
    );
  }
  const label = range(s.steps);
  const w = Math.max(2 * r, label.length * 8 * inv + 12 * inv);
  const p: Pt = { x: s.box.x + 8 * inv, y: s.box.y - r };
  return (
    <g className={`ov-stop ${state}`} onClick={(e) => { e.stopPropagation(); onPick(); }}>
      <rect className="ov-stop-ring" x={s.box.x - 3} y={s.box.y - 3} width={s.box.w + 6} height={s.box.h + 6} rx={5} />
      <rect className="ov-stop-num" x={p.x} y={p.y} width={w} height={2 * r} rx={r} />
      <text x={p.x + w / 2} y={p.y + r} dy="0.35em" textAnchor="middle" style={{ fontSize: 13 * inv }}>{label}</text>
    </g>
  );
}

function Caption({ p, inv, title, sub }: { p: Pt; inv: number; title: string; sub: string }) {
  const fs = 14 * inv;
  const w = Math.max(title.length, sub.length * 0.86) * fs * 0.55 + 24 * inv;
  const h = 46 * inv;
  return (
    <g className="ov-caption" transform={`translate(${(p.x - w / 2).toFixed(1)},${(p.y + 10 * inv).toFixed(1)})`}>
      <rect width={w} height={h} rx={6 * inv} />
      <text x={12 * inv} y={18 * inv} style={{ fontSize: fs }} className="ov-caption-title">{title}</text>
      <text x={12 * inv} y={36 * inv} style={{ fontSize: fs * 0.82 }} className="ov-caption-sub">{sub}</text>
    </g>
  );
}
```

```bash
export function recordProtects(repo: Repo, bus: Bus, turnId: string): { id: string; protects: Protects }[] {
```

```text
/** Index helpers over a projection: visible nodes by id, drawn nodes, columns (memoized per projection). */
export function indexOf(p: Projection) {
  let ix = indexes.get(p);
  if (!ix) indexes.set(p, (ix = buildIndex(p)));
  return ix;
}

function buildIndex(p: Projection) {
  const byId = new Map(p.nodes.map((n) => [n.id, n]));
  const showUnassigned = (() => {
    const u = byId.get(UNASSIGNED);
    return !!u && (u.rollup.leaves > 0 || u.expanded);
  })();
  /** The expanded file a symbol row sits in (rows nest under classes, which are not containers). */
  const moduleOf = (id: string): string | null => {
    for (let x = byId.get(byId.get(id)?.parent ?? ''); x; x = byId.get(x.parent ?? '')) if (x.kind === 'file' && x.expanded) return x.id;
    return null;
  };
  const drawn = (id: string) => {
    const n = byId.get(id);
    if (!n) return false;
    if (n.kind === 'cell') return true;
    if (id === UNASSIGNED) return showUnassigned;
    return isContainer(byId.get(n.parent ?? '')) || (n.kind === 'symbol' && moduleOf(id) !== null && drawnModule(moduleOf(id)!));
  };
  const drawnModule = (file: string): boolean => drawn(file);
  const drawnMemo = new Map<string, boolean>();
  const drawnCached = (id: string) => { let d = drawnMemo.get(id); if (d === undefined) drawnMemo.set(id, (d = drawn(id))); return d; };
  /** Column id of a node: its domain, or the Unassigned column. */
  const colId = (id: string): string | null => {
    const n = byId.get(id);
    if (!n) return null;
    if (n.domain) return n.domain;
    for (let x: VisibleNode | undefined = n; x; x = byId.get(x.parent ?? '')) if (x.id === UNASSIGNED) return UNASSIGNED_COL;
    return null;
  };
  /** ELK containers above a node, innermost first. */
  const containers = (id: string): string[] => {
    const out: string[] = [];
    for (let x = byId.get(byId.get(id)?.parent ?? ''); x; x = byId.get(x.parent ?? '')) if (isContainer(x)) out.push(x.id);
    return out;
  };
  return { byId, drawn: drawnCached, colId, containers, showUnassigned, moduleOf };
}

/** Expanded containers, deepest first (the bottom-up layout order). */
export function containerOrder(p: Projection): string[][] {
  const levels = new Map<number, string[]>();
  for (const n of p.nodes) if (isContainer(n)) (levels.get(n.depth) ?? levels.set(n.depth, []).get(n.depth)!).push(n.id);
  return [...levels].sort((a, b) => b[0] - a[0]).map(([, ids]) => ids);
}
  region: readonly string[] | null;
  key: string;
};

export function buildFrame({ projection: p, meta, layouts, region, key }: FrameInput): Frame {
  const ix = indexOf(p);
  const cells = p.nodes.filter((n) => n.kind === 'cell');
  const openCol = new Set(cells.filter((n) => n.expanded).map((n) => n.domain!));
  const unassigned = ix.byId.get(UNASSIGNED);
  if (ix.showUnassigned && unassigned?.expanded) openCol.add(UNASSIGNED_COL);
  const any = openCol.size > 0;
  const dmeta = new Map(meta.domains.map((d) => [d.id, d]));
  const lmeta = new Map(meta.layers.map((l) => [l.id, l]));

  // ---- tracks
  const colIds = [...p.grid.domains, ...(ix.showUnassigned ? [UNASSIGNED_COL] : [])];
  const cols: Col[] = [];
  let x = 0;
  colIds.forEach((id, i) => {
    const open = openCol.has(id);
    let w = open ? COL_W : any ? SPINE_W : COL_W;
    if (open) {
      for (const c of cells) if (c.domain === id && c.expanded) w = Math.max(w, layouts.get(c.id)?.w ?? 0);
      if (id === UNASSIGNED_COL) w = Math.max(w, layouts.get(UNASSIGNED)?.w ?? 0);
      w = up(w);
    }
    const d = dmeta.get(id);
    cols.push({ id, name: d?.name ?? (id === UNASSIGNED_COL ? 'Unassigned' : id), purpose: d?.purpose ?? 'Files that match no cell in domains.yaml', x, w, spine: any && !open, open, index: i });
    x += w + GAP_X;
  });
  const rows: Row[] = [];
  let y = 0;
  for (const l of p.grid.layers) {
    let h = any ? ROW_H_SPINE : ROW_H;
    for (const c of cells) if (c.layer === l && c.expanded) h = Math.max(h, up(layouts.get(c.id)?.h ?? 0));
    rows.push({ id: l, name: lmeta.get(l)?.name ?? l, y, h });
    y += h + GAP_Y;
  }
  const width = Math.max(0, x - GAP_X);
  const height = Math.max(0, y - GAP_Y);
  const colOf = new Map(cols.map((c) => [c.id, c]));
  const rowOf = new Map(rows.map((r, j) => [r.id, { ...r, index: j }]));

  // ---- boxes: bands and grid cells, then container children (parents before children: projection pre-order)
  const nodes: FrameNode[] = [];
  const boxes: Record<string, FrameNode> = {};
  const add = (n: FrameNode) => { nodes.push(n); boxes[n.id] = n; };
  let focus: Box | null = null;
  for (const c of cols) {
    if (!c.open) continue;
    const id = c.id === UNASSIGNED_COL ? `band:${UNASSIGNED}` : `domain:${c.id}`;
    const b = { x: c.x - 14, y: -14, w: c.w + 28, h: height + 28 };
    add({ id, type: 'band', z: 0, ...b });
    focus = focus ? union(focus, b) : b;
  }
  for (const n of p.nodes) {
    if (n.kind === 'cell') {
      const c = colOf.get(n.domain!)!;
      const r = rowOf.get(n.layer!)!;
      add({ id: n.id, type: n.expanded ? 'container' : c.spine ? 'spine' : 'cell', z: 1, x: c.x, y: r.y, w: c.w, h: r.h });
    } else if (n.id === UNASSIGNED && ix.showUnassigned) {
      const c = colOf.get(UNASSIGNED_COL)!;
      const h = n.expanded ? Math.max(height, layouts.get(UNASSIGNED)?.h ?? 0) : height;
      add({ id: n.id, type: n.expanded ? 'container' : c.spine ? 'spine' : 'cell', z: 1, x: c.x, y: 0, w: c.w, h });
    } else if (ix.drawn(n.id)) {
      const host = layouts.get(n.parent!)?.nodes[n.id] ? n.parent! : ix.moduleOf(n.id);
      const parent = host ? boxes[host] : undefined;
      const b = host ? layouts.get(host)?.nodes[n.id] : undefined;
      if (!parent || !b) continue;
      const type: NodeType = n.kind === 'symbol' ? 'symbol' : n.kind === 'file' ? (n.expanded ? 'module' : 'file') : isContainer(n) ? 'container' : n.kind === 'group' ? 'group' : 'chip';
      add({ id: n.id, type, z: n.depth, x: parent.x + b.x, y: parent.y + b.y, w: b.w, h: b.h });
    }
  }

  // ---- gutters and lanes
  const colGutter = (g: number) => (g <= 0 ? -GAP_X / 2 : cols[g - 1]!.x + cols[g - 1]!.w + GAP_X / 2);
  const rowGutter = (g: number) => (g <= 0 ? -GAP_Y / 2 : rows[g - 1]!.y + rows[g - 1]!.h + GAP_Y / 2);
  const used = new Map<string, number>();
  const take = (k: string) => { const n = used.get(k) ?? 0; used.set(k, n + 1); return n; };
  const lane = (i: number, s: number) => (i === 0 ? 0 : (i % 2 ? 1 : -1) * Math.ceil(i / 2) * s);
```

```typescript
    const seen: string[] = [];
    for (const e of bus.events) if (!seen.includes(e.session)) seen.push(e.session);
    return seen.indexOf(first.session) + 1;
  }
  return rec.session ?? null;
}

/** Insert or replace top-level keys in a DR file's front matter, keeping the body as written. */
function setFrontMatter(path: string, fields: Record<string, unknown>) {
  const text = readFileSync(path, 'utf8');
  const m = /^---\n([\s\S]*?)\n---\n?([\s\S]*)$/.exec(text);
  if (!m) return;
  const fm = { ...(parseYaml(m[1]!) as Record<string, unknown>), ...fields };
  writeFileSync(path, `---\n${stringifyYaml(fm).trim()}\n---\n${m[2]!.startsWith('\n') ? '' : '\n'}${m[2]}`);
}

/**
 * Beat 4: when the turn that made decisions ends, record what each one protects (`protectsFor` in core: the files and
 * symbols the turn built for the chosen option, plus its tests), write `protects:` into decisions/DR-n.md, commit only
 * those files, and re-emit `decision_recorded { …, protects }`. A decision already carrying `protects`, or whose turn
 * built nothing, is left alone. Returns the decisions updated.
 */
export function recordProtects(repo: Repo, bus: Bus, turnId: string): { id: string; protects: Protects }[] {
  const ui = reduce(bus.events);
  const turn = ui.turns.find((t) => t.id === turnId);
  if (!turn?.decisions.length) return [];
  const records = new Map(listDecisions(repo.root).map((d) => [d.id, d]));
  const done: { id: string; protects: Protects }[] = [];
  for (const id of turn.decisions) {
    const dec = ui.decisions.find((d) => d.id === id);
    const rec = records.get(id);
    if (!dec || !rec || rec.protects) continue;
    const protects = protectsFor(turn.paths, { paths: dec.paths, option: dec.option }, repo.mapper);
    if (!protects.paths.length) continue;
    setFrontMatter(join(repo.root, 'decisions', `${id}.md`), { protects });
    done.push({ id, protects });
  }
  if (!done.length) return [];
  const paths = done.map((d) => `decisions/${d.id}.md`);
  try { commitPaths(repo.root, paths, `docs(decisions): what ${done.map((d) => d.id).join(', ')} protect${done.length > 1 ? '' : 's'}`); }
  catch (e) { bus.emit('error', { message: `Could not commit ${paths.join(', ')}: ${(e as Error).message}` }); }
  for (const { id, protects } of done) {
    const prev = bus.events.findLast((e) => e.kind === 'decision_recorded' && (e.data as { id: string }).id === id);
    if (prev) bus.emit('decision_recorded', { ...(prev.data as EventData['decision_recorded']), protects }, { turn: turnId });
  }
  return done;
}
```

```typescript
// Beat 1's "the risky part is drawn, not described": every path to the model provider at once, in three classes —
// through the gateway (the design: quiet indigo), crossing a rule (red), and calling the provider SDK outside the
// gateway without breaking one (amber, "uncosted") — converging on one Claude pin. Also core `trace` from one node.
import { useMemo } from 'react';
import type { ContextGraph, DomainMap, ProviderPath, ProviderPathClass, Violation } from '@harness/core/view';
import type { Frame } from '../layout/frame';
import type { Box } from '../layout/containers';
import { boxOf, centre, link, unionBox } from './geometry';
import { useOverlay } from './state';
import { Spotlight, Tag, useInv } from './svg';
import { pathsToProvider, shortName, traceFrom } from './trace';

const LANE: Record<ProviderPathClass, number> = { gateway: 0, violation: 9, uncosted: -9 };
const PIN = { w: 200, h: 56 };

/** The provider pin: under the gateway column, below the last row (the map keeps its geometry; the pin is overlay-only). */
export function pinBox(frame: Frame, map: DomainMap): Box {
  const via = map.invariants.find((i) => i.kind === 'only_via');
  const gw = via?.kind === 'only_via' ? via.allowed_from[0] : undefined;
  const col = frame.cols.find((c) => c.id === gw) ?? frame.cols.at(-1)!;
  const row = frame.rows.at(-1)!;
  return { x: col.x + col.w / 2 - PIN.w / 2, y: row.y + row.h + 64, ...PIN };
}

type Drawn = { cls: ProviderPathClass; boxes: Box[]; ids: string; callers: string[]; invariant?: string };

/** Each path as a chain of drawn boxes ending at the pin; paths with the same chain merge (their callers listed). */
export function drawnPaths(paths: readonly ProviderPath[], graph: ContextGraph, frame: Frame, pin: Box): Drawn[] {
  const out = new Map<string, Drawn>();
  for (const p of paths) {
    const boxes: (Box & { id: string })[] = [];
    for (const n of p.nodes) {
      const b = boxOf(frame, graph, n);
      if (b && b.id !== boxes.at(-1)?.id) boxes.push(b);
    }
    const ids = `${p.class}|${boxes.map((b) => b.id).join('>')}`;
    const caller = shortName(p.nodes[0]!);
    const cur = out.get(ids);
    if (cur) { if (!cur.callers.includes(caller)) cur.callers.push(caller); continue; }
    out.set(ids, { cls: p.class, boxes: [...boxes, pin], ids, callers: [caller], ...(p.invariant ? { invariant: p.invariant } : {}) });
  }
  return [...out.values()];
}

const CLASS_TAG: Record<ProviderPathClass, (d: Drawn) => string> = {
  gateway: () => 'through the gateway',
  violation: (d) => `${d.invariant ?? 'rule'} · ${d.callers.join(', ')} · unredacted`,
  uncosted: (d) => `uncosted · ${d.callers.join(', ')}`,
};

export function ProviderTraceLayer({ graph, frame, map, violations }: { graph: ContextGraph; frame: Frame; map: DomainMap; violations: readonly Violation[] }) {
  const inv = useInv();
  const focus = useOverlay((s) => s.traceClass);
  const setFocus = useOverlay((s) => s.setTraceClass);
  const pin = pinBox(frame, map);
  const drawn = useMemo(() => drawnPaths(pathsToProvider(graph, map, violations), graph, frame, pin), [graph, map, violations, frame, pin.x, pin.y]); // eslint-disable-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps
  if (!drawn.length) return null;
  const holes = [...new Map(drawn.flatMap((d) => d.boxes).map((b) => [`${b.x},${b.y}`, b])).values()];
  const bounds = unionBox([frame.bounds, pin])!;
  // quiet first, so red and amber sit on top
  const order = [...drawn].sort((a, b) => (a.cls === 'gateway' ? -1 : 0) - (b.cls === 'gateway' ? -1 : 0));
  const pc = centre(pin);
  const classes = new Set(drawn.map((d) => d.cls));
  return (
    <svg className="ov-svg" width={1} height={1}>
      <Spotlight bounds={bounds} holes={holes} />
      {order.map((d) => {
        const dim = focus && focus !== d.cls;
        const segs = d.boxes.slice(1).map((b, k) => link(d.boxes[k]!, b, LANE[d.cls]));
        const first = segs[0]!;
        return (
          <g key={d.ids} className={`ov-ppath is-${d.cls} ${dim ? 'is-dim' : ''}`} onClick={(e) => { e.stopPropagation(); setFocus(focus === d.cls ? null : d.cls); }}>
            {segs.map((s, k) => <path key={k} className="ov-ppath-hit" d={s.d} />)}
            {segs.map((s, k) => <path key={`l${k}`} className="ov-ppath-line" d={s.d} markerEnd={k === segs.length - 1 ? `url(#ov-arrow-${d.cls})` : undefined} />)}
            <circle className="ov-ppath-dot" cx={first.from.x} cy={first.from.y} r={5 * inv} />
            {!dim && <Tag x={first.mid.x} y={first.mid.y - 4 * inv} text={CLASS_TAG[d.cls](d)} inv={inv} px={12} className={`is-${d.cls}`} />}
          </g>
        );
      })}
      <defs>
        {(['gateway', 'violation', 'uncosted'] as const).map((k) => (
          <marker key={k} id={`ov-arrow-${k}`} viewBox="0 0 10 10" refX="9" refY="5" markerWidth="7" markerHeight="7" orient="auto-start-reverse">
            <path d="M0,1 L9,5 L0,9 z" className={`ov-arrowhead is-${k}`} />
          </marker>
        ))}
      </defs>
      <g className="ov-pin">
        <rect x={pin.x} y={pin.y} width={pin.w} height={pin.h} rx={pin.h / 2} />
        <text x={pc.x} y={pc.y - 6} textAnchor="middle" className="ov-pin-title">Claude</text>
        <text x={pc.x} y={pc.y + 14} textAnchor="middle" className="ov-pin-sub">{classes.size === 1 ? 'one way in' : `${classes.size} ways in · the design says 1`}</text>
      </g>
    </svg>
  );
}

/** Core trace from one node: indigo chains to their sinks; a hop that crosses a current rule is red. */
export function FromTraceLayer({ graph, frame, from, violations }: { graph: ContextGraph; frame: Frame; from: string; violations: readonly Violation[] }) {
  const inv = useInv();
  const paths = useMemo(() => traceFrom(graph, from, violations), [graph, from, violations]);
  const chains = useMemo(() => paths.map((p) => {
    const boxes: { b: Box & { id: string }; red: boolean }[] = [];
    p.nodes.forEach((n, i) => {
      const b = boxOf(frame, graph, n);
      if (!b) return;
      if (b.id === boxes.at(-1)?.b.id) { if (p.red[i]) boxes.at(-1)!.red = true; return; }
      boxes.push({ b, red: p.red[i]! });
    });
    return { boxes, sink: p.nodes.at(-1)! };
  }), [paths, frame, graph]);
  const start = boxOf(frame, graph, from);
  if (!start) return null;
  const holes = [start, ...chains.flatMap((c) => c.boxes.map((x) => x.b))];
  return (
    <svg className="ov-svg" width={1} height={1}>
      <Spotlight bounds={frame.bounds} holes={holes} />
      {chains.map((c, i) => (
        <g key={i} className="ov-tpath">
          {c.boxes.slice(1).map((x, k) => <path key={k} className={`ov-tpath-line ${x.red ? 'is-red' : ''}`} d={link(c.boxes[k]!.b, x.b, (i - (chains.length - 1) / 2) * 6).d} />)}
          {c.boxes.length > 0 && <Tag x={centre(c.boxes.at(-1)!.b).x} y={c.boxes.at(-1)!.b.y + c.boxes.at(-1)!.b.h + (14 + 22 * i) * inv} text={`→ ${shortName(c.sink)}`} inv={inv} px={11} className="is-quiet" />}
        </g>
      ))}
      <rect className="ov-tstart" x={start.x - 4} y={start.y - 4} width={start.w + 8} height={start.h + 8} rx={5} />
    </svg>
  );
}
```

```typescript
// Beat 5: what a pending cartographer proposal would change, for the candidate being previewed. The chosen candidate's
// changes come with the proposal; the others are diffed here (pure: parse the candidate's yaml, diffMaps against the map).
import { describeScores, diffMaps, parseDomainMap, summarizeChanges, type DomainMap, type MapScore, type ProposalChange, type ProposalState, type UIState } from '@harness/core/view';

export type Preview = {
  state: ProposalState;
  index: number; // candidate index previewed (−1 for a manual proposal with no candidate)
  changes: ProposalChange[];
  map: DomainMap | null; // the candidate map (null when manual)
  score: MapScore | null;
  scoreLine: string | null;
  summary: string;
};

export function pendingProposals(ui: UIState): ProposalState[] {
  return Object.values(ui.proposals).filter((p) => p.status === 'pending').sort((a, b) => b.at - a.at);
}

const cache = new Map<string, { map: DomainMap; changes: ProposalChange[] } | null>();

export function previewOf(ui: UIState, state: ProposalState, pick: number | undefined): Preview {
  const p = state.proposal;
  if (!p.candidates.length) {
    return { state, index: -1, changes: p.changes, map: null, score: null, scoreLine: null, summary: summarizeChanges(p.changes) };
  }
  const index = pick !== undefined && p.candidates[pick] ? pick : p.chosen;
  const cand = p.candidates[index]!;
  let changes = p.changes;
  let map: DomainMap | null = null;
  const key = `${p.id}#${index}`;
  let hit = cache.get(key);
  if (hit === undefined) {
    try {
      const m = parseDomainMap(cand.yaml);
      hit = { map: m, changes: index === p.chosen || !ui.map ? p.changes : diffMaps(ui.map, m, Object.keys(ui.files)) };
    } catch { hit = null; }
    cache.set(key, hit);
  }
  if (hit) { map = hit.map; changes = hit.changes; }
  return { state, index, changes, map, score: cand.score, scoreLine: describeScores(p.current, cand.score), summary: summarizeChanges(changes) };
}

/** Rule changes as badges: id and what happens to it. */
export function ruleBadges(changes: readonly ProposalChange[]): { id: string; text: string; kind: 'add' | 'change' | 'retire' }[] {
  return changes.flatMap((c) => {
    if (c.kind === 'add_rule') return [{ id: c.invariant, text: c.rule, kind: 'add' as const }];
    if (c.kind === 'change_rule') return [{ id: c.invariant, text: c.rule, kind: 'change' as const }];
    if (c.kind === 'retire_rule') return [{ id: c.invariant, text: 'retired', kind: 'retire' as const }];
    return [];
  });
}
```

```bash
/**
 * Beat 1: the system at a glance, deterministic. Domains (purpose, files per layer, tables), cross-domain import edges
 * with counts, current rule violations, and every path to a model provider classified as through the gateway, a rule
 * violation, or uncosted (`providerPaths` in core). Paths are repo paths, so the user can click them.
 */
export function overviewText(g: ContextGraph, map: DomainMap, facts: Facts, mapper: Mapper, violations: readonly Violation[]): string {
  const name = (id: string) => map.domains.find((d) => d.id === id)?.name ?? id;
  const lines: string[] = [`${map.domains.length} domains × ${map.layers.length} layers (${map.layers.map((l) => l.id).join(', ')}); ${facts.files.length} files.`, '', 'Domains:'];
  for (const d of map.domains) {
    const byLayer = new Map<string, number>();
    for (const f of facts.files) {
      const p = mapper.place(f);
      if (p.kind === 'cell' && p.domain === d.id) byLayer.set(p.layer, (byLayer.get(p.layer) ?? 0) + 1);
    }
    const n = [...byLayer.values()].reduce((a, b) => a + b, 0);
    const layers = map.layers.filter((l) => byLayer.has(l.id)).map((l) => `${l.id} ${byLayer.get(l.id)}`).join(', ');
    const tables = Object.values(d.cells).flatMap((c) => c.tables ?? []);
    lines.push(`- ${d.name} (domain:${d.id}): ${d.purpose}. ${n} files (${layers})${tables.length ? `; tables ${tables.join(', ')}` : ''}`);
  }
  const counts = new Map<string, number>();
  for (const f of facts.files) { const p = mapper.place(f); if (p.kind !== 'cell' && p.kind !== 'test') counts.set(p.kind, (counts.get(p.kind) ?? 0) + 1); }
  if (counts.size) lines.push(`  (outside domains: ${[...counts].map(([k, n]) => `${k} ${n}`).join(', ')})`);
  const edges = domainEdges(facts, mapper);
  lines.push('', `Cross-domain dependencies (${edges.length}, imports):`, ...edges.map((e) => `- ${name(e.from)} → ${name(e.to)}: ${e.files.length}`));
  lines.push('', `Rule violations now (${violations.length}):`, ...violations.map((v) => `- ${v.invariant}: ${v.detail} (${map.invariants.find((i) => i.id === v.invariant)?.rule ?? ''})`));
  const paths = providerPaths(g, map, violations);
  if (paths.length) {
    const label = { gateway: 'through the gateway (redacted, cost-logged)', violation: 'RULE VIOLATION', uncosted: 'outside the gateway, no rule broken (uncosted, unredacted)' } as const;
    lines.push('', `Paths to a model provider (${paths.length}):`);
    for (const p of paths) lines.push(`- ${label[p.class]}${p.invariant ? ` ${p.invariant}` : ''}: ${p.nodes.join(' → ')}`);
  }
  lines.push('', 'Next: trace <symbol|route> for call chains, graph_neighbors <path> for what touches a file, domain <id> for its cells and rules.');
  return cap(lines);
}
```
