```typescript
// Beat 5: a cartographer proposal as ghosts on the map — a proposed new domain as a dashed column with its cells,
// the files it places or moves sliding (once, as a preview) into their proposed cells, removed or renamed domains
// marked on their column, and rule changes as dashed rule badges. Nothing changes until you accept.
import { useLayoutEffect, useMemo, useRef } from 'react';
import type { ContextGraph } from '@harness/core/view';
import { COL_W, GAP_X, type Frame } from '../layout/frame';
import type { Box } from '../layout/containers';
import { reducedMotion } from '../transition';
import { boxOf, centre, link } from './geometry';
import { ruleBadges, type Preview } from './proposal';
import { Tag, useInv } from './svg';

const CHIP = { w: 196, h: 26, gap: 6 };

type Ghost = { id: string; name: string; x: number; cells: Record<string, Box> };

export function ProposalLayer({ preview, graph, frame }: { preview: Preview; graph: ContextGraph; frame: Frame }) {
  const inv = useInv();
  const { changes, map } = preview;

  const ghosts = useMemo(() => {
    const out: Ghost[] = [];
    const last = frame.cols.at(-1);
    let x = last ? last.x + last.w + GAP_X : frame.bounds.x;
    for (const c of changes) {
      if (c.kind !== 'add_domain') continue;
      const cells: Record<string, Box> = {};
      const layers = new Set<string>([
        ...Object.keys(map?.domains.find((d) => d.id === c.domain)?.cells ?? {}),
        ...changes.flatMap((x) => (x.kind === 'add_cell' && x.domain === c.domain ? [x.layer] : x.kind === 'place' && x.domain === c.domain ? [x.layer] : x.kind === 'move' && x.to.domain === c.domain ? [x.to.layer] : [])),
      ]);
      for (const r of frame.rows) if (layers.has(r.id)) cells[r.id] = { x, y: r.y, w: COL_W, h: r.h };
      out.push({ id: c.domain, name: c.name, x, cells });
      x += COL_W + GAP_X;
    }
    return out;
  }, [changes, map, frame]);

  const moves = useMemo(() => {
    const slots = new Map<string, number>();
    return changes.flatMap((c) => {
      if (c.kind !== 'place' && c.kind !== 'move') return [];
      const to = c.kind === 'place' ? { domain: c.domain, layer: c.layer } : c.to;
      const target = ghosts.find((g) => g.id === to.domain)?.cells[to.layer] ?? frame.boxes[`cell:${to.domain}/${to.layer}`];
      const from = boxOf(frame, graph, c.path);
      if (!target) return [];
      const k = `${target.x},${target.y}`;
      const n = slots.get(k) ?? 0;
      slots.set(k, n + 1);
      const dest: Box = { x: target.x + (target.w - CHIP.w) / 2, y: target.y + 30 + n * (CHIP.h + CHIP.gap), w: CHIP.w, h: CHIP.h };
      return [{ path: c.path, from, dest, n }];
    });
  }, [changes, ghosts, frame, graph]);

  const marks = useMemo(() => changes.flatMap((c) => {
    if (c.kind !== 'remove_domain' && c.kind !== 'rename_domain') return [];
    const col = frame.cols.find((x) => x.id === c.domain);
    return col ? [{ col, text: c.kind === 'remove_domain' ? 'removed' : `→ ${c.to}`, remove: c.kind === 'remove_domain' }] : [];
  }), [changes, frame]);

  const rules = ruleBadges(changes);
  const ruleCol = preview.state.proposal.scope.map((s) => frame.cols.find((c) => `domain:${c.id}` === s)).find(Boolean) ?? null;
  const top = frame.rows[0]?.y ?? frame.bounds.y;
  const bottom = (frame.rows.at(-1)?.y ?? 0) + (frame.rows.at(-1)?.h ?? 0);
  const key = `${preview.state.proposal.id}#${preview.index}`;

  return (
    <svg className="ov-svg" width={1} height={1}>
      {ghosts.map((g) => (
        <g key={g.id} className="ov-ghost-col">
          <rect className="ov-ghost-band" x={g.x - 10} y={top - 12} width={COL_W + 20} height={bottom - top + 24} rx={4} />
          {Object.entries(g.cells).map(([layer, b]) => <rect key={layer} className="ov-ghost-cell" x={b.x} y={b.y} width={b.w} height={b.h} rx={2} />)}
          <Tag x={g.x + COL_W / 2} y={top - 34 * inv} text={`${g.name} · proposed`} inv={inv} px={15} className="is-ghost" />
        </g>
      ))}
      {marks.map((m, i) => (
        <g key={i} className={`ov-col-mark ${m.remove ? 'is-remove' : ''}`}>
          <rect x={m.col.x - 6} y={top - 8} width={m.col.w + 12} height={bottom - top + 16} rx={4} />
          <Tag x={m.col.x + m.col.w / 2} y={top - 34 * inv} text={m.text} inv={inv} px={14} className="is-ghost" />
        </g>
      ))}
      {rules.length > 0 && ruleCol && rules.map((r, i) => (
        <Tag key={r.id} x={ruleCol.x + ruleCol.w / 2} y={bottom + (22 + 26 * i) * inv} text={`${r.id} ${r.kind === 'retire' ? 'retired' : r.kind === 'add' ? 'new rule' : 'rule changes'}`} inv={inv} px={13} className="is-rule" title={r.text} />
      ))}
      {moves.map((m) => m.from && <path key={`c${m.path}`} className="ov-move-link" d={link(m.from, m.dest).d} />)}
      {moves.map((m) => <Slide key={`${key}|${m.path}`} m={m} />)}
    </svg>
  );
}

/** One file chip sliding from where the file is now to its proposed cell: a preview that plays once per candidate. */
function Slide({ m }: { m: { path: string; from: Box | null; dest: Box; n: number } }) {
  const ref = useRef<SVGGElement>(null);
  useLayoutEffect(() => {
    const el = ref.current;
    if (!el || !m.from || reducedMotion()) return;
    const c = centre(m.from);
    const dx = c.x - (m.dest.x + m.dest.w / 2);
    const dy = c.y - (m.dest.y + m.dest.h / 2);
    el.animate([{ transform: `translate(${dx}px, ${dy}px)`, opacity: 0.2 }, { transform: 'translate(0, 0)', opacity: 1 }], { duration: 700, delay: 250 + m.n * 90, easing: 'cubic-bezier(0.2, 0.7, 0.2, 1)', fill: 'backwards' });
  }, [m]);
  const name = m.path.split('/').pop()!;
  return (
    <g ref={ref} className="ov-slide">
      <title>{m.path}</title>
      <rect x={m.dest.x} y={m.dest.y} width={m.dest.w} height={m.dest.h} rx={2} />
      <text x={m.dest.x + 10} y={m.dest.y + m.dest.h / 2} dy="0.35em">{name}</text>
    </g>
  );
}
```

```typescript
// Inferred sub-group labels (NAVIGATION_PLAN §4.5): inside an open cell, files the cartographer grouped under one name
// get a dashed hull and the name, marked inferred. Labels carry no rule weight; confirming one is a domains.yaml change.
import { useMemo } from 'react';
import type { ContextGraph, Label } from '@harness/core/view';
import type { Frame } from '../layout/frame';
import { padBox, unionBox } from './geometry';
import { useInv } from './svg';

export function LabelLayer({ labels, graph, frame }: { labels: Record<string, Label>; graph: ContextGraph; frame: Frame }) {
  const inv = useInv();
  const hulls = useMemo(() => {
    const groups = new Map<string, { text: string; confirmed: boolean; boxes: { x: number; y: number; w: number; h: number }[] }>();
    for (const l of Object.values(labels)) {
      if (l.kind !== 'group') continue;
      const b = frame.boxes[l.target];
      const parent = graph.nodes[l.target]?.parent;
      if (!b || !parent) continue; // only files drawn on their own (their cell is open)
      const k = `${parent}|${l.text}`;
      const g = groups.get(k) ?? groups.set(k, { text: l.text, confirmed: l.confirmed, boxes: [] }).get(k)!;
      g.boxes.push(b);
    }
    return [...groups.values()].map((g) => ({ ...g, box: padBox(unionBox(g.boxes)!, 7) }));
  }, [labels, graph, frame]);
  if (!hulls.length) return null;
  const fs = 12 * inv;
  return (
    <svg className="ov-svg is-under" width={1} height={1}>
      {hulls.map((h, i) => (
        <g key={i} className={`ov-hull ${h.confirmed ? 'is-confirmed' : ''}`}>
          <rect x={h.box.x} y={h.box.y} width={h.box.w} height={h.box.h} rx={6} />
          <text x={h.box.x + 6} y={h.box.y - 5 * inv} style={{ fontSize: fs }}>
            {h.text}
            {!h.confirmed && <tspan className="ov-inferred" dx={6 * inv}>inferred</tspan>}
          </text>
        </g>
      ))}
    </svg>
  );
}
```

```typescript
// The server endpoints the overlays and panels call (living map, auditor, journeys). Results arrive as events on the
// socket, so nothing here updates UI state directly. Fake logs (`?fake=…`) send nothing.
import { fakeMode } from '../../connection';

async function post(path: string, body?: unknown): Promise<{ ok: boolean; error?: string }> {
  if (fakeMode) return { ok: true };
  try {
    const r = await fetch(path, { method: 'POST', headers: { 'content-type': 'application/json' }, body: JSON.stringify(body ?? {}) });
    const j = (await r.json().catch(() => ({}))) as { error?: string };
    return r.ok ? { ok: true } : { ok: false, error: j.error ?? `HTTP ${r.status}` };
  } catch (e) {
    return { ok: false, error: (e as Error).message };
  }
}

const seg = (id: string) => encodeURIComponent(id);

export const overlayApi = {
  acceptProposal: (id: string, candidate?: number) => post(`/api/proposals/${seg(id)}/accept`, candidate === undefined ? {} : { candidate }),
  rejectProposal: (id: string, reason?: string) => post(`/api/proposals/${seg(id)}/reject`, reason ? { reason } : {}),
  survey: () => post('/api/living-map/survey'),
  dismissFinding: (id: string) => post(`/api/findings/${seg(id)}/dismiss`),
  promoteFinding: (id: string) => post(`/api/findings/${seg(id)}/promote`),
  confirmJourney: (id: string, name?: string) => post(`/api/journeys/${seg(id)}/confirm`, name ? { name } : {}),
  refreshJourneys: () => post('/api/journeys/refresh'),
};
```

```typescript
// Shared reads for overlays and panels: the graph for the current state (memoized on its inputs, like the renderer's),
// open findings, and the faint placement guesses for unassigned files.
import { useMemo } from 'react';
import { instantGuess, type ContextGraph, type DomainMap, type PlacementGuess, type UIState } from '@harness/core/view';
import { useView } from '../../derive';
import { graphMemo } from '../scene';

const memo = graphMemo();

export function useGraph(): ContextGraph | null {
  const ui = useView().ui;
  return useMemo(() => memo(ui), [ui]);
}

export type Guess = PlacementGuess & { name: string; isNew: boolean };

const guessCache = new WeakMap<object, Map<string, Guess | null>>();

/** "probably Billing?": the deterministic guess for an unassigned file (cached per facts object). */
export function guessFor(ui: UIState, path: string): Guess | null {
  const map = ui.map as DomainMap | null;
  if (!map) return null;
  let per = guessCache.get(ui.facts);
  if (!per) guessCache.set(ui.facts, (per = new Map()));
  const k = `${map.domains.length}|${path}`;
  if (per.has(k)) return per.get(k)!;
  const g = instantGuess(map, ui.facts, path);
  const d = g && map.domains.find((x) => x.id === g.domain);
  const out = g && g.basis !== 'cell' ? { ...g, name: d?.name ?? g.domain, isNew: !d } : null;
  per.set(k, out);
  return out;
}

/** One line for the Unassigned column: the guesses agree → "probably Watchlists?", else a count. */
export function guessSummary(ui: UIState, files: readonly string[]): string | null {
  const gs = files.map((f) => guessFor(ui, f)).filter((g): g is Guess => !!g);
  if (!gs.length) return null;
  const names = [...new Set(gs.map((g) => (g.isNew ? `a new domain (${g.name})` : g.name)))];
  return names.length === 1 ? `probably ${names[0]}?` : `${gs.length} guesses: ${names.slice(0, 2).join(', ')}${names.length > 2 ? '…' : ''}`;
}
```

```typescript
// Beat 1: the journeys rail. Names stay marked "inferred" until you confirm them; confirm or rename inline. Picking one
// draws it over the map; ▶ plays it step by step.
import { useState } from 'react';
import type { Journey } from '@harness/core/view';
import { useView } from '../../derive';
import { stepCaption } from '../overlays/journey';
import { useGraph } from '../overlays/hooks';
import { useOverlay } from '../overlays/state';
import { overlayApi } from './api';

export function JourneysPanel() {
  const ui = useView().ui;
  const journeys = [...ui.journeys].sort((a, b) => b.steps.length - a.steps.length || a.name.localeCompare(b.name));
  const active = useOverlay((s) => s.journey);
  if (!journeys.length) return <p className="pn-empty">No journeys yet. They are computed from entries (routes, pages, CLI) once the map is confirmed.</p>;
  return (
    <ul className="pn-journeys">
      {journeys.map((j) => <Row key={j.id} j={j} active={active === j.id} />)}
    </ul>
  );
}

function Row({ j, active }: { j: Journey; active: boolean }) {
  const show = useOverlay((s) => s.showJourney);
  const [editing, setEditing] = useState(false);
  const [name, setName] = useState(j.name);
  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const submit = async (text?: string) => {
    const r = await overlayApi.confirmJourney(j.id, text);
    setError(r.ok ? null : r.error ?? 'Could not confirm.');
    if (r.ok) setEditing(false);
  };
  return (
    <li className={`pn-journey ${active ? 'is-active' : ''}`}>
      <div className="pn-journey-head">
        {editing ? (
          <input
            className="pn-input"
            autoFocus
            value={name}
            aria-label="Journey name"
            onChange={(e) => setName(e.target.value)}
            onKeyDown={(e) => {
              if (e.key === 'Enter') void submit(name.trim());
              if (e.key === 'Escape') { setEditing(false); setName(j.name); }
            }}
          />
        ) : (
          <button className="pn-journey-name" onClick={() => show(active ? null : j.id)} aria-pressed={active} title={j.entry}>
            {j.name}
            {j.inferred && <span className="pn-inferred">inferred</span>}
          </button>
        )}
        <span className="pn-journey-meta">{j.steps.length} steps{j.branches.length ? ` · ${j.branches.length} branches` : ''}</span>
        <span className="pn-journey-actions">
          <button className="pn-icon" title="Play" aria-label={`Play ${j.name}`} onClick={() => show(j.id, true)}>▶</button>
          {j.inferred && !editing && <button className="pn-icon" title="Confirm this name" aria-label="Confirm name" onClick={() => void submit()}>✓</button>}
          {!editing && <button className="pn-icon" title="Rename" aria-label="Rename" onClick={() => { setName(j.name); setEditing(true); }}>✎</button>}
        </span>
      </div>
      {error && <p className="pn-error">{error}</p>}
      {active && <Steps j={j} />}
    </li>
  );
}

function Steps({ j }: { j: Journey }) {
  const graph = useGraph();
  const map = useView().ui.map;
  const step = useOverlay((s) => s.step);
  const setStep = useOverlay((s) => s.setStep);
  if (!graph) return null;
  return (
    <ol className="pn-steps">
      {j.steps.map((s, i) => {
        const c = stepCaption(j, i, graph, map);
        const weak = s.confidence === 'dispatch' || s.confidence === 'inferred';
        return (
          <li key={i} className={`${i === step ? 'is-now' : i < step ? 'is-done' : ''}`}>
            <button onClick={() => setStep(i)}>
              <span className="pn-step-n">{i + 1}</span>
              <span className="pn-step-title">{c.title}{weak && <span className="pn-weak" title={`Reached through ${s.confidence}`}>{s.confidence}</span>}</span>
              <span className="pn-step-sub">{c.sub}</span>
            </button>
          </li>
        );
      })}
    </ol>
  );
}
```

```typescript
// Beat 6: the auditor's advisory findings. Each cites a decision, points at lines, says how sure it is, and can be
// dismissed (remembered) or promoted to a rule proposal. Findings never touch the ledger.
import type { FindingState } from '@harness/core/view';
import { useView } from '../../derive';
import { useStore } from '../../store';
import { overlayApi } from './api';
import { openLine } from './open';

export function FindingsPanel() {
  const ui = useView().ui;
  const all = Object.values(ui.findings).sort((a, b) => (a.status === 'open' ? 0 : 1) - (b.status === 'open' ? 0 : 1) || b.at - a.at);
  if (!all.length) return <p className="pn-empty">No findings. After each turn the auditor reads the work against your standing decisions; what rules can't express shows up here.</p>;
  return (
    <ul className="pn-findings">
      {all.map((f) => <FindingItem key={f.id} f={f} />)}
    </ul>
  );
}

export function FindingItem({ f, compact = false }: { f: FindingState; compact?: boolean }) {
  const select = useStore((s) => s.select);
  const live = useView().live;
  const open = f.status === 'open';
  return (
    <li className={`pn-finding ${open ? '' : 'is-resolved'}`}>
      <div className="pn-finding-head">
        <span className="pn-audit">audit</span>
        <span className="pn-inferred">inferred</span>
        {f.decision && <button className="pn-dec" onClick={() => select({ decision: f.decision! })} title="Open the decision">{f.decision}</button>}
        <span className={`pn-conf is-${f.confidence}`}>{f.confidence} confidence</span>
        {!open && <span className="pn-status">{f.status}</span>}
      </div>
      <p className="pn-finding-text">{f.text}</p>
      {!compact && f.lines.length > 0 && (
        <ul className="pn-lines">
          {f.lines.map((l) => (
            <li key={`${l.path}:${l.line}`}><button className="link" onClick={() => openLine(l.path, l.line)}>{l.path}:{l.line}</button></li>
          ))}
        </ul>
      )}
      {!compact && !f.lines.length && f.files.length > 0 && (
        <ul className="pn-lines">{f.files.map((p) => <li key={p}><button className="link" onClick={() => openLine(p)}>{p}</button></li>)}</ul>
      )}
      {open && !compact && (
        <div className="pn-actions">
          <button className="btn" disabled={!live} onClick={() => void overlayApi.dismissFinding(f.id)}>Dismiss</button>
          <button className="btn" disabled={!live} onClick={() => void overlayApi.promoteFinding(f.id)} title="Turn it into a rule proposal">Promote to rule</button>
        </div>
      )}
    </li>
  );
}
```

```typescript
// Open a path (and line) from a panel: the code pane when the shell has one (lane A's `openCode` on the store, if
// present), otherwise the inspector's file view.
import { useStore } from '../../store';

type MaybeCode = { openCode?: (path: string, line?: number) => void };

export function openLine(path: string, line?: number) {
  const s = useStore.getState() as ReturnType<typeof useStore.getState> & MaybeCode;
  if (typeof s.openCode === 'function') return s.openCode(path, line);
  s.select({ file: path });
}
```

```text
// History units (Interpretability turns and git commits) that maps are scored and drift is measured against.
import type { UIState } from '../events';
import type { HistoryTurn } from '../contracts/cartography';

/**
 * Interpretability turns as history units: the files each turn edited (attributed or not), in log order.
 * Turns that only read are skipped; they say nothing about where change lands.
 */
export function historyFromUI(ui: UIState): HistoryTurn[] {
  const out: HistoryTurn[] = [];
  for (const t of ui.turns) {
    const files = Object.entries(t.paths).filter(([, a]) => a.edits > 0).map(([p]) => p).sort();
    if (files.length) out.push({ id: t.id, source: 'turn', files });
  }
  return out;
}

/**
 * Bulk units (initial imports, mass reformatting) say nothing about boundaries and would swamp the means:
 * a unit is bulk when it touches more than 10 known files and more than 30% of them.
 */
export function isBulk(files: readonly string[], known: ReadonlySet<string>): boolean {
  const n = files.filter((f) => known.has(f)).length;
  return n > 10 && n > 0.3 * known.size;
}
/** Distinct cells each history unit lights under `map` (unassigned files share one "Unassigned" cell). Bulk and empty units are skipped. */
export function cellsLitPerUnit(map: DomainMap | Mapper, facts: Readonly<Record<string, FileFacts>>, history: readonly HistoryTurn[]): number[] {
  const mapper = 'place' in map ? map : createMapper(map);
  const known = new Set(Object.keys(facts));
  const out: number[] = [];
  for (const unit of history) {
    if (isBulk(unit.files, known)) continue;
    const cells = new Set<string>();
    for (const f of unit.files) {
      if (!known.has(f)) continue; // deleted or non-code files say nothing about the current map
      const k = cellKeyOf(mapper.place(f));
      if (k) cells.add(k);
    }
    if (cells.size) out.push(cells.size);
  }
  return out;
}

/**
 * Newman modularity Q of the undirected file import graph, partitioned by domain. Nodes are code files in a cell
 * or unassigned (each unassigned file is its own community, so leaving coupled files unplaced is penalized);
 * neutral, ignored and test files are left out, as they draw no edges on the map.
```

```typescript
// A file's diff against a turn's baseline, for the code pane's gutters (NAVIGATION_PLAN §2, Code level). Unified
// hunks with no context (`-U0`), so every hunk line is a change. A file that did not exist at the baseline
// (created this turn, or untracked) diffs against /dev/null, as numstat in git.ts does.
import { execFileSync } from 'node:child_process';
import { existsSync } from 'node:fs';
import { join } from 'node:path';
import type { HarnessEvent } from '@harness/core';

export type Hunk = { oldStart: number; oldLines: number; newStart: number; newLines: number; lines: string[] };
export type FileDiff = { path: string; base: string | null; created: boolean; hunks: Hunk[] };

const SHA = /^[0-9a-f]{4,64}$/i;

function run(repo: string, args: string[]): string {
  try {
    return execFileSync('git', args, { cwd: repo, encoding: 'utf8', stdio: ['ignore', 'pipe', 'pipe'], maxBuffer: 16 << 20 });
  } catch (e) {
    // `git diff --no-index` exits 1 when the files differ; its diff is on stdout
    return String((e as { stdout?: string }).stdout ?? '');
  }
}

/** The baseline a turn started from (`turn_started.baseline`), else an explicit sha, else the latest turn's, else HEAD. */
export function baselineFor(events: readonly HarnessEvent[], turn: string | null, sha: string | null): string | null {
  const starts = events.filter((e) => e.kind === 'turn_started');
  const of = (e: HarnessEvent | undefined) => (e?.data as { baseline?: string } | undefined)?.baseline || null;
  if (turn) {
    const b = of(starts.find((e) => e.turn === turn));
    if (b) return b;
  }
  if (sha && SHA.test(sha)) return sha;
  if (turn) return null; // an unknown turn (e.g. a fake log) with no usable sha: no diff rather than a wrong one
  return of(starts.at(-1)) ?? 'HEAD';
}

export function parseHunks(out: string): Hunk[] {
  const hunks: Hunk[] = [];
  let cur: Hunk | null = null;
  for (const line of out.split('\n')) {
    const m = line.match(/^@@ -(\d+)(?:,(\d+))? \+(\d+)(?:,(\d+))? @@/);
    if (m) {
      cur = { oldStart: +m[1]!, oldLines: m[2] === undefined ? 1 : +m[2], newStart: +m[3]!, newLines: m[4] === undefined ? 1 : +m[4], lines: [] };
      hunks.push(cur);
    } else if (cur && (line.startsWith('+') || line.startsWith('-')) && !line.startsWith('+++') && !line.startsWith('---')) cur.lines.push(line);
  }
  return hunks;
}

export function fileDiff(repo: string, path: string, base: string | null): FileDiff {
  if (!base || !SHA.test(base) && base !== 'HEAD') return { path, base: null, created: false, hunks: [] };
  const verified = run(repo, ['rev-parse', '--verify', '--quiet', `${base}^{commit}`]).trim();
  if (!verified) return { path, base: null, created: false, hunks: [] };
  const inBase = run(repo, ['cat-file', '-t', `${verified}:${path}`]).trim() === 'blob';
  if (!inBase) {
    if (!existsSync(join(repo, path))) return { path, base: verified, created: false, hunks: [] };
    return { path, base: verified, created: true, hunks: parseHunks(run(repo, ['diff', '--no-index', '--no-color', '-U0', '/dev/null', path])) };
  }
  return { path, base: verified, created: false, hunks: parseHunks(run(repo, ['diff', '--no-color', '-U0', verified, '--', path])) };
}
```

```text
import { appendFileSync, existsSync, mkdirSync, readFileSync, writeFileSync } from 'node:fs';
import { join } from 'node:path';
import { randomUUID } from 'node:crypto';
import type { HarnessEvent, EventKind, EventData, Cell } from '@harness/core';

type Listener = (e: HarnessEvent) => void;

/** Append-only event log: `.harness/events.jsonl` in the target repo, broadcast to every listener. */
export class Bus {
  readonly events: HarnessEvent[] = [];
  readonly session = randomUUID().slice(0, 8);
  turn: string | null = null;
  private listeners = new Set<Listener>();
  private file: string;

  constructor(repo: string, opts: { fresh?: boolean } = {}) {
    const dir = join(repo, '.harness');
    mkdirSync(join(dir, 'turns'), { recursive: true });
    // Keep .harness/ out of the target's git without touching its .gitignore.
    if (!existsSync(join(dir, '.gitignore'))) writeFileSync(join(dir, '.gitignore'), '*\n');
    this.file = join(dir, 'events.jsonl');
    if (opts.fresh) writeFileSync(this.file, '');
    else if (existsSync(this.file)) {
      for (const line of readFileSync(this.file, 'utf8').split('\n')) {
        if (line.trim()) this.events.push(JSON.parse(line) as HarnessEvent);
      }
    }
  }

  emit<K extends EventKind>(kind: K, data: K extends keyof EventData ? EventData[K] : never, extra: { cell?: Cell | null; path?: string; turn?: string | null } = {}): HarnessEvent {
    const e: HarnessEvent = {
      id: randomUUID().slice(0, 12),
      t: Date.now(),
      session: this.session,
      turn: extra.turn === undefined ? this.turn : extra.turn,
      kind,
      ...(extra.cell ? { cell: extra.cell } : {}),
      ...(extra.path ? { path: extra.path } : {}),
      data: data as Record<string, unknown>,
    };
    this.events.push(e);
    appendFileSync(this.file, JSON.stringify(e) + '\n');
    for (const l of this.listeners) l(e);
    return e;
  }

  on(l: Listener) {
    this.listeners.add(l);
    return () => this.listeners.delete(l);
  }
}
```

```typescript
// The small map-health readout (NAVIGATION_PLAN §4.8 "map quality is measured, not asserted") and the quiet
// Maintenance panel (cartographer and auditor runs: agent, trigger, time, cost). Neither feeds the ledger.
import { useMemo } from 'react';
import { cellsLitPerUnit, historyFromUI, median, type DriftSignal, type UIState } from '@harness/core/view';
import { useView } from '../../derive';

const SIGNAL: Record<DriftSignal['signal'], string> = {
  unassigned: 'Unplaced code',
  wide_turns: 'Turns too wide',
  co_change: 'Co-change across a boundary',
  coupling_growth: 'Coupling growth',
  rule_erosion: 'Rule erosion',
  rule_reinforcement: 'Rule reinforcement',
  bloated_cell: 'Bloated cell',
  new_top_level: 'New top-level code',
  stale_label: 'Stale label',
};

export type Health = { width: number | null; turns: number; unassigned: number; signals: DriftSignal[] };

export function healthOf(ui: UIState, unassigned: number): Health {
  const lit = ui.map ? cellsLitPerUnit(ui.map, ui.facts, historyFromUI(ui).slice(-10)) : [];
  return { width: lit.length ? median(lit) : null, turns: lit.length, unassigned, signals: ui.drift };
}

export function useHealth(): Health {
  const v = useView();
  return useMemo(() => healthOf(v.ui, v.unassigned.length), [v.ui, v.unassigned.length]);
}

const fmt = (n: number) => (Number.isInteger(n) ? String(n) : n.toFixed(1));

/** One line for the dock: "Map health · 1 signal" or "Map health · steady". */
export const healthTag = (h: Health) => (h.signals.length ? `${h.signals.length} signal${h.signals.length === 1 ? '' : 's'}` : 'steady');

export function HealthPanel() {
  const h = useHealth();
  return (
    <div className="pn-health">
      <dl className="pn-metrics">
        <div><dt>Turn width</dt><dd>{h.width === null ? '–' : `${fmt(h.width)} cells`}</dd><dd className="pn-metric-sub">median per turn{h.turns ? `, last ${h.turns}` : ''}</dd></div>
        <div><dt>Unassigned</dt><dd>{h.unassigned}</dd><dd className="pn-metric-sub">files in no cell</dd></div>
        <div><dt>Signals</dt><dd>{h.signals.length}</dd><dd className="pn-metric-sub">drift, held two turns to act</dd></div>
      </dl>
      {h.signals.length > 0 ? (
        <ul className="pn-signals">
          {h.signals.map((s, i) => (
            <li key={`${s.signal}${i}`} className={s.persisted >= 2 ? 'is-firing' : ''}>
              <span className="pn-signal-name">{SIGNAL[s.signal] ?? s.signal}</span>
              <span className="pn-signal-metric">{s.metric}: {fmt(s.value)} (threshold {fmt(s.threshold)})</span>
              <span className="pn-signal-scope">{s.scope.slice(0, 3).join(', ')}{s.scope.length > 3 ? ` +${s.scope.length - 3}` : ''} · held {s.persisted} turn{s.persisted === 1 ? '' : 's'}</span>
            </li>
          ))}
        </ul>
      ) : (
        <p className="pn-empty">No drift. The map matches how the code changes.</p>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

export function MaintenancePanel() {
  const runs = useView().ui.maintenance;
  if (!runs.length) return <p className="pn-empty">No maintenance runs yet.</p>;
  const total = runs.reduce((s, r) => s + (r.cost ?? 0), 0);
  return (
    <div className="pn-maint">
      <p className="pn-note">Background agents keep the map current. They never block a turn and never count in the ledger.</p>
      <table className="pn-table">
        <thead><tr><th>Agent</th><th>Trigger</th><th>Time</th><th>Cost</th></tr></thead>
        <tbody>
          {[...runs].reverse().map((r, i) => (
            <tr key={i} className={r.ok ? '' : 'is-failed'}>
              <td>{r.agent}</td>
              <td>{r.trigger}{r.ok ? '' : ' · failed'}</td>
              <td>{r.ms < 1000 ? `${r.ms} ms` : `${(r.ms / 1000).toFixed(1)} s`}</td>
              <td>{r.cost === null ? '–' : `$${r.cost.toFixed(4)}`}</td>
            </tr>
          ))}
        </tbody>
        <tfoot><tr><td colSpan={3}>{runs.length} run{runs.length === 1 ? '' : 's'}</td><td>${total.toFixed(4)}</td></tr></tfoot>
      </table>
    </div>
  );
}
```

```text
  get mapPath() { return join(this.root, 'domains.yaml'); }
  hasMap() { return existsSync(this.mapPath); }

  /** Load (or reload) domains.yaml text. */
  setMap(text: string) {
    const map = parseDomainMap(text); // throws before anything changes
    this.mapText = text;
    this.map = map;
    this.mapper = createMapper(this.map);
    this.index = createFactsIndex(this.root, this.map, this.exists, (p) => this.current(p));
  }

  loadMapFile() { this.setMap(readFileSync(this.mapPath, 'utf8')); }

  /** Repo-relative POSIX path for an absolute path from a hook, or null if it is outside the repo. */
  rel(p: string): string | null {
    let abs = isAbsolute(p) ? p : join(this.root, p);
    try { abs = realpathSync(abs); } catch {
      // New file: resolve the parent instead.
      const i = abs.lastIndexOf('/');
      try { abs = join(realpathSync(abs.slice(0, i)), abs.slice(i + 1)); } catch { /* keep as is */ }
    }
    const r = relative(this.root, abs);
    if (!r || r.startsWith('..') || isAbsolute(r)) return null;
    return r.split('\\').join('/');
  }

  place(path: string): Placement { return this.mapper.place(path); }

  cellOf(path: string) {
    const p = this.place(path);
    return p.kind === 'cell' ? { domain: p.domain, layer: p.layer } : null;
  }

  /** Placement for a directory (Grep/Glob path): the single cell all known files under it share, if any. */
  cellForDir(dir: string) {
    const prefix = dir.replace(/\/$/, '') + '/';
    let found: { domain: string; layer: string } | null = null;
    for (const f of this.facts.files) {
      if (!f.startsWith(prefix)) continue;
      const c = this.cellOf(f);
      if (!c) continue;
      if (found && (found.domain !== c.domain || found.layer !== c.layer)) return null;
      found = c;
    }
    return found;
  }

  /** Every non-ignored file under the current map. */
  listFiles() { return listRepoFiles(this.root, this.map, this.mapper); }
```

```typescript
// Beat 5: the proposal card next to its ghosts. What would change, the deterministic score line, a candidate picker,
// and Accept / Reject (Accept is hidden for a manual proposal: there is no candidate map to commit).
import { useState } from 'react';
import { useView } from '../../derive';
import { pendingProposals, previewOf, ruleBadges, type Preview } from '../overlays/proposal';
import { useOverlay } from '../overlays/state';
import { overlayApi } from './api';

export function usePreview(): Preview | null {
  const ui = useView().ui;
  const picks = useOverlay((s) => s.candidate);
  const p = pendingProposals(ui)[0];
  return p ? previewOf(ui, p, picks[p.proposal.id]) : null;
}

export function ProposalCard({ preview }: { preview: Preview }) {
  const v = useView();
  const pick = useOverlay((s) => s.pickCandidate);
  const [busy, setBusy] = useState(false);
  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const p = preview.state.proposal;
  const pending = pendingProposals(v.ui).length;
  const rules = ruleBadges(preview.changes);
  const auditor = p.rationale.startsWith('Promoted from') || p.trigger.some((t) => t.signal === 'rule_reinforcement');
  const run = async (f: () => Promise<{ ok: boolean; error?: string }>) => {
    setBusy(true);
    const r = await f();
    setBusy(false);
    setError(r.ok ? null : r.error ?? 'Failed.');
  };
  return (
    <section className="pn-card pn-proposal" aria-label={`Map proposal ${p.id}`}>
      <p className="pn-kicker">
        <span>{auditor ? 'Auditor' : 'Cartographer'} proposal {p.id}</span>
        <span className="pn-inferred">inferred</span>
        {pending > 1 && <span className="pn-more">+{pending - 1} more</span>}
      </p>
      <p className="pn-summary">{preview.summary}</p>
      {preview.scoreLine && <p className="pn-score">{preview.scoreLine}</p>}
      {rules.length > 0 && (
        <div className="pn-rules">
          {rules.map((r) => <span key={r.id} className={`pn-rule is-${r.kind}`} title={r.text}><b>{r.id}</b> {r.kind === 'retire' ? 'retired' : r.text}</span>)}
        </div>
      )}
      {p.candidates.length > 1 && (
        <div className="pn-cands" role="radiogroup" aria-label="Candidate maps">
          {p.candidates.map((c, i) => (
            <button key={i} role="radio" aria-checked={i === preview.index} className={`pn-cand ${i === preview.index ? 'is-on' : ''}`} onClick={() => pick(p.id, i)} title={`score ${c.score.total} (lower is better)`}>
              <span>{String.fromCharCode(65 + i)}</span>
              <small>{c.score.cellsLitMean} cells{i === p.chosen ? ' · best' : ''}</small>
            </button>
          ))}
        </div>
      )}
      {p.rationale && <p className="pn-rationale">{p.rationale}</p>}
      {error && <p className="pn-error">{error}</p>}
      <div className="pn-actions">
        {p.candidates.length > 0 && (
          <button className="btn btn-primary" disabled={busy || !v.live} onClick={() => void run(() => overlayApi.acceptProposal(p.id, preview.index))}>Accept</button>
        )}
        <button className="btn" disabled={busy || !v.live} onClick={() => void run(() => overlayApi.rejectProposal(p.id))}>Reject</button>
        <span className="pn-hint">{p.candidates.length ? 'Accept commits domains.yaml.' : 'Manual: write the rule by hand, or reject.'}</span>
      </div>
    </section>
  );
}
```

```typescript
// Point (NAVIGATION_PLAN §3.4, beat 2): the map nodes the user shift-clicked, resolved to the paths and symbols they
// name and the cells they sit in, as one line prepended to what Claude receives. Deterministic; no model call.
import type { DomainMap, Placement } from '@harness/core';

export type Placer = { map: DomainMap; place(path: string): Placement };

const MAX = 12;

function cellName(map: DomainMap, domain: string, layer?: string): string {
  const d = map.domains.find((x) => x.id === domain);
  const l = layer ? map.layers.find((x) => x.id === layer) : undefined;
  return `${d?.name ?? domain}${l ? ` › ${l.name}` : ''}`;
}

function where(r: Placer, path: string): string {
  const p = r.place(path);
  if (p.kind === 'cell') return cellName(r.map, p.domain, p.layer);
  if (p.kind === 'test') return `${cellName(r.map, p.domain)} tests`;
  if (p.kind === 'neutral') return 'shared code';
  return 'unassigned';
}

/** One node id → a phrase: `src/gateway/cost-ledger.ts#recordCost (Model gateway › Data)`. Null for ids it can't read. */
export function describeNode(r: Placer, id: string): string | null {
  const s = id.trim();
  if (!s) return null;
  let m = s.match(/^domain:(.+)$/);
  if (m) {
    const d = r.map.domains.find((x) => x.id === m![1]);
    if (!d) return null;
    const globs = Object.values(d.cells).flatMap((c) => c.paths ?? []);
    return `the ${d.name} domain (${globs.slice(0, 6).join(', ')}${globs.length > 6 ? ', …' : ''})`;
  }
  m = s.match(/^cell:([^/]+)\/(.+)$/);
  if (m) {
    const d = r.map.domains.find((x) => x.id === m![1]);
    const c = d?.cells[m[2]!];
    if (!d || !c) return null;
    return `the ${cellName(r.map, d.id, m[2])} cell (${[...(c.paths ?? []), ...(c.tables ?? []).map((t) => `table ${t}`)].join(', ')})`;
  }
  m = s.match(/^group:([^/]+)\/([^/]+)\/(.+)$/);
  if (m) return `${m[3]}/ (${cellName(r.map, m[1]!, m[2])})`;
  m = s.match(/^vendor:(.+)$/);
  if (m) return `the package ${m[1]}`;
  m = s.match(/^table:(.+)$/);
  if (m) return `the table ${m[1]}`;
  if (/^(route|entry|journey|tests|group):/.test(s) || s === 'unassigned' || s === 'neutral' || s === 'repo') return s;
  const hash = s.indexOf('#');
  const path = hash < 0 ? s : s.slice(0, hash);
  if (!/^[\w@.\-/]+$/.test(path) || path.startsWith('/') || path.split('/').includes('..')) return null;
  return `${s} (${where(r, path)})`;
}

/** "The user is pointing at: …" for the ids that resolve, or null when none do. */
export function pointingLine(r: Placer, ids: readonly string[] | undefined): string | null {
  if (!ids?.length) return null;
  const parts = [...new Set(ids)].slice(0, MAX).map((id) => describeNode(r, id)).filter((x): x is string => !!x);
  return parts.length ? `[The user is pointing at: ${parts.join('; ')}]` : null;
}
```

```typescript
// Screen-space chrome for the overlays: the dock (one click each for Journeys, Paths to Claude, Findings, Map health,
// Maintenance), its drawer, the trace legend and the journey player.
import { useEffect, type ReactNode } from 'react';
import type { ContextGraph, DomainMap, Journey, Violation } from '@harness/core/view';
import { useView } from '../../derive';
import { stepCaption } from '../overlays/journey';
import { useOverlay, type Panel } from '../overlays/state';
import { pathsToProvider, shortName, summarize } from '../overlays/trace';
import { FindingsPanel } from './FindingsPanel';
import { HealthPanel, MaintenancePanel, healthTag, useHealth } from './HealthPanels';
import { JourneysPanel } from './JourneysPanel';

const TITLES: Record<Panel, string> = { journeys: 'Journeys', findings: 'Findings', health: 'Map health', maintenance: 'Maintenance' };

export function Dock({ graph }: { graph: ContextGraph | null }) {
  const ui = useView().ui;
  const panel = useOverlay((s) => s.panel);
  const toggle = useOverlay((s) => s.togglePanel);
  const trace = useOverlay((s) => s.trace);
  const setTrace = useOverlay((s) => s.setTrace);
  const health = useHealth();
  const open = Object.values(ui.findings).filter((f) => f.status === 'open').length;
  const provider = trace?.mode === 'provider';
  const btn = (p: Panel, label: ReactNode, extra = '') => (
    <button className={`dk-btn ${panel === p ? 'is-on' : ''} ${extra}`} aria-pressed={panel === p} onClick={() => toggle(p)}>{label}</button>
  );
  return (
    <>
      <div className="dk" role="toolbar" aria-label="Map overlays">
        {btn('journeys', <>Journeys <span className="dk-count">{ui.journeys.length}</span></>)}
        <button className={`dk-btn dk-paths ${provider ? 'is-on' : ''}`} aria-pressed={provider} disabled={!graph} onClick={() => setTrace(provider ? null : { mode: 'provider' })} title="Every path to the model provider (P)">
          <span className="dk-swatches" aria-hidden="true"><i className="is-gateway" /><i className="is-violation" /><i className="is-uncosted" /></span>
          Paths to Claude
        </button>
        {btn('findings', <>Findings{open > 0 && <span className="dk-count is-amber">{open}</span>}</>)}
        {btn('health', <>Map health <span className={`dk-dot ${health.signals.length ? 'is-amber' : ''}`} aria-hidden="true" /><span className="dk-sub">{healthTag(health)}</span></>)}
        {ui.maintenance.length > 0 && btn('maintenance', <>Maintenance <span className="dk-count">{ui.maintenance.length}</span></>, 'is-quiet')}
      </div>
      {panel && (
        <aside className="dk-drawer" aria-label={TITLES[panel]}>
          <header className="dk-drawer-head">
            <h2>{TITLES[panel]}</h2>
            <button className="dk-close" aria-label="Close panel" onClick={() => toggle(panel)}>×</button>
          </header>
          <div className="dk-drawer-body">
            {panel === 'journeys' && <JourneysPanel />}
            {panel === 'findings' && <FindingsPanel />}
            {panel === 'health' && <HealthPanel />}
            {panel === 'maintenance' && <MaintenancePanel />}
          </div>
        </aside>
      )}
    </>
  );
}

const CLASS_TEXT = {
  gateway: { title: 'Through the gateway', sub: 'redacted and cost-logged: the design' },
  violation: { title: 'Around the gateway, breaking a rule', sub: 'unredacted and uncosted' },
  uncosted: { title: 'Around the gateway, no rule broken', sub: 'calls the SDK directly: uncosted' },
} as const;

/** Beat 1's legend: the classes present, each clickable to bring it forward. */
export function TraceLegend({ graph, map, violations }: { graph: ContextGraph; map: DomainMap; violations: readonly Violation[] }) {
  const focus = useOverlay((s) => s.traceClass);
  const setFocus = useOverlay((s) => s.setTraceClass);
  const setTrace = useOverlay((s) => s.setTrace);
  const rows = summarize(pathsToProvider(graph, map, violations));
  const ways = rows.length;
  return (
    <section className="ov-legend" aria-label="Paths to Claude">
      <header>
        <h2>{ways === 1 ? 'One way to Claude' : `${ways} ways to Claude`}<span className="ov-legend-design">{ways > 1 ? ' · the design says one' : ''}</span></h2>
        <button className="dk-close" aria-label="Hide paths" onClick={() => setTrace(null)}>×</button>
      </header>
      <ul>
        {rows.map((r) => (
          <li key={r.cls}>
            <button className={`ov-legend-row is-${r.cls} ${focus && focus !== r.cls ? 'is-dim' : ''}`} aria-pressed={focus === r.cls} onClick={() => setFocus(focus === r.cls ? null : r.cls)}>
              <span className="ov-legend-swatch" aria-hidden="true" />
              <span className="ov-legend-title">{CLASS_TEXT[r.cls].title}{r.invariant ? '' : ''}{r.invariants.length ? <b> {r.invariants.join(', ')}</b> : null}</span>
              <span className="ov-legend-sub">{CLASS_TEXT[r.cls].sub}</span>
              <span className="ov-legend-files">{r.callers.map(shortName).join(', ')} → {r.providers.map(shortName).join(', ')}</span>
            </button>
          </li>
        ))}
      </ul>
    </section>
  );
}

/** Play / step / scrub through a journey. Playback stops at the end (nothing loops). */
export function JourneyPlayer({ j, graph, map }: { j: Journey; graph: ContextGraph; map: DomainMap | null }) {
  const step = useOverlay((s) => s.step);
  const playing = useOverlay((s) => s.playing);
  const { setStep, setPlaying, showJourney } = useOverlay.getState();
  const n = j.steps.length;
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!playing) return;
    if (step >= n - 1) { setPlaying(false); return; }
    const t = setTimeout(() => setStep(step + 1), step === 0 ? 700 : 1100);
    return () => clearTimeout(t);
  }, [playing, step, n, setStep, setPlaying]);
  const cap = stepCaption(j, step, graph, map);
  return (
    <section className="ov-player" aria-label={`Journey ${j.name}`}>
      <div className="ov-player-name">
        <span>{j.name}</span>
        {j.inferred && <span className="pn-inferred">inferred</span>}
      </div>
      <div className="ov-player-controls">
        <button className="pn-icon" aria-label="Previous step" disabled={step === 0} onClick={() => { setPlaying(false); setStep(step - 1); }}>‹</button>
        <button className="pn-icon is-play" aria-label={playing ? 'Pause' : 'Play'} onClick={() => { if (!playing && step >= n - 1) setStep(0); setPlaying(!playing); }}>{playing ? '❚❚' : '▶'}</button>
        <button className="pn-icon" aria-label="Next step" disabled={step >= n - 1} onClick={() => { setPlaying(false); setStep(step + 1); }}>›</button>
        <input className="ov-scrub" type="range" min={0} max={n - 1} value={step} aria-label="Scrub steps" onChange={(e) => { setPlaying(false); setStep(Number(e.target.value)); }} />
        <span className="ov-player-step"><b>{step + 1}</b> of {n}</span>
      </div>
      <div className="ov-player-cap"><b>{cap.title}</b> <code>{cap.sub}</code></div>
      <button className="dk-close" aria-label="Close journey" onClick={() => showJourney(null)}>×</button>
    </section>
  );
}

/** "Trace from …" header: what is traced, and a way out. */
export function TraceFromBar({ from, graph }: { from: string; graph: ContextGraph }) {
  const setTrace = useOverlay((s) => s.setTrace);
  const n = graph.nodes[from];
  return (
    <section className="ov-legend is-from" aria-label="Trace">
      <header>
        <h2>Trace from <code>{n?.label ?? from}</code></h2>
        <button className="dk-close" aria-label="Hide trace" onClick={() => setTrace(null)}>×</button>
      </header>
      <p className="ov-legend-sub">Shortest call chains to the services and tables it reaches. Dispatch through a registry counts; a red hop crosses a rule.</p>
    </section>
  );
}
```

```typescript
// Server pieces of N6/N7: the "pointing at" line Claude receives with a message, and the code pane's diff route
// (unified -U0 hunks against the turn baseline; a file created after the baseline diffs against /dev/null).
import { afterAll, describe, expect, it } from 'vitest';
import { cpSync, mkdtempSync, rmSync, writeFileSync, appendFileSync } from 'node:fs';
import { tmpdir } from 'node:os';
import { join } from 'node:path';
import { execFileSync } from 'node:child_process';
import { describeNode, pointingLine } from '../../../apps/server/src/context';
import { baselineFor, fileDiff, parseHunks } from '../../../apps/server/src/diff';
import { createMapper } from '../src/mapper';
import type { HarnessEvent } from '../src/events';
import { fixtureRepo, loadMap } from './helpers';

const map = loadMap();
const mapper = createMapper(map);
const placer = { map, place: (p: string) => mapper.place(p) };

describe('Point: the line Claude receives', () => {
  it('resolves symbols, files, cells and domains with where they sit', () => {
    expect(describeNode(placer, 'src/gateway/cost-ledger.ts#recordCost')).toBe('src/gateway/cost-ledger.ts#recordCost (Model gateway › Data)');
    expect(describeNode(placer, 'cell:tools/data')).toMatch(/^the Research tools › Data cell \(/);
    expect(describeNode(placer, 'domain:gateway')).toMatch(/^the Model gateway domain \(src\/gateway/);
    expect(describeNode(placer, 'vendor:@anthropic-ai/sdk')).toBe('the package @anthropic-ai/sdk');
    expect(describeNode(placer, '../etc/passwd')).toBeNull();
    expect(pointingLine(placer, [])).toBeNull();
    expect(pointingLine(placer, ['src/gateway/cost-ledger.ts#recordCost', 'src/gateway/cost-ledger.ts#recordCost'])).toBe(
      '[The user is pointing at: src/gateway/cost-ledger.ts#recordCost (Model gateway › Data)]',
    );
  });
});

const dirs: string[] = [];
afterAll(() => { for (const d of dirs) rmSync(d, { recursive: true, force: true }); });
const git = (cwd: string, ...args: string[]) => execFileSync('git', args, { cwd, encoding: 'utf8' }).trim();

describe('code pane diff', () => {
  it('parses -U0 hunks', () => {
    const out = '@@ -3 +3,2 @@ x\n-old\n+new\n+more\n@@ -10,2 +11,0 @@\n-a\n-b\n';
    expect(parseHunks(out)).toEqual([
      { oldStart: 3, oldLines: 1, newStart: 3, newLines: 2, lines: ['-old', '+new', '+more'] },
      { oldStart: 10, oldLines: 2, newStart: 11, newLines: 0, lines: ['-a', '-b'] },
    ]);
  });

  it('diffs a file against the turn baseline, and a created file against /dev/null', () => {
    const dir = mkdtempSync(join(tmpdir(), 'harness-diff-'));
    dirs.push(dir);
    cpSync(fixtureRepo, dir, { recursive: true });
    git(dir, 'init', '-q');
    git(dir, 'add', '-A');
    git(dir, '-c', 'user.email=t@t', '-c', 'user.name=t', 'commit', '-qm', 'base');
    const head = git(dir, 'rev-parse', 'HEAD');
    appendFileSync(join(dir, 'src/gateway/redact.ts'), '\nexport const EXTRA = 1;\n');
    writeFileSync(join(dir, 'src/gateway/new-file.ts'), 'a\nb\n');
    const events = [{ id: '1', t: 1, session: 's', turn: 't1', kind: 'turn_started', data: { prompt: '', head, baseline: head } }] as HarnessEvent[];
    const base = baselineFor(events, 't1', null);
    expect(base).toBe(head);
    const d = fileDiff(dir, 'src/gateway/redact.ts', base);
    expect(d.created).toBe(false);
    expect(d.hunks.flatMap((h) => h.lines)).toEqual(['+', '+export const EXTRA = 1;']);
    const n = fileDiff(dir, 'src/gateway/new-file.ts', base);
    expect(n).toMatchObject({ created: true, hunks: [{ newStart: 1, newLines: 2, lines: ['+a', '+b'] }] });
    // an unknown turn with no usable sha gives no diff rather than a wrong one; a bad sha is refused
    expect(baselineFor(events, 'nope', null)).toBeNull();
    expect(fileDiff(dir, 'src/gateway/redact.ts', 'zz;rm').hunks).toEqual([]);
  });
});
```

```typescript
// The one mount point for wave 3's overlays and panels (lane B), rendered as a child of MapV2's <ReactFlow>:
// world-space layers (journey, trace, proposal ghosts, inferred labels) in a ViewportPortal, and screen-space chrome
// (dock and drawer, proposal card, trace legend, journey player). Everything is derived from the event log plus
// view-only state in ./state.ts.
import { useEffect, useMemo, useRef } from 'react';
import { ViewportPortal } from '@xyflow/react';
import { useView } from '../../derive';
import type { Frame } from '../layout/frame';
import { Dock, JourneyPlayer, TraceFromBar, TraceLegend } from '../panels/Chrome';
import { ProposalCard, usePreview } from '../panels/ProposalCard';
import { useCamera } from './camera';
import { padBox, unionBox } from './geometry';
import { useGraph } from './hooks';
import { JourneyLayer, useJourneyStops } from './JourneyLayer';
import { stopOf } from './journey';
import { LabelLayer } from './LabelLayer';
import { ProposalLayer } from './ProposalLayer';
import { useOverlay } from './state';
import { FromTraceLayer, pinBox, ProviderTraceLayer } from './TraceLayer';
import { COL_W, GAP_X } from '../layout/frame';
import './overlays.css';
import '../panels/panels.css';

/** An assistant answer that talks about how the code reaches the model provider (beat 1) opens the provider trace once. */
const PROVIDER_TALK = /(paths? to (claude|the (model|provider))|model provider|llm-anthropic|anthropic-ai\/sdk|bypass(es)? the gateway|around the gateway|outside the gateway)/i;

export function MapOverlays({ frame, chrome = true }: { frame: Frame | null; chrome?: boolean }) {
  const v = useView();
  const ui = v.ui;
  const graph = useGraph();
  const journeyId = useOverlay((s) => s.journey);
  const trace = useOverlay((s) => s.trace);
  const step = useOverlay((s) => s.step);
  const j = useMemo(() => ui.journeys.find((x) => x.id === journeyId) ?? null, [ui.journeys, journeyId]);
  const preview = usePreview();
  const stops = useJourneyStops(j, graph, frame ?? EMPTY);
  const { fit, reveal } = useCamera();

  // Camera: fit the journey when it opens, then keep the current stop on screen (staged, never looping).
  const fitted = useRef<string | null>(null);
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!frame || !j || !stops.length) { if (!j) fitted.current = null; return; }
    if (fitted.current !== j.id) {
      fitted.current = j.id;
      fit(padBox(unionBox(stops.map((s) => s.box))!, 70));
      return;
    }
    const s = stops[stopOf(stops, step)];
    if (s) reveal(padBox(s.box, 60));
  }, [frame, j, stops, step, fit, reveal]);

  // The provider trace includes the Claude pin below the grid; fit both when it opens.
  const traceKey = trace ? (trace.mode === 'provider' ? 'provider' : `from:${trace.from}`) : null;
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!frame || !ui.map || !traceKey) return;
    fit(padBox(traceKey === 'provider' ? unionBox([frame.bounds, pinBox(frame, ui.map)])! : frame.bounds, 30));
  }, [traceKey]); // eslint-disable-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps -- fit once per trace opened

  // A proposed domain is drawn right of the grid; bring it into view when the proposal (or candidate) appears.
  const ghostKey = preview && preview.changes.some((c) => c.kind === 'add_domain') ? `${preview.state.proposal.id}#${preview.index}` : null;
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!frame || !ghostKey || !preview) return;
    const n = preview.changes.filter((c) => c.kind === 'add_domain').length;
    fit(padBox({ ...frame.bounds, w: frame.bounds.w + n * (COL_W + GAP_X) }, 40));
  }, [ghostKey]); // eslint-disable-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps -- once per proposal shown

  // Beat 1: when Claude's answer is about the paths to the provider, draw them (once per answer; live only).
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!v.live || !graph) return;
    const i = ui.chat.findLastIndex((m) => m.role === 'assistant');
    const st = useOverlay.getState();
    if (i < 0 || i <= st.autoTraced || !PROVIDER_TALK.test(ui.chat[i]!.text)) return;
    useOverlay.setState({ autoTraced: i });
    if (!st.trace) st.setTrace({ mode: 'provider' });
  }, [ui.chat, v.live, graph]);

  // `p` toggles the paths to Claude (one key for the presenter); Esc closes a journey or trace first.
  useEffect(() => {
    const onKey = (e: KeyboardEvent) => {
      const t = e.target as HTMLElement | null;
      if (t?.closest('textarea, input, [contenteditable]') || e.metaKey || e.ctrlKey || e.altKey) return;
      const st = useOverlay.getState();
      if (e.key === 'p') { st.setTrace(st.trace?.mode === 'provider' ? null : { mode: 'provider' }); }
      else if (e.key === 'Escape' && (st.journey || st.trace)) { e.stopImmediatePropagation(); st.showJourney(null); st.setTrace(null); }
    };
    window.addEventListener('keydown', onKey, true);
    return () => window.removeEventListener('keydown', onKey, true);
  }, []);

  if (!frame || !graph || !ui.map) return null;
  return (
    <>
      <ViewportPortal>
        <LabelLayer labels={ui.labels} graph={graph} frame={frame} />
        {preview && <ProposalLayer preview={preview} graph={graph} frame={frame} />}
        {j && <JourneyLayer j={j} graph={graph} frame={frame} map={ui.map} />}
        {!j && trace?.mode === 'provider' && <ProviderTraceLayer graph={graph} frame={frame} map={ui.map} violations={ui.violations} />}
        {!j && trace?.mode === 'from' && <FromTraceLayer graph={graph} frame={frame} from={trace.from} violations={ui.violations} />}
      </ViewportPortal>
      {chrome && (
        <div className="ov-chrome">
          <Dock graph={graph} />
          {preview && <ProposalCard preview={preview} />}
          {!j && trace?.mode === 'provider' && <TraceLegend graph={graph} map={ui.map} violations={ui.violations} />}
          {!j && trace?.mode === 'from' && <TraceFromBar from={trace.from} graph={graph} />}
          {j && <JourneyPlayer j={j} graph={graph} map={ui.map} />}
        </div>
      )}
    </>
  );
}

const EMPTY: Frame = { nodes: [], boxes: {}, edges: [], cols: [], rows: [], bounds: { x: 0, y: 0, w: 0, h: 0 }, focus: null, gutters: { x: [], y: [] }, key: '' };
```

```typescript
// The single slot node components render for overlay badges (lane B): the amber "audit" badge for open findings
// (inferred), a dashed mark for pending proposals, the faint "probably <domain>?" guess on unassigned code, and a
// one-time tick when files arrive in a cell while the map assembles. Reads only this node's slice.
import { useEffect, useRef, useState } from 'react';
import type { VisibleNode } from '@harness/core/view';
import { useView } from '../../derive';
import { reducedMotion } from '../transition';
import { useV2 } from '../store';
import { guessFor, guessSummary } from './hooks';
import { useOverlay } from './state';

const MARK: Record<string, string> = { add: 'placed', move_in: 'moves in', move_out: 'moves', remove: 'removed', rename: 'renamed' };

export function BadgeSlot({ id }: { id: string }) {
  const n = useV2((s) => s.nodes[id]) as VisibleNode | undefined;
  if (!n) return null;
  const r = n.rollup;
  const unassigned = n.id === 'unassigned' || (n.kind === 'file' && !n.domain);
  return (
    <>
      {(r.audit > 0 || r.proposal) && (
        <span className="ov-badges">
          {r.proposal && <span className="ov-badge is-proposal" title="A pending map proposal touches this">{MARK[r.proposal] ?? 'proposal'}</span>}
          {r.audit > 0 && (
            <button
              className="ov-badge is-audit"
              title={`${r.audit} open audit finding${r.audit === 1 ? '' : 's'} (advisory, inferred)`}
              onClick={(e) => { e.stopPropagation(); useOverlay.getState().setPanel('findings'); }}
            >
              audit{r.audit > 1 ? ` ${r.audit}` : ''}<i>inferred</i>
            </button>
          )}
        </span>
      )}
      {unassigned && <Guess id={n.id} kind={n.kind} />}
      {(n.kind === 'cell' || n.kind === 'unassigned') && <Arrive leaves={r.leaves} />}
    </>
  );
}

function Guess({ id, kind }: { id: string; kind: string }) {
  const v = useView();
  const text = kind === 'file'
    ? (() => { const g = guessFor(v.ui, id); return g ? `probably ${g.isNew ? `a new domain (${g.name})` : g.name}?` : null; })()
    : guessSummary(v.ui, v.unassigned);
  if (!text) return null;
  return <span className="ov-guess" title="A deterministic guess from folder siblings and imports; the cartographer proposes at turn end">{text}</span>;
}

/** "+3" for a moment when a cell gains files (the map assembling on load, or new code landing). */
function Arrive({ leaves }: { leaves: number }) {
  const prev = useRef(leaves);
  const [tick, setTick] = useState<{ n: number; k: number } | null>(null);
  useEffect(() => {
    const d = leaves - prev.current;
    prev.current = leaves;
    if (d <= 0 || reducedMotion()) return;
    setTick((t) => ({ n: d + (t ? t.n : 0), k: (t?.k ?? 0) + 1 }));
    const h = setTimeout(() => setTick(null), 900);
    return () => clearTimeout(h);
  }, [leaves]);
  if (!tick) return null;
  return <span key={tick.k} className="ov-arrive" aria-hidden="true">+{tick.n}</span>;
}
```

```typescript
// Links back (NAVIGATION_PLAN §3.4): a path or `path#symbol` named in chat flies the map there, opening what is on
// the way (the file opens into rows for a symbol), and opens the code pane. Light module: no React Flow or ELK, so
// the chat pane can import it without pulling in the map.
import { fileOf, type ContextGraph } from '@harness/core/view';
import { useStore } from '../store';
import { jump } from './nav';
import { useV2 } from './store';

/** The latest scene's graph, set by the map for handlers outside React's render (chat links, keyboard, palette). */
export const sceneGraph: { current: ContextGraph | null } = { current: null };

/** Reveal a repo path or `path#symbol`: open the containers on the way, focus it, fly there, open the code pane. */
export function reveal(ref: string, opts: { code?: boolean } = {}) {
  const file = fileOf(ref) ?? ref;
  const symbol = ref.includes('#') ? ref : null;
  const graph = sceneGraph.current;
  const st = useV2.getState();
  if (graph && (graph.nodes[ref] || graph.nodes[file])) {
    const next = jump(graph, { open: st.open, focus: st.focus }, ref);
    st.go(next, next.focus ?? file);
  }
  if (opts.code !== false) {
    const s = useStore.getState();
    if (s.selection) s.select(null); // the code pane and the inspector share the right edge
    s.openCode(file, symbol);
  }
}
```

```typescript
// Lane B's parts of the inspector, mounted through two small hooks in components/Inspector.tsx:
// - DecisionBody: the decision view (beat 3's "in Alike" chip with a copyable URN, what it refines, what it protects);
// - InspectorSlot: "Trace from here" for code nodes, and the open audit findings on the selected file.
import { useState } from 'react';
import { fileOf, sessionNumber } from '@harness/core/view';
import { useView } from '../../derive';
import type { Selection } from '../../store';
import { useOverlay } from '../overlays/state';
import { FindingItem } from './FindingsPanel';
import { openLine } from './open';

export function DecisionBody({ id }: { id: string }) {
  const v = useView();
  const d = v.ui.decisions.find((x) => x.id === id);
  const [copied, setCopied] = useState(false);
  if (!d) return <p className="insp-note">{id} is not in the log at this point.</p>;
  const inv = v.ui.map?.invariants.find((i) => i.id === d.invariant);
  const turn = d.turn ? v.ui.turns.findIndex((t) => t.id === d.turn) + 1 : 0;
  const session = sessionNumber(v.ui, d.session);
  const copy = async () => {
    if (!d.urn) return;
    try { await navigator.clipboard.writeText(d.urn); setCopied(true); setTimeout(() => setCopied(false), 1400); } catch { /* clipboard blocked */ }
  };
  return (
    <>
      <h2 className="insp-title">{d.id} <span className="insp-layer">decision</span></h2>
      <p className="insp-sub">{d.title}</p>
      <div className="pn-dec-meta">
        {d.alike && (
          <span className="pn-alike">
            <span className="pn-alike-chip">in Alike</span>
            {d.urn && <code className="pn-urn" title={d.urn}>{d.urn}</code>}
            {d.urn && <button className="pn-copy" onClick={() => void copy()} aria-label="Copy URN">{copied ? 'Copied' : 'Copy'}</button>}
          </span>
        )}
        <span className="insp-note">Option {d.option}{session ? ` · decided in session ${session}` : ''}{turn ? `, turn ${turn}` : ''}</span>
      </div>
      <section className="insp-section">
        <h3>Refines</h3>
        <p><strong>{d.invariant}</strong> {inv?.rule ?? ''}</p>
      </section>
      {d.protects && (d.protects.paths.length > 0 || d.protects.symbols.length > 0) && (
        <section className="insp-section">
          <h3>Protects</h3>
          <ul className="insp-files">
            {[...d.protects.symbols, ...d.protects.paths.filter((p) => !d.protects!.symbols.some((s) => fileOf(s) === p))].map((p) => (
              <li key={p}><button className="link" onClick={() => openLine(fileOf(p) ?? p)}>{p}</button></li>
            ))}
          </ul>
        </section>
      )}
      {d.paths.length > 0 && (
        <section className="insp-section">
          <h3>Anchored on</h3>
          <ul className="insp-files">{d.paths.map((p) => <li key={p}><button className="link" onClick={() => openLine(p)}>{p}</button></li>)}</ul>
        </section>
      )}
      <section className="insp-section">
        <h3>Record</h3>
        <p className="insp-note"><code>decisions/{d.id}.md</code>{d.alike ? ', and in Alike, where every agent working on these folders is given it.' : ' in the repo.'}</p>
      </section>
    </>
  );
}

const CODE = new Set(['file', 'symbol', 'route', 'entry']);

export function InspectorSlot({ sel }: { sel: Selection }) {
  const v = useView();
  const setTrace = useOverlay((s) => s.setTrace);
  const id = 'file' in sel ? sel.file : 'node' in sel ? sel.node : null;
  if (!id) return null;
  const kind = id.startsWith('route:') ? 'route' : id.startsWith('entry:') ? 'entry' : id.includes('#') ? 'symbol' : 'file' in sel ? 'file' : null;
  const file = fileOf(id);
  const findings = Object.values(v.ui.findings).filter((f) => f.status === 'open' && file && f.files.includes(file));
  if (!kind && !findings.length) return null;
  return (
    <div className="pn-insp-slot">
      {kind && CODE.has(kind) && (
        <button className="btn pn-trace-btn" onClick={() => setTrace({ mode: 'from', from: id })}>Trace from here</button>
      )}
      {findings.length > 0 && (
        <section className="insp-section">
          <h3>Audit findings ({findings.length})</h3>
          <ul className="pn-findings">{findings.map((f) => <FindingItem key={f.id} f={f} />)}</ul>
        </section>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}
```

```typescript
// Lane B's parts of the chat pane, mounted through two small hooks in components/ChatPane.tsx:
// - chatLines: the chat log plus derived system lines ("DR-4 in Alike" when the server re-emits a decision with
//   `alike: true`), placed where they happened in the log;
// - PlanReviewNotes: the auditor's plan-review notes on the approval card (findings on the awaiting turn raised after
//   its latest plan). Advisory only: they never block Approve.
import type { HarnessEvent, UIState } from '@harness/core/view';
import { useView } from '../../derive';
import { useStore } from '../../store';

export type ChatLine = UIState['chat'][number] & { tag?: 'alike'; decision?: string; urn?: string };

let cache: { events: readonly HarnessEvent[]; upTo: number; out: { afterChat: number; id: string; urn?: string }[] } | null = null;

/** "DR-n in Alike" lines, each after the chat message count at the moment Alike confirmed it (first confirmation only). */
export function alikeNotes(events: readonly HarnessEvent[], upTo: number) {
  if (cache && cache.events === events && cache.upTo === upTo) return cache.out;
  const out: { afterChat: number; id: string; urn?: string }[] = [];
  const seen = new Set<string>();
  let chats = 0;
  for (let i = 0; i < Math.min(upTo, events.length); i++) {
    const e = events[i]!;
    if (e.kind === 'chat') chats++;
    else if (e.kind === 'decision_recorded') {
      const d = e.data as { id: string; alike?: boolean; urn?: string };
      if (d.alike && !seen.has(d.id)) { seen.add(d.id); out.push({ afterChat: chats, id: d.id, ...(d.urn ? { urn: d.urn } : {}) }); }
    }
  }
  cache = { events, upTo, out };
  return out;
}

/** The chat as shown: messages plus the derived Alike lines in log order. */
export function useChatLines(): ChatLine[] {
  const v = useView();
  const events = useStore((s) => s.events);
  const notes = alikeNotes(events, v.upTo);
  if (!notes.length) return v.ui.chat;
  const out: ChatLine[] = [];
  const at = (n: number) => notes.filter((x) => x.afterChat === n).forEach((x) => out.push({ role: 'system', text: `${x.id} in Alike`, turn: null, t: 0, tag: 'alike', decision: x.id, ...(x.urn ? { urn: x.urn } : {}) }));
  at(0);
  v.ui.chat.forEach((m, i) => { out.push(m); at(i + 1); });
  return out;
}

/** The body of a derived line (the default renders `text`). */
export function AlikeLine({ line }: { line: ChatLine }) {
  const select = useStore((s) => s.select);
  return (
    <button className="pn-alike-line" onClick={() => line.decision && select({ decision: line.decision })} title={line.urn ?? 'Recorded in Alike'}>
      <span className="pn-alike-chip">Alike</span>
      <span><b>{line.decision}</b> in Alike</span>
      <span className="pn-alike-sub">every agent on these folders is given it</span>
    </button>
  );
}

export function PlanReviewNotes() {
  const v = useView();
  const events = useStore((s) => s.events);
  const wait = v.ui.awaitingApproval;
  if (!wait?.turn) return null;
  let planned = -1;
  for (let i = Math.min(v.upTo, events.length) - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
    const e = events[i]!;
    if (e.kind === 'planned' && e.turn === wait.turn) { planned = i; break; }
  }
  const notes = Object.values(v.ui.findings).filter((f) => f.turn === wait.turn && f.at > planned && f.status === 'open');
  if (!notes.length) return null;
  return (
    <div className="pn-review" aria-label="Auditor notes on this plan">
      {notes.map((f) => (
        <p key={f.id} className="pn-review-note">
          <span className="pn-audit">audit</span>
          {f.decision && <b>{f.decision}</b>} {f.text}
          <span className={`pn-conf is-${f.confidence}`}>{f.confidence}</span>
        </p>
      ))}
    </div>
  );
}
```

```typescript
// ⌘K entries for the overlays, appended by the palette through one hook: "Paths to Claude", each journey, and
// "Trace from …" for routes, symbols and files (found by typing "trace").
import { fileOf, type ContextGraph, type UIState } from '@harness/core/view';
import { useOverlay } from './state';

export type PaletteExtra = { key: string; kind: string; label: string; sub: string; hay: string; rank: number; run: () => void };

export function paletteExtras(graph: ContextGraph, ui: UIState): PaletteExtra[] {
  const st = useOverlay.getState;
  const out: PaletteExtra[] = [{
    key: 'ov:paths', kind: 'trace', label: 'Paths to Claude', sub: 'every path to the model provider, in three classes', rank: 0,
    hay: 'paths to claude model provider trace gateway anthropic llm', run: () => st().setTrace({ mode: 'provider' }),
  }];
  for (const j of ui.journeys) {
    out.push({ key: `ov:${j.id}`, kind: 'journey', label: j.name, sub: `${j.steps.length} steps${j.inferred ? ' · inferred name' : ''}`, rank: 1, hay: `journey ${j.name} ${j.entry}`.toLowerCase(), run: () => st().showJourney(j.id, true) });
  }
  for (const n of Object.values(graph.nodes)) {
    if (n.kind !== 'route' && n.kind !== 'file' && !(n.kind === 'symbol' && n.symbol?.kind !== 'type' && n.symbol?.kind !== 'property')) continue;
    const label = n.kind === 'symbol' ? n.id.slice(n.id.indexOf('#') + 1) : n.label;
    out.push({ key: `ov:trace:${n.id}`, kind: 'trace', label: `Trace from ${label}`, sub: fileOf(n.id) ?? '', rank: 8, hay: `trace from ${label} ${fileOf(n.id) ?? ''}`.toLowerCase(), run: () => st().setTrace({ mode: 'from', from: n.id }) });
  }
  return out;
}
```

```typescript
// Which tokens in Claude's replies name something on the map (beat 1: "each path in the reply is a link"). Built from
// the reduced log's facts and placements only, so it works in any turn, including a plain question with no plan or
// edits. Deterministic and cheap: one index per facts object.
import { useMemo } from 'react';
import type { UIState } from '@harness/core/view';
import { reveal } from '../v2/reveal';
import type { Links } from './Markdown';

type Index = { paths: Set<string>; byBase: Map<string, string[]>; symbols: Set<string>; byName: Map<string, string[]> };

const cache = new WeakMap<object, Index>();

function indexOf(ui: UIState): Index {
  const key = ui.facts;
  const hit = cache.get(key);
  if (hit && hit.paths.size >= Object.keys(ui.files).length) return hit;
  const paths = new Set<string>([...Object.keys(ui.files), ...Object.keys(ui.facts)]);
  const byBase = new Map<string, string[]>();
  for (const p of paths) {
    const b = p.slice(p.lastIndexOf('/') + 1);
    (byBase.get(b) ?? byBase.set(b, []).get(b)!).push(p);
  }
  const symbols = new Set<string>();
  const byName = new Map<string, string[]>();
  for (const f of Object.values(ui.facts)) {
    for (const s of f.symbols) {
      symbols.add(s.id);
      (byName.get(s.name) ?? byName.set(s.name, []).get(s.name)!).push(s.id);
    }
  }
  const ix = { paths, byBase, symbols, byName };
  cache.set(key, ix);
  return ix;
}

/** A path as written (`src/a.ts`, `./a.ts`, `gateway/redact.ts`, `redact.ts`) → the one repo path it names, or null. */
function resolvePath(ix: Index, raw: string): string | null {
  const p = raw.replace(/^\.\//, '').replace(/:\d+(?:[-:]\d+)?$/, '');
  if (ix.paths.has(p)) return p;
  const base = p.slice(p.lastIndexOf('/') + 1);
  const cands = (ix.byBase.get(base) ?? []).filter((x) => x === p || x.endsWith(`/${p}`));
  return cands.length === 1 ? cands[0]! : null;
}

/** A token from a reply → a map id (repo path or `path#symbol`), or null. `code`: it was in backticks (bare symbol names count). */
export function resolveToken(ui: UIState, token: string, code: boolean): string | null {
  const ix = indexOf(ui);
  const t = token.trim().replace(/[.,;:!?)]+$/, '').replace(/\(\)$/, '');
  if (!t || t.length > 200 || /\s/.test(t)) return null;
  const hash = t.indexOf('#');
  if (hash > 0) {
    const path = resolvePath(ix, t.slice(0, hash));
    const sym = t.slice(hash + 1);
    return path && /^[\w.$~<>]+$/.test(sym) ? `${path}#${sym}` : null;
  }
  const path = resolvePath(ix, t);
  if (path) return path;
  if (!code) return null;
  // a bare symbol name in backticks (`recordCost`, `Redactor.redact`): only when exactly one symbol has that name
  if (!/^[A-Za-z_$][\w$]*(?:\.[\w$]+)*$/.test(t)) return null;
  const ids = ix.byName.get(t) ?? [];
  return ids.length === 1 ? ids[0]! : null;
}

export function useLinks(ui: UIState): Links {
  return useMemo(() => ({ resolve: (t, code) => resolveToken(ui, t, code), open: (id) => reveal(id) }), [ui]);
}
```

```typescript
// Beat 4 on the server: what a decision protects is recorded when its turn ends (DR file + commit + event), plans and
// edits that touch it emit `decision_touched`, the submit_plan result and the PostToolUse hook carry the reminder (once
// per decision per turn), and the brief lists it. Fixture repo copy; no model.
import { afterAll, beforeAll, describe, expect, it } from 'vitest';
import { appendFileSync, cpSync, mkdirSync, mkdtempSync, readFileSync, realpathSync, rmSync, writeFileSync } from 'node:fs';
import { tmpdir } from 'node:os';
import { join } from 'node:path';
import { execFileSync } from 'node:child_process';
import { parse as parseYaml } from 'yaml';
import { Bus } from '../../../apps/server/src/bus';
import { Repo } from '../../../apps/server/src/repo';
```
