```typescript
// The flow map (map-first redesign): the system drawn left → right in the direction of calls, rolled up to the
// components that matter at overview zoom (~15–30 nodes). Pure, deterministic and browser-safe: the same graph and
// open set always give the same model, in the same order, so the ELK layout (model order) is stable.
//
// Rollup rules, applied per cell of domains.yaml (tests, shared code and node builtins are never drawn):
//   ui        one `page` per cell (a feature's screens)
//   entry     one `door` per file (each way in is distinct: HTTP routes, CLI)
//   data      one `store` per cell, named by its tables; drawn below the flow
//   external  one `service` per package directory (`vendor/<name>/`)
//   logic     a cell whose files implement a shared interface (≥ 2 `implements` sources: a registry's tools) or that
//             holds ≤ 3 files is drawn per file; a larger cell is one `step` named after its domain (the gateway)
//   packages  a bare package reached from drawn non-UI code (the model SDK) is an `sdk` sink on the far right
// Folding: a file whose only callers are one other file in its cell folds into that caller (planner → agent,
// sec-edgar → enrichment), and a leaf helper only called from its own domain's doors folds into the first door.
// An open region (domain) is drawn per file instead, so zooming in shows its internal flow.
import type { DomainMap } from '../schema';
import type { Journey } from '../contracts/cartography';
import { fileOf, type ContextGraph, type EdgeKind, type GraphNode } from '../contracts/graph';

export type FlowNodeKind = 'page' | 'door' | 'step' | 'service' | 'store' | 'sdk';

export type FlowNode = {
  id: string; // `flow:<cell or file or package>`
  kind: FlowNodeKind;
  label: string;
  detail: string; // a quiet second line: what is rolled up, routes, tables
  domain: string | null;
  layer: string | null;
  /** Graph leaf ids drawn by this node (files, tables, vendors). */
  members: string[];
  order: number; // model order for the layout
  /** More than one file underneath: opening its region splits it. */
  rolled: boolean;
};

export type FlowEdge = {
  id: string; // `from->to` (flow node ids)
  from: string;
  to: string;
  kinds: EdgeKind[];
  count: number; // distinct file-level pairs underneath
  /** Into a store (reads/writes): drawn below the flow, quietly. */
  store: boolean;
};

export type FlowRegion = { id: string; domain: string; name: string; purpose: string; nodes: string[]; open: boolean };

export type FlowModel = {
  nodes: FlowNode[];
  edges: FlowEdge[];
  regions: FlowRegion[];
  /** Graph leaf id (file, table, vendor) → flow node id. Symbols, routes and entries resolve through `flowNodeOf`. */
  nodeOf: Record<string, string>;
  open: string[];
  key: string; // changes when the node set or open set changes (the layout's cache key)
};

export type FlowOptions = {
  /** Domains drawn per file (zoomed in). */
  open?: readonly string[];
  /** Journeys link pages to the routes they call (fetch → route matching). */
  journeys?: readonly Journey[];
};

const FLOW_KINDS: EdgeKind[] = ['calls', 'imports', 'uses', 'handles', 'writes', 'reads'];
const KIND_RANK: Record<FlowNodeKind, number> = { page: 0, door: 1, step: 2, service: 3, sdk: 4, store: 5 };
const LAYER_RANK: Record<string, number> = { ui: 0, entry: 1, logic: 2, data: 4, external: 3 };
const SMALL_CELL = 3;

export const flowId = (key: string) => `flow:${key}`;

const stem = (path: string) => {
  const parts = path.split('/');
  const last = parts.pop() ?? path;
  if (/^index\.[cm]?[jt]sx?$/.test(last) && parts.length) return parts.pop()!;
  return last.replace(/\.[a-z]+$/, '');
};
const packageDir = (path: string) => {
  const parts = path.split('/');
  return parts.length > 2 ? parts.slice(0, 2).join('/') : path;
};

/** The flow node drawing a graph id (file, symbol, route, entry, table, vendor), or null when it is not drawn. */
export function flowNodeOf(model: FlowModel, graph: ContextGraph | null, id: string): string | null {
  if (model.nodeOf[id]) return model.nodeOf[id]!;
  const f = fileOf(id);
  if (f && model.nodeOf[f]) return model.nodeOf[f]!;
  // routes and entries live under their file
  for (let n: GraphNode | undefined = graph?.nodes[id]; n; n = n.parent ? graph?.nodes[n.parent] : undefined) {
    if (model.nodeOf[n.id]) return model.nodeOf[n.id]!;
  }
  if (id.startsWith('domain:')) return null;
  return null;
}

export function flowModel(graph: ContextGraph, map: DomainMap, opts: FlowOptions = {}): FlowModel {
  const open = [...new Set(opts.open ?? [])].filter((d) => map.domains.some((x) => x.id === d)).sort();
  const openSet = new Set(open);
  const nodes = new Map<string, FlowNode>();
  const nodeOf: Record<string, string> = {};
  const domainIdx = new Map(map.domains.map((d, i) => [d.id, i]));

  // ---- leaves by cell (files, tables) in graph order
  const files: GraphNode[] = [];
  const tables: GraphNode[] = [];
  const vendors: GraphNode[] = [];
  for (const n of Object.values(graph.nodes)) {
    if (n.kind === 'file' && n.domain && n.layer) files.push(n);
    else if (n.kind === 'file' && !n.domain && !n.layer && isUnassigned(graph, n)) files.push(n);
    else if (n.kind === 'table') tables.push(n);
    else if (n.kind === 'vendor') vendors.push(n);
  }
  files.sort((a, b) => (a.id < b.id ? -1 : 1));
  const byCell = new Map<string, GraphNode[]>();
  for (const f of files) {
    const k = f.domain ? `${f.domain}/${f.layer}` : 'unassigned';
    (byCell.get(k) ?? byCell.set(k, []).get(k)!).push(f);
  }

  // ---- file-level call/import adjacency (for folding and dispatch detection)
  const out = new Map<string, Set<string>>();
  const inn = new Map<string, Set<string>>();
  const implementers = new Set<string>();
  for (const e of graph.edges) {
    const a = fileOf(e.from) ?? e.from;
    const b = fileOf(e.to) ?? e.to;
    if (e.kind === 'implements') { implementers.add(a); continue; }
    if (a === b || !FLOW_KINDS.includes(e.kind)) continue;
    (out.get(a) ?? out.set(a, new Set()).get(a)!).add(b);
    (inn.get(b) ?? inn.set(b, new Set()).get(b)!).add(a);
  }
  const testOrShared = (id: string) => {
    const n = graph.nodes[id];
    return !n || n.kind === 'tests' || !n.domain || isUnder(graph, id, 'tests:');
  };
  const callers = (id: string) => [...(inn.get(id) ?? [])].filter((x) => !testOrShared(x)).sort();

  const add = (n: Omit<FlowNode, 'order' | 'rolled'>) => {
    const node: FlowNode = { ...n, order: 0, rolled: n.members.filter((m) => graph.nodes[m]?.kind === 'file').length > 1 };
    nodes.set(n.id, node);
    for (const m of n.members) nodeOf[m] = n.id;
    return node;
  };

  for (const [cellKey, list] of [...byCell].sort(([a], [b]) => cellRank(map, a, domainIdx) - cellRank(map, b, domainIdx) || (a < b ? -1 : 1))) {
    if (cellKey === 'unassigned') {
      add({ id: flowId('unassigned'), kind: 'step', label: 'Unassigned', detail: `${list.length} files`, domain: null, layer: null, members: list.map((f) => f.id) });
      continue;
    }
    const [domain, layer] = cellKey.split('/') as [string, string];
    const dom = map.domains.find((d) => d.id === domain)!;
    const cellTables = tables.filter((t) => t.domain === domain && t.layer === layer).map((t) => t.id);
    const isOpen = openSet.has(domain);

    if (layer === 'ui') {
      const pages = list.filter((f) => /Page\.[jt]sx?$/.test(f.id)).map((f) => stem(f.id).replace(/Page$/, ''));
      add({ id: flowId(`cell:${cellKey}`), kind: 'page', label: pages.length ? pages.join(', ') : `${dom.name} app`, detail: list.length > 1 ? `${list.length} files` : stem(list[0]!.id), domain, layer, members: list.map((f) => f.id) });
      continue;
    }
    if (layer === 'data' && !isOpen) {
      add({ id: flowId(`cell:${cellKey}`), kind: 'store', label: cellTables.map((t) => t.slice(6)).join(', ') || dom.name, detail: dom.name, domain, layer, members: [...list.map((f) => f.id), ...cellTables] });
      continue;
    }
    if (layer === 'data') {
      for (const f of list) if (!f.id.endsWith('.sql')) add({ id: flowId(f.id), kind: 'step', label: stem(f.id), detail: '', domain, layer, members: [f.id] });
      const schema = list.filter((f) => f.id.endsWith('.sql')).map((f) => f.id);
      cellTables.forEach((t, i) => add({ id: flowId(t), kind: 'store', label: t.slice(6), detail: dom.name, domain, layer, members: i === 0 ? [t, ...schema] : [t] }));
      continue;
    }
    if (layer === 'entry') {
      for (const f of list) add({ id: flowId(f.id), kind: 'door', ...doorLabel(graph, f), domain, layer, members: [f.id] });
      continue;
    }
    if (layer === 'external') {
      const groups = new Map<string, string[]>();
      for (const f of list) {
        const k = isOpen ? f.id : packageDir(f.id);
        (groups.get(k) ?? groups.set(k, []).get(k)!).push(f.id);
      }
      for (const [k, members] of groups) add({ id: flowId(k), kind: 'service', label: stem(k), detail: '', domain, layer, members });
      continue;
    }
    // logic (and any other layer)
    const plural = list.filter((f) => implementers.has(f.id)).length >= 2;
    if (isOpen || plural || list.length <= SMALL_CELL) {
      for (const f of list) add({ id: flowId(f.id), kind: 'step', label: stem(f.id), detail: '', domain, layer, members: [f.id] });
    } else {
      add({ id: flowId(`cell:${cellKey}`), kind: 'step', label: dom.name, detail: list.map((f) => stem(f.id)).join(', '), domain, layer, members: list.map((f) => f.id) });
    }
  }

  // ---- folding (closed regions only): a file called only by one other file in its cell joins that caller
  const fold = (id: string, into: string) => {
    const a = nodes.get(id)!;
    const b = nodes.get(into)!;
    b.members.push(...a.members);
    b.detail = b.detail ? `${b.detail}, ${a.label}` : `with ${a.label}`;
    b.rolled = true;
    for (const m of a.members) nodeOf[m] = into;
    nodes.delete(id);
  };
  const single = [...nodes.values()].filter((n) => n.members.length === 1 && (n.kind === 'step' || n.kind === 'service') && n.domain && !openSet.has(n.domain));
  const foldedInto = new Map<string, number>();
  const plan: [string, string][] = [];
  for (const n of single) {
    const file = n.members[0]!;
    if (n.kind === 'service') {
      // a service called only by another service of the same cell (sec-edgar ← enrichment)
      const c = callers(file);
      const hosts = new Set(c.map((x) => nodeOf[x]));
      const host = c.length && hosts.size === 1 ? nodes.get([...hosts][0]!) : undefined;
      if (host && host.id !== n.id && host.kind === 'service' && host.domain === n.domain && host.layer === n.layer) plan.push([n.id, host.id]);
      continue;
    }
    const c = callers(file);
    const hosts = [...new Set(c.map((x) => nodeOf[x]).filter((x): x is string => !!x))];
    if (hosts.length === 1 && hosts[0] !== n.id) {
      const host = nodes.get(hosts[0]!)!;
      if (host.domain === n.domain && host.layer === n.layer && host.kind === 'step') { plan.push([n.id, host.id]); continue; }
    }
    // a leaf helper (no calls out to other drawn nodes) only reached from its own domain's doors
    const outs = [...(out.get(file) ?? [])].filter((x) => nodeOf[x] && nodeOf[x] !== n.id);
    const doorHosts = hosts.map((h) => nodes.get(h)!).filter((h) => h.kind === 'door' && h.domain === n.domain);
    if (!outs.length && hosts.length > 0 && doorHosts.length === hosts.length) plan.push([n.id, doorHosts[0]!.id]);
  }
  // one fold per host keeps a registry's tools apart (a host never absorbs two siblings)
  for (const [, host] of plan) foldedInto.set(host, (foldedInto.get(host) ?? 0) + 1);
  for (const [id, host] of plan) if (foldedInto.get(host) === 1 && nodes.has(id) && nodes.has(host)) fold(id, host);

  // ---- bare packages reached from drawn non-UI code (the model SDK); node builtins and UI libraries stay off
  for (const v of vendors.sort((a, b) => (a.id < b.id ? -1 : 1))) {
    if (v.id.startsWith('vendor:node:')) continue;
    const users = callers(v.id).length ? callers(v.id) : [...(inn.get(v.id) ?? [])];
    const drawnUsers = users.filter((u) => { const n = nodes.get(nodeOf[u] ?? ''); return !!n && n.kind !== 'page'; });
    if (!drawnUsers.length) continue;
    add({ id: flowId(v.id), kind: 'sdk', label: v.label, detail: 'package', domain: v.domain ?? null, layer: v.layer ?? null, members: [v.id] });
  }

  // ---- edges between drawn nodes
  const edges = new Map<string, FlowEdge & { pairs: Set<string> }>();
  const link = (fromNode: string, toNode: string, kind: EdgeKind, pair: string) => {
    if (fromNode === toNode) return;
    const id = `${fromNode}->${toNode}`;
    const to = nodes.get(toNode)!;
    const e = edges.get(id) ?? edges.set(id, { id, from: fromNode, to: toNode, kinds: [], count: 0, store: to.kind === 'store', pairs: new Set() }).get(id)!;
    if (!e.kinds.includes(kind)) e.kinds.push(kind);
    e.pairs.add(pair);
  };
  for (const e of graph.edges) {
    if (!FLOW_KINDS.includes(e.kind)) continue;
    const a = resolveLeaf(graph, nodeOf, e.from);
    const b = resolveLeaf(graph, nodeOf, e.to);
    if (!a || !b) continue;
    link(a, b, e.kind, `${fileOf(e.from) ?? e.from}|${fileOf(e.to) ?? e.to}`);
  }
  // pages → the doors whose routes they call (journeys: page … route)
  for (const j of opts.journeys ?? []) {
    let page: string | null = null;
    for (const s of j.steps) {
      const at = resolveLeaf(graph, nodeOf, s.node);
      const n = at ? nodes.get(at) : undefined;
      if (n?.kind === 'page') page = n.id;
      else if (page && s.kind === 'route' && at) { link(page, at, 'calls', `${page}|${s.node}`); break; }
    }
  }

  // ---- order: kind rank (pages, doors, steps, services, sdk, stores), then domain order, then id
  const list = [...nodes.values()].sort((a, b) =>
    KIND_RANK[a.kind] - KIND_RANK[b.kind] || (domainIdx.get(a.domain ?? '') ?? 99) - (domainIdx.get(b.domain ?? '') ?? 99) || (a.id < b.id ? -1 : 1));
  list.forEach((n, i) => { n.order = i; n.members.sort(); });
  const edgeList = [...edges.values()].map(({ pairs, ...e }) => ({ ...e, count: pairs.size, kinds: e.kinds.sort() })).sort((a, b) => (a.id < b.id ? -1 : 1));

  const regions: FlowRegion[] = map.domains.map((d) => ({
    id: `region:${d.id}`, domain: d.id, name: d.name, purpose: d.purpose,
    nodes: list.filter((n) => n.domain === d.id && n.kind !== 'page' && n.kind !== 'store' && n.kind !== 'sdk').map((n) => n.id),
    open: openSet.has(d.id),
  })).filter((r) => r.nodes.length);

  return { nodes: list, edges: edgeList, regions, nodeOf, open, key: `${open.join(',')}|${list.map((n) => n.id).join(',')}` };
}

function resolveLeaf(graph: ContextGraph, nodeOf: Record<string, string>, id: string): string | null {
  if (nodeOf[id]) return nodeOf[id]!;
  const f = fileOf(id);
  if (f && nodeOf[f]) return nodeOf[f]!;
  for (let n = graph.nodes[id]; n; n = n.parent ? graph.nodes[n.parent]! : undefined!) if (nodeOf[n.id]) return nodeOf[n.id]!;
  return null;
}

function doorLabel(graph: ContextGraph, f: GraphNode): { label: string; detail: string } {
  const kids = graph.children[f.id] ?? [];
  const routes = kids.filter((k) => graph.nodes[k]?.kind === 'route').length;
  if (routes) return { label: 'HTTP routes', detail: `${routes} routes · ${stem(f.id)}` };
  const cli = kids.map((k) => graph.nodes[k]).find((n) => n?.kind === 'entry' && n.id.startsWith('entry:cli:'));
  if (cli) return { label: 'CLI', detail: cli.label };
  return { label: stem(f.id), detail: '' };
}

function cellRank(map: DomainMap, key: string, domainIdx: Map<string, number>) {
  if (key === 'unassigned') return 1e6;
  const [d, l] = key.split('/') as [string, string];
  return (LAYER_RANK[l] ?? 5) * 1000 + (domainIdx.get(d) ?? 99) + (map.layers.findIndex((x) => x.id === l) >= 0 ? 0 : 500);
}

function isUnder(graph: ContextGraph, id: string, prefix: string): boolean {
  for (let n = graph.nodes[id]; n; n = n.parent ? graph.nodes[n.parent]! : undefined!) if (n.id.startsWith(prefix)) return true;
  return false;
}

function isUnassigned(graph: ContextGraph, n: GraphNode): boolean {
  return isUnder(graph, n.id, 'unassigned');
}
```

```typescript
// Local stand-in for the `ProviderPaths` contract (contracts/api.ts), until lane C lands
// journeys/provider-paths.ts. Same signature and output; swap the import in the shell and delete this file.
// Deterministic: provider sinks are the files an `only_via` rule protects (vendor/llm-*), plus the bare packages those
// files use (the model SDK). Every edge into a sink from outside the sinks is one path, classified:
//   gateway    the caller is in the rule's allowed domain (the design)
//   violation  the caller crosses a current violation of the rule (red)
//   uncosted   anything else reaching a sink, e.g. a search client calling the SDK directly (amber)
import { matchesAny } from '../mapper';
import type { DomainMap } from '../schema';
import type { Violation } from '../rules';
import type { ProviderPath, ProviderPaths } from '../contracts/api';
import { fileOf, type ContextGraph } from '../contracts/graph';

export const providerPathsStub: ProviderPaths = (graph: ContextGraph, map: DomainMap, violations: readonly Violation[]): ProviderPath[] => {
  const rules = map.invariants.filter((i) => i.kind === 'only_via');
  if (!rules.length) return [];
  const sinkFiles = new Set<string>();
  const allowed = new Map<string, Set<string>>(); // sink file → allowed domains
  for (const n of Object.values(graph.nodes)) {
    if (n.kind !== 'file') continue;
    for (const r of rules) {
      if (r.kind !== 'only_via' || !matchesAny(r.targets, n.id)) continue;
      sinkFiles.add(n.id);
      const set = allowed.get(n.id) ?? new Set<string>();
      for (const d of r.allowed_from) set.add(d);
      allowed.set(n.id, set);
    }
  }
  const sdks = new Set<string>();
  for (const e of graph.edges) if (e.kind === 'uses' && sinkFiles.has(fileOf(e.from) ?? e.from) && e.to.startsWith('vendor:')) sdks.add(e.to);
  const allowedFor = (sink: string) => allowed.get(sink) ?? new Set([...allowed.values()].flatMap((s) => [...s]));

  const out: ProviderPath[] = [];
  const seen = new Set<string>();
  for (const e of graph.edges) {
    if (e.kind !== 'imports' && e.kind !== 'uses' && e.kind !== 'calls') continue;
    const from = fileOf(e.from) ?? e.from;
    const to = sdks.has(e.to) ? e.to : fileOf(e.to) ?? e.to;
    if (!sinkFiles.has(to) && !sdks.has(to)) continue;
    if (sinkFiles.has(from)) continue; // the provider's own SDK use is part of the sink
    const node = graph.nodes[from];
    if (!node?.domain || graph.nodes[node.parent ?? '']?.kind === 'tests' || node.parent?.startsWith('tests:')) continue;
    const key = `${from}|${to}`;
    if (seen.has(key)) continue;
    seen.add(key);
    const v = violations.find((x) => x.kind === 'only_via' && x.file === from && (!x.target || x.target === to));
    const cls = allowedFor(to).has(node.domain) ? 'gateway' : v ? 'violation' : 'uncosted';
    const nodes = [from, to];
    // a provider file that wraps an SDK continues to it, so every class ends at the same door when there is one
    const sdk = sinkFiles.has(to) ? [...sdks].find((s) => graph.edges.some((x) => x.kind === 'uses' && (fileOf(x.from) ?? x.from) === to && x.to === s)) : undefined;
    if (sdk) nodes.push(sdk);
    out.push({ class: cls, nodes, provider: nodes[nodes.length - 1]!, ...(v ? { invariant: v.invariant } : {}) });
  }
  return out.sort((a, b) => (a.nodes.join() < b.nodes.join() ? -1 : 1));
};
```

```text
import type { FactDelta } from './facts';
import { createMapper, matchesAny, type Mapper } from './mapper';
import type { DomainMap, Invariant } from './schema';

export type Violation = {
  invariant: string;
  kind: Invariant['kind'];
  /** One plain sentence naming the file and the rule. */
  reason: string;
  file: string;
  /** Short fact, e.g. `src/a.ts → vendor/b/index.ts` or `src/a.ts writes "runs"`. */
  detail: string;
  /** [A: comply, B: add an exception and record why]. */
  options: [string, string];
  /** Imported file or written table. */
  target?: string;
  /** Latest decision linked to the invariant, if any. */
  decision?: string;
};

const lowerFirst = (s: string) => s.charAt(0).toLowerCase() + s.slice(1);

/**
 * THE invariant checker: the violations a set of added imports and writes would cause.
 * Used on load (whole-repo facts), on `submit_plan`, and in the edit hook.
 * Ignored files never violate; neutral files have no domain, so they are exempt from
 * `only_via` and `no_edge` but still bound by `owns_writes`. Test files are bound by import rules only.
 */
export function check(map: DomainMap, delta: FactDelta, mapper: Mapper = createMapper(map)): Violation[] {
  const domainName = (id: string) => map.domains.find((d) => d.id === id)?.name ?? id;
  const found = new Map<string, Violation>();

  const add = (inv: Invariant, file: string, target: string, fact: string, detail: string, optionA: string) => {
    if (inv.exceptions.some((e) => matchesAny([e.path], file))) return;
    const decision = inv.decisions?.at(-1);
    const v: Violation = {
      invariant: inv.id,
      kind: inv.kind,
      reason: `${decision ? `You decided this in ${decision}. ` : ''}${file} ${fact}, but ${inv.id}: ${inv.rule}.`,
      file,
      if (pe.imports.every((i) => ids.has(edgeId('imports', i.from, i.to)))) continue;
      for (const i of pe.imports) {
        const hit = turn.planViolations.find((v) => v.file === i.from && (!v.target || v.target === i.to));
        const violation: ViolationState = !hit ? null : known(hit.file, hit.invariant) ? 'existing' : 'new';
        const decision = decided(hit?.decision);
        plannedEdges.push({ from: i.from, to: i.to, steps: [...pe.steps], violation, ...(decision ? { decision } : {}) });
      }
    }
    // an import the edit gate blocked is a would-be edge: a ghost carrying the new violation
    for (const v of turn.gateBlocks) {
      if (!v.target || !has(v.file) || !has(v.target) || ids.has(edgeId('imports', v.file, v.target))) continue;
      const kind = graph.nodes[v.target]!.kind;
      if (kind !== 'file' && kind !== 'vendor') continue;
      if (plannedEdges.some((p) => p.from === v.file && p.to === v.target)) continue;
      const decision = decided(v.decision);
      plannedEdges.push({ from: v.file, to: v.target, steps: [], violation: 'new', source: 'gate', ...(decision ? { decision } : {}) });
    }
    // an approach the plan avoids because a decision rules it out: drawn struck through, never red
    if (turn.avoided.length && ui.map) {
      const mapper = createMapper(ui.map);
      const cellIn = (domain: string, layer?: string) =>
        [layer, 'logic', ...ui.map!.layers.map((l) => l.id)].map((l) => l && cellId(domain, l)).find((c) => c && has(c)) ?? null;
      const layerOf = (id: string): string | undefined => {
        const n = graph.nodes[id];
        if (n?.layer) return n.layer;
        const p = id.startsWith('domain:') ? null : mapper.place(id);
        return p?.kind === 'cell' ? p.layer : undefined;
      };
      const node = (id: string, other: string): string | null => {
        if (id.startsWith('domain:')) return has(id) ? cellIn(id.slice(7), layerOf(other)) : null;
        if (has(id)) return id;
        const p = mapper.place(id);
        return p.kind === 'cell' && has(cellId(p.domain, p.layer)) ? cellId(p.domain, p.layer) : null;
      };
      for (const a of turn.avoided) {
        const from = node(a.from, a.to);
        const to = node(a.to, a.from);
        if (!from || !to || from === to) continue;
        plannedEdges.push({ from, to, steps: [], violation: null, source: 'avoided', decision: decided(a.decision) });
      }
    }
    plannedEdges.sort((a, b) => byId(a.from, b.from) || byId(a.to, b.to));
  }

  const added = new Set<string>();
  for (const e of turn?.edgesAdded ?? []) added.add(edgeId('imports', e.edge.from, e.edge.to));
  for (const c of turn?.callsAdded ?? []) added.add(edgeId('calls', c.from, c.to));

  return {
    turn: turn?.id ?? null,
    leaves,
    plannedEdges,
    addedEdges: [...added].filter((id) => ids.has(id)).sort(byId),
    cursor,
    verb: cursor ? ui.cursor!.verb : null,
    violations: { files: [...files].sort(byId), edges: [...edges].sort(byId) },
    rules: Object.fromEntries(Object.entries(rules).map(([k, v]) => [k, v.sort(byId)])),
    plannedNew: plannedNew.sort(byId),
  };
}
```

```typescript
// What the agent is doing on the flow map, as a pure read of the event log: its trail and cursor, its notes and
// highlight, the plan as a ghost route, a fork as two routes, decisions that protect code, rejected routes, and the
// end-of-turn counts. Everything is keyed by flow node id (see model.ts), so the shell only draws.
import { sessionNumber, type HarnessEvent, type UIState, type EventData } from '../events';
import { turnLedger } from '../ledger';
import type { ProviderPathClass } from '../contracts/api';
import type { TurnActivity } from '../contracts/api';
import { cellId, fileOf, type ContextGraph } from '../contracts/graph';
import type { Violation } from '../rules';
import { flowNodeOf, type FlowModel } from './model';
import { providerPathsStub } from './provider-paths';

export type FlowNodeState = {
  looked: boolean;
  edited: boolean;
  added: number;
  removed: number;
  /** Planned and not built yet: a ghost (new) node, or plan steps on an existing one. */
  ghost: boolean;
  steps: number[];
  violation: 'existing' | 'new' | null;
  rules: string[];
};

export type FlowPathEdge = { from: string; to: string };
export type FlowFork = { invariant: string; file: string; routes: { option: 'A' | 'B'; label: string; text: string; path: string[] }[] };

export type FlowOverlay = {
  turn: string | null;
  live: boolean; // the turn has not ended
  nodes: Record<string, FlowNodeState>;
  /** Where the agent has been this turn, oldest first (consecutive repeats merged). */
  trail: { node: string; verb: string; path: string }[];
  cursor: { node: string; verb: string; path: string } | null;
  annotations: { id: string; node: string; leaf: string; text: string; tone: EventData['annotation']['tone'] }[];
  highlight: { nodes: string[]; edges: FlowPathEdge[]; label: string } | null;
  /** The latest `focus` hint (event index, so Follow can tell a new one). */
  focus: { node: string; leaf: string; reason: string; at: number } | null;
  plan: { steps: { n: number; text: string; nodes: string[]; done: boolean }[]; edges: { from: string; to: string; steps: number[]; violation: boolean }[] } | null;
  fork: FlowFork | null;
  approval: { anchor: string; steps: number } | null;
  /** Approaches ruled out by an earlier decision (struck through, "rejected in DR-4, session 1"). */
  rejected: { from: string; to: string; decision: string; session: number }[];
  /** Protected code this turn touches (beat 4): a marker on the node with the principle. */
  touched: { node: string; decision: string; principle: string; session: number }[];
  /** Model-provider paths, classified, at flow level (beat 1's three classes). */
  providers: { from: string; to: string; class: ProviderPathClass }[];
  /** Non-zero end-of-turn counts (SPEC §9; counts only) and the decisions recorded. */
  end: { counts: { label: string; value: number }[]; decisions: string[]; regions: string[] } | null;
};

const verbOf = (e: HarnessEvent): string | null => {
  if (e.kind === 'looked') return (e.data as EventData['looked'] | undefined)?.tool === 'Grep' || (e.data as EventData['looked'] | undefined)?.tool === 'Glob' ? 'searching' : 'reading';
  if (e.kind === 'cursor') return (e.data as EventData['cursor']).verb;
  if (e.kind === 'edited') return (e.data as EventData['edited']).unattributed ? null : 'editing';
  return null;
};

/** The short, one-line form of a checker option: no parenthetical, no "instead of …", file names without folders. */
export function shortOption(text: string): string {
  return text
    .replace(/\s*\([^)]*\)/g, '')
    .replace(/\s+instead of .*$/i, '')
    .replace(/\s+and record why$/i, '')
    .replace(/(?:[\w.-]+\/)+([\w.-]+)\.[jt]sx?/g, '$1')
    .trim();
}

export function flowOverlay(
  ui: UIState,
  events: readonly HarnessEvent[],
  graph: ContextGraph,
  model: FlowModel,
  activity: TurnActivity,
): FlowOverlay {
  const turn = activity.turn ? ui.turns.find((t) => t.id === activity.turn) ?? null : null;
  const at = (id: string) => flowNodeOf(model, graph, id) ?? cellNode(model, id);
  const nodes: Record<string, FlowNodeState> = {};
  const st = (id: string) => (nodes[id] ??= { looked: false, edited: false, added: 0, removed: 0, ghost: false, steps: [], violation: null, rules: [] });

  for (const [leaf, l] of Object.entries(activity.leaves)) {
    if (leaf.includes('#')) continue; // lines and marks live on files
    const id = at(leaf);
    if (!id) continue;
    const s = st(id);
    s.looked ||= l.looked;
    s.edited ||= l.edited;
    s.added += l.added;
    s.removed += l.removed;
    for (const n of l.ghostSteps) if (!s.steps.includes(n)) s.steps.push(n);
    if (l.violation === 'new' || (l.violation === 'existing' && !s.violation)) s.violation = l.violation;
  }
  for (const leaf of activity.plannedNew) {
    const id = at(leaf);
    if (!id) continue;
    const members = model.nodes.find((n) => n.id === id)?.members ?? [];
    if (members.every((m) => activity.plannedNew.includes(m) || activity.plannedNew.some((p) => fileOf(p) === m))) st(id).ghost = true;
  }
  for (const [leaf, rules] of Object.entries(activity.rules)) {
    const id = at(leaf);
    if (id) for (const r of rules) if (!st(id).rules.includes(r)) st(id).rules.push(r);
  }

  if (turn) {
    events.forEach((e, i) => {
      if (e.turn !== turn.id) return;
      if (e.kind === 'focus') {
        const f = e.data as EventData['focus'];
        const node = at(f.node);
        if (node) focus = { node, leaf: f.node, reason: f.reason, at: i };
        return;
      }
      const verb = verbOf(e);
      if (!verb || !e.path) return;

  const annotations = Object.values(turn?.annotations ?? {}).flatMap((a) => {
    const node = at(a.node);

  });
  let highlight: FlowOverlay['highlight'] = null;
  if (turn?.highlight) {
    const hn = [...new Set(turn.highlight.nodes.map(at).filter((x): x is string => !!x))];
    const he = turn.highlight.edges.flatMap((e) => {
      const from = at(e.from);
      const to = at(e.to);
      return from && to && from !== to ? [{ from, to }] : [];
    });
    highlight = { nodes: hn, edges: dedupe(he), label: turn.highlight.label };
  }

  let plan: FlowOverlay['plan'] = null;
  if (turn && turn.steps.length) {
    const editedFiles = new Set(Object.entries(turn.paths).filter(([, p]) => p.edits > 0).map(([p]) => p));
    const steps = turn.steps.map((s) => {
      const files = [...s.files, ...(s.symbols ?? [])].map((f) => fileOf(f) ?? f);
      return {

        text: s.text,

        done: files.length > 0 && files.every((f) => editedFiles.has(f)),

    for (const e of activity.plannedEdges) {
      if (e.source === 'avoided') continue;
      const from = at(e.from);
      const to = at(e.to);
      if (!from || !to || from === to) continue;
      const k = `${from}->${to}`;
      const cur = pe.get(k) ?? { from, to, steps: [], violation: false };
      for (const n of e.steps) if (!cur.steps.includes(n)) cur.steps.push(n);

      pe.set(k, cur);
    }
    plan = { steps, edges: [...pe.values()] };
  }

  let fork: FlowFork | null = null;
  const pending = ui.pendingFork && turn && ui.pendingFork.turn === turn.id ? ui.pendingFork.violations : null;
  const v: Violation | undefined = pending?.find((x) => x.target) ?? pending?.[0];
  if (v && ui.map) {
    const from = at(v.file);
    const to = v.target ? at(v.target) : null;
    const rule = ui.map.invariants.find((i) => i.id === v.invariant);
    let via: string | null = null;
    if (rule?.kind === 'only_via' && to) {
      const allowed = new Set(rule.allowed_from);
      via = model.edges.find((e) => e.to === to && allowed.has(model.nodes.find((n) => n.id === e.from)?.domain ?? ''))?.from ?? null;
    }
    if (from && to) {
      fork = {
        invariant: v.invariant,
        file: v.file,
        routes: [
          { option: 'A', label: shortOption(v.options[0]), text: v.options[0], path: via ? [from, via, to] : [from, to] },
          { option: 'B', label: shortOption(v.options[1]), text: v.options[1], path: [from, to] },
        ],
      };
    }
  }

  let approval: FlowOverlay['approval'] = null;
  if (ui.awaitingApproval && turn && ui.awaitingApproval.turn === turn.id && plan) {
    const last = [...plan.steps].reverse().find((s) => s.nodes.length);
    if (last) approval = { anchor: last.nodes[last.nodes.length - 1]!, steps: plan.steps.length };
  }

  // ---- decided against (struck through) and protected code (markers)
  const rejected: FlowOverlay['rejected'] = [];
  for (const e of activity.plannedEdges) {
    if (!e.decision) continue;
    const from = at(e.from);
    const to = at(e.to);
    if (!from || !to || from === to || rejected.some((r) => r.from === from && r.to === to)) continue;
    rejected.push({ from, to, decision: e.decision.id, session: e.decision.session });
  }
  const touched: FlowOverlay['touched'] = [];
  for (const t of turn?.touched ?? []) {
    const dec = ui.decisions.find((d) => d.id === t.decision);
    for (const p of [...t.paths, ...t.symbols]) {
      const node = at(fileOf(p) ?? p);
      if (!node || touched.some((x) => x.node === node && x.decision === t.decision)) continue;
      touched.push({ node, decision: t.decision, principle: t.principle, session: dec ? sessionNumber(ui, dec.session) : 0 });
    }
  }

  // ---- paths to the model provider, at flow level
  const providers: FlowOverlay['providers'] = [];
  if (ui.map) {
    for (const p of providerPathsStub(graph, ui.map, ui.violations)) {
      for (let i = 0; i + 1 < p.nodes.length; i++) {
        const from = at(p.nodes[i]!);
        const to = at(p.nodes[i + 1]!);
        if (!from || !to || from === to) continue;
        const cur = providers.find((x) => x.from === from && x.to === to);
        // the worst class wins on a shared segment
        if (cur) { if (rank(p.class) > rank(cur.class)) cur.class = p.class; continue; }
        providers.push({ from, to, class: p.class });
      }
    }
  }

  // ---- the end-of-turn card: non-zero counts only
  let end: FlowOverlay['end'] = null;
  if (turn && turn.endedAt !== null) {
    const l = turnLedger(ui, turn);
    const counts = [
      { label: 'lines changed', value: l.linesChanged ?? 0 },
      { label: 'places to review', value: l.cellsToReview },
      { label: 'forks caught before code', value: l.forksCaughtBeforeCode },
      { label: 'rejected options blocked', value: l.rejectedOptionsBlocked },
    ].filter((c) => c.value > 0);
    const regions = [...new Set(Object.values(turn.edited).flatMap((c) => c.files).map((f) => ui.files[f]).flatMap((p) => (p && p.kind === 'cell' ? [p.domain] : [])))];

  }

  return { turn: turn?.id ?? null, live, nodes, trail, cursor, annotations, highlight, focus, plan, fork, approval, rejected, touched, providers, end };
}

const rank = (c: ProviderPathClass) => (c === 'violation' ? 2 : c === 'uncosted' ? 1 : 0);

function dedupe(list: FlowPathEdge[]): FlowPathEdge[] {
  const seen = new Set<string>();
  return list.filter((e) => { const k = `${e.from}->${e.to}`; if (seen.has(k)) return false; seen.add(k); return true; });
}

/** A cell id (from activity for files that do not exist yet) → the flow node drawing that cell, if any. */
function cellNode(model: FlowModel, id: string): string | null {
  if (!id.startsWith('cell:')) return null;
  const direct = model.nodes.find((n) => n.id === `flow:${id}`);
  if (direct) return direct.id;
  const [domain, layer] = id.slice(5).split('/');
  return model.nodes.find((n) => n.domain === domain && n.layer === layer && n.id !== cellId(domain!, layer!))?.id ?? null;
}
```

```typescript
// The narrator line: one short sentence about what the agent is doing, generated from events (never Claude's prose).
// Pure: the latest narratable event of the turn decides the line; waiting states (a fork, an approval) win while open.
import type { EventData, HarnessEvent, UIState } from '../events';
import { fileOf } from '../contracts/graph';

export type NarrationTone = 'agent' | 'rule' | 'wait' | 'done';
export type Narration = { text: string; tone: NarrationTone; at: number };

const base = (p: string) => (fileOf(p) ?? p).split('/').pop() ?? p;
const plural = (n: number, one: string, many = `${one}s`) => `${n} ${n === 1 ? one : many}`;

/** Domain names a set of files belongs to, in map order. */
function regionsOf(ui: UIState, files: readonly string[]): string[] {
  const doms = new Set<string>();
  for (const f of files) {
    const p = ui.files[fileOf(f) ?? f];
    if (p && (p.kind === 'cell' || p.kind === 'test')) doms.add(p.domain);
  }
  for (const c of Object.values(ui.turns.at(-1)?.planned ?? {})) if (c.files.some((f) => files.includes(f))) doms.add(c.cell.domain);
  return (ui.map?.domains ?? []).filter((d) => doms.has(d.id)).map((d) => d.name);
}

export function narrate(ui: UIState, events: readonly HarnessEvent[], upTo = events.length): Narration | null {
  const turn = ui.turns.at(-1);
  if (!turn) return null;
  if (ui.pendingFork && ui.pendingFork.turn === turn.id) {
    const v = ui.pendingFork.violations[0];
    return { text: `Stopped: crosses ${v?.invariant ?? 'a rule'} — choose a route`, tone: 'rule', at: upTo };
  }
  for (let i = Math.min(upTo, events.length) - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
    const e = events[i]!;
    if (e.turn !== turn.id) continue;
    const line = lineFor(ui, e, turn.id);
    if (line) return { ...line, at: i };
  }
  return null;
}

function lineFor(ui: UIState, e: HarnessEvent, turnId: string): Omit<Narration, 'at'> | null {
  const turn = ui.turns.find((t) => t.id === turnId)!;
  switch (e.kind) {
    case 'turn_ended': {
      const files = Object.values(turn.edited).flatMap((c) => c.files);
      const regions = regionsOf(ui, files);
      if (!files.length) return { text: turn.highlight ? `Answered · ${turn.highlight.label}` : 'Done · nothing changed', tone: 'done' };
      return { text: `Done · ${plural(regions.length, 'region')} changed`, tone: 'done' };
    }
    case 'approval_requested': {
      if (!ui.awaitingApproval) return null;
      return { text: `Plan ready: ${plural(turn.steps.length, 'step')} — build when you are`, tone: 'wait' };
    }
    case 'gate_blocked': {
      const { violation } = e.data as EventData['gate_blocked'];
      return { text: `Stopped: ${base(violation.file)} would cross ${violation.invariant}`, tone: 'rule' };
    }
    case 'plan_approved':
      return { text: `Building 0 of ${turn.steps.length}`, tone: 'agent' };
    case 'edited': {
      const ed = e.data as EventData['edited'];
      if (ed.unattributed || !e.path) return null;
      const done = stepsDone(turn);
      return { text: turn.steps.length ? `Building ${Math.max(1, done)} of ${turn.steps.length} · ${base(e.path)}` : `Editing ${base(e.path)}`, tone: 'agent' };
    }
    case 'planned': {
      const p = e.data as EventData['planned'];
      const regions = regionsOf(ui, p.steps.flatMap((s) => s.files));
      return { text: `Planning: ${plural(p.steps.length, 'step')}${regions.length ? ` through ${regions.join(' → ')}` : ''}`, tone: 'agent' };
    }
    case 'decision_touched': {
      const t = e.data as EventData['decision_touched'];
      return { text: `${t.decision} protects ${t.paths[0] ? base(t.paths[0]) : 'this code'} — keeping it true`, tone: 'rule' };
    }
    case 'decision_recorded': {
      const d = e.data as EventData['decision_recorded'];
      return { text: `Recorded ${d.id}: ${d.title}`, tone: 'agent' };
    }
    case 'fork_answered': {
      const f = e.data as EventData['fork_answered'];
      return { text: `Route ${f.option} chosen · replanning`, tone: 'agent' };
    }
    case 'highlight': {
      const h = e.data as EventData['highlight'];
      return h.label ? { text: `Showing ${lowerFirst(h.label)}`, tone: 'agent' } : null;
    }
    case 'annotation': {
      const a = e.data as EventData['annotation'];
      return a.text ? { text: `Noting ${base(a.node)}`, tone: 'agent' } : null;
    }
    case 'focus': {
      const f = e.data as EventData['focus'];
      return { text: `Looking at ${base(f.node)}`, tone: 'agent' };
    }
    case 'looked':
    case 'cursor': {
      if (!e.path) return null;
      const tool = (e.data as EventData['looked'] | undefined)?.tool;
      const verb = e.kind === 'cursor' ? (e.data as EventData['cursor']).verb : tool === 'Grep' || tool === 'Glob' ? 'searching' : 'reading';
      return { text: `${verb === 'searching' ? 'Searching' : verb === 'editing' ? 'Editing' : 'Reading'} ${base(e.path)}`, tone: 'agent' };
    }
    case 'turn_started':
      return { text: 'Reading the map', tone: 'agent' };
    default:
      return null;
  }
}

/** Plan steps whose files have all been edited. */
export function stepsDone(turn: UIState['turns'][number]): number {
  const edited = new Set(Object.entries(turn.paths).filter(([, p]) => p.edits > 0).map(([p]) => p));
  return turn.steps.filter((s) => s.files.length > 0 && s.files.every((f) => edited.has(fileOf(f) ?? f))).length;
}

const lowerFirst = (s: string) => (/^[A-Z][a-z]/.test(s) ? s.charAt(0).toLowerCase() + s.slice(1) : s);

```

```typescript
// A recorded live run of beats 3 → 4 → 4b (wave 3; real Claude Opus 5.5, fresh Scout copy, Alike off), one server
// session per beat: packages/core/test/fixtures/beats-3-4-4b.events.json (Tier 2 `facts_resolved` events dropped).
// Beat 3 built the 10-K tool through the gateway without forking (Opus never took the shortcut in 3 tries), so DR-4
// was recorded on that real turn by the server's own recordFork + recordProtects (option A, the scripted answer).
// Beat 4's plan and edits touched what DR-4 protects and kept filing mode; beat 4b avoided the direct call per DR-4.
import { describe, expect, it } from 'vitest';
import { readFileSync } from 'node:fs';
import { reduce, type HarnessEvent } from '../src/events';
import { ledger } from '../src/ledger';
import { activityFor, graphOf, project } from '../src/graph';

const events = JSON.parse(readFileSync(new URL('./fixtures/beats-3-4-4b.events.json', import.meta.url), 'utf8')) as HarnessEvent[];
const ui = reduce(events);
const [beat3, beat4, beat4b] = ui.turns;

describe('recorded beats 3 → 4 → 4b', () => {
  it('three sessions, one turn each; DR-4 made in session 1 protects the filing mode and its tests', () => {
    expect(ui.sessions).toHaveLength(3);
    expect(ui.turns.map((t) => t.prompt.slice(0, 32))).toEqual(['Can we add a tool that summarize', "We're seeing account numbers in ", 'Can we add a tool that summarize']);
    expect(ui.decisions).toHaveLength(1);
    expect(ui.decisions[0]).toMatchObject({
      id: 'DR-4', invariant: 'DR-1', option: 'A', turn: beat3!.id, paths: ['src/tools/filing-summarize.ts'],
      protects: { paths: ['src/gateway/redact.ts', 'test/gateway/redact.test.ts', 'test/tools/tools.test.ts'], symbols: ['src/gateway/redact.ts#Redactor', 'src/gateway/redact.ts#Redactor.redact'] },
    });
    expect(ui.sessions.indexOf(ui.decisions[0]!.session)).toBe(0);
  });

  it('beat 4: the plan touched DR-4 (redact.ts, then the tests) and so did the edits; no violation, no fork', () => {
    const key = (t: (typeof beat4)['touched'][number]) => [t.decision, t.source, t.step ?? null, t.paths.join(','), t.symbols.length];
    expect(beat4!.touched.map(key)).toEqual([
      ['DR-4', 'plan', 1, 'src/gateway/redact.ts', 2],
      ['DR-4', 'plan', 4, 'test/gateway/redact.test.ts,test/tools/tools.test.ts', 0],
      ['DR-4', 'edit', null, 'src/gateway/redact.ts', 2],
      ['DR-4', 'edit', null, 'test/gateway/redact.test.ts', 0],
      ['DR-4', 'edit', null, 'test/tools/tools.test.ts', 0],
    ]);
    expect(beat4!.violationsSeen).toHaveLength(0);
    expect(beat4!.forks).toHaveLength(0);
    // The build kept filing mode: the 10-K tool now asks the gateway for it.
    expect(Object.keys(beat4!.paths).filter((p) => beat4!.paths[p]!.edits)).toEqual(expect.arrayContaining(['src/gateway/redact.ts', 'src/gateway/complete.ts', 'src/tools/filing-summarize.ts']));
  });

  it('beat 4b: the plan avoids the direct provider call per DR-4, drawn as a rejected edge (session 1); nothing calls the provider', () => {
    expect(beat4b!.avoided).toEqual([expect.objectContaining({ from: 'src/tools/earnings-summarize.ts', to: 'vendor/llm-anthropic/index.ts', decision: 'DR-4' })]);
    expect(beat4b!.edgesAdded.map((e) => `${e.edge.from}→${e.edge.to}`)).toEqual(['src/tools/earnings-summarize.ts→src/gateway/complete.ts']);
    const g = graphOf(ui)!;
    const p = project(g, { expanded: [], focus: null, lens: { kinds: [], turnOnly: false }, budget: 25, follow: false }, activityFor(ui, g, beat4b!.id));
    expect(p.edges.filter((e) => e.decision).map((e) => [e.from, e.to, e.status, e.decision!.id, e.decision!.session])).toEqual([['domain:tools', 'domain:gateway', 'ghost', 'DR-4', 1]]);
  });

  it('ledger: exact counts per turn and for the session', () => {
    const l = ledger(ui);
    expect(l.turns.map((t) => [t.linesChanged, t.cellsToReview, t.forksCaughtBeforeCode, t.rejectedOptionsBlocked])).toEqual([[72, 1, 0, 0], [77, 0, 0, 0], [67, 1, 0, 1]]);
    expect(l.session).toEqual({ linesChanged: 216, cellsToReview: 2, forksCaughtBeforeCode: 0, rejectedOptionsBlocked: 1 });
  });
});
```

```typescript
// Event-log snapshots (NAVIGATION_PLAN N11): the UI state after the first `upTo` events, so load and replay on a long
// log fold only the events after the nearest snapshot. A snapshot is a cache of `reduce(events, upTo)`, never a source
// of truth: `reduceFrom(snapshot, events, n)` must equal `reduce(events, n)` (tested). Pure and browser-safe.
import { apply, initialState, reduce, type HarnessEvent, type UIState } from '../events';

/** How often the server snapshots (in events). */
export const SNAPSHOT_EVERY = 500;

export type Snapshot = { upTo: number; state: UIState };
/** One stored snapshot: blob `.harness/snapshots/<hash>.json` holds `{ upTo, state }`. */
export type SnapshotEntry = { upTo: number; hash: string; lastEvent: string };

/** The snapshot of the first `upTo` events (a fresh state; the events are not touched). */
export const snapshotOf = (events: readonly HarnessEvent[], upTo: number): Snapshot => ({ upTo: Math.min(upTo, events.length), state: reduce(events, upTo) });

/** A deep copy of a state, so folding more events never changes a snapshot (states are plain JSON). */
export const cloneState = (s: UIState): UIState => JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(s)) as UIState;

/**
 * `reduce(events, upTo)` starting from a snapshot of a prefix of the same log: copy the snapshot's state, then apply
 * events `snapshot.upTo … upTo-1` with their real indexes (provenance uses them). A snapshot past `upTo` is unusable
 * for that point, so it falls back to a full reduce.
 */
export function reduceFrom(snapshot: Snapshot | null, events: readonly HarnessEvent[], upTo = events.length): UIState {
  const n = Math.min(upTo, events.length);
  if (!snapshot || snapshot.upTo > n) return reduce(events, n);
  const s = snapshot.upTo ? cloneState(snapshot.state) : initialState();
  for (let i = snapshot.upTo; i < n; i++) apply(s, events[i]!, i);
  return s;
}

/** The latest entry at or before `upTo` whose last event id matches the log (a snapshot of a different log is ignored). */
export function nearestSnapshot(entries: readonly SnapshotEntry[], events: readonly HarnessEvent[], upTo = events.length): SnapshotEntry | null {
  let best: SnapshotEntry | null = null;
  for (const e of entries) {
    if (e.upTo < 1 || e.upTo > Math.min(upTo, events.length) || events[e.upTo - 1]?.id !== e.lastEvent) continue;
    if (!best || e.upTo > best.upTo) best = e;
  }
  return best;
}

/** Snapshot points for a log of `length` events: every `every` events. */
export const snapshotPoints = (length: number, every = SNAPSHOT_EVERY): number[] =>
  Array.from({ length: Math.floor(length / every) }, (_, i) => (i + 1) * every);
```

function sectionPoints(e: ElkExtendedEdge): Pt[] {
  const s = e.sections?.[0];
  if (!s) return [];
  return [s.startPoint, ...(s.bendPoints ?? []), s.endPoint].map((p) => ({ x: p.x, y: p.y }));
}

export function readLayout(c: ContainerInput, root: ElkNode, ms: number): ContainerLayout {
  const out = root.children?.[0] ?? root;
  const nodes: ContainerLayout['nodes'] = {};
  for (const n of out.children ?? []) nodes[n.id] = { x: n.x ?? 0, y: n.y ?? 0, w: n.width ?? 0, h: n.height ?? 0 };
  const edges: ContainerLayout['edges'] = {};
  const ports: ContainerLayout['ports'] = {};
  const portAt = new Map((out.ports ?? []).map((p) => [p.id, { x: (p.x ?? 0) + (p.width ?? 0) / 2, y: (p.y ?? 0) + (p.height ?? 0) / 2 }]));
  const w = out.width ?? 0;
  const h = out.height ?? 0;
  for (const p of c.ports) {
    const at = portAt.get(p.key) ?? { x: p.side === 'left' ? 0 : w, y: h / 2 };
    // snap to the border on the declared side (ELK centres a 2 px port on it)
    if (p.side === 'left') at.x = 0;
    if (p.side === 'right') at.x = w;
    if (p.side === 'top') at.y = 0;
    if (p.side === 'bottom') at.y = h;
    ports[p.key] = { at, side: p.side };
  }
  for (const e of out.edges ?? []) {
    if (e.id.startsWith('pe:')) {
      const p = c.ports[Number(e.id.slice(3))]!;
      const pts = sectionPoints(e);
      const at = ports[p.key]!.at;
      if (pts.length) pts[p.direction === 'out' ? pts.length - 1 : 0] = { ...at };
      edges[p.edge] = pts;
    } else edges[e.id] = sectionPoints(e);
  }
  return { id: c.id, w, h, nodes, edges, ports, ms };
}

export type ElkApi = { layout(g: ElkNode): Promise<ElkNode> };
export type LayoutFn = (c: ContainerInput) => Promise<ContainerLayout>;

/** A layout function over an ELK instance, cached by the container's whole input (children, sizes, edges, ports). */
export function cachedLayout(getElk: () => Promise<ElkApi>, cache = new Map<string, ContainerLayout>()): LayoutFn & { cache: Map<string, ContainerLayout> } {
  const fn = async (c: ContainerInput) => {
    const key = JSON.stringify(c);
    const hit = cache.get(key);
    if (hit) return hit;
    const api = await getElk();
    const t0 = performance.now();
    const out = await api.layout(elkGraph(c));
    const l = readLayout(c, out, performance.now() - t0);
    cache.set(key, l);
    return l;
  };
  return Object.assign(fn, { cache });
}
export const union = (a: Box, b: Box): Box => {
  const x = Math.min(a.x, b.x);
  const y = Math.min(a.y, b.y);
  return { x, y, w: Math.max(a.x + a.w, b.x + b.w) - x, h: Math.max(a.y + a.h, b.y + b.h) - y };
};

function dedupe(pts: Pt[]): Pt[] {
  const out: Pt[] = [];
  for (const p of pts) {
    const q = out[out.length - 1];
    if (q && Math.abs(q.x - p.x) < 0.5 && Math.abs(q.y - p.y) < 0.5) continue;
    out.push(p);
  }
  return out;
}

function midpoint(pts: Pt[]): Pt {
  let total = 0;
  for (let i = 1; i < pts.length; i++) total += Math.hypot(pts[i]!.x - pts[i - 1]!.x, pts[i]!.y - pts[i - 1]!.y);
  let half = total / 2;
  for (let i = 1; i < pts.length; i++) {
    const a = pts[i - 1]!;
    const b = pts[i]!;
    const d = Math.hypot(b.x - a.x, b.y - a.y);
    if (half <= d && d > 0) return { x: a.x + ((b.x - a.x) * half) / d, y: a.y + ((b.y - a.y) * half) / d };
    half -= d;
  }
  return pts[0]!;
}

export function roundedPath(pts: Pt[], r: number): string {
  const f = (n: number) => n.toFixed(1);
  let d = `M${f(pts[0]!.x)},${f(pts[0]!.y)}`;
  for (let i = 1; i < pts.length - 1; i++) {
    const p = pts[i - 1]!;
    const c = pts[i]!;
    const n = pts[i + 1]!;
    const d1 = Math.hypot(c.x - p.x, c.y - p.y);
    const d2 = Math.hypot(n.x - c.x, n.y - c.y);
    const rr = Math.min(r, d1 / 2, d2 / 2);
    if (rr < 0.5) { d += `L${f(c.x)},${f(c.y)}`; continue; }
    const ax = c.x - ((c.x - p.x) / d1) * rr;
    const ay = c.y - ((c.y - p.y) / d1) * rr;
    const bx = c.x + ((n.x - c.x) / d2) * rr;
    const by = c.y + ((n.y - c.y) / d2) * rr;
    d += `L${f(ax)},${f(ay)}Q${f(c.x)},${f(c.y)} ${f(bx)},${f(by)}`;
  }
  const last = pts[pts.length - 1]!;
  return `${d}L${f(last.x)},${f(last.y)}`;
}

/** Stroke width by count (aggregated edges read heavier). */
export const strokeFor = (count: number) => 1.5 + Math.min(3, Math.log2(Math.max(1, count))) * 0.75;

export { PAD };

/** Just enough markdown for chat: fenced code, headings, lists, paragraphs, `code`, **bold**, *italic*. */
export function Markdown({ text }: { text: string }) {
  const blocks: ReactNode[] = [];
  const lines = text.replace(/\r\n/g, '\n').split('\n');
  let i = 0;
  let key = 0;
  while (i < lines.length) {
    const line = lines[i]!;
    const fence = line.match(/^\s*```(\w*)/);
    if (fence) {
      const body: string[] = [];
      i++;
      while (i < lines.length && !/^\s*```/.test(lines[i]!)) body.push(lines[i++]!);
      i++;
      blocks.push(<pre key={key++} className="md-pre"><code>{body.join('\n')}</code></pre>);
      continue;
    }
    if (!line.trim()) { i++; continue; }

```typescript
// Event-log snapshots on the server (NAVIGATION_PLAN N11). The bus folds every event into a running UI state; every
// SNAPSHOT_EVERY events that state is written as a content-addressed blob `.harness/snapshots/<sha256>.json` and listed
// in `.harness/snapshots/index.json`. On start the running state is rebuilt from the nearest snapshot plus the events
// after it. Snapshots are a cache of the log (delete the folder and nothing changes but speed); the shell can fetch
// them for replay. Deterministic, no model.
import { createHash } from 'node:crypto';
import { existsSync, mkdirSync, readFileSync, writeFileSync } from 'node:fs';
import { join } from 'node:path';
import { Hono } from 'hono';
import { apply, cloneState, nearestSnapshot, reduceFrom, SNAPSHOT_EVERY, type Snapshot, type SnapshotEntry, type UIState } from '@harness/core';
import type { Bus } from './bus';

export type SnapshotStore = {
  /** The UI state after every event so far (shared; callers must not mutate it). */
  state(): UIState;
  entries(): SnapshotEntry[];
  /** A stored snapshot by hash, or null. */
  read(hash: string): Snapshot | null;
  /** The state after the first `upTo` events, from the nearest snapshot. */
  at(upTo: number): UIState;
  detach(): void;
};

export function attachSnapshots(bus: Bus, root: string, every = SNAPSHOT_EVERY): SnapshotStore {
  const dir = join(root, '.harness', 'snapshots');
  const indexPath = join(dir, 'index.json');
  const readJson = <T>(p: string, fallback: T): T => { try { return existsSync(p) ? (JSON.parse(readFileSync(p, 'utf8')) as T) : fallback; } catch { return fallback; } };
  let entries = readJson<{ entries: SnapshotEntry[] }>(indexPath, { entries: [] }).entries;
  const read = (hash: string): Snapshot | null => (/^[0-9a-f]{64}$/.test(hash) ? readJson<Snapshot | null>(join(dir, `${hash}.json`), null) : null);

  const load = (upTo: number): UIState => {
    const e = nearestSnapshot(entries, bus.events, upTo);
    const snap = e ? read(e.hash) : null;
    return reduceFrom(snap && snap.upTo === e!.upTo ? snap : null, bus.events, upTo);
  };

  const save = (upTo: number, state: UIState) => {
    const body = JSON.stringify({ upTo, state });
    const hash = createHash('sha256').update(body).digest('hex');
    mkdirSync(dir, { recursive: true });
    const file = join(dir, `${hash}.json`);
    if (!existsSync(file)) writeFileSync(file, body);
    entries = [...entries.filter((x) => x.upTo !== upTo), { upTo, hash, lastEvent: bus.events[upTo - 1]!.id }].sort((a, b) => a.upTo - b.upTo);
    writeFileSync(indexPath, JSON.stringify({ entries }, null, 1));
  };

  // The running state: rebuilt from the nearest snapshot, then kept current event by event.
  let running = load(bus.events.length);
  let count = bus.events.length;
  const off = bus.on((e) => {
    apply(running, e, count++);
    if (count % every === 0) {
      try { save(count, cloneState(running)); }
      catch { /* a cache: the log stays the source of truth */ }
    }
  });

  return {
    state: () => running,
    entries: () => entries,
    read,
    at: (upTo) => (upTo >= count ? cloneState(running) : load(upTo)),
    detach: () => { off(); running = load(bus.events.length); },
  };
}

/** HTTP endpoints, mounted under /api: the index, and one snapshot blob by hash (for replay in the shell). */
export function snapshotRoutes(store: SnapshotStore) {
  const r = new Hono();
  r.get('/snapshots', (c) => c.json({ every: SNAPSHOT_EVERY, entries: store.entries() }));
  r.get('/snapshots/:hash', (c) => {
    const s = store.read(c.req.param('hash'));
    return s ? c.json(s) : c.json({ error: 'not found' }, 404);
  });
  return r;
}
```

```typescript
// Event-log snapshots (N11): reduceFrom(snapshot, events, n) equals reduce(events, n) at every cut, snapshots never
// change when more events are folded, and the server stores them content-addressed and reloads from the nearest one.
import { afterAll, describe, expect, it } from 'vitest';
import { existsSync, mkdtempSync, readFileSync, readdirSync, rmSync } from 'node:fs';
import { tmpdir } from 'node:os';
import { join } from 'node:path';
import { reduce, type HarnessEvent } from '../src/events';
import { nearestSnapshot, reduceFrom, snapshotOf, snapshotPoints } from '../src/snapshots';
import { Bus } from '../../../apps/server/src/bus';
import { attachSnapshots } from '../../../apps/server/src/snapshots';

const fixture = (name: string) => JSON.parse(readFileSync(new URL(`./fixtures/${name}`, import.meta.url), 'utf8')) as HarnessEvent[];
const logs = { 'beats-3-4-4b': fixture('beats-3-4-4b.events.json'), 'beats-3-4': fixture('beats-3-4.events.json') };
const dirs: string[] = [];
afterAll(() => { for (const d of dirs) rmSync(d, { recursive: true, force: true }); });

describe('reduceFrom', () => {
  for (const [name, events] of Object.entries(logs)) {
    it(`equals a full reduce at every replay point from every snapshot (${name}, ${events.length} events)`, () => {
      const cuts = [0, 1, 7, Math.floor(events.length / 3), Math.floor(events.length / 2), events.length - 1, events.length];
      for (const at of cuts) {
        const snap = snapshotOf(events, at);
        for (const n of cuts.filter((c) => c >= at)) expect(reduceFrom(snap, events, n)).toEqual(reduce(events, n));
        expect(reduceFrom(snap, events, Math.max(0, at - 1))).toEqual(reduce(events, Math.max(0, at - 1))); // past the point: full reduce
      }
      expect(reduceFrom(null, events)).toEqual(reduce(events));
    });
  }

  it('never mutates the snapshot', () => {
    const events = logs['beats-3-4-4b'];
    const snap = snapshotOf(events, 50);
    const before = JSON.stringify(snap);
    reduceFrom(snap, events);
    reduceFrom(snap, events, 120);
    expect(JSON.stringify(snap)).toBe(before);
  });

  it('picks the nearest snapshot of this log only', () => {
    const events = logs['beats-3-4-4b'];
    const entries = [
      { upTo: 50, hash: 'a', lastEvent: events[49]!.id },
      { upTo: 100, hash: 'b', lastEvent: events[99]!.id },
      { upTo: 150, hash: 'c', lastEvent: 'from another log' },
    ];
    expect(nearestSnapshot(entries, events)?.hash).toBe('b');
    expect(nearestSnapshot(entries, events, 99)?.hash).toBe('a');
    expect(nearestSnapshot(entries, events, 10)).toBeNull();
    expect(snapshotPoints(1234)).toEqual([500, 1000]);
  });
});

describe('server snapshots', () => {
  it('saves every N events as a content-addressed blob with an index, and reloads from the nearest one', () => {
    const root = mkdtempSync(join(process.env.HARNESS_TEST_TMP ?? tmpdir(), 'harness-snap-'));
    dirs.push(root);
    const source = logs['beats-3-4-4b'];
    const bus = new Bus(root, { fresh: true });
    const store = attachSnapshots(bus, root, 40);
    for (const e of source) bus.emit(e.kind, e.data as never, { turn: e.turn, path: e.path, cell: e.cell });
    const n = source.length;
    expect(store.entries().map((e) => e.upTo)).toEqual(snapshotPoints(n, 40));
    const dir = join(root, '.harness', 'snapshots');
    expect(readdirSync(dir).filter((f) => f !== 'index.json')).toHaveLength(Math.floor(n / 40));
    expect(store.state()).toEqual(reduce(bus.events));
    expect(store.at(100)).toEqual(reduce(bus.events, 100));
    const last = store.entries().at(-1)!;
    expect(store.read(last.hash)).toEqual(JSON.parse(JSON.stringify({ upTo: last.upTo, state: reduce(bus.events, last.upTo) })));
    expect(store.read('../../etc/passwd')).toBeNull();
    store.detach();

    // A restart: a new bus on the same log rebuilds its running state from the nearest snapshot.
    const bus2 = new Bus(root);
    const store2 = attachSnapshots(bus2, root, 40);
    expect(store2.state()).toEqual(reduce(bus2.events));
    expect(existsSync(join(dir, 'index.json'))).toBe(true);
    store2.detach();
  });
});
```

```typescript
// Flow layout: one ELK layered run, direction RIGHT, over the flow model. Domains are compound nodes (soft regions);
// pages, the SDK and anything without a domain sit at the root. Stores are left out of ELK and placed in one row below
// the flow, under the nodes that use them. Deterministic: sorted input (model order), fixed sizes, a fixed seed,
// `considerModelOrder`, and a cache keyed by the whole input.
import type { ElkExtendedEdge, ElkNode } from 'elkjs/lib/elk-api';
import type { FlowModel, FlowNode, FlowNodeKind } from '@harness/core/view';

export type Pt = { x: number; y: number };
export type Box = { x: number; y: number; w: number; h: number };
export type ElkApi = { layout(g: ElkNode): Promise<ElkNode> };

export const SIZE: Record<FlowNodeKind, { w: number; h: number }> = {
  page: { w: 132, h: 34 },
  door: { w: 158, h: 48 },
  step: { w: 164, h: 48 },
  service: { w: 146, h: 40 },
  sdk: { w: 176, h: 48 },
  store: { w: 168, h: 44 },
};
const REGION_PAD = { top: 36, left: 18, bottom: 18, right: 18 };
const STORE_GAP_Y = 84;
const STORE_GAP_X = 20;

export type FrameNode = Box & { id: string; kind: FlowNodeKind };
export type FrameEdge = { id: string; from: string; to: string; d: string; pts: Pt[]; status: 'existing'; store: boolean; ghost: boolean };
export type FrameRegion = Box & { id: string; domain: string; name: string; purpose: string; open: boolean };
export type FlowFrame = {
  key: string;
  nodes: FrameNode[];
  boxes: Record<string, FrameNode>;
  edges: FrameEdge[];
  regions: FrameRegion[];
  bounds: Box;
};

/** Extra edges the layout should respect (the plan's ghost imports), by flow node id. */
export type ExtraEdge = { id: string; from: string; to: string };

export function elkGraph(model: FlowModel, extra: readonly ExtraEdge[] = []): ElkNode {
  const flowNodes = model.nodes.filter((n) => n.kind !== 'store');
  const inRegion = new Map<string, string>();
  for (const r of model.regions) for (const id of r.nodes) inRegion.set(id, r.id);
  const leaf = (n: FlowNode): ElkNode => ({ id: n.id, width: SIZE[n.kind].w, height: SIZE[n.kind].h });
  const children: ElkNode[] = [];
  const regionNodes = new Map<string, ElkNode>();
  for (const n of flowNodes) {
    const r = inRegion.get(n.id);
    if (!r) { children.push(leaf(n)); continue; }
    let rn = regionNodes.get(r);
    if (!rn) {
      rn = { id: r, layoutOptions: { 'elk.padding': `[top=${REGION_PAD.top},left=${REGION_PAD.left},bottom=${REGION_PAD.bottom},right=${REGION_PAD.right}]` }, children: [] };
      regionNodes.set(r, rn);
      children.push(rn);
    }
    rn.children!.push(leaf(n));
  }
  const drawn = new Set(flowNodes.map((n) => n.id));
  const edges: ElkExtendedEdge[] = [];
  for (const e of model.edges) if (!e.store && drawn.has(e.from) && drawn.has(e.to)) edges.push({ id: e.id, sources: [e.from], targets: [e.to] });
  for (const e of extra) if (drawn.has(e.from) && drawn.has(e.to) && !edges.some((x) => x.id === e.id)) edges.push({ id: e.id, sources: [e.from], targets: [e.to] });
  return {
    id: 'root',
    layoutOptions: {
      'elk.algorithm': 'layered',
      'elk.direction': 'RIGHT',
      'elk.hierarchyHandling': 'INCLUDE_CHILDREN',
      'elk.edgeRouting': 'ORTHOGONAL',
      'elk.randomSeed': '1',
      'elk.layered.considerModelOrder.strategy': 'NODES_AND_EDGES',
      'elk.layered.crossingMinimization.forceNodeModelOrder': 'false',
      'elk.layered.nodePlacement.strategy': 'NETWORK_SIMPLEX',
      'elk.layered.spacing.nodeNodeBetweenLayers': '64',
      'elk.layered.spacing.edgeNodeBetweenLayers': '18',
      'elk.spacing.nodeNode': '18',
      'elk.spacing.edgeEdge': '9',
      'elk.spacing.edgeNode': '14',
      'elk.spacing.componentComponent': '40',
      'elk.layered.thoroughness': '10',
      'elk.padding': '[top=0,left=0,bottom=0,right=0]',
    },
    children,
    edges,
  };
}

const sectionPoints = (e: ElkExtendedEdge, ox: number, oy: number): Pt[] => {
  const s = e.sections?.[0];
  if (!s) return [];
  return [s.startPoint, ...(s.bendPoints ?? []), s.endPoint].map((p) => ({ x: p.x + ox, y: p.y + oy }));
};

export function readFrame(model: FlowModel, root: ElkNode, extra: readonly ExtraEdge[] = []): FlowFrame {
  const kinds = new Map(model.nodes.map((n) => [n.id, n.kind]));
  const abs = new Map<string, Pt>([['root', { x: 0, y: 0 }]]);
  const boxes: Record<string, FrameNode> = {};
  const regions: FrameRegion[] = [];
  const elkEdges: { e: ElkExtendedEdge; container: string }[] = [];
  const walk = (n: ElkNode, ox: number, oy: number) => {
    for (const c of n.children ?? []) {
      const x = ox + (c.x ?? 0);
      const y = oy + (c.y ?? 0);
      abs.set(c.id, { x, y });
      if (c.children?.length) {
        const r = model.regions.find((rr) => rr.id === c.id)!;
        regions.push({ id: r.id, domain: r.domain, name: r.name, purpose: r.purpose, open: r.open, x, y, w: c.width ?? 0, h: c.height ?? 0 });
        walk(c, x, y);
      } else {
        boxes[c.id] = { id: c.id, kind: kinds.get(c.id)!, x, y, w: c.width ?? 0, h: c.height ?? 0 };
      }
    }
    for (const e of n.edges ?? []) elkEdges.push({ e, container: n.id });
  };
  walk(root, 0, 0);
  const extraIds = new Set(extra.map((e) => e.id));
  const edges: FrameEdge[] = [];
  for (const { e } of elkEdges) {
    const c = abs.get((e as ElkExtendedEdge & { container?: string }).container ?? 'root') ?? { x: 0, y: 0 };
    const pts = dedupe(sectionPoints(e, c.x, c.y));
    if (pts.length < 2) continue;
    edges.push({ id: e.id, from: e.sources[0]!, to: e.targets[0]!, d: roundedPath(pts, 10), pts, status: 'existing', store: false, ghost: extraIds.has(e.id) });
  }

  // ---- stores: one row below the flow, each under the mean x of the nodes that use it, in that order
  let bounds = boundsOf([...Object.values(boxes), ...regions]);
  const stores = model.nodes.filter((n) => n.kind === 'store');
  const want = stores.map((s) => {
    const users = model.edges.filter((e) => e.to === s.id && boxes[e.from]).map((e) => boxes[e.from]!);
    const cx = users.length ? users.reduce((a, b) => a + b.x + b.w / 2, 0) / users.length : bounds.x + bounds.w / 2;
    return { s, cx };
  }).sort((a, b) => a.cx - b.cx || a.s.order - b.s.order);
  const y = bounds.y + bounds.h + STORE_GAP_Y;
  let cursor = -Infinity;
  for (const { s, cx } of want) {
    const { w, h } = SIZE.store;
    const x = Math.max(cx - w / 2, cursor + STORE_GAP_X);
    boxes[s.id] = { id: s.id, kind: 'store', x, y, w, h };
    cursor = x + w;
  }
  // store edges: from the bottom of the user to the top of the store (and out of a store to a service: top → bottom)
  for (const e of model.edges) {
    const a = boxes[e.from];
    const b = boxes[e.to];
    if (!a || !b || !(e.store || a.kind === 'store')) continue;
    const p0 = a.kind === 'store' ? { x: a.x + a.w / 2, y: a.y } : { x: a.x + a.w / 2, y: a.y + a.h };
    const p1 = b.kind === 'store' ? { x: b.x + b.w / 2, y: b.y } : { x: b.x + b.w / 2, y: b.y + b.h };
    const dy = Math.max(40, Math.abs(p1.y - p0.y) * 0.5);
    const d = a.kind === 'store'
      ? `M${p0.x.toFixed(1)},${p0.y.toFixed(1)}C${p0.x.toFixed(1)},${(p0.y - dy).toFixed(1)} ${p1.x.toFixed(1)},${(p1.y + dy).toFixed(1)} ${p1.x.toFixed(1)},${p1.y.toFixed(1)}`
      : `M${p0.x.toFixed(1)},${p0.y.toFixed(1)}C${p0.x.toFixed(1)},${(p0.y + dy).toFixed(1)} ${p1.x.toFixed(1)},${(p1.y - dy).toFixed(1)} ${p1.x.toFixed(1)},${p1.y.toFixed(1)}`;
    edges.push({ id: e.id, from: e.from, to: e.to, d, pts: [p0, p1], status: 'existing', store: true, ghost: false });
  }
  const nodes = model.nodes.map((n) => boxes[n.id]).filter((b): b is FrameNode => !!b);
  bounds = boundsOf([...nodes, ...regions]);
  edges.sort((a, b) => (a.id < b.id ? -1 : 1));
  return { key: model.key + '|' + extra.map((e) => e.id).join(','), nodes, boxes, edges, regions, bounds };
}

const cache = new Map<string, FlowFrame>();

export async function layoutFlow(elk: ElkApi, model: FlowModel, extra: readonly ExtraEdge[] = []): Promise<FlowFrame> {
  const g = elkGraph(model, extra);
  const key = JSON.stringify([g, model.nodes.filter((n) => n.kind === 'store').map((n) => n.id), model.edges.filter((e) => e.store).map((e) => e.id), model.regions]);
  const hit = cache.get(key);
  if (hit) return hit;
  const out = await elk.layout(g);
  const frame = readFrame(model, out, extra);
  cache.set(key, frame);
  if (cache.size > 40) cache.delete(cache.keys().next().value!);
  return frame;
}

export function boundsOf(list: readonly Box[]): Box {
  if (!list.length) return { x: 0, y: 0, w: 1, h: 1 };
  const x = Math.min(...list.map((b) => b.x));
  const y = Math.min(...list.map((b) => b.y));
  return { x, y, w: Math.max(...list.map((b) => b.x + b.w)) - x, h: Math.max(...list.map((b) => b.y + b.h)) - y };
}

export const pad = (b: Box, p: number): Box => ({ x: b.x - p, y: b.y - p, w: b.w + 2 * p, h: b.h + 2 * p });
export const center = (b: Box): Pt => ({ x: b.x + b.w / 2, y: b.y + b.h / 2 });

function dedupe(pts: Pt[]): Pt[] {
  const out: Pt[] = [];
  for (const p of pts) {
    const q = out[out.length - 1];
    if (q && Math.abs(q.x - p.x) < 0.5 && Math.abs(q.y - p.y) < 0.5) continue;
    out.push(p);
  }
  return out;
}

export function roundedPath(pts: Pt[], r: number): string {
  const f = (n: number) => n.toFixed(1);
  let d = `M${f(pts[0]!.x)},${f(pts[0]!.y)}`;
  for (let i = 1; i < pts.length - 1; i++) {
    const p = pts[i - 1]!;
    const c = pts[i]!;
    const n = pts[i + 1]!;
    const d1 = Math.hypot(c.x - p.x, c.y - p.y);
    const d2 = Math.hypot(n.x - c.x, n.y - c.y);
    const rr = Math.min(r, d1 / 2, d2 / 2);
    if (rr < 0.5) { d += `L${f(c.x)},${f(c.y)}`; continue; }
    const ax = c.x - ((c.x - p.x) / d1) * rr;
    const ay = c.y - ((c.y - p.y) / d1) * rr;
    const bx = c.x + ((n.x - c.x) / d2) * rr;
    const by = c.y + ((n.y - c.y) / d2) * rr;
    d += `L${f(ax)},${f(ay)}Q${f(c.x)},${f(c.y)} ${f(bx)},${f(by)}`;
  }
  const last = pts[pts.length - 1]!;
  return `${d}L${f(last.x)},${f(last.y)}`;
}

/** A smooth curve between two boxes in flow direction (right side → left side), for routes that are not laid out. */
export function curve(a: Box, b: Box, bend = 0): string {
  const forward = b.x >= a.x + a.w - 4;
  const p0 = forward ? { x: a.x + a.w, y: a.y + a.h / 2 } : { x: a.x + a.w / 2, y: a.y + (b.y > a.y ? a.h : 0) };
  const p1 = forward ? { x: b.x, y: b.y + b.h / 2 } : { x: b.x + b.w / 2, y: b.y + (b.y > a.y ? 0 : b.h) };
  const dx = Math.max(40, Math.abs(p1.x - p0.x) * 0.45);
  const f = (n: number) => n.toFixed(1);
  if (forward) return `M${f(p0.x)},${f(p0.y)}C${f(p0.x + dx)},${f(p0.y + bend)} ${f(p1.x - dx)},${f(p1.y + bend)} ${f(p1.x)},${f(p1.y)}`;
  const dy = Math.max(40, Math.abs(p1.y - p0.y) * 0.45) * (b.y > a.y ? 1 : -1);
  return `M${f(p0.x)},${f(p0.y)}C${f(p0.x + bend)},${f(p0.y + dy)} ${f(p1.x + bend)},${f(p1.y - dy)} ${f(p1.x)},${f(p1.y)}`;
}

/** The point halfway along a polyline. */
export function midpoint(pts: Pt[]): Pt {
  let total = 0;
  for (let i = 1; i < pts.length; i++) total += Math.hypot(pts[i]!.x - pts[i - 1]!.x, pts[i]!.y - pts[i - 1]!.y);
  let half = total / 2;
  for (let i = 1; i < pts.length; i++) {
    const a = pts[i - 1]!;
    const b = pts[i]!;
    const d = Math.hypot(b.x - a.x, b.y - a.y);
    if (half <= d && d > 0) return { x: a.x + ((b.x - a.x) * half) / d, y: a.y + ((b.y - a.y) * half) / d };
    half -= d;
  }
  return pts[0] ?? { x: 0, y: 0 };
}
```

```text
}

/** Every non-ignored file under `root`, sorted. */
export function listRepoFiles(root: string, map: DomainMap, mapper: Mapper = createMapper(map)): string[] {
  const files: string[] = [];
  const walk = (dir: string) => {
    for (const entry of fs.readdirSync(dir ? `${root}/${dir}` : root, { withFileTypes: true })) {
      if (entry.name === 'node_modules' || entry.name === '.git') continue;
      const path = dir ? `${dir}/${entry.name}` : entry.name;
      if (mapper.isIgnored(path)) continue;
      if (entry.isDirectory()) walk(path);
      else if (entry.isFile()) files.push(path);
    }
  };
  walk('');
  return files.sort();
}

/** Full fact scan of a repo: every non-ignored file, plus resolved imports and table writes of code files. */
export function scanRepo(root: string, map: DomainMap): Facts {
  const files = listRepoFiles(root, map);
  const exists = scanExists(root, files);
  const imports: ImportEdge[] = [];
  const writes: WriteFact[] = [];
  for (const file of files) {
    if (!isCodeFile(file)) continue;
    const delta = factsForSource(file, fs.readFileSync(`${root}/${file}`, 'utf8'), exists);
    imports.push(...delta.imports);
    writes.push(...delta.writes);
  }
  return { files, imports, writes };
}

/** Files known from the walk, then disk; carries the repo resolver. */
function scanExists(root: string, files: readonly string[]): Exists {
  const known = new Set(files);
  const onDisk = fileExistsIn(root);
  return carryResolver((p: string) => known.has(p) || onDisk(p), onDisk);
}

/** Imports and writes of one file, with the gate's own multiset counting. */
function counts(path: string, record: ModuleRecord, exists: Exists) {
  const imports = new Map<string, number>();
  for (const s of record.specs) {
    const to = resolveImport(path, s.spec, exists);
    if (to) imports.set(to, (imports.get(to) ?? 0) + 1);
  }
  const writes = new Map<string, number>();
  for (const w of record.writes) writes.set(w.table, (writes.get(w.table) ?? 0) + 1);
  return { imports, writes };
}

/** One file's resolved imports and table writes (each target/table once). */
export function factsForSource(path: string, source: string, exists: Exists): FactDelta {
  return deltaForEdit(path, null, source, exists);
}

/**
 * Imports and writes that `newSource` adds over `oldSource` (multiset difference by target/table). This is the edit gate's
 * hot path: no AST walk, the old text's record is usually cached, and large or minified files skip parsing (< 20 ms at 1 MB).
 */
export function deltaForEdit(path: string, oldSource: string | null, newSource: string, exists: Exists): FactDelta {
  const file = normalizePath(path) ?? path;
  const before = oldSource === null ? null : counts(file, moduleRecord(file, oldSource), exists);
  const after = counts(file, moduleRecord(file, newSource), exists);
  const added = (key: string, n: number, old: Map<string, number> | undefined) => n > (old?.get(key) ?? 0);
  return {
    imports: [...after.imports].filter(([to, n]) => added(to, n, before?.imports)).map(([to]) => ({ from: file, to })),
    writes: [...after.writes].filter(([t, n]) => added(t, n, before?.writes)).map(([table]) => ({ file, table })),
  };
}

/** Apply a Claude Code `Edit` to file text. Throws if `oldString` is not found. */
export function applyEdit(current: string, oldString: string, newString: string, replaceAll = false): string {
  if (!current.includes(oldString)) throw new Error('old_string not found in file');
  return replaceAll ? current.split(oldString).join(newString) : current.replace(oldString, () => newString);
}

/** Cross-domain edges between cell files. Neutral, ignored, unassigned and test files, and same-domain imports, draw none. */
export function domainEdges(facts: Facts | FactDelta, mapper: Mapper): DomainEdge[] {
  const edges = new Map<string, DomainEdge>();
  for (const imp of facts.imports) {
    const a = mapper.place(imp.from);
    const b = mapper.place(imp.to);
    if (a.kind !== 'cell' || b.kind !== 'cell' || a.domain === b.domain) continue;
    const key = `${a.domain}\u0000${b.domain}`;
    let edge = edges.get(key);
    if (!edge) edges.set(key, (edge = { from: a.domain, to: b.domain, files: [] }));
    edge.files.push(imp);
  }
  return [...edges.values()].sort((x, y) => x.from.localeCompare(y.from) || x.to.localeCompare(y.to));
}

// ---- Tier 1 facts (NAVIGATION_PLAN §3.1)

/**
 * Per-repo extraction state: resolves through `exists`'s resolver, reads other files for barrel linking, and knows
 * package.json entries and `cartography.routes`. `read(path)` returns current text (or null), e.g. the server's cache.
 */
export function createFactsIndex(root: string, map: DomainMap, exists: Exists, read: (path: string) => string | null) {
  const resolve = (from: string, spec: string) => resolveSpecifier(from, spec, exists);
  let entries: Map<string, PackageEntry[]> | null = null;
  const routes = map.cartography?.routes ?? [];
  const ctx = (path: string): ExtractContext => ({
    recordOf: (file) => {
      if (!isCodeFile(file)) return null;
      const text = read(file);
      return text === null ? null : moduleRecord(file, text);
    },
    entries: (entries ??= packageEntries(root, exists)).get(path) ?? [],
    routes,
  });
  return {
    resolve,
    /** Facts for one file, calls not yet settled (see `settleCalls`). `parsed` is false for source with syntax errors. */
    extract: (path: string, source: string) => extract(path, source, resolve, ctx(path)),
  };
}

/** Symbol names per file, for `settleCalls` (memoized). */
export function symbolNames(facts: Readonly<Record<string, FileFacts>>): (file: string) => ReadonlySet<string> | null {
  const sets = new Map<string, ReadonlySet<string> | null>();
  return (file) => {
    if (!sets.has(file)) sets.set(file, facts[file] ? new Set(facts[file]!.symbols.map((s) => s.name)) : null);
    return sets.get(file)!;
  };
}

/** `scanRepo` plus Tier 1 `FileFacts` for every code and `.sql` file, calls settled against the whole repo. */
export function scanRepoFacts(root: string, map: DomainMap): Facts & { fileFacts: Record<string, FileFacts> } {
  const files = listRepoFiles(root, map);
  const exists = scanExists(root, files);
  const texts = new Map<string, string>();
  const read = (p: string) => {
    let t = texts.get(p);
    if (t === undefined) {
      try {
        t = fs.readFileSync(`${root}/${p}`, 'utf8');
      } catch {
        return null;
      }
      texts.set(p, t);
    }
    return t;
  };
  const index = createFactsIndex(root, map, exists, read);
  const imports: ImportEdge[] = [];
  const writes: WriteFact[] = [];
  const fileFacts: Record<string, FileFacts> = {};
  for (const file of files) {
    if (file.endsWith('.sql')) {
      fileFacts[file] = index.extract(file, read(file)!).facts; // schema tables, no imports
      continue;
    }
    if (!isCodeFile(file)) continue;
    const source = read(file)!;
    fileFacts[file] = index.extract(file, source).facts; // first: it leaves the record cached for the gate facts
    const delta = factsForSource(file, source, exists);
    imports.push(...delta.imports);
    writes.push(...delta.writes);
  }
  const names = symbolNames(fileFacts);
  for (const f of Object.values(fileFacts)) f.calls = settleCalls(f.calls, names);
  return { files, imports, writes, fileFacts };
}
```
