```text
// Small, fast, deterministic string hash (two FNV-1a variants → 16 hex chars). Browser-safe.

export function hashText(text: string): string {
  let a = 0x811c9dc5;
  let b = 0x01000193 ^ text.length;
  for (let i = 0; i < text.length; i++) {
    const c = text.charCodeAt(i);
    a = Math.imul(a ^ c, 0x01000193);
    b = Math.imul(b ^ c, 0x5bd1e995);
    b ^= b >>> 15;
  }
  return (a >>> 0).toString(16).padStart(8, '0') + (b >>> 0).toString(16).padStart(8, '0');
}

/** Collapse whitespace runs so formatting-only edits keep the same hash. */
export const squash = (text: string) => text.replace(/\s+/g, ' ').trim();
```

```bash
function spineOf(graph: ContextGraph, nodeOf: Record<string, string>, nodes: FlowNode[], edges: FlowEdge[], journeys: readonly Journey[]): string[] {
```

```text
import * as fs from 'node:fs';
import type { FileFacts } from './contracts/facts';
import { attachResolver, carryResolver } from './facts/context';
import { settleCalls, extract, type ExtractContext, type PackageEntry } from './facts/extract';
import { moduleRecord, type ModuleRecord } from './facts/record';
import { createRepoResolver } from './facts/resolver';
import { packageEntries } from './facts/entries';
import { normalizePath, resolveImport, resolveSpecifier } from './imports';
import { createMapper, type Mapper } from './mapper';
import type { DomainMap } from './schema';

/** File → file import. */
export type ImportEdge = { from: string; to: string };
export type WriteFact = { file: string; table: string };
/** Cross-domain dependency (domain ids) with the file imports behind it. */
export type DomainEdge = { from: string; to: string; files: ImportEdge[] };
export type Facts = { files: string[]; imports: ImportEdge[]; writes: WriteFact[] };
export type FactDelta = { imports: ImportEdge[]; writes: WriteFact[] };

export type Exists = (path: string) => boolean;

export const CODE_EXTENSIONS = ['.ts', '.tsx', '.js', '.jsx', '.mjs', '.cjs', '.mts'];

export function isCodeFile(path: string): boolean {
  return CODE_EXTENSIONS.some((ext) => path.endsWith(ext));
}

/**
 * File-existence check against a repo root, cached. Call `clear()` after files are created or deleted.
 * It carries the repo's module resolver (tsconfig paths, package exports, workspaces) for `resolveImport`.
 */
export function fileExistsIn(root: string): Exists & { clear(): void } {
  const cache = new Map<string, boolean>();
  let resolver: ReturnType<typeof createRepoResolver> | null = null;
  const exists = (path: string) => {
    let hit = cache.get(path);
    if (hit === undefined) {
      try {
        hit = fs.statSync(`${root}/${path}`).isFile();
      } catch {
        hit = false;
      }
      cache.set(path, hit);
    }
    return hit;
  };
  attachResolver(exists, () => (resolver ??= createRepoResolver(root)));
  return Object.assign(exists, {
    clear: () => {
      cache.clear();
      resolver?.clear();
    },
  });
}

/** `exists`, plus `paths` that will exist (e.g. files a plan creates). Keeps `exists`'s resolver. */
export function withExtra(exists: Exists, paths: readonly string[]): Exists {
  const extra = new Set(paths.map((p) => normalizePath(p) ?? p));
  return carryResolver((path: string) => extra.has(path) || exists(path), exists);
}
```

```text
// A repo resolver rides along on an `Exists` function, so `resolveImport(from, spec, exists)` and every caller of
// it (gate, plan, load scan) gain tsconfig paths, package exports and workspaces without a signature change.

/** Module resolution against one repo on disk (see `createRepoResolver`). */
export type RepoResolverLike = {
  /** Repo path, `vendor:<pkg>` (package or node builtin), or null. Files on disk only. */
  resolve(fromFile: string, spec: string): string | null;
  /**
   * Repo-relative candidate bases for a non-relative spec from tsconfig `paths`/`baseUrl` (for files that don't exist
   * yet); `alias` is true when a `paths` pattern matched, i.e. the spec is not a package name.
   */
  candidates(fromFile: string, spec: string): { bases: string[]; alias: boolean };
  clear(): void;
};

const KEY = Symbol.for('harness.repoResolver');

type Carrier = { [KEY]?: () => RepoResolverLike };

/** The resolver attached to `fn`, if any. */
export function resolverOf(fn: object): RepoResolverLike | null {
  return (fn as Carrier)[KEY]?.() ?? null;
}

/** Attach a (lazily created) resolver to `fn`. Returns `fn`. */
export function attachResolver<T extends object>(fn: T, get: () => RepoResolverLike): T {
  Object.defineProperty(fn, KEY, { value: get, enumerable: false, configurable: true });
  return fn;
}

/** Give `fn` the resolver `from` carries, if any. Returns `fn`. */
export function carryResolver<T extends object>(fn: T, from: object): T {
  const get = (from as Carrier)[KEY];
  return get ? attachResolver(fn, get) : fn;
}
```

```text
/** Same graph inputs: facts by content hash (stubs and edge-adjusted files compare their imports), map and Tier 2 by hash. */
export function sameInputs(a: Record<string, FileFacts>, b: Record<string, FileFacts>): boolean {
  const ka = Object.keys(a);
  if (ka.length !== Object.keys(b).length) return false;
  for (const k of ka) {
    const x = a[k]!;
    const y = b[k];
    if (!y) return false;
    if (x === y) continue;
    if (x.hash !== y.hash || !sameImports(x.imports, y.imports) || x.writes.length !== y.writes.length) return false;
  }

const semKey = (ui: UIState) => Object.values(ui.semantic).map((s) => `${s.path}@${s.hash}`).sort().join('|');

/**
 * graphOf(ui), rebuilt only when what it is built from changes. Replay re-reduces the log, so UIState objects are
 * new on every event; the facts inside them are the events' own objects, so most comparisons are by reference.
 */
export function graphMemo() {
  let last: { map: unknown; mapJson: string; facts: Record<string, FileFacts>; sem: string; graph: ContextGraph } | null = null;
  return (ui: UIState): ContextGraph | null => {
    if (!ui.map) return (last = null);
    const facts = graphFacts(ui);
    const sem = semKey(ui);
    const mapJson = last && last.map === ui.map ? last.mapJson : JSON.stringify(ui.map);
    if (last && last.mapJson === mapJson && last.sem === sem && sameInputs(last.facts, facts)) {
      last.map = ui.map;
      return last.graph;
    }
    const graph = buildGraph(ui.map, facts, ui.semantic);
    last = { map: ui.map, mapJson, facts, sem, graph };
    return graph;
  };
}
```

```typescript
// The flow pipeline: events → ui (reduce, replay-aware) → graph (memoized) → flow model (open regions) → activity →
// overlay and narration. All of it is a pure read of the log; the only view state is what is open.
import { useMemo } from 'react';
import {
  activityFor, flowModel, flowOverlay, narrate,
  type ContextGraph, type FlowModel, type FlowOverlay, type HarnessEvent, type Narration, type UIState,
} from '@harness/core/view';
import { useView } from '../derive';
import { useStore } from '../store';
import { graphMemo } from '../v2/scene';
import type { ExtraEdge } from './layout';
import { useFlow } from './store';

export type FlowScene = {
  ui: UIState;
  events: readonly HarnessEvent[];
  graph: ContextGraph;
  model: FlowModel;
  overlay: FlowOverlay;
  narration: Narration | null;
  /** Ghost edges the layout respects (plan imports, rejected routes), so planned nodes sit where they will connect. */
  extra: ExtraEdge[];
};

const memoGraph = graphMemo();

export function useFlowScene(): FlowScene | null {
  const v = useView();
  const events = useStore((s) => s.events);
  const open = useFlow((s) => s.open);
  const graph = useMemo(() => memoGraph(v.ui), [v.ui]);
  const journeys = v.ui.journeys;
  const map = v.ui.map;
  const model = useMemo(() => (graph && map ? flowModel(graph, map, { open, journeys }) : null), [graph, map, open, journeys]);
  return useMemo(() => {
    if (!graph || !model) return null;
    const shown = events.slice(0, v.upTo);
    const activity = activityFor(v.ui, graph, v.turn?.id ?? null);
    const overlay = flowOverlay(v.ui, shown, graph, model, activity);
    const extra: ExtraEdge[] = [];
    for (const e of overlay.plan?.edges ?? []) extra.push({ id: `ghost:${e.from}->${e.to}`, from: e.from, to: e.to });
    for (const r of overlay.rejected) extra.push({ id: `ghost:${r.from}->${r.to}`, from: r.from, to: r.to });
    const real = new Set(model.edges.map((e) => e.id));
    return { ui: v.ui, events: shown, graph, model, overlay, narration: narrate(v.ui, shown), extra: extra.filter((e) => !real.has(`${e.from}->${e.to}`)) };
  }, [graph, model, v.ui, v.turn, v.upTo, events]);
}
```

```typescript
// The flow camera: a translate/scale on one world element, flown along the van Wijk & Nuij smooth zoom-and-pan path
// (d3's interpolateZoom, ρ ≈ √2), retargetable mid-flight. Pan with drag or the wheel, zoom with pinch or ⌘/ctrl-wheel.
// Any manual move calls `onManual` (Follow pauses).
import { interpolateZoom } from 'd3-interpolate';
import type { Box } from './layout';

export type View = { x: number; y: number; k: number };
export type Insets = { top: number; right: number; bottom: number; left: number };

const reduced = () => typeof matchMedia !== 'undefined' && matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)').matches;
export const K_MIN = 0.25;
export const K_MAX = 2.2;

export class Camera {
  v: View = { x: 0, y: 0, k: 1 };
  private raf = 0;
  private el: HTMLElement | null = null;
  private stage: HTMLElement | null = null;
  onManual: (() => void) | null = null;
  onChange: ((v: View) => void) | null = null;

  attach(stage: HTMLElement, world: HTMLElement) {
    this.stage = stage;
    this.el = world;
    this.apply();
    let drag: { x: number; y: number; vx: number; vy: number; moved: boolean; id: number } | null = null;
    const down = (e: PointerEvent) => {
      if (e.button !== 0 || (e.target as HTMLElement).closest('button, a, input, textarea, .fm-nopan')) return;
      drag = { x: e.clientX, y: e.clientY, vx: this.v.x, vy: this.v.y, moved: false, id: e.pointerId };
    };
    const move = (e: PointerEvent) => {
      if (!drag || e.pointerId !== drag.id) return;
      const dx = e.clientX - drag.x;
      const dy = e.clientY - drag.y;
      if (!drag.moved && Math.hypot(dx, dy) < 4) return;
      if (!drag.moved) { drag.moved = true; this.stop(); this.onManual?.(); stage.setPointerCapture(e.pointerId); stage.classList.add('is-panning'); }
      this.set({ ...this.v, x: drag.vx + dx, y: drag.vy + dy });
    };
    const up = () => { drag = null; stage.classList.remove('is-panning'); };
    const wheel = (e: WheelEvent) => {
      if ((e.target as HTMLElement).closest('.fm-dock')) return;
      e.preventDefault();
      this.stop();
      this.onManual?.();
      if (e.ctrlKey || e.metaKey) {
        const r = stage.getBoundingClientRect();
        const px = e.clientX - r.left;
        const py = e.clientY - r.top;
        const k = clamp(this.v.k * Math.exp(-e.deltaY * 0.0085), K_MIN, K_MAX);
        const wx = (px - this.v.x) / this.v.k;
        const wy = (py - this.v.y) / this.v.k;
        this.set({ k, x: px - wx * k, y: py - wy * k });
      } else {
        this.set({ ...this.v, x: this.v.x - e.deltaX, y: this.v.y - e.deltaY });
      }
    };
    stage.addEventListener('pointerdown', down);
    stage.addEventListener('pointermove', move);
    stage.addEventListener('pointerup', up);
    stage.addEventListener('pointercancel', up);
    stage.addEventListener('wheel', wheel, { passive: false });
    return () => {
      stage.removeEventListener('pointerdown', down);
      stage.removeEventListener('pointermove', move);
      stage.removeEventListener('pointerup', up);
      stage.removeEventListener('pointercancel', up);
      stage.removeEventListener('wheel', wheel);
    };
  }

  size() {
    const r = this.stage?.getBoundingClientRect();
    return { W: r?.width ?? 1, H: r?.height ?? 1 };
  }

  set(v: View) {
    this.v = v;
    this.apply();
  }

  private apply() {
    if (!this.el) return;
    this.el.style.transform = `translate(${this.v.x}px, ${this.v.y}px) scale(${this.v.k})`;
    this.el.style.setProperty('--k', String(this.v.k));
    this.el.style.setProperty('--inv', String(clamp(1 / this.v.k, 0.75, 1.8)));
    this.onChange?.(this.v);
  }

  stop() {
    cancelAnimationFrame(this.raf);
    this.raf = 0;
  }

  /** The view that fits `b` into the stage minus `ins`, zoom clamped to [minK, maxK]. */
  fit(b: Box, ins: Insets, opts: { maxK?: number; minK?: number } = {}): View {
    const { W, H } = this.size();
    const aw = Math.max(80, W - ins.left - ins.right);
    const ah = Math.max(80, H - ins.top - ins.bottom);
    const k = clamp(Math.min(aw / b.w, ah / b.h), opts.minK ?? K_MIN, opts.maxK ?? 1.15);
    return { k, x: ins.left + aw / 2 - (b.x + b.w / 2) * k, y: ins.top + ah / 2 - (b.y + b.h / 2) * k };
  }

  /** Where a world box sits on screen at the current view. */
  screen(b: Box): Box {
    const { x, y, k } = this.v;
    return { x: x + b.x * k, y: y + b.y * k, w: b.w * k, h: b.h * k };
  }

  fly(to: View, opts: { animate?: boolean; ms?: number } = {}) {
    this.stop();
    if (opts.animate === false || reduced()) return this.set(to);
    const { W, H } = this.size();
    const from = this.v;
    const a: [number, number, number] = [(W / 2 - from.x) / from.k, (H / 2 - from.y) / from.k, W / from.k];
    const b: [number, number, number] = [(W / 2 - to.x) / to.k, (H / 2 - to.y) / to.k, W / to.k];
    const interp = interpolateZoom.rho(1.3)(a, b);
    const ms = opts.ms ?? clamp(interp.duration * 0.55, 380, 1100);
    const t0 = performance.now();
    const ease = (t: number) => (t < 0.5 ? 4 * t * t * t : 1 - Math.pow(-2 * t + 2, 3) / 2);
    const step = (now: number) => {
      const t = Math.min(1, (now - t0) / ms);
      const [cx, cy, w] = interp(ease(t));
      const k = W / w;
      this.set({ k, x: W / 2 - cx * k, y: H / 2 - cy * k });
      if (t < 1) this.raf = requestAnimationFrame(step);
      else this.raf = 0;
    };
    this.raf = requestAnimationFrame(step);
  }

  get flying() {
    return this.raf !== 0;
  }
}

export const clamp = (n: number, a: number, b: number) => Math.max(a, Math.min(b, n));
```

```typescript
// Tier 1 facts for Python and Go (NAVIGATION_PLAN §3.1, N11) with web-tree-sitter. The runtime and grammars come pinned
// together from @vscode/tree-sitter-wasm (tree-sitter 0.25.1). Loading is async (`initTreeSitter`, once per process);
// after that every parse is synchronous, so these files go through the same sync scan, edit gate and PostToolUse
// paths as TypeScript. Before it is loaded, Python and Go files simply have no facts.
//
// Produces the same `FileFacts` as the TypeScript extractor: imports (repo paths, else `vendor:<package>`), symbols
// (functions, classes, methods; Go types), calls through import bindings and same-file/package definitions, routes
// (FastAPI/Flask decorators; Go `HandleFunc`/`Handle`, chi `r.Get`, gin `r.GET`), entries (routes, `__main__`, Go
// `main`), and table writes/reads (Django `Model.objects…`, SQLAlchemy `session.add(Model(…))` / `insert(Model)`, raw SQL).
import { createRequire } from 'node:module';
import * as fs from 'node:fs';
import { dirname, join } from 'node:path';
import type { CallFact, EntryFact, FileFacts, RouteFact, SymbolFact, SymbolKind, WriteSite } from '../contracts/facts';
import { hashText, squash } from './hash';
import { routeFact } from './routes';
import { normalizePath } from '../imports';

type TS = typeof import('@vscode/tree-sitter-wasm');
type Node = import('@vscode/tree-sitter-wasm').Node;
type Parser = import('@vscode/tree-sitter-wasm').Parser;

export type TreeSitterLang = 'python' | 'go';
export const TREE_SITTER_EXTENSIONS: Record<string, TreeSitterLang> = { '.py': 'python', '.go': 'go' };
export const treeSitterLang = (path: string): TreeSitterLang | null => {
  const dot = path.lastIndexOf('.');
  return dot < 0 ? null : TREE_SITTER_EXTENSIONS[path.slice(dot)] ?? null;
};

let parsers: Partial<Record<TreeSitterLang, Parser>> | null = null;
let loading: Promise<void> | null = null;

/** Load the runtime and the Python and Go grammars (idempotent). Rejects if the wasm files can't be loaded. */
export function initTreeSitter(): Promise<void> {
  return (loading ??= (async () => {
    const require = createRequire(import.meta.url);
    const main = require.resolve('@vscode/tree-sitter-wasm');
    const dir = dirname(main);
    const ts = require('@vscode/tree-sitter-wasm') as TS;
    await ts.Parser.init({ locateFile: (file: string) => join(dir, file) });
    const out: Partial<Record<TreeSitterLang, Parser>> = {};
    for (const [lang, file] of [['python', 'tree-sitter-python.wasm'], ['go', 'tree-sitter-go.wasm']] as const) {
      const p = new ts.Parser();
      p.setLanguage(await ts.Language.load(join(dir, file)));
      out[lang] = p;
    }
    parsers = out;
  })());
}

/** Whether Python and Go files can be parsed now (after `initTreeSitter` resolved). */
export const treeSitterReady = () => parsers !== null;

/** What the extractor may look up about the rest of the repo (all optional; without them imports stay unresolved). */
export type LangContext = {
  exists?: (path: string) => boolean;
  /** Files directly in a repo directory (Go packages are directories). */
  listDir?: (dir: string) => string[];
  read?: (path: string) => string | null;
  /** go.mod `module` path. */
  goModule?: string | null;
};

/** A LangContext on the files under `root` on disk (go.mod read once). */
export function diskLangContext(root: string, exists?: (path: string) => boolean): LangContext {
  let goModule: string | null | undefined;
  return {
    exists: exists ?? ((p) => { try { return fs.statSync(join(root, p)).isFile(); } catch { return false; } }),
    listDir: (dir) => { try { return fs.readdirSync(join(root, dir), { withFileTypes: true }).filter((e) => e.isFile()).map((e) => (dir ? `${dir}/${e.name}` : e.name)).sort(); } catch { return []; } },
    read: (p) => { try { return fs.readFileSync(join(root, p), 'utf8'); } catch { return null; } },
    get goModule() {
      if (goModule === undefined) {
        try { goModule = /^\s*module\s+(\S+)/m.exec(fs.readFileSync(join(root, 'go.mod'), 'utf8'))?.[1] ?? null; } catch { goModule = null; }
      }
      return goModule;
    },
  };
}

/** Facts for a Python or Go file. `parsed` is false when the tree has syntax errors (or tree-sitter isn't loaded). */
export function extractTreeSitter(path: string, source: string, ctx: LangContext = {}): { facts: FileFacts; parsed: boolean } {
  const facts: FileFacts = { path, hash: hashText(source), imports: [], writes: [], reads: [], symbols: [], calls: [], routes: [], entries: [] };
  const lang = treeSitterLang(path);
  const parser = lang ? parsers?.[lang] : undefined;
  if (!lang || !parser) return { facts, parsed: false };
  const tree = parser.parse(source);
  if (!tree) return { facts, parsed: false };
  try {
    const x = new Extraction(path, source, ctx, facts);
    if (lang === 'python') x.python(tree.rootNode);
    else x.go(tree.rootNode);
    x.finish();
    return { facts, parsed: !tree.rootNode.hasError };
  } finally {
    tree.delete();
  }
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------- shared

const SQL_WRITE = /\b(?:INSERT\s+(?:OR\s+\w+\s+)?INTO|UPDATE|DELETE\s+FROM|MERGE\s+INTO)\s+[`"[]?([A-Za-z_][\w.]*)/gi;
const SQL_READ = /\b(?:FROM|JOIN)\s+[`"[]?([A-Za-z_][\w.]*)/gi;
const snake = (name: string) => name.replace(/([a-z0-9])([A-Z])/g, '$1_$2').replace(/([A-Z]+)([A-Z][a-z])/g, '$1_$2').toLowerCase();

type Binding = { kind: 'module'; file: string | null; dir?: string; vendor: string | null } | { kind: 'symbol'; to: string };

class Extraction {
  readonly symbols: SymbolFact[] = [];
  private readonly calls = new Map<string, CallFact>();
  private readonly imports = new Map<string, boolean>();
  private readonly routes = new Map<string, RouteFact>();
  private readonly entries = new Map<string, EntryFact>();
  private readonly writes = new Map<string, WriteSite>();
  private readonly reads = new Map<string, WriteSite>();
  private readonly bindings = new Map<string, Binding>();
  private readonly tableNames = new Map<string, string>(); // class name → table (`__tablename__`, Meta.db_table)

  constructor(private readonly path: string, private readonly source: string, private readonly ctx: LangContext, private readonly facts: FileFacts) {}

  finish() {
    const f = this.facts;
    f.imports = [...this.imports].map(([to, typeOnly]) => ({ to, typeOnly }));
    f.symbols = this.symbols;
    f.calls = [...this.calls.values()];
    f.routes = [...this.routes.values()];

  private site(map: Map<string, WriteSite>, table: string, symbol: string | null, via: string) {

  private symbol(name: string, kind: SymbolKind, node: Node, parent: SymbolFact | null, sig: string, body: string, exported: boolean): SymbolFact {

  private own(name: string): string | null {

  // ---------------------------------------------------------------- Python

  /** `a.b.c` (level dots) → repo file: `a/b/c.py` or `a/b/c/__init__.py`, from the importing file's package (relative) or the repo root / `src/`. */
  private pyModule(dotted: string, level: number): { file: string | null; vendor: string | null } {

    const defs = (block: Node | null, parent: SymbolFact | null) => {

        const def = child.type === 'decorated_definition' ? child.childForFieldName('definition') : child;

    for (const c of root.descendantsOfType('call')) {

  private pyTableName(cls: string, body: Node | null) {
    for (const st of body?.namedChildren ?? []) {
      const m = /^__tablename__\s*=\s*['"]([\w.]+)['"]/.exec(st?.text ?? '');

  /** What a callee expression calls: a symbol id, a module file, or `vendor:<pkg>`. */
  private pyTarget(fn: Node, from: string): string | null {

      const b = this.bindings.get(fn.text);
      if (b?.kind === 'symbol') return b.to;

    }
    if (fn.type !== 'attribute') return null;
    const chain: string[] = [];
    let cur: Node | null = fn;
    while (cur?.type === 'attribute') { chain.unshift(cur.childForFieldName('attribute')!.text); cur = cur.childForFieldName('object'); }

    const head = cur.text;

      const cls = from.includes('#') ? from.slice(from.indexOf('#') + 1).split('.')[0] : null;
      return cls && chain.length === 1 ? this.own(`${cls}.${chain[0]}`) : null;
    }

    if (!b) {

      if (!base) break;

      file = next;

  /** Django ORM, SQLAlchemy session/core writes and reads. */
  private pyData(c: Node, fn: Node, from: string) {

  /** FastAPI (`@app.get("/x")`, `@router.api_route(...)`) and Flask (`@app.route("/x", methods=[...])`, `@bp.post`). */
  private pyRoutes(decorated: Node, handler: SymbolFact) {
    for (const d of decorated.namedChildren) {
      if (d?.type !== 'decorator') continue;
      const call = d.namedChildren[0];
      if (call?.type !== 'call') continue;
      const fn = call.childForFieldName('function');
      if (fn?.type !== 'attribute') continue;

      const args = call.childForFieldName('arguments')?.namedChildren ?? [];

    const target = (fn: Node): string | null => {

    }
    for (const s of root.descendantsOfType(['interpreted_string_literal', 'raw_string_literal'])) {
      if (!s) continue;
      const text = s.text.slice(1, -1);
      if (/\b(?:INSERT|UPDATE|DELETE|MERGE|SELECT|WITH)\b/i.test(text)) this.sql(text, s.startIndex);

  /** `http.HandleFunc("GET /x", h)`, `mux.Handle("/x", h)`, chi `r.Get("/x", h)`, gin/echo `r.GET("/x", h)`. */
  private goRoute(c: Node, fn: Node, target: (fn: Node) => string | null) {
    if (fn.type !== 'selector_expression') return;
    const field = fn.childForFieldName('field')!.text;
    const args = c.childForFieldName('arguments')?.namedChildren ?? [];
    const first = args[0];
    if (!first || (first.type !== 'interpreted_string_literal' && first.type !== 'raw_string_literal')) return;
    const lit = first.text.slice(1, -1);

  }
```

    while (i < lines.length && lines[i]!.trim() && !/^\s*(```|#{1,4}\s|[-*]\s|\d+[.)]\s)/.test(lines[i]!)) para.push(lines[i++]!);
    blocks.push(<p key={key++}>{inline(para.join(' '))}</p>);
  }
  return <div className="md">{blocks}</div>;
}

function inline(s: string): ReactNode[] {
  const out: ReactNode[] = [];
  const re = /(`[^`]+`)|(\*\*[^*]+\*\*)|(\*[^*\s][^*]*\*)/g;
  let last = 0;
  let m: RegExpExecArray | null;
  let k = 0;
  while ((m = re.exec(s))) {
    if (m.index > last) out.push(<Fragment key={k++}>{s.slice(last, m.index)}</Fragment>);
    const t = m[0];
    if (m[1]) out.push(<code key={k++}>{t.slice(1, -1)}</code>);
    else if (m[2]) out.push(<strong key={k++}>{t.slice(2, -2)}</strong>);
    else out.push(<em key={k++}>{t.slice(1, -1)}</em>);
    last = m.index + t.length;
  }
  if (last < s.length) out.push(<Fragment key={k++}>{s.slice(last)}</Fragment>);
  return out;
}
import { useEffect, useRef, useState } from 'react';

export const reducedMotion = () => typeof matchMedia !== 'undefined' && matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)').matches;

/** Counts up (or down) to `value` over ~400 ms whenever it changes. */
export function useTween(value: number, ms = 400): number {
  const [shown, setShown] = useState(value);
  const from = useRef(value);
  useEffect(() => {
    if (reducedMotion() || from.current === value) {
      from.current = value;
      setShown(value);
      return;
    }
    const start = performance.now();
    const a = from.current;
    let raf = 0;
    const step = (now: number) => {
      const k = Math.min(1, (now - start) / ms);
      const eased = 1 - (1 - k) ** 3;
      setShown(Math.round(a + (value - a) * eased));
      if (k < 1) raf = requestAnimationFrame(step);
      else from.current = value;
    };
    raf = requestAnimationFrame(step);
    return () => {
      cancelAnimationFrame(raf);
      from.current = value;
    };
  }, [value, ms]);

```typescript
// The flow map: the system left → right in the direction of calls (one ELK run in the worker), with the agent drawn on
// it — trail, cursor, notes, highlight, the plan as a ghost route, a fork as two routes, Build on the route, decision
// markers and struck-through rejected routes. Layout changes FLIP through the v2 Transitioner; the camera follows the
// agent with hysteresis and keeps its focus out from under the dock.
import { memo, useCallback, useEffect, useLayoutEffect, useMemo, useRef, useState, type CSSProperties } from 'react';
import { flushSync } from 'react-dom';
import { flowNodeOf, type FlowNode, type FlowNodeState, type FlowOverlay } from '@harness/core/view';
import { api } from '../connection';
import { getElk } from '../v2/layout/elk';
import { Transitioner, type Enter } from '../v2/transition';
import { Camera, type Insets } from './camera';
import { boundsOf, center, curve, layoutFlow, midpoint, pad, type Box, type FlowFrame, type FrameEdge, type Pt } from './layout';
import type { FlowScene } from './scene';
import { useFlow } from './store';

type Shown = { frame: FlowFrame; enter: Enter };
const TOP = 64;

export function FlowMap({ scene }: { scene: FlowScene }) {
  const stageRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
  const worldRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
  const camera = useMemo(() => new Camera(), []);
  const [shown, setShown] = useState<Shown | null>(null);
  const dockH = useFlow((s) => s.dockH);
  const insets = useCallback((): Insets => ({ top: TOP, left: 36, right: 36, bottom: useFlow.getState().dockH + 28 }), []);

  const tr = useMemo(() => new Transitioner<FlowFrame>({
    root: () => worldRef.current,
    commit: (frame, enter) => flushSync(() => setShown({ frame, enter })),
    camera: () => {},
    nodeEl: (root, id) => root.querySelector(`[data-node="${CSS.escape(id)}"]`),
  }), []);

  useLayoutEffect(() => {
    if (!stageRef.current || !worldRef.current) return;
    camera.onManual = () => useFlow.getState().setFollow(false);
    return camera.attach(stageRef.current, worldRef.current);
  }, [camera]);

  // ---- layout (ELK in the worker, cached by input); the transitioner FLIPs from what is on screen
  const extraKey = scene.extra.map((e) => e.id).join('|');
  const extra = useMemo(() => scene.extra, [extraKey]); // eslint-disable-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps
  useEffect(() => {
    let live = true;
    void getElk().then((elk) => layoutFlow(elk, scene.model, extra)).then((f) => { if (live) tr.go(f); });
    return () => { live = false; };
  }, [scene.model, extra, tr]);
  useEffect(() => () => tr.cancel(), [tr]);

  useDirector(camera, shown?.frame ?? null, scene, insets, dockH);
  usePulses(shown?.frame ?? null, scene.overlay);

  // ---- keys: Esc closes regions, f toggles Follow
  useEffect(() => {
    const onKey = (e: KeyboardEvent) => {
      if ((e.target as HTMLElement).closest('input, textarea')) return;
      if (e.key === 'Escape') { useFlow.getState().setOpen([]); useFlow.getState().flyTo('__all'); }
      if (e.key === 'f') useFlow.getState().setFollow(!useFlow.getState().follow);
    };
    window.addEventListener('keydown', onKey);
    return () => window.removeEventListener('keydown', onKey);
  }, []);

  return (
    <div ref={stageRef} className="fm-stage">
      <div ref={worldRef} className="fm-world">
        {shown && <World frame={shown.frame} enter={shown.enter} scene={scene} />}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------- camera direction

/**
 * Follow mode, with hysteresis: the camera moves for a new fork (fit both routes), a `focus` hint (open the region if
 * the node is rolled up, then fly there), a new plan (fit the route), the end of the turn (fit everything), and when
 * the agent's node leaves the comfortable middle of the stage. Manual navigation pauses Follow; fly requests (reply
 * links, region open) always move.
 */
function useDirector(camera: Camera, frame: FlowFrame | null, scene: FlowScene, insets: () => Insets, dockH: number) {
  const last = useRef({ init: false, fork: '', plan: '', end: '', focus: -1, cursor: '', fly: 0, pending: null as string | null, key: '' });
  const fly = useFlow((s) => s.fly);
  const follow = useFlow((s) => s.follow);
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!frame) return;
    const L = last.current;
    const o = scene.overlay;
    const ins = insets();
    const fitAll = (animate = true) => camera.fly(camera.fit(pad(frame.bounds, 12), ins, { maxK: 1 }), { animate });
    const boxOf = (id: string): Box | null => {
      if (id === '__all') return frame.bounds;
      const direct = frame.boxes[id] ?? frame.regions.find((r) => r.id === id || r.domain === id) ?? null;
      if (direct) return direct;
      const n = flowNodeOf(scene.model, scene.graph, id);
      return n ? frame.boxes[n] ?? null : null;
    };
    const fitNodes = (ids: string[], p = 70, minK = 0.5, maxK = 1.05) => {
      const boxes = ids.map(boxOf).filter((b): b is Box => !!b);
      if (!boxes.length) return;
      camera.fly(camera.fit(pad(boxesUnion(boxes), p), ins, { minK, maxK }));
    };
    const signals = {
      fork: o.fork ? `${o.fork.file}|${o.fork.routes.map((r) => r.path.join()).join()}` : '',
      plan: o.plan ? o.plan.steps.map((s) => `${s.n}:${s.nodes.join()}`).join('|') : '',
      end: o.end ? o.turn ?? '' : '',
      focus: o.focus?.at ?? -1,
      cursor: o.cursor?.node ?? '',
    };
    if (!L.init) {
      L.init = true;
      Object.assign(L, signals, { key: frame.key });
      fitAll(false);
      return;
    }
    const keyChanged = L.key !== frame.key;
    L.key = frame.key;
    if (fly && fly.seq !== L.fly) {
      const b = boxOf(fly.id);
      if (b) {
        L.fly = fly.seq;
        if (fly.id === '__all') fitAll();
        else camera.fly(camera.fit(pad(b, b === frame.bounds ? 12 : 90), ins, { minK: 0.7, maxK: 1.1 }));
        return;
      }
    }
    if (!follow) { Object.assign(L, signals); return; }
    if (signals.fork && signals.fork !== L.fork) {
      fitNodes(o.fork!.routes.flatMap((r) => r.path), 110, 0.5, 1);
    } else if (signals.focus !== L.focus && o.focus) {
      const node = scene.model.nodes.find((n) => n.id === o.focus!.node);
      if (node?.rolled && node.domain && !scene.model.open.includes(node.domain)) {
        L.pending = o.focus.leaf;
        useFlow.getState().setOpen([...scene.model.open, node.domain]);
      } else fitNodes([o.focus.node], 160, 0.75, 1.1);
    } else if (L.pending && keyChanged) {
      const target = L.pending;
      L.pending = null;
      const n = flowNodeOf(scene.model, scene.graph, target);
      const region = frame.regions.find((r) => scene.model.regions.find((x) => x.id === r.id)?.nodes.includes(n ?? ''));
      if (region) camera.fly(camera.fit(pad(region, 60), ins, { minK: 0.7, maxK: 1.1 }));
      else if (n) fitNodes([n], 160, 0.75, 1.1);
    } else if (signals.plan && signals.plan !== L.plan) {
      fitNodes([...o.plan!.steps.flatMap((s) => s.nodes), ...(o.cursor ? [o.cursor.node] : [])], 90, 0.5, 1);
    } else if (signals.end && signals.end !== L.end) {
      fitAll();
    } else if (signals.cursor && (signals.cursor !== L.cursor || keyChanged)) {
      const b = frame.boxes[signals.cursor];
      if (b && !comfortable(camera, b, ins)) {
        const c = center(b);
        const { W, H } = camera.size();
        const k = Math.max(camera.v.k, 0.6);
        const cx = ins.left + (W - ins.left - ins.right) / 2;
        const cy = ins.top + (H - ins.top - ins.bottom) / 2;
        camera.fly({ k, x: cx - c.x * k, y: cy - c.y * k });
      }
    }
    Object.assign(L, signals);
  }, [frame, scene, fly, follow, dockH, camera, insets]);
}

function comfortable(camera: Camera, b: Box, ins: Insets): boolean {
  const s = camera.screen(b);
  const { W, H } = camera.size();
  const m = 48;
  return s.x >= ins.left + m && s.y >= ins.top + 8 && s.x + s.w <= W - ins.right - m && s.y + s.h <= H - ins.bottom - 8;
}

const boxesUnion = (list: Box[]) => boundsOf(list);

// ---------------------------------------------------------------- pulses: one shot along an edge the agent just used

type Pulse = { id: string; d: string; seq: number };
const pulseStore = { list: [] as Pulse[], seq: 0, listeners: new Set<() => void>() };

function usePulses(frame: FlowFrame | null, o: FlowOverlay) {
  const lastLen = useRef(0);
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!frame) return;
    const t = o.trail;
    if (t.length < lastLen.current) lastLen.current = 0;
    if (t.length > lastLen.current && t.length >= 2 && lastLen.current > 0) {
      const a = t[t.length - 2]!.node;
      const b = t[t.length - 1]!.node;
      const e = frame.edges.find((x) => (x.from === a && x.to === b) || (x.from === b && x.to === a));
      if (e) {
        const p = { id: e.id, d: e.d, seq: ++pulseStore.seq };
        pulseStore.list = [...pulseStore.list.slice(-3), p];
        pulseStore.listeners.forEach((l) => l());
        window.setTimeout(() => { pulseStore.list = pulseStore.list.filter((x) => x.seq !== p.seq); pulseStore.listeners.forEach((l) => l()); }, 1100);
      }
    }
    lastLen.current = t.length;
  }, [frame, o.trail]);
}

function usePulseList() {
  const [, force] = useState(0);
  useEffect(() => {
    const l = () => force((n) => n + 1);
    pulseStore.listeners.add(l);
    return () => { pulseStore.listeners.delete(l); };
  }, []);
  return pulseStore.list;
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------- the world

function World({ frame, enter, scene }: { frame: FlowFrame; enter: Enter; scene: FlowScene }) {
  const o = scene.overlay;
  const nodesById = useMemo(() => new Map(scene.model.nodes.map((n) => [n.id, n])), [scene.model]);
  const forkHover = useFlow((s) => s.forkHover);
  const hover = useFlow((s) => s.hover);

  // emphasis: a fork pending dims everything off its routes; a highlight dims everything off the path
  const focusSet = useMemo(() => {
    if (o.fork) return new Set(o.fork.routes.flatMap((r) => r.path));
    if (o.highlight && o.live) return new Set(o.highlight.nodes);
    return null;
  }, [o.fork, o.highlight, o.live]);

  const provider = useMemo(() => new Map(o.providers.map((p) => [`${p.from}->${p.to}`, p.class])), [o.providers]);
  const spine = useMemo(() => new Set(scene.model.spine), [scene.model.spine]);
  const planned = useMemo(() => new Map((o.plan?.edges ?? []).map((e) => [`${e.from}->${e.to}`, e])), [o.plan]);
  const hlEdges = useMemo(() => new Set((o.highlight?.edges ?? []).map((e) => `${e.from}->${e.to}`)), [o.highlight]);
  const rejected = useMemo(() => new Map(o.rejected.map((r) => [`${r.from}->${r.to}`, r])), [o.rejected]);

  const edgeClass = (e: FrameEdge) => {
    const k = e.id.replace(/^ghost:/, '');
    const cls = ['fm-edge'];
    if (e.store) cls.push('is-store');
    const pc = provider.get(k);
    if (pc) cls.push(`is-${pc}`);
    if (spine.has(k)) cls.push('is-spine');
    const pe = planned.get(k);
    if (pe) cls.push('is-planned', pe.violation ? 'is-rule' : '');
    if (rejected.has(k)) cls.push('is-rejected');
    if (hlEdges.has(k)) cls.push('is-hl');
    if (focusSet && !(focusSet.has(e.from) && focusSet.has(e.to))) cls.push('is-dim');
    if (hover && (e.from === hover || e.to === hover)) cls.push('is-hover');
    if (enter.edges.has(e.id)) cls.push('fm-draw');
    return cls.filter(Boolean).join(' ');
  };

  const pulses = usePulseList();
  const b = frame.bounds;
  return (
    <>
      {frame.regions.map((r) => (
        <div key={r.id} className={`fm-region${r.open ? ' is-open' : ''}${focusSet ? ' is-dim' : ''}`} style={box(r)}
          onDoubleClick={() => { useFlow.getState().toggleRegion(r.domain); useFlow.getState().flyTo(r.open ? '__all' : r.id); }}>
          <span className="fm-region-name fm-inv" title={r.purpose}>{r.name}</span>
        </div>
      ))}
      <svg className="fm-svg" style={{ left: b.x - 400, top: b.y - 400, width: b.w + 800, height: b.h + 800 }} viewBox={`${b.x - 400} ${b.y - 400} ${b.w + 800} ${b.h + 800}`}>
        <defs>
          <marker id="fm-arrow" viewBox="0 0 8 8" refX="7" refY="4" markerWidth="7" markerHeight="7" orient="auto-start-reverse">
            <path d="M0,0.8 L7,4 L0,7.2" fill="none" stroke="context-stroke" strokeWidth="1.4" />
          </marker>
        </defs>
        <Trail frame={frame} o={o} />
        {frame.edges.map((e) => <path key={e.id} d={e.d} className={edgeClass(e)} markerEnd={e.store ? undefined : 'url(#fm-arrow)'} />)}
        <HighlightExtra frame={frame} o={o} />
        <Rejected frame={frame} o={o} />
        <ForkRoutes frame={frame} o={o} hover={forkHover} />
        {pulses.map((p) => <path key={p.seq} d={p.d} className="fm-pulse" pathLength={1} />)}
      </svg>
      {frame.nodes.map((n) => {
        const node = nodesById.get(n.id);
        if (!node) return null;
        return <NodeView key={n.id} node={node} box={n} st={o.nodes[n.id]} dim={!!focusSet && !focusSet.has(n.id)} hl={!!o.highlight && o.highlight.nodes.includes(n.id)} enter={enter.nodes.has(n.id)} cursor={o.cursor?.node === n.id} />;
      })}
      <Cursor frame={frame} o={o} />
      <Annotations frame={frame} o={o} />
      <Markers frame={frame} o={o} />
      <HighlightLabel frame={frame} o={o} />
      <ForkChips frame={frame} o={o} />
      <BuildChip frame={frame} o={o} />
    </>
  );
}

const box = (b: Box): CSSProperties => ({ transform: `translate(${b.x}px, ${b.y}px)`, width: b.w, height: b.h });
const at = (p: Pt): CSSProperties => ({ transform: `translate(${p.x}px, ${p.y}px)` });

const NodeView = memo(function NodeView({ node, box: b, st, dim, hl, enter, cursor }: { node: FlowNode; box: Box; st: FlowNodeState | undefined; dim: boolean; hl: boolean; enter: boolean; cursor: boolean }) {
  const cls = ['fm-node', `kind-${node.kind}`];
  if (st?.ghost) cls.push('is-ghost');
  else if (st?.steps.length) cls.push('is-planned');
  if (st?.edited) cls.push('is-edited');
  if (st?.looked) cls.push('is-looked');
  if (st?.violation) cls.push(`is-violation-${st.violation}`);
  if (dim) cls.push('is-dim');
  if (hl) cls.push('is-hl');
  if (cursor) cls.push('is-cursor');
  if (enter) cls.push('fm-enter');
  const lines = st && (st.added || st.removed) ? `+${st.added} −${st.removed}` : '';
  const title = node.members.join('\n');
  return (
    <div className={cls.join(' ')} data-node={node.id} style={box(b)} title={title}
      onMouseEnter={() => useFlow.getState().setHover(node.id)} onMouseLeave={() => useFlow.getState().setHover(null)}
      onClick={(e) => { if (e.shiftKey) useFlow.getState().point(node.members.find((m) => !m.startsWith('table:')) ?? node.id); }}
      onDoubleClick={() => { if (node.domain && (node.rolled || node.kind === 'store')) { useFlow.getState().toggleRegion(node.domain); useFlow.getState().flyTo(`region:${node.domain}`); } }}>
      <span className="fm-node-label">{node.label}</span>
      {(node.detail || lines) && <span className="fm-node-detail">{lines ? <b>{lines}</b> : null}{lines && node.detail ? ' ' : ''}{node.detail}</span>}
      {st?.steps.length ? <span className="fm-steps">{st.steps.map((n) => <i key={n}>{n}</i>)}</span> : null}
      {st?.rules.length ? <span className="fm-rule-tag">{st.rules.join(' ')}</span> : null}
    </div>
  );
});

function Trail({ frame, o }: { frame: FlowFrame; o: FlowOverlay }) {
  const segs: { d: string; age: number }[] = [];
  const t = o.trail;
  for (let i = 1; i < t.length; i++) {
    const a = frame.boxes[t[i - 1]!.node];
    const b = frame.boxes[t[i]!.node];
    if (!a || !b) continue;
    segs.push({ d: curveCenters(a, b), age: t.length - 1 - i });
  }
  return (
    <g className="fm-trail">
      {segs.map((s, i) => <path key={i} d={s.d} style={{ opacity: Math.max(0.12, 0.55 - s.age * 0.07) }} />)}
      {t.map((s, i) => {
        const bx = frame.boxes[s.node];
        if (!bx) return null;
        return <circle key={`${s.node}-${i}`} cx={bx.x + 6} cy={bx.y + bx.h / 2} r={3} style={{ opacity: Math.max(0.15, 0.7 - (t.length - 1 - i) * 0.08) }} />;
      })}
    </g>
  );
}

/** A soft curve between box centres (the trail jumps; it does not follow wiring). */
function curveCenters(a: Box, b: Box): string {
  const p = center(a);
  const q = center(b);
  const mx = (p.x + q.x) / 2;
  const lift = Math.min(60, Math.abs(q.x - p.x) * 0.15 + 18);
  return `M${p.x.toFixed(1)},${p.y.toFixed(1)}Q${mx.toFixed(1)},${(Math.min(p.y, q.y) - lift).toFixed(1)} ${q.x.toFixed(1)},${q.y.toFixed(1)}`;
}

function Cursor({ frame, o }: { frame: FlowFrame; o: FlowOverlay }) {
  const c = o.cursor;
  const b = c ? frame.boxes[c.node] : undefined;
  if (!c || !b) return null;
  return (
    <div className="fm-cursor" style={box(pad(b, 5))}>
      <span className="fm-cursor-tag fm-inv">{c.verb} {c.path.split('/').pop()}</span>
    </div>
  );
}

function Annotations({ frame, o }: { frame: FlowFrame; o: FlowOverlay }) {
  const below = frame.bounds.y + frame.bounds.h * 0.62;
  return (
    <>
      {o.annotations.map((a, i) => {
        const b = frame.boxes[a.node];
        if (!b) return null;
        const sameNode = o.annotations.slice(0, i).filter((x) => x.node === a.node).length;
        const down = b.y > below;
        const p = { x: b.x + b.w * 0.5, y: down ? b.y + b.h + 10 : b.y - 10 };
        return (
          <div key={a.id} className={`fm-note tone-${a.tone}${down ? ' is-below' : ''}`} style={{ ...at(p), zIndex: 30 + i }}>
            <div className="fm-note-body fm-inv" style={{ marginTop: down ? sameNode * 44 : -sameNode * 44 }}>{a.text}</div>
          </div>
        );
      })}
    </>
  );
}

function Markers({ frame, o }: { frame: FlowFrame; o: FlowOverlay }) {
  return (
    <>
      {o.touched.map((t) => {
        const b = frame.boxes[t.node];
        if (!b) return null;
        return (
          <div key={`${t.node}|${t.decision}`} className="fm-marker" style={at({ x: b.x + b.w - 8, y: b.y })}>
            <span className="fm-marker-chip fm-inv" tabIndex={0}>
              <b>{t.decision}</b> protects this
              <span className="fm-marker-card">{t.principle}{t.session ? <em>Decided in session {t.session}</em> : null}</span>
            </span>
          </div>
        );
      })}
    </>
  );
}

function HighlightExtra({ frame, o }: { frame: FlowFrame; o: FlowOverlay }) {
  const h = o.highlight;
  if (!h) return null;
  const have = new Set(frame.edges.map((e) => e.id));
  return (
    <g>
      {h.edges.filter((e) => !have.has(`${e.from}->${e.to}`)).map((e) => {
        const a = frame.boxes[e.from];
        const b = frame.boxes[e.to];
        return a && b ? <path key={`${e.from}->${e.to}`} d={curve(a, b)} className="fm-edge is-hl" /> : null;
      })}
    </g>
  );
}

function HighlightLabel({ frame, o }: { frame: FlowFrame; o: FlowOverlay }) {
  const h = o.highlight;
  if (!h || !h.label) return null;
  const boxes = h.nodes.map((n) => frame.boxes[n]).filter((b): b is NonNullable<typeof b> => !!b);
  if (!boxes.length) return null;
  const u = boundsOf(boxes);
  return <div className="fm-hl-label" style={at({ x: u.x + u.w / 2, y: u.y + u.h + 26 })}><span className="fm-inv">{h.label}</span></div>;
}

function Rejected({ frame, o }: { frame: FlowFrame; o: FlowOverlay }) {
  return (
    <g>
      {o.rejected.map((r) => {
        const e = frame.edges.find((x) => x.id === `ghost:${r.from}->${r.to}` || x.id === `${r.from}->${r.to}`);
        const a = frame.boxes[r.from];
        const b = frame.boxes[r.to];
        if (!a || !b) return null;
        const d = e?.d ?? curve(a, b);
        const m = e ? midpoint(e.pts) : midpoint([center(a), center(b)]);
        return (
          <g key={`${r.from}->${r.to}`} className="fm-rejected">
            <path d={d} />
            <path d={`M${m.x - 7},${m.y - 7}L${m.x + 7},${m.y + 7}M${m.x + 7},${m.y - 7}L${m.x - 7},${m.y + 7}`} className="fm-x" />
            <foreignObject x={m.x - 120} y={m.y + 8} width={240} height={40}>
              <div className="fm-rejected-label">rejected in {r.decision}, session {r.session}</div>
            </foreignObject>
          </g>
        );
      })}
    </g>
  );
}

function forkGeometry(frame: FlowFrame, o: FlowOverlay) {
  if (!o.fork) return [];
  return o.fork.routes.map((r, i) => {
    const segs: { d: string; mid: Pt }[] = [];
    for (let j = 1; j < r.path.length; j++) {
      const a = frame.boxes[r.path[j - 1]!];
      const b = frame.boxes[r.path[j]!];
      if (!a || !b) continue;
      const bend = r.option === 'B' ? 46 : -10;
      const d = curve(a, b, bend);
      segs.push({ d, mid: bezierMid(d) });
    }
    return { ...r, segs, chip: segs[0]?.mid ?? null, i };
  });
}

function ForkRoutes({ frame, o, hover }: { frame: FlowFrame; o: FlowOverlay; hover: 'A' | 'B' | null }) {
  return (
    <g>
      {forkGeometry(frame, o).map((r) => (
        <g key={r.option} className={`fm-route route-${r.option}${hover && hover !== r.option ? ' is-off' : ''}${hover === r.option ? ' is-on' : ''}`}>
          {r.segs.map((s, j) => <path key={j} d={s.d} />)}
        </g>
      ))}
    </g>
  );
}

function ForkChips({ frame, o }: { frame: FlowFrame; o: FlowOverlay }) {
  const hover = useFlow((s) => s.forkHover);
  return (
    <>
      {forkGeometry(frame, o).map((r) => r.chip && (
        <div key={r.option} className="fm-fork-chip" style={at({ x: r.chip.x, y: r.chip.y + (r.option === 'B' ? 18 : -18) })}>
          <button className={`fm-inv route-${r.option}${hover === r.option ? ' is-on' : ''}`} onMouseEnter={() => useFlow.getState().setForkHover(r.option)} onMouseLeave={() => useFlow.getState().setForkHover(null)}
            onClick={() => { useFlow.getState().setForkHover(null); void api.chat(`${r.option}. ${r.text}`); }}>
            <b>{r.option}</b>{r.label}
          </button>
        </div>
      ))}
    </>
  );
}

function BuildChip({ frame, o }: { frame: FlowFrame; o: FlowOverlay }) {
  const a = o.approval;
  const b = a ? frame.boxes[a.anchor] : undefined;
  if (!a || !b) return null;
  return (
    <div className="fm-build-chip" style={at({ x: b.x + b.w + 12, y: b.y + b.h / 2 })}>
      <button className="fm-inv" onClick={() => void api.approve()}>Build</button>
    </div>
  );
}

/** The midpoint of a single cubic `M p0 C c1 c2 p3` path. */
function bezierMid(d: string): Pt {
  const n = d.match(/-?\d+(?:\.\d+)?/g)?.map(Number) ?? [];
  if (n.length < 8) return { x: n[0] ?? 0, y: n[1] ?? 0 };
  const [x0, y0, x1, y1, x2, y2, x3, y3] = n as [number, number, number, number, number, number, number, number];
  return { x: (x0 + 3 * x1 + 3 * x2 + x3) / 8, y: (y0 + 3 * y1 + 3 * y2 + y3) / 8 };
}
```

```text
import { existsSync, readFileSync, realpathSync } from 'node:fs';
import { join, relative, isAbsolute } from 'node:path';
import { watch, type FSWatcher } from 'chokidar';
import { diffLines } from 'diff';
import {
  parseDomainMap, createMapper, listRepoFiles, scanRepoFacts, factsForSource, domainEdges, check, fileExistsIn, createFactsIndex,
  settleCalls, diffSymbols, moduleRecord, treeSitterLang,
  type CallFact, type DomainMap, type Facts, type FileFacts, type ImportEdge, type Violation, type Placement, type SymbolDiff, type SymbolFact,
} from '@harness/core';
import type { Bus } from './bus';

const CODE = /\.(ts|tsx|js|jsx|mjs|cjs|mts|py|go)$/; // .py/.go: Tier 1 via tree-sitter (N11)
/** Files that change how imports resolve or what the entries are: a change rescans facts (domains.yaml reloads the map). */
const CONFIG = /(^|\/)(package\.json|tsconfig[^/]*\.json|jsconfig\.json|pnpm-workspace\.yaml)$/;
export const isConfigFile = (rel: string) => rel === 'domains.yaml' || CONFIG.test(rel);
/** Importers re-linked after one file's exports or symbols change (re-exports are followed up to 4 barrels deep). */
export const MAX_RELINK = 200;

const callKey = (c: { from: string; to: string }) => `${c.from}\u0000${c.to}`;
/** Export names, re-export targets and `export *` of a module record: what importers link through. */
const exportShape = (path: string, text: string | null | undefined) => {
  if (text == null || treeSitterLang(path)) return ''; // Python/Go: symbol names alone drive relinking
  const r = moduleRecord(path, text);
  return JSON.stringify([[...r.exports].sort(([a], [b]) => (a < b ? -1 : 1)), r.stars]);
};
const isBarrel = (path: string, text: string | null) => {
  if (text === null || treeSitterLang(path)) return false;
  const r = moduleRecord(path, text);
  return r.stars.length > 0 || [...r.exports.values()].some((t) => 'spec' in t);
};
```

```typescript
// The dialogue dock: a narrow floating panel at the bottom centre. Its header is the live status line (narrated from
// events, never Claude's prose). It shows only the latest exchange — your message, Claude's reply capped to three
// lines with paths as links that fly the map — and folds the rest behind "N previous messages". A fork shows as two
// choices in sync with the two routes on the map; approval is a Build button mirrored on the ghost route.
import { Fragment, useEffect, useLayoutEffect, useRef, useState, type ReactNode } from 'react';
import type { Narration } from '@harness/core/view';
import { api, fakeMode } from '../connection';
import { useStore } from '../store';
import type { FlowScene } from './scene';
import { useFlow } from './store';

type Msg = FlowScene['ui']['chat'][number];

export function Dock({ scene }: { scene: FlowScene }) {
  const ref = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
  const minimized = useFlow((s) => s.dock === 'collapsed');
  const history = useFlow((s) => s.history);
  const delta = useStore((s) => s.delta);
  const o = scene.overlay;
  const turnId = o.turn;
  const chat = scene.ui.chat.filter((m) => m.role !== 'system');
  // the latest exchange: the last user message and the latest reply after it
  const lastUser = findLastIndex(chat, (m) => m.role === 'user');
  const reply = lastUser >= 0 ? chat.slice(lastUser + 1).filter((m) => m.role === 'assistant').at(-1) ?? null : null;
  const latest = lastUser >= 0 ? chat[lastUser]! : null;
  const older = chat.filter((m, i) => i < lastUser || (i > lastUser && m !== reply && m.role === 'assistant'));
  const live = delta && o.live ? delta : null;
  const hasExchange = !!latest && latest.turn === turnId;
  const showThread = !minimized && hasExchange;

  useLayoutEffect(() => {
    const el = ref.current;
    if (!el) return;
    const ro = new ResizeObserver(() => useFlow.getState().setDockH(el.getBoundingClientRect().height));
    ro.observe(el);
    return () => ro.disconnect();
  }, []);

  return (
    <div ref={ref} className={`fm-dock${showThread ? ' has-thread' : ''}`} role="region" aria-label="Conversation">
      <header className="fm-dock-head">
        <Status n={scene.narration} live={o.live} />
        {hasExchange && (
          <button className="fm-icon" aria-label={minimized ? 'Show the conversation' : 'Hide the conversation'} onClick={() => useFlow.getState().setDock(minimized ? 'open' : 'collapsed')}>
            {minimized ? <Chevron up /> : <Chevron />}
          </button>
        )}
      </header>
      {showThread && (
        <div className="fm-thread">
          {older.length > 0 && (
            <button className="fm-older" onClick={() => useFlow.getState().setHistory(!history)}>
              {history ? 'Hide' : ''} {older.length} previous {older.length === 1 ? 'message' : 'messages'} <Chevron right={!history} />
            </button>
          )}
          {history && <div className="fm-history">{older.map((m, i) => <Bubble key={i} m={m} full />)}</div>}
          {latest && <Bubble m={latest} />}
          {(live || reply) && <Reply text={live ?? reply!.text} key={reply?.t ?? 'live'} />}
        </div>
      )}
      {o.fork && <Choices scene={scene} />}
      {o.approval && (
        <div className="fm-build">
          <span>{o.approval.steps} {o.approval.steps === 1 ? 'step' : 'steps'} on the map</span>
          <button className="fm-primary" onClick={() => void api.approve()}>Build</button>
        </div>
      )}
      <Composer />
    </div>
  );
}

function Status({ n, live }: { n: Narration | null; live: boolean }) {
  const text = n ? n.text + (live && n.tone === 'agent' ? '…' : '') : 'Ask about the system, or ask for a change';
  return (
    <p className={`fm-status tone-${n?.tone ?? 'idle'}`} aria-live="polite">
      <i aria-hidden="true" />
      <span key={n?.at ?? -1}>{text}</span>
    </p>
  );
}

function Bubble({ m, full }: { m: Msg; full?: boolean }) {
  if (m.role === 'user') return <p className="fm-you">{m.text}</p>;
  return <div className={`fm-reply${full ? ' is-full' : ''}`}><Rich text={m.text} /></div>;
}

function Reply({ text }: { text: string }) {
  const [more, setMore] = useState(false);
  const [clamped, setClamped] = useState(false);
  const ref = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
  useEffect(() => {
    const el = ref.current;
    if (el) setClamped(el.scrollHeight > el.clientHeight + 2);
  }, [text, more]);
  return (
    <div className="fm-reply-wrap">
      <div ref={ref} className={`fm-reply${more ? ' is-full' : ''}`}><Rich text={text} /></div>
      {(clamped || more) && <button className="fm-more" onClick={() => setMore(!more)}>{more ? 'Less' : 'More'}</button>}
    </div>
  );
}

/** `code`, **bold** and bare repo paths; paths become links that fly the map. */
function Rich({ text }: { text: string }) {
  const out: ReactNode[] = [];
  const re = /`([^`]+)`|\*\*([^*]+)\*\*|((?:src|vendor|web|test)\/[\w./-]+)/g;
  let last = 0;
  let k = 0;
  let m: RegExpExecArray | null;
  const flat = text.replace(/\n+/g, ' ');
  while ((m = re.exec(flat))) {
    if (m.index > last) out.push(<Fragment key={k++}>{flat.slice(last, m.index)}</Fragment>);
    const code = m[1] ?? m[3];
    if (code && /\/|\.[jt]sx?$/.test(code)) out.push(<PathLink key={k++} path={code} />);
    else if (code) out.push(<code key={k++}>{code}</code>);
    else out.push(<strong key={k++}>{m[2]}</strong>);
    last = m.index + m[0].length;
  }
  if (last < flat.length) out.push(<Fragment key={k++}>{flat.slice(last)}</Fragment>);
  return <>{out}</>;
}

function PathLink({ path }: { path: string }) {
  const clean = path.replace(/[.,;:]$/, '');
  return (
    <button className="fm-path" onClick={() => { useFlow.getState().setFollow(false); useFlow.getState().flyTo(clean.replace(/\/$/, '')); }}
      onMouseEnter={() => useFlow.getState().setHover(null)}>
      {clean}
    </button>
  );
}

function Choices({ scene }: { scene: FlowScene }) {
  const fork = scene.overlay.fork!;
  const hover = useFlow((s) => s.forkHover);
  return (
    <div className="fm-choices" role="group" aria-label={`Choose a route: this crosses ${fork.invariant}`}>
      {fork.routes.map((r) => (
        <button key={r.option} className={`fm-choice route-${r.option}${hover === r.option ? ' is-on' : ''}`} title={r.text}
          onMouseEnter={() => useFlow.getState().setForkHover(r.option)} onMouseLeave={() => useFlow.getState().setForkHover(null)}
          onClick={() => { useFlow.getState().setForkHover(null); void api.chat(`${r.option}. ${r.text}`); }}>
          <b>{r.option}</b><span>{r.label}</span>
        </button>
      ))}
    </div>
  );
}

function Composer() {
  const [text, setText] = useState('');
  const pointed = useFlow((s) => s.pointed);
  const send = () => {
    const t = text.trim();
    if (!t) return;
    void api.chat(t, pointed);
    setText('');
    useFlow.getState().clearPointed();
    useFlow.getState().setDock('open');
  };
  return (
    <form className="fm-composer" onSubmit={(e) => { e.preventDefault(); send(); }}>
      {pointed.length > 0 && (
        <div className="fm-pointed">
          {pointed.map((p) => <button type="button" key={p} onClick={() => useFlow.getState().point(p)} title="Remove">{p.split('/').pop()}</button>)}
        </div>
      )}
      <input value={text} onChange={(e) => setText(e.target.value)} placeholder={fakeMode ? 'Ask or change something (recorded session)' : 'Ask or change something'} aria-label="Message Claude" />
      <button type="submit" className="fm-send" aria-label="Send" disabled={!text.trim()}><Arrow /></button>
    </form>
  );
}

const Chevron = ({ up, right }: { up?: boolean; right?: boolean }) => (
  <svg width="12" height="12" viewBox="0 0 12 12" aria-hidden="true" style={{ transform: up ? 'rotate(180deg)' : right ? 'rotate(-90deg)' : undefined }}>
    <path d="M3 4.5 6 7.5 9 4.5" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth="1.5" strokeLinecap="round" strokeLinejoin="round" />
  </svg>
);
const Arrow = () => (
  <svg width="14" height="14" viewBox="0 0 14 14" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M7 11.5V2.5M3 6.5 7 2.5l4 4" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth="1.6" strokeLinecap="round" strokeLinejoin="round" /></svg>
);

function findLastIndex<T>(list: readonly T[], f: (x: T) => boolean): number {
  for (let i = list.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) if (f(list[i]!)) return i;
  return -1;
}

```

```typescript
// `?ui=flow`: the map-first prototype. The flow map is the whole screen; the dialogue dock floats at the bottom centre;
// the only other chrome is the repo name (and the open region), a Follow pill while paused, and the end-of-turn card.
import '@fontsource/barlow/400-italic.css';
import '@fontsource/barlow/700.css';
import './flow.css';
import type { FlowOverlay } from '@harness/core/view';
import { useStore } from '../store';
import { Dock } from './Dock';
import { FlowMap } from './FlowMap';
import { useFlowScene } from './scene';
import { useFlow } from './store';

export default function FlowApp() {
  const scene = useFlowScene();
  const repo = useStore((s) => s.repo).replace(/ \(.*\)$/, '') || 'scout-agent';
  return (
    <div className="fm-app">
      {scene ? <FlowMap scene={scene} /> : <p className="fm-empty">Reading the repo</p>}
      <TopBar repo={repo} names={scene?.model.regions.filter((r) => r.open).map((r) => r.name) ?? []} />
      {scene?.overlay.end && <EndCard end={scene.overlay.end} />}
      {scene && <Dock scene={scene} />}
    </div>
  );
}

function TopBar({ repo, names }: { repo: string; names: string[] }) {
  const follow = useFlow((s) => s.follow);
  return (
    <header className="fm-top">
      <nav className="fm-crumbs" aria-label="Where you are">
        <button className="fm-repo" onClick={() => { useFlow.getState().setOpen([]); useFlow.getState().flyTo('__all'); }}>{repo}</button>
        {names.map((n) => <span key={n} className="fm-crumb">{n}</span>)}
      </nav>
      {!follow && <button className="fm-follow" onClick={() => useFlow.getState().setFollow(true)}>Follow Claude</button>}
    </header>
  );
}

function EndCard({ end }: { end: NonNullable<FlowOverlay['end']> }) {
  if (!end.counts.length && !end.decisions.length) return null;
  return (
    <aside className="fm-end" aria-label="This turn">
      <ul>
        {end.counts.map((c) => <li key={c.label}><b>{c.value.toLocaleString()}</b> {c.label}</li>)}
        {end.decisions.map((d) => <li key={d} className="is-decision"><b>{d}</b> recorded</li>)}
      </ul>
    </aside>
  );
}
```

```text
import { describe, expect, it } from 'vitest';
import { parseDomainMap } from '../src/schema';
import { loadMap, mapYaml } from './helpers';

describe('parseDomainMap', () => {
  it('parses the Scout fixture', () => {
    const map = loadMap();
    expect(map.layers.map((l) => l.id)).toEqual(['ui', 'entry', 'logic', 'data', 'external']);
    expect(map.domains.map((d) => d.id)).toEqual(['channels', 'orchestrator', 'tools', 'gateway', 'memory', 'outreach']);
    expect(map.invariants.map((i) => [i.id, i.kind])).toEqual([
      ['DR-1', 'only_via'],
      ['DR-2', 'owns_writes'],
      ['DR-3', 'no_edge'],
    ]);
    expect(map.invariants[0]!.exceptions).toEqual([]);
  });

  it('normalizes string exceptions to { path }', () => {
    const map = parseDomainMap(mapYaml.replace('exceptions: []', 'exceptions: ["src/tools/x.ts", { path: src/y.ts, decision: DR-9 }]'));
    expect(map.invariants[0]!.exceptions).toEqual([{ path: 'src/tools/x.ts' }, { path: 'src/y.ts', decision: 'DR-9' }]);
  });

  it('throws readable errors on bad input', () => {
    expect(() => parseDomainMap('version: [')).toThrow(/not valid YAML/);
    expect(() => parseDomainMap('version: 1\nlayers: []\ndomains: [{ id: a }]')).toThrow(/invalid[\s\S]*name/);
    expect(() => parseDomainMap(mapYaml.replace('kind: no_edge', 'kind: nope'))).toThrow(/invalid/);
    expect(() => parseDomainMap(mapYaml.replace('to: outreach', 'to: billing'))).toThrow(/unknown domain "billing"/);
    expect(() => parseDomainMap(mapYaml.replace('logic: { paths: ["src/channels/validate.ts"] }', 'brains: {}'))).toThrow(/unknown layer "brains"/);
  });
});
```

```css
/* The flow map. Atlas tone: paper, graphite hairlines, soft region washes. One accent — the agent (ultramarine) —
   red for rules, amber only for uncosted model calls. Everything else stays quiet. */
.fm-app {
  --paper: #f5f6f3;
  --wash: #e9ece8;
  --wash-open: #e3e7e2;
  --node: #ffffff;
  --ink: #1d2421;
  --ink-2: #4f5955;
  --quiet: #87908c;
  --hair: #cfd5d1;
  --edge: #a3aba7;
  --spine: #46504b;
  --agent: #3a3fe0;
  --agent-2: #6f73f0;
  --agent-wash: #ecedfd;
  --rule: #cf2f2a;
  --rule-wash: #fcecea;
  --amber: #b9800d;
  --sans: 'Barlow', system-ui, sans-serif;
  --cond: 'Barlow Semi Condensed', 'Barlow', system-ui, sans-serif;
  --mono: 'JetBrains Mono', ui-monospace, monospace;
  position: fixed;
  inset: 0;
  overflow: hidden;
  background: var(--paper);
  color: var(--ink);
  font-family: var(--sans);
  font-size: 14px;
  -webkit-font-smoothing: antialiased;
}
.fm-app button { font: inherit; color: inherit; }
.fm-empty { position: absolute; inset: 0; display: grid; place-items: center; color: var(--quiet); margin: 0; }

/* ---- stage and world */
.fm-stage { position: absolute; inset: 0; cursor: default; touch-action: none; }
.fm-stage.is-panning { cursor: grabbing; }
.fm-world { position: absolute; left: 0; top: 0; transform-origin: 0 0; will-change: transform; --inv: 1; --k: 1; }
.fm-inv { display: inline-block; transform: scale(var(--inv)); }

/* ---- regions: soft labelled washes, not cells */
.fm-region { position: absolute; left: 0; top: 0; border-radius: 16px; background: var(--wash); transition: opacity 0.3s; }
.fm-region.is-open { background: var(--wash-open); box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px var(--hair); }
.fm-region.is-dim { opacity: 0.55; }
.fm-region-name {
  position: absolute; left: 16px; top: 11px; transform-origin: 0 0;
  font-family: var(--cond); font-weight: 600; font-size: 14px; letter-spacing: 0.01em; color: var(--ink-2); white-space: nowrap;
}

/* ---- edges */
.fm-svg { position: absolute; overflow: visible; pointer-events: none; }
.fm-edge { fill: none; stroke: var(--edge); stroke-width: 1.25; transition: opacity 0.3s, stroke 0.3s, stroke-width 0.3s; }
.fm-edge.is-spine { stroke: var(--spine); stroke-width: 2; }
.fm-edge.is-store { stroke: var(--hair); stroke-width: 1; stroke-dasharray: 2 4; }
.fm-edge.is-gateway { stroke: var(--spine); stroke-width: 2; }
.fm-edge.is-violation { stroke: var(--rule); stroke-width: 2.25; }
.fm-edge.is-uncosted { stroke: var(--amber); stroke-width: 2; stroke-dasharray: 7 4; }
.fm-edge.is-planned { stroke: var(--agent); stroke-width: 2; stroke-dasharray: 6 5; }
.fm-edge.is-planned.is-rule { stroke: var(--rule); }
.fm-edge.is-rejected { opacity: 0; }
.fm-edge.is-hl { stroke-width: 3.5; }
.fm-edge.is-hl:not(.is-violation):not(.is-uncosted) { stroke: var(--agent); }
.fm-edge.is-dim { opacity: 0.22; }
.fm-edge.is-hover { stroke-width: 2.5; opacity: 1; }
.fm-edge.fm-draw { animation: fm-fade-in 0.35s ease-out 0.2s both; }
.fm-pulse { fill: none; stroke: var(--agent); stroke-width: 3.5; stroke-linecap: round; stroke-dasharray: 0.12 1; stroke-dashoffset: 0.12; animation: fm-pulse 0.9s ease-in-out forwards; }
@keyframes fm-pulse { from { stroke-dashoffset: 0.12; opacity: 1; } to { stroke-dashoffset: -1; opacity: 0.2; } }
@keyframes fm-fade-in { from { opacity: 0; } }

/* the trail: where the agent has been this turn, fading */
.fm-trail path { fill: none; stroke: var(--agent-2); stroke-width: 2; stroke-linecap: round; }
.fm-trail circle { fill: var(--agent); }

/* ---- nodes */
.fm-node {
  position: absolute; left: 0; top: 0; box-sizing: border-box; padding: 0 12px;
  display: flex; flex-direction: column; justify-content: center; gap: 1px;
  background: var(--node); border: 1px solid var(--hair); border-radius: 8px;
  transition: opacity 0.3s, border-color 0.3s, background 0.3s, box-shadow 0.3s;
  --fs: calc(14px * min(max(var(--inv), 1), 1.24));
}
.fm-node-label { font-size: var(--fs); font-weight: 500; line-height: 1.15; white-space: nowrap; overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; }
.fm-node-detail { font-size: calc(var(--fs) * 0.78); color: var(--quiet); line-height: 1.2; white-space: nowrap; overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; }
.fm-node-detail b { color: var(--agent); font-weight: 600; }
.fm-node.kind-page { background: transparent; border-color: transparent; padding-left: 0; align-items: flex-end; text-align: right; }
.fm-node.kind-page .fm-node-label { color: var(--ink-2); }
.fm-node.kind-page .fm-node-detail { display: none; }
.fm-node.kind-door { border-left: 3px solid var(--ink); }
.fm-node.kind-service { border-radius: 999px; padding: 0 16px; }
.fm-node.kind-sdk { border-radius: 999px; border: 1.5px solid var(--ink); padding: 0 18px; }
.fm-node.kind-store { border-radius: 6px 6px 14px 14px; border-top: 3px double var(--hair); background: #fbfbfa; }
.fm-node.kind-store .fm-node-label { font-weight: 500; color: var(--ink-2); }
.fm-node.is-looked { border-color: #b9bcf3; }
.fm-node.is-edited { background: var(--agent-wash); border-color: var(--agent-2); }
.fm-node.is-planned { border: 1.5px dashed var(--agent); }
.fm-node.is-ghost { background: transparent; border: 1.5px dashed var(--agent); }
.fm-node.is-ghost .fm-node-label { font-style: italic; color: var(--agent); }
.fm-node.is-ghost.is-edited { background: var(--agent-wash); border-style: solid; }
.fm-node.is-ghost.is-edited .fm-node-label { font-style: normal; color: var(--ink); }
.fm-node.is-violation-existing, .fm-node.is-violation-new { border-color: var(--rule); box-shadow: 0 0 0 1px var(--rule); }
.fm-node.is-violation-new { background: var(--rule-wash); }
.fm-node.is-hl { box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px var(--agent); border-color: var(--agent); }
.fm-node.is-hl.is-violation-existing { box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px var(--rule); border-color: var(--rule); }
.fm-node.is-dim { opacity: 0.35; }
.fm-node.fm-enter { animation: fm-fade-in 0.3s ease-out 0.25s both; }
.fm-steps { position: absolute; left: -9px; top: -9px; display: flex; gap: 3px; transform: scale(var(--inv)); transform-origin: 0 0; }
.fm-steps i { font-style: normal; width: 18px; height: 18px; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--agent); color: #fff; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 600; display: grid; place-items: center; }
.fm-rule-tag { position: absolute; right: -6px; top: -9px; padding: 1px 5px; border-radius: 4px; background: var(--rule); color: #fff; font-size: 10.5px; font-weight: 600; transform: scale(var(--inv)); transform-origin: 100% 0; }

/* ---- the agent: cursor, notes, highlight, routes */
.fm-cursor { position: absolute; left: 0; top: 0; pointer-events: none; border: 2px solid var(--agent); border-radius: 11px; transition: transform 0.5s cubic-bezier(0.3, 0.8, 0.3, 1), width 0.5s, height 0.5s; z-index: 20; }
.fm-cursor-tag { position: absolute; left: -2px; bottom: calc(100% + 4px); transform-origin: 0 100%; white-space: nowrap; background: var(--agent); color: #fff; font-size: 11.5px; font-weight: 500; padding: 2px 7px 3px; border-radius: 5px; }

.fm-note { position: absolute; left: 0; top: 0; width: 0; height: 0; z-index: 30; pointer-events: none; }
.fm-note-body {
  position: absolute; left: -12px; bottom: 0; transform-origin: 12px 100%;
  width: max-content; max-width: 230px; padding: 7px 10px 8px; border-radius: 8px;
  background: #fff; border: 1px solid var(--hair); box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgb(29 36 33 / 0.08);
  font-size: 12.5px; line-height: 1.35; color: var(--ink); border-left: 3px solid var(--agent);
  animation: fm-note-in 0.35s ease-out both;
}
.fm-note.is-below .fm-note-body { bottom: auto; top: 0; transform-origin: 12px 0; }
.fm-note.tone-finding .fm-note-body { border-left-color: var(--rule); }
.fm-note.tone-question .fm-note-body { border-left-color: var(--amber); }
@keyframes fm-note-in { from { opacity: 0; translate: 0 4px; } }

.fm-hl-label { position: absolute; left: 0; top: 0; width: 0; z-index: 25; }
.fm-hl-label span { position: absolute; left: 0; top: 0; translate: -50% 0; transform-origin: 50% 0; white-space: nowrap; font-weight: 600; font-size: 13px; color: var(--agent); background: var(--paper); padding: 2px 8px; border-radius: 6px; }

.fm-marker { position: absolute; left: 0; top: 0; width: 0; height: 0; z-index: 35; }
.fm-marker-chip { position: absolute; right: 0; bottom: 2px; transform-origin: 100% 100%; white-space: nowrap; background: var(--ink); color: #fff; font-size: 11.5px; padding: 3px 8px; border-radius: 5px; cursor: help; }
.fm-marker-chip b { font-weight: 600; margin-right: 3px; }
.fm-marker-card { display: none; position: absolute; right: 0; bottom: calc(100% + 6px); width: 240px; white-space: normal; background: #fff; color: var(--ink); border: 1px solid var(--hair); border-radius: 8px; padding: 8px 10px; font-size: 12.5px; line-height: 1.35; box-shadow: 0 2px 8px rgb(29 36 33 / 0.1); }
.fm-marker-card em { display: block; margin-top: 4px; font-style: normal; color: var(--quiet); font-size: 11.5px; }
.fm-marker-chip:hover .fm-marker-card, .fm-marker-chip:focus .fm-marker-card, .fm-marker.is-open .fm-marker-card { display: block; }

.fm-route path { fill: none; stroke-width: 3; stroke-linecap: round; transition: opacity 0.2s, stroke-width 0.2s; }
.fm-route.route-A path { stroke: var(--agent); }
.fm-route.route-B path { stroke: var(--rule); stroke-dasharray: 8 6; }
.fm-route.is-off path { opacity: 0.2; }
.fm-route.is-on path { stroke-width: 4.5; }
.fm-fork-chip, .fm-build-chip { position: absolute; left: 0; top: 0; width: 0; height: 0; z-index: 40; }
.fm-fork-chip button {
  position: absolute; left: 0; top: 0; translate: -50% -50%; transform-origin: 50% 50%;
  display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 7px; white-space: nowrap; cursor: pointer;
  padding: 4px 11px 5px 5px; border-radius: 999px; font-size: 12.5px; font-weight: 500;

}

.fm-fork-chip button:hover, .fm-fork-chip button.is-on { box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgb(58 63 224 / 0.15); }
.fm-fork-chip button.route-B:hover, .fm-fork-chip button.route-B.is-on { box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgb(207 47 42 / 0.15); }
.fm-build-chip button { position: absolute; left: 0; top: 0; translate: 0 -50%; transform-origin: 0 50%; cursor: pointer; border: 0; background: var(--agent); color: #fff; font-weight: 600; font-size: 13px; padding: 6px 14px; border-radius: 999px; }
.fm-build-chip button:hover { background: #2c30c4; }

.fm-rejected path { fill: none; stroke: var(--quiet); stroke-width: 2; stroke-dasharray: 3 5; }

.fm-rejected-label { text-align: center; font-size: 12px; color: var(--ink-2); font-family: var(--sans); text-decoration: line-through; text-decoration-color: rgb(29 36 33 / 0.35); }

/* ---- chrome: top bar, end card */
.fm-top { position: absolute; left: 0; right: 0; top: 0; height: 56px; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; padding: 0 22px; pointer-events: none; }
.fm-top > * { pointer-events: auto; }
.fm-crumbs { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; font-size: 14px; }
```
